Cuna del Invierno es un vasto valle cubierto de nieve ubicado en lo alto de las laderas nororientales del Monte Hyjal, justo por encima de los bosques encantados de Claro de la Luna y Frondavil. Conocida por su frío cortante, antiguas ruinas Altonato y formidables depredadores errantes, la región se articula en torno al puesto neutral goblin de Vista Eterna. Sigue siendo una tierra repleta de feroces peligros naturales que acoge a supervivientes del Vuelo Azul mientras combate la corrupción demoníaca a lo largo de sus cumbres meridionales. Encaramada a miles de metros sobre la naturaleza que la rodea, Cuna del Invierno descansa bajo un aire alpino glacial e implacables tormentas de nieve. Las enormes raíces expuestas del Árbol del Mundo, Nordrassil, atraviesan las acumulaciones de nieve como altísimos arcos de madera, deformadas y retorcidas durante las trascendentales batallas de la Tercera Guerra. Mientras que gran parte del norte de Kalimdor está dominada por densas arboledas y climas cálidos, Cuna del Invierno es una tierra apacible de bosques alpinos, peñascos rocosos y lagos helados, hogar de temibles sables de hielo, quimeras, yetis y osos invernales de espeso pelaje.

Isla de Zephras. La Isla de Zephras es una isla flotante suspendida en Muro Celeste, el Plano Elemental del aire. Sirve como hogar ancestral de inicio de los cielonatos, cuya sociedad se enfrenta ahora a una crisis existencial a medida que la magia que sustenta la isla se erosiona sin cesar. Con el contacto cortado con los reinos celestes vecinos, sus habitantes luchan contra el colapso elemental y la llegada de refugiados. La Isla de Zephras es una masa de tierra aislada a la deriva en los vientos interminables de Muro Celeste. Durante generaciones, los cielonatos vivieron aquí junto a los elementales de aire nativos que ayudaban a preservar las corrientes mágicas que mantenían la isla a flote. Sin embargo, hace varios siglos, esos custodios elementales desaparecieron por completo. Privados de su presencia y tutela, los encantamientos latentes que sostienen la tierra han comenzado a fallar lentamente, provocando que Zephras se fracture y desestabilice poco a poco.

La Isla de Zephras está situada en Muro Celeste, el Plano Elemental del aire, en lugar de sobre la superficie de Azeroth. Flota entre las nubes perpetuas y las corrientes de viento de este dominio etéreo.

La isla dependía de la presencia de elementales de aire nativos que antaño coexistían con los cielonatos. Hace varios siglos, estos elementales desaparecieron, dejando que los cimientos mágicos que anclan y preservan la tierra flotante se debiliten y decaigan lentamente con el tiempo.

Son islas flotantes vecinas en Muro Celeste también pobladas por los cielonatos. La Isla de Zephras perdió la comunicación con ambas cuando los elementales desaparecieron, y los refugiados que huyen informan ahora de que tanto Anvilas como Siroccas se están derrumbando hacia el olvido.

Los cielonatos operan muelles celestes en el asentamiento de Valanaar. Los barcos voladores zarpan desde estos muelles a través de la frontera planar hacia Azeroth, aterrizando cerca de Dalaran en las Montañas de Alterac y en la Meseta de Miracielos en Mulgore.

Los cielonatos son los habitantes que tienen su hogar en la Isla de Zephras y sus reinos celestes hermanos. Tras haber morado en Muro Celeste durante generaciones, ahora afrontan la lenta destrucción de su patria flotante a medida que su magia vinculante se desvanece.

Aparte de las aldeas pacíficas y los refugiados recién llegados, la isla se ve asolada por bandidos locales, garranocturnas cavernícolas y bestias que habitan zonas como la Guarida de Chilladoras y la Caverna Garranoche.

npc:abercrombie.s: Abercrombie. Abercrombie parece ser un ermitaño débil y excéntrico que habita en una choza destartalada en el oeste de Bosque del Ocaso, cerca del Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo. Afirmando ser un ermitaño inofensivo acosado por los horrores del bosque, recluta con presteza a viajeros compasivos para que reúnan reactivos y suministros peculiares en su nombre. Escondido entre las sombras putrefactas cerca del Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo, Abercrombie ofrece un aspecto patético. Se presenta como un anciano que simplemente intenta sobrevivir a los terrores de Bosque del Ocaso, pidiendo a los viajeros que hagan modestos recados en Villa Oscura en busca de suministros, hierbas e hilo. Para aquellos que no conocen la historia de la región, no parece más que otra alma desafortunada abandonada a su suerte mientras la provincia caía en la decadencia.

ang.class:Paladin: Abercrombie represents the sinister corruption of necromancy festering under the guise of an ordinary, harmless townsman in need of charity.
ang.class:Warlock: Abercrombie's sacrifice of his own heart to reanimate a corpse demonstrates the extreme, self-destructive lengths mortals will go to wield dark magic.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance heroes who naively lend a helping hand to the miserable hermit unknowingly provide the materials needed to orchestrate an assault on Darkshire.

faq.a: Abercrombie is a hermit dwelling near Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. Once a skilled alchemist, he lost his mind following the death of his wife and is secretly the necromantic figure known as the Embalmer.
faq.q: Who is Abercrombie?

faq.a: While Abercrombie claims he needs domestic supplies and thread to survive in the wilderness, he is actually tricking adventurers into gathering the necessary parts to assemble the monstrous abomination Stitches.
faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want supplies from Darkshire?

faq.a: Eliza was Abercrombie's wife. After she died, Abercrombie attempted to resurrect her using dark magic, transplanting his own heart into her corpse. She returned as a ravenous undead monster that he had to keep buried in Raven Hill Cemetery.
faq.q: Who was Eliza?

faq.a: The note reveals Abercrombie's true identity as the Embalmer and his vengeful hatred for Darkshire. Delivering the letter triggers the march of Stitches down the road to assault the town.
faq.q: What happens when you deliver the Note to the Mayor?

faq.a: Driven utterly mad by grief and dark magic, Abercrombie blames the town and its leadership for the tragic events of Duskwood and seeks their total destruction through his monstrous creation.
faq.q: Why does Abercrombie hate Darkshire?

faq.a: No. Abercrombie is an independent rogue alchemist and necromancer practicing forbidden arts born of his own grief-fueled madness, unrelated to the Lich King's armies.
faq.q: Is Abercrombie allied with the Scourge?

text.s: Abercrombie appears to be a feeble, eccentric hermit dwelling in a dilapidated shack in western Duskwood near Raven Hill Cemetery. Claiming to be a harmless recluse plagued by the horrors of the woods, he readily enlists sympathetic travelers to gather peculiar reagents and supplies on his behalf.

sec.b: Tucked away in the rotting shadows near Raven Hill Cemetery, Abercrombie cuts a pathetic figure. He presents himself as an old man merely trying to survive the terrors of Duskwood, asking travelers to run modest errands into Darkshire for supplies, herbs, and thread. To those unfamiliar with the history of the region, he seems like just another unfortunate soul left behind as the province fell into decay.

Before grief consumed his mind, Abercrombie was a respected, kindly alchemist living in Raven Hill. When his beloved wife, Eliza, died, sorrow broke his sanity. Turning to forbidden necromantic arts, he cut out his own heart and placed it within Eliza's dead breast to bring her back. The ritual succeeded only in creating a monster: Eliza returned cursed with an insatiable hunger for living flesh, forcing the mad alchemist to keep her buried in the cemetery.

Known in dark folklore simply as 'The Embalmer,' Abercrombie nurses a deep, psychotic grudge against the township of Darkshire and its leaders. The seemingly innocuous tasks he assigns to helpful adventurers—fetching ghoul ribs, specialty thread, and caustic brews—are actually the final components required to assemble Stitches, a colossal, flesh-stitched abomination engineered to slaughter the Night Watch and burn the town.

npc:agathelos-the-raging.s: Agathelos el Furioso. Agathelos el Furioso es un colosal jabalí acorazado recluido en los túneles espinosos de Horado Rajacieno. Criado por los jabaespines Calavera de la Muerte como máquina de asedio viviente y avatar de su antiguo dios, ha sido empujado a un frenesí violento y antinatural. Su masa colosal y su fuerza lo convierten en una de las bestias más peligrosas que acechan bajo el sur de Los Baldíos. Los jabaespines veneran a todos los porcinos como descendientes de su deidad patrona y progenitor, el dios Agamaggan. Para ellos, los jabalíes de tamaño y tenacidad excepcionales se consideran bendiciones directas de su dios caído. Una bestia del tamaño de Agathelos —que mide aproximadamente el doble que un lagarto del trueno de Los Baldíos— posee una trascendencia espiritual y ceremonial enorme entre las tribus de Rajacieno.

ang.class:Druid: Druids hold Agamaggan in high esteem as one of the great Ancients who fell during the War of the Ancients; witnessing a sacred boar tortured with bat poison to serve as a siege weapon is an affront to Cenarius's wild balance.
ang.class:Hunter: A hunter can appreciate the sheer predatory bulk of Agathelos, though his twisted, chemically fueled madness marks him as a tragic perversion of natural beasts.
ang.race:Tauren: The earth-attuned tauren know the legends of Agamaggan well, recognizing that the quilboar's corruption of his kindred beasts is another sign of the rot infesting the Barrens.

faq.a: Agathelos is naturally a massive specimen of swine, which the quilboar revere as a divine blessing of Agamaggan. His unnatural bulk and swollen strength were further enhanced by the Death's Head tribe feeding him potent bat guano to induce a hulking, berserk state.
faq.q: Why is Agathelos so huge?

faq.a: The bat guano fed to Agathelos drove him completely insane with rage. Because he cannot tell friend from foe, his quilboar wardens must keep him sealed inside a fortified cul-de-sac using magical fields until they are ready to direct his wrath against their enemies.
faq.q: Why do the quilboar keep him locked behind a barrier?

faq.a: Agamaggan is the great boar Ancient and progenitor of the quilboar race. Because of this ancestry, quilboar view all boars as sacred, and gigantic specimens like Agathelos are revered as living embodiments and divine gifts of Agamaggan's enduring bloodline.
faq.q: What is his connection to Agamaggan?

faq.a: The Death's Head quilboar, the necromantic and fanatical caste embedded within the Razorfen, captured and cultivated Agathelos. They intended to unleash him as a living battering ram against anyone who challenges their dominion over the Barrens.
faq.q: What tribe created Agathelos?

faq.a: The guano produced by the bats nesting in Razorfen Kraul contains hallucinogenic and maddening properties. When fed to Agathelos, it acted as a stimulant that drastically heightened his stamina, aggression, and pain tolerance at the expense of his sanity.
faq.q: Why was he fed bat guano?

faq.a: No. Agathelos is an elite, heavily armored monster whose rage is too deeply rooted in madness and dark sorcery to be brought under a hunter's control.
faq.q: Can hunters tame Agathelos?

text.s: Agathelos the Raging is a colossal armored boar penned within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. Reared by the Death's Head quilboar as a living siege engine and avatar of their ancient god, he has been driven into a violent, unnatural frenzy. His sheer mass and strength make him one of the most dangerous beasts lurking under the southern Barrens.

sec.b: Quilboar venerate all swine as descendants of their patron deity and progenitor, the god Agamaggan. To them, boars of exceptional size and tenacity are considered direct blessings from their fallen god. A beast the size of Agathelos—standing roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard—carries massive spiritual and ceremonial significance among the Razorfen tribes.

The Death's Head tribe, not content to leave Agathelos as merely a sacred icon, actively transformed him into a weapon of war. By force-feeding him the noxious bat guano gathered from the cavern ceilings of the Kraul, his handlers induced a maddened, unending delirium. The foul mixture drastically increased the colossal beast's stamina and fury, transforming him into a rampage waiting to be unleashed upon the tribe's rivals.
sec.t: A Weapon of the Death's Head

sec.b: Because Agathelos is completely out of his mind with rage, even his handlers cannot let him roam loose within the Kraul. He is kept trapped in a dead-end tunnel behind an energetic ward maintained by quilboar shamans and guards. Should intruders break past the barrier, they face a beast driven completely wild by chemical madness, growing even more terrifying in size and power when struck.

npc:aku-mai.s: Aku'mai. Aku'mai es una monstruosa hidra de tres cabezas que mora en las ruinas sumergidas de las Cavernas de Brazanegra, junto a La Ensanada de Zoram. Imbuida de sombras primordiales y favorecida por los antiguos Dioses Antiguos, la bestia es venerada como heraldo de la ruina apocalíptica. El culto del Martillo Crepuscular cuida a la criatura en su guarida sumergida, ofreciéndole sacrificios vivos para saciar su hambre eterna. Mucho antes de que los miembros del culto reclamaran el templo sumergido bajo el mar, Aku'mai acechaba la costa de Vallefresno como una plaga viviente sobre La Ensanada de Zoram. Siendo una criatura de aguas profundas y poderes oscuros, esta hidra gigantesca porta un fragmento de la antigua malevolencia de los Dioses Antiguos en sus tres voraces cabezas. En lugar de un habitante común de las mareas, Aku'mai es un terror ancestral que ha merodeado en las ruinas sumergidas desde la caída del templo de los elfos de la noche dedicado a Elune, envenenando las aguas con malicia corrupta por el Vacío.

ang.class:Druid: Aku'mai's unnatural corruption warps the coastal waters of Ashenvale, demanding cleansing to restore natural balance.
ang.class:Priest: The vile presence of Aku'mai and the Twilight's Hammer represents the direct corruption of the Void against the teachings of the Holy Light and Elune.
ang.race:NightElf: Aku'mai has defiled the deepest sanctorum of a ruined temple once consecrated to the moon-goddess Elune, turning a holy site into a pit of sacrifice.

faq.a: Aku'mai is an ancient, three-headed hydra infused with dark Void energies. Originating as a favored pet of the Old Gods, it has haunted the Zoram Strand and the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps for generations.
al: what kind of monster is akumai
faq.q: What is Aku'mai?

faq.a: Aku'mai resides in the deepest submerged grottos of Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined temple complex dedicated to Elune located along the coast of the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where does Aku'mai live?

faq.a: The Twilight's Hammer views Aku'mai as an emissary and herald of their Old God masters. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists offer living sacrifices to feed the beast's hunger, believing that nourishing it will hasten the return of the Old Gods and reward them with dark blessings.
faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer feeding Aku'mai?

faq.a: Beyond its immense physical size and multiple snapping heads, Aku'mai channels shadow and Void energy gifted by the Old Gods. Its presence corrupts surrounding waters and instills madness in those who draw near.
faq.q: What powers does Aku'mai possess?

faq.a: No. Aku'mai is not an Old God, but rather a primordial hydra serving as their favored pet and conduit. It holds a tiny fraction of their ancient dark power, sufficient to drive cultists to worship it.
faq.q: Is Aku'mai an Old God?

faq.a: Left unchecked, Aku'mai's endless hunger and the cult's sacrifices threaten to unleash a calamitous evil across Ashenvale and Kalimdor. Both Alliance and Horde authorities seek to put an end to the Twilight's Hammer and slay the horror lurking at the heart of the temple.
faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the deeps to slay it?

text.s: Aku'mai is a monstrous, three-headed hydra dwelling in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand. Imbued with primordial shadow and favored by the ancient Old Gods, the beast is revered as a herald of apocalyptic ruin. The Twilight's Hammer cult tends to the creature in its submerged lair, offering living sacrifices to sate its eternal hunger.

sec.b: Long before cultists claimed the sunken temple beneath the sea, Aku'mai haunted the coast of Ashenvale as a living blight upon the Zoram Strand. A creature of deep water and darker powers, this gargantuan hydra carries a fragment of the Old Gods' ancient malevolence within its three ravenous heads. Rather than an ordinary denizen of the tides, Aku'mai is an ancient terror that has lurked in the submerged ruins since the fall of the night elves' temple to Elune, poisoning the waters with Void-tainted malice.

Aku'mai's foul aura eventually drew the Twilight's Hammer deep into the subterranean caverns. Viewing the hydra as an anointed pet and harbinger of their dread masters, the cult established their sanctum around its nesting ground. Twilight Lord Kelris became consumed by the creature, convinced that tending to Aku'mai and facilitating its unending appetite would usher in the resurgence of the Old Gods and grant him eternal life. Cultists and captured captives alike are regularly cast into the hydra's pool to nourish its vile growth.
sec.t: A Pet of the Primordial Darkness

npc:alanndarian-nightsong.s: Alanndarian Arrullanoche. Alanndarian Arrullanoche es una elfa de la noche residente de Auberdine en Costa Oscura que se dedica a cuidar de la asediada fauna de la región. Trabaja junto a los viajeros para poner remedio a las plagas que azotan a la fauna local, en particular a los zancudos autóctonos y a las criaturas del bosque corrompidas por fuerzas oscuras. Ubicada en el asentamiento costero de Auberdine, Alanndarian Arrullanoche vela por el frágil equilibrio ecológico de Costa Oscura. A medida que unas misteriosas impurezas se filtran en el suelo y las aguas, las criaturas de los antiguos bosques han comenzado a sucumbir a la enfermedad y a una agresividad antinatural. Alanndarian actúa como guardiana y naturalista, buscando remedios prácticos para aliviar su sufrimiento y restaurar su vigor natural.

ang.class:Druid: Druids will find a kindred spirit in Alanndarian's pursuit to identify waterborne taints and physically cure poisoned creatures across Darkshore.
ang.class:Hunter: Hunters attuned to beast behaviors assist Alanndarian closely, using their tracking skills to locate wild striders and distressed game.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alanndarian serves as a vital contact for Alliance travelers landing in Auberdine, helping newcomers understand the delicate state of northern Kalimdor's wilderness.
ang.race:NightElf: Her reverence for the forest and dedication to purifying corrupted wildlife reflect the core preservationist ideals of the kaldorei.

faq.a: Alanndarian Nightsong is a night elf naturalist located in the port town of Auberdine in Darkshore. She focuses on caring for afflicted local wildlife and finding herbal cures for the unnatural sicknesses plaguing the coast.
faq.q: Who is Alanndarian Nightsong?

faq.a: She makes her home in Auberdine, the primary night elf hub along the foggy coastline of Darkshore.
faq.q: Where can Alanndarian Nightsong be found?

faq.a: Alanndarian asks adventurers to track down the sources of sickness tainting Darkshore's creatures, collect vital curative components from the wilderness, and administer remedies directly to ailing animals such as deer and striders.
faq.q: What tasks does she ask adventurers to perform?

faq.a: Her surname connects her to other prominent night elves of the Nightsong lineage, such as Master Nightsong in Darnassus and Falara Nightsong, though her immediate daily focus remains the stewardship of Darkshore's wilderness.
faq.q: Is she related to other Nightsongs?

faq.a: The woodlands and waterways of Darkshore suffer from an creeping corruption seeping through ancient ruins and corrupted elementals, driving native wildlife to madness and wasting sickness.
faq.q: Why are the creatures in Darkshore sick?

faq.a: Though rumor holds she has great knowledge of striders, she does not actively train tamed pets for hunters in the field, keeping her focus instead on wild populations.
faq.q: Can she train tallstrider pets?

text.s: Alanndarian Nightsong is a night elf resident of Auberdine in Darkshore dedicated to tending to the region's beleaguered fauna. She works alongside travelers to remedy the blights plaguing the local wildlife, particularly the native striders and forest creatures corrupted by dark forces.

sec.b: Situated in the coastal settlement of Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong watches over the fragile ecological balance of Darkshore. As mysterious taints seep into the soil and waters, the creatures of the ancient woods have begun to succumb to sickness and unnatural aggression. Alanndarian acts as a guardian and naturalist, seeking practical remedies to ease their suffering and restore their natural vigor.

Much of Alanndarian's attention is focused on identifying the root causes of the afflictions spreading through the local fauna. Through careful gathering of botanical reagents and researching the principal water sources of the region, she crafts salves and curative draughts. She enlists wandering adventurers to apply these cures directly to ailing forest creatures, attempting to stave off the spreading corruption before it permanently overtakes Darkshore's wildlife.

npc:althea-ebonlocke.s: Althea Cerranegro. La Comandante Althea Cerranegro lidera a la Guardia Nocturna, la asediada guardia local que protege Villa Oscura de los terrores de Bosque del Ocaso. Pariente del alcalde Ello Cerranegro, asume la defensa de una región aislada y abandonada por el ejército regular de Ventormenta. Organiza patrullas, encarga a los aventureros purgar los horrores de la zona y coordina la supervivencia del pueblo frente a constantes amenazas monstruosas. Mientras su pariente, el alcalde Ello Cerranegro, gestiona el gobierno civil en el ayuntamiento, la Comandante Althea dirige la delgada línea de defensa física de Villa Oscura. Cuando Ventormenta no desplegó tropas reales para defender Bosque del Ocaso contra los horrores que acechan, la ciudadanía formó la Guardia Nocturna. Bajo el mando firme e implacable de Althea, estos voluntarios patrullan los caminos envueltos en niebla, impidiendo que no-muertos esqueléticos, lobos feroces y arañas arrasen el perímetro del pueblo.

ang.class:Paladin: Paladins walking the gloomy roads of Duskwood can assist Althea in putting restless souls to peace, lifting some of the spiritual dread weighing on her militia.
ang.class:Warrior: Warriors find in Althea a stern, practical commander who respects martial discipline and values frontline fighters willing to hold the line against overwhelming odds.
ang.faction:Alliance: Althea represents the grim determination of the Alliance's forgotten frontiers, holding the kingdom together where the crown's armies have withdrawn.

faq.a: Commander Althea Ebonlocke is the leader of the Night Watch, the town militia of Darkshire in Duskwood. She is responsible for organizing the defense of the region against the undead and beasts that lurk in the shadows.
al: who is the night watch commander
faq.q: Who is Althea Ebonlocke?

faq.a: The Night Watch is a volunteer militia raised by the citizens of Darkshire. Because Stormwind has provided virtually no military support to Duskwood, the local townspeople banded together under Althea's leadership to patrol the roads and fight back the horrors of the woods.
faq.q: What is the Night Watch?

faq.a: Althea is a relative of Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor of Darkshire. While the mayor governs town affairs from the town hall, Althea commands the militia in the field.
faq.q: How is Althea related to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke?

faq.a: With King Varian Wrynn missing and Stormwind's resources strained, the House of Nobles has largely neglected the kingdom's outer territories. Darkshire receives virtually no soldiers or relief, forcing Althea to depend on local volunteers and freelance adventurers.
faq.q: Why is Stormwind not helping Althea defend Darkshire?

faq.a: Althea offers the core Night Watch questline, dispatching adventurers to hunt wolves, skeletal fiends, and ghouls across Duskwood. She also assists in investigating the Legend of Stalvan and dealing with the wandering terror Mor'Ladim.
faq.q: What quests does Commander Althea offer?

faq.a: When the stitched abomination created by Abercrombie marches on Darkshire, Althea sounds the alarm and leads the town's remaining Night Watch guards in a direct, bloody stand to stop the monster before it enters the town square.
faq.q: What does Althea do when Stitches attacks Darkshire?

text.s: Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch, the beleaguered town guard protecting Darkshire from the terrors of Duskwood. A relative of Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, she shoulders the defense of an isolated region abandoned by Stormwind's regular military. She organizes patrols, tasks adventurers with culling local horrors, and coordinates the town's survival against constant monstrous threats.

sec.b: While her relative, Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, handles civil governance within the town hall, Commander Althea directs Darkshire's thin line of physical defense. When Stormwind failed to deploy royal troops to guard Duskwood against creeping horrors, the citizenry formed the Night Watch. Under Althea's steady, unyielding command, these volunteers patrol the fog-shrouded roads, keeping skeletal undead, ferocious wolves, and spiders from overrunning the town perimeter.

Althea is pragmatic and understands the limits of her militia. Outnumbered and continually bleeding recruits, she freely enlists passing mercenaries and travelers to thin the threats at Darkshire's doorstep. She directs campaigns against the ghouls and skeletons at the tranquil and sorrowful graveyards of the forest, while remaining vigilant against darker rumors stirring deep in the woods.

Beyond common forest vermin, Althea coordinates the investigation and destruction of Duskwood's greatest blights. She assists in unraveling the dark fate of Stalvan Mistmantle and seeks answers to the restless wandering of Mor'Ladim, the fallen knight Morgan Ladimore. When Abercrombie unleashes the monstrous abomination Stitches down the main road, it is Althea who rallies the Watch for Darkshire's desperate last stand.

npc:anastasia-hartwell.s: Anastasia Pozovenado. Anastasia Pozovenado es una destacada instructora de magos Renegados que reside en el Barrio de la Magia de Entrañas. Guía a taumaturgos novatos y en desarrollo en el dominio de las artes arcanas y supervisa investigaciones mágicas vitales y misiones de campo por todo Lordaeron y más allá. Desde las oscuras y resonantes cámaras del Barrio de la Magia de Entrañas, Anastasia Pozovenado instruye a magos Renegados y de la Horda en la canalización de energías arcanas. Aunque el reino de Lordaeron quedó en ruinas, antiguos practicantes humanos como Anastasia han preservado sus tradiciones eruditas en la no-muerte. Sostiene que la magia exige una disciplina estricta, advirtiendo a cualquier viajero que encuentra que los encantamientos descuidados consumen con rapidez a los inexpertos.

ang.class:Mage: Anastasia Hartwell is an essential mentor for Horde mages passing through the Undercity, training higher spell ranks and commissioning vital class quests.
ang.faction:Horde: Through partnerships with trainers like Deino in Orgrimmar, Anastasia bridges Lordaeron's arcane heritage with the broader magical endeavors of the Horde.
ang.race:Undead: She represents the continuation of Dalaran and Lordaeron's esteemed arcane traditions among the Forsaken, preserved even through the tragedy of undeath.

faq.a: Anastasia Hartwell is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. She teaches spells to developing mages and provides specialized assignments to retrieve arcane artifacts and reagents across Lordaeron.
faq.q: Who is Anastasia Hartwell?

faq.a: She is located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, gathered among other arcane practitioners and trainers under the city's vaulted subterranean ceilings.
faq.q: Where can I find Anastasia Hartwell?

faq.a: She offers cautious advice to non-mage visitors, warning them to be wary of magic as they journey across the world, noting that it readily burns the untrained.
faq.q: What does Anastasia say to non-mages?

faq.a: Anastasia offers various training assignments for mages, including investigating the Balnir Farmstead, exploring ruined alchemist shops for supplies, and liaising with distant teachers such as Deino in Orgrimmar and Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
faq.q: What quests does Anastasia Hartwell offer?

faq.a: She shares a surname with Andrew Hartwell and Geoffrey Hartwell, but their family relationship is unconfirmed.
faq.q: Is Anastasia Hartwell related to other Hartwells in Tirisfal?

faq.a: She asks mages to gather Balnir Snapdragons so she can measure the spread of the plague in Tirisfal Glades and send the flowers to the apothecaries.
faq.q: Why does Anastasia send mages to the Balnir Farmstead?

text.s: Anastasia Hartwell is a prominent Forsaken mage trainer residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. She guides fledgling and developing spellcasters in mastering the arcane arts and oversees vital magical research and field missions across Lordaeron and beyond.

sec.b: Standing within the dark, echoing chambers of the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Anastasia Hartwell instructs Forsaken and Horde mages in channeling arcane energies. Though the kingdom of Lordaeron fell to ruin, former human practitioners like Anastasia have preserved their scholarly traditions in undeath. She maintains that magic demands strict discipline, warning any traveler she meets that careless incantations will quickly consume the untrained.

Beyond fundamental spell instruction, Anastasia directs promising students toward vital field investigations. She dispatches mages into Tirisfal Glades, including the blighted grounds of the Balnir Farmstead and ruined alchemist workshops, to recover lost reagents and salvage remnants of forgotten arcane lore. Through her tasks, practitioners learn that securing magical dominance requires braving the hazardous ruins of their former homeland.

Anastasia's connections reach well beyond the borders of Tirisfal. As Horde spellcasters grow in proficiency, she coordinates with fellow trainers in distant lands, such as Deino in Orgrimmar, and directs advanced students toward solitary masters like Tabetha in the swamplands of Dustwallow Marsh. Her guidance ensures that Forsaken mages remain woven into the wider tapestry of the Horde's magical pursuits.

npc:apothecary-johaan.s: Boticario Johann. El Boticario Johann es un alquimista e investigador de la Sociedad Real de Boticarios destinado en Rémol. Con el encargo de su orden y de lady Sylvanas, lleva a cabo experimentos letales con la flora y fauna locales para desarrollar la nueva peste de los Renegados. Trabajando abiertamente desde el asentamiento renegado de Rémol en los Claros de Tirisfal, el Boticario Johann representa las ambiciones científicas de la recién formada Sociedad Real de Boticarios. Al igual que sus colegas por todo Lordaeron, Johann opera bajo órdenes directas de crear armas biológicas y alquímicas capaces de asegurar el frágil futuro de los Renegados frente a los vivos y a la Plaga por igual.

ang.faction:Horde: While orcs and tauren might balk at alchemical blights, Johaan's deadly concoctions serve the strategic security of the Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
ang.race:Undead: Johaan's research is central to the Forsaken cause, developing the very weapons needed to carve out a permanent homeland free of Scourge and living threats.

faq.a: Apothecary Johaan is an alchemical researcher stationed in Brill. He belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society and directs young Forsaken champions to gather vile reagents across Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Who is Apothecary Johaan?

faq.a: He can be found standing outside near the gallows and alchemical apparatus in the town of Brill, just north of the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where can I find Apothecary Johaan?

faq.a: Johaan is formulating and refining early strains of the New Plague, testing biological agents and venomous extracts from Tirisfal's blighted fields and beasts.
faq.q: What is Johaan working on?

faq.a: Once test mixtures are concocted and their lethality assessed, Johaan packages the samples and sends couriers to deliver them to allied apothecaries stationed in Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: What does he do with the plague samples?

faq.a: He is an active member of the Royal Apothecary Society, the alchemical guild serving Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken in the Undercity.
faq.q: What organization does Johaan belong to?

faq.a: Human farms like the Solliden Farmstead and the nearby pumpkin patches contain fungal growths and blighted crops that provide key chemical precursors for his experimental toxins.
faq.q: Why is he interested in the local farms?

text.s: Apothecary Johaan is an alchemist and researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Brill. Tasked by his order and Lady Sylvanas, he conducts lethal experiments on local flora and fauna to develop the Forsaken's new plague.

sec.b: Working openly out of the Forsaken settlement of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, Apothecary Johaan represents the scientific ambitions of the newly formed Royal Apothecary Society. Like his colleagues across Lordaeron, Johaan operates under direct orders to craft biological and alchemical weapons capable of securing the Forsaken's fragile future against the living and the Scourge alike.

Johaan coordinates early field trials for what the Society calls the 'New Plague'. Using raw materials harvested from Tirisfal's corrupted wildlife and agricultural blights—such as gloom weed and the tainted soil of nearby farmsteads—he tests toxin mixtures and evaluates their potency on living subjects before dispatching results down south to Silverpine Forest.

npc:aramis-hammerhand.s: Aramis Manomartillo. Aramis Manomartillo es un guerrero sagrado no-muerto que se encuentra en el interior de la capilla profanada de Camposanto. Como instructor de paladines Renegado, adiestra a los muertos recién alzados que buscan recuperar su vínculo con la Luz Sagrada. Recorrer este camino en la no-muerte exige una inmensa disciplina, ya que blandir una energía tan radiante inflige un dolor atroz a su carne descompuesta. Erguido entre los sombríos muros de la capilla de Camposanto, Aramis Manomartillo representa una anomalía entre los Renegados recién despertados. En vida, muchos ciudadanos de Lordaeron respondieron a la llamada de la Mano de Plata, solo para perecer cuando la Plaga arrasó el norte. Aramis sobrevivió a la caída solo para ser alzado en la no-muerte; no obstante, optó por no abandonar las enseñanzas marciales y espirituales de su existencia anterior. Ahora ofrece guía a otros que se niegan a renunciar a su devoción.

ang.class:Paladin: For Forsaken paladins, Aramis is the first mentor they meet, guiding them through the agony and spiritual discipline required to wield the Holy Light in an undead vessel.
ang.race:Undead: Aramis demonstrates that rising into undeath does not require abandoning Lordaeron's proud heritage of holy warfare, even if it comes with immense personal suffering.

faq.a: Aramis Hammerhand is a Forsaken paladin trainer located inside the chapel at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He assists newly risen undead who wish to pursue the path of holy combat.
faq.q: Who is Aramis Hammerhand?

faq.a: Yes, through sheer willpower and conviction, Forsaken can call upon the Holy Light. However, doing so causes immense physical agony, as the radiant energy burns and scours their rotting flesh while healing or bolstering them.
faq.q: Can the Forsaken actually wield the Holy Light?

faq.a: He can be found standing inside the chapel of Deathknell, the introductory settlement for the Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where can I find Aramis Hammerhand?

faq.a: Aramis offers several class-specific quests for newly risen paladins, including 'A Difficult Path', 'Rediscovering the Light', 'A Light in the Darkness', 'Coming to Terms', and 'Continue Your Training'.
faq.q: What quests does Aramis Hammerhand offer?

faq.a: Before the plague, Lordaeron was the cradle of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Many of the newly liberated Forsaken remember their oaths and refuse to abandon their sacred calling, regardless of their undead state.
faq.q: Why is a paladin trainer working for the Forsaken?

faq.a: While the Light can mend their bodies and grant them martial strength, the process is excruciating. It reignites their sensory nervous systems, forcing them to feel the rot of their own bodies.
faq.q: Does using the Light heal the undead in the normal way?

text.s: Aramis Hammerhand is an undead holy warrior situated within the desecrated chapel of Deathknell. As a Forsaken paladin trainer, he instructs newly risen dead who seek to reclaim their bond with the Holy Light. Walking this path in undeath requires immense discipline, as wielding such radiant energy inflicts agonizing pain upon their decayed flesh.

sec.b: Standing within the somber walls of Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand represents an anomaly among the recently awakened Forsaken. In life, many citizens of Lordaeron answered the call of the Silver Hand, only to perish when the Scourge swept across the north. Aramis survived the fall only to be raised into undeath, yet he chose not to abandon the martial and spiritual teachings of his former existence. Now, he offers guidance to others who refuse to surrender their devotion.

For an undead being, channeling the Holy Light is an ordeal of supreme willpower. The power burns necrotic flesh and reawakens long-dead nerves to excruciating pain. Aramis instructs his initiates that holding to this faith requires enduring continual torment. Through tasks like 'A Difficult Path' and 'Rediscovering the Light', he demands that young paladins confront the physical and spiritual costs of wielding a force inherently opposed to their present nature.
sec.t: The Agony of the Holy Light

npc:arcanist-doan.s: Arcanista Doan. El Arcanista Doan es un maestro mago humano que reside en el Ateneo del ala de la Librería del Monasterio Escarlata. Antaño asociado de la Mano de Plata que colaboró en la forja de la legendaria Crematoria, ahora sirve a la Cruzada Escarlata como uno de sus especialistas arcanos más letales y custodio de archivos clave de la cruzada. Antes de que la Cruzada Escarlata se volviera fanática y se aislara, el Arcanista Doan caminaba entre los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata. Durante la Tercera Guerra, se reunió con el Alto Señor Alexandros Mograine y otros fundadores en Costasur. Cuando Mograine reveló un cristal sombrío arrebatado a un brujo orco durante la Segunda Guerra, Doan observó su insólita capacidad para absorber energía sagrada. Uniendo su conocimiento arcano a la magia sagrada de sus compañeros, Doan ayudó a purificar el cristal del Vacío hasta transformarlo en luz radiante, conformando el núcleo del arma conocida como Crematoria.

ang.class:Mage: Doan's mastery of arcane defenses makes his protective bubble a vivid example of magical warding.
ang.class:Paladin: Doan fought beside the founding members of the Silver Hand and was directly involved in purifying the crystal that created the Ashbringer before joining the crusade's descent into zealotry.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance forces, Doan represents what remains of Lordaeron's proud Kirin Tor and Silver Hand defenders who abandoned reason in favor of the Crusade's violent paranoia.
ang.faction:Horde: The Forsaken and their Horde allies see Doan as a dangerous Scarlet commander whose library shelters vital intelligence and keys needed to breach the Crusade's inner sanctums.

faq.a: Although the Crusade is dominated by zealot paladins and priests, Doan has been allied with its founders since the Silver Hand days. He firmly believes that masterwork arcane magic is an indispensable weapon needed to cleanse the Scourge from Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why is a mage in the Scarlet Crusade?

faq.a: At a council in Southshore during the Third War, Alexandros Mograine presented an orb of darkness taken from an orc warlock. Doan helped direct the magical experiment where the Silver Hand poured their magic into the relic, successfully purifying it into the radiant core that forged the Ashbringer.
faq.q: What is Arcanist Doan's connection to the Ashbringer?

faq.a: Doan keeps watch over the Monastery's repository of books and historical records in the Athenaeum. Behind him sits a lockbox containing the Scarlet Key, an essential key that opens the locked gates to the Monastery's Armory and Cathedral wings.
faq.q: What does Doan guard in the Library?

faq.a: Doan blends abjuration and evocation magic. He is famous for casting an Arcane Bubble that renders him invulnerable while he channels a massive, room-engulfing Detonation spell. He also disrupts spellcasters with area silences and polymorphs threats into sheep.
faq.q: What magic does Doan use in combat?

faq.a: Beyond attending the pivotal war councils in Southshore, Doan fought on the front lines at Hearthglen, using catastrophic blizzard spells from the ramparts to break massive undead assault waves.
faq.q: Where did Doan fight during the Third War?

faq.a: Doan serves as an arcanist of the Scarlet Crusade. His private romantic attachments are unrecorded in the Classic sources.
faq.q: Does Doan harbor any personal secrets?

text.s: Arcanist Doan is a master human mage residing within the Athenaeum of the Scarlet Monastery's Library wing. Formerly an associate of the Silver Hand who assisted in forging the legendary Ashbringer, he now serves the Scarlet Crusade as one of its most lethal arcane specialists and guardian of key crusade archives.

sec.b: Before the Scarlet Crusade turned inward and zealous, Arcanist Doan walked among the Knights of the Silver Hand. During the Third War, he met with Highlord Alexandros Mograine and other founders at Southshore. When Mograine revealed a shadowy crystal taken from an orc warlock during the Second War, Doan observed its unnatural ability to absorb holy energy. Joining his arcane insight with the holy magic of his peers, Doan helped cleanse the void crystal into radiant light, forming the heart of the weapon known as the Ashbringer.

As the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, Doan advocated for total plague containment. When the undead battered Hearthglen's fortifications, he held the ramparts alongside High Inquisitor Isillien. While others urged him to unleash magic immediately, Doan methodically gathered his strength, unleashing a devastating blizzard at the precise moment necessary to shatter the advancing undead ranks. His clinical patience proved his lethal mastery of battlefield evocation.

While the fanatical ranks of the Scarlet Crusade lean heavily on martial fury and holy fervor, Doan remained convinced that raw arcane power was essential to purging the Scourge from Lordaeron. Stationed deep inside the Athenaeum of the Monastery's library, he was entrusted as both a lorekeeper and an operational gatekeeper, safeguarding the Scarlet Key that secures crusade sanctuaries across the northern kingdoms.

npc:arugal.s: Arugal. El archimago Arugal es un antiguo mago de Dalaran y Gilneas que desató a los salvajes huargen sobre Lordaeron. Consumido por la locura y el dolor, ahora gobierna desde las alturas del Castillo de Colmillo Oscuro, tratando a las brutales bestias como a sus amados hijos mientras amenaza a todo el Bosque de Argénteos. Antes de la caída de Lordaeron, Arugal era miembro del Kirin Tor, aunque algunos colegas como Dalar Tejalba lo tachaban de charlatán cuya débil hechicería dependía en gran medida de baratijas encantadas. Cuando la Plaga arrasó el norte durante la Tercera Guerra, Arugal buscó un arma lo bastante poderosa para frenar su avance. Basándose en las investigaciones esotéricas del difunto mago de Dalaran Ur, Arugal desgarró el velo entre reinos e invocó a los huargen al mundo mortal. Las voraces bestias despedazaron a las legiones de no-muertos según lo previsto, pero su ferocidad salvaje no pudo contenerse, y su voraz apetito no tardó en volverse contra mortales inocentes.

ang.class:Mage: Arugal represents the catastrophic danger of reckless conjuration, turning the deep research of the Kirin Tor into an uncontrollable nightmare.
ang.faction:Horde: Arugal's worgen infest the road south of the Sepulcher, and Lady Sylvanas has ordered his execution to secure Silverpine Forest for the Forsaken.
ang.race:Undead: Arugal's beasts have killed several Deathstalkers and apothecaries; putting an end to his madness is a vital task for the Royal Apothecary Society.

faq.a: Arugal is a former human archmage of the Kirin Tor and Gilneas. During the Third War, he summoned the monstrous worgen to battle the Scourge. Overwhelmed by his actions, he retreated into Shadowfang Keep, where he now leads packs of worgen as their self-proclaimed father.
faq.q: Who is Arugal?

faq.a: During the Third War, the Scourge threatened to overrun northern Lordaeron and Gilneas. Desperate for a weapon to halt the undead, Arugal utilized the extraplanar research of the Dalaran mage Ur. He believed the savage beasts could destroy the Scourge, but he lost control of the creatures once summoned.
faq.q: Why did Arugal summon the worgen?

faq.a: Arugal makes his lair at the pinnacle of Shadowfang Keep, an ancient fortress situated on the sea cliffs above Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest. He is guarded by his monstrous wolf pet, Fenrus, alongside swarms of loyal worgen and restless spirits.
faq.q: Where does Arugal reside right now?

faq.a: Baron Silverlaine was the noble lord who originally ruled the fortress and the village of Pyrewood. When Arugal's worgen besieged the castle, Silverlaine and his court were brutally slaughtered. Their vengeful, tortured ghosts now haunt the blood-stained halls of the keep.
faq.q: What happened to Baron Silverlaine?

faq.a: Arugal's packs terrorize Silverpine Forest, attacking Forsaken scouts, ambushing patrols, and even infecting loyal servants of the Royal Apothecary Society. Sylvanas Windrunner considers the mad archmage a direct threat to the security and expansion of the Undercity's borders.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Arugal dead?

faq.a: Arugal cast wretched enchantments across the region, subjecting the human inhabitants of Pyrewood Village to the worgen curse. By daylight, the villagers appear as normal human subjects, but come nightfall, they transform into vicious beasts bound to defend Arugal's territory.
faq.q: What is the curse on Pyrewood Village?

text.s: Archmage Arugal is a former wizard of Dalaran and Gilneas who unleashed the feral worgen upon Lordaeron. Overcome by madness and grief, he now rules from the heights of Shadowfang Keep, treating the savage beasts as his beloved children while menacing all of Silverpine Forest.

sec.b: Before the fall of Lordaeron, Arugal was a member of the Kirin Tor, though some peers like Dalar Dawnweaver dismissed him as a charlatan whose weak spellcraft relied heavily on enchanted trinkets. When the Scourge swept across the north during the Third War, Arugal sought a weapon powerful enough to stem the tide. Drawing upon the esoteric research of the late Dalaran mage Ur, Arugal pierced the veil between realms and summoned the worgen into the mortal world. The ravenous beasts tore through the undead legions as intended, but their feral ferocity could not be contained, and their savage hunger swiftly turned against innocent mortals.

The summoned horrors slaughtered the Gilnean soldiers stationed outside the Greymane Wall and spread their dreadful affliction through Gilneas. Some of the beasts then besieged the ancestral seat of Baron Silverlaine, and the keep fell swiftly to claws and fangs, its lord and retainers slain in the massacre. Rather than flee from his monstrous creation, Arugal's mind fractured under the weight of guilt, and he adopted the beasts as his own offspring. Renaming the fortress Shadowfang Keep, Arugal entrenched himself within its ramparts, surrounded by ghostly victims and loyal hound-packs.

From his high perch in Shadowfang Keep, Arugal extends his twisted dominion over the surrounding countryside. His dark sorcery blankets Pyrewood Village, where townsfolk live under a nocturnal curse, and infests the Deep Elem Mine with ravenous Moonrage beasts. He works intricate enchantments allowing select favored servants to retain human intellect while yielding entirely to his will. The Forsaken now view him as an intolerable threat; Sylvanas Windrunner's Deathstalkers and apothecaries actively plot the mad archmage's execution to secure the borders of their fledgling kingdom.

npc:auntie-bernice-stonefield.s: "Tía" Bernice Pedregosa. La «Tía» Bernice Pedregosa es una anciana de la familia Pedregosa que reside en su hacienda, en la zona centro-sur de Bosque de Elwynn. Viuda tras la caída de su esposo en combate durante las campañas militares del reino, es famosa en todo el valle por sus célebres pasteles de tripa de cerdo. Se la puede encontrar fuera de la granja junto a La vieja Pedregosa, vigilando con agudeza los alrededores y albergando una profunda desconfianza hacia la familia rival, los Maclure. Como muchas personas de a pie de todo el Reino de Ventormenta, Bernice ha pagado el alto precio de la guerra continua. Habiendo perdido a su esposo en campañas militares, ahora pasa sus días en la hacienda familiar junto a sus parientes, ayudando a gestionar los quehaceres diarios de la granja junto a la matriarca, La vieja Pedregosa. A pesar de su pérdida personal, mantiene a la familia alimentada y el hogar en marcha, ganándose una notable fama local por sus célebres pasteles de tripa de cerdo.

ang.profession:Cooking: Bernice's pork belly pie is famous across Elwynn Forest as a quintessential staple of hearty human frontier cooking.
ang.race:Human: Bernice embodies the gritty resilience of Stormwind's rural folk, carrying on daily life and family pride after losing a husband to the kingdom's wars.

faq.a: She is an elder of the Stonefield clan living at the Stonefield Farm in southern Elwynn Forest. She is a war widow who spends her days tending the farm alongside Ma Stonefield and baking her famous pork belly pies.
faq.q: Who is Auntie Bernice Stonefield?

faq.a: Bernice became a widow when her husband was killed during a military campaign fought for the Kingdom of Stormwind.
faq.q: What happened to Auntie Bernice's husband?

faq.a: She is well known throughout the local countryside for her savory pork belly pies, a treat delicious enough that even mischievous neighbors cannot resist bargaining for a slice.
faq.q: What is Auntie Bernice famous for?

faq.a: Bernice suspected Billy Maclure stole her cherished family necklace, stoking the fires of the long-standing family feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures.
faq.q: Why is Auntie Bernice angry with Billy Maclure?

faq.a: Billy found the necklace, but while carrying it, he was chased by the notorious kobold Goldtooth near the Fargodeep Mine and dropped it during his escape. Goldtooth subsequently took possession of it.
faq.q: Did Billy Maclure actually steal the necklace?

faq.a: She can be found standing right outside the main farmhouse on the Stonefield Farm, located south of the road between Goldshire and Westfall, standing beside Ma Stonefield.
faq.q: Where is Auntie Bernice located?

text.s: “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield is an elder of the Stonefield family, residing at their homestead in south-central Elwynn Forest. Widowed after her husband fell in battle during the kingdom's military campaigns, she is renowned throughout the valley for her famous pork belly pies. She can be found outside the farmhouse alongside Ma Stonefield, keeping a sharp eye on the neighborhood and harboring a deep suspicion of the rival Maclure family.

sec.b: Like many common folk across the Kingdom of Stormwind, Bernice has borne the steep price of ongoing war. Having lost her husband to military campaigns, she now lives out her days on the family homestead with her kin, helping manage daily farm affairs alongside matriarch Ma Stonefield. Despite personal loss, she keeps the household fed and running, earning local fame for her celebrated pork belly pies.

The long-standing bitterness between the Stonefields and the Maclures is a defining part of Bernice's world. When her prized family necklace went missing, she immediately suspected young Billy Maclure of swiping it. However, recovering her keepsake proves more complicated than dealing with a petty neighbor's prank: Billy insists he dropped it while running away from the fearsome kobold Goldtooth over at the Fargodeep Mine.
sec.t: The Feud and the Missing Necklace

npc:baine-bloodhoof.s: Baine Pezuña de Sangre. Baine Pezuña de Sangre es el hijo del gran jefe Cairne Pezuña de Sangre y el protector en funciones de Poblado Pezuña de Sangre en Mulgore. Mientras su padre gobierna las tribus desde las imponentes alturas de Cima del Trueno, Baine supervisa directamente la defensa local, investigando la intrusión de la explotación industrial y defendiendo la zona de los depredadores salvajes. Ejerce como un puente esencial entre los jóvenes bravos tauren y la sabiduría ancestral de su clan. Nacido de Cairne y la difunta Tamaala, Baine pasó su juventud viajando junto a su pueblo nómada antes de que reclamaran las ricas praderas de Mulgore. Sus primeros años estuvieron marcados por la constante amenaza de los clanes de centauros. Poco después de la Tercera Guerra, una partida de guerra de centauros a las órdenes de Khiragg capturó al joven Baine, sumiendo a Cairne en un estupor de dolor que casi desmorona los asentamientos recién fundados. Solo gracias al valor del campeón Rexxar se logró liberar a Baine de su cautiverio. Aquel rescate restauró el espíritu de Cairne, lo que permitió a los tauren alzarse junto a la Horda de Thrall frente a los invasores de Kul Tiras y consolidar su posición en el continente.

ang.class:Shaman: Baine respects the spirits above all else, sending travelers to silence dwarven machines and reckless miners before the fury of the earth elementals is unleashed.
ang.faction:Horde: Baine embodies the calm wisdom and quiet martial strength that anchors the tauren within Thrall's Horde, offering guidance to those passing through central Mulgore.
ang.race:Tauren: Baine represents both the honorable lineage of High Chieftain Cairne and the living hope of the young tribes gathered across the plains of Mulgore.

faq.a: Baine is the only son of Cairne Bloodhoof, the High Chieftain of the tauren tribes. He oversees defense and tribal affairs in Bloodhoof Village, stepping in to direct local braves and protect Mulgore while his father rules from Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Who is Baine Bloodhoof?

faq.a: Baine stands in Bloodhoof Village, situated in central Mulgore just south of Thunder Bluff. He can be found near the town center organizing tasks for newly arrived adventurers.
faq.q: Where can Baine be found right now?

faq.a: Following the Third War, a centaur leader named Khiragg captured Baine, plunging Cairne into debilitating despair. The beastmaster Rexxar sought out Bovan Windtotem's outcasts, tracked the centaur to their encampment, slew the captors, and safely returned Baine to his father.
faq.q: How was Baine rescued from the centaur?

faq.a: Baine coordinates efforts against the aggressive Palemane gnolls harassing local herds and keeps a close watch on foreign invaders, such as the goblin Venture Company and Alliance dwarven excavators disrupting the earth.
faq.q: What problems does Baine manage in Bloodhoof Village?

faq.a: Baine believes the violent blasting techniques of the Bael'dun miners harm the spirits of the earth. He seeks to sabotage their industrial tools and scare them off before their reckless digging brings elemental retribution upon the region.
faq.q: What is Baine's stance on the Bael'dun dwarven digsite?

faq.a: As Cairne's beloved son and right-hand advisor, Baine already acts as temporary leader whenever Cairne is away from Thunder Bluff. He is widely considered the natural heir to lead the united tauren tribes in the future.
faq.q: Will Baine succeed Cairne as High Chieftain?

text.s: Baine Bloodhoof is the son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof and the acting protector of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. While his father governs the tribes from the towering heights of Thunder Bluff, Baine directly oversees local defense, investigating encroaching industrial exploitation and defending against feral predators. He serves as an essential bridge between youthful tauren braves and the ancestral wisdom of his clan.

sec.b: Born to Cairne and the late Tamaala, Baine spent his youth traveling alongside his nomadic people before they claimed the rich grasslands of Mulgore. His early life was marked by the ever-present threat of the centaur clans. Shortly after the Third War, a centaur warband under Khiragg captured young Baine, plunging Cairne into a grief-stricken stupor that nearly shattered the newly founded settlements. It was only through the courage of the champion Rexxar that Baine was liberated from captivity. That rescue restored Cairne's spirit, allowing the tauren to stand with Thrall's Horde against the invading Kul Tirans and secure their foothold on the continent.

Rather than lingering in the relative comfort of the capital mesas, Baine chooses to reside among his kin in Bloodhoof Village. As Cairne advances in age, Baine carries an increasing burden of stewardship, representing the next generation of tauren leadership. He directs braves and visiting allies to combat the unruly Palemane gnolls who pester the borders, and keeps a watchful eye on suspicious outside influences threatening Mulgore's natural balance. Whenever Cairne departs the capital on state affairs, Baine steps forward as the acting leader for the united tribes.

Beyond territorial border clashes, Baine faces modern encroachers unconcerned with spiritual balance. To the east, the goblin Venture Company cuts deep into the sacred landscape, while dwarven prospectors from Bael Modan dig into ancestral soil at the Bael'dun Digsite. Baine advocates for a firm yet measured response: attempting to warn the miners and destroy their destructive equipment rather than rushing into senseless bloodshed. He warns that the dwarves' violent digging is hurting the spirits of the earth, though the miners refuse to listen.

npc:balthule-shadowstrike.s: Balthule Golpesombra. Balthule Golpesombra es un oteador elfo de la noche apostado en el norte de Costa Oscura, cerca de la Torre de Althalaxx. Ejerce como agente de avanzada para Delgren el Purificador y vigila a los siniestros sectarios y practicantes oscuros que ocupan las antiguas ruinas élficas. A menudo se envía a los aventureros que viajan por la costa norte a buscarlo para ayudar a desentrañar e interrumpir los oscuros rituales que tienen lugar en la torre. Apostado en la espesura justo al oeste de la Torre de Althalaxx, Balthule Golpesombra mantiene una vigilia solitaria y peligrosa. Los confines septentrionales de Costa Oscura están repletos de espíritus inquietos y ruinas sombrías, pero la actividad en torno a la torre supone una amenaza especialmente grave. Balthule actúa bajo las órdenes de Delgren el Purificador, observando los movimientos de los taumaturgos oscuros que se han infiltrado en los antiguos vestigios de los Altonatos.

ang.class:Rogue: Operating deep in hostile territory right under the noses of dangerous spellcasters, Balthule exemplifies the patience and vigilance of a true elven scout.
ang.faction:Alliance: Balthule serves as an important forward contact for Alliance members sent north from Auberdine to excise the dark cultists operating around the Tower of Althalaxx.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, the desecration of ancient Kalimdor ruins by foul cultists is an outrage that Balthule seeks to avenge before the corruption spreads further into their lands.

faq.a: Balthule Shadowstrike is a night elf scout stationed in northern Darkshore. He acts as an advance scout and agent working in concert with Delgren the Purifier to monitor evil cultist activities in the area.
faq.q: Who is Balthule Shadowstrike?

faq.a: He is stationed in northern Darkshore, positioned just west of the ominous Tower of Althalaxx near the coastline.
faq.q: Where is Balthule Shadowstrike located?

faq.a: He was sent to spy upon the dark spellcasters and cultists who have taken up residence in the Tower of Althalaxx, helping to gather intelligence and coordinate strikes to disrupt their corrupt rituals.
faq.q: What is his mission at the Tower of Althalaxx?

faq.a: Delgren the Purifier is an Argent Dawn paladin stationed at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale who coordinates the campaign against the dark forces plaguing northern Darkshore. Balthule serves as his forward eyes and ears.
faq.q: Who is Delgren the Purifier?

faq.a: The tower and its surrounding grounds are overrun by dark cultists, sorcerers, and summoned demonic or shadowy minions bent on using ancient Highborne power for sinister purposes.
faq.q: What kind of enemies occupy the Tower of Althalaxx?

faq.a: The Tower of Althalaxx is an ancient elven structure. The presence of foul sorcery and demonic activity so close to elven lands represents a direct threat to the safety of Darkshore and the night elves of Darnassus.
faq.q: Why is the Alliance interested in these ruins?

text.s: Balthule Shadowstrike is a night elf scout stationed in northern Darkshore near the Tower of Althalaxx. Serving as a forward agent for Delgren the Purifier, he keeps watch over the sinister cultists and dark practitioners occupying the ancient elven ruins. Adventurers traveling along the northern coast are often directed to him to assist in unravelling and disrupting the dark rituals underway at the tower.

sec.b: Perched in the wilderness just west of the Tower of Althalaxx, Balthule Shadowstrike maintains a lonely and perilous vigil. Darkshore's northern reaches are thick with restless spirits and shadowed ruins, but the activity around the tower poses a particularly acute threat. Balthule operates under the direction of Delgren the Purifier, observing the movements of dark casters who have crept into the ancient Highborne remnants.

The sorcerers and cultists who have claimed the Tower of Althalaxx are engaged in dark, forbidden magic, harvesting artifacts and souls from the surrounding ruins. Balthule relies on traveling Alliance champions to venture into the tower grounds, strike down the cultist leadership, and recover parchment and talismans that reveal the true scope of their summoning efforts.

npc:baron-aquanis.s: Barón Aquanis. El Barón Aquanis es un poderoso elemental de agua de las inundadas Ruinas del Santuario Lunar en las Cavernas de Brazanegra, donde el Martillo Crepuscular ha establecido su guarida. Emerge de las aguas profundas cuando alguien perturba la piedra de las profundidades de las ruinas. Los chamanes del Anillo de la Tierra lo consideran desde hace tiempo un poder elemental corrompido, y sospechan que la secta está detrás de ello. Sumergida bajo las salas inundadas de las Ruinas del Santuario Lunar, la piedra de las profundidades se encuentra justo delante de las narices de los sectarios del Martillo Crepuscular que ahora ocupan las ruinas. En su interior hay un Núcleo de las profundidades, un artefacto que, leído adecuadamente, revela la historia de toda la actividad elemental a su alrededor. Je'neu Sancrea, del Anillo de la Tierra, envía a aventureros de la Horda a recuperar el núcleo, y perturbar la piedra hace emerger al Barón Aquanis de las profundidades.

ang.class:Shaman: For shamans of the Earthen Ring, Baron Aquanis is a tragic example of elemental perversion, whose tainted remains offer crucial insights into purifying twisted spirits.
ang.faction:Horde: Je'neu Sancrea works with the Horde on Ashenvale's coast, and the fathom core his Horde helpers recover is meant to show what the Twilight's Hammer is doing to the elements there.

faq.a: Baron Aquanis dwells in the flooded Moonshrine Ruins deep inside Blackfathom Deeps. He doesn't roam the halls: he rises from the water when the ruins' underwater Fathom Stone is disturbed, which Horde adventurers do while recovering its fathom core for Je'neu Sancrea.
faq.q: Where can I find Baron Aquanis?

faq.a: The Strange Water Globe is what Baron Aquanis leaves behind when he is destroyed: an orb that no physical force can break, with putrid water sloshing inside. It seems to have fed the elemental energy. Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring wants to study it, believing it will prove what corrupted the baron and how it was done.
al: what is the water globe for
faq.q: What is the Strange Water Globe?

faq.a: The Earthen Ring watches over the balance of the elements. Je'neu Sancrea and his comrades have long thought Baron Aquanis a corrupted elemental power, and with the Twilight's Hammer now in the Moonshrine Ruins they fear the cult is coercing the elements to work against the Horde. The baron's remains and the ruins' fathom core could show them what the cult is up to.
faq.q: Why is the Earthen Ring interested in Baron Aquanis?

faq.a: The Fathom Core is an elemental artifact housed within the sunken Fathom Stone. When properly read by a trained shaman, it reveals a comprehensive history of regional elemental activity, exposing whatever dark rituals the Twilight's Hammer are conducting in the ruins.
faq.q: What is the Fathom Core?

faq.a: Not by choice, as far as anyone can tell. The Earthen Ring considers him a corrupted elemental rather than a willing servant, and the Twilight's Hammer cultists who hold the Moonshrine Ruins are the obvious suspects. Je'neu Sancrea says it would be no surprise if they were behind it, but he wants proof before he says for sure.
faq.q: Is Baron Aquanis allied with the Twilight's Hammer?

faq.a: Not directly. The Fathom Stone, and with it Baron Aquanis, are Je'neu Sancrea's concern: he is an Earthen Ring shaman working with the Horde on Ashenvale's coast, and it is Horde adventurers he sends to recover the fathom core. Alliance explorers in Blackfathom Deeps have other errands there.
faq.q: Does the Alliance have business with Baron Aquanis?

text.s: Baron Aquanis is a powerful water elemental of the flooded Moonshrine Ruins in Blackfathom Deeps, where the Twilight's Hammer has made its lair. He rises from the deep water when someone disturbs the ruins' Fathom Stone. The shamans of the Earthen Ring have long thought him a corrupted elemental power, and they suspect the cult is behind it.

sec.b: Submerged beneath the flooded halls of the Moonshrine Ruins, the Fathom Stone lies right under the noses of the Twilight's Hammer cultists who now occupy the ruins. Inside it is a fathom core, a device that, properly read, tells the history of all elemental activity around it. Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring sends Horde adventurers to recover the core, and disturbing the stone draws Baron Aquanis up from the depths.

The Earthen Ring has long thought of Baron Aquanis as a corrupted elemental power. When he is destroyed, he leaves behind a Strange Water Globe: an impervious orb of putrid, sloshing water that seems to have fed him energy. Je'neu Sancrea believes the globe will prove what corrupted the baron, and how. It would be no surprise to him if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer.

npc:baron-silverlaine.s: Barón Filargenta. El Barón Filargenta era el legítimo señor humano de la fortaleza antaño conocida como el Torreón Filargenta, encaramada en lo alto sobre la Aldea Piroleña. Cuando el Archimago Arugal desató a los salvajes huargen sobre la región, el barón y su servidumbre fueron masacrados sin piedad. Ahora, su espíritu atormentado vaga por el comedor en ruinas, atado a la no-muerte para defender la misma guarida que se convirtió en su tumba. Antes de que la sombra de las bestias lobo cubriera las colinas del sur de Argénteos, el Barón Filargenta gobernaba sobre una orgullosa hacienda noble. Su fortaleza brindaba seguridad y vigilancia a las tierras gilneanas circundantes. Esa paz se hizo añicos cuando el Archimago Arugal, en busca de un arma contra la desbocada Plaga, desató huargen invocados en la región. Las monstruosidades salvajes no pudieron ser controladas; asaltaron la fortaleza, arrollaron a sus guardias y masacraron al barón junto con toda su familia.

ang.class:Mage: Silverlaine's fate serves as a grim warning of magical recklessness; the summoner's art, when mishandled as Archmage Arugal did, destroys innocent lives and leaves indelible scars.
ang.race:Human: Silverlaine stands as a bitter testament to the downfall of human noble authority on the borders of Gilneas, his family wiped out by the magical hubris of a Dalaran-trained wizard.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken pushing across Silverpine, Silverlaine's specter is merely another remnant of old Gilnean aristocracy that must be cleared to break Arugal's grip on the keep.

faq.a: He was the noble Gilnean human master of the fortress originally named Keep Silverlaine, situated above Pyrewood Village. He was slain alongside his family when worgen overran the fortress.
faq.q: Who was Baron Silverlaine?

faq.a: Silverlaine was slaughtered in his own home during the worgen onslaught unleashed by Archmage Arugal. Cursed in death, his ghost remains tethered to the dining hall of his ruined keep, unable to move on.
faq.q: Why is he haunting Shadowfang Keep?

faq.a: His cursed spirit remains within his former home, where he attacks trespassers in the Great Hall.
faq.q: Why does Silverlaine attack trespassers?

faq.a: Baron Silverlaine haunts the Great Hall, which served as the keep's lavish dining room before it was wrecked during the fall of his estate.
faq.q: Where in the keep can he be found?

faq.a: It was originally called Keep Silverlaine, named after the baron's noble family who held dominion over it before Arugal took control.
faq.q: What was Shadowfang Keep called before the worgen attack?

faq.a: No. Historical accounts confirm that Baron Silverlaine and his entire family were slaughtered inside the keep when the feral worgen invaded.
faq.q: Did anyone in Silverlaine's family survive?

text.s: Baron Silverlaine was the rightful human lord of the fortress once known as Keep Silverlaine, perched high above Pyrewood Village. When Archmage Arugal unleashed the savage worgen upon the region, the baron and his household were mercilessly slaughtered. Now, his tormented spirit lingers in the ruined dining hall, bound in undeath to defend the very lair that became his tomb.

sec.b: Before the shadow of the wolf-beasts blanketed the southern hills of Silverpine, Baron Silverlaine ruled over a proud noble estate. His fortress provided safety and oversight to the surrounding Gilnean lands. That peace shattered when Archmage Arugal, seeking a weapon against the rampaging Scourge, unleashed summoned worgen into the region. The feral monstrosities could not be controlled; they stormed the stronghold, overran its guards, and butchered the baron along with his entire family.

Death brought no release to Baron Silverlaine. Bound to the keep's ancient Great Hall, his restless ghost now wanders the trashed dining tables where he once feasted. The cursed lord lashes out at intruders who enter his ruined home.

npc:baros-alexston.s: Baros Alexston. Baros Alexston es el arquitecto jefe de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, apostado dentro del ayuntamiento con vistas a la Plaza de la Catedral. Antiguo miembro de la Hermandad de los Albañiles que ayudó a reconstruir la capital tras la Primera Guerra, optó por aceptar un puesto oficial antes que seguir a su viejo amigo Edwin VanCleef a una rebelión abierta. Baros creció en la Hacienda de Alexston, en las onduladas praderas de Páramos de Poniente. Durante su juventud, unos ladrones asaltaron e incendiaron el hogar de su familia, obligando a su padre a esconder a toda prisa sus reliquias más queridas por los terrenos antes de huir. Con el tiempo, Baros viajó a la capital y se unió a la Hermandad de los Albañiles, dedicando años de extenuante trabajo junto al maestro de hermandad Edwin VanCleef para levantar de nuevo Ventormenta de las cenizas de la Primera Guerra.

ang.class:Rogue: For rogues navigating the shadows of the capital, Baros provides a link to Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7, who hold quiet debts to the architect despite his past ties to VanCleef.
ang.faction:Alliance: Baros Alexston represents the painful compromises made within the Alliance, illustrating how the betrayal of the Stonemasons Guild tore apart craftsmen who poured their lives into rebuilding the capital.
ang.race:Human: Human adventurers from Westfall will recognize Baros's surname from the overgrown, ruined farmstead now overrun by thieves and gnolls.

faq.a: Baros Alexston is stationed inside Stormwind City Hall, situated right along the northern side of Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can I find Baros Alexston?

faq.a: He serves as the Chief Architect of Stormwind City. He manages the ongoing construction, municipal upkeep, and architectural planning of the capital.
faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's role in Stormwind?

faq.a: They were close colleagues in the Stonemasons Guild who labored side by side rebuilding Stormwind after the First War. When the House of Nobles refused to pay the workers, VanCleef led a rebellion, whereas Baros stayed behind to accept the post of City Architect.
faq.q: How does Baros know Edwin VanCleef?

faq.a: Baros held ideological disagreements with the guild's descent into violent revolt. When the House of Nobles offered him the position of City Architect if he refused to follow VanCleef, Baros chose civic order over an outlaw life.
faq.q: Why didn't Baros join the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Upon Edwin VanCleef's death in the Deadmines, adventurers recover an unsent letter written directly to Baros Alexston, revealing lingering personal resentment and unresolved history between the two former craftsmen.
faq.q: What is the unsent letter found on Edwin VanCleef?

faq.a: Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall. His family fled after thieves burned the property, and Baros later recruits adventurers to reclaim his childhood possessions, including his very first compass.
faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's connection to Westfall?

text.s: Baros Alexston is the Chief Architect of Stormwind City, stationed within the City Hall overlooking Cathedral Square. A former member of the Stonemasons Guild who helped rebuild the capital after the First War, he chose to accept an official post rather than follow his old friend Edwin VanCleef into open rebellion.

sec.b: Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in the rolling grasslands of Westfall. During his youth, thieves overran and torched his family's homestead, forcing his father to hurriedly stash their most cherished heirlooms across the grounds before fleeing. Baros eventually journeyed to the capital and joined the Stonemasons Guild, dedicating years of grueling labor alongside Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef to raise Stormwind anew from the ashes of the First War.
sec.t: From the Farmstead to the Scaffold

sec.b: When the rebuilding drew to an end, the House of Nobles reneged on the agreed payment, leading to furious protests, the dissolution of the Stonemasons Guild, and deadly street riots. As VanCleef led the disenfranchised artisans into exile to form the Defias Brotherhood, the nobles offered Baros the prestigious position of City Architect on the condition that he disavow the uprising. Harboring ideological disagreements with the guild's path toward violent banditry, Baros accepted the offer, cementing a tragic rift between himself and his former comrades.

From his desk in City Hall, Baros continues overseeing the maintenance of the capital, carrying political ties that include a discreet favor owed to him by Mathias Shaw of SI:7. Yet his past refuses to stay buried. Following the fall of VanCleef within the depths of the Deadmines, an unsent letter addressed personally to Baros rests upon the Defias leader's corpse—a testament to a bond severed by politics, treason, and the blood shed over Stormwind's foundation stones.
sec.t: The Ghost in the Dead Mines

npc:bazil-thredd.s: Bazil Thredd. Bazil Thredd es el lugarteniente y asistente de mayor confianza de Edwin VanCleef, encerrado en las Mazmorras de Ventormenta desde los disturbios de los canteros en los que murió la reina Tiffin. Ahora la prisión se ha sublevado y Thredd lidera el motín de los reclusos Defias desde su bloque de celdas oriental. Cuando la nobleza de Ventormenta se negó a pagar a la Hermandad de los Albañiles por reconstruir la ciudad, Edwin VanCleef rechazó las medidas de apaciguamiento del gobierno e inició una revuelta abierta. Bazil Thredd estuvo al lado de VanCleef como su lugarteniente principal y asistente de mayor confianza. Durante los violentos enfrentamientos posteriores —que provocaron la muerte de la reina Tiffin Wrynn—, Thredd fue capturado por la guardia de la ciudad. Mientras VanCleef y los canteros supervivientes huían a Páramos de Poniente para fundar la Hermandad Defias, Thredd fue arrojado a las profundidades de las Mazmorras de Ventormenta.

ang.faction:Alliance: A Defias revolt right beneath Stormwind's streets is a direct threat to the capital, and Warden Thelwater wants its leader dealt with before it spreads.
ang.race:Human: Thredd is a living reminder of the Stonemasons' riots that claimed Queen Tiffin and set the Defias Brotherhood against the kingdom.

faq.a: Bazil Thredd was the right hand of Edwin VanCleef during the Stonemasons' rebellion in Stormwind. Following his capture during the riots that killed Queen Tiffin, he was imprisoned in the Stockade, where he now leads the mutinous inmates.
faq.q: Who is Bazil Thredd?

faq.a: He is located deep inside the Stormwind Stockade, the prison complex beneath the Canal District near the Mage Quarter. At the main hallway intersection, head down the eastern cell block past the ogre brute Hamhock; Thredd commands from the center cell of the far chamber.
faq.q: Where can Bazil Thredd be found?

faq.a: The inmates have overpowered the guards, opened the cells and taken the prison's halls for themselves. Bazil Thredd, the most important Defias prisoner in the Stockade, has taken command of the rioting bandits and convicts, and Warden Thelwater is struggling to keep the revolt from spilling into the streets of Stormwind.
faq.q: Why is the Stockade rioting?

faq.a: Warden Thelwater believes the uprising cannot be quelled while Thredd lives to direct it. With the prison guard overwhelmed and the inmates holding the complex, the warden orders Thredd executed to shatter the rebellion's command structure.
faq.q: Why does Warden Thelwater want Thredd dead?
