faq.a: A quiet man claiming the name Maelik visited Thredd weekly in the months leading up to the uprising. Though Thelwater was suspicious, the visitor held legitimate paperwork, strongly implying Defias sympathizers or corrupt officials inside Stormwind facilitated the contact.
faq.q: Who was visiting Thredd before the riot?

faq.a: Thredd served as Edwin VanCleef's principal lieutenant during the reconstruction of Stormwind and the subsequent labor disputes, helping organize the guild's resistance when the House of Nobles refused to compensate them for their labor.
faq.q: What was Thredd's role in the Stonemasons Guild?

text.s: Bazil Thredd is Edwin VanCleef's lieutenant and most trusted assistant, locked in the Stormwind Stockade since the Stonemasons' riots that killed Queen Tiffin. Now the prison has risen in revolt, and Thredd leads the rioting Defias inmates from its eastern cell block.

sec.b: When the Stonemasons Guild was refused payment by the nobility of Stormwind for rebuilding the city, Edwin VanCleef rejected government appeasements and sparked open revolt. Bazil Thredd stood at VanCleef's side as his chief lieutenant and most trusted assistant. During the violent clashes that followed—which resulted in the death of Queen Tiffin Wrynn—Thredd was captured by the city guard. While VanCleef and the surviving masons fled into Westfall to form the Defias Brotherhood, Thredd was cast into the depths of the Stormwind Stockade.

For years, Thredd remained silent and seemingly forsaken behind iron bars. That isolation shattered with a massive prison riot that overran the guards, opening the cells and turning the Stockade into an armed fortress right under the Mage Quarter. Taking leadership of the imprisoned Defias bandits, insurgents, and allied cutthroats, Thredd established his command post in the eastern wing under the guard of an ogre named Hamhock. Warden Thelwater, desperate to restore order before the chaos spills into the city streets, demands Thredd's head to break the rebellion's leadership.

Warden Thelwater long believed the Brotherhood had abandoned Thredd to rot. However, a few months prior to the uprising, an enigmatic man presenting papers under the name Maelik began visiting Thredd once or twice a week. Despite Thelwater's suspicions, the visitor's documentation proved entirely legitimate. These secretive meetings ended just as the prison erupted into coordinated violence, suggesting that outside hands within the city actively organized the riot.

npc:bazzalan.s: Bazzalan. Bazzalan es un siniestro pícaro sátiro que acecha en las profundidades volcánicas de Sima Ígnea. Junto a Jergosh el Conjurador, comanda las oscuras actividades del culto Filo Ardiente directamente bajo la capital de la Horda, Orgrimmar. Mientras Thrall se esfuerza por establecer el nuevo hogar de los orcos por todo Durotar, antiguos males se han asentado bajo sus pies. Bazzalan, un astuto pícaro sátiro, se ha aliado con el culto Filo Ardiente en el interior de las serpenteantes cavernas de lava de Sima Ígnea. Rápido y letal con dos hojas gemelas, sirve como uno de los principales comandantes de campo del culto.

ang.class:Rogue: Bazzalan displays classic stealth techniques, vicious strikes, and venom-coated blades, making him an opponent of distinct professional interest.
ang.faction:Horde: Bazzalan and his cult pose an intolerable hazard right below Thrall's stronghold, necessitating immediate extermination.
ang.race:Orc: Having fought so hard to escape the clutches of demonic manipulation, Orcs view a satyr directing cultists in their own foundations as an outrage.

faq.a: Bazzalan is a satyr rogue and co-leader of the Searing Blade cult operating inside Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Who is Bazzalan?

faq.a: He lurks along the upper ledges of Ragefire Chasm, stationed above Jergosh the Invoker. He can be reached by climbing dark ramps cut into the cavern walls.
faq.q: Where can Bazzalan be found in Ragefire Chasm?

faq.a: Bazzalan works in concert with the Searing Blade, a demonic cult seeking to undermine the Horde from within. Satyrs are bound to demonic powers and frequently act as instigators and assassins for shadow councils.
al: why is there a satyr in orgrimmar
faq.q: What is a satyr doing beneath Orgrimmar?

faq.a: Bazzalan fights as a classic rogue, striking rapidly with melee weapons, using Sinister Strike, and occasionally afflicting opponents with a mild debilitating poison.
faq.q: What abilities does Bazzalan use in combat?

faq.a: Bazzalan and Jergosh share leadership of the Searing Blade inside Ragefire Chasm. While Jergosh focuses on invocations and summoning dark forces, Bazzalan acts as the martial and stealth authority.
faq.q: What is his relationship to Jergosh the Invoker?

faq.a: His presence deep beneath the capital represents a direct demonic threat. Horde leaders commission adventurers to infiltrate Ragefire Chasm and eliminate him before the Searing Blade's plot endangers the city.
faq.q: Why does the Horde want Bazzalan dead?

text.s: Bazzalan is a sinister satyr rogue lurking within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm. Alongside Jergosh the Invoker, he commands the dark activities of the Searing Blade cult directly beneath the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

sec.b: While Thrall works to establish the Orcs' new home across Durotar, ancient evils have found a roost beneath his feet. Bazzalan, a cunning satyr rogue, has allied with the Searing Blade cult inside the winding lava caverns of Ragefire Chasm. Swift and lethal with twin blades, he serves as one of the cult's primary field commanders.

Perched upon a dark volcanic ledge overlooking the central chamber where Jergosh the Invoker conducts demonic rituals, Bazzalan oversees his cultist guards. Like all satyrs, his ultimate loyalty lies with demonic masters, using poisons, fast strikes, and dark stealth to eliminate any Horde scouts who venture too close to the cult's staging ground.

npc:bethor-iceshard.s: Bethor Duroyelo. Bethor Duroyelo es un poderoso mago Renegado que se encuentra en el Barrio de la Magia de Entrañas. Al presidir a los practicantes de lo arcano y las sombras en el Templo de los Condenados, ostenta una autoridad considerable en el reino de Sylvanas. Bajo su gélido porte se esconde un pasado entrelazado con viejos amigos a los que la Plaga separó. Desde el Templo de los Condenados, Bethor Duroyelo supervisa a quienes practican las artes arcanas y la Magia de las Sombras en Entrañas. Respetado y temido por su intelecto y su férrea determinación, Bethor posee el peso político y mágico necesario para dar instrucciones directas a los magistrados provinciales de Lordaeron. Dirige a agentes de los Renegados para conseguir valiosos grimorios, investigar anomalías arcanas y erradicar poderes rivales que amenacen el dominio de Entrañas.

ang.class:Mage: For Forsaken mages, Bethor represents the pinnacle of perseverance, demonstrating that the arcane arts can thrive even within the cold grasp of undeath.
ang.faction:Horde: Bethor coordinates crucial offensive magic and counter-necromancy operations that protect the Horde's foothold across Lordaeron.
ang.race:Undead: Bethor's personal tragedy mirrors that of many Forsaken: severed from cherished friendships and homes by the Scourge, only to face former allies as bitter enemies.

faq.a: Bethor Iceshard is a high-ranking Forsaken mage who presides over the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He coordinates magical research, rogue intelligence, and covert arcane operations on behalf of the Dark Lady.
faq.q: Who is Bethor Iceshard?

faq.a: Bethor resides inside the Temple of the Damned, the central structure situated in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
faq.q: Where can Bethor Iceshard be found?

faq.a: Bethor and Gunther were close friends during their days as apprentice mages in Lordaeron. After dying during the Scourge invasion, both eventually broke free from the Lich King's control, and Bethor orchestrated Gunther's recruitment into the Forsaken.
faq.q: What is Bethor's history with Gunther Arcanus?

faq.a: Thule Ravenclaw was the third member of Bethor and Gunther's apprentice circle. Unlike the other two, Thule willingly pledged his soul to the Lich King during the Scourge invasion, becoming a hated necromancer residing at Fenris Isle.
faq.q: Who was Thule Ravenclaw to Bethor?

faq.a: In their youth, Bethor, Gunther, and Thule wove their practice wands together as a symbol of their eternal friendship. That braided keepsake remains a poignant artifact tying the three fractured spellcasters to their mortal past.
faq.q: What is the story behind Bethor's wand?

faq.a: Bethor serves as one of the leading arcane authorities in the Undercity. He guides newly risen magi and warlocks, directs military intelligence regarding rogue necromancers, and holds authority over regional Forsaken civil officials such as magistrate Sevren.
faq.q: What role does Bethor play in Forsaken society?

text.s: Bethor Iceshard is a powerful Forsaken mage based in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Presiding over the arcane and shadow practitioners within the Temple of the Damned, he commands considerable authority in Sylvanas's realm. Beneath his chilly demeanor lies a past entwined with old friends torn apart by the Scourge.

sec.b: Standing within the Temple of the Damned, Bethor Iceshard oversees the practitioners of the arcane arts and shadow magic in the Undercity. Respected and feared for his intellect and icy resolve, Bethor wields sufficient political and magical weight to give direct instructions to provincial magistrates across Lordaeron. He directs agents of the Forsaken to secure valuable grimoires, investigate arcane anomalies, and stamp out rival powers that threaten the Undercity's dominion.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor was a mortal apprentice studying magic alongside two close companions: Gunther Arcanus and Thule Ravenclaw. As a testament to their fellowship, the three students wove their practice wands together. The Scourge shattered that bond entirely. When death and dark magic swept across the kingdom, Thule Ravenclaw willfully surrendered his soul to the Lich King, Gunther perished and rose on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake, and Bethor succumbed only to later break free as Forsaken.

Bethor has not forgotten his former companions. Tracking down powerful undead spellcasters throughout Tirisfal and Silverpine, he dispatches agents to discern whether rogue practitioners serve the Lich King or might be turned toward the Forsaken cause. When Bethor identifies Gunther Arcanus raising the dead on Brightwater Lake, he works patiently to bring his old friend into Lady Sylvanas's fold, while offering no mercy to Thule Ravenclaw, whose willing betrayal doomed their past brotherhood.

npc:billy-maclure.s: Billy Maclure. Billy Maclure es un travieso muchacho humano que vive en Los Viñedos de Maclure, en el Bosque de Elwynn. En medio de una amarga disputa entre su familia y los vecinos Stonefield, las mezquinas travesuras de Billy suelen causar problemas a ambas granjas. Su debilidad por los pasteles recién hechos facilita sobornarlo cuando sus fechorías se le van de las manos. Por lo general, se puede encontrar a Billy Maclure holgazaneando fuera del granero en Los Viñedos de Maclure, no lejos del granjero Gerard Tiller. Criado entre hileras interminables de vides, Billy pasa gran parte de su tiempo eludiendo las tareas y correteando por los prados rurales del centro del Bosque de Elwynn. Al igual que el resto de su familia, es muy consciente de la prolongada hostilidad entre los Maclure y los Stonefield, aunque Billy se toma la disputa más bien como un juego de bromas y pequeños hurtos que como un conflicto serio.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance adventurers newly arrived from Northshire, assisting with Billy's foolish pranks provides an introduction to the dangers lurking in Fargodeep Mine.
ang.profession:Cooking: Auntie Bernice's renowned pork belly pie demonstrates how simple frontier cooking can resolve tense local disputes and pry confessions from tight-lipped farm boys.
ang.race:Human: Billy represents the grounded, everyday squabbles of the Elwynn countryside, showing that even with Stormwind's political turmoil, local farm feuds and childhood misbehavior carry on as usual.

faq.a: Billy Maclure is a young human child living at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. He spends his days dodging work around the farm, playing pranks, and aggravating the neighboring Stonefield family.
faq.q: Who is Billy Maclure?

faq.a: Billy is stationed just outside the main barn on the grounds of the Maclure Vineyards, located in central Elwynn Forest to the southwest of the Stonefield Farm.
faq.q: Where can Billy Maclure be found?

faq.a: Billy snuck over to the Stonefield Farm and stole Auntie Bernice Stonefield's heirloom necklace as part of the ongoing feud between their families.
faq.q: What did Billy do to Auntie Bernice?

faq.a: While playing carelessly near the entrance of Fargodeep Mine, Billy dropped the necklace. It was swiftly picked up by Goldtooth, a notorious and formidable kobold who carried it deep into the mine.
faq.q: What happened to the necklace Billy stole?

faq.a: Billy refuses to tell the truth out of stubbornness and fear of punishment, but he cannot resist his appetite. Offering him one of Auntie Bernice's freshly baked pork belly pies is enough to loosen his tongue.
faq.q: How do you get Billy to confess what happened to the necklace?

faq.a: Goldtooth is an exceptionally large and vicious kobold leader who nests inside Fargodeep Mine. He snatched Auntie Bernice's dropped necklace from near the mine's entrance and hoards it within the dark tunnels.
faq.q: Who is Goldtooth?

text.s: Billy Maclure is a mischievous young human boy living at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Caught in the midst of a bitter feud between his family and the neighboring Stonefields, Billy's petty antics often cause trouble for both farms. His weakness for fresh pastries makes him easy to bribe when his shenanigans get out of hand.

sec.b: Billy Maclure can usually be found loitering outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, not far from the farmer Gerard Tiller. Growing up amidst the endless rows of grapevines, Billy spends much of his time dodging chores and running wild across the rural meadows of central Elwynn Forest. Like the rest of his kin, he is keenly aware of the long-standing hostility between the Maclures and the Stonefields, though Billy treats the feud more like a game of pranks and petty theft than a serious conflict.

Billy's mischief crossed the line when he swiped a treasured heirloom necklace belonging to Auntie Bernice Stonefield. While dashing about near the perilous Fargodeep Mine, the frightened youngster lost his grip on the trinket. Before he could retrieve it, the necklace was snatched up by a particularly massive and vicious kobold named Goldtooth, who vanished back into the subterranean tunnels. Terrified of both the subterranean vermin and the wrath of the neighboring elders, Billy remains reluctant to confess until coaxed with a savory bribe—specifically, a hot pork belly pie baked by Auntie Bernice herself.

npc:blind-hunter.s: Cazador ciego. El Cazador ciego es un esquivo murciélago albino que anida en las profundidades de Horado Rajacieno. A diferencia de los murciélagos ordinarios que anidan cerca de las entradas de las cavernas, esta criatura poco común merodea por las profundidades sin sol del reducto de los jabaespines. Horado Rajacieno está repleto de zarzales serpenteantes y oscuras cavernas subterráneas. Mientras que los murciélagos comunes del Horado anidan más cerca de la superficie, donde se filtra una tenue luz del mundo exterior, el Cazador ciego se ha adaptado por completo a los recovecos más lejanos y oscuros de la maleza. Su piel pálida y albina y su mirada lechosa son probablemente el resultado de generaciones pasadas en total aislamiento de la luz solar natural.

ang.class:Hunter: For beastmasters traversing the Barrens, the Blind Hunter represents a prize quarry—either as a rare albino beast to tame or as a source of well-crafted subterranean bows.

faq.a: The Blind Hunter is a rare albino bat dwelling in the deepest, pitch-black tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. It is remarkably pale and elusive compared to the common cavern bats found closer to the entrance.
faq.q: What is the Blind Hunter?

faq.a: It dwells in the shadowy interior paths of Razorfen Kraul, nesting well past the threshold where outside daylight fades away entirely.
faq.q: Where does the Blind Hunter appear?

faq.a: While naturalists and adventurers suspect it is truly blind due to its milky eyes and deep-cave habitat, its hunting ability remains razor-sharp, relying on keen hearing and echolocation in the darkness.
faq.q: Is the Blind Hunter actually blind?

faq.a: Yes, beastmasters capable of managing winged predators can tame the Blind Hunter, making it a distinctive pale companion for those patient enough to track it down.
faq.q: Can hunters tame the Blind Hunter?

faq.a: It is an albino specimen whose coloration likely developed from living in perpetual darkness far from the reach of the sun, unlike bats that venture near the cave mouth.
faq.q: Why is the Blind Hunter white?

faq.a: Ordinary Kraul bats possess typical dark coloration and live nearer to the entrance where light still penetrates, whereas the Blind Hunter is pale, reclusive, and adapted strictly to deep subterranean tunnels.
faq.q: How does it differ from regular Kraul bats?

text.s: The Blind Hunter is an elusive, albino bat that roosts deep within Razorfen Kraul. Unlike the ordinary bats nesting near the cavern entrances, this rare creature prowls the sunless depths of the quilboar redoubt.

sec.b: Razorfen Kraul is riddled with winding briars and dark subterranean caverns. While common Kraul bats roost nearer to the surface where faint light filters in from the outside world, the Blind Hunter has adapted entirely to the furthest, darkest alcoves of the tangle. Its pale, albino hide and milky gaze are likely the result of generations spent completely isolated from natural sunlight.

True to its name, scholars and scouts believe the creature has lost most or all of its conventional eyesight, relying instead on keen senses of hearing and echolocation to track prey through the gloom. It rarely shows itself, appearing only on occasion to hunt through the dense thickets, making an encounter with this phantom beast a prized occurrence among cavern explorers.

npc:blind-mary.s: Mary la Ciega. Mary la Ciega es un alma en pena atormentada que ronda una granja ruinosa y abandonada justo al sureste de Villa Oscura, en el Bosque del Ocaso. Antaño una mujer mortal hermosa y vanidosa, su violenta muerte y transformación la empujaron a la automutilación debido al dolor por aquello en lo que se había convertido. Antes de que las sombras se cernieran sobre el Bosque del Ocaso, Mary era conocida como una llamativa mujer mortal que se enorgullecía enormemente de su belleza y a la que rara vez se veía sin su preciado espejo. Cuando los no-muertos asolaron la región, Mary fue asesinada junto con muchos de sus vecinos. A diferencia de aquellos que hallaron descanso en la tierra, su espíritu perduró como una etérea alma en pena, condenada a vagar por el reino mortal en una forma fantasmal y traslúcida.

ang.class:Priest: Mary represents a tragic example of a soul untethered by horrific trauma, caught halfway between life and damnation through grief and vanity.
ang.faction:Alliance: Blind Mary's tragic fate is an intimate reminder for Darkshire's defenders of how deeply the curse of Duskwood has devastated everyday townsfolk.
ang.profession:Tailoring: Artisans of the loom occasionally seek out spectral entities like Mary for ghost hair thread, a delicate and supernatural material woven from ethereal remnants.

faq.a: Blind Mary is a banshee haunting a ruined homestead on the southeastern outskirts of Darkshire. In life, she was a beautiful local woman, but she was slaughtered during Duskwood's descent into darkness and arose as an undead spirit.
faq.q: Who is Blind Mary?

faq.a: Consumed by grief and despair over her horrific banshee form, Mary clawed her own eyes out with her bare hands so she would never have to witness her own reflection again.
al: how did blind mary lose her eyes
faq.q: Why is she called Blind Mary?

faq.a: She lingers inside a dilapidated farmhouse known as Blind Mary's Haunt, situated just southeast of the town of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood.
faq.q: Where does Blind Mary dwell?

faq.a: Unlike the aggressive ghouls and skeletons wandering the surrounding woods, Blind Mary does not immediately attack travelers. She remains trapped in mourning and can be spoken to by those who approach her ruin.
al: can you talk to blind mary
faq.q: Is Blind Mary hostile to living travelers?

faq.a: After tearing out her eyes in horror at her spectral state, Mary cast away her prized looking glass, leaving it lost somewhere among the haunted reaches of Duskwood.
faq.q: What happened to Mary's looking glass?

faq.a: Travelers and local artisans visit Mary during tasks around Darkshire, whether seeking to recover long-lost items like her discarded mirror, gathering ghost hair for specialized stitching, or returning forgotten personal keepsakes to soothe her tormented spirit.
faq.q: Why do adventurers seek out Blind Mary?

text.s: Blind Mary is a tormented banshee haunting an abandoned, ruined farmhouse just southeast of Darkshire in Duskwood. Once a vain and beautiful mortal woman, her violent death and transformation drove her to self-inflicted mutilation in grief over what she had become.

sec.b: Before the shadows fell across Duskwood, Mary was known as a striking mortal woman who took immense pride in her beauty, rarely seen without her treasured looking glass. When the undead swept over the region, Mary was slain along with many of her neighbors. Unlike those who found rest in the earth, her spirit lingered on as an ethereal banshee, condemned to wander the mortal realm in a ghastly, translucent form.

Awakening to undeath, Mary was overwhelmed by sorrow, horror, and fury at her monstrous reflection. Incapable of enduring the sight of her spectral visage, she clawed out her own eyes with her bare hands so she would never gaze upon herself again. In her agony, she discarded her beloved looking glass, leaving her to drift through her abandoned home as a blind, weeping wraith clutching to faint memories of the mortal life she lost.

npc:bolvar-fordragon.s: Bolvar Fordragón. El Alto Señor Bolvar Fordragón ejerce de regente de Ventormenta y comandante supremo de sus fuerzas armadas tras la misteriosa desaparición del rey Varian Wrynn. Junto al joven rey niño Anduin Wrynn en el Castillo de Ventormenta, se esfuerza por mantener unido el reino en medio de una creciente agitación interna. Aunque profundamente honorable, Bolvar a menudo ve sus decisiones marciales influenciadas y paralizadas por la consejera real Lady Katrana Prestor. Cuando el rey Varian desapareció de camino a una cumbre de paz en Isla Theramore, Ventormenta se vio sumida en el caos político. El príncipe Anduin, de diez años, fue coronado para mantener la continuidad, pero el verdadero poder de gobierno recayó en el Alto Señor Bolvar Fordragón como regente. Bolvar es un venerado paladín consagrado a la corona, pero se enfrenta a una inmensa tensión. El ejército de Ventormenta se encuentra disperso por Páramos de Poniente, Montañas Crestagrana y Bosque del Ocaso. Para agravar estas crisis, Bolvar acata con frecuencia el consejo de Lady Katrana Prestor, cuyas opiniones desdeñosas le impiden de forma constante destinar tropas reales a las poblaciones periféricas.

ang.class:Paladin: Bolvar represents the pinnacle of the Alliance's martial paladins, embodying steadfast devotion to the Light and unyielding duty to his people despite mounting political subterfuge.
ang.faction:Alliance: As Supreme Commander of Stormwind, Bolvar is the administrative head of the human military, balancing localized rebellions with broader Alliance obligations.

faq.a: King Varian Wrynn disappeared under suspicious circumstances while traveling by ship to a diplomatic summit at Theramore Isle. In his absence, Varian's ten-year-old son Anduin was crowned king to preserve political order, while Highlord Bolvar was appointed Regent to govern the kingdom and command its armies until the king is found.
faq.q: Why is Bolvar ruling instead of King Varian?

faq.a: Stormwind's standing armies are stretched thin guarding the core territories and borders. Furthermore, Bolvar's chief advisor, Lady Katrana Prestor, repeatedly questions the urgency of reports from places like Lakeshire, calling them exaggerations and advising against allocating royal forces. Lacking military proof, Bolvar instead deputizes independent adventurers to intervene.
faq.q: Why won't Bolvar send soldiers to help Redridge or Westfall?

faq.a: Lady Katrana Prestor is the premier royal councilor to the throne of Stormwind. Bolvar respects her political acumen and deep knowledge of noble affairs. However, she continually uses her influence to counsel restraint, urging him to dismiss rumors of dragons, orcs, and Defias plots.
al: who is lady prestor to bolvar
faq.q: What is Bolvar's relationship with Lady Katrana Prestor?

faq.a: Bolvar is not related to Anduin, but he acts as the young king's fierce protector, guardian, and mentor. Bolvar stands beside Anduin's throne in Stormwind Keep, shielding the boy from court intrigue and ensuring that the Wrynn dynasty remains secure until Varian returns.
faq.q: What is Bolvar's connection to young Prince Anduin?

text.s: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon serves as the Regent of Stormwind and Supreme Commander of its armed forces following the mysterious disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. Standing beside the young boy-king Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep, he strives to hold the kingdom together amid escalating domestic turmoil. Though fiercely honorable, Bolvar often finds his martial decisions influenced and stalled by royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor.

sec.b: When King Varian vanished en route to a peace summit on Theramore Isle, Stormwind was thrown into political disarray. Ten-year-old Prince Anduin was crowned to maintain continuity, but actual governing power fell to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon as Regent. Bolvar is a venerated paladin devoted to the crown, yet he faces immense strain. Stormwind's military is thinly stretched across Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood. Compounding these crises, Bolvar frequently defers to the counsel of Lady Katrana Prestor, whose dismissive advice consistently blocks him from committing royal troops to peripheral towns.

Behind the scenes in the royal court, Bolvar's hands are tied tighter than he realizes. While town magistrates and frontier marshals beg for reinforcements against the Defias Brotherhood and Blackrock orcs, Lady Prestor subtly manipulates royal decrees and belittles all reports of danger. Bolvar respects the nobility's counsel and hesitates to move without undeniable proof, unwittingly leaving the crown paralyzed. Only when compelling evidence arrives—such as investigative warnings from Theramore or missing field officers—does the Regent bypass standard court decorum to enlist independent adventurers.

npc:brewmaster-drohn.s: Cebador Drohn. El Cebador Drohn es un maestro cervecero orco que vive colina arriba desde el bullicioso puerto de Trinquete. Tras aprender el arte de la fermentación exótica gracias a sus vínculos con el legendario pandaren errante Chen Cerveza de Trueno, Drohn elabora potentes bebidas en la árida frontera de Los Baldíos. Los aventureros que descubren barriles abandonados por todo Kalimdor a menudo acaban siendo dirigidos directamente a su porche. Con vistas a los muelles goblins de Trinquete se encuentra el Cebador Drohn, un orco que ha dedicado su oficio a la ciencia de la elaboración de cerveza en lugar del simple combate. Al frente de Destilería de Drohn desde su casa en la ladera, opera pacíficamente dentro del remanso neutral establecido por el Cártel Bonvapor de Gazlowe. Mientras que la mayoría de los orcos se conforman con grog áspero o licores sencillos, el trabajo de Drohn requiere ingredientes exóticos, equilibrios refinados de sabor y técnicas rara vez practicadas entre los suyos.

ang.faction:Alliance: Though an orc, Drohn resides under Steamwheedle protection in Ratchet; attacking him will swiftly earn the wrath of the local goblin authorities.
ang.profession:Cooking: Culinary adventurers will appreciate Drohn's precise blending of rare flora and fauna to craft world-class beverages in the middle of a desert.
ang.race:Orc: Unlike most warriors who followed Thrall to Kalimdor to build fortresses, Drohn channels the newfound peace of Durotar and the Barrens into the refined art of brewing.

faq.a: Brewmaster Drohn is an orcish brewer living in Ratchet in the Barrens. He is renowned for his mastery of exotic ales and his direct ties to the brewing traditions of the wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout.
faq.q: Who is Brewmaster Drohn?

faq.a: Drohn's mentor was taught how to brew Stormstout by Chen Stormstout himself, passing the knowledge down to Drohn. Later, Chen personally taught Drohn the recipe and methods required to brew Trogg Ale.
faq.q: How does Drohn know Chen Stormstout?

faq.a: Take the keg to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet. He recognizes Chen's personal handiwork immediately and will enlist you to track down the rare indigenous ingredients needed to reproduce the brew.
faq.q: What should I do if I find Chen's Empty Keg?

faq.a: Drohn is an orc, but he resides and plies his trade in the neutral goblin port of Ratchet. Attacking him ruins an Alliance adventurer's reputation with Ratchet and the Steamwheedle Cartel.
faq.q: Is Brewmaster Drohn aligned with the Horde?

faq.a: Through Drohn's Distillery, he crafts potent mixtures including Trogg Ale and iterations of Chen Stormstout's recipes, which require local plants and creature essences found throughout Kalimdor.
faq.q: What kind of drinks does Drohn make?

faq.a: He can be found standing outside his house on the hill overlooking the port town of Ratchet, just northwest of the main docks in the Barrens.
faq.q: Where exactly is Drohn located?

text.s: Brewmaster Drohn is an orcish brewmaster living just uphill from the bustling port of Ratchet. Having learned the art of exotic fermentation through ties connected to the legendary wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout, Drohn crafts potent beverages on the arid frontier of the Barrens. Adventurers who discover discarded kegs across Kalimdor often find themselves directed straight to his porch.

sec.b: Overlooking the goblin docks of Ratchet sits Brewmaster Drohn, an orc who has devoted his craft to the science of brewing rather than simple combat. Running Drohn's Distillery from his hillside home, he operates peacefully within the neutral haven established by Gazlowe's Steamwheedle cartel. While most orcs settle for coarse grog or simple spirits, Drohn's work involves rare ingredients, refined balances of flavor, and techniques rarely practiced among his kin.
sec.t: A Master of the Craft in Ratchet

sec.b: Drohn's craft is heavily shaped by Chen Stormstout, the famed pandaren wanderer who fought alongside Rexxar and the Horde during the founding of Durotar. Drohn's mentor studied directly under Chen, learning the guarded secrets of Stormstout brews, and Chen himself later instructed Drohn in crafting Trogg Ale. When travelers stumble across Chen's distinct, discarded kegs in the wilds, Drohn is the sole local authority capable of identifying the ingredients and recreating the wanderer's potent concoctions.

npc:brine.s: Salmuera. Salmuera es una chamán orca que reside en las áridas colinas de Loma Espina Negra, en el sur de Los Baldíos. Como experta en los espíritus del agua, guía a los iniciados chamán por la senda espiritual para comulgar con las mareas y obtener su Tótem de agua. Encaramada a una colina azotada por el viento en el norte de Loma Espina Negra, Salmuera vive lejos de los bulliciosos puestos comerciales de Los Baldíos. A pesar de las secas sabanas que la rodean, ha dedicado su vida a comprender el elemento fluido y voluble del agua. Se indica a los chamanes de toda la Horda que busquen su sabiduría una vez que han dominado la tierra y el fuego, pues el agua requiere una paciencia y una perspectiva que pocos comprenden tan profundamente como ella.

ang.class:Shaman: Brine is an essential guide along your journey, testing your endurance and spirit before you can commune with water and claim your Water Totem.
ang.faction:Horde: A veteran of the wars in Hillsbrad, Brine serves the Horde not on the front lines, but by passing down the spiritual heritage of the elements to new generations.

faq.a: Brine is an experienced orc shaman living isolated atop a hill in the northern part of Blackthorn Ridge in the southern Barrens. She acts as a mentor for spiritual initiates seeking communion with water spirits.
faq.q: Who is Brine?

faq.a: While the Barrens are dry, water's true value and spiritual purity are often clearest where life is parched. Her solitude allows her to commune deeply with the elements away from the noise of settlements.
al: why does brine live in the desert
faq.q: Why is a water shaman living in a desert?

faq.a: Years ago, Brine fought alongside Horde warriors in Hillsbrad Foothills and entered Tarren Mill. There she found a small well of pure spring water, which served as a lasting symbol of life and hope amidst the ruin of war.
faq.q: What is Brine's connection to Tarren Mill?

faq.a: Brine oversees several stages of the 'Call of Water' trials. She directs initiates to gather pristine water samples across the world, teaching them humility and resilience before granting the insight needed for their Water Totem.
faq.q: What role does Brine play in shaman training?

faq.a: She can be found sitting atop a high bluff in northern Blackthorn Ridge, located in the southern half of the Barrens, just north of Razorfen Kraul.
faq.q: Where exactly is Brine located?

faq.a: Brine believes in finding slivers of hope and pure renewal even in times of intense pain and sorrow. She teaches that water represents life and perseverance against harsh trials.
faq.q: What philosophy guides her teachings?

text.s: Brine is an orc shaman residing in the arid hills of Blackthorn Ridge in the southern Barrens. As an expert on the spirits of water, she guides shaman initiates along the spiritual path to commune with the tides and earn their Water Totem.

sec.b: Perched upon a windswept hill in northern Blackthorn Ridge, Brine lives far from the bustling trading posts of the Barrens. Despite the dry savannas surrounding her, she has dedicated her life to understanding the fluid and fickle element of water. Shaman across the Horde are directed to seek her wisdom once they have mastered earth and fire, for water requires patience and perspective that few understand as deeply as she does.

In her younger years, Brine marched alongside her orc companions across the Hillsbrad Foothills, taking part in battles against human settlements. During that arduous campaign, she found herself in Tarren Mill, where she encountered a humble well fed by pure, fresh spring water. That well remained in her memory as a symbol of life persisting amidst devastation, reinforcing a lesson taught to her as a child: even in the darkest times of sorrow, a small token of hope can still be found.

Brine tests aspiring shaman by sending them on pilgrimages to gather droplets of purity from varied sources, teaching them that water can be gentle yet unyielding. Her rituals culminate in communion with the spirits of the elements, allowing shaman to bind the restorative essence of water to their totemic focus.

npc:cairne-bloodhoof.s: Cairne Pezuña de Sangre. Cairne Pezuña de Sangre es el venerable gran caudillo de las tribus tauren unidas y gobernante de Cima del Trueno. Un imponente guerrero de inmensa sabiduría, unió el destino de los tauren al de la Horda de Thrall después de que los orcos ayudaran a su pueblo a escapar de la extinción a manos de los centauros. Durante generaciones, los tauren vivieron como nómadas errantes por Los Baldíos, continuamente cazados y empujados hacia la extinción por salvajes merodeadores centauros. Cuando Thrall y sus orcos llegaron a las costas de Kalimdor, Cairne reconoció en ellos una nobleza poco común. Thrall ofreció protección militar y escoltó a la desesperada caravana de Cairne a través de las llanuras hasta la seguridad de Mulgore a cambio de que los guiara hasta el Oráculo en Cima del Espolón. Al asentarse sobre las imponentes mesetas de Cima del Trueno, Cairne finalmente estableció un hogar permanente y unificado para todas las tribus tauren.

ang.faction:Horde: Alongside Thrall, Cairne is a founding father of the modern Horde on Kalimdor, serving as a pillar of honor, wisdom, and military power.
ang.race:Tauren: Cairne is the savior of your people, having united the scattered tribes, repelled the centaur, and led the construction of Thunder Bluff.

faq.a: Cairne Bloodhoof is the High Chieftain of the united tauren tribes, chieftain of the Bloodhoof tribe, and leader of Thunder Bluff. He is an ancient warrior whose leadership and strength led the tauren out of nomadic exile and into a secure homeland.
faq.q: Who is Cairne Bloodhoof?

faq.a: During the Third War, marauding centaur tribes were hunting the tauren to extinction. Thrall and his newly arrived orcs fought off the marauders and escorted Cairne's great caravan to Mulgore. In gratitude, Cairne pledged his people's loyalty and strength to Thrall's Horde.
faq.q: Why are the tauren allied with the orcs?

faq.a: He presides atop Thunder Bluff, the capital city built on the high mesas of Mulgore, ruling alongside the leaders of the various reunited tauren tribes.
faq.q: Where does Cairne reside?

faq.a: Baine is Cairne's beloved son and heir. When Baine was abducted by centaur raiders, Cairne fell into deep grief, refusing to fight until Rexxar and his companions tracked Baine down and returned him safely home.
faq.q: Who is Baine Bloodhoof to Cairne?

text.s: Cairne Bloodhoof is the venerable High Chieftain of the united tauren tribes and ruler of Thunder Bluff. A towering warrior of immense wisdom, he bound the fate of the tauren to Thrall's Horde after the orcs aided his people in escaping extinction at the hands of the centaur.

sec.b: For generations, the tauren lived as wandering nomads across the Barrens, continually hunted and driven toward extinction by savage centaur marauders. When Thrall and his orcs arrived on the shores of Kalimdor, Cairne recognized a rare nobility in them. Thrall offered military protection, escorting Cairne's desperate caravan across the plains to the safety of Mulgore in exchange for guidance to the Oracle at Stonetalon Peak. Settling upon the towering mesas of Thunder Bluff, Cairne finally established a permanent, unified home for all tauren tribes.

Indebted to Thrall, Cairne followed the orcs to Stonetalon Peak and fought side by side with the Horde and Jaina Proudmoore's humans against the Burning Legion during the Third War. Later, when Admiral Daelin Proudmoore invaded Durotar, Cairne personally took up his ancestral runespear once more to fight alongside Rexxar after his captured son, Baine, was safely recovered. Today, Cairne stands as one of the Horde's most respected elders and Thrall's closest confidant, offering calm council against reckless warmongering.

npc:calor.s: Calor. Calor es un entregado habitante de Villa Oscura que ayuda a la Guardia Nocturna y a la familia Carevin a defender Bosque del Ocaso. Bajo las órdenes de Jonathan Carevin, coordina activamente los esfuerzos para dar caza a los despiadados huargen que acechan en los lúgubres bosques. Los aventureros que buscan hacer retroceder a las voraces bestias que rondan la espesura a menudo reciben sus misiones a través de él. Apostado en el asediado asentamiento de Villa Oscura, Calor colabora estrechamente con Jonathan Carevin, uno de los defensores más destacados de la villa. En medio de la penumbra constante y los terrores que acechan en Bosque del Ocaso, Calor se consagra a respaldar la misión de la casa Carevin: erradicar los horrores sobrenaturales que asedian el perímetro de la villa antes de que masacren al resto de sus habitantes.

ang.class:Hunter: Hunters will find steady work with Calor, tracking and culling savage, otherworldly beasts that defy the natural order of the forest.
ang.faction:Alliance: Calor serves as a vital contact for Alliance champions willing to brave the gloomy woods to defend the isolated townsfolk of Darkshire.

faq.a: Calor is a human allied with the Carevin family living in Darkshire. He assists in the town's defense by dispatching adventurers to hunt down dangerous threats in Duskwood.
faq.q: Who is Calor?

faq.a: Calor is stationed in Darkshire, the primary Alliance town nestled in the shadowed forests of Duskwood.
faq.q: Where can Calor be found?

faq.a: Calor is a staunch supporter of the Carevin family. He follows the directives of Jonathan Carevin, helping him wage war against the deadly monsters plaguing the forest.
faq.q: What is Calor's relationship with Jonathan Carevin?

faq.a: Calor tasks adventurers with hunting the bloodthirsty worgen packs that infest the woods, particularly directing strikes against them near places such as the Rotting Orchard.
faq.q: What enemies does Calor have you fight?

faq.a: The worgen are vicious, ravenous predators that attack anything on sight. Without regular culls coordinated by figures like Calor and the Night Watch, the beasts would quickly overrun Darkshire's thin defense lines.
faq.q: Why is the worgen threat so urgent in Duskwood?

faq.a: While Calor works in close conjunction with town defenders and aligns with Jonathan Carevin, he primarily operates as a direct agent and supporter of the Carevin family's anti-worgen crusade.
faq.q: Is Calor a member of the Night Watch?

text.s: Calor is a dedicated resident of Darkshire who aids the Night Watch and the Carevin family in defending Duskwood. Operating under the direction of Jonathan Carevin, he actively coordinates efforts to hunt down the vicious worgen stalking the gloomy forests. Adventurers looking to push back the ravenous beasts haunting the woods often find their assignments through him.

sec.b: Stationed within the beleaguered settlement of Darkshire, Calor works closely with Jonathan Carevin, one of the town's prominent defenders. Amid the endless gloom and creeping terrors of Duskwood, Calor devotes himself to supporting the Carevin household's mission: eradicating the supernatural horrors encroaching upon the town's perimeter before the remaining townsfolk are slaughtered.

Calor's primary duty centers on confronting the feral worgen prowling the woods, particularly around blighted areas like the Rotting Orchard. These ferocious wolf-men are far more aggressive and dangerous than common beasts, slaughtering travelers and patrols alike. Calor enlists capable fighters to cull their ranks and investigate their origins, desperate to stem the bloodthirsty tide.

npc:canaga-earthcaller.s: Clamor de Tierra Canaga. Clamor de Tierra Canaga es un chamán trol de Lanza Negra apostado en el soleado Valle de los Retos. Instruye a los chamanes novicios de la Horda en la comunión con los espíritus de la tierra y en la obtención de sus primeros tótems elementales. Más allá de su guía ritual, mantiene un ojo vigilante sobre los exploradores heridos y las amenazas emergentes cerca de El Cubil. Encaramado en los riscos rojos del Valle de los Retos, Clamor de Tierra Canaga ejerce como uno de los primeros guías espirituales para los trols de Lanza Negra y los orcos que recorren la senda del chamán. Mientras que muchos instructores se centran estrictamente en la preparación marcial, Canaga enseña a los recién llegados a aquietar sus mentes y escuchar los retumbos del mismísimo Kalimdor, preparando el sapta de tierra necesario para comulgar con los espíritus.

ang.class:Shaman: Canaga is your very first spiritual mentor in Durotar, preparing the Earth Sapta so you can commune with the elements and claim your Earth Totem.
ang.race:Orc: Canaga works side by side with orcish instructors in the valley, helping young orcs bind their spirit to the harsh soil of their new homeland.
ang.race:Troll: As one of the prominent Darkspear figures in the Valley of Trials, Canaga ensures that troll recruits are looked after, including dispatched scouts like Hana'zua.

faq.a: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman residing in the Valley of Trials. He mentors young shamans taking their first steps in the Horde and helps coordinate aid for fallen scouts nearby.
faq.q: Who is Canaga Earthcaller?

faq.a: Canaga oversees the Call of Earth ritual chain for Horde shamans starting in Durotar. He brews the Earth Sapta, a mystical draught that allows initiates to perceive and speak with the local earth elemental spirit to earn their first totem.
faq.q: What does Canaga teach young shamans?

faq.a: Earth Sapta is a specially brewed spiritual draught crafted from regional reagents. Shamans drink it to open their senses to the hidden spirits of the land, allowing them to communicate directly with elemental manifestations.
faq.q: What is the Earth Sapta Canaga prepares?

faq.a: Hana'zua, a good friend of Canaga's, went out into the valley heading north, where the scorpids hunt, and never returned. The spirits tell Canaga that his friend is not well, so he asks adventurers to search for him and lend assistance.
faq.q: Why does Canaga send adventurers to find Hana'zua?

faq.a: Following the Third War, the Darkspear tribe integrated closely with Thrall's Horde and settled alongside the orcs in Durotar. Troll shamans and warriors now train side by side with young orcs within the Valley of Trials.
al: why troll in valley of trials
faq.q: Why is a troll training shamans in an orcish proving ground?

faq.a: Canaga sits on the rock plateaus overlooking the eastern paths of the Valley of Trials, just south of the main training hub.
faq.q: Where can Canaga Earthcaller be found?

text.s: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman stationed in the sunbaked Valley of Trials. He instructs novice Horde shamans in communing with the spirits of the land and obtaining their first elemental totems. Beyond ritual guidance, he keeps a watchful eye on wounded scouts and emerging threats near the Den.

sec.b: Perched on the red bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller serves as one of the very first spiritual guides for Darkspear trolls and orcs who walk the path of the shaman. While many trainers focus strictly on martial readiness, Canaga teaches newcomers how to quiet their minds and listen to the rumblings of Kalimdor itself, preparing the earth sapta necessary to commune with the spirits.

Before any fledgling shaman can truly channel the elemental fury of the earth, they must prove their respect and resolve to the spirits. Canaga directs initiates to gather sacred reagents and journey to the local spirit rock in Durotar. Through his guidance, novices drink the earth sapta, behold the elemental spirits firsthand, and earn their Earth Totem.

Canaga does not merely dwell on esoteric rituals; he remains attuned to the valley's immediate dangers. When his friend Hana'zua heads north into the valley where the scorpids hunt and fails to return, Canaga directs capable travelers to search for him, ensuring the tribe's scouts are not left to perish in the wilderness.

npc:captain-grayson.s: Capitán Grisillo. El Capitán Grisillo es el espíritu inquieto de un capitán pirata apostado en el Faro de Poniente. Habiendo perdido su propia vida cuando su barco se estrelló contra la oscura costa, ahora vigila el faro para evitar que otros marineros sufran su mismo destino. En vida, Grisillo capitaneó un navío a lo largo de los peligrosos mares del sur de los Reinos del Este. Su viaje llegó a un violento final frente a los escarpados bajíos de Páramos de Poniente, en una noche en que el fuego del faro se había apagado. Arrojado contra las rocas, Grisillo pereció junto a su barco, solo para despertar como un fantasma atado al mundo terrenal, atrapado en la costa.

ang.class:Paladin: Though Grayson is an undead spirit, his purpose is selfless and protective. Assisting him honors the sacred duty of defending the helpless and purging the murderous tides of murlocs.
ang.class:Priest: Grayson's spirit is anchored by guilt and grief over watching an innocent family die. Offering aid brings a measure of solace to his restless soul.
ang.faction:Alliance: With the Defias Brotherhood choking Westfall and Stormwind neglecting its borders, it falls to visiting Alliance travelers to answer Grayson's plea and secure the lighthouse flame.

faq.a: Captain Grayson is a human ghost pirate residing at the Westfall Lighthouse. After wrecking on the coast because the beacon went out, his spirit took it upon himself to maintain the light and protect passing mariners.
faq.q: Who is Captain Grayson?

faq.a: He died when his pirate vessel was driven onto the treacherous rocks along Westfall's shore. The lighthouse was dark that night, giving him and his crew no warning before their ship was torn apart.
al: how did grayson become a ghost
faq.q: How did Captain Grayson die?

faq.a: The keeper and his family were attacked by coastal murlocs. Though they escaped the initial assault and returned to relight the beacon, Old Murk-Eye rallied a second raid and slaughtered them all before Grayson's eyes.
faq.q: What happened to the real lighthouse keeper?

faq.a: Old Murk-Eye is a cunning and vicious murloc chieftain stalking the Westfall shoreline. He led the assault that killed the lighthouse keeper's family and poses a constant threat to anyone attempting to keep the beacon lit.
faq.q: Who is Old Murk-Eye?

faq.a: Having drowned because the coastline was pitch black, Grayson considers it his solemn duty in the afterlife to ensure no other sailors meet that same fate upon the shoals.
faq.q: Why does Grayson want the lighthouse kept lit?

faq.a: No. Despite his pirate background in life, Grayson harbors no ill will toward the living. He has witnessed too much slaughter and seeks only peace and assistance in tending the flame.
faq.q: Is Captain Grayson hostile to adventurers?

text.s: Captain Grayson is the restless spirit of a pirate captain stationed at the Westfall Lighthouse. Having lost his own life when his ship smashed against the dark coastline, he now watches over the beacon to prevent other sailors from suffering his fate.

sec.b: In life, Grayson captained a vessel along the perilous southern seas of the Eastern Kingdoms. His voyage came to a violent end off the jagged shoals of Westfall on a night when the lighthouse fire had gone dark. Cast upon the rocks, Grayson perished alongside his ship, only to awaken as an earthbound phantom trapped upon the coast.
sec.t: A Life Cut Short by the Rocks

sec.b: Drawn to the Westfall Lighthouse in death, Grayson hoped to find answers about the afterlife. Instead, he witnessed sheer tragedy. A notorious murloc known as Old Murk-Eye drove the lighthouse keeper and his family away. Though the keepers bravely returned to rekindle the flame, Old Murk-Eye rallied the surrounding murlocs for a second, brutal slaughter. Grayson could only watch helplessly as the family was butchered.

With the keepers dead and Westfall crumbling under neglect, Captain Grayson took the solemn burden of the beacon upon his spectral shoulders. He seeks aid from passing adventurers to gather fuel for the great flame and avenge the slaughtered family by hunting down Old Murk-Eye and driving back the coastal murloc tide.

npc:captain-greenskin.s: Capitán Verdetez. El Capitán Verdetez es un pirata goblin de élite que supervisa la construcción y la tripulación del colosal acorazado de Edwin VanCleef. Oculto en las profundidades de la ensenada subterránea de Las Minas de la Muerte, comanda las fuerzas piratas contratadas por la Hermandad Defias. Su objetivo es tener el buque de guerra listo para zarpar contra Ventormenta. El Capitán Verdetez, que patrulla la cubierta principal del gigantesco acorazado en construcción en la ensenada de Las Minas de la Muerte, representa la columna vertebral naval de la conspiración de los Defias. Verdetez, un avezado marinero goblin que operaba anteriormente desde Bahía del Botín, fue incorporado al círculo íntimo de Edwin VanCleef para transformar una caverna subterránea en un dique seco destinado a una máquina de guerra.

ang.class:Rogue: Greenskin stands at the apex of Defias piracy, heavily guarded by corsairs and brutes right on the warship's deck.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance forces, Captain Greenskin represents the maritime threat of the Defias rebellion; if his juggernaut breaches the coast, the undefended shores of Westfall and Stormwind are at direct risk.

faq.a: Captain Greenskin is a goblin pirate captain hired by Edwin VanCleef to supervise the completion and operation of the Defias Brotherhood's secret war juggernaut in the Deadmines.
faq.q: Who is Captain Greenskin?

faq.a: Greenskin originally hails from Booty Bay in the southern reaches of Stranglethorn Vale, where he formerly commanded a fleet of pirate vessels before entering VanCleef's pay.
faq.q: Where did Greenskin come from before joining the Defias?

faq.a: His command includes his first mate, the tauren Mr. Smite, as well as Cookie the murloc cook and a contingent of Defias pirates patrolling the ironclad's deck.
faq.q: Who serves under Captain Greenskin?

faq.a: He is tasked with making the massive ironclad warship seaworthy and prepared to sail out of the subterranean grotto into the Great Sea to strike at the kingdom of Stormwind.
faq.q: What is Greenskin's purpose in the Deadmines?

faq.a: He paces the main deck of the large juggernaut anchored in the final cavern of the Deadmines, guarding the approach to Edwin VanCleef.
faq.q: Where can Captain Greenskin be found?

faq.a: He is a mercenary pirate captain in the direct employ of Edwin VanCleef, commanding the naval forces aligned with the Defias Brotherhood's plot.
faq.q: Is Captain Greenskin part of the Defias Brotherhood or a mercenary?

text.s: Captain Greenskin is an elite goblin pirate overseeing the construction and crew of Edwin VanCleef's massive ironclad juggernaut. Hidden deep in the subterranean cove of the Deadmines, he commands the pirate forces hired by the Defias Brotherhood. His goal is to bring the warship to readiness to sail against Stormwind.

sec.b: Pacing the main deck of the gigantic juggernaut under construction in the Deadmines cove, Captain Greenskin represents the naval backbone of the Defias conspiracy. A seasoned goblin mariner who previously operated out of Booty Bay, Greenskin was brought into Edwin VanCleef's inner circle to turn an underground cavern into a drydock for an engine of war.

Greenskin does not command an ordinary crew of stonemasons or bandits. Under his direct watch serve seasoned cutthroats, including his fearsome tauren first mate Mr. Smite and the murloc ship's cook, Cookie. Together, they hold the ship's gangplanks and upper deck, standing between intruders and VanCleef's private cabin atop the bridge.

npc:captain-stoutfist.s: Capitán Puñorrecio. El Capitán Puñorrecio es el oficial enano al mando de las defensas militares en el Puerto de Menethil, en Los Humedales. Con el clan Faucedraco avanzando agresivamente desde sus fortalezas pantanosas, Puñorrecio coordina maniobras defensivas y contraofensivas para garantizar que este vital puerto de la Alianza no caiga. El Puerto de Menethil sirve como el principal puerto de aguas profundas que conecta Forjaz y Ventormenta con las tierras bajas pantanosas de Los Humedales y el mar más allá. Como oficial al mando de la localidad, el Capitán Puñorrecio soporta la pesada carga de mantener sus muelles, la población civil y la guarnición a salvo de las amenazas circundantes. Los pantanales son notoriamente peligrosos, pero el mayor peligro para el asentamiento es una oleada organizada de orcos renegados.

ang.class:Warrior: A no-nonsense dwarven tactician, Stoutfist values bold martial strikes over cautious fortification, putting warriors on the front line to dismantle enemy artillery and leadership.
ang.faction:Alliance: Captain Stoutfist holds the line at one of the Alliance's most crucial maritime hubs, keeping naval routes open between Khaz Modan, Stormwind, and distant outposts.
ang.race:Dwarf: Stoutfist represents the rugged resolve of Ironforge's military, entrusted with safeguarding vital lowlands infrastructure far below the safety of the mountain peaks.

faq.a: Captain Stoutfist is the dwarf military commander tasked with defending Menethil Harbor. He coordinates garrison defenses, assesses regional threats, and recruits volunteers to push back enemies targeting the port.
faq.q: Who is Captain Stoutfist?

faq.a: He is stationed inside Menethil Harbor, the main Alliance hub on the western coast of the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where is Captain Stoutfist located?

faq.a: The local garrison is stretched thin across the Wetlands. With Dragonmaw orcs seizing the mountain passes at Dun Algaz and encroaching on the town, Stoutfist lacks the regular manpower to launch offensive strikes and maintain harbor security simultaneously.
faq.q: Why does Captain Stoutfist need outside help?

faq.a: Nek'rosh Skullcrusher is the ruthless leader of the Dragonmaw orcs operating in the Wetlands. Captain Stoutfist orders his death to shatter the orcs' coordination and protect Menethil Harbor from an all-out assault.
faq.q: Who is Nek'rosh Skullcrusher?

faq.a: Dun Algaz is the vital mountain pass connecting Loch Modan and Ironforge to the Wetlands. When Dragonmaw orcs pushed into the pass, Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw warned that Menethil was endangered, redirecting adventurers to Stoutfist to help reinforce the harbor.
faq.q: How does Dun Algaz connect to Captain Stoutfist's mission?

faq.a: The Dragonmaw assembled siege weaponry to batter down fortifications and siege Menethil Harbor directly. Stoutfist directs champions to sabotage these catapults before they can be rolled into firing range.
faq.q: What threat do the Dragonmaw catapults pose?

text.s: Captain Stoutfist is the dwarven officer in charge of military defenses at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. With the Dragonmaw clan pushing aggressively out of their marshland strongholds, Stoutfist coordinates defensive maneuvers and counter-offensives to ensure the vital Alliance port does not fall.

sec.b: Menethil Harbor serves as the principal deepwater port connecting Ironforge and Stormwind to the marshy lowlands of the Wetlands and the sea beyond. As the town's commanding officer, Captain Stoutfist bears the heavy burden of keeping its docks, civilian populace, and garrison secure against surrounding threats. The marshlands are notoriously hazardous, but the biggest peril to the settlement is an organized surge from renegade orcs.

The Dragonmaw clan, entrenched within the Wetlands since the Second War, has begun pushing their operations directly toward the roadways and passes. By infiltrating Dun Algaz, they threaten to sever the overland lifeline connecting Loch Modan and Ironforge to Menethil Harbor. Facing a severe shortage of troops, Captain Stoutfist relies on visiting Alliance volunteers recommended by Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw to stem the tide.

Rather than waiting for a siege, Captain Stoutfist spearheads a aggressive campaign against the orc encampments. He directs allied forces to seize war banners near Whelgar's Excavation Site, sabotage Dragonmaw catapults preparing for an assault, and eliminate the clan's ruthless local chieftain, Nek'rosh Skullcrusher. By cutting down Nek'rosh, Stoutfist aims to break the spine of the orc offensive before Menethil Harbor is overwhelmed.

npc:chief-engineer-hinderweir-vii.s: Ingeniero Jefe Hinderweir VII. El Ingeniero Jefe Hinderweir VII es un veterano ingeniero enano apostado en lo alto de la Presa de las Tres Cabezas, en Loch Modan. Con la tarea de mantener y defender esta monumental hazaña de ingeniería, supervisa sus delicados mecanismos mientras vigila posibles sabotajes. Quienes hablan con él descubren rápidamente que graves peligros amenazan la integridad de la gran presa. La Presa de las Tres Cabezas es uno de los mayores logros de la cantería e ingeniería enanas, conteniendo las inmensas aguas de Loch Modan. El Ingeniero Jefe Hinderweir VII carga con la inmensa responsabilidad de mantener su estructura y su maquinaria operativa. Situado a lo largo de la cresta de la presa, vigila los canales fluviales, las compuertas y los puntos de tensión estructural frente a los elementos y los peligros locales.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Alliance cannot afford to let the dam fall; catastrophic failure would disrupt supply routes and devastate allied lands north of Loch Modan.
ang.profession:Engineering: Engineers can appreciate the sheer mechanical scale of Hinderweir's charge, as the Stonewrought Dam represents a peerless mix of civil architecture and mechanical control.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Hinderweir represents the solemn duty of preserving Khaz Modan's greatest stonecraft achievements against outside malice.

faq.a: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven supervisor in charge of maintaining and defending the Stonewrought Dam in northern Loch Modan.
faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?

faq.a: He can be found standing along the top walkway of the Stonewrought Dam, which spans the northern edge of Loch Modan near the border to the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where can I find Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?

faq.a: The Stonewrought Dam is a massive dwarven architectural wonder that holds back the waters of Loch Modan, preventing the lake from violently spilling into the lower wetlands to the north.
faq.q: What is the Stonewrought Dam?

faq.a: Hinderweir investigates active sabotage against the dam, discovering evidence of dark plots and explosive devices planted to crack its foundations.
al: who wants to destroy the dam
faq.q: What threats is Hinderweir worried about?

faq.a: VII is the Roman numeral for seven. The reason it appears in Hinderweir's name is unrecorded.
faq.q: Why does his name include 'VII'?

faq.a: He offers the quest chain 'A Dark Threat Looms', which directs adventurers to investigate tampering and protect the Stonewrought Dam from destruction.
faq.q: What quests does Chief Engineer Hinderweir offer?

text.s: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is a veteran dwarven engineer stationed atop the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. Tasked with the upkeep and defense of this monumental feat of engineering, he oversees its delicate mechanisms while keeping watch for sabotage. Those who speak with him quickly discover that grave dangers threaten the integrity of the great dam.

sec.b: The Stonewrought Dam is one of the crowning achievements of dwarven stonecraft and engineering, holding back the massive waters of the Loch. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII bears the immense responsibility of maintaining its structure and operational machinery. Perched along the crest of the dam, he monitors the waterways, sluice gates, and structural stress points against the elements and local hazards.

Running the dam is more than routine maintenance; dark forces continually test its defenses. Hinderweir uncovers signs of calculated sabotage orchestrated by hostile elements in the region. Aware that a catastrophic breach would flood the lowlands and devastate Khaz Modan's delicate infrastructure, the Chief Engineer enlists reliable Alliance adventurers to trace the conspiracy, disarm hidden explosives, and neutralize the threat before the stone gives way.

npc:chief-hawkwind.s: Jefe Vientaguilar. El Jefe Vientaguilar es el líder tribal del Campamento Narache, el terreno de pruebas enclavado en la Mesa de la Nube Roja de Mulgore. Responsable de guiar a la juventud de los Shu'halo, tutela a los nuevos aventureros mientras se embarcan en sus tradicionales ritos de iniciación. Bajo su atenta mirada, los jóvenes valientes aprenden humildad, respeto por la tierra y la fuerza necesaria para proteger a su pueblo. Erguido en el corazón del Campamento Narache, el Jefe Vientaguilar carga con la solemne responsabilidad de preparar a la próxima generación de tauren para el resto del mundo. La Mesa de la Nube Roja sirve como un refugio protegido donde los noveles cazadores, chamanes, druidas y guerreros emprenden los ancestrales Ritos de la Madre Tierra. Vientaguilar supervisa estas costumbres, asegurándose de que cada joven aprenda el deber y la resistencia antes de aventurarse más allá de la seguridad de la mesa.

ang.faction:Horde: Hawkwind's teachings ensure that newly raised tauren braves step forward not just as capable warriors and spellcasters, but as steadfast and honorable allies to the young Horde.
ang.race:Tauren: As the first chieftain to guide you on your journey, Chief Hawkwind instills the foundational values of the Shu'halo: reverence for the Earthmother, loyalty to the tribe, and humility in strength.

faq.a: Chief Hawkwind is the chieftain of Camp Narache in the Red Cloud Mesa. He oversees tribal matters in the area and mentors young tauren as they prepare to take their first steps into the wider world of Mulgore and Kalimdor.
al: who is the chief at camp narache
faq.q: Who is Chief Hawkwind?

faq.a: The Rites of the Earthmother are a traditional series of sacred trials undertaken by young tauren coming of age. Guided by elders like Chief Hawkwind, these rites test humility, strength, courage, and spiritual connection to the land and the ancestors.
faq.q: What are the Rites of the Earthmother?

faq.a: Hawkwind assigns 'A Humble Task' to remind young braves that service and respect for the community are as vital as martial strength. Gathering fresh water for tribal elders teaches patience and humility before initiates are sent into battle.
faq.q: Why does Chief Hawkwind have you fetch water first?

faq.a: Camp Narache is under constant pressure from hostile Bristleback quilboar who inhabit the surrounding hills of Red Cloud Mesa. Chief Hawkwind must organize the defense of the mesa and send initiates to thin the quillboar ranks.
faq.q: What threat is Camp Narache facing?

faq.a: Once a young brave completes the preliminary rites on the mesa, Chief Hawkwind directs them down into the sprawling valleys of Mulgore, sending them toward Bloodhoof Village to continue their trials under the guidance of Cairne Bloodhoof's elders.
al: where do i go after hawkwind
faq.q: Where does Chief Hawkwind send adventurers next?

faq.a: Yes, Greatmother Hawkwind is his mother. The Hawkwind family has long held deep roots and leadership roles among the tauren dwelling on Red Cloud Mesa.
faq.q: Is Chief Hawkwind related to Greatmother Hawkwind?

text.s: Chief Hawkwind is the tribal leader of Camp Narache, the proving grounds nestled in the Red Cloud Mesa of Mulgore. Responsible for guiding the youth of the Shu'halo, he mentors new adventurers as they embark on their traditional rites of passage. Under his watchful gaze, young braves learn humility, respect for the land, and the strength needed to protect their people.

sec.b: Standing at the heart of Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind carries the solemn responsibility of preparing the next generation of tauren for the wider world. Red Cloud Mesa serves as a sheltered haven where fledgling hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors undertake the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. Hawkwind oversees these customs, ensuring that every youth learns duty and endurance before venturing beyond the safety of the mesa.

Hawkwind's lessons begin with humility rather than martial glory. He sends initiates on simple chores, such as fetching clean spring water, to instill reverence for the natural world and their elders. Only after demonstrating a humble heart are braves guided toward tests of martial prowess, culminating in trials that test their resolve against the aggressive Bristleback quilboar encroaching upon the ancestral plains.

Beyond his role as a mentor, Chief Hawkwind must reckon with rising dangers right at his camp's doorstep. The Bristleback tribe has grown increasingly bold, pressing hard against the perimeter of Red Cloud Mesa. Hawkwind coordinates the defense of the settlement, tasking newly proven braves with blunting the quilboar assaults to ensure the sacred training grounds remain secure.

npc:clerk-daltry.s: Dependiente Daltry. El Dependiente Daltry es el encargado del registro civil destinado en ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura, en Bosque del Ocaso. Rodeado de libros de contabilidad y registros, ayuda a investigar el pasado de la villa y a localizar documentos históricos, aunque sus archivos estén algo descuidados y desactualizados. Mientras Villa Oscura lucha contra las bestias que la acechan, horrores no-muertos y una penumbra sobrenatural, los quehaceres cívicos cotidianos recaen en el Dependiente Daltry. Trabajando en el ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura junto a Lord Ello Cerranegro y el consejo local, Daltry mantiene los libros de cuentas históricos, los censos de propiedades y los datos del padrón de la villa. En una región fracturada por el desastre, sus registros figuran entre los pocos vínculos supervivientes con los días anteriores a que Grand Hamlet cayera en la sombra.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance investigators uncovering the sinister mysteries of Duskwood, Clerk Daltry is an essential bureaucratic contact for long-lost records and cold case files.
ang.race:Human: Daltry preserves what remains of the historical heritage of Grand Hamlet before the darkness descended upon the woodland realm.

faq.a: Clerk Daltry is found inside the Darkshire Town Hall, located in the central village of Darkshire in Duskwood. He stands amidst the town officials and council members, managing the municipal records.
faq.q: Where is Clerk Daltry located?

faq.a: He serves as Darkshire's civic clerk, tasked with preserving documents, town rolls, and legal registries. He assists adventurers who need archival information regarding former residents, land claims, or historical inquiries.
faq.q: What is Clerk Daltry's job in Darkshire?

faq.a: Duskwood has suffered years of isolation, magical corruption, and violent turmoil. With the town's focus consumed by immediate survival against the Night Watch's enemies, maintaining up-to-date ledgers has often fallen by the wayside, leaving his archives fragmented.
faq.q: Why are his records incomplete?

faq.a: Daltry is a crucial figure in 'The Legend of Stalvan' storyline, helping players track down the elusive past of Stalvan Mistmantle. He also assists with investigations such as 'The Carevin Family' and 'The Shadowy Search Continues'.
faq.q: What questlines does Clerk Daltry start or participate in?

faq.a: It is widely suspected they share family ties given their common surname and service roles, though Clerk Daltry stays strictly focused on his municipal duties in Darkshire.
faq.q: Is Clerk Daltry related to Surveyor Daltry?

faq.a: No. Clerk Daltry is an Alliance-affiliated municipal servant. Darkshire and its town hall are guarded by the Night Watch and hostile to all Horde adventurers.
faq.q: Can Horde players speak with Clerk Daltry?

text.s: Clerk Daltry is the civic record keeper stationed in Darkshire Town Hall in Duskwood. Surrounded by ledgers and registry books, he helps investigate the village's past and track down historical records, even if his archives are somewhat neglected and out of date.

sec.b: While Darkshire struggles against encroaching beasts, undead horrors, and supernatural gloom, everyday civic duties fall to Clerk Daltry. Working out of the Darkshire Town Hall alongside Lord Ello Ebonlocke and the local council, Daltry maintains the town's historical ledgers, property rolls, and census data. In a region fractured by disaster, his records are among the few surviving links to the days before Grand Hamlet fell into shadow.

Because Darkshire has been cut off from regular Stormwind administration, Daltry's record-keeping is notoriously imperfect. Old documents go missing, ledgers fall behind, and vital town files are frequently misplaced or damaged. Adventurers investigating local cold cases or long-lost residents frequently consult him, only to find that uncovering the truth requires digging through overlooked notes or venturing out into the dangerous woods to recover lost papers.

Daltry plays a central role in untangling the dark mystery of Stalvan Mistmantle. When an ominous family legend leads investigators back to Darkshire, Daltry searches his archives for records of the former schoolteacher. Because his town registry entries on Stalvan are fragmented, Daltry must send seekers across town and into forgotten homesteads across the kingdom to piece together the tragic and bloody truth.

npc:cliffwatcher-longhorn.s: Vigiarrisco Cuernolargo. El Vigiarrisco Cuernolargo es el estoico líder tauren apostado en lo alto de Poblado Viento Libre, en Las Mil Agujas. Con la tarea de salvaguardar el aislado puesto de avanzada de la Horda, coordina las defensas contra los invasores centauros Galak y vigila las sospechosas maquinaciones de la tribu Tótem Siniestro. Encaramado sobre las imponentes agujas de roca de Las Mil Agujas, Poblado Viento Libre depende de ojos avizores y un liderazgo firme para sobrevivir. El Vigiarrisco Cuernolargo supervisa la seguridad diaria de este precario asentamiento. Con fuerzas hostiles congregándose en el fondo del cañón y a lo largo de las crestas vecinas, Cuernolargo actúa como el principal coordinador del asentamiento para los informes de exploración y las labores defensivas militares.

ang.faction:Horde: Freewind Post is the vital link securing supply lines across southern Kalimdor, and Longhorn ensures the Horde retains its precarious foothold amidst hostile centaur territory.
ang.race:Tauren: For tauren travelers, Longhorn represents the frontier spirit of the Shu'halo, keeping watch over contested sacred mesas while navigating the bitter, unresolved friction with the Grimtotem tribe.

faq.a: Cliffwatcher Longhorn is the tauren authority figure in command of Freewind Post, the Horde's towering outpost in Thousand Needles. He organizes scouts, defense patrols, and responses to local threats.
faq.q: Who is Cliffwatcher Longhorn?

faq.a: He is located atop the main mesa of Freewind Post in Thousand Needles, accessible by taking the lift up from the canyon floor and crossing the wooden bridges.
faq.q: Where can I find Cliffwatcher Longhorn?

faq.a: Reports brought in by scouts like Brave Moonhorn show an alarming surge in Galak centaur hostility. Longhorn orders proactive strikes to pacify the clan and prevent them from overwhelming the outpost's approaches.
faq.q: Why is Longhorn concerned about the centaur?

faq.a: While technically living among the Horde, the Grimtotem clan behaves with open secrecy and malice. Longhorn suspects foul play and commissions adventurers to steal their hidden notes to discover what they are plotting.
faq.q: What is his interest in the Grimtotem tribe?

faq.a: Arnak Grimtotem carried out a violent attack against the post's inhabitants. Longhorn issues a bounty on his head to ensure Arnak faces justice for his treachery.
faq.q: Who is Arnak Grimtotem and why does Longhorn want him?

faq.a: Yes, his brother Nataka Longhorn is stationed far to the west at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Preoccupied with duty, Cliffwatcher rarely finds the opportunity to write him.
faq.q: Does Cliffwatcher Longhorn have any family?

text.s: Cliffwatcher Longhorn is the stoic tauren leader stationed high atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Tasked with safeguarding the isolated Horde outpost, he coordinates defenses against encroaching Galak centaur and monitors the suspicious machinations of the Grimtotem tribe.

sec.b: Perched upon the soaring rock spires of Thousand Needles, Freewind Post relies on sharp eyes and steady leadership to survive. Cliffwatcher Longhorn oversees the day-to-day security of this precarious settlement. With hostile forces gathering on the canyon floor below and along neighboring ridges, Longhorn acts as the settlement's primary coordinator for scouting reports and defensive military efforts.

Longhorn contends with threats on multiple fronts. Down in the canyon, the aggressive Galak centaur relentlessly probe the perimeter, prompting him to dispatch adventurers to push them back and curb their numbers. Even more troubling to him, however, are the Grimtotem tauren. Deeply distrustful of their secretive camp near the post, Longhorn arranges reconnaissance to seize their hidden notes, uncovering troubling evidence of internal treachery, including the violent crimes of Arnak Grimtotem.

npc:coleman-farthing.s: Coleman Lontananza. Coleman Lontananza es un amargado superviviente Renegado que reside en el Mesón La Horca en Rémol. En vida, trabajó para la acaudalada dinastía Agamand en sus extensos molinos de harina en el norte de Tirisfal. Convencido para quedarse y defender la finca contra la Plaga, murió junto a sus compañeros de trabajo y ahora dedica su no-muerte a cobrarse venganza de sus antiguos amos. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, Coleman Lontananza se ganaba honradamente la vida como obrero en los Molinos de Agamand, la mayor explotación agrícola y harinera de los Claros de Tirisfal. Cuando la Plaga arrasó Lordaeron, la aristocrática familia Agamand se negó a huir de sus valiosas tierras. En su lugar, instaron a sus sirvientes y peones a tomar las armas junto a ellos, prometiendo que podrían defender las granjas contra la horda de no-muertos. Coleman y sus compañeros se quedaron, confiando en sus señores, una decisión que les costó la vida a todos y cada uno de ellos.

ang.class:Warrior: Coleman points aspiring warriors directly toward the Agamand Family Crypt, urging them to plunder the martial heirlooms of a fallen aristocratic house to arm themselves for the wars ahead.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Coleman represents the shared resentment many commoners hold toward Lordaeron's old nobility, whose arrogance and pride often hastened their subjects' demise during the plague.

faq.a: Coleman Farthing spends his days inside the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, located in central Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where can Coleman Farthing be found?

faq.a: When the Scourge invaded Lordaeron, the Agamand patriarchs convinced their workers—including Coleman—to stay and fight to protect the mills rather than flee to safety. The entire workforce was slaughtered as a result. Coleman views their rallying cry as arrogant manipulation that led him directly to his death.
faq.q: Why does Coleman hate the Agamand family so much?

faq.a: The sprawling estate was completely overrun by the Scourge. Its wind-driven mills stand ruined and haunted, while the Agamand family members and their slaughtered workers wander the blighted fields as mindlessly hostile undead under the Lich King's sway.
faq.q: What happened to the Agamand Mills?

faq.a: Coleman directs adventurers to journey north to the Agamand Mills to cull the roaming undead, slay the risen members of the Agamand lineage to recover their remains for desecration, and raid the Agamand Family Crypt for ancestral weaponry.
