faq.q: What tasks does Coleman give to adventurers?

faq.a: Coleman sees the Agamands' ancestral weaponry as symbols of the hollow pride that led his fellow workers to their deaths. He sends skilled warriors to plunder these relics from the family crypt, both to strip the dynasty of its honor and put the weapons to practical use against their enemies.
faq.q: Why does Coleman want the Agamand heirloom weapons?

faq.a: They share a surname and origins in the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, but there is no confirmed record of their specific familial ties.
faq.q: Is Coleman Farthing related to Bishop Farthing?

text.s: Coleman Farthing is a bitter Forsaken survivor residing in the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. In life, he worked for the wealthy Agamand dynasty at their extensive flour mills in northern Tirisfal. Convinced to stay and defend the estate against the Scourge, he died alongside his fellow laborers, and now dedicates his undeath to exacting vengeance on his former masters.

sec.b: Before the Third War, Coleman Farthing earned an honest living as a laborer at the Agamand Mills, the largest milling and agricultural operation in Tirisfal Glades. When the Scourge poured across Lordaeron, the aristocratic Agamand family refused to flee their valuable lands. Instead, they urged their household and laborers to take up arms alongside them, promising they could hold the farmsteads against the undead horde. Coleman and his fellow workers stayed, believing their masters—a decision that cost every last one of them their lives.

Raised into undeath only to break free under the banner of the Forsaken, Coleman harbors a burning hatred for the Agamands. Rather than blaming only the Scourge, he blames the sheer hubris and greed of his employers for tricking their staff into an impossible last stand. Now loitering in Brill's tavern, Coleman enlists Horde champions to march into the blighted mills, cut down the risen Agamand kin, and shatter the heirloom relics housed within their family crypt so that their legacy is utterly erased.

npc:collin-mauren.s: Collin Mauren. Collin Mauren es un mago humano que reside en el Barrio de los Magos, en la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Como erudito investigador y creador de encantamientos, experimenta con componentes naturales exóticos para concebir hechizos de utilidad únicos. Entre sus ocupaciones está ayudar a su conocido, el ingeniero y explorador gnomo Gaxim Silvóxido, con pergaminos arcanos especializados. Ubicado en el bullicioso Barrio de los Magos de Ventormenta, Collin Mauren pasa sus días dedicándose a las aplicaciones más tranquilas y prácticas de la magia. En lugar de perseguir el poder elemental en estado puro, se centra en elaborar fórmulas arcanas que resuelvan problemas logísticos concretos. Collin suele recurrir a anomalías naturales y componentes brutos recolectados por todo Azeroth, entrelazando sus propiedades intrínsecas en pergaminos mágicos funcionales y reactivos tanto para amigos como para viajeros.

ang.class:Mage: Collin exemplifies the experimental craft of spell creation, demonstrating how earthly reagents like elemental debris and basilisk scales can be harnessed to weave utility magic.
ang.faction:Alliance: Collin facilitates communication and trade across the Alliance by supplying adventurers with utility magic spanning from Westfall to Kalimdor.
ang.race:Human: Living quietly in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin represents the scholarly pursuits of human wizards who study the broader world from the heart of the capital.

faq.a: Collin Mauren is located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City, tucked among the towers and shops frequented by the capital's arcane scholars.
faq.q: Where can Collin Mauren be found?

faq.a: Collin specializes in applied enchantments and utility spells. Rather than combat evocations, he experiments with raw natural components—such as elemental debris and beast scales—to devise long-distance messaging scrolls and unique dweomers.
faq.q: What kind of magic does Collin specialize in?

faq.a: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an adventurous gnome tinkerer and a friend of Collin. Collin supports Gaxim's distant journeys by providing him with custom-crafted communication scrolls.
faq.q: Who is Gaxim Rustfizzle and how is Collin connected to him?

faq.a: Collin uses the essence of Westfall's elemental Dust Devils to power a messaging spell. The windy debris of the elementals carries the harmonic energy required to craft reliable communication scrolls.
faq.q: Why does Collin need elemental debris from Westfall?

faq.a: Collin studies the magical properties of basilisk scales native to the Stonetalon Mountains in Kalimdor. He uses their sturdy, naturally resistant hides as reagent bases to synthesize new incantations.
faq.q: Why is Collin interested in the Stonetalon Mountains?

faq.a: While Collin resides in the Mage Quarter and practices the traditions common among Alliance wizards, he functions primarily as an independent researcher and reagent crafter rather than an active Dalaran representative.
faq.q: Is Collin aligned with the Kirin Tor?

text.s: Collin Mauren is a human mage residing in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. A scholarly researcher and crafter of incantations, he experiments with exotic natural reagents to devise unique utility spells. Among his pursuits is assisting his acquaintance, the gnome engineer and explorer Gaxim Rustfizzle, with specialized arcane scrolls.

sec.b: Situated within Stormwind's bustling Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren spends his days pursuing the quieter, more practical applications of magic. Rather than chasing raw elemental power, he focuses on crafting arcane formulas that solve specific, logistical problems. Collin often turns to natural anomalies and raw components scavenged across Azeroth, weaving their intrinsic properties into functional magic scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers alike.

Collin maintains a close correspondence and friendship with the gnomish tinker Gaxim Rustfizzle. When Gaxim needed a reliable way to communicate across great distances during his travels, Collin designed a specialized messaging spell. To anchor the spell, he utilizes the whirling debris left behind by Westfall's erratic Dust Devils, capturing the essence of shifting wind to ensure long-distance messages reach his adventurous colleague.

Beyond his work with local elementals, Collin's research extends clear across the Great Sea to the crags of Kalimdor. Curiously captivated by the resilient hides of basilisks native to the Stonetalon Mountains, Collin seeks out their scales to synthesize new spells. Travelers venturing into Kalimdor frequently receive his requests for these rare hides, fueling Collin's ongoing fascination with how primal creature anatomy can stabilize complex enchantments.

npc:cookie.s: El Chef. El Chef es un múrloc de élite que ejerce de cocinero del barco a bordo del acorazado oculto en lo profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte. Un recluta inusual dentro de la Hermandad Defias, cuida los calderos de la tripulación bajo la atenta mirada del Capitán Verdetez y de Edwin VanCleef. Es el único jefe completamente opcional que se encuentra en el dique seco subterráneo. Bajo las cubiertas del imponente acorazado en la Cala del Acorazado, las tareas culinarias no recaen en un batidor humano ni en un ingeniero goblin, sino en un múrloc solitario conocido simplemente como El Chef. La forma en que consiguió el puesto sigue siendo un secreto que solo guarda el mismísimo Edwin VanCleef. Sean cuales sean las dudas que el resto de la tripulación pueda albergar acerca de que un múrloc gestione sus raciones, los piratas rara vez están en posición de ser quisquillosos, y en los bajos fondos de Arroyo de la Luna, comida es comida.

ang.class:Rogue: VanCleef's rogue network relies on strange, unconventional assets, and Cookie proves that even the Brotherhood's supply lines feature odd surprises.
ang.faction:Alliance: Stormwind's scouts are often surprised to find murlocs actively working within the Defias leadership rather than merely infesting Westfall's outer shores.
ang.profession:Cooking: Finding a murloc appointed as chief cook aboard an outlaw juggernaut is a testament to the desperate, unrefined standards of pirate cuisine.

faq.a: Edwin VanCleef is the only one who knows why Cookie was recruited and granted the galley duties. The Defias outlaws and goblin shipwrights simply accept the arrangement because pirate crews take food where they can get it, regardless of the chef's species.
al: why is cookie on the ship
faq.q: Why is a murloc working as a cook for the Defias?

faq.a: Cookie is located in the Ironclad Cove at the very end of the Deadmines. He patrols the shallow water and docks near the stern of the giant wooden juggernaut, just past the ramp where Mr. Smite stands guard.
faq.q: Where can Cookie be found in the Deadmines?

faq.a: No, Cookie is the only optional boss in the dungeon. Infiltrators can board the vessel directly to confront Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef without ever disturbing the cook's patrol along the shore.
al: do you have to kill cookie
faq.q: Is Cookie required to finish the Deadmines?

faq.a: Cookie is not associated with any of the known local murloc tribes, such as those along the Westfall coast. He lives and works entirely among the outlaws and scoundrels of the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: Does Cookie belong to a specific murloc tribe?

faq.a: Cookie wields cooking implements in melee combat and can hurl caustic splashes of acid at attackers, burning them with dangerous culinary mixtures.
faq.q: What weapons or attacks does Cookie use?

faq.a: Cookie directly serves the naval arm of the Defias Brotherhood under the command of Captain Greenskin, answering ultimately to Edwin VanCleef himself.
faq.q: Who does Cookie report to on the juggernaut?

text.s: Cookie is an elite murloc serving as the ship's cook aboard the juggernaut hidden deep within the Deadmines. An unusual recruit among the Defias Brotherhood, he tends the crew's cauldrons beneath the watchful eye of Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef. He is the only entirely optional boss encountered within the underground dry dock.

sec.b: Beneath the decks of the towering juggernaut in the Ironclad Cove, cooking duty falls neither to a human outrider nor a goblin engineer, but to a solitary murloc known simply as Cookie. How he secured the position remains a private secret kept by Edwin VanCleef himself. Whatever doubts the rest of the crew might harbor about a murloc presiding over their rations, pirates are rarely in a position to be picky, and in the underworld of Moonbrook, a meal is a meal.

Cookie patrols the waterways and shores around the pirate flagship, wielding his cooking utensils alongside acidic brews. Despite being isolated from typical murloc tribes, he defends his cauldron with savage ferocity, flinging caustic concoctions at any intruders who wander into the docks. Because his station sits away from the main gangplanks, many who storm the cove bypass his kitchen entirely, making him the only optional overseer aboard the Defias juggernaut.

npc:corithras-moonrage.s: Coriithas Furia Lunar. Coriithas Furia Lunar es un erudito elfo de la noche y asignador de misiones apostado en la aldea de Dolanaar, en Teldrassil. Guía a los aventureros recién llegados para que comprendan la naturaleza del gran Árbol del Mundo y les encomienda la tarea de mantener sus pozos de la luna sagrados. A través de sus enseñanzas, revela tanto la importancia espiritual de Teldrassil como las crecientes cargas que soportan los kaldorei. Afincado en el sombrío asentamiento de Dolanaar, Coriithas Furia Lunar ejerce de instructor para los viajeros que abandonan los confines protegidos de Cañada Umbría. A medida que los jóvenes kaldorei se adentran en las ramas más extensas de Teldrassil, Coriithas se asegura de que comprendan la historia de su nuevo hogar. Enseña que sobrevivir en esta era cambiante requiere vigilancia y reverencia hacia el orden natural.

ang.class:Druid: Druids will find Corithras's tasks deeply connected to their calling, as his moonwell rites directly track the health and creeping ailments of the World Tree.
ang.class:Priest: Priests of Elune assist Corithras in carrying the blessed waters of the moonwells, maintaining the spiritual and physical harmony of Dolanaar's surrounding wilds.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, speaking with Corithras is a foundational lesson in the post-Third War reality, confronting the loss of ancient immortality and the disputed creation of Teldrassil.

faq.a: Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar located in Dolanaar. He introduces adventurers to the history of Teldrassil and tasks them with tending to the sacred moonwells and testing the waters of the World Tree.
faq.q: Who is Corithras Moonrage?

faq.a: He can be found standing outdoors in Dolanaar, the central crossroads village situated in the southern reaches of Teldrassil.
faq.q: Where can Corithras Moonrage be found?

faq.a: The Crown of the Earth quests involve drawing water from moonwells across Teldrassil. Corithras combines the collected water for delivery to Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, where the druids need to replenish their moonwell.
faq.q: What is the Crown of the Earth questline about?

faq.a: Corithras shares the history of how Teldrassil was planted after the Third War to restore night elven immortality. Because the Dragon Aspects refused to bless the tree, Corithras remains acutely aware that the tree lacks divine protection and that his people remain mortal.
faq.q: Why is Corithras concerned about Teldrassil's origins?

faq.a: He imparts lessons on the recent sacrifices of the Third War, the founding of Teldrassil, and the responsibility each kaldorei bears to defend their new woodland home.
faq.q: What does Corithras teach new adventurers?

faq.a: He serves as a loyal citizen and scholar of Darnassus in Dolanaar, working closely with druids and priests alike to monitor the well-being of the forest and its waters.
faq.q: Is Corithras aligned with the Cenarion Circle or Darnassus?

text.s: Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar and quest giver stationed in the village of Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He guides newly arrived adventurers in understanding the nature of the great World Tree and tasks them with maintaining its sacred moonwells. Through his lessons, he reveals both the spiritual importance of Teldrassil and the growing burdens carried by the kaldorei.

sec.b: Residing in the shaded settlement of Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage serves as an instructor to travelers leaving the sheltered bounds of Shadowglen. As young kaldorei venture into the wider boughs of Teldrassil, Corithras ensures they understand the history of their new home. He teaches that survival in this changing era requires vigilance and reverence for the natural order.

Much of Corithras's duty revolves around collecting moonwell water for the druids in Darnassus. He directs adventurers to collect pure waters from moonwells across Teldrassil in specially crafted phials for delivery to Fandral Staghelm. Through these trials, he monitors the health of the World Tree and seeks to maintain the delicate balance of the wilderness against creeping corruption.

Beneath Corithras's guidance lies an uneasy truth regarding Teldrassil's creation. Unlike the ancient Nordrassil, this new World Tree was raised without the blessings of the Dragon Aspects, who refused Fandral Staghelm's ambitious creation. Corithras reflects on the loss of night elven immortality and the fragile, uncertain future the kaldorei now face under the boughs of an unblessed bough.

npc:dalar-dawnweaver.s: Dalar Tejalba. Dalar Tejalba es un antiguo archimago de Dalaran que ahora sirve a los Renegados en El Sepulcro, en el Bosque de Argénteos. Asesinado durante la destrucción de la ciudad de los magos a manos de la Plaga y liberado más tarde del control del Rey Exánime, enfoca su intelecto mágico en analizar las amenazas regionales. Desde las sombras de la tumba, dirige los esfuerzos para comprender la persistente presencia de Dalaran y poner fin a la locura del archimago Arugal. En vida, Dalar Tejalba ostentaba un alto rango en el Kirin Tor y recorría las estancias de la Ciudadela Violeta cuando Dalaran era la cumbre del dominio arcano. Su vida mortal llegó a su fin cuando la Plaga saqueó la ciudad para preparar la invocación de Archimonde. Reanimado como un siervo descerebrado del Rey Exánime, Dalar se liberó junto a Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz cuando el dominio de la Plaga decayó. Ahora apostado en El Sepulcro, conserva el agudo intelecto de un archimago, volcado por completo en proteger el reino de los Renegados.

ang.class:Mage: Forsaken mages will find in Dalar a dark mirror of Dalaran's former grandeur, demonstrating how Kirin Tor training can be weaponized in service to the Dark Lady.
ang.faction:Horde: Stationed at the Sepulcher, Dalar secures the Horde's western frontier by coordinating strikes against the worgen of Shadowfang Keep and hostile Kirin Tor enclaves.
ang.race:Undead: Dalar exemplifies the reclaimed agency of the Forsaken, turning the very knowledge he possessed in life against Dalaran remnants and rogue wizards who threaten their sovereignty.

faq.a: Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken mage found at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. In life, he was an archmage of the Kirin Tor in Dalaran. After dying during the Third War and being raised by the Scourge, he broke free of the Lich King's control to serve the Dark Lady.
faq.q: Who is Dalar Dawnweaver?

faq.a: Dalar was present in Dalaran when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge invaded to recover the Book of Medivh. Slain during the assault as Kel'Thuzad summoned Archimonde into Azeroth, Dalar was raised into undeath as a servant of the Scourge until Sylvanas liberated him.
faq.q: What happened to him during the Third War?

faq.a: He serves as the local arcane authority for the Forsaken in Silverpine Forest. His historical familiarity with both the Kirin Tor forces occupying Ambermill and his former peer, Archmage Arugal, makes him ideally suited to counter those threats.
faq.q: Why is Dalar stationed at the Sepulcher?

faq.a: Both were mages of the Kirin Tor in Dalaran before its fall. Dalar recognizes the tragic descent and lethal danger of Arugal's summoning experiments in Shadowfang Keep, tasking adventurers with gathering relics of Arugal's folly and ultimately demanding the mad mage's death.
faq.q: What is Dalar's connection to Archmage Arugal?

faq.a: Dalar keeps a watchful eye on his former homeland and the surviving Kirin Tor forces stationed at Ambermill. He directs agents to intercept their communications and analyze their intentions to ensure they cannot threaten the Forsaken in Silverpine.
faq.q: What does Dalar want with Dalaran's remnants?

faq.a: No. While he was once an archmage among them, his loyalty now lies with the Forsaken and the Horde. He actively opposes the surviving Kirin Tor forces operating within Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Is Dalar aligned with the Kirin Tor?

text.s: Dalar Dawnweaver is a former archmage of Dalaran who now serves the Forsaken at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Slain during the Scourge's destruction of the magi's city and later freed from the Lich King's control, he turns his magical intellect toward dissecting regional threats. From the shadows of the tomb, he directs efforts to understand Dalaran's lingering presence and undo the madness of Archmage Arugal.

sec.b: In life, Dalar Dawnweaver held high rank among the Kirin Tor, walking the halls of the Violet Citadel when Dalaran was a pinnacle of arcane mastery. His mortal life ended when the Scourge sacked the city to pave the way for Archimonde's summoning. Reanimated into the mindless thrall of the Lich King, Dalar broke free alongside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner when the Scourge's grip faltered. Now stationed at the Sepulcher, he retains the piercing intellect of an archmage, turned entirely toward safeguarding the Forsaken realm.

Silverpine Forest is caught between multiple perils, and Dalar serves as the Sepulcher's arcane strategist. To the south, Dalaran wizards occupy Ambermill under a protective dome, meddling in matters Dalar seeks to uncover and disrupt. Even closer looms Shadowfang Keep and the feral worgen loosed upon the woods. Dalar possesses intimate knowledge of his former colleague, Archmage Arugal, and meticulously orchestrates campaigns to neutralize Arugal's beastly creations before they overrun the region.

npc:daphne-stilwell.s: Daphne Fontana. Daphne Fontana cuida de un huerto aislado en lo alto de los acantilados costeros de Páramos de Poniente con vistas a Playa Larga. Junto a su esposo Jordan, huyó del caos del norte y se trasladó al sur, colaborando discretamente con la Iglesia de la Luz Sagrada mientras defiende su hogar de los forajidos de los alrededores. Encaramada a los riscos al oeste de Arroyo de la Luna y la salida de Las Minas de la Muerte, Daphne Fontana regenta una granja y un huerto de manzanos retirados. Desde abajo, a lo largo de Playa Larga, o desde arriba en las rutas de grifos hacia el sur rumbo a la Vega de Tuercespina, la pequeña granja parece tranquila y modesta. Sin embargo, llevar una hacienda en los Páramos de Poniente actuales dista mucho de ser seguro. A pesar del asedio de los bandidos y los carroñeros errantes, Daphne trabaja con esmero sus árboles y vigila su aislado pedazo de tierra.

ang.class:Paladin: Daphne Stilwell is a vital figure in the trials of the Tome of Valor; defending her from ruthless Defias marauders proves a paladin's devotion to protecting the innocent.
ang.faction:Alliance: The Stilwells embody the plight of displaced northern refugees who continue to serve the Alliance and the Church of the Holy Light despite the perils of the Westfall frontier.

faq.a: Daphne Stilwell is a human homesteader living in an isolated farmhouse above Westfall's Longshore. She is the wife of the famed blacksmith Jordan Stilwell, with whom she escaped the devastated northern kingdoms.
faq.q: Who is Daphne Stilwell?

faq.a: Daphne previously lived in the north near Pyrewood Village and worked at what is now known as Shadowfang Keep before calamity drove her and Jordan southward to the lands of Stormwind.
faq.q: Where did Daphne come from?

faq.a: Her farm sits on the cliffs directly overlooking the southern waters of Westfall, right above the exit tunnels of the Deadmines. Its proximity to the Defias stronghold makes it an easy target for outlaws looking to raid supplies or remove meddlers.
faq.q: Why is her farm attacked by the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Her husband Jordan aids the Church of the Holy Light by forging sanctified weapons. As part of their trials for the Tome of Valor, paladins of the Silver Hand are dispatched to Westfall to safeguard Daphne from bandit attacks.
faq.q: What is Daphne's connection to paladins?

faq.a: Yes. When the Defias assault her orchard, she does not cower; she draws a weapon and directly battles the attackers alongside any paladins defending the homestead.
faq.q: Can Daphne defend herself?

faq.a: Her farm is tucked on the clifftops of south-western Westfall, situated southwest of Moonbrook near the Deadmines secret cove exit overlooking the Longshore.
al: how to get to stilwell farm
faq.q: How do you reach her farmhouse?

text.s: Daphne Stilwell tends an isolated orchard nestled atop the coastal cliffs of Westfall overlooking the Longshore. Together with her husband Jordan, she fled turmoil in the north and relocated south, quietly aiding the Church of the Holy Light while defending her home from nearby outlaws.

sec.b: Perched on the bluffs to the west of Moonbrook and the exit of the Deadmines, Daphne Stilwell manages a secluded homestead and apple orchard. From below along the Longshore or above on gryphon routes south to Stranglethorn Vale, the small farm looks quiet and unassuming. Yet running a homestead in modern Westfall is anything but safe. Despite the encroaching bandits and roaming scavengers, Daphne diligently works her trees and keeps watch over her isolated patch of land.

Before settling in the hills of Westfall, Daphne and her husband Jordan lived in Lordaeron near Pyrewood Village, working in what is now Shadowfang Keep. When darkness and disaster overtook the region, they were driven southward along with thousands of other human refugees. In Stormwind's orbit, Jordan's renowned craftsmanship and Daphne's steady presence led them to forge close ties with the Church of the Holy Light, providing support and holy arms to paladins of the Silver Hand.

Living so close to the Deadmines puts Daphne square in the path of the Defias Brotherhood. While Jordan travels or labors on forging holy weaponry outside the capital, Daphne is frequently left to maintain their coastal home alone. When brigands raided the farmstead seeking retribution or plunder, Daphne picked up arms and fought alongside aspiring paladins sent by the Cathedral, proving herself remarkably fierce and capable in the heat of battle.

npc:darsok-swiftdagger.s: Darsok Movedaga. Darsok Movedaga es un guerrero y explorador orco apostado en El Cruce, en pleno corazón de Los Baldíos. Conocido por su feroz odio hacia las arpías, dirige a los aventureros de la Horda hacia el norte, a Las Colinas Áridas, para desarticular el matriarcado aviar que hostiga a viajeros y asentamientos. Mantiene contactos por todas las llanuras y actúa como un intermediario de confianza para el médico brujo Jin'Zil en Malaka'jin. En medio del bullicioso enclave de El Cruce, Darsok Movedaga vigila atentamente las amenazas que surgen del matorral septentrional. La arteria comercial que conecta Durotar, Mulgore y las regiones del norte se encuentra bajo un asedio constante, no solo por parte de saqueadores y centauros, sino también de cazadoras aéreas organizadas. Darsok concentra su ira en las arpías Alabruja, cuyos nidos en Las Colinas Áridas, al noroeste de Las Charcas del Olvido, amenazan directamente a las caravanas del norte.

ang.class:Rogue: Living up to the name Swiftdagger, Darsok favors precise, lethal decapitation strikes against enemy leadership rather than grinding attrition.
ang.faction:Horde: For Horde travelers, Darsok provides crucial early tactical missions that secure the crossroads trade routes against aerial ambush.
ang.race:Orc: Darsok exemplifies the focused, martial mindset of orcs tasked with taming and securing Kalimdor's perilous frontier.

faq.a: Darsok Swiftdagger is stationed in the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He stands ready to direct passing travelers toward northern threats.
faq.q: Where is Darsok Swiftdagger located?

faq.a: The Witchwing harpies roost in the canyons northwest of the Forgotten Pools and pose a constant predatory danger to Horde caravans, travelers, and scouts moving along the northern trails of the Barrens.
faq.q: Why is Darsok hunting harpies?

faq.a: Serena Bloodfeather is the cruel matriarch leading the Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills. Darsok tasks adventurers with slaying her to shatter the cohesion and command of the flock.
faq.q: Who is Serena Bloodfeather?

faq.a: Darsok is an ally and correspondent of Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, a Darkspear troll stationed at Malaka'jin. He facilitates communications and sends adventurers carrying missives to Jin'Zil's remote encampment.
faq.q: What is Darsok's connection to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?

faq.a: Darsok organizes his harpy campaign from the Crossroads. No Classic source here identifies either Sergra Darkthorn or Thork as his direct superior.
faq.q: Does Darsok report to Sergra Darkthorn or Thork?

faq.a: The Witchwing harpies roost in the Dry Hills, a series of jagged ravines and cliffs situated northwest of the Forgotten Pools in the northern reaches of the Barrens.
faq.q: Where do the Witchwing harpies nest?

text.s: Darsok Swiftdagger is an orc warrior and scout stationed at the Crossroads in the heart of the Barrens. Known for his fierce hatred of harpies, he directs Horde adventurers north into the Dry Hills to break the avian matriarchy harassing travelers and settlements. He maintains ties across the plains, serving as a trusted contact for Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin.

sec.b: Amid the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger keeps a sharp eye on the threats creeping out of the northern scrubland. The trade artery connecting Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern reaches is under constant siege, not only from raiders and centaur, but from organized aerial hunters. Darsok focuses his wrath on the Witchwing harpies, whose roosts in the Dry Hills northwest of the Forgotten Pools directly threaten northern caravans.

Darsok does not merely defend the roads; he coordinates targeted strikes deep into harpy territory. His campaign begins by thinning the aggressive Harpy Raiders before tasking hardened fighters with executing lieutenants and ultimately taking the head of their matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather. By systematically dismantling their leadership, Swiftdagger aims to leave the predatory flock broken and scattered across the crags.

While his immediate duties center around harpy eradication, Darsok Swiftdagger serves as an important point of contact within the Horde network. He maintains correspondence with Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, the enigmatic troll residing at Malaka'jin on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains. Messages and intelligence carried through Darsok help ensure that outlying enclaves stay informed of developments across the central plains.

npc:deathguard-dillinger.s: Guardia de la Muerte Dillinger. El Guardia de la Muerte Dillinger es un centinela Renegado apostado en Rémol, en los Claros de Tirisfal. Vigilando el perímetro de la villa, orienta a los no-muertos recién llegados hacia los servicios necesarios y encomienda a los reclutas la tarea de mantener a raya a los restos locales de la Plaga. Como miembro de la Guardia de la Muerte de los Renegados, Dillinger hace guardia a la entrada de Rémol, sirviendo tanto de protector de primera línea como de guía de orientación para los viajeros que salen de Camposanto. Proporciona indicaciones hacia los servicios del pueblo, como la posada, el ayuntamiento y los instructores locales, ayudando a los no-muertos recién despertados a orientarse en su nueva realidad bajo el mandato de la Dama Oscura.

ang.class:Warrior: Aspiring Forsaken warriors frequently work directly with Dillinger to test their martial mettle against the ferocious ghouls and skeletal horrors prowling the outskirts of Brill.
ang.faction:Horde: Dillinger represents the Forsaken's struggle to carve out a secure foothold in northern Lordaeron, showing Horde allies the relentless menace posed by mindless Scourge at their doorsteps.
ang.race:Undead: For newly freed Forsaken arriving from Deathknell, Dillinger is often the first face of military authority they meet, directing them toward training and their first duties in service of Sylvanas.

faq.a: Deathguard Dillinger is posted on the outskirts of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades, watching the path leading into town.
faq.q: Where can I find Deathguard Dillinger?

faq.a: The Deathguard serves as the military standing army and constabulary of the Forsaken, guarding settlements like Brill and the Undercity against the Scourge, the Scarlet Crusade, and other regional threats.
faq.q: What is the role of the Deathguard?

faq.a: Dillinger tasks adventurers with slaying mindless Scourge wandering the surrounding fields and mills, reclaiming vital local infrastructure, and dealing with dangerous entities like Ulag the Cleaver.
faq.q: What tasks does Deathguard Dillinger offer?

faq.a: Yes, speaking with Dillinger allows players to request directions to essential services, profession trainers, and class mentors located throughout Brill.
faq.q: Can Deathguard Dillinger provide directions?

faq.a: The mindless undead wandering Tirisfal remain under the thrall of the Scourge and the Lich King. Having broken free of that mental control, the Forsaken must eliminate these feral remnants to protect their own territory.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken fighting other undead near Brill?

faq.a: Ulag the Cleaver is a dangerous Scourge horror tied to nearby tombs outside Brill. Dillinger coordinates with Forsaken recruits to summon and destroy Ulag to keep the surrounding area safe.
faq.q: Who is Ulag the Cleaver?

text.s: Deathguard Dillinger is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Standing watch over the town's perimeter, he directs newly arrived undead toward necessary services and tasks recruits with keeping the local Scourge remnants at bay.

sec.b: As a member of the Forsaken Deathguard, Dillinger stands at the entrance of Brill, serving as both a frontline protector and an orienting guide for travelers emerging from Deathknell. He provides directions to town amenities such as the inn, the town hall, and local trainers, helping newly awakened undead navigate their new reality under the Dark Lady's rule.

Dillinger actively enlists capable adventurers to purge lingering mindless Scourge from the nearby farms and mills. Through assignments like cullling rotting ghouls and reclaiming infested facilities, he seeks to establish a buffer zone of security around Brill, ensuring the fledgling Forsaken settlements can endure against unending undead predation.

Beyond routine patrols, Dillinger coordinates responses against persistent Scourge threats lurking in the ruins around Brill. When summoned horrors such as Ulag the Cleaver emerge from nearby tombs or neglected homesteads, Dillinger ensures able fighters are dispatched to put the rampaging monstrosities down before they breach the settlement's borders.

npc:delgren-the-purifier.s: Delgren el Purificador. Delgren el Purificador es un paladín humano apostado en la Atalaya de Maestra, en el extremo norte de Vallefresno. Junto a sus camaradas Balthule Golpesombra y Feero Ferramán, ayuda a los elfos de la noche a purgar la magia demoníaca y la Magia de las Sombras que amenazan la frontera, centrándose en particular en el siniestro Culto de la Facción Oscura. Los paladines humanos son una visión poco común en las profundidades de los antiguos bosques de Kalimdor, pero Delgren el Purificador llegó con una misión. Vinculado al Alba Argenta, Delgren viajó hacia el oeste con un destacamento de guerreros sagrados decididos a prestar ayuda a los nuevos aliados elfos de la noche de la Alianza frente a los males residuales de demonios y vestigios de no-muertos de la Tercera Guerra. Apostado cerca de la frontera entre Costa Oscura y Vallefresno, mantiene una constante vigilancia sobre los viajeros que avanzan hacia el sur desde Auberdine.

ang.class:Paladin: Delgren represents the far reach of the Holy Light on Kalimdor, demonstrating how paladins adapt their crusade against demons and dark magic far beyond the Eastern Kingdoms.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers heading south from Darkshore, Delgren and his companions provide a reassuring military foothold along the dangerous Ashenvale road.
ang.race:NightElf: Though traditional kaldorei are often skeptical of foreign creeds, Delgren's company has earned trust through their practical crusade against the demonic cults troubling ancient ruins.

faq.a: Delgren is a human paladin stationed at Maestra's Post along the road in northern Ashenvale. As an agent of the Argent Dawn, he assists the night elves in defending their lands from demonic corruption, cultists, and lingering shadows left in the wake of the Legion's invasion.
al: who is the paladin at maestras post
faq.q: Who is Delgren the Purifier?

faq.a: Delgren stands at Maestra's Post, a small night elven outpost in northwestern Ashenvale just south of the border trail leading into Darkshore.
faq.q: Where can I find Delgren?

faq.a: Delgren journeyed west with a company of Argent Dawn paladins to offer aid to the Alliance's night elven allies. Their purpose is to help purge demonic incursions, undead remnants, and dark cults that threaten northern Kalimdor.
al: why are there humans in ashenvale
faq.q: Why is a human paladin all the way out in Ashenvale?

faq.a: Delgren and his companions monitor the corrupt activities radiating from the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. He directs adventurers to investigate the ruin, hunt the Cult of the Dark Strand, and dismantle their dark summoning practices.
faq.q: What is Delgren's connection to the Tower of Althalaxx?

faq.a: Delgren learned Orcish to better comprehend the situation and inhabitants of Kalimdor, a decision that earned him notable disapproval from his superiors within the order.
faq.q: Why did Delgren learn Orcish?

faq.a: He operates alongside Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand, working as a coordinated unit to monitor border threats, handle logistics, and purge shadow cultists along the Ashenvale frontier.
faq.q: Who does Delgren work with at Maestra's Post?

text.s: Delgren the Purifier is a human paladin stationed at Maestra's Post on the northern edge of Ashenvale. Operating alongside comrades Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand, he aids the night elves in cleansing demonic and shadow magic threatening the frontier, with a particular focus on the sinister Cult of the Dark Strand.

sec.b: Human paladins are a rare sight deep within the ancient forests of Kalimdor, but Delgren the Purifier arrived with a mission. Affiliated with the Argent Dawn, Delgren traveled west with a cadre of holy warriors determined to assist the Alliance's new night elf allies against the lingering evils of demons and undead remnants from the Third War. Stationed near the border of Darkshore and Ashenvale, he maintains a watchful vigil over travelers passing south from Auberdine.
sec.t: A Crusader on the Kaldorei Frontier

sec.b: Delgren's immediate crusade pits him directly against the Cult of the Dark Strand, a malevolent cabal operating around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. Teaming with the scout Balthule Shadowstrike, Delgren orchestrates strikes into the cult's territory, investigating their dark rituals and sending adventurers to strike down cultists, shatter their summoning focuses, and root out corrupt warlocks who dare traffic with demonic shadow.

Despite his fierce devotion to the Holy Light and zealous nickname, Delgren possesses an unusual perspective on Kalimdor's tangled politics. Much to the annoyance and disdain of his conservative superiors, he took the time to learn Orcish. This rare linguistic skill hints at an unconventional mind—one that seeks to understand the enemies and neighbors sharing this untamed continent rather than relying solely on blind dogma.

npc:denalan.s: Denalan. Denalan es un consumado herborista y botánico elfo de la noche que cuida de una tranquila parcela junto a la orilla oriental del Lago Al'Ameth. Al abrigo de un modesto toldo, consagra sus días al estudio de la flora de la isla y a buscar remedios botánicos para la extraña corrupción que aqueja a Teldrassil. A menudo recurre a jóvenes aventureros para recolectar muestras, estudiar a los violentos brezomaderas y probar tierras encantadas. Mientras muchos kaldorei se centran en la vigilancia marcial o en los grandes ritos druídicos, Denalan cultiva el paciente y meticuloso oficio de la botánica. Asentado en las serenas orillas orientales del Lago Al'Ameth, ha levantado un modesto campamento de investigación provisto de un toldo de tela, aperos sencillos y ordenadas hileras de jardineras de cultivo. En vez de retirarse a los majestuosos túmulos de Darnassus, prefiere permanecer pegado a la tierra para examinar de primera mano la insólita vegetación que ha brotado tras la plantación del nuevo Árbol del Mundo.

ang.class:Druid: Druids will find common cause with Denalan's lakeside experiments, as his work directly assists the Cenarion Circle's efforts to trace and purge the taint spreading through Teldrassil's roots.
ang.profession:Herbalism: Denalan exemplifies the kaldorei tradition of botanical study, demonstrating how gathering and cultivating wild plants can diagnose deeper ailments in the natural world.
ang.race:NightElf: Denalan's research at Lake Al'Ameth represents early kaldorei attempts to understand the unexpected flaws and growing pains of their new home, Teldrassil.

faq.a: Denalan is located on the eastern bank of Lake Al'Ameth in southern Teldrassil, south of Dolanaar. He maintains a small camp with an awning and several cultivated planting beds right near the water's edge.
faq.q: Where can I find Denalan?

faq.a: Denalan is an herbalist studying the unusual flora of Teldrassil and the aggressive behavior of local woodland spirits. He uses enchanted planter boxes to grow timberling seeds, analyze curious wild plant specimens, and find ways to cleanse corruption seeping into the new World Tree's ecosystem.
al: why is denalan at the lake
faq.q: What is Denalan researching at his campsite?

faq.a: Timberlings are plant-like nature spirits native to the boughs of Teldrassil. Normally peaceful parts of the forest ecology, they have become violent and erratic due to an unnatural corruption spreading through the soil and roots of the World Tree, prompting researchers like Denalan to investigate their seeds.
faq.q: Why are the timberlings attacking people?

faq.a: Denalan keeps specially prepared planter beds filled with enchanted earth. He uses them to cultivate wild seeds and strange botanical cuttings, allowing him to safely observe how the forest's flora reacts to purified soil away from wild contaminants.
faq.q: What are Denalan's planter boxes used for?

faq.a: Denalan has worked closely with fellow herbalists such as Sylvia Whisperbloom and stays in regular communication with druidic researchers and scholars across Teldrassil, including Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
faq.q: Who does Denalan work with?

faq.a: The Moss-twined Heart is a blighted botanical core recovered from Blackmoss the Fetid, a corrupted timberling in Teldrassil. Denalan studies it in his enchanted soil to understand the unnatural sickness twisting the island's plant life.
faq.q: What is the Moss-twined Heart that Denalan examines?

text.s: Denalan is an accomplished night elf herbalist and botanist who tends a quiet lakeside plot along the eastern shore of Lake Al'Ameth. Working under a simple awning, he devotes his days to studying the island's plant life and seeking botanical remedies for the strange corruption affecting Teldrassil. He frequently enlists young adventurers to gather samples, study violent timberlings, and test enchanted soils.

sec.b: While many kaldorei focus on martial vigilance or high druidic rites, Denalan pursues the patient, meticulous craft of herbalism. Stationed along the tranquil eastern banks of Lake Al'Ameth, he has established a modest research camp consisting of a cloth awning, simple field tools, and tidy rows of cultivated planter boxes. Rather than retreating to the grand barrows of Darnassus, he prefers to remain close to the loam, directly examining the unusual flora that has sprouted since the planting of the new World Tree.

Denalan's research is far more than an academic curiosity; it addresses the growing unrest among Teldrassil's native wildlife. The timberlings, normally docile woodland beings of wood and sprout, have turned increasingly aggressive. Denalan enchants specialized soil to nurse wild seeds in captivity and analyze how malignant forces seep into the root systems. By studying strange specimens like shimmering fronds, glowing fruit, and moss-twined growths, he seeks to isolate whatever dark taint is troubling the forest boughs.

npc:dendrite-starblaze.s: Dendrite Rafagaestelar. Dendrite Rafagaestelar es un druida elfo de la noche que reside en la aldea sagrada de Amparo de la Noche, en Claro de la Luna. Al servicio del Círculo Cenarion, actúa como un mentor y guía esencial para los druidas noveles, tanto elfos de la noche como tauren. A través de él, los practicantes son convocados a la arboleda sagrada para dominar ritos fundamentales como la purificación de toxinas y la comunión con las formas de la naturaleza. Ubicado en Amparo de la Noche, Dendrite Rafagaestelar representa el espíritu neutral y duradero del Círculo Cenarion. Cuando los druidas novatos aprenden a sintonizar sus espíritus con Teletransporte a: Claro de la Luna, Dendrite se encuentra entre los primeros en darles la bienvenida a su llegada. Une la antigua tradición kaldorei con la senda emergente de los tauren, tratando a todos los que escuchan la llamada de la naturaleza como hermanos bajo las ramas del sagrado refugio.

ang.class:Druid: Dendrite Starblaze is one of your principal guides upon first teleporting to Moonglade, instructing you in curing sickness and pursuing aquatic forms.
ang.race:NightElf: Dendrite preserves the classical rites of Kaldorei nature stewardship, welcoming Kaldorei initiates into the Cenarion order at Nighthaven.
ang.race:Tauren: For Shu'halo druids visiting Moonglade from Mulgore, Dendrite serves as living proof that the Cenarion Circle's bond transcends the feud between the Horde and the Alliance.

faq.a: Dendrite Starblaze is a night elf druid and Cenarion Circle mentor located in Nighthaven within Moonglade. He guides developing druids through vital class trials and training.
faq.q: Who is Dendrite Starblaze?

faq.a: The Cenarion Circle stands outside the political factions of the Alliance and Horde. In Moonglade, night elves and tauren practice the druidic arts together under ancient oaths of brotherhood, leaving worldly conflicts beyond the mountain passes.
faq.q: Why does a night elf train Horde tauren?

faq.a: Dendrite oversees several foundational druid class trials. These include quests to master venom and disease curing, as well as trials leading toward the communion required for aquatic form.
faq.q: What quests does Dendrite Starblaze offer?

faq.a: He is located in Nighthaven, the settlement situated on the northern shores of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.
faq.q: Where can Dendrite Starblaze be found?

faq.a: Novice druids are taught the spell Teleport: Moonglade by their racial trainers around their tenth circle of training. Casting this sends them directly to Moonglade, where Dendrite awaits their arrival.
faq.q: How do young druids reach Dendrite for the first time?

faq.a: Non-druids can visit Nighthaven and speak with Dendrite, but he does not offer training, trials, or quests to those outside the Cenarion Circle's druidic traditions.
faq.q: Can non-druid adventurers interact with him?

text.s: Dendrite Starblaze is a night elf druid residing in the sacred village of Nighthaven within Moonglade. Serving the Cenarion Circle, he acts as a vital mentor and guide for budding druids of both night elf and tauren descent. Through him, practitioners are summoned to the holy grove to master essential rites such as cleansing toxins and communing with nature's forms.

sec.b: Perched within Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze represents the nonpartisan, enduring spirit of the Cenarion Circle. When novice druids learn to attune their spirits to Teleport: Moonglade, Dendrite is among the first to welcome them upon arrival. He bridges the gap between ancient Kaldorei tradition and the emerging path of the tauren, treating all who heed the call of the wild as kin beneath the boughs of the sacred haven.
sec.t: A Guide in the Sacred Haven

sec.b: Dendrite's primary duty involves initiating druidic apprentices into the deeper mysteries of nature. He directs novices through the trials required to understand poison and pestilence, sending them to examine tainted waters and discover herbal curatives. He also oversees the steps that lead druids to the water trials, testing their patience and endurance beneath the surface before granting communion with aquatic forms.

npc:devrak.s: Devrak. Devrak es un maestro de jinetes del viento orco apostado en El Cruce, en Los Baldíos. Como enlace aéreo principal de Kalimdor central, supervisa la red de dracoleones de la Horda que transporta suministros y mensajeros entre Durotar, Mulgore y los puestos de avanzada fronterizos. También se asegura de que la logística crucial, como las carnes de caza y los cueros preparados, llegue sin problemas a las capitales de la Horda. Situado en la intersección de las principales rutas comerciales de Kalimdor, Devrak cuida de los dracoleones que mantienen unida a la Horda a través de vastas distancias. El Cruce se encuentra a la intemperie bajo un sol abrasador, vulnerable tanto a los jabaespines como a los centauros y a los exploradores de la Alianza, lo que hace indispensable el tránsito aéreo rápido. Devrak atiende tanto a caminantes experimentados como a mensajeros novatos, asignando a cada viajero un dracoleón adiestrado capaces de cruzar la sabana y alcanzar las alturas montañosas de Mulgore o los cañones rocosos de Durotar.

ang.faction:Horde: Devrak is an indispensable ally for any Horde adventurer navigating Kalimdor, serving as the central hub connecting the territories of the orcs, trolls, and tauren.
ang.race:Orc: Stationed in the dry heart of the Barrens, Devrak demonstrates the orcish talent for working with Kalimdor's wind riders, bonding with the fierce beasts to secure aerial dominance.

faq.a: Devrak is the Horde flight master stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He tends the outpost's wind riders, granting flight paths to connecting settlements across Kalimdor and coordinating the transport of couriers, soldiers, and essential trade goods.
faq.q: What is Devrak's role at the Crossroads?

faq.a: From his roost at the Crossroads, Devrak connects to major capitals like Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff, as well as frontier outposts in Ashenvale, Stonetalon Mountains, Dustwallow Marsh, Thousand Needles, and southern frontiers, assuming you have spoken to those flight masters first.
al: where can i fly from crossroads
faq.q: Where can Devrak fly me?

faq.a: Devrak assists in courier tasks that teach young Horde adventurers how to use the flight network, including sending fresh meat to Gryshka in Orgrimmar and bundles of hides to Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: What quests does Devrak offer?

faq.a: Devrak is guarded by his roost. If assaulted by Alliance raiders or hostile beasts, he can summon ferocious enraged wyverns to aid him in combat, driving attackers off with tooth and talon.
faq.q: How does Devrak defend himself if the Crossroads is attacked?

faq.a: The Barrens is the connective spine of central Kalimdor. Because the Crossroads links Durotar, Mulgore, Ashenvale, and Stonetalon, Devrak's roost allows the Horde to rapidly reposition forces and coordinate supplies without relying on days-long journeys on foot.
al: why is crossroads flight master important
faq.q: Why is having a flight master at the Crossroads so critical?

faq.a: Devrak manages wind riders, also known as wyverns. These draconic, winged predators native to the peaks and mesas of Kalimdor were befriended by the Horde to serve as reliable flying mounts across rough terrain.
faq.q: What creatures does Devrak handle?

text.s: Devrak is an orc wind rider master stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Serving as the primary aerial conduit of central Kalimdor, he oversees the Horde's network of wyverns shuttling supplies and couriers between Durotar, Mulgore, and frontier outposts. He also ensures that crucial logistics, such as game meats and prepared hides, travel smoothly to the Horde's capitals.

sec.b: Positioned at the intersection of Kalimdor's major trade routes, Devrak tends the wyverns that keep the Horde unified across vast distances. The Crossroads sits exposed under the baking sun, vulnerable to quillboar, centaur, and Alliance scouts alike, making rapid aerial transit indispensable. Devrak handles both seasoned wayfarers and untested messengers, pairing riders with trained wind riders capable of crossing the savannah and reaching the mountain heights of Mulgore or the stone canyons of Durotar.

Beyond ferrying travelers, Devrak plays a vital role in frontier logistics. The hunters of the Barrens harvest meat and pelts in abundance, which Devrak helps channel directly to the cooking fires of Orgrimmar and the tanners of Thunder Bluff. By introducing budding couriers to flight masters across the continents, he cements the aerial lifeline that feeds the Horde's heartlands.
sec.t: Supplies for the Warchief and the Chieftain

sec.b: Flight masters in contested frontier territories cannot afford to be defenseless. Devrak is far more than a simple beast handler; when the Crossroads falls under attack, he calls upon enraged wyverns to tear into hostile intruders with venomous stingers and talons, making his roost a dangerous target for anyone bold enough to strike the settlement.

npc:dextren-ward.s: Dextren Tutor. Dextren Tutor es un infame criminal y profanador de tumbas encerrado en las Mazmorras de Ventormenta. Antes de su captura, se lucró exhumando cadáveres del Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo de Bosque del Ocaso y entregándoselos al nigromante Morbent Vil. Atrapado ahora en medio del sangriento motín de la prisión, sigue sentenciado a muerte por el consejo de Villa Oscura. Antes de acabar encadenado bajo las calles de Ventormenta, Dextren Tutor dirigía un negocio tan lúgubre como lucrativo en los bosques asfixiados por la niebla de Bosque del Ocaso. El Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo ya era un lugar de dolor y horror creciente, pero Tutor convirtió sus camposantos en su cantera privada. En lugar de limitarse a buscar baratijas y reliquias enterradas con los difuntos, Tutor comerciaba con carne, desenterrando tumbas recientes para abastecer a los practicantes de artes oscuras locales.

ang.class:Paladin: Ward's collaboration with necromancers to provide fresh corpses represents an abhorrent offense against the Sanctity of the Light and the peaceful rest of the departed.
ang.class:Priest: The desecration of holy burial ground at Raven Hill makes Ward's fate an imperative of moral and spiritual restitution.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions assisting Darkshire, putting an end to Dextren Ward is an act of justice for the desecrated families of Duskwood and an essential task in reclaiming the rioting Stockade.

faq.a: Dextren Ward is a notorious criminal imprisoned in the Stormwind Stockade. He is an elite human inmate responsible for robbing the dead in Duskwood to fuel dark rituals.
faq.q: Who is Dextren Ward?

faq.a: Ward was captured and imprisoned for grave robbing in Duskwood's Raven Hill Cemetery. Instead of stealing valuables, he exhumed fresh corpses to sell directly to the necromancer Morbent Fel.
faq.q: Why is Dextren Ward in the Stockade?

faq.a: Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants Ward dead. Millstipe seeks retribution for the desecration of Duskwood's graves and demands Ward's severed hand as proof of his demise.
faq.q: Who wants Dextren Ward dead?

faq.a: Ward acted as a corpse supplier for Morbent Fel. By unearthing the freshly buried dead of Raven Hill Cemetery, Ward provided the raw material Fel needed for his necromantic experiments and undead creations.
faq.q: What is Ward's connection to Morbent Fel?

faq.a: He is located inside the Stormwind Stockade, the high-security prison situated in the canals of Stormwind City. He lurks in one of the holding wings during the ongoing prison revolt.
faq.q: Where can Dextren Ward be found?

faq.a: Councilman Millstipe explicitly asks for Ward's cold, dead hand as irrefutable physical proof that the grave robber can no longer dig up the graves of Duskwood or profit from necromancy.
faq.q: Why does the quest require Dextren's hand?

text.s: Dextren Ward is an infamous criminal and grave robber locked away inside the Stormwind Stockade. Before his capture, he profited by exhuming bodies from Duskwood's Raven Hill Cemetery and delivering them to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Now caught in the midst of the prison's bloody uprising, he remains marked for death by the town council of Darkshire.

sec.b: Before ending up in chains beneath the streets of Stormwind, Dextren Ward conducted a grim and lucrative business in the fog-choked woods of Duskwood. Raven Hill Cemetery was already a site of sorrow and growing horror, but Ward treated its burial grounds as a private quarry. Rather than hunting merely for trinkets and heirlooms left with the dead, Ward dealt in flesh, unearthing fresh graves to supply local dark practitioners.

Ward's primary customer was Morbent Fel, a necromancer whose dark rituals have plagued Duskwood and swelled the ranks of the undead. In supplying bodies to Fel, Ward actively contributed to the terror that grips Darkshire. Though eventually caught by Stormwind authorities and dragged into the Stockade, his crimes earned him the undying enmity of the people of Duskwood, prompting Councilman Millstipe to demand Ward's hand as proof of justice served.

When a sweeping rebellion broke out inside the Stockade, Ward was not liberated by allies, but rather freed from his cell to join the chaos within the locked-down dungeon. Armed and vicious, he commands his own corner of the prison and uses terror to ward off interlopers, making him one of the priority targets Alliance forces seek to eliminate while restoring order.

npc:dirania-silvershine.s: Dirania Brillargente. Dirania Brillargente es una elfa de la noche que reside en Cañada Umbría, en Teldrassil. Profundamente leal y observadora, vela por la apacible arboleda y cuida de su compañero Iverron cuando sus imprudentes andanzas lo ponen en peligro. Dirania permanece entre las tranquilas ramas de Cañada Umbría, el aislado valle donde los jóvenes elfos de la noche comienzan su servicio a Kalimdor y a la Alianza. Mientras muchos en los túmulos y santuarios se centran en amplios deberes espirituales, Dirania permanece atenta a quienes tiene más cerca, pendiente de los peligros silenciosos que se agitan incluso en el corazón de Teldrassil.

ang.race:NightElf: For young night elves stepping into Shadowglen, Dirania serves as an early reminder of the bonds of friendship and the creeping dangers threatening even the newest sanctuaries of the World Tree.

faq.a: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf found in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. She acts as a quest giver, primarily concerned with rescuing and curing her friend Iverron after he runs afoul of local poisonous wildlife.
faq.q: Who is Dirania Silvershine?

faq.a: Dirania is located within Shadowglen, the starter vale inside Teldrassil, not far from the central path near Aldrassil.
faq.q: Where can I find Dirania Silvershine?

faq.a: Dirania and Iverron are close friends. Dirania is the more sensible and watchful of the pair, stepping in to arrange an antidote whenever Iverron acts foolishly and suffers a poisonous bite from the local fauna.
faq.q: What is Dirania's relationship to Iverron?

faq.a: She offers quests centered on helping her companion, notably 'A Friend in Need' and 'Iverron's Antidote', tasking adventurers with securing ingredients to brew a cure for Iverron's spider venom.
faq.q: What quests does Dirania offer?

faq.a: The webwood spiders dwelling in the boughs of Shadowglen carry a potent venom. While experienced sentinels can handle them, novice elves like Iverron frequently underestimate the danger and risk succumbing to their bites.
faq.q: Why is Dirania worried about spiders in Shadowglen?

faq.a: Dirania is an Alliance night elf living peacefully in Teldrassil. She is not depicted as an active member of the Sisterhood of Elune or the Cenarion Circle, but rather a caring civilian looking out for her fellow kin.
faq.q: Does Dirania belong to any formal order or faction?

text.s: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf resident of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Deeply loyal and observant, she watches over the tranquil grove and looks out for her companion Iverron when his reckless ventures land him in peril.

sec.b: Dirania stands among the tranquil boughs of Shadowglen, the secluded vale where young night elves begin their service to Kalimdor and the Alliance. While many in the barrow mounds and sanctuaries look to broad spiritual duties, Dirania stays mindful of those nearest to her, attentive to the quiet dangers that stir even in the heart of Teldrassil.

Dirania's immediate concern is her companion Iverron. Overeager and careless around the poisonous woodland creatures creeping across the glen, Iverron frequently gets into trouble. When he succumbs to a venomous bite from the local webwood spiders, Dirania takes it upon herself to seek out willing hands to gather ingredients and prepare a remedy before the venom takes a permanent toll.

npc:dorn-plainstalker.s: Dorn Acechaprados. Dorn Acechaprados es un solitario anciano tauren que reside en El Hueco Perdido, con vistas a los cañones de Las Mil Agujas. Ejerce como supervisor de las tradicionales pruebas del rito de iniciación, desafiando a los aventureros de la Horda a demostrar su carácter y fortaleza. A través de pruebas de fe, resistencia, fuerza y conocimiento, evalúa si los viajeros son dignos servidores de la Madre Tierra y de su pueblo. Aislado en una cueva poco profunda en lo alto de las crestas del cañón de El Hueco Perdido, Dorn Acechaprados vive apartado del bullicio de Poblado Viento Libre. Para llegar a su reducto montañoso es necesario serpentear a lo largo de los escarpados acantilados del norte que dominan las imponentes mesetas situadas abajo. Desde este tranquilo mirador, Dorn mantiene antiguas costumbres y juzga a quienes buscan orientación en los áridos territorios del sur.

ang.faction:Horde: Dorn welcomes all Horde champions willing to brave his trials, ensuring that warriors, hunters, and shamans of every race prove their mettle in Kalimdor's rugged wilds.
ang.race:Tauren: For tauren wandering through Thousand Needles, Dorn represents the continuation of nomadic ancestral traditions and spiritual rites that test one's balance with the Earth Mother.

faq.a: Dorn Plainstalker is a tauren hermit and elder who dwells in the Weathered Nook, a secluded cliffside shelter high above Thousand Needles. He administers traditional trials of passage to aspiring Horde champions.
faq.q: Who is Dorn Plainstalker?

faq.a: He is located in a cave at the Weathered Nook. From Freewind Post, head north to the high cliff walls bordering the canyon, then follow the ridge east until you discover a ramp ascending into his mountain sanctuary.
faq.q: Where can I find Dorn Plainstalker?

faq.a: Dorn oversees four sacred tests: the Test of Faith, Test of Endurance, Test of Strength, and Test of Lore. Completing them proves a traveler's courage, physical resolve, combat skill, and respect for tradition.
faq.q: What are the trials Dorn administers?

faq.a: The Test of Faith requires the pilgrim to step off a dizzying cliff plank into the chasm below, demonstrating absolute trust and overcoming primal fear.
faq.q: What is the Test of Faith?

faq.a: Dorn adheres to ascetic tauren spiritual traditions. By dwelling alone in the heights of the Weathered Nook, away from the daily trade and defense of Freewind Post, he maintains an untroubled place of contemplation and trial for seekers.
faq.q: Why does Dorn live alone in a cave?

faq.a: While he lives outside Freewind Post itself, Dorn is a loyal member of the Horde and the tauren tribes, assisting brave travelers who wander through the windswept canyons.
faq.q: Is Dorn affiliated with Freewind Post?

text.s: Dorn Plainstalker is a solitary tauren elder residing in the Weathered Nook overlooking the canyons of Thousand Needles. He serves as an overseer of traditional rite of passage trials, challenging Horde adventurers to prove their character and fortitude. Through trials of faith, endurance, strength, and lore, he tests whether travelers are worthy servants of the Earth Mother and their people.

sec.b: Secluded in a shallow cave high atop the canyon ridges of the Weathered Nook, Dorn Plainstalker lives apart from the bustle of Freewind Post. Reaching his mountain redoubt requires winding along the sheer northern cliffs overlooking the towering mesas below. From this quiet vantage point, Dorn maintains ancient customs and judges those who seek guidance in the harsh southern barrens.

Dorn Plainstalker guides pilgrims through a demanding series of tests meant to measure the core virtues of a tauren champion: faith, endurance, strength, and lore. Rather than mere exercises in brute force, these trials force aspirants to confront fear, leap blindly into the unknown, outlast cunning wilderness predators, and ponder the sacred history of Kalimdor before claiming their final passage.

npc:duthorian-rall.s: Duthorian Rall. Duthorian Rall es un respetado caballero humano de la Mano de Plata apostado en la Catedral de la Luz de Ventormenta. Reconocido como uno de los paladines más influyentes de la Alianza, supervisa el entrenamiento y las pruebas espirituales de los guerreros sagrados emergentes. Guía a los reclutas a través de votos solemnes de caridad, valor y devoción para defender Azeroth contra la Plaga y las amenazas internas al acecho. Situado en el transepto abovedado de la Catedral de la Luz, Duthorian Rall representa las venerables tradiciones de los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata. Con el reino inquieto por los conflictos internos y la desaparición del rey Varian Wrynn, Duthorian asume el vital deber de inculcar una disciplina recta en los nuevos iniciados. Paladines respetados en el campo de batalla, incluidos Hermano Fijalontad en Villanorte y Brandur Martiyerro en Forjaz, dirigen a los reclutas prometedores a su tutela para comenzar sus pruebas sagradas.

ang.class:Paladin: Duthorian Rall is one of your primary spiritual mentors in Stormwind, testing your compassion and valor through foundational trials that unlock the power of resurrection, divine senses, and your warhorse.
ang.faction:Alliance: As an influential leader within the Silver Hand, Duthorian ensures that the Alliance's defenders remain morally upright and capable of defending the realm against bandits and undead alike.
ang.race:Human: Anchored in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian represents the enduring devotion and chivalric discipline central to human faith and society.

faq.a: Duthorian Rall is a prominent knight of the Silver Hand residing in the Cathedral of Light within Stormwind City. He serves as an instructor and spiritual mentor for new paladins, testing their devotion and courage on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light.
faq.q: Who is Duthorian Rall?

faq.a: He can be found standing in the eastern wing of the Cathedral of Light, located at the heart of the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can Duthorian Rall be found?

faq.a: Duthorian provides paladins with the Book of Divinity and guides them through trials of humility, compassion, and rescue. Fulfilling his trials proves an initiate is worthy to wield the Light's power of resurrection.
faq.q: What is his connection to the Tome of Divinity?

faq.a: During the trial for the Tome of Valor, Duthorian sends paladins to protect Daphne Stilwell from Defias bandits on her farm in Westfall, demonstrating their willingness to sacrifice themselves to defend the innocent.
faq.q: Why does Duthorian send paladins to Westfall?

faq.a: Successful paladins earn key holy capabilities through his guidance, including the sacred gift of resurrection, the ability to sense undead, protective armaments such as the Bastion of Stormwind, and eventually their summoned warhorse.
al: what do you get from duthorian
faq.q: What rewards does Duthorian grant to paladins who pass his trials?

faq.a: Aspirants are typically directed to him by paladin trainers, including Brother Wilhelm in Northshire Valley and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge.
faq.q: Who sends adventurers to Duthorian initially?

text.s: Duthorian Rall is a respected human knight of the Silver Hand stationed within Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Renowned as one of the most influential paladins in the Alliance, he oversees the training and spiritual trials of emerging holy warriors. He guides recruits through solemn vows of charity, valor, and devotion to defend Azeroth against the Scourge and lurking domestic threats.

sec.b: Standing within the vaulted transept of the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall represents the venerable traditions of the Knights of the Silver Hand. With the kingdom unsettled by internal strife and the missing King Varian Wrynn, Duthorian shoulders the vital duty of instilling righteous discipline in fresh initiates. Respected paladins in the field, including Brother Wilhelm in Northshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, direct promising recruits to his guidance to begin their sacred trials.
sec.t: A Pillar of the Silver Hand

sec.b: Duthorian teaches that martial power without moral foundation is hollow. Through the Tome of Divinity, he tests a paladin's capacity for empathy, requiring acts of mercy and selfless service across Stormwind before entrusting them with deeper mysteries. His trials culminate in testing candidates with the Symbol of Life near Heroes' Vigil, sending them to aid wounded allies and teach them to channel the Light's miraculous power to restore fallen comrades from death.

Beyond spiritual contemplation, Duthorian demands resolute courage in the face of peril. In his tests of valor, he cautions aspirants that their vows may demand their lives. He tests this resolve by sending initiates into dangerous territory—such as defending Daphne Stilwell against Defias renegades in Westfall—before directing them on toward master smith Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge and granting them holy steeds worthy of their station.

npc:edwin-vancleef.s: Edwin VanCleef. Edwin VanCleef fue el brillante maestre del gremio de los Albañiles que reconstruyó Ciudad de Ventormenta tras la Segunda Guerra. Tras ser estafado por la Casa de los Nobles, que le denegó el pago, lideró una violenta revuelta obrera y formó la ilegal Hermandad Defias. Al operar desde las profundidades de Las Minas de la Muerte en Páramos de Poniente, busca venganza contra el reino que ayudó a restaurar. Tras la devastación de la Primera Guerra, Edwin VanCleef fue elegido para liderar al gremio de los Albañiles en la monumental tarea de reconstruir Ciudad de Ventormenta. Artesano sin igual e idealista, VanCleef dirigió la construcción de las imponentes murallas y las altas catedrales de la capital, e incluso supervisó el levantamiento del Castillo de Nethergarde para vigilar El Portal Oscuro. Junto a su maestría en la arquitectura, VanCleef era un agente extraordinariamente letal; fue entrenado en el sigilo, el subterfugio y el manejo de las hojas por su amigo de la infancia, Mathias Shaw.

ang.class:Rogue: VanCleef was trained by SI:7 leader Mathias Shaw himself, making him one of the most capable rogues in Azeroth, blending formal guild leadership with elite assassination techniques.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance commanders consider VanCleef the premier internal security threat to southern human lands, paralyzing Westfall and the borders of Elwynn Forest.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, VanCleef embodies the tragedy of the kingdom's postwar recovery: a loyal hero whose denied livelihood turned him into the realm's deadliest insurgent.

faq.a: He is the mastermind behind the Defias Brotherhood and the former Guildmaster of the Stonemasons. He is the master architect who rebuilt Stormwind City after the Horde destroyed it during the First War.
faq.q: Who is Edwin VanCleef?

faq.a: After the rebuilding of Stormwind City, the House of Nobles refused to pay the Stonemasons Guild their agreed wages due to excessive kingdom debt. When VanCleef and the workers protested, the nobles disbanded the guild, igniting violent riots in the streets.
faq.q: Why did the Stonemasons revolt against Stormwind?

faq.a: He commands the Defias Brotherhood from the innermost sanctum of the Deadmines in Westfall, whose entrance is rumored to lie through the quiet village of Moonbrook.
faq.q: Where is Edwin VanCleef hiding?

faq.a: Mathias Shaw was a childhood friend of Edwin. Shaw personally trained VanCleef in the arts of stealth, thievery, and combat, originally hoping VanCleef would join him in the royal intelligence agency SI:7.
faq.q: What is his connection to Mathias Shaw?

faq.a: During the chaotic street riots stirred by the unpaid Stonemasons, a hurled stone struck and killed King Varian's young wife, Queen Tiffin Wrynn. Her death drove King Varian into a furious crackdown, forcing VanCleef and his men to flee the city.
faq.q: What happened to Queen Tiffin during the riot?

faq.a: Rumor has it that the Defias have conscripted clever goblins to help them build something terrible at the bottom of the Deadmines, but what it may be is still uncertain.
faq.q: What is he building in the Deadmines?

text.s: Edwin VanCleef was the brilliant Guildmaster of the Stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind City after the Second War. After being cheated of payment by the House of Nobles, he led a violent workers' revolt and formed the outlaw Defias Brotherhood. Operating from deep within the Deadmines of Westfall, he seeks vengeance against the kingdom he helped restore.

sec.b: Following the devastation of the First War, Edwin VanCleef was chosen to lead the Stonemasons Guild in the monumental task of rebuilding Stormwind City. A peerless craftsman and an idealist, VanCleef directed the construction of the capital's grand ramparts and towering cathedrals, and even oversaw the erection of Nethergarde Keep to watch over the Dark Portal. Alongside his mastery of architecture, VanCleef was a remarkably deadly operative; he was trained in stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft by his childhood friend, Mathias Shaw.

When the years of labor concluded, the House of Nobles ran up colossal debts through military campaigns and refused to provide the Stonemasons their promised compensation. Enraged, VanCleef demanded restitution, only for the nobles to officially dissolve the guild. The artisans revolted, triggering chaotic street riots in Stormwind during which King Varian Wrynn's wife, Queen Tiffin, was slain. Driven out of the capital by the crown's retribution, VanCleef gathered his exiled workers and allied outcasts in Westfall, uniting them beneath the banner of the Defias Brotherhood.

Taking advantage of the crown's neglect of the countryside, the Defias drove off Westfall's farmers and claimed its rich gold deposits. Within the depths of Moonbrook's Deadmines, VanCleef oversaw the construction of a massive juggernaut warship, preparing an armed assault against Stormwind itself. While the House of Nobles dismissed the thieves as disorganized brigands, VanCleef forged alliances with river crooks, gnolls, and the Bloodsail Buccaneers, turning an embittered labor union into an army poised to crush the monarchy.

npc:eitrigg.s: Eitrigg. Eitrigg es un curtido veterano de la Primera y Segunda Guerra que permanece junto al Jefe de Guerra Thrall como un estimado consejero en Orgrimmar. Antaño un teniente de alto rango del Clan Roca Negra, acabó desilusionado con la vieja Horda demoníaca y vivió en el exilio hasta que una extraordinaria amistad con un paladín humano cambió su destino. En la actualidad, ayuda a guiar a la nueva Horda de regreso a sus raíces de honor y chamanismo. Nacido en Draenor en el seno del Clan Roca Negra, Eitrigg fue antaño uno de los principales tenientes del Jefe de Guerra Puño Negro junto a Orgrim Martillo Maldito y Varok Colmillosauro. Cuando Martillo Maldito se hizo con el liderazgo de la Horda, Eitrigg siguió siendo un oficial de confianza y custodió a la prisionera semiorca y asesina Garona. Aunque al principio desestimó las revelaciones de ella sobre Gul'dan y la corrupción demoníaca del Consejo de la Sombra, las espantosas batallas y la derrota definitiva de la Horda en la Segunda Guerra lo obligaron a afrontar la oscura realidad. Asqueado al darse cuenta de cómo habían manipulado a su pueblo, Eitrigg se apartó de los remanentes dispersos y se retiró a un exilio autoimpuesto, buscando únicamente la soledad en las tierras salvajes de Lordaeron.

ang.class:Paladin: The story of Eitrigg and Tirion Fordring is renowned among paladins as the ultimate test of duty versus righteous honor.
ang.class:Warrior: Eitrigg represents martial honor preserved through decades of tragedy, having survived two wars through sheer strength and unbroken discipline.
ang.faction:Horde: Eitrigg serves as the living institutional memory of the Horde, standing by Thrall to ensure the mistakes of the demon-tainted past are never repeated.
ang.race:Orc: For the orcs of Durotar, Eitrigg is a revered elder whose Blackrock heritage proves that any orc can embrace honor and redeem their people's legacy.

faq.a: Eitrigg is an elderly Blackrock orc warrior who served as a lieutenant under Blackhand and Orgrim Doomhammer during the First and Second Wars. Today, he resides in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar as a trusted counselor and advisor to Warchief Thrall.
faq.q: Who is Eitrigg?

faq.a: While living in exile in Lordaeron, Eitrigg saved the life of the paladin Tirion Fordring during a duel that brought down a stone tower. In return, Tirion defended Eitrigg's location and later fought his own people in Stratholme to prevent Eitrigg's execution, losing his title and lands in the process. Bound by mutual honor, Eitrigg views Tirion as his brother.
faq.q: Why does Eitrigg consider a human his brother?

faq.a: Eitrigg belongs to the Blackrock clan. He was a high-ranking commander during the old wars, though he abandoned the clan's corrupt remnants after learning the truth of the demonic corruption that guided them.
faq.q: What clan does Eitrigg belong to?

faq.a: During the Second War, Eitrigg guarded the assassin Garona, who revealed the demon worship and manipulations of Gul'dan and the Shadow Council. Following the Horde's defeat, Eitrigg realized her claims were true and left in disgust, seeking a quiet place to die rather than serve a corrupt war machine.
faq.q: Why did Eitrigg leave the old Horde?

faq.a: When Alliance forces captured Eitrigg and prepared to execute him in Stratholme, Thrall and his forces raided the city and freed him. Seeing Thrall's commitment to honor and the rediscovery of shamanism, Eitrigg chose to follow the young Warchief to Kalimdor.
faq.q: How did Eitrigg end up in Orgrimmar?

faq.a: Eitrigg advises Thrall directly within Grommash Hold and assists in testing and evaluating new recruits who swear loyalty to the New Horde.
faq.q: What role does Eitrigg play in Orgrimmar right now?

text.s: Eitrigg is a seasoned veteran of the First and Second Wars who stands beside Warchief Thrall as an esteemed advisor in Orgrimmar. Once a high-ranking lieutenant of the Blackrock clan, he became disillusioned with the old demonic Horde and lived in exile until an extraordinary friendship with a human paladin changed his fate. Today, he helps guide the New Horde back to its roots of honor and shamanism.

sec.b: Born on Draenor into the Blackrock clan, Eitrigg was once one of Warchief Blackhand's primary lieutenants alongside Orgrim Doomhammer and Varok Saurfang. When Doomhammer seized leadership of the Horde, Eitrigg remained a trusted officer and oversaw the captured half-orc assassin Garona. Although he initially dismissed her revelations regarding Gul'dan and the demonic corruption of the Shadow Council, the horrific battles and ultimate defeat of the Horde in the Second War forced him to confront the dark reality.
