Sickened by the realization of how his people had been manipulated, Eitrigg walked away from the scattered remnants and retreated into self-imposed exile, seeking only solitude in the wilds of Lordaeron.
sec.t: A Veteran of the Old Horde

sec.b: Years into his wilderness exile, Eitrigg was discovered sheltering in an abandoned tower near Hearthglen by the human paladin Tirion Fordring. Their initial clash collapsed the ruins, but instead of finishing the unconscious human, Eitrigg pulled him from the rubble to safety. Moved by this display of pure martial honor, Tirion swore an oath of friendship and refused to betray the hermit's location. When the local Alliance authorities ultimately captured Eitrigg and sentenced him to hang in Stratholme, Tirion threw away his own knighthood, lands, and freedom in an attack to rescue the condemned orc. This legendary bond proved to both warriors that honor transcended the bitter hatred between their species.

During Tirion's desperate attempt to free Eitrigg in Stratholme, Thrall's newly united Horde raided the city and extracted the aging warrior. Meeting Thrall convinced Eitrigg that the orcs were throwing off the demonic taint and rediscovering their ancestral shamanic heritage. Returning with Thrall across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, Eitrigg took up a revered post in the Valley of Wisdom within Orgrimmar. He now stands inside Grommash Hold as an advisor to the young Warchief, helping evaluate new recruits and imparting his hard-earned wisdom so that the New Horde never repeats the tragedies of the past.

npc:electrocutioner-6000.s: Electrocutor 6000. El Electrocutor 6000 es un letal y sobrecargado tanque araña desplegado para defender la Hangar de Lanzamiento en las salas irradiadas de Gnomeregan. Pilotado por el infame gnomo paria, el teniente Tom «Chisporroteo» Manivela, representa la temeraria ambición del Mekigeniero Termochufe de utilizar la electricidad de alto voltaje como arma. El Mekigeniero Termochufe nunca ha destacado por realizar rigurosas pruebas de seguridad. Impulsado por la megalomanía y las prisas, suele enviar máquinas de guerra no probadas directamente de la mesa de dibujo al combate real. El Electrocutor 6000 fue su intento inicial de aprovechar las corrientes eléctricas puras como un sistema ofensivo montado sobre el chasis blindado de un tanque araña. En lugar de resolver las sobrecargas eléctricas letales en un laboratorio, Termochufe lo envió de inmediato a vigilar los niveles superiores de la Hangar de Lanzamiento de Gnomeregan.

ang.faction:Alliance: Breaching the Launch Bay and eliminating Crankle is vital to securing the Workshop Key, bypassing hazardous front corridors during liberation efforts into Gnomeregan.
ang.profession:Engineering: Engineers marvel at the raw high-voltage output harnessed within the chassis, even if Thermaplugg's reckless lack of grounding makes it a lethal hazard to its own crew.
ang.race:Gnome: For the exiled gnomes of Ironforge, the Electrocutioner 6000 is an insult to their craft: a dangerous, untested monstrosity that reflects Thermaplugg's twisted disregard for proper engineering ethics and gnome lives.

faq.a: The Electrocutioner 6000 is positioned on an elevated catwalk platform overlooking the Launch Bay inside the fallen city of Gnomeregan.
faq.q: Where can the Electrocutioner 6000 be found?

faq.a: It is piloted by Lieutenant Tom Crankle, better known as 'Sizzlepants.' He is a crazed leper gnome officer who achieved renown among Thermaplugg's forces as the sole pilot to survive the tank's dangerous internal electrical discharge.
faq.q: Who pilots the Electrocutioner 6000?

faq.a: Mekgineer Thermaplugg refuses to spend time conducting proper safety evaluations, preferring to rush inventions immediately into service. The Electrocutioner 6000 was his first trial with an electrified spider tank, leaving its lethal power feeds volatile and perilous even to its own operator.
faq.q: Why is the machine so volatile?

faq.a: The pilot holds the Workshop Key, an essential device that unlocks the back door entrance into Gnomeregan's deeper engineering sectors, allowing strike teams a faster route through the reclaimed facilities.
faq.q: Why is defeating the Electrocutioner 6000 important for explorers?

faq.a: It is a modified spider tank, functioning as an armored mechano-vehicle guided manually by its pilot from an internal cockpit, rather than an autonomous robotic construct.
faq.q: Is the Electrocutioner an automaton or a vehicle?

text.s: The Electrocutioner 6000 is a deadly, super-charged spider tank deployed to defend the Launch Bay within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan. Piloted by the notorious leper gnome Lieutenant Tom 'Sizzlepants' Crankle, it represents Mekgineer Thermaplugg's reckless ambition to weaponize high-voltage electricity.

sec.b: Mekgineer Thermaplugg has never been known for rigorous safety testing. Driven by megalomania and haste, he regularly rushes unproven war machines straight from the drawing board into live combat. The Electrocutioner 6000 was his initial attempt to harness raw electrical currents as an offensive system mounted to an armored spider tank chassis. Rather than working out lethal power surges in a laboratory, Thermaplugg sent it immediately to guard the upper tiers of Gnomeregan's Launch Bay.

Operating experimental machinery is often a death sentence, particularly when lethal voltage is involved. Early test pilots perished in agonizing mishaps, but Lieutenant Tom Crankle managed to withstand the lethal surges and survived at the controls. Earning the grim moniker 'Sizzlepants,' he became an idol of resilience among the irradiated leper gnomes loyal to Thermaplugg, fiercely guarding the path toward the inner workshops.

npc:elling-trias.s: Elling Trias. Elling Trias regenta Queso de Trias, un pequeño establecimiento situado en el bullicioso Distrito de Mercaderes de la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Aunque se presenta como un jovial y apasionado vendedor de lácteos, opera discretamente como uno de los intermediarios de información mejor conectados del reino. Entre ruedas de queso y charlas cordiales, Trias mantiene el oído bien atento a todo lo que ocurre a lo largo de varios continentes. Para el cliente casual que pasea por el Distrito de Mercaderes, Elling Trias no es más que un artesano dedicado a los quesos selectos que atiende su negocio junto a su esposa Elaine y su hijo Ben. Promociona con entusiasmo ruedas de queso y charla amistosamente con los lugareños. Sin embargo, quienes están al tanto saben que Queso de Trias es una de las tapaderas más fiables de Ventormenta. El constante ajetreo del comercio urbano ofrece la cobertura perfecta para operativos, cortesanos y aventureros que necesitan intercambiar información discreta sin llamar la atención de la guardia de la ciudad.

ang.class:Rogue: Any practitioner of subtlety recognizes that Elling's cheese shop is an ideal drop point. His proximity to Old Town and tight links to Mathias Shaw make him a fixture in Stormwind's underworld.
ang.faction:Alliance: Elling serves as an unsung pillar of Alliance intelligence, quietly filtering rumors from Theramore to Hearthglen to protect the realm from internal rot.

faq.a: Elling Trias is ostensibly a cheese vendor operating Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District alongside his family. Beneath that cover, he is a seasoned intelligence broker with ties to SI:7, the Church, and distant outposts across Azeroth.
faq.q: Who is Elling Trias?

faq.a: You can find Trias' Cheese in the Trade District of Stormwind City, tucked into the shop row along the outer canal wall, near the border leading toward Old Town.
faq.q: Where is his cheese shop located?

faq.a: Trias is not a member of the Defias Brotherhood; rather, he tracks their movements through his informant network. He helps Alliance adventurers trace Defias involvement in subversive plots, including the kidnapping of a royal diplomat.
faq.q: What is his connection to the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Elling collaborates closely with Master Mathias Shaw and the intelligence apparatus of SI:7. His shop provides an informal listening post where discreet inquiries can be launched outside official royal channels.
faq.q: How does he know Mathias Shaw?

faq.a: Elling runs Trias' Cheese with his wife, Elaine Trias, and his son, Ben Trias. Together they maintain the appearance of a bustling, ordinary family-run trade shop.
faq.q: Who runs the shop with him?

faq.a: Sent to Trias by Bishop DeLavey, investigators use Elling's expansive web of contacts—including his old associates Jorgen and Tyrion—to trace Defias movements and discover who seized the diplomat bound for Theramore.
faq.q: What is his involvement in the Missing Diplomat investigation?

text.s: Elling Trias manages Trias' Cheese, a small storefront nestled in the bustling Trade District of Stormwind City. While he presents himself as a jovial and passionate purveyor of dairy, he quietly operates as one of the kingdom's most connected information brokers. Behind wheels of cheese and cordial banter, Trias maintains an ear to the ground that reaches across continents.

sec.b: To the casual customer strolling the Trade District, Elling Trias is merely an artisan dedicated to fine curds, working his shop alongside his wife Elaine and son Ben. He enthusiastically hawks wheels of cheese and chats amicably with townsfolk. Yet those in the know understand that Trias' Cheese is one of the most reliable fronts in Stormwind. The steady hum of city commerce provides perfect cover for operatives, courtiers, and adventurers who need to trade quiet words without drawing the attention of the city watch.

Elling's network of informants and allies is staggering for a shopkeeper. He maintains ties with Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7, coordinates with Church contacts like Bishop DeLavey, and corresponds with agents as far afield as Darkshire, Theramore Isle, and the distant Plaguelands near Hearthglen. When odd rumors surface—whether concerning highway bandits or quiet movements in the countryside—Trias often pieces the puzzle together long before the royal court takes notice.

When a high-ranking diplomat vanishes on a voyage to Theramore, Elling Trias becomes an essential pivot in unraveling the conspiracy. Directing investigators to his contacts—including an estranged operative named Jorgen and old friend Tyrion—Trias helps unmask the Defias Brotherhood's hand in the abduction. Despite his sharp wit and cynical banter, Elling recognizes that the plot reaches deep into the heart of Stormwind's aristocracy.

npc:executor-arren.s: Ejecutor Arren. El Ejecutor Arren es un oficial Renegado de alto rango apostado en Camposanto. Supervisa la defensa inmediata y la consolidación del asentamiento a medida que los no-muertos recién despertados emergen de sus tumbas. Arren coordina la campaña local contra los zombis descerebrados de la Plaga, las bestias salvajes y los invasores fanáticos de la Cruzada Escarlata. Firme y resuelto justo a las afueras de la capilla de Camposanto, el Ejecutor Arren ejerce como la principal voz militar para los Renegados nacientes dentro de sus terrenos de despertar. Mientras los celadores de las criptas guían a los no-muertos recién alzados a través de su desorientación, Arren dirige su atención hacia el exterior en pos de la supervivencia. Bajo el estandarte de la Reina Sylvanas Brisaveloz, organiza operaciones locales para barrer a los zombis descerebrados que amenazan las fronteras de la aldea, estableciendo un territorio seguro a la sombra de la caída de Lordaeron.

ang.faction:Horde: Arren's frontline commands in Deathknell represent the Horde's initial foothold in northern Lordaeron, securing survival amidst hostile surroundings.
ang.race:Undead: Executor Arren is one of the first commanders every Forsaken meets upon emerging into Tirisfal, giving them their earliest taste of duty under the Dark Lady.

faq.a: Executor Arren is the commanding military officer overseeing Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He organizes newly risen Forsaken into an effective fighting force to defend the village and secure the surrounding countryside.
faq.q: Who is Executor Arren?

faq.a: Executors are trusted military and administrative commanders within the Forsaken hierarchy. They govern local garrisons, direct operations in the field, and enforce the will and law of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: What rank is an Executor among the Forsaken?

faq.a: The zombies prowling near Deathknell are mindless Scourge remnants left behind after the plague devastated Lordaeron. Arren orders them cleared so that newly awakened undead are not torn apart upon leaving the crypts.
faq.q: Why does Arren send recruits against the zombies?

faq.a: The Scarlet Crusade is a radical human faction dedicated to exterminating all undead. They hold outposts across the ruins of Lordaeron and actively seek to purge the Forsaken, considering them identical to the Scourge.
faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades?

faq.a: Night Web's Hollow is a spider-infested cave north of Deathknell. Arren directs recruits to clear out the aggressive arachnids to eliminate a major local hazard and demonstrate martial competence.
faq.q: What is Night Web's Hollow?

faq.a: Once Deathknell's immediate threats are neutralized, Arren directs capable recruits outward to Brill to report to Executor Zygand and aid the broader Forsaken effort across Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where does Arren send recruits once they finish his tasks?

text.s: Executor Arren is a high-ranking Forsaken officer stationed in Deathknell. He oversees the immediate defense and consolidation of the settlement as newly awakened undead emerge from their graves. Arren coordinates the local campaign against mindless Scourge zombies, feral beasts, and the encroaching zealots of the Scarlet Crusade.

sec.b: Standing resolute just outside the chapel in Deathknell, Executor Arren serves as the primary military voice for the nascent Forsaken within their awakening grounds. While the caretakers in the crypts guide newly raised undead through their disorientation, Arren directs their focus outward toward survival. Under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's banner, he organizes local operations to sweep away mindless zombies that threaten the village borders, establishing secure territory in the shadow of Lordaeron's fall.

Deathknell is surrounded by perils far deadlier than confused fledglings. Under Arren's orders, scouts and initiates strike at the vicious arachnids inhabiting Night Web's Hollow and eliminate dangerous predators haunting the woodland fringes. By demanding decisive action from every capable hand, Arren tests the fortitude of new arrivals, ensuring only those capable of defending their second chance at existence remain in the service of the Dark Lady.

Arren's greatest strategic concern lies with the Scarlet Crusade. The zealots consider all undead to be monstrosities requiring total eradication, failing or refusing to distinguish between the Scourge and the free-willed Forsaken. Arren organizes targeted strikes against Scarlet patrols encamped in the Tirisfal wilderness, intercepting couriers and analyzing stolen dispatches to safeguard Deathknell from being purged in holy fire.

npc:executor-zygand.s: Ejecutor Zygand. El Ejecutor Zygand es un veterano comandante de los Renegados apostado en el ayuntamiento de Rémol, que supervisa las operaciones defensivas y militares por el centro de los Claros de Tirisfal. Rindiendo cuentas directamente al alto mando de Entrañas, coordina la purga de las fuerzas de la Cruzada Escarlata que se adentran en territorio Renegado. Situado en el corazón administrativo de Rémol, el Ejecutor Zygand coordina la defensa regional de los Renegados tras su despertar inicial en Camposanto. Como superior directo de oficiales regionales como el Ejecutor Arren y de centinelas de campo como la Guardia de la Muerte Linnea, Zygand recopila los informes de los exploradores y envía a reclutas cualificados a salvaguardar las fronteras de Lordaeron de posibles incursiones.

ang.faction:Horde: Travelers from Kalimdor visiting Tirisfal Glades see in Zygand the structured, disciplined military leadership driving the Forsaken's struggle to secure Lordaeron.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken venturing out of Deathknell, Executor Zygand represents the wider military authority of the Undercity, welcoming new citizens into active service against their bitterest enemies.

faq.a: Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken officer operating out of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He commands local Deathguard garrisons, receives tactical reports from lower-ranking officers, and directs military campaigns against local threats.
faq.q: Who is Executor Zygand?

faq.a: He is located inside or near the main town hall of Brill, the central Forsaken settlement in Tirisfal Glades situated just north of the Undercity.
faq.q: Where can I find Executor Zygand?

faq.a: His primary focus is orchestrating the regional war against the Scarlet Crusade. He monitors the zealots' movements throughout Tirisfal and issues orders to dismantle their encampments and leadership before they can march on the Undercity.
faq.q: What is Zygand's main goal in Tirisfal Glades?

faq.a: Zygand acts as the superior officer to Executor Arren, who directs initial recruits in Deathknell, as well as field sentries like Deathguard Linnea patrolling the main crossroads of Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Who reports to Executor Zygand?

faq.a: Yes. In addition to fighting the Scarlet Crusade, Zygand issues regional bounties to eliminate feral undead and dangerous rogue scavengers, such as the corpse-stealing gnoll Maggot Eye, that endanger travel through the glades.
faq.q: Does Executor Zygand handle rogue undead threats?

faq.a: An Executor serves as a regional governor and military commander within the Forsaken hierarchy. They manage settlements, command local units of the Deathguard, and enforce Queen Sylvanas's rule across Lordaeron's contested regions.
faq.q: What rank does an 'Executor' hold among the Forsaken?

text.s: Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken commander stationed at the town hall in Brill, overseeing defensive and military operations across central Tirisfal Glades. Reporting directly to the Undercity's high command, he coordinates the purge of Scarlet Crusade forces pressing into Forsaken territory.

sec.b: Positioned at the administrative heart of Brill, Executor Zygand coordinates regional defense for the Forsaken after their initial awakening in Deathknell. Serving as the direct superior to regional officers like Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea, Zygand synthesizes scout intelligence and dispatches able recruits to safeguard Lordaeron's borders from encroachment.

Zygand's primary military concern is the fanatic presence of the Scarlet Crusade, which infests outposts across Tirisfal Glades. Under his direction, agents are sent systematically to strike at Crusader scouts, encampments, and forward bases, ensuring the zealots never muster sufficient strength to threaten the approaches to the Undercity.

npc:fandral-staghelm.s: Fandral Corzocelada. El archidruida Fandral Corzocelada lidera a los druidas del Círculo Cenarion desde el Enclave Cenarion en Darnassus. Al asumir el poder tras la desaparición de Malfurión Tempestira en el Sueño Esmeralda, impulsó la plantación del nuevo Árbol del Mundo, Teldrassil. Orgulloso, arisco e implacablemente ambicioso, Fandral aboga por un resurgimiento agresivo de los kaldorei que a menudo lo enfrenta a la suma sacerdotisa Tyrande Susurravientos. Tras la Tercera Guerra y el sacrificio de Nordrassil en la cima del Monte Hyjal, los elfos de la noche perdieron su inmortalidad y su sagrado santuario. Mientras Malfurión Tempestira aconsejaba paciencia y advertía contra la vanidad, Fandral defendió la audaz creación de un nuevo Árbol del Mundo frente a la costa de Kalimdor. Cuando Malfurión cayó en coma posteriormente en el Sueño Esmeralda, Fandral tomó la iniciativa y guio a los druidas para erigir Teldrassil. Concibió la colosal rama como un monumento a la resistencia de los kaldorei y un medio para restaurar su supremacía perdida, aun cuando los Aspectos Dragón negaron deliberadamente sus bendiciones a tal empresa no consentida.

ang.class:Druid: Staghelm commands the Darnassian druids, pushing the Cenarion Circle toward direct worldly authority while clashing with the traditional teachings of the sleeping Malfurion Stormrage.
ang.faction:Alliance: Though Teldrassil serves as an Alliance bastion in northern Kalimdor, Staghelm views the younger races with thinly veiled disdain, tolerating their presence only as political expediency demands.
ang.race:NightElf: As one of Darnassus's primary leaders, Fandral embodies Kaldorei pride and fury, driving the settlement of Teldrassil even as ordinary citizens feel the rift between his enclave and the Temple of the Moon.

faq.a: Fandral Staghelm is the acting Archdruid of the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus, presiding over Kaldorei druids in Malfurion Stormrage's absence. Known for his fiery temperament and imperial ambitions, he is the primary visionary behind the creation of Teldrassil.
faq.q: Who is Fandral Staghelm?

faq.a: Fandral advocates for Kaldorei military resurgence, aggressive expansion, and reclaiming lost immortality. Tyrande Whisperwind pursues cautious spiritual guidance through Elune. Their competing visions for the night elves' post-Hyjal future spark fierce political friction within Darnassus.
al: why do druids and priestesses disagree
faq.q: Why doesn't Fandral get along with Tyrande?

faq.a: Malfurion believed planting a replacement for Nordrassil was an act of hubris that nature would not condone. When Malfurion vanished into his coma, Fandral rallied the remaining druids to plant Teldrassil regardless, seeking to restore Kaldorei power and reclaim their lost immortality.
faq.q: Why was Teldrassil planted against Malfurion's wishes?

faq.a: During the War of the Shifting Sands in Silithus, Fandral's son Valstann was lured into an ambush at Southwind Village. The qiraji General Rajaxx captured Valstann and slaughtered him in front of Fandral, leaving the Archdruid grief-stricken and permanently embittered.
faq.q: What happened to Fandral's son?

faq.a: Fandral stands atop the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, surrounded by his loyal druids and overseeable business of the Kaldorei capital.
faq.q: Where can Fandral Staghelm be found?

text.s: Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids of the Cenarion Circle from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Stepping into power after Malfurion Stormrage vanished into the Emerald Dream, he championed the planting of the new World Tree, Teldrassil. Proud, abrasive, and relentlessly ambitious, Fandral advocates for an aggressive Kaldorei resurgence that frequently pits him against High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

sec.b: Following the Third War and the sacrifice of Nordrassil atop Mount Hyjal, the night elves lost their immortality and their sacred sanctuary. While Malfurion Stormrage cautioned patience and warned against vanity, Fandral championed the bold creation of a new World Tree off the coast of Kalimdor. When Malfurion subsequently fell comatose within the Emerald Dream, Fandral seized the initiative and led the druids in raising Teldrassil. He envisioned the colossal bough as a monument to Kaldorei endurance and a vessel to restore their lost supremacy, even though the Dragon Aspects pointedly withheld their blessings from the unapproved endeavor.

A millennium before the First War, Fandral served as the Kaldorei field commander in Silithus during the War of the Shifting Sands. Renowned among the insectoid qiraji as 'Kar'sis'—the Hand of Earth—he held the front lines alongside his beloved only son, Valstann. Exploiting Fandral's devotion, the qiraji General Rajaxx engineered a feint against Southwind Village and captured Valstann, ruthlessly executing him directly in front of the horrified Archdruid. The loss shattered Fandral's spirit, precipitating a devastating retreat and cementing an abiding, bitter hatred for the swarm that remains etched into his haughty demeanor.

Within the marble boughs of Darnassus, Fandral governs Kaldorei affairs with a haughty, unyielding hand. Unlike High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, who favors spiritual preservation and cautious diplomacy, Fandral views military expansion and decisive strength as paramount to the survival of their people.

npc:farthing.s: Lontananza. El Obispo Lontananza es un clérigo humano que reside en la Catedral de la Luz, en la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Ante visitantes y devotos, se presenta como un devoto siervo de la Sagrada Luz que guía a los feligreses y canaliza ayuda hacia los asentamientos asediados de todo el reino. Entre las serenas salas de mármol de la Catedral de la Luz, el Obispo Lontananza se erige como una de las figuras destacadas dedicadas a atender las necesidades espirituales de la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Junto al Arzobispo Benedictus y al resto del clero congregado, ofrece consejo a los viajeros, asiste a quienes se instruyen en las artes sagradas y se ocupa de las obligaciones cívicas y pastorales de la Iglesia de la Luz Sagrada.

ang.class:Priest: For priests visiting the Cathedral of Light, Farthing represents the established hierarchy and scholarly wisdom of the human clergy in Stormwind.
ang.faction:Alliance: Adventurers battling the creeping corruption in southern Alliance territories such as Duskwood look to Farthing and his fellow clergy for divine insight and spiritual resolve.

faq.a: Bishop Farthing resides inside the Cathedral of Light, located at the center of Cathedral Square within Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can Bishop Farthing be found?

faq.a: He serves as an ordained bishop within the Church of the Holy Light, offering guidance to visiting faithful, priests in training, and adventurers seeking holy wisdom on behalf of distant settlements.
faq.q: What role does Farthing play in the Cathedral?

faq.a: Farthing is sought out by adventurers dealing with the undead menace in Duskwood, advising on the dark arts sustaining the necromancer Morbent Fel and directing souls toward purification.
faq.q: How is Farthing involved with Duskwood?

faq.a: Several other individuals across human lands share the surname Farthing, including Coleman and Yvette Farthing, though he does not actively speak of any direct family ties.
faq.q: Is Farthing related to other citizens bearing the same name?

text.s: Bishop Farthing is a human clergyman residing within the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. To visitors and worshippers, he presents himself as a devout servant of the Holy Light who guides parishioners and directs aid toward beleaguered settlements across the kingdom.

sec.b: Within the serene marble halls of the Cathedral of Light, Bishop Farthing stands as one of the prominent figures attending to the spiritual needs of Stormwind City. Alongside Archbishop Benedictus and the gathered clergy, he offers counsel to travelers, assists those pursuing the holy arts, and attends to the civic and pastoral obligations of the Church of the Holy Light.

Despite remaining situated within the capital, Farthing directs earnest travelers toward darker corners of the kingdom that desperately require holy aid. When troubled reports filter in regarding the necromancer Morbent Fel and the creeping undead blight overtaking Duskwood, Farthing serves as an advisor in seeking out methods to overcome dark sorceries and cleanse the blighted frontier.

npc:fenrus-the-devourer.s: Fenrus el Devorador. Fenrus el Devorador es un enorme huargo que merodea por el sagrario superior del Castillo de Colmillo Oscuro. Mantenido como mascota personal y guardián por el Archimago Arugal, la voraz bestia está hinchada de magias antinaturales. Cualquiera que se atreva a traspasar el estudio personal del archimago debe enfrentarse a este horror salvaje y al amo que vela por él. En lo profundo del Castillo de Colmillo Oscuro, a las puertas de los aposentos personales del Archimago Arugal, acecha el monstruoso huargo conocido como Fenrus el Devorador. A diferencia de los huargen lupinos que recorren las almenas, Fenrus es un verdadero huargo, hinchado hasta alcanzar proporciones gigantescas. Merodeando entre estanterías, pergaminos y aparatos arcanos del estudio privado de Arugal, la bestia sirve tanto de mascota como de violento guardia perimetral contra cualquier intruso que busque la cabeza del mago loco.

ang.class:Hunter: Do not waste time attempting to charm Fenrus. The beast's mind is irrevocably twisted by Shadowfang's dark arts and cannot be bound by the wild.
ang.class:Mage: Fenrus stands as a grim reminder of how far Archmage Arugal has fallen, using arcane arts to warp wild beasts into grotesque domestic guardians.
ang.class:Warlock: Archmage Arugal's ability to summon voidwalkers to aid his hound reveals how deeply the former Dalaran mage has delved into shadowy, forbidden conjurations.

faq.a: Fenrus is an exceptionally large worg, a natural wolf-like predator indigenous to Lordaeron, rather than a bipedal worgen. His unnatural bulk and vicious ferocity are the direct results of prolonged exposure to the dark magic practicing within Shadowfang Keep.
faq.q: What kind of creature is Fenrus?

faq.a: Fenrus prowls the study chambers high inside Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. His lair is situated directly along the approach to Archmage Arugal's inner redoubt.
faq.q: Where can Fenrus be found?

faq.a: No. Despite being an ordinary beast by classification, Fenrus cannot be tamed. His mind is thoroughly broken, feral, and tied to Archmage Arugal's dark will.
faq.q: Can hunters tame Fenrus as a pet?

faq.a: Arugal views Fenrus as his prized pet and final line of defense before his sanctum. When Fenrus bellows upon entering combat, Arugal intervenes directly, conjuring voidwalkers into the chamber to overwhelm whoever threatens his beast.
faq.q: Why does Arugal summon demons when Fenrus is attacked?

faq.a: Fenrus's massive size is believed to be the consequence of Archmage Arugal's dark magical experimentation, or magical fallout from the worgen infestation overtaking the keep.
faq.q: Why is Fenrus so much larger than normal worgs?

faq.a: When Fenrus engages in combat, he unleashes a thunderous roar so loud it can be heard by anyone anywhere inside Shadowfang Keep, alerting all to the battle taking place outside Arugal's door.
faq.q: What happens across the dungeon when Fenrus is engaged?

text.s: Fenrus the Devourer is an enormous worg that prowls the upper sanctum of Shadowfang Keep. Kept as a personal pet and guardian by Archmage Arugal, the ravenous beast is bloated on unnatural magics. Anyone daring to breach the archmage's personal study must contend with this feral horror and the master who watches over it.

sec.b: Deep within Shadowfang Keep, just outside Archmage Arugal's personal chambers, lurks the monstrous worg known as Fenrus the Devourer. Unlike the lupine worgen roaming the ramparts, Fenrus is an actual worg, swollen to gargantuan proportions. Prowling the shelves, scrolls, and arcane apparatuses of Arugal's private study, the beast serves both as a pet and as a violent perimeter guard against any intruder seeking the mad mage's head.
sec.t: A Beast in the Master's Study

sec.b: Fenrus's unnatural bulk suggests he was subjected to the dark magics saturating the keep since Baron Silverlaine's downfall. Archmage Arugal or his unleashed worgen clearly warped the creature with arcane or shadowy experiments, transforming a native predator into a ravenous juggernaut. Fenrus is so feral and magically bound that no hunter can charm or tame his mind.

Disturbing Fenrus is an immediate death sentence for the careless. When the beast spots an intruder, it lets loose an ear-splitting howl that echoes across the entire fortress, drawing the direct attention of Arugal himself. Rather than leaving his pet undefended, the archmage projects his dark will into the chamber, summoning voidwalkers to assist Fenrus in overwhelming and devouring invaders.

npc:first-mate-fitzsimmons.s: Primer oficial Fistimos. El Primer oficial Fistimos es un marinero andrajoso y maloliente que pasa los días bebiendo frente al Mesón Aguahonda, en el Puerto de Menethil. Antaño primer oficial a bordo del Wave Mistress de La Tercera Flota de Kul Tiras, es el único superviviente conocido con vida de la destrucción de la flota durante la Segunda Guerra. Atormentado por la tragedia, busca aventureros dispuestos a enfrentarse a los espíritus inquietos de sus camaradas ahogados. Tumbado frente al Mesón Aguahonda en medio del húmedo aire salino del Puerto de Menethil, el Primer oficial Fistimos es un hombre fácil de pasar por alto, o de evitar por completo debido a su hedor a falta de aseo. Para la mayoría de los parroquianos, no es más que otro viejo lobo de mar acabado que ahoga sus recuerdos en alcohol. Sin embargo, quienes estén dispuestos a sentarse y escuchar oirán relatos desgarradores sobre una orgullosa flota abatida por el fuego y las garras.

ang.faction:Alliance: Fitzsimmons represents a tragic chapter in Alliance naval history, reminding heroes of the catastrophic losses suffered against the Horde's enslaved dragon armada.
ang.race:Human: As a veteran of Kul Tiras, Fitzsimmons shares deep cultural ties with the seafaring human kingdom that sacrificed much to defend Lordaeron during the Second War.

faq.a: He is an old Kul Tiran sailor and former first mate of the Wave Mistress. He survived the catastrophic sinking of Kul Tiras's Third Fleet during the Second War and now drinks his days away outside Menethil Harbor's Deepwater Tavern.
faq.q: Who is First Mate Fitzsimmons?

faq.a: The Wave Mistress and the rest of the Third Fleet were ambushed by enslaved red dragons ridden by the Dragonmaw clan during the Second War. The vessels were burned and broken upon the reef off the Wetlands coast.
faq.q: What happened to his ship?

faq.a: The shattered hulls of the fleet lie submerged along the rocky coastline north of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, now guarded by murlocs and the restless spirits of drowned sailors.
faq.q: Where is the Lost Fleet located?

faq.a: The drowned sailors of the Third Fleet rose as cursed, tormented undead rather than passing on. Fitzsimmons seeks brave travelers to put them to rest and retrieve the artifacts keeping their souls shackled.
faq.q: Why does he want adventurers to fight his old crew?

faq.a: It is an ancient, potent artifact carried aboard the Third Fleet. Its dark power is tied to the curse afflicting the sunken sailors, making its recovery crucial to granting the drowned fleet peace.
faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?

faq.a: Having lost everything when his fleet went down, Fitzsimmons has lived in drunken neglect outside the Deepwater Tavern for years, wearing sea-soaked rags and rarely washing.
faq.q: Why does Fitzsimmons smell so bad?

text.s: First Mate Fitzsimmons is a ragged, reeking sailor who spends his days drinking outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Once the first mate aboard the Wave Mistress of the Kul Tiras Third Fleet, he is the sole known living survivor of the fleet's destruction during the Second War. Haunted by the tragedy, he seeks willing adventurers to face the restless spirits of his drowned comrades.

sec.b: Lounging outside the Deepwater Tavern amid the damp salt air of Menethil Harbor, First Mate Fitzsimmons is an easy man to overlook—or avoid entirely, given his unwashed stench. To most patrons, he is just another broken old salt drinking his memories away. Yet those willing to sit and listen will hear harrowing tales of a proud fleet brought low by fire and claw.

During the Second War, Fitzsimmons served as first mate aboard the Wave Mistress, part of the Kul Tiras Third Fleet dispatched to fight the Horde. Off the coast of the Wetlands, the fleet was ambushed and incinerated by enslaved red dragons flown by Dragonmaw orcs. The ships were shattered and sunk, leaving Fitzsimmons as the only man to drag himself ashore alive.
sec.t: The Fall of the Third Fleet

sec.b: Surviving the dragonfire did not bring Fitzsimmons peace. The remains of the ships, now remembered as the Lost Fleet, are haunted by his former crewmates, who rose as cursed undead unable to rest in their watery graves. Driven by guilt and terror, Fitzsimmons recruits travelers to put down the undead sailors and recover ancient relics that might finally lift the evil binding their souls.

npc:foreman-oslow.s: Supervisor Olento. El Supervisor Olento es el asediado maestro de obras de Villa del Lago, encargado de reparar el derruido puente del Lago Sempiterno en el corazón de las Montañas Crestagrana. Acosado por la artillería de los orcos Rocanegra y los asaltantes grolls, sus esfuerzos de reconstrucción se han estancado debido a envíos perdidos y equipo hundido. Depende en gran medida de los aventureros errantes para recuperar su equipo y asegurar materiales para que Villa del Lago pueda reconectar su ruta comercial vital. Junto a la mampostería fracturada del puente del Lago Sempiterno, el Supervisor Olento se enfrenta a una ardua batalla. El puente es la arteria de Villa del Lago, cruzando la extensión del Lago Sempiterno y uniendo los caminos occidentales hacia Elwynn con las costas orientales. Los orcos Rocanegra, descendiendo de los riscos de Petravista, atacaron el paso para inutilizar la logística y el movimiento militar de la villa, dejándola dividida y vulnerable.

ang.faction:Alliance: Lakeshire's severed bridge leaves the eastern frontier exposed, making Oslow's restoration efforts a strategic necessity for securing the Alliance border.
ang.profession:Mining: Oslow relies on raw materials, metalwork, and quarry shipments to rebuild broken masonry, keeping him intimately tied to local mineral deliveries.

faq.a: Foreman Oslow is a human stonemason and builder stationed in Lakeshire. He is the head craftsman responsible for the maintenance and reconstruction of the Everstill Bridge.
faq.q: Who is Foreman Oslow?

faq.a: The Everstill Bridge was shattered by the Blackrock orcs of Redridge Mountains. Destroying the span severed Lakeshire's main thoroughfare, severely weakening the town's defenses and cutting off easy transit between the eastern and western shores.
faq.q: Why is the Everstill Bridge broken?

faq.a: Oslow's heavy toolbox rests at the bottom of Lake Everstill. The boat transporting them from Goldshire was struck and sunk by a Blackrock catapult barrage.
faq.q: Where are Oslow's lost tools?

faq.a: Between orc catapult fire sinking his tools in the lake and gnolls stealing building supplies from incoming shipments, Oslow lacks the necessary materials and equipment to resume construction without outside help.
faq.q: Why hasn't the bridge been repaired yet?

faq.a: His replacement tools were originally carted in on a wagon from Goldshire in Elwynn Forest before being transferred to a lake ferry to bypass the broken span.
faq.q: Where did Oslow's supplies come from originally?

faq.a: Oslow faces constant harassment from two fronts: the Blackrock clan orcs entrenched in the nearby heights, whose siege engines bombard the lake, and prowling gnolls who pick off supply convoys.
faq.q: What threats is Oslow dealing with?

text.s: Foreman Oslow is Lakeshire's beleaguered master builder, tasked with repairing the ruined Everstill Bridge in the heart of Redridge Mountains. Beset by Blackrock orc artillery and gnoll raiders, his reconstruction efforts have stalled due to lost shipments and sunken equipment. He relies heavily on traveling adventurers to retrieve his gear and secure materials so Lakeshire can reconnect its vital trade route.

sec.b: Standing by the fractured masonry of the Everstill Bridge, Foreman Oslow faces an uphill battle. The bridge is the lifeline of Lakeshire, spanning the expanse of Lake Everstill and linking the western roads toward Elwynn to the eastern shores. Blackrock orcs, sweeping down from the crags of Stonewatch, targeted the crossing to cripple the town's logistics and military movement, leaving the settlement splintered and vulnerable.

Every attempt Oslow makes to rebuild seems plagued by misfortune. When the bridge fell, his replacement tools were shipped overland from Goldshire and loaded onto a lake ferry. Orc catapult crews caught the vessel in their sights, sending his heavy iron toolbox straight to the muddy bed of Lake Everstill. To compound matters, local Redridge gnolls ambushed his supply wagons, making off with timber and mortar rivets necessary to raise the arches.

npc:furen-longbeard.s: Furen Barbalarga. Furen Barbalarga es un maestro armero enano establecido en el bullicioso Distrito de los Enanos de la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Como aprendiz del renombrado herrero Grimand Elmore, se especializa en fabricar equipo de protección pesado y mallas resistentes para los avezados defensores de la Alianza. Guerreros de todo el reino acuden a él en busca de sus conocimientos de metalurgia para forjar armaduras especializadas y listas para el combate. Furen Barbalarga ejerce su oficio lejos de las grandes forjas de Forjaz, habiendo establecido su hogar entre los adoquines y el hollín del Distrito de los Enanos de Ventormenta. Como muchos de sus congéneres, Furen llevó la metalurgia tradicional enana hacia el sur para apoyar la reconstrucción y la defensa del reino. Trabajando entre fogones ardientes y yunques resonantes, mantiene estrechos lazos con otros artesanos por toda la ciudad y más allá.

ang.class:Warrior: For Alliance warriors coming of age, Furen Longbeard is a pivotal contact who turns raw martial resolve and gathered reagents into vital, fire-hardened defensive armor.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: Furen represents the high standards of dwarven smithing established in Stormwind, showcasing advanced techniques passed down by Grimand Elmore.
ang.race:Dwarf: Even far from Ironforge, Furen Longbeard keeps dwarven metallurgical traditions alive in the heart of the human capital.

faq.a: Furen Longbeard is a dwarven armorer operating out of the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He serves as an essential contact and mentor for Alliance warriors looking to acquire mastercrafted mail armor.
faq.q: Who is Furen Longbeard?

faq.a: He is located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City, standing near the bustling forges and smithing workshops that dominate the neighborhood.
faq.q: Where can Furen Longbeard be found?

faq.a: Furen was taught armorcraft and metallurgy by Grimand Elmore, a respected veteran craftsman also residing in the Dwarven District.
faq.q: Who taught Furen his smithing craft?

faq.a: He is renowned for fashioning Fire Hardened Mail, a resilient set of armor created through exacting metallurgical processes requiring rare components gathered across the continent.
faq.q: What armor is Furen famous for crafting?

faq.a: He shares his clan name with several other prominent dwarves across the Eastern Kingdoms, such as the seasoned mountaineer Pilot Longbeard, though he focuses strictly on smithing.
faq.q: Is Furen Longbeard related to other Longbeards?

faq.a: Warriors who have proven their basic martial prowess are directed to Furen to obtain heavy, durable armor capable of enduring front-line combat against deadlier threats.
faq.q: Why do warriors seek out Furen Longbeard?

text.s: Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorer stationed within Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. Apprenticed under the renowned smith Grimand Elmore, he specializes in crafting heavy protective gear and sturdy mail for seasoned defenders of the Alliance. Warriors across the kingdom seek out his metallurgical expertise to forge specialized, battle-ready armor.

sec.b: Furen Longbeard plies his craft far from the great forges of Ironforge, making his home instead among the cobblestones and soot of Stormwind's Dwarven District. Like many of his kin, Furen brought traditional dwarven metallurgy south to support the rebuilding and defense of the kingdom. Working amidst blazing hearths and clanging anvils, he maintains strong ties with other artisans throughout the city and beyond.
sec.t: A Dwarven Smith in the Human Capital

sec.b: Taught by the venerable craftsman Grimand Elmore, Furen has perfected techniques for treating heavy mail and plate to withstand extreme battlefield punishment. Promising young warriors seeking durable protection often turn to Furen, who requires rare ores, specialized components, and exotic reagents from distant corners of the world to fashion his signature fire-hardened armor.

npc:gakin-the-darkbinder.s: Gakin el Presotenebra. Gakin el Presotenebra es un maestro brujo que opera en secreto en las profundidades de la taberna El Cordero Degollado, en el Barrio de los Magos de Ventormenta. Instruye a los aspirantes de la Alianza en las artes oscuras y pone a prueba su determinación antes de iniciar rituales para invocar y someter a demonios de otros mundos a su servicio. Mientras los magos de Ventormenta practican abiertamente en sus imponentes santuarios, los practicantes de las sombras y lo vil deben morar donde las miradas indiscretas no puedan llegar. Oculto bajo la sala común de El Cordero Degollado hay un sótano húmedo similar a una cripta, equipado con círculos de invocación y siniestros tomos. Gakin ejerce como eje central de este cónclave oculto, asegurándose de que los jóvenes brujos aprendan disciplina y moderación antes de desatar horrores que no puedan controlar.

ang.class:Warlock: Gakin is a vital mentor for human and gnome warlocks, offering pivotal class quests to master the voidwalker and succubus rituals in the crypts of Stormwind.
ang.faction:Alliance: Operating secretly under the capital city, Gakin's coven demonstrates the pragmatic, shadow-drenched compromises made in the heart of the Alliance.

faq.a: Gakin is located deep beneath The Slaughtered Lamb tavern in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind. Head inside the tavern, find the downward ramp at the back, and descend through the stone tunnels until you reach the summoning circle in the lowest crypt.
faq.q: Where can I find Gakin the Darkbinder?

faq.a: He serves as a prominent warlock quest-giver and mentor for Alliance characters. He tests novitiates by sending them on trials across Azeroth and teaching them how to summon and bind demons like the Voidwalker and Succubus.
faq.q: What does Gakin the Darkbinder do?

faq.a: Demonic magic is forbidden and deeply mistrusted in Stormwind. The practitioners under The Slaughtered Lamb operate in strict secrecy, tolerated only as a dangerous covert asset and hidden away from the city's guards and citizens.
faq.q: Why are warlocks allowed under The Slaughtered Lamb?

faq.a: Surena Caledon was a former student of Gakin who stole a powerful Bloodstone Choker from him. Her betrayal poses a danger to their hidden order, prompting Gakin to task warlocks with tracking her down.
faq.q: Who is Surena Caledon?

faq.a: Gakin oversees the binding rituals for both Voidwalkers and Succubi, guiding warlocks to draw the creatures into the subterranean circle and subdue them.
faq.q: Which demons does Gakin help summon?

faq.a: Strahad Farsan is an experienced warlock residing in the Ratchet hills of Kalimdor. Once a student advances past Gakin's fundamental binding rituals, Gakin directs them across the sea to continue their darker education with Strahad.
al: where does gakin send me next
faq.q: Who is Strahad and why does Gakin mention him?

text.s: Gakin the Darkbinder is a master warlock operating covertly deep beneath The Slaughtered Lamb tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He instructs aspiring Alliance practitioners in the dark arts, testing their resolve before initiating rituals to summon and bind otherworldly demons to their service.

sec.b: While Stormwind's mages practice openly in their towering sanctuaries, practitioners of shadow and fel must dwell where prying eyes cannot reach. Hidden below the taproom of The Slaughtered Lamb is a damp crypt-like cellar equipped with summoning circles and grim tomes. Gakin serves as the anchor of this hidden conclave, ensuring that young warlocks learn discipline and restraint before unleashing horrors they cannot control.

Gakin's expertise lies in demonology and binding rituals. Initiates who earn his notice are sent across the kingdom to acquire rare relics and ingredients—from stolen bloodstone talismans to corrupt wood from the dark forests. Once the reagents are assembled, Gakin oversees rituals in the crypt's summoning circle, forcing novitiates to subjugate voidwalkers and succubi in life-or-death trials of willpower.

Not all of Gakin's students remain obedient. One former apprentice, Surena Caledon, absconded with a valuable Bloodstone Choker, fleeing into the wilds. Such internal treacheries threaten to expose the warlock circle to the city guards, prompting Gakin to dispatch loyal followers to recover lost artifacts and silence loose ends before the authorities take notice.

npc:gan-rul-bloodeye.s: Ojo sangriento de Gan'rul. Ojo sangriento de Gan'rul es un veterano instructor de brujos orco que reside en las profundidades de la oscura caverna del Circo de las Sombras, en Orgrimmar. Oculto a la atenta mirada de la ciudad de la superficie, inicia a los brujos de la Horda en ritos demoníacos más oscuros. Bajo su tutela, los iniciados aprenden a someter a su voluntad a entidades de otros mundos, como abisarios y súcubos. Aunque el Jefe de Guerra Thrall tolera la presencia de brujos en la nueva Horda, sus artes oscuras no son bienvenidas a plena luz del sol en Durotar. Ojo sangriento de Gan'rul tiene su morada en el Circo de las Sombras, un refugio subterráneo bajo Orgrimmar donde tejedores de sombras, pícaros y taumaturgos viles pueden estudiar sin ser molestados. Desde este enclave subterráneo, Gan'rul ejerce de tutor principal para los practicantes prometedores de la magia vil.

ang.class:Warlock: For warlocks seeking forbidden knowledge, Gan'rul is a vital mentor in Kalimdor, providing the knowledge and trials needed to bind voidwalkers and succubi.
ang.faction:Horde: Gan'rul embodies the precarious position of fel magic in Thrall's Horde—utilized for military strength, but confined to the underground recesses of the capital.

faq.a: Gan'rul Bloodeye is an orc warlock trainer stationed in Orgrimmar. He mentors novice and intermediate Horde warlocks, teaching them how to summon and bind demons from the Twisting Nether.
faq.q: Who is Gan'rul Bloodeye?

faq.a: He is located in the Cleft of Shadow, the subterranean cavern network hidden beneath Orgrimmar. He stands alongside fellow dark practitioners, away from the main thoroughfares of the city.
al: where is cleft of shadow trainer
faq.q: Where can I find Gan'rul Bloodeye?

faq.a: Warchief Thrall and the shamanistic society of the new Horde strongly distrust fel magic and demonic corruption after the orcs' past enslavement. Warlocks are permitted within the Horde strictly for their utility, but their practice is relegated to the shadows to prevent civic unrest.
faq.q: Why are warlocks hidden in the Cleft of Shadow?

faq.a: Gan'rul guides warlocks through the rituals required to summon and subjugate both the voidwalker and the succubus. Completing his tasks proves that the summoner possesses the necessary willpower to control these fiends.
faq.q: What demons does Gan'rul help summon?

faq.a: He shares a surname with Halga Bloodeye, though their precise relationship is not openly documented.
faq.q: Does Gan'rul have any known family?

faq.a: Strahad Farsan is an accomplished warlock residing in the Barrens near the Ratchet hills. Gan'rul eventually sends promising students to Strahad for more advanced instruction and greater challenges.
faq.q: Who is Strahad, whom Gan'rul mentions?

text.s: Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior orc warlock trainer residing deep within the dark cavern of the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Hidden away from the watchful gaze of the city above, he initiates Horde warlocks into darker demonic rites. Under his instruction, initiates learn to bend otherworldly entities like voidwalkers and succubi to their will.

sec.b: While Warchief Thrall tolerates the presence of warlocks in the new Horde, their dark arts are not welcomed in the open sunlight of Durotar. Gan'rul Bloodeye makes his home in the Cleft of Shadow, a subterranean refuge beneath Orgrimmar where shadow weavers, rogues, and fel casters can study unmolested. From this subterranean perch, Gan'rul serves as a primary tutor for rising practitioners of fel magic.

Gan'rul's primary duty is overseeing the dangerous summoning rituals required of ambitious warlocks. Practitioners seeking to bind greater demons—such as the resilient voidwalker or the seductive succubus—must consult Gan'rul to secure ritual components and learn the precise incantations needed to dominate the summoned creature before it consumes its master.

npc:gann-stonespire.s: Gann Picopiedra. Gann Picopiedra es un agraviado nómada tauren al que se encuentra vagando por los caminos del sur de Los Baldíos, cerca de Bael Modan. Expulsado de los cotos de caza ancestrales de su tribu por excavadores enanos, busca represalias contra el yacimiento arqueológico que no deja de expandirse. Antes de que la expedición enana llegara desde Forjaz para excavar la fortaleza de Bael Modan, las tierras circundantes servían como territorio ancestral y cotos de caza para la tribu de Gann Picopiedra. Los mineros enanos expulsaron a los tauren autóctonos de su suelo con picos, armas de fuego y maquinaria pesada, rechazando cualquier intento pacífico. Ahora, acampado junto al polvoriento camino del sur de Los Baldíos, Gann se niega a entregar su herencia en silencio y reúne a viajeros para contraatacar a los excavadores.

ang.faction:Horde: Assisting Gann provides the Horde a vital tactical opportunity to blunt Alliance expansionism entrenched within the southern Barrens.
ang.race:Tauren: Gann's plight represents the broader struggle of the nomadic tauren, whose ancestral ranges and sacred earth are repeatedly desecrated by foreign Alliance expeditions.

faq.a: Gann Stonespire is a tauren warrior whose tribe once inhabited the lands now occupied by the dwarven fortress of Bael Modan. Having been displaced when the dwarves established their dig site, he now waits by the roadside in the southern Barrens seeking vengeance and the reclamation of his people's homeland.
faq.q: Who is Gann Stonespire?

faq.a: The Bael'dun dwarven expedition arrived in the southern Barrens and forcefully ejected the local tauren from their ancestral hunting grounds to construct their excavation fortress. After the dwarves rejected all diplomatic efforts, Gann resolved to dismantle their operation through force.
faq.q: Why is Gann fighting the dwarves of Bael Modan?

faq.a: Gann first commissions the death of dwarven overseers, including Prospector Khazgorm, to seize excavation records. Using stolen dwarven ordnance and blasting supplies, he then orchestrates the assembly of a bomb to destroy the expedition's flying machine and disrupt their technological dominance.
faq.q: What is Gann's plan against the excavation?

faq.a: He can be found wandering the road just west of Bael Modan in the southern Barrens, just outside the perimeter of the excavation site.
faq.q: Where does Gann Stonespire make his camp?

text.s: Gann Stonespire is an aggrieved tauren nomad found wandering the roads of the southern Barrens near Bael Modan. Driven from his tribe's ancestral hunting grounds by dwarven excavators, he seeks retaliation against the encroaching dig site.

sec.b: Before the dwarven expedition arrived from Ironforge to carve out the fortress of Bael Modan, the surrounding land served as ancestral territory and hunting grounds for Gann Stonespire's tribe. The dwarven miners drove the indigenous tauren from their soil with pickaxes, firearms, and heavy machinery, refusing peaceful overtures. Now camping along the dusty southern Barrens road, Gann refuses to quietly surrender his heritage, marshaling travelers to strike back at the excavators.

Recognizing that peaceful diplomacy has completely failed, Gann directs Horde operatives to break the dwarves' hold over the dig site. His retribution targets key expedition leadership, notably Prospector Khazgorm, before repurposing dwarven blasting powder and ordnance into an explosive charge. By detonating the contraption directly beneath the dwarven flying machine, Gann aims to cripple their technological advantage and reclaim honor for his displaced people.

npc:gaxim-rustfizzle.s: Gaxim Silvóxido. Gaxim Silvóxido es un ambicioso erudito y manitas gnomo destinado en un pequeño campamento de la Alianza a lo largo de la Senda de las Tejedoras en Sierra Espolón. Como representante de la Asamblea Iluminada de Arcanología, Alquimia e Ingeniería, busca demostrar a los escépticos elfos de la noche que los artificios avanzados y la alquimia pueden preservar su reino boscoso. Su curiosidad científica va acompañada de un profundo afán de venganza contra las destructivas operaciones de Ventura y Cía. Mientras que los elfos de la noche confían tradicionalmente en el druidismo ancestral y la magia de la naturaleza, Gaxim Silvóxido llegó a los escarpados desfiladeros de Sierra Espolón para demostrar una perspectiva radicalmente diferente. Como representante de la Asamblea Iluminada de Arcanología, Alquimia e Ingeniería, cree firmemente que los mecanismos calculados y las soluciones químicas pueden defender y restaurar las tierras vírgenes de Kalimdor con la misma eficacia que las plegarias a Elune. Acampado junto a la centinela Kaela Lanzasombra en la Senda de las Tejedoras, trabaja sin descanso para convencer a sus altos y solitarios aliados del valor ecológico de la ingeniería.

ang.faction:Alliance: Perched on the perilous Webwinder Path, Gaxim provides crucial scouting, intelligence, and sabotage missions to check aggressive industrial incursions in Stonetalon.
ang.profession:Engineering: Gaxim puts engineering principles to work in the field, designing covert operations and tactical devices specifically tuned to disrupt crude Venture Company machinery.
ang.race:Gnome: Gaxim represents gnomish academic pride at its finest, showing Kalimdor's ancient cultures that gears and reagents can save a forest just as well as nature magic.
ang.race:NightElf: Though traditionalists may scoff at his whirring gadgets and bubbling vials, Gaxim is a steadfast ally actively defending Ashenvale and Stonetalon borders from goblin industry.

faq.a: Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome scholar and inventor stationed at an Alliance lookout along the Webwinder Path in the Stonetalon Mountains. He serves as an emissary for the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences.
faq.q: Who is Gaxim Rustfizzle?

faq.a: It is an academic and scientific society of gnomes dedicated to blending the disciplines of arcane magic, alchemical mixtures, and mechanical engineering. Gaxim represents their ideals abroad in Kalimdor.
faq.q: What is the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences?

faq.a: Gaxim wants to demonstrate to the night elves that gnomish science and alchemy can actively protect and heal natural woodlands, offering a modern Alliance answer to forest conservation alongside traditional druidism.
faq.q: Why is Gaxim working with the night elves?

faq.a: The Venture Company is ruthlessly clear-cutting Windshear Crag with crude machines and toxic pollution. Gaxim despises their reckless exploitation and relishes turning volatile chemicals and sabotage against their operations.
faq.q: Why does Gaxim hate the Venture Company?

faq.a: He shares his small outpost with Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel watching over the trails leading into Windshear Crag.
faq.q: Who is camped with Gaxim on Webwinder Path?

faq.a: He is located at a modest Alliance camp along the Webwinder Path, just southwest of the industrial logging pits of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.
faq.q: Where can Gaxim Rustfizzle be found?

text.s: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an ambitious gnome scholar and tinker stationed at a small Alliance camp along the Webwinder Path in Stonetalon Mountains. A representative of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, he seeks to prove to skeptical night elves that advanced artifice and alchemy can preserve their woodland realm. His scientific curiosity is matched by a fierce vendetta against the destructive operations of the Venture Company.

sec.b: While night elves traditionally rely on ancient druidism and nature magic, Gaxim Rustfizzle arrived in the craggy passes of Stonetalon to demonstrate a radically different perspective. Representing the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, he genuinely believes that calculated mechanisms and chemical solutions can defend and restore Kalimdor's wilderness just as effectively as prayers to Elune. Camped alongside the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear on the Webwinder Path, he works tirelessly to convince his tall, reclusive allies of engineering's ecological merits.

Much of Gaxim's energy is channeled against the Venture Company, whose clear-cutting and industrial greed desecrate nearby Windshear Crag. Believing that crude goblin machinery deserves neither respect nor mercy, Gaxim coordinates covert operations and volatile chemical sabotage against their logging operations. To him, crippling their shredders and stealing their schematics is not merely tactical warfare—it is a practical demonstration that superior gnomish intellect always triumphs over careless corporate plunder.

npc:gazrog.s: Gazrog. Gazrog es un guerrero orco apostado en El Cruce, en el corazón de Los Baldíos. Con la tarea de mantener la logística y la seguridad a lo largo de los peligrosos caminos de la sabana, recluta a viajeros competentes de la Horda para hacer frente a las amenazas regionales e investigar patrullas perdidas. El Cruce sirve como el nudo vital para todo el tránsito de la Horda a través de Kalimdor, pero su aislamiento deja las líneas de suministro vulnerables tanto a merodeadores como a bestias. Gazrog monta guardia junto a los defensores del asentamiento, esforzándose por garantizar que los cargamentos, las monedas y los mensajeros lleguen a sus destinos. Mantener el orden en un territorio tan extenso exige una vigilancia constante, y Gazrog depende enormemente de los aventureros de paso para atajar las crisis que se gestan más allá de las empalizadas del puesto avanzado.

ang.faction:Horde: Gazrog is an early contact for Horde adventurers leaving Durotar or Mulgore, offering critical work to establish secure travel corridors across Kalimdor.
ang.race:Orc: As an orc veteran holding down the Crossroads, Gazrog embodies the gritty, no-nonsense grit required to tame the unforgiving Kalimdor frontier.

faq.a: Gazrog is located at the Crossroads, the central settlement connecting the northern, southern, and eastern routes of the Barrens.
faq.q: Where can Gazrog be found?

faq.a: He acts as an operational coordinator and guard at the Crossroads, handing out tasks to safeguard regional supply lines, recover intercepted shipments, and locate missing Horde personnel.
faq.q: What role does Gazrog play for the Horde?

faq.a: Horde coin convoys are frequently targeted by clever savannah raptors and opportunists roaming the Barrens trails, prompting Gazrog to send champions to hunt down the beasts and recover the cargo.
faq.q: What happened to the stolen silver Gazrog asks about?

faq.a: Dogran is a Horde grunt who was posted to the Crossroads to work with Gazrog. He never returned from duty: Gazrog has heard he is alive but injured and held prisoner by the quilboar, news he would rather keep from Dogran's mate, Zankaja.
faq.q: Who is Dogran?

faq.a: No. Gazrog serves the Horde directly out of the Crossroads, maintaining security for orc, tauren, and troll interests across the central Barrens.
faq.q: Is Gazrog affiliated with Ratchet or the goblins?

faq.a: No one is quite sure. The raptors hid the stolen silver at their nests in the Raptor Grounds south of Ratchet, and Gazrog wonders whether the stories of their intelligence are closer to the mark than he thought.
faq.q: Why are raptors stealing supplies in the Barrens?

text.s: Gazrog is an orc warrior stationed at the Crossroads in the heart of the Barrens. Tasked with maintaining logistics and security along the savannah's perilous roads, he recruits able Horde travelers to deal with regional threats and investigate lost patrols.

sec.b: The Crossroads serves as the vital junction for all Horde transit through Kalimdor, but its isolation leaves supply lines vulnerable to marauders and beasts alike. Gazrog stands watch alongside the settlement's defenders, working to ensure that cargo, coin, and couriers reach their destinations. Maintaining order in a sprawling wilderness requires constant vigilance, and Gazrog relies heavily on passing adventurers to handle crises brewing beyond the outpost's stockades.

Between predatory raptors harassing trails and aggressive quillboar clans ambushing scouts, Gazrog's duties never end. He frequently coordinates responses to highway robberies—such as retrieving stolen Horde shipments—and keeps track of missing soldiers like the grunt Dogran, who ended up an injured prisoner of the quilboar.

npc:gelbin-mekkatorque.s: Gelbin Mekkatorque. Gelbin Mekkatorque es el Manitas Mayor de los gnomos y reside actualmente exiliado en la Ciudad Manitas, dentro de Forjaz. Reconocido como un ingeniero visionario cuyas invenciones incluyen el mecanozancudo y el Tren subterráneo, ahora carga con el pesado fardo de la caída de Gnomeregan y supervisa los esfuerzos para recuperar el hogar ancestral de su pueblo. El liderazgo de los gnomos se gana mediante el intelecto y el mérito en lugar de linajes sanguíneos, y el ascenso de Gelbin Mekkatorque a Manitas Mayor fue impulsado por puro genio inventivo. Graduado en Gearshaft University, Mekkatorque revolucionó el transporte personal con la creación del primer mecanozancudo funcional. A lo largo de décadas de innovación, diseñó el microajustador giromático, robots de reparación automatizados y se asoció con los enanos Barbabronce para diseñar sus formidables máquinas de asedio. Cuando Ventormenta necesitó una conexión de tránsito rápido con Forjaz tras la Segunda Guerra, el Rey Magni Barbabronce recurrió a Mekkatorque, quien dibujó personalmente los esquemas y supervisó la construcción del Tren subterráneo.

ang.profession:Engineering: Standing before the High Tinker is standing before the author of the mechanostrider, the gyromatic micro-adjustor, and the Deeprun Tram. His workshop in Tinker Town represents the cutting edge of technological innovation.
ang.race:Gnome: Mekkatorque is the heart of your people in exile. Though the guilt of Gnomeregan's poisoning weighs on him, his brilliance and devotion to liberating your ancestral home command absolute loyalty in Tinker Town.

faq.a: Gelbin Mekkatorque is the elected High Tinker and leader of the gnomes. He is a master engineer who designed pivotal gnomish technologies, including the mechanostrider, repair bots, and the Deeprun Tram.
faq.q: Who is Gelbin Mekkatorque?

faq.a: Gnomeregan was overrun by a savage trogg invasion followed by a catastrophic radioactive fallout. Mekkatorque led the evacuation of his people across Dun Morogh to Ironforge, where King Magni Bronzebeard granted them refuge in Tinker Town while plans are made to take the city back.
faq.q: Why is Mekkatorque in Ironforge instead of Gnomeregan?

faq.a: Facing endless waves of troggs, Mekkatorque was persuaded by a trusted advisor to vent toxic radioactive coolant into the lower chambers to halt the beasts. Tragically, the gas failed to stop the troggs and instead irradiated the city, killing thousands of gnomes.
faq.q: What caused the catastrophe in Gnomeregan?

faq.a: Mekkatorque invented the mechanostrider, giving gnomes their own agile mount. He also designed the gyromatic micro-adjustor, repair bots, the schematics for the Deeprun Tram between Ironforge and Stormwind, and co-developed the dwarven siege engine.
faq.q: What did Mekkatorque invent before becoming High Tinker?

faq.a: Gnomes do not have a hereditary monarchy; their leader is an elected High Tinker chosen on merit and intellectual achievement. His title and authority derive from his election as High Tinker.
faq.q: Is Mekkatorque an actual king?

text.s: Gelbin Mekkatorque is the High Tinker of the gnomes, currently residing in exile in Tinker Town within Ironforge. Renowned as a visionary engineer whose inventions include the mechanostrider and the Deeprun Tram, he now carries the heavy burden of Gnomeregan's fall and oversees efforts to reclaim his people's ancestral home.

sec.b: Gnomish leadership is earned through intellect and merit rather than bloodlines, and Gelbin Mekkatorque's rise to High Tinker was propelled by pure inventive genius. A graduate of Gearshaft University, Mekkatorque revolutionized personal transportation with the creation of the first functioning mechanostrider. Over decades of innovation, he drafted the gyromatic micro-adjustor, automated repair bots, and partnered with the Bronzebeard dwarves to engineer their formidable siege engines. When Stormwind required a rapid transit connection to Ironforge after the Second War, King Magni Bronzebeard turned to Mekkatorque, who personally drew the schematics and oversaw construction of the subterranean Deeprun Tram.
sec.t: The High Tinker and Master Inventor

sec.b: Mekkatorque's greatest tragedy struck when troggs invaded Gnomeregan from deep below. Urged by his trusted friend and chief advisor, Sicco Thermaplugg, Mekkatorque ordered the venting of radioactive waste into the lower corridors to exterminate the attackers. Instead, the toxic gas slaughtered thousands of innocent gnomes and mutated the survivors, while Thermaplugg seized the ruined city. Crushed by guilt yet determined to fix his mistake, Mekkatorque led the surviving refugees across Dun Morogh to Ironforge. Operating out of Tinker Town under King Magni's hospitality, the High Tinker directs gnomekind's military and scientific energies toward a single unwavering objective: liberating Gnomeregan.

npc:gelihast.s: Gelihast. Gelihast es un feroz líder múrloc que empuña dos espadas y reside en Alberca de Ask'ar, en las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Atraído por los oscuros susurros de los Dioses Antiguos, se abrió paso masacrando hasta las ruinas del templo sumergido antes de ganarse el reacio respeto de los cultores del Martillo Crepuscular. Mientras que la mayoría de los múrlocs permanecen cerca de los bajíos costeros, Gelihast sintió la oscura y ominosa atracción de los Dioses Antiguos en las profundidades de Vallefresno. Impulsado por estos susurros primordiales, se abrió camino por la fuerza hasta el templo sumergido de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Cuando los cultores del Martillo Crepuscular intentaron cerrarle el paso, mató él solo a casi una docena de ellos usando sus espadas dobles.

ang.class:Warrior: Gelihast attacks with blinding sword speed; skilled warriors who brace themselves can turn his frantic dual-wielding assault entirely against him.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance forces seeking to cleanse the corruption leaking into Ashenvale, removing Gelihast is essential to secure the northern passages of the submerged temple.
ang.faction:Horde: Horde adventurers dispatched to scour Blackfathom Deeps must eliminate Gelihast to disrupt the cultist alliance festering beneath the Zoram Strand.

faq.a: Gelihast is a vicious murloc chieftain who commands the Blindlight tribe inside the Pool of Ask'ar in Blackfathom Deeps. He fights with twin blades and serves the dark presence lingering within the ruins.
faq.q: Who is Gelihast?

faq.a: He was drawn by the whispers of the Old Gods. Desiring to reach the source of the dark call, he invaded the ruins and carved a bloody path through the local cultists to claim his own territory.
al: why is there a murloc in bfd
why is gelihast in the temple
faq.q: Why is Gelihast inside Blackfathom Deeps?

faq.a: Although Gelihast slaughtered nearly a dozen Twilight's Hammer cultists upon entering the temple, the survivors were so impressed by his ferocity and cruelty that they permitted him to stay and worship alongside them.
faq.q: How did the Twilight's Hammer react to him?

faq.a: Gelihast erected the shrine to offer bloody sacrifices to the ominous presence in the ruins. Travelers who defeat him can touch the altar to receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.
faq.q: What is the altar behind Gelihast?

faq.a: He leads the Blindlight murlocs, an aggressive tribe that infests the Pool of Ask'ar within the caverns.
faq.q: What tribe of murlocs does he lead?

faq.a: He continues to sacrifice victims at his altar in the Pool of Ask'ar, serving as a vicious enforcer and fanatic servant of the shadowy horrors infesting the ruins.
faq.q: What happens to Gelihast if he is left unchecked?

text.s: Gelihast is a ferocious, twin-blade wielding murloc chieftain residing in the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps. Lured by the dark whispers of the Old Gods, he butchered his way into the sunken temple ruins before earning the reluctant respect of the Twilight's Hammer cultists.

sec.b: While most murlocs stay near coastal shallows, Gelihast felt the dark, ominous tug of the Old Gods deep beneath Ashenvale. Driven by these primordial whispers, he forced his way into the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps. When Twilight's Hammer cultists tried to halt his path, he slaughtered nearly a dozen of them single-handedly using his twin swords.

Rather than seeking vengeance, the cultists admired Gelihast's raw savagery and granted him dominion over the Pool of Ask'ar. There, surrounded by his Blindlight brood, the bloodthirsty murloc constructed a crude altar. He performs grim sacrifices upon it, receiving dark boons directly from the foul presence slumbering in the abyss.

npc:ghamoo-ra-classic.s: Ghamoo-ra. Ghamoo-ra es una antigua tortuga marina gigante que habita en Alberca de Ask'ar, dentro de Cavernas de Brazanegra. Antaño un habitante pacífico del templo sumergido de Elune, fue capturado, torturado y conducido a la locura por el culto del Martillo Crepuscular para servir como un feroz guardián. Antes de la profanación de Cavernas de Brazanegra, Ghamoo-ra se contaba entre los últimos habitantes naturales y pacíficos que moraban entre las ruinas anegadas del templo de los elfos de la noche dedicado a Elune. Cuando el nihilista culto del Martillo Crepuscular tomó el control del santuario, arrancó a la antigua tortuga de su vida tranquila y la encerró en cautiverio. En lugar de matarla, la atormentaron sistemáticamente durante años, sometiéndola a un desollamiento físico y mental a manos de los miembros del culto.

ang.class:Druid: Druids view Ghamoo-ra's torment and forced aggression as a tragic corruption of natural wildlife by the servants of the Old Gods.
ang.class:Hunter: Hunters venturing into Blackfathom Deeps may pity Ghamoo-ra, a noble, ancient beast broken by dark captivity, though a patient hunter may yet tame him.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, Ghamoo-ra's plight is a bitter reminder of the defilement of Elune's sacred temple by the vile Twilight's Hammer.

faq.a: Ghamoo-ra is a giant turtle found in the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps. Originally a peaceful dweller of the temple of Elune, he was captured, tortured, and broken into a ferocious guard beast by the Twilight's Hammer cult.
faq.q: Who is Ghamoo-ra?

faq.a: The Twilight's Hammer cult imprisoned the turtle and tortured him over several years, breaking his spirit and driving him to utter madness. They conditioned him to lash out at any outsider who approaches the inner shrines.
faq.q: Why is Ghamoo-ra hostile to outsiders?

faq.a: Yes. Despite his size and years of torment, Ghamoo-ra can be tamed by a skilled hunter.
faq.q: Can a hunter tame Ghamoo-ra?

faq.a: The Pool of Ask'ar is a flooded subterranean cavern in Blackfathom Deeps. Ghamoo-ra roams the center of a small island there, encircled by docile native turtles.
faq.q: What is the Pool of Ask'ar?

faq.a: While not inherently a creature of the Void, Ghamoo-ra's mind was warped by Twilight's Hammer cultists who worship the Old Gods. They twisted the ancient creature into an unwitting protector of their dark ritual grounds.
faq.q: What connection does he have to the Old Gods?

text.s: Ghamoo-ra is an ancient, giant sea turtle inhabiting the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps. Once a peaceful denizen of Elune's sunken temple, he was captured, tortured, and driven mad by the Twilight's Hammer cult to serve as a vicious guardian.

sec.b: Before the defilement of Blackfathom Deeps, Ghamoo-ra was among the last peaceful natural inhabitants dwelling among the flooded ruins of the night elven temple dedicated to Elune. When the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult took control of the sanctuary, they roused the ancient turtle from his quiet life and locked him in captivity. Rather than slain, he was systematically tormented for years, suffering mental and physical flaying at the hands of the cultists.

Broken by prolonged cruelty, the great turtle finally succumbed to madness. Bestowing the name Ghamoo-ra upon the ruined creature, the cultists trained him into a ferocious defense beast. Now patrolling a small island in the Pool of Ask'ar surrounded by lesser turtles, Ghamoo-ra blindly attacks any intruders who enter the caverns, serving the very cult that shattered his mind.

npc:gilnid.s: Gilnid. Gilnid, conocido como el Fundidor, es el maestro ingeniero goblin que dirige las forjas en las profundidades de Las Minas de la Muerte. Supervisa la fundición del mineral en bruto para transformarlo en metal refinado y munición para el acorazado secreto de Edwin VanCleef. Sin sus ardientes operaciones, la Hermandad Defias carecería de los cañones pesados necesarios para asaltar Ventormenta. En lo profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte, la Hermandad Defias recurre a la pericia industrial para forjar armas de guerra. Gilnid ejerce como jefe de fundición de VanCleef y comanda un pequeño ejército de peones, manitas y herreros goblin en la fundición central. Al ser más corpulento que la mayoría de los suyos, somete a su cuadrilla a un ritmo implacable entre humo y escoria, ladrando órdenes y negándoles descansos para garantizar que el mineral de hierro en bruto se transforme en pesados blindajes y munición letal.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stopping Gilnid shuts down the Defias weapons assembly line, preventing VanCleef's warship from being fully armed before it can threaten Stormwind Harbor.
ang.profession:Engineering: Gilnid's foundry is a prime example of goblin heavy industry, churning out standardized naval cannons, ammunition, and structural plating under extreme conditions.
ang.profession:Mining: The massive blast furnaces and smelting pots in Gilnid's workshop demonstrate how the Defias Brotherhood turns the raw mineral wealth of Westfall into refined iron and armaments.

faq.a: Gilnid is a goblin engineer and the head smelter for Edwin VanCleef in the Deadmines. He oversees the Brotherhood's forges and leads the industrial effort to cast cannons and ammunition for their war machine.
faq.q: Who is Gilnid?
