faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood hired mercenary goblin engineers to build and supply their hidden warship. Gilnid was placed in charge of the smelting works, transforming mined iron ore into refined parts, armor, and artillery.
al: why is a goblin in deadmines
faq.q: Why is Gilnid in the Deadmines?

faq.a: Gilnid is responsible for manufacturing the massive cannons, ship parts, and shot needed to arm the juggernaut hidden in the docks deeper inside the mines.
faq.q: What is Gilnid working on?

faq.a: Gilnid controls the industrial foundry blocking the path to the cove. The heavy blast doors leading deeper toward the Defias ship remain sealed until the smelting room is secured.
faq.q: Why must Gilnid be defeated?

faq.a: Yes. He is not a member of the original Stonemasons, but rather a contracted goblin specialist serving directly under VanCleef to handle heavy metallurgy and weapons production.
faq.q: Does Gilnid work directly for Edwin VanCleef?

faq.a: Gilnid leads a specialized goblin engineering crew in the foundry. They operate the blast furnaces, pour molten iron, and assemble ordnance under his strict, unrelenting supervision.
faq.q: Why are there so many goblins around him?

text.s: Gilnid, known as the Smelter, is the goblin master engineer running the forges in the depths of the Deadmines. He oversees the smelting of raw ore into refined metal and munitions for Edwin VanCleef's hidden ironclad juggernaut. Without his fiery operations, the Defias Brotherhood would lack the heavy cannons needed to assault Stormwind.

sec.b: Deep within the Deadmines, the Defias Brotherhood relies on industrial expertise to forge weapons of war. Gilnid serves as VanCleef's head smelter, commanding a small army of goblin laborers, tinkers, and smiths in the central foundry. Towering over most of his kin, he drives his crew relentlessly through smoke and slag, barking orders and refusing breaks to ensure raw iron ore is processed into heavy plating and lethal ordnance.

The smelting works are critical to the Brotherhood's grand ambition. Gilnid is directly responsible for forging the heavy cannons and ammunition intended for the colossal ironclad warship docked in the subterranean cove beyond his workshop. Until his foundry churns out every gun, barrel, and ball, the Defias vessel remains unready for its planned strike against Stormwind.

npc:glorin-steelbrow.s: Glorin Frenteacerada. Glorin Frenteacerada es un agente enano al que se puede encontrar bebiendo en el Mesón Aguahonda, en Puerto de Menethil. Como colaborador del Obispo Lontananza, de la Catedral de la Luz en Ventormenta, ayuda a los aventureros a investigar la desaparecida Tercera Flota y a recuperar reliquias y materiales sagrados dispersos por la costa de Los Humedales. Sus esfuerzos conectan directamente las tierras embrujadas de Bosque del Ocaso con los pecios sumergidos del norte. Mientras el Obispo Lontananza ayuda a los habitantes de Bosque del Ocaso contra sus terrores acechantes desde la Catedral de la Luz en Ventormenta, mantiene contactos muy al norte, en Puerto de Menethil. Apostado en el bullicioso Mesón Aguahonda, Glorin Frenteacerada actúa como los ojos y las manos de Lontananza en la costa. Ofrece ayuda y orientación a los viajeros enviados al norte en busca de metales sagrados y reliquias olvidadas, sirviendo de puente crucial entre los problemas del bosque del sur y los restos hundidos de Los Humedales.

ang.class:Paladin: Paladins following Farthing's orders will find Glorin indispensable in recovering Lightforge iron, a sacred metal essential for crafting weapons blessed by the Holy Light.
ang.faction:Alliance: Glorin plays a key role in recovering crucial Alliance military relics and sanctified materials lost during naval disasters in the Wetlands.
ang.race:Dwarf: Glorin represents dwarven enterprise and solidarity, coordinating from the maritime hub of Menethil Harbor to support allies across Khaz Modan and the southern human kingdoms.

faq.a: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarf stationed in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. He works in coordination with Bishop Farthing of Stormwind, assisting adventurers who travel north to salvage sunken cargo and relics off the Wetlands coast.
faq.q: Who is Glorin Steelbrow?

faq.a: Glorin is located on the ground floor of the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, situated on the western coast of the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where can I find Glorin Steelbrow?

faq.a: Bishop Farthing of Stormwind's Cathedral of Light seeks powerful holy relics and consecrated metals to fight the darkness encroaching on Duskwood. He sends trusted emissaries to Glorin Steelbrow, who knows the Wetlands coast and can point salvagers toward the sunken remains of the Third Fleet.
faq.q: Why is a dwarf in Menethil Harbor involved with Duskwood?

faq.a: The Third Fleet was an Alliance naval expedition that met catastrophe off the coast of the Wetlands. Its shattered hulls now litter the seabed, haunted by drowned sailors and hiding valuable cargo like Lightforge iron and ancient artifacts.
faq.q: What is the Third Fleet that Glorin talks about?

faq.a: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient religious relic carried aboard the sunken fleet. Once recovered from the ocean floor with Glorin's guidance, it must undergo cleansing by the priesthood due to the dark corruption lingering around the shipwreck.
faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?

faq.a: Lightforge iron is a rare, sanctified metal used to craft blessed weapons capable of striking down powerful undead and demonic forces. Glorin helps recover lost ingots from the shipwrecks to aid the defenders of Duskwood.
faq.q: What is Lightforge iron used for?

text.s: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven operative found drinking at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Acting as an associate of Bishop Farthing of Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, he helps adventurers investigate the lost Third Fleet and recover sacred relics and materials scattered across the Wetlands coast. His efforts tie the haunted wilderness of Duskwood directly to the sunken shipwrecks of the north.

sec.b: While Bishop Farthing aids the people of Duskwood against its creeping terrors from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, he maintains ties far to the north in Menethil Harbor. Stationed inside the bustling Deepwater Tavern, Glorin Steelbrow acts as Farthing's eyes and hands on the coast. He offers aid and direction to travelers sent north in search of sacred metals and forgotten relics, providing a crucial bridge between the troubles of the southern forest and the sunken wreckage of the Wetlands.

Steelbrow is intimately familiar with the tragedy of the Third Fleet, whose ships were battered and dragged beneath the waves along the Wetlands shore. He guides adventurers to scour the haunted wreckage for lost ingots of Lightforge iron and the powerful, cursed artifact known as the Eye of Paleth. Glorin knows that recovering such holy armaments is vital for forging weapons capable of holding back the dark forces threatening the Alliance.
sec.t: The Doomed Fleet and Lost Relics

npc:gornek.s: Gornek. Gornek es un capataz orco apostado en el Valle de los Retos, en Durotar. Actúa como el principal punto de recepción para los nuevos reclutas orcos y trols Lanza Negra que se disponen a demostrar su valía ante la nueva Horda. Apostado justo en el corazón del Valle de los Retos, Gornek representa la prueba inicial de disciplina para los aspirantes a guerreros, exploradores y lanzadores de conjuros de la Horda. Por orden del Jefe de Guerra Thrall, cada joven y recién llegado debe ganarse su lugar mediante el tesón y la perseverancia, y no por derecho de cuna. Gornek evalúa a quienes entran en el valle leyendo sus órdenes de presentación y dirigiéndolos a los instructores del recinto. Ya lleve el iniciado un garabato cifrado, un Glyphic Parchment o una Tablilla sencilla, es Gornek quien recibe sus credenciales y los encamina en su dura senda de supervivencia.

ang.race:Orc: For young orcs, reporting to Gornek is the very first step toward shedding childhood and earning an honorable place in Durotar.
ang.race:Troll: As allies sheltered by Thrall, Darkspear trolls present their credentials to Gornek to prove they stand as capable equals alongside their orc brothers.

faq.a: Gornek is an orc greeter and taskmaster in the Valley of Trials. He oversees new recruits of the Horde, reading their induction documents and guiding them to their respective class trainers.
faq.q: Who is Gornek?

faq.a: He stands near the center of the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar, just outside the Den where young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin their journeys.
faq.q: Where can I find Gornek?

faq.a: New arrivals carry training scrolls and tablets designating their chosen discipline. Gornek evaluates these letters of introduction, confirms their eligibility, and sends them to the appropriate mentors within the valley.
faq.q: Why do new recruits report to him?

faq.a: He acts as an entry coordinator for Thrall's New Horde. His duty is to ensure no recruit enters the broader lands of Durotar without first learning the basic tenets of honor, survival, and martial readiness.
faq.q: What is his role in the New Horde?

text.s: Gornek is an orc overseer stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He serves as the primary point of intake for fresh orc and Darkspear troll recruits preparing to prove their worth to the New Horde.

sec.b: Standing directly at the heart of the Valley of Trials, Gornek represents the initial test of discipline for aspiring Horde warriors, scouts, and spellcasters. Under Warchief Thrall's order, every youth and newcomer must earn their place through grit and perseverance rather than entitlement. Gornek assesses those stepping into the valley, reading their introductory orders and directing them to trainers throughout the compound. Whether an initiate carries an encrypted scrawl, a glyphic parchment, or a simple tablet, it is Gornek who receives their credentials and sets them upon their harsh path of survival.

The arid canyons of the valley test more than battle prowess; they instill the communal ethos of the New Horde. Gornek ensures that novices do not linger aimlessly, pointing them toward the trials of the nearby scorpid burrows, the dens of feral boars, and the watchful eyes of veteran instructors. For those who survive the training grounds and slay the threats lurking in the red rock gullies, Gornek offers the final acknowledgment before dispatching them outward into the wider, perilous landscape of Durotar.
sec.t: A Life in Service to Durotar

npc:grelin-whitebeard.s: Grelin Barbablanca. Grelin Barbablanca es un explorador enano apostado en el Valle de Crestanevada por decreto real para evaluar la amenaza de los troles Melenafreche. Desde un campamento aislado y junto a un aprendiz torpe, depende de los nuevos aventureros para mantener a raya a los troles mientras la atención de Forjaz sigue consumida por la crisis de los troggs. Grelin Barbablanca y su hermano Senir fueron enviados al Valle de Crestanevada bajo órdenes directas del Senado de Forjaz y del mismísimo Rey Magni Barbabronce. Su misión era clara: evaluar y neutralizar la amenaza que suponían los troles Melenafreche autóctonos. Con el ejército oficial de Forjaz totalmente empantanado combatiendo los brotes de troggs por todo Dun Morogh, los hermanos recibieron muy pocos recursos para cumplir su cometido. Grelin tuvo que establecer un puesto en las colinas nevadas y recurrir a reclutas locales y a los iniciados que pasaban por allí para llevar a cabo el trabajo necesario.

ang.faction:Alliance: Grelin's plight reveals just how thin the Alliance and Ironforge armies are stretched in Dun Morogh, forcing solitary scouts to wage quiet wars against troll enclaves.
ang.race:Dwarf: Serving King Magni directly, Grelin represents the quiet, stubborn perseverance of Ironforge scouts holding Dun Morogh's borders together against mounting internal threats.
ang.race:Gnome: Fresh out of Gnomeregan's tragedy, gnome refugees passing through Coldridge Valley find Grelin working alongside a wandering gnome at his remote camp.

faq.a: Grelin was officially commissioned by the Senate of Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard to investigate and quell the Frostmane troll threat in Coldridge Valley. Because the dwarven military is tied down fighting the trogg menace elsewhere, Grelin must rely on independent volunteers.
faq.q: Why is Grelin Whitebeard out here in the snow?

faq.a: A Frostmane troll named Grik'nir the Cold raided Grelin's camp while it was left unattended. Grelin only caught a glimpse of a heavily marked brute fleeing into the southern troll caves with his field notes.
faq.q: Who stole Grelin's journal?

faq.a: His brother is Senir Whitebeard, an operative stationed further down the mountain in the town of Kharanos. Grelin compiles his findings on troll movements into reports and sends trusted runners to deliver them directly to Senir.
faq.q: Who is Grelin's brother?

faq.a: Grelin shares his small encampment with an absent-minded dwarven apprentice, leaving him with little competent help until capable recruits arrive.
faq.q: Who is with Grelin at his camp?

faq.a: Ironforge's defenders and Senate forces are almost entirely consumed by the widespread trogg infestations that have erupted across Dun Morogh. This leaves scouts like Grelin to solve regional threats using local recruits.
faq.q: Why doesn't Ironforge send regular soldiers to help him?

faq.a: Jona Ironstock is an old and trusted friend of Grelin. Stationed near the starting grounds of Coldridge Valley, Jona helps direct new dwarven and gnomish recruits toward Grelin's camp.
faq.q: What is Grelin's connection to Jona Ironstock?

text.s: Grelin Whitebeard is a dwarven scout stationed in Coldridge Valley by royal decree to assess the Frostmane troll threat. Operating out of an isolated camp with a bumbling apprentice, he relies on rising adventurers to keep the trolls contained while Ironforge's attention remains consumed by the trogg crisis.

sec.b: Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir were dispatched to Coldridge Valley under direct orders from the Senate of Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard himself. Their mission was clear: assess and neutralize the threat posed by the native Frostmane trolls. With Ironforge's official military fully bogged down combating trogg outbreaks across Dun Morogh, the brothers were given very few resources to accomplish their task. Grelin had to establish an outpost in the snowy hills and look toward local recruits and passing initiates to carry out the necessary work.

From his camp, Grelin monitors the encroaching Frostmane tribe south of Coldridge Valley. The trolls have grown increasingly aggressive, staging bolder incursions outside their mountain caverns. During one such raid, a heavily painted brute named Grik'nir the Cold slipped into the unattended camp and made off with Grelin's field journal, containing his critical observations. Unwilling to fail the King, Grelin uses intrepid travelers to strike deep into the Frostmane caves, recover his stolen writings, and ensure his final intelligence reaches Senir in Kharanos.

npc:grif-wildheart.s: Grif Corazón Salvaje. Grif Corazón Salvaje es un experimentado instructor de cazadores enano apostado en el exterior de la Destilería Cebatruenos en Kharanos. Célebre entre los montañeros locales por su profunda afinidad con la fauna, instruye a los tiradores noveles en rastreo, puntería y los ritos de doma de bestias. Para los jóvenes cazadores que emergen del Valle de Crestanevada, Grif ofrece el puente vital entre disparar un rifle y caminar junto a un leal compañero animal. Mientras muchos enanos de Forjaz prefieren el calor ardiente de una forja o el repiqueteo constante de los picos, Grif Corazón Salvaje ha dedicado su vida por entero a la gélida naturaleza de Dun Morogh. Los montañeros locales bromean diciendo que pasa demasiado tiempo con bestias de cuatro patas, pero nadie discute su dominio de lo salvaje. Tras pasar años rastreando a lo largo de crestas nevadas junto a veteranos compañeros de caza, Grif posee un conocimiento íntimo de los depredadores naturales que merodean por los riscos.

ang.class:Hunter: Grif is the essential mentor who initiates Alliance hunters into beast taming, offering the vital quests that allow you to bond with wild predators across Dun Morogh.
ang.faction:Alliance: Stationed in Kharanos, Grif prepares Alliance scouts and sharpshooters to survive the harsh wilderness surrounding the mountain kingdom of Ironforge.
ang.race:Dwarf: Embodying the dwarven mountaineer tradition, Grif shows how a dwarf's rugged resilience makes them exceptionally suited for living side-by-side with wild mountain beasts.

faq.a: Grif Wildheart is a dwarven hunter trainer located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He serves as the primary mentor for novice Alliance hunters learning their trade outside of Coldridge Valley.
faq.q: Who is Grif Wildheart?

faq.a: He stands outside near the Thunderbrew Distillery in the village of Kharanos, along the snowy road connecting Coldridge Pass to Ironforge.
faq.q: Where can I find Grif Wildheart?

faq.a: Beyond offering general hunter abilities and ranged combat techniques, Grif guides young hunters through the trials of beast taming, teaching them to soothe and master wild boars, leopards, and bears.
faq.q: What does Grif teach novice hunters?

faq.a: Grif charges his students with tracking down and taming three specific creatures of Dun Morogh: a Large Crag Boar, a Snow Leopard, and an Ice Claw Bear.
al: which animals to tame dun morogh
faq.q: What beasts does Grif send hunters to tame?

faq.a: After proving their ability to tame wild animals, Grif directs hunters to travel into the city of Ironforge to consult with advanced beast trainers about feeding and commanding their pets.
faq.q: Where does Grif send hunters after completing their taming trials?

faq.a: The local Ironforge Mountaineers note that Grif spends a bit too much time in the company of animals rather than people, but they readily admit he knows the hunter's craft better than almost anyone.
faq.q: What do the Ironforge mountaineers think of Grif?

text.s: Grif Wildheart is a seasoned dwarven hunter trainer stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Renowned among the local mountaineers for his deep affinity with wildlife, he instructs budding marksmen in tracking, marksmanship, and the rites of beast taming. For young hunters emerging from Coldridge Valley, Grif provides the vital bridge between firing a rifle and walking alongside a loyal animal companion.

sec.b: While many Ironforge dwarves prefer the fiery warmth of a forge or the steady clink of pickaxes, Grif Wildheart has dedicated his life entirely to the frozen wilderness of Dun Morogh. Local mountaineers half-jokingly say he spends a bit too much time with four-legged beasts, but none dispute his mastery of the wild. Having spent years tracking across snowbound ridges alongside seasoned hunting companions, Grif possesses an intimate understanding of the natural predators that roam the crags.

When young dwarf hunters finish their preliminary trials in Coldridge Valley, they are directed straight to Kharanos to seek Grif's guidance. While he sharpens their aim and teaches essential wilderness survival tricks, his true specialty lies in forging bonds between hunter and beast. Through a sequence of rigorous trials, Grif sends his pupils out into the freezing wastes with a taming rod to test their mettle against Dun Morogh's iconic predators: Large Crag Boars, Snow Leopards, and Ice Claw Bears.

Once a hunter demonstrates the will and composure needed to calm three distinct wild beasts, Grif's tutelage in Kharanos reaches its conclusion. Recognizing that a hunter must also learn to feed, discipline, and train their new ally, he sends his graduates up the mountainside to Ironforge. There, under the great vaulted roofs of the dwarven capital, novice hunters report to master beast trainers to learn the deeper art of caring for their permanent lifelong companion.

npc:guard-thomas.s: Guardia Thomas. El Guardia Thomas es un devoto soldado del ejército de Ventormenta destinado en el puente al oeste del Aserradero de la Vega del Este. Aislado en la frontera oriental del Bosque de Elwynn, supervisa la defensa de los colonos locales frente a la fauna depredadora y a los múrlocs invasores. Mientras gran parte de la atención del reino se centra hacia el interior, hacia la capital, o hacia el oeste, hacia los Páramos de Poniente, el Guardia Thomas ocupa uno de los puestos más tranquilos pero a la vez más precarios del Bosque de Elwynn. Situado en el puente de piedra que cruza el río hacia el Aserradero de la Vega del Este, Thomas constituye una frágil línea de defensa entre los trabajadores forestales y las agresivas criaturas que merodean por los bosques. Con las fuerzas militares de Ventormenta al límite de su capacidad, guardias como Thomas deben depender enormemente de los aventureros que pasan por allí para mantener el orden y llevar mensajes al mando central.

ang.class:Warrior: For young warriors of the Alliance, Thomas represents frontline discipline and the unglamorous realities of regional border defense.
ang.faction:Alliance: Guard Thomas embodies the overstretched state of the Stormwind Army, holding a vital outpost on the frontier with minimal support from the crown.

faq.a: Guard Thomas is posted on the stone bridge spanning the river just west of the Eastvale Logging Camp, along the eastern road in Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where can I find Guard Thomas?

faq.a: He is an officer of the Stormwind Army assigned to protect the eastern frontier of Elwynn. His responsibilities include securing the trade bridge, defending nearby workers from wild predators, and monitoring hostile murloc encroachments along the riverbanks.
faq.q: What is Guard Thomas's duty in Elwynn Forest?

faq.a: Routine patrols dispatched into the river basins have failed to report back. Without sufficient reinforcements to leave his post unmanned, Thomas enlists traveling adventurers to search the waterways and find out what happened to his missing comrades.
faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas asking for help with lost guards?

faq.a: Murloc tribes have increasingly crept up the river systems of eastern Elwynn. Their growing presence threatens both local logging operations and overland supply routes, prompting Thomas to place open bounties on their fins to keep the waterways clear.
faq.q: Why are murlocs a problem for Guard Thomas?

faq.a: Thomas serves within the Stormwind Army, reporting through the military hierarchy back to regional command in Goldshire and the capital. As matters deteriorate across the borders, his dispatches also coordinate with frontier leadership like Gryan Stoutmantle out in Westfall.
faq.q: Who does Guard Thomas report to?

faq.a: Once the immediate threats around Eastvale and the eastern river are handled, Thomas provides reports directing seasoned travelers toward Westfall to aid Gryan Stoutmantle and the struggling People's Militia.
faq.q: Where does Guard Thomas send adventurers once their work in Elwynn is done?

text.s: Guard Thomas is a dedicated soldier of the Stormwind Army stationed at the bridge west of the Eastvale Logging Camp. Isolated on the eastern frontier of Elwynn Forest, he oversees the defense of local settlers against predatory wildlife and encroaching murlocs.

sec.b: While much of the realm's attention is focused inward toward the capital or west toward Westfall, Guard Thomas holds one of the quietest yet most precarious posts in Elwynn Forest. Positioned at the stone bridge crossing the river toward Eastvale Logging Camp, Thomas acts as the thin blue line between everyday forestry workers and the aggressive creatures roaming the woods. With the Stormwind military stretched thin, guards like Thomas must rely heavily on passing adventurers to maintain order and carry messages back to central command.

The eastern edges of Elwynn face persistent pressures. Aggressive bears and prowlers stalk the treeline, threatening lumberjacks and travelers, while strange murloc tribes have established camps along the waterways. Thomas tracks the movements of these aquatic predators and issues bounties to cull their numbers. Worse still, scouting patrols along the river occasionally vanish without a trace, leaving Thomas to piece together the fate of his fellow guards amidst rising regional instability.

npc:gunther-arcanus.s: Gunther Arcanos. Gunther Arcanos es un nigromante excepcionalmente poderoso que mora en una isla aislada en el Lago Aguasclaras. Asesinado durante la Tercera Guerra y levantado en la no-muerte, logró romper el control mental del Rey Exánime completamente por su cuenta. Creyendo durante mucho tiempo que era el único no-muerto con libre albedrío, defendió su retiro frente a cualquier intruso hasta que fue descubierto por los Renegados. Antes de la caída de Lordaeron, Gunther era un prometedor aprendiz entre el Kirin Tor en Dalaran. Junto a sus amigos cercanos Bethor Duroyelo y Thule Corvozarpa, estudió las artes arcanas, adentrándose en secreto en la nigromancia a pesar de las estrictas prohibiciones del Kirin Tor contra la magia oscura. Para conmemorar su hermandad, el trío unió una vez sus varitas de aprendiz en una sola reliquia.

ang.class:Mage: Trained in Dalaran, Gunther represents the Kirin Tor wizards who covertly dabbled in forbidden necromantic spells before the Scourge invaded Lordaeron.
ang.class:Warlock: Gunther's commanding grasp of dark arts and reanimation demonstrates how far forbidden scholarship could flourish outside the watchful eyes of Dalaran's leadership.
ang.race:Undead: Gunther's self-liberation makes him an anomaly among the Forsaken, proving that intense arcane training and iron will alone could sometimes shatter the Lich King's mental dominion.

faq.a: He is a former wizard of the Kirin Tor from Dalaran who perished during the Third War. Raised into undeath, he broke free of the Lich King's domination on his own and retreated to an island in Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Who is Gunther Arcanus?

faq.a: While traditional liches transfer their spirits into phylacteries and generate monstrous, floating skeletal forms, Gunther achieved his lich-like necromantic status without abandoning his original reanimated corpse, preserving his physical mortal appearance.
faq.q: Why does Gunther look like a regular Forsaken instead of a skeletal lich?

faq.a: After breaking the Lich King's mental control, Gunther believed he was the only undead in existence with free will. Assuming all other walking dead were still mindless slaves of the Scourge, he secluded himself and ordered his minions to strike down anyone who approached.
faq.q: Why was Gunther living alone on an island?

faq.a: They were classmates and close friends in Dalaran studying under the Kirin Tor, along with a third mage named Thule Ravenclaw. The three friends even wove their apprentice wands together as a symbol of their bond.
faq.q: How does Gunther know Bethor Iceshard?

faq.a: Yes. Once adventurers return his enchanted spellbook and execute the local Scourge agent Lillith Nefara to prove their independence from the Lich King, Gunther pledges his allegiance to Bethor and the Forsaken cause.
faq.q: Does Gunther join the Forsaken?

faq.a: Lillith Nefara is an agent of the Scourge stationed in Tirisfal Glades. Gunther requires her death as proof that the adventurer truly serves an enemy of the Lich King rather than the Scourge itself.
faq.q: Who is Lillith Nefara?

text.s: Gunther Arcanus is an exceptionally powerful necromancer dwelling on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake. Slain during the Third War and raised into undeath, he managed to shatter the Lich King's mental grip entirely on his own. Long believing he was the sole undead possessing free will, he defended his retreat against all outsiders until discovered by the Forsaken.

sec.b: Before the fall of Lordaeron, Gunther was a promising apprentice among the Kirin Tor in Dalaran. Alongside close friends Bethor Iceshard and Thule Ravenclaw, he studied the arcane arts, secretly delving into necromancy despite the Kirin Tor's strict prohibitions against dark magic. To commemorate their brotherhood, the trio once bound their apprentice wands together into a single heirloom.

When the Scourge swept across the north during the Third War, Gunther perished to the Plague of Undeath and was raised into servitude. Unlike most who required the Lich King's power to weaken or Lady Sylvanas to break their chains, Gunther's raw arcane mastery and sheer willpower allowed him to shake off the Lich King's mental domination entirely by himself. Convinced that every other walking corpse remained a mindless thrall of the Scourge, he retreated to an island in Tirisfal Glades, surrounding himself with shambling guardians and cutting off all contact with the living and dead alike.

Seeking powerful allies against the Scourge, the Forsaken sent emissaries to claim the mysterious necromancer's spellbook. Upon examining the arcane tome in the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard recognized the unique handwriting of his long-lost peer. By enchanting the returned grimoire and demanding the destruction of local Scourge commanders, Gunther finally realized he was not alone in his freedom. Convinced that Sylvanas's faction represents a true rebellion against the Scourge, he has forged a pact with his former schoolmate to aid the Forsaken.

npc:gwennyth-bly-leggonde.s: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde es una elfa de la noche que reside en el puerto costero de Auberdine. Apostada a lo largo de la brumosa costa de Costa Oscura, vigila las mareas y encarga a los viajeros que investiguen los extraños restos que llegan a la orilla. Su preocupación se centra en las misteriosas criaturas marinas y las enormes tortugas cuyos cadáveres han comenzado a abarrotar las playas del norte. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde tiene su hogar en Auberdine, el bullicioso refugio costero de Costa Oscura. Mientras muchos en la villa se preocupan por el bosque o por el transporte marítimo a través de Mar de la Bruma, Gwennyth mantiene la mirada fija en el litoral. Últimamente las mareas han tomado un cariz sombrío, arrastrando los restos de colosales seres marinos hasta la orilla. Para comprender lo que ocurre en las aguas mar adentro, confía en aventureros dispuestos a recorrer las arenas, recuperar muestras óseas y traer respuestas.

ang.class:Druid: Druids committed to preserving Kalimdor's natural harmony will find Gwennyth's reports of stranded marine life an alarming indicator of disturbance within the coastal ecosystem.
ang.faction:Alliance: Auberdine serves as the Alliance's primary coastal port in northern Kalimdor; keeping its waterways and beaches safe from hidden threats is vital to all allied races venturing through.
ang.race:NightElf: For the kaldorei, the unnatural death of great sea beasts off the shores of Darkshore is a troubling sign of imbalance in their ancestral lands, making Gwennyth's beachside watch especially urgent.

faq.a: She is a night elf inhabitant of Auberdine in Darkshore who studies the recent ecological disturbances along the shoreline. She enlists travelers to survey the beach and investigate strange wash-ups from the sea.
faq.q: Who is Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde?

faq.a: She can be found in the coastal settlement of Auberdine, situated near the beach and docks along the mist-shrouded coast of Darkshore.
faq.q: Where can I find Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde?

faq.a: The sudden deaths and beachings of massive sea turtles and mysterious marine behemoths point to an imbalance or unseen predator in the waters off Darkshore. Gwennyth seeks to understand the cause by examining remains recovered from along the coast.
faq.q: Why is she interested in beached creatures?

faq.a: She sends adventurers out on 'Washed Ashore' and serves as the turn-in point for various discoveries related to the beached sea creatures and beached sea turtles found along Darkshore's coastline.
faq.q: What quests does Gwennyth offer?

faq.a: Neither. She is a Priestess of the Moon serving the Sisters of Elune in Auberdine rather than a Cenarion druid or Sentinel commander, yet she shares her kin's deep concern for the health and balance of Darkshore's natural environment.
faq.q: Is she part of the Cenarion Circle or the Sentinels?

faq.a: While fitting the rhythmic naming style of the kaldorei, her unusual surname 'Bly'Leggonde' is an anagram of 'Leggy Blonde', a playful touch from the world's creators.
faq.q: What does her name mean?

text.s: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf residing in the coastal port of Auberdine. Stationed along the misty Darkshore coast, she watches the tides and directs travelers to investigate the strange remains washing ashore. Her concerns center on the mysterious sea creatures and massive turtles whose carcasses have begun littering the northern beaches.

sec.b: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde makes her home in Auberdine, the bustling seaside haven of Darkshore. While many in town concern themselves with the forest or shipping across the Veiled Sea, Gwennyth keeps her gaze firmly on the coastline. The tides have recently turned grim, depositing the remains of colossal marine life onto the surf. To understand what is happening in the waters offshore, she relies on willing adventurers to scour the sands, retrieve skeletal samples, and bring back answers.

The beaches north and south of Auberdine have seen an alarming influx of beached sea creatures and ancient sea turtles. Rather than letting their deaths go unnoticed, Gwennyth tasks travelers with inspecting these fallen titans. By studying the bones and discovering what drove these beasts ashore or took their lives, she hopes to piece together the hidden perils lurking off the shores of northern Kalimdor.

npc:hamhock.s: Hamhock. Hamhock es un descomunal ogro de dos cabezas recluido en las profundidades de las Mazmorras de Ventormenta. Encerrado bajo la capital junto a curtidos insurgentes y degolladores Defias, se erige como un recluso particularmente brutal e inesperado en medio del motín carcelario. Las Mazmorras de Ventormenta se construyeron para albergar a ladronzuelos, asesinos y disidentes políticos, lo que convierte a un imponente ogro de dos cabezas en una visión imponente entre las celdas. Cuando los prisioneros se alzaron y tomaron el control de las instalaciones, Hamhock permaneció atrincherado en el caos, aplastando a cualquiera lo bastante insensato como para adentrarse en su bloque de celdas.

ang.class:Warrior: Subduing Hamhock requires meeting raw, hulking strength head-on within the tight confines of the prison hallways.
ang.faction:Alliance: Finding a two-headed ogre unrestrained directly beneath the capital's streets underscores just how catastrophically the city guards have lost control of the Stockade.

faq.a: Hamhock is an elite two-headed ogre prisoner held within the Stormwind Stockade. Amid the uprising led by the Defias convicts, he acts as a dangerous obstacle deep inside the prison corridors.
al: who is the ogre in stockade
faq.q: Who is Hamhock?

faq.a: Official records do not detail his capture, but he is widely thought to either be a captured brute from the Splinter Fist clan inhabiting Duskwood or a hired enforcer employed by the Defias Brotherhood who was caught during illicit operations.
al: why is there an ogre in stockades
faq.q: How did an ogre end up in the Stormwind Stockade?

faq.a: While the entire facility has fallen into rebellion under Defias ringleaders, it is unclear whether Hamhock truly coordinates with them or simply revels in the unbridled mayhem of the broken cells.
faq.q: Is Hamhock allied with the Defias rioters?

faq.a: Many believe he originated from the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in Duskwood, which would place him among the Splinter Fist clan led by Zzarc'Vul prior to being captured and brought to Stormwind.
faq.q: Is Hamhock related to the ogres in Duskwood?

faq.a: No official bounties or city warrants are offered specifically for Hamhock's head. He is an incidental menace whom adventurers encounter while clearing out the rioting stronghold.
al: is there a quest for hamhock
faq.q: Is Hamhock tied to any specific bounty or quest?

faq.a: Two-headed ogres possess distinct personalities between their heads and are often more cunning or magically adept than their single-headed kin, making Hamhock exceptionally dangerous to standard prison guards.
faq.q: Why are two-headed ogres significant?

text.s: Hamhock is a massive two-headed ogre confined within the depths of the Stormwind Stockade. Locked away beneath the capital alongside hardened Defias insurgents and cutthroats, he looms as a particularly brutal and unexpected inmate amidst the prison riot.

sec.b: The Stormwind Stockade was built to hold petty thieves, murderers, and political dissidents, making a towering two-headed ogre an imposing sight among the cells. When the prisoners rose up and took control of the facility, Hamhock remained entrenched in the chaos, crushing anyone foolish enough to intrude on his cellblock.

Stormwind authorities keep few public records regarding how Hamhock was captured. Popular speculation among guards and city residents suggests he may have been dragged north from the Splinter Fist clan at Duskwood's Vul'Gol Ogre Mound. Others suspect he was recruited into the Defias Brotherhood as mercenary muscle before falling into the custody of the city watch.

npc:herod.s: Herod. Herod es un renombrado adalid y bersérker de la Cruzada Escarlata que comanda la Armería dentro del Monasterio Escarlata. Conocido por su feroz destreza marcial y su inquebrantable celo, entrena a los reclutas en el brutal combate cuerpo a cuerpo necesario para librar una guerra santa. Tanto los disidentes de la Alianza como los gobernantes de la Horda en Entrañas buscan su muerte para debilitar el núcleo militar de la Cruzada. Dentro de las salas fortificadas de la Armería del Monasterio Escarlata, Herod representa la personificación de la agresividad marcial de la Cruzada. A diferencia de los taumaturgos y paladines que canalizan magia sagrada en la Catedral, Herod confía en un poder físico puro y sanguinario. Ataviado con malla y blandiendo una descomunal hacha de dos manos, entrena personalmente a cohortes de aprendices escarlata, inculcándoles una furiosa devoción por exterminar a cualquiera que no esté aliado con su fanática causa.

ang.class:Warrior: Herod is a prime example of an enraged warrior whose furious whirlwind strikes and reckless aggression make him a feared martial paragon among the Scarlet Crusade's recruits.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance heroes who answer Raleigh the Devout's plea can witness firsthand how the once-noble defenders of Lordaeron have fallen into deranged, fanatical bloodlust under leaders like Herod.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Horde and the Forsaken in particular, eliminating Herod directly fulfills Varimathras's orders to break the leadership threatening the borders of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.a: Herod is an elite human warrior and commander of the Armory in the Scarlet Monastery. He serves as one of the four principal leaders of the Monastery, responsible for outfitting and drilling the Crusade's zealous melee fighters.
faq.q: Who is Herod?

faq.a: Herod can be found at the heart of the Armory wing in the Scarlet Monastery, situated in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. He awaits challengers in a central training ring surrounded by viewing galleries.
faq.q: Where is Herod located?

faq.a: The dreadlord Varimathras, acting on behalf of the Forsaken in the Undercity, seeks the elimination of the Monastery's key commanders—including Herod—to eradicate the Crusade's lingering threat right on the Forsaken capital's doorstep.
faq.q: Why does the Horde want Herod dead?

faq.a: Raleigh the Devout, a former member of the Scarlet Crusade stationed in Hillsbrad Foothills, recognizes that the order has descended into fanatical zealotry. He asks Alliance champions to purge Herod to strip the Crusade of its brutal warrior leadership.
al: in the name of the light
faq.q: Why does the Alliance want Herod dead?

faq.a: Upon Herod's defeat, a mob of young Scarlet Trainees surges out from the surrounding barracks into the ring to avenge their master, illustrating the sheer depth of devotion he fostered in his students.
faq.q: What happens when Herod is defeated?

faq.a: Herod is a berserker and warrior rather than a traditional holy paladin. He uses vicious charges and sweeping whirlwind strikes to pulverize foes, relying on sheer physical frenzy over spells of the Holy Light.
faq.q: What kind of fighter is Herod?

text.s: Herod is a renowned champion and berserker of the Scarlet Crusade, commanding the Armory within the Scarlet Monastery. Known for his ferocious martial prowess and unyielding zeal, he trains recruits in the brutal melee combat needed to wage holy war. His death is sought by both Alliance dissidents and the Horde's rulers in Undercity to weaken the Crusade's military core.

sec.b: Within the fortified halls of the Scarlet Monastery's Armory, Herod stands as the embodiment of the Crusade's martial aggression. Unlike the spellcasters and paladins who channel holy magic in the Cathedral, Herod relies on raw, bloodthirsty physical power. Clad in mail and wielding a massive two-handed axe, he personally trains cohorts of Scarlet Trainees, instilling a furious devotion to exterminating anyone not allied with their fanatical cause.

Because Herod oversees the armaments and martial training of the Crusade's front-line warriors, taking him down is essential for anyone seeking to dismantle the order. Raleigh the Devout, an ex-Crusader disillusioned with the order's madness residing in Southshore, calls for Herod's demise to shatter their military leadership. Across Lordaeron, the dreadlord Varimathras in the Undercity similarly seeks his execution to clear out a dangerous human bastion bordering Forsaken territory.

npc:high-executor-darthalia.s: Suma Ejecutora Darthalia. La Suma Ejecutora Darthalia es una comandante militar renegada de alto rango destinada en Molino Tarren, en las Laderas de Trabalomas. Actuando bajo la autoridad directa de Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz y Varimathras, dirige las operaciones de los Renegados contra el bastión humano de Costasur y los bandidos locales de la Hermandad. Su liderazgo es fundamental para asegurar el flanco sur de la Horda en Lordaeron. Operando desde Molino Tarren, la Suma Ejecutora Darthalia ejerce como comandante operacional de las fuerzas de los Renegados en todas las Laderas de Trabalomas. Su principal preocupación estratégica es detener la expansión de la resistencia humana, mantener contenidas a las fuerzas de la Alianza en Costasur y dar caza a los forajidos de la Hermandad que infestan la campiña circundante. Cada ofensiva hacia el sur de Trabalomas pasa directamente por su mando.

ang.faction:Alliance: To the humans of Southshore and their allies, Darthalia is the ruthless architect behind the relentless assaults threatening their last foothold in Lordaeron.
ang.faction:Horde: Horde adventurers report to Darthalia to check Alliance aggression and hold the contested frontier of Hillsbrad Foothills.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Darthalia represents the iron will of the Undercity, ensuring that Lordaeron remains firmly in the hands of the free-willed undead.

faq.a: High Executor Darthalia is a Forsaken military leader stationed in Hillsbrad Foothills. She is responsible for directing Horde and Forsaken military efforts against the human town of Southshore and eliminating hostile regional threats.
faq.q: Who is High Executor Darthalia?

faq.a: She commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill, organizing troops and coordinating strikes across the central region of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Where can Darthalia be found?

faq.a: Darthalia operates under the direct military hierarchy of the Undercity, answering to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the dreadlord Varimathras as they coordinate the defense and expansion of Forsaken territory.
faq.q: Who does Darthalia answer to?

faq.a: Darthalia tasks Horde champions with striking directly against human settlements, executing dangerous outlaws, and hunting down members of the Syndicate operating throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.
faq.q: What tasks does Darthalia give to adventurers?

faq.a: Southshore represents the primary Alliance military foothold in Lordaeron. Darthalia's mission is to suppress the human presence, protect Tarren Mill, and prevent the Alliance from pushing north toward the Undercity.
faq.q: Why is Darthalia fighting the humans of Southshore?

faq.a: As a High Executor, Darthalia holds one of the highest field-grade ranks within the Forsaken military hierarchy, granting her operational command over regional forces, outposts, and war strategy in the zone.
faq.q: What is Darthalia's rank in the Forsaken military?

text.s: High Executor Darthalia is a high-ranking Forsaken military commander stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Acting under the direct authority of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she directs Forsaken operations against the human stronghold of Southshore and local Syndicate brigands. Her leadership is central to securing the Horde's southern flank in Lordaeron.

sec.b: Operating out of Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia serves as the operational commander for Forsaken forces throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills. Her primary strategic concern is halting the expansion of human resistance, keeping the Alliance forces in Southshore contained, and hunting down the lawless Syndicate rogues infesting the surrounding countryside. Every offensive push into southern Hillsbrad flows directly through her command.

Under direct orders originating from the Undercity's high leadership—the Banshee Queen and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras—Darthalia oversees the relentless attrition war across Hillsbrad. She coordinates scouting missions, targeted strikes against human leadership, and bounties on dangerous outlaws who threaten the Forsaken hold on northern Lordaeron.

npc:high-executor-hadrec.s: Sumo Ejecutor Hadrec. El Sumo Ejecutor Hadrec es el comandante militar de la guarnición de los Renegados apostada en El Sepulcro, en el Bosque de Argénteos. Desde esta cripta central, supervisa la defensa contra las amenazas regionales, incluidos los gnolls del clan Putrepellejo, e investiga la desaparición de exploradores por toda la zona. Ejerce como el oficial principal que dirige las operaciones de la Horda en todo Argénteos. Apostado en la penumbra de El Sepulcro, el Sumo Ejecutor Hadrec dirige las operaciones militares de los Renegados en el Bosque de Argénteos. Mientras que los Claros de Tirisfal están firmemente asegurados por las fuerzas de la Dama Oscura, Argénteos sigue plagado de peligros, rodeado de magos hostiles de Dalaran, feroces huargen y gnolls invasores. Hadrec carga con la sombría responsabilidad de consolidar el territorio de los Renegados y erradicar todo lo que desafíe la autoridad de Entrañas al sur de la capital.

ang.class:Rogue: Hadrec relies heavily on the Deathstalkers for intelligence, frequently employing stealthy operatives to recover missing comrades and gather enemy ichor and documents.
ang.faction:Horde: Allies of the Forsaken arriving from Kalimdor report to Hadrec to aid in stabilizing Silverpine, learning firsthand how tenuous the Horde's foothold in northern Lordaeron remains.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken traveling south from Deathknell, Hadrec represents the voice of the Undercity's high command, turning newborn undead into organized defenders of Lordaeron.

faq.a: Hadrec is a Forsaken military officer holding the rank of High Executor. He commands the garrison based at the Sepulcher, making him the supreme Forsaken authority over operations in Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Who is High Executor Hadrec?

faq.a: He is located inside the Sepulcher, the Forsaken settlement situated in central Silverpine Forest along the main north-south road.
faq.q: Where can High Executor Hadrec be found?

faq.a: Hadrec directs soldiers and adventurers against the Rot Hide gnolls that plague the Dead Fields and Fenris Isle. He also oversees missions to locate missing Deathstalker spies and uncover what is unfolding inside Shadowfang Keep.
faq.q: What threats does Hadrec direct players against?

faq.a: A High Executor is a high-ranking field commander in the Forsaken military, entrusted with full strategic oversight of an entire regional outpost or front line under the authority of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: What does a High Executor do in Forsaken military structure?

faq.a: Fenris Isle has become the primary den of the Rot Hide gnolls. To secure Lake Lordamere and the surrounding waterways for Forsaken supply lines, Hadrec coordinates reconnaissance and an eventual assault to break the gnoll leadership.
faq.q: Why is Hadrec interested in Fenris Isle?

faq.a: Hadrec coordinates with the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken espionage order. When scouts sent toward Shadowfang Keep fail to report back, Hadrec commissions trusted agents to investigate the keep and uncover what happened to them.
faq.q: What is Hadrec's connection to Shadowfang Keep?

text.s: High Executor Hadrec is the military commander of the Forsaken garrison stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. From this central crypt, he oversees defense against regional threats including the gnolls of the Rot Hide clan and investigates the disappearance of scouts across the zone. He serves as the primary officer directing Horde operations throughout Silverpine.

sec.b: Stationed within the gloom of the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec directs Forsaken military operations across Silverpine Forest. While Tirisfal Glades is firmly secured by the Dark Lady's forces, Silverpine remains fraught with peril, bordered by hostile Dalaran mages, feral worgen, and encroaching gnolls. Hadrec bears the grim responsibility of consolidating Forsaken territory and stamping out anything that challenges Undercity authority south of the capital.

Much of Hadrec's immediate concern revolves around the Rot Hide gnolls and Fenris Isle. These undead-tainted beasts have infested the Dead Fields and the shores of Lake Lordamere, posing an unpredictable and vicious threat to Forsaken patrols. Hadrec dispatches agents to scour the decrepit ferries and rotting farmsteads for clues, determine what empowers the beasts, and prepare an outright strike against their island stronghold.

Beyond the gnoll infestation, Hadrec closely monitors intelligence gathered by the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's secretive rogue intelligence arm. When covert operatives disappear near the eerie spires of Shadowfang Keep, Hadrec tasks adventurers with discovering their fate, ensuring the Dark Lady remains informed of the shadowy archmage Arugal and his cursed worgen.

npc:high-priestess-laurena.s: Suma Sacerdotisa Laurena. La Suma Sacerdotisa Laurena es una respetada instructora de sacerdotes humana situada detrás del gran altar dentro de la Catedral de la Luz, en la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Tras haber escapado de la destrucción de Lordaeron como refugiada durante la Tercera Guerra, ahora instruye a los sacerdotes novatos de la Alianza en la devoción espiritual y las protecciones arcanas. Antes de ocupar su puesto en las imponentes salas de la Catedral de la Luz, Laurena vivía en el reino norteño de Lordaeron. Cuando la Plaga arrasó la región durante la Tercera Guerra, ella y toda su familia tuvieron la suerte de sobrevivir y huir hacia el sur, llegando a la Ciudad de Ventormenta como refugiados desplazados. A pesar del inmenso dolor y el caos que destruyeron su tierra natal, Laurena se mantuvo firme en su devoción y con el tiempo ascendió hasta convertirse en Suma Sacerdotisa al servicio de la Iglesia de la Luz Sagrada.

ang.class:Priest: High Priestess Laurena acts as one of Stormwind's primary priest mentors, guiding human acolytes through sacred trials, blessing them with Desperate Prayer, and teaching methods to disrupt enemy spellcasters.
ang.faction:Alliance: From within the Cathedral of Light, Laurena helps strengthen the spiritual backbone of the Alliance, ensuring its champions can withstand dark magic and undead horrors.
ang.race:Human: Like many humans in Stormwind, Laurena carries the sorrow of the fallen northern realm of Lordaeron, having rebuilt her life as a spiritual pillar for fellow survivors.

faq.a: She stands behind the main altar inside the Cathedral of Light, which is located in Cathedral Square within Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can I find High Priestess Laurena?

faq.a: Laurena is a priest trainer. She provides foundational instruction to human priests and teaches specialized racial prayers such as Desperate Prayer, as well as wards like Arcane Feedback to protect against hostile spellcasters.
faq.q: What does High Priestess Laurena teach?

faq.a: Laurena originally lived in the kingdom of Lordaeron. During the Third War, her family managed to escape the horrors of the Scourge and fled to Stormwind City as refugees, where she continued her religious calling.
faq.q: Where did Laurena come from before Stormwind?

faq.a: Yes. Archbishop Benedictus is the spiritual leader of the Church of the Holy Light and presides over the Cathedral of Light, where Laurena serves as a High Priestess.
faq.q: Does she serve under Archbishop Benedictus?

faq.a: Different cultures and races within the Alliance commune with the divine in unique ways. Once Laurena has taught her students the foundational prayers of the Holy Light, she sends them to master priests of other disciplines—such as dwarven masters in Ironforge or night elf priestesses in Darnassus—to expand their spiritual horizons.
faq.q: Why does she direct me to other priest trainers?

faq.a: Remarkably, her immediate family survived the fall of Lordaeron. They were among the fortunate refugees who managed to escape the Scourge intact and make the long voyage south to the safety of Stormwind.
faq.q: Did Laurena lose her family to the undead?

text.s: High Priestess Laurena is a respected human priest trainer stationed behind the grand altar within Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. Having escaped the destruction of Lordaeron as a refugee during the Third War, she now instructs budding Alliance priests in spiritual devotion and arcane wards.

sec.b: Before taking her post within the towering halls of the Cathedral of Light, Laurena dwelt in the northern kingdom of Lordaeron. When the Scourge swept across the land during the Third War, she and her entire family were fortunate enough to survive and flee southward, arriving in Stormwind City as displaced refugees. Despite the immense grief and chaos that shattered her homeland, Laurena remained steadfast in her devotion, eventually rising to become a High Priestess in service to the Church of the Holy Light.

Positioned directly behind the central altar within the cathedral sanctuary, High Priestess Laurena dedicates herself to mentoring aspiring priests. When promising acolytes demonstrate sufficient dedication and piety, they are directed to her to deepen their studies. Laurena guides them in the invocation of sacred boons such as Desperate Prayer and instructs them in defensive arts, including spells designed to turn enemy arcane magic back against those who wield it. Once an initiate has learned all she can offer, she sends them onward to other master priests across the Alliance.

npc:houndmaster-loksey.s: Domador de jaurías Loksey. El Domador de jaurías Loksey es el oficial encargado de criar y adiestrar a los temibles perros de guerra de la Cruzada Escarlata. Destinado en las perreras del interior de la Armería del Monasterio Escarlata, dirige jaurías de sabuesos para dar caza a no-muertos, intrusos y supuestos herejes. Su disciplina despiadada ha hecho que las bestias del Monasterio sean infames en todos los Claros de Tirisfal. Entre los muros fuertemente fortificados del Monasterio Escarlata, el Domador de jaurías Loksey dirige el adiestramiento de feroces perros de rastreo y ataque. La Cruzada Escarlata confía en estos sabuesos entrenados para olfatear cadáveres corrompidos por la peste, descubrir infiltrados ocultos y perseguir a cualquier superviviente que huya de la ira de los fanáticos. Loksey ostenta una autoridad absoluta sobre el ala de las perreras de la Armería, asegurándose de que sus pupilos estén listos para despedazar a los intrusos miembro a miembro.

ang.class:Hunter: Loksey exemplifies a brutal, aggressive approach to beast training, bending fierce hounds to obey zealotry rather than forging a bond of mutual respect.
ang.race:Undead: Forsaken intruders must beware Loksey's hounds, which are trained specifically to catch the scent of dead flesh and alert the Crusade's garrisons.

faq.a: Houndmaster Loksey is located inside the Armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, surrounded by his attack dogs within the kennels.
faq.q: Where can Houndmaster Loksey be found?

faq.a: He is the chief animal handler and houndmaster for the Scarlet Crusade at the Monastery, responsible for breeding, conditioning, and directing the war dogs used to sniff out undead and hunt down intruders.
faq.q: What role does Loksey serve in the Scarlet Crusade?

faq.a: Huntsman Leopold is Loksey's brother. Leopold represents the Scarlet Crusade at Light's Hope Chapel and looks down on Loksey, claiming Loksey cannot properly manage his hounds or handle diplomatic responsibilities.
faq.q: Who is Huntsman Leopold to Loksey?

faq.a: The Crusade trains vicious hounds to track down the Scourge and Forsaken through scent, as well as to guard the Monastery's grounds and tear fleeing enemies to pieces.
faq.q: Why does the Scarlet Crusade use hounds?

faq.a: Yes, Loksey is recognized as one of the key commanding figures in the Scarlet Monastery's military structure, overseeing the critical kennel operations within the Armory.
faq.q: Is Loksey considered a leader of the Scarlet Monastery?

faq.a: Yes. Bred for aggression and conditioned by Loksey, the Monastery's war hounds are fierce predators capable of ripping an armored intruder limb from limb in moments.
faq.q: Are the hounds dangerous on their own?

text.s: Houndmaster Loksey is the officer charged with breeding and training the fearsome war dogs of the Scarlet Crusade. Stationed in the kennels within the Scarlet Monastery's Armory, he directs packs of hounds to hunt down undead, intruders, and perceived heretics. His merciless discipline has made the Monastery's beasts infamous throughout Tirisfal Glades.

sec.b: Within the heavily fortified walls of the Scarlet Monastery, Houndmaster Loksey commands the training of vicious tracking and attack dogs. The Scarlet Crusade relies on these trained hounds to sniff out plague-tainted corpses, uncover hidden infiltrators, and run down any survivors fleeing the zealots' wrath. Loksey holds absolute authority over the Armory's kennel wing, ensuring his charges are primed to tear intruders apart limb by limb.

Loksey is not the only beast handler in his family serving the cause. His brother, Huntsman Leopold, serves as the Scarlet Crusade's envoy to the Argent Dawn at Light's Hope Chapel. Leopold holds a low opinion of his brother, privately asserting that Loksey can barely manage his own hounds, let alone represent the order in high-stakes diplomacy. Despite Leopold's scorn, Loksey remains a key officer within the Monastery's inner hierarchy.

npc:interrogator-vishas.s: Interrogador Vishas. El Interrogador James Vishas es el maestro del tormento de la Cruzada Escarlata, apostado en lo más profundo del Cementerio del Monasterio Escarlata. Célebre por su voz estridente y su crueldad absoluta, disfruta de una manera retorcida quebrando a los cautivos y poniendo a prueba los límites de la carne mortal. Pocos de los que entran en sus cámaras de tortura vuelven a salir con la mente o el cuerpo intactos. En el interior de las oscuras criptas y los camposantos del Monasterio Escarlata, el Interrogador Vishas se ocupa de los enemigos apresados por la Cruzada. Mientras los fanáticos del exterior desfilan con armaduras resplandecientes bajo estandartes de pureza, Vishas encarna la cruda realidad que se oculta tras su cruzada: un sadismo desenfrenado disfrazado de justa furia religiosa. Vishas no aborda el interrogatorio como una simple labor de inteligencia, sino como un preciado oficio, deleitándose con la agonía de los cautivos Renegados, los miembros de la Plaga capturados y cualquier viajero vivo con la mala fortuna de haber sido tachado de hereje.

ang.class:Priest: Seeing Vishas invoke zealotry to sanctify horrific mutilation offers a chilling demonstration of how holy purpose can curdle into twisted madness.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance heroes who discover Vishas' work quickly realize that the Scarlet Crusade no longer distinguishes between Scourge monsters and innocent living travelers.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Vishas embodies the hypocritical malice of the living zealots, torturing captured undead out of pure spite while claiming to serve the Holy Light.

faq.a: Interrogator Vishas is located deep inside the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery, in Tirisfal Glades. He oversees a grim torture chamber lined with iron cages and bloodied racks.
faq.q: Where can Interrogator Vishas be found?

faq.a: While the Scarlet Crusade justifies tormenting captives to root out Scourge corruption and extract information, Vishas personally delights in the pain he causes. He takes enormous personal pride in his cruelty, viewing torture as his artistic craft.
faq.q: Why does Vishas torture his prisoners?

faq.a: Vorrel Sengutz is a captive imprisoned and brutally tortured by Vishas inside the Monastery's Graveyard. Vishas subjected Vorrel to weeks of pain and stole his wedding band, intending it as a gift for his wife.
al: who is the prisoner in the cage
faq.q: Who is Vorrel Sengutz?

faq.a: His family lives far from the Monastery, at an unassuming cottage situated along the eastern bank of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. His wife Nancy and Grandpa Vishas dwell there quietly, seemingly detached from his atrocities.
faq.q: Where does Vishas' family live?

faq.a: The Scarlet Crusade regards the undead as enemies. Among Vishas's prisoners is the Forsaken Vorrel Sengutz, whom he has tortured for weeks.
faq.q: Who does Vishas hold prisoner?

faq.a: Vishas is infamous among those who face him for his grating, high-pitched voice, cackling laughter, and disturbing excitement whenever an opportunity presents itself to rip secrets from an unwilling victim.
faq.q: What is Vishas' voice and demeanor like?

text.s: Interrogator James Vishas is the Scarlet Crusade's master of torment, stationed deep within the Scarlet Monastery's Graveyard wing. Infamous for his shrill voice and sheer cruelty, he takes twisted pleasure in breaking captives and testing the limits of mortal flesh. Few who enter his torture chambers ever leave with their minds or bodies intact.

sec.b: Within the dark crypts and burial grounds of the Scarlet Monastery, Interrogator Vishas tends to the Crusade's captive enemies. While the zealots outside march in gleaming armor under banners of purity, Vishas represents the grim reality behind their crusade: unbridled sadism cloaked in religious righteous fury. He approaches interrogation not merely as an intelligence duty, but as a prized craft, reveling in the agony of Forsaken captives, captured Scourge, and any living travelers unlucky enough to be branded heretics.

Behind the bloody aprons and screams of the torture chamber, Vishas leads a bizarrely domestic double life. Outside the monastery walls, his family—including his wife, Nancy Vishas, and his elder relative Grandpa Vishas—resides peacefully in an isolated cottage on the eastern shores of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. Vishas even carries gruesome tokens from his victims back into his personal life, having stripped a captive Forsaken named Vorrel Sengutz of his cherished wedding ring to present it as a gift to Nancy.

npc:islen-waterseer.s: Islen Vident'aqua. Islen Vident'aqua es una respetada chamán tauren que mora junto a una tranquila cabaña de pesca en el Escalón de la Marea, con vistas al mar oriental de Los Baldíos. Al poseer una íntima comunión con los espíritus del agua, guía a los iniciados en las pruebas necesarias para sintonizar con el elemento. Los chamanes novatos de toda la Horda buscan su sabiduría para obtener su Tótem de agua. Lejos de los bulliciosos cruces de caminos y campamentos de Los Baldíos, Islen Vident'aqua vive a lo largo de la escarpada costa conocida como el Escalón de la Marea. Aquí, donde las áridas llanuras rompen contra el Mare Magnum, la presencia de los espíritus del agua es pura y omnipresente. En lugar de habitar en salas atronadoras o ciudades ajetreadas, Islen prefiere este tranquilo puesto de avanzada, dedicando sus días a escuchar las mareas y a ayudar a los chamanes que buscan la comunión con el fluido elemento.

ang.class:Shaman: Islen is an essential mentor on your journey, guiding you through the elemental rites needed to bind and commune with the spirits of water to earn your Water Totem.
ang.faction:Horde: Stationed along the Barrens coast, Islen serves as a tranquil Horde spiritual anchor, welcoming travelers from Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff alike.
ang.race:Tauren: Islen embodies the traditional tauren reverence for the Earth Mother's gifts, choosing a solitary life by the sea to stay attuned to the subtle currents of the wild.

faq.a: Islen Waterseer is a wise tauren shaman who resides along the coast of the Barrens at the Tidus Stair. She possesses a rare, deep bond with the elemental spirits of water and acts as a spiritual mentor for shamans journeying to earn their Water Totem.
faq.q: Who is Islen Waterseer?

faq.a: Horde shamans are directed to Islen by their trainers in Durotar, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff during the Call of Water trials. She tests their understanding of the element and instructs them on crafting the Water Sapta to perceive water elementals directly.
faq.q: Why do shamans travel to see her?

faq.a: She can be found sitting outside a small fishing hut on the Tidus Stair, situated on the eastern shoreline of the Barrens, south of the Merchant Coast.
faq.q: Where is Islen Waterseer located?

faq.a: The Water Sapta is a specially brewed spiritual draught crafted through elemental components. Consuming it allows a shaman's sight to penetrate the physical plane and witness the hidden spirits of water dwelling in sacred springs and tides.
faq.q: What is the Water Sapta she speaks of?

faq.a: Greta Mosshoof is an old tauren companion and fellow practitioner of spiritual crafts. The two share an enduring friendship, consulting one another on spiritual cleansing and the restorative nature of water.
faq.q: Who is Islen's friend Greta Mosshoof?

faq.a: Islen is allied with the Horde and the United Tauren Tribes under Cairne Bloodhoof. Though she lives in isolation along the coast, she readily aids orc, troll, and tauren shamans sent by the Horde's elders.
faq.q: Does Islen belong to a specific faction or tribe?

text.s: Islen Waterseer is a respected tauren shaman who dwells beside a quiet fishing hut on the Tidus Stair, overlooking the eastern sea of the Barrens. Possessing an intimate communion with the spirits of water, she guides initiates on the trials necessary to attune with the element. Novice shamans across the Horde seek her wisdom to earn their Water Totem.

sec.b: Far from the bustling crossroads and encampments of the Barrens, Islen Waterseer lives along the craggy coastline known as the Tidus Stair. Here, where the arid plains break against the Great Sea, the presence of the water spirits is raw and pervasive. Rather than dwelling in thunderous halls or busy cities, Islen prefers this quiet outpost, dedicating her days to listening to the tides and assisting shamans who seek communion with the fluid element.

Understanding water requires more than simple study; it demands internal harmony and spiritual perception. Islen guides seekers through the preparation of the Water Sapta, a sacred brew that pierces the veil between mortal senses and elemental manifestations. Her teachings remind shamans that water is as unyielding and deep as it is fluid and restorative, requiring immense respect from any who hope to call upon its aid.

While Islen maintains a quiet life on the coast, her spiritual reach and connections extend across Kalimdor. She maintains a close, enduring friendship with Greta Mosshoof, another wise tauren versed in the restorative arts. Through these connections, Islen's knowledge of water's purifying essence touches matters well beyond the Barrens, even offering spiritual aid to lands afflicted by deep corruption.

npc:iverron.s: Iverron. Iverron es un joven elfo de la noche que se encuentra en Cañada Umbría, la resguardada rama inicial de Teldrassil. Afectado por el veneno de los arácnidos cada vez más alterados del bosque, su desdicha sirve como una advertencia temprana de la creciente corrupción en el Árbol del Mundo. Mientras deambulaba por el tranquilo dosel de Cañada Umbría, Iverron tropezó con las arañas tejemadera que anidan en el valle. Sucumbiendo rápidamente a su mordedura tóxica, el joven elfo quedó incapacitado, incapaz de regresar a un lugar seguro por sus propios medios. Su estado de indefensión pone de manifiesto la repentina agresividad que invade a criaturas que antes compartían el claro en paz.

ang.class:Druid: Druids studying in Shadowglen view Iverron's poisoning as a symptom of a deeper affliction gripping nature, requiring remedies forged directly from the flora and fauna of the glade.
ang.profession:Herbalism: Iverron's survival depends on the prompt gathering of local Shadowglen flora, emphasizing the critical value of herbal knowledge in preserving life.
ang.race:NightElf: For fledgling night elves taking their first steps outside Aldrassil, Iverron's misfortune is an early lesson in how quickly the wilds of Teldrassil are falling into imbalance.

faq.a: Iverron is a young night elf dwelling in Shadowglen within Teldrassil. During his travels through the woodland, he fell victim to the poisonous fauna haunting the boughs and required urgent aid to survive.
faq.q: Who is Iverron?

faq.a: He was bitten by the aggressive webwood spiders that inhabit the thickets of Shadowglen, suffering from a debilitating venom that standard rest could not cure.
faq.q: What poisoned Iverron?

faq.a: He is cured through a concoction made of local Teldrassil plant matter, including hyacinth mushrooms and moonpetal lilies, mixed with webwood ichor from the spiders to create a targeted antidote.
faq.q: How is Iverron cured?

faq.a: He is located in Shadowglen, the secluded starting glade in the crown of Teldrassil where novice night elves begin their training.
faq.q: Where can Iverron be found?

faq.a: Iverron sends adventurers to his friend Dirania Silvershine, who gathers the ingredients for an antidote and sends it back to him before it loses its potency.
faq.q: Who is helping Iverron?

faq.a: The sudden aggression of Shadowglen's spiders is part of an unnatural malady creeping into Teldrassil, warping normally reclusive beasts into violent predators.
faq.q: Why are the spiders in Shadowglen so hostile?

text.s: Iverron is a young night elf found in Shadowglen, the sheltered starting bough of Teldrassil. Stricken by the venom of the woodland's increasingly agitated arachnids, his plight serves as an early warning of the growing corruption within the World Tree.

sec.b: While wandering through the quiet canopies of Shadowglen, Iverron ran afoul of the webwood spiders nesting in the vale. Succumbing quickly to their toxic bite, the young elf was left incapacitated, unable to return to safety on his own. His helpless condition highlights the sudden aggression sweeping through creatures that once shared the glade in peace.

Iverron's survival falls upon the quick thinking of his companions and local healers, who require potent woodland ingredients—such as hyacinth mushrooms, moonpetal lilies and webwood ichor—to brew an antidote. His brush with death is a sober reminder to all young kaldorei in Shadowglen that the boughs of Teldrassil are far from unblemished sanctuary.

npc:jaina-proudmoore.s: Jaina Valiente. Lady Jaina Valiente es la gobernante de Isla Theramore y la hechicera humana más poderosa con vida. Antigua alumna estrella del Kirin Tor de Dalaran, guio a los supervivientes de Lordaeron a través del Mare Magnum y ahora se esfuerza por mantener una frágil paz entre la Alianza y la nueva Horda. Hija del gran almirante Daelin Valiente de Kul Tiras, Jaina mostró una notable aptitud para lo arcano a temprana edad y estudió con el archimago Antonidas en Dalaran. Durante la Tercera Guerra, investigó la misteriosa Plaga de la no-muerte junto al príncipe Arthas Menethil, presenciando de primera mano la trágica caída de Lordaeron. Guiada por las advertencias del profeta Medivh, reunió una expedición de supervivientes humanos y zarpó hacia el oeste, rumbo al olvidado continente de Kalimdor. Allí, sus fuerzas forjaron una alianza sin precedentes con la Horda de Thrall y los elfos de la noche, manteniéndose unidos en la cima del Monte Hyjal para derrotar a Archimonde y hacer añicos la invasión de la Legión Ardiente.

ang.class:Mage: Trained under Archmage Antonidas himself, Lady Jaina is widely considered the most powerful living human sorceress, demonstrating the height of Dalaran's arcane mastery.
ang.faction:Alliance: Jaina provides the Alliance with its critical foothold in southern Kalimdor, balancing loyalty to Highlord Bolvar's regency in Stormwind against her desire to avoid war with the neighboring Horde.

faq.a: Jaina is the ruler of Theramore Isle and arguably the most gifted human mage alive. She is the daughter of the late Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras and a former apprentice of Archmage Antonidas in Dalaran.
faq.q: Who is Lady Jaina Proudmoore?

faq.a: Before the fall of Lordaeron in the Third War, the Prophet Medivh warned Jaina to lead as many people as possible across the sea to Kalimdor. Her expedition survived the journey, fought at Mount Hyjal, and settled the port-fortress of Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh.
faq.q: Why is Jaina in Kalimdor instead of the Eastern Kingdoms?

faq.a: Jaina maintains an unusual, cautious friendship with Warchief Thrall. After fighting together against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal, both leaders have strived to keep the peace between their peoples, despite sharp opposition from hardliners on both sides.
faq.q: What is Jaina's relationship with the Horde?

faq.a: Jaina and Arthas were childhood friends whose bond deepened into romance as young adults. They jointly investigated the plague spreading across Lordaeron, but Jaina was horrified by Arthas's descent into ruthlessness—culminating in the purging of Stratholme, where she refused to participate in the slaughter of infected citizens.
faq.q: What happened between Jaina and Prince Arthas Menethil?

text.s: Lady Jaina Proudmoore is the ruler of Theramore Isle and the most powerful human sorceress alive. Formerly a star pupil of Dalaran's Kirin Tor, she led the survivors of Lordaeron across the Great Sea and now strives to maintain a fragile peace between the Alliance and the New Horde.

sec.b: The daughter of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras, Jaina showed remarkable aptitude for the arcane at an early age and studied under Archmage Antonidas in Dalaran. During the Third War, she investigated the mysterious Plague of Undeath alongside Prince Arthas Menethil, witnessing firsthand the tragic downfall of Lordaeron. Guided by the warnings of the Prophet Medivh, she rallied an expedition of human survivors and set sail westward to the forgotten continent of Kalimdor. There, her forces forged an unprecedented alliance with Thrall's Horde and the night elves, standing together atop Mount Hyjal to defeat Archimonde and shatter the Burning Legion's invasion.

Following the Legion's defeat, Jaina founded the island citadel of Theramore off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, establishing the primary bastion of the Alliance in southern Kalimdor. Her commitment to diplomacy was tested to its limits when her father arrived seeking vengeance against the orcs; Jaina refused to support his war, stepping aside as Thrall's forces slew the Grand Admiral to prevent Kalimdor from plunging into another devastating conflict. Today, she rules Theramore as a steadfast advocate for coexistence, working closely with Warchief Thrall while anchoring the Alliance's presence against rising local tensions.

npc:je-neu-sancrea.s: Je'neu Sancrea. Je'neu Sancrea es un trol de Lanza Negra y miembro del Anillo de la Tierra apostado en la Avanzada de Zoram'gar, a lo largo de la costa de Vallefresno. Al percibir oscuras perturbaciones en las profundidades de la costa, dirige a los aventureros de la Horda para investigar la corrupción que infesta el antiguo templo sumergido de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Mientras la mayor parte del Anillo de la Tierra se centra en la armonía elemental por todo Kalimdor, Je'neu Sancrea vigila la aislada y peligrosa La Ensanada de Zoram. Establecido en la Avanzada de Zoram'gar, observa los oscuros temblores y las mareas antinaturales que se agitan cerca del templo en ruinas de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Aunque está sujeto a los deberes chamánicos de su círculo, su fuerte lealtad a la tribu Lanza Negra y a la Horda de Thrall hace que trabaje exclusivamente junto a los campeones de la Horda.

ang.class:Shaman: As a prominent Darkspear member of the Earthen Ring, Je'neu represents the shamanic duty to balance corrupted elementals and restore balance to the waters of Kalimdor.
ang.faction:Horde: Je'neu serves as the Horde's primary quest hub and lore guide for entering the depths of Blackfathom Deeps from Ashenvale.
ang.race:Troll: Je'neu demonstrates how Darkspear trolls have embraced the spiritual paths of the Earthen Ring alongside their tauren and orc allies.

faq.a: Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll shaman affiliated with the Earthen Ring. He is stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Ashenvale coast, where he monitors the growing corruption spilling out from Blackfathom Deeps.
faq.q: Who is Je'neu Sancrea?

faq.a: Although the Earthen Ring as an organization pursues elemental balance rather than faction warfare, Je'neu's personal ties remain firmly rooted in the Darkspear tribe and the Horde. Because he resides within a frontline Horde military outpost in Ashenvale, he does not welcome Alliance travelers.
faq.q: Why does Je'neu only deal with Horde adventurers if he is Earthen Ring?

faq.a: Je'neu investigates the unnatural elemental unrest and dark magic rising from Blackfathom Deeps. He charges champions with retrieving corrupted water cores, slaying Twilight's Hammer cultists, and confirming whispers that an ancient hydra, Aku'mai, serves ancient malevolent masters beneath the sea.
faq.q: What is Je'neu investigating in Blackfathom Deeps?

faq.a: Je'neu is located at Zoram'gar Outpost, a fortified Horde settlement on the far northwestern coast of Ashenvale, right along the Zoram Strand just south of Blackfathom Deeps.
faq.q: Where is Je'neu Sancrea located?
