faq.a: The Earthen Ring is an ancient circle of shamans dedicated to understanding and soothing the elemental spirits of the world, intervening whenever dark forces or chaotic entities disrupt natural elemental harmony.
faq.q: What is the Earthen Ring?

faq.a: The Twilight's Hammer cult has infiltrated Blackfathom Deeps to venerate the beast Aku'mai and conduct rituals dedicated to the Old Gods. Je'neu tasks Horde adventurers with cutting down their leaders to halt their dark work.
al: who are the cultists in bfd
faq.q: What is the threat of the Twilight's Hammer in the Deeps?

text.s: Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll and a member of the Earthen Ring stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the Ashenvale coast. Sensing dark disturbances deep beneath the shoreline, he directs Horde adventurers to investigate the corruption infesting the ancient submerged temple of Blackfathom Deeps.

sec.b: While most of the Earthen Ring focuses on elemental harmony across Kalimdor, Je'neu Sancrea keeps watch over the secluded and dangerous Zoram Strand. Perched at Zoram'gar Outpost, he observes the dark tremors and unnatural tides stirring near the ruined temple of Blackfathom Deeps. Though bound by the shamanic duties of his circle, his strong loyalties to the Darkspear tribe and Thrall's Horde keep him working exclusively alongside Horde champions.

Je'neu seeks to uncover the true cause behind the creeping corruption around the coast. Through bold adventurers, he collects tainted sapphire cores, investigates the vile remnants of water elementals like Baron Aquanis, and uncovers the insidious influence of the Twilight's Hammer cult. The dark rituals taking place beneath the waves threaten not only the balance of the local elements, but herald the dark return of forces sworn to the Old Gods.

npc:jern-hornhelm.s: Jern Cornamenta. Jern Cornamenta es un minero enano afiliado a la Liga de Expedicionarios, apostado en el poblado de Thelsamar. Coordina la logística vital y la comunicación entre el asentamiento, Forjaz y el yacimiento arqueológico situado más al interior de Loch Modan. Los aventureros le ayudan con frecuencia transportando suministros de minería e informes de progresos por toda la región. Apostado en el rústico poblado de Thelsamar, Jern Cornamenta desempeña un papel logístico clave para las operaciones de los enanos en todo Loch Modan. Mientras los eruditos y los equipos de campo enanos se adentran en las tierras salvajes para desenterrar su pasado ancestral, mantener unas cadenas de suministro constantes sigue siendo esencial. Jern se asegura de que los recursos vitales, las herramientas y las comunicaciones lleguen sanos y salvos a las excavaciones activas.

ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance travelers passing through Loch Modan find Jern to be an essential point of contact for securing the region and maintaining dwarven infrastructure.
ang.profession:Mining: Miners will appreciate Jern's trade background and practical understanding of subterranean logistics, blasting, and resource hauling.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, assisting Jern directly advances the sacred quest to uncover the race's ancient Titan heritage buried deep within the mountains.

faq.a: Jern Hornhelm is a dwarven miner and logistics coordinator based in Thelsamar in Loch Modan. He works on behalf of the Explorers' League to keep local excavation efforts running smoothly.
faq.q: Who is Jern Hornhelm?

faq.a: He can be found standing outdoors in the town of Thelsamar, situated centrally in Loch Modan along the main road.
faq.q: Where can I find Jern Hornhelm?

faq.a: Jern is aligned with the Alliance and specifically represents the dwarven Explorers' League, managing the movement of personnel and mining supplies.
faq.q: What faction does Jern Hornhelm belong to?

faq.a: Archaeological digs in the mountainous terrain require controlled demolitions to break through stubborn rock faces. Jern coordinates the delivery of specialized blasting powder to Prospector Ironband's dig site so the crew can safely uncover Titan relics and ancient stone halls.
faq.q: Why does Jern need blasting powder sent to the excavation?

faq.a: Jern serves as a vital communications link between remote digs in Loch Modan and the high leadership of the Explorers' League located in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, frequently dispatching field progress reports back to the capital.
faq.q: What is Jern Hornhelm's connection to Ironforge?

faq.a: The sudden rise of aggressive troggs displaced from beneath the earth has severely threatened excavation efforts and blocked trade routes, making regular delivery runs dangerous without armed adventurers to escort supplies.
faq.q: What problems are the dig sites facing in Loch Modan?

text.s: Jern Hornhelm is a dwarven miner affiliated with the Explorers' League, stationed in the town of Thelsamar. He coordinates vital logistics and communication between the settlement, Ironforge, and the archaeological dig site deeper in Loch Modan. Adventurers frequently assist him with shuttling mining supplies and progress reports across the region.

sec.b: Stationed within the rustic town of Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm plays a key logistical role for dwarven operations throughout Loch Modan. While dwarven scholars and field teams venture out into the wilderness to unearth their ancestral past, maintaining consistent supply chains remains essential. Jern ensures that vital resources, tools, and communications reach the active dig sites safely.

As a member of the Explorers' League, Jern bridges the gap between field archaeologists and the League's leadership in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. Sites such as Ironband's Excavation rely heavily on blasting powder, equipment, and regular dispatches to keep work moving forward. Jern enlists reliable travelers to navigate the trogg-infested roads and keep the dig fully operational.

npc:jonathan-carevin.s: Jonathan Carevin. Jonathan Carevin es un decidido cazador humano que reside en Villa Oscura, entregado a erradicar la oscuridad que asola Bosque del Ocaso. A diferencia de la defensiva Guardia Nocturna, él y su familia cazan activamente a los no-muertos, huargen y cualquier amenaza herética que aceche bajo las sombrías copas de los árboles. Aunque Villa Oscura depende de la Guardia Nocturna para patrullar los caminos y proteger el pueblo, Jonathan Carevin cree que un mero perímetro defensivo no basta. Junto a su familia y aliados como Calor, Jonathan toma la ofensiva. Pone en su punto de mira a los engendros profanos que deambulan por Bosque del Ocaso, embarcándose en una cruzada personal para purgar a todos los demonios, no-muertos y herejes de la región bajo la gracia de la Luz.

ang.class:Hunter: Hunters find common ground with Carevin's proactive tracking and methodical culling of Duskwood's nocturnal predators.
ang.class:Paladin: Carevin's zeal and invocation of the Light against demonic and undead corruption resonate deeply with a paladin's sacred vows.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions trying to stabilize Duskwood, Jonathan Carevin provides targeted strikes against the supernatural threats that Stormwind's neglect has left unchecked.

faq.a: Jonathan Carevin is a grim hunter living in Darkshire in Duskwood. He leads the Carevin family in an active fight against the foul monsters haunting the forest.
faq.q: Who is Jonathan Carevin?

faq.a: While the Night Watch focuses primarily on guarding Darkshire's perimeter and keeping the roads passable, Jonathan and his supporters actively track and hunt down the undead and other abominations to eradicate them at their source.
faq.q: How does he differ from the Night Watch?

faq.a: Jonathan actively hunts the undead, ravenous worgen packs, demons, and anyone who would offer shelter or aid to such unholy abominations.
faq.q: What threats does he fight?

faq.a: His harsh rhetoric, fervent devotion to the Light, and strict zero-tolerance approach toward corruption mirror Scarlet beliefs, but officially he operates independently alongside his family in Darkshire.
faq.q: Is Jonathan affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade?

faq.a: Beyond his immediate family, Jonathan receives direct assistance from sympathetic combatants such as Calor, who aids him in tracking monstrous incursions across the woods.
faq.q: Who assists Jonathan in his mission?

faq.a: Jonathan views the worgen as an unnatural menace terrorizing Duskwood's people and tasks travelers with uncovering the source of their sudden emergence in the wilderness.
faq.q: What is his connection to the worgen?

text.s: Jonathan Carevin is a resolute human hunter residing in Darkshire, dedicated to eradicating the darkness plaguing Duskwood. Unlike the defensive Night Watch, he and his family actively hunt down the undead, worgen, and any heretical threats lurking under the darkened canopies.

sec.b: While Darkshire depends upon the Night Watch to patrol the roads and safeguard the township, Jonathan Carevin believes a mere defensive perimeter is insufficient. Alongside his family and allies like Calor, Jonathan takes the offensive. He actively targets the unholy fiends wandering Duskwood, pursuing a personal crusade to purge all demons, undead, and heretics from the region under the grace of the Light.

Jonathan's vigilance extends beyond shambling skeletons and ghouls. He pays close attention to the savage, wolf-like beasts known as worgen that stalk the forest depths. Knowing the danger they present to an already besieged settlement, Jonathan coordinates investigations into their mysterious presence, seeking to uncover where these ungodly predators originated and putting an end to their nocturnal prowling.

npc:jordan-stilwell.s: Jordan Fontana. Jordan Fontana es un diestro forjador de armas humano apostado a las afueras de las nevadas Puertas de Forjaz, en Dun Morogh. Aunque en un principio estaba destinado a convertirse en paladín de la Luz Sagrada, siguió el oficio de su padre para convertirse en un artesano cuyo trabajo sirve a los paladines de toda la Alianza. Es conocido sobre todo por forjar el Puño de Verigan en honor a su viejo amigo, Bosch Verigan. Aunque se esperaba que Jordan Fontana tomara los votos sagrados y se convirtiera en paladín de la Iglesia de la Luz Sagrada, al final eligió el camino de la forja. Siguió los pasos de su padre empuñando el martillo de herrero encantado de este. Jordan perfeccionó su oficio bajo la tutela del herrero enano Bailor Petramano. A pesar de dejar a un lado el manto de guerrero sagrado ungido, Jordan sigue siendo profundamente fiel a la Luz, dedicando su extraordinaria maestría a equipar a los campeones que luchan en su nombre.

ang.class:Paladin: Jordan Stilwell is a crucial figure in a paladin's early trials, tasking them with scouring Azeroth for rare components to forge their signature warhammer, Verigan's Fist.
ang.faction:Alliance: Having fled the horrors of Arugal's worgen in Silverpine Forest, Jordan found sanctuary with the dwarves of Dun Morogh and now lends his craft directly to Alliance champions.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: Trained by the dwarf Bailor Stonehand and wielding an enchanted hammer inherited from his father, Jordan represents the pinnacle of mortal holy metalworking.

faq.a: Jordan Stilwell is a master human blacksmith found working outside the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He crafts sacred armaments for paladins of the Church of the Holy Light, most notably the legendary warhammer Verigan's Fist.
al: who is this blacksmith outside ironforge
faq.q: Who is Jordan Stilwell?

faq.a: According to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind, Jordan prefers working in the crisp, cool mountain air of Dun Morogh rather than the stifling interior of the Great Forge within Ironforge.
al: why is he in the snow
faq.q: Why does Jordan Stilwell work outside in the snow instead of inside Ironforge?

faq.a: Jordan was once an armorer and blacksmith stationed at Baron Silverlaine's estate in Silverpine Forest. He managed to flee the keep before or during the disastrous uprising when Archmage Arugal and his feral worgen slaughtered the garrison and overtook the fortress.
faq.q: What is Jordan Stilwell's connection to Shadowfang Keep?

faq.a: Verigan's Fist is a powerful two-handed holy hammer forged by Jordan Stilwell for Alliance paladins. It is named in honor of Jordan's old friend, Bosch Verigan.
faq.q: What is Verigan's Fist?

faq.a: Jordan inherited his craft and an enchanted smithing hammer from his father, and went on to refine his expertise under the instruction of the dwarven blacksmith Bailor Stonehand.
faq.q: Who trained Jordan Stilwell in blacksmithing?

faq.a: Jordan is married to Daphne Stilwell. Together, the couple has provided immense aid to the Church of the Holy Light over the years, and both are revered as deeply devout servants of the faith.
faq.q: Who is Jordan Stilwell's wife?

text.s: Jordan Stilwell is a skilled human weaponsmith stationed outside the snowy Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. Though originally meant to become a paladin of the Holy Light, he followed his father's craft to become an artisan whose work serves paladins across the Alliance. He is best known for forging Verigan's Fist in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan.

sec.b: Though Jordan Stilwell was expected to take holy vows and become a paladin within the Church of the Holy Light, he ultimately chose the way of the forge. He followed in his father's footsteps, taking up his father's enchanted smithing hammer. Jordan refined his craft under the tutelage of the dwarven blacksmith Bailor Stonehand. Despite setting aside the mantle of an anointed holy warrior, Jordan remains deeply faithful to the Light, dedicating his extraordinary craftsmanship to outfitting champions who fight in its name.

Long before setting up shop in the biting cold of Dun Morogh, Jordan served as a smith at the keep of Baron Silverlaine in Silverpine Forest. When Archmage Arugal unleashed the feral worgen upon the fortress, turning it into the cursed bastion known as Shadowfang Keep, Jordan managed to escape the bloodshed. Forced to abandon his forge and his former home, he eventually found refuge among the dwarves of Dun Morogh.

Jordan keeps his forge outdoors near the gates of Ironforge, favoring the brisk alpine air over the stifling heat of the Great Forge inside the mountain. When the Church of the Holy Light sends worthy paladins to him, Jordan tasks them with recovering rare materials from across the world to craft a legendary two-handed warhammer. Named Verigan's Fist in honor of his old friend Bosch Verigan, the weapon stands as a testament to the enduring bond between devoted faith and masterful steel.

npc:kadrak.s: Kadrak. Kadrak es un curtido comandante orco apostado en La Muralla de Mor'shan, en la frontera entre Los Baldíos y Vallefresno. Con la tarea de salvaguardar la frontera norte, coordina la llegada de despachos y refuerzos al disputado bosque. Para los aventureros de la Horda que avanzan más allá de las llanuras áridas, Kadrak actúa como la puerta de entrada a la incesante lucha contra los elfos de la noche. Apostado en lo alto de las barricadas fortificadas de madera de La Muralla de Mor'shan, Kadrak vigila la ruta principal que conecta Los Baldíos con Vallefresno. La frontera es un límite precario: al sur se extienden las llanuras abrasadas por el sol reclamadas por la Horda, mientras que al norte se alzan los antiguos bosques defendidos con fiereza por los elfos de la noche. Kadrak se asegura de que el perímetro defensivo permanezca intacto frente a las incursiones de las Centinelas y las hostiles criaturas del bosque.

ang.class:Warrior: Kadrak embodies frontline discipline, relying on raw steel and martial strength to hold a fortified choke point against hostile woodcraft and guerrilla raids.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance forces attempting to strike into the Barrens from Ashenvale, Kadrak and his rampart represent a fortified roadblock guarding the Horde's heartland.
ang.faction:Horde: Kadrak is your entry point to Ashenvale's campaigns, directing the flow of warriors northward to defend lumber operations and carve out Horde territory.
ang.race:Orc: As a steadfast veteran upholding the legacy of the Warsong Clan's territorial efforts, Kadrak represents the unyielding orcish resolve on the Ashenvale border.

faq.a: Kadrak is an orc officer stationed at the Mor'shan Rampart. He oversees border security and directs Horde forces traveling between the Barrens and the warzones of Ashenvale.
al: who is the orc at the wall
faq.q: Who is Kadrak?

faq.a: Kadrak stands at the Mor'shan Rampart, the fortified wooden barricade at the far northern edge of the Barrens, marking the boundary leading into Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where can Kadrak be found?

faq.a: He commands the defensive perimeter at the border, gathers military intelligence from scout runners, and briefs Horde travelers heading north to reinforce outposts like Splintertree Post.
faq.q: What is Kadrak's role in the Horde?

faq.a: The Rampart protects the northern approaches of the Barrens and Durotar from retaliatory night elf incursions sparked by the Horde's logging operations in Ashenvale.
faq.q: Why is the Mor'shan Rampart heavily defended?

faq.a: Kadrak receives reports carried from the Barrens and dispatches adventurers on missions regarding Warsong scouting reports and establishing a firmer Horde presence along the forest frontier.
faq.q: What quests does Kadrak provide or complete?

faq.a: Kadrak has ties to frontline Horde officers, including Captain Shatterskull, and maintains regular communication with the Warsong Outriders operating within Ashenvale.
faq.q: Does Kadrak have ties to other notable Horde figures?

text.s: Kadrak is a seasoned orc commander stationed at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Barrens and Ashenvale. Tasked with safeguarding the northern frontier, he coordinates the flow of dispatches and reinforcements into the contested forest. For Horde adventurers pushing past the arid plains, Kadrak serves as the gateway to the ongoing struggle against the night elves.

sec.b: Standing atop the fortified timber barricades of the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak watches over the primary route connecting the Barrens to Ashenvale. The border is a precarious frontier: to the south lie the sun-scorched plainsclaimed by the Horde, while to the north loom the ancient woods guarded fiercely by the night elves. Kadrak ensures that the defensive perimeter remains unbroken against encroaching Sentinels and hostile woodland creatures.

Beyond holding the line, Kadrak manages essential military intelligence between the Barrens and the forward logging camps deeper in the forest. He receives couriers bearing critical combat reports from the Warsong Outriders and coordinates the movement of supplies and fresh blood into outpost hubs like Splintertree Post. Those reporting to him are promptly directed into the heart of the territorial war.

npc:kaela-shadowspear.s: Kaela Lanzasombra. Kaela Lanzasombra es una centinela elfa de la noche apostada al suroeste de Risco Cortaviento, en Sierra Espolón. Desde su pequeño puesto avanzado, se coordina con otras centinelas para vigilar la creciente tensión y las perturbaciones territoriales en la naturaleza. Confía en viajeros valientes para explorar el peligroso territorio y llevar ayuda a los defensores heridos de la tierra. Apostada justo al suroeste de la devastación industrial de Risco Cortaviento, Kaela Lanzasombra mantiene una atenta vigilancia sobre los pasos circundantes. Sierra Espolón está plagada de peligros a medida que la Horda avanza y las operaciones de los goblins explotan los recursos naturales de la zona. Operando junto al gnomo Gaxim Silvóxido, Kaela actúa como un enlace avanzado fundamental para los elfos de la noche, rastreando las amenazas que se adentran en territorio ancestral.

ang.class:Druid: Druids will find common cause with Kaela's efforts to nurse injured ancients back to health and silence the agony of disturbed nature spirits.
ang.faction:Alliance: Kaela Shadowspear serves as a crucial point of contact for Alliance adventurers venturing into the contested reaches of Stonetalon, coordinating intelligence between distant outposts.
ang.race:NightElf: For the night elves, Kaela represents the steadfast defense of sacred ground, laboring to soothe outraged spirits and safeguard the revered ancients of Kalimdor.

faq.a: Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf quest giver stationed in a frontier camp southwest of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. She oversees regional scouting and aids in protecting the local wildlife and spirits.
faq.q: Who is Kaela Shadowspear?

faq.a: She is located in a small Alliance camp situated southwest of Windshear Crag along the road in the Stonetalon Mountains, sharing the camp with the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle.
faq.q: Where can Kaela Shadowspear be found?

faq.a: Kaela coordinates closely with Sentinel Thenysil, regularly sending and receiving intelligence updates on enemy movements and local threats across Stonetalon.
faq.q: Who does Kaela report to?

faq.a: Intense logging, mining, and military encroachment in Stonetalon have deeply disturbed the natural balance, causing elemental spirits to fly into a rage and attack anyone nearby.
faq.q: Why is Kaela concerned about the elementals?

faq.a: The regional conflicts and rapid deforestation have left ancient protectors wounded and suffering. Kaela seeks the aid of travelers to find and heal these fallen protectors of the wild.
faq.q: What is happening to the ancients near Windshear Crag?

faq.a: Kaela shares her camp with Gaxim Rustfizzle, an Alliance gnome. While Kaela focuses on the spiritual and tactical balance of the wilderness, Gaxim is concerned with counteracting the hostile goblin machinery and operations nearby.
faq.q: Why is a gnome stationed with Kaela?

text.s: Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf sentinel stationed southwest of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. From her small outpost, she coordinates with fellow sentinels to monitor escalating tensions and regional disruptions in the wilderness. She relies on brave travelers to scout dangerous territory and bring aid to the land's wounded defenders.

sec.b: Positioned just southwest of the industrial devastation of Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear keeps a watchful vigil over the surrounding passes. The Stonetalon Mountains are fraught with danger as the Horde encroaches and goblin operations exploit the land's natural bounty. Operating alongside the gnome Gaxim Rustfizzle, Kaela acts as an essential forward liaison for the night elves, tracking threats that push deeper into ancestral territory.

The unrest in Stonetalon goes far beyond territorial skirmishes. The violent disruption of nature has agitated the elementals and brought harm to ancient guardians of the forest. Kaela works tirelessly to dispatch adventurers against raging elemental spirits and to tend to the wounded ancients suffering in the crossfire of the region's conflicts, striving to restore peace before the land is irrevocably scarred.

npc:kam-deepfury.s: Kam Furiahonda. Kam Furiahonda es un infame saboteador Hierro Negro encarcelado en las profundidades de las Mazmorras de Ventormenta. A diferencia de la mayoría de los reclusos de la prisión, no rinde lealtad a la Hermandad Defias, pues fue capturado tras orquestar una devastadora explosión a lo largo del Puente Thandol, muy al norte. Aunque Las Mazmorras están repletas en su inmensa mayoría de albañiles descontentos y rebeldes Defias, Kam Furiahonda es un caso aparte. Siendo un enano Hierro Negro tan astuto como violento, Furiahonda fue capturado y llevado a Ventormenta tras liderar una operación que inutilizó infraestructura vital en el norte. Se encuentra encerrado en lo más profundo de las celdas de la prisión, aislado de sus congéneres bajo la Montaña Roca Negra, pero tan hostil hacia la Alianza como cualquier amotinado que comparte los pasillos.

ang.faction:Alliance: While most eyes in Stormwind are focused on the Defias uprising, Deepfury is a reminder of the broader Dark Iron menace threatening the northern frontiers of the Alliance.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves of Ironforge, Kam Deepfury is a bitter enemy whose sabotage severed the Thandol Span and murdered the kin of Longbraid the Grim. Avenging that loss is a point of personal honor.

faq.a: Kam Deepfury is an elite Dark Iron dwarf prisoner locked inside the Stormwind Stockade. He is known for orchestrating the sabotage of the Thandol Span in the north and has no ties to the Defias rebels imprisoned alongside him.
al: who is the dwarf in stockades
faq.q: Who is Kam Deepfury?

faq.a: Deepfury was captured after coordinating an attack that blew up one of the bridges at the Thandol Span, killing dwarven defenders and cutting off a vital land crossing between the Wetlands and Arathi. He was sent to Stormwind's high-security prison to await justice.
faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf locked in the Stormwind Stockade?

faq.a: No. Although he is imprisoned alongside the Defias Brotherhood during their uprising inside the Stockade, Deepfury belongs to the hostile Dark Iron clan. He acts entirely on his own clan's aggressive agenda against the Alliance and Ironforge.
faq.q: Is Kam Deepfury part of the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Motley Garmason and the Ironforge dwarven forces stationed at Dun Modr want him dead. Longbraid the Grim lost a relative in Deepfury's bombing of the Thandol Span, prompting them to send word to adventurers in Stormwind to claim his head.
al: who gave the quest for deepfury
faq.q: Who wants Kam Deepfury dead?

faq.a: Deepfury organized the sabotage at the Thandol Span, the colossal bridge complex connecting the Wetlands with the Arathi Highlands far north of Stormwind.
al: where was the bridge blown up
faq.q: Where did Kam Deepfury commit his crime?

faq.a: Kam Deepfury is held within the cell blocks of the Stormwind Stockade, situated beneath the canal district of Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can Kam Deepfury be found inside the Stockade?

text.s: Kam Deepfury is a notorious Dark Iron saboteur incarcerated within the depths of the Stormwind Stockade. Unlike the majority of the prison's inmates, he has no allegiance to the Defias Brotherhood, having been captured for orchestrating a devastating explosion along the Thandol Span far to the north.

sec.b: While the Stockade is overwhelmingly filled with disgruntled Stonemasons and Defias rebels, Kam Deepfury stands apart. A Dark Iron dwarf of cunning and violence, Deepfury was captured and brought to Stormwind after masterminding an operation that crippled vital northern infrastructure. He is locked deep within the prison's cells, isolated from his kin beneath Blackrock Mountain but just as hostile to the Alliance as any rebel rioter sharing the corridors.

Alliance intelligence stationed at Dun Modr, near the northern border of the Wetlands, identified Deepfury as the chief architect behind the explosion that shattered the Thandol Span. The blast severed one of the massive stone bridges linking the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands. Beyond crippling a critical trade and military route for Ironforge and the Alliance, the sabotage claimed the life of a kin of the dwarf commander Longbraid the Grim.

The Dark Iron insurrectionist did not manage to escape retribution for long, though imprisonment in Stormwind offered him temporary protection from his victims' relatives. Back in the Wetlands, Motley Garmason and the grieving Longbraid the Grim have sought mercenaries willing to infiltrate the riot-torn prison and sever Deepfury's head, settling a bloody grudge sparked hundreds of miles to the north.

npc:lady-anacondra.s: Lady Anacondra. Lady Anacondra es una de las Señoras del Colmillo que lideran a los Druidas del Colmillo en las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Antaño una acólita elfa de la noche llamada Scarletleaf, fue la primera en ofrecerse voluntaria para la ambiciosa empresa de Naralex de sanar Los Baldíos. Cuando la comunión de su maestro con el Sueño Esmeralda se convirtió en una pesadilla, su mente se quebró, retorciendo su devoción en un impulso venenoso por ver Kalimdor invadido por serpientes. Antes de adoptar su título serpentino, Lady Anacondra era conocida como Scarletleaf. Cuando el druida anciano Naralex ideó acceder a los manantiales subterráneos de Los Baldíos a través del Sueño Esmeralda, ella dio un paso al frente como su primerísima voluntaria. Su ferviente lealtad, sin embargo, supuso su perdición. Mientras la mente de Naralex caía presa de oscuras visiones, la pesadilla se filtró desde el reino onírico y contaminó a sus discípulos, destrozando la cordura de Scarletleaf y transformando su devoción en una fría obsesión reptiliana.

ang.class:Druid: Anacondra represents a cautionary tragedy for Cenarion druids: an earnest acolyte whose zeal to heal the land made her vulnerable to the nightmare that twisted her communion into madness.
ang.faction:Horde: The Horde cannot allow Anacondra and the Fanglords to threaten the delicate lifelines of the Barrens, making her removal critical to securing Crossroads and the nearby oases.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing a sister of Kaldorei lineage discard her heritage and form in pursuit of a twisted serpentine dream is a sobering reminder of the perils lurking within the Emerald Dream.

faq.a: She was originally a young night elf acolyte named Scarletleaf. She was the very first disciple to volunteer to accompany the druid Naralex on his mission into the Barrens.
faq.q: Who was Lady Anacondra originally?

faq.a: When Naralex attempted to connect to the Emerald Dream beneath the Barrens, his thoughts were overrun by a nightmare. That same nightmare infected the minds of his acolytes, corrupting Scarletleaf and driving her to cast aside her old life to serve the twisted dream.
al: how did she become a druid of the fang
faq.q: Why did she turn against the Cenarion Circle?

faq.a: She serves as one of the four Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang. She guards the upper reaches of the caverns, ensuring that Naralex remains trapped in his corrupted sleep while dreaming of a reptilian future for the world.
faq.q: What is her role in the Wailing Caverns?

faq.a: Lady Anacondra wanders the first large network of caverns near the entrance of the Wailing Caverns. She patrols among the cavern's raptors and serpents, often shifting between a few resting spots.
faq.q: Where can she be found inside the caverns?

faq.a: She carries the Gem of Anacondra. Slaying her and claiming the gem is required by the druid Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff to break the Fanglords' hold over the Barrens.
faq.q: What item is taken from her for the Cenarion Circle?

faq.a: She draws upon nature magic, striking her foes from afar with searing bolts of lightning and casting magical slumber to incapacitate invaders while her reptilian allies attack.
faq.q: What powers does she wield in battle?

text.s: Lady Anacondra is one of the Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf acolyte named Scarletleaf, she was the first to volunteer for Naralex's ambitious effort to heal the Barrens. When her master's Emerald Dream communion turned into a nightmare, her mind broke, twisting her devotion into a venomous drive to see Kalimdor overrun by serpents.

sec.b: Before adopting her serpentine title, Lady Anacondra was known as Scarletleaf. When the elder druid Naralex conceived of tapping into the subterranean springs of the Barrens through the Emerald Dream, she stepped forward as his very first volunteer. Her eager loyalty, however, proved her undoing. As Naralex's mind was seized by dark visions, the nightmare seeped out from the dreaming realm and contaminated his disciples, shattering Scarletleaf's sanity and reshaping her reverie into a cold, reptilian obsession.

Now styling herself Lady Anacondra, she stands guard among the first subterranean chambers of the Wailing Caverns. Like her fellow Fanglords, she abandoned the traditional tenets of the Cenarion Circle in favor of the vicious aspects of the viper. Channeling lightning, nature magic, and slumbering trances, she enforces Naralex's twisted slumber and works to spread the nightmare's corruption into the arid land above.

npc:lady-sarevess.s: Lady Sarevess. Lady Sarevess es una retorcida hechicera naga que mora en las ruinas inundadas de Cavernas de Brazanegra, donde experimenta con oscuras brujerías. En la Alberca de Ask'ar, Lady Sarevess lleva a cabo sus rituales en una gruta inundada del templo en ruinas. Una taumaturga muy retorcida, experimenta con magia oscura mientras los cultores del Martillo Crepuscular que también rondan el templo sumergido continúan con su propio culto en lo más profundo de la caverna.

ang.class:Mage: Sarevess demonstrates how highborne magical practices degenerated into raw, chaotic lightning and tidal sorcery under centuries of oceanic corruption.
ang.race:NightElf: The ruins Lady Sarevess inhabits were once a sacred temple of Elune. Seeing her twisted naga kin defile the waters of Ask'ar is a bitter reminder of the Sundering.

faq.a: Lady Sarevess is a naga spellcaster who has taken up residence within the subterranean Pool of Ask'ar inside Blackfathom Deeps. She is a very twisted spellcaster who dabbles in dark magic.
faq.q: Who is Lady Sarevess?

faq.a: She makes her lair in the Pool of Ask'ar, a flooded chamber situated in the early reaches of the Blackfathom Deeps temple complex along the Ashenvale coast.
faq.q: Where can Lady Sarevess be found?

faq.a: Drawing upon the traditions of naga sea witches, Sarevess wields powerful water and elemental magic, particularly violent bursts of forked lightning, to strike down anyone who enters her cove.
faq.q: What powers does Lady Sarevess command?

text.s: Lady Sarevess is a twisted naga sorceress dwelling within the flooded ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, where she dabbles in dark sorceries.

sec.b: Within the Pool of Ask'ar, Lady Sarevess conducts her rituals in a flooded grotto of the ruined temple. A very twisted spellcaster, she dabbles in dark magic while the Twilight's Hammer cultists who also haunt the sunken temple pursue their own worship deeper in the cavern.

Much like a sea witch of the deep oceans, Sarevess commands elemental currents and crackling arcs of lightning. Surrounded by loyal naga sentinels and summoned water elementals, she fiercely defends her sanctuary against any intruders who threaten her dark work.

npc:laurna-morninglight.s: Laurna Luzdelalba. Laurna Luzdelalba es una instructora de sacerdotes elfa de la noche que reside en el tranquilo asentamiento de Dolanaar, en Teldrassil. Devota de las Hermanas de Elune, guía a los acólitos en ciernes procedentes de Cañada Umbría en los ritos espirituales y las gracias sanadoras de la Diosa de la Luna. Sus enseñanzas preparan a los jóvenes sacerdotes elfos de la noche para las crecientes amenazas que acechan las ramas del Árbol del Mundo. Situada entre las ramas de Dolanaar, Laurna Luzdelalba ejerce como una de las principales mentoras de los jóvenes sacerdotes que han completado sus ritos iniciales en Cañada Umbría. A medida que los nuevos iniciados se adentran en las extensiones más amplias de Teldrassil, les enseña a profundizar en su comunión con Elune, equilibrando la luz sanadora con los ritos defensivos necesarios para sobrevivir en una naturaleza cada vez más hostil.

ang.class:Priest: For night elf priests arriving from Shadowglen, Laurna Morninglight is your first major mentor outside the starting vale, teaching foundational spells and guiding your early devotion to Elune.
ang.race:NightElf: Laurna embodies the traditional kaldorei devotion to the Moon Goddess, reminding adventurers that priestcraft in Teldrassil draws from Elune rather than the Holy Light.

faq.a: Laurna Morninglight is stationed in the village of Dolanaar, located in the central reaches of Teldrassil just down the road from Shadowglen.
faq.q: Where can I find Laurna Morninglight?

faq.a: She is a priest trainer for night elf characters. She teaches new spells, refines ranks of known abilities, and provides early guidance through class-specific rites.
faq.q: What does Laurna Morninglight do?

faq.a: She initiates class quests for fledgling priests, directing them to aid wounded allies and seek Elune's divine favor through ceremonial vestments and prayers.
faq.q: What kind of quests does she offer?

faq.a: While she is culturally rooted in the Sisterhood of Elune, priest trainers in the Alliance will instruct any allied priest who comes seeking spiritual discipline.
faq.q: Does she train other races?

faq.a: Yes, as a kaldorei priestess, her vows and magic are dedicated entirely to the Goddess Elune and the broader traditions overseen by the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
faq.q: Is she affiliated with the Temple of the Moon?

faq.a: No relatives of Laurna are known among the kaldorei of Teldrassil.
faq.q: Does she share a family name with other night elves?

text.s: Laurna Morninglight is a night elf priest trainer residing in the tranquil settlement of Dolanaar within Teldrassil. Devoted to the Sisterhood of Elune, she guides budding acolytes emerging from Shadowglen in the spiritual rites and healing graces of the Moon Goddess. Her teachings prepare young night elf priests for the growing threats encroaching on the boughs of the World Tree.

sec.b: Situated amidst the boughs of Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight serves as one of the primary mentors for young priests who have completed their initial rites in Shadowglen. As new initiates step out into the broader reaches of Teldrassil, she instructs them on expanding their communion with Elune, balancing the light of healing with defensive rites necessary to survive an increasingly hostile wild.

Priestcraft among the kaldorei is deeply intertwined with the worship of Elune rather than the abstract Holy Light revered by humans and dwarves. Laurna tasks her students with spiritual labors such as receiving sacred robes and healing a wounded Sentinel. Through these traditions, acolytes learn that their powers are direct gifts of the Mother Moon, meant to preserve and mend the kaldorei people.

npc:lieutenant-farren-orinelle.s: Teniente Farren Orinelle. El Teniente Farren Orinelle es un oficial del ejército de Ventormenta actualmente destinado en la posada de Costasur, en las Laderas de Trabalomas. Profundamente descontento con su puesto fronterizo, pasa la mayor parte del tiempo bebiendo mientras subcontrata sus obligaciones a los viajeros que pasan por allí. Su principal asignación militar es ocuparse de los múrlocs que invaden la costa, una tarea que delega con entusiasmo con la esperanza de conseguir un traslado de vuelta al sur. El Teniente Farren Orinelle no eligió Costasur. Enviado lejos de Ciudad de Ventormenta, el teniente considera que las costas húmedas y disputadas de Trabalomas son un descenso deplorable respecto a las comodidades civilizadas de la capital. En lugar de patrullar los campos o coordinar las defensas con su oficial al mando, el Alguacil Rutagrana, Orinelle prácticamente ha fijado su residencia permanente en el interior de la posada de Costasur. Pasa los días enfurruñado, bebiendo y soñando con una orden oficial de traslado que lo devuelva al sur.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions, Orinelle represents the disgruntled Southern troops holding a lonely Northern outpost, willing to offer coin and commendation to anyone handling his duties.
ang.race:Human: As a Stormwind soldier stuck far from Elwynn Forest, Orinelle's disdain for northern frontier duty highlights the rift between comfortable capital life and harsh overseas deployments.

faq.a: He is an officer of the Stormwind military stationed in Southshore, a town in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He can be found drinking inside the Southshore inn, grumbling about his posting.
faq.q: Who is Lieutenant Farren Orinelle?

faq.a: He was transferred north from Stormwind City to bolster the local garrison and support Marshal Redpath. He thoroughly dislikes the assignment and longs to return home.
faq.q: Why is he in Southshore?

faq.a: Marshal Redpath ordered him to deal with the hostile murlocs infesting the Hillsbrad coast, though Orinelle prefers paying traveling mercenaries to do the fighting for him.
faq.q: What is his official assignment?

faq.a: No. Orinelle spends almost all of his time lingering by the inn's bar, reluctant to brave the muddy beaches or hostile elements outside.
faq.q: Does he ever leave the Southshore inn?

faq.a: He wants nothing more than to secure an official reassignment back to Stormwind City, away from the dangers and bleakness of Lordaeron's coast.
faq.q: What is Farren's ultimate goal?

faq.a: He reports to Marshal Redpath, who commands the Alliance military detachment defending Southshore.
faq.q: Who is Orinelle's commander?

text.s: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is an officer of the Stormwind army currently stationed at the Southshore inn in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Deeply unhappy with his frontier posting, he spends most of his time drinking while outsourcing his duties to passing travelers. His primary military assignment is dealing with the encroaching murlocs along the coast, a chore he eagerly delegates in hopes of securing a transfer back south.

sec.b: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle did not choose Southshore. Dispatched far from Stormwind City, the lieutenant finds the damp, contested shores of Hillsbrad a miserable step down from the civilized comforts of the capital. Instead of patrolling the fields or coordinating defenses with his commanding officer, Marshal Redpath, Orinelle has practically taken up permanent residence inside Southshore's inn. His days are spent sulking, drinking, and dreaming of an official transfer order that will return him to the south.

Despite his comfortable seat at the tavern, Orinelle still answers to Marshal Redpath, who tasked the lieutenant with clearing out the murlocs swarming the nearby shoreline. Unwilling to soil his boots in coastal mud, Orinelle relies on wandering adventurers to cull the creatures and gather proof of their demise. He hopes that presenting tangible results back to his superiors will show his duty is accomplished, hastening his eventual recall to Stormwind.

npc:lord-cobrahn.s: Lord Cobrahn. Lord Cobrahn, anteriormente el druida elfo de la noche Jarlaxla, es uno de los corruptos Druidas del Colmillo que acechan en las profundidades de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Antaño célebre en el Círculo Cenarion por su maestría con el cambio de forma, sucumbió a la pesadilla que infecta los manantiales de la caverna. Tras rebautizarse con el nombre de su nueva y letal apariencia, Cobrahn comanda ahora camadas de serpientes descarriadas y defiende el retorcido laberinto. Antes de adoptar el sobrenombre de Lord Cobrahn, Jarlaxla era un respetado miembro del Círculo Cenarion, elogiado entre sus compañeros druidas por su extraordinaria habilidad para canalizar formas animales. Cuando Naralex se adentró en las Cuevas de los Lamentos bajo Los Baldíos con la esperanza de aprovechar sus manantiales subterráneos y devolver una vida exuberante a los páramos áridos, Jarlaxla lo acompañó. Sin embargo, cuando la comunión de Naralex con el Sueño Esmeralda degeneró en una pesadilla retorcida, la mente de Jarlaxla se quebró junto a la de sus hermanos.

ang.class:Druid: Cobrahn serves as a grim warning of how druidic shapeshifting can be perverted when connected to the nightmare rather than natural balance.
ang.faction:Horde: Horde adventurers seek Cobrahn to end the foul corruption leaking into the Barrens and protect the fragile ecosystem of Kalimdor's plains.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, Cobrahn's fall is a bitter tragedy, seeing a skilled brother of the Cenarion Circle abandon his heritage to lead monsters in the subterranean depths.

faq.a: Lord Cobrahn was originally named Jarlaxla. He was a prominent night elf druid within the Cenarion Circle, widely respected for his rare talent and deep affinity for animal shapeshifting forms.
faq.q: Who was Lord Cobrahn before he turned evil?

faq.a: Upon falling victim to the nightmare in the Wailing Caverns, Jarlaxla perfected a lethal serpentine shapeshifting form. He discarded his former name and took the title Lord Cobrahn to reflect his dangerous new power and mastery over serpents.
faq.q: Why is he called Lord Cobrahn?

faq.a: Lord Cobrahn resides deep within the Wailing Caverns, a twisting underground network located in the central Barrens, surrounded by deviate pythons and other nightmare-corrupted beasts.
faq.q: Where can Lord Cobrahn be found?

faq.a: He is one of the primary Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang. He carries the Gem of Cobrahn, which the druid Nara Wildmane of Thunder Bluff seeks in order to break the Fang leaders' hold over the Barrens.
faq.q: Why do adventurers need to defeat him?

faq.a: Unlike ordinary night elves, Cobrahn is noticeably larger in stature, wields a sharp claw on his right hand, and can transform completely into an oversized, venomous snake during combat.
faq.q: What unique physical traits does he possess?

faq.a: Cobrahn is one of the four key Fanglords alongside Lady Anacondra and their kin. They are former Cenarion Circle druids who entered the caverns with Naralex and jointly fell to the twisting corruption of the nightmare.
faq.q: What is his connection to the other Druids of the Fang?

text.s: Lord Cobrahn, formerly the night elf druid Jarlaxla, is one of the corrupted Druids of the Fang lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once renowned within the Cenarion Circle for his mastery of shapeshifting, he succumbed to the nightmare infecting the cavern springs. Renaming himself after his new lethal guise, Cobrahn now commands broods of deviate serpents and defends the twisted labyrinth.

sec.b: Before adopting the moniker Lord Cobrahn, Jarlaxla was a respected member of the Cenarion Circle, celebrated among his fellow druids for his extraordinary skill in channeling animal forms. When Naralex ventured into the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens hoping to tap their underground springs and restore lush life to the arid wastes, Jarlaxla accompanied him. However, when Naralex's Emerald Dream communion decayed into a twisting nightmare, Jarlaxla's mind shattered alongside his brothers.

Rather than channeling the traditional totemic beasts of Cenarion tradition, the nightmare warped Jarlaxla's shapeshifting prowess into something predatory and reptilian. Adopting the name Lord Cobrahn, he developed a deadly serpentine form that he unleashes in battle. Flanked by venomous deviate pythons and bearing a vicious clawed right hand, he oversees his section of the grottos, violently purging anyone seeking to break the nightmare's hold on the caverns.

npc:lord-ello-ebonlocke.s: Lord Ello Cerranegro. Lord Ello Cerranegro es el alcalde de Villa Oscura y el líder de su consejo de gobierno, apostado en el ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura. Rodeado por la oscuridad y horrores acechantes, lucha a diario por mantener el orden y proteger a sus asediados ciudadanos a pesar de recibir escasa ayuda de Ventormenta. Sentado en la penumbra del ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura, Lord Ello Cerranegro carga con el pesado fardo de gobernar un asentamiento al borde de la ruina. Antaño parte del próspero remanso rural conocido como Grand Hamlet, Villa Oscura se encuentra ahora asfixiada por una sombra perpetua y asediada por necrófagos voraces, abominaciones esqueléticas y bestias salvajes. Ello preside el Consejo de Villa Oscura, esforzándose contra viento y marea por mantener en funcionamiento los vestigios de la civilización mientras Ventormenta hace la vista gorda ante su difícil situación.

ang.faction:Alliance: Lord Ebonlocke represents the forgotten edges of the Alliance, where isolated mayors must lead their people through nightmare conditions without imperial aid.
ang.race:Human: For humans traveling from Stormwind, speaking with Lord Ebonlocke is a sobering reminder of how far the southern provinces have fallen into ruin and abandonment.

faq.a: Lord Ello Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire and head of the Council of Darkshire. From his seat in the town hall, he oversees the defense, civic affairs, and survival of Duskwood's remaining human populace.
faq.q: Who is Lord Ello Ebonlocke?

faq.a: Commander Althea Ebonlocke, the stalwart leader of the Night Watch, is Lord Ello's close kin. While he governs the civic and diplomatic affairs of Darkshire, she directs the militia that actively guards the settlement.
faq.q: How is he related to Commander Althea Ebonlocke?

faq.a: When Magistrate Solomon requests aid against the Blackrock orcs in Redridge, Lord Ebonlocke is forced to refuse. Darkshire is so hard-pressed by undead and monstrosities that stripping the town of guards would cause it to be completely overrun before the militia even reached the forest border.
faq.q: Why does Lord Ebonlocke refuse to send troops to Lakeshire?

faq.a: He is located inside the Darkshire Town Hall, which stands at the center of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood.
faq.q: Where can Lord Ello Ebonlocke be found?

faq.a: Stormwind is embroiled in internal political strife following King Varian Wrynn's disappearance. With the kingdom's resources constrained, the House of Nobles has largely abandoned the southern regions, forcing local leaders like Lord Ebonlocke to organize their own defenses.
faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send troops to help Lord Ebonlocke?

faq.a: Lord Ebonlocke assists in handling communications with the hermit Abercrombie, helping arrange translations of strange notes.
faq.q: What is Lord Ebonlocke's involvement with Abercrombie?

text.s: Lord Ello Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire and the leader of its governing council, stationed inside the Darkshire Town Hall. Surrounded by darkness and creeping horrors, he struggles daily to maintain order and protect his besieged citizens despite receiving little aid from Stormwind.

sec.b: Seated in the gloom of the Darkshire Town Hall, Lord Ello Ebonlocke bears the heavy burden of governing a settlement on the brink of ruin. Once part of the prosperous rural haven known as Grand Hamlet, Darkshire is now smothered by perpetual shadow and besieged by ravenous ghouls, skeletal abominations, and feral beasts. Ello presides over the Council of Darkshire, striving against impossible odds to keep the remnants of civilization functioning while Stormwind turns a blind eye to their plight.

Because Stormwind's garrison refuses to spare soldiers for the borderlands, Darkshire relies almost entirely on local volunteer militias like the Night Watch, commanded by his relative, Althea Ebonlocke. When neighboring leaders like Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire plead for reinforcements to combat Blackrock orcs, Lord Ebonlocke must make agonizing choices. As he solemnly explains to messengers from Redridge, Darkshire cannot spare a single blade: sending their guards beyond the forest's edge would leave their own homes to be instantly overrun by the surrounding evils.

Beyond patrolling the roads, Lord Ebonlocke frequently relies on wandering adventurers to handle peculiar matters around the woods. In his earnest desire to assist all residents of Duskwood, he coordinates communications with solitary figures like the hermit Abercrombie. Regrettably, Ebonlocke's lack of true insight into the hermit's cryptic writings blinds him to the grisly, stitched nightmare festering just beyond the town borders until it is nearly too late.

npc:lord-pythas.s: Lord Pythas. Lord Pythas, antaño un guerrero elfo de la noche llamado Aryn, es uno de los cuatro líderes corruptos de los Druidas del Colmillo en las Cuevas de los Lamentos. En su origen amigo de la infancia y protector jurado del archidruida Naralex, cayó víctima de la pesadilla que contamina el oasis subterráneo. Ahora blande tanto poder marcial como una retorcida magia de serpiente contra cualquiera que intente llegar hasta su aletargado maestro. Antes de adoptar el sobrenombre de Pythas, este elfo de la noche era conocido como Aryn. Un curtido guerrero y leal compañero de infancia de Naralex, sirvió como guardia personal del archidruida cuando la expedición se adentró en los secarrales de Los Baldíos. Deseoso de servir mejor al ambicioso sueño de Naralex de restaurar la frondosa vida en el árido reino, Aryn comenzó a estudiar el druidismo y demostró un aprendizaje excepcionalmente rápido. Sin embargo, la disciplina física y el valor marcial no ofrecieron protección alguna contra la insidiosa corrupción que aguardaba en lo profundo de las fisuras subterráneas.

ang.class:Druid: Pythas represents the tragic fate of a promising acolyte who embraced nature magic out of devotion, only to have the Emerald Dream's corruption twist his teachings into a viperous heresy.
ang.class:Warrior: Before he was corrupted into a serpent cultist, Pythas was a disciplined night elf warrior and personal protector—a grim reminder that martial prowess alone cannot stave off mental madness.
ang.race:NightElf: Watching a respected protector like Aryn fall to dark madness is a bitter sorrow for any night elf seeking to restore balance to the scarred soils of Kalimdor.

faq.a: Lord Pythas was originally a night elf warrior named Aryn. He was a childhood friend and personal bodyguard to Archdruid Naralex who studied druidism to assist his master's work in the Barrens.
faq.q: Who is Lord Pythas?

faq.a: Pythas did not betray Naralex willingly. When Naralex attempted to tap into the Emerald Dream to heal the Barrens, a nightmare seized the archdruid's thoughts. The corrupting dream seeped into the minds of his acolytes, stripping away Aryn's sanity and remaking him into a serpent lord.
al: why did he become druid of the fang
faq.q: Why did he turn against Naralex?

faq.a: Unlike the other leaders who rely purely on nature magic and beast forms, Pythas was a seasoned warrior before training as a druid. He combines martial combat skill with druidic magic, making him one of the most physically formidable defenders in the caverns.
faq.q: What makes Pythas different from the other Fang leaders?

faq.a: Pythas carries one of the four enchanted gems needed to complete the quest Leaders of the Fang. The quest is given by the druid Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff, who requires the gems of all four Fang leaders to free the Barrens from their twisted dreams.
faq.q: Why do adventurers need to defeat him?

faq.a: Lord Pythas lurks within the deep interior chambers of the Wailing Caverns, surrounded by corrupted beasts and fellow Fang cultists.
faq.q: Where can Lord Pythas be found?

faq.a: Upon his defeat, the Gem of Pythas is recovered from his remains. Adventurers bring it, along with the gems of the other three serpent lords, to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff to prove the leadership of the Fang has been broken.
faq.q: What happens to his gem?

text.s: Lord Pythas, once a night elf warrior named Aryn, is one of the four corrupted leaders of the Druids of the Fang in the Wailing Caverns. Originally a childhood friend and sworn protector of the archdruid Naralex, he fell victim to the nightmare tainting the oasis underground. Now he wields both martial might and twisted serpent magic against any who try to reach his slumbering master.

sec.b: Before adopting the moniker Pythas, this night elf was known as Aryn. A seasoned warrior and trusted childhood companion to Naralex, he served as the archdruid's personal guard when the expedition ventured into the dry wastes of the Barrens. Eager to better serve Naralex's ambitious dream of restoring lush life to the arid realm, Aryn took up the study of druidism, proving to be an exceptionally fast learner. However, physical discipline and martial valor offered no shelter against the insidious corruption waiting deep within the subterranean fissures.

When Naralex's connection to the Emerald Dream was hijacked by dark nightmares, Aryn's mind succumbed alongside those of his fellow acolytes. Shedding his former name and loyalty, he became Lord Pythas, leader among the Druids of the Fang. Where his fellow serpent lords favor cunning spellcasting or beast forms, Pythas seamlessly blends lethal combat prowess with nature magic. He now prowls the winding tunnels of the caverns, determined to defend the nightmare's twisted grip on the cavern spring.

npc:lord-serpentis.s: Lord Serpentis. Lord Serpentis es un druida elfo de la noche corrupto que se erige como uno de los cuatro líderes de los renegados Druidas del Colmillo dentro de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Antaño un druida de gran poder y prestigio en la orden de Naralex, cayó en la locura cuando el sueño de Naralex se convirtió en una pesadilla dentro de los manantiales subterráneos. Ahora, ayuda a liderar la secta que rinde culto a las serpientes en las profundidades de las cavernas, donde el corrupto Naralex yace aletargado. Antes de que la oscuridad se apoderara de los manantiales de la caverna, Serpentis era un druida de gran poder y prestigio, miembro de la noble orden liderada por Naralex que esperaba utilizar los manantiales de las cavernas y el Sueño Esmeralda para sanar Los Baldíos. Sin embargo, cuando la visión de Naralex se convirtió en una pesadilla corruptora, Serpentis estuvo entre los druidas cuyas mentes sucumbieron a la locura emergente.

ang.class:Druid: Serpentis represents the tragic danger lurking within the Emerald Dream, showcasing how even a druid of great power can be twisted when a noble vision becomes a nightmare.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, Serpentis and his followers are a painful disgrace—kaldorei scholars of great renown who threw away their sacred duty to nature to become monstrous serpent lords.
ang.race:Tauren: Tauren see the corruption of Serpentis as a foul desecration of the Earth Mother's balance, threatening the fragile ecosystem of the Barrens with unnatural madness.

faq.a: Lord Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang, located deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf druid of great power and prestige in Naralex's order, he was corrupted by Naralex's nightmare along with his fellow druids.
faq.q: Who is Lord Serpentis?

faq.a: When Naralex's attempt to heal the Barrens through the Emerald Dream turned into a nightmare, its corruption spread to the druids who followed him, turning Serpentis's mind toward madness and serpent worship.
faq.q: Why did Serpentis turn evil?

faq.a: Serpentis was once one of the noble druids who followed Naralex into the caverns. Rather than aiding in his master's recovery, he became a leader of the Druids of the Fang, who now seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams.
faq.q: What is his relationship to Naralex?

faq.a: Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang. Eliminating him is essential to break the sect's grip on the Wailing Caverns, secure his gem for the quest Leaders of the Fang, and clear a path toward awakening Naralex.
faq.q: Why do players need to kill him?

faq.a: They are a renegade faction of night elf druids who followed Naralex into the Wailing Caverns. Corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare, they abandoned traditional druidic forms to adopt the aspects, venoms, and behaviors of serpents under the command of Serpentis and their other fanglords.
al: what are druids of the fang
faq.q: Who are the Druids of the Fang?

text.s: Lord Serpentis is a corrupted night elf druid who stands as one of the four leaders of the rogue Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once a druid of great power and prestige in the order of Naralex, he was twisted into madness when Naralex's dream became a nightmare within the subterranean springs. Now, he helps command the serpent-worshipping sect deep in the caverns where the corrupted Naralex lies slumbering.

sec.b: Before darkness overtook the cavern springs, Serpentis was a druid of great power and prestige, one of the noble order led by Naralex that hoped to use the caverns' springs and the Emerald Dream to heal the Barrens. However, when Naralex's vision became a corrupting nightmare, Serpentis was among the druids whose minds fell to the emerging madness.
sec.t: From Noble Druid to Serpent Lord

sec.b: Succumbing completely to the corruption radiating from Naralex's twisted dreams, Serpentis and his fellow druids became the Druids of the Fang. Forsaking traditional Cenarion balance and the totem animals of old, they now seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams rather than heal it. Serpentis rules the sect as one of its four leaders, alongside Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn and Lord Pythas.

Perched deep inside the winding caverns, Lord Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the rogue sect, each of whom carries a dream gem. Those seeking to wake the trapped master or reclaim the waters of the Oasis must strike down Serpentis and claim the gem he carries, breaking the serpent's hold over the labyrinth.

npc:madame-eva.s: Lady Eva. Lady Eva es una venerada adivina y matriarca que vive en Villa Oscura, en el sombrío Bosque del Ocaso. Practicante de antiguas artes místicas de adivinación y cartomancia, a menudo es la primera lugareña en percibir perturbaciones antinaturales por todo el bosque. Los viajeros acuden con frecuencia a ella para desentrañar lúgubres misterios o conseguir talismanes ocultos contra la oscuridad que acecha. Lady Eva, que vive discretamente entre las sombras de Villa Oscura, practica la cartomancia y antiguos rituales populares que muchos en la catedral de Ventormenta verían con recelo. En una región olvidada y asolada por bestias salvajes, no-muertos y horrores aún más oscuros, sus inquietantes visiones son toleradas y buscadas tanto por los desesperados lugareños como por los aventureros de paso.

ang.class:Priest: While the Holy Light brings solace to the living, priests will find Eva's reliance on cartomancy and spirit remnants a curious, earthen counterpoint to traditional church liturgy.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions stepping into the oppressive shadow of Duskwood, Madame Eva is an indispensable guide whose premonitions cut through the woods' deadly confusion.
ang.profession:Tailoring: Tailors will appreciate Eva's knowledge of bizarre weaving materials, specifically her ability to work spectral thread plucked directly from the ghosts of the region.

faq.a: Madame Eva is an elderly human fortune-teller and diviner residing in Darkshire. She practices cartomancy and ancient folk crafts to glimpse the unseen perils stalking Duskwood.
faq.q: Who is Madame Eva?

faq.a: Madame Eva reads the cards and senses an imminent, supernatural danger encircling her granddaughter Alyssa. Her readings guide adventurers to investigate forgotten documents and trails that uncover the grim history of Stalvan Mistmantle.
al: why does eva care about stalvan
faq.q: What is Madame Eva's role in the mystery of Stalvan?

faq.a: Eva is primarily a seer and practitioner of older mystic arts, such as cartomancy, spirit-thread weaving, and folk effigies. Her magic is more akin to traditional fortune-telling and occult lore than the structured arcanum of Dalaran or the Holy Light.
faq.q: Is Madame Eva a witch or a mage?

faq.a: She is the grandmother of Alyssa Eva and Lohgan Eva. The town's Night Watch also includes Watcher Eva, who is believed to share ties with her family.
faq.q: Who is related to Madame Eva in Darkshire?

faq.a: Madame Eva gathers ethereal strands of ghost hair thread from restless spirits to weave specially prepared ritual garments and provide supplies needed by allies across the realm.
faq.q: What is Ghost Hair Thread used for?

faq.a: Madame Eva crafts the Totem of Infliction as a dark, sympathetic effigy. By binding specific creature materials to it, the totem directs curses and harm back onto the fell beasts terrorizing the woods.
faq.q: Why does Madame Eva craft the Totem of Infliction?

text.s: Madame Eva is a revered fortune-teller and matriarch living in Darkshire in the shadowed forest of Duskwood. Practicing older, mystic arts of divination and cartomancy, she often serves as the first townsperson to sense unnatural disturbances across the woods. Travelers frequently seek her out to unravel grim mysteries or procure occult charms against the creeping dark.

sec.b: Dwelling quietly amidst the gloom of Darkshire, Madame Eva practices cartomancy and ancient folk rituals that many in Stormwind's cathedral would view with suspicion. In a forsaken region plagued by feral beasts, the undead, and darker horrors, her eerie insights are tolerated and sought after by desperate townspeople and visiting adventurers alike.

Beyond her role as an occult reader, Madame Eva is deeply devoted to her family, serving as grandmother to Alyssa Eva and young Lohgan. When her cartomancy reveals dark omens threatening her granddaughter, Eva does not hesitate to enlist the aid of passing wanderers to scour the woods, uncovering long-buried tragedies before history can repeat itself.

Eva's knowledge extends beyond card reading to ritual crafting and warding. From weaving supernatural garments using spectral thread to crafting bizarre folk relics like the Totem of Infliction, she understands the strange, twilight logic that governs Duskwood's restless spirits better than almost anyone else in town.

npc:magatha-grimtotem.s: Magatha Tótem Siniestro. Magatha Tótem Siniestro es la matriarca de la tribu Tótem Siniestro y la vieja bruja de Cima del Trueno. Una formidable chamana e intrigante política, reside en el Alto de los Ancestros mientras desafía continuamente la visión de Cairne Pezuña de Sangre para la nación tauren. Magatha ascendió a la autoridad absoluta sobre los Tótem Siniestro a través de una unión concertada seguida del repentino y mortal accidente de escalada de su pareja. Operando desde el Alto de los Ancestros con su séquito personal y guardaespaldas, se erige como la líder política y espiritual indiscutible de su aislada tribu. A diferencia de Cairne Pezuña de Sangre, Magatha predica la dominación tauren, considerando a las otras razas mortales como intrusas en Kalimdor que deberían ser erradicadas o apartadas.

ang.class:Shaman: Magatha is undeniably one of the most powerful shamans on Kalimdor, commanding primal elements with an authority few living tauren can rival.
ang.faction:Horde: While Magatha offers valuable aid and council against regional threats, her fierce clan loyalty and open contempt for other races make her an untrustworthy comrade.
ang.race:Tauren: Every tauren knows of the Grimtotem's dark reputation, making Magatha's presence on Elder Rise an uneasy reminder of the ideological divide threatening their united tribes.
ang.race:Undead: Forsaken travelers find a surprisingly warm reception from the Elder Crone, who actively consults the Royal Apothecary Society in the Pools of Vision.

faq.a: Magatha is the elder crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe. A gifted shaman since childhood, she assumed total rule of her clan after her mate died in a climbing accident. She resides on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where she serves as Cairne Bloodhoof's primary political rival.
faq.q: Who is Magatha Grimtotem?

faq.a: Ostensibly, Magatha believes tauren traditions and shamanic understanding can guide the Forsaken back toward humanity. However, many suspect her friendship with the Royal Apothecary Society is driven by a desire for esoteric alchemical secrets and political allies outside Cairne's loyal inner circle.
faq.q: Why does Magatha support the Forsaken?

faq.a: Magatha views Cairne as soft, naive, and unfit to lead the united tauren. While Cairne advocates coexistence within the Horde and peace across Kalimdor, Magatha believes the Grimtotem should reclaim ancestral lands by force and eliminate foreign intruders.
faq.q: What is Magatha's relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof?

faq.a: Magatha sent an emissary named Maur into Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar to negotiate with the resident troggs. The troggs killed Maur instead, prompting Magatha to send Horde adventurers into the cavern to retrieve Maur's satchel and butcher the troggs in retribution.
faq.q: What was the mission in Ragefire Chasm?

faq.a: Arikara is a vengeful wind serpent spirit said to seek retribution against the tauren people. Magatha claims Arikara seeks vengeance directly against Cairne Bloodhoof and tasks capable champions with using enchanted agave to summon and slay the beast.
faq.q: Who is Arikara?

faq.a: Magatha resides inside the large main tent atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, attended by her servant Rahauro and two stoic Grimtotem guards.
faq.q: Where can Magatha Grimtotem be found?

text.s: Magatha Grimtotem is the matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe and the Elder Crone of Thunder Bluff. A formidable shaman and political schemer, she resides on Elder Rise while continually challenging Cairne Bloodhoof's vision for the tauren nation.

sec.b: Magatha rose to absolute authority over the Grimtotem through an arranged union followed by the sudden, fatal climbing accident of her mate. Operating from Elder Rise with her personal retinue and bodyguards, she stands as the undisputed political and spiritual leader of her reclusive tribe. Unlike Cairne Bloodhoof, Magatha preaches tauren dominance, viewing other mortal races as intruders upon Kalimdor who ought to be eradicated or swept aside.

Despite her open disdain for non-tauren, Magatha was among the earliest advocates for admitting the Forsaken into the Horde. She claims the tauren can teach the undead spiritual balance and guide them toward reclaiming their humanity. In practice, however, Magatha collaborates directly with the Royal Apothecary Society beneath Thunder Bluff, consulting figures like Apothecary Zamah on practical alchemy and arcane relic studies.

Behind a facade of wise counsel, Magatha actively works to weaken Cairne's authority while testing the defenses of potential threats. She dispatches adventurers into deep hazards—from probing trogg forces in Ragefire Chasm to hunting down the vengeful spirit Arikara. Every task she assigns serves to either consolidate Grimtotem leverage or prepare for the day she can supplant the Bloodhoof dynasty entirely.

npc:maggran-earthbinder.s: Ligaterra Maggran. Ligaterra Maggran es un veterano tauren entrado en años al que el gran jefe Cairne Pezuña de Sangre designó para liderar el campamento de la Horda en el Refugio Roca del Sol. Curtido por una vida entera de brutales conflictos, supervisa la defensa de los escarpados valles de Sierra Espolón frente a bestias voraces y agresivas parvadas de arpías. Aunque fatigado por incontables batallas, sigue siendo un guardián inquebrantable del asentamiento. Ligaterra Maggran fue enviado a Sierra Espolón por el mismísimo gran jefe Cairne Pezuña de Sangre. Como veterano de incontables escaramuzas y sangrientas campañas, Maggran admite que la edad y la violencia han endurecido su corazón, despojándolo de la apacibilidad natural característica de su pueblo. El Refugio Roca del Sol debía ser tanto un puesto avanzado bajo su firme mando como un lugar de sosiego, donde los vientos cálidos y el sol de la montaña pudieran aliviar su espíritu desgastado por la guerra.

ang.faction:Horde: For travelers navigating the steep climbs of Stonetalon, Maggran is the primary authority coordinating local Horde patrols and keeping supply routes clear of beasts and harpies.
ang.race:Tauren: Maggran embodies the heavy toll warfare takes on the shu'halo spirit, serving as a reminder of how conflict can harden even the most grounded children of the Earth Mother.

faq.a: Maggran Earthbinder is the commanding tauren elder at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Hardened by countless battles, he was stationed here by Cairne Bloodhoof to watch over the settlement and keep its supply roads and borders secure.
faq.q: Who is Maggran Earthbinder?

faq.a: Cairne Bloodhoof appointed him to lead Sun Rock Retreat partly for his seasoned military leadership and partly as a retreat. Maggran's body and soul have been heavily worn by a lifetime of combat, and the quiet mountain sun offers him a measure of healing.
faq.q: Why was Maggran sent to Sun Rock Retreat?

faq.a: Maggran directs defense efforts against the savage Bloodfury harpies infesting the mountains and sends warriors to eliminate the giant spider matriarch Besseleth, a terrifying predator he narrowly escaped earlier in his travels.
faq.q: What threats does Maggran ask adventurers to deal with?

faq.a: Maggran was previously bitten by the colossal spider Besseleth. Though he managed to fend her off and escape with his life, he sends capable adventurers to slay the beast so no one else falls victim to her web.
faq.q: What happened between Maggran and Besseleth?

faq.a: Maggran serves directly at the behest of Thunder Bluff's High Chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof. While stationed out in the field at Sun Rock Retreat, his authority and orders stem straight from the capital.
faq.q: Does Maggran have a role in Thunder Bluff?

faq.a: No. Maggran is a staunch leader of the Horde and remains fully hostile to any Alliance adventurers who stumble into Sun Rock Retreat.
faq.q: Is Maggran Earthbinder friendly to Alliance players?

text.s: Maggran Earthbinder is a grizzled tauren veteran appointed by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to lead the Horde encampment at Sun Rock Retreat. Hardened by a lifetime of brutal conflict, he oversees the defense of the craggy valleys of Stonetalon against ravenous beasts and aggressive harpy covens. Though wearied by countless battles, he remains a steadfast guardian of the settlement.

sec.b: Maggran Earthbinder was sent into the Stonetalon Mountains by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof himself. A veteran of countless skirmishes and bloody campaigns, Maggran admits that age and violence have hardened his heart, stripping away the natural gentleness typical of his people. Sun Rock Retreat was meant to be both an outpost under his steady command and a place of respite, where warm winds and mountain sunshine might soothe his battle-worn spirit.

Even in Stonetalon, Maggran finds little peace. As overseer of Sun Rock Retreat, he coordinates defense efforts against the Bloodfury harpies nesting in the peaks and marshals fighters to counter predatory perils across the crags. Having once survived an ambush by the giant spider Besseleth herself, Maggran holds no illusions about the deadly wilderness around them and frequently enlists travelers to eliminate deadly regional predators before they overrun the outpost.

npc:magistrate-solomon.s: Magistrado Salomón. El Magistrado Salomón es el gobernante electo y magistrado principal de Villa del Lago, y preside los asuntos locales desde el ayuntamiento. Asediado por los orcos Roca Negra e implacables clanes de gnolls, pasa sus días suplicando con desesperación ayuda militar a una Ventormenta indiferente y distraída. El Magistrado Salomón gobierna Villa del Lago durante la hora más oscura de su historia reciente. El tranquilo asentamiento a orillas del lago está rodeado de hostilidad: los gnolls Crestagrana y Pellejo Sombrío merodean por las colinas circundantes, mientras que los orcos Roca Negra descienden desde el norte en partidas de guerra organizadas. Salomón trabaja junto al Alguacil Marris para mantener el orden civil y organizar una defensa, pero la milicia y los guardias locales de Villa del Lago están al límite de sus fuerzas.

ang.faction:Alliance: Solomon's political abandonment illustrates the deep fractures within the Alliance of Stormwind, showing how outer provinces are left entirely to rely on freelance heroes.
ang.race:Dwarf: Dwarven visitors may find a tragic connection in Solomon's history, as Ironforge's effort to answer his distress call resulted in the ambush and capture of Princess Moira Bronzebeard.
ang.race:Human: For human travelers, speaking to Solomon reveals the grim state of the kingdom outside the safety of Elwynn Forest's inner borders.

faq.a: Magistrate Solomon is the elected civil leader of Lakeshire and presiding judge of the Court of Lakeshire. Operating from the town hall, he oversees local administrative matters and orchestrates the town's desperate defense against invading gnolls and orcs.
faq.q: Who is Magistrate Solomon?

faq.a: Stormwind's military is already stretched thin across several troubled regions. When Solomon appeals for aid, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is heavily influenced by royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor, who questions Solomon's reports and actively discourages committing regular kingdom troops to Redridge.
faq.q: Why can't Stormwind send troops to help him?

faq.a: Yes. At Solomon's plea, King Magni Bronzebeard dispatched a relief contingent headed by Princess Moira Bronzebeard. However, the expedition never made it to Redridge, having been ambushed and captured in the Burning Steppes.
faq.q: Did Ironforge try to send help?

faq.a: Lakeshire faces simultaneous pressure from the Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls who terrorize the hills and roads, as well as the aggressive Blackrock orcs raiding south from Stonewatch Keep and the Burning Steppes.
faq.q: What threats are troubling Lakeshire?

faq.a: Solomon coordinates primarily with Marshal Marris, who directs the local town guard. Because regular reinforcements never arrive, the two officials are forced to enlist and deputize traveling adventurers to push back the encroaching threats.
faq.q: Who works with Solomon to defend the town?

faq.a: Knowing Stormwind's court has stalled, Solomon attempts to form mutual aid pacts with neighboring Alliance settlements. Unfortunately, Westfall is paralyzed by the Defias Brotherhood and Darkshire is overwhelmed by the undead and feral beasts, leaving neither able to spare a single defender.
faq.q: Why does Solomon send couriers to Darkshire and Westfall?

text.s: Magistrate Solomon is the elected ruler and chief magistrate of Lakeshire, presiding over local affairs from the town hall. Besieged by Blackrock orcs and relentless gnoll clans, he spends his days frantically pleading for military aid from an indifferent and distracted Stormwind.

sec.b: Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire during the darkest hour in its recent history. The tranquil lakeside settlement is surrounded by hostility: Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls prowl the surrounding hills, while Blackrock orcs descend from the north in organized warbands. Solomon works alongside Marshal Marris to maintain civil order and muster a defense, but Lakeshire's local guards and militia are stretched to their absolute breaking point.

Desperate to secure reinforcements, Solomon has dispatched messengers across the kingdom—pleading for aid from Westfall, Darkshire, and the capital of Stormwind itself. His petitions have yielded bitter disappointment. Westfall struggles under the grip of the Defias Brotherhood, Duskwood is consumed by its own creeping terrors, and Stormwind City refuses to deploy troops to the eastern frontier, leaving Lakeshire entirely to its own devices.

When evidence emerges that the Blackrock orcs are allied with the black dragonflight, Solomon forwards the warning straight to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Despite the magnitude of the threat, royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor dismisses Solomon's pleas as wild exaggeration. Constrained by her counsel and Stormwind's thinly spread forces, Bolvar declines to commit the Stormwind Army, offering Solomon only royal sanction to deputize independent mercenaries.

npc:magni-bronzebeard.s: Magni Barbabronce. Magni Barbabronce es el Señor de Forjaz, thane del clan Barbabronce y gobernante de Khaz Modan.
