Herrero sin igual y veterano comandante de la Segunda Guerra, lidera su reino montañoso en medio del dolor y la tensión política, a la vez que defiende la arqueología enana por todo Azeroth. Siendo el mayor de tres hermanos, Magni creció muy consciente del peso que le aguardaba bajo la montaña. Cuando la Horda invadió durante la Segunda Guerra, mantuvo Forjaz tras sus impenetrables puertas y salió a comprometer a Khaz Modan con la Alianza de Lordaeron una vez roto el asedio. En los años de paz posteriores, Magni acogió a sus aliados gnomos en la ciudad tras la caída de Gnomeregan, concediendo santuario dentro de la montaña al Manitas Mayor Gelbin Mekkatorque y a sus refugiados. Para unir los fracturados reinos del norte y del sur, Magni pidió a Mekkatorque que diseñara una maravilla subterránea sin precedentes: el Tren subterráneo, que conecta directamente Forjaz con Ventormenta.

ang.faction:Alliance: A stalwart founder of the Grand Alliance alongside Lordaeron and Stormwind, Magni provides martial strength, engineering prowess, and steadfast loyalty to the coalition.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: Magni is considered one of the greatest living smiths on Azeroth, having shaped the fabled Ashbringer from an otherworldly crystal at Ironforge's Great Anvil.
ang.race:Dwarf: Magni is your undisputed sovereign and the protector of Khaz Modan, leading the Bronzebeard clan through external wars and the internal search for your race's earthen heritage.
ang.race:Gnome: King Magni offered his city as a refuge to the survivors of Gnomeregan, maintaining a close friendship and technological alliance with High Tinker Mekkatorque.

faq.a: Magni Bronzebeard is the King of Khaz Modan, Thane of Ironforge, and chieftain of the Bronzebeard clan. He rules the mountain kingdom from the High Seat in Ironforge and is one of the staunch pillars of the Grand Alliance.
faq.q: Who is Magni Bronzebeard?

faq.a: King Magni forged the legendary sword himself at the Great Anvil in Ironforge. Alexandros Mograine and High Inquisitor Fairbanks brought him an enigmatic crystal of living Light, and Magni poured his grief and fury over Muradin's reported death into the blade over three days of nonstop smithing.
faq.q: Who forged the Ashbringer?

faq.a: Magni is the eldest of three brothers. His brother Muradin served as an Alliance ambassador to Lordaeron and was reported killed by Prince Arthas in Northrend. His youngest brother, Brann, is a renowned explorer who travels the far corners of the world leading the Explorers' League.
faq.q: What happened to Magni's brothers?

faq.a: Princess Moira Bronzebeard, Magni's only child, has disappeared from Ironforge. Official reports within the mountain hold that she was abducted by the antagonistic Dark Iron dwarves and is being held captive deep within Blackrock Mountain.
faq.q: Where is Princess Moira?

faq.a: Following the trogg invasion and horrific irradiation of Gnomeregan, King Magni opened Ironforge's gates to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the gnomish survivors. Magni granted them an entire district of the city, now known as Tinker Town.
al: why are gnomes in the dwarf city
faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Ironforge?

faq.a: The Explorers' League is an archaeological organization founded by King Magni and his brother Brann. After discovering ancient titan ruins, Magni directed dwarven industries toward uncovering the truth behind their race's origins, sending survey teams across Azeroth.
faq.q: What is the Explorers' League?

text.s: Magni Bronzebeard is the Lord of Ironforge, Thane of the Bronzebeard clan, and ruler of Khaz Modan. A peerless smith and veteran commander of the Second War, he leads his mountainous kingdom through grief and political tension while championing dwarven archaeology across Azeroth.

sec.b: The eldest of three brothers, Magni grew up keenly aware of the weight awaiting him under the mountain. When the Horde invaded during the Second War, he held Ironforge behind its impenetrable gates, emerging to pledge Khaz Modan to the Alliance of Lordaeron once the siege was broken. In the years of peace that followed, Magni welcomed his gnomish allies into the city after the fall of Gnomeregan, granting High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his refugees sanctuary within the mountain. To unite the fractured southern and northern kingdoms, Magni petitioned Mekkatorque to engineer an unprecedented subterranean marvel: the Deeprun Tram, connecting Ironforge directly to Stormwind.

Beneath Magni's regal bearing lies deep personal tragedy. During the Third War, word arrived from Northrend that Prince Arthas Menethil had betrayed and murdered Magni's beloved younger brother, Muradin. Overwhelmed by sorrow and wrath, Magni took up his hammer at the Great Anvil when High Inquisitor Fairbanks and Alexandros Mograine brought him a crystal of pure, radiant Light. Over three tireless days, the dwarven king poured all his grief, rage, and desire for vengeance into the metal. The resulting blade—the Ashbringer—stands as the greatest masterwork of his lifetime, forged to bring ruin to Arthas and the Scourge.

Under Magni's decree, dwarven society has turned much of its focus away from traditional commercial mining toward the unearthing of ancient history. Spurred by discoveries of strange titan relics deep beneath the earth, Magni co-founded the Explorers' League alongside his surviving brother, Brann Bronzebeard. Dwarven dig sites now dot the continents, from Dun Morogh to Kalimdor, striving to unlock the mystery of how the earthen became the modern dwarf. However, domestic peace remains fragile: Magni's daughter, Princess Moira, has gone missing, believed kidnapped by the hated Dark Iron clan.

npc:malfurion-stormrage.s: Malfurión Tempestira. Malfurión Tempestira es el primer druida mortal y el venerado líder de los elfos de la noche junto a la suma sacerdotisa Tyrande Susurravientos. Célebre por derrotar a la Legión Ardiente tanto en la Guerra de los Ancestros como en la Tercera Guerra, es venerado como el Shan'do, o maestro de honor. En la actualidad, yace atrapado en un letargo comatoso dentro del Sueño Esmeralda, dejando a los kaldorei sin su guía despierta. Hace diez mil años, antes de que el Gran Cataclismo destrozara el antiguo Kalimdor, Malfurión estudió bajo la tutela del semidiós Cenarius. Mientras la reina Azshara y su casta de Altonato se adentraban peligrosamente en las energías arcanas del Pozo de la Eternidad, Malfurión recurrió a las fuerzas primigenias de la naturaleza, convirtiéndose en el primer druida mortal de Azeroth. Sus sospechas sobre los Altonato demostraron ser trágicamente ciertas cuando la imprudente hechicería de Azshara desgarró el velo e invocó a Sargeras y a la Legión Ardiente en Azeroth, desatando la catastrófica Guerra de los Ancestros.

ang.class:Druid: Every druid traces their teachings back to Malfurion, who learned directly from Cenarius. His absence in the Emerald Dream casts a heavy shadow over the Cenarion Circle.
ang.class:Priest: Malfurion is the beloved partner of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, uniting the spiritual devotion of Elune with the sacred guardianship of nature.
ang.race:NightElf: Malfurion is revered as the ancient protector and savior of your people, though his continued slumber leaves governance entirely to Tyrande and Archdruid Fandral Staghelm.

faq.a: Malfurion is physically asleep in the barrow dens of Moonglade, while his consciousness remains trapped deep within the spirit realm of the Emerald Dream. He cannot be visited as an active NPC in Darnassus, as his body lies comatose and inaccessible to most adventurers.
faq.q: Where is Malfurion Stormrage right now?

faq.a: Druids regularly hibernate within the Emerald Dream to commune with nature, sustain the world's flora and fauna, and restore their spiritual strength. Following the immense magical strain of defeating Archimonde at Mount Hyjal, Malfurion entered the Dream to recover, but an unnatural malaise has severed his spirit from his body.
faq.q: Why is Malfurion asleep?

faq.a: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rules the kaldorei nation from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, leading the Sentinels and the Sisterhood of Elune. Meanwhile, the Cenarion Circle and druidic affairs are overseen by Archdruid Fandral Staghelm.
al: who is the night elf leader
faq.q: Who rules the night elves while Malfurion sleeps?

faq.a: In Darnassian, 'Shan'do' translates to 'honored teacher.' It is a title of supreme reverence reserved for master druids, most notably Malfurion Stormrage, who first brought druidism to mortal races under the tutelage of Cenarius.
faq.q: What does 'Shan'do' mean?

faq.a: Malfurion's twin brother is Illidan Stormrage. Despite their shared youth in Suramar, Illidan's obsession with arcane magic and reckless pursuit of demonic power caused a bitter rift between them during the War of the Ancients, leading Malfurion to imprison him for millennia.
faq.q: Who is Malfurion's brother?

faq.a: During the climax of the Third War, Malfurion blew the Horn of Cenarius at the World Tree Nordrassil, calling forth thousands of ancestral forest spirits (wisps). These spirits swarmed the demon lord Archimonde and detonated, destroying the demon and immolating the World Tree to save Kalimdor.
faq.q: What did Malfurion do at the Battle of Mount Hyjal?

text.s: Malfurion Stormrage is the first mortal druid and the revered leader of the night elves alongside High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Renowned for defeating the Burning Legion in both the War of the Ancients and the Third War, he is venerated as the Shan'do, or honored teacher. Currently, he lies trapped in a comatose slumber within the Emerald Dream, leaving the kaldorei without his waking guidance.

sec.b: Ten thousand years ago, before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, Malfurion studied under the demigod Cenarius. While Queen Azshara and her Highborne caste delved dangerously into the arcane energies of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion turned toward the primal forces of nature, becoming Azeroth's first mortal druid. His suspicions regarding the Highborne proved tragically correct when Azshara's reckless sorcery pierced the veil and summoned Sargeras and the Burning Legion into Azeroth, igniting the catastrophic War of the Ancients.

Alongside Cenarius, Tyrande Whisperwind, and his twin brother Illidan, Malfurion spearheaded the resistance that halted the demon onslaught and closed the portal over the Well of Eternity. Following the world's shattering, Malfurion committed the druids to the Emerald Dream to rebuild and protect Azeroth's living tapestry. Ten millennia later, Tyrande awakened him from his long barrow sleep to confront Archimonde during the Third War, where he rallied the forest spirits at Mount Hyjal to shatter the Burning Legion once more.

Following the Third War, Malfurion returned to his slumber within the Moonglade to commune with the Emerald Dream and replenish his spent power. However, his spirit has failed to return to his physical body, plunging him into an unnatural, comatose state. In Darnassus, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm has assumed the temporal duties of leadership among the Cenarion Circle, while Tyrande and the sisterhood watch anxiously for signs of their great Shan'do's waking.

npc:mangletooth.s: Quebrantadientes. Quebrantadientes es un jabaespín Crinjarrun encarcelado y retenido por la Horda en el Campamento Taurajo. Ante su inminente ejecución, intercambia información estratégica sobre sus rivales y el saber antiguo de Agamaggan con los aventureros dispuestos a cumplir sus órdenes. Retenido en una jaula en el Campamento Taurajo por cazadores tauren y centinelas orcos, Quebrantadientes es un jabaespín Crinjarrun capturado que espera su ejecución. En lugar de resignarse a la muerte, intenta manipular a sus captores y a los aventureros de la Horda que lo visitan para abatir a los enemigos de su tribu, con la esperanza de que su astucia demuestre su valía o asegure su rescate.

ang.faction:Horde: Camp Taurajo's guards keep Mangletooth caged under close watch, yet the Horde is willing to exploit the prisoner's bitter grievances to crush quilboar strongholds throughout the Barrens.
ang.race:Tauren: Tauren hunters clash constantly with quilboar for territory across the plains, making Mangletooth's willingness to turn on his own kind a valuable, if unsettling, military asset.

faq.a: Mangletooth is a captured Razormane quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Facing execution by the Horde, he bargains with adventurers, offering guidance and ancient boons in exchange for eliminating his rivals.
faq.q: Who is Mangletooth?

faq.a: He was captured during clashes between the Horde and the quilboar in the southern Barrens. The tauren and orcs at Camp Taurajo keep him caged while awaiting his execution.
faq.q: Why is Mangletooth in a cage?

faq.a: Mangletooth realized that his clanmates—Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane—left him to die rather than mounting a rescue. Enraged by their betrayal, he tasks travelers with executing them out of pure spite.
faq.q: Why does Mangletooth ask you to attack other Razormane quilboar?

faq.a: Blood Shards are crystalline minerals that formed where the blood of the Great Boar Ancient, Agamaggan, soaked into the earth when he fell during the War of the Ancients. Bristleback quilboar often carry them.
faq.q: What are Blood Shards?

faq.a: If you supply Mangletooth with Blood Shards, he will channel Agamaggan's sacred power into temporary blessings, granting enhanced strength, agility, resilience, spirit, or swiftness.
faq.q: What can you do with Blood Shards at Mangletooth?

faq.a: Mangletooth recounts that Agamaggan fell in battle during the War of the Ancients. His spilled blood gave rise to the massive thorn spires, and his colossal skull lies enshrining a cavern to the south.
faq.q: Where does Mangletooth say Agamaggan died?

text.s: Mangletooth is an imprisoned Razormane quilboar held captive by the Horde inside Camp Taurajo. Facing execution, he trades strategic information about his rivals and the ancient lore of Agamaggan to adventurers willing to do his bidding.

sec.b: Held in a cage at Camp Taurajo by tauren hunters and orc sentries, Mangletooth is a captured Razormane quilboar awaiting execution. Rather than resigning to death, he attempts to manipulate his captors and visiting Horde adventurers into striking down the enemies of his tribe, hoping his cunning will prove his worth or secure his rescue.

Mangletooth initially schemes to earn his clan's gratitude by steering Horde muscle toward the rival Bristleback tribe. However, he soon realizes that his fellow Razormane leaders—Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane—have completely abandoned him to rot. Furious at their treachery, the captive quilboar turns his vengeance against his own kin, directing adventurers to execute his former allies.

Well-versed in the religious history of his people, Mangletooth knows that the massive thorns across the Barrens sprang from the spilled blood of Agamaggan during the ancient War of the Ancients. By collecting red crystalline Blood Shards from fallen Bristlebacks, Mangletooth channels the residual divine energy of the fallen boar god, bestowing formidable ancient blessings upon those who aid him.

npc:marshal-dughan.s: Alguacil Dughan. El alguacil Dughan es el oficial al mando del destacamento del ejército de Ventormenta apostado en Villadorada. Con la tarea de proteger el corazón del Bosque de Elwynn, se encuentra con una guarnición local desbordada ante las crecientes incursiones de kóbolds, gnolls y bandidos. Para mantener a salvo este pueblo de paso y las granjas de los alrededores, depende en gran medida de aventureros independientes. Apostado en un lugar destacado de Villadorada, a las puertas de la Posada Orgullo de León, el alguacil Dughan carga con la pesada responsabilidad de mantener seguro el Bosque de Elwynn mientras los recursos militares de Ventormenta están ocupados en otros lugares. La situación de los bosques circundantes empeora constantemente: las alimañas atestan las minas, los gnolls se congregan a orillas del río y los asaltantes de caminos hostigan a los viajeros a lo largo del Camino del Rey. Al disponer de muy pocos soldados bajo su mando directo, Dughan organiza la defensa local enviando a nuevos reclutas a reforzar los puestos de avanzada y explorar el terreno disputado.

ang.class:Warrior: For martial fighters, Dughan embodies the standard discipline and logistical strain of Stormwind's military footmen holding the line against impossible odds.
ang.faction:Alliance: Marshal Dughan represents the frontline administrative authority for the Alliance in Elwynn, providing newly arrived recruits with their earliest military assignments on behalf of Stormwind.

faq.a: Marshal Dughan is an officer of the Stormwind Army stationed in Goldshire. He oversees military security for central Elwynn Forest, coordinating defense efforts against local threats such as thieves, gnolls, and kobolds.
faq.q: Who is Marshal Dughan?

faq.a: The Stormwind Army is spread thin, leaving Dughan with barely enough guards to maintain order in Goldshire itself. Because he lacks the standing manpower to garrison every outlying farm and border post, he relies on visiting adventurers to scout hot spots, deliver dispatches, and eliminate regional dangers.
faq.q: Why doesn't Dughan send more guards to help Westbrook Garrison or the east?

faq.a: Initially, Dughan dismissed warnings from Remy 'Two Times' that murlocs were a serious threat to the region. He only recognized the true peril after Guard Thomas sent tragic reports confirming the deaths of guardsmen Rolf Hartford and Malakai Stone along the eastern waterways.
faq.q: What is Dughan's view on the murloc threat in Elwynn?

faq.a: Dughan enforces the law strictly but gives fair warning before throwing citizens behind bars. When locals or travelers cause public disturbances in Goldshire, he warns them that continuing to pick fights will land them directly in Stormwind's Stockade, and he will actively hunt them down if they commit murder.
faq.q: How does Dughan handle local crime and rowdy civilians?

faq.a: Fargodeep Mine and Jasperlode Mine are essential sources of gold and ore for Stormwind. Kobolds have overrun both subterranean complexes, driving out the miners and threatening to expand their tunnels directly under Elwynn's settlements.
faq.q: Why is Dughan concerned about the mines?

faq.a: Yes. Once an adventurer proves their capability in Elwynn Forest, Marshal Dughan directs them to Westfall to report to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill, where the People's Militia desperately needs veteran help against the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: Does Marshal Dughan coordinate with Westfall?

text.s: Marshal Dughan is the commanding officer of the Stormwind Army detachment stationed in Goldshire. Tasked with protecting the heart of Elwynn Forest, he finds his local garrison stretched thin against growing incursions of kobolds, gnolls, and bandits. To keep the crossroads town and surrounding farmsteads safe, he relies heavily on independent adventurers.

sec.b: Stationed prominently in Goldshire outside the Lion's Pride Inn, Marshal Dughan bears the heavy burden of keeping Elwynn Forest secure while Stormwind's military resources are tied up elsewhere. The surrounding woods are steadily deteriorating: vermin choke the mines, gnolls mass along the riverbanks, and highwaymen harass travelers along the King's Road. With too few footmen under his direct command, Dughan orchestrates local defense by directing fresh recruits to reinforce outposts and scout contested ground.

Dughan's immediate concerns lie with the kobold infestations overrunning Fargodeep and Jasperlode Mines, threatening Goldshire's vital mineral output. To the west, Riverpaw gnolls led by the notorious Hogger press hard against Westbrook Garrison. To the east, Dughan is forced to confront reports from Guard Thomas concerning vicious murlocs slaughtering patrols along the river. Managing these overlapping crises with limited manpower keeps the marshal in constant need of capable mercenaries.

npc:marshal-marris.s: Alguacil Marris. El Alguacil Marris es el asediado oficial militar que comanda la guardia de Villa del Lago. Apostado cerca del puente del pueblo, coordina las operaciones defensivas contra la masiva invasión de orcos Roca Negra que desciende desde las alturas de las Montañas Crestagrana. Ante la ausencia del ejército de Ventormenta, confía en los aventureros de paso para frenar los avances de la horda. Villa del Lago se encuentra al borde del colapso, atrapada entre los gnolls al oeste y el aterrador poderío militar del Clan Roca Negra al este. El Alguacil Marris supervisa la línea de guardia en el puente principal del pueblo, pero sus recursos están agotados y sus soldados, dispersos hasta el límite. Con el reino de Ventormenta reteniendo los refuerzos reales, Marris soporta la pesada carga de evitar que el asentamiento sucumba ante la fuerza bruta.

ang.class:Warrior: Marris appreciates straightforward martial discipline, sending capable front-line fighters into the jaws of Stonewatch to trade blows with seasoned Blackrock veterans.
ang.faction:Alliance: Marshal Marris embodies the plight of the rural Alliance territories, left vulnerable by Stormwind's political paralysis and forced to fight for survival on their own.
ang.race:Human: For humans of the kingdom, Marris represents the stoic, beleaguered frontier guard holding the line against the remnants of the Old Horde.

faq.a: Marshal Marris is the senior military commander in charge of defending Lakeshire. He can be found standing guard near the western end of the town's bridge, trying to keep the settlement fortified against hostile incursions.
al: who is the guard at lakeshire bridge
faq.q: Who is Marshal Marris?

faq.a: The Kingdom of Stormwind has failed to send adequate garrison reinforcements to the Redridge Mountains, leaving Lakeshire's local guard hopelessly outnumbered. Facing gnoll warbands and an entrenched invasion of Blackrock orcs, Marris is forced to enlist mercenary heroes to carry out critical strikes.
faq.q: Why is Marshal Marris hiring independent adventurers?

faq.a: While gnolls plague the outskirts, Marris is primarily focused on the Blackrock orcs who have seized Stonewatch Keep. These orcs, commanded by Tharil'zun and bolstered by shadow magic, represent an imminent existential threat to Lakeshire and the greater kingdom.
faq.q: What threats is Marshal Marris fighting against?

faq.a: They share a surname common to the human kingdoms of Lordaeron and Stormwind, but no official record confirms a direct familial relationship between Marshal Marris in Redridge and the famed ranger Nathanos Marris from the north.
faq.q: Is Marshal Marris related to Nathanos Marris?

faq.a: Marris implements a war of attrition and decapitation. He directs combatants to cull the Blackrock infantry, gather magical components from their shadow magic users, and breach Stonewatch Keep to execute their leader, Tharil'zun.
faq.q: What is Marris's plan to defeat the Blackrock clan?

faq.a: Marris is stationed in Lakeshire within the Redridge Mountains, positioned prominently along the bridge near the center of town.
faq.q: Where can Marshal Marris be found?

text.s: Marshal Marris is the beleaguered military officer commanding the town watch at Lakeshire. Stationed near the town's bridge, he coordinates defense operations against the massive Blackrock orc invasion pressing down from the heights of the Redridge Mountains. With Stormwind's army absent, he relies on visiting adventurers to blunt the horde's advances.

sec.b: Lakeshire stands on the brink of collapse, caught between the gnolls to the west and the terrifying military might of the Blackrock clan to the east. Marshal Marris oversees the guard line at the town's primary bridge, but his resources are depleted and his soldiers are spread impossibly thin. With the kingdom of Stormwind withholding royal reinforcements, Marris carries the heavy burden of keeping the township from being overwhelmed by brute force.

Recognizing that defense alone will not save Redridge, Marris orchestrates decisive offensive strikes against the orc encampments. He directs mercenaries to cull the Blackrock warriors, dismantle their shadowcasters, and ultimately hunt down Tharil'zun, the menacing commander entrenched inside the ruins of Stonewatch Keep. His orders aim to break the command structure of the orcs before an all-out assault crushes Lakeshire completely.

npc:marshal-mcbride.s: Alguacil McBride. El alguacil Douglas McBride es el comandante de la guarnición de Ventormenta apostada en la Abadía de Villanorte. Con la tarea de defender el Valle de Villanorte, dirige a los reclutas recién llegados contra la creciente plaga de kóbold que amenaza las granjas y minas locales. Actúa como la principal autoridad militar para los recién llegados que inician su servicio al reino de Ventormenta. Apostado justo a las puertas de la Abadía de Villanorte, el alguacil Douglas McBride representa la autoridad directa del ejército de Ventormenta en este tranquilo valle. Aunque la propia abadía es un enclave de fe y aprendizaje, la creciente agitación por todo el reino ha mermado las guarniciones militares. McBride debe mantener la paz y asegurar el suministro de alimentos y recursos del valle con tan solo un puñado de guardias juramentados y una afluencia de reclutas novatos que buscan entrenamiento con los maestros de la abadía.

ang.class:Warrior: McBride actively seeks out sturdy fighters to serve the kingdom, relying on frontline warriors to clear out the tunnels of Echo Ridge.
ang.faction:Alliance: McBride represents the starting frontier of the Grand Alliance in the heartland of humanity, inducting recruits into service of the Crown.
ang.race:Human: For humans beginning their adventures in Northshire, Marshal McBride is the first representative of Stormwind's royal authority they encounter.

faq.a: Marshal Douglas McBride is an officer of the Stormwind Army stationed as the garrison commander at Northshire Abbey. He is in charge of defending Northshire Valley and directing new recruits into service.
faq.q: Who is Marshal McBride?

faq.a: Kobolds have infested the forests around Northshire and seized control of Echo Ridge Mine. With Stormwind's military stretched thin, McBride relies on newly arrived adventurers to clear the vermin and secure the area.
faq.q: Why is McBride having recruits fight kobolds?

faq.a: Once a recruit has demonstrated their capability by dealing with the threats in Northshire Valley, McBride directs them down the southern road to Goldshire to assist Marshal Dughan.
al: where do i go after mcbride
faq.q: Where does McBride send recruits next?

faq.a: Echo Ridge Mine is a mineral-rich cavern located on the northern edge of Northshire Valley. It has recently been overrun by tunneling kobolds, prompting McBride to order several operations to reclaim it.
faq.q: What is Echo Ridge Mine?

faq.a: No. Northshire Abbey is maintained by the holy orders and priests of the Light. McBride oversees the military garrison tasked with defending the abbey and the surrounding valley.
al: who is in charge of the abbey
faq.q: Does McBride command the abbey itself?

faq.a: While kobolds are the most immediate nuisance, McBride watches for deeper instability. Bandits and outlaws hover at the fringes of the valley, signaling broader unrest brewing across Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Is McBride concerned about threats beyond kobolds?

text.s: Marshal Douglas McBride is the commander of the Stormwind garrison stationed at Northshire Abbey. Tasked with the defense of Northshire Valley, he directs freshly arrived recruits against the rising kobold infestation threatening local farms and mines. He serves as the primary military authority for newcomers beginning their service to the kingdom of Stormwind.

sec.b: Stationed right outside Northshire Abbey, Marshal Douglas McBride represents the direct authority of the Stormwind Army in this quiet valley. While the abbey itself is an enclave of faith and learning, rising turmoil across the kingdom has stretched military garrisons thin. McBride must maintain peace and secure the valley's food and resource supplies with only a handful of sworn guards and an influx of green recruits seeking training under the abbey's masters.

McBride's primary headache is the sudden aggression of local vermin. Kobolds, once merely a nuisance, have overrun the surrounding woods and seized Echo Ridge Mine—a vital local asset. Lacking the regular soldiers needed to clear them out, McBride marshals paladins, warriors, and other novices to push back the tunneling pests and uncover the extent of the infestation before the valley is completely choked off.

npc:master-apothecary-faranell.s: Maestro boticario Faranell. El Maestro boticario Faranell es el líder de la Sociedad Real de Boticarios, apostado en las profundidades del Apothecarium en Entrañas. En vida fue un respetado erudito de Dalaran; en la no-muerte dirige a los Renegados en su búsqueda de una Nueva Plaga devastadora para erradicar tanto a la Plaga como a los vivos. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, Faranell era un estimado alquimista que pasó décadas estudiando junto a los doctos magos de Dalaran. Dedicó sus días mortales a buscar curas, remedios y pociones para mejorar la salud de los mortales. Cuando la peste de la Plaga le arrebató la vida y resucitó como un renegado con libre albedrío, su antigua curiosidad científica se tornó en crueldad. Conservando su intelecto enciclopédico, cambió los ungüentos curativos por reactivos catastróficos, convirtiéndose rápidamente en uno de los investigadores más valiosos de la reina Sylvanas Brisaveloz en las entrañas de la caída capital de Lordaeron.

ang.faction:Horde: Though orc, troll, and tauren allies may be unsettled by the green ooze and caged subjects of the Apothecarium, Faranell's research is tolerated as vital warfare against the common threat of the Scourge.
ang.profession:Herbalism: Faranell's vats consume endless quantities of rare flora, mosses, and fungal extracts, serving as a dark demonstration of botanical study weaponized for destruction.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Faranell represents the vanguard of biological sovereignty, laboring in the dark to ensure their people possess weapons capable of shattering the Lich King.

faq.a: Faranell is the head of the Royal Apothecary Society, the alchemical guild serving Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity. He oversees all research regarding toxins, stitched abominations, and the development of the New Plague.
faq.q: Who is Master Apothecary Faranell?

faq.a: He resides in the Apothecarium, the alchemical quarter located in the western sector of the Undercity, surrounded by bubbling cauldrons, testing cages, and his apothecary subordinates.
faq.q: Where can Faranell be found?

faq.a: In life, Faranell was an acclaimed alchemist and doctor who studied with the wizards of Dalaran. He spent his living years inventing remedies to heal disease before the plague killed him and twisted his curiosity toward lethal toxins.
faq.q: What was Faranell's background before he died?

faq.a: Under Queen Sylvanas's directive, the society is manufacturing a New Plague. Their goal is to craft a weapon virulent enough to destroy the Scourge and exact vengeance upon the Lich King, while also defending the Forsaken from mortal enemies.
faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to create?

faq.a: He seeks the research journal of his former colleague, Apothecary Berard, who went mad and succumbed to the worgen curse in Pyrewood. Berard's field notes contain critical data on toxic agents needed to refine their plague experiments.
faq.q: Why does Faranell send adventurers to Pyrewood Village?

faq.a: Faranell tests how opposing volatile compounds interact. He uses kraul guano collected from the razorfen quilboar dens alongside the freshly harvested hearts of Scarlet Crusade zealots to test acidic colloids and biological contamination.
faq.q: Why does he need reagents from Razorfen Kraul and the Scarlet Monastery?

text.s: Master Apothecary Faranell is the head of the Royal Apothecary Society, stationed within the depths of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. In life a respected Dalaran scholar, in undeath he directs the Forsaken's search for a devastating New Plague to eradicate both the Scourge and the living.

sec.b: Before the Third War, Faranell was an esteemed alchemist who spent decades studying alongside the learned mages of Dalaran. He spent his mortal days seeking cures, remedies, and potions to improve mortal health. When the Scourge plague claimed his life and he arose as a free-willed Forsaken, his former scientific curiosity curdled into cruelty. Retaining his encyclopedic intellect, he traded healing salves for catastrophic reagents, quickly becoming one of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's most valued researchers in the bowels of Lordaeron's fallen capital.

Operating out of the noxious laboratories of the Apothecarium, Faranell coordinates the far-flung research of the Royal Apothecary Society. He oversees the construction of lumbering abominations and directs subordinate apothecaries stationed throughout Lordaeron and beyond. Every batch of strange venom, tainted blood, and cursed flora gathered by field researchers across the continents eventually passes through his vats for distillation and refinement.

Faranell's single driving obsession is fulfilling the Dark Lady's mandate: uncovering the New Plague. To brew a contagion capable of destroying Arthas and his mindless Scourge legions, Faranell coordinates extensive reagent gathering. He dispatches adventurers to recover the research notes of his fallen colleague Apothecary Berard from Pyrewood Village, procures bat guano from the deep dens of Razorfen Kraul, and tests acidic colloids against the organs of zealots from the Scarlet Monastery.

npc:master-gadrin.s: Maestro Gadrin. El Maestro Gadrin es un anciano trol de la jungla y un venerable médico brujo de la tribu Lanza Negra que reside actualmente en Poblado Sen'jin. Tras haber instruido en su día a los sacerdotes y magos de la tribu junto al médico brujo renegado Zalazane, ahora coordina los esfuerzos para ayudar a su pueblo desplazado y romper la oscura maldición que atenaza su arrebatado hogar en las Islas del Eco. Mucho antes de que los Lanza Negra llegaran a Kalimdor, el Maestro Gadrin sirvió como médico brujo de su tribu en sus islas ancestrales de los Mares del Sur, donde guio el adiestramiento místico de generaciones de trols Lanza Negra.

ang.class:Mage: Gadrin broke ground by tutoring Darkspear trolls in the arcane arts after the Third War, proving that troll magic could expand far beyond raw ritual mojo.
ang.class:Priest: As the elder who instructed Darkspear priests in communing with the spirits and the loa, Gadrin embodies the shadow and faith traditions of the jungle trolls.
ang.faction:Horde: Master Gadrin is one of Vol'jin's most trusted advisors, keeping watchful eyes on coastal Durotar and warning Razor Hill when dark cults threaten the fledgling nation of Durotar.
ang.race:Troll: For Darkspear trolls, Master Gadrin is a living connection to your ancestral home and the traditions of Sen'jin. He has shaped your tribe's spiritual leadership for generations and feels a fatherly grief over the tragedy of the Echo Isles.

faq.a: Master Gadrin is a witch doctor and an elder spiritual leader of the Darkspear trolls. Located in Sen'jin Village on the coast of Durotar, he serves as a senior advisor to Chieftain Vol'jin.
faq.q: Who is Master Gadrin?

faq.a: On the Echo Isles, Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane led the mystical training of the Darkspear's priests and mages together, only for Gadrin to watch in horror as Zalazane fell to dark magic, went mad, and drove the Darkspear from their island home.
faq.q: What is Gadrin's history with Zalazane?

faq.a: When Zalazane's curse drove the Darkspear off the Echo Isles, the survivors established Sen'jin Village on the southern coast of Durotar as a refuge. Gadrin remains in the village to counsel refugees, track local threats, and direct strikes against Zalazane's forces.
al: what is gadrin doing in senjin village
faq.q: Why is Gadrin staying in Sen'jin Village?

faq.a: Minshina was Master Gadrin's brother. He perished during the turmoil on the Echo Isles, and his restless spirit began calling to Gadrin in dreams. Gadrin asks trusted adventurers to recover his brother's skull so his soul may finally find peace.
faq.q: Who is Minshina?

faq.a: Yes. After receiving word from Zureetha Fargaze about the Burning Blade infiltrating the Valley of Trials, Gadrin monitors the cult's presence near Sen'jin Village. Seeing the wider danger to Durotar, he sends recruits north to report to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
faq.q: Does Gadrin help with the Burning Blade cult?

faq.a: Gadrin is a master of ancient troll theology. When the Forsaken Apothecary Lydon seeks a potent venom used by the Hinterlands Witherbark trolls, Gadrin identifies it as a gift from Shadra the spider loa, directing adventurers to Zul'Farrak to read the tablet bearing her true name, which he needs to write a spell of summoning.
faq.q: What does Gadrin know about the loa Shadra?

text.s: Master Gadrin is an elderly jungle troll and a venerable witch doctor of the Darkspear tribe, currently residing in Sen'jin Village. Having once trained the tribe's priests and mages alongside the renegade witch doctor Zalazane, he now coordinates efforts to aid his displaced people and break the dark curse gripping their stolen home on the Echo Isles.

sec.b: Long before the Darkspear arrived on Kalimdor, Master Gadrin served as a witch doctor of his tribe in their ancestral South Seas islands, where he guided the mystical training of generations of Darkspear trolls.

When the Darkspear settled the Echo Isles alongside the Horde, Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane led the mystical training of the tribe's priests and mages together. Tragically, Zalazane succumbed to madness, intoxicated by the dark voodoo forces he sought to wield. The rogue practitioner enslaved his brethren's minds and drove Vol'jin and the uncorrupted Darkspear onto the mainland of Durotar. Now based in Sen'jin Village, Gadrin carries the personal sorrow of seeing a former companion become a tyrannical monster, working tirelessly to lay slain tribesfolk to rest and end Zalazane's reign.

Beyond the crisis on the Echo Isles, Gadrin stands as one of the Horde's greatest living authorities on troll spiritualism and loa lore. Scholars, shamans, and even the Royal Apothecary Society seek his insight on arcane and alchemical mysteries. When strange threats like the Burning Blade brush against Durotar, or distant researchers require forgotten rituals—such as deciphering ancient tablets in Zul'Farrak to invoke Shadra the spider loa—it is Gadrin who possesses the knowledge to craft the necessary bindings.

npc:mathias-shaw.s: Mathias Shaw. El Maestro Mathias Shaw es el líder de Inteligencia de Ventormenta (IV:7), la agencia de espionaje encubierta del Reino de Ventormenta. Desde las sombras del Casco Antiguo, dirige a espías y exploradores para proteger al reino tanto de conspiraciones internas como de amenazas exteriores. Mathias Shaw es el principal maestro de espías y asesino de Ventormenta. Desde el discreto cuartel general de IV:7, oculto tras el cuartel del Casco Antiguo, Shaw coordina una red secreta que abarca los Reinos del Este y más allá. Pragmático, calculador y ferozmente leal a la Casa de Wrynn, se guía por la filosofía de que la seguridad de Ventormenta depende tanto de dagas invisibles y misivas robadas como de armaduras resplandecientes y guarniciones palaciegas.

ang.class:Rogue: Mathias Shaw represents the absolute pinnacle of human roguecraft. Alliance rogues are often sent to him for advanced tactical assignments and specialty poisons.
ang.faction:Alliance: As the kingdom's spymaster, Shaw serves as the first line of defense against subversion, gathering vital military intelligence for Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the boy-king Anduin.
ang.race:Human: Shaw's tragic falling-out with his childhood friend Edwin VanCleef reflects the broader, bitter fracture within the Kingdom of Stormwind following its reconstruction.

faq.a: Mathias Shaw is the leader of SI:7, Stormwind's intelligence service and guild of assassins. Operating out of Old Town, he coordinates the kingdom's espionage and covert defense under the authority of the throne.
faq.q: Who is Mathias Shaw?

faq.a: He is located inside the SI:7 headquarters in the Old Town district of Stormwind City, secluded behind the military barracks.
faq.q: Where can Mathias Shaw be found?

faq.a: Shaw and Edwin VanCleef were childhood friends. Shaw personally trained VanCleef in roguecraft and espionage, hoping they would work together. After the Stonemasons' dispute turned violent, VanCleef used those very skills to forge the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: What is his connection to Edwin VanCleef?

faq.a: SI:7 is the premier intelligence organization of Stormwind, specializing in surveillance, reconnaissance, espionage, and covert assassinations to safeguard the kingdom and Alliance interests.
faq.q: What does SI:7 stand for?

faq.a: Westfall is the stronghold of the Defias Brotherhood. Shaw keeps active operatives in the region to spy on rebel activities and disrupt their plots against Stormwind.
faq.q: Why is Mathias Shaw interested in Westfall?

faq.a: Shaw dispatched five operatives to scout suspicious Forsaken movement in the Eastern Plaguelands. Four never returned, and the sole survivor came back babbling about "Nathanos" and a "Blightcaller" before dying in his sleep days later.
faq.q: What happened to the agents Shaw sent to the Plaguelands?

text.s: Master Mathias Shaw is the leader of SI:7, the covert intelligence agency of the Kingdom of Stormwind. Operating from the shadows of Old Town, he directs spies and scouts to protect the realm from internal conspiracies and external horrors alike.

sec.b: Mathias Shaw stands as Stormwind's foremost spymaster and assassin. From SI:7's discreet headquarters tucked behind the barracks in Old Town, Shaw coordinates a covert network that spans the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond. Pragmatic, calculating, and fiercely loyal to the House of Wrynn, he operates on the philosophy that Stormwind's safety depends just as much on unseen daggers and stolen missives as it does on gleaming armor and palace garrisons.

Shaw shares a deeply personal history with Edwin VanCleef, leader of the rebel Defias Brotherhood. The two were childhood companions, and Shaw personally trained VanCleef in the arts of stealth and assassination, once hoping the gifted stonemason would put his talents toward serving the kingdom alongside him. Instead, when the Stonemasons Guild was cast out following the rebuilding of Stormwind, VanCleef turned those lethal lessons against the crown. Today, Shaw directs the surveillance and infiltration operations aimed at dismantling his old friend's insurrection across Westfall.

While domestic insurrection consumes Westfall and Elwynn, Shaw's attention is constantly drawn outward to lethal unknowns. When reports reached him of bizarre Forsaken operations in the Eastern Plaguelands, he dispatched five of his finest agents to investigate. Only one returned alive—babbling in terror about "Nathanos" and a "Blightcaller" before dying in his sleep. Shaw relies on trusted independent champions to venture where his scouts vanish, seeking to pierce the gloom gathering at the kingdom's borders.

npc:mathrengyl-bearwalker.s: Mathrengyl Garroso. Mathrengyl Garroso es un maestro instructor de druidas y un respetado anciano del Círculo Cenarion que reside en el Enclave Cenarion de Darnassus. Habiendo servido en su día como ayudante directo del archidruida Fandral Corzocelada, guía a los jóvenes druidas de la Alianza a través de sus pruebas espirituales, ritos de cambio de forma y deberes por todo Kalimdor. Apostado en los confines verdes del Enclave Cenarion en Darnassus, Mathrengyl Garroso se erige como uno de los druidas más venerables y equilibrados de Teldrassil. Ejerce como guía primordial para los druidas noveles de la Alianza, supervisando su comunión con Claro de la Luna y poniendo a prueba su preparación para dominar las formas animales primigenias. Habiendo experimentado en su propia juventud la intensa y sobrecogedora comunión con el Gran Espíritu del Oso, Mathrengyl comprende el peso de estos ritos, encargando personalmente a los iniciados que demuestren su temple espiritual frente al sagrado lechúcico lunar Garraluna antes de iniciarlos en la senda del druida de la garra.

ang.class:Druid: For Alliance druids, Mathrengyl is an essential mentor who bridges Darnassus with Moonglade, unlocking the secrets of Bear Form, Aquatic Form, and herbal cures for deadly poisons.
ang.faction:Alliance: Mathrengyl represents the steady, traditional leadership of the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus, offering a temperate contrast to Fandral Staghelm's aggressive posturing.
ang.race:NightElf: A paragon of Kaldorei druidism, Mathrengyl embodies devotion to nature and balance in the aftermath of the Third War and the growth of Teldrassil.

faq.a: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a veteran night elf druid trainer stationed in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Revered as one of Teldrassil's most balanced sages, he instructs initiates in shapeshifting, poison cleansing, and duties on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.
faq.q: Who is Mathrengyl Bearwalker?

faq.a: Mathrengyl served as Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant and second. While obediently managing Fandral's requests—including gathering morrowgrain and delegating missions—Mathrengyl harbors subtle doubts regarding some of Fandral's harsh viewpoints and eccentric projects.
faq.q: What is his relationship with Fandral Staghelm?

faq.a: Mathrengyl instructs young druids after their spiritual pilgrimages to Moonglade, overseeing their communion with Lunaclaw to earn Bear Form, as well as concluding their trials in Darkshore and Westfall to master Aquatic Form.
faq.q: What forms does Mathrengyl help druids learn?

faq.a: He assists Archdruid Fandral Staghelm with ongoing botanical research on Teldrassil by collecting morrowgrain cultivated by adventurers. Even so, Mathrengyl has admitted to feeling deeply uneasy whenever he is in the plant's presence.
faq.q: Why is Mathrengyl gathering morrowgrain?

faq.a: Unlike Fandral Staghelm, who views tauren druids with open skepticism, Mathrengyl is more thoughtful. After reviewing the sacrifice of a tauren druid fighting the Scourge in the Western Plaguelands, he admitted the tauren might walk closer to the teachings of Cenarius than Fandral allows.
faq.q: How does Mathrengyl feel about tauren druids?

faq.a: When adventurers bring a corrupted Nightmare Shard to Falla Sagewind, she sends them on to Mathrengyl, who inspects it with great alarm, sensing the creeping corruption threatening the Emerald Dream.
faq.q: What does he do with the Nightmare Shard?

text.s: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a master druid trainer and respected elder of the Cenarion Circle residing in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. Having once served as Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant, he guides young Alliance druids through their spiritual trials, shapeshifting rites, and duties across Kalimdor.

sec.b: Perched within the verdant reaches of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker stands as one of the most venerable and balanced druids on Teldrassil. He serves as a primary guide for fledgling Alliance druids, overseeing their communion with Moonglade and testing their readiness to master primal animal forms. Having undergone the intense, bewildering communion with the Great Bear Spirit in his own youth, Mathrengyl understands the weight of these rites, personally charging initiates to prove their spirit against the sacred moonkin Lunaclaw before inducting them into the path of the Druid of the Claw.

Mathrengyl has long operated as Fandral Staghelm's second, managing day-to-day circle affairs and handling recruitment for the Archdruid's ambitious endeavors. When Fandral demanded vast quantities of morrowgrain, Mathrengyl organized its collection from returning adventurers, despite privately confiding a quiet unease regarding the strange plant's unnatural essence. He also coordinates Alliance responses to summons from Moonglade, navigating the delicate politics of the Cenarion Circle while Fandral turns his gaze toward southern Kalimdor and the Plaguelands.

While Staghelm is infamous for his fierce pride and disdain for other races, Mathrengyl often displays a more contemplative, open mind. When relics arrived in Darnassus from the fallen druid Mulgris Deepriver—who perished fighting the Scourge in the Western Plaguelands—Mathrengyl was deeply moved to discover the investigator was a tauren. Reflecting on the Cenarion Circle's shared mission, he quietly mused that the tauren may not have drifted nearly as far from the teachings of Cenarius as the Archdruid insists.

npc:mebok-mizzyrix.s: Mebok Mizzyrix. Mebok Mizzyrix es un emprendedor goblin que reside en la ciudad portuaria de Trinquete. Siempre deseoso de convertir los reactivos más extraños de la naturaleza en beneficios, contrata a aventureros que van de paso para recolectar flora y fauna inusuales de Los Baldíos y más allá. Su proyecto más notorio consiste en preparar una bebida comercial que potencia el intelecto a base de cuernos de raptor. Operando desde el bullicioso y neutral puerto de Trinquete, Mebok Mizzyrix encarna el clásico espíritu de implacable oportunismo del Cártel Bonvapor. Mientras Trinquete atiende a marineros, piratas y mercaderes de toda clase, Mebok fija su aguda mirada en las tierras salvajes de Kalimdor. En lugar de extraer mineral corriente o comerciar con telas mundanas, busca raras curiosidades biológicas que cree poder refinar en pociones y mercancías sumamente lucrativas.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stepping off the boat from Booty Bay into neutral Ratchet gives Alliance explorers access to Mebok's tasks without fear of hostile guards.
ang.faction:Horde: Passing through Ratchet on the way across the Barrens offers Horde travelers an easy source of coin clearing out dangerous beasts nearby.
ang.profession:Cooking: Culinary adventurers will find Mebok's culinary and beverage recipes questionable at best, given his insistence on brewing ground raptor horn.
ang.profession:Herbalism: Mebok's fascination with odd specimens like Blueleaf tubers showcases the wilder, commercial side of gathering Kalimdor's unique flora.

faq.a: Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin merchant and alchemical schemer located in the neutral port town of Ratchet in the Barrens. He contracts adventurers to gather strange wildlife and plant parts to fuel his commercial projects.
faq.q: Who is Mebok Mizzyrix?

faq.a: Smart Drinks are experimental intellect-boosting tonics Mebok Mizzyrix hopes to brew and sell. He believes grinding down the horns of clever Barrens raptors will impart their sharp instincts and cunning to the drinker.
faq.q: What are Smart Drinks?

faq.a: He can be found standing among the buildings in the port city of Ratchet, on the eastern coast of the Barrens, accessible to both Horde and Alliance travelers.
faq.q: Where can Mebok Mizzyrix be found?

faq.a: Mebok hypothesizes that the cunning intelligence of the raptors roaming the Barrens is concentrated within their horns. He plans to pulverize them as the primary active ingredient in his intellect-enhancing beverages.
al: what does mebok do with horns
faq.q: Why does Mebok want raptor horns?

faq.a: He enlists adventurers to delve into Razorfen Kraul to dig up Blueleaf tubers using a trained sniffer, seeking the rare plant for its valuable and unusual botanical properties.
faq.q: Why does Mebok send people to Razorfen Kraul?

faq.a: Mebok is an independent member of the Steamwheedle Cartel in neutral Ratchet. He is loyal to coin and will happily trade and contract with members of either faction.
faq.q: Does Mebok work for the Horde or the Alliance?

text.s: Mebok Mizzyrix is an enterprising goblin entrepreneur residing in the port town of Ratchet. Ever eager to turn bizarre wilderness reagents into profit, he hires passing adventurers to gather unusual flora and fauna from across the Barrens and beyond. His most notorious project involves concocting a commercial intellect-enhancing beverage out of raptor horns.

sec.b: Operating out of the bustling, neutral port of Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix embodies the classic Steamwheedle spirit of relentless opportunism. While Ratchet caters to sailors, pirates, and merchants of all stripes, Mebok focuses his keen eye on Kalimdor's wilderness. Rather than mining standard ore or trading mundane cloth, he seeks out rare biological curiosities that he believes can be refined into highly lucrative concoctions and commodities.

Mebok's premier commercial endeavor is a proprietary 'smart drink' intended to artificially boost the intellect of whoever consumes it. Convinced that the natural cunning and ferocity of local raptors stems from the horns crowning their snouts, Mebok commissions hunters to harvest intact horns across the Barrens. To him, ethics and taste take a backseat to raw market potential, so long as paying customers believe the brew delivers results.

Beyond raptor-derived elixirs, Mebok maintains a constant demand for other bizarre specimens. From collecting volatile Deepmoss spider eggs to commissioning the retrieval of rare Blueleaf tubers buried deep within the brambles of Razorfen Kraul, his pursuits consistently push intrepid mercenaries into perilous territory. If an organism possesses strange properties, Mebok is certain there is a way to bottle and sell it.

npc:melor-stonehoof.s: Melor Pezuñapétrea. Melor Pezuñapétrea es un veterano cazador tauren apostado en lo alto del Alto de los Cazadores, en Cima del Trueno. Como mentor en los hábitos de la caza, pone a prueba la destreza de rastreo y el temple de los cazadores de la Horda enviándolos tras las bestias depredadoras más peligrosas a lo largo de Los Baldíos y Las Mil Agujas. Encaramado en la ventosa extensión del Alto de los Cazadores, Melor Pezuñapétrea observa las llanuras que se extienden abajo con mirada experta. El arte de la caza es sagrado para los tauren, entrelazado con la supervivencia, el equilibrio espiritual y el respeto por los mayores depredadores de la naturaleza. Melor se asegura de que aquellos que empuñan el arco y la espada en nombre de la Horda comprendan este equilibrio, guiando a los acechadores prometedores a perfeccionar su oficio mediante pruebas contra bestias legendarias.

ang.class:Hunter: Melor is one of the quintessential quest givers for Horde hunters, guiding you through rites of tracking that embody the sacred hunter's path.
ang.faction:Horde: Melor ensures that warriors and stalkers throughout the Horde are hardened against the wild beasts that endanger settlements from Mulgore to Thousand Needles.
ang.race:Tauren: Stationed high upon Hunter Rise, Melor exemplifies your people's deep reverence for the hunt as both a trial of strength and an act of balance with the Earth Mother.

faq.a: Melor Stonehoof is located on Hunter Rise in the city of Thunder Bluff. Hunter Rise is the easternmost elevated mesa of the tauren capital, accessible via rope bridges from the central totem mesa.
faq.q: Where can I find Melor Stonehoof?

faq.a: Melor offers a series of hunting challenges aimed at mid-level adventurers. These include directing players to Sergra Darkthorn in the Barrens, hunting the ferocious hyena Steelsnap, and tracking down formidable beasts farther afield, such as the crocolisk Deadmire in Dustwallow Marsh and the yeti Frostmaw in the Alterac Mountains.
faq.q: What quests does Melor Stonehoof offer?

faq.a: Steelsnap is a notoriously vicious and cunning hyena stalking Thousand Needles. Melor sends capable hunters to track and slay her as a test of skill, endurance, and courage in the wild.
faq.q: Why does Melor send hunters after Steelsnap?

faq.a: Deadmire is an unusually large and aggressive crocolisk that prowls the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh. Melor challenges hunters to slay it as a rite of prowess.
faq.q: What is Deadmire?

faq.a: No. While his trials represent the philosophy of the hunter's way and are thematic for the hunter class, Melor offers his hunting contracts to any capable adventurer fighting for the Horde.
al: can other classes do melor quests
faq.q: Do you need to be a hunter class to take his quests?

faq.a: Sergra Darkthorn is an orc huntress stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Melor directs promising hunters to her so they can aid in subduing the unruly predators of the plains and learn from another veteran of the wild.
faq.q: Who is Sergra Darkthorn, and why does Melor send you to her?

text.s: Melor Stonehoof is a veteran tauren huntsman stationed atop Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. As a mentor in the ways of the hunt, he tests the tracking prowess and mettle of Horde hunters by sending them after the most dangerous predatory beasts across the Barrens and Thousand Needles.

sec.b: Perched upon the breezy expanse of Hunter Rise, Melor Stonehoof observes the plains below with a practiced eye. The art of the hunt is sacred to the tauren, entwined with survival, spiritual balance, and respect for nature's greatest predators. Melor ensures that those who carry bow and blade in the name of the Horde understand this balance, directing promising stalkers to master their craft through trials against legendary beasts.

Melor challenges hunters to seek out legendary and elusive beasts that terrorize the wild. He directs trackers across the plains of the Barrens, from aiding the huntress Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads to pursuing Steelsnap, a cunning and vicious hyena in Thousand Needles. Through these trials, hunters prove they can outsmart and outfight the deadliest creatures of central Kalimdor.

For those whose skills exceed the Barrens, Melor points toward far-off lands. He charges seasoned hunters with bringing down beasts of terrifying strength, including Deadmire, an ancient crocolisk lurking in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh, and the savage yeti Frostmaw of the Alterac Mountains. Each hunt serves to test whether a stalker has truly mastered the Hunter's Way.

npc:menara-voidrender.s: Menara Nadiz. Menara Nadiz es una bruja humana que reside en el puerto goblin de Trinquete. Actúa como mentora para ambiciosos practicantes de las artes oscuras procedentes tanto de la Alianza como de la Horda, compartiendo sus profundos conocimientos sobre artefactos de atadura demoníaca y artesanía arcana. Su posición aislada en Kalimdor la mantiene lejos de la atenta mirada de las autoridades ortodoxas. Mientras la mayoría de los brujos de los Reinos del Este practican en sótanos húmedos o en mataderos apartados bajo sus ciudades de origen, Menara Nadiz eligió el neutral puerto goblin de Trinquete, en Los Baldíos. Al operar lejos del escrutinio del Kirin Tor, de los guardias de Ventormenta o de los capataces de Orgrimmar, es libre de dedicarse a sus estudios ocultistas a la vista de todos. Su disposición a tratar con cualquier aprendiz capaz, sin importar su facción, la convierte en un insólito punto de encuentro entre los practicantes de las artes oscuras.

ang.class:Warlock: Menara is a vital mentor on Kalimdor, teaching practitioners from both factions how to forge their signature enchanted robes and bind demons into focus orbs.
ang.profession:Tailoring: Menara blends advanced tailoring materials with fel reagents to weave durable, spell-woven vestments capable of channeling demonic power.
ang.race:Human: Far from Stormwind's catacombs, Menara represents human warlocks who cast aside kingdom loyalties to pursue dark arts unhindered in neutral territories.

faq.a: Menara Voidrender is a human warlock stationed in the neutral port town of Ratchet in the Barrens. She serves as an instructor and artificer for developing warlocks, guiding them through crafting rituals and demon-binding sorcery.
al: who is the warlock in ratchet
faq.q: Who is Menara Voidrender?

faq.a: Ratchet offers neutrality and distance from the watchful eyes of major governments. By basing herself in a goblin-run port, Menara can practice forbidden arts and instruct students from both the Alliance and the Horde without interference from paladins, mages, or city guards.
al: why is she in the barrens
faq.q: Why is a human warlock living in the Barrens?

faq.a: Menara specializes in demonology, enchanting dark fabrics, and fashioning vessels designed to trap demonic entities. She is especially known for her mastery in creating and restoring orbs that bind demons, such as the Orb of Orahil.
faq.q: What kind of magic does Menara specialize in?

faq.a: Menara and the reclusive sorceress Tabetha share a past connection. Despite Tabetha living secluded in Dustwallow Marsh and practicing traditional wizardry, warlocks seeking knowledge regarding the Orb of Orahil find that the two women are familiar with each other's talents.
faq.q: What is Menara's connection to Tabetha?

faq.a: Menara operates neutrally out of Ratchet. She offers her tutelage and crafting tasks to any warlock who proves competent and ambitious enough to handle fel energies, welcoming both Alliance and Horde practitioners.
faq.q: Does Menara favor the Alliance or the Horde?

faq.a: Menara directs apprentices in weaving the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a garment imbued with demonic power, and assists advanced practitioners in recovering and assembling components for the Orb of Orahil.
faq.q: What major artifacts does she help create?

text.s: Menara Voidrender is a human warlock residing in the goblin port of Ratchet. She acts as a mentor to ambitious practitioners of the dark arts from both the Alliance and the Horde, sharing her deep knowledge of demon-binding artifacts and arcane craft. Her secluded position in Kalimdor keeps her far from the watchful eyes of orthodox authorities.

sec.b: While most warlocks in the Eastern Kingdoms practice in damp cellars or secluded slaughterhouses beneath their home cities, Menara Voidrender chose the neutral goblin port of Ratchet in the Barrens. Operating far from the scrutiny of the Kirin Tor, Stormwind's guards, or Orgrimmar's overseers, she is free to pursue her occult studies in plain sight. Her willingness to deal with any capable apprentice, regardless of faction, makes her a rare point of commonality among practitioners of the dark arts.

Menara is renowned among veteran conjurers as an authority on creating orbs that imprison and harness demonic spirits. She works closely with intricate reagents, guiding apprentices through demanding rituals to forge enchanted attire and binding implements. Word of her expertise reaches as far as Ironforge and the Undercity, leading senior warlocks across Azeroth to direct their most promising students across the sea to seek her counsel.

Among Menara's distant acquaintances is the hermit mage Tabetha, who lives in deep isolation in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh. Though Tabetha pursues the arcane and Menara delves into fel bindings and demonology, the two women share an old history. When powerful relics like the Orb of Orahil require restoration or specialized knowledge, their shared past becomes an unexpected bridge across Kalimdor's wilderness.

npc:miner-johnson.s: Minero Johnson. El Minero Johnson es un minero esquivo y curtido, afiliado a la Hermandad Defias en lo más profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte. Oculto en una alcoba lateral junto a peones comunes, este peligroso prospector supervisa las labores de excavación antes de llegar a la maquinaria pesada de las profundidades subterráneas. Como vaga de manera impredecible por los túneles subterráneos, los aventureros solo se cruzan con él en contadas ocasiones. Mientras cientos de trabajadores pican las vetas subterráneas de Las Minas de la Muerte para abastecer la fortaleza oculta de Edwin VanCleef, el Minero Johnson destaca entre ellos como una figura inusualmente formidable. Acechando en una sombría alcoba a la izquierda antes de los pesados trituradores de la Sala de los Mástiles, es mucho más resistente y agresivo que la plantilla habitual. Su impredecible presencia lo convierte en un objetivo legendario para los exploradores que atraviesan los túneles Defias.

ang.faction:Alliance: Striking down Johnson disrupts the steady stream of smeltable ore flowing into the Defias war machine hidden below Moonbrook.
ang.profession:Mining: For prospectors, Johnson represents the rugged, lawless side of subterranean labor, guarding rich mineral deposits deep beneath Westfall with blood and pickaxe.

faq.a: Miner Johnson is a rare elite human miner allied with the Defias Brotherhood. He works deep within the Deadmines, situated in a side alcove with other laborers just before the goblin shredder.
faq.q: Who is Miner Johnson?

faq.a: He can be found in the upper shafts of the Deadmines before reaching the room housing Sneed and his shredder. Look for a small excavation alcove off to the left where a pocket of miners are actively chipping away at the rock.
faq.q: Where exactly is Miner Johnson located?

faq.a: Miner Johnson is a rare spawn, meaning he only appears occasionally when an expedition enters the Deadmines. Most groups running through the mine shafts will find an ordinary miner in his place instead.
faq.q: Why isn't Miner Johnson always there?

faq.a: Miner Johnson is not associated with any formal quest bounty. He is simply an opportunistic encounter for dungeon delve parties lucky enough to find him working the seam.
al: does miner johnson have a quest
faq.q: Is Miner Johnson part of any quest?

faq.a: He is an experienced foreman or master digger helping the Defias Brotherhood extract precious metal, stone, and resources necessary to construct their massive underground base and hidden juggernaut.
faq.q: What is Miner Johnson's role in the Deadmines?

faq.a: Yes. While the standard diggers throughout the Deadmines are relatively fragile, Miner Johnson is an elite combatant with significantly more vitality and striking power, requiring a coordinated group to bring down safely.
faq.q: Is Miner Johnson dangerous compared to other miners?

text.s: Miner Johnson is an elusive, seasoned miner affiliated with the Defias Brotherhood deep inside the Deadmines. Tucked away in a side alcove alongside ordinary laborers, this dangerous prospector oversees excavation efforts ahead of the heavy machinery found deeper underground. Because he wanders the subterranean tunnels erratically, adventurers only occasionally cross his path.

sec.b: While hundreds of laborers pick at the subterranean veins of the Deadmines to supply Edwin VanCleef's hidden fortress, Miner Johnson stands out as an unusually formidable figure among them. Lurking in a shadowed alcove to the left before the lumbering shredders of the Mast Room, he is far tougher and more aggressive than the regular workforce. His unpredictable presence makes him a legendary target for explorers traversing the Defias tunnels.
sec.t: A Rare Face in the Deep

sec.b: The Defias Brotherhood's clandestine operation beneath Moonbrook requires vast amounts of raw ore to forge weapons, reinforce shafts, and assemble mechanical contraptions. Miners like Johnson provide the muscle behind the metal, hacking away at the rich mineral seams beneath Westfall. Anyone stumbling into Johnson's workspace will quickly discover that he defends his dig site with lethal fervor.

npc:motega-firemane.s: Motega Pirocabello. Motega Pirocabello es un erudito tauren apostado en el Campamento del Tramo Blanco en Las Mil Agujas. Dedicado a catalogar la peligrosa fauna del cañón, ve interrumpidos sus estudios por el espíritu vengativo de una serpiente alada y las temerarias desventuras de su joven ayudante. Cuatro años después de la Tercera Guerra, Motega Pirocabello viajó hacia el sur, a Las Mil Agujas, para observar y registrar a las singulares bestias que sobrevivían entre las imponentes mesetas. Acompañado por su joven ayudante, Pao'ka Velocimontés —cuyo protector padre se resistía a dejarlo marchar de Mulgore—, Motega montó un campamento junto a Kanati Nubegris en el Campamento del Tramo Blanco. Aunque su vocación original era la tranquila observación natural, los duros peligros del fondo del cañón exigen constantemente un enfoque más marcial para sobrevivir.

ang.class:Hunter: Hunters find common ground with Motega, who relies on skilled trackers to harvest canyon flora, track wyverns in Highperch, and stalk the mighty spirit Arikara.
ang.faction:Horde: Motega represents the Horde's expansion into the untamed regions of Kalimdor, maintaining a tenuous research outpost while safeguarding High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof from spiritual threats.
ang.race:Tauren: Through his reverence for nature and dutiful devotion to Cairne Bloodhoof, Motega embodies the tauren ethos of studying the Earth Mother's creatures while defending the tribe against ancient spirits.

faq.a: Motega Firemane is a tauren researcher stationed at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. He came to the canyons to study the local wildlife alongside fellow braves and his assistant, Pao'ka Swiftmountain.
faq.q: Who is Motega Firemane?

faq.a: He is located at Whitereach Post, a small Horde campsite nestled along the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, situated north of the shimmering salt flats.
faq.q: Where can Motega Firemane be found?

faq.a: Arikara is a vengeful serpent spirit that has manifested in Thousand Needles targeting Cairne Bloodhoof. Though baffled as to why the spirit bears a grudge against the High Chieftain, Motega takes the threat seriously and directs hunters to summon and eliminate the creature.
faq.q: Why is Motega concerned about Arikara?

faq.a: Motega tasks adventurers with collecting Incendia agave and carrying it to Magatha Grimtotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Magatha uses her shamanic knowledge to enchant the plant into a sacred powder capable of summoning the elusive Arikara.
faq.q: What role does Magatha Grimtotem play in Motega's plans?

faq.a: Pao'ka Swiftmountain strayed into the dangerous wyvern roosts of Highperch and became lost. Motega was anxious over the youth's fate, especially given how reluctant Pao'ka's father had been to allow the journey, but travelers successfully escorted him back to Whitereach Post.
faq.q: What happened to Motega's companion, Pao'ka?

faq.a: Beyond rogue spirits and predators, the camp is actively targeted by the nearby Galak centaur, who orchestrate ambushes and plot assassinations against Kanati Greycloud and the other tauren stationed at the post.
faq.q: What other dangers does Whitereach Post face?

text.s: Motega Firemane is a tauren scholar stationed at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. Dedicated to cataloging the dangerous wildlife of the canyon, he finds his studies disrupted by a vengeful wind serpent spirit and the reckless misadventures of his young assistant.

sec.b: Four years following the Third War, Motega Firemane journeyed south into Thousand Needles to observe and record the distinct beasts surviving among the towering mesas. Accompanied by his youthful assistant, Pao'ka Swiftmountain—whose protective father was reluctant to let him leave Mulgore—Motega set up camp alongside Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post. While his original calling was quiet natural observation, the harsh perils of the canyon floor continually demand a more martial approach to survival.

Motega's peaceful research was upended when word arrived from Freewind Post that Arikara, a ferocious and legendary winged serpent spirit, had returned to the canyons seeking vengeance against Cairne Bloodhoof. Perplexed by why such a creature held a vendetta against the High Chieftain, Motega acted swiftly to protect the Horde. He instructed scouts to gather Incendia agave from the canyon basin and carry it to Elder Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff to be enchanted into a sacred powder. Using this preparation, hunters summoned and slew the serpent spirit, returning its hide to Whitereach Post as proof that Cairne was safe.

Arikara was not the only hazard challenging Motega's stay at Whitereach Post. Local Galak centaur continuously probed the camp, even scheming an assassination plot against Kanati Greycloud and his followers. To worsen matters, young Pao'ka wandered away from the safety of the campfire and vanished into the wyvern-infested heights of Highperch. Though frustrated by the young brave's thoughtlessness, Motega was immensely relieved when Horde travelers escorted the youth back alive.

npc:mr-smite.s: Don Mamporro. Don Mamporro es el imponente tauren y primer oficial que sirve a bordo del buque insignia de la Hermandad Defias en las profundidades de Las Minas de la Muerte. Experto maestro de armas a las órdenes del Capitán Verdetez, vigila el acceso del muelle hacia el gigante oculto con una disciplina implacable. Los intrusos que se enfrentan a él deben lidiar con su arsenal cambiante y su demoledora fuerza física. Al custodiar los muelles de la Cala del Acorazado, Don Mamporro ejerce como primer oficial del goblin Capitán Verdetez. Si bien la Hermandad Defias está compuesta predominantemente por humanos descontentos y manitas goblin aliados, Don Mamporro destaca como una sorprendente anomalía: un tauren gigantesco y curtido en combate, muy lejos de las llanuras de Kalimdor. Encargado de mantener un orden férreo entre una tripulación pirata alborotadora, se asegura de que los trabajos de preparación del acorazado secreto de Edwin VanCleef prosigan sin interrupciones.

ang.class:Warrior: Smite demonstrates remarkable martial discipline, seamlessly transitioning between swift single-handed strikes, dual-wielded axes, and punishing two-handed hammer blows.
ang.faction:Alliance: Smite serves as the primary barrier preventing Alliance agents from storming the gangplank to reach Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef.
ang.race:Tauren: Seeing a fellow tauren serving as a cutthroat first mate among seafaring outlaws in the Eastern Kingdoms is a jarring sight for any traveler from Mulgore.

faq.a: While the vast majority of tauren dwell in Kalimdor alongside their Horde allies, mercenary outcasts and wanderers occasionally find their way east. Smite serves as a pirate officer rather than an ideological follower of the Defias Brotherhood, hired alongside Captain Greenskin's crew to supervise the cove and ready the dreadnaught for sea.
faq.q: Why is a tauren working with human bandits in Westfall?

faq.a: Smite answers directly to Captain Greenskin, the goblin master of the pirate vessel anchored in Ironclad Cove. Above them both in the overall conspiracy stands Edwin VanCleef, the grand leader of the Defias Brotherhood.
al: who does mr smite work for
faq.q: Who is Mr. Smite's superior?

faq.a: Smite begins battle with a Thief's Blade. As the fight turns against him, he retreats to his chest to equip a pair of Smite's Reavers, and finally draws out Smite's Mighty Hammer when pushed to his limits.
al: what does smite pull out of the chest
faq.q: What weapons does Mr. Smite use during the fight?

faq.a: Mr. Smite stands watch on the wooden piers of Ironclad Cove, the final cavern within the Deadmines, guarding the gangplank leading up to the giant Defias dreadnaught.
faq.q: Where can Mr. Smite be found?

faq.a: Smite keeps two stealthy Defias rogues hidden at his side, ready to ambush any trespassers who advance down the pier toward the ship.
faq.q: Does Mr. Smite fight alone?

faq.a: His signature tauren War Stomp sends shockwaves through the wooden dock, stunning entire parties of adventurers long enough for him to rearm himself from his footlocker and resume the assault with heavier weaponry.
faq.q: What makes Mr. Smite so dangerous in close quarters?

text.s: Mr. Smite is the imposing tauren first mate serving aboard the Defias Brotherhood's flagship deep inside the Deadmines. An expert weaponmaster under Captain Greenskin, he commands the dockside approach to the hidden juggernaut with ruthless discipline. Intruders who face him must contend with his shifting arsenal and devastating physical strength.

sec.b: Guarding the docks of Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite serves as first mate to the goblin Captain Greenskin. While the Defias Brotherhood is predominantly composed of disenfranchised humans and allied goblin tinkerers, Smite stands as a striking anomaly: a massive, battle-hardened tauren far from the plains of Kalimdor. Tasked with maintaining strict order among a rowdy pirate crew, he ensures that the labor fitting out Edwin VanCleef's secret dreadnaught proceeds without disruption.

Smite is not merely a brute enforcer; he is a theatrical and versatile weaponmaster. He delights in toying with would-be heroes, deliberately prolonging combat to offer opponents a false sense of hope. When pressed, he unleashes a staggering, earth-shattering stomp that leaves foes stunned while he rummages through his nearby weapon chest. Beginning combat with a nimble dueling blade, he will escalate to twin cleaving reavers, and finally resort to his colossal two-handed warhammer when thoroughly provoked.

npc:mull-thunderhorn.s: Mull Tronacuerno. Mull Tronacuerno es un anciano tauren que reside en el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre, en Mulgore. Profundamente devoto de la Madre Tierra y del equilibrio de la tierra, vela por los pozos de agua sagrados dispersos por las llanuras. Mientras explotadores forasteros amenazan las aguas vivificantes de la región, Mull guía a los jóvenes tauren a través de los rituales necesarios para purificar los manantiales ancestrales. Haciendo guardia en el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre, Mull Tronacuerno carga con el peso del bienestar espiritual de Mulgore. Las tribus nómadas se han reunido bajo el mando del Gran jefe Cairne Pezuña de Sangre para establecer un hogar permanente, pero sus tierras ya se encuentran asediadas por la codicia y la expansión imprudente. Mull sirve como ancla espiritual para los jóvenes valientes que salen del Campamento Narache, llamándolos a salvaguardar los recursos vitales de sus ancestros.

ang.class:Druid: Druids share Mull's urgency, witnessing firsthand how the corrupted water wells poison the balance of Mulgore's wildlife.
ang.class:Shaman: Shaman will recognize Mull's reliance on elemental harmony, as his cleansing totems utilize ancestral spirits to mend waters torn by mechanical greed.
ang.faction:Horde: Mull's struggle underscores the Horde's friction with unaligned, exploitative organizations like the Venture Company that strip Kalimdor's riches without consent.
ang.race:Tauren: For the tauren, Mull Thunderhorn represents tribal memory and ancestral duty, guiding young braves in protecting the sacred plains against greedy foreign invaders.

faq.a: Mull Thunderhorn is a tauren quest giver situated in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He acts as a guardian of the sacred water wells in the area, offering rites and rituals to keep the earth and its waters pure from external contamination.
faq.q: Who is Mull Thunderhorn?

faq.a: The ancestral water wells—such as the Winterhoof, Thunderhorn, and Wildmane wells—are life-giving sources for the tribes and wildlife of Mulgore. Intrusive operations nearby have tainted these sacred springs with noxious runoff and pollution, threatening the natural balance of the plains.
