faq.q: Why is Mull Thunderhorn worried about the water wells?

faq.a: The pollution is caused by the Venture Company, a reckless goblin enterprise establishing industrial mining and logging footholds across the edges of Mulgore. Their operations show no regard for the sacred landscape, spilling industrial toxins into the local water table.
faq.q: Who is polluting the water wells in Mulgore?

faq.a: The water wells hold deep ancestral and spiritual significance tied to the founding lineages of the tauren tribes—including the Thunderhorn, Winterhoof, and Wildmane clans. Cleansing them is viewed as a sacred rite of passage and cultural duty for maturing tauren.
faq.q: Why do Mull's purification quests only involve tauren?

faq.a: Mull instructs travelers to assemble specially consecrated totems imbued with local natural reagents, such as claws and hides. Once consecrated, these totems are brought directly to the fouled wells to channel spiritual purification and wash away the unnatural toxins.
faq.q: How are the water wells purified?

faq.a: The Rite of Vision is a foundational spiritual journey undertaken by young tauren to commune with their ancestors and animal spirits. Initiates are sent to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village to undertake this visionary trial as one of the Rites of the Earthmother.
faq.q: What is the Rite of Vision?

text.s: Mull Thunderhorn is a tauren elder residing in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Deeply devoted to the Earth Mother and the balance of the land, he watches over the sacred water wells scattered across the plains. As outside exploiters threaten the region's lifegiving waters, Mull guides young tauren through the rituals required to cleanse the ancestral springs.

sec.b: Standing watch in Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn carries the weight of Mulgore's spiritual well-being. The nomadic tribes have gathered under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to establish a permanent home, yet their lands are already under siege by greed and reckless expansion. Mull serves as a spiritual anchor for the young braves stepping out of Camp Narache, calling upon them to safeguard the vital resources of their ancestors.

The primary crisis facing Mull is the sudden sickness spreading through Mulgore's water sources: the Winterhoof, Thunderhorn, and Wildmane water wells. This foul affliction is traced to the goblins of the Venture Company, an unscrupulous commercial outfit carving operations into the surrounding hills and dumping poisons into the local water table. Mull directs young tauren to prepare specific purification totems and perform cleansing rites at each ancestral well before the corruption spreads irrevocably into the land and its wildlife.
sec.t: Tainted Wells and the Venture Company

npc:mutanus-the-devourer.s: Mutanus el Devorador. Mutanus el Devorador es un monstruoso y pálido múrloc manifestado directamente a partir de la Pesadilla Esmeralda. Al acecho en los rincones más oscuros de la mente de Naralex, el druida durmiente, emerge para devorar a cualquiera que intente romper el dominio de la Pesadilla sobre las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Matar a esta aberración retorcida es el paso final para liberar a Naralex de su tormentoso letargo. Cuando el druida elfo de la noche Naralex canalizó los manantiales subterráneos bajo Los Baldíos, su objetivo era devolver la vida a los páramos áridos conectándolos con El Sueño Esmeralda. En su lugar, una antigua corrupción conocida como la Pesadilla Esmeralda invadió sus pensamientos. Atrapado en una visión agonizante, los miedos subconscientes de Naralex tomaron forma física. La corrupción se aprovechó de una extraña y primaria repulsión en la psique del druida (su arraigado terror a los múrlocs) y la amplificó hasta convertirla en un inmenso depredador albino.

ang.class:Druid: Mutanus represents the terrifying hazards of delving too deeply into the Emerald Dream without safeguards, as a fellow druid's mind was completely overtaken by corruption.
ang.faction:Horde: The Horde cannot allow Mutanus and the Nightmare to corrupt the heart of the Barrens, threatening the vital oasis waters needed to sustain Durotar and Mulgore.
ang.race:NightElf: For the kaldorei, Mutanus is a tragedy brought to life, embodying how Naralex's noble ambitions to heal the Barrens warped into a monstrous nightmare.

faq.a: Mutanus the Devourer is an enormous, pale murloc-like aberration born from the Emerald Nightmare. He is not a normal denizen of Azeroth, but a living nightmare summoned into reality from the corrupted mind of the sleeping druid Naralex.
al: what kind of creature is mutanus
faq.q: What is Mutanus the Devourer?

faq.a: The Nightmare twisted Naralex's subconscious thoughts and drew out his worst personal enemy: murlocs. The corruption weaponized that deep-seated fear, manifesting it as a colossal albino monstrosity.
faq.q: Why does Mutanus look like a giant murloc?

faq.a: The dark presence corrupting the Emerald Dream ordered Mutanus to prevent anyone from breaking Naralex's slumber. When Naralex's disciples begin the awakening ritual, Mutanus crosses over into the physical cavern to devour the rescuers.
faq.q: Why does Mutanus appear at the end of the ritual?

faq.a: Mutanus originates from the Emerald Nightmare, the corrupted realm that has ensnared Naralex. Crossing over from the dreamscape into Azeroth, he even brought along strange relics like the Deep Fathom Ring.
faq.q: Where does Mutanus come from?

faq.a: Yes. Once Mutanus is slain, the nightmare's immediate hold over Naralex's mind is shattered, allowing his disciples to successfully awaken the druid and break the cavern's dark trance.
faq.q: Does killing Mutanus save Naralex?

faq.a: Mutanus is an aberration woven from dark nightmare energies, making him naturally resilient against necrotic and shadow spells that would harm mundane beasts.
faq.q: Why is Mutanus immune to shadow magic?

text.s: Mutanus the Devourer is a monstrous, pale murloc manifested directly from the Emerald Nightmare. Lurking in the darkest recesses of the sleeping druid Naralex's mind, it emerges to devour anyone attempting to break the Nightmare's hold over the Wailing Caverns. Slaying this twisted aberration is the final step in freeing Naralex from his tormented slumber.

sec.b: When the night elf druid Naralex tapped into the underground springs beneath the Barrens, he aimed to restore life to the arid wastes by connecting them to the Emerald Dream. Instead, an ancient corruption known as the Emerald Nightmare invaded his thoughts. Trapped in an agonizing vision, Naralex's subconscious fears took physical form. The corruption seized upon a bizarre, primal revulsion in the druid's psyche—his deep-seated terror of murlocs—and amplified it into an immense, albino predator.

Mutanus was sent forth into the waking world by the dark force infesting Naralex's mind, tasked with ensuring the druid never awakens. When a Disciple of Naralex performs the ritual to revive their master, Mutanus breaches the boundary between dream and reality. Along with his unnatural form, he brings alien relics from the dreamscape, such as the mysterious Deep Fathom Ring. Until Mutanus falls, Naralex remains a prisoner of his own corrupted imagination.

npc:naralex.s: Naralex. Naralex es un elfo de la noche druida que intentó restaurar los marchitos Baldíos para convertirlos en un bosque exuberante usando los poderes del Sueño Esmeralda. En su lugar, una oscura pesadilla se apoderó de su letargo, deformando las Cuevas de los Lamentos bajo tierra y transformando a sus seguidores en engendros venenosos. Mucho antes del Gran Cataclismo, las llanuras abrasadas por el sol de Los Baldíos fueron antaño un bosque vibrante. Al considerar esta pérdida como una tragedia, Naralex viajó al sur desde Darnassus con una cohorte de devotos discípulos para revertir la sequía. En las profundidades bajo la sabana, descubrió una intrincada red subterránea de manantiales y géiseres impetuosos, a los que llamó las Cuevas de los Lamentos por el viento aullante y el vapor que gemían a través de la roca. Creía que, al entrar en un profundo trance y canalizar las energías puras del Sueño Esmeralda hacia estas aguas subterráneas, el caudal vivificante alcanzaría la superficie y haría florecer todo el páramo.

ang.class:Druid: Naralex serves as a grim cautionary tale to druids: meddling blindly with primal natural states or tapping too deeply into the Dream without caution can unleash catastrophic perversions of the wild.
ang.faction:Horde: A night elf's failed mystical experiment has polluted the heart of the Barrens, forcing Horde forces from the Crossroads to deal with the rampaging beasts boiling up from the cavern.
ang.race:NightElf: While Naralex sought to heal Kalimdor, his unchecked ambition deep in Horde territory brought disgrace to the Cenarion Circle and spawned the treacherous Druids of the Fang.
ang.race:Tauren: The twisted waters beneath the Barrens pose an immediate threat to the oasis pools and wildlife that sustain the tribes of Mulgore and the savannah.

faq.a: Naralex is a night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle. He led an expedition into the Wailing Caverns with the goal of tapping into the Emerald Dream to turn the arid Barrens back into the lush forest it had been before the Sundering.
faq.q: Who is Naralex?

faq.a: He entered a meditative trance to channel energies directly from the Emerald Dream into the underground aquifers beneath the Barrens. However, an overwhelming nightmare seized his mind, trapping him in a fevered slumber that he cannot wake from on his own.
faq.q: Why is Naralex asleep inside the Wailing Caverns?

faq.a: They were originally Naralex's faithful disciples. When the Emerald Nightmare corrupted Naralex's dream connection, the leaking malice drove his followers insane. They abandoned the Cenarion Circle, embraced serpent totems, and now protect his slumber to keep the corruption spreading.
al: who are druids of the fang
faq.q: What created the Druids of the Fang?

faq.a: Naralex's sleeping body became an open conduit for the Emerald Nightmare. The foul dream energies seeped directly into the subterranean river system, warping the caverns' plants, crocodiles, raptors, and serpents into aggressive deviate mutants.
faq.q: What caused the Wailing Caverns to mutate?

faq.a: Yes, with outside help. His remaining loyal disciple, Muyoh, works with adventurers willing to enter the depths, slay the twisted Druids of the Fang, and perform a ritual to break the grip of the nightmare on Naralex's mind.
faq.q: Can Naralex be awakened?

faq.a: Naralex learned that the Barrens was once a flourishing forest before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor. He saw its current arid condition as an ecological wound and wished to restore its ancient verdant canopy.
faq.q: Why did Naralex want to change the Barrens?

text.s: Naralex is a night elf druid who sought to restore the parched Barrens to a lush forest using the powers of the Emerald Dream. Instead, his slumber was overtaken by a dark nightmare, twisting the Wailing Caverns beneath the earth and turning his followers into venomous fiends.

sec.b: Long before the Great Sundering, the sun-scorched plains of the Barrens were once a vibrant forest. Viewing this loss as a tragedy, Naralex journeyed south from Darnassus with a cohort of devoted disciples to reverse the drought. Deep beneath the savannah, he discovered an intricate subterranean network of underground springs and rushing geysers, naming them the Wailing Caverns after the howling wind and steam that moaned through the rock. He believed that by entering a deep trance and channeling the pristine energies of the Emerald Dream into these subterranean waters, the life-giving flow would reach the surface and cause the entire wasteland to bloom.

Naralex seated himself in deep meditation deep within the subterranean caverns, but his noble design collapsed the moment his consciousness touched the realm of the Dream. Rather than finding peaceful fonts of wild nature, his mind was ensnared by a malignant, encroaching corruption—an Emerald Nightmare. The festering corruption seized the sleeping druid's body, transforming him into an open conduit through which dark energies bled into the living world. The pristine springs turned foul, sprouting mutated fungal blooms and warping the native beasts of the caverns into ravenous deviate horrors.

The nightmare did not stop with the wildlife. Naralex's own disciples, driven completely mad by the psychic backlash bleeding out of their master's trance, broke away from the traditions of the Cenarion Circle. Casting aside their reverence for balance, they took on serpent forms and renamed themselves the Druids of the Fang. Believing their twisted growth must spread across Kalimdor, they now guard Naralex's slumbering body to ensure he never wakes, leaving only a few loyal disciples, such as Muyoh, searching for allies brave enough to break the trance.

npc:oggleflint.s: Ogglesílex. Ogglesílex es el cabecilla de la tribu de troggs que habita en las profundidades volcánicas de la Sima Ígnea, directamente bajo Orgrimmar. Antaño amo de toda la caverna subterránea, él y sus congéneres se han visto empujados hacia los túneles superiores por la llegada de los sectarios de la Hoja Ardiente. Ahora atrincherado cerca de la entrada, comanda a su salvaje manada y supone una amenaza inmediata para la capital de la Horda que se alza sobre ellos. Antes de que los sectarios de las sombras se infiltraran en la sima situada bajo Orgrimmar, Ogglesílex y sus troggs dominaban sin oposición los ardientes túneles subterráneos. Brutales y territoriales, forjaron un dominio primitivo entre la roca fundida. Aunque los troggs carecen prácticamente de civilización avanzada, Ogglesílex mantuvo una autoridad absoluta sobre la manada a base de pura fuerza bruta.

ang.class:Warrior: Facing Oggleflint means confronting a heavy brute who relies entirely on raw muscle and primal rage rather than armor or discipline.
ang.faction:Horde: Living directly beneath Thrall's fortress, Oggleflint's troggs represent a wild, unpredictable security risk right in the heart of Durotar.
ang.race:Orc: For young orcs proving their mettle in the trial of arms, slaying the chieftain lurking right under the Drag is an early test of martial discipline.

faq.a: Oggleflint is a powerful trogg chieftain who leads the pack inhabiting Ragefire Chasm beneath the city of Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Who is Oggleflint?

faq.a: He is located in the upper caverns of Ragefire Chasm, not far from the entrance tunnel, where his surviving clan made camp after being pushed out of the deeper reaches.
faq.q: Where can Oggleflint be found?

faq.a: Troggs naturally dwell deep underground in subterranean volcanic networks. Oggleflint's pack claimed the fiery caverns beneath Durotar long before the Searing Blade cult arrived.
faq.q: Why are the troggs in Ragefire Chasm?

faq.a: Troggs are fiercely territorial and violent beasts by nature. Pushed toward the surface by cultists, Oggleflint and his followers pose an imminent danger to the Horde tunnels and the city above.
faq.q: Why is Oggleflint hostile to the Horde?

faq.a: They are bitter enemies. The Searing Blade cultists invaded Ragefire Chasm and overpowered Oggleflint's troggs, driving the survivors into the upper caves.
faq.q: What is Oggleflint's relationship with the Searing Blade?

text.s: Oggleflint is the chieftain of the trogg tribe dwelling within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm directly beneath Orgrimmar. Once master of the entire subterranean cavern, he and his kin have been pushed toward the upper tunnels by the arrival of the Searing Blade cultists. Now entrenched near the entrance, he commands his savage pack and poses an immediate threat to the Horde capital above.

sec.b: Before shadow cultists infiltrated the chasm beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint and his troggs ruled the fiery subterranean tunnels uncontested. Brutal and territorial, they carved out a primitive domain among the molten rock. Though troggs possess little in the way of advanced civilization, Oggleflint maintained absolute authority over the pack through sheer brute strength.

The balance of power beneath the city shattered when the Searing Blade moved into the deepest chambers of Ragefire Chasm. Unable to match the dark magic and coordinated zealots of the cult, Oggleflint was forced to cede the lower tunnels. Retreating upward, the trogg chieftain now waits near the cavern entrance, striking at any outsiders while nursing grudges against the interlopers below.

Having displaced troggs directly beneath Thrall's capital is a hazard the Horde cannot tolerate. Pushed closer to the surface, Oggleflint's tribe is far too volatile to leave unchecked, threatening to spill into the Drag and Cleft of Shadows if left undisturbed.

npc:old-serra-kis.s: Viejo Serra'kis. El Viejo Serra'kis es un antiguo y descomunal trilladón que mora en las aguas subterráneas sumergidas de Cavernas de Brazanegra. Aunque los invasores del Martillo Crepuscular sacrificaron gran parte de la vida acuática del templo para aprovisionarse, esta enorme bestia resultó ser letal para cualquiera que intentara cazarla. Cuando los sectarios del Martillo Crepuscular descendieron a las sumergidas Ruinas del Santuario Lunar, masacraron la fauna nativa bajo las aguas para alimentarse. Sin embargo, bajo el Santuario Lunar, una criatura primigenia se negó a convertirse en presa. El Viejo Serra'kis, el trilladón más grande del templo sumergido, despachó rápidamente a cualquier sectario lo bastante insensato como para intentar clavarle un arpón. Con el tiempo, los cazadores abandonaron su empeño y dejaron al antiguo carnívoro tranquilo en su dominio acuático.

ang.class:Druid: Druids of the wild will find Aquatic Form indispensable when diving into the lightless pool to confront this prehistoric predator.
ang.class:Shaman: Water Breathing spells granted by spiritual communion with the elements ensure your companions don't drown while grappling with the ancient thresher.
ang.class:Warlock: A warlock's ability to bestow Unending Breath turns an otherwise deadly, airless subterranean ambush into a manageable fight.

faq.a: Old Serra'kis is a massive, ancient threshadon—a long-necked, aquatic reptile native to the lakes and coastal waters of Azeroth.
faq.q: What kind of creature is Old Serra'kis?

faq.a: The cult slaughtered most aquatic life beneath the Moonshrine Ruins for food, but Serra'kis was too powerful and cunning. Cultists who persisted in attempting to hunt him inevitably ended up as his meals instead, leading the cult to avoid his cave entirely.
faq.q: Why didn't the Twilight's Hammer kill him?

faq.a: He lurks in a submerged cavern beneath the water surrounding the Moonshrine Sanctum within Blackfathom Deeps. Swimmers must dive under the ruins into an airless pool to encounter him.
faq.q: Where is Old Serra'kis located?

faq.a: Beyond fighting entirely underwater without natural pockets of air, Old Serra'kis leeches shadow energy from all nearby foes to heal his own wounds throughout combat.
faq.q: What makes fighting him dangerous?

faq.a: No. Unlike other beasts corrupted or trained by the cult, Old Serra'kis remains a completely untamed wild predator defending his subterranean lair.
faq.q: Does Serra'kis serve the Twilight's Hammer?

faq.a: His enclosed cave offers no ceiling air pockets, forcing underwater fighters to either manage their breath, use magical water-breathing aid, or kite the beast out toward open water.
faq.q: Can you breathe during the battle with Serra'kis?

text.s: Old Serra'kis is an ancient, massive threshadon dwelling in the submerged subterranean waters of Blackfathom Deeps. While the invading Twilight's Hammer culled much of the temple's aquatic life for provisions, this enormous beast proved entirely lethal to any who attempted to hunt it.

sec.b: When the Twilight's Hammer cultists descended upon the sunken Moonshrine Ruins, they slaughtered the native wildlife beneath the waters for sustenance. Yet beneath the Moonshrine Sanctum, one primeval creature refused to become prey. Old Serra'kis, the largest threshadon in the sunken temple, made short work of any cultist brazen enough to spear him. Eventually, the hunters abandoned their efforts, leaving the ancient carnivore undisturbed in his watery domain.

Reaching Old Serra'kis requires plunging deep beneath the temple floor into a flooded cavern beneath the ruins. Lacking air pockets, the cave itself is as deadly as the beast within. Those who corner him find that Serra'kis possesses an unnatural shadow-leeching resilience, draining the life from his attackers while sustaining his own vitality in the murky darkness.

npc:orgnil-soulscar.s: Orgnil Escaralma. Orgnil Escaralma es un investigador orco apostado en Cerrotajo, en el centro de Durotar. Ejerce como agente de la paz informal, coordinando la defensa y la información contra amenazas internas para la incipiente nación. Su principal preocupación es la sombra que proyecta la secta del Filo Ardiente en los cañones de Durotar. Apostado en Cerrotajo, Orgnil Escaralma asume la sombría responsabilidad de rastrear la subversión y las amenazas insidiosas por todo Durotar. Mientras las patrullas de brutos miran hacia el exterior, hacia los enclaves de la Alianza y las partidas de asalto centauros, Orgnil se centra en la podredumbre que se gesta desde dentro. Recopila informes de exploradores de toda la región, uniendo pruebas de corrupción ritual y reuniones ilícitas.

ang.class:Warlock: Warlocks must tread carefully around Orgnil, as his entire focus is hunting down and eradicating unchecked demonic corruption within Durotar's borders.
ang.faction:Horde: Orgnil ensures that while the Horde looks outward to build a new nation, its heartland is not hollowed out by cultists from within.
ang.race:Orc: For young orcs, Orgnil represents the frontline against the demonic taint that once enslaved the clans, reminding new recruits of the vigilance required to keep their new homeland pure.

faq.a: Orgnil Soulscar is an orc official based in Razor Hill who acts as an investigator and coordinator for Durotar's defense. He directs warriors and scouts against covert dangers threatening the newly settled orc lands.
faq.q: Who is Orgnil Soulscar?

faq.a: Orgnil is dedicated to rooting out the Burning Blade cult. He sees their presence in Durotar's hidden caverns and their corruptive fel magic as a lethal threat to the fresh start Thrall envisions for the Horde.
faq.q: What threat is Orgnil most worried about?

faq.a: Margoz is a knowledgeable hermit living north of Razor Hill who understands the dark signs and rituals of the Burning Blade. Orgnil directs scouts to Margoz to decipher the cult's movements and unravel the brewing magical corruption.
faq.q: Why does Orgnil send travelers to Margoz?

faq.a: Orgnil is stationed outdoors in the settlement of Razor Hill, near the central crossroads of Durotar.
faq.q: Where can Orgnil Soulscar be found?

faq.a: The Burning Blade is a sinister cult beholden to demonic masters and the Shadow Council. They hide in ravines like Skull Rock and the Dustwind Cave, attempting to poison Durotar's wildlife and seduce young orcs back to demonic subservience.
faq.q: What is the Burning Blade in Durotar?

faq.a: Orgnil operates as part of the regional defense apparatus centered in Razor Hill, carrying out the Warchief's mandate to safeguard Durotar from sedition and demonic influence.
faq.q: Does Orgnil work directly for Thrall?

text.s: Orgnil Soulscar is an orc investigator stationed at Razor Hill in central Durotar. He serves as an informal officer of the peace, coordinating defense and intelligence against internal threats to the fledgling nation. His primary concern is the shadow cast by the Burning Blade cult within Durotar's canyons.

sec.b: Positioned at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar takes on the grim responsibility of tracking subversion and insidious threats across Durotar. While grunt patrols look outward toward Alliance footholds and centaur raiding parties, Orgnil focuses on rot brewing from within. He collects reports from scouts across the region, piecing together evidence of ritual corruption and illicit gatherings.

Orgnil's chief focus is the clandestine resurgence of the Burning Blade cult, whose warlocks hide in caves such as Skull Rock. Knowing the devastation fel magic brought upon the orcish people in past generations, Orgnil refuses to let demon worship gain another foothold near Orgrimmar. He directs trusted recruits to strike down cultists, gather ritual talismans, and consult with local hermits and shamans like Margoz to understand the dark magics at play.

npc:orgrim-doomhammer.s: Orgrim Martillo Maldito. Orgrim Martillo Maldito fue el Jefe de Guerra supremo de la Antigua Horda durante la Segunda Guerra, recordado como uno de los mayores guerreros orcos de la historia. Aunque murió liberando los campos de internamiento en las Tierras Altas de Arathi, su legado perdura en la capital de Orgrimmar y a través de Thrall, quien heredó su poderoso martillo de guerra y su armadura de placas negra. Originalmente el segundo al mando de Puño Negro en el Clan Roca Negra, Orgrim rechazó la sangre demoníaca ofrecida por Gul'dan, aunque ocultó sus dudas bajo una feroz lealtad. Hacia el final de la Primera Guerra, asqueado por la traición del Consejo de la Sombra y el asesinato de su amigo de la infancia Durotan, Orgrim mató a Puño Negro en combate honorable. Tras asumir el manto de Jefe de Guerra, purgó implacablemente a los brujos de Gul'dan y lideró a la Horda a través de los Reinos del Este durante la Segunda Guerra. Aunque fue un estratega devastador que llevó a los reinos humanos al borde de la ruina, finalmente fue derrotado y capturado frente a la Cumbre de Roca Negra después de que la traición de Gul'dan dividiera sus fuerzas.

ang.faction:Alliance: To the Alliance, Doomhammer remains a grim symbol of the near-destruction of the Eastern Kingdoms during the Second War, having butchered countless champions before his defeat at Blackrock Spire.
ang.race:Orc: Orcs revere Orgrim Doomhammer as the liberator who freed their people from lethargy and interned enslavement, choosing honor over demonic subjugation.

faq.a: He was the Chieftain of the Blackrock clan and the Warchief who commanded the Horde during the Second War. After escaping human captivity years later, he fought alongside Thrall to liberate their imprisoned kin until his death in the Arathi Highlands.
faq.q: Who was Orgrim Doomhammer?

faq.a: Orgrim was slain during an assault on a human internment camp in the Arathi Highlands, struck from behind by a knight's lance. Thrall took up his mantle, and the site of that victory was named Hammerfall in memory of his sacrifice.
faq.q: How did Orgrim Doomhammer die?

faq.a: Thrall named the fortified city in Durotar to honor his mentor and predecessor. Orgrim saw the promise in Thrall and named him the new Warchief, ensuring the Horde would rebuild on honor rather than demonic corruption.
faq.q: Why is the Horde capital named Orgrimmar?

faq.a: No. Orgrim feigned humility, telling Blackhand and Gul'dan that a mere servant was not worthy to drink from the same cup as the Warchief. This clever excuse allowed him to retain his clarity and eventually destroy Gul'dan's Shadow Council from within.
faq.q: Did Orgrim drink the demon blood?

text.s: Orgrim Doomhammer was the supreme Warchief of the Old Horde throughout the Second War, remembered as one of the greatest orc warriors in history. Though he died liberating the internment camps in the Arathi Highlands, his legacy endures in the capital of Orgrimmar and through Thrall, who inherited his mighty warhammer and black plate armor.

sec.b: Originally second-in-command to Blackhand of the Blackrock clan, Orgrim refused the demonic blood offered by Gul'dan, though he concealed his doubts beneath fierce loyalty. Near the close of the First War, disgusted by the Shadow Council's treachery and the murder of his childhood friend Durotan, Orgrim slew Blackhand in honorable combat. Assuming the mantle of Warchief, he ruthlessly purged Gul'dan's warlocks and led the Horde across the Eastern Kingdoms during the Second War. Though a devastating strategist who pushed human kingdoms to the brink of ruin, he was ultimately defeated and captured outside Blackrock Spire after the betrayal of Gul'dan split his forces.

Escaping human captivity, Doomhammer lived in hiding until he met Thrall, Durotan's orphaned son. Reinvigorated by the young shaman's vision, Orgrim rallied what was left of the orcish clans to storm the internment camps and break their people free. During a fierce battle at an encampment in the Arathi Highlands, the Warchief was struck down from behind by a lance. As he lay dying, he bestowed his black plate armor, his ancestral weapon—the Doomhammer—and the title of Warchief upon Thrall. In his honor, the liberated outpost was renamed Hammerfall, and the newly founded capital in Durotar was christened Orgrimmar.

npc:overlord-ramtusk.s: Señor Supremo Colmicarnero. El Señor Supremo Colmicarnero es el curtido comandante de las fuerzas militares de la tribu Caramuerte en las profundidades de Horado Rajacieno. Siendo un imponente y veterano guerrero jabaespín, su pellejo está profundamente marcado por décadas de brutales enfrentamientos a lo largo de Los Baldíos. Derrotarlo supone quebrar la columna vertebral marcial de los defensores de Horado. El Señor Supremo Colmicarnero ha sobrevivido a décadas en una de las fronteras más violentas de Kalimdor. Su pellejo grueso y curtido está repleto de profundas cicatrices obtenidas en escaramuzas contra partidas de asalto centauras, arpías salvajes, orcos invasores y aguerridos bravos tauren. Aunque la avanzada edad ralentiza a muchos guerreros, los curtidos instintos y la resistencia física de Colmicarnero no han hecho más que endurecerse, lo que le permite gobernar la guarnición permanente de Horado Rajacieno con una autoridad implacable.

ang.class:Warrior: Ramtusk represents pure, brutal martial veteranhood, relying on thunderous strikes and commanding battle shouts rather than shamans' geomancy or thorn magic.
ang.race:Orc: The quilboar have actively raided Horde settlements since the founding of Durotar and the Barrens outposts. Breaking Ramtusk's military command secures the Southern Barrens.
ang.race:Tauren: For generations, the nomadic tribes of the Barrens fought bitter skirmishes against Ramtusk and his marauders; putting him down avenges fallen braves.

faq.a: Overlord Ramtusk is the supreme military commander of the Death's Head quilboar in Razorfen Kraul. He is an imposing, heavily scarred veteran who has fought every major power in the Barrens.
faq.q: Who is Overlord Ramtusk?

faq.a: He commands his elite guards from within the thorny heart of Razorfen Kraul, located at the southern tip of the Barrens.
faq.q: Where can Overlord Ramtusk be found?

faq.a: His scarred hide tells the tale of countless clashes across the Barrens against centaur packs, territorial harpies, newly arrived orcs, and native tauren defenders.
faq.q: What enemies has Ramtusk fought in the past?

faq.a: He is the high military leader of the Death's Head tribe, the dominant quilboar faction entrenched within Razorfen Kraul.
faq.q: What tribe does Ramtusk belong to?

faq.a: As the supreme commander of the Death's Head forces, Ramtusk's death deals a crippling blow to the quilboar military hierarchy, throwing their defensive line into complete disarray.
faq.q: Why is Ramtusk targeted by adventurers?

faq.a: Ramtusk fights as a classic battle-hardened warrior, using demoralizing cries to empower his cohort, crushing shockwaves to stagger enemies, and coordinating alongside elite ranged bodyguards.
faq.q: How does Ramtusk fight?

text.s: Overlord Ramtusk is the grizzled commander of the Death's Head tribe's military forces deep within Razorfen Kraul. A massive, aging quilboar warrior, his hide is heavily scarred from decades of brutal clashes across the Barrens. Striking him down shatters the martial backbone of the Kraul's defenders.

sec.b: Overlord Ramtusk has survived decades in one of Kalimdor's most violent frontiers. His thick, leathery hide is crisscrossed with deep scars earned in skirmishes against centaur raiding parties, feral harpies, encroaching orcs, and stalwart tauren braves. While advanced age slows many warriors, Ramtusk's seasoned instincts and physical resilience have only hardened, allowing him to rule Razorfen Kraul's standing garrison with unyielding authority.

Within the winding brambles of the Kraul, Ramtusk directs the military forces of the Death's Head quilboar. As their warlord, he maintains tight discipline among the bristled fighters defending the tribe's sanctum. Flanked by elite marksmen, Ramtusk fights like a frontline berserker, bellowing rallying shouts and unleashing earth-shattering slams that can break opposing battle lines in seconds.

npc:ozzie-togglevolt.s: Oci Voltiflop. Oci Voltiflop es un ingeniero gnomo y superviviente de la caída de Gnomeregan que actualmente opera desde la nevada aldea de Kharanos, en Dun Morogh. Atormentado por la tragedia que asoló a su pueblo, trabaja junto a su compañero Razzle Energiodentado para investigar un remedio para los gnomos parias irradiados. Oci Voltiflop se encontraba en el interior de las maravillas subterráneas de Gnomeregan cuando sobrevino la catástrofe. Cuando se liberó la lluvia radiactiva tóxica por los conductos para frenar la invasión de los troggs, Oci estaba junto a su compañero gnomo, Gnoarn. Una repentina descarga radiactiva alcanzó a Gnoarn de lleno, alterándolo para siempre ante los ojos de Oci. Aunque Oci logró salir con vida a la superficie y alcanzar el refugio de Dun Morogh, el espantoso recuerdo de aquel desastre jamás lo abandonó.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stationed right outside Ironforge in Kharanos, Ozzie aids travelers while maintaining Alliance footholds in the frigid hills of Dun Morogh.
ang.profession:Engineering: Ozzie showcases the trial-and-error realities of gnome craftsmanship, where devices can backfire dramatically in combat or yield ingenious breakthroughs in biochemical decontamination.
ang.race:Gnome: For gnome adventurers, Ozzie represents the grief and determination of the survivors of Gnomeregan, refusing to abandon irradiated kin to their fate.

faq.a: Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnomish engineer residing in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He fled the radioactive devastation of Gnomeregan and now dedicates his technical expertise toward finding a cure for his afflicted brethren.
faq.q: Who is Ozzie Togglevolt?

faq.a: Ozzie and his colleague Razzle Sprysprocket are researching a method to cleanse the toxic irradiation that turned so many of their kin into madness-stricken leper gnomes.
faq.q: What is Ozzie trying to cure?

faq.a: Gnoarn was with Ozzie in Gnomeregan when the toxic vents were unleashed. Ozzie witnessed a radioactive bolt strike Gnoarn directly, a tragic incident that drove Ozzie's obsession with reversing the contamination.
faq.q: Who is Gnoarn to Ozzie?

faq.a: Ozzie works alongside Razzle Sprysprocket. Together, they tinker in Kharanos, developing concoctions and gathering contaminated field specimens to analyze the radioactive fallout.
faq.q: Who is working with Ozzie in Kharanos?

faq.a: Yes. When a massive Frostmane troll assaulted Kharanos, Ozzie and Razzle attempted to fend it off by hurling what they thought were impact grenades, only to discover they were actually delayed time bombs before fellow inventor Lazlo Grindwidget intervened.
faq.q: Did Ozzie help defend Kharanos from trolls?

faq.a: Ozzie enlists travelers in Dun Morogh to gather irradiated residues and components from around Gnomeregan through tasks such as 'The Day After', 'Gnogaine', and 'The Only Cure is More Green Glow'.
faq.q: What quests does Ozzie offer?

text.s: Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnome engineer and survivor of Gnomeregan's fall, currently operating out of the snowy village of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Haunted by the tragedy that struck his people, he works alongside his partner Razzle Sprysprocket to research a remedy for the irradiated leper gnomes.

sec.b: Ozzie Togglevolt was inside the subterranean wonders of Gnomeregan when catastrophe struck. When the toxic fallout was vented throughout the corridors to stem the trogg invasion, Ozzie stood right beside his fellow gnome, Gnoarn. A sudden radioactive discharge struck Gnoarn directly, altering him forever before Ozzie's eyes. Though Ozzie made it to the surface alive and reached the haven of Dun Morogh, the horrifying memory of that disaster never left him.

Now established in Kharanos, Ozzie spends his days tinkering alongside Razzle Sprysprocket. Despite minor mishaps and defensive scrambles against encroaching Frostmane trolls, their primary technological and scientific endeavor remains intensely personal: finding a way to reverse the horrific mutagenic fallout of their lost home and cure the suffering leper gnomes.

npc:pelturas-whitemoon.s: Pelturas Lunablanca. Pelturas Lunablanca es un padre elfo de la noche que vive en Astranaar y cuya joven hija, Relara, ha sido víctima de una terrible enfermedad corruptora. Desesperado por salvarla, colabora estrechamente con el herborista local Orendil Hojasangre y con campeones viajeros de la Alianza para reunir remedios sagrados de las tierras salvajes circundantes. Su misión para sanar a Relara lleva a los aventureros a algunas de las ruinas y arboledas sagradas más antiguas de Vallefresno. Afincado bajo las serenas ramas de Astranaar, Pelturas Lunablanca lleva la vida tranquila típica de los kaldorei del bosque, aventurándose a menudo con su joven hija Relara a recoger relucientes piedras lunares alrededor del Lago Cielo Estrellado. Sin embargo, cuando Relara cae gravemente enferma por una misteriosa aflicción, su apacible mundo se desmorona en una frenética desesperación. Astranaar está sitiada en muchos frentes, pero para Pelturas no hay nada en el gran bosque más importante que salvar a su hija.

ang.class:Priest: The cleansing rites and holy reagents consecrated to Elune showcase the healing power and sacred reverence that the Sisterhood of Elune brings to night elf culture.
ang.faction:Alliance: Helping Pelturas save his daughter reinforces the Alliance's commitment to defending and aiding the Kaldorei settlements in Kalimdor.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The sequence of natural draughts, poultices, and botanical tinctures needed for Relara highlights the deep connection between Kaldorei medicine and herbal lore.
ang.race:NightElf: Pelturas's struggle reflects the vulnerability of everyday Kaldorei families as ancient glades fall prey to corruption and regional conflict.

faq.a: Pelturas Whitemoon is a night elf resident of Astranaar in central Ashenvale. He is best known for seeking the aid of passing Alliance travelers to gather sacred ingredients to cure his seriously ill daughter, Relara.
faq.q: Who is Pelturas Whitemoon?

faq.a: Relara suffers from a sudden, virulent disease that causes a severe fever and deep weakness. The sickness appears tied to the unnatural corruption spreading through Ashenvale's wilds, resisting mundane medicine and requiring sacred reagents to cleanse.
faq.q: What is wrong with his daughter, Relara?

faq.a: Pelturas seeks council from Orendil Broadleaf, a knowledgeable local night elf who prescribes traditional Kaldorei remedies, including cleansing stones and herbal poultices.
faq.q: Who helps Pelturas treat the sickness?

faq.a: Saving Relara requires a progression of treatments: an initial herbal draught from Orendil, a purifying Elune's Tear, powdered stardust from ancient ruins to break her burning fever, and a moonstone from Fallen Sky Lake brewed into tea to restore her vigor.
faq.q: What reagents are needed to cure Relara?

faq.a: Fallen Sky Lake was a place where Pelturas and Relara used to spend time together gathering moonstones. The lake has recently been overtaken by hostile Shadethicket bog beasts, forcing Pelturas to ask adventurers to retrieve the moonstone needed for his daughter's recovery.
faq.q: Why is Fallen Sky Lake significant to Pelturas?

faq.a: No. Pelturas is a civilian town resident of Astranaar, representing the everyday Kaldorei families who live within Ashenvale and suffer from the forest's encroaching dangers.
faq.q: Is Pelturas a member of the Cenarion Circle or the Sentinels?

text.s: Pelturas Whitemoon is a night elf father dwelling in Astranaar whose young daughter, Relara, has been struck by a terrible, corrupting illness. Desperate to save her, he works closely with local herbalist Orendil Broadleaf and traveling Alliance champions to gather sacred remedies from the surrounding wilds. His quest to heal Relara takes adventurers into some of Ashenvale's oldest sacred groves and ruins.

sec.b: Residing in the serene boughs of Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon lives the quiet life typical of forest-dwelling Kaldorei, often venturing out with his young daughter Relara to collect shimmering moonstones around Fallen Sky Lake. However, when Relara falls critically ill with a mysterious affliction, his quiet world collapses into frantic desperation. Astranaar is besieged on many fronts, but for Pelturas, nothing in the great forest matters more than saving his child.

Normal herbal remedies fail to break Relara's condition, prompting Pelturas to turn to the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf. Treating the affliction requires rare and sacred reagents tied to the land and the Moon Goddess, including an Elune's Tear and shimmering stardust from ancient Kaldorei ruins to cool her burning fever. Each step only narrowly keeps death at bay, highlighting how deeply the corruption spreading through Ashenvale's soil and waters has begun to touch its people.

To fully restore Relara's vitality, Pelturas seeks a moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle at Fallen Sky Lake. The lake, once a tranquil spot where father and daughter peacefully gathered stones together, has grown perilous due to the violent emergence of corrupted bog beasts. By crushing the recovered moonstone into a restorative tea, Pelturas finally breaks the lingering weakness, restoring Relara to health.

npc:priestess-alathea.s: Sacerdotisa Alathea. La Sacerdotisa Alathea es una instructora de sacerdotes elfa de la noche que reside en las apacibles estancias del Templo de la Luna, en Darnassus. Consagrada a la Diosa de la Luna, guía a los novicios en las artes sagradas y en las bendiciones raciales otorgadas por Elune. Sus enseñanzas ayudan a los practicantes elfos de la noche a armonizar sus mentes con plegarias defensivas y magia celestial. Erguida bajo las imponentes alturas plateadas del mayor santuario de Darnassus, la Sacerdotisa Alathea sirve a las Hermanas de Elune como instructora y guía espiritual. A medida que los iniciados elfos de la noche avanzan más allá de las tranquilas ramas de Cañada Umbría, se les encomienda acudir al Templo de la Luna para profundizar en su pacto con la Diosa. Alathea se encuentra entre las sacerdotisas dispuestas a transmitir conocimientos sagrados a quienes consagran su vida a la sanación, la protección y la luz divina.

ang.class:Priest: Priestess Alathea is a vital contact for Alliance priests visiting Darnassus, offering rank advancements and guiding kaldorei acolytes to their unique celestial powers.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alathea opens the Temple of the Moon's teachings to all traveling members of the Alliance who study the clerical arts.
ang.race:NightElf: As a priestess in the heart of Darnassus, Alathea represents the living spiritual traditions of the Sisterhood of Elune that have protected the kaldorei for millennia.

faq.a: Priestess Alathea is a kaldorei priest trainer stationed inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, responsible for training budding priests and guiding night elf acolytes through their sacred trials.
faq.q: Who is Priestess Alathea?

faq.a: She offers standard priest spell training as well as specific trials for night elf racials, including Starshards and Elune's Grace, which channel the direct power and protection of the Moon Goddess.
faq.q: What abilities does she teach?

faq.a: She resides on the ground floor of the Temple of the Moon in the southern reaches of Darnassus, surrounded by the sanctuary's luminous waters and fellow priestesses.
faq.q: Where can I find Priestess Alathea?

faq.a: As kaldorei priests advance in their training, novice instructors across Teldrassil send them to Alathea to undertake spiritual rites—such as Stars of Elune and Elune's Grace—marking their transition into mature servants of the goddess.
faq.q: Why do night elf priests visit her specifically?

faq.a: Yes. While human and dwarven priests belong to the Church of the Holy Light, any Alliance priest visiting Darnassus can learn general spells from her, though she only administers kaldorei-specific racial trials to night elves.
faq.q: Does she train races other than night elves?

faq.a: While the priests of Stormwind and Ironforge invoke the ambient and philosophical Holy Light, Alathea and her sisters revere Elune as a living deity, wielding starlight and moonlit wards alongside curative magic.
faq.q: How does her faith differ from human and dwarven priests?

text.s: Priestess Alathea is a night elf priest trainer residing within the tranquil halls of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Devoted to the Moon Goddess, she guides novitiates in the sacred arts and racial blessings bestowed by Elune. Her teachings help night elf practitioners attune their minds to defensive prayers and celestial magic.

sec.b: Standing within the soaring silver heights of Darnassus's grandest sanctuary, Priestess Alathea serves the Sisterhood of Elune as an instructor and spiritual guide. As night elf initiates progress beyond the quiet boughs of Shadowglen, they are directed to the Temple of the Moon to deepen their covenant with the Goddess. Alathea stands among the priestesses ready to impart sacred knowledge to those who dedicate their lives to healing, warding, and divine light.
sec.t: Devotion in the Temple of the Moon

sec.b: Unlike priests of the Holy Light who draw strength strictly from human and dwarven traditions, kaldorei priests draw directly upon the grace of Elune. Alathea plays a key role in testing and granting blessings tailored to night elves, such as Stars of Elune and Elune's Grace. Through her guidance, acolytes learn how to weave starlight into shields of swiftness and defensive power to survive the growing perils facing Kalimdor.

npc:raene-wolfrunner.s: Raene Correlobo. Raene Correlobo es una consumada oficial centinela y cazadora apostada en el corazón de Astranaar, en Vallefresno. Acompañada por sus leales compañeros, un lobo y un sable de la noche, coordina las labores de defensa a lo largo del bosque frente a las fuerzas invasoras de la Horda y las tribus de fúrbolgs corrompidos. Actúa como un apoyo vital para los adalides de la Alianza que se esfuerzan por proteger la espesura sagrada. Raene Correlobo permanece vigilante en Astranaar junto a sus fieles compañeros: Korra, un sable de la noche, y Dagri, un lobo. Como oficial de las Centinelas, supervisa las patrullas por todo Vallefresno y coordina la información que llega más allá de sus fronteras, enviando exploradoras como Kaela Lanzasombra a regiones vecinas como Sierra Espolón. La devoción de Raene por los antiguos bosques es absoluta; ha afirmado que preferiría enfrentarse sola a las fuerzas de tala de la Horda antes que verlas talar y quemar la madera sagrada sin impedimento alguno.

ang.class:Hunter: As a seasoned hunter who commands both a wolf and a saber cat, Raene represents the wilderness mastery and kinship with beasts prized by her class.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers arriving from Darkshore, Raene is the principal officer coordinating the military and ecological defense of Ashenvale.
ang.race:NightElf: Raene embodies the Sentinel dedication to Elune and Kalimdor's wilderness, refusing to allow the woodland sanctuaries of Ashenvale to be despoiled.

faq.a: Raene is stationed in Astranaar, the central night elf town of Ashenvale. She stands ready outdoors, flanked by her two animal companions.
faq.q: Where can Raene Wolfrunner be found?

faq.a: They are her trained hunting companions: a saber cat named Korra and a wolf named Dagri, who remain by her side in Astranaar.
faq.q: Who are the animals standing next to Raene?

faq.a: She acts as a ranking Sentinel officer in central Ashenvale, issuing orders to scouts, managing outposts, and coordinating tactical operations against local threats.
faq.q: What is Raene's role within the Sentinels?

faq.a: Teronis was aiding the Sentinels by seeking a gemstone needed for Dartol's Rod. He was slain in the field, leading Raene to recover his remains and complete his mission.
faq.q: What happened to Raene's friend Teronis?

faq.a: Corrupted tribes like the Foulweald and Thistlefur have grown increasingly aggressive, ambushing travelers on forest roads and threatening the stability of Astranaar.
faq.q: Why is Raene focusing so heavily on the furbolgs?

faq.a: The reconstructed rod allows an adventurer to temporarily adopt the form of a furbolg, opening communication with Krolg to target and vanquish the corrupt chieftain Ran Bloodtooth.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Dartol's Rod in her questline?

text.s: Raene Wolfrunner is an accomplished Sentinel officer and hunter stationed at the heart of Astranaar in Ashenvale. Accompanied by her loyal wolf and saber cat companions, she coordinates defense efforts across the forest against encroaching Horde forces and corrupted furbolg tribes. She serves as a vital anchor for Alliance champions striving to protect the sacred wilderness.

sec.b: Raene Wolfrunner stands watchful in Astranaar alongside her trusty saber cat Korra and wolf Dagri. As an officer among the Sentinels, she oversees patrols throughout Ashenvale and coordinates intelligence reaching beyond its borders, dispatching scouts like Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions such as the Stonetalon Mountains. Raene's devotion to the ancient woods is absolute; she has declared she would sooner face the Horde's lumbering forces alone than watch them hack and burn through the sacred timber unhindered.

Beyond the tensions with the Horde, Raene is deeply invested in addressing the dark taint sickening Ashenvale's native denizens. She directs campaigns against hostile furbolg tribes, including aggressive strikes against the Foulweald camps harassing travelers and targeted culls against rising Thistlefur leadership. Her subordinate scouts keep close watch over changing furbolg behavior, relying on Raene's steady command to protect local settlements and passing wayfarers from coordinated ambushes.

Raene's most personal crusade involves Dartol's Rod, an ancient relic tied to furbolg purification. Her longtime friend Teronis was slain while searching for the rod's missing gemstone, prompting Raene to order his body recovered and pledge to see his research fulfilled. Working in tandem with the dryad Shael'dryn, she helps champions assemble the relic, ultimately enabling an adventurer to assume furbolg guise, confer with chieftain Krolg, and defeat the tainted leader Ran Bloodtooth to purge the regional threat.

npc:rhahk-zor.s: Rhahk'Zor. Rhahk'Zor es un descomunal ogro que ejerce de capataz principal en Las Minas de la Muerte. Supervisa las obras de construcción subterráneas de Edwin VanCleef y mantiene a raya a los obreros y mineros Defias a base de pura fuerza bruta y una disciplina implacable. En las profundidades de las colinas onduladas de Páramos de Poniente, la Hermandad Defias ha transformado las minas de oro abandonadas de Arroyo de la Luna en una fortaleza subterránea. Coordinar esta descomunal construcción exige una disciplina férrea, un papel que desempeña el ogro Rhahk'Zor. Nombrado capataz principal, supervisa a las cuadrillas de excavación y a los peones, empujándolos a abrir túneles y ensamblar los proyectos secretos de VanCleef.

ang.class:Warrior: Facing Rhahk'Zor is a test of raw frontline endurance, pitted against a massive ogre swinging a sledgehammer that shatters stone and bone alike.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance adventurers pushing into Moonbrook, Rhahk'Zor is the first grim proof that the Defias Brotherhood has organized far beyond petty highway banditry into a heavily fortified army.
ang.profession:Mining: Rhahk'Zor drives his miners with crude brutality rather than respect for the veins of gold, churning Westfall's storied old mines into a rushed industrial war machine.

faq.a: Rhahk'Zor is an ogre who acts as the primary foreman and enforcer for the Defias Brotherhood inside the Deadmines. He stands watch over the initial excavation tunnels, ensuring the workforce keeps digging without stepping out of line.
al: who is the ogre boss in deadmines
faq.q: Who is Rhahk'Zor?

faq.a: Edwin VanCleef's rebellion relies on whatever muscle and mercenary talent they can acquire. An ogre provides unmatched physical intimidation, making Rhahk'Zor an ideal taskmaster to drive the grueling labor of excavating the mines.
al: why is there an ogre in deadmines
faq.q: Why is an ogre working for the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: He serves as the head construction foreman. Rhahk'Zor supervises the miners, goblins, and Defias builders as they hollow out the caverns, maintain equipment, and build fortifications for the Brotherhood.
faq.q: What is Rhahk'Zor's job in the mines?

faq.a: Rhahk'Zor guards the early quarry chambers of the Deadmines, standing past the initial miner tunnels and right before the heavy iron threshold known as Rhahk'Zor's Door.
faq.q: Where in the Deadmines is Rhahk'Zor located?

faq.a: Ogres once inhabited the Deadmines during the First War before being wiped out by Blackhand's Horde. Whether Rhahk'Zor is a lingering remnant of those earlier clans or simply a brute hired by VanCleef remains unconfirmed.
faq.q: Does Rhahk'Zor have any connection to the ogres from the First War?

faq.a: Defeating Rhahk'Zor breaks the Defias hold on the outer quarry, clearing the way through the reinforced blast door he guards and allowing trespassers deeper into the clandestine shipyards and workshops.
faq.q: What happens when Rhahk'Zor is defeated?

text.s: Rhahk'Zor is a hulking ogre serving as the head foreman within the Deadmines. Overseeing Edwin VanCleef's subterranean construction efforts, he keeps the Defias laborers and miners in line through sheer brute force and heavy-handed discipline.

sec.b: Deep beneath the rolling hills of Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood has transformed the abandoned gold mines of Moonbrook into an underground fortress. Coordinating this sprawling construction requires harsh discipline, a role filled by the ogre Rhahk'Zor. Appointed as head foreman, he oversees the excavation crews and laborers, driving them forward to carve out tunnels and assemble VanCleef's secret projects.

Rhahk'Zor maintains order through relentless muscle rather than careful engineering. Armed with an immense stone-headed hammer, his idea of workplace supervision is direct and unforgiving. Defias diggers and goblin engineers alike step lively around him, knowing that falling behind schedule or showing defiance invites a crushing blow from the towering taskmaster.

npc:rorian-the-dayseeker.s: Rorian el Buscadía. Rorian el Buscadía es una figura anciana de los cielonatos situada en Thendal, en la Isla de Zephras. Supervisa la iniciación de los jóvenes volantones mientras descubren su vocación, dan el paso a la madurez y se sintonizan con los elementos naturales de su tierra natal. Bajo su atenta guía, los recién llegados aprenden los fundamentos de la supervivencia, la tradición y el servicio a su comunidad. Dentro de los serenos confines de Thendal, en la Isla de Zephras, Rorian el Buscadía se erige como uno de los mentores principales para los jóvenes cielonatos. Venerado por su experiencia y serena sabiduría, Rorian guía a los jóvenes durante su crucial transición a la edad adulta. Bajo su instrucción, los iniciados emprenden su tradicional rito de iniciación, demostrando que están listos para defender y apoyar a su hogar insular.

ang.class:Mage: Novice arcanists find an understanding guide in Rorian, who directs budding scholars of the arcane toward teachers capable of honing raw magical potential.
ang.class:Shaman: Rorian places heavy emphasis on the island's harmony, dispatching fledglings to soothe agitated elementals and connect with ancestral traditions.
ang.class:Warrior: Rorian recognizes the physical dedication of aspiring fighters, pointing aspiring warriors toward the mentors who teach discipline on the battlefield.
ang.race:Skyborne: For every fledgling Skyborne, Rorian the Dayseeker represents the first threshold of duty and tradition, guiding your transition into adulthood in Thendal Village.

faq.a: Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder Skyborne leader found in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He serves as the primary mentor for novice adventurers and fledgling Skyborne embarking on their early trials.
faq.q: Who is Rorian the Dayseeker?

faq.a: He is located in Thendal Village, the starting settlement for the Skyborne on Zephras Isle.
faq.q: Where can Rorian the Dayseeker be found?

faq.a: Rorian oversees the initial rites of passage that mark a fledgling's transition into adulthood. He tests their mettle and attunement to island life before directing them outward to serve the wider settlement.
faq.q: What is Rorian's role in the Skyborne coming of age?

faq.a: Once a novice proves their worth, Rorian advises them on where to pursue advanced training, offering guidance toward the paths of the warrior, hunter, rogue, mage, shaman, or druid.
faq.q: How does Rorian direct new trainees into their classes?

faq.a: The natural balance around Zephras Isle is vulnerable to agitation. Rorian tasks capable initiates with investigating and calming elemental unrest so that Thendal Village and the surrounding wildlands remain in harmony.
faq.q: Why does Rorian send adventurers to deal with elementals?

faq.a: Aetheen of the Gales is an individual on Zephras Isle to whom Rorian directs fledglings as they progress through their island responsibilities and training.
faq.q: Who is Aetheen of the Gales?

text.s: Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder Skyborne figure situated in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He oversees the initiation of young fledglings as they discover their calling, step into maturity, and attune themselves to the natural elements of their homeland. Under his watchful guidance, newcomers learn the fundamentals of survival, tradition, and service to their community.

sec.b: Within the serene confines of Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker stands as one of the primary mentors for the fledgling Skyborne. Revered for his experience and calm wisdom, Rorian directs youth during their crucial transition into adulthood. It is under his instruction that initiates undertake their traditional rite of passage, marking their readiness to defend and support their island home.

Beyond fundamental trials, Rorian points promising initiates toward specialized paths suited to their talents. Whether an aspiring warrior, hunter, rogue, mage, shaman, or druid, fledglings are directed by Rorian to dedicated trainers across the isle. He also alerts them to elemental disturbances disrupting the island's harmony, instilling an enduring duty to preserve balance across the windswept heights.

npc:scarlet-commander-mograine.s: Comandante Escarlata Mograine. El Comandante Escarlata Mograine ejerce como líder militar de la guarnición apostada en el interior de la Catedral del Monasterio Escarlata. Como ferviente paladín de La Cruzada Escarlata, defiende la capilla junto a la Alta Inquisidora Melenablanca. Tanto la Horda como la Alianza lo tienen como objetivo para desbaratar a los fanáticos que amenazan los Claros de Tirisfal y las tierras circundantes. Apostado en la imponente Capilla del Cruzado, en el corazón del Monasterio Escarlata, el Comandante Escarlata Mograine lidera la guarnición permanente de La Cruzada Escarlata. Utiliza el poder sagrado de un paladín con feroz entrega, valiéndose de la reprensión, escudos divinos y golpes aturdidores para destrozar a cualquiera que la Cruzada considere corrupto o impuro.

ang.class:Paladin: Mograine embodies the tragic corruption of the paladin's calling, twisting holy vows of protection and righteousness into ruthless, unyielding zealotry.
ang.faction:Alliance: Though the Scarlet Crusade once shared common ground with the Alliance, leaders in Southshore and Stormwind recognize that fanatical commanders like Mograine have descended into violent madness.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Commander Mograine represents the sharpest blade of the Scarlet Crusade, whose presence directly borders the Undercity and threatens their survival in Tirisfal.

faq.a: He is located inside the Cathedral wing of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. You will find him waiting before the altar within the Crusader's Chapel.
faq.q: Where can Scarlet Commander Mograine be found?

faq.a: He serves as the military commander of the Scarlet Crusade's forces garrisoned at the Monastery, directing its paladins and soldiers alongside High Inquisitor Whitemane.
faq.q: What is Mograine's role in the Scarlet Crusade?

faq.a: Mograine fights as a heavy melee paladin. He uses Hammer of Justice to stun his opponents, unleashes Crusader Strikes, protects himself with Retribution Aura, and relies on Divine Shield when pushed to the brink.
faq.q: How does he fight?

faq.a: Whitemane and Mograine share an intense bond and fight together as leaders of the Monastery. When Mograine falls in battle, Whitemane intervenes, puts their attackers to sleep with her magic, and raises Mograine back to life with full strength.
faq.q: Why does High Inquisitor Whitemane revive him?

faq.a: The Scarlet Crusade views all outsiders—living or undead—as carriers of corruption. Both the Alliance and the Forsaken send champions to strike at the Cathedral and execute its leaders to neutralize the Crusade's fanatical presence in Lordaeron.
al: in the name of the light
faq.q: Why are the Alliance and Horde fighting him?

faq.a: Yes, in a pinch. Besides Divine Shield and his melee attacks, he can call on Lay on Hands to restore himself to full health, and High Inquisitor Whitemane adds further healing once she enters the battle.
faq.q: Does Mograine heal himself during the encounter?

text.s: Scarlet Commander Mograine serves as the military leader garrisoned inside the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A zealous paladin of the Scarlet Crusade, he defends the chapel alongside High Inquisitor Whitemane. Both the Horde and Alliance target him to disrupt the zealots threatening Tirisfal Glades and the surrounding lands.

sec.b: Stationed within the grand Crusader's Chapel at the heart of the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Commander Mograine commands the standing garrison of the Scarlet Crusade. He wields the holy power of a paladin with ferocious dedication, relying on retribution, divine shields, and stunning blows to shatter any whom the Crusade deems corrupted or unclean.

Mograine's defense of the chapel is intrinsically tied to High Inquisitor Whitemane. Should an attacking force bring the Commander to his knees, Whitemane emerges from the rear sanctum to turn the tide. Calling upon the Holy Light, she incapacitates intruders in an instant and restores Mograine from death, forcing their foes to confront both commanders in a desperate, simultaneous struggle.

npc:senani-thunderheart.s: Senani Truenozón. Senani Truenozón es una cazadora tauren apostada en el Puesto del Hachazo, en Vallefresno, justo al norte de Los Baldíos. Al servicio de la Horda, pone a prueba el valor de los viajeros que pasan por allí desafiándolos a perseguir a los feroces depredadores salvajes que merodean por el antiguo bosque. A través de sus pruebas, los cazadores demuestran su destreza mientras reducen el número de mortíferas bestias que rondan cerca del territorio de la Horda. Establecida en el campamento del Puesto del Hachazo, Senani Truenozón representa las tradiciones de caza de los tauren en medio de las arboledas sombrías de Vallefresno. Lejos de las llanuras abiertas de Mulgore, encomienda a los aventureros de la Horda poner a prueba sus habilidades de rastreo y combate contra las bestias alfa del bosque. Considera la caza tanto un desafío honorable como un ritual necesario para sobrevivir en una tierra indómita y disputada.

ang.class:Hunter: Senani embodies the classic hunter's spirit, testing your tracking skills against Ashenvale's elusive beasts: Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon.
ang.faction:Horde: Splintertree Post serves as the Horde's foothold in Ashenvale, where Senani helps Horde scouts prove their worth and secure the wilderness.
ang.race:Tauren: For tauren travelers, meeting Senani brings a reminder of the Earth Mother's trials, honoring the ancient balance between hunter and quarry even far from Mulgore.

faq.a: Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress and quest giver located at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She serves the Horde by directing adventurers to hunt the most dangerous wildlife prowling the forest.
faq.q: Who is Senani Thunderheart?

faq.a: Senani is stationed at Splintertree Post, the Horde outpost in Ashenvale directly north of the Barrens.
faq.q: Where can I find Senani Thunderheart?

faq.a: The Ashenvale Hunt is a series of hunting challenges issued by Senani. Hunters are tasked with tracking down and slaying three legendary forest predators: Ursangous the bear, Shadumbra the nightsaber, and Sharptalon the hippogryph.
faq.q: What is the Ashenvale Hunt?

faq.a: She asks hunters to return with Ursangous's Paw, Shadumbra's Head, and Sharptalon's Claw to prove that all three formidable beasts have been bested.
faq.q: Which trophies does Senani require for the hunt?

faq.a: Not in her own tasks. Senani's charge is the Ashenvale Hunt; the Foulweald and other furbolg tribes are simply among the many dangers a hunter faces in the forest.
faq.q: Does Senani have any connection to the furbolgs in the area?

faq.a: No, Senani is aligned directly with the Horde and the tauren tribes, approaching the woods from the perspective of a traditional hunter rather than a Cenarion druidic guardian.
faq.q: Is Senani affiliated with the Cenarion Circle?

text.s: Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress stationed at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, just north of the Barrens. Serving the Horde, she tests the mettle of passing travelers by challenging them to pursue the fierce wild predators that roam the ancient forest. Through her trials, hunters prove their skill while thinning the deadly beasts prowling near Horde territory.

sec.b: Found keeping camp at Splintertree Post, Senani Thunderheart represents the hunting traditions of the tauren amid the shadowed groves of Ashenvale. Far from the open plains of Mulgore, she directs Horde adventurers to test their tracking and combat prowess against the forest's apex beasts. She views the hunt as both an honorable challenge and a necessary ritual to survive in an untamed, contested land.

Senani oversees the traditional hunting trials of Ashenvale, directing hunters toward three notorious predators: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon. Claiming their tokens—a paw, a head, and a claw—is a rite of passage that demonstrates a hunter's respect for the land and dominion over its fiercest denizens.

npc:senir-whitebeard.s: Senir Barbablanca. Senir Barbablanca es un dignatario y agente de campo enano apostado a las afueras de la Destilería Cebatruenos en Kharanos. En calidad de enviado especial del Senado de Forjaz, tiene la misión de vigilar las crecientes amenazas que rodean Dun Morogh. Su cometido se centra en evaluar la ofensiva de los trols Peloescarcha y transmitir sus movimientos directamente a los líderes enanos. Aunque la mayoría de los viajeros visitan Kharanos por su animada posada y su famosa cerveza negra, Senir Barbablanca está aquí en misión oficial. Al ser un representante enviado directamente por el Senado de Forjaz, su presencia subraya la seriedad con la que los altos mandatarios se toman la desestabilización de Dun Morogh. Sirve como un puente esencial entre los exploradores locales que arrostran peligros en la frontera nevada y los legisladores que debaten directrices tras las puertas de piedra de la ciudad.

ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance recruits passing through Dun Morogh aid Senir to safeguard the heartland of Ironforge from being cut off by indigenous troll uprisings.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Senir represents the bureaucratic yet essential connection between frontier defenders and the governing body in Ironforge.

faq.a: Senir Whitebeard is an envoy sent by the Senate of Ironforge to Dun Morogh. He stands outside Kharanos gathering intelligence on regional threats, especially the local Frostmane troll tribes.
faq.q: Who is Senir Whitebeard?

faq.a: Senir is stationed in Kharanos to observe troll activity and coordinate scout reports. Because Kharanos is the crossroad of Dun Morogh, it serves as the ideal hub to receive field intelligence before relaying it to the Senate in Ironforge.
faq.q: What is Senir doing in Kharanos?

faq.a: The Ironforge Senate requires reliable, firsthand field data to allocate resources and direct guards. Senir serves as an impartial official assessing whether the Frostmane threat warrants immediate military escalation from the capital.
faq.q: Why does the Senate of Ironforge need an envoy here?

faq.a: His chief focus is the Frostmane troll incursions. The trolls have been pushing aggressively out of their camps into dwarf territory, culminating in direct threats against nearby settlements like Kharanos.
faq.q: What is Senir's primary concern in Dun Morogh?

faq.a: No, Senir functions as an administrator and intelligence gatherer. He depends on local scouts, Mountaineers, and passing adventurers to enter hostile sites like Frostmane Hold and retrieve critical reconnaissance for him.
faq.q: Does Senir fight the trolls himself?

faq.a: Once Senir has compiled field notes regarding troll positions and strengths, the finished reports are sent directly up the mountain road to the Senate and leadership in Ironforge.
faq.q: Where do Senir's reports go?

text.s: Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven dignitary and field agent stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Serving as a special envoy from the Senate of Ironforge, he is tasked with monitoring the growing threats encircling Dun Morogh. His mission centers on evaluating the Frostmane troll offensive and reporting their movements directly back to the dwarven leadership.

sec.b: While most travelers visit Kharanos for its bustling inn and famous stout, Senir Whitebeard is here on official business. As a representative sent directly by the Senate of Ironforge, his presence highlights how seriously the high halls take the destabilization of Dun Morogh. He serves as an essential bridge between local scouts facing danger on the snowy frontier and the legislators arguing policy behind the city's stone gates.

Senir's primary concern is the escalating aggression of the Frostmane trolls. Displaced and desperate in the frozen crags, the trolls have begun pushing dangerously close to dwarven settlements and roads. Rather than charging into battle himself, the venerable envoy gathers reconnaissance on troll positions, particularly around their stronghold, compiling meticulous reports so Ironforge's military commanders can strike decisively.

npc:shadow-priest-allister.s: Sacerdote de las Sombras Allister. El Sacerdote de las Sombras Allister es un sacerdote Renegado apostado en El Sepulcro, en el Bosque de Argénteos. Al frente de las labores tácticas y de inteligencia en la región, coordina operaciones para vigilar a los magos de Dalaran y proteger las fronteras de Lordaeron para la Dama Oscura. Operando desde El Sepulcro, el Sacerdote de las Sombras Allister dirige el reconocimiento de los Renegados por todo el Bosque de Argénteos. Desde este asentamiento central en una cripta, rastrea las amenazas cercanas, que abarcan desde humanos renegados e incursiones bestiales hasta las maquinaciones arcanas que se desarrollan cerca de la cúpula resplandeciente de Dalaran.

ang.class:Priest: As the author of 'Holy Bologna', Allister represents the Forsaken perspective on the Cult of Forgotten Shadow and their disillusionment with the Light.
ang.faction:Horde: Allister works to secure Silverpine Forest, ensuring Horde allies have safe passage between Tirisfal Glades and lands to the south.
ang.race:Undead: Allister exemplifies the Forsaken's ruthless pragmatism, turning his back on former holy dogmas to safeguard his people against living enemies.

faq.a: He is a Forsaken shadow priest stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest who coordinates surveillance and strikes against nearby threats, particularly Dalaran forces.
faq.q: Who is Shadow Priest Allister?

faq.a: He resides in the Sepulcher, the primary Forsaken settlement located along the main road running through Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Where can I find Shadow Priest Allister?

faq.a: The Kirin Tor mages stationed at Ambermill pose a constant threat to Forsaken territory. Allister seeks to decrypt their communications, uncover their intentions, and keep their influence contained.
faq.q: Why is Allister focused on Dalaran and Ambermill?

faq.a: Allister authored 'Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You', an irreverent and critical critique of the Holy Light that found its way across the sea to the ancient libraries of Dire Maul.
al: what the light wont tell you
faq.q: What book did Allister write?

faq.a: He offers several intelligence-gathering missions around Silverpine Forest, including Border Crossings, Maps and Runes, Ambermill Investigations, and tasks confronting Dalaran agents.
faq.q: What quests does Allister offer?

faq.a: Like many Forsaken priests who felt abandoned by the Holy Light upon their deaths, Allister turned to the shadows, finding power and resolve in a discipline that embraces their undead existence.
faq.q: Why does Allister practice Shadow magic instead of the Holy Light?

text.s: Shadow Priest Allister is a Forsaken priest stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Overseeing intelligence and tactical efforts in the region, he coordinates operations to monitor Dalaran's wizards and secure the borders of Lordaeron for the Dark Lady.

sec.b: Operating out of the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister directs Forsaken reconnaissance throughout Silverpine Forest. From this central crypt settlement, he tracks nearby threats ranging from renegade humans and beastly incursions to the arcane machinations unfolding near Dalaran's shimmering dome.

Allister's chief concern lies with the surviving mages of Dalaran, particularly those occupying Ambermill and probing across the borders. Unwilling to let the Kirin Tor entrench themselves in Forsaken lands, he dispatches agents to intercept Dalaran messengers, decipher arcane runes, and determine the wizards' long-term ambitions.

Beyond his duties as a field strategist, Allister is a cynical philosopher of the shadow. He is the author of 'Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You'—a scathing treatise criticizing traditional holy doctrine. The text explores the harsh realities of undeath and how the Holy Light fails those discarded by life, a work that has somehow circulated as far afield as the ruins of Dire Maul in Kalimdor.

npc:shadow-priest-sarvis.s: Sacerdote de las Sombras Sarvis. El Sacerdote de las Sombras Sarvis se encuentra en el interior de la capilla en ruinas de Camposanto, donde ejerce de guía principal para los Renegados recién despertados. Muestra a los nuevos cadáveres su cruda realidad, encomendándoles purgar a los no-muertos sin juicio y reunir información sobre las amenazas locales. Bajo el estandarte de Lady Sylvanas, Sarvis trabaja sin descanso para convertir a no-muertos desorientados en siervos disciplinados de los Renegados. En la sombría capilla de Camposanto, el Sacerdote de las Sombras Sarvis aguarda a quienes acaban de salir de la tumba. El despertar de un Renegado resulta chocante y aterrador, y muchos pierden de inmediato la cordura sumiéndose en el frenesí irracional o el abatimiento. Sarvis actúa como un ancla, otorgando un propósito a los recién levantados. Encarga a los nuevos reclutas abatir a los cadáveres renqueantes y sin juicio que vagan por el cementerio y les ordena proteger las fronteras de Camposanto frente al avance de la Plaga.

ang.class:Priest: Sarvis exemplifies the Forsaken's embrace of shadow magic, serving as a dark mentor figure in a chapel stripped of Holy Light.
ang.race:Undead: Sarvis is one of the very first voices you hear after waking from the grave, setting you on your path to serve the Dark Lady.

faq.a: Sarvis is a Forsaken shadow priest stationed in Deathknell. He guides freshly awakened undead, giving them their initial orders and helping secure the town against the Scourge.
faq.q: Who is Shadow Priest Sarvis?

faq.a: He is located inside the ruined church at the center of Deathknell, the Forsaken starting area in Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where can I find Shadow Priest Sarvis?

faq.a: Not every corpse raised from the grave retains their free will and sanity. Those who succumb to madness are deemed a hazard to the settlement and must be destroyed before they endanger the living dead.
faq.q: Why is Sarvis having players kill mindless zombies?

text.s: Shadow Priest Sarvis stands inside the ruined chapel of Deathknell, serving as one of the primary guides for newly awakened Forsaken. He introduces fresh corpses to their grim reality, directing them to purge mindless undead and gather intelligence on local threats. Under Lady Sylvanas's banner, Sarvis works tirelessly to shape bewildered undead into disciplined servants of the Forsaken.

sec.b: Within the shadowy chapel of Deathknell, Shadow Priest Sarvis waits for those who have just clawed their way out of the grave. The awakening of a Forsaken soul is jarring and horrific, with many immediately losing their minds to mindless frenzy or despondency. Sarvis acts as an anchor, giving purpose to the newly risen. He assigns new recruits to put down the shambling, mindless corpses roaming the cemetery and directs them to secure Deathknell's borders against the encroaching Scourge.

Beyond acclimating new recruits, Sarvis oversees crucial local defenses against lingering threats in Tirisfal Glades. He coordinates the containment of Scourge forces probing Deathknell's perimeter. By directing novices toward vital intelligence and martial trials, Sarvis ensures that the town remains a fortified bastion for the Forsaken.

npc:shenthul.s: Shenthul. Shenthul es un instructor de pícaros trol de la selva asentado en las sombrías profundidades subterráneas del Circo de las Sombras, en Orgrimmar. Como agente de Mano Destrozada, coordina operaciones de espionaje por todo Kalimdor e inicia a los pícaros novatos en las filas clandestinas de la hermandad. Oculto en las turbias profundidades del Circo de las Sombras, Shenthul ejerce como uno de los mentores de pícaros más destacados de la Horda.
