Mientras los guerreros y chamanes de la superficie marchan abiertamente por el polvo rojo de Durotar, Shenthul adiestra a quienes prefieren el sigilo, la emboscada y el subterfugio. Bajo su tutela, los iniciados dominan las técnicas de campo esenciales y las artes letales, aprendiendo a desenvolverse en la despiadada política y las duras tierras salvajes de Kalimdor.

ang.class:Rogue: Shenthul is a primary mentor and handler for Horde rogues arriving in Orgrimmar, offering skill training, initiation trials, and covert assignments.
ang.faction:Horde: Operating beneath the surface of the capital, Shenthul directs the covert intelligence arm that protects the Horde from unseen internal and external threats.
ang.race:Troll: As a jungle troll embedded deeply in the traditionally orcish Shattered Hand, Shenthul demonstrates how Darkspear rogues have woven themselves into the Horde's highest levels of espionage.

faq.a: Shenthul is a jungle troll rogue trainer and operative of the Shattered Hand stationed in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Who is Shenthul?

faq.a: He can be found in the Cleft of Shadow, the subterranean cavern complex accessed through the darker tunnels of Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Where can I find Shenthul?

faq.a: Shenthul is a dedicated operative and recruiter for the Shattered Hand, the covert intelligence and assassin guild operating within the Horde.
faq.q: What is Shenthul's connection to the Shattered Hand?

faq.a: Shenthul is loyal to the craft and security of the Horde, but maintains that the Order of the Shattered Hand existed before Thrall and will outlast his rule, seeing his guild as an eternal necessity.
faq.q: What does Shenthul think of Warchief Thrall?

faq.a: He guides rogues through initiation trials, sends them on covert infiltration missions, and points them to the Venture Company's locked supply boxes in the Stonetalon Mountains to improve their lockpicking.
faq.q: What missions does Shenthul offer to rogues?

faq.a: Yes, during crucial field operations where rogues face lethal toxins, Shenthul directs agents to Hinott to ensure survival and ongoing fieldwork.
faq.q: Does Shenthul assist with rogue poisons?

text.s: Shenthul is a jungle troll rogue trainer based in the shadowy subterranean reaches of the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. As an operative of the Shattered Hand, he orchestrates espionage operations across Kalimdor and initiates rising rogues into the guild's covert ranks.

sec.b: Tucked away inside the murky depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul serves as one of the Horde's foremost rogue mentors. While the warriors and shamans above march openly across the red dust of Durotar, Shenthul trains those who prefer stealth, ambush, and subterfuge. Under his tutelage, initiates master essential fieldcraft and lethal arts, learning to operate within the unforgiving politics and harsh wilderness of Kalimdor.

Shenthul represents the Shattered Hand, an order transformed from an old orcish clan into the Horde's intelligence network and secret service. He views the organization as a timeless, watchful veil blanketing Kalimdor—acting as investigator, judge, jury, and executioner. Fiercely pragmatic and independent of shifting political tides, Shenthul famously reminds outsiders that the Shattered Hand existed long before Warchief Thrall took power and will endure long after him.

Beyond basic training, Shenthul coordinates delicate missions into contested territories. His assignments send operatives on perilous infiltration assignments, such as conducting deep-cover operations against hostile interests, practicing their lockpicking on the Venture Company's locked supply boxes around Windshear Crag, and testing recruits through demanding clandestine trials. When poisons strike his field agents, Shenthul ensures they secure remedies before fatal consequences take hold.

npc:sneed.s: Sneed. Sneed es el maestro maderero goblin de la Hermandad Defias, apostado en lo profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte. Desde la cámara maderera conocida como Sala de los Mástiles, pilota una pesada trituradora de diseño propio para procesar madera destinada al coloso secreto de Edwin VanCleef. Aunque la Hermandad Defias nutre sus filas principales de canteros humanos marginados y peones comunes, la construcción de un buque de guerra acorazado requiere oficios especializados. Edwin VanCleef reclutó a Sneed específicamente por sus conocimientos de ingeniería y su implacable eficiencia goblin. Apostado en la Sala de los Mástiles junto a la red ferroviaria subterránea, Sneed supervisa la rápida tala, corte y moldeado de la madera necesaria para la estructura del colosal acorazado de VanCleef.

ang.faction:Alliance: Taking down Sneed cripples the supply of timber heading toward the Ironclad Cove, striking a critical blow against the Defias Brotherhood's shipbuilding efforts.
ang.profession:Engineering: Sneed's customized shredder showcases classic goblin craftsmanship: devastatingly efficient, heavily armed, and pushed far past standard safety tolerances to maximize production speed.
ang.race:Gnome: Gnomish visitors to the Mast Room will find Sneed's machine a typical example of goblin ingenuity—loud, hazardous, and built without regard for operator comfort or structural longevity.

faq.a: Sneed is a goblin engineer and lumbermaster employed by Edwin VanCleef. He is tasked with overseeing the processing of lumber inside the Deadmines to build the Defias juggernaut.
faq.q: Who is Sneed?

faq.a: Sneed is located in the Mast Room, an industrial lumber mill chamber situated along the mining tracks inside the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook.
faq.q: Where can Sneed be found?

faq.a: Edwin VanCleef needed specialized industrial knowledge and fast results to construct his secret warship. He hired mercenary goblins like Sneed who care little about politics or ethics as long as the coin is good.
faq.q: Why is a goblin working for the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Sneed pilots Sneed's Shredder, a heavy, saw-wielding bipedal mechanical harvester that he built himself to harvest and slice timber at terrifying speeds.
faq.q: What is Sneed piloting in battle?

faq.a: Destroying the shredder does not finish the fight. Sneed ejects from the smoking remains of the machine and continues fighting intruders directly on foot.
faq.q: What happens when his shredder is destroyed?

faq.a: The timber cut in Sneed's chamber is transported downstream to the Ironclad Cove, where the Brotherhood is assembling a massive warship intended to strike back against Stormwind.
faq.q: What is Sneed building timber for?

text.s: Sneed is the Defias Brotherhood's goblin lumbermaster stationed deep within the Deadmines. Operating from the lumber chamber known as the Mast Room, he pilots a heavy shredder of his own design to process timber for Edwin VanCleef's secret juggernaut.

sec.b: While the Defias Brotherhood draws its core membership from disenfranchised human stonemasons and common laborers, building an ironclad warship requires specialist trades. Edwin VanCleef recruited Sneed specifically for his engineering know-how and ruthless goblin efficiency. Stationed in the Mast Room along the subterranean rail network, Sneed oversees the rapid felling, cutting, and shaping of timber needed to frame VanCleef's colossal dreadnaught.

Sneed's primary concern is cutting costs and meeting deadlined quotas, consequences be damned. To speed up the process, he commands the floor from inside a customized shredder equipped with oversized buzz saws. The deadly machine turns raw trunks into shipbuilding timber in seconds. If cornered by intruders, Sneed relies on the armor of his machine to grind them down, but he is more than willing to scramble out of the wreckage and fight with his bare hands if his contraption fails.

npc:sneed-s-shredder.s: Machacador de Sneed. La Machacador de Sneed es una imponente cosechadora de madera mecanizada ubicada en lo más profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte. Pilotada por el capataz goblin Sneed, esta letal máquina actúa tanto de maquinaria industrial pesada para los carpinteros de ribera de Edwin VanCleef como de aterrador defensor perimetral. En la fundición dominada por goblins de Las Minas de la Muerte, las trituradoras mecánicas cumplen un doble propósito: procesar las ingentes cantidades de madera necesarias para el coloso oculto de Edwin VanCleef y servir como máquinas de choque blindadas contra los intrusos. Sneed, el supervisor de las obras madereras, maneja directamente esta bestia mecánica modificada, convirtiendo una sierra circular descomunal en un instrumento defensivo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Eliminating Sneed and his machine cripples the lumber milling operations supporting Edwin VanCleef's secret war fleet.
ang.profession:Engineering: The shredder is a classic marvel of goblin mechanical design, though it remains vulnerable to the overrides of a Gnomish Universal Remote.
ang.race:Gnome: Shoni the Shilent of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew wants this goblin-built monster's power supply to drive the drills that could reopen the way to Gnomeregan.

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood relies heavily on goblin machinery to carve through subterranean stone and process massive quantities of timber needed to construct their secret juggernaut. Sneed uses this shredder to mill wood and brutally enforce order over the underground works.
al: why is there a shredder in deadmines
faq.q: What is Sneed's Shredder used for in the Deadmines?

faq.a: When the shredder suffers critical mechanical failure, Sneed himself survives the wreckage. The goblin pilot emerges directly from the ruined vehicle, brandishing his own weapons and attacking intruders with fierce tenacity.
al: does sneed die with the shredder
faq.q: What happens when the shredder is destroyed?

faq.a: Edwin VanCleef hired goblin engineers, craftsmen, and mercenary laborers to oversee the complex mechanical operations beneath Westfall, including steam-powered forges, gun foundries, and woodmills.
faq.q: Why do the Defias Brotherhood have goblin technology?

faq.a: Clever inventors carrying a Gnomish Universal Remote can briefly override the shredder's control systems, temporarily wresting control of the machine away from Sneed.
faq.q: Can the shredder be hacked or controlled by engineers?

faq.a: Yes. Its intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, is sought by Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind, who needs it to power the gnomes' gyrodrillmatic excavationators for an assault on Gnomeregan.
faq.q: Does Sneed's Shredder carry anything valuable?

faq.a: The machine is commanded by Sneed, a seasoned goblin supervisor who directs the logging and carpentry operations deep within the Deadmines.
faq.q: Who pilots the shredder?

text.s: Sneed's Shredder is an imposing mechanised lumber harvester stationed deep within the Deadmines. Piloted by the goblin taskmaster Sneed, this deadly machine acts as both heavy industrial machinery for Edwin VanCleef's shipwrights and a terrifying perimeter defender.

sec.b: Within the goblin-dominated foundry of the Deadmines, mechanical shredders serve a dual purpose: processing vast amounts of timber and lumber required for Edwin VanCleef's hidden juggernaut, and serving as armored shock engines against intruders. Sneed, the overseer of the lumber works, operates this modified mechanical beast directly, turning an oversized buzzsaw into an instrument of defense.

Defeating the machine does not end the threat. Sneed perches inside an open cockpit above the spinning blades, relying on heavy iron plating and terrifying clatter to scatter his foes. Even when the machinery breaks down and the shredder collapses in a shower of sparks, Sneed leaps from the smoking wreckage to fight to the bitter end.

npc:sprite-jumpsprocket.s: Duendy Ruedadentada. Duendy Ruedadentada es una aprendiz de ingeniera gnoma que reside actualmente en el concurrido Distrito de los Enanos de la Ciudad de Ventormenta. Como muchos gnomos que buscaron refugio tras la caída de Gnomeregan, se dedica a la artesanía técnica y a la innovación junto a sus compañeros manitas. Su presencia pone de manifiesto la próspera comunidad de artesanos enanos y gnomos que mantienen la capital abastecida de engranajes, artilugios y conocimientos mecánicos. En las calles cubiertas de hollín y los bulliciosos talleres del Distrito de los Enanos, gnomos y enanos trabajan codo con codo forjando metal y diseñando complejos artilugios. Duendy Ruedadentada ejerce como aprendiz de ingeniera en este vibrante núcleo. Tras haberse integrado en la capital del reino, los aprendices de manitas como Duendy perfeccionan su oficio bajo la tutela de maestros experimentados, aportando sus mentes inventivas a los mecanismos cotidianos y a las maravillas tecnológicas de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Alliance: Her work in the Dwarven District illustrates the everyday cooperation between humans, dwarves, and gnomes supporting the capital's infrastructure.
ang.profession:Engineering: For budding tinkers, Sprite Jumpsprocket stands as a fellow student of sprockets, copper tubing, and volatile concoctions in Stormwind's most industrial enclave.
ang.race:Gnome: Sprite is a reminder of the perseverance of Gnomeregan's exiles, continuing their love of craft and mechanical mastery far from their lost homeland.

faq.a: Sprite Jumpsprocket is a female gnome apprentice engineer living and working within the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.
faq.q: Who is Sprite Jumpsprocket?

faq.a: She can be found in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City, surrounded by workshops, anvils, and fellow engineering enthusiasts.
faq.q: Where can I find Sprite Jumpsprocket?

faq.a: Sprite is an apprentice engineer. She represents the ongoing presence of gnomish tinkerers honing their inventive crafts in the Alliance capital.
faq.q: What role does she serve in Stormwind?

faq.a: After the catastrophic fall of Gnomeregan, many gnomes sought refuge among their dwarven cousins in Ironforge and throughout human lands, particularly Stormwind City, where their industrial ingenuity is in high demand.
faq.q: Why are gnomes like Sprite living in Stormwind?

faq.a: Sprite plays a minor role in the local neighborhood of the Dwarven District, mainly standing as part of the district's engineering community.
faq.q: Is Sprite Jumpsprocket tied to any notable quests?

faq.a: While sometimes indexed near surrounding southern kingdoms records, Sprite is stationed squarely in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City, though engineering creations throughout the region often share gnomish designs.
faq.q: Is she associated with Westfall?

text.s: Sprite Jumpsprocket is an apprentice gnome engineer currently residing in the busy Dwarven District of Stormwind City. Like many gnomes who sought refuge following the fall of Gnomeregan, she pursues technical craft and innovation alongside her fellow tinkers. Her presence highlights the thriving community of dwarven and gnomish artisans who keep the capital city supplied with gears, gadgets, and mechanical expertise.

sec.b: In the soot-covered streets and bustling workshops of the Dwarven District, gnomes and dwarves work shoulder-to-shoulder forging metal and designing intricate contraptions. Sprite Jumpsprocket serves as an apprentice engineer in this vibrant hub. Having integrated into the kingdom's capital, apprentice tinkers like Sprite hone their craft under experienced masters, contributing their inventive minds to the everyday mechanisms and technological marvels of the Alliance.

Following the devastating loss of Gnomeregan, displaced gnomes dispersed across Alliance lands, bringing their singular knack for tinkering, chemistry, and mechanics with them. In Stormwind City, gnomes found a welcoming sanctuary within the Dwarven District, where blast furnaces and workbenches are plentiful. Sprite Jumpsprocket represents this resilient, forward-looking spirit—determined to master the complex discipline of engineering despite the hardships faced by her kin.

npc:sputtervalve.s: Petardol. Petardol es un estresado ingeniero goblin afincado en la ciudad portuaria de Trinquete. Al servicio del Gremio de Manitas bajo las órdenes del Director Riddlevox, supervisa la investigación y el desarrollo regional de trituradoras bajo unos plazos corporativos asfixiantes. Para mantener su puesto, suele contratar a aventureros que lleven a cabo espionaje industrial contra sus rivales de Ventura y Cía. Operando desde Trinquete, Petardol responde ante el Director Riddlevox del Gremio de Manitas. Puesto a cargo del desarrollo de trituradoras, no tardó en descubrir que mantener el ritmo de la mecanización moderna es una tarea brutal. Ante una competencia feroz y un plazo implacable, Petardol se vio con muy pocos prototipos funcionales propios. En lugar de admitir el fracaso ante el Gremio, recurrió a la clásica solución goblin: robar diseños mejores a quienquiera que los hubiese construido primero.

ang.faction:Horde: Though Ratchet maintains neutrality, Sputtervalve relies heavily on Horde travelers crossing the Barrens to break Venture Company operations and smuggle machine parts.
ang.profession:Engineering: Sputtervalve represents goblin engineering's ruthless ethos: when innovation stalls, steal the schematics from the nearest competitor.

faq.a: Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer affiliated with the Tinkers' Union based in Ratchet. Director Riddlevox tasked him with shredder research and development, leaving him scrambling to deliver results before his strict corporate deadlines expire.
faq.q: Who is Sputtervalve?

faq.a: The Venture Company developed cutting-edge shredders at the Sludge Fen featuring interchangeable hands and superior control grips. Unable to surpass their designs legitimately, Sputtervalve resorted to corporate espionage to 'borrow' their blueprints and machinery.
faq.q: Why is Sputtervalve targeting the Venture Company?

faq.a: A samophlange is an intricate mechanical component found within Venture Company shredders and control consoles. Sputtervalve hires adventurers to extract and examine it in hopes of mastering their technology.
faq.q: What is a samophlange?

faq.a: Wizzlecrank is an operative and associate sent by Sputtervalve into the Sludge Fen to steal shredder prototypes. His mission went sideways when he became trapped inside one of the machines, requiring an escort out.
faq.q: Who is Wizzlecrank?

faq.a: He does not study organic curiosities himself, but his familiarity with the Barrens makes him an ideal contact. When shown the shard recovered from the Wailing Caverns, he points adventurers toward the druids perched on the hills above the caves.
faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve care about the Glowing Shard?

faq.a: Director Riddlevox is the high-ranking leader of the Tinkers' Union who placed Sputtervalve in charge of shredder innovation, holding him to strict and unforgiving production timelines.
faq.q: Who is Director Riddlevox?

text.s: Sputtervalve is a stressed goblin engineer stationed in the port town of Ratchet. Serving the Tinkers' Union under Director Riddlevox, he oversees regional shredder research and development under crushing corporate deadlines. To keep his standing, he frequently hires adventurers to engage in industrial espionage against the rival Venture Company.

sec.b: Operating out of Ratchet, Sputtervalve answers to Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union. Put in charge of shredder development, he quickly discovered that keeping pace with modern mechanization is brutal work. Facing fierce competition and an unforgiving deadline, Sputtervalve found himself with few working prototypes of his own. Rather than admit failure to the Union, he turned toward the classic goblin solution: stealing better designs from whoever built them first.

Sputtervalve's primary target is the Venture Company's drilling operation at the Sludge Fen to the northwest. Their latest shredder models boast interchangeable hands, refined control grips, and advanced internal mechanisms like the elusive samophlange. Desperate to crack their secrets, Sputtervalve dispatched his associate Wizzlecrank into the Fen for 'field research,' only for the operative to get trapped, forcing Sputtervalve to hire wandering mercenaries to recover stolen technology and rescue his partner.

Beyond his shredder dilemmas, Sputtervalve acts as a general point of contact for strange curiosities passing through the Barrens. When adventurers drag bizarre, corrupter-infused artifacts out of the Wailing Caverns—such as a glowing shard—Sputtervalve knows enough about the local landscape to direct them away from gadgetry and toward the isolated druids encamped above the caverns.

npc:sten-stoutarm.s: Sten Brazofuerte. Sten Brazofuerte es un práctico sastre y mensajero enano apostado frente a Yunquemar, en el Valle de Crestanevada. Encargado de mantener equipados a los nuevos reclutas y de gestionar los despachos locales, ayuda a garantizar que los montañeros noveles permanezcan abrigados, alimentados e informados a pesar de las duras condiciones de la montaña. Situado cerca del corazón del Valle de Crestanevada, Sten Brazofuerte es uno de los primeros rostros amables con los que se topan los nuevos reclutas enanos y gnomos frente a la taberna de Yunquemar. Con el valle aislado por las ventiscas invernales y los peligros invasores, Sten se encarga personalmente de equipar a los aprendices novatos con equipo resistente antes de que se congelen o se adentren sin preparación en la nieve acumulada.

ang.faction:Alliance: Maintaining communication through Coldridge Pass is critical for Ironforge's training grounds, and Sten's mail network keeps the valley connected to the wider Alliance.
ang.race:Dwarf: Sten embodies the no-nonsense hospitality of Dun Morogh, making sure his kin are clad in thick leather and fed before sending them into the snow.
ang.race:Gnome: As gnomish refugees train alongside dwarves in Anvilmar, Sten treats them with the same practical expectations, dispatching them with mail and outfitting them for the elements.

faq.a: Sten Stoutarm is a dwarven outfitter and messenger stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He assists fresh recruits by supplying warm clothing and delegating local mail deliveries.
faq.q: Who is Sten Stoutarm?

faq.a: Sten serves as both a quartermaster and courier contact for Anvilmar. He collects local resources like wolf meat and pelts to craft protective gear for apprentices, while also routing correspondence and training memoranda across the valley.
faq.q: What role does he play in Coldridge Valley?

faq.a: With Coldridge Pass endangered by troggs and winter weather, mail and supplies struggle to flow into the valley. Once messages make it through, Sten relies on dependable novices to deliver parcels and letters to residents such as Talin Keeneye.
faq.q: Why does Sten need mail delivered?

faq.a: Sten takes a weary, unimpressed view of the pests infesting the surrounding hills, famously remarking that once you have seen one trogg, you have seen them all.
faq.q: What does Sten think about the troggs in the valley?

faq.a: Sten trades durable, warm gloves to passing adventurers in exchange for tough wolf meat, helping sustain the valley's defenders while outfitting them against the biting Dun Morogh cold.
faq.q: Why does he ask for wolf meat?

faq.a: They are sealed letters and training tokens dispatched from superiors across Ironforge and Dun Morogh, directing young apprentices to report to their respective class trainers inside Anvilmar.
faq.q: What are the runes and memoranda Sten gives to new adventurers?

text.s: Sten Stoutarm is a practical dwarven outfitter and courier stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Responsible for keeping new recruits equipped and managing local dispatches, he helps ensure that novice mountaineers stay warm, fed, and informed despite the harsh mountain conditions.

sec.b: Positioned near the heart of Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm is one of the first friendly faces new dwarven and gnomish recruits encounter outside Anvilmar's tavern. With the valley isolated by winter blizzards and encroaching dangers, Sten takes it upon himself to outfit green apprentices with sturdy gear before they freeze or wander unprepared into the drifts.
sec.t: A Helping Hand in the Snow

sec.b: Beyond assembling winter outfitting from local wolf hides, Sten serves as an informal postmaster for Coldridge Valley. He handles messages passed through the treacherous Coldridge Pass and distributes official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers throughout the basin, ensuring novice warriors, priests, and mages get their instructions despite the hostile trogg presence blocking the tunnels.

npc:strahad-farsan.s: Strahad Farsan. Strahad Farsan es un maestro brujo humano que habita en una apartada torre de piedra con vistas a Trinquete, en Los Baldíos. Renombrado más allá de las fronteras de las facciones, opera al margen de la política convencional de la Alianza y de la Horda, instruyendo a aspirantes a invocadores en las peligrosas artes de someter a demonios mayores. Practicantes de la magia vil tanto de Ventormenta como de Orgrimmar y Entrañas acuden en busca de su rigurosa tutela. Encaramada en los riscos situados sobre el puerto goblin de Trinquete, la torre de Strahad Farsan se erige apartada de los bulliciosos muelles comerciales. La neutralidad de Trinquete le otorga a Strahad la libertad necesaria para llevar a cabo peligrosas invocaciones demoníacas lejos de las miradas indiscretas de los magistrados de la Alianza o los chamanes de la Horda. Rodeado de sus acólitos, estudia los misterios más profundos del Vacío Abisal en relativo aislamiento, ajeno a las disputas territoriales menores.

ang.class:Warlock: Strahad is a pivotal mentor for intermediate summoners, guiding you through the harrowing rituals required to bind felhunters and summon steeds from the Nether.
ang.faction:Alliance: Sent by Gakin the Darkbinder from the crypts of the Slaughtered Lamb, Alliance warlocks travel to Kalimdor specifically to study under Strahad.
ang.faction:Horde: Despite being an Alliance-born human, Strahad remains open to dealing with Horde practitioners under the neutral aegis of Ratchet.
ang.race:Human: Strahad demonstrates that human masters of the dark arts operate far beyond the kingdom of Stormwind when seeking greater power.

faq.a: Strahad Farsan is an accomplished human warlock and master trainer residing in a stone tower above Ratchet. He belongs to the inner circle of the prominent Stormwind warlock Gakin the Darkbinder, but his immense skill in demonic summoning makes him an authority sought by warlocks of both the Alliance and the Horde.
faq.q: Who is Strahad Farsan?

faq.a: Ratchet is a neutral port run by the Steamwheedle Cartel, providing an ideal haven for dark spellcasters. Living on the bluffs allows Strahad to experiment with dangerous summoning rituals far from the restrictive laws of the Alliance and the watchful scrutiny of the Horde.
faq.q: Why is a human warlock living in the Barrens?

faq.a: Strahad's mastery over demonic entities transcends factional allegiance. Mentors in Orgrimmar and the Undercity acknowledge his expertise in binding complex demons, such as felhunters, and send their most promising pupils across the sea to learn directly from him.
al: why do orcs go to strahad
faq.q: Why do Horde warlocks visit Strahad?

faq.a: When Strahad first attempted to bind a felhunter, the ritual nearly cost him his life. He barely survived the confrontation, an experience that taught him the brutal precision required to subjugate such magic-consuming predators.
faq.q: What happened to Strahad when he summoned his first felhunter?

faq.a: They share the uncommon surname Farsan, which strongly suggests a family connection, though Strahad remains focused entirely on his dark craft and reveals nothing about his familial ties.
faq.q: Is Strahad related to Godrick Farsan?

faq.a: Strahad oversees several dedicated acolytes, including Magaz, Fenrick, and Wytula. They assist him with maintaining protective wards, preparing intricate summoning circles, and tending to the demanding rituals carried out at the tower.
faq.q: Who are the acolytes around his tower?

text.s: Strahad Farsan is a master human warlock who dwells in a secluded stone tower overlooking Ratchet in the Barrens. Renowned across faction lines, he operates outside conventional Alliance and Horde politics, training aspiring summoners in the dangerous arts of binding higher demons. Practitioners of fel magic from Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and the Undercity alike seek his severe guidance.

sec.b: Perched on the bluffs above the goblin port of Ratchet, Strahad Farsan's tower stands apart from the bustling trade docks below. Ratchet's neutrality offers Strahad the freedom to conduct perilous demonic summonings away from the prying eyes of Alliance magistrates or Horde shamans. Surrounded by his acolytes, he studies the deeper mysteries of the Twisting Nether in relative seclusion, unbothered by petty territorial squabbles.

Strahad earned his formidable reputation through direct, deadly experience. When first binding a felhunter into service, he barely escaped with his life—an ordeal that left him both acutely cautious and unyielding in his expectations. Despite his human heritage, he has earned the respect of shadowy figures across Azeroth, including Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind and demonic scholars in the Undercity and Orgrimmar. Warlocks of any banner who wish to command creatures as volatile as felhunters or fiery steeds are inevitably directed to his doorstep.

npc:sylvanas-windrunner.s: Sylvanas Brisaveloz. Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz es la Reina Alma en Pena y gobernante suprema de los Renegados, y celebra audiencia en Entrañas, bajo las Ruinas de Lordaeron. Antaño la valiente General Forestal de Lunargenta, fue asesinada y alzada en la no-muerte por Arthas Menethil antes de liberarse del yugo del Rey Exánime. Ahora aliada con la Horda de Thrall por pura supervivencia mutua, está ferozmente dedicada a asegurar un futuro para sus no-muertos con libre albedrío y a cobrarse venganza contra la Plaga. En vida, Lady Sylvanas fue la célebre General Forestal de Lunargenta, al mando de la defensa de Quel'Thalas durante la Tercera Guerra. Cuando el príncipe Arthas Menethil marchó con la Plaga hacia el reino de los altos elfos para alcanzar la Fuente del Sol, Sylvanas luchó con ferocidad para frenar su avance. Frustrado por su resistencia, Arthas la asesinó, pero le negó una muerte limpia. Arrancó su alma de su cadáver y la transformó en una vengativa alma en pena, obligándola a servir a la Plaga y a colaborar en la matanza de su propio pueblo.

ang.faction:Horde: Though accepted into the Horde through the advocacy of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and Thrall's compassion, many orcs and trolls view Sylvanas and her court with lingering wariness.
ang.race:Undead: To the Forsaken, the Dark Lady is a liberator and protector, the solitary reason they possess free will and a fortified home rather than mindlessly serving the Scourge.

faq.a: She is the sovereign leader of the Forsaken, holding court in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. In life she was the elven Ranger-General of Quel'Thalas, but after being slain and raised by Arthas Menethil, she broke away from the Scourge to lead the free-willed undead.
faq.q: Who is Sylvanas Windrunner?

faq.a: The Forsaken are reviled by the living nations of the Alliance, who see them only as monsters. Surrounded by the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade in Lordaeron, Sylvanas required strong allies to ensure her fledgling nation's survival, prompting her to petition Warchief Thrall for entry into the Horde.
faq.q: Why did Sylvanas align the Forsaken with the Horde?

faq.a: When the Lich King's psychic power began to bleed away during the aftermath of the Third War, his iron control over the Scourge fractured. Sylvanas was among the first powerful spirits to regain her autonomy, immediately reclaiming her mortal remains and turning her wrath upon Arthas.
faq.q: How did Sylvanas break free from the Lich King?

faq.a: Above all else, Sylvanas seeks total retribution against Arthas Menethil and the Scourge for destroying her homeland and enslaving her soul. Concurrently, she strives to fortify the Undercity and carve out a secure, permanent haven for the Forsaken in Lordaeron.
faq.q: What is Sylvanas's primary goal?

text.s: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner is the Banshee Queen and supreme ruler of the Forsaken, holding court in the Undercity beneath the ruins of Lordaeron. Once the brave Ranger-General of Silvermoon, she was slain and raised into undeath by Arthas Menethil before breaking free from the Lich King's grip. Now allied with Thrall's Horde out of mutual survival, she is fiercely dedicated to securing a future for her free-willed undead and exacting vengeance upon the Scourge.

sec.b: In life, Lady Sylvanas was the celebrated Ranger-General of Silvermoon, commanding the defense of Quel'Thalas during the Third War. When Prince Arthas Menethil marched the Scourge into the high elven kingdom to reach the Sunwell, Sylvanas fought fiercely to delay his advance. Frustrated by her resistance, Arthas murdered her, but denied her a clean death. He ripped her soul from her corpse and twisted it into a vengeful banshee, forcing her to serve the Scourge and assist in the slaughter of her own people.

When the Lich King's magical grip fractured after the Third War, Sylvanas broke free of his dominion and repossessed her preserved body. Amassing other undead who had regained their free will, she overthrew the dreadlords occupying the ruins of Lordaeron, dubbed her people the Forsaken, and established the subterranean realm of the Undercity. Recognizing the precarious isolation of her people—threatened by Scourge remnants, zealous Scarlet crusaders, and suspicious human realms—she forged an uneasy alliance of convenience with Warchief Thrall and the Horde.

npc:tallonkai-swiftroot.s: Tallonkai Cruzarraíz. Tallonkai Cruzarraíz es un elfo de la noche residente de Dolanaar en Teldrassil. Preocupado por la incipiente corrupción que mancilla las grandes ramas, recluta a jóvenes aventureros para recuperar reliquias encantadas y frenar las viles fuerzas que asolan los bosques. Tallonkai Cruzarraíz habita en el asentamiento de las copas de Dolanaar, manteniendo un ojo vigilante sobre los bosques circundantes. Como muchos elfos de la noche que viven bajo las ramas del recién crecido Árbol del Mundo, está alarmado por la agitación antinatural de la fauna y las inquietantes sombras que se congregan en los confines de sus poblados.

ang.class:Druid: Tallonkai's concerns center on relics that tether minds safely to the Emerald Dream, making his requests deeply relevant to druidic spiritual traditions.
ang.race:NightElf: Tallonkai Swiftroot represents the vigilance needed to protect Teldrassil during its vulnerable early years, asking young Kaldorei to purge corruption taking root in their new home.

faq.a: Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf quest giver stationed in Dolanaar on the boughs of Teldrassil, dedicated to safeguarding the settlement from local threats.
faq.q: Who is Tallonkai Swiftroot?

faq.a: He is located in the town of Dolanaar, the central night elf village found just outside Shadowglen in Teldrassil.
faq.q: Where can I find Tallonkai Swiftroot?

faq.a: He asks travelers to retrieve the Emerald Dreamcatcher from the gnarlpine furbolgs, defeat the Gnarlpine furbolg Ferocitas the Dream Eater, and confront the warped gnarlpine threat in quests like Twisted Hatred.
faq.q: What tasks does Tallonkai give?

faq.a: Dreamcatchers are sacred night elf talismans tied to the Emerald Dream, used to ward against nightmares and dark visions. Their theft and corruption by hostile creatures poses a spiritual danger to the local druids and denizens of Teldrassil.
faq.q: Why is he concerned about the dreamcatchers?

faq.a: Ferocitas the Dream Eater is the leader of a band of corrupted Gnarlpine mystics north of Starbreeze. He stole the emerald from Tallonkai's dreamcatcher and wears it on a necklace that glows green in the night.
faq.q: Who is Ferocitas the Dream Eater?

faq.a: A growing sickness and unnatural corruption has seeped into Teldrassil, driving previously peaceful creatures like the gnarlpine furbolgs into violent madness.
faq.q: What is causing the unrest Tallonkai fights against?

text.s: Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf resident of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Concerned with the emerging corruption tainting the great boughs, he enlists young adventurers to recover enchanted relics and stem the foul forces plaguing the woods.

sec.b: Dwelling in the canopy settlement of Dolanaar, Tallonkai Swiftroot keeps a watchful eye over the surrounding woods. Like many night elves living beneath the boughs of the newly grown World Tree, he is alarmed by the unnatural agitation of the wildlife and the unsettling shadows gathering at the edges of their settlements.

Tallonkai directs adventurers to confront foul entities disturbing Teldrassil's peace. His concerns include corrupted dream catchers crafted to protect sleeping druids, vicious gnarlpine furbolgs succumbing to a dark malaise, and the corrupted Gnarlpine mystics led by Ferocitas the Dream Eater. To Tallonkai, cleansing these disturbances is crucial to defending the fragile home of the Kaldorei.

npc:taragaman-the-hungerer.s: Taragaman el Hambriento. Taragaman el Hambriento es un descomunal guardia vil que acecha en las cavernas incandescentes de Sima Ígnea, bajo Orgrimmar. Aunque muchos le temen como el amo demoníaco tras el culto Filoardiente, su presencia en las profundidades ardientes sirve a un propósito más oscuro y engañoso. La Horda busca su destrucción para purgar la corrupción demoníaca que envenena las entrañas de la ciudad. Merodeando entre los charcos de magma de Sima Ígnea, Taragaman el Hambriento representa una amenaza inmediata y aterradora para la seguridad de Orgrimmar. Para muchos exploradores y jóvenes guerreros enviados a la oscura sima, el guardia vil demoníaco parece ser el cabecilla principal de los cultores Filoardiente, sirviéndose de una fuerza infernal para doblegar a los débiles de espíritu y corromper los pasajes subterráneos bajo la fortaleza de Thrall.

ang.class:Warlock: While warlocks practice their dark arts within the Cleft of Shadow above, a wild and hostile felguard like Taragaman poses an untamed danger to the secrecy and safety of their hidden craft.
ang.class:Warrior: Facing Taragaman requires standing firm against crushing physical blows and avoiding being tossed into the surrounding lava by his brutal uppercuts.
ang.faction:Horde: For the young warriors and spellcasters of the Horde, slaying Taragaman in the depths beneath Orgrimmar is a critical proving ground to protect their capital from demonic corruption.

faq.a: Taragaman is a felguard, a brutal demonic shock trooper of the Burning Legion. He wields heavy melee strikes and fiery magic to crush intruders within the magma caverns of Ragefire Chasm.
faq.q: What kind of demon is Taragaman the Hungerer?

faq.a: He is widely believed to be. Taragaman is the most fearsome demonic power in Ragefire Chasm, and the Horde's young defenders are sent to slay him as the cult's master, though the chasm may hold more secrets than a single felguard.
faq.q: Is Taragaman the Hungerer the leader of the Searing Blade cult?

faq.a: The Horde cannot allow an active demonic presence to fester beneath their capital city. Taragaman's infernal corruption threatens to poison Orgrimmar from within, and eliminating him is vital to securing the cavern passages beneath the streets.
faq.q: Why does the Horde want Taragaman dead?

faq.a: Taragaman resides deep within Ragefire Chasm, located in the subterranean volcanic tunnels accessible from the Cleft of Shadow inside Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Where can Taragaman be found?

faq.a: Victorious adventurers carve out Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart as proof of the beast's demise to complete the task of clearing out the demonic vanguard festering below Orgrimmar.
faq.q: What happens to Taragaman's heart?

faq.a: Taragaman relies on devastating physical attacks, a powerful uppercut that knocks foes through the air, and occasional bursts of Fire Nova that scorch anyone standing close to him.
faq.q: How does Taragaman fight in combat?

text.s: Taragaman the Hungerer is a hulking felguard lurking within the molten caverns of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. While widely feared as the demonic master behind the Searing Blade cult, his presence in the fiery depths serves a darker, more deceptive purpose. The Horde seeks his destruction to eliminate the demonic taint poisoning the city's underbelly.

sec.b: Prowling amidst the magma pools of Ragefire Chasm, Taragaman the Hungerer represents an immediate and terrifying threat to the safety of Orgrimmar. For many scouts and young warriors sent into the dark chasm, the demonic felguard appears to be the central ringleader of the Searing Blade cultists, wielding infernal strength to bend the weak-willed and corrupt the subterranean passages beneath Thrall's fortress.

Despite his commanding demeanor and devastating brutality, Taragaman is not the mastermind directing the Searing Blade. True leadership of the cult rests in the shadows with the satyr Bazzalan and the warlock Jergosh the Invoker. To these calculating schemers, the towering felguard is little more than expendable bait—a monstrous distraction designed to draw aspiring Horde defenders into the searing volcanic depths where they can be slaughtered.

npc:targorr-the-dread.s: Targor el Pavoroso. Targor el Pavoroso es un infame verdugo orco Roca Negra encarcelado en las profundidades de las Mazmorras de Ventormenta. Conocido por sus brutales torturas a los soldados capturados de Ventormenta, su ejecución se retrasó indefinidamente debido a la incompetencia y la corrupción burocráticas. Cuando las Mazmorras estallaron en una revuelta liderada por la Hermandad Defias, Targor se liberó y se alió con los convictos amotinados. Antes de su captura, Targor el Pavoroso ejerció como verdugo supremo del clan Roca Negra bajo las órdenes del Señor de la guerra Gath'Ilzogg. Operando desde las ruinas ocupadas en Crestagrana, su crueldad destacó por ser excepcionalmente salvaje incluso para los violentos estándares de la Horda Oscura. Los guardias y milicianos de Ventormenta que luchaban por defender las tierras fronterizas fueron sometidos a tormentos agonizantes y a una muerte lenta a sus manos, convirtiendo su nombre en uno de los más aborrecidos del reino.

ang.faction:Alliance: Putting down Targorr within the rioting Stockade brings long-overdue justice to the fallen defenders of Lakeshire and helps contain the chaos beneath the capital.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind—particularly those with ties to Redridge—Targorr embodies the terrible cost of the kingdom's bureaucratic failures and the ongoing threat of the Blackrock orcs.

faq.a: Targorr the Dread is a Blackrock orc who served as the supreme executioner under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg. Notorious for torturing captured Stormwind soldiers, he was caught and imprisoned inside the Stormwind Stockade.
faq.q: Who is Targorr the Dread?

faq.a: Although Targorr was captured and scheduled to face justice, Stormwind's inefficient, bloated, and corrupt legal administration dragged out the process. His execution was delayed by endless bureaucratic red tape until the prison riots erupted.
faq.q: Why wasn't Targorr executed when he was captured?

faq.a: Targorr does not share the Defias Brotherhood's political grievances, but during the chaos of the prison uprising, convicts of all stripes united against their jailers. He allied with the rioters simply to secure his freedom and slaughter any guards or adventurers who cross his path.
faq.q: Why is an orc allied with the Defias Brotherhood?

faq.a: Guard Berton, stationed at Lakeshire in Redridge, offers a bounty for Targorr's severed head. The people of Lakeshire suffered extensively under Targorr's cruelty and want to see the execution Stormwind's courts failed to deliver.
faq.q: Who wants Targorr dead now?

faq.a: Targorr is located inside the Stormwind Stockade instance, holed up in one of the rear cellblocks alongside other rioting inmates.
faq.q: Where can Targorr be found?

faq.a: Targorr belongs to the Blackrock orcs, part of the rogue Dark Horde remnants operating out of the Redridge Mountains and Blackrock Spire, rather than the New Horde led by Thrall.
faq.q: What clan does Targorr belong to?

text.s: Targorr the Dread is an infamous Blackrock orc executioner imprisoned deep within the Stormwind Stockade. Known for his brutal tortures of captured Stormwind soldiers, his execution was indefinitely delayed by bureaucratic incompetence and corruption. When the Stockade erupted into revolt under the Defias Brotherhood, Targorr broke free and allied with the rioting convicts.

sec.b: Before his capture, Targorr the Dread served as the supreme executioner for the Blackrock clan under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg. Operating out of the occupied ruins in Redridge, his cruelty stood out as exceptionally savage even by the violent standards of the Dark Horde. Stormwind guards and militiamen who fought to defend the borderlands were subjected to agonizing torment and slow death at his hands, making his name one of the most reviled in the kingdom.

When Alliance forces finally managed to capture Targorr alive, he was brought in chains to the capital and locked inside the high-security Stockade to await execution. However, the rot within Stormwind's judicial and political bureaucracy stalled the proceedings. Paralyzed by graft, endless paperwork, and neglect, the courts failed to deliver the death sentence he had earned, leaving a bloodthirsty war criminal sitting in a cell beneath the heart of the city.

When the Defias Brotherhood staged their violent prison break, Targorr saw his opportunity. Breaking free from his cell, the ruthless orc threw his lot in with the Defias rioters, turning his cellblock into a slaughterhouse. With the prison entirely out of Warden Thelwater's control, towns like Lakeshire—still nursing the bitter wounds Targorr inflicted on their defenders—seek adventurers willing to venture into the riots and bring back the butcher's head.

npc:tavernkeep-smitts.s: Tabernero Smitts. El Tabernero Smitts es el camarero del Mesón del Cuervo Escarlata en Villa Oscura. Al regentar el centro social de Bosque del Ocaso, Smitts posee un conocimiento enciclopédico de los cotilleos del pueblo y de las tragedias locales sin resolver. Su prodigiosa memoria y su mirada atenta lo convierten en un contacto de valor incalculable para cualquiera que investigue la oscura historia de la región. Tras la barra del Mesón del Cuervo Escarlata, el Tabernero Smitts ofrece el calor del fuego y bebida a viajeros agotados, vecinos del pueblo y nerviosos guardias de la Guardia Nocturna que desafían los peligros de Bosque del Ocaso. Al ser una de las figuras públicas más veteranas del pueblo, Smitts se entera de cada rumor que se filtra a través de la penumbra. Mientras otros lugareños se encogen tras contraventanas atrancadas, Smitts vigila con ojo pragmático y observador a todo el que cruza su puerta, atento a conductas inusuales, huidas apresuradas y clientes extraños.

ang.class:Rogue: Rogues investigating cold cases and shadowy figures will find Smitts an ideal informant, as he notices what patrons write, when they panic, and what they leave behind.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers stepping out of the shadowed woods, Smitts provides not just shelter and drinks, but essential local intelligence regarding the threats haunting Duskwood.

faq.a: Smitts stands behind the counter on the ground floor of the Scarlet Raven Tavern, the central inn located on the town square in Darkshire.
faq.q: Where can I find Tavernkeep Smitts?

faq.a: Years ago, Smitts accompanied Marshal Haggard to investigate the slaughter of visiting nobles. Smitts discovered muddy, torn pages at the scene, which he preserved. If presented with new evidence linking Stalvan to the crime, Smitts hands over the muddy journal pages so they can be delivered to Commander Althea Ebonlocke.
faq.q: What does Smitts know about Stalvan Mistmantle?

faq.a: Jitters spent time staying at the Scarlet Raven Tavern, where Smitts observed him frantically writing in a journal before fleeing in terror. When you bring Jitters's journal back to the tavern, Smitts identifies it and directs you toward Raven Hill Cemetery to track him down.
faq.q: What does Smitts know about Jitters?

faq.a: Smitts is involved in procuring components for local concoctions, including sending adventurers into the cursed wilds for Rot Blossoms to brew a potent local mixture known colloquially as Zombie Juice.
faq.q: What drinks does Smitts brew or request?

faq.a: Marshal Haggard is an old veteran of the Stormwind Guard who lives in a secluded cottage in the hills. He and Smitts worked together years ago to investigate the grisly noble murders, forming a bond over the unsolved case.
faq.q: Who is Marshal Haggard, and how does Smitts know him?

faq.a: None that anyone speaks of. Smitts keeps the Scarlet Raven on his own, and no relatives of his are known in Darkshire.
faq.q: Does Smitts have any known family in Darkshire?

text.s: Tavernkeep Smitts is the barkeep of the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. Operating at the social center of Duskwood, Smitts possesses an encyclopedic knowledge of town gossip and unsolved local tragedies. His long memory and keen eye make him an invaluable contact for anyone investigating the region's dark history.

sec.b: Behind the bar of the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Tavernkeep Smitts offers warm hearth fires and drink to the weary travelers, local townspeople, and nervous Night Watch guards braving Duskwood's perils. As one of the longest-standing public faces in town, Smitts hears every rumor that filters through the gloom. While other townsfolk shrink behind locked shutters, Smitts maintains a pragmatic, observant eye on everyone who passes through his door, noting unusual behavior, hurried departures, and strange patrons.

Smitts has spent years quietly tracking the legend of Stalvan Mistmantle. When a visiting family of Stormwind nobles was butchered years ago, Smitts joined Marshal Haggard to examine the scene of the slaughter. Smitts recovered torn, muddy journal pages from the carnage, but investigators were never able to formally connect the handwriting to Stalvan at the time. Smitts held onto those faded scraps for years, convinced that the grim truth would eventually come to light.

Smitts's attentiveness extends to contemporary threats as well. When the terrified hermit Jitters took refuge in the Scarlet Raven, Smitts watched him scribbling feverishly into a personal diary before fleeing the tavern in blind panic. When an investigator recovers the abandoned journal, Smitts readily recognizes the book and points the tracker toward Raven Hill, aiding the effort to unravel the cursed events plaguing the woods.

npc:telf-joolam.s: Telf Joolam. Telf Joolam es un chamán trol de la jungla de Lanza Negra que custodia el Santuario de la Llama Latente. Guía a los iniciados de la Horda a través de las pruebas necesarias para comulgar con el volátil elemento del fuego y dominarlo. Encaramado entre los riscos que dominan las tierras fronterizas, Telf Joolam cuida del Santuario de la Llama Latente. A diferencia de la serena certeza de la tierra o la paciente profundidad del agua, los espíritus ígneos exigen una disciplina rigurosa y una concentración inquebrantable. Telf ejerce como maestro de pruebas, preparando a los jóvenes chamanes para demostrar su valía ante las ascuas salvajes antes de ser consumidos por ellas.

ang.class:Shaman: Telf Joolam is a key figure along your spiritual path, guiding you through the trials of the Fire Sapta to master your Fire Totem.
ang.faction:Horde: By safeguarding sacred elemental shrines throughout the borderlands, elders like Telf strengthen the spiritual backbone of the new Horde.
ang.race:Troll: Seeing a Darkspear elder keeper guiding initiates demonstrates how deeply troll spirituality has interwoven with the Horde's shamanic revival.

faq.a: Telf Joolam is a Darkspear troll shaman serving as the keeper of the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. He mentors young shamans seeking to commune with fire.
faq.q: Who is Telf Joolam?

faq.a: He resides at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, nestled high along the rocky ridge between Durotar and the Barrens.
faq.q: Where can Telf Joolam be found?

faq.a: The Fire Sapta is a specially brewed draught that opens an initiate's spiritual vision, allowing them to perceive and speak with elemental fire spirits that are otherwise invisible to mortal senses.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Fire Sapta he asks for?

faq.a: He specializes in the element of fire, testing shamans to ensure they possess the strength and will to control flame without falling victim to its destructive nature.
faq.q: What element does Telf Joolam teach?

faq.a: Since joining Thrall's Horde, many Darkspear trolls have embraced the spiritual ways of shamanism alongside the orcs and tauren, with experienced practitioners like Telf guiding the next generation.
faq.q: Why is a troll overseeing shamanic rites here?

faq.a: After proving mastery over the flame spirits upon the nearby peak, initiates gain the knowledge and blessing required to forge their permanent Fire Totem.
faq.q: What happens after completing Telf Joolam's tasks?

text.s: Telf Joolam is a Darkspear jungle troll shaman watching over the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. He guides initiates of the Horde through the trials required to commune with and command the volatile element of fire.

sec.b: Perched among the crags overlooking the borderlands, Telf Joolam tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Unlike the calm certainty of earth or the patient depth of water, the fiery spirits require sharp discipline and unwavering focus. Telf acts as a trialmaster, preparing young shamans to prove their worth to the wild embers before they are consumed by them.

Under Telf's direction, initiates brew and drink a ritual Fire Sapta to grant their mortal eyes sight into the unseen elemental planes. He directs supplicants up into the rocky summits to confront burning spirits directly, ensuring that every shaman who earns the flame carries respect for its ravenous hunger rather than reckless pride.

npc:terenthis.s: Terenthis. Terenthis es un elfo de la noche druida apostado en el asentamiento costero de Auberdine. En representación del Círculo Cenarion, investiga la alarmante corrupción que se propaga por Costa Oscura y Teldrassil. Recluta a viajeros competentes para evaluar las crecientes amenazas a lo largo de la costa y ayudar a los aliados locales atrapados por la fauna corrupta. Enviado a Auberdine por el Círculo Cenarion, Terenthis se centra en rastrear la propagación del Musgovil y otras fuerzas corruptoras que se filtran en Costa Oscura desde Teldrassil. Los elfos de la noche ven esta plaga insidiosa con gran preocupación, temiendo que el equilibrio natural del norte de Kalimdor pueda quebrarse por completo si no se ataja. Terenthis trabaja para descubrir las causas profundas de la putrefacción y encontrar formas de frenar su avance antes de que consuma los bosques.

ang.class:Druid: As a Cenarion Circle brother, Terenthis represents the front line against the unnatural corruption spilling from Teldrassil into the mainland.
ang.race:NightElf: Terenthis exemplifies the kaldorei commitment to purifying their sacred lands from lingering fel taint and protecting innocent forest life.

faq.a: Terenthis is a night elf druid affiliated with the Cenarion Circle, currently residing in the harbor town of Auberdine in Darkshore.
faq.q: Who is Terenthis?

faq.a: He was dispatched to investigate how widely Fel Moss and magical corruption have spread from Teldrassil into Darkshore, seeking a way to put an end to the blight.
faq.q: Why is Terenthis in Auberdine?

faq.a: The bear, Grimclaw, sought out Terenthis in Auberdine for help after his master, the druid Volcor, was attacked and wounded by hostile furbolgs.
al: why is there a bear in auberdine
faq.q: What is the bear beside Terenthis doing there?

faq.a: Terenthis is a member of the Cenarion Circle, the druidic order dedicated to preserving balance and safeguarding nature across Kalimdor.
faq.q: What organization does Terenthis belong to?

faq.a: He is primarily concerned with Fel Moss corruption affecting the regional wildlife, as well as the rising hostility of local furbolg tribes that threaten travelers and druids alike.
faq.q: What threats is Terenthis most concerned with?

faq.a: Yes. He directs adventurers to assess corrupting threats along the coast, coordinate with fellow druids like Thundris Windweaver, and mount a rescue for Volcor.
faq.q: Does Terenthis offer any tasks to adventurers?

text.s: Terenthis is a night elf druid stationed in the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Representing the Cenarion Circle, he is investigating the alarming corruption spreading through Darkshore and Teldrassil. He enlists capable travelers to gauge rising threats along the coast and assist local allies trapped by corrupted wildlife.

sec.b: Sent to Auberdine by the Cenarion Circle, Terenthis focuses on tracking the spread of Fel Moss and other corruptive forces seeping into Darkshore from Teldrassil. The night elves view this creeping blight with immense concern, fearing the wild balance of northern Kalimdor may fracture completely if left unchecked. Terenthis works to uncover the root causes of the rot and devise ways to halt its advance before it consumes the forests.

Terenthis also acts as a liaison for dire emergencies in the field. When the loyal bear Grimclaw arrives in Auberdine wounded and alone, Terenthis recognizes that the creature's master, the druid Volcor, has run into grave trouble. Lacking the ability to leave his post, Terenthis directs passing adventurers into the wilderness to find Volcor, who has been ambushed and pinned down by aggressive furbolg tribes.

npc:theocritus.s: Theocritus. El archimago Theocritus es un excéntrico hechicero humano que reside en lo alto de la Torre de Azora, en el este del Bosque de Elwynn. Anteriormente vinculado al Kirin Tor de Dalaran, ahora vive de forma independiente, rodeado de sirvientes y dispositivos mágicos de clarividencia. Desde su elevado sagrario, Theocritus orienta sus talentos arcanos a vigilar el reino y combatir a su oscuro rival, el mago renegado Morganth. Antaño miembro del prestigioso Kirin Tor de Dalaran, el archimago Theocritus decidió establecer un bastión independiente muy al sur, en el reino de Ventormenta. Se asentó en la prominente Torre de Azora, situada cerca del camino oriental hacia Crestagrana. Theocritus es conocido por sus excéntricas costumbres y su cómodo estilo de vida, contando con un nutrido servicio doméstico que incluye a numerosos asistentes gnomos y a su propio pañero particular, Morley Eberlein. Aunque se mantiene en gran medida al margen de las preocupaciones mundanas de los aldeanos locales, su presencia sirve como un baluarte mágico fundamental en el este de Elwynn.

ang.class:Mage: Theocritus represents the life of a wizard who operates outside Dalaran's strict hierarchy, demonstrating how solitary masters set up sanctums and conduct long-distance scrying.
ang.faction:Alliance: Though eccentric and aloof, Theocritus uses his arcane vision and resources to actively defend eastern Elwynn and Redridge from rogue spellcasters.
ang.race:Human: The conflict between Theocritus and Morganth mirrors the dual paths of human sorcery: disciplined scholarship dedicated to defense versus corruption and dark ambition.

faq.a: Archmage Theocritus is a former Kirin Tor wizard who makes his home in the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He lives an eccentric, somewhat isolated life, focusing his arcane craft on safeguarding the region from dark magical threats.
al: who is the mage in the tower
faq.q: Who is Theocritus?

faq.a: While he once operated within the Kirin Tor alongside peers like Archmage Karlain, Theocritus chose to become an independent practitioner. He relocated to Elwynn Forest to pursue his own studies and maintain his personal sanctum at the Tower of Azora.
faq.q: Why did Theocritus leave Dalaran?

faq.a: His chief rival is Morganth, a fallen human mage who has taken up dark magic in the Tower of Ilgalar across the border in Redridge. Theocritus sees Morganth as both an offensive personal foe and a dire threat to the safety of Stormwind.
faq.q: Who is Theocritus fighting against?

faq.a: The Eye of Azora is a powerful scrying apparatus developed and housed by Theocritus atop his tower. He uses it to magically peer into distant lands, track threats, and even attempt to read the thoughts of his rival, Morganth.
faq.q: What is the Eye of Azora?

faq.a: The Shadowhide gnolls serve Morganth and wear enchanted pendants tied to their master. Theocritus studies these trinkets to learn how their magical link operates, hoping to broadcast an arcane attack through the network to paralyze the gnolls in battle.
faq.q: Why does Theocritus want Shadowhide gnoll pendants?

faq.a: Theocritus surrounds himself with an unusual household, including an entire retinue of gnomish servants who see to his daily affairs, as well as a personal clothier named Morley Eberlein who tends to his wardrobe.
al: who lives in tower of azora
faq.q: Who serves Theocritus in his tower?

text.s: Archmage Theocritus is an eccentric human wizard who resides at the peak of the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. Formerly affiliated with the Kirin Tor of Dalaran, he now lives independently, surrounded by servants and magical scrying devices. From his high sanctum, Theocritus directs his arcane talents toward keeping watch over the kingdom and combating his dark rival, the rogue mage Morganth.

sec.b: Once a member of Dalaran's prestigious Kirin Tor, Archmage Theocritus chose to establish an independent stronghold far to the south in the kingdom of Stormwind. He settled in the prominent Tower of Azora, situated near the eastern road to Redridge. Theocritus is known for his eccentric habits and comfortable lifestyle, employing an extensive household staff that includes numerous gnomish attendants and his own dedicated clothier, Morley Eberlein. Though he keeps himself largely detached from the mundane concerns of local villagers, his presence serves as a critical magical bulwark in eastern Elwynn.

Theocritus's greatest ongoing concern is the fallen mage Morganth, a dangerous warlock operating from the Tower of Ilgalar in the nearby Redridge Mountains. Viewing Morganth both as a personal nemesis and a severe peril to Stormwind, Theocritus has dedicated months of arcane research to undermining him. Through scrying artifacts like the Eye of Azora, Theocritus monitors the villain's actions and delves into his thoughts. He also works to turn Morganth's own creations against him, studying the magical pendants carried by the Shadowhide gnolls in hopes of transmitting an arcane pulse that can immobilize the entire pack.

npc:thotar.s: Thotar. Thotar es un experimentado instructor de cazadores orco apostado en el asentamiento de Cerrotajo, en Durotar. Guía a los futuros exploradores y tiradores de la Horda en las antiguas tradiciones del rastreo, la arquería y el vínculo con las bestias salvajes. Para los jóvenes orcos y trols que dan sus primeros pasos fuera del Valle de los Retos, él proporciona los ritos fundamentales necesarios para dominar la escarpada fauna de Kalimdor. Ubicado dentro del enclave fortificado de Cerrotajo, Thotar ejerce de veterano instructor para los tiradores de la Horda. Mientras que los nuevos reclutas aprenden los conceptos más básicos en el Valle de los Retos, a Thotar le corresponde guiar a los cazadores cuando se enfrentan a la naturaleza depredadora y más hostil de Durotar. Basándose en tradiciones transmitidas a lo largo de incontables generaciones de orcos, no solo enseña puntería, sino también el profundo respeto requerido para convivir con las criaturas más letales de Kalimdor y dirigirlas.

ang.class:Hunter: Thotar represents a key milestone for young Horde hunters, teaching the vital rites of beast taming and wilderness mastery once novices step out of the starter valleys.
ang.faction:Horde: As a frontline trainer in Razor Hill, Thotar ensures that scouts and marksmen patrolling Durotar's borders are disciplined, sharp-eyed, and well-bonded with combat beasts.
ang.race:Orc: Thotar preserves and passes down traditional orcish hunting customs, ensuring that life on Kalimdor remains anchored in deep ancestral respect for tracking and beast companionship.
ang.race:Troll: For Darkspear hunters setting out from Sen'jin Village, Thotar offers vital instruction that blends ancestral Horde survival skills with the predatory challenges of Durotar.

faq.a: Thotar is a veteran orc hunter trainer stationed in Razor Hill in Durotar. He educates young hunters in traditional wilderness lore, marksmanship, and animal taming.
faq.q: Who is Thotar?

faq.a: He is located in the Horde settlement of Razor Hill, situated in central Durotar just north of the Valley of Trials.
faq.q: Where can Thotar be found?

faq.a: Thotar teaches the ancient survival and tracking traditions passed down through generations of orcs. He emphasizes weapon mastery, wilderness survival, and learning to bond with animal companions through patience and ritual.
faq.q: What traditions does Thotar teach?

faq.a: While he is an orc steeped in his people's ways, Thotar instructs any hunter aligned with the Horde who arrives in Razor Hill, regularly mentoring Darkspear trolls and wandering tauren passing through Durotar.
faq.q: Does Thotar only train orcs?

faq.a: Thotar directs novice hunters on the rites of 'Taming the Beast,' tasking them with tracking down native Durotar wildlife—such as boars, surf crawlers, and scorpids—and using a taming rod to earn their trust and obedience.
al: what does thotar send you to do
faq.q: What tasks does Thotar give to young hunters?

faq.a: For Horde hunters, a beast companion is a vital partner on the battlefield and in the wild. Thotar teaches that properly bonding with a beast ensures mutual survival, transforming raw predators into loyal defenders of the Horde.
faq.q: Why is beast taming so important in his training?

text.s: Thotar is a seasoned orc hunter trainer stationed in the settlement of Razor Hill in Durotar. He guides aspiring Horde scouts and marksmen in the ancient traditions of tracking, archery, and bonding with wild beasts. For young orcs and trolls taking their first steps outside the Valley of Trials, he provides the foundational rites needed to master Kalimdor's rugged fauna.

sec.b: Perched within the fortified hub of Razor Hill, Thotar serves as a veteran instructor for marksmen of the Horde. While new recruits learn the very basics in the Valley of Trials, it falls to Thotar to guide hunters as they face the harsher predatory wilderness of Durotar. Drawing upon traditions passed down through countless generations of orcs, he teaches not only marksmanship, but the deeper respect required to live alongside and direct Kalimdor's deadliest creatures.

Thotar plays a crucial role in introducing young hunters to the ancient art of beast taming. Through a sequence of trials, he sends novices into the arid canyons to pacify and commune with native beasts, such as venomous scorpid, armored surf crawlers, and cunning boars. By guiding these young scouts through the sacred rites of taming, Thotar ensures the Horde's trackers build a loyal bond with nature rather than merely attempting to dominate it by force.

npc:thrall.s: Thrall. Thrall es el Jefe de Guerra de la Horda y el gobernante de Durotar, y celebra audiencia desde el Valle de la Sabiduría en Orgrimmar. Antaño esclavo de los humanos y criado para ser gladiador de arena, rompió las cadenas de su pueblo, redescubrió sus antiguas tradiciones chamánicas y lo guio a través del Mare Magnum para construir un nuevo hogar. Nacido como Go'el, hijo del caudillo de los Lobo Gélido Durotan y de Draka, Thrall quedó huérfano siendo un bebé cuando sus padres fueron asesinados por los sicarios de Gul'dan. Fue descubierto por el comandante humano Aedelas Lodonegro, quien lo llamó «Thrall» —que significa esclavo— y lo crio en el Castillo de Durnholde como luchador de arena con formación en tácticas humanas. Ayudado por su hermana de acogida Taretha Foxton, Thrall acabó escapando de sus captores. Guiado por el exiliado del Clan Lobo Gélido Drek'Thar, dejó a un lado la corrupción demoníaca para dominar a los espíritus elementales, convirtiéndose en el primero de una nueva generación de chamanes orcos.

ang.class:Shaman: Thrall is revered as the first new orcish shaman in a generation, having restored the sacred communion between his people and the elemental spirits after decades of demonic corruption.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance leaders view Thrall as a dangerous yet pragmatic leader whose disciplined Horde is vastly preferable to the bloodthirsty conquerors of the First and Second Wars.
ang.faction:Horde: Thrall is your supreme commander and Warchief, having led the Horde out of enslavement and ruin to claim an honorable future on Kalimdor.
ang.race:Orc: To the orcs, Thrall is a living savior who broke the lethargy of the human internment camps and returned the race to its ancestral honor.

faq.a: Thrall is the Warchief of the Horde and the leader of the orcish people. Born Go'el of the Frostwolf clan, he was raised as an enslaved gladiator by humans before breaking free, learning the shamanic arts, and leading the orcs to Kalimdor to found their new capital of Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Who is Thrall?

faq.a: His birth name is Go'el, given by his parents Durotan and Draka. His human captor, Aedelas Blackmoore, named him 'Thrall'—an old human word meaning slave. Thrall retained the name as a reminder of where he came from and the oppression his people swore never to endure again.
faq.q: Where does Thrall's name come from?

faq.a: Thrall wears the black plate armor and wields the Doomhammer passed to him by Orgrim Doomhammer, the former Warchief. Upon receiving a mortal wound during the liberation of the internment camps, Orgrim bestowed both the weapon and the mantle of Warchief upon Thrall with his dying breath.
faq.q: Why does Thrall wear black armor and carry a hammer?

faq.a: Thrall resides inside the Valley of Wisdom within Orgrimmar, the Horde capital in Durotar. He stands inside Grommash Hold accompanied by his bodyguards and advisers.
faq.q: Where can I find Thrall in the game?

faq.a: Thrall and Lady Jaina Proudmoore forged a mutual respect and pact of cooperation while fighting alongside each other during the Third War at Mount Hyjal. Though their respective factions remain deeply distrustful, the two leaders strive to preserve a fragile peace between Orgrimmar and Theramore.
faq.q: What is Thrall's relationship with Jaina Proudmoore?

faq.a: While cautious of the undead, Thrall recognized the desperate plight of Sylvanas Windrunner's Forsaken, who had freed themselves from the Lich King's control. Aided by the diplomatic urging of the tauren, who believe the Forsaken can be redeemed, Thrall granted them membership to secure a strategic foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: Why did Thrall allow the Forsaken into the Horde?

text.s: Thrall is the Warchief of the Horde and the ruler of Durotar, holding court from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. Once a human slave raised to be an arena gladiator, he broke the chains of his people, rediscovered their ancient shamanic traditions, and led them across the Great Sea to build a new homeland.

sec.b: Born Go'el, the son of Frostwolf chieftain Durotan and Draka, Thrall was orphaned as an infant when his parents were murdered by Gul'dan's assassins. He was discovered by human commander Aedelas Blackmoore, who named him 'Thrall'—meaning slave—and raised him at Durnholde Keep as an arena fighter with an education in human tactics. Aided by his foster sister Taretha Foxton, Thrall eventually escaped his captors. Guided by the Frostwolf exile Drek'Thar, he cast aside demonic corruption to master the elemental spirits, becoming the first of a new generation of orcish shaman.

Thrall joined forces with the legendary Orgrim Doomhammer to liberate the lethargic orcs languishing in Alliance internment camps after the Second War. When Doomhammer fell in battle, he bestowed his black plate armor and mighty warhammer upon Thrall, naming him the new Warchief. Following prophetic visions from the mysterious Prophet Medivh, Thrall led his people to commandeer human ships and sail across the Great Sea to the forgotten continent of Kalimdor, escaping the doom falling upon the Eastern Kingdoms.

In Kalimdor, Thrall reshaped the Horde from a warmongering engine into an alliance of survival and honor. He rescued the Darkspear trolls led by Vol'jin and allied with Cairne Bloodhoof's tauren before leading the coalition alongside human and night elf forces to defeat the Burning Legion atop Mount Hyjal. Afterward, Thrall founded the nation of Durotar and its capital Orgrimmar, named after his father and mentor. Despite maintaining an uneasy peace with Jaina Proudmoore's Theramore, Thrall now balances the defense of his fragile nation with controversial alliances, such as admitting the Forsaken of Lordaeron into the Horde fold.

npc:thyn-tel-bladeweaver.s: Thyn'tel Tejespada. Thyn'tel Tejespada es una centinela elfa de la noche apostada en el Bancal del Guerrero en Darnassus. Está profundamente preocupada por la desaparición de la sacerdotisa Velinde Cantoestelar y envía a aventureros de confianza de la Alianza a rastrear pistas sobre su paradero. A través de sus indagaciones, busca recomponer el misterio que se oculta tras la Guadaña de Elune. Montando guardia sobre Darnassus desde el Bancal del Guerrero, Thyn'tel Tejespada representa el brazo militar vigilante de los kaldorei. Cuando la sacerdotisa Velinde Cantoestelar desapareció misteriosamente sin dejar rastro, Thyn'tel se negó a dejar que la pista se enfriara. Intuyendo que fuerzas funestas estaban involucradas, se encarga de encargar a aventureros dispuestos que investiguen las pertenencias personales de la sacerdotisa y descubran adónde la llevó su viaje.

ang.class:Warrior: Positioned right among the trainers on the Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel is a familiar sentinel face to Alliance warriors passing through Darnassus.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance heroes who visit the Warrior's Terrace are entrusted by Thyn'tel to venture deep into neutral and contested territory to uncover the truth.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, Thyn'tel's assignment strikes close to home, uncovering the hidden tragedy of a revered priestess who fell victim to forces beyond her control.

faq.a: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a night elf sentinel located on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She serves as a quest giver initiating the investigation into the disappearance of Priestess Velinde Starsong.
faq.q: Who is Thyn'tel Bladeweaver?

faq.a: She can be found standing in Darnassus, specifically stationed on the Warrior's Terrace among the kaldorei warriors and sentinels.
faq.q: Where can I find Thyn'tel Bladeweaver?

faq.a: She is the primary contact for the quest chain investigating Velinde Starsong, providing quests such as 'Velinde's Effects', 'The Barrens Port', and concluding with 'Answered Questions'.
faq.q: What quests does Thyn'tel Bladeweaver offer?

faq.a: Velinde Starsong was a priestess who served in Ashenvale until she disappeared abruptly, leaving her work unfinished. Thyn'tel seeks to discover her fate and uncover the dark mystery surrounding her departure.
faq.q: Why is she interested in Velinde Starsong?

faq.a: After examining Velinde's effects in Darnassus, Thyn'tel directs investigators south across the sea to Ratchet in the Barrens to track down shipping records of Velinde's voyage.
faq.q: Where does her quest chain lead?

faq.a: Yes. Stationed within the night elf capital of Darnassus, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver offers quests exclusively to members of the Alliance.
faq.q: Is Thyn'tel Bladeweaver an Alliance-only contact?

text.s: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a night elf sentinel stationed at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She is deeply troubled by the disappearance of Priestess Velinde Starsong and dispatches trusted Alliance adventurers to track down clues regarding her whereabouts. Through her inquiries, she seeks to piece together the unraveling mystery behind the Scythe of Elune.

sec.b: Standing watch over Darnassus from the Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver represents the vigilant military arm of the kaldorei. When Priestess Velinde Starsong mysteriously vanished without leaving word, Thyn'tel refused to let the trail go cold. Sensing that grave forces were involved, she takes it upon herself to commission adventurers willing to dig into the priestess's personal belongings and uncover where her journey led.

Thyn'tel directs investigators to inspect Velinde's remaining effects left behind in the capital. The clues uncovered reveal a journal describing Velinde's communion with Elune and the terrifying worgen beasts summoned through the Scythe of Elune. Guided by Thyn'tel, travelers follow the trail southward through the port of Ratchet into the Barrens, attempting to find where the desperate priestess sailed before she vanished entirely.

npc:tiza-battleforge.s: Tiza Forjabatalla. Tiza Forjabatalla es una veterana paladín enana de los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata destinada en la Sala de los Misterios de Forjaz. Célebre por su firme devoción y perspicacia, guía a los jóvenes paladines enanos por la senda de la virtud, la caridad y la abnegación. A través del estudio de los textos sagrados y de pruebas sobre el terreno, evalúa si los iniciados están verdaderamente preparados para blandir el don de la resurrección de la Luz. En las serenas cámaras de la Sala de los Misterios de Forjaz, Tiza Forjabatalla destaca como una de las paladines enanas más respetadas de los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata. Los iniciados de toda la Alianza —enviados por tutores como Brandur Martiyerro en Forjaz, Azar Martillopujante en Dun Morogh y Lord Grisillo Quiebrasombras en Ventormenta— acuden a ella para avanzar en su instrucción espiritual. Tiza sostiene que la Luz Sagrada exige más que destreza marcial; requiere un servicio humilde, compasión y una entereza inquebrantable frente a la oscuridad invasora de la Plaga y otras amenazas.

ang.class:Paladin: For dwarven paladins, Tiza Battleforge is a pivotal mentor who tests your worthiness through the Tome of Divinity and entrusts you with the power to resurrect fallen allies.
ang.faction:Alliance: Working closely with mentors from Stormwind to Kharanos, Tiza ensures the Silver Hand maintains unified standards of virtue and martial readiness across all Alliance lands.
ang.race:Dwarf: Tiza represents the deep integration of the Holy Light within dwarven culture and the Silver Hand, guiding Khaz Modan's defenders against threats like the Dark Iron clan.

faq.a: Tiza Battleforge is an esteemed dwarven paladin belonging to the Knights of the Silver Hand. Located in the Hall of Mysteries within Ironforge, she tests and mentors dwarven paladins who are seeking to deepen their bond with the Holy Light.
faq.q: Who is Tiza Battleforge?
