faq.a: She is located in the Hall of Mysteries, the center of spiritual and arcane learning situated in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
faq.q: Where can I find Tiza Battleforge?

faq.a: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred instructional text containing the core virtues and teachings of the Holy Light. Tiza gives it to paladins so they may study its lessons before embarking on practical trials of charity, courage, and mercy.
faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity she gives to paladins?

faq.a: Her husband, Muiredon Battleforge, faces hostile threats from the Dark Iron dwarves while trying to assist his companion Narm Faulk. Tiza uses this crisis to test an initiate's combat bravery and their readiness to use the Symbol of Life to bring fallen comrades back from the brink of death.
faq.q: Why does Tiza send paladins to help her husband Muiredon?

faq.a: Upon completing her trials of charity and rescuing Muiredon's fallen comrade, Tiza grants the initiate the power of Redemption, the paladin's sacred rite of resurrection.
faq.q: What ability does Tiza teach worthy paladins?

faq.a: Brandur Ironhammer is a fellow dwarven paladin trainer stationed alongside her in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. Tiza once candidly pointed out to Brandur that his jealousy was a spiritual weakness, prompting him to swear to her that he would strive to overcome it.
faq.q: What is her connection to Brandur Ironhammer?

text.s: Tiza Battleforge is a veteran dwarven paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand stationed within Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. Renowned for her steadfast devotion and insight, she guides young dwarven paladins along the path of virtue, charity, and self-sacrifice. Through study of the sacred texts and trials in the field, she tests whether initiates are truly ready to wield the Light's gift of resurrection.

sec.b: Within the serene chambers of the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge stands as one of the most respected dwarven paladins of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Initiates across the Alliance—directed by tutors such as Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, Azar Stronghammer in Dun Morogh, and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind—are sent to her to advance their spiritual education. Tiza believes that the Holy Light demands more than martial skill; it requires humble service, compassion, and unwavering fortitude against the encroaching darkness of the Scourge and other threats.

When young paladins arrive seeking deeper mysteries, Tiza presents them with the Tome of Divinity. Once the text has been studied, she dispatches them to perform tangible acts of selfless charity, starting by aiding those in humble need like John Turner. She then challenges initiates to put their faith and prowess on the line to aid her husband, Muiredon Battleforge, against the regional threat of the Dark Iron dwarves. Those who conquer these tests and revive fallen allies with the Symbol of Life are deemed worthy by Tiza to wield the sacred art of resurrection.

npc:tonga-runetotem.s: Tonga Runatótem. Tonga Runatótem es un sabio druida tauren apostado junto a la posada de El Cruce, en Los Baldíos. Enviado desde Cima del Trueno, investiga una corrupción antinatural que se filtra en los escasos oasis de la región y enferma a la fauna autóctona. Sus pesquisas buscan rastrear el origen de esta perturbación espiritual antes de que el delicado ecosistema colapse por completo. Entre el polvo y el bullicioso comercio de El Cruce, Tonga Runatótem mantiene una discreta vigilia. Enviado desde las altas mesetas de Mulgore por los ancianos de su pueblo en Cima del Trueno, Tonga posee un profundo conocimiento de la árida sabana. Donde otros solo ven matorrales yermos y bestias depredadoras, él percibe las sutiles corrientes de la salud de la tierra. En tiempos recientes, esas corrientes se han deteriorado de forma alarmante, lo que le ha llevado a reclutar a viajeros capaces para investigar el núcleo vital de la sabana: sus oasis aislados.

ang.class:Druid: For tauren druids learning their craft, Tonga represents the practical application of Cenarion teachings, demonstrating how to diagnose and cleanse blighted ecosystems far from Moonglade.
ang.faction:Horde: The Horde relies on Tonga's ecological investigations to ensure their primary thoroughfare through the Barrens remains habitable and protected from subterranean magical threats.
ang.race:Tauren: Tonga exemplifies the tauren commitment to the Earth Mother, working diligently to safeguard the fragile water sources that keep life alive across the parched plains.

faq.a: Tonga is a tauren druid located near the inn at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He acts as an investigator sent by his elders in Thunder Bluff to study the strange natural corruptions spreading across the savannah.
faq.q: Who is Tonga Runetotem?

faq.a: He is investigating the unnatural emergence of strange vapors, mutated beasts, and tainted waters within the Barrens oases, including the Forgotten Pools and the Stagnant Oasis.
faq.q: What is Tonga investigating in the Barrens?

faq.a: Through studying altered creatures and water fissures, Tonga deduces that the magical taint infecting the oases originates deep underground within the Wailing Caverns.
faq.q: Where does Tonga believe the corruption is coming from?

faq.a: They share the Runetotem name, and Tonga sends word of the Barrens' troubles to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise, but no source says whether they are related.
faq.q: Is Tonga related to Hamuul Runetotem?

faq.a: Using teachings from Moonglade alongside local reagents, Tonga prepares curative salves to treat poisoned gazelles and counteract toxins flowing from sources like Dreadmist Peak.
faq.q: What does Tonga do for the poisoned wildlife?

faq.a: The Crossroads serves as the central hub of the northern Barrens, placing Tonga in close proximity to the affected oases while providing access to adventurers who can venture into dangerous territory on his behalf.
faq.q: Why is Tonga stationed at the Crossroads instead of Camp Taurajo or Thunder Bluff?

text.s: Tonga Runetotem is a knowledgeable tauren druid stationed outside the inn at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Dispatched from Thunder Bluff, he investigates an unnatural corruption seeping into the region's sparse oases and sickening the native wildlife. His research aims to trace the spiritual disturbance back to its origin before the delicate ecosystem collapses entirely.

sec.b: Amid the dust and bustling commerce of the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem keeps a quiet vigil. Sent down from the high mesas of Mulgore by his elders in Thunder Bluff, Tonga possesses an intimate understanding of the arid savannah. Where others see only barren scrub and predatory beasts, he reads the subtle currents of the land's health. In recent times, those currents have soured dramatically, compelling him to recruit capable travelers to investigate the heart of the savannah's life: its isolated oases.

The Barrens depends entirely on its scattered water sources, but the waters of the Forgotten Pools and the Stagnant Oasis have turned volatile. Strange bubbles of magical vapor rise to the surface, and the creatures drinking from them have begun mutating into aberrant, aggressive forms. Tonga works tirelessly to collect plant and creature samples, seeking to understand whether this malady is natural rot or the work of an intrusive power. His findings increasingly point toward deep subterranean fissures, connecting the poisoned pools directly to the subterranean labyrinths of the Wailing Caverns.

Bearing the proud name of the Runetotem clan, Tonga carries the heavy druidic heritage championed by Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. While Archdruid Hamuul maintains relations with the Cenarion Circle and studies in the sacred groves of Moonglade, scouts like Tonga are the eyes and hands on the frontier. Tonga calls upon Moonglade's traditional botanical wisdom to compound healing salves and counter poisons, ensuring the young tauren druidic tradition proves its vital worth to the fledgling Horde.

npc:turak-runetotem.s: Turak Runatótem. Turak Runatótem es un venerado instructor de druidas tauren que reside en la Sala de los Ancestros, en lo alto del Alto de los Ancestros de Cima del Trueno. Como asistente de confianza del archidruida Hamuul Runatótem, guía a los tauren novicios por las sendas sagradas de la naturaleza y el equilibrio. A través de Turak, los jóvenes druidas emprenden pruebas fundamentales para comulgar con los espíritus y dominar los aspectos animales. Dentro de los serenos confines de la Sala de los Ancestros, Turak Runatótem destaca como uno de los mentores druídicos más destacados de la Horda. Renombrado por su profunda paciencia y su temperamento equilibrado, asiste al archidruida Hamuul Runatótem en revivir las antiguas artes druídicas entre el pueblo tauren. Turak se asegura de que cada aspirante a druida honre la voluntad de la Madre Tierra, enseñando que el poder físico siempre debe fundamentarse en el respeto espiritual y la armonía con la naturaleza.

ang.class:Druid: For tauren druids, Turak Runetotem is the pillar of early training, granting the ability to teleport to Moonglade and testing aspirants until they earn their Bear and Aquatic forms.
ang.faction:Horde: Turak plays a vital part in anchoring nature magic within the Horde, training guardians capable of combating blights, environmental corruption, and the lingering scars across Kalimdor.
ang.race:Tauren: As a member of the Runetotem tribe, Turak embodies the revival of druidic customs among the tauren following the Third War, helping his people reclaim their ancient harmony with the Earthmother.

faq.a: Turak Runetotem is located on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, stationed inside the tent of the Hall of Elders alongside Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem.
faq.q: Where can I find Turak Runetotem?

faq.a: He serves as the primary quest giver and instructor for young tauren druids. He teaches them to commune with Moonglade, unlocks their Bear and Aquatic forms through sacred trials, and instructs them in curing natural poisons.
faq.q: What role does Turak play for new druids?

faq.a: Turak teaches novice druids the spell to teleport directly to the sacred grove of Moonglade, directing them to the Cenarion Circle's representative, Dendrite Starblaze, for advanced spiritual guidance.
faq.q: What is Turak's connection to Moonglade?

faq.a: Both belong to the venerable Runetotem tribe. Turak serves directly under Archdruid Hamuul as one of his most trusted assistants and teachers in the Hall of Elders.
faq.q: How is Turak related to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem?

faq.a: Turak sends students to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade to learn about poison, and Dendrite dispatches them to help with a rash of animal poisonings around the Crossroads. When they return, Turak rewards them with the power to cure poison permanently.
faq.q: Why does Turak send druids to the Crossroads?

faq.a: Turak openly shares that when he first walked the path to become a Druid of the Claw, his communion with the Great Bear Spirit was bewildering yet profoundly intense, an experience that deepened his reverence for the form.
faq.q: What was Turak's personal experience with the Great Bear Spirit?

text.s: Turak Runetotem is a revered tauren druid trainer residing in the Hall of Elders atop Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Serving as a trusted assistant to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, he guides novice tauren along the sacred paths of nature and balance. Through Turak, young druids undertake foundational trials to commune with spirits and master animal aspects.

sec.b: Within the serene confines of the Hall of Elders, Turak Runetotem stands as one of the Horde's foremost druidic mentors. Renowned for his deep patience and balanced demeanor, he assists Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in reviving the ancient druidic arts among the tauren people. Turak ensures that every aspiring druid honors the will of the Earthmother, teaching that physical power must always be grounded in spiritual respect and harmony with nature.

When a fledgling druid is prepared to embrace animal forms, Turak directs them into the wider world. He initiates their communion with the Cenarion Circle, teaching the art of teleporting across Kalimdor to the sacred haven of Moonglade. Recalling the bewilderment and intensity of his own youthful audience with the Great Bear Spirit, Turak tests his students' courage by sending them to face Lunaclaw and obtain the strength of body and heart needed to walk the Path of the Claw.

Turak's guidance expands beyond primal combat forms to environmental stewardship. He sends his disciples back to Dendrite Starblaze to learn about poison, and Dendrite dispatches them to a rash of animal poisonings near the Crossroads, a situation that surprises even Turak. Through these trials, along with the arduous rituals beneath the tides to awaken the aquatic form, Turak shapes novices into enduring protectors capable of healing Azeroth's deepest wounds.

npc:twilight-lord-kelris.s: Señor Crepuscular Kelris. El Señor Crepuscular Kelris es un brujo orco y un líder de alto rango dentro del culto del Martillo Crepuscular que opera en las profundidades de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Desde su posición en Santuario Lunar, dirige oscuros rituales y cuida de la hidra primordial Aku'mai, con el objetivo de marcar el comienzo de un reinado de caos cósmico. El Señor Crepuscular Kelris dirige a los cultistas del Martillo Crepuscular que se apoderaron de las ruinas sumergidas de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Durante años, Kelris escapó de la mirada vigilante de Darnassus, evadiendo al Alba Argenta y ganándose una sombría reputación: cada vez que una malicia ancestral se agitaba en Kalimdor, se sospechaba que Kelris la había orquestado. En lugar de servir a señores de la guerra o clanes, este orco se ha consagrado por entero a los Dioses Antiguos, buscando destruir la civilización mortal y devolver Azeroth a un estado de caos absoluto y primordial.

ang.class:Warlock: While typical warlocks barter with demons of the Burning Legion, Kelris demonstrates the dark, trance-induced shadow magic born from yielding to Old God whispers.
ang.faction:Alliance: The Argent Dawn operating from Darnassus seeks the end of Kelris's elusive career of stirring dark cults and terror across northern Kalimdor.
ang.faction:Horde: Elders and shamans view Kelris as a cautionary abomination—an orc who abandoned the elements and ancestral spirits to grovel before ancient cosmic horrors.
ang.race:NightElf: Kelris's blasphemous rituals actively despoil the sacred Moonshrine Sanctum, desecrating an ancient elven temple dedicated to Elune.

faq.a: Twilight Lord Kelris is an orc sorcerer who commands the Twilight's Hammer presence in Blackfathom Deeps. He coordinates cult activity throughout the sunken temple and is deeply devoted to the Old Gods.
faq.q: Who is Twilight Lord Kelris?

faq.a: The Argent Dawn views Kelris as an elusive instigator of malice throughout Kalimdor. Though he was once believed dead or missing, his hand was discovered behind numerous dark plots across the continent, making his elimination a priority.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn hunting Kelris?

faq.a: Kelris believes the three-headed hydra Aku'mai is a direct herald of the Old Gods and his path to eternal life. He personally nurtures the monster, offering it live sacrifices to fuel its growth.
faq.q: What is Kelris doing with the hydra Aku'mai?

faq.a: Behind Kelris sits an altar with four ceremonial candles. Lighting these candles unbinds the sanctum's protective wards, summoning waves of Aku'mai's servants and opening the sealed gate to the beast's lair.
faq.q: What happens after Kelris is defeated?

faq.a: Kelris wields potent shadow spells, mental domination, and a magical slumber that can incapacitate his enemies while his dark rites continue.
faq.q: What powers does Kelris use in combat?

faq.a: Bashana Runetotem is an ally investigating the corruption in Blackfathom Deeps who warns adventurers of Kelris's obsession with Old God worship and his desire to plunge the world back into primeval chaos.
faq.q: Who is Bashana Runetotem?

text.s: Twilight Lord Kelris is an orc warlock and high-ranking leader within the Twilight's Hammer cult operating deep inside Blackfathom Deeps. From his perch in the Moonshrine Sanctum, he leads dark rituals and tends to the primordial hydra Aku'mai, aiming to usher in a reign of cosmic chaos.

sec.b: Twilight Lord Kelris directs the cultists of the Twilight's Hammer who seized the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. For years, Kelris slipped through the grasp of watchful eyes in Darnassus, evading the Argent Dawn and earning a grim reputation: whenever ancient malice stirred across Kalimdor, Kelris was suspected of orchestrating it. Rather than serving warlords or clans, this orc has pledged himself entirely to the Old Gods, seeking to unmake mortal civilization and return Azeroth to a state of absolute, primordial chaos.

Within the Moonshrine Sanctum, Kelris oversees the worship and cultivation of Aku'mai, a vicious three-headed hydra considered a herald and favored pet of the Old Gods. Convinced that raising this abomination will unlock his own immortality and signal the return of his masters, Kelris personally monitors its growth. To sate the creature's bottomless hunger, he feeds it captured sacrifices and even disobedient cultists from his own ranks.

Kelris commands potent shadow magic capable of seizing minds and plunging intruders into deep, unnatural sleep. He conducts constant prayers before a corrupted altar surrounded by candles that channel dark energies. Those attempting to strike down Kelris must not only defeat the cult leader, but also navigate the latent horrors that stir once his ritualistic vigil is broken.

npc:tyrande-whisperwind.s: Tyrande Susurravientos. Tyrande Susurravientos es la suma sacerdotisa de Elune y la líder suprema de los elfos de la noche. Junto a su amado, el archidruida Malfurión Tempestira, guio a su pueblo a través de la cataclísmica Guerra de los Ancestros y durante los diez milenios de la Larga Vigilia. Gobernando ahora desde las ramas sagradas de Teldrassil, comanda a las Hermanas de Elune y dirige al ejército de centinelas en defensa de la naturaleza sagrada de Kalimdor. Nacida en la antigua ciudad de Suramar, Tyrande creció junto a los hermanos gemelos Malfurión e Illidan Tempestira. Mientras los hermanos se inclinaron por el druidismo y la hechicería, Tyrande entró al servicio de Elune como novicia en la hermandad. Cuando la demoníaca Legión Ardiente invadió Azeroth por primera vez durante la Guerra de los Ancestros, la moribunda suma sacerdotisa Dejahna eligió a Tyrande como su sucesora. Bendecida con el favor directo de la Diosa de la Luna, Tyrande transformó a las Hermanas en una radiante fuerza de combate, empuñando tanto la restauración divina como la abrasadora cólera lunar para rescatar a su pueblo del borde de la aniquilación total.

ang.class:Druid: While Malfurion slumbers in the Emerald Dream, Tyrande coordinates closely with the Cenarion Circle to protect sacred groves and nurture Teldrassil.
ang.class:Priest: As the living vessel of Elune's divine favor, Tyrande embodies the pinnacle of kaldorei priesthood, calling down lunar stars and mending wounds through pure faith.
ang.faction:Alliance: Though historically reclusive and fiercely independent, Tyrande leads the night elves within the Alliance to secure mutual defense against Kalimdor's growing perils.
ang.faction:Horde: To the Horde, Tyrande is a formidable, uncompromising adversary who has commanded the Sentinels to violently resist resource harvesting across Ashenvale.
ang.race:NightElf: Tyrande is your supreme leader and High Priestess. For over ten thousand years, she has kept vigil over your race, championing the light of Elune through every trial.

faq.a: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and the supreme spiritual and political leader of the night elves. She has guided her people for over ten thousand years from the War of the Ancients through the Third War, and currently leads the kaldorei from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
faq.q: Who is Tyrande Whisperwind?

faq.a: Tyrande resides in the capital city of Darnassus, situated high in the branches of the world tree Teldrassil. She presides from the upper sanctuary of the Temple of the Moon, surrounded by the Priestesses of Elune and Sentinel guards.
faq.q: Where does Tyrande reside right now?

faq.a: Tyrande and Malfurion Stormrage are lifelong partners who have guided the night elf civilization together for ten millennia. Though both Malfurion and his twin brother Illidan sought her love in their youth, Tyrande chose Malfurion, whose deep devotion to balance and nature mirrored her faith in Elune.
faq.q: What is the relationship between Tyrande and Malfurion?

faq.a: The Sisterhood of Elune is the ancient religious order of night elf priestesses dedicated to worshiping the Moon Goddess. Under Tyrande's leadership as High Priestess, the sisters serve not only as healers and spiritual guides, but also as fierce martial commanders and combatants.
faq.q: What is the Sisterhood of Elune?

faq.a: During the ten thousand years after the Sundering, while Malfurion and the male druids slumbered in the Emerald Dream, Tyrande established and commanded the Sentinels. She patrolled the wilds of Kalimdor, hunted remaining satyrs and demons, and kept her people safe in isolation.
faq.q: What role did Tyrande play in the Long Vigil?

faq.a: During the Third War, the orcs entered Ashenvale and began clear-cutting sacred forests, slaying the demigod Cenarius under the influence of demon blood. While an uneasy truce was struck at Mount Hyjal, the Horde's ongoing logging operations in Ashenvale ensure Tyrande keeps her Sentinels on high alert.
faq.q: Why is Tyrande wary of the Horde?

text.s: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and the supreme leader of the night elves. Alongside her beloved, the Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage, she guided her people through the cataclysmic War of the Ancients and ten millennia of the Long Vigil. Now governing from the sacred boughs of Teldrassil, she commands the Sisterhood of Elune and directs the Sentinel army in defense of Kalimdor's sacred wilderness.

sec.b: Born in the ancient city of Suramar, Tyrande grew up alongside the twin brothers Malfurion and Illidan Stormrage. While the brothers followed druidism and sorcery, Tyrande entered the service of Elune as a novice in the sisterhood. When the demonic Burning Legion first invaded Azeroth during the War of the Ancients, the dying High Priestess Dejahna chose Tyrande as her successor. Blessed with direct favor from the Moon Goddess, Tyrande transformed the Sisterhood into a radiant fighting force, wielding both divine restoration and searing lunar wrath to deliver her people from the brink of total annihilation.

Following the Great Sundering and the sealing of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion and the druids entered the Emerald Dream for deep, prolonged hibernations. Tyrande took upon herself the lonely burden of defending their recovering realm. She organized the Sentinels—an elite cadre of warrior-women who patrolled Kalimdor's forests for ten thousand years. Throughout this Long Vigil, she stood watchful guard over ancient evils and lingering demonic remnants, maintaining unbroken faith in Elune while she waited centuries between brief reunions with Malfurion.
sec.t: The Long Vigil and the Sentinels

sec.b: When the Burning Legion returned during the Third War, Tyrande acted decisively to wake the sleeping druids and face the catastrophic threat. Overcoming fierce mistrust toward the newly arrived orcs and humans, she helped forge the desperate coalition at Mount Hyjal, sacrificing the night elves' immortality atop Nordrassil to shatter Archimonde. With Mount Hyjal scarred and Malfurion once again occupied with safeguarding the Emerald Dream, Tyrande governs the kaldorei from the grand Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, watching cautiously over both Horde incursions and the growing Alliance alliance.
sec.t: The Third War and a New Haven

npc:verdan-the-everliving.s: Verdan el Eterno. Verdan el Eterno es una colosal bestia del pantano que acecha en las profundidades de los túneles verdes de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Antaño un pacífico protector de los manantiales subterráneos y de la flora, fue corrompido por la pesadilla despierta que irradiaba del druida durmiente Naralex. Ahora vinculado a los corrompidos Druidas del Colmillo, Verdan ataca con violencia a todo aquel que se adentre en sus húmedas hondonadas. Mucho antes de que Naralex llegara para aprovechar los manantiales naturales de Los Baldíos, Verdan se formó a partir de la frondosa vegetación, el limo y la humedad que llenaban las cuevas. Considerado el espíritu guardián original del oasis subterráneo, Verdan era un elemental antiguo y apacible que velaba por la flora subterránea.

ang.class:Druid: Verdan's fall is a tragic reminder of what happens when natural elemental wardens are poisoned by a corrupted Emerald Dream.
ang.class:Shaman: As an elemental spirit of earth and water grown warped and violent, putting down Verdan is an act of restoring balance to the fractured elements of the Barrens.
ang.faction:Horde: Because the Wailing Caverns sit at the heart of the Barrens, defeating dangerous beasts like Verdan is essential to protecting nearby crossroads and settlements.

faq.a: Verdan is a massive bog beast, an elemental being animated out of plant matter, peat, and subterranean mire. He formed naturally from the rich flora of the caves long ago.
faq.q: What kind of creature is Verdan?

faq.a: Verdan was once a peaceful guardian of the caverns, but the nightmare emanating from the slumbering Archdruid Naralex corrupted his mind. Now maddened, he perceives all outside intruders as trespassers to be crushed.
faq.q: Why is Verdan hostile to adventurers?

faq.a: Both Verdan and the Druids of the Fang fell victim to the same corrupting nightmare. Sharing this twisted vision, Verdan acts as an ally and enforcer for the insane druids, guarding the deeper reaches of the caverns.
faq.q: What is Verdan's connection to the Druids of the Fang?

faq.a: Verdan dwells in a cavernous, mossy chamber deep in the winding paths of the Wailing Caverns, past several of the corrupted Fang leaders.
faq.q: Where in the Wailing Caverns is Verdan located?

faq.a: There is no known way to cleanse Verdan. The nightmare took deep root in his elemental form, leaving adventurers no choice but to destroy the hulking beast to ensure safe passage through the cavern.
faq.q: Can Verdan be cured or cleansed?

faq.a: The origin of his epithet is unknown. Verdan is an ancient bog beast formed from the Wailing Caverns' lush foliage.
faq.q: Why was Verdan called 'the Everliving'?

text.s: Verdan the Everliving is a colossal bog beast lurking deep within the verdant tunnels of the Wailing Caverns. Once a peaceful protector of the underground springs and flora, he was twisted by the waking nightmare radiating from the sleeping druid Naralex. Now bound to the corrupted Druids of the Fang, Verdan violently attacks any who venture into his damp hollows.

sec.b: Long before Naralex arrived to tap into the natural springs of the Barrens, Verdan was formed from the overgrown foliage, silt, and moisture filling the caves. Thought to be the original guardian spirit of the subterranean oasis, Verdan was an ancient, gentle elemental keeping watch over the underground flora.

When Naralex attempted to cultivate the dry Barrens into a lush paradise, his ritual fractured into a vivid nightmare within the Emerald Dream. The resulting corruption bled through the subterranean waters, tainting everything living inside the cavern. Verdan could not resist the pervasive blight; his gentle temperament vanished, leaving behind an enormous, hostile brute sworn to protect the mad Druids of the Fang.

npc:verner-osgood.s: Verner Bonmete. Verner Bonmete es el herrero residente de Villa del Lago, apostado justo a las afueras de la herrería del pueblo. Compaginando el comercio civil local con las abrumadoras exigencias del ejército de Ventormenta, trabaja sin descanso para mantener a los caballos herrados y a los defensores armados en medio de incesantes incursiones de gnolls. Junto a la forja en el centro de Villa del Lago, Verner Bonmete representa la tensa columna vertebral industrial de las Montañas Crestagrana. Con la tarea de forjar suministros básicos como herraduras para las monturas locales, Verner ve cómo sus existencias son confiscadas constantemente para fabricar armas y armaduras para la Guardia de Ventormenta. Con el reino extendiendo sus fronteras hasta el límite y las guarniciones locales carentes de suministros, herreros independientes como Verner deben cargar con el peso logístico de la defensa del reino.

ang.faction:Alliance: Towns like Lakeshire depend on local craftsmen like Verner to survive as Stormwind's military aid remains dangerously constrained.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: Verner embodies the gritty reality of rural smithing, balancing civilian shoeing with the harsh quotas demanded by garrison defense.
ang.race:Human: Osgood represents the enduring resilience of the Kingdom of Stormwind's common folk, holding ground against gnolls and shortages alike.

faq.a: Verner Osgood is the local blacksmith operating the forge in Lakeshire. He handles metalwork and horse shoeing for the town while attempting to meet the heavy equipment demands of the local garrison.
faq.q: Who is Verner Osgood?

faq.a: The town's supply of iron is continually requisitioned to forge weapons and armor for the Stormwind Guard stationed in Redridge, leaving Verner with barely enough metal to care for the local horses.
faq.q: Why is Verner low on horseshoes and iron?

faq.a: Gnoll raiding parties roam closely around Lakeshire, snatching away Verner's horses whenever they wander away from town. He seeks retribution and safety by hiring adventurers to eliminate the beasts.
faq.q: What problem does Verner have with the gnolls?

faq.a: Yowler is the menacing leader of the local gnoll packs in the hills. Verner wants him slain to break the coordination of the raiders who terrorize the township and slaughter his horses.
faq.q: Who is Yowler and why does Verner want him dead?

faq.a: Verner operates under the civic authority of Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire, balancing civilian craft with the civic and martial needs commanded by the magistrate's beleaguered administration.
faq.q: What is Verner's connection to Magistrate Solomon?

faq.a: He shares a surname with several other tradesmen in the Kingdom of Stormwind, such as Donal and Basil Osgood, suggesting an established lineage of working-class human craftsmen across the region.
faq.q: Does Verner have family in Stormwind?

text.s: Verner Osgood is the resident blacksmith of Lakeshire, stationed just outside the town smithy. Balancing local civilian trade with the crushing demands of the Stormwind military, he works tirelessly to keep horses shod and defenders armed amid relentless gnoll raids.

sec.b: Standing by the forge in central Lakeshire, Verner Osgood represents the strained industrial backbone of the Redridge Mountains. Tasked with crafting basic supplies like horseshoes for local mounts, Verner finds his stock constantly co-opted to manufacture weapons and armor for the Stormwind Guard. With the kingdom stretching its borders thin and local garrisons lacking supplies, independent smiths like Verner must carry the logistical burden of the realm's defense.

Verner's troubles extend far beyond a shortage of iron. The gnolls infesting the Redridge hills routinely ambush livestock, carrying off working horses whenever they stray outside the town perimeter. Driven to exasperation by the destruction of his livelihood, Verner actively recruits traveling adventurers to cull the marauding packs and hunt down their ferocious packleader, Yowler.

npc:viktori-prism-antras.s: Viktori Prism'Antras. Viktori Prism'Antras es un excéntrico astrónomo aficionado que reside en una pequeña cabaña en la ladera con vistas a Villa Oscura. Mientras el pueblo que lo rodea sucumbe al pavor y a horrores inminentes, Viktori se concentra intensamente en construir un telescopio para contemplar los cielos con claridad. Para hacer realidad su visión, confía en viajeros intrépidos que le consigan piezas complejas basadas en esquemas gnómicos. Encaramado en la pendiente más allá del Nidal de Grifos, Viktori Prism'Antras pasa los días oteando desde la penumbra de Bosque del Ocaso. En medio de incursiones de no-muertos, arañas voraces y sombras acechantes, su obsesión se sitúa mucho más allá del asfixiante dosel. Sueña con construir un magnífico telescopio óptico capaz de enfocar las estrellas con brillantez, ofreciendo un sereno escape del espanto que envuelve a la aldea.

ang.faction:Alliance: Assisting Viktori provides a rare, peaceful pursuit in Darkshire, helping an Alliance townsman seek wonder amidst pervasive tragedy.
ang.profession:Engineering: Tinkers will appreciate Viktori's endeavor, as building his precision viewing instrument relies entirely on sophisticated gnomish schematics.
ang.race:Gnome: Viktori's entire project rests on the ingenuity of the gnome inventor Cog Glitzspinner, showcasing the reach of gnomish engineering even in the most desolate human towns.

faq.a: Viktori is an eccentric human stargazer residing in Darkshire. Rather than concerning himself with the town's immediate political or supernatural threats, he is singularly obsessed with constructing a powerful telescope to study the stars.
faq.q: Who is Viktori Prism'Antras?

faq.a: He lives in a small wooden hut up the hill just past the Darkshire gryphon master, located to the right as you ascend the path.
faq.q: Where can I find Viktori in Darkshire?

faq.a: Viktori is attempting to build an astronomical telescope using blueprints drawn up by his gnomish colleague Cog Glitzspinner, which requires several specialized lenses and components to assemble.
faq.q: What is Viktori trying to build?

faq.a: Despite the darkness and constant terror permeating Duskwood, Viktori is consumed by celestial curiosity. Focusing on the untainted majesty of the night sky provides him an intellectual refuge from the decaying land around him.
faq.q: Why is he studying the stars from Duskwood?

faq.a: The blueprints were engineered by Cog Glitzspinner, an inventive gnome acquaintance of Viktori who provided the schematics necessary to assemble the viewing apparatus.
faq.q: Who designed the plans for Viktori's telescope?

faq.a: No. Viktori is a civilian scholar rather than a warrior. He leaves the defense of the town to Commander Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch, preferring to dedicate all his energies to his astronomical work.
faq.q: Does Viktori help defend Darkshire?

text.s: Viktori Prism'Antras is an eccentric stargazer residing in a small hillside hut overlooking Darkshire. While the town around him succumbs to dread and looming horrors, Viktori focuses intently on building a telescope to view the heavens clearly. To realize his vision, he relies on adventurous travelers to acquire intricate parts based on gnomish schematics.

sec.b: Perched up the slope just beyond the gryphon roost, Viktori Prism'Antras spends his days peering outward from the gloom of Duskwood. Amid undead incursions, ravenous spiders, and creeping shadows, his obsession lies far beyond the suffocating canopy. He dreams of building a magnificent optical telescope capable of bringing the stars into brilliant focus, offering a quiet escape from the dread that engulfs the hamlet.

Constructing such a delicate apparatus is no simple matter in a cursed forest. Viktori works from blueprints provided by his gnomish friend, Cog Glitzspinner. To complete the device, he enlists passersby to track down rare lens-crafting materials and mechanical housings, ranging from finely cut glass to metal lenses scattered across perilous territory.

npc:viscous-fallout.s: Radiactivo viscoso. El Radiactivo viscoso es un elemental de agua corrupto que vaga por los pasillos irradiados de Gnomeregan. Antaño un espíritu puro que habitaba los prístinos acuíferos de la ciudad, fue transformado en una monstruosidad tóxica por la devastadora liberación de radiación del Mekigeniero Termochufe. Antes de la caída de Gnomeregan, la capital gnoma dependía de complejas y sofisticadas vías fluviales y acuíferos subterráneos limpios para alimentar y mantener sus maravillas mecánicas. Un solitario elemental de agua moraba pacíficamente en este prístino suministro de agua. Cuando se abrieron los conductos de ventilación de radiación por el traicionero consejo del Mekigeniero Termochufe para aniquilar a los troggs invasores, la consiguiente contaminación química se filtró profundamente en los embalses de la ciudad, atrapando al elemental y corrompiendo su propia sustancia.

ang.class:Druid: Druids view the creature as a living wound upon nature, illustrating the horrific consequences of reckless industrial contamination seeping into natural underground waters.
ang.class:Shaman: A shaman will recognize the perversion of the elemental plane, seeing in Viscous Fallout a pure water spirit driven mad and defiled by artificial toxic waste.
ang.race:Gnome: For gnomes, Viscous Fallout is a tragic reminder of the damage Mekgineer Thermaplugg inflicted upon their home, corrupting even the pristine subterranean springs that once sustained Gnomeregan.

faq.a: Viscous Fallout is a water elemental mini-boss located inside the ruined city of Gnomeregan. Formerly a pure water spirit native to the city's deep aquifers, it became thoroughly tainted by toxic sludge and radioactive fallout.
al: what kind of mob is viscous fallout
faq.q: What is Viscous Fallout?

faq.a: When Gnomeregan was flooded with radiation on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to repel the trogg invasion, the contaminated runoff infiltrated the city's plumbing and aquifers. The trapped water elemental absorbed the deadly chemical stew, warping into an acidic, irradiated horror.
faq.q: How did it become corrupted?

faq.a: Viscous Fallout patrols the lower irradiated passages and runoff canals below the main entry paths of Gnomeregan, often blending in among the ordinary mutated slimes and toxic wastes infesting the area.
faq.q: Where in Gnomeregan does it wander?

faq.a: The elemental is driven mad by relentless agony and toxic corruption. Stripped of its natural purity, it lashes out furiously at any living creature trespassing in the tainted waterways.
faq.q: Why is it hostile?

faq.a: Gnomish refugees in Tinker Town inside Ironforge remember the complex waterways that once supported Gnomeregan. Items associated with the waterworks, such as the Hydrocane, are tied to these corrupted chambers and sought after for recovery.
faq.q: Does it have any connection to Ironforge?

faq.a: No cure exists for the elemental. The radiation and toxic chemicals have permeated its form so entirely that destroying it is the only way to end its suffering.
faq.q: Can the elemental be cleansed or cured?

text.s: Viscous Fallout is a corrupted water elemental wandering the irradiated corridors of Gnomeregan. Once a pure spirit inhabiting the city's pristine aquifers, it was twisted into a toxic monstrosity by Mekgineer Thermaplugg's devastating radiation release.

sec.b: Before the fall of Gnomeregan, the gnomish capital relied on sophisticated, intricate waterways and clean subterranean aquifers to power and sustain its mechanical marvels. A solitary water elemental dwelt peacefully within this pristine water supply. When the radiation vents were opened on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to wipe out the invading troggs, the resulting chemical contamination seeped deep into the city's reservoirs, trapping the elemental and corrupting its very substance.

Now, the creature is little more than a living pool of toxic sludge, drifting aimlessly through the irradiated lower passages. Transformed into an embodiment of Thermaplugg's treachery, Viscous Fallout lashes out at anything in its path, consumed by constant pain and fury. Striking it down is a grim necessity for those venturing into Gnomeregan to cleanse the tainted depths.

npc:warden-thelwater.s: Alcaide Thelagua. El Alcaide Thelagua es el asediado supervisor de Las Mazmorras, la prisión subterránea de máxima seguridad de Ciudad de Ventormenta. Sorprendido sin preparación cuando estalló un violento motín entre los prisioneros Defias, ahora recluta desesperadamente a aventureros capaces para sofocar la rebelión antes de que la noticia se extienda a la ciudad de arriba. Ocultas bajo los canales de Ventormenta, Las Mazmorras albergan a los malhechores más peligrosos del reino, ladronzuelos y conspiradores políticos. El Alcaide Thelagua tenía el encargo de mantenerlos encerrados a buen recaudo, pero una revuelta organizada pilló a los guardias completamente desprevenidos. Con los prisioneros superando a la seguridad y tomando el control de las celdas, Thelagua se vio atrincherado en la entrada, luchando por contener una insurrección armada justo debajo de las calles de la capital.

ang.class:Paladin: For holy warriors dedicated to order and justice, Thelwater's desperate struggle to restore containment provides a direct call to bring righteous discipline to violent criminals.
ang.class:Rogue: Rogues entering the Stockade for Thelwater find themselves navigating the messy fallout of Defias intrigue and underground prison politics.
ang.faction:Alliance: Warden Thelwater represents the fragile order within Stormwind, relying on loyal Alliance champions to squash the prison mutiny before it threatens the capital's citizens.

faq.a: Warden Thelwater is the human official stationed at the entrance of the Stockade in Stormwind City. He is responsible for managing the high-security prison complex.
faq.q: Who is Warden Thelwater?

faq.a: A coordinated revolt broke out among the prisoners, primarily driven by incarcerated members of the Defias Brotherhood. The inmates overpowered the guards and took over the cellblocks, leaving Thelwater and his remaining men pinned near the entrance.
faq.q: What happened to the Stockade?

faq.a: Bazil Thredd is the mastermind orchestrating the revolt from deep inside the prison. He commands the Defias inmates and directed the sudden strike against the guards.
faq.q: Who is leading the prison riot?

faq.a: Thelwater aims to resolve the disaster quietly. Broadcasting that Stormwind's most fortified dungeon fell to its own inmates would ignite widespread panic across the city, so he enlists discreet adventurers to clean up the mess inside.
faq.q: Why hasn't the Stormwind City Guard intervened in force?

faq.a: The facility holds petty crooks, thieves, murderers, and dangerous political insurgents, most notably high-ranking members of the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: What kind of prisoners are kept here?

faq.a: He is stationed just outside the entrance of the Stockade, located near the canals between the Mage Quarter and Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can Warden Thelwater be found?

text.s: Warden Thelwater is the besieged overseer of the Stockade, Stormwind City's underground maximum-security prison. Caught unprepared when a violent riot erupted among the Defias prisoners, he now desperately recruits capable adventurers to quell the rebellion before word spreads to the city above.

sec.b: Hidden beneath the canals of Stormwind, the Stockade holds the kingdom's most dangerous miscreants, petty thieves, and political conspirators. Warden Thelwater was charged with keeping them securely locked away, but an organized revolt took the guards completely off guard. With the prisoners overwhelming security and taking control of the cells, Thelwater found himself barricaded at the threshold, struggling to contain an armed insurrection right beneath the streets of the capital.

Rather than allowing panic to spill into the streets of Stormwind, Thelwater has chosen to handle the uprising with absolute discretion. The mastermind behind the breakout, Bazil Thredd, holds tremendous influence among the Defias Brotherhood locked inside. To prevent the riot from exposing wider vulnerabilities within Stormwind's governance, Thelwater relies on outside mercenaries to infiltrate the cellblocks, strike down the ringleaders, and quietly reclaim the facility.

npc:william-pestle.s: William Mortero. William Mortero es un alquimista humano que se aloja en la Posada Orgullo de León, en Villadorada. Junto con su hermano Morgan, ayuda a regentar la botica en el Distrito de Mercaderes de Ventormenta. Con frecuencia contrata a aventureros de paso para reunir reactivos peculiares como velas de kobolds, kelp de múrlocs y suministros de hierbas. Mientras su hermano Morgan Mortero atiende el mostrador de la botica de los Mortero en el Distrito de Mercaderes de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, William opera desde la Posada Orgullo de León, en Villadorada. Estar destinado en el Bosque de Elwynn le permite trabajar estrechamente con los recolectores locales y conseguir las materias primas que las tiendas de la ciudad necesitan constantemente. Mantiene envíos regulares a la capital, asegurando que los ciudadanos de Ventormenta tengan un acceso constante a ungüentos reparadores, brebajes y polvos.

ang.faction:Alliance: William helps keep the Trade District in Stormwind supplied with vital medicines and sundries, relying on Alliance recruits passing through Goldshire to secure materials from the surrounding forest.
ang.profession:Herbalism: For herbalists wandering through Goldshire, William Pestle represents the practical trade side of plant gathering, constantly turning wild growth and strange aquatic kelp into useful mixtures.

faq.a: William Pestle is an alchemist and apothecary living at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Alongside his brother Morgan in Stormwind City, he gathers and prepares alchemical supplies for the kingdom.
faq.q: Who is William Pestle?

faq.a: He is located inside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, situated in Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where can William Pestle be found?

faq.a: William collects the wax candles carried by kobolds in Elwynn's mines, melting them down and refining the tallow for his alchemical mixtures and general apothecary inventory.
faq.q: What does William do with kobold candles?

faq.a: William uses Crystal Kelp harvested from local Elwynn lakes to formulate an Invisibility Liquor, which helps Maybell Maclure sneak past her family to see Tommy Joe Stonefield.
faq.q: Why does William need Crystal Kelp?

faq.a: William and his brother Morgan run the apothecary in the Trade District of Stormwind City. William gathers ingredients in Goldshire and coordinates shipments back to the city shop.
faq.q: What is William Pestle's connection to Stormwind City?

faq.a: William is an old friend of Mildred Stonefield. He aids Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure by concocting a covert brew to help them bypass their families' bitter feud.
faq.q: How is William involved with the Stonefields and Maclures?

text.s: William Pestle is a human alchemist staying inside Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn. Together with his brother Morgan, he helps run the apothecary shop in Stormwind's Trade District. He frequently employs traveling adventurers to gather odd reagents like kobold candles, murloc kelp, and herbal supplies.

sec.b: While his brother Morgan Pestle manages the counter at Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District of Stormwind City, William operates out of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Being stationed in Elwynn Forest allows him to work closely with local gatherers and secure raw materials that city shops constantly require. He maintains regular shipments back to the capital, ensuring Stormwind's citizens have steady access to restorative salves, draughts, and powders.

William's craft often demands unusual components that go beyond simple garden herbs. He frequently commissions newcomers to gather wax candles carried by Elwynn's infesting kobolds, as well as crystal kelp taken from the murlocs of Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire. Although such concoctions seem bizarre to the uninitiated, William insists these strange ingredients possess potent alchemical virtues.

Beyond his standard trade, William is an old friend of Mildred Stonefield. When the young lovers Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield find themselves caught between their bitterly feuding farmstead families, William agrees to brew an Invisibility Liquor. Using the kelp gathered from local waters, his draft allows Maybell to slip away unnoticed and rendezvous with Tommy Joe.

npc:wizbang-cranktoggle.s: Maniveo Zumbang. Maniveo Zumbang es un excéntrico ingeniero gnomo que reside en la planta superior de la posada de Auberdine. A pesar de encontrarse lejos de las salas repletas de engranajes de Gnomeregan o Forjaz, ha enfocado su ingenio mecánico en instalar y mantener dispositivos de comunicación automatizados conocidos como buzzboxes a lo largo de la salvaje costa de Costa Oscura. Mientras que los elfos de la noche de Auberdine prefieren vivir en armonía con la naturaleza y apoyarse en antiguas costumbres, Maniveo Zumbang representa la curiosa y manitas presencia de la Alianza. Aposentado en la planta superior de la posada de Auberdine, rodeado de herramientas y piezas de repuesto, Maniveo apenas presta atención a las solemnes tradiciones druídicas de Kalimdor, centrándose en su lugar en desafíos mecánicos pragmáticos.

ang.profession:Engineering: Wizbang's reliance on custom tools like gaffer jacks and electropellers highlights the classic gnomish mindset: mechanical answers to logistical problems in uncharted lands.
ang.race:Gnome: Seeing a fellow gnome operating an experimental communication network along Kalimdor's rugged coast is a welcome reminder of Gnomeregan's relentless inventiveness.
ang.race:NightElf: While elven sentinels and druids rely on whisps, messengers, and natural bonds, Wizbang brings loud, whirring gears and metal boxes into Darkshore's sacred woods.

faq.a: Wizbang is located on the upper floor of the inn in the seaside night elf settlement of Auberdine, in Darkshore.
faq.q: Where can I find Wizbang Cranktoggle?

faq.a: He is an Alliance engineer working on establishing and maintaining a network of automated communication machines called buzzboxes throughout the Darkshore wilderness.
faq.q: What is Wizbang Cranktoggle doing in Darkshore?

faq.a: Buzzboxes are mechanical communication and monitoring devices invented by Wizbang Cranktoggle to relay information across Darkshore, though they frequently break down due to wildlife attacks and harsh weather.
faq.q: What are buzzboxes?

faq.a: He shares a surname with Delber Cranktoggle, suggesting they may belong to the same family of tinkerers.
faq.q: Is Wizbang related to any other gnomes?

faq.a: As fellow members of the Grand Alliance, the night elves provide lodging and refuge to allied races in Auberdine, even if gnomish contraptions contrast sharply with traditional elven harmony.
faq.q: Why do the night elves tolerate his tinkering in Auberdine?

faq.a: Wizbang asks adventurers to help repair and configure his buzzbox machines, which involves scouring the shoreline for specialized parts like electropellers and gaffer jacks.
faq.q: What tasks does Wizbang give to adventurers?

text.s: Wizbang Cranktoggle is an eccentric gnome engineer residing on the upper floor of the Auberdine inn. Despite being far from the cog-filled halls of Gnomeregan or Ironforge, he has turned his mechanical ingenuity toward setting up and maintaining automated communication devices known as buzzboxes across the wild coast of Darkshore.

sec.b: While the night elves of Auberdine prefer living in harmony with nature and leaning upon ancient customs, Wizbang Cranktoggle represents the curious, tinkering presence of the Alliance. Perched on the top floor of Auberdine's inn, surrounded by tools and spare components, Wizbang pays little mind to the solemn druidic traditions of Kalimdor, focusing instead on pragmatic mechanical challenges.

Wizbang's primary project along Darkshore is deploying and maintaining his peculiar invention: the buzzbox. Designed to establish automated reporting and long-distance communication across the rugged, sprawling coastline, these contraptions often suffer from coastal weathering and the hostility of local wildlife. Wizbang frequently recruits travelers to gather components, salvage tools like gaffer jacks, and recover electropellers to keep his mechanical surveillance functioning.

npc:yaw-sharpmane.s: Guin Crinafilada. Guin Crinafilada es un experimentado instructor de cazadores tauren ubicado en el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre, en Mulgore. Guía a los jóvenes cazadores que parten del Campamento Narache, ayudándoles a dominar a las bestias salvajes de sus llanuras ancestrales. Situado entre las tiendas y hogueras del Poblado Pezuña de Sangre, Guin Crinafilada sirve a los Shu'halo como instructor en las artes de la puntería, el rastreo y la supervivencia. Los jóvenes cazadores que han demostrado su valía en la Mesa de la Nube Roja son enviados ante Guin para perfeccionar su destreza mientras se adentran en las amplias llanuras de Mulgore.

ang.class:Hunter: For tauren hunters leaving the safety of Red Cloud Mesa, Yaw Sharpmane is an essential mentor who guides you through bonding with your very first wild companion.
ang.race:Tauren: Yaw represents the revered Shu'halo tradition of living in harmony with nature and honoring the spirits of the wild beasts of Mulgore.

faq.a: Yaw Sharpmane is the resident hunter trainer in Bloodhoof Village. He instructs young tauren hunters in marksmanship, wilderness survival, and the art of taming animal companions.
faq.q: Who is Yaw Sharpmane?

faq.a: Yaw is located in Bloodhoof Village, situated in central Mulgore along the shores of Stonebull Lake.
faq.q: Where can I find Yaw Sharpmane?

faq.a: He offers standard hunter training, selling rank-ups for basic abilities and directing promising hunters through the rites required to tame and command beasts.
faq.q: What does Yaw Sharpmane teach hunters?

faq.a: Yaw provides the tauren version of the beast-taming questline, starting with 'The Hunter's Path' and progressing through 'Taming the Beast' and 'Training the Beast.'
faq.q: What quests does Yaw offer?

faq.a: Upon reaching their tenth season, hunters are sent to Yaw to learn the sacred methods of capturing, feeding, and commanding permanent animal companions from the wilds of Mulgore.
faq.q: Why do hunters need to speak to him around level 10?

faq.a: He will speak politely with travelers of other callings, but his professional knowledge and specific quest trials are reserved strictly for hunters.
al: can other classes talk to yaw
faq.q: Does Yaw Sharpmane interact with non-hunters?

text.s: Yaw Sharpmane is an experienced tauren hunter trainer stationed in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He guides young hunters venturing out from Camp Narache, helping them master the wild beasts of their ancestral plains.

sec.b: Positioned amidst the tents and fires of Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane serves the Shu'halo as an instructor in the ways of marksmanship, tracking, and survival. Young hunters who have proven themselves in Red Cloud Mesa are directed to Yaw to hone their craft as they step onto the broader plains of Mulgore.

Yaw's most essential role is guiding novice hunters through the ancient rite of taming wild beasts. He tasks initiates with bonding with the native fauna of Mulgore, testing their patience and respect for the natural balance before instructing them on how to properly care for and train a permanent companion.

subzone:addle-s-stead.s: Granja de Addle. Granja de Addle es una granja abandonada en el suroeste de Bosque del Ocaso, que yace en silencio bajo la penumbra del bosque al sur de Cerro del Cuervo. Aunque sus colonos originales huyeron hace mucho tiempo, la granja se ha convertido en un punto de reunión oculto para la Hermandad Defias. Al igual que muchos de los hogares olvidados repartidos por Bosque del Ocaso, Granja de Addle cayó en el abandono cuando la oscuridad y la ruina envolvieron la región. En lugar de permanecer vacía, la granja ha sido reutilizada por la Hermandad Defias. Sus agentes merodean por el perímetro, acechan dentro de la decrépita granja y esconden suministros en el establo, aprovechando el cobijo sombrío del suroeste de Bosque del Ocaso para pasar desapercibidos tanto para Guardia Nocturna como para las autoridades de Ventormenta.

ang.class:Rogue: The covert outpost shows how deeply the Defias syndicates slip unnoticed across territorial borders, embedding their operatives behind the veil of Duskwood's gloom.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance investigators tracking the missing King Varian Wrynn, this dilapidated farmhouse holds vital conspiratorial dockets left by the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.a: Addle's Stead is in southwestern Duskwood, situated just south of the Raven Hill township and directly west of the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.
faq.q: Where is Addle's Stead located?

faq.a: The farmstead is heavily occupied by the Defias Brotherhood, including night runners, night blades, and enchanters who use the old house and barn as a remote hideout.
faq.q: Who controls Addle's Stead right now?

faq.a: Like much of Duskwood, the farm was abandoned by its original inhabitants when the forest fell under a pervasive curse of darkness, beasts, and undead, driving common folk away.
faq.q: Why is the farm abandoned?

faq.a: Adventurers investigating the disappearance of King Varian Wrynn are guided toward Addle's Stead to retrieve an important Defias docket linking rogue agents to the royal abduction.
faq.q: What brings Alliance adventurers to Addle's Stead?

text.s: Addle's Stead is an abandoned farmstead in southwestern Duskwood, lying quiet under the forest's gloom south of Raven Hill. While its original homesteaders fled long ago, the farm has become a hidden staging ground for the Defias Brotherhood.

sec.b: Like many of the forgotten homesteads scattered across Duskwood, Addle's Stead fell into disrepair when darkness and ruin enveloped the region. Rather than remaining empty, the farm has been repurposed by the Defias Brotherhood. Agents prowl the perimeter, lurk within the decrepit farmhouse, and stash supplies in the barn, using the shadowy cover of southwestern Duskwood to escape the notice of both the Night Watch and Stormwind authorities.

The presence of the Defias here goes beyond simple banditry. Addle's Stead functions as an operational safehouse holding sensitive records for the Brotherhood. Crucial documents and dockets linking regional conspirators to the disappearance of King Varian Wrynn can be traced back to this very plot of land, turning an unassuming derelict farm into a vital thread in unraveling treason within the Alliance.

subzone:agama-gor.s: Agama'gor. Agama'gor es un importante campamento de jabaespines Erizacrin situado en el sur de Los Baldíos, ubicado justo al norte del camino que lleva al oeste hacia Mulgore desde el Campamento Taurajo. Representa una espina clavada constante en el costado del cercano puesto avanzado de la Horda, rebosante de jabaespines hostiles que se aferran ferozmente a su escarpado territorio. Extendido a lo largo de las polvorientas llanuras del sur de Los Baldíos, Agama'gor sirve como un asentamiento fortificado para la agresiva tribu Erizacrin de jabaespines. Ubicados peligrosamente cerca del Campamento Taurajo, los jabaespines de aquí mantienen una densa red de zarzales, chozas y tótems rudimentarios. Su densa presencia supone una amenaza activa para los viajeros que se desplazan entre Los Baldíos y las verdes colinas de Mulgore, lo que empuja a los exploradores y cazadores de la Horda a librar una guerra constante de contención contra ellos.

ang.faction:Horde: Camp Taurajo's safety hinges on keeping the Bristlebacks of Agama'gor in check, making the eradication of their warriors a priority for passing Horde defenders.
ang.race:Tauren: Situated directly on the path to the Great Gate and Mulgore, Agama'gor's marauders present an enduring danger to tauren supply lines and pilgrims.

faq.a: Agama'gor is a large Bristleback quilboar settlement in the southern Barrens. It sits directly north of the main road heading west from Camp Taurajo toward Mulgore.
faq.q: What is Agama'gor?

faq.a: Quilboar believe that all land touched by the fallen Ancient boar god Agamaggan rightfully belongs to them. As a result, the Bristlebacks regard the nearby tauren and orcs of Camp Taurajo as unwelcome invaders infringing upon their ancestral soil.
faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar here so hostile?

faq.a: The Bristleback quilboar throughout Agama'gor frequently carry Blood Shards—crystallized deposits steeped in primal power that can be traded to the exiled quilboar Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo.
faq.q: What can you find in Agama'gor?

faq.a: Mangletooth is an exiled quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. He harbors bitter grudges against his kin and will readily empower Horde adventurers with protective charms in exchange for Blood Shards taken from his former brethren in Agama'gor.
faq.q: Who is Mangletooth and how does he relate to this place?

text.s: Agama'gor is a major Bristleback quilboar encampment situated in the southern Barrens, nestled just north of the road leading west toward Mulgore from Camp Taurajo. It represents a constant thorn in the side of the nearby Horde outpost, teeming with hostile quilboar fiercely clinging to their rugged territory.

sec.b: Sprawling across the dusty plains of the southern Barrens, Agama'gor serves as a fortified settlement for the aggressive Bristleback tribe of quilboar. Located dangerously close to Camp Taurajo, the quilboar here maintain a dense network of brambles, huts, and crude totems. Their heavy presence poses an active threat to travelers moving between the Barrens and the grassy hills of Mulgore, prompting Horde scouts and hunters to wage a perpetual war of containment against them.

Beyond the general animosity between the Horde and the quilboar, Agama'gor is a prime source of the mysterious, crimson stones known as Blood Shards. Found on the Bristleback inhabiting this village, these geomantic minerals are prized by Mangletooth, a quilboar exile held captive at Camp Taurajo. Driven by ancient beliefs tied to Agamaggan's sacred essence, adventurers often raid Agama'gor to harvest these shards and trade them for potent tribal charms.

subzone:agamand-family-crypt.s: Cripta de la Familia Agamand. Enclavada en las colinas justo al norte de los Molinos de Agamand, la Cripta de la Familia Agamand es el antiguo lugar de descanso de una de las dinastías agrícolas más ricas de Tirisfal. Ahora reclamada por la Plaga bajo el mando del capitán Dargol, sus tumbas han sido profanadas y sus antepasados durmientes han sido alzados como terrores descerebrados. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, la familia Agamand poseía extensas fincas por todo el norte de los Claros de Tirisfal, sepultando a sus antepasados dentro de este mausoleo en la ladera. Cuando la Plaga arruinó el reino, la cripta cayó en las garras del capitán Dargol, un agente de la Plaga. En lugar de dejar descansar en paz al acaudalado linaje, Dargol recurrió a la nigromancia oscura para despertar a los esqueletos sepultados y a apariciones vengativas, transformando un camposanto sagrado en un agresivo bastión de la Plaga justo en el límite del territorio de los Renegados.

ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, Captain Dargol's occupation of the crypt is an intolerable Scourge presence in Tirisfal, mocking the dead and threatening the Undercity's northern frontier.

faq.a: The crypt is carved into the hillside just north of Agamand Mills in the northern reaches of Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Crypt located?

faq.a: The tomb is held by Captain Dargol, a servant of the Scourge who orchestrates the dark magic within and commands the raised dead.
faq.q: Who controls the crypt right now?

faq.a: The crypt is filled with awakened skeletons and restless spirits of the Agamand ancestors. Driven by dark magic, these vengeful undead assault anyone who steps into the tombs.
faq.q: What will I encounter inside the crypt?

faq.a: No. The creatures inside are thralls of the Scourge answering to Captain Dargol, making them hostile to the Forsaken and living travelers alike.
faq.q: Are the undead inside the crypt allied with the Forsaken?

text.s: Tucked into the hills just north of Agamand Mills, the Agamand Family Crypt is the ancient resting ground of one of Tirisfal's wealthiest farming dynasties. Now claimed by the Scourge under Captain Dargol, its tombs have been ripped open, and the slumbering ancestors raised as mindless terrors.

sec.b: Before the Third War, the Agamand family held expansive estates across northern Tirisfal Glades, entombing their forebears within this hillside mausoleum. When the Plague brought ruin to the kingdom, the crypt fell into the clutches of Captain Dargol, an agent of the Scourge. Rather than letting the wealthy lineage rest in peace, Dargol employed dark necromancy to awaken the entombed skeletons and vengeful apparitions, transforming a sacred burial ground into an aggressive Scourge foothold right on the edge of Forsaken territory.

subzone:agamand-mills.s: Molinos de Agamand. Molinos de Agamand es un extenso complejo de granjas y molinos ubicado en las colinas septentrionales de los Claros de Tirisfal. En su día fue la orgullosa hacienda de la acaudalada dinastía Agamand, pero ha caído en la ruina y se alza como la mayor fortaleza de la Plaga en la región. Hace siglos, ricos nobles inmigrantes de Strom establecieron la hacienda Agamand y construyeron una vasta red de molinos por el norte de Tirisfal. Cuando estalló la Tercera Guerra y la Plaga asoló Lordaeron, el patriarca Gregor Agamand se negó a huir: fortificó el recinto y convenció a sus sirvientes y trabajadores para que resistieran. Sus provisiones y muros de piedra podrían haber aguantado, pero su hijo menor, Devlin Agamand, traicionó a su propia sangre. Devlin asesinó a los guardias de la hacienda y dejó entrar a los muertos vivientes en los dormitorios. Debilitados desde dentro, los defensores restantes fueron aniquilados y la familia pasó a engrosar las filas de los no-muertos sin voluntad.

ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Agamand Mills is not merely tactical—it is personal vengeance against the Scourge and a settling of scores by former estate servants like Coleman Farthing.

faq.a: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, the Agamand family fortified their estate and attempted to hold out against the undead horde. However, the youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed his family and opened the gates to the Scourge, leading to the slaughter and reanimation of everyone within.
al: why are there undead at the mills
faq.q: Why is Agamand Mills overrun with Scourge?

faq.a: The estate serves as a regional forward outpost for the Scourge, led by Captain Dargol. Dargol operates deep within the fortified Agamand Family Crypt, where he uses dark magic to raise ancestral corpses into new soldiers.
al: who is in charge at the mills
faq.q: Who controls the mills right now?

faq.a: The mills represent the largest concentration of mindless Scourge forces remaining in Tirisfal Glades. If left unchecked, Captain Dargol's force threatens Brill and could choke off roads leading south to the Undercity.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about this place?

faq.a: They were an ancient, wealthy human noble house descended from Stromgarde immigrants who purchased rich farmlands in Tirisfal over a millennium ago. Today, its reanimated scions—including Gregor, Nissa, Thurman, and Devlin—wander the grounds as mindless thralls.
faq.q: Who was the Agamand family?

text.s: Agamand Mills is a sprawling farm and windmill complex nestled in the northern heights of Tirisfal Glades. Once the proud estate of the wealthy Agamand dynasty, it has fallen into ruin and stands as the largest Scourge stronghold in the region.

sec.b: Centuries ago, wealthy noble immigrants from Strom established the Agamand estate, building a vast milling network across northern Tirisfal. When the Third War broke out and the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the patriarch Gregor Agamand refused to flee, fortifying the compound and convincing his retainers and laborers to make their stand. Their provisions and stone walls might have held, but their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed his blood. Devlin slaughtered the estate watchmen and let the walking dead into the sleeping quarters. Crippled from within, the remaining defenders were wiped out, and the family joined the mindless ranks of the undead.

Today, the Agamand Mills are the most entrenched bastion of the Scourge in Tirisfal Glades, posing an immediate threat to the Forsaken realm. The rotting windmills now churn above infested fields of wights, zombies, and skeletal horrors. Beneath the estate, Captain Dargol commands the garrison from the deep Agamand Family Crypt, practicing necromancy to reanimate generations of Agamand ancestors. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren and the Deathguards wage an active campaign to clear the mills and purge the Scourge presence before it can march upon the Undercity.

subzone:aldrassil.s: Aldrassil. Aldrassil es el colosal árbol y asentamiento situado en el corazón de Cañada Umbría, en el noreste de Teldrassil. Sirve como refugio principal y campo de entrenamiento para los jóvenes kaldorei, y sus huecos tallados albergan instructores, comerciantes y líderes locales. Elevándose por encima del apartado valle de Cañada Umbría, Aldrassil funciona tanto de refugio como de centro cívico para los jóvenes elfos de la noche que dan sus primeros pasos en el mundo. Construidas dentro y alrededor del colosal tronco de este antiguo árbol, unas rampas serpenteantes pasan junto a instructores de clase y artesanos hasta el alto nido donde Tenaron Tormentagarre supervisa la protección del claro. Mientras la rama del mundo, Teldrassil, se extiende por el horizonte, Aldrassil proporciona un dosel seguro y firme donde los novicios aprenden sus artes antes de aventurarse hacia las turbulentas tierras salvajes de Kalimdor.

ang.class:Druid: Aldrassil demonstrates the kaldorei affinity for living architecture, shaped from living wood without breaking the balance of the forest.
ang.race:NightElf: For many young kaldorei, the carved hollows and ramps of Aldrassil are their first memory of civic life and the foundation of their early training.

faq.a: Aldrassil is the massive, hollowed-out tree and settlement situated in the center of Shadowglen, northeastern Teldrassil. It serves as the starting haven where young night elves gather training, goods, and guidance.
faq.q: What is Aldrassil?

faq.a: Tenaron Stormgrip oversees Shadowglen from his roost at the very top of Aldrassil, coordinating the defense of the vale and guiding newly awakened kaldorei.
faq.q: Who leads the settlement at Aldrassil?

faq.a: The tree houses class trainers for young night elf warriors, rogues, druids, hunters, and priests, alongside local supply merchants, armorers, and questgivers attending to the immediate needs of the glade.
faq.q: What services can be found here?

text.s: Aldrassil is the colossal bough-tree and settlement nestled at the heart of Shadowglen in northeastern Teldrassil. Serving as the primary refuge and training ground for young kaldorei, its carved hollows shelter trainers, merchants, and local leadership.

sec.b: Rising high above the secluded vale of Shadowglen, Aldrassil functions as both shelter and civic hub for young night elves taking their first steps in the world. Built into and around the colossal trunk of this ancient growth, winding ramps lead past class trainers and artisans to the high roost where Tenaron Stormgrip oversees the glade's protection. While the world bough Teldrassil stretches across the horizon, Aldrassil provides a safe, grounded canopy where novices learn their arts before venturing down into the troubled wilds of Kalimdor.

subzone:alexston-farmstead.s: Hacienda de Alexston. La Hacienda de Alexston es una granja abandonada en los Páramos de Poniente, cubierta de maleza y acechada por Vigías de la cosecha fuera de control. En su día fue el hogar de la infancia del arquitecto municipal de Ventormenta, Baros Alexston, pero ha acabado en la ruina como gran parte del granero que la rodea. Situada en medio de las secas llanuras de los Páramos de Poniente, la Hacienda de Alexston se alza como otro sombrío testimonio del abandono del reino. Al igual que las fincas vecinas, la granja fue abandonada por sus cuidadores cuando el bandidaje estalló por toda la comarca. Hoy en día, los campos están cubiertos de maleza y los Vigías de la cosecha mecánicos que quedaron atrás para cuidar los cultivos se han descontrolado, atacando violentamente a cualquiera que se acerque a la yerma casa de campo.

ang.faction:Alliance: The farm is a reminder of the quiet, hardworking roots that built Stormwind's finest minds, as well as the Alliance's ongoing struggle to protect its own borders.

faq.a: The farmstead takes its name from the family of Baros Alexston, the city architect of Stormwind. Baros worked the land here as a young boy before moving to the capital to pursue architecture.
faq.q: Who owns the Alexston Farmstead?

faq.a: Like much of Westfall, the farmstead was abandoned in the wake of widespread unrest and banditry by the Defias Brotherhood. With the kingdom unable to offer protection, the farmers fled, leaving the homestead to rot.
faq.q: Why is the farm abandoned?

faq.a: The mechanical Harvest Watchers were originally built to work the soil and protect crops from scavengers. Left unmaintained after the farmers fled, their internal clockwork has malfunctioned, turning them violently hostile to any living creature.
faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?

faq.a: Baros Alexston left behind a personal compass in the farmhouse from his youth. Travelers doing work in Stormwind City are sometimes asked to retrieve it from the abandoned homestead.
faq.q: Is there anything hidden inside the farmhouse?

text.s: The Alexston Farmstead is a derelict farm in Westfall, overgrown and prowled by haywire Harvest Watchers. Once the childhood home of Stormwind's city architect, Baros Alexston, it has fallen into ruin like much of the breadbasket around it.

sec.b: Situated amidst the dry plains of Westfall, the Alexston Farmstead stands as another grim testament to the kingdom's neglect. Like neighboring estates, the farm was abandoned by its caretakers when banditry erupted across the countryside. Today, the fields are overgrown, and the mechanical Harvest Watchers left behind to tend the crops have spun out of control, violently attacking anyone who approaches the barren farmhouse.

Despite its bleak state, the farm is tied to one of Stormwind's most prominent citizens. Baros Alexston, the skilled architect who helped design parts of the rebuilt capital, spent his youth toiling on these very fields. He left the farmstead long before the unrest began to pursue his trade in masonry and construction, leaving behind a memento of his early life nestled among the ruins.

subzone:algaz-station.s: Estación de Algaz. La Estación de Algaz es un puesto de avanzada militar enano situado en el noroeste de Loch Modan, directamente al sur del paso fortificado de Dun Algaz. Al guarnecer el acceso a los túneles del norte, su destacamento de montaraces ayuda a proteger a los viajeros y vigilar la frontera que conduce hacia Los Humedales. Ubicada justo al este del Paso de la Puerta Norte y al sur de Dun Algaz, la Estación de Algaz sirve como un punto de vigilancia estratégico vital para el reino de Forjaz. Un cuadro de montaraces enanos mantiene aquí una vigilia permanente, manteniendo el camino vital entre Loch Modan y las tierras bajas del norte abierto al comercio y al movimiento de tropas. Dadas las frecuentes amenazas en las colinas circundantes, desde bestias errantes hasta troggs invasores, el puesto de avanzada proporciona descanso, reparaciones y apoyo marcial para los viajeros fatigados antes de que se aventuren a través de los túneles de las montañas.

ang.faction:Alliance: The outpost offers a secure staging ground and repair stop for Alliance adventurers journeying between Loch Modan and the marshlands of the north.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarven travelers, Algaz Station is a familiar emblem of Ironforge's reach, ensuring the king's highways remain guarded against threats spilling from the mountains.

faq.a: It is an Ironforge military outpost in northwestern Loch Modan. It serves as a guard post and waystation for Mountaineers patrolling the mountain passes leading north to Dun Algaz.
faq.q: What is Algaz Station?

faq.a: It takes its name from Dun Algaz, the massive dwarven pass and tunnel system situated just north of the station that connects Loch Modan to the Wetlands.
al: why is it called algaz station
faq.q: Where does the station get its name?

faq.a: The outpost is manned by dwarven Mountaineers, including Mountaineer Stormpike, alongside support personnel like the armorer Gothor Brumn who provides field repairs to travelers.
faq.q: Who can be found at Algaz Station?

text.s: Algaz Station is a dwarven military outpost situated in northwestern Loch Modan, directly south of the fortified pass of Dun Algaz. Manning the approach to the northern tunnels, its garrison of Mountaineers helps safeguard travelers and watch the frontier leading toward the Wetlands.

sec.b: Perched just east of North Gate Pass and south of Dun Algaz, Algaz Station serves as a vital strategic watchpoint for the kingdom of Ironforge. A cadre of dwarven Mountaineers maintains a permanent vigil here, keeping the vital road between Loch Modan and the northern lowlands open to trade and troop movements. Given the frequent threats in the surrounding hills, from wandering beasts to encroaching troggs, the outpost provides respite, repairs, and martial support for weary travelers before they venture through the mountain tunnels.

subzone:alterac-mountains.s: Montañas de Alterac. Las Montañas de Alterac son una cordillera escarpada y cubierta de nieve que se alza justo sobre los ondulados pastos de Trabalomas. Antaño el corazón de un orgulloso reino humano, sus laderas albergan ahora asentamientos en ruinas, facciones de bandidos y una naturaleza salvaje y peligrosa donde los viajeros rara vez se adentran desprotegidos. Mucho antes de que las colinas cayeran en el caos, estas tierras altas formaban la nación soberana de Alterac, uno de los siete reinos nacidos del antiguo Arathor. Ese legado se quebró durante la Segunda Guerra, cuando el rey Aiden Perenolde forjó un pacto clandestino con la Horda Antigua, permitiendo a las fuerzas orcas atravesar los picos a cambio de la seguridad de su reino. La Alianza de Lordaeron descubrió la traición y depuso a Perenolde, dejando la región fracturada por la ley marcial y disputas territoriales.

ang.class:Rogue: The mountain passes are rife with Syndicate agents and hired cutthroats, making the hills a prime testing ground for survival and counter-espionage.
ang.faction:Alliance: For the Alliance, Alterac stands as a bitter monument to betrayal, where Perenolde's treachery nearly doomed humanity during the Second War.
