faq.a: The human kingdom of Alterac held these mountains for generations after the splintering of the Empire of Arathor. Its capital sat among the highest peaks, commanding the roads between Lordaeron, Dalaran, and the Arathi highlands until its fall during the Second War.
faq.q: What kingdom used to rule these mountains?

faq.a: During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance of Lordaeron by assisting the Horde. When the treason was exposed, Alliance armies crushed Alterac's forces and deposed the crown. With no legitimate ruler and subsequent devastation from the Third War, the nation collapsed into rubble.
faq.q: Why is Alterac in ruins?

faq.a: The Syndicate is an outlaw syndicate made up of former Alteraci nobility and their retainers. Led by Aliden Perenolde, they employ brigands, assassins, and rogue mercenaries to destabilize the region in hopes of violently restoring their kingdom.
al: why are there bandits in alterac
faq.q: Who are the Syndicate lurking in the hills?

faq.a: Travelers brave enough to climb the slopes must contend with the brutal Crushridge ogres, packs of Highland gnolls, scavenging kobolds, and opportunistic Syndicate brigands patrolling the passes.
faq.q: What threats wander the snowy peaks?

text.s: The Alterac Mountains are a rugged, snow-capped range rising directly above the rolling pastures of Hillsbrad. Once the heart of a proud human kingdom, the slopes now harbor ruined settlements, bandit factions, and dangerous wilderness where travelers rarely walk unguarded.

sec.b: Long before the hills fell into chaos, these highlands formed the sovereign nation of Alterac, one of the seven kingdoms born from ancient Arathor. That legacy shattered during the Second War when King Aiden Perenolde struck a clandestine pact with the Old Horde, allowing orcish forces passage through the peaks in exchange for his kingdom's safety. The Alliance of Lordaeron uncovered the betrayal and deposed Perenolde, leaving the region fractured by martial law and territorial disputes.

Following the devastation of the Third War, the mountains collapsed into complete lawlessness. The disinherited nobles of the realm banded together to form the Syndicate, operating out of the ruins of Strahnbrad and plotting to reclaim their lost dominion through sabotage and assassination. Between ruthless Crushridge ogres occupying the shattered capital, marauding gnolls, and the shattered magical ruins around Dalaran, the passes of Alterac remain some of the most perilous pathways in Lordaeron.

subzone:alther-s-mill.s: Molino de Alther. El Molino de Alther es un aserradero en ruinas enclavado en las escarpadas colinas al noreste de Villa del Lago, en las Montañas Crestagrana. Antaño una fuente vital de madera procesada para los constructores locales, sus terrenos abandonados se han deteriorado hasta convertirse en un refugio para carroñeros salvajes y depredadores al acecho. Para los aventureros que viajan al este hacia Petravista, estas estructuras ruinosas sirven como un sombrío punto de referencia que delimita el fin del territorio fronterizo seguro. Antes de que la región cayera presa de depredadores invasores y de las incursiones orcas, el Molino de Alther bullía con el comercio maderero que abastecía la construcción de Villa del Lago y los asentamientos circundantes. Su apacible claro al noreste del Lago Sempiterno ofrecía un fácil acceso a las masas forestales de las montañas. A medida que aumentaban las tensiones en el reino de Ventormenta y el Clan Roca Negra descendía desde las alturas de Petravista, los molineros locales abandonaron las instalaciones, dejando que los secos edificios de madera y la rueda se pudrieran con el tiempo.

ang.class:Rogue: Alliance scoundrels know Alther's Mill well, as thieves' syndicates use the scattered, forgotten lockboxes and secluded grounds of the mill as a quiet training ground to practice delicate lockpicking.
ang.faction:Alliance: The ruined mill stands as another stark reminder of Stormwind's strained frontier garrisons, where valuable industry lies broken and abandoned within sight of Lakeshire.

faq.a: Alther's Mill is a ruined lumber mill located northeast of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. It previously harvested and processed timber for the surrounding settlements until mounting wilderness dangers forced its abandonment.
faq.q: What is Alther's Mill?

faq.a: As regional defenses weakened following the First and Second Wars, aggressive wildlife like giant spiders and encroachment by Blackrock orcs made frontier operations too perilous for ordinary laborers to maintain without royal military protection.
faq.q: Why is the mill abandoned?

faq.a: The grounds and surrounding scrublands are primarily overrun by giant mountain tarantulas, scavenger buzzards, and roving predators, along with stray marauders moving between Stonewatch and Lake Everstill.
faq.q: What creatures roam around the mill?

faq.a: The isolated, debris-strewn grounds make it a favored proving ground for Alliance rogues, who are directed here by their trainers to practice picking locked footlockers and retrieve valuable thieving certifications.
faq.q: Why do rogues visit Alther's Mill?

text.s: Alther's Mill is a ruined lumber mill tucked into the rugged hills northeast of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Once a vital source of processed timber for local builders, the abandoned grounds have deteriorated into a haven for feral scavengers and prowling predators. For adventurers traveling east toward Stonewatch, the dilapidated structures serve as a grim landmark marking the boundary of safe frontier territory.

sec.b: Before the region fell prey to invading predators and orc raids, Alther's Mill bustled with timber trade that supplied the construction of Lakeshire and surrounding settlements. Its quiet clearing northeast of Lake Everstill provided ready access to mountain timber stands. As turmoil mounted across the kingdom of Stormwind and the Blackrock clan pushed down from the heights of Stonewatch, local millers abandoned the facility, leaving the dry timber buildings and wheel to decay into rot.

In the absence of human workers, the mill became infested with monstrous tarantulas, carrion vultures, and opportunistic raiders. Travelers cutting through the path to the eastern passes must skirt its shadowed perimeter carefully. In recent years, shadowy operatives and thieves have also taken advantage of the abandoned compound, using its discarded storage boxes and hidden corners to hone illicit lockpicking crafts and covert trades far from the eyes of the Lakeshire Town Watch.

subzone:amberstill-ranch.s: Granja de Semperámbar. La Granja de Semperámbar es un tranquilo hogar enano enclavado junto al camino nevado hacia Loch Modan, directamente al norte de la Cantera de Gol'Bolar. Sirve como el principal centro de cría y adiestramiento de los célebres carneros de montaña de Forjaz. Los aventureros visitan la granja para adquirir resistentes monturas enanas, entrenar equitación o ayudar a la familia a defender su ganado de los depredadores locales. Resguardada contra los riscos de Dun Morogh, la Granja de Semperámbar es famosa en todo Khaz Modan por criar los carneros de montaña más robustos de los Reinos del Este. La familia Amberstill gestiona los establos y corrales, adiestrando a estas bestias de paso firme para sortear traicioneros pasos nevados y escarpados acantilados alpinos. Además de suministrar monturas y ganado doméstico, la familia a menudo lidia con la salvaje fauna de las colinas, en particular con los wéndigos errantes atraídos por el olor del rebaño fresco.

ang.faction:Alliance: The sturdy rams raised by the Amberstills provide the Alliance with dependable, cold-weather cavalry suitable for rugged mountain terrain.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarven adventurers, the ranch is a proud cultural cornerstone where young heroes acquire their first Barak Tor'ol ram mount.

faq.a: The ranch is the Alliance's central hub for breeding Barak Tor'ol mountain rams. Dwarves and honored Alliance champions come here to learn ram riding and purchase mounts from the local stable masters.
faq.q: What is Amberstill Ranch known for?

faq.a: Rams are traditionally reserved for dwarven riders who understand their stubborn temperament. Members of other Alliance races may only learn to ride and purchase them if they have earned the utmost trust and exalted standing with Ironforge.
faq.q: Can non-dwarves purchase mounts here?

faq.a: The herd is under constant threat from hungry wendigos descending from the frozen bluffs. The most notorious predator prowling the surrounding heights is Vagash, a massive wendigo that regularly targets the vulnerable livestock.
faq.q: What threats does the ranch face?

faq.a: Young Yarlyn Amberstill keeps a collection of domestic snowshoe rabbits and is willing to sell crated rabbits to travelers looking for a companion pet on the road.
faq.q: Can you obtain anything else at the ranch?

text.s: Amberstill Ranch is a tranquil dwarven homestead nestled along the snowy roadway toward Loch Modan, directly north of Gol'Bolar Quarry. It serves as the primary breeding and training grounds for Ironforge's celebrated mountain rams. Adventurers visit the ranch to acquire hardy dwarven mounts, train in riding, or help the family defend their livestock from local predators.

sec.b: Tucked against the crags of Dun Morogh, Amberstill Ranch is renowned throughout Khaz Modan for raising the sturdiest mountain rams in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Amberstill family manages the stables and paddocks, training these sure-footed beasts to navigate treacherous snowy passes and steep alpine cliffs. Outside of supplying riding mounts and domestic livestock, the family often contends with the savage fauna of the hills, particularly wandering wendigos drawn by the scent of fresh flock.

subzone:ameth-aran.s: Ameth'Aran. Ameth'Aran es una antigua ruina en el sur de Costa Oscura, en su día una próspera ciudad donde los Altonato de la reina Azshara practicaban la hechicería arcana. Cuando el Gran Cataclismo destrozó el mundo antiguo, la ciudad cayó con él. Hoy en día, sus columnatas rotas están encantadas por los fantasmas vengativos de los elfos que murieron allí. Antes del Gran Cataclismo, Ameth'Aran y su asentamiento hermano, Bashal'Aran, se alzaban como centros gemelos de la influencia de los Altonato a lo largo de la antigua costa. Con el favor de la reina Azshara, la ciudad presumía de bulliciosos bazares y elegantes santuarios dedicados a Elune, aunque su nobleza gobernante se dedicaba a la experimentación arcana desenfrenada. Gobernada desde la distancia por el hechicero Athrikus Narassin en La torre de Althalaxx, la ciudad prosperó hasta que el colapso catastrófico del Pozo de la Eternidad desgarró el Imperio kaldorei.

ang.class:Druid: Druids view the ruins as an unhealed scar upon Darkshore, where tormented spirits linger and disrupt the natural balance of the wilds.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves, Ameth'Aran is a grim monument to the hubris and treachery of the Highborne caste that brought about the Sundering.

faq.a: Ameth'Aran was already in ruins in the final days of the Kaldorei Empire, and it was destroyed when the Well of Eternity was shattered in the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago. The ruins remain haunted by the spirits of the Highborne who died there.
faq.q: What happened to Ameth'Aran?

faq.a: They are the restless spirits of the Highborne elves who lived and practiced arcane magic in the city before the Great Sundering. Unable to find rest, they wander the broken stones in perpetual agony and fury.
faq.q: Who are the ghosts wandering the ruins?

faq.a: Anaya Dawnrunner was a resident of Ameth'Aran and the beloved of Cerellean Whiteclaw. She perished when the city fell during the Sundering, and her ghost remained bound to the ruins until Cerellean sought outside aid to finally grant her soul release.
faq.q: Who was Anaya Dawnrunner?

faq.a: The ruins contain ancient stone tablets inscribed with the history of Ameth'Aran and the account of its fall. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade attempted to decipher them to deliver a historical report to the Cenarion Circle, but hostile ghosts forced her to rely on passing travelers.
faq.q: What are the stone tablets found in the ruins?

text.s: Ameth'Aran is an ancient ruin in southern Darkshore, once a thriving city where Queen Azshara's Highborne practiced arcane sorcery. When the Great Sundering shattered the ancient world, the city fell with it. Today, its broken colonnades are haunted by the vengeful ghosts of the elves who died there.

sec.b: Before the Great Sundering, Ameth'Aran and its sister settlement, Bashal'Aran, stood as twin centers of Highborne influence along the ancient coastline. Under the favor of Queen Azshara, the city boasted bustling bazaars and graceful shrines to Elune, though its ruling nobility dedicated themselves to unrestrained arcane experimentation. Governed from afar by the sorcerer Athrikus Narassin in the Tower of Althalaxx, the city thrived until the catastrophic collapse of the Well of Eternity tore the Kaldorei Empire apart.

As the world began to tear itself apart, Athrikus Narassin returned to Ameth'Aran, promising his panicked subjects salvation through powerful shielding magic. Instead of shielding them, the sorcerer enacted a horrific betrayal, stealing their life force to feed his own soul gems under the cruel guise of giving them eternal preservation. Shattered by cataclysm and dark magic, Ameth'Aran fell. Today, its grounds are stalked by anguished Highborne specters, unable to find rest ten thousand years after their murder.

subzone:angerfang-encampment.s: Campamento Dentellada. El Campamento Dentellada es el principal bastión del clan Faucedraco en el centro de Los Pantanales. Liderados por el Jefe Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, estos orcos renegados utilizan el extenso campamento como base de operaciones para amenazar los asentamientos enanos cercanos y planear la destrucción del Puerto de Menethil. Extendido a lo largo del fango en el centro de Los Pantanales, el Campamento Dentellada sirve como el corazón fortificado del poder Faucedraco en la región. A diferencia de las partidas de asalto dispersas que deambulan por los pantanos, este recinto cuenta con barricadas fuertemente defendidas, torres de vigilancia y una formidable hueste de guerreros, custodios óseos y oscuros lanzadores de conjuros leales a las viejas costumbres. Desde aquí, los Faucedraco proyectan su fuerza militar por todos los pantanos, asaltando a los viajeros en los caminos y amenazando las excavaciones enanas cercanas, como la Excavación de Whelgar.

ang.class:Warlock: The dark shadowwarders within the encampment carry Rods of Channeling, essential artifacts sought for the bindings written within the Tome of the Cabal.
ang.faction:Alliance: For the defenders of Menethil Harbor, Angerfang is a clear and present danger; bringing down Nek'rosh's war banners and taking his head is vital to securing the coastal trade routes.

faq.a: The camp is ruled by Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, the son of the notorious Dragonmaw warlock Nekros Skullcrusher. From his command tent deep within the encampment, Nek'rosh directs regional raiding parties and plans the conquest of Menethil Harbor.
faq.q: Who rules the Angerfang Encampment?

faq.a: No. The Dragonmaw clan here remains independent of Thrall's New Horde. They cling to the dark heritage of the Old Horde, remaining hostile to Alliance and Horde travelers alike. Thrall's warriors view them as feral outcasts, even hunting them down for armor crafting materials.
al: is angerfang part of thralls horde
faq.q: Are the orcs here allied with Thrall's Horde?

faq.a: Captain Stoutfist and the dwarven defenders of Menethil Harbor discovered that Nek'rosh has assembled catapults and massive forces at Angerfang to bombard and conquer the harbor. The Alliance attacks preemptively to crush the siege before it begins.
faq.q: Why is the Alliance focused on destroying this camp?

faq.a: The dark spellcasters among the Dragonmaw at Angerfang carry Rods of Channeling, dark ritual implements coveted by practitioners of the demonic arts seeking to complete the Tome of the Cabal.
faq.q: Why do warlocks seek out this encampment?

text.s: The Angerfang Encampment is the primary stronghold of the Dragonmaw clan in the central Wetlands. Led by Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, these renegade orcs use the sprawling camp as a staging ground to threaten nearby dwarven settlements and plot the destruction of Menethil Harbor.

sec.b: Sprawling across the muck of the central Wetlands, the Angerfang Encampment serves as the fortified heart of Dragonmaw power in the region. Unlike the scattered raiding parties found wandering the marshes, this compound boasts heavily defended barricades, watchtowers, and a formidable host of warriors, bonewarders, and dark spellcasters loyal to the old ways. From here, the Dragonmaw project military force across the marshlands, raiding travelers along the roads and menacing nearby dwarven digs like Whelgar's Excavation Site.

The encampment is commanded by Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, son of the infamous warlock Nekros who once enslaved the red dragonflight at Grim Batol. Harboring a deep hatred for the Alliance, Nek'rosh has marshaled catapults and raised war banners in preparation for an all-out assault against Menethil Harbor. Aware of the looming siege, Alliance commanders in the port city dispatch champions into the belly of Angerfang to capture their banners, smash their war machines, and claim Nek'rosh's head before his offensive can drown the harbor in fire.

subzone:apothecarium.s: Apothecarium. El Apothecarium es el barrio suroeste de Entrañas y la sede de la Sociedad Real de Boticarios. Dentro de estos nocivos laboratorios, los alquimistas Renegados trabajan incansablemente a las órdenes del Maestro boticario Faranell para elaborar pestes virulentas, toxinas y horrores modificados. Se erige como el lúgubre corazón de la investigación biológica de Entrañas, vital para la campaña de Lady Sylvanas contra los vivos y la Plaga. Ocupando la terraza suroeste de la capital subterránea, el Apothecarium es un laberinto de cubas burbujeantes, mesas de disección y acres vapores químicos. Liderada por el Maestro boticario Faranell, la Sociedad Real de Boticarios utiliza este distrito para profundizar en su comprensión de la mortalidad y la putrefacción. Aquí, alquimistas y cirujanos experimentan con injertos de tejido, vivisección y el ensamblaje de poderosas abominaciones. Su propósito primordial, encomendado por Lady Sylvanas Brisaveloz, es la formulación de una nueva peste capaz de erradicar tanto a la Plaga como a la persistente presencia humana en Lordaeron.

ang.profession:Herbalism: Botanists supply the foul distillers of the Royal Apothecary Society with rare, blighted flora gathered from the ruins of the northern kingdoms.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, the Apothecarium is the forge of their survival, producing the chemical and stitched weapons essential to holding Lordaeron against overwhelming enemies.

faq.a: The Apothecarium serves as the research and manufacturing wing for the Royal Apothecary Society. It is where Forsaken alchemists brew experimental poisons, refine the New Plague, construct abominations, and instruct practitioners in alchemy and herbalism.
faq.q: What is the Apothecarium used for?

faq.a: The district and its researchers are led by Master Apothecary Faranell, the chief scientist of the Royal Apothecary Society, operating with the full authority and patronage of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: Who leads the Apothecarium?

faq.a: Their primary endeavor is cultivating a lethal New Plague engineered to annihilate both the Scourge forces of the Lich King and any living human resistance contesting Forsaken territory in Lordaeron.
faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to create?

faq.a: Yes. The district is the capital's main hub for alchemists and herbalists, hosting advanced profession trainers along its walkways and chambers.
faq.q: Can players learn professions here?

text.s: The Apothecarium is the southwestern quarter of the Undercity and the headquarters of the Royal Apothecary Society. Within these noxious laboratories, Forsaken alchemists labor tirelessly under Master Apothecary Faranell to concoct virulent plagues, toxins, and engineered horrors. It stands as the grim heart of Undercity's biological research, vital to Lady Sylvanas's campaign against the living and the Scourge.

sec.b: Occupying the southwestern terrace of the subterranean capital, the Apothecarium is a labyrinth of bubbling vats, dissection tables, and pungent chemical fumes. Led by Master Apothecary Faranell, the Royal Apothecary Society utilizes this district to advance their understanding of mortality and rot. Here, alchemists and surgeons experiment on tissue grafts, vivisection, and the assembly of mighty abominations. Their overriding purpose, mandated by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, is the formulation of a new plague capable of eradicating both the Scourge and the lingering human presence across Lordaeron.

Beyond grand military ambitions, the quarter serves as the premier center of practical alchemy and herbalism for the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms. Initiates and masters alike gather beside toxic canals to distill concoctions, study botanical blights, and consult master practitioners.

subzone:astranaar.s: Astranaar. Astranaar es el principal asentamiento de elfos de la noche en el centro de Vallefresno, construido a lo largo de una serena isla en un lago que se extiende a ambos lados del antiguo camino del bosque. Al actuar como el corazón palpitante de las operaciones de la Alianza en la región, proporciona un refugio vital a los viajeros que se enfrentan a las crecientes amenazas de los fúrbolgs hostiles, los sátiros y la Horda. Situada sobre una isla en medio de un lago forestal, Astranaar se erige como el mayor asentamiento de elfos de la noche de Vallefresno. Conectada a tierra firme por pasarelas de madera que cruzan las aguas, la localidad alberga centinelas, sacerdotisas y artesanos que vigilan los bosques. Además de ofrecer comodidades básicas como una posada, comerciantes y un peletero experto, sus perchas elevadas cuentan con un maestro de vuelo que ofrece viajes en hipogrifo a puestos remotos por todo Kalimdor.

ang.faction:Alliance: Astranaar serves as the Alliance's command post and primary logistical hub while maneuvering through the contested wilderness of Ashenvale.
ang.race:NightElf: For the Kaldorei, Astranaar is the central bastion of their ancient homeland in central Kalimdor, safeguarding sacred groves and housing the grave of fallen hero Valstann Staghelm.

faq.a: Astranaar offers a full suite of amenities for Alliance travelers, including an inn, general goods vendors, an expert leatherworking trainer, and a flight master connecting to key outposts throughout Ashenvale and Kalimdor.
faq.q: What services are available in Astranaar?

faq.a: The cemetery by the lake contains the tomb of Valstann Staghelm, son of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, who was slain during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands against the Qiraji in Silithus.
faq.q: Who is buried in the graveyard across the lake?

faq.a: The Thistlefur furbolgs to the north have fallen under dark, corrupting influences. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner fears that left unchecked, their growing aggression will embolden them to mount an open assault against Astranaar itself.
faq.q: Why are the Sentinels in Astranaar worried about the local furbolgs?

faq.a: No. Astranaar is a heavily fortified Alliance stronghold guarded by armed Night Elf Sentinels who will attack Horde members on sight.
faq.q: Can Horde players visit Astranaar safely?

text.s: Astranaar is the primary Night Elf settlement in central Ashenvale, built across a serene lake island straddling the ancient forest road. Serving as the beating heart of Alliance operations in the region, it provides vital refuge to travelers facing encroaching threats from hostile furbolgs, satyrs, and the Horde.

sec.b: Situated atop an island in the middle of a forest lake, Astranaar stands as the largest night elven settlement in Ashenvale. Connected to the mainland by wooden footbridges spanning the waters, the town houses sentinels, priests, and artisans who keep vigil over the woodlands. In addition to offering basic comforts such as an inn, traders, and an expert leatherworker, its elevated perches host a flight master providing hippogryph travel to distant outposts across Kalimdor.

Despite its tranquil waters and glowing lanterns, Astranaar exists in a state of perpetual readiness. Local leaders like Raene Wolfrunner coordinate patrols and defensive actions against the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs encroaching from the north, fearful they may mount a direct assault on the settlement. The town also bears quiet historical sorrow: across the lake in the cemetery lies the resting place of Valstann Staghelm, who fell a thousand years ago during the War of the Shifting Sands.

subzone:auberdine.s: Auberdine. Auberdine es una ciudad portuaria costera de elfos de la noche en las sombrías costas de Costa Oscura, que sirve como la principal puerta de entrada marítima de la Alianza al norte de Kalimdor. Cobijada bajo cielos encapotados y riscos cubiertos de pinos, conecta el hogar insular de Teldrassil con los Reinos del Este, a la vez que actúa como un refugio administrativo frente a la naturaleza circundante. Asentada a orillas del Mar de la Bruma, Auberdine es el único asentamiento importante que ha logrado perdurar en la Costa Oscura moderna. A diferencia de las aisladas ciudades en las copas de los árboles de Teldrassil, Auberdine mira hacia el exterior, sirviendo como el puerto más transitado de la Alianza en el norte. Barcos regulares navegan entre aquí y el Puerto de Menethil en los Reinos del Este, mientras que los transbordadores locales viajan a Aldea Rut'theran, a las ramas del Árbol del Mundo. Debido a su papel comercial, Auberdine acoge un ambiente más cosmopolita que los enclaves élficos tradicionales; los visitantes encuentran farolas que iluminan calles empedradas, carteles bilingües en darnassiano y común, y comerciantes de tierras lejanas, incluidos enanos y gnomos, mezclándose entre las casas bajas de madera arqueada.

ang.faction:Alliance: This port is the lifeblood of Alliance travel and supply lines into northern Kalimdor, ensuring steady logistics between Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus.
ang.race:NightElf: For kaldorei venturing out from Teldrassil, Auberdine is the first true mainland hub where ancient tradition meets the strange ways and bustling industry of younger Alliance allies.

faq.a: The docks connect northern Kalimdor to the wider Alliance world. One pier hosts the ferry to Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil, while another berths large ocean-going vessels that sail across the Great Sea directly to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where do the ships in Auberdine go?

faq.a: Auberdine is stewarded by elder Thundris Windweaver alongside the Auberdine Village Council. The settlement's defense is overseen by the Sentinels, led locally by Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.
faq.q: Who rules Auberdine?

faq.a: Because Auberdine serves as the Alliance's chief port on northern Kalimdor, foreign traders, craftsmen, and travelers arrive here first. Dwarves have set up a local smithy to service visiting ships and travellers, making the town unusually diverse and welcoming compared to traditional night elf settlements.
faq.q: Why are there dwarves and humans living in a night elf town?

faq.a: Traditionalists and isolationists in Darnassus often regard Auberdine as tainted by worldly commerce and outland influences. Some orthodox elves consider its people to be misfits, and the bustling trade hub is viewed as poorly suited to strictly traditional druidic lifestyles.
faq.q: Why do night elves from Darnassus look down on Auberdine?

text.s: Auberdine is a coastal night elven port town on the gloomy shores of Darkshore, serving as the Alliance's primary maritime gateway to northern Kalimdor. Sheltered beneath overcast skies and pine-covered bluffs, it connects the island home of Teldrassil to the Eastern Kingdoms while serving as an administrative haven against the encroaching wilderness.

sec.b: Resting along the shores of the Veiled Sea, Auberdine is the only major settlement to successfully endure in modern Darkshore. Unlike the secluded treetop cities of Teldrassil, Auberdine looks outward, serving as the Alliance's busiest port in the north. Regular ships sail between here and Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms, while local ferries run to Rut'theran Village at the boughs of the World Tree. Because of its trade role, Auberdine embraces a more cosmopolitan air than traditional elven enclaves; visitors find lamps illuminating stone-laid streets, bilingual signs in Darnassian and Common, and outland merchants including dwarves and gnomes mingling among the low-slung, arched timber houses.

Governed by elder Thundris Windweaver and the Auberdine Village Council, the town coordinates the defence of Darkshore alongside the local Sentinels. Despite its role as a vital trade hub, highborn denizens of Darnassus often look askance at Auberdine, viewing its population of traders, fishermen, and outsiders as misfits. The town endures relentless regional perils: aggressive murlocs raid the fishing boats along the strand, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs press from the south, and foul magic seeping down from Felwood agitates the local wildlife.

subzone:azurelode-mine.s: Mina Azur. Mina Azur es una activa mina de hierro de la Alianza situada en las colinas suroccidentales de Laderas de Trabalomas. Custodiada por la milicia de Costasur y trabajada por peones humanos, su constante suministro de mineral abastece el esfuerzo bélico humano local contra los Renegados de Molino Tarren. Situada al suroeste de las tierras de cultivo abiertas y justo al oeste de Costasur, Mina Azur lleva mucho tiempo extrayendo las riquezas minerales de las crestas a lo largo de la costa. Antes de que se sellara la Muralla de Cringrís, estas colinas se consideraban parte del territorio gilneano. Hoy en día, los mineros humanos trabajan a gran profundidad bajo la atenta mirada de Foreman Bonds, extrayendo hierro para forjar armas y armaduras destinadas a los defensores de la Alianza que defienden la región frente a Entrañas.

ang.faction:Horde: Striking at Azurelode Mine cuts off Southshore's supply of fresh iron, directly supporting the Forsaken offensive in the Foothills.
ang.profession:Mining: The tunnels inside and the ridges around Azurelode are rich in iron deposits, though Alliance miners guard the interior fiercely.

faq.a: Azurelode Mine is controlled by the Alliance and operated by human miners affiliated with Southshore and the Hillsbrad township, overseen on-site by Foreman Bonds.
faq.q: Who controls Azurelode Mine?

faq.a: The mine supplies vital iron to the armories of Southshore and local Alliance militia. Tarren Mill's leadership targets the miners and overseers to cripple human weapon production in the Foothills.
faq.q: Why is the mine important to the Horde?

faq.a: Historically, the rugged ridge holding Azurelode Mine fell within the outer borders of Gilneas before King Genn Greymane erected the Greymane Wall, walling his kingdom off from the rest of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Was Azurelode Mine always part of Hillsbrad?

faq.a: The mine primarily produces iron ore for nearby human armories.
faq.q: What metals are mined here?

text.s: Azurelode Mine is an active Alliance iron mine nestled in the southwestern hills of Hillsbrad Foothills. Guarded by Southshore's militia and worked by human laborers, its steady supply of ore fuels the local human war effort against the Forsaken of Tarren Mill.

sec.b: Situated southwest of the open farmland and just west of Southshore, Azurelode Mine has long tapped into the mineral-rich ridges along the coast. Before the Greymane Wall was sealed, these hills were considered part of Gilnean territory. Today, human miners labor deep underground under the watchful eye of Foreman Bonds, extracting iron to forge arms and armor for the Alliance defenders holding the region against the Undercity.

Because Azurelode Mine supplies the bulk of the raw iron needed to maintain Southshore's garrisons and town militia, it sits directly in the crosshairs of the Horde. Tarren Mill has targeted its workforce and guards in an effort to shatter the supply lines that sustain Hillsbrad's human strongholds.

subzone:bael-dun-digsite.s: Excavación Bael'Dun. La Excavación Bael'Dun es una excavación enana horadada en lo profundo de las montañas a lo largo del confín occidental de Mulgore. Establecida por el equipo del Prospector Khazgorm desde Bael Modan, la cantera es considerada por los tauren locales como una profanación directa de su tierra ancestral y un insulto a la Madre Tierra. Emplazada en las laderas montañosas del oeste de Mulgore, la Excavación Bael'Dun representa el punto más meridional de la expedición de la Liga de Expedicionarios enana con base en Bael Modan, en el sur de Los Baldíos. Sin preocuparse por las fronteras territoriales ni por las tradiciones espirituales de las tribus recién asentadas, los prospectores enanos llegaron con picos, palas y pólvora para desenterrar antiguas reliquias de los titanes enterradas bajo las llanuras.

ang.faction:Alliance: Though driven by an earnest thirst for historical discovery, the Bael'dun miners have overextended deep into sovereign Horde territory, sparking violent friction with the locals.
ang.race:Tauren: The intrusive scarring of Mulgore's western hills makes Bael'dun a direct insult to the Earth Mother, demanding decisive action to protect ancestral soil from foreign desecration.

faq.a: The prospectors belong to the dwarven expedition headquartered at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. Driven by the Explorers' League's quest to uncover ancient artifacts and Titan heritage, they established this outpost wherever their instruments suggested relics might lie, disregarding tauren sovereignty.
faq.q: Why are dwarves digging in Mulgore?

faq.a: The tauren view the operation as an intolerable wound against the Earth Mother. After the dwarves refused early warnings to leave peacefully, Baine Bloodhoof and the village leaders sent warriors to destroy the miners' tools and drive the trespassers out of Mulgore.
faq.q: How does the Bloodhoof tribe respond to the digsite?

faq.a: Bael'dun is a satellite digsite established directly from the fortress and primary excavation at Bael Modan, located just across the mountain ridge in the southern Barrens.
al: where do these dwarves come from
faq.q: What is the connection between Bael'dun and Bael Modan?

faq.a: Baine Bloodhoof initially pursued diplomatic solutions and issued formal warnings to the expedition leaders. However, the dwarves treated Mulgore as unclaimed wilderness and completely ignored tauren spiritual concerns, leaving force as the tribe's only recourse.
faq.q: Why didn't the tauren simply negotiate with the expedition?

text.s: The Bael'dun Digsite is a dwarven excavation carved deep into the mountains along the western edge of Mulgore. Established by Prospector Khazgorm's team out of Bael Modan, the quarry is viewed by the local tauren as a direct desecration of their ancestral homeland and an insult to the Earth Mother.

sec.b: Perched on the mountain slopes of western Mulgore, the Bael'dun Digsite represents the southernmost reach of the dwarven Explorers' League expedition based out of Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. Unconcerned with territorial borders or the spiritual traditions of the newly settled tribes, dwarven prospectors arrived with picks, shovels, and blasting powder to unearth ancient Titan relics buried beneath the plains.

The Bloodhoof tribe viewed this invasive quarrying as an outright assault on the Earth Mother. Baine Bloodhoof initially urged caution and attempted to warn the interlopers away, but the dwarves flatly refused to abandon their trenches. Concluding that diplomacy had failed, the tauren resolved to break the expedition's tools and forcibly expel the miners before their destructive digging tears further into Mulgore's sacred earth.

subzone:bael-dun-keep.s: Fortaleza de Bael'dun. La Fortaleza de Bael'dun es una imponente fortificación enana que domina la excavación de Bael Modan en el sur de Los Baldíos. Bajo el mando del General Twinbraid, esta fortaleza afianza la controvertida presencia de la Alianza en la región, lo que la enfrenta en un violento conflicto con los territorios circundantes de la Horda. Construida según los diseños del arquitecto enano Haggis Boatmurder, la Fortaleza de Bael'dun sirve como el corazón militar fortificado de la presencia de Forjaz en el sur de Los Baldíos. Elevándose sobre las extensas trincheras de excavación de Bael Modan, la fortaleza protege a los prospectores y arqueólogos que buscan antiguos artefactos de los titanes. Fuertemente armada con herrería y artillería, su guarnición mantiene una vigilancia constante, asegurando las líneas de suministro enanas y proyectando el poder marcial de la Alianza directamente en el corazón de Kalimdor.

ang.faction:Alliance: This keep is your primary military toehold in the southern Barrens, guarding the vital discoveries of the Explorers' League against hostile Horde forces.
ang.race:Tauren: Bael'dun Keep stands on sacred grounds stolen from the Stonespire tribe, serving as an insulting reminder of Alliance encroachment on your homeland.

faq.a: The fortress is garrisoned by dwarven soldiers answering to the Alliance and the Explorers' League of Ironforge, led by the steadfast commander General Twinbraid.
faq.q: Who controls Bael'dun Keep?

faq.a: It was established to defend Bael Modan, a massive archaeological expedition digging for titan relics and ancient dwarven origins in Kalimdor.
al: why are dwarves in the barrens
faq.q: Why is Bael'dun Keep built in the southern Barrens?

faq.a: The excavation and fortress displaced the native Stonespire tauren from their ancestral grounds. Survivors like Gann Stonespire seek vengeance and the destruction of the dwarven invaders.
faq.q: Why are the local tauren attacking Bael'dun Keep?

faq.a: Dwarven architectural records indicate the fortress was designed and constructed by Haggis Boatmurder.
faq.q: Who was the architect of the fortress?

text.s: Bael'dun Keep is an imposing dwarven fortification overlooking the Bael Modan excavation in the southern Barrens. Under the command of General Twinbraid, this fortress anchors the Alliance's controversial presence in the region, bringing them into violent conflict with the surrounding Horde territories.

sec.b: Constructed according to designs by the dwarven architect Haggis Boatmurder, Bael'dun Keep serves as the fortified military heart of the Ironforge presence in the southern Barrens. Towering over the expansive excavation trenches of Bael Modan, the fortress protects the Prospectors and archaeologists searching for ancient titan artifacts. Heavily armed with ironworks and artillery, its garrison maintains a vigilant watch, securing dwarven supply lines and projecting Alliance martial power straight into Kalimdor's heartland.

The construction of Bael'dun Keep and the adjoining digsite did not come peacefully; it displaced the local Stonespire tribe of tauren from their ancestral home. Now, Bael'dun sits as a simmering flashpoint in the Barrens. Nearby Horde outposts view the fortress as a flagrant military intrusion, while Gann Stonespire wages a personal war of vengeance against the invaders. Between aggrieved tauren, opportunistic scouts, and suspicious outposts like Camp Taurajo, the keep is constantly under threat of raid and sabotage.

subzone:bael-modan.s: Bael Modan. Bael Modan es un puesto de avanzada enano fortificado y una excavación arqueológica situada en el sur de Los Baldíos. Establecida por excavadores enanos que buscan antiguas reliquias de los titanes, esta instalación fuertemente armada ha desatado un amargo conflicto al desplazar a los tauren Picopiedra indígenas. Bael Modan se compone de la fortificada Fortaleza de Bael'dun, un despliegue de enormes cañones de asedio, pistas de aterrizaje para girocópteros y una profunda fosa de excavación a cielo abierto. Los prospectores enanos llegaron a Kalimdor convencidos de que una antigua instalación de los titanes yace sepultada bajo la tierra roja. Sin embargo, sus voladuras atravesaron directamente tierras sagradas pertenecientes a los tauren Picopiedra. En lugar de negociar, la expedición enana expulsó a los Picopiedra de sus tierras ancestrales a base de disparos y explosivos, dejando a los miembros supervivientes de la tribu dispersos y sedientos de venganza.

ang.race:Dwarf: The dig site represents the Explorers' League's relentless drive to uncover Titan history, though its commanders' heavy-handed tactics have earned the fierce enmity of the local tribes.
ang.race:Tauren: Bael Modan stands as an open wound in the Barrens, built atop the ruins of the Stonespire tribe's sacred grounds. Helping Gann Stonespire extract vengeance is a matter of tribal honor.

faq.a: The dwarves are searching for ancient Titan structures and relics buried beneath Kalimdor. Their excavations are part of a broader expedition to uncover the origins of their race, which they believe are linked to buried Titan research facilities.
faq.q: Why are dwarves digging in the Barrens?

faq.a: The land originally belonged to the Stonespire tribe, who considered the hills holy ground. When the dwarves arrived, they used explosives to blast open the dig site, slaughtering or driving away the resident tauren and destroying their village.
faq.q: What happened to the tauren who used to live here?

faq.a: Gann Stonespire is one of the few surviving members of the Stonespire tribe. After attempts at a peaceful resolution failed, he camps near the road outside Bael Modan and enlists Horde travelers to sabotage the dwarven flying machines and kill the officers responsible for destroying his people's home.
faq.q: Who is Gann Stonespire?

faq.a: The Tear of the Moons is a mysterious artifact unearthed by the excavators. It drives mortals who handle it mad, and it has left the exiled dwarf Feegly obsessed with reclaiming it.
faq.q: What is the Tear of the Moons?

text.s: Bael Modan is a fortified dwarven outpost and archaeological dig site located in the southern Barrens. Established by dwarven excavators searching for ancient Titan relics, the heavily armed installation has ignited a bitter conflict by displacing the indigenous Stonespire tauren.

sec.b: Bael Modan consists of the fortified Bael'dun Keep, an array of massive siege cannons, gyrocopter landing pads, and a deep open excavation pit. Dwarven prospectors arrived in Kalimdor under the conviction that an ancient Titan facility rests buried beneath the red earth. However, their blasting operations ripped directly through sacred ground belonging to the Stonespire tauren. Rather than negotiating, the dwarven expedition drove the Stonespire off their ancestral lands with gunfire and explosives, leaving the surviving tribesmen scattered and vengeful.

The excavation has unearthed far more than historical stonework. Dwarven diggers recently uncovered an artifact known as the Tear of the Moons, a relic that induced paranoia and madness in those near it. One banished prospector, Feegly the Exiled, succumbed entirely to its influence, only to be twisted into a trogg the moment the stone returned to his grasp. Between deadly relics and the enraged tauren seeking retribution outside the gates, the dwarven camp stands under constant peril.

subzone:balnir-farmstead.s: Hacienda Balnir. La Hacienda Balnir es una finca abandonada en el este de Claros de Tirisfal, al noreste de las Ruinas de Lordaeron. Antaño célebre por criar a los afamados caballos blancos predilectos de la familia real de Lordaeron, estas tierras yacen ahora arruinadas e infestadas de miembros errantes de la Plaga. En la actualidad, la hacienda se alza como un sombrío monumento a los primeros años de vida del príncipe Arthas Menethil y el lugar donde reclamó a su corcel no-muerto. Durante generaciones, la familia Balnir crio a los legendarios sementales blancos de Lordaeron desde su propiedad en las onduladas colinas de Tirisfal. Siendo un niño, el príncipe Arthas Menethil visitaba a menudo la granja para escapar de la vida en la corte real, entablando amistad con el joven Jarim Balnir. Fue aquí donde Arthas presenció y ayudó en el parto del potro al que bautizó como Invencible. Años más tarde, después de que un trágico accidente de equitación acabara con la vida del corcel, Invencible recibió sepultura en las tierras de la hacienda a petición personal de Arthas.

ang.class:Mage: Forsaken magi are dispatched to these blighted grounds to gather surviving Balnir snapdragons, studying them to detect the lingering magical taint of the Scourge.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, the farmstead is a bitter reminder of the prince who doomed Lordaeron, as well as a nagging security breach where Scourge from the Plaguelands slip behind the Bulwark.

faq.a: Arthas spent much of his youth sneaking away to the farmstead to play with the breeder's son. He was present for the birth of his beloved horse, Invincible, and later buried the beast here after a fatal fall. Following his descent into darkness, Arthas returned to exhume and raise Invincible into undeath.
faq.q: Why is the Balnir Farmstead significant to Prince Arthas?

faq.a: The farm was managed by Jorum Balnir, his wife Vara, and their son Jarim. They were master horse breeders who raised prized white horses for Lordaeron's nobility. The entire family was slaughtered when Arthas's Scourge swept through Tirisfal during the Third War.
faq.q: Who lived at the farmstead before the plague?

faq.a: Mindless Scourge often slip past the Bulwark from the Plaguelands and gather at the farmstead, threatening the eastern approaches to Tirisfal. Additionally, Undercity scholars study the resilient snapdragons still growing in the gardens to measure the spread of plague contamination.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken monitoring the farm now?

faq.a: After Invincible died in a riding accident, Arthas asked that his beloved horse be buried on the farmstead's grounds. After returning as a death knight during the Third War, Arthas raised Invincible into undeath.
faq.q: Why was Invincible buried at Balnir Farmstead?

text.s: The Balnir Farmstead is a derelict estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades, northeast of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Once renowned for raising the famed white horses favored by Lordaeron's royal family, the lands now lie ruined and infested by wandering Scourge. Today, the estate stands as a somber monument to Prince Arthas Menethil's early life and the site where he claimed his undead steed.

sec.b: For generations, the Balnir family bred the legendary white stallions of Lordaeron from their homestead in the rolling hills of Tirisfal. As a boy, Prince Arthas Menethil frequently visited the farm to escape royal court life, befriending the young Jarim Balnir. It was here that Arthas assisted in the foaling of the colt he named Invincible. Years later, after a tragic riding accident claimed the steed's life, Invincible was laid to rest in the soil of the farmstead upon Arthas's personal request.

When Prince Arthas returned from Northrend and sacked Capital City, the Scourge wiped out the Balnir family without mercy. Newly fallen as a death knight, Arthas marched to the farmstead to exhume and resurrect Invincible with Frostmourne, leaving behind an open, ransacked grave. In the wake of the Third War, the ruins serve as a foothold for mindless Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. Forsaken deathguards watch the farm warily, while Undercity magi harvest surviving snapdragons from the garden to test how deeply plague corruption has crept into the soil.

subzone:ban-ethil-barrow-den.s: Túmulo de Ben'ethil. El Túmulo de Ben'ethil es un santuario subterráneo sagrado excavado en el interior de las raíces de Teldrassil. Creado originalmente como lugar de descanso para los durmientes Druidas de la Garfa, el complejo de cavernas ha caído recientemente en el caos. Los fúrbolgs corruptos de la tribu Tuercepinos han invadido sus cámaras, convirtiendo un lugar de pacífico letargo en una peligrosa guarida de locura. Los túmulos sirven como sagradas cámaras de descanso donde los druidas elfos de la noche duermen mientras proyectan sus espíritus hacia el Sueño Esmeralda. El Túmulo de Ben'ethil estaba dedicado específicamente a cobijar a los Druidas de la Garfa mientras comulgaban con la naturaleza. Dividido en cámaras subterráneas superiores e inferiores, el cubil antaño resonaba con una tranquila ensoñación y una profunda magia meditativa. Sin embargo, la aflicción que asola a la fauna de Teldrassil no perdonó a los fúrbolgs Tuercepinos, quienes invadieron el complejo y convirtieron sus salas excavadas en una madriguera fortificada.

ang.class:Druid: Ban'ethil represents sacred ground for the Cenarion Circle, specifically built to protect Druids of the Talon while communing with the Emerald Dream.
ang.race:NightElf: The occupation of Ban'ethil by corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs is an alarming sign of the growing sickness plaguing their new home of Teldrassil.

faq.a: Ban'ethil Barrow Den is a subterranean hollow in Teldrassil crafted by the night elves. It was designed to shelter sleeping Druids of the Talon while their spirits roamed the Emerald Dream.
faq.q: What is Ban'ethil Barrow Den?

faq.a: The Gnarlpine furbolgs have fallen victim to a spreading corruption affecting Teldrassil's creatures. Driven hostile and territorial, they invaded the barrow den, displacing the keepers and threatening the slumbering druids.
faq.q: Why are there furbolgs inside Ban'ethil Barrow Den?

faq.a: The cavern complex is split into two primary interconnected tiers: the Upper Den near the entrance passages and the Lower Den deeper in the subterranean roots.
faq.q: What are the sections of the barrow den?

faq.a: Barrow dens provide safe, secure physical shelter for druids who enter prolonged, deep slumbers to project their consciousness into the Emerald Dream, leaving their waking bodies helpless for years or decades.
al: why do druids sleep in barrows
faq.q: Why are barrow dens so important to druids?

text.s: Ban'ethil Barrow Den is a sacred subterranean sanctuary hollowed out within the roots of Teldrassil. Originally created as a resting place for the sleeping Druids of the Talon, the cavern complex has recently fallen into chaos. The corrupted furbolgs of the Gnarlpine tribe have overrun its chambers, turning a place of peaceful slumber into a perilous den of madness.

sec.b: Barrow dens serve as sacred resting chambers where night elf druids slumber while projecting their spirits into the Emerald Dream. Ban'ethil Barrow Den was dedicated specifically to sheltering the Druids of the Talon as they communed with nature. Divided into upper and lower subterranean chambers, the den once resonated with tranquil reverie and deep meditative magic. However, the affliction sweeping Teldrassil's wildlife did not spare the Gnarlpine furbolgs, who invaded the complex, turning its hollowed halls into a fortified warren.

Driven mad by mysterious corruption taking root across the World Tree, the Gnarlpine tribe drove out or endangered the slumbering druids within Ban'ethil. The furbolgs now fiercely guard the winding tunnels, aggressive toward any night elf who approaches. For the defenders of Teldrassil, reclaiming the barrow den is an urgent priority, not merely to drive back the hostile furbolgs, but to protect the vulnerable druids and sacred relics trapped within its lower depths.

subzone:ban-ethil-hollow.s: Hondonada Ban'ethil. La Hondonada Ban'ethil es un barranco escarpado que se adentra en el bosque justo al sur del camino principal que conecta Dolanaar y Darnassus. Se ha convertido en un peligroso refugio para fúrbolgs corruptos y agresivos que representan una amenaza constante para los viajeros. Escondida en el fondo del barranco se encuentra la entrada al Túmulo de Ben'ethil. Situada junto al camino entre Dolanaar y Darnassus, la Hondonada Ban'ethil es un crudo recordatorio de que las ramas de Teldrassil no son del todo seguras. Los fúrbolgs enloquecidos por la extraña aflicción que asola el Árbol del Mundo se han refugiado por todo el descenso rocoso. Con frecuencia acechan el sendero cercano, esperando para emboscar a mensajeros incautos y centinelas errantes. En lo profundo del barranco se halla el umbral del Túmulo de Ben'ethil, donde druidas dormidos y túneles ancestrales se enfrentan a la invasión de las bestias enloquecidas del exterior.

ang.class:Druid: The hollow conceals the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den, sacred ground where druids traditionally rest to commune with the Emerald Dream, now endangered by rabid wildlife.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing the furbolgs fall to madness so close to the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus is a grim sign of Teldrassil's mounting sickness, requiring young sentinels and druids to step in.

faq.a: Ban'ethil Hollow is a ravine in central Teldrassil, located just south of the primary road running between the village of Dolanaar and the capital city of Darnassus.
faq.q: Where is Ban'ethil Hollow located?

faq.a: The furbolgs across Teldrassil have succumbed to a spreading corruption and madness that grips the World Tree's wildlife. Instead of living peacefully alongside the night elves as they historically have, these tribes have become fiercely territorial and violent.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?

faq.a: The Ban'ethil Barrow Den is an underground complex historically used by night elven druids to enter deep hibernation and commune with the Emerald Dream. However, with corruption rising in the hollow, the den has become dangerous ground.
al: what is in the barrow den
faq.q: What is inside the Ban'ethil Barrow Den at the back of the hollow?

faq.a: The main road is generally patrolled by night elf sentinels, but furbolgs from Ban'ethil Hollow often venture up from the ravine to ambush travelers. Travelers making the journey between Dolanaar and Darnassus should remain on their guard.
faq.q: Is the road above the hollow safe to travel?

text.s: Ban'ethil Hollow is a rugged ravine cutting into the woodland just south of the main road connecting Dolanaar and Darnassus. It has become a dangerous haven for corrupted, aggressive furbolgs who pose a constant threat to travelers. Tucked away in the back of the ravine lies the entrance to the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sec.b: Situated off the highway between Dolanaar and Darnassus, Ban'ethil Hollow is a sharp reminder that the boughs of Teldrassil are not entirely safe. Furbolgs driven mad by the strange affliction plaguing the World Tree have taken refuge throughout the rocky descent. They frequently stalk the nearby path, waiting to ambush unwary couriers and wandering sentinels. Deep within the ravine sits the threshold of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where slumbering druids and ancient tunnels face encroachment from the maddened beasts outside.

subzone:baradin-bay.s: Bahía de Baradin. La Bahía de Baradin es la extensa masa de agua situada entre las costas de Khaz Modan, los Humedales, las Tierras Altas de Arathi y el sur de Lordaeron. Antaño patrullada intensamente por la poderosa armada de Kul Tiras durante la Segunda Guerra, sus aguas ocultan ahora arrecifes traicioneros, buques de guerra hundidos y depredadores acuáticos hostiles. Enmarcada por las costas de Dun Morogh al sur y Lordaeron al norte, la Bahía de Baradin sirve como un paso marítimo vital que conecta los puertos de los Reinos del Este. La bahía cuenta con puertos de gran actividad como Puerto de Menethil en los Humedales y Costasur en las Laderas de Trabalomas. Sin embargo, navegar por estas aguas es peligroso: los bancos de arena poco profundos, los escollos escarpados y una fauna peligrosa compuesta por múrlocs, crocoliscos y tiburones de aguas profundas suponen una amenaza constante tanto para marineros como para viajeros.

ang.faction:Alliance: Baradin Bay serves as the maritime lifeline connecting Alliance operations in Khaz Modan with their outposts in Arathi and Hillsbrad, though naval hazards and sunken wreckage make every crossing risky.
ang.race:Human: For humans, especially those tracing lineage back to Kul Tiras or Lordaeron, the bay is hallowed and somber ground holding the watery graves of Second War sailors.

faq.a: The most prominent settlements on the bay's coast are Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands and Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills, which sustain vital naval transit across the sea.
faq.q: What major ports are located along Baradin Bay?

faq.a: Many of the wrecks, including the Lost Fleet along the Wetlands shore and those resting on Drowned Reef, were ships of the Kul Tiras navy sunk during intense naval clashes in the Second War.
faq.q: Why are there so many shipwrecks along the bay's coast?

faq.a: The shallows are crawling with aggressive murlocs and swamp crocolisks, while the deeper waters are infested with predatory crabs, sharks, and the restless spirits of drowned sailors.
al: is it safe to swim in baradin bay
faq.q: What threats can be found in the waters of Baradin Bay?

faq.a: Baradin Bay is enclosed by northwestern Dun Morogh, the marshy shores of the Wetlands, the cliffs of the Arathi Highlands, and the coasts of southern Hillsbrad and Gilneas.
faq.q: Which territories border Baradin Bay?

text.s: Baradin Bay is the expansive body of water lying between the shores of Khaz Modan, the Wetlands, the Arathi Highlands, and southern Lordaeron. Once vigorously patrolled by the powerful navy of Kul Tiras during the Second War, its waters now conceal treacherous reefs, sunken warships, and hostile aquatic predators.

sec.b: Framed by the coasts of Dun Morogh to the south and Lordaeron to the north, Baradin Bay serves as a vital maritime passage connecting the harbors of the Eastern Kingdoms. The bay is anchored by busy ports like Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands and Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. However, navigating these waters is perilous: shallow sandbanks, jagged shoals, and dangerous fauna like murlocs, crocolisks, and deep-sea sharks pose constant threats to sailors and travelers alike.

During the Second War, Baradin Bay witnessed heavy naval conflict as the fleets of Kul Tiras clashed with the Horde. Today, grim reminders of those battles litter the coast and the seabed. The shattered hulls of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet—known locally as the Lost Fleet—rest half-submerged along the Wetlands coast, while other vessels have plummeted down to Drowned Reef. Hostile spirits, opportunistic salvagers, and ravenous sea beasts now haunt the waters surrounding these decaying timber ruins.

subzone:bathran-s-haunt.s: Ruinas de Bathran. Ruinas de Bathran es una antigua ruina kaldorei ubicada en el noroeste de Vallefresno, al este de La Ensenada de Zoram. Recientemente, herboristas Renegados y sus guardianes se han apoderado del lugar para recolectar la flora local para sus investigaciones alquímicas, marchitando progresivamente el bosque circundante. Al norte de Las Ruinas de Ordil'Aran, pilares derruidos de elfos de la noche se yerguen engullidos por el espeso follaje de Vallefresno. Lo que otrora fue una tranquila reliquia kaldorei ha caído bajo la sombra de los Renegados. Merodeando entre el mármol roto, herboristas no-muertos y sus ejecutores han establecido un rudimentario laboratorio al aire libre. Su sola presencia corrompe el suelo ancestral: la hierba se pudre adoptando un tono pardo enfermizo, las flores vibrantes se marchitan y una descomposición antinatural avanza por la arboleda mientras recolectan metódicamente reactivos raros del bosque para sus experimentos.

ang.profession:Herbalism: The ruins are botanically unique as the only known habitat for Bathran's Hair, an herb sought after for its rare remedial properties.
ang.race:NightElf: The Forsaken encampment at Bathran's Haunt is an outrage to kaldorei heritage, where undead intruders defile ancient elven stonework and blight the sacred soil.

faq.a: Bathran's Haunt sits in northwestern Ashenvale, positioned directly north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran and inland to the east of the Zoram Strand.
al: how to get to bathrans haunt
faq.q: Where is Bathran's Haunt located?

faq.a: Forsaken herbalists have established an encampment and laboratory among the ruins to gather and study the unique botanical life of the forest, most notably a rare remedial plant known as Bathran's Hair.
al: what are undead doing in ashenvale
why are forsaken at bathrans haunt
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken here?

faq.a: Bathran's Hair is a distinctive, valuable herb with potent restorative qualities that grows exclusively around the crumbling stonework of Bathran's Haunt.
faq.q: What is Bathran's Hair?

faq.a: The prolonged presence and alchemical activities of the Forsaken have corrupted the immediate area, causing the grass to wither brown and delicate woodland flowers to die.
faq.q: Why is the ground dying around the ruins?

text.s: Bathran's Haunt is an ancient kaldorei ruin nestled in northwestern Ashenvale, east of the Zoram Strand. Recently, Forsaken herbalists and their guardians have overtaken the site to harvest local flora for their alchemical research, steadily withering the surrounding woodland.

sec.b: North of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran, crumbling night elf pillars stand swallowed by thick Ashenvale foliage. What was once a tranquil kaldorei relic has fallen under the shadow of the Forsaken. Skulking among the broken marble, undead herbalists and their enforcers have set up a crude open-air laboratory. Their presence alone blights the ancient soil: grass rots into a sickly brown, vibrant blossoms wilt, and an unnatural decay creeps through the grove as they methodically harvest rare woodland reagents for their experiments.
sec.t: A Blighted Refuge in the Ancient Woods

sec.b: The primary draw of these ruins is Bathran's Hair, a unique remedial herb found taking root only among these particular stones. While night elf and Alliance scouts view the Forsaken presence as a vile desecration of sacred elven soil, the undead work diligently to extract the plant's potent properties. The Horde maintains a vested interest in the compound's botanical yield, though the Forsaken's secretive methods and the resulting corruption of the earth draw suspicion from outsiders and allies alike.

subzone:beggar-s-haunt.s: Refugio de los Mendigos. El Refugio de los Mendigos es una torre de vigilancia de Ventormenta abandonada, encaramada en una ladera del noreste del Bosque del Ocaso, cerca del camino de montaña hacia el Paso de la Muerte. Aunque en un principio se construyó para vigilar las fronteras orientales del reino, se ha convertido en un puesto de avanzada para infiltrados Renegados en pleno territorio de la Alianza. Encaramado sobre las brumosas colinas al este de la Mansión Mantoniebla, el Refugio de los Mendigos fue antaño un puesto de observación activo custodiado por la Guardia de Ventormenta para proteger los accesos orientales al reino. A medida que Grand Hamlet sucumbía a la penumbra del actual Bosque del Ocaso y las patrullas del reino se replegaban a Villa Oscura, la torre de piedra quedó abandonada a merced de los elementos. Hoy en día, su posición estratégica y dominante sirve a un propósito mucho más siniestro: agentes de los Renegados, entre ellos miembros de la Sociedad Real de Boticarios y Mortacechadores, utilizan la fortaleza en ruinas para investigar y vigilar la región en las mismas narices de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Alliance: The presence of Forsaken agents stationed inside an old Stormwind scout tower just off the main road is an alarming sign of Horde infiltration right on Darkshire's doorstep.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken operatives, this secluded outpost offers a rare and dangerous foothold deep within the human lands of the south.

faq.a: Agents from the Undercity, including Apothecary Faustin of the Royal Apothecary Society and Deathstalker Zraedus, have claimed the abandoned watchtower. From here, they can monitor Alliance movements and quietly carry out experiments far to the south.
faq.q: Why are there Forsaken at Beggar's Haunt?

faq.a: No. The tower was constructed as a scout outpost by the kingdom of Stormwind. When local defenses faltered and the region deteriorated into Duskwood, the Stormwind Guard abandoned it, leaving it empty until Forsaken scouts seized it.
faq.q: Was this tower originally built by the Forsaken?

faq.a: Down the path behind the haunt lies Knight's Hollow, a secluded waterfall pool featuring an unmarked grave framed by hooded guardian statues identical in style to the monuments flanking the Dark Portal.
faq.q: What is the strange grave behind the tower?

faq.a: Yes. The Forsaken stationed at the tower are seasoned agents who will strike down any Alliance adventurers that wander too close to their hillside redoubt.
faq.q: Is Beggar's Haunt hostile to Alliance travelers?

text.s: Beggar's Haunt is an abandoned Stormwind scout tower perched on a hillside in northeastern Duskwood, near the mountain road to Deadwind Pass. While originally built to keep watch over the kingdom's eastern borders, it has become an outpost for Forsaken infiltrators deep within Alliance territory.

sec.b: Perched above the foggy hills east of Manor Mistmantle, Beggar's Haunt was once an active observation post manned by the Stormwind Guard to secure the eastern approaches to the realm. As Grand Hamlet collapsed into the gloom of modern Duskwood and kingdom patrols withdrew to Darkshire, the stone tower was abandoned to the elements. Today, its commanding vantage point serves a far more sinister purpose: agents of the Forsaken, including members of the Royal Apothecary Society and Deathstalkers, use the ruined stronghold to conduct research and monitor the region under the Alliance's nose.

Behind the tower, a steep, twisting path descends to a secluded pool and waterfall known as Knight's Hollow. Here lies an unmarked grave flanked by two ominous hooded stone statues resembling the guardians flanking the Dark Portal. Nearby resting plots, including the burial site of an Unknown Soldier, speak to forgotten clashes fought along this frontier long before the Forsaken moved into the watchtower.
sec.t: Knight's Hollow and the Forgotten Dead

subzone:beren-s-peril.s: El Desafío de Beren. El Desafío de Beren es una apartada caverna montañosa oculta en las colinas rocosas al suroeste de Molino Ámbar, en el Bosque de Argénteos. Sirve como reducto atrincherado para leales renegados de la Plaga que sirven al nigromante Thule Corvozarpa, conspirando contra los Renegados cercanos. Oculto en lo alto de los riscos al suroeste de Molino Ámbar, El Desafío de Beren consta de una sombría cueva y un serpenteante sendero de montaña escondidos de la calzada principal. Tras la devastación de la Tercera Guerra, no-muertos renegados de la Plaga bajo el mando del nigromante rebelde Thule Corvozarpa fortificaron este enclave. En lugar de someterse a la Dama Oscura o retirarse al norte, los siervos de Corvozarpa —regentes, guardianes y braceros— se reunieron aquí en secreto para preparar un asalto contra la base de los Renegados en El Sepulcro. Su presencia fue descubierta por exploradores renegados, convirtiendo el tranquilo acantilado en una zona de guerra activa para los operativos de la Horda enviados a eliminar la amenaza antes de que pudiera materializarse un ataque.

ang.faction:Horde: Securing the rugged paths of Silverpine Forest means clearing out rogue undead nests before they can sever supply lines between the Sepulcher and the southern territories.
ang.race:Undead: The Ravenclaw minions at Beren's Peril are a bitter reminder of the Scourge's lasting grip, threatening the safety of the Sepulcher and requiring swift, merciless eradication by Sylvanas's loyalists.

faq.a: It is a cave and surrounding hillside pass located southwest of Ambermill in Silverpine Forest, situated between the central highway and the Ambermill side road.
faq.q: What is Beren's Peril?

faq.a: The cave is occupied by Scourge undead loyal to the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, including Ravenclaw guardians, drudgers, and regents.
faq.q: Who controls Beren's Peril?

faq.a: Forsaken scouts discovered that the undead holed up inside Beren's Peril were amassing troops and arming for an impending assault on the Sepulcher, prompting Shadow Priest Allister to order preemptive strikes against them.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about this location?

faq.a: Thule Ravenclaw is a powerful necromancer operating in Silverpine Forest who maintained control over pockets of mindless and hostile Scourge minions, using sites like Beren's Peril and Fenris Keep to menace the region.
faq.q: Who is Thule Ravenclaw?

text.s: Beren's Peril is a secluded mountain cavern tucked in the rocky hills southwest of Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. It serves as an entrenched redoubt for rogue Scourge loyalists serving the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, plotting against the nearby Forsaken.

sec.b: Tucked away high in the crags southwest of Ambermill, Beren's Peril consists of a shadowed cave and winding mountain path hidden from the main roadway. Following the devastation of the Third War, rogue Scourge undead under the command of the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw fortified this enclave. Rather than bowing to the Dark Lady or retreating north, Ravenclaw's thralls—regents, guardians, and drudgers—gathered here in secret to muster an assault against the Forsaken base at the Sepulcher. Their presence was uncovered by Forsaken scouts, turning the quiet cliffside into an active warzone for Horde operatives sent to eliminate the threat before an attack could materialize.
sec.t: A Hidden Threat in the Hills

subzone:blackwolf-river.s: Río Lobonegro. El Río Lobonegro es un curso de agua que nace en el Lago del Peñasco y desciende a través del Risco Cortaviento en Sierra Espolón. Antaño un arroyo de montaña limpio, sus aguas han acabado totalmente contaminadas por la agresiva tala y las operaciones industriales de Ventura y Cía. Al descender del Lago del Peñasco, el Río Lobonegro atraviesa la cuenca del Risco Cortaviento. Lo que debería ser un afluente alpino prístino ha sufrido en su lugar el impacto de la desenfrenada iniciativa goblin. A medida que Ventura y Cía. tala los bosques circundantes con maquinaria pesada y sierras circulares, lodos, petróleo y residuos de la tala se filtran de forma constante en la corriente. El río despojado se erige como un claro ejemplo del expolio comercial que amenaza las tierras salvajes de Sierra Espolón.

ang.class:Druid: The desecration of Blackwolf River by goblin timber operations is a sharp affront to the Cenarion Circle and all who revere the untamed waters of Kalimdor.
ang.race:Tauren: Seeing the earth scarred and the waters fouled by profit-driven interlopers reinforces the tauren resolve to cleanse Stonetalon of reckless industrial blight.

faq.a: The river flows down out of Cragpool Lake in the upper reaches of the mountains and winds through the logged basin of Windshear Crag.
faq.q: Where does the Blackwolf River start and lead?

faq.a: The Venture Company operates massive deforestation and mechanical logging rigs throughout Windshear Crag. Runoff from their steam machinery, waste, and clear-cutting drains directly into the watercourse.
faq.q: Why is the river water polluted?

faq.a: The Venture Company dominates the riverbank, utilizing the surrounding valley for heavy lumber harvesting and mechanical operations despite resistance from local wildlife and native inhabitants.
faq.q: Who is currently operating along the river?

text.s: Blackwolf River is a waterway flowing out of Cragpool Lake down through Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a clean mountain stream, its waters have become thoroughly polluted by the Venture Company's aggressive logging and industrial operations.

sec.b: Descending from Cragpool Lake, the Blackwolf River cuts across the basin of Windshear Crag. What should be a pristine alpine tributary has instead borne the brunt of unchecked goblin enterprise. As the Venture Company clears the surrounding woodlands with heavy machinery and buzzsaws, sludge, oil, and logging waste leach steadily into the current. The despoiled river stands as a vivid example of the commercial plunder threatening Stonetalon's wilderness.

subzone:blackwood-den.s: Cubil del Bosque Negro. El Cubil del Bosque Negro es un campamento de fúrbolgs corrompidos situado en los confines meridionales de Costa Oscura, cerca de la frontera con Vallefresno. La cueva y los campamentos circundantes, que antaño fueron un asentamiento pacífico, han sucumbido a la locura junto al resto de la tribu Bosque Negro. Un solitario explorador elfo de la noche llamado Volcor se encuentra atrapado en el interior de la caverna, a la espera de recibir ayuda desde Auberdine. Situado cerca de la frontera sur, donde Costa Oscura se une con Vallefresno, el Cubil del Bosque Negro está formado por una serpenteante red de toscos campamentos y una cueva rocosa. Los fúrbolgs Bosque Negro que moran aquí han sucumbido a la omnipresente corrupción que azota la región, volviéndose violentamente hostiles hacia los forasteros. En las profundidades de la cueva del cubil, el elfo de la noche Volcor permanece acorralado y en peligro por culpa de la agresiva tribu, necesitando con desesperación la ayuda de exploradores y viajeros enviados desde Auberdine.

ang.class:Druid: Druids mourn the fall of the furbolgs, who were once steadfast protectors of the wilderness, and view the madness at Blackwood Den as another painful symptom of Kalimdor's tainted nature.
ang.race:NightElf: For the night elves of Auberdine, the loss of the Blackwood tribe to corruption is a tragic development, and rescuing Volcor from their clutches is an urgent duty to keep their people safe along the southern road.

faq.a: Blackwood Den is a furbolg settlement and cave complex located in far southern Darkshore, close to the border of Ashenvale. It serves as a base for the corrupted Blackwood furbolg tribe.
faq.q: What is Blackwood Den?

faq.a: Inside the cave sits Volcor, a night elf who has become trapped behind enemy lines. Travelers who encounter him must coordinate with allies in Auberdine to stage an escape and guide him safely out of the den.
al: who is trapped in the cave
faq.q: Who is inside the cave at Blackwood Den?

faq.a: The Blackwood furbolgs have fallen victim to the dark corruption spreading across Darkshore and Kalimdor following the Third War. The affliction has driven them into a maddened frenzy, causing them to attack any outsiders on sight.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?

text.s: Blackwood Den is a corrupted furbolg encampment nestled in the southern reaches of Darkshore near the border of Ashenvale. Once a peaceful dwelling, the cave and surrounding camps have fallen into madness alongside the rest of the Blackwood tribe. A lone night elf scout named Volcor sits trapped within the cavern, awaiting aid from Auberdine.

sec.b: Situated near the southern border where Darkshore meets Ashenvale, Blackwood Den consists of a winding network of crude camps and a rocky cave. The Blackwood furbolgs who dwell here have succumbed to the pervasive corruption gripping the region, turning violently hostile toward outsiders. Deep inside the den's cave, the night elf Volcor remains pinned down and endangered by the aggressive tribe, desperately needing assistance from scouts and travelers dispatched from Auberdine.

subzone:bladefist-bay.s: Bahía de Garrafilada. La Bahía de Garrafilada es el escarpado tramo de costa que bordea el este de Durotar, justo a las puertas de Orgrimmar. Bautizada en honor a Kargath Garrafilada, la bahía sirve como un puerto natural frente al Mare Magnum, a la sombra de riscos escarpados y de las cercanas costas meridionales de Azshara. Extendiéndose a lo largo del extremo nororiental de Durotar, la Bahía de Garrafilada se abre directamente a las vastas aguas del Mare Magnum. Flanqueada por acantilados rocosos y un oleaje traicionero, funciona como un umbral marítimo primordial para la capital de la Horda, Orgrimmar. Las mareas depositan con frecuencia madera flotante, desperdicios marinos y restos de naufragios en la costa, lo que le ha valido entre los lugareños la reputación de ser un punto de recolección natural de restos oceánicos. Directamente al norte, los antiguos acantilados rojos y las ruinas de Azshara se alzan al otro lado del agua, convirtiendo a la bahía en una frontera marítima vital para Durotar.

ang.class:Rogue: The Shattered Hand operates within Orgrimmar's shadows as the Horde's guild of thieves and assassins, giving this coast quiet resonance for covert operatives.
ang.race:Orc: The bay bears the proud and brutal name of Kargath Bladefist, serving as a reminder of the trials of the Shattered Hand clan on Draenor.

faq.a: The bay is named after Kargath Bladefist, the legendary chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan known for replacing his severed hand with a lethal scythe blade.
faq.q: Who is Bladefist Bay named after?

faq.a: It lies along the northeastern coast of Durotar, directly east of Orgrimmar's main gates and south across the water from Azshara.
al: how to get to bladefist bay
faq.q: Where is Bladefist Bay located?

faq.a: The shoreline is situated right beside Skull Rock, a cavern infamous for harboring warlocks, demons, and members of the sinister Burning Blade cult.
faq.q: What threats lurk around Bladefist Bay?

faq.a: Ocean currents from the Great Sea routinely sweep sea detritus, wreckage, and rubble straight onto its shores, giving it a reputation as a dumping ground for the sea's refuse.
faq.q: Why is the bay sometimes called a midden heap?

text.s: Bladefist Bay is the rugged stretch of coast lining eastern Durotar just outside the gates of Orgrimmar. Named in honor of Kargath Bladefist, the bay serves as a natural harbor facing the Great Sea, shadowed by craggy bluffs and the nearby southern shores of Azshara.

sec.b: Stretching along the northeastern edge of Durotar, Bladefist Bay opens directly into the vast waters of the Great Sea. Flanked by rocky cliffs and treacherous surf, it functions as a primary maritime threshold for the Horde capital of Orgrimmar. The tides frequently deposit driftwood, ocean refuse, and flotsam onto the coastline, earning it a reputation among locals as a natural collection point for ocean debris. Directly north, the ancient red cliffs and ruins of Azshara loom across the water, making the bay a vital maritime boundary for Durotar.
sec.t: A Harbor on the Great Sea

sec.b: The bay honors Kargath Bladefist, the famed chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan who severed his own hand to replace it with a blade during the old Horde's trials on Draenor. The proximity of the bay to places like Skull Rock—where cultists and hidden rogue networks operate in the shadows—echoes the fierce and ruthless legacy of the clan whose chieftain gave the waters their name.

subzone:bloodhoof-village.s: Poblado Pezuña de Sangre. El Poblado Pezuña de Sangre es un asentamiento tauren central ubicado a orillas del Lago Toro de Piedra, en Mulgore.
