Bautizado en honor a la tribu Pezuña de Sangre, sirve como el primer gran núcleo de reunión para los jóvenes cazadores y bravos que viajan desde el Campamento Narache hacia Cima del Trueno. Dirigido por Baine Pezuña de Sangre, el poblado coordina la defensa local, el comercio y los ritos tradicionales por todas las llanuras. Situado en torno a las aguas cristalinas del Lago Toro de Piedra, el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre es un bullicioso centro de comercio, artesanía y ceremonias en el centro de Mulgore. Los jóvenes tauren que concluyen sus pruebas en el Campamento Narache llegan aquí para perfeccionar sus habilidades antes de aventurarse hacia las grandes mesetas de Cima del Trueno. También es muy conocido en todo Kalimdor por sus maestros constructores de tambores y por los pacientes criadores que domestican kodos salvajes para el transporte.

ang.faction:Horde: This peaceful settlement serves as a critical stopover and logistics link between the southern plains of Mulgore and the Horde capital at Thunder Bluff.
ang.race:Tauren: For young tauren, entering Bloodhoof Village marks the first real step beyond youth into broader tribal responsibility and spiritual maturity.

faq.a: Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, leads the settlement and directs its defenses against threats to the central plains.
al: who is in charge of bloodhoof village
faq.q: Who leads Bloodhoof Village?

faq.a: Spiritual advisors such as Zarlman Two-Moons guide young tauren through the traditional Rite of Vision, an essential spiritual journey on the path to adulthood.
faq.q: What major rites are conducted here?

faq.a: Bloodhoof Village is famed for its uniquely crafted ceremony drums and is the primary hub where wild plains kodos are tamed and trained as mounts.
faq.q: What is the settlement known for producing?

faq.a: Once their deeds in central Mulgore are complete, travelers are generally directed northward to Thunder Bluff, the capital city of the tauren.
faq.q: Where do travelers go after finishing their tasks here?

text.s: Bloodhoof Village is a central tauren settlement resting along the banks of Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. Named in honor of the Bloodhoof tribe, it serves as the first major gathering hub for young hunters and braves journeying out from Camp Narache toward Thunder Bluff. Led by Baine Bloodhoof, the village coordinates local defense, trade, and traditional rites across the plains.

sec.b: Situated around the clear waters of Stonebull Lake, Bloodhoof Village is a bustling center of commerce, craft, and ceremony in central Mulgore. Young tauren departing their trials at Camp Narache arrive here to hone their skills before venturing onward to the great mesas of Thunder Bluff. It is also well-known across Kalimdor for its master drum makers and the patient breeders who tame wild kodo beasts for travel.

Day-to-day governance and the defense of the region fall under Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Under his watchful eye, braves are dispatched to secure the grasslands against aggressive wildlife, quilboar encroachers, and the shadowy presence of the Venture Company. Alongside Baine, spiritual guides such as Zarlman Two-Moons tend to the inner life of the tribe, directing novices through sacred journeys like the Rite of Vision.

subzone:bloodtooth-camp.s: Asentamiento Sangradientes. El Asentamiento Sangradientes es un campamento de fúrbolgs hostiles y corruptos ubicado en el centro de Vallefresno, situado justo al oeste del Río Falfarren. Lideradas por el cabecilla Ran Sangradientes, estas criaturas que antaño eran pacíficas han sucumbido a una oscura locura y atacan a cualquiera que se acerque. El campamento es un objetivo prioritario para los exploradores de la Alianza que trabajan para purificar los bosques circundantes. Enclavado al suroeste del Pozo de la Luna meridional y al oeste del Río Falfarren, el Asentamiento Sangradientes sirve como un crudo recordatorio de la creciente decadencia de Vallefresno. Los fúrbolgs que viven aquí estuvieron una vez conectados con la naturaleza sagrada de Kalimdor, pero una persistente corrupción espiritual ha consumido a su tribu. Bajo el mando de Ran Sangradientes, custodian su tosco poblado con una hostilidad rabiosa, arremetiendo tanto contra viajeros como contra protectores elfos de la noche.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance adventurers, Bloodtooth Camp represents a localized hotspot of corruption that threatens the safety of Ashenvale's southern groves and moonwells.
ang.race:NightElf: Night elves view the maddened state of Ran Bloodtooth's tribe as a tragic symptom of the deep corruption blighting their ancient ancestral homeland.

faq.a: Bloodtooth Camp is situated in central Ashenvale, directly west of the Falfarren River and just southwest of the southern Moonwell.
faq.q: Where is Bloodtooth Camp located?

faq.a: Like many furbolg tribes across Ashenvale, the Bloodtooth clan has fallen victim to a dark demonic corruption lingering in the wilderness. It drives them into madness and boundless aggression toward all outsiders.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?

faq.a: The camp is ruled by Ran Bloodtooth, a fierce chieftain who commands the local furbolgs alongside his personal cadre of bodyguards.
faq.q: Who leads the furbolgs at Bloodtooth Camp?

faq.a: During the efforts surrounding Raene's Cleansing, the exiled furbolg Krolg directs Alliance champions to strike at the encampment, eliminate Ran Bloodtooth, and remove the threat his corrupted followers pose to the region.
faq.q: Why does the Alliance send scouts here?

text.s: Bloodtooth Camp is an encampment of hostile, corrupted furbolgs tucked into central Ashenvale, situated just west of the Falfarren River. Led by the chieftain Ran Bloodtooth, these once-peaceful creatures have succumbed to dark madness and attack anyone who approaches. The camp is a primary target for Alliance scouts working to cleanse the surrounding woodlands.

sec.b: Nestled southwest of the southern Moonwell and west of the Falfarren River, Bloodtooth Camp serves as a stark reminder of Ashenvale's encroaching decay. The furbolgs living here were once connected to the sacred wilderness of Kalimdor, but a lingering spiritual corruption has consumed their tribe. Under the command of Ran Bloodtooth, they guard their crude settlement with rabid hostility, turning upon travelers and night elven protectors alike.

Because Ran Bloodtooth's band poses an immediate danger to nearby sacred sites, Alliance sentinels and their allies cannot ignore the camp. As part of efforts to restore harmony to the forest—namely aiding Raene Wolfrunner's cleansing endeavors—adventurers are directed by Krolg to infiltrate the camp, cut down Ran Bloodtooth, and put an end to his ferocious bodyguards.

subzone:bough-shadow.s: Talloumbrío. Talloumbrío es una arboleda apartada escondida en el extremo noreste de Vallefresno, al este de Canción del Bosque. Se articula en torno a un colosal Gran Árbol cuyas raíces se asientan sobre un antiguo portal que conduce directamente a El Sueño Esmeralda. Talloumbrío alberga uno de los escasos Grandes Árboles nacidos a partir de un esqueje del Árbol del Mundo, Nordrassil. Plantado hace mucho tiempo por druidas seguidores de Fandral Corzocelada, sus raíces se hunden en las profundidades de la tierra alrededor de un cruce natural hacia El Sueño Esmeralda. En la actualidad, esta arboleda tranquila a la vez que imponente se halla fuertemente custodiada por el Vuelo del Dragón Verde. Dracos esmeralda como Phantim y Dreamstalker sobrevuelan las copas de los árboles, mientras que patrullas de dragonantes Emeraldon y oráculos montan una guardia atenta e inquebrantable sobre el arremolinado portal verde de su base, rechazando a cualquier mortal que ose acercarse sin ser invitado.

ang.class:Druid: Bough Shadow represents sacred ground for druids, housing one of the tangible thresholds linking Azeroth directly to the domain of the Green Flight and the Emerald Dream.
ang.race:NightElf: Lying deep beyond the ruins of Forest Song, this great tree was shaped by kaldorei hands from the branch of Nordrassil itself, standing as a living monument of ancient elven stewardship.

faq.a: The swirling vortex at the foot of the Great Tree is a direct gateway leading into the Emerald Dream, the untamed spirit realm of Azeroth. It is one of several such natural crossings scattered across the world.
al: what is the portal in bough shadow
faq.q: What is the glowing green portal here?

faq.a: Ysera's Green Dragonflight is charged with watching over the Emerald Dream and its direct passages into the physical world. Emerald drakes and dragonspawn patrol Bough Shadow to ensure no corrupting forces or intruders slip through the threshold.
al: why are there dragons in ashenvale
faq.q: Why are green dragons guarding Bough Shadow?

faq.a: The tree was planted millennia ago by night elf druids loyal to Fandral Staghelm, who used a cutting taken from the boughs of the World Tree, Nordrassil, to root over the site.
faq.q: Who planted the Great Tree here?

faq.a: No. The gateway remains tightly sealed to mortals in the physical world, and venturing too close will provoke the wrath of the surrounding elite dragonkin guards.
al: can i go through the portal
faq.q: Can players enter the portal?

text.s: Bough Shadow is a secluded grove tucked away in the far northeastern corner of Ashenvale, east of Forest Song. It centers around a colossal Great Tree rooted over an ancient portal leading directly into the Emerald Dream.

sec.b: Bough Shadow houses one of the rare Great Trees grown from a cutting of the World Tree, Nordrassil. Planted long ago by druids following Fandral Staghelm, its roots plunge deep into the earth around a natural crossing into the Emerald Dream. Today, the tranquil yet imposing grove is heavily guarded by the Green Dragonflight. Emerald drakes such as Phantim and Dreamstalker circle above the canopy, while patrols of Emeraldon dragonspawn and oracles keep a vigilant, unyielding watch over the swirling green portal at its base, turning away any mortal who approaches unbidden.

subzone:boulder-lode-mine.s: Mina Pedrusco. Mina Pedrusco es una agresiva excavación excavada en las colinas del noreste de Los Baldíos. Aunque los estandartes orcos y las torres de vigilancia sugieren que la Horda estableció primero el lugar, ahora está firmemente tomada y explotada por la despiadada Ventura y Cía. La presencia de arquitectura orca desgastada alrededor de la entrada de Mina Pedrusco indica que la Horda en su momento poseyó o fundó el yacimiento. Hoy en día, sin embargo, la zona está plagada de capataces y matones de Ventura y Cía. que trabajan bajo las órdenes de Boss Copperplug. La organización goblin explota a cielo abierto el cañón sin apenas consideración por el ecosistema local o sus trabajadores, motivado únicamente por la búsqueda de minerales valiosos, gemas de alto rendimiento y maquinaria industrial.

ang.faction:Horde: Seeing the Venture Company operating out of fortifications marked with Horde standards is an irritating reminder of how aggressively the goblin cartel encroaches on Kalimdor lands.
ang.profession:Mining: The deep excavation tunnels cut straight into the arid hills, revealing rich mineral veins that the Venture Company mercilessly strips.

faq.a: The mine is operated by the Venture Company under the immediate authority of Boss Copperplug, guarded by heavily armed corporate enforcers and labor overseers.
faq.q: Who controls Boulder Lode Mine?

faq.a: The surviving orcish woodwork, watchtowers, and weathered Horde banners strongly indicate that the Horde initially established or claimed the site before the Venture Company moved in and took control.
faq.q: Did the Horde originally own this mine?

faq.a: Dizzywig caught wind that a miner inside Boulder Lode dug up an unusually large and valuable emerald, and he hires cutthroat freelancers to infiltrate the tunnels and swipe it for a cut of the profits.
faq.q: Why is Wharfmaster Dizzywig interested in this place?

faq.a: Boss Copperplug possesses the essential operating manual for the mysterious samophlange machinery found nearby, and engineers in Ratchet send adventurers to recover the book and its scattered pages from his crew.
faq.q: What is Boss Copperplug's connection to the samophlange?

text.s: Boulder Lode Mine is an aggressive excavation cut into the hills of the northeastern Barrens. Though orcish banners and watchtowers suggest the Horde first established the site, it is now firmly seized and operated by the ruthless Venture Company.

sec.b: The presence of weathered orcish architecture around the mouth of Boulder Lode Mine indicates that the Horde once held or founded the claim. Today, however, the area crawls with Venture Company overseers and enforcers working under the direction of Boss Copperplug. The goblin syndicate strip-mines the canyon with little regard for the local ecosystem or their workers, driven purely by the search for valuable minerals, high-yield gems, and industrial machinery.

Word of the riches pulled from Boulder Lode Mine has reached outside ears in Ratchet. Wharfmaster Dizzywig has dispatched mercenaries to pocket a rumored massive emerald unearthed in its tunnels, while engineers seeking to understand complex goblin machinery know Boss Copperplug keeps key operational manuals hidden away within his camp.

subzone:boulderslide-cavern.s: Cueva del Alud. La Cueva del Alud es una madriguera subterránea escondida en el extremo más profundo del Barranco del Alud, en Sierra Espolón. Sirve como guarida principal y lugar de excavación para los kóbold Alud locales, que excavan túneles de forma obsesiva en busca de formaciones minerales brillantes. Los kóbold Alud han horadado las profundidades de los riscos de Sierra Espolón, estableciendo la Cueva del Alud como su fortaleza. A diferencia de las alimañas ordinarias que solo buscan cobijo, estos kóbold extraen frenéticamente resonita, un raro cristal morado brillante incrustado por toda la piedra. Los cristales pulsan con una magia terránea residual, lo que sume a las criaturas en un frenesí defensivo contra cualquier intruso que se acerque a su excavación.

ang.class:Shaman: The resonite crystals and the slumbering earthen Goggeroc both resonate with primordial earth magic, an echo of the world's ancient stone shapers.
ang.profession:Mining: The cavern is intensely worked by the Boulderslide clan, who tunnel relentlessly to uncover glowing veins of magical resonite.

faq.a: The kobolds are mining resonite, a rare purple crystal found embedded in the cavern's rock walls. The mineral hums with faint traces of earthen magic, making it a valuable prize and causing the kobolds to guard their caches fanatically.
faq.q: What are the kobolds mining here?

faq.a: Goggeroc is an ancient earthen who lies dormant within a resonite cask deep inside the cavern. The kobolds' excavation around his resting place risks disturbing his centuries-long slumber.
faq.q: Who is Goggeroc?

faq.a: The cavern entrance sits at the far end of Boulderslide Ravine, nestled in the craggy mountains of southern Stonetalon Mountains, just northeast of the path toward the Barrens.
faq.q: Where is Boulderslide Cavern located?

faq.a: The Horde keeps watch on the cavern to curb the aggressive kobold infestation spilling into the ravine, and out of interest in the magical properties of the resonite crystals they mine.
faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this cavern?

text.s: Boulderslide Cavern is a subterranean warren tucked at the deepest end of Boulderslide Ravine in the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as the primary den and excavation site for the local Boulderslide kobolds, who obsessively tunnel in search of glowing mineral formations.

sec.b: The Boulderslide kobolds have burrowed deep into the crags of Stonetalon, establishing Boulderslide Cavern as their stronghold. Unlike ordinary vermin merely seeking shelter, these kobolds mine frantically for resonite, a rare glowing purple crystal embedded throughout the stone. The crystals pulse with lingering earthen magic, driving the creatures into a defensive frenzy against any intruders who approach their dig.

Deeper inside the caverns, reckless excavation has breached ancient secrets. Embedded in the subterranean rock lies a resonite cask containing Goggeroc, a slumbering earthen from ages past. The kobolds' relentless digging around this mystical relic risks awakening a being imbued with primordial stone magic, posing a sudden danger to the entire ravine.

subzone:boulderslide-ravine.s: Barranco del Alud. El Barranco del Alud es un cañón escarpado y apartado escondido en los picos centrales de Sierra Espolón, al que se accede a través de la Senda de las Tejedoras. En gran medida a salvo de los enfrentamientos directos entre la Horda y la Alianza, sirve como aproximación rocosa a la Cueva del Alud y sigue siendo el hogar de bestias salvajes de la montaña. Escondido junto a la Senda de las Tejedoras, el Barranco del Alud es un estrecho corte en la roca en las alturas de Sierra Espolón. Mientras los leñadores, los elfos de la noche y la Horda luchan por la madera y los claros sagrados por toda la región, este paso risco permanece relativamente libre de fuerzas militares. Carneros salvajes de montaña y bestias de los riscos que merodean como los Cliff Stormers componen la fauna local, recorriendo las traicioneras cornisas y las escarpadas paredes de piedra. Los prospectores también vigilan el barranco, ya que con frecuencia afloran ricas vetas de mineral a lo largo de las laderas rocosas que conducen hacia la red de cavernas.

ang.profession:Mining: The steep rock walls of the ravine are a reliable place to spot mineral veins exposed by the mountain's shifting stone.
ang.race:Tauren: The faded art inside the small side cave bears the distinct touch of tauren tribal markers, hinting at ancestral paths through the Stonetalon heights.

faq.a: Boulderslide Ravine is located in the Stonetalon Mountains. It is reached by traveling along Webwinder Path into the higher crags.
al: how to get to boulderslide ravine
faq.q: Where is Boulderslide Ravine located?

faq.a: The ravine is mainly populated by local wildlife, particularly mountain rams and dangerous crag stalkers such as Cliff Stormers.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit Boulderslide Ravine?

faq.a: Facing the cavern entrance is a small alcove lit by torches and stocked with old barrels. Its stone walls display tribal pictographs that resemble traditional tauren art, pointing to past use by local wanderers or hunters.
faq.q: What is the abandoned cave across from Boulderslide Cavern?

faq.a: It serves as the natural approach to Boulderslide Cavern, a subterranean lair deep in the mountains, and offers valuable mineral outcroppings for travelers passing through.
faq.q: Why is Boulderslide Ravine significant?

text.s: Boulderslide Ravine is a rugged, secluded canyon tucked away in the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains, reached via Webwinder Path. Largely spared from the direct clashes between the Horde and Alliance, it serves as the rocky approach to Boulderslide Cavern and remains home to wild mountain beasts.

sec.b: Tucked away off Webwinder Path, Boulderslide Ravine is a narrow cut of rock in the Stonetalon heights. While loggers, night elves, and the Horde battle over timber and sacred glades throughout the region, this craggy pass remains relatively undisturbed by military forces. Wild mountain rams and roaming crag beasts like Cliff Stormers make up the local fauna, navigating the treacherous ledges and sheer stone walls. Prospectors also keep an eye on the ravine, as rich mineral veins frequently crop up along the rocky slopes leading deeper toward the cavern network.

Opposite the entrance to Boulderslide Cavern lies a small, quiet cave overlooking the ravine. Lit by rough torches and stacked with weathered supply barrels, the shelter contains primitive tribal paintings across its interior walls. The crude artwork bears a striking resemblance to ancient tauren designs, suggesting that native tribes traveled or sought temporary shelter in these crags long before modern conflict swept into the mountains.

subzone:brackwell-pumpkin-patch.s: Plantación de Calabazas de Brackwell. La Plantación de Calabazas de Brackwell es una granja invadida en el sureste del Bosque de Elwynn. Antaño hogar de la familia Brackwell, los campos y la cabaña han sido tomados por completo por la Hermandad Defias como escondite operativo. Sirve de punto de encuentro para pícaros conspiradores y base de operaciones para el contrabando de oro robado. Situada al sureste del hogar de los Stonefield, la granja de los Brackwell fue en su día una productiva parcela de labranza en Elwynn. Hoy en día, los legítimos propietarios han desaparecido sin dejar rastro, expulsados o algo peor a causa de la creciente marea criminal. En su ausencia, la Hermandad Defias se adueñó de la robusta cabaña y los campos abandonados de la granja. La zona funciona como refugio y puesto de transferencia, donde los forajidos se reagrupan lejos de la atenta mirada de las patrullas de Villadorada. Conspiradores de alto perfil como Morgan el Coleccionista utilizan la aislada parcela para recibir cargamentos de oro obtenido ilícitamente y sustraído de las minas del bosque.

ang.class:Warlock: The farm's shack shelters the fugitive apprentice Surena Caledon, whose stolen bloodstone choker is needed to bind a voidwalker.
ang.faction:Alliance: The overrun patch marks one of the easternmost operational bases of the Defias inside Elwynn, directly threatening nearby farms and trade routes.

faq.a: Their exact fate remains unknown. When the Defias Brotherhood expanded their presence throughout southeastern Elwynn Forest, the Brackwells were either forced to flee or killed, leaving their pumpkin fields and farmhouse to the bandits.
faq.q: What happened to the Brackwell family?

faq.a: The farm provides an out-of-the-way base close to the forest's borders. It allows the brotherhood to store plundered goods and coordinate smuggling operations, such as receiving shipments of stolen mine gold via couriers like Morgan the Collector, well away from the Stormwind Guard.
al: what are bandits doing at the pumpkin patch
faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood using this farm?

faq.a: Princess is an enormous, prize-winning pig originally raised by the Brackwells. Left behind when the farm fell, she has grown even larger by regularly breaking into the nearby Stonefield Farm to devour their prized crops.
al: why is there a huge boar here
faq.q: Who is Princess?

faq.a: Surena Caledon, an apprentice of the Stormwind warlock trainer Gakin the Darkbinder, stole a powerful bloodstone choker and fled to the farm to hide alongside her lover, the Defias bandit Erlan Drudgemoor. Gakin sends novice warlocks here to execute her and recover the relic.
faq.q: Why do warlocks come to the pumpkin patch?

text.s: Brackwell Pumpkin Patch is an overrun farmstead in southeastern Elwynn Forest. Once home to the Brackwell family, the fields and cottage have been thoroughly seized by the Defias Brotherhood as an operational hideout. It serves as a meeting point for rogue conspirators and a staging ground for smuggling stolen gold.

sec.b: Situated southeast of the Stonefield homestead, the Brackwell farm was once a productive patch of Elwynn farmland. Today, the rightful owners have vanished without a trace, driven out or worse by the rising criminal tide. In their absence, the Defias Brotherhood claimed the farm's sturdy cottage and overgrown fields. The area functions as a safehouse and transfer post, where brigands regroup away from the watchful eyes of Goldshire's patrols. High-profile conspirators like Morgan the Collector use the isolated patch to receive shipments of illicitly gathered gold skimmed from the forest's mines.

The Defias are not the only troublemakers prowling the pumpkin vines. The Brackwells left behind an enormous prize-winning sow named Princess, who roams the patch and constantly terrorizes neighboring fields. Meanwhile, the farmhouse attic and outbuildings shelter dangerous personal dealings: bandit Erlan Drudgemoor seduced Surena Caledon, a rogue warlock apprentice who fled her master in Stormwind with a stolen bloodstone artifact, bringing the attention of dark practitioners down upon the hideout.

subzone:brambleblade-ravine.s: Barranco Cortazarza. El Barranco Cortazarza es un cañón escarpado que se abre paso en el extremo nororiental de la Mesa de la Nube Roja. Sirve como guarida fortificada para la tribu de jabaespines Erizaclara, quienes asaltan persistentemente el cercano asentamiento tauren de Campamento Narache. Los jóvenes valientes tauren son enviados aquí para demostrar su fuerza y proteger su tierra natal de estos fieros intrusos. Esculpido en la tierra abrasada por el sol de la Mesa de la Nube Roja, el Barranco Cortazarza está repleto de densas zarzas espinosas y campamentos de jabaespines. La tribu Erizaclara utiliza esta fortaleza natural como base de operaciones para sus asaltos contra Campamento Narache, amenazando la seguridad de los jóvenes tauren que alcanzan la edad adulta. Los chamanes y guerreros Erizaclara, liderados por el jefe Cornapunta Mantospina, habitan en las profundidades del barranco entre jabatos de combate entrenados. Para los Shu'halo, adentrarse en el corazón del cañón es un rito de iniciación crucial y una sombría necesidad para asegurar las llanuras.

ang.faction:Horde: Clearing out the aggressive Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine helps solidify the Horde's early foothold across Mulgore.
ang.race:Tauren: For young tauren coming of age at Camp Narache, striking into Brambleblade Ravine is one of the very first tests of martial and spiritual endurance to defend the tribe.

faq.a: Brambleblade Ravine is a canyon situated on the northeastern edge of Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. It is heavily inhabited by Bristleback quilboar and serves as their local stronghold.
faq.q: What is Brambleblade Ravine?

faq.a: The Bristlebacks are fiercely territorial and view the presence of the tauren as an encroachment upon lands they claim. From Brambleblade Ravine, they launch frequent raids on the nearby settlement of Camp Narache.
faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar attacking from here?

faq.a: The quilboar here are led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, a formidable chieftain who resides in a large hut located towards the back of the ravine.
faq.q: Who leads the quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine?

faq.a: Tauren elders and chieftains at Camp Narache task fledgling braves with entering the ravine to push back the Bristleback threat, cull their numbers, and defeat their leadership to keep the mesa safe.
faq.q: Why do young tauren travel to the ravine?

text.s: Brambleblade Ravine is a rugged canyon cutting into the northeastern edge of Red Cloud Mesa. It serves as a fortified den for the Bristleback quilboar tribe, who persistently raid the nearby tauren settlement of Camp Narache. Young tauren braves are sent here to prove their strength and protect their homeland from these fierce interlopers.

sec.b: Carved into the sun-scorched earth of Red Cloud Mesa, Brambleblade Ravine is choked with dense, thorny briars and quilboar encampments. The Bristleback tribe uses this natural fortress as a staging ground for raids against Camp Narache, threatening the safety of young tauren coming of age. Bristleback shamans and warriors, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, dwell deep within the ravine among trained battleboars. For the Shu'halo, striking into the heart of the canyon is a crucial rite of passage and a grim necessity to secure the plains.
sec.t: A Thorn in the Mesa's Side

subzone:bramblescar.s: Rajazarza. Rajazarza es un asentamiento de jabaespines Crinfilada fuertemente fortificado, situado en el sur de Los Baldíos. Espesas zarzas espinosas protegen el campamento mientras sus habitantes libran una brutal guerra contra la tribu rival Erizapúa al otro lado del Camino del Oro. Esculpido entre los gigantescos y escarpados zarzales del sur de Los Baldíos, Rajazarza sirve como un reducto vital para los jabaespines Crinfilada. Estas zarzas defensivas crecen lo bastante densas y afiladas como para disuadir a los viajeros ocasionales, pero los jabaespines de su interior distan mucho de ser pacíficos. Ferozmente territoriales y hostiles con los forasteros, entablan constantes escaramuzas contra cualquiera que se aventure cerca de sus fronteras, pues consideran a todo aquel que no sea jabaespín un intruso en tierras bendecidas por sus antiguos dioses jabalí.

ang.faction:Horde: Securing the Gold Road against quillboar raids from Bramblescar is crucial to maintaining safe passage between Crossroads, Camp Taurajo, and the southern frontier.

faq.a: Bramblescar is inhabited by the Razormane tribe of quilboar, who defend their thorn-choked encampment against both rival quilboar and any travelers passing through.
faq.q: Who lives in Bramblescar?

faq.a: The Razormane of Bramblescar and the Bristleback quilboar across the road at Agama'gor are bitter enemies locked in a fierce territorial blood feud for control of the southern Barrens.
faq.q: Why are the quilboar here fighting each other?

faq.a: Bramblescar lies in the southern plains of the Barrens, positioned just east of the main Gold Road across from Agama'gor.
faq.q: Where is Bramblescar located?

faq.a: Yes. The Razormane quilboar view the Horde as invaders who have encroached on their sacred tribal lands, and they will attack any traveler who wanders close.
faq.q: Are the quilboar here hostile to the Horde?

text.s: Bramblescar is a heavily fortified Razormane quilboar settlement situated in the southern Barrens. Thick, thorny brambles shield the encampment as its inhabitants wage a brutal war against the rival Bristleback tribe across the Gold Road.

sec.b: Carved into the jagged, giant briars of the southern Barrens, Bramblescar serves as a vital redoubt for the Razormane quilboar. These defensive brambles grow thick and sharp enough to deter casual wanderers, but the quilboar within are far from peaceful. Fiercely territorial and hostile to outsiders, they mount continuous skirmishes against anyone who ventures near their borders, viewing all non-quilboar as intruders upon land blessed by their ancient boar gods.

Bramblescar sits in perpetual tension directly across the Gold Road from Agama'gor, an encampment held by the rival Bristleback tribe. The two factions are locked in an unrelenting tribal war for dominion over the southern Barrens. Between fighting off Horde travelers along the highway and repelling Bristleback raiding parties, the Razormane warriors of Bramblescar remain on constant, violent alert.

subzone:brewnall-village.s: Las Birras. Las Birras es un pequeño asentamiento enano ubicado en el Valle Escalofrío, cerca de la entrada a Gnomeregan. Establecido por la familia Barleybrew, este puesto avanzado sirve como campo de pruebas para audaces experimentos cerveceros y como defensa regional frente a las bestias salvajes. A pesar de llamarse aldea, funciona principalmente como un rústico campamento en las nevadas tierras bajas gnomísticas de Dun Morogh. Resguardada entre los ventisqueros del Valle Escalofrío, Las Birras se encuentra de lleno en los dominios tradicionalmente gnomos del oeste de Dun Morogh. El asentamiento es el hogar del clan Barleybrew, unos incondicionales maestros cerveceros enanos dedicados a perfeccionar recetas ancestrales y elaborar la cerveza negra definitiva. Aunque se la califica de aldea, el puesto avanzado consta en su mayoría de tiendas de campaña y equipo de destilación al aire libre en vez de arquitectura permanente de piedra. Entre probar lotes experimentales de cerveza y defenderse de los feroces lobos y osos de la zona, los Barleybrew dependen en gran medida de los montañeros itinerantes para reunir ingredientes raros y mantener seguro el valle.

ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, the Barleybrews' quest for the ultimate recipe is an honorable pursuit that upholds one of Ironforge's finest traditions.
ang.race:Gnome: Situated close to Gnomeregan, the village is an unexpected dwarven outpost deep within western Dun Morogh's gnomish valleys.

faq.a: Brewnall Village is a small dwarven camp located in Chill Breeze Valley within western Dun Morogh, just east of Gnomeregan. It serves as an outpost where the Barleybrew clan experiments with new beer recipes and manages local wildlife threats.
faq.q: What is Brewnall Village?

faq.a: Despite carrying the name village, the site is essentially an open-air encampment made up of tents and supply kegs. The Barleybrews have staked out their brewing operation here in the cold climate without building formal stone houses.
faq.q: Why is it called a village if there are no buildings?

faq.a: While the western half of Dun Morogh surrounds Gnomeregan and is primarily inhabited by gnomes, the close alliance between Ironforge and the gnomes makes shared settlement common. The Barleybrews settled here in Chill Breeze Valley to pursue their craft undisturbed.
faq.q: Why is a dwarven settlement located in gnomish territory?

faq.a: The encampment faces frequent attacks from the valley's aggressive wildlife, particularly crag boars, bears, and frost wolves. Additionally, the Barleybrews are constantly searching for rare and exotic ingredients to invent new, superior brews.
faq.q: What problems do the residents face?

text.s: Brewnall Village is a small dwarven settlement nestled in Chill Breeze Valley near the entrance to Gnomeregan. Established by the Barleybrew family, this outpost serves as a proving ground for bold brewing experiments and regional defense against wild beasts. Despite being called a village, it functions largely as a rustic encampment in the snowy gnomish lowlands of Dun Morogh.

sec.b: Tucked away in the snowdrifts of Chill Breeze Valley, Brewnall Village lies squarely within the traditional gnomish reaches of western Dun Morogh. The settlement is home to the Barleybrew clan, stalwart dwarven brewers devoted to perfecting age-old recipes and crafting the ultimate stout. Though dubbed a village, the outpost consists mostly of tents and outdoor brewing equipment rather than permanent stone architecture. Between testing experimental batches of ale and defending against the ferocious local wolves and bears, the Barleybrews rely heavily on wandering mountaineers to gather rare ingredients and keep the valley secure.
sec.t: A Bitter Brew in the Valley

subzone:brightwood-grove.s: Arboleda del Destello. Arboleda del Destello es una sombría extensión de bosque situada justo al oeste de Villa Oscura, en Bosque del Ocaso. En su día formó parte del sereno paisaje agrícola de la región, pero ahora está infestada de salvajes huargen Nocturnos que acampan entre granjas en ruinas y atacan a cualquier viajero que se acerque demasiado. Situada a la vista del perímetro de Villa Oscura, Arboleda del Destello representa el peligro insidioso que amenaza las fronteras del pueblo. Las granjas y cercas que antaño delimitaban apacibles tierras de cultivo yacen ahora derruidas y podridas. En su lugar, los huargen Nocturnos han levantado toscos campamentos y merodean por los claros cubiertos de maleza. La proximidad de estas bestias lupinas plantea una amenaza constante para la villa, obligando a la Guardia Nocturna y a los aventureros de paso a diezmar continuamente su número antes de que el asentamiento sea invadido.

ang.class:Hunter: The dark thickets of the grove provide harsh terrain for tracking the vicious Nightbane, testing any hunter's awareness against ambushes lurking behind the tree line.
ang.faction:Alliance: Brightwood Grove sits right outside the gates of Darkshire, making the elimination of its worgen packs vital to keeping the beleaguered town from being cut off from the west.

faq.a: Brightwood Grove is located in eastern Duskwood, lying just west of the town of Darkshire along the main paths.
faq.q: Where is Brightwood Grove?

faq.a: The grove is heavily infested by savage Nightbane worgen. These cursed wolf-men have established crude camps throughout the ruined buildings and attack anyone who approaches.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit Brightwood Grove?

faq.a: Because Brightwood Grove sits immediately west of Darkshire, the aggressive worgen packs lurking in the brush are an immediate hazard to town patrols, supply lines, and any travelers arriving along the road.
faq.q: Why is the grove dangerous to Darkshire?

faq.a: No. The few stone buildings and farmsteads on the outskirts of the grove lie entirely in ruins, abandoned to the elements and occupied by roving worgen.
faq.q: Are there any friendly settlements in the grove?

text.s: Brightwood Grove is a shadowed expanse of woodland located just west of Darkshire in Duskwood. Once part of the region's serene agrarian landscape, it is now infested with savage Nightbane worgen who make camp among ruined homesteads and attack any travelers wandering too close.

sec.b: Situated within sight of Darkshire's perimeter, Brightwood Grove represents the creeping peril threatening the town's borders. The homesteads and fences that once demarcated peaceful farmland now lie collapsed and rotting. In their place, crude camps have been erected by the Nightbane worgen, who prowl the overgrown clearings. The proximity of these wolf-beasts poses an ongoing threat to the town, forcing the Night Watch and passing adventurers to continually cull their numbers before the settlement is overrun.

subzone:brill.s: Rémol. Rémol es el principal asentamiento de los Renegados en el corazón de los Claros de Tirisfal, situado justo al norte de las Ruinas de Lordaeron. Antaño una próspera villa humana, hoy sirve como centro administrativo y militar para los no-muertos recién despertados que se aventuran más allá de los confines de Camposanto. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, Rémol era una animada aldea bajo la influencia de nobles regionales como las familias Barov y Agamand. Esa prosperidad terminó cuando Kel'Thuzad eligió la zona para los primeros experimentos del Culto de los Malditos con la peste de la no-muerte. La devastadora plaga se extendió con tal rapidez entre la población que las milicias locales fueron expulsadas, dejando a su paso un inmenso cementerio. Reconstruido ahora por los Renegados bajo el liderazgo del Magistrado Sevren, el pueblo conserva su desgastada arquitectura de Lordaeron bajo una atmósfera de sombrío propósito. Rémol funciona como centro de mando regional, coordinando las defensas frente a las incursiones de la Cruzada Escarlata, los restos errantes de la Plaga y las bestias autóctonas deformadas por la corrupción nigromántica.

ang.faction:Horde: The zeppelin dock outside town serves as the northern Horde's primary link between Lordaeron and allied strongholds in Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken venturing out from Deathknell, Brill is the first glimpse of civilization and the starting ground for proving loyalty to the Dark Lady.

faq.a: Magistrate Sevren oversees the civil administration and local defenses of Brill on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken.
al: who is in charge of brill
faq.q: Who rules Brill?

faq.a: Kel'Thuzad conducted some of his very first live experiments with the Plague of Undeath in Brill. The contagion wiped out the local human population with horrifying speed, necessitating a mass graveyard to inter the victims before they rose as Scourge.
faq.q: Why is there such a massive graveyard outside Brill?

faq.a: Aside from lodging weary travelers, the tavern's cellar serves as a base for apothecaries conducting chemical and toxicological experiments on captured Scarlet Crusade zealots.
al: what is happening in the brill tavern
faq.q: What is Gallows' End Tavern used for?

faq.a: The zeppelin tower operated by goblin crews connects Lordaeron directly to Kalimdor outside Orgrimmar, as well as south to Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: Where does the zeppelin tower outside Brill travel to?

text.s: Brill is the primary Forsaken settlement in the heart of Tirisfal Glades, situated just north of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Once a prosperous human town, it now serves as the administrative and military hub for newly awakened undead stepping beyond the confines of Deathknell.

sec.b:
Before the Third War, Brill was a lively village under the sway of regional nobles such as the Barov and Agamand families. That prosperity ended when Kel'Thuzad chose the area for the Cult of the Damned's earliest experiments with the Plague of Undeath. The devastating blight swept through the population so quickly that local militia were driven out, leaving a sprawling mass graveyard in its wake.

Now rebuilt by the Forsaken under the leadership of Magistrate Sevren, the town retains its weathered Lordaeron architecture beneath an atmosphere of grim purpose. Brill functions as the regional command center, coordinating defenses against Scarlet Crusade incursions, roaming Scourge remnants, and native beasts warped by necromantic decay.

Beyond local defense, Brill is an essential crossroads linking Tirisfal Glades to the wider Horde. Overhead, the goblin-operated zeppelin tower provides transit south toward Durotar and deep into Stranglethorn Vale. Within the settlement, Gallows' End Tavern serves not only as a dark shelter for travelers, but also as a makeshift laboratory where captured Scarlet zealots are interrogated and subjected to apothecarial testing.

subzone:brill-town-hall.s: Concejo de Rémol. El Concejo de Rémol es el núcleo administrativo del asentamiento de Rémol, en el centro de Claros de Tirisfal. Al erigirse como la estructura más prominente del pueblo, sirve como sede cívica desde la que los Renegados gobiernan sus posesiones locales y coordinan la defensa de los claros. Mientras que gran parte de Lordaeron yace destruida y en ruinas, el Concejo de Rémol sigue en pie como un centro cívico funcional bajo el mandato de los no-muertos. En su interior, el Magistrado Sevren dirige los asuntos del pueblo desde su podio, encomendando encargos y directrices vitales a los aventureros renegados. Aparte de la Guarida de los Rapiñadores en las Tierras Altas de Arathi, es uno de los pocos concejos reconocidos en el mundo conocido administrados activamente por los Renegados, sirviendo como una parodia sombría y una continuación funcional de la antigua burocracia municipal de Lordaeron.

ang.faction:Horde: Allies of the Horde arriving in Tirisfal can visit the town hall to understand how the Forsaken maintain civil authority and martial order in their darkened homelands.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken venturing out from Deathknell, the town hall represents the first taste of structured civic governance under Queen Sylvanas's realm, where local defense and reclamation efforts are formally organized.

faq.a: It serves as the local seat of government for the settlement of Brill. Forsaken leadership, particularly Magistrate Sevren, uses the building to coordinate local defense, issue decrees, and assign critical tasks to travelers and newly awakened undead.
faq.q: What is the Brill Town Hall used for?

faq.a: Magistrate Sevren presides over the town hall from his podium, managing municipal affairs on behalf of the Forsaken and directing operations throughout central Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Who is in charge here?

faq.a: Town halls are typically relics of living human kingdoms. Brill Town Hall is notable for being one of the only active civic halls maintained and operated by the Forsaken, mirroring only places like the Defiler's Den in Arathi.
al: are there other forsaken town halls
faq.q: Why is this town hall notable compared to others?

text.s: Brill Town Hall is the administrative heart of the settlement of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Standing as the most prominent structure in town, it serves as the civic headquarters from which the Forsaken govern their local holdings and coordinate the defense of the glades.

sec.b: While much of Lordaeron lies shattered and ruined, Brill Town Hall remains standing as a functioning civic center under undead rule. Inside, Magistrate Sevren directs town affairs from his podium, handing out vital commissions and directives to Forsaken adventurers. Aside from the Defiler's Den in the Arathi Highlands, it is one of the only recognized town halls in the known world actively run by the Forsaken, serving as a bleak parody and functional continuation of old Lordaeron's municipal bureaucracy.

subzone:burning-blade-coven.s: Aquelarre del Filo Ardiente. Enclavado en los acantilados septentrionales del Valle de los Retos, el Aquelarre del Filo Ardiente es una red de cuevas infestada que amenaza a los nuevos reclutas de la Horda. Cultistas corruptos y demonios invocados acechan en su interior, transformando una antigua caverna de minerales en una base de operaciones para la magia oscura a las puertas de Durotar. Las polvorientas montañas rojas que bordean el Valle de los Retos fueron antaño una mera naturaleza salvaje de prueba para los jóvenes orcos y trols de Lanza Negra que daban sus primeros pasos al servicio de la Horda. En los últimos días, sin embargo, oscuros rituales se han apoderado de las cuevas del norte. Diablillos y engendros menores surgen de la entrada de la caverna, desatando el caos y amenazando a los reclutas. Liderado por el sombrío brujo Yarrog Sombróseo, el culto del Filo Ardiente se ha atrincherado en lo más profundo, convirtiendo lo que solía ser un campo de entrenamiento rutinario en un campo de batalla activo contra la corrupción demoníaca.

ang.class:Warlock: The demonic imps and dark rituals here are an early, cautionary glimpse into what happens when fel power is wielded recklessly in open defiance of the Horde.
ang.race:Orc: The presence of the Burning Blade cult so close to the Valley of Trials is an intolerable insult to Thrall's new Horde and a stark reminder of the demon worship the orcs fought to leave behind.

faq.a: The cave is embedded in the high red rock ridges directly along the northern edge of the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
faq.q: Where is the Burning Blade Coven located?

faq.a: The coven is led by a warlock named Yarrog Baneshadow, who directs the local rituals and commands the summoned demons.
faq.q: Who leads the cultists here?

faq.a: The cave is infested with rogue imps, minor demonic servitors, and mortal acolytes aligned with the shadowy Burning Blade cult.
al: what mobs are in the cave
faq.q: What kinds of enemies lurk inside?

faq.a: Braving the dark depths of the cave, recovering lost tools like Foreman Thazz'ril's pick, and slaying Yarrog Baneshadow serves as the final initiation rite for new orc and troll adventurers before leaving the valley.
faq.q: Why do new recruits go into the cave?

text.s: Tucked into the northern cliffs of the Valley of Trials, the Burning Blade Coven is an infested cave network threatening the Horde's newest recruits. Corrupted cultists and summoned demons lurk within, turning an old mineral cavern into a staging ground for dark magic right on Durotar's doorstep.

sec.b: The dusty red mountains rimming the Valley of Trials were once simply a testing wilderness for young orcs and Darkspear trolls taking their first steps in service to the Horde. In recent days, however, dark rituals have taken hold of the northern caves. Imps and lesser fiends spill from the cavern mouth, stirring chaos and threatening recruits. Led by the shadowy warlock Yarrog Baneshadow, the Burning Blade cult has entrenched itself deep inside, turning what was once a routine training ground into an active battleground against demonic corruption.
sec.t: A Shadow Over the Proving Grounds

sec.b: Before the demons took root, the caves attracted the attention of local overseers hoping to harvest raw materials for the settlement. Foreman Thazz'ril ventured deep inside on a mineral survey, only to be driven out in haste, leaving valuable equipment behind as the cultists made their presence known. Now, driving back Baneshadow's coven serves as the ultimate proving trial for aspiring warriors, rogues, and spellcasters before they are deemed ready to venture out into greater Durotar.

subzone:calmbreeze-inn.s: Posada Brisa Calmada. El nombre Posada Brisa Calmada hace referencia a los principales establecimientos que ofrecen cobijo y servicios a lo largo de la Isla de Zephras, situados tanto en Aldea Shen'dar como en Valanaar. Sirven como puntos de descanso esenciales para los viajeros que exploran la isla, albergando instructores de profesiones locales, taberneros y artefactos históricos. Las posadas Brisa Calmada proporcionan un santuario entre los serpenteantes senderos de la Isla de Zephras. En Aldea Shen'dar, la posada funciona bajo la dirección de Coriella Brisa Calmada y hace las veces de núcleo central donde se reúnen los artesanos de la isla, incluidos mentores de herboristería, desuello y encantamiento. Al otro lado, en Valanaar, otra posada Brisa Calmada aloja a los caminantes locales y resguarda curiosidades poco comunes, entre ellas un cristal de audio que registra la historia de la antigua rebelión de Eldre'Thalas.

ang.class:Rogue: Miriann Mistblade offers rogue instruction from the hearth of the Shen'dar Village Calmbreeze Inn.
ang.profession:Herbalism: Herbalists visiting Shen'dar Village can seek out Halassa Fernbreeze inside the Calmbreeze Inn to hone their gathering craft.

faq.a: Calmbreeze Inn locations can be found in both Shen'dar Village and Valaanar on Zephras Isle.
faq.q: Where are the Calmbreeze Inns located?

faq.a: The Shen'dar Village location is maintained by Innkeeper Coriella Calmbreeze, offering hospitality to island residents and travelers alike.
faq.q: Who runs the inn in Shen'dar Village?

faq.a: In Shen'dar Village, the inn houses Halassa Fernbreeze for Herbalism, Mendalass Tattermend for Skinning, Nasalanna Windsinger for Enchanting, and Miriann Mistblade for Rogue training.
faq.q: What trainers can be found at the inn?

faq.a: Upstairs in the Valaanar inn rests an audio crystal containing Part 3 of 'The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas', chronicling historic events from the ancient Highborne city.
faq.q: What is the audio crystal found upstairs in Valaanar?

text.s: Calmbreeze Inn refers to the primary establishments offering shelter and services across Zephras Isle, found in both Shen'dar Village and Valaanar. They serve as essential rest stops for travelers exploring the island, housing local trade trainers, innkeepers, and historical artifacts.

sec.b: The Calmbreeze Inns provide sanctuary amid the winding trails of Zephras Isle. In Shen'dar Village, the inn operates under Coriella Calmbreeze and doubles as a central hub where island tradesfolk gather, including mentors in herbalism, skinning, and enchanting. Across the way in Valaanar, another Calmbreeze Inn accommodates local wayfarers and shelters rare curios, including an audio crystal recording the history of the ancient rebellion in Eldre'Thalas.

faq.a: El Campamento Narache es la aldea de inicio para los jóvenes tauren, situada en lo alto de la Mesa de la Nube Roja, en el sur de Mulgore. Es el campamento central de la tribu Vientaguilar y sirve como santuario donde cazadores, guerreros, druidas y chamanes novatos dominan sus artes antes de viajar hacia el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre y Cima del Trueno.

El Jefe Vientaguilar guía a los valientes de la tribu y coordina las defensas de la mesa, junto a la venerada anciana de la tribu, la Gran Madre Vientaguilar. Los instructores y ancianos de la tribu se reúnen en el centro del campamento para instruir a los jóvenes aventureros.

El campamento es hostigado continuamente por los jabaespines Erizacongelada que operan desde el Barranco Cortazarza, al este. Además de los jabalíes de batalla salvajes y los zancudos que deambulan por los riscos cercanos, el persistente peligro de las bandas de centauros depredadores mantiene a los valientes Vientaguilar en alerta constante.

La Mesa de la Nube Roja está delimitada de forma natural por escarpados acantilados. La única forma de bajar a las grandes llanuras de Mulgore es a través de un sendero de montaña custodiado que se dirige hacia el norte, vigilado por los valientes Vientaguilar para evitar que las bestias hostiles y los jabaespines tiendan emboscadas a los viajeros.

subzone:camp-narache.s: Campamento Narache. El Campamento Narache es una aldea aislada situada en la Mesa de la Nube Roja, en el sur de Mulgore. Sirve como hogar ancestral de la tribu Vientaguilar y como terreno de pruebas donde los jóvenes tauren comienzan su entrenamiento. Protegido muy por encima de las llanuras, el campamento mantiene tradiciones ancestrales mientras se defiende constantemente del avance de los jabaespines y de las persistentes amenazas de los centauros. Situado en el extremo norte de la elevada Mesa de la Nube Roja, el Campamento Narache es el asentamiento principal de la tribu Vientaguilar. La aldea consta de varias tiendas y pabellones grandes de piel, incluida una tienda comunal para los valientes heridos, una armería, una tienda de panadería y una sala de los espíritus dedicada a la meditación y a la comunión ancestral. En el centro del campamento, los ancianos de la tribu y los instructores de clase forman un círculo en el que la venerable Gran Madre Vientaguilar sigue ofreciendo consejo, guiando a los jóvenes recién iniciados a medida que asumen su papel como defensores de la Madre Tierra.

ang.class:Shaman: Young shaman take their very first steps along the spiritual path here, undertaking trials to earn their Earth Totem and speak directly with the elementals of the mesa.
ang.race:Tauren: For the tauren, Camp Narache represents childhood's end—the sacred earth where you take your first rites of the hunt and attune yourself to the ancestral spirits under the watchful gaze of the Hawkwind elders.

faq.a: Camp Narache is the starting village for young tauren, located atop Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. It is the central encampment of the Hawkwind tribe, serving as a sanctuary where fledgling hunters, warriors, druids, and shamans master their crafts before traveling outward to Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: What is Camp Narache?

faq.a: Chief Hawkwind guides the tribe's braves and coordinates the defenses of the mesa, alongside the tribe's revered elder, Greatmother Hawkwind. The tribe's trainers and elders gather at the center of the camp to instruct young adventurers.
faq.q: Who leads the village?

faq.a: The encampment is continually harassed by Bristleback quilboar operating out of Brambleblade Ravine to the east. In addition to feral battleboars and striders wandering the surrounding bluffs, the lingering danger of predatory centaur bands keeps the Hawkwind braves on constant alert.
faq.q: What threats does the camp face?

faq.a: Red Cloud Mesa is naturally bounded by sheer cliffs. The only way down into the greater plains of Mulgore is along a guarded mountain path leading north, watched over by Hawkwind braves to prevent hostile beasts and quilboar from ambushing travelers.
faq.q: Can travelers easily leave the mesa?

text.s: Camp Narache is a secluded village nestled upon Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. It serves as the ancestral home of the Hawkwind tribe and the proving ground where young tauren begin their training. Sheltered high above the plains, the camp maintains ancient traditions while constantly guarding against encroaching quilboar and lingering centaur threats.

sec.b: Situated at the northern edge of the elevated Red Cloud Mesa, Camp Narache is the primary settlement of the Hawkwind tribe. The village consists of several large hide lodges and pavilions, including a communal tent for wounded braves, an armory, a bakery tent, and a spirit lounge dedicated to meditation and ancestral communion. At the center of the camp, tribal elders and path trainers stand in a circle at the heart of the camp, where the venerable Greatmother Hawkwind still offers guidance, guiding newly initiated youth as they step into their roles as defenders of the Earth Mother.

Though naturally fortified by the steep sheer cliffs of the mesa, Camp Narache faces persistent unrest. Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine continuously encroach upon Hawkwind lands, while centaur scouts linger in the distance. Young hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors prove their mettle here by culling the aggressive local wildlife, protecting the village's water well, and turning back quilboar raiders before descending the grand path into the wider valleys of Mulgore.

subzone:camp-taurajo.s: Campamento Taurajo. El Campamento Taurajo es un tranquilo asentamiento tauren enclavado en el sur de Los Baldíos, situado justo junto al paso de montaña que conduce al oeste hacia Mulgore. Sirve como un refugio fronterizo vital, ofreciendo a los caminantes cansados una posada, suministros, instructores de profesión y transporte en jinete del viento entre las llanuras y el centro de Kalimdor. Situado en la boca oriental del paso a Mulgore, el Campamento Taurajo suele ser el primer vistazo a la inmensidad de Los Baldíos que tienen los jóvenes tauren que se aventuran desde el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre. Rodeado de matorrales secos y mesetas escarpadas, el campamento funciona como puesto de avanzada y centro comercial. Da cobijo a cazadores, peleteros y herboristas de campo, al tiempo que mantiene conexiones de jinetes del viento con Cima del Trueno, El Cruce y el Poblado Viento Libre más al sur.

ang.faction:Horde: Camp Taurajo secures a critical overland junction and flight path, binding Mulgore closely to the rest of Horde-controlled central Kalimdor.
ang.race:Tauren: For tauren journeying out of Mulgore for the very first time, Camp Taurajo is the first friendly sanctuary encountered on the harsh plains of the Barrens.

faq.a: Camp Taurajo is a tauren outpost and settlement in the southern Barrens, acting as a crucial waypoint between the homeland of Mulgore and the arid scrublands of the Barrens.
faq.q: What is Camp Taurajo?

faq.a: Following the dirt trail west past Camp Taurajo leads through the mountain pass into Mulgore, directly toward Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Where does the road west lead?

faq.a: The local flight master coordinates wyvern routes connecting the camp directly to the Crossroads to the north, Thunder Bluff to the west, and Freewind Post in Thousand Needles to the south.
faq.q: Where do the wind riders from Camp Taurajo fly?

text.s: Camp Taurajo is a quiet tauren settlement nestled in the southern Barrens, sitting right along the mountain pass leading west into Mulgore. It serves as a vital frontier haven, offering tired wanderers an inn, supplies, profession mentors, and wind rider transit between the plains and central Kalimdor.

sec.b: Situated at the eastern mouth of the pass to Mulgore, Camp Taurajo is often the first glimpse of the wider Barrens seen by young tauren venturing out from Bloodhoof Village. Surrounded by dry scrubland and rugged mesas, the camp operates as both an outpost and a trading hub. It shelters hunters, leathercrafters, and field herbalists while maintaining wind rider connections to Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and Freewind Post deeper south.

subzone:canals-stormwind-city.s: Canales (Ciudad de Ventormenta). Los Canales son una red de vías fluviales bordeadas de piedra que serpentean por Ciudad de Ventormenta, separando sus distintos distritos. Sirven como vías de paso tranquilas para peatones y pescadores, a la vez que albergan discretamente peligros ocultos y la entrada a la prisión de la ciudad. Los Canales conectan y definen los distritos de Ventormenta, dividiendo los bulliciosos mercados del Distrito de Mercaderes de los antiguos callejones del Casco Antiguo, los jardines de la catedral y el Distrito de los Enanos. Puentes de piedra, arcos y paseos junto al agua enmarcan establecimientos tranquilos como Bodega Gallina, sastrerías y serenas viviendas residenciales. Además de servir a comerciantes locales y pescadores aficionados, las vías fluviales ocultan la entrada fortificada a Las Mazmorras, donde los criminales y rebeldes más peligrosos de Ventormenta están recluidos bajo el nivel de la calle.

ang.faction:Alliance: The canals stand as a testament to the rebuilding of the capital by the Alliance of Lordaeron, having transformed the choked, corpse-ridden ruins of the First War back into a functional, picturesque city.
ang.profession:Cooking: The quiet canal banks provide convenient spots for aspiring chefs to practice fishing for fresh catches without ever leaving the safety of the capital's walls.

faq.a: When the Orcish Horde conquered and sacked Stormwind in the First War, the waterways were left filled with broken stone, timber, and rotting bodies. The retaking forces of the Alliance of Lordaeron had to painstakingly dredge the canals and properly bury the fallen before the city could be rebuilt.
faq.q: What happened to the canals during the First War?

faq.a: No one can say for certain. Persistent urban legends tell of a massive white crocolisk lurking in the waterways. City guards and residents often dismiss it as tavern gossip, but the reports keep coming, and adventurers are warned not to fall in.
faq.q: Is there really a monster in the Stormwind canals?

faq.a: The Stockade entrance is located along the northernmost stretch of the canal surrounding the Mage Quarter, guarded heavily by the Stormwind City Guard.
faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Stockade located?

faq.a: Swimming the canals is entirely possible, though getting back out onto the street requires finding stone stairs or docks spaced along the waterside paths.
faq.q: Can players swim through the canals to travel around Stormwind?

text.s: The Canals are a network of stone-lined waterways weaving through Stormwind City, separating its distinct districts. They serve as quiet thoroughfares for pedestrians and anglers, while quietly harboring hidden hazards and the entrance to the city's prison.

sec.b: The Canals link and define the districts of Stormwind, dividing the bustling markets of the Trade District from the aged alleys of Old Town, the cathedral gardens, and the Dwarven District. Stone bridges, archways, and waterside walkways frame quiet establishments like the Gallina Winery, tailor shops, and quiet residential homes. In addition to serving local merchants and recreational fishermen, the waterways conceal the fortified entrance to the Stockade, where Stormwind's most dangerous criminals and rebels are held beneath street level.

The placid surface of the waterways belies a violent past. Following the sack of Stormwind during the First War, the canals were discovered choked with rubble, timber, and the corpses of slaughtered defenders. When the Alliance of Lordaeron liberated the ruins, soldiers undertook the grim labor of clearing the waterways and burying the dead before rebuilding began. Today, while cleaned and restored, the depths retain an air of mystery, fueled by city rumors of a massive albino crocolisk prowling beneath the docks.
sec.t: A Gruesome History and Lurking Shadows

subzone:canals-undercity.s: Canales (Entrañas). Los Canales forman un foso turbio y circular que serpentea entre los distintos barrios de Entrañas. Llenos de un limo verde, nocivo y antinatural en lugar de agua dulce, sirven tanto de sistema de alcantarillado como de sombrío símbolo de la fortaleza subterránea de los Renegados. Excavados en las profundidades subterráneas bajo las Ruinas de Lordaeron, los Canales rodean el corazón de Entrañas, dividiendo sus barrios con anchos cauces de fango verde y viscoso. Mientras que las ciudades de los mortales canalizan el agua corriente de los ríos para limpiar sus avenidas, los Renegados han llenado estos conductos de piedra con desechos industriales, vertidos químicos y residuos alquímicos. El líquido emite un brillo tenue y enfermizo, además de vapores pestilentes, lo que imposibilita cruzarlo mediante métodos mágicos ordinarios como Caminar sobre el agua. A pesar de la letalidad de esta masa cenagosa, pescadores desesperados extraen ocasionalmente curiosidades extrañas y corrompidas de entre el lodo.

ang.class:Shaman: The elements hold little sway over the polluted muck filling the Undercity's waterways, causing conventional spells like Water Walking to fail entirely.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, the foul canals are entirely harmless to their unliving physiology, serving as a functional moat and chemical runoff channel suited to their subterranean realm.

faq.a: It is an alchemical sludge composed of toxic runoff, plague byproducts, and industrial waste that collects within the Undercity's drainage system. Unlike clean water, it is visibly tainted and noxious.
al: what is the slime in undercity
faq.q: What is the green liquid in the canals?

faq.a: Yes, patient anglers can cast a line into the sludge. Along with sickly, contaminated fish, people occasionally haul up discarded junk, including old human skulls from Lordaeron's fallen past.
faq.q: Can you fish in the Undercity canals?

faq.a: The thick, chemical slurry does not behave like natural water. Its foul viscosity and unnatural composition prevent shamans and other spellcasters from holding surface tension through conventional water-walking magic.
al: why cant i walk on water undercity
faq.q: Why doesn't Water Walking work on the canals?

text.s: The Canals form a murky, circular moat winding between the distinct quarters of the Undercity. Filled with an unnatural, noxious green slime rather than fresh water, they serve as both a sewage system and a grim symbol of the Forsaken's subterranean stronghold.

sec.b: Carved into the subterranean depths beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, the Canals encircle the heart of the Undercity, dividing its quarters with wide channels of sluggish green sludge. While mortal cities channel flowing river water to clean their avenues, the Forsaken have filled these stone conduits with industrial refuse, chemical runoff, and alchemical waste. The liquid emits a faint, sickly glow and foul vapors, making it impossible to traverse by ordinary magical means like water walking. Despite the lethality of the slurry, desperate anglers occasionally haul bizarre, tainted curiosities from the muck.

subzone:cathedral-of-light.s: Catedral de la Luz. La Catedral de la Luz es el corazón espiritual de la Ciudad de Ventormenta y el santuario principal de la Iglesia de la Luz Sagrada. Alzándose sobre la Plaza de la Catedral, sirve como bastión central para el sacerdocio humano y los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata. Reconstruida tras su devastación durante la Primera Guerra bajo la guía del Arzobispo Alonsus Faol y el por entonces obispo Benedictus, la Catedral de la Luz se erige como un imponente faro de resiliencia. Sus vastas salas y catacumbas subterráneas albergaron a refugiados desesperados durante las horas más oscuras de la reconstrucción de Ventormenta. Con la caída de Lordaeron ante la Plaga durante la Tercera Guerra, la sede de la Iglesia se trasladó al sur, a Ventormenta. Hoy en día, el Arzobispo Benedictus guía a los fieles desde esta gran sala, brindando guía espiritual a toda la Alianza.

ang.class:Paladin: The Cathedral of Light serves as your principal order hall in Stormwind, where mentors like Duthorian Rall and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker guide you through the sacred trials of the Tomes of Valor and Divinity.
ang.class:Priest: As the supreme seat of the Church of the Holy Light in the southern kingdoms, the cathedral is where High Priestess Laurena and Archbishop Benedictus nurture your spiritual devotion and sacred healing arts.

faq.a: Archbishop Benedictus serves as the head of the Church of the Holy Light. Following the fall of Lordaeron and the demise of Archbishop Alonsus Faol, Benedictus assumed spiritual leadership over the reformed Church from his dais in Stormwind.
faq.q: Who leads the Church inside the cathedral?

faq.a: The cathedral serves as the operational headquarters of the Knights of the Silver Hand in the kingdom of Stormwind. Renowned paladins like Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall instruct new squires, bestow sacred tomes, and direct crusaders against enemies of the realm.
faq.q: What is the cathedral's connection to the paladins?

faq.a: Beneath the main sanctuary lie ancient catacombs. Historically used as a shelter for refugees during the First and Second Wars, they now serve as the final resting place for honored heroes, priests, and paladins.
faq.q: What lies beneath the cathedral floor?

faq.a: The great bell tolling from the cathedral was forged upon the Great Forge in Ironforge. Crafted alongside a twin bell meant for Lordaeron, it was gifted to humanity by the dwarves as a testament to the enduring friendship between their kingdoms.
faq.q: Where did the cathedral's bell come from?

text.s: The Cathedral of Light is the spiritual heart of Stormwind City and the primary sanctuary of the Church of the Holy Light. Standing tall over Cathedral Square, it serves as the central bastion for human priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand.

sec.b: Rebuilt after its devastation during the First War under the guidance of Archbishop Alonsus Faol and then-Bishop Benedictus, the Cathedral of Light stands as a towering beacon of resilience. Its vast halls and subterranean catacombs sheltered desperate refugees during the darkest hours of Stormwind's reconstruction. With the fall of Lordaeron to the Scourge during the Third War, the seat of the Church shifted south to Stormwind. Today, Archbishop Benedictus shepherds the faithful from this grand hall, providing spiritual guidance to the entire Alliance.

Beyond serving as a house of prayer and healing, the cathedral acts as the primary headquarters for the remaining Knights of the Silver Hand in the southern kingdoms. High-ranking figures such as Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall train promising squires through the sacred trials of the Tome of Valor and the Tome of Divinity. Alongside them, High Priestess Laurena guides devout acolytes in the deepest tenets of the Light, preparing holy champions to defend the realm against the rising threat of the Defias Brotherhood and the Scourge.

subzone:cathedral-square.s: Plaza de la Catedral. La Plaza de la Catedral es el corazón cívico y espiritual de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, presidido por la majestuosa Catedral de la Luz. Más allá de servir como lugar de culto y devoción, esta animada plaza alberga instituciones municipales como el ayuntamiento, el orfanato de la ciudad y el cuartel general regional del Alba Argenta. Situada al noroeste del Distrito de Mercaderes y al sureste del Distrito de los Enanos, Plaza de la Catedral sirve como el epicentro de la fe en el Reino de Ventormenta. Dominando el horizonte se alza la Catedral de la Luz, el santuario preeminente para los devotos de la Luz Sagrada en todo Azeroth. Sacerdotes, paladines y sanadores se reúnen aquí para estudiar, orar y entrenar. Ciudadanos, peregrinos y escolares locales guiados por la Maestra de escuela Danna se mezclan habitualmente en la plaza para conversar y meditar.

ang.class:Paladin: For paladins, Cathedral Square is the fountainhead of faith and duty, housing mentors, sacred vows, and specialized armorers tailored to holy warriors.
ang.class:Priest: The quiet halls and towering spires of the square offer priests a tranquil sanctuary to commune with the Holy Light, advance their spiritual studies, and minister to the citizens of Stormwind.

faq.a: Cathedral Square is a major district in Stormwind City centered on the Cathedral of Light. It serves as both the spiritual hub for practitioners of the Light and a vital civic center housing City Hall, the local orphanage, and various shops.
faq.q: What is Cathedral Square?

faq.a: Priests and Paladins of the Alliance come to Cathedral Square and the Cathedral of Light to hone their skills and study sacred doctrines. Medics and caregivers also study here under First Aid trainers.
faq.q: Who trains in Cathedral Square?

faq.a: The Argent Dawn maintains a prominent embassy in Cathedral Square to recruit able-bodied champions and coordinate logistical support from Stormwind for their relentless crusade against the Scourge in the Plaguelands.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn located here?

faq.a: Bridges and canal paths link Cathedral Square directly to the bustling Trade District to the southeast, the industrial Dwarven District to the northwest, and the quiet gardens of the Park to the southwest.
faq.q: Where does Cathedral Square lead?

text.s: Cathedral Square is the spiritual and civic heart of Stormwind City, dominated by the majestic Cathedral of Light. Beyond serving as a place of worship and devotion, the bustling plaza houses municipal institutions like City Hall, the city orphanage, and the regional headquarters of the Argent Dawn.

sec.b: Situated northwest of the Trade District and southeast of the Dwarven District, Cathedral Square serves as the epicenter of faith in the Kingdom of Stormwind. Dominating the skyline is the Cathedral of Light, the preeminent sanctuary for followers of the Holy Light across Azeroth. Priests, paladins, and healers gather here to study, pray, and train. Citizens, pilgrims, and local schoolchildren led by School Mistress Danna regularly mingle in the square for conversation and contemplation.

The district is not merely reserved for prayer; it is one of the capital's busiest civic centers. The square houses the Stormwind Orphanage as well as City Hall, anchoring the administrative life of the kingdom. Specialized armorers and weaponsmiths catering to holy crusaders, such as Righteous Plates and Just Maces, line the avenues. It also serves as the base of operations for the Argent Dawn within Stormwind, where recruiters and representatives coordinate relief efforts and rally champions against the encroaching threats of the Scourge in the northern kingdoms.

subzone:cavern-of-mists.s: Caverna de las Brumas. La Caverna de las Brumas es la amplia antecámara exterior que conduce a las profundidades de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Alimentada por géiseres subterráneos que brotan a través de la roca, su poza central y su densa niebla albergan una extraña fauna mutada que merodea justo fuera del umbral del portal. Antes de descender al verdadero corazón de las Cuevas de los Lamentos, los viajeros deben abrirse paso por la Caverna de las Brumas. Un vapor denso y cálido flota permanentemente en el aire, alimentado por géiseres naturales que brotan del suelo de la caverna hacia una profunda poza central. Aunque sirve como entrada, dista mucho de ser un lugar apacible. Manadas de raptores, serpientes, mocos y trilladones semiacuáticos deambulan por las cornisas y las aguas, junto a bestias tristemente célebres como la hidra Trigore el Azotador. Ofrece a los aventureros un sombrío anticipo del crecimiento antinatural que se corrompe en las profundidades.

ang.class:Druid: The twisted wildlife thriving in the heavy vapors gives Cenarion druids their first warning of how deeply Naralex's Emerald Dream communion has gone astray.
ang.faction:Horde: Resting right in the heart of the Barrens, clearing out the predatory beasts lurking in these mists is critical to securing the trade routes and outposts around the Crossroads.

faq.a: The Cavern of Mists comprises the outer cave system of the Wailing Caverns, located southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. It is the non-instanced chamber that players must traverse to reach the instance portal itself.
faq.q: Where is the Cavern of Mists?

faq.a: Active geysers constantly burst from the stone floor, feeding the central pool and filling the subterranean air with heavy, humid fog.
faq.q: Why is it called the Cavern of Mists?

faq.a: The chamber is populated by raptors, oozes, wind serpents, snakes, toads, and threshadons inhabiting the pool, as well as occasional sightings of the rare hydra Trigore the Lasher.
faq.q: What creatures live here?

faq.a: Trigore the Lasher is a dangerous rare hydra that can occasionally be found swimming alongside the threshadons in the chamber's central pool.
faq.q: Who is Trigore the Lasher?

text.s: The Cavern of Mists is the expansive outer antechamber leading into the depths of the Wailing Caverns. Fed by subterranean geysers that erupt through the rock, its central pool and hanging fog harbor strange, mutated wildlife roaming just outside the portal threshold.

sec.b: Before descending into the true heart of the Wailing Caverns, travelers must navigate the Cavern of Mists. Thick, warm vapor hangs permanently in the air, fed by natural geysers erupting from the cavern floor into a deep central pool. Though it serves as an entryway, it is far from peaceful. Swarms of raptors, serpents, oozes, and semi-aquatic threshadons wander the ledges and waters, alongside notorious beasts like the hydra Trigore the Lasher. It provides adventurers an ominous preview of the unnatural growth festering deeper below.

subzone:champions-hall.s: Sala de los Campeones. Escondida en los confines meridionales del Casco Antiguo, la Sala de los Campeones sirve como cuartel de oficiales y armería de suministros para los veteranos condecorados de la Alianza en Ventormenta. Tras cruzar su umbral, los intendentes proporcionan armas especializadas, armaduras de placas y distintivos a los guerreros consagrados de la facción. El acceso está estrictamente custodiado y reservado únicamente para aquellos oficiales que hayan demostrado su valor en el campo de batalla. Oculta tras una entrada vigilada en el Casco Antiguo, la Sala de los Campeones es un refugio exclusivo para los combatientes más distinguidos de la Alianza. Los mandos militares se reúnen aquí ante mapas tácticos de Azeroth para deliberar sobre las campañas en curso, rodeados de armamento y las insignias honoríficas de su rango. Solo aquellos soldados que hayan ascendido en la jerarquía militar de la Alianza hasta alcanzar el estatus de oficial —concretamente el rango de Knight o superior— tienen permitida la entrada. En su interior, los intendentes militares suministran a los curtidos soldados armas de élite, armaduras y monturas fabricadas expresamente para decantar la balanza contra la Horda en los territorios en disputa de todo el mundo.

ang.class:Warrior: For front-line combatants, the hall represents the ultimate military stockpile, offering heavy battle gear and armaments reserved only for proven battlefield leaders.
ang.faction:Alliance: The hall stands as the premier symbol of Alliance military merit in Stormwind, honoring those who dedicate their lives to repelling Horde incursions.

faq.a: The Champions' Hall is located in the southern section of Old Town in Stormwind City, tucked away behind a guarded entrance.
faq.q: Where is the Champions' Hall located?

faq.a: Only Alliance veterans who have earned the military rank of Knight (Rank 6) or higher through the faction's honor system are granted passage through the entrance portal. Unproven recruits and civilians are barred at the threshold.
al: why cant i enter champions hall
faq.q: Who is allowed inside the Champions' Hall?

faq.a: The hall contains quartermasters offering officer-tier weapons, armor, insignia, and specialized war mounts. Alliance tacticians and generals also congregate around war tables lined with regional maps of Azeroth.
al: what vendors are in champions hall
faq.q: What is inside the Champions' Hall?
