faq.a: The Horde counterpart is the Hall of Legends, situated in Orgrimmar, which provides identical military supply services to decorated warriors of the Horde.
faq.q: What is the Horde equivalent of this building?

text.s: Tucked away in the southern reaches of Old Town, the Champions' Hall serves as the officer's barracks and supply armory for the Alliance's decorated veterans in Stormwind. Beyond its threshold, quartermasters dispense specialized weapons, plate, and regalia to proven warriors of the faction. Access is strictly guarded, reserved only for officers who have demonstrated valor on the field of war.

sec.b: Hidden behind a guarded threshold in Old Town, the Champions' Hall is a restricted haven for the Alliance's most distinguished combatants. Military commanders gather here over tactical maps of Azeroth to confer on ongoing campaigns, flanked by armaments and the grand insignias of rank. Only soldiers who have climbed the Alliance hierarchy to achieve officer status—specifically the rank of Knight or higher—are permitted entry. Inside, military quartermasters supply battle-hardened soldiers with elite arms, armor, and mounts crafted specifically to turn the tide against the Horde in contested zones across the world.

subzone:charred-vale.s: La Vega Carbonizada. La Vega Carbonizada es un valle humeante en el suroeste de Sierra Espolón, devastado por la tala imprudente y la maquinaria de Ventura y Cía. Antaño un próspero refugio para antárboles y quimeras, ahora está envuelto en llamas, elementales errantes y arpías hostiles. No hace mucho tiempo, esta cuenca del suroeste era un floreciente bosque alpino custodiado por majestuosos antárboles y habitado por quimeras y arpías autóctonas. Su ruina comenzó con la llegada de Ventura y Cía. La codiciosa organización de goblins taló por completo el bosque con maquinaria explosiva, corrompiendo a los guardianes y despertando a caóticos elementales de fuego. Aunque los antárboles acabaron haciendo retroceder a los goblins, la tierra quedó quebrantada, marcada por el fuego y mancillada por los viles artefactos que desplegaron los leñadores en su retirada.

ang.class:Druid: The devastation here serves as a harsh warning of what happens when natural balance is shattered by uncontrolled greed, making the valley a key focus for reclamation efforts.
ang.faction:Horde: Operating out of Sun Rock Retreat, Horde forces work closely with Cenarion allies to contain the elemental unrest and push back the corruptive lingering aftermath of the Venture Company.

faq.a: The devastation was caused by the Venture Company's ruthless logging operations. Their destructive machinery and aggressive deforestation enraged the primal spirits of the land and unleashed destructive fire elementals that spread across the valley.
faq.q: Why is the Charred Vale on fire?

faq.a: Tauren druids from nearby Sun Rock Retreat believe it can. They task travelers with soothing the maddened treants and planting enchanted earthen seeds amidst the ash, hoping to coax green shoots from the ruined soil.
faq.q: Can the forest in the Charred Vale ever recover?

faq.a: The basin is crawling with hostile elemental fire spirits, blackened and vengeful ancients, Scorched Basilisks, and wild chimaeras. It is also plagued by Bloodfury harpies.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Charred Vale?

faq.a: Its original name has been lost to time, but it was renowned as a lush woodland sanctuary long before goblin axes arrived.
faq.q: What was the Charred Vale called before it burned?

text.s: The Charred Vale is a smoldering valley in southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, devastated by the reckless deforestation and machinery of the Venture Company. Once a thriving haven for treants and chimaeras, it is now engulfed in flames, roving elementals, and hostile harpies.

sec.b: Not long ago, this southwest basin was a flourishing alpine wood guarded by majestic treants and inhabited by native chimaeras and harpies. Its ruin began with the arrival of the Venture Company. The greedy goblin outfit clear-cut the forest with explosive machinery, corrupting the guardians and awakening chaotic fire elementals. Though the treants eventually forced the goblins back, the land was left broken, scarred by fire, and tainted by whatever foul devices the retreating loggers deployed.

Today, blackened ancients wander blindly through smoke and ash alongside enraged elementals. Bloodfury harpies roost in the skeletal snags, defending what remains of their territory. Despite the hostility of the valley, druids from Sun Rock Retreat refuse to abandon the region, dispatching travelers to sow enchanted seeds and tend the corrupted ancients in a persistent campaign to reclaim the scorched earth.

subzone:chill-breeze-valley.s: Valle Escalofrío. El Valle Escalofrío es un paso escarpado y cubierto de nieve situado en el oeste de Dun Morogh que conecta el asentamiento enano de Kharanos con la asediada ciudad de Gnomeregan. Aunque su camino principal es una vía muy transitada por jóvenes viajeros y refugiados, sus apartados rincones albergan peligrosas bestias y sangrientas guaridas. El Valle Escalofrío forma una trinchera en forma de T a través de las montañas del oeste de Dun Morogh. El sendero principal de este a oeste registra un tránsito constante de enanos y gnomos novatos que viajan entre Kharanos y las afueras de Gnomeregan. Sin embargo, adentrarse en la ramificación norte-sur del valle es un asunto completamente diferente. Repletas de manchas de sangre y cadáveres destrozados, estas sombrías zonas albergan feroces depredadores, sobre todo salvajes wendigos que anidan en profundas cuevas de hielo y cazan a cualquiera lo bastante imprudente como para adentrarse en sus cotos de caza.

ang.race:Dwarf: Mountaineers and young dwarven hunters test their mettle clearing out the ferocious wendigos that menace the vital passage connecting central Dun Morogh to the western highlands.
ang.race:Gnome: For gnomish refugees fleeing the fallout of Gnomeregan toward the safety of Kharanos and Ironforge, surviving the trek through Chill Breeze Valley's predatory perimeter is a critical first step.

faq.a: Chill Breeze Valley is situated in western Dun Morogh, positioned directly between the bustling mountain hub of Kharanos to the east and the technological gnome city of Gnomeregan to the west.
faq.q: Where is Chill Breeze Valley located?

faq.a: While the main path between Kharanos and Gnomeregan is relatively safe and heavily traveled, the northern and southern offshoots of the valley are hunting grounds for predatory beasts. The snow there is stained with blood and torn carcasses, leading to caves inhabited by vicious, territorial wendigos.
faq.q: Why is the valley so dangerous to travel through?

faq.a: The deeper recesses of the valley are home to ferocious wendigos, including particularly large and elite alpha beasts that have claimed several cave dens as their personal lairs.
al: what lives in chill breeze valley
faq.q: What kinds of beasts make their dens here?

text.s: Chill Breeze Valley is a rugged, snow-covered pass in western Dun Morogh linking the dwarven settlement of Kharanos with the embattled city of Gnomeregan. While its main path is a well-traveled thoroughfare for young travelers and refugees, its secluded recesses harbor dangerous beasts and bloody dens.

sec.b: Chill Breeze Valley forms a T-shaped trench through the mountains of western Dun Morogh. The main east-west trail sees steady foot traffic from novice dwarves and gnomes journeying between Kharanos and the outskirts of Gnomeregan. However, straying into the valley's north-south offshoot is another matter entirely. Strewn with bloodstains and mangled carcasses, these shadowy reaches harbor ferocious predators—most notably savage wendigos that lair in deep ice caves and prey on anyone reckless enough to wander into their hunting grounds.
sec.t: A Crossroads of Snow and Claws

subzone:cleft-of-shadow.s: Circo de las Sombras. Oculto en las profundidades de las cavernas subterráneas bajo Orgrimmar, Circo de las Sombras alberga a quienes practican el sigilo, la hechicería y la demonología en la ciudad. Lejos del orgulloso espíritu guerrero de los distritos superiores de Thrall, sirve como un refugio necesario para pícaros, brujos y magos que operan en las sombras de la Horda. Aunque la nueva Horda de Thrall defiende el honor, el chamanismo y la fuerza de las armas, un liderazgo práctico exige un lugar para artes más sutiles. Excavado en las húmedas cavernas de piedra bajo la capital, Circo de las Sombras acoge a la Hermandad Shadowswift de pícaros, al Enclave Darkfire de brujos y a los eruditos del Enclave Arcano. Apartado del ajetreo diario de los distritos del valle, este sombrío barrio permite a quienes manejan venenos, energía vil y magia arcana ejercer sus oficios lejos de la vista pública directa, mientras permanecen bajo la atenta mirada de los líderes de Orgrimmar.

ang.class:Rogue: The Shadowswift Brotherhood gathers here alongside poison merchants and lockpickers, turning this dark recess into the primary den for the Horde's stealth operatives.
ang.class:Warlock: The Darkfire Enclave gives Horde warlocks a sanctioned place to summon demons and bind fel energy beneath Orgrimmar without drawing the immediate wrath of shaman and warriors.

faq.a: Thrall strives to keep the Horde united under honorable shamanic and warrior traditions. While the utility of warlocks and rogues is acknowledged, their practices are distrusted by much of the orcish public. Confining them to the subterranean caverns keeps dangerous fel and illicit activities contained and monitored.
faq.q: Why are warlocks and rogues kept underground here?

faq.a: The cavern serves as Orgrimmar's primary hub for rogue, warlock, and mage trainers. It also hosts poison suppliers, reagent vendors, and wand and staff merchants.
al: who is in cleft of shadow
faq.q: What major trainers and services can be found in the Cleft of Shadow?

faq.a: The chasm plunging into the cavern floor leads to Ragefire Chasm, a perilous subterranean network of lava tubes beneath Orgrimmar infested with troggs, searing elementals, and rogue cultists.
faq.q: What is the entrance at the bottom of the cavern?

text.s: Tucked deep within the subterranean caverns beneath Orgrimmar, the Cleft of Shadow houses the city's practitioners of stealth, sorcery, and demonology. Far from the proud warrior ethos of Thrall's upper districts, it serves as a necessary haven for rogues, warlocks, and mages operating in the shadows of the Horde.

sec.b: While Thrall's new Horde champions honor, shamanism, and strength of arms, practical leadership demands a place for subtler arts. Carved into the damp stone caverns below the capital, the Cleft of Shadow hosts the Shadowswift Brotherhood of rogues, the Darkfire Enclave of warlocks, and the scholars of the Arcane Enclave. Kept away from the everyday bustle of the valley districts, this dark quarter allows practitioners of poison, fel energy, and arcane magic to ply their trades out of direct public view while remaining under the watchful eye of Orgrimmar's leadership.

Beyond acting as a center for covert instruction and magical reagents, the Cleft of Shadow descends directly into Ragefire Chasm. This fiery network of volcanic caves honeycombs beneath Orgrimmar itself, posing an ongoing security threat that draws adventurous defenders and sinister cultists alike right to the cavern's edge.

subzone:cliffspring-falls.s: Salto de Fonrroca. El Salto de Fonrroca marca el espectacular origen del vital Río Fonrroca de Costa Oscura, precipitándose desde los acantilados orientales hacia el bosque costero. Celebrado durante mucho tiempo como la principal fuente de agua potable limpia para la región, sus aguas han sido víctimas recientemente de una vil y expansiva corrupción. La caverna subterránea que alimenta la cascada se ha infestado de hostiles nagas y sombríos cultores del Martillo Crepuscular. Brotando de cavernas encaramadas a gran altura en los riscos rocosos del borde oriental de Costa Oscura, el Salto de Fonrroca alimenta el Río Fonrroca, que serpentea hacia el oeste a través de los bosques hasta desembocar en el mar. Tradicionalmente, esta cascada proporcionaba el agua potable más pura para los asentamientos locales de elfos de la noche. En tiempos recientes, sin embargo, las aguas se han vuelto fétidas y turbias, propagando la enfermedad y el deterioro ecológico por toda la cuenca del río. Los naturalistas que investigan el suceso han descubierto que la red de cuevas en la cabecera de las cataratas está invadida por viles nagas y oscuros cultores, que conspiran entre las sombras mientras la corrupción demoníaca del vecino Frondavil amenaza con filtrarse a través del lecho rocoso de las tierras altas.

ang.class:Druid: Druids of the Cenarion Circle monitor the river closely, striving to diagnose and cleanse the unnatural rot that threatens to choke the wilderness.
ang.race:NightElf: For the kaldorei of Auberdine, the corruption of Cliffspring Falls is an environmental and spiritual crisis, polluting the vital waters that nourish Darkshore's ancient forests.

faq.a: Cliffspring Falls is a major waterfall in eastern Darkshore that forms the headwaters of the Cliffspring River. It historically supplied the primary fresh drinking water for the surrounding forest.
faq.q: What is Cliffspring Falls?

faq.a: Two sinister influences are suspected: demonic taint seeping through the mountains from corrupted Felwood, and the active presence of Twilight's Hammer cultists and hostile naga lurking inside the caverns feeding the cascade.
faq.q: Why is the water coming from the falls corrupted?

faq.a: The caverns above and behind the waterfall are infested with hostile naga slithering through the flooded chambers, alongside cultists belonging to the apocalyptic Twilight's Hammer.
faq.q: Who occupies the caverns behind the falls?

faq.a: The Cliffspring River cuts through the center of northern Darkshore. Because it serves as the principal source of fresh water, its poisoning directly endangers wildlife, ancient groves, and local night elf habitations.
faq.q: Why is Cliffspring Falls so important to Darkshore?

text.s: Cliffspring Falls marks the dramatic origin of Darkshore's vital Cliffspring River, tumbling down from the eastern cliffs into the coastal forest. Long celebrated as the principal source of clean drinking water for the region, its waters have recently fallen victim to a foul, spreading taint. The subterranean cavern feeding the waterfall has become infested with hostile naga and shadowy Twilight's Hammer cultists.

sec.b: Pouring out from caverns perched high in the rocky bluffs along Darkshore's eastern border, Cliffspring Falls feeds the Cliffspring River, which winds westward across the woods to empty into the sea. Traditionally, this cascade provided the purest drinking water for local night elf settlements. In recent times, however, the waters have turned foul and murky, spreading sickness and ecological decay throughout the river basin. Investigating naturalists have discovered that the cave network at the falls' headwaters is overrun by vile naga and dark cultists, who plot in the shadows while demonic corruption from neighboring Felwood threatens to seep through the highland bedrock.

subzone:cold-hearth-manor.s: Mansión Fríogar. La Mansión Fríogar es una granja asolada ubicada justo al oeste de Rémol, junto al camino principal de Claros de Tirisfal. Antaño una finca bulliciosa y hospitalaria conocida por sus abundantes cosechas, el brote de la Plaga de la Muerte aniquiló a sus residentes, dejando los campos circundantes plagados de miembros de la Plaga sin mente. En la actualidad, los Renegados han asegurado la casa de campo principal como puesto de avanzada y parada para los viajeros. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, esta granja gozaba de una reputación de calidez y hospitalidad, produciendo ricas cosechas en el corazón de Lordaeron. Cuando la Plaga arrasó el reino, la familia entera y sus trabajadores sucumbieron, alzándose de nuevo como cascarones atados a la Plaga. Aunque los muertos vivientes ferales todavía deambulan por los campos en ruinas, las fuerzas de los Renegados lograron expulsar a los muertos sin mente de la casa de campo principal, recuperando la estructura para que sirviera como puesto comercial y punto de apoyo a lo largo del camino hacia los claros del este.

ang.faction:Horde: The manor offers a secure vantage along the road between Brill and the eastern reaches of Tirisfal, providing a safe waypoint for travelers navigating the plagued countryside.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, reclaiming places like Cold Hearth Manor is a bitter reminder of their lost mortal lives, converting former human sanctuaries into grim defensive outposts against both the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.a: The farmers and workers who tended the estate were completely wiped out when the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron. Rather than finding peace in death, they were raised as mindless zombies that still haunt the surrounding fields.
faq.q: What happened to the people who lived here?

faq.a: The estate originally had a reputation for its warm atmosphere and welcoming fires. The grim moniker was likely adopted by the Forsaken as an ironic nod to its former life, marking how cold, dead, and blighted the farm has become.
faq.q: Why is it called Cold Hearth Manor?

faq.a: The Forsaken have taken control of the primary farmhouse, using it as a safe stop for travelers and traders along the road from Brill. However, the open fields and barns surrounding the manor remain infested with hostile Scourge.
faq.q: Who controls the manor right now?

faq.a: The Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades are stretched thin, fighting off mindless Scourge remnants while warding off Scarlet Crusade crusaders. Securing the farmhouse and main road provides immediate utility, leaving the scattered dead in the fields as a nuisance rather than an immediate threat to Brill.
al: why are there zombies in the fields
faq.q: Why don't the Forsaken clear out the fields?

text.s: Cold Hearth Manor is a blighted farmstead located just west of Brill along the main road of Tirisfal Glades. Once a bustling, hospitable estate known for bountiful crops, the outbreak of the Plague of Undeath wiped out its residents, leaving the surrounding fields choked with mindless Scourge. Today, the Forsaken have secured the main farmhouse as an outpost and waystation for travelers.

sec.b: Before the Third War, this homestead bore a reputation for warmth and hospitality, supporting rich harvests in the heart of Lordaeron. When the Plague swept through the kingdom, the entire family and their laborers succumbed, rising again as husks bound to the Scourge. While feral undead still stumble through the ruined fields, Forsaken forces managed to push the mindless dead out of the main farmhouse, reclaiming the structure to serve as a trading post and foothold along the road toward the eastern glades.

subzone:coldridge-pass.s: Desfiladero de Crestanevada. El Desfiladero de Crestanevada es un túnel escarpado y cubierto de nieve que atraviesa la cordillera montañosa meridional de Dun Morogh. Sirve como la única ruta terrestre que conecta los apartados campos de entrenamiento del Valle de Crestanevada con el resto del reino, desembocando cerca de la bulliciosa villa de Kharanos. Debido a que unos troggs hostiles han invadido el paso, cualquier viajero que intente cruzarlo debe abrirse camino luchando o emprender una carrera desesperada hacia el otro lado. Para los jóvenes reclutas enanos y los novicios gnomos que dan sus primeros pasos más allá del Valle de Crestanevada, el Desfiladero de Crestanevada es un duro rito de iniciación. Cincelado directamente a través de la roca, este túnel constituye el enlace principal que envía a los aventureros recién instruidos hacia el este, con rumbo al núcleo fronterizo de Kharanos. Lo que otrora fuera un corredor de montaña seguro se ha convertido en un peligroso cuello de botella, infestado de agresivos troggs que han emergido desde oscuros subterráneos para amenazar a cualquier alma que intente viajar entre el resguardado valle y las extensiones más amplias de Dun Morogh.

ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarven mountaineers and recruits, traversing Coldridge Pass represents your departure from novice training at Anvilmar into active service across Ironforge's lands.
ang.race:Gnome: Exiled gnomes seeking to aid the Alliance must push through this trogg-infested choke point to reach Kharanos and the higher road toward Ironforge.

faq.a: The pass connects Coldridge Valley in the southwest to the greater region of Dun Morogh, emptying out into the snowy hills just west of the town of Kharanos.
faq.q: Where does Coldridge Pass lead?

faq.a: Troggs have recently surged forth from the deep subterranean cracks beneath Dun Morogh, seizing dark caves and tunnels throughout the region. Coldridge Pass provided them shelter and an easy ambush point against mountain travelers.
faq.q: Why are there troggs in Coldridge Pass?

faq.a: No, it is not safe. The tunnel is swarming with hostile troggs, meaning recruits and travelers must cut their way through the brutes or sprint through the darkness to reach the opposite end.
al: can i walk through coldridge pass
faq.q: Is Coldridge Pass safe to travel through?

faq.a: Mountaineers watch the valley and road exits, but the tunnel interior remains contested and uncleared, leaving individual travelers to defend themselves as they make the crossing.
faq.q: Who guards or maintains the pass?

text.s: Coldridge Pass is a rugged, snowbound tunnel cutting through the southern mountain ridge of Dun Morogh. It serves as the sole overland route connecting the secluded training grounds of Coldridge Valley to the rest of the kingdom, emerging near the bustling town of Kharanos. Because hostile troggs have overrun the passage, any traveler attempting the journey must either fight their way through or make a desperate dash for the other side.

sec.b: For young dwarven recruits and gnome novices taking their first steps beyond Coldridge Valley, Coldridge Pass is a harsh rite of passage. Chiseled straight through the rock, this tunnel forms the primary link sending newly trained adventurers eastward toward the frontier hub of Kharanos. What was once a secure mountain corridor has become a perilous choke point, infested with aggressive troggs that have pushed up from dark sub-terrains to menace any soul trying to travel between the sheltered valley and the wider reaches of Dun Morogh.
sec.t: The Gateway Out of the Valley

faq.a: La única ruta terrestre para salir del valle discurre por el Desfiladero de Crestanevada, un túnel nevado que atraviesa la cordillera hacia el noreste. Una vez cruzado el desfiladero, el camino se dirige hacia el este, directo a la ciudad de Kharanos y en adelante hacia las grandes Puertas de Forjaz.

Tras la trágica caída de Gnomeregan a manos de los troggs y la lluvia radiactiva, los gnomos supervivientes huyeron a Dun Morogh como refugiados. La gente del Manitas Mayor Mekkatorque fue acogida por el Rey Magni Barbabronce, lo que llevó a muchos aprendices gnomos exiliados a entrenar codo con codo con jóvenes enanos en Yunquemar.

El valle se enfrenta a dos amenazas principales: los hostiles trols Peloescarcha, que resienten los asentamientos enanos en su territorio montañoso, y los toscos troggs Quijaroca, que han surgido de las entrañas de la tierra para bloquear el Desfiladero de Crestanevada. Los depredadores locales, como lobos y jabalíes, también hostigan a los viajeros desprevenidos.

Yunquemar es el pabellón fortaleza central y asentamiento del Valle de Crestanevada. Alberga a instructores de clase, maestros de forja y oficiales montaraces locales que coordinan la defensa del valle y preparan a los aventureros recién instruidos para adentrarse en el resto del mundo.

subzone:coldridge-valley.s: Valle de Crestanevada. El Valle de Crestanevada es un valle resguardado y cubierto de nieve, situado en las alturas del suroeste de Dun Morogh. Articulado alrededor de la aldea de Yunquemar, sirve como campo de entrenamiento donde jóvenes enanos y gnomos refugiados toman las armas por primera vez al servicio de Forjaz. Un único túnel, el Desfiladero de Crestanevada, conecta esta hondonada aislada con el resto del reino montañoso. Cobijado por escarpados riscos montañosos, el Valle de Crestanevada permanece prácticamente aislado de las concurridas rutas comerciales de Dun Morogh. En su corazón se encuentra Yunquemar, un robusto salón de piedra y aldea donde veteranos instructores enanos y eruditos gnomos desplazados entrenan a los nuevos reclutas en las artes del combate, el sigilo y la hechicería. Fuera de la calidez de los hogares de Yunquemar, el suelo del valle está cubierto de una espesa capa de nieve y acechado por jabalíes y hambrientos lobos invernales, lo que brinda a los novatos su primera toma de contacto real con la supervivencia en la frontera.

ang.race:Dwarf: As the traditional starting ground for Bronzebeard mountaineers and clerics, the valley represents a dwarf's first steps beyond the hearth and into service of the High Seat.
ang.race:Gnome: For gnome exiles forced from Gnomeregan, the snows of Coldridge Valley offer a safe haven to master their spells and machinery alongside their dwarven hosts.

faq.a: The only overland route out of the valley leads through Coldridge Pass, a snowy tunnel cutting northeast through the mountain ridge. Once through the pass, the road heads east directly toward the town of Kharanos and onward to the great gates of Ironforge.
faq.q: How do you leave Coldridge Valley?

faq.a: Following the tragic fall of Gnomeregan to troggs and radioactive fallout, surviving gnomes fled into Dun Morogh as refugees. High Tinker Mekkatorque's people were welcomed by King Magni Bronzebeard, leading many exiled gnomish apprentices to train side by side with young dwarves in Anvilmar.
faq.q: Why are gnomes starting here alongside dwarves?

faq.a: The valley faces two major menaces: the hostile Frostmane trolls, who resent dwarven settlements on their mountain territory, and crude Rockjaw troggs, who have clawed up from the deep earth to choke Coldridge Pass. Local predators like wolves and boars also harass unwary travelers.
faq.q: What threats are troubling the valley?

faq.a: Anvilmar is the central fortress-lodge and settlement within Coldridge Valley. It houses class trainers, forge-masters, and local mountaineer officers who coordinate the defense of the valley and prepare newly forged adventurers for the wider world.
faq.q: What is Anvilmar?

text.s: Coldridge Valley is a sheltered, snow-covered vale tucked into the southwestern heights of Dun Morogh. Centered around the hamlet of Anvilmar, it serves as the training ground where young dwarves and gnome refugees first take up arms in service of Ironforge. A single tunnel, Coldridge Pass, connects this secluded hollow to the wider mountain realm.

sec.b: Cradled by sheer mountain cliffs, Coldridge Valley remains largely cut off from the bustling trade routes of Dun Morogh. At its heart sits Anvilmar, a sturdy stone hall and hamlet where veteran dwarven instructors and displaced gnome scholars train fresh recruits in the arts of battle, stealth, and sorcery. Outside the warmth of Anvilmar's hearths, the valley floor is carpeted in thick snow and prowled by boars and hungry winter wolves, providing novices with their first real taste of frontier survival.

Despite its isolation, Coldridge Valley faces immediate danger from two relentless enemies. Indigenous Frostmane trolls have established camps like the Frostmane Hovel, skirmishing with mountaineers and defending their ancestral claims against dwarven encroachment. Worse still, savage Rockjaw troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, the natural tunnel linking the valley to Kharanos. Until these subterranean brutes are pushed back, travelers and supplies cannot freely move between the valley and the high seat of Ironforge.

subzone:command-center.s: Centro de Mando. El Centro de Mando, a menudo conocido como el Cuartel de Ventormenta, se alza en el corazón del Casco Antiguo como el cuartel general operativo de los oficiales militares de la ciudad. En tiempos de paz alberga al ejército permanente, pero con las fuerzas de Ventormenta desplegadas en fronteras distantes, actualmente opera con una dotación mínima de veteranos centrada en instruir a los reclutas y a la milicia local. Situado en las desgastadas calles del Casco Antiguo, el Centro de Mando sirve como la guarnición principal y el campo de entrenamiento marcial para el reino de Ventormenta. Aunque normalmente está repleto de infantería regular y oficiales de alto rango, las instalaciones se encuentran inusualmente vacías. Con gran parte del ejército real comprometido en campañas en el extranjero, el cuartel depende de un cuadro de instructores veteranos —incluidos Ander Germaine y el artista marcial Wu Shen— para adiestrar a los nuevos guerreros, mientras figuras como Wulf Hansreim entrenan a tiradores para reforzar las defensas de la ciudad.

ang.class:Hunter: Marksmen visiting Stormwind report to the Command Center to learn techniques from veteran trainers such as Wulf Hansreim.
ang.class:Warrior: The Command Center is the primary hub in Stormwind for warrior training, where veterans like Ander Germaine and Wu Shen hone recruits into disciplined frontline soldiers.

faq.a: Most of Stormwind's standing army has been deployed to distant outposts and foreign battlefields across the world. The Command Center currently maintains only a skeleton crew of seasoned veterans to instruct new recruits and organize local defense.
faq.q: Why is the Command Center so empty?

faq.a: Yes. While officially designated the Command Center, city guards and local residents routinely refer to the building as the Stormwind Barracks when giving directions.
al: are command center and barracks the same
faq.q: Is the Command Center the same as the Stormwind Barracks?

faq.a: Ander Germaine coordinates and trains the city's warriors alongside instructors like Wu Shen and Ilsa Corbin, while Wulf Hansreim oversees hunter and marksman training.
faq.q: Who leads the training here?

faq.a: The Command Center is located in Old Town, situated near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and central to the district's training facilities.
faq.q: Where is the Command Center located?

text.s: The Command Center, often referred to as the Stormwind Barracks, stands in the heart of Old Town as the operational headquarters for the city's military officers. In peacetime, it houses the standing army, but with Stormwind's forces dispatched to distant frontiers, it currently operates with a seasoned skeleton crew focused on drilling recruits and local militia.

sec.b: Situated within the weathered streets of Old Town, the Command Center serves as the primary garrison and martial training ground for the kingdom of Stormwind. Normally packed with regular infantry and ranking officers, the facility is uncharacteristically sparse. With much of the royal army committed to campaigns abroad, the barracks relies on a veteran cadre of instructors—including Ander Germaine and martial artist Wu Shen—to train fresh warriors, while figures like Wulf Hansreim drill marksmen to bolster the city's defenses.

Guards throughout Stormwind often direct newcomers to the 'Barracks' when seeking instruction in heavy arms and tactical combat. The building's proximity to both the Pig and Whistle Tavern and the shadowy operations elsewhere in Old Town makes it an essential anchor of order in a district known for tavern brawls and roguish activity.

subzone:craftsmen-s-terrace.s: Bancal del Artesano. El Bancal del Artesano es el bullicioso distrito artesanal situado en los confines septentrionales de Darnassus. Funciona como el principal centro comercial y manufacturero de la capital de los elfos de la noche, albergando talleres, instructores de profesión y una concurrida posada. El distrito también acoge a representantes externos, incluida una embajada de la facción neutral del Alba Argenta. Extendiéndose por el extremo norte de la ciudad de copas arbóreas, el Bancal del Artesano reúne los diversos oficios que mantienen en funcionamiento a Darnassus. Tallistas de madera, peleteros, alquimistas y otros artesanos gestionan aquí sus talleres, combinando los métodos tradicionales de los elfos de la noche con la artesanía práctica. El distrito también ofrece servicios comunitarios esenciales, como una posada, un maestro de hermandad y vendedores de peticiones de hermandad. Sendos puentes conectan el bancal directamente con el Enclave Cenarion al oeste y con el Bancal del Guerrero al sur.

ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance visitors find the terrace to be one of Darnassus's most welcoming quarters, offering familiar trade supplies, guild administration, and lodging alongside foreign representatives.
ang.race:NightElf: For the kaldorei, the terrace is proof of their society's self-reliance on Teldrassil, blending ancient craftsmanship with the day-to-day needs of their new capital.

faq.a: The district houses most of the city's trade profession trainers, craft supply merchants, an inn, and guild registry services. It serves as the commercial center for travelers looking to learn or practice practical skills in Darnassus.
faq.q: What services are found in the Craftsmen's Terrace?

faq.a: The Argent Dawn maintains an embassy in the district to liaise with the night elves and recruit aid against the Scourge. Their presence offers a diplomatic bridge between the Alliance forces in the west and the war-torn lands of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn present in the Craftsmen's Terrace?

faq.a: The terrace occupies the northern section of Darnassus. You can reach it via bridges leading north from the Warrior's Terrace or east from the Cenarion Enclave.
al: how to get to craftsmen terrace
faq.q: How do you reach the Craftsmen's Terrace?

faq.a: Scholarly volumes rest throughout the workshops, including histories of the War of the Ancients, the aftermath of the Second War, and a study on the Old Gods housed within the Argent Dawn's quarters.
faq.q: What notable books can be found around the workshops?

text.s: The Craftsmen's Terrace is the bustling artisan district situated in the northern reaches of Darnassus. It serves as the primary trade and manufacturing hub for the night elf capital, housing workshops, profession trainers, and a lively inn. The district also hosts external representatives, including an embassy for the neutral Argent Dawn.

sec.b: Spanning the northern edge of the canopy city, the Craftsmen's Terrace gathers the diverse trades that keep Darnassus running. Woodworkers, leathercrafters, alchemists, and other artisans operate their shops here, integrating classic night elven methods with practical craft. The district also provides essential community amenities, including an inn, a guild master, and guild petition vendors. Bridges connect the terrace directly to the Cenarion Enclave to the west and the Warrior's Terrace to the south.

Despite the kaldorei's historic isolation, the Craftsmen's Terrace is home to foreign connections, most notably an embassy established by the Argent Dawn to coordinate with northern allies against the Scourge. Visitors browsing the district's various workshops might also stumble across scattered scholarly volumes, ranging from historical accounts of the War of the Ancients to chronicles detailing the Second War and esoteric treatises on the Old Gods.

subzone:crag-of-the-everliving.s: Risco del Eterno. El Risco del Eterno es una cámara cavernosa cubierta de vegetación enclavada en las profundidades de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Dominada por una flora exuberante y corrupta junto a criaturas vegetales depredadoras, sirve como dominio del Noble del Colmillo Lord Pythas. Sus imponentes niveles superiores albergan a la entidad ancestral que da nombre al risco. Mientras que gran parte de las Cuevas de los Lamentos está excavada en piedra subterránea húmeda, el Risco del Eterno rebosa de una vegetación desmedida y retorcida alimentada por la Pesadilla que corrompe el letargo de Naralex. Imponentes plataformas musgosas y sinuosos senderos están abarrotados de arrastrapiés descarriados: moles vegetales vivientes que merodean por la maleza. Lord Pythas, uno de los discípulos caídos de Naralex, vigila los tramos centrales del risco, habiendo cambiado sus nobles votos druídicos por los ritos venenosos de los Druidas del Colmillo.

ang.class:Druid: Seeing the Crag of the Everliving is a tragic lesson for Cenarion druids, as pure natural vitality and elemental guardianship have been warped into lethal tools of the Nightmare.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The crag's unnaturally lush subterranean atmosphere nourishes rare underground roots and mushrooms that flourish in the humid, dream-soaked soil.

faq.a: The chamber is named after Verdan the Everliving, an ancient and colossal plant beast residing in the highest terraces of the crag. Though once an embodiment of nature's timeless vitality, he has fallen under the sway of the Nightmare that afflicts the caverns.
faq.q: Where does this area get its name?

faq.a: Lord Pythas, one of the primary Fanglords, directly presides over the crag. In the higher ledges above him lurk both Verdan the Everliving and Lord Serpentis, the leader of the Druids of the Fang.
faq.q: Who controls this part of the caverns?

faq.a: The crag is overrun with Deviate Shamblers—shambling plant horrors birthed from the corrupted springs—alongside twisted serpents and the fanatical Druids of the Fang.
faq.q: What creatures are commonly found in the Crag of the Everliving?

faq.a: The underground springs were harnessed by the night elf druid Naralex to rejuvenate the Barrens. When his ritual was snared by the Emerald Nightmare, the wild growth ran rampant and twisted into hostile, aberrant flora.
faq.q: Why is plant life thriving so deep underground?

text.s: The Crag of the Everliving is a verdant cavern chamber nestled deep within the Wailing Caverns. Dominated by lush, corrupted flora and predatory plant creatures, it serves as the domain of the Fanglord Lord Pythas. Its towering upper reaches shelter the ancient entity after whom the crag is named.

sec.b: While much of the Wailing Caverns is carved of damp subterranean stone, the Crag of the Everliving bursts with unruly, twisted vegetation fueled by the Nightmare corrupting Naralex's slumber. Towering mossy platforms and winding paths are choked with Deviate Shamblers—living plant hulks prowling the undergrowth. Lord Pythas, one of Naralex's fallen disciples, watches over the crag's central reaches, having traded his noble druidic vows for the venomous rites of the Druids of the Fang.

The chamber draws its name from Verdan the Everliving, a colossal, primordial plant elemental who resides in the crag's upper heights. Corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare that grips the cavern, Verdan now acts as a fearsome line of defense rather than a peaceful natural guardian. Beyond his towering form lurks Lord Serpentis, the self-proclaimed chief of the Fanglords, who oversees the sect's descent into serpentine madness.

subzone:crossroads.s: El Cruce. El Cruce es el corazón del transporte de la Horda por el centro de Kalimdor, situado donde el Camino del Oro de norte a sur se cruza con la ruta que va desde Trinquete hasta Sierra Espolón. Sirve como un bullicioso puesto comercial, zona de preparación militar y centro de tránsito para los viajeros que se desplazan entre Durotar, Mulgore y los frentes del norte. Fiel a su nombre, El Cruce se asienta justo en la intersección del Camino del Oro y la ruta de este a oeste que cruza desde el puerto goblin de Trinquete hasta Sierra Espolón. A pesar de contar con alojamientos modestos, el puesto funciona como un bullicioso centro neurálgico regional. Maestros de jinetes del viento, comerciantes, herreros e instructores mantienen puestos permanentes bajo sus torres de vigilancia. Para los jóvenes guerreros que viajan desde Durotar o Mulgore, el asentamiento suele ser el primer lugar donde son testigos de la vasta logística en múltiples frentes que une a la nueva Horda.

ang.faction:Alliance: Striking the Crossroads directly cuts off the flow of Horde reinforcements moving between Orgrimmar, Mulgore, and the disputed borders of Ashenvale.
ang.faction:Horde: The Crossroads is the central proving ground and crossroads of your fledgling nation, linking the homelands of the orcs, tauren, and trolls while coordinating supplies across Kalimdor.

faq.a: It anchors the major transit arteries of central Kalimdor. Every traveler moving overland between Durotar, Mulgore, Ratchet, Stonetalon, or Ashenvale must pass through or near the Crossroads, making it the primary hub for logistics and reinforcements.
faq.q: Why is the Crossroads so important to the Horde?

faq.a: Devrak serves as the flight master at the Crossroads, managing the settlement's wind rider roost and connecting travelers directly to outposts across Kalimdor, including Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Who provides flight transport at the Crossroads?

faq.a: Because the Crossroads is central to Horde transit and located within easy striking distance of both Ashenvale to the north and the neutral port of Ratchet to the east, Alliance raiding parties regularly target the outpost to disrupt Horde supply lines.
faq.q: Why does the Alliance attack the Crossroads so frequently?

faq.a: Barrens raptors raided the Crossroads guard tower and made off with a shipment of silver intended to pay the settlement's defending guards, scattering it into the surrounding savannah.
faq.q: What happened to the outpost's payroll silver?

text.s: The Crossroads is the beating heart of Horde travel through central Kalimdor, situated where the north-south Gold Road intersects the path from Ratchet to the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as a bustling trading outpost, military staging area, and transit hub for travelers journeying between Durotar, Mulgore, and northern frontlines.

sec.b: True to its name, the Crossroads sits squarely at the crossing of the Gold Road and the east-west route cutting from the goblin port of Ratchet into the Stonetalon Mountains. Despite having modest lodgings, the outpost functions as a bustling regional hub. Wind rider masters, merchants, blacksmiths, and trainers maintain permanent setups beneath its watchtowers. For young warriors traveling out from Durotar or Mulgore, the settlement is often the first place they witness the vast, multi-front logistics binding the new Horde together.
sec.t: A Vital Junction in the Savannah

sec.b: Maintaining order at the Crossroads is a relentless struggle. Local wildlife—including plains raptors bold enough to plunder payroll silver from the guard towers—poses a persistent nuisance, while harpies, quilboar, and centaur tribes continually pressure the perimeter. Beyond the threats native to the Barrens, the settlement's proximity to neutral Ratchet and the contested forests of Ashenvale makes it a prime target for encroaching Alliance scouting parties, leading to frequent skirmishes just outside its defensive barricades.

subzone:crusader-outpost.s: Avanzada de los Cruzados. La Avanzada de los Cruzados es una torre de vigilancia fortificada situada en lo alto de las escarpadas colinas del este de los Claros de Tirisfal. Guarnecida por celosos miembros de la Cruzada Escarlata, vigila los accesos que conducen hacia su bastión en el Monasterio Escarlata. Desde esta altura, los cruzados observan el tránsito por el camino y están preparados para repeler cualquier incursión de los Renegados. Construida en los riscos que dominan el camino oriental, la Avanzada de los Cruzados sirve como principal estación de alerta temprana para la Cruzada Escarlata. Desde su elevada torre, los centinelas vigilan el movimiento entre Rémol y los confines orientales de Lordaeron, asegurándose de que los no-muertos errantes o los grupos de exploración sean avistados mucho antes de alcanzar las puertas del Monasterio. La torre también otorga a la guarnición la capacidad táctica de flanquear a cualquier fuerza que intente marchar valle arriba hacia su sagrado bastión.

ang.faction:Horde: Navigating the eastern trails of Tirisfal requires caution, as Scarlet sentries atop this hill will swiftly attack anyone traveling toward the Monastery.
ang.race:Undead: This watchtower sits right on the edge of Forsaken territory, serving as a bitter reminder that zealous living crusaders still hold sovereign pockets within the glades.

faq.a: It is a fortified scouting tower held by the Scarlet Crusade in eastern Tirisfal Glades. It monitors the road passing below and protects the southern approach to the Scarlet Monastery.
faq.q: What is the Crusader Outpost?

faq.a: The outpost is manned by zealots of the Scarlet Crusade under the command of Captain Vachon. They view all undead as abominations to be eradicated on sight.
faq.q: Who controls this outpost?

faq.a: Its elevated position offers clear sightlines over the main eastern thoroughfare of Tirisfal Glades. This allows Crusaders to detect Forsaken troop movements early and flank any forces attempting an assault on the Scarlet Monastery.
faq.q: Why is the tower situated in these hills?

faq.a: Yes. The Scarlet Crusade considers all outsiders—particularly the Forsaken and their Horde allies—corrupt enemies who must be purged in holy fire.
faq.q: Will the guards here attack me?

text.s: Crusader Outpost is a fortified watchtower perched atop the rugged hills of eastern Tirisfal Glades. Manned by zealous members of the Scarlet Crusade, it guards the approaches leading toward their stronghold at the Scarlet Monastery. From this height, Crusaders observe travel along the road and stand ready to repel any Forsaken incursion.

sec.b: Built into the bluffs overlooking the eastern road, the Crusader Outpost serves as a primary early-warning station for the Scarlet Crusade. From their elevated tower, sentries watch over movement between Brill and the eastern reaches of Lordaeron, ensuring that wandering undead or scouting parties are spotted long before reaching the Monastery gates. The tower also grants the garrison tactical flanking capability against any force seeking to march up the valley toward their holy bastion.

Under the command of Scarlet officers like Captain Vachon, the garrison stationed here maintains unwavering vigilance. They see the surrounding woods not as sovereign territory of the Forsaken, but as unhallowed soil stolen from humanity by monstrosities. For travelers loyal to the Undercity, the outpost represents an ever-present ambush point where crossbow bolts and cleansing steel await anyone straying too close to the bluffs.
sec.t: A Thorn in the Dark Lady's Side

subzone:crystal-lake.s: Lago de Cristal. El Lago de Cristal es una masa de agua situada justo al este de Villadorada, en el corazón del Bosque de Elwynn. Aunque antaño era un lugar tranquilo, sus costas han sido invadidas por agresivos múrlocs, convirtiéndose en un peligro habitual para los lugareños y los viajeros de paso. Situado a poca distancia a pie de la Posada Orgullo de León, el Lago de Cristal debería ser un idílico retiro rural, pero está plagado de fauna peligrosa. Tribus de múrlocs de agua dulce se han apoderado de la orilla y de los bajíos, atacando a cualquiera que se acerque demasiado. El alquimista local William Mortero contrata con frecuencia a los aventureros que pasan por allí para que se aventuren hasta la orilla del agua, indicándoles que derroten a las criaturas y recolecten las algas de cristal que portan para utilizarlas en sus brebajes experimentales.

ang.faction:Alliance: The murloc infestation so close to Goldshire underscores how thinly stretched the kingdom's military has become in safeguarding its core territories.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The freshwater shallows harbor Crystal Kelp, though it is primarily gathered directly from the resident murlocs who harvest it from the lake bed.

faq.a: Crystal Lake lies directly east of the crossroads town of Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest, easily reached by walking past the outskirts of the village.
faq.q: Where is Crystal Lake located?

faq.a: Like many waterways in Elwynn Forest, Crystal Lake provides a natural freshwater habitat where murlocs can nest and forage. Their numbers have swelled close to Goldshire due to the strained resources of Stormwind's local guard.
faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered at Crystal Lake?

faq.a: The grave marker on the central island reads only 'Deeply missed, never forgotten.' There is no name etched upon the stone, leaving the identity of the person buried there an enduring local mystery.
al: who is buried at crystal lake
faq.q: Whose grave is on the island in the lake?

faq.a: William Pestle, an apothecary working out of Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, contracts adventurers to slay the murlocs along the shore to gather crystal kelp, which he requires for an invisibility potion.
faq.q: What do adventurers need from Crystal Lake?

text.s: Crystal Lake is a body of water lying just east of Goldshire in the heart of Elwynn Forest. While once a peaceful spot, its shores have been overrun by aggressive murlocs, turning it into a frequent hazard for local villagers and passing travelers.

sec.b: Situated within walking distance of Lion's Pride Inn, Crystal Lake should be an idyllic rural retreat, but it is plagued by dangerous wildlife. Tribes of freshwater murlocs have claimed the shoreline and shallow shoals, attacking anyone who strays too close. Local alchemist William Pestle frequently hires passing adventurers to venture to the water's edge, directing them to defeat the creatures and harvest the crystal kelp they carry for use in his experimental concoctions.

Resting quietly in the center of the lake is a tiny, isolated islet. Solitary and overgrown, it bears a simple grave marked with the tender inscription: 'Deeply missed, never forgotten.' The identity of whoever rests beneath the soil remains unrecorded in town ledgers, providing a somber mystery amidst the surrounding croaks of the shoreline murlocs.

subzone:cut-throat-alley.s: Callejón de los Degolladores. Callejón de los Degolladores es un rincón apartado y deshabitado de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, oculto tras las tiendas de los canales. Escondido detrás de un establecimiento llamado La Dama Sombría, cerca del límite con Distrito de los Enanos, consta de un patio tranquilo y una residencia vacía aislada del tránsito habitual de la ciudad. Callejón de los Degolladores es uno de los rincones más silenciosos y reservados de Ventormenta. Aunque técnicamente figura cartografiado junto al Distrito de los Enanos, no comparte en absoluto los rugientes fuegos de las forjas ni el denso hollín de dicho distrito. No se puede acceder al callejón desde ninguna de las avenidas principales de la ciudad; el único paso a pie atraviesa directamente La Dama Sombría, una pequeña tienda situada junto a los canales, justo al sur del puente de la Plaza de la Catedral. Tras la puerta del comercio se halla un pequeño callejón sin salida pavimentado, repleto de cajas apiladas, barriles olvidados y una única residencia desocupada de dos plantas. Completamente oculto a la vista de los guardias que patrullan y de los ciudadanos corrientes, reposa en absoluto silencio en medio del bullicio de la capital.

ang.class:Rogue: Accessible only through the rear door of a shady canal shop, this unpatrolled dead-end offers an ideal hideout for anyone who prefers to stay out of sight of the Stormwind City Guard.

faq.a: Head to the canal front along the edge of the Dwarven District, just south of the footbridge leading to Cathedral Square. Look for a shop named the Shady Lady. Walking straight through the back of this establishment brings you right out into the tucked-away alley.
faq.q: How do you get to Cut-Throat Alley?

faq.a: The outdoor passage shares the broader Dwarven District subzone label on common maps. The name 'Cut-Throat Alley' only reveals itself on your compass once you step inside the empty two-story home at the back of the lot.
al: why does it say dwarven district
faq.q: Why does the map call this the Dwarven District?

faq.a: No. The alley and its lone two-story house are completely abandoned. Aside from stacked cargo crates and empty barrels, there are no residents, shopkeepers, or city watchmen stationed here.
al: who lives in cut throat alley
faq.q: Is anyone living in Cut-Throat Alley?

faq.a: There are no formal duties or civic assignments that lead into the alley. It serves purely as an overlooked, secluded backdrop within the capital.
faq.q: Are there any quests in Cut-Throat Alley?

text.s: Cut-Throat Alley is a secluded, unpopulated back corner of Stormwind City hidden away behind the canal shops. Tucked behind a storefront called the Shady Lady near the Dwarven District border, it consists of a quiet courtyard and an empty residence cut off from normal city foot traffic.

sec.b: Cut-Throat Alley is one of Stormwind's quietest and most secretive corners. Though technically charted alongside the Dwarven District, it shares none of the district's roaring forge fires or heavy soot. The alley cannot be reached from any of the city's main avenues; the only foot path leads straight through the Shady Lady, a small shop lining the canals just south of the bridge from Cathedral Square. Beyond the shop door lies a small paved dead-end lined with stacked crates, forgotten barrels, and a single unoccupied two-story residence. Completely hidden from passing guards and ordinary citizens, it sits entirely silent amidst the bustle of the capital.

subzone:dagger-hills.s: Las Colinas Afiladas. Las Colinas Afiladas forman una escarpada cresta que se alza a lo largo del sur de Páramos de Poniente, justo detrás del pueblo devastado de Arroyo de la Luna. Desatendidas durante mucho tiempo por la corona, estas tierras altas y rocosas sirven como un refugio hostil para degolladores, bandidos y horrores acechantes que amenazan las llanuras circundantes. Elevándose muy por encima del ruinoso asentamiento de Arroyo de la Luna, Las Colinas Afiladas marcan los escarpados confines meridionales de Páramos de Poniente. Desprovistas de patrullas reales oficiales de Ventormenta, estas áridas tierras altas se han convertido en una fortificación natural para la Hermandad Defias. Pendencieros, acechacampos y salteadores de caminos merodean entre las crestas rocosas y los matorrales, emboscando a los viajeros incautos y vigilando los accesos a sus fortalezas más abajo.

ang.faction:Alliance: The hills represent the utter breakdown of law in southern Westfall, where Gryan Stoutmantle's People's Militia must fight to reclaim ground surrendered by Stormwind's absence.
ang.race:Dwarf: The solitary presence of Grimbooze Thunderbrew on this exposed ridge shows the sheer stubbornness of dwarven brewers searching for undisturbed space to perfect their craft.

faq.a: The Dagger Hills form the high, rocky southern border of Westfall, standing directly behind the abandoned settlement of Moonbrook.
al: how to get to dagger hills
faq.q: Where are the Dagger Hills located?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood maintains a heavy presence across the ridge, deploying highwaymen, pathstalkers, and knuckledusters to guard the southern hills.
faq.q: Who controls the Dagger Hills?

faq.a: Grimbooze Thunderbrew has set up his distilling works in these lonely heights to craft his potent dwarven brews, braving bandits and beasts alike in the name of good drink.
faq.q: Why is a dwarf brewing ale out here?

faq.a: Leprithus is an infamous ghoul known to roam the crags of the Dagger Hills, terrifying any travelers or bandits unfortunate enough to run across it in the dark.
faq.q: What is Leprithus?

text.s: The Dagger Hills form a rugged ridge rising across southern Westfall, directly behind the blighted town of Moonbrook. Long neglected by the crown, this rocky highland serves as a hostile hideout for cutthroats, bandits, and creeping terrors that threaten the surrounding plains.

sec.b: Rising high above the dilapidated settlement of Moonbrook, the Dagger Hills mark the jagged southern reaches of Westfall. Stripped of official royal patrols from Stormwind, this arid highland has become a natural fortification for the Defias Brotherhood. Knuckledusters, pathstalkers, and highwaymen lurk among the rocky crests and scrub, ambushing unwary travelers and keeping watch over the approaches to their strongholds below.

Beyond mortal outlaws, the Dagger Hills carry an eerie reputation under cover of darkness. The unsettling specter Leprithus, a wandering ghoul, has been sighted stalking the desolate heights when the sun dips. Aside from wandering outlaws and lingering undead, the only resident willing to brave the ridge is Grimbooze Thunderbrew, a dwarven brewer who sets up his distilling equipment in the rugged wilderness regardless of the nearby dangers.

subzone:darkcloud-pinnacle.s: Cumbre de la Nube Negra. Cumbre de la Nube Negra es un asentamiento tauren fortificado situado sobre varias mesetas interconectadas al este de El Gran Elevador, en Las Mil Agujas. En manos del belicoso clan Tótem Siniestro, esta fortaleza en las alturas sirve como base de operaciones para desestabilizar la región y llevar a cabo turbios negocios. Distribuida a lo largo de tres mesetas principales unidas por puentes de cuerda, Cumbre de la Nube Negra domina la cuenca del cañón que se extiende a sus pies. A las alturas solo se puede acceder mediante una empinada pendiente natural que asciende desde el fondo del cañón cruzando puentes de madera, o a través de un paso elevado cerca de Zahúrda Rajacieno. Desde estas rocas azotadas por el viento, los Tótem Siniestro vigilan el valle, a salvo de asaltos fortuitos y aislados del resto de tribus tauren.

ang.faction:Horde: The Grimtotem occupying this mesa act as hostiles, menacing travelers passing from the Great Lift deeper into Thousand Needles.
ang.race:Tauren: The Grimtotem's treacherous behavior on these mesas stands in stark opposition to the unity and peace Cairne Bloodhoof strives to maintain among the tribes.

faq.a: The stronghold belongs to the Grimtotem clan, an aggressive and reclusive tauren faction openly hostile to most outsiders and deeply suspicious of the Horde.
faq.q: Who controls Darkcloud Pinnacle?

faq.a: The pinnacle can be accessed by climbing a natural ramp up an adjacent mesa from the canyon floor and crossing wooden rope bridges, or via a bridge situated near Razorfen Downs.
al: how to get up darkcloud pinnacle
faq.q: How do you reach Darkcloud Pinnacle?

faq.a: The settlement's operations are overseen by prominent Grimtotem figures, including Arnak Grimtotem and Harb Foulmountain.
faq.q: Who leads the Grimtotem here?

faq.a: The Grimtotem at the pinnacle maintain secret communications with an unknown dark influence, working toward shadowy goals that threaten the stability of Thousand Needles.
al: what is happening at darkcloud pinnacle
faq.q: What are the Grimtotem plotting here?

text.s: Darkcloud Pinnacle is a fortified tauren settlement perched atop several interconnected mesas east of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. Held by the aggressive Grimtotem clan, the aerial stronghold serves as a base of operations for regional disruption and shady dealings.

sec.b: Spanning three main mesas joined by rope bridges, Darkcloud Pinnacle commands the canyon basin below. The heights are accessible only by a steep natural slope leading from the canyon floor across wooden bridges, or via a high crossing near Razorfen Downs. From these windswept rocks, the Grimtotem watch the valley, safe from casual assault and isolated from the broader tauren tribes.

Commanded by leaders such as Arnak Grimtotem and Harb Foulmountain, the settlement is more than a simple outpost. Secret correspondence discovered on the mesa suggests the Grimtotem are actively coordinating with dark and unknown powers, pursuing ambitions far removed from the peace forged by Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

subzone:darkshire-town-hall.s: ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura. ayuntamiento de Villa Oscura se alza en el extremo occidental de la plaza del pueblo como la sede del gobierno local en el Bosque del Ocaso. Desde el interior de estas salas tenuemente iluminadas, el alcalde Lord Ello Cerranegro y su consejo intentan administrar un asentamiento asediado por una oscuridad insidiosa y monstruosidades no-muertas. Ubicado directamente al oeste de la plaza principal del pueblo, el ayuntamiento es el lugar donde los líderes cívicos de Villa Oscura se reúnen para gobernar un territorio cada vez más aislado. Entre sus muros desgastados se encuentra el alcalde Lord Ello Cerranegro, quien lucha por preservar el orden civil y proteger a la población mientras Ventormenta ofrece muy poca ayuda militar. Junto al alcalde, funcionarios municipales como el dependiente Daltry trabajan para llevar el registro local y seguir la pista de los viajeros que desafían los peligrosos caminos del Bosque del Ocaso, aunque mantener los libros al día es una tarea sombría y difícil en tiempos tan aciagos.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers, the Town Hall represents the fragile authority of the kingdom's southern frontiers, showing how thin Stormwind's protection stretches in isolated settlements.

faq.a: Lord Ello Ebonlocke serves as the Mayor of Darkshire and presides over the town council from inside the Town Hall. He directs local defenses and appeals to visiting adventurers for help, as the town receives virtually no reinforcements from the kingdom's capital.
al: who is in the town hall
faq.q: Who leads the town from this building?

faq.a: Clerk Daltry maintains town registries documenting the residents and the travelers passing through Darkshire. Due to the chaos and frequent dangers plaguing Duskwood, many of his logs and records have fallen somewhat out of date.
faq.q: What records are kept inside the Town Hall?

faq.a: With Duskwood cut off from direct military support from Stormwind, the Town Hall functions as the operational hub for the Night Watch and local authorities. It is where the council coordinates civilian defense and dispatches aid across the shadowy region.
al: why does the town hall matter
faq.q: Why is the Town Hall so important to Duskwood's survival?

text.s: Darkshire Town Hall stands on the western edge of the town square as the seat of local governance in Duskwood. From inside these dimly lit halls, Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke and his council attempt to administer a settlement besieged by creeping darkness and undead monstrosities.

sec.b: Located directly west of the main town square, the Town Hall is where Darkshire's civic leadership gathers to govern an increasingly isolated territory. Within its weathered walls sits Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke, struggling to preserve civil order and protect the populace while Stormwind offers little in the way of military aid. Alongside the mayor, municipal officials like Clerk Daltry work to track local records and the travelers braving Duskwood's dangerous roads, though keeping ledgers current is a grim and challenging task in such perilous times.

subzone:darkspear-strand.s: Playa de Lanza Negra. Playa de Lanza Negra es el tramo de costa en el sur de Durotar donde los trols de Lanza Negra llegaron a la orilla tras su exilio de las Islas del Eco. Situada justo al lado de Poblado Sen'jin, esta playa marca el amargo comienzo del refugio de la tribu en el continente bajo el liderazgo de Vol'jin. Cuando el médico brujo Zalazane enloqueció y tomó el control de las Islas del Eco, los trols de Lanza Negra supervivientes se vieron obligados a abandonar su hogar insular. Los refugiados, desesperados, cruzaron las estrechas aguas y desembarcaron a lo largo de esta costa blanqueada por el sol. En lugar de dispersarse por los hostiles páramos rojos de Durotar, los supervivientes se unieron a escasos metros tierra adentro desde la costa para construir Poblado Sen'jin. Hoy en día, la playa sirve como un silencioso recordatorio de su desplazamiento, con vistas al oleaje hacia las islas que aún esperan recuperar.

ang.faction:Horde: The strand marks the southern coast where the Darkspear cemented their place on the Kalimdor mainland beside their Orc allies after losing their island settlement.
ang.race:Troll: For Darkspear trolls, stepping onto this shore carries the sting of Zalazane's betrayal and the bittersweet memory of escaping with their lives to found Sen'jin Village.

faq.a: This coastline is where the Darkspear trolls made landfall after fleeing the Echo Isles. When Zalazane turned his dark magic against his own people, the survivors evacuated across the water and came ashore here, immediately gathering nearby to establish Sen'jin Village.
al: why is it called darkspear strand
faq.q: What happened at Darkspear Strand?

faq.a: The witch doctor Zalazane betrayed his kin and used dark voodoo to enslave the minds of his fellow tribesfolk. Chief Vol'jin led the remaining uncorrupted Darkspear off the islands to escape total subjugation, landing on this strand.
al: why did trolls leave echo isles
faq.q: Why did the Darkspear leave the Echo Isles?

faq.a: Sen'jin Village sits just yards inland from the beach. It was established by the refugees immediately after landing on the strand and serves as the primary Darkspear outpost and spiritual center in Durotar.
faq.q: What settlement is located next to Darkspear Strand?

text.s: Darkspear Strand is the stretch of coastline in southern Durotar where the Darkspear trolls washed ashore following their exile from the Echo Isles. Located directly beside Sen'jin Village, this beach marks the bitter beginning of the tribe's mainland refuge under Vol'jin's leadership.

sec.b: When the witch doctor Zalazane went mad and seized control of the Echo Isles, the surviving Darkspear trolls were forced to abandon their offshore home. Desperate refugees crossed the narrow waters and landed along this sun-bleached coast. Rather than scatter into the hostile red wastes of Durotar, the survivors banded together just yards inland from the shoreline to construct Sen'jin Village. Today, the strand serves as a quiet reminder of their displacement, looking out across the surf toward the islands they still hope to reclaim.

subzone:dawning-isles.s: Islas del Alba. Las Islas del Alba son un grupo de islotes bajos situados en el Lago Lordamere, a lo largo del extremo oriental de Bosque de Argénteos. En su día fueron retiros idílicos, pero han sucumbido al añublo de la Plaga de la No-Muerte y están invadidos por agresivos múrlocs. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, las Islas del Alba eran conocidas como pintorescos cayos que reposaban sobre las aguas tranquilas y cristalinas del Lago Lordamere. Cuando la Plaga de la No-Muerte arrasó Lordaeron, la corrupción se filtró en los bajíos del lago. La vegetación se volvió pálida y putrefacta, desvaneciendo su idílica tranquilidad. Hoy en día, la tribu de múrlocs Vile Fin domina las orillas enfangadas y la maleza enmarañada, defendiendo con agresividad sus florecientes colonias de cualquiera que intente cruzar el lago.

ang.faction:Alliance: The blighted islands serve as a grim reminder of how far the corruption of the Scourge reached into Lordaeron's most scenic waters.
ang.race:Undead: The blighted Dawning Isles lie on Lordamere Lake, within sight of the western approaches to the Undercity, and the Vile Fin murlocs that hold them grow more numerous each year.

faq.a: The Dawning Isles are located in Lordamere Lake, bordering the eastern boundary of Silverpine Forest and resting just west of the Ruins of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Where are the Dawning Isles located?

faq.a: The islands are primarily infested by the Vile Fin tribe of murlocs, which thrives along the corrupted shorelines. In the past, dangerous bog beasts also prowled the islets, though they have largely vanished in favor of the teeming murloc population.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Dawning Isles?

faq.a: The islands were tainted during the Third War when the Plague of Undeath swept Lordaeron. The water and soil absorbed the blight, poisoning the vegetation and leaving the islets murky, sickly, and decayed.
faq.q: Why are the trees and shores rotting here?

text.s: The Dawning Isles are a cluster of low-lying islets situated within Lordamere Lake along the eastern edge of Silverpine Forest. Once idyllic retreats, they have succumbed to the blight of the Plague of Undeath and are overrun by aggressive murlocs.

sec.b: Before the Third War, the Dawning Isles were known as scenic keys resting on the calm, clear waters of Lordamere Lake. When the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron, corruption seeped into the lake's shallows. The vegetation turned pallid and rotting, driving away idyllic peacefulness. Today, the Vile Fin murloc tribe dominates the muddy shores and tangled brush, aggressively defending their burgeoning colonies from anyone seeking to traverse the lake.

Murlocs were not always the only danger on the isles. Bog beasts once prowled the blighted islets alongside them, but the bog beasts have since vanished. In their absence the Vile Fin population has swelled to the point that the murlocs now control the isles outright, turning what was once a quiet chain of keys into their stronghold on Lordamere Lake.

subzone:dawning-wood-catacombs.s: Catacumbas del Bosque Aurora. Talladas en las profundidades del Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo, las Catacumbas del Bosque Aurora son un oscuro laberinto repleto de los no-muertos más feroces de Bosque del Ocaso. Quienes se atreven a adentrarse en los túneles subterráneos se enfrentan a enjambres atrincherados de guardianes esqueléticos y necrófagos devoradores de carne. Mucho antes de que la maldición crepuscular se asentara sobre el bosque, las Catacumbas del Bosque Aurora servían como un gran lugar de descanso para los difuntos ilustres de Grand Hamlets y las granjas circundantes. Ahora sepultados bajo las ruinas del Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo, estos oscuros pasillos de piedra albergan a los no-muertos más letales de la región. Las catacumbas cuentan con dos alas subterráneas distintas: los pasadizos occidentales están ocupados por hileras de esqueletos reanimados que custodian tumbas ancestrales, mientras que los orientales descienden hacia una fétida madriguera atestada de necrófagos voraces y portadores de enfermedades. Los viajeros solitarios rara vez sobreviven en sus profundidades.

ang.class:Paladin: The catacombs are a grim testament to the fallen of the kingdom, demanding that the holy wrath of the Light cleanse the desecrated tombs.
ang.class:Priest: Beneath the stone vaults of Raven Hill, restless spirits and decaying corpses cry out for final rest, making the catacombs a somber trial of faith.

faq.a: The catacombs lie directly beneath Raven Hill Cemetery, on the far western edge of Duskwood. Entrances descend from the surface among the sprawling grave markers and ruined crypts.
faq.q: Where are the Dawning Wood Catacombs located?

faq.a: The catacombs harbor the most concentrated and ferocious undead in Duskwood. The western wing is defended by heavily armed skeletal warriors, while the eastern tunnels are infested with savage, plague-ridden ghouls.
al: what is in dawning wood catacombs
faq.q: What lurks inside the catacombs?

faq.a: Back when the region was still the verdant Brightwood, the catacombs were excavated as a grand burial vault for local families and luminaries. The dark curse that later engulfed the woods reanimated those entombed within.
faq.q: Why were the catacombs built in the first place?

faq.a: Venturing into the catacombs alone is perilous. The claustrophobic tunnels offer little room to retreat, and the undead pack tightly together in aggressive swarms capable of overwhelming isolated travelers.
faq.q: Is it safe to explore the catacombs alone?

text.s: Carved deep beneath Raven Hill Cemetery, the Dawning Wood Catacombs are a dark labyrinth teeming with the fiercest undead in Duskwood. Those who brave the subterranean tunnels face entrenched swarms of skeletal guardians and flesh-eating ghouls.

sec.b: Long before the twilight curse settled over the forest, the Dawning Wood Catacombs served as a grand resting place for the honored dead of Grand Hamlets and the surrounding homesteads. Now buried beneath the ruined Raven Hill Cemetery, these dark stone corridors hold the most lethal undead in the region. The catacombs feature two distinct subterranean wings: the western passages are held by ranks of animated skeletons guarding ancestral tombs, while the eastern passages descend into a foul warren overrun by ravenous, disease-bearing ghouls. Lone travelers rarely survive deep within their depths.

subzone:dead-acre.s: El Campo Funesto. El Campo Funesto es una granja en ruinas que todavía humea en el sureste de Páramos de Poniente, cerca del puente sobre el río hacia Bosque del Ocaso. Reducidos a cenizas por la Hermandad Defias durante su levantamiento por toda la región, sus campos ennegrecidos están ahora desiertos de vida humana y acechados por gólems de la cosecha rebeldes. Situado justo al norte del camino que une Colina del Centinela con Bosque del Ocaso, El Campo Funesto fue antaño una próspera hacienda entre los fértiles campos de Páramos de Poniente. Cuando la Hermandad Defias se alzó en armas y expulsó a los terratenientes locales, esta granja encontró un final violento. La vivienda y los cultivos circundantes fueron reducidos a cenizas, dejando tras de sí maderos carbonizados, tierra humeante y Vigías de la cosecha mecánicos que siguen cosechando sin descanso el suelo estéril.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Dead Acre stands as a grim reminder of Stormwind's neglect in Westfall, leaving loyal farmers defenseless against the violent depredations of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood burned the farmstead and its surrounding fields to the ground when taking control of Westfall. The farm earned its grim name from the blackened ruins and smoldering earth left in their wake.
faq.q: Why is this place called the Dead Acre?

faq.a: Like many farms across Westfall, the mechanical reapers built to tend the crops were left behind when the settlers fled or died. Corrupted or left without caretakers, the automated Harvest Watchers continue to endlessly patrol the burned-out fields, attacking anyone who draws near.
faq.q: Why are mechanical Harvest Watchers wandering here?

faq.a: The Dead Acre sits in southeastern Westfall, nestled just north of the main road near the bridge that crosses into the shadowed borders of Duskwood.
faq.q: Where is the Dead Acre located?

text.s: The Dead Acre is a ruined, smoldering farmstead in southeastern Westfall near the river bridge to Duskwood. Burned to ash by the Defias Brotherhood during their uprising across the countryside, the blackened fields are now abandoned by people and stalked by rogue harvest golems.

sec.b: Situated just north of the road linking Sentinel Hill to Duskwood, the Dead Acre was once a productive homestead among the breadbasket farms of Westfall. When the Defias Brotherhood rose in revolt and drove out the local landowners, this farm met a violent end. The homestead and its surrounding crops were put to the torch, leaving behind scorched timber, smoking earth, and wandering mechanical Harvest Watchers that still reap the barren soil.

subzone:dead-field.s: El Campo Muerto. El Campo Muerto es una granja abandonada y asolada situada en el norte del Bosque de Argénteos. Antaño una tranquila tierra de labranza rural, ha sido tomada por los gnolls Putrepellejo y convertida en una base avanzada para las fuerzas de la Plaga. Los repetidos intentos de los Renegados por despejar la zona han fracasado bajo el mando de la banshee Nightlash. Poco queda de la granja original en los confines septentrionales del Bosque de Argénteos, pues sus antiguos ocupantes vivos sucumbieron hace mucho a la Tercera Guerra. Hoy en día, la parcela en ruinas sirve como base de operaciones para los gnolls Putrepellejo, que actúan como devotos sirvientes de la Plaga. A medida que su número aumentaba, los exploradores Mortacechadores que pasaban por la región detectaron indicios de una inminente movilización militar que amenazaba las líneas de suministro y los puestos avanzados de los Renegados. Pequeños asaltos de los Renegados contra la granja han fracasado repetidamente, repelidos por la aullante aparición Nightlash, una banshee que se manifiesta cada vez que sus esclavos gnolls se ven en peligro.

ang.class:Rogue: Deathstalker recon teams monitor the farm closely; infiltrating the gnoll ranks and striking their command structure is a critical tactical priority.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, the Scourge foothold at the Dead Field poses an immediate threat to the road between the Sepulcher and northern Lordaeron, demanding swift extermination.

faq.a: The Dead Field is a decrepit, blighted farmstead located in northern Silverpine Forest. Once an ordinary human farm, it has fallen into ruin and is now occupied by Scourge-aligned Rot Hide gnolls.
faq.q: What is the Dead Field?

faq.a: These Rot Hide gnolls are under the sway of the Scourge. They use the farmstead as a forward staging ground to gather forces and prepare attacks against Forsaken positions in northern Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Why are there gnolls at the farm?

faq.a: Nightlash is a Scourge banshee commanding the Rot Hide gnolls at the farm. Whenever Forsaken strike forces assault the encampment, she materializes to defend her servants, repelling previous attempts to reclaim the land.
faq.q: Who is Nightlash?

faq.a: The encampment answers to Thule Ravenclaw, a powerful necromancer operating from nearby Fenris Isle. He coordinates the gnolls through apparitions and magical oversight to harass Forsaken expansion.
faq.q: Who commands the Scourge forces here?

text.s: The Dead Field is a blighted, abandoned farmstead situated in northern Silverpine Forest. Once quiet rural farmland, it has been seized by the Rot Hide gnolls and transformed into a forward staging ground for Scourge forces. Repeated Forsaken attempts to clear the area have faltered under the command of the banshee Nightlash.

sec.b: Little remains of the original farmstead in the northern reaches of Silverpine Forest, its previous living occupants long lost to the Third War. Today, the ruined plot serves as a base of operations for the Rot Hide gnolls, who act as willing servants to the Scourge. As their numbers swelled, Deathstalker scouts passing through the region noted signs of imminent military mobilization threatening Forsaken supply lines and outposts. Small Forsaken assaults against the farm have repeatedly failed, turned back by the wailing apparition Nightlash—a banshee who manifests whenever her gnoll thralls are endangered.

The Rot Hide gnolls do not act alone. Their operations in the Dead Field are orchestrated from afar by the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, based out of Fenris Isle. Intending to assert Scourge dominance over Silverpine and drive Sylvanas's forces out of Lordaeron, Ravenclaw projects magical apparitions to the farmstead to survey his undead horde and issue warnings to Forsaken intruders.

subzone:deadeye-shore.s: Costa de Mortojo. Costa de Mortojo es un tramo de costa azotado por el viento en el extremo oriental de Durotar, directamente al este de Barranco Árido.
