Nombrada en memoria del legendario caudillo de Bleeding Hollow, Kilrogg Deadeye, por sus áridas arenas merodean principalmente rapaces salvajes, escórpidos y jabalíes ferales. Extendiéndose bajo los riscos rojos del centro de Durotar, Costa de Mortojo toma su nombre de Kilrogg Deadeye, el caudillo tuerto del clan Bleeding Hollow que luchó en la Primera y Segunda Guerra. Desde las alturas, la arena y los afloramientos rocosos recuerdan levemente la forma de una calavera a la que le falta una cuenca ocular. Aunque carece de asentamientos importantes o puestos militares, la costa dista mucho de ser pacífica: la fauna agresiva domina las arenas, y se sabe que siniestros cultores de Filo Ardiente bajan hacia el agua desde sus escondites cercanos en los barrancos.

ang.race:Orc: For orcs establishing their new nation in Durotar, the shore honors Kilrogg Deadeye, reminding them of the old chieftains who shaped the Horde's history during the wars on Azeroth.

faq.a: The shoreline is named after Kilrogg Deadeye, the famed chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow clan. The natural coastal terrain also resembles a skull missing an eye, echoing the chieftain's own blinded socket.
faq.q: Why is it called Deadeye Shore?

faq.a: No permanent settlements stand on Deadeye Shore. The stretch of coast is inhabited primarily by native wildlife like raptors, scorpids, and boars, though fishermen and travelers occasionally pass through—sometimes running afoul of hidden Burning Blade cultists.
faq.q: Who lives along Deadeye Shore?

faq.a: Beyond aggressive local beasts, the greatest danger comes from the neighboring Drygulch Ravine. Cultists belonging to the Burning Blade occasionally wander down from the rocky canyons toward the coast, ambushing unwary travelers and fishermen.
faq.q: What threats are found around Deadeye Shore?

text.s: Deadeye Shore is a windswept stretch of coastline along Durotar's eastern edge, directly east of Drygulch Ravine. Named in memory of the legendary Bleeding Hollow chieftain Kilrogg Deadeye, the barren sands are roamed primarily by wild raptors, scorpids, and feral boars.

sec.b: Stretching beneath the red bluffs of central Durotar, Deadeye Shore takes its name from Kilrogg Deadeye, the one-eyed chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow clan who fought in the First and Second Wars. From high above, the sand and rocky outcrops faintly mirror the shape of a skull with a missing eye socket. While lacking major settlements or military outposts, the shoreline is far from peaceful: aggressive wildlife dominates the sands, and shadowy cultists from the Burning Blade have been known to prowl down toward the water from their nearby hideouts in the ravines.
sec.t: A Shoreline of the Bleeding Hollow

faq.a: No todos los cadáveres levantados tras la Tercera Guerra se liberaron con la mente intacta. La plaza del pueblo y la forja del norte están infestadas por los «Descerebrados»: zombis salvajes, necrófagos y esqueletos aún impulsados por la voluntad residual y persistente de la Plaga. Los defensores renegados los eliminan periódicamente para recuperar equipo y defender la iglesia.

Un destacamento de la Cruzada Escarlata mantiene un campamento en las colinas al sureste de la aldea. Dedicados con fanatismo a destruir a todos los no-muertos indiscriminadamente, vigilan el paso, emboscan a los Renegados recién despertados e intercambian información de reconocimiento con las fortalezas escarlata de otras partes de Lordaeron.

Hoya Nocturácnidas, la mina de oro situada en los riscos al noroeste de la aldea, está completamente invadida por arañas agresivas. Asegurar recursos naturales como el oro es fundamental para el esfuerzo bélico de los Renegados, pero hasta que no se erradique la plaga, el asentamiento no puede explotar la veta.

subzone:deathknell.s: Camposanto. Camposanto es una aldea fortificada enclavada en un valle apartado al suroeste de Claros de Tirisfal. Sirve como el principal lugar de despertar para los no-muertos recién liberados que se zafan del yugo del Rey Exánime para unirse a los Renegados. Asediado por restos descerebrados de la Plaga, fanáticos locales y una fauna agresiva, el asentamiento es un duro campo de pruebas para quienes reclaman un lugar en el reino de Sylvanas Brisaveloz. Escondido tras colinas escarpadas justo al norte de la frontera con Silverpine, Camposanto es donde los no-muertos recién despertados abren por primera vez los ojos a su sombría realidad. A diferencia de la mayoría de los asentamientos de Claros de Tirisfal, que conservaron sus nombres humanos del caído Reino de Lordaeron, Camposanto fue rebautizado de forma explícita por los no-muertos que lo reclamaron. El pueblo en sí está dividido en dos: los Renegados se aferran tenazmente a los terrenos del sur alrededor de la vieja iglesia, mientras que la mitad norte, incluida la forja de la aldea, permanece invadida por zombis descerebrados de la Plaga y necrófagos salvajes. Guardianes de la muerte de élite mantienen el estrecho desfiladero fuera del valle firmemente sellado contra intrusos, lo que permite a los cuidadores locales incorporar a los recién llegados al servicio de la Reina Alma en Pena.

ang.faction:Horde: Though isolated and dark, this valley is the gateway to the Forsaken kingdom, supplying fresh soldiers to bolster the Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
ang.race:Undead: Every Forsaken adventurer begins here, rising from the cold earth of the Shadow Grave to find purpose and shelter under Lady Sylvanas after the horror of the Plague.

faq.a: Deathknell was renamed after it became an undead settlement, unlike most communities in Tirisfal that retained their human names. The reason for the new name is unknown.
faq.q: Why was the town renamed Deathknell?

faq.a: Not every corpse raised in the wake of the Third War broke free with their minds intact. The northern village square and forge are infested by the 'Mindless Ones'—feral zombies, ghouls, and skeletons still driven by the residual, lingering will of the Scourge. Forsaken defenders regularly clear them out to salvage equipment and defend the church.
faq.q: Why is the northern half of the town overrun by undead?

faq.a: A detachment of the Scarlet Crusade maintains an encampment in the hills southeast of the village. Fanatically dedicated to destroying all undead indiscriminately, they monitor the pass, ambush newly awakened Forsaken, and exchange scouting intelligence with Scarlet strongholds elsewhere in Lordaeron.
faq.q: What is the Scarlet Crusade doing near Deathknell?

faq.a: Night Web's Hollow, the gold mine situated in the cliffs northwest of the village, is completely overrun by aggressive spiders. Securing natural resources like gold is critical for the Forsaken war effort, but until the infestation is cleared, the settlement cannot exploit the vein.
faq.q: Why can't the Forsaken use the local gold mine?

text.s: Deathknell is a fortified village nestled in a secluded valley in southwestern Tirisfal Glades. It serves as the primary awakening grounds for newly freed undead breaking free from the Lich King's grasp to join the Forsaken. Besieged by mindless Scourge remnants, local zealots, and aggressive wildlife, the settlement is a harsh proving ground for those claiming a place in Sylvanas Windrunner's kingdom.

sec.b: Tucked away behind jagged hills just north of the Silverpine border, Deathknell is where newly awakened undead first open their eyes to their bleak reality. Unlike most settlements in Tirisfal Glades that preserved their human names from the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, Deathknell was explicitly renamed by the undead who claimed it. The town itself is cleaved in two: the Forsaken cling stubbornly to the southern grounds around the old church, while the northern half—including the village forge—remains overrun by mindless Scourge zombies and feral ghouls. Elite Deathguards keep the narrow gorge out of the valley securely sealed against intruders, allowing local caretakers to induct new arrivals into the Banshee Queen's service.

Survival in Deathknell is precarious. To the northwest, Night Web's Hollow—a gold mine vital for the Forsaken's fledgling economy—has been lost to monstrous spiders. To the southeast, an aggressive encampment of the Scarlet Crusade maintains constant watch, trading couriers with their strongholds to the east and probing the valley's defenses. Meanwhile, the village caretakers must continually fight off the mindless undead wandering the northern ruins while gathering scrap metal, tools, and supplies to equip newly arisen souls for the long road ahead.

subzone:decrepit-ferry.s: El Viejo Embarcadero. El Viejo Embarcadero es un muelle en ruinas en la orilla oriental del Bosque de Argénteos que antaño permitía cruzar el Lago Lordamere hacia la Isla de Fenris. Tras la caída de Lordaeron, el transbordador fue destruido, su barquero asesinado y la costa invadida por no-muertos y despiadados gnolls Putrapiel. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, este muelle bullía con el tráfico diario a través del Lago Lordamere. Los granjeros locales llevaban productos frescos hasta la orilla, vendiendo sus cosechas directamente al acaudalado señor de la Isla de Fenris y a su séquito. Por una módica tarifa, el barquero transportaba mercancías, mensajeros y nobles de visita de un lado a otro entre tierra firme y el torreón. Ese comercio pacífico terminó abruptamente cuando la Plaga arrasó el reino. El barquero fue asesinado brutalmente, las barcas quedaron destrozadas y el embarcadero cayó en la decadencia.

ang.race:Undead: The ruins are a grim reminder of Lordaeron's fall, now overrun by mind-numbing Scourge remnants and filthy gnolls that threaten Forsaken operations in eastern Silverpine.

faq.a: It was the main crossing point between mainland Silverpine and Fenris Isle. Local farmers used the ferry to haul their harvests across Lordamere Lake to sell to the island's noble lord, paying the local ferryman a small fare for each voyage.
al: why is there a ferry here
faq.q: What was the Decrepit Ferry used for originally?

faq.a: When the Scourge invaded Lordaeron, the dock was attacked. The ferryman was murdered, the boats and crossing gear were destroyed, and the location was abandoned to the undead.
faq.q: What happened to the ferry and its ferryman?

faq.a: The shoreline is infested with remnants of the Scourge, including ghouls and skeletal warriors, alongside dangerous Rot Hide gnolls prowling the nearby banks.
faq.q: What monsters lurk around the ferry docks now?

faq.a: No. The ferry was wrecked during the invasion and lies in ruins. Anyone wishing to reach Fenris Isle must swim or find alternative passage across the lake.
al: how to get to fenris isle
faq.q: Can you still take a boat to Fenris Isle from here?

text.s: The Decrepit Ferry is a ruined dock on the eastern shore of Silverpine Forest that once provided passage across Lordamere Lake to Fenris Isle. Following the fall of Lordaeron, the ferry was destroyed, its operator murdered, and the shoreline overrun by undead and vicious Rot Hide gnolls.

sec.b: Before the Third War, this dock bustled with daily traffic across Lordamere Lake. Local farmers brought fresh produce down to the water, selling their crops directly to the wealthy lord of Fenris Isle and his household. For a modest fee, the ferryman carried trade goods, messengers, and visiting nobles back and forth between the mainland and the keep. That peaceful commerce ended abruptly when the Scourge swept through the kingdom. The ferryman was brutally killed, the boats were smashed, and the pier fell into decay.

Today, the docks are a hazard to any traveler passing along the lake shore. With the ferry out of commission, Fenris Isle sits isolated across the water, while the ruins themselves crawl with ghouls, skeletal warriors, and roving Rot Hide gnolls. What was once an orderly point of transit has become another festering pocket of danger in Silverpine.

subzone:deep-elem-mine.s: Mina de Elem. Mina de Elem es un lugar de excavación enclavado en el corazón de Bosque de Argénteos. En su día fue una explotación activa, pero quedó arrasada cuando la magia oscura del Archimago Arugal barrió la región, transformando a sus mineros en salvajes huargen. Situada en el centro de Bosque de Argénteos, Mina de Elem sirvió antaño a los habitantes vivos de Lordaeron como un filón ordinario de recursos. Cuando el Archimago Arugal desató la pesadilla lupina sobre el bosque, su maldición feral se extendió hasta las profundidades de los túneles. Los peones del interior sucumbieron a la aflicción, convirtiéndose en feroces huargen que abandonaron sus picos para reclamar la caverna como una guarida depredadora.

ang.profession:Mining: Though currently hazardous due to the feral pack residing within, the mine represents one of Silverpine's richest subterranean mineral deposits.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, securing the mine is both an economic necessity and a direct mandate from the Sepulcher to break Arugal's encroaching grip on central Silverpine.

faq.a: The mine is infested with hostile worgen afflicted by Archmage Arugal's magic. They are led by their former human foreman, Grimson the Pale, who now rules the pack deep within the tunnels.
al: who lives in deep elem mine
faq.q: What is inside Deep Elem Mine?

faq.a: The Forsaken seek to exploit the mine's natural mineral wealth to bolster their war efforts in Lordaeron. Dalar Dawnweaver and the leadership at the Sepulcher intend to claim its resources in the name of Dreadlord Varimathras once the worgen are eradicated.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Deep Elem Mine cleared?

faq.a: Grimson was originally the mortal foreman overseeing operations at Deep Elem Mine. After Arugal's feral curse transformed the workers, Grimson became a cunning worgen alpha who retained enough intellect to command the pack inhabiting the mine.
faq.q: Who is Grimson the Pale?

faq.a: They were not outsiders who moved in; the original miners were transformed by the spread of Archmage Arugal's curse across Silverpine Forest, turning the workforce into monsters where they worked.
al: why are there worgen in the mine
faq.q: How did the worgen get into the mine?

text.s: Deep Elem Mine is an excavation site nestled in the heart of Silverpine Forest. Once an active operation, it was overrun when Archmage Arugal's dark magic swept through the region, transforming its miners into savage worgen.

sec.b: Situated central to Silverpine Forest, the Deep Elem Mine once served the living inhabitants of Lordaeron as an ordinary resource vein. When Archmage Arugal unleashed the lupine nightmare upon the forest, his feral curse spread deep into the tunnels. The laborers inside succumbed to the affliction, turning into vicious worgen who abandoned their pickaxes to claim the cavern as a predatory lair.

The pack within the mine is commanded by Grimson the Pale, the former mine foreman who retained his cunning even after his monstrous transformation. Recognizing the strategic value of the tunnels and their ore, the Forsaken at the Sepulcher take a keen interest in reclaiming the site. Under orders backed by the authority of Dreadlord Varimathras, Forsaken agents seek to sever Grimson's head and purge the beasts so the Horde can secure the mine's wealth.

subzone:deeprun-tram.s: Tren subterráneo. El Tren subterráneo es una maravilla subterránea de la ingeniería gnoma que une las capitales de la Alianza de Forjaz y Ciudad de Ventormenta. Encargado por el Rey Magni Barbabronce tras la Segunda Guerra, permite a ciudadanos y soldados recorrer grandes distancias bajo tierra en cuestión de minutos. Las vías dobles cerradas atraviesan montañas y lagos subterráneos, sirviendo como una arteria vital para el comercio y el apoyo militar de la Alianza. Tras la devastación de la Segunda Guerra, el Rey Magni Barbabronce se sentía cada vez más frustrado por la lentitud con la que la ayuda enana y los suministros de construcción llegaban a Ventormenta a través de los pasos montañosos. Para solventar este obstáculo logístico y garantizar que los soldados enanos pudieran reforzar rápidamente la capital humana en tiempos de crisis, Magni recurrió al Manitas Mayor Gelbin Mekkatorque. El maestro ingeniero gnomo trazó los planos de un ferrocarril subterráneo cerrado impulsado por tecnología puntera. A pesar de las complicaciones durante la excavación —que incluyeron atravesar un inmenso lago subterráneo y lidiar con incesantes plagas de ratas de las profundidades—, el tren se convirtió en uno de los mayores logros de la Alianza, transportando gratis a miles de viajeros entre Forjaz y Ventormenta.

ang.faction:Alliance: The tram serves as the primary strategic artery connecting the Alliance's two most fortified capitals, allowing for rapid troop redeployment and mutual defense within minutes.
ang.profession:Engineering: The entire railway is an unparalleled gnomish masterpiece, showcasing advanced track propulsion, pressurized glasswork capable of withstanding subterranean lake depths, and intricate electrical switching stations.

faq.a: After the Second War, King Magni Bronzebeard needed a faster way to transport supplies and dwarven troops to assist in rebuilding and defending Stormwind. He commissioned High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who drafted and executed the subterranean railway project to seamlessly bind the two capitals together.
faq.q: Why was the Deeprun Tram built?

faq.a: During the excavation between Dun Morogh and Stormwind, gnomish engineers breached a massive subterranean lake. Rather than routing around it, they constructed a sealed, reinforced glass viewing tunnel directly through the deep water, allowing passengers to watch wild threshadons and sharks swim alongside the track.
faq.q: How does the tram travel underwater?

faq.a: The damp, dark subterranean shafts provide an ideal breeding ground for vermin. Gnomish station masters constantly struggle to keep the rat population from chewing through cables or overrunning the platforms, occasionally relying on travelers and rat catchers like Monty to cull their numbers.
faq.q: Why are there so many rats along the tracks?

faq.a: Yes. Sponsored as an open civic and military project by the governments of Ironforge and Stormwind, the tram operates continuously and without fare for all citizens and allies of the Alliance.
faq.q: Is the tram free to ride?

text.s: The Deeprun Tram is an subterranean marvel of gnomish engineering linking the Alliance capitals of Ironforge and Stormwind City. Commissioned by King Magni Bronzebeard following the Second War, it allows citizens and soldiers to cross vast distances beneath the earth in mere minutes. The enclosed twin tracks cut beneath mountain and lake, serving as a vital artery for Alliance military support and commerce.

sec.b: Following the devastation of the Second War, King Magni Bronzebeard grew increasingly frustrated with how slowly dwarven aid and construction supplies reached Stormwind across the mountain passes. To solve the logistical hurdle and guarantee that dwarven soldiers could rapidly reinforce the human capital in times of crisis, Magni turned to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. The master gnomish engineer drafted designs for an enclosed underground railway powered by cutting-edge technology. Despite excavation complications—including cutting right through a vast subterranean lake and battling relentless infestations of underground rats—the tram became a crowning achievement of the Alliance, moving thousands of travelers free of charge between Ironforge and Stormwind.

subzone:deepwater-tavern.s: Mesón Aguahonda. El Mesón Aguahonda es la bulliciosa posada costera de Puerto de Menethil, enclavada en las húmedas marismas de Los Humedales. Sirve como punto de encuentro principal, lugar de reabastecimiento y descanso para viajeros y marineros que recorren la transitada ciudad portuaria. Entre abundantes tragos y rumores del puerto, los parroquianos a menudo encuentran trabajo o se topan con volátiles peleas de taberna. Ubicado en las empapadas calles de Puerto de Menethil, el Mesón Aguahonda ofrece a los viajeros un agradable refugio frente a las marismas traicioneras y en perpetua llovizna del exterior. Marineros, estibadores, mercaderes y aventureros agotados se reúnen bajo sus vigas de madera para intercambiar noticias, compartir un fuego cálido y curar sus heridas. Más allá de los servicios habituales de una posada portuaria, alberga a un instructor de primeros auxilios residente y a mercaderes locales que atienden a quienes se dirigen a los peligros de la ciénaga o se embarcan a través del Mare Magnum. El ambiente es bullicioso y en ocasiones peligroso; las disputas estallan con facilidad por una cerveza derramada, y es sabido que alborotadores notorios como Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn desatan de vez en cuando peleas en toda la taberna.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Deepwater Tavern serves as an indispensable rallying point and rest haven for Alliance members passing between Ironforge and the open sea.

faq.a: The Deepwater Tavern is situated near the waterfront of Menethil Harbor, the primary port town of the Wetlands on the western coast of Khaz Modan.
faq.q: Where is the Deepwater Tavern located?

faq.a: Besides typical innkeeper lodging and refreshments, the tavern houses merchants and a first aid trainer, making it a critical resupply and healing point for adventurers traveling through the marshlands.
al: what can i find at deepwater tavern
faq.q: What services are available inside the tavern?

faq.a: The tavern is famous for spontaneous fights, with a shifty troublemaker named Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn frequently instigating brawls among the rowdy patrons and sailors.
al: who starts fights at deepwater tavern
faq.q: Who frequently starts brawls in the tavern?

faq.a: Menethil Harbor is the major shipping and naval gateway linking Khaz Modan to Kalimdor and northern ports. As the sole major inn in town, it gathers a steady flow of sailors, mercenaries, and Alliance adventurers heading into the Wetlands.
faq.q: Why is the tavern so busy?

text.s: The Deepwater Tavern is the bustling seaside inn of Menethil Harbor, nestled in the damp marshlands of the Wetlands. It serves as the primary meeting spot, resupply point, and resting place for travelers and mariners navigating the busy port town. Between hearty drinks and harbor rumors, patrons frequently find work or run into volatile tavern brawls.

sec.b: Standing within the sodden streets of Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern offers travelers a welcome shelter from the perpetually drizzly, treacherous marshlands outside. Sailors, dockworkers, merchants, and weary adventurers gather beneath its timber beams to trade news, share a warm fire, and patch their wounds. Beyond the usual amenities of a harbor inn, it houses a resident first aid trainer and local merchants catering to those bound for the perils of the marsh or embarking across the Great Sea. The atmosphere is boisterous and occasionally hazardous; disputes flare up quickly over spilled ale, with notorious troublemakers like Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn known to spark the occasional tavern-wide brawl.

subzone:defias-hideout.s: Escondite Defias. Escondite Defias es una casa discreta y ruinosa situada en el extremo sur de Arroyo de la Luna. Aunque se mimetiza con el resto de este asentamiento en ruinas, su piso superior oculta la principal entrada terrestre a la extensa red subterránea de Las Minas de la Muerte. A simple vista, Escondite Defias parece una casa solariega o una granja saqueada más de Arroyo de la Luna, abarrotada de vagabundos indigentes y matones Defias. Sin embargo, su modesto interior enmascara el centro neurálgico de las operaciones en el sur de Edwin VanCleef. Al subir a la planta superior, se revela una abertura que conduce directamente al laberinto de Las Minas de la Muerte. Debido a que la Hermandad concentra su mano de obra en vigilar el perímetro de Arroyo de la Luna y en faenar en lo más profundo del subsuelo, la guarida en sí cuenta con escasa guarnición, funcionando más como un cuello de botella intensamente vigilado que como un bastión activo.

ang.class:Rogue: The hideout is a masterclass in clandestine defense: by disguising the gateway to a massive underground fortress within a nondescript ruined manor, the Defias keep their true scale hidden from casual Stormwind patrols.
ang.faction:Alliance: This decrepit estate serves as the front door to Edwin VanCleef's conspiracy, making it a critical staging ground for Alliance adventurers seeking to put an end to the Defias rebellion.

faq.a: Inside the structure lies a staircase that leads up to a winding tunnel, serving as the overland entrance to the Deadmines. Aside from wandering vagrants and scattered bandits, the building itself is mostly bare, acting primarily as a guarded entryway.
faq.q: What is inside the Defias Hideout?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood concentrates its fighting forces outside in the streets of Moonbrook to intercept intruders before they draw close, while the rest of their laborers and enforcers are busy working far below in the depths of the mines.
faq.q: Why is the hideout relatively unguarded inside?

faq.a: The hideout is located on the southern edge of Moonbrook in southwestern Westfall, distinguished as a large, intact two-story building resting near the base of the mountains.
faq.q: Where in Moonbrook is this building located?

faq.a: The building and the surrounding town are populated by Defias bandits along with desperate vagrants who have gathered in Moonbrook, having fled poverty or aligned themselves with the Brotherhood out of necessity.
faq.q: Who are the people lingering around the hideout?

text.s: The Defias Hideout is an unassuming, derelict house situated on the southern edge of Moonbrook. Though it blends in with the surrounding ruined settlement, its upper floor conceals the primary overland entrance into the extensive subterranean network of the Deadmines.

sec.b: To the casual eye, the Defias Hideout looks like any other ransacked manor or farmhouse in Moonbrook, overrun by destitute vagrants and Defias thugs. However, its modest interior masks the nerve center of Edwin VanCleef's southern operations. Ascending to the upper floor reveals an opening that leads directly down into the sprawling labyrinth of the Deadmines. Because the Brotherhood focuses its manpower on guarding the perimeter of Moonbrook and laboring deep underground, the hideout itself is sparsely garrisoned, functioning more as a heavily monitored bottleneck than an active stronghold.

subzone:demon-fall-canyon.s: Barranco del Demonio. El Barranco del Demonio es un desfiladero marcado y corrompido por la energía vil situado en el sur de Vallefresno. Señala el legendario campo de batalla donde Grommash Grito Infernal y Thrall se enfrentaron al señor del foso Mannoroth, poniendo fin a la maldición de sangre demoníaca que había esclavizado a la raza orca durante una generación. Tallado en las abruptas fronteras meridionales de Vallefresno, cerca del Cerro Lumbrevil y de la Cresta del Demonio, este cañón exhibe las profundas cicatrices de la Tercera Guerra. Fue aquí donde el Jefe de Guerra Thrall y el caudillo Grommash Grito Infernal rastrearon al señor del foso Mannoroth para romper su dominio sobre la Horda. Durante el feroz duelo, Mannoroth incapacitó a Thrall, pero Grom aprovechó la oportunidad para clavar su hacha, Aullavísceras, directamente en el pecho del demonio. La consiguiente explosión infernal destrozó al señor del foso y también mató a Grom, liberando permanentemente a los orcos de su persistente servidumbre demoníaca.

ang.faction:Horde: This scorched ground is sacred to the Horde as the site of Grommash Hellscream's ultimate sacrifice, where the blood curse of the Burning Legion was finally broken.
ang.race:Orc: Every orc owes their spiritual and physical freedom to the battle fought in this canyon, where Grom traded his life to shatter their demonic bondage.

faq.a: The canyon was named by the Horde to commemorate the death of the pit lord Mannoroth, who fell here after being slain by Grommash Hellscream.
al: how did it get its name
faq.q: Why is this place called Demon Fall Canyon?

faq.a: Thrall and Grom confronted Mannoroth together. Thrall was knocked unconscious, but Grom dealt a lethal blow with his axe. The violent explosion of demonic fire released by Mannoroth's demise fatally wounded Grom, freeing his people from the blood curse with his dying breath.
faq.q: What happened between Grom and Mannoroth here?

faq.a: When the pit lord Mannoroth died, the tremendous blast of demonic energy permanently corrupted the canyon floor, leaving behind lingering fel corruption that attracts and harbors lesser demons.
faq.q: Why are there still demons roaming the canyon?

faq.a: A memorial monument honoring Grom Hellscream stands nearby in the vicinity of Demon Fall Canyon, where Horde pilgrims come to pay tribute to the warrior who freed their people.
faq.q: Where is Grom Hellscream's memorial?

text.s: Demon Fall Canyon is a scarred, fel-corrupted gorge situated in southern Ashenvale. It marks the legendary battleground where Grommash Hellscream and Thrall confronted the pit lord Mannoroth, ending the demonic blood curse that had enslaved the orcish race for a generation.

sec.b: Carved into the rugged southern borders of Ashenvale near Felfire Hill and Demon Fall Ridge, this canyon bears the heavy scars of the Third War. It was here that Warchief Thrall and chieftain Grommash Hellscream tracked down the pit lord Mannoroth to break his hold over the Horde. During the fierce duel, Mannoroth incapacitated Thrall, but Grom seized the opening to drive his axe, Gorehowl, straight into the demon's chest. The resulting infernal explosion shattered the pit lord and slew Grom as well, permanently liberating the orcs from their lingering demonic servitude.

Following Mannoroth's demise, the Horde dubbed the canyon to commemorate Grom's final stand, erecting a monument nearby to honor his redemption. Despite the pit lord's destruction, his violent death unleashed raw demonic power that thoroughly tainted the surrounding land. Today, the canyon remains saturated in fel magic and crawls with hostile lingering lesser demons, making any pilgrimage to this hallowed ground a perilous venture.

subzone:demon-fall-ridge.s: Cresta del Demonio. Cresta del Demonio es una meseta asolada en el sureste de Vallefresno, con vistas al cañón donde cayó Mannoroth. Plagada de demonios menores y magia corruptora, la cresta se centra en torno a un cubil de túmulos de los elfos de la noche profanado y reclamado por la Legión Ardiente. Elevándose directamente al oeste y por encima de Barranco del Demonio, Cresta del Demonio está manchada por los persistentes residuos viles de la Tercera Guerra. Mientras que el cañón inferior marca el lugar del catastrófico enfrentamiento entre Grommash Grito Infernal y el señor del foso Mannoroth, este terreno elevado sirve como punto de partida para los invasores demoníacos supervivientes. Demonios menores patrullan los acantilados rocosos, mancillando el antiguo bosque y amenazando a cualquier viajero que recorra la frontera sur de Vallefresno.

ang.class:Druid: Seeing a barrow den—once a sacred haven of the Emerald Dream—desecrated and occupied by demons makes this ridge an affront to the Cenarion Circle.
ang.class:Warlock: The fel presence here is led by an active dreadlord, offering dark practitioners a glimpse of organized Legion remnants in Kalimdor.

faq.a: Demon Fall Ridge is located in south-eastern Ashenvale. It sits elevated directly west and above Demon Fall Canyon, near the border with the Barrens.
faq.q: Where is Demon Fall Ridge?

faq.a: The ridge overlooks the site where the pit lord Mannoroth met his end during the Third War. Demons that survived the Legion's defeat scattered into the surrounding heights, entrenching themselves upon the ridge and inside an abandoned barrow den.
faq.q: Why are there demons on this ridge?

faq.a: The conclave on the ridge is commanded by Diathorus the Seeker, a powerful nathrezim dreadlord who dwells in the deepest recesses of the barrow den.
faq.q: Who leads the demons here?

faq.a: It is an ancient night elf barrow den. Once a sanctum used by druids for entering the Emerald Dream, it was abandoned and has since been overrun and desecrated by the Burning Legion.
faq.q: What is the structure carved into the ridge?

text.s: Demon Fall Ridge is a blighted highland in south-eastern Ashenvale, overlooking the canyon where Mannoroth fell. Swarming with lesser demons and corrupting magic, the ridge centers around a desecrated night elf barrow den claimed by the Burning Legion.

sec.b: Rising directly west and above Demon Fall Canyon, Demon Fall Ridge is stained with lingering fel residue from the Third War. While the canyon below marks the site of the catastrophic clash between Grommash Hellscream and the pit lord Mannoroth, this high ground serves as a staging area for surviving demonic invaders. Lesser demons patrol the rocky cliffs, defiling the ancient woodland and threatening any travelers traversing the southern border of Ashenvale.

Carved into the side of the ridge rests an abandoned night elf barrow den, hollowed out and converted into a stronghold of dark sorcery. Rather than slumbering druids, the subterranean passages teem with fel fiends. Deep in the subterranean depths lurks Diathorus the Seeker, a cunning dreadlord who rules over this conclave, directing the remaining demonic remnants throughout the forest.

subzone:demont-s-place.s: Paraje de Demont. El Paraje de Demont es una hacienda en ruinas situada en el suroeste de Páramos de Poniente, justo al oeste del pueblo abandonado de Arroyo de la Luna. Antaño una parcela agrícola en funcionamiento, la granja quedó en la ruina junto con el resto de la región y fue reclamada por los agentes rebeldes de la Hermandad Defias. Hoy en día, sus vallas desgastadas y sus campos vacíos son una víctima más de la menguante prosperidad del reino. Situado a la vista de Arroyo de la Luna y de la extensión putrefacta de El Campo Funesto, el Paraje de Demont fue antaño una de las fincas familiares privadas que abastecían al Reino de Ventormenta. El colapso económico y el repentino auge de los bandidos proscritos despojaron a la granja de su sustento, obligando a huir a sus encargados originales. Al igual que sus campos vecinos, la parcela ha degenerado en un tosco escondite, invadido por forajidos que utilizan sus desgastados terrenos como una extensión del bastión de los Defias en Arroyo de la Luna.

ang.class:Rogue: The sprawling ruined plots around Moonbrook, including Demont's Place, offer a stark look at the lawless network established by the Defias Brotherhood across the countryside.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers, Demont's Place is a grim reminder of how far order has retreated from Westfall, with former farmland actively held by Defias outlaws right under the kingdom's nose.

faq.a: Demont's Place is situated in southwestern Westfall, immediately west of the abandoned town of Moonbrook and near the blighted fields of the Dead Acre.
faq.q: Where is Demont's Place located?

faq.a: The farm likely belonged to a settler named Demont before the peasant unrest and economic troubles swept the countryside. Any original inhabitants have long since fled or perished, leaving the ruined acreage to brigands.
faq.q: Who owns Demont's Place?

faq.a: The homestead is currently infested by members of the Defias Brotherhood, who use the decrepit grounds as a peripheral staging point outside their base of operations in Moonbrook.
al: what enemies are at demonts place
faq.q: Who currently occupies the farm?

faq.a: Not under current conditions. With the Defias actively entrenched throughout southern Westfall and Stormwind unable to spare garrison troops, the homestead remains far too dangerous for ordinary tillers to rebuild.
faq.q: Can the farm be restored to production?

text.s: Demont's Place is a ruined homestead nestled in southwestern Westfall, just west of the forsaken town of Moonbrook. Once a working agricultural plot, the farm was driven to ruin alongside the rest of the region and claimed by the rogue agents of the Defias Brotherhood. Today, its weathered fences and empty fields stand as another casualty of the realm's fading prosperity.

sec.b: Situated within sight of Moonbrook and the rotting expanse of the Dead Acre, Demont's Place was once among the private family holdings feeding the Kingdom of Stormwind. Economic collapse and the sudden rise of outlaw brigands stripped the farm of its livelihood, forcing out its original caretakers. Much like its neighboring fields, the plot has degenerated into a rough hideout, overrun by outlaws using its weathered grounds as an extension of the Defias stronghold in Moonbrook.

Because of its close proximity to Moonbrook, Demont's Place serves the Defias Brotherhood as an operational outpost on the outskirts of their regional center. Thugs, cutpurses, and displaced laborers linger among the fences and shattered structures, ambushing travelers who wander off the southern roads. Until Moonbrook is reclaimed and the outlaws broken, the ground remains far too dangerous for peaceful farming to ever return.

subzone:dolanaar.s: Dolanaar. Dolanaar es un tranquilo asentamiento de elfos de la noche enclavado entre las ramas del este central de Teldrassil. Situado justo al suroeste de Cañada Umbría, sirve como el primer pueblo auténtico que los jóvenes kal'dorei encuentran tras dejar sus resguardadas zonas de entrenamiento. Aquí, montaraces, druidas y artesanos se reúnen para guiar a los recién llegados y hacer frente a las extrañas aflicciones invasoras que perturban al Árbol del Mundo. Repitiéndose bajo el frondoso dosel al suroeste de Cañada Umbría, Dolanaar sirve como una encrucijada vital para los viajeros que recorren Teldrassil. Construido a la manera tradicional de los elfos de la noche, sus hogares y plataformas se hallan perfectamente integrados en el bosque. La aldea ofrece a los recién llegados su primera instrucción completa en profesiones, artes marciales y artesanías de la naturaleza, y se encuentra en el camino hacia la capital, Darnassus. Debido a su céntrica ubicación, los informes sobre fauna corrupta, fúrbolgs agresivos y musgos inmundos procedentes de las ramas circundantes acaban llegando inevitablemente al consejo de Dolanaar.

ang.class:Druid: Dolanaar is an essential stop for initiates seeking guidance on Teldrassil's ailments and learning to attune their spirits to the natural balance.
ang.race:NightElf: For young night elves, Dolanaar marks their first steps into the wider world, testing their vows to preserve nature as they witness the growing corruption upon the World Tree.

faq.a: Dolanaar is the primary questing hub and outpost for young night elves leaving the novice grounds of Shadowglen. It acts as an administrative outpost in eastern Teldrassil, housing tradesfolk, trainers for martial and magical arts, and links to the capital.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Dolanaar?

faq.a: Dolanaar lies in the central-eastern region of Teldrassil, just a short walk down the trail southwest of Shadowglen and east of the capital city of Darnassus.
faq.q: Where is Dolanaar located?

faq.a: Dolanaar has no flight path of its own. Travelers follow the forest road west through Teldrassil to reach the gates of Darnassus on foot.
faq.q: How can travelers reach Darnassus from here?

faq.a: The woodland surrounding Dolanaar suffers from a strange corruption creeping into Teldrassil, leading to diseased beasts, crazed timberlings, and hostile furbolg tribes nearby.
faq.q: What threats affect Dolanaar?

text.s: Dolanaar is a tranquil night elf settlement nestled in the central-eastern boughs of Teldrassil. Situated just southwest of Shadowglen, it serves as the first true town young kal'dorei encounter after departing their sheltered training grounds. Here, rangers, druids, and craftsmen gather to guide newcomers and address the strange, encroaching afflictions disturbing the World Tree.

sec.b: Resting beneath the lush canopy southwest of Shadowglen, Dolanaar serves as a vital crossway for travelers traversing Teldrassil. Built in the traditional night elven manner, its homes and platforms sit seamlessly woven into the woodland. The village provides newcomers with their first comprehensive training in trades, martial arts, and nature crafts, and sits on the road to the capital city of Darnassus. Because of its central location, reports of corrupted wildlife, aggressive furbolgs, and foul mosses from the surrounding boughs inevitably find their way into Dolanaar's council.

subzone:dormitory.s: Dormitorio. Dormitorio es un sector residencial dentro de la caída capital tecnológica de Gnomeregan. Antaño proporcionaba alojamiento a innumerables ciudadanos gnomos, pero ahora se encuentra asfixiado por la lluvia radiactiva y plagado de salvajes troggs irradiados. Ubicado justo después de las cámaras de descontaminación de la Zona Limpia, Dormitorio albergaba antiguamente a los inventores, obreros y familias de Gnomeregan. Cuando el Manitas Mayor Mekkatorque inició la purga de radiación de emergencia para combatir a la horda invasora de troggs, este sector densamente poblado se convirtió en una trampa. En la actualidad, sus salas comunales y unidades residenciales están completamente desprovistas de vida gnómica, ocupadas en su lugar por troggs mutados que prosperan en el miasma radiactivo. Los viajeros que descienden hacia los niveles inferiores de la ciudad deben luchar a través de este trágico recordatorio de la catástrofe para alcanzar la parte inferior de la Sala de los Engranajes.

ang.profession:Engineering: Even amid total bio-containment failure, automated terminals like the Matrix Punchograph 3005-B continue processing algorithmic security punch cards flawlessly.
ang.race:Gnome: Stepping into the Dormitory is personal for every gnome: this was once your home, now reduced to irradiated rubble and overrun by the very brutes who drove you from it.

faq.a: The Dormitory served as everyday living quarters for Gnomeregan's vast population of inventors, workers, and their families. Its proximity to industrial and civic sectors allowed gnome citizens easy access between their workstations and resting bunks before toxic radiation flooded the lower corridors.
faq.q: What was the Dormitory used for before the fall?

faq.a: When the troggs breached the city from beneath, High Tinker Mekkatorque flooded the city with toxic gas to kill them. Instead of wiping them out, the radiation mutated the surviving troggs, making them more vicious and entirely resistant to the irradiated environment of the residential blocks.
faq.q: Why is the Dormitory infested with troggs?

faq.a: The Dormitory sits just beyond the sanitized airlocks of the Clean Zone and connects the upper levels to the lower level of the Hall of Gears, making it an unavoidable chokepoint for anyone pushing deeper into Gnomeregan.
faq.q: Where does the Dormitory lead?

faq.a: The Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. Their encoded cards grant clearance to higher-security terminals, allowing the recovery of important data left behind in Gnomeregan.
faq.q: What are the Matrix Punchograph machines found here?

text.s: The Dormitory is a residential sector within the fallen technological capital of Gnomeregan. Once providing living quarters for countless gnome citizens, it now lies choked with radioactive fallout and crawls with savage, irradiated troggs.

sec.b: Situated just past the decontamination chambers of the Clean Zone, the Dormitory formerly housed the inventors, laborers, and families of Gnomeregan. When High Tinker Mekkatorque initiated the emergency radiation venting to combat the invading trogg horde, this densely populated sector became a trap. Today, its communal halls and living units are completely abandoned by gnomish life, occupied instead by mutated troggs that thrive in the radioactive miasma. Travelers descending toward the lower levels of the city must fight through this tragic reminder of the catastrophe to reach the lower Hall of Gears.

Amid the abandoned living quarters, remnants of the city's administrative apparatus still function. The Matrix Punchograph 3005-B machines process security punch cards. These terminals provide clearance for higher-security data terminals deeper within Gnomeregan, helping recover important records left behind when the gnomes fled.

subzone:drag.s: Calle Mayor. La Calle Mayor es una bulliciosa y sombría vía tallada en la roca roja de Orgrimmar, que une el Valle de la Fuerza con el Valle del Honor y el Valle de la Sabiduría. Conocida en todo Durotar como el corazón del comercio de la capital, las paredes de su cañón están repletas de artesanos, comerciantes y artífices. También oculta el descenso cavernoso hacia el infame Circo de las Sombras. Enclavada en las profundidades de los muros rojos del cañón de Orgrimmar, La Calle Mayor sirve como la columna vertebral comercial de la capital de la Horda. Mientras que el Valle de la Fuerza se centra en la concentración militar y el mando administrativo, en La Calle Mayor es donde se desarrolla la vida diaria de la ciudad. A la sombra de altos riscos y pieles, la calle está impregnada de los olores de las cubas de curtido, los calderos de alquimia burbujeantes y el traqueteo de los engranajes de los manitas. Artesanos de casi todas las disciplinas se reúnen aquí para ejercer sus oficios y enseñar a los aspirantes a aventureros, desde peletería y sastrería hasta talleres de ingeniería goblin, como el Taller de Nogg.

ang.faction:Horde: Every traveler passing through the capital eventually treads the Drag, as it links Orgrimmar's martial core directly to the communal and mystical quarters.
ang.profession:Engineering: The Drag is home to Nogg's Machine Shop, where goblin tinkerers impart schematics, explosives, and specialized engineering knowledge to the Horde.

faq.a: The Drag is Orgrimmar's primary shopping and trade district. It hosts trainers and supply vendors for a wide array of professions, including alchemy, tailoring, leatherworking, skinning, enchanting, and engineering, alongside general salvage and trading goods.
al: what shops are in the drag
faq.q: What is the Drag used for in Orgrimmar?

faq.a: The canyon street links the Valley of Strength in the south to the Valley of Honor in the northeast, with pathways also leading toward the Valley of Wisdom. Crucially, the entrance descending into the shadowy caverns of the Cleft of Shadow is located along the western cliffside of the Drag.
al: how to get to cleft of shadow
faq.q: Where does the Drag lead?

faq.a: Nogg is an enterprising goblin engineer who operates Nogg's Machine Shop along the Drag, serving as a prominent engineering trainer and gadget supplier for members of the Horde.
faq.q: Who is Nogg?

faq.a: Most crafting and gathering professions maintain shops along the lower and upper shelves of the Drag, but not all of them. Notably, the city's blacksmiths and miners prefer the fiery forges of the Valley of Honor.
faq.q: Are all profession trainers located in the Drag?

text.s: The Drag is a bustling, shaded thoroughfare carved into the red rock of Orgrimmar, linking the Valley of Strength to the Valley of Honor and the Valley of Wisdom. Known throughout Durotar as the heart of the capital's commerce, its canyon walls are lined with crafters, traders, and artisans. It also conceals the cavernous descent into the notorious Cleft of Shadow.

sec.b: Tucked deep between the red canyon walls of Orgrimmar, the Drag serves as the commercial backbone of the Horde's capital. While the Valley of Strength focuses on military muster and administrative command, the Drag is where daily city life unfolds. Shaded under high cliffs and hides, the street is thick with the smells of tanning vats, bubbling alchemical cauldrons, and the clatter of tinkerers' gears. Craftsmen of almost every discipline gather here to practice their trades and teach aspiring adventurers, from leatherworking and tailoring to goblin-led engineering workshops like Nogg's Machine Shop.

Beyond housing merchant storefronts and salvage houses, the Drag occupies an uneasy position within Orgrimmar's social geography. Nestled along its canyon face lies the guarded entrance to the subterranean Cleft of Shadow. This makes the Drag an inescapable crossroads where honest tradesmen, shaman on their way to the Valley of Wisdom, and secretive practitioners of dark arts brush shoulders beneath the dim, dusty overhangs of the canyon.
sec.t: A Crossroads of Shadows and Craft

subzone:dreadmist-peak.s: Cima Calígine. Cima Calígine es una montaña escarpada y desolada que se alza al noroeste de El Cruce, en Los Baldíos. Envuelto en un miasma carmesí sobrenatural, el pico sirve como reducto aislado para los cultistas demoníacos del Filo Ardiente. Elevándose muy por encima de las áridas sabanas de Los Baldíos, Cima Calígine destaca como un lugar de maldad palpable. A medida que los viajeros ascienden por los riscos, el cielo brillante queda oculto por una densa neblina rojiza: el miasma residual de una antigua maldición demoníaca. En la cresta de la montaña y dentro de sus cavidades subterráneas, el culto del Filo Ardiente opera en secreto, albergando a brujos, toxicólogos y diabólicos grellkin. Desde esta posición privilegiada, los cultistas propagan venenos en el nivel freático cercano y conspiran contra los incipientes poderes que se asientan en el centro de Kalimdor.

ang.class:Druid: Tauren druids from Camp Taurajo investigate Dreadmist Peak's water sources, seeking to identify the unnatural toxins poisoning the gazelles and wildlife of the plains.
ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance agents operating near Ashenvale trace corrupting magic bound to befouled water elementals straight to Sarilus Foulborne, an undead summoner lurking on the peak.

faq.a: The reddish-orange fog smothering the peak is lingering miasma left behind by an ancient demonic curse, sustained and intensified by the foul rituals of the resident Burning Blade warlocks.
faq.q: Why is the air red and foggy around Dreadmist Peak?

faq.a: The mountain is controlled by the Burning Blade cult, who keep watch along its trails and guard Dreadmist Den beneath. It is also occupied by dark figures such as the renegade undead mage Sarilus Foulborne.
faq.q: Who controls Dreadmist Peak?

faq.a: Three years after the Third War, a minor demon named Zmodlor used Dreadmist Peak as a base to orchestrate hostilities between the Horde and Theramore. Lady Jaina Proudmoore, accompanied by Aegwynn, tracked the plot here and banished the demon, narrowly averting war.
faq.q: What happened here between Theramore and the Horde?

faq.a: Follow the main road north from the Crossroads until it forks toward Ashenvale and Stonetalon. Face northwest to see the crag looming overhead, then ascend the spiraling path up its eastern face.
faq.q: How do you reach Dreadmist Peak?

text.s: Dreadmist Peak is a jagged, desolate mountain looming northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Shrouded in an unnatural, crimson miasma, the peak serves as a secluded redoubt for the demonic cultists of the Burning Blade.

sec.b: Rising high above the arid savannas of the Barrens, Dreadmist Peak stands out as a site of palpable evil. As travelers wind their way up the crags, the bright sky is blotted out by a dense, reddish haze—the residual miasma of an ancient demonic curse. At the mountain's crest and within its subterranean hollows, the Burning Blade cult operates in secret, harboring warlocks, toxicologists, and fiendish grellkin. From this vantage, the cultists spread poisons into the nearby water table and scheme against the nascent powers establishing control over central Kalimdor.

Beyond housing warlocks and their dark rituals around Dreadmist Den, the peak has drawn other malevolent figures. The rogue Forsaken mage Sarilus Foulborne made his camp upon the heights, bending elemental forces to corrupt water spirits as far north as Ashenvale. Furthermore, when the minor demon Zmodlor conspired to spark outright war between Thrall's Horde and Theramore, it was here that Lady Jaina Proudmoore and Aegwynn confronted and banished the entity, cutting short a catastrophic bloodbath.

subzone:drygulch-ravine.s: Barranco Árido. El Barranco Árido es un desfiladero escarpado y oculto entre los riscos rocosos del este de Durotar. Accesible únicamente a través del oscuro pasaje de una cueva desde el Cañón del Ventajo o mediante una peligrosa caída desde las alturas, esta zanja pedregosa está infestada de arpías Dustwind que anidan allí y amenazan las caravanas de suministros cercanas. Tallado en las profundidades de los riscos al este de Orgrimmar, el Barranco Árido está casi por completo aislado del tránsito habitual. Su único acceso a nivel del suelo es un estrecho túnel natural conectado con el Cañón del Ventajo. Alimentada por un modesto río, esta depresión resguardada albergó en su día un asentamiento orco pacífico, pero las bestias salvajes y los nidos de las arpías Dustwind la han convertido en un rincón sin ley en Durotar. Estas carroñeras aladas aprovechan las empinadas paredes del acantilado para anidar sus camadas y acumular mercancías robadas a las caravanas de suministros de la Horda que recorren los caminos de la región.

ang.faction:Horde: Clearing the ravine's roosts and recovering stolen supplies helps secure Durotar's internal trade routes against constant banditry.
ang.race:Orc: Drygulch Ravine stands as a test of frontier endurance, where young orcs prove their mettle against the ferocious harpies perched on the homeland's rocky bluffs.

faq.a: Unless you survive a leap from the high cliffs above, the only ground route is through a small cave entrance tucked within neighboring Razorwind Canyon.
al: where is the cave to drygulch
faq.q: How do you get into Drygulch Ravine?

faq.a: The ravine is dominated by Dustwind harpies who build their nests, lay eggs, and stash looted caravan supplies along the craggy rock shelves.
faq.q: What creatures live in Drygulch Ravine?

faq.a: The Dustwind harpies raid Durotar's vital trade trails, hoarding stolen cargo in the gorge. Horde authorities in Razor Hill regularly send recruits to recover provisions and cull the flock.
faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this ravine?

faq.a: Yes. A few years after the Third War, agitated thunder lizards broke out of nearby Thunder Ridge and threatened Drygulch Ravine, forcing local orcs to seek military aid from Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Did thunder lizards once attack the ravine?

text.s: Drygulch Ravine is a rugged, hidden gorge tucked into the rocky bluffs of eastern Durotar. Accessible only through an obscure cave passage from Razorwind Canyon or a perilous drop from above, this craggy trench is overrun by nesting Dustwind harpies who menace nearby supply caravans.

sec.b: Carved deep into the crags east of Orgrimmar, Drygulch Ravine is almost entirely cut off from casual travel. Its only ground-level access is a cramped natural tunnel connected to Razorwind Canyon. Fed by a modest river, this sheltered depression once saw peaceful orc habitation, but wild beasts and roosting Dustwind harpies have turned it into a lawless pocket of Durotar. The winged scavengers use the steep cliff faces to nest their broods and stockpile stolen goods taken from Horde supply trains passing along the regional trails.
sec.t: A Bandit Haven in the Red Rocks

sec.b: Life in Drygulch Ravine has long been precarious. Not long after the Third War, escaped thunder lizards from Thunder Ridge threatened the area, prompting warnings to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. Today, the harpies pose the immediate danger. Their matriarchs fiercely defend clutches of eggs tucked along the high ledges, and Horde scouts frequently dispatch young warriors to cull the flock, recover plundered trade crates, and break the harpies' grip on the ravine.

subzone:dun-algaz.s: Dun Algaz. Dun Algaz es el paso de montaña fortificado y la red de túneles que conecta Loch Modan con Los Humedales. Disputada históricamente durante la Segunda Guerra, esta arteria comercial vital ha caído recientemente bajo el asedio de los orcos Faucedraco, interrumpiendo el tránsito fluido entre los territorios de Forjaz y el Puerto de Menethil. Dun Algaz es anterior a la Guerra de los Tres Martillos, ya que sirvió originalmente como el paso que el clan Martillo Salvaje utilizó para migrar hacia el norte tras ser expulsado de Forjaz. Tallado en las profundidades de los picos escarpados que separan Loch Modan de Los Humedales, el paso consta de amplios túneles de piedra, bastiones y puestos de vigilancia. Su valor estratégico es incalculable: quien controla Dun Algaz domina la única vía terrestre que une el corazón de las tierras enanas con el mar occidental en el Puerto de Menethil.

ang.faction:Alliance: The route through Dun Algaz is critical for Alliance logistics, securing the overland road that joins the port of Menethil Harbor with Loch Modan and Ironforge.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Dun Algaz is an ancestral highway cut through the spine of Khaz Modan. Seeing Dragonmaw orcs occupy dwarven bastions and threaten supply lines to Menethil Harbor is an ongoing insult and security crisis.

faq.a: Dragonmaw orcs have descended from the surrounding mountains and seized control of the lower pass and stronghold. Dwarven Mountaineers have been pushed back to the upper pass near Algaz Station, leaving the main road swarming with hostile orcs who ambush travelers attempting to pass between Loch Modan and the Wetlands.
al: why are there orcs in dun algaz
faq.q: Why is Dun Algaz so dangerous right now?

faq.a: Dun Algaz is the primary overland route connecting Ironforge and Loch Modan to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Menethil Harbor serves as the main shipping gateway between Khaz Modan and the rest of the Alliance territories, making Dun Algaz an essential corridor for supplies, troops, and trade.
al: why does ironforge need dun algaz
faq.q: Why is this pass so important to the dwarves?

faq.a: Yes. Following their loss at Dun Modr, the Orcish Horde fell back across the Thandol Valley to make Dun Algaz a defensive stronghold. Sir Anduin Lothar ordered an assault to dislodge them and drive them from Khaz Modan, but the Alliance was unable to fully root out the Horde, leaving it as one of their final strongholds in the region.
faq.q: Did Dun Algaz play a role in the Second War?

faq.a: Long before the Second War, during the ancient War of the Three Hammers, the Wildhammer dwarves were driven out of Ironforge. They traveled through Dun Algaz to migrate north into the Wetlands and eventually settle in Grim Batol.
al: war of the three hammers pass
faq.q: What is the history between Dun Algaz and the Wildhammer dwarves?

text.s: Dun Algaz is the fortified mountain pass and network of tunnels connecting Loch Modan to the Wetlands. Historically contested during the Second War, this vital trade artery has recently fallen under siege by Dragonmaw orcs, cutting off easy transit between Ironforge's territories and Menethil Harbor.

sec.b: Dun Algaz predates the War of the Three Hammers, originally serving as the passage the Wildhammer clan used to migrate north after being driven out of Ironforge. Carved deep into the jagged peaks separating Loch Modan and the Wetlands, the pass consists of sweeping stone tunnels, bastions, and watchposts. Its strategic value cannot be overstated: whoever holds Dun Algaz commands the only overland highway linking the dwarven heartlands to the western sea at Menethil Harbor.

During the Second War, the Old Horde retreated to Dun Algaz after their defeat at Dun Modr, turning it into their final southern bulwark against Sir Anduin Lothar's forces. Years later, Nekros Skullcrusher sheltered the Dragonmaw clan in the surrounding caves. Though the Alliance reclaimed the pass for a time, Dragonmaw orcs have once again overrun the stronghold, forcing the dwarven Mountaineers to retreat to the upper tunnels and turning the mountain corridor into a deadly gauntlet for travelers.

subzone:dun-garok.s: Dun Garok. Dun Garok es un bastión montañoso y fortificado de los enanos, situado en las alturas surorientales de las Laderas de Trabalomas. Al mando del capitán Ferrocolina, la inquebrantable guarnición del puesto defiende los intereses regionales de la Alianza y operaciones cercanas como la Mina Azur frente a incursiones hostiles. Para los Renegados de Molino Tarren, esta fortaleza enana atrincherada supone una amenaza militar constante junto a sus dominios. Tallado en las escarpadas colinas del sureste de las Laderas de Trabalomas, Dun Garok se erige como un reducto fuertemente defendido por montañeros y fusileros de Forjaz. Al mando del capitán Ferrocolina, los enanos de este enclave mantienen un perímetro defensivo crucial, protegiendo los asentamientos humanos de Trabalomas y asegurando operaciones vitales en la Mina Azur. Su sólida arquitectura de piedra y sus profundos atrincheramientos proporcionan a la Alianza un punto de apoyo contra las amenazas cercanas.

ang.faction:Horde: This well-defended dwarven enclave poses an ongoing danger to Forsaken expansion and border security around Tarren Mill, making its garrison a priority target.
ang.race:Dwarf: Dun Garok is a proud symbol of Ironforge's reach into Lordaeron, where Captain Ironhill and his mountaineers stand resolute in defense of their human allies.

faq.a: Dun Garok is a fortified dwarven outpost located in the southeastern mountains of the Hillsbrad Foothills. It is manned by troops from Ironforge dedicated to defending regional Alliance holdings.
faq.q: What is Dun Garok?

faq.a: The stronghold is commanded by Captain Ironhill, who leads the local mountaineers and riflemen in safeguarding Hillsbrad and the nearby Azurelode Mine.
faq.q: Who commands Dun Garok?

faq.a: The Forsaken view an active, fortified dwarven stronghold right on their southern border as a major security threat to Tarren Mill and actively dispatch agents to eradicate the garrison.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to destroy Dun Garok?

faq.a: Dun Garok serves as a key military anchor in Hillsbrad, helping maintain Alliance security in the region and protecting the nearby Azurelode Mine from hostile takeovers.
faq.q: What is Dun Garok's strategic value to the Alliance?

text.s: Dun Garok is a fortified dwarven mountain bastion situated in the southeastern heights of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Commanded by Captain Ironhill, the outpost's stalwart garrison defends regional Alliance interests and nearby operations like the Azurelode Mine against hostile encroachment. To the Forsaken of Tarren Mill, this entrenched dwarven stronghold stands as a constant military threat bordering their domain.

sec.b: Carved into the craggy southeastern hills of Hillsbrad Foothills, Dun Garok stands as a heavily defended redoubt of Ironforge mountaineers and riflemen. Commanded by Captain Ironhill, the dwarves here maintain a critical defensive perimeter, shielding human settlements in Hillsbrad and securing vital operations at the Azurelode Mine. Their sturdy stone architecture and deep entrenchments provide the Alliance with an anchor against nearby threats.

Because of its close proximity to Tarren Mill, Dun Garok is viewed by the Forsaken as an intolerable intrusion on their southern border. Sylvanas Windrunner's forces loathe the presence of heavily armed dwarven troops so close to their stronghold, routinely plotting to infiltrate the fortress, break its defenses, and eliminate Captain Ironhill's garrison to secure Forsaken dominion over Hillsbrad.

subzone:dun-modr.s: Dun Modr. Dun Modr es una antigua ciudad enana fortificada en el norte de los Humedales que vigila el acceso sur al Puente Thandol. Antaño una fortaleza crucial defendida y disputada a lo largo de múltiples guerras, ha caído recientemente ante una fuerza hostil de enanos Hierro Negro. Situada en el extremo norte de los Humedales, Dun Modr domina la principal vía terrestre que une Khaz Modan con los reinos humanos del norte. Debido a esta ubicación vital, la fortaleza ha presenciado un intenso derramamiento de sangre a lo largo de las décadas. Durante la Segunda Guerra, la Horda orca la capturó y se atrincheró en el bastión enano, utilizándolo como base de operaciones avanzada para lanzar incursiones y repeler a los ejércitos de la Alianza. Los guerreros de Stromgarde lanzaron un brutal asalto anfibio desde Tol Barad para recuperarla, pero los orcos contraatacaron en un sangriento toma y daca. Las fuerzas de la Alianza lideradas por Lord Anduin Lothar finalmente expulsaron a los invasores hacia el sur a través del Puente Thandol, devolviendo la custodia del bastión a los enanos.

ang.faction:Alliance: The fall of Dun Modr threatens the critical transit route across the Thandol Span, severing easy travel between Ironforge and the northern Alliance remnants.
ang.race:Dwarf: Seeing a storied Bronzebeard mountain settlement fall into the hands of the treacherous Dark Iron clan is a bitter insult that demands vengeance.

faq.a: Dun Modr sits directly along the major northern road in the Wetlands leading to the Thandol Span. Controlling the fortress means controlling all overland traffic, supply lines, and military movement between Khaz Modan and the northern continent of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why is Dun Modr so important?

faq.a: The stronghold has fallen to the Dark Iron clan, led on-site by a warlock named Balgaras the Foul. Bronzebeard Mountaineers loyal to Ironforge maintain a watchful camp nearby, hoping to reclaim it.
faq.q: Who controls Dun Modr right now?

faq.a: The Orcish Horde overran the town and turned it into a forward military base. Stromgarde forces struck from the island of Tol Barad to retake the ruins, sparking fierce clashes until Anduin Lothar's Alliance forces finally swept the Horde out of the region.
faq.q: What happened to Dun Modr during the Second War?

faq.a: Balgaras the Foul is the Dark Iron warlock leading the occupation of Dun Modr. Under his command, the Dark Irons managed to damage the Thandol Span and drive the local Ironforge defenders out of the fortress.
faq.q: Who is Balgaras the Foul?

text.s: Dun Modr is an ancient fortified dwarven town in northern Wetlands, guarding the southern approach to the Thandol Span. Once a critical fortress held and contested across multiple wars, it has recently fallen to a hostile force of Dark Iron dwarves.

sec.b: Situated at the northern edge of the Wetlands, Dun Modr commands the primary overland highway linking Khaz Modan with the northern human kingdoms. Because of this vital location, the stronghold has seen heavy bloodshed over the decades. During the Second War, the Orcish Horde captured and entrenched themselves within the dwarven fortress, using it as a forward staging ground to launch raids and repel Alliance armies. Stromgarde warriors launched a brutal amphibious assault from Tol Barad to reclaim it, only for the Orcs to strike back in a bloody tug-of-war. Alliance forces led by Lord Anduin Lothar ultimately drove the invaders south across the Thandol Span, restoring dwarven custody over the bastion.

With Ironforge's attention divided and many of its finest mountaineers committed to Alliance duties abroad, Dun Modr was left vulnerable. Seizing the opportunity, Dark Iron invaders pushed north and sabotaged the Thandol Span with explosives before swarming the fortress. Under the command of the Dark Iron warlock Balgaras the Foul, these infiltrators overran the town's defenders, driving out the Bronzebeard garrison and transforming the strategic outpost into a hostile den. Surrounding Mountaineers now maintain a grim perimeter just down the road, desperately seeking aid to dislodge the occupiers.

subzone:durnholde-keep.s: Castillo de Durnholde. El Castillo de Durnholde es una fortaleza devastada situada al este de Molino Tarren, en las Laderas de Trabalomas. Antaño centro neurálgico de los campos de internamiento de orcos de la Alianza y lugar donde el Jefe de Guerra Thrall fue criado como gladiador cautivo, hoy yace en ruinas, ocupado por los forajidos de la Hermandad. Construido por la Alianza, Durnholde sirvió como cuartel general para supervisar los campos de internamiento del sur tras la Segunda Guerra. Bajo el mando del ambicioso y corrupto teniente general Aedelas Blackmoore, funcionaba tanto de fortaleza administrativa como de arena de gladiadores. Fue aquí donde Blackmoore crio al infante huérfano Go'el, dándole el nombre de Thrall y adiestrándolo para combatir por diversión y beneficio económico. Con la ayuda de Taretha Foxton, Thrall escapó de su cautiverio y más tarde unió a los dispersos clanes orcos bajo el estandarte de la nueva Horda. Al regresar a Durnholde, Thrall sitió la fortaleza, abatió a Blackmoore y suplicó a los espíritus de la tierra que derribaran sus muros.

ang.faction:Alliance: Once a linchpin of Lordaeron's defense and justice, Durnholde's shattered ramparts now serve only as a wretched lair for Syndicate outlaws and cutthroats.
ang.race:Orc: The ruined stones of Durnholde mark the forge where Warchief Thrall threw off his chains, ending decades of orcish captivity and kindling the rebirth of the Horde.

faq.a: Thrall returned to Durnholde at the head of the liberated Horde to defeat his former master, Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore. After slaying Blackmoore, Thrall communed with the spirits of the earth to demolish the fortress so it could never again cage his people.
faq.q: Why is Durnholde Keep in ruins?

faq.a: The stronghold is held by the Syndicate, a faction of exiled Alterac nobles turned outlaws. They use the crumbling ramparts as a fortified redoubt to conduct banditry and launch attacks across Hillsbrad.
faq.q: Who currently occupies Durnholde Keep?

faq.a: Aedelas Blackmoore discovered the orphaned orc as a child and raised him at Durnholde as a slave. Thrall was educated in tactics and forced to fight as a gladiator in the arena before he managed to break out with help from a human woman named Taretha Foxton.
faq.q: What was Thrall's connection to this place?

faq.a: Beyond serving as an Alliance stronghold, it was used as a prison facility. During the conflict, the forest troll warlord Zul'jin was held captive here until Orgrim Doomhammer breached the fortress to liberate him.
faq.q: What purpose did the keep serve during the Second War?

text.s: Durnholde Keep is a shattered fortress situated east of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Once the nerve center of the Alliance's orc internment camps and the place where Warchief Thrall was raised as a captive gladiator, it now lies in ruin, occupied by outlaws of the Syndicate.

sec.b: Built by the Alliance, Durnholde served as the headquarters overseeing the southern internment camps following the Second War. Commanded by the ambitious and corrupt Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore, it functioned as both an administrative fortress and a gladiatorial arena. It was here that Blackmoore raised the orphaned infant Go'el, naming him Thrall and training him to fight for sport and profit. Aided by Taretha Foxton, Thrall escaped captivity and later united the dispersed orc clans under the banner of the new Horde. Returning to Durnholde, Thrall laid siege to the fortress, slew Blackmoore, and called upon the earth spirits to shatter its walls.

Since its collapse prior to the Third War, Durnholde Keep has remained a scarred heap of masonry. In the vacuum left by Lordaeron's fall, the aristocratic bandits of the Syndicate took refuge among the ramparts. Operating out of the broken bailey and towers, these dispossessed Alterac nobles and cutthroats prey upon travelers across the Hillsbrad Foothills, turning a former instrument of martial law into a heavily fortified rogue outpost.
sec.t: In the Clutches of the Syndicate

subzone:dust-plains.s: Los Yermos Polvorientos. Los Yermos Polvorientos forman la frontera meridional de Páramos de Poniente, seca y azotada por el viento. Marcada por un terreno árido y matorrales escasos, la región está invadida por agresivos campamentos de gnolls y limita con la vieja torre de un mago a lo largo de su elevación oriental. Extendiéndose por el sur de Páramos de Poniente, Los Yermos Polvorientos marcan la transición entre las convulsas tierras de cultivo y un páramo desolado. A diferencia de las granjas saqueadas del norte, esta árida extensión lleva mucho tiempo abandonada a manadas de gnolls salvajes que tienden emboscadas a los viajeros y desafían a cualquiera que se aventure hacia la costa o las colinas cercanas. En el límite oriental se alza Torre de Klaven, un solitario refugio mágico que no ofrece cobijo frente a las bestias que merodean por los yermos circundantes.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Dust Plains represent another lawless fringe where Stormwind's neglect is starkly visible, forcing travelers and local defenders to fend off relentless gnoll packs without official reinforcement.

faq.a: The Dust Plains occupy the southernmost portion of Westfall, lying south of the abandoned farmsteads and extending toward the cliffs and Mortwake's Tower on the east.
faq.q: Where are the Dust Plains located?

faq.a: The region is heavily populated by savage gnolls, who maintain crude camps throughout the dusty landscape and violently assault anyone who wanders near.
faq.q: What threats can travelers find in the Dust Plains?

faq.a: That is Mortwake's Tower, an old wizard's spire that overlooks the eastern verge of the Dust Plains.
faq.q: What is the tower on the eastern edge of the plains?

faq.a: No. The People's Militia is already stretched dangerously thin defending Sentinel Hill and the northern farms from the Defias Brotherhood, leaving the Dust Plains entirely in the hands of prowling gnolls.
faq.q: Does the People's Militia hold any control over the Dust Plains?

text.s: The Dust Plains form the dry, wind-scoured southern frontier of Westfall. Marked by arid ground and scarce scrub, the region is overrun by aggressive gnoll encampments and borders an old wizard's tower along its eastern rise.

sec.b: Stretching across southern Westfall, the Dust Plains mark the transition from troubled farmland to desolate wilderness. Unlike the plundered farmsteads to the north, this arid reach has long been surrendered to packs of feral gnolls who ambush travelers and challenge anyone venturing toward the coast or the nearby hills. On the eastern boundary sits Mortwake's Tower, a lonely magical retreat that offers no shelter from the beasts prowling the surrounding wastes.

subzone:dustwind-cave.s: Cueva Viento Seco. La Cueva Viento Seco es una hondonada apartada situada en lo alto de los acantilados del Cañón del Ventajo, justo al noreste de Cerrotajo. Sirve como campo de entrenamiento activo y santuario secreto para los iniciados de la nefasta secta Filo Ardiente que opera en Durotar. Con vistas al Cañón del Ventajo, la Cueva Viento Seco es una de las amenazas más cercanas y peligrosas para Cerrotajo. Aunque muchos asumen que los sectarios demoníacos solo se reúnen en las profundidades subterráneas, aquí el Filo Ardiente entrena a nuevos reclutas ante las mismísimas narices de las autoridades de la Horda. Sectarios sombríos instruyen a los iniciados en magias oscuras prohibidas y demonología, preparándolos para socavar el joven reino orco desde el interior de las fronteras de Durotar.

ang.class:Warlock: Warlocks of the Horde will recognize the dark rituals taking place within Dustwind Cave, though the Burning Blade wields their fel gifts toward rebellion rather than the service of Thrall's new order.
ang.faction:Horde: Dustwind Cave represents an embarrassing and dangerous internal breach, harboring demon cultists within shouting distance of Razor Hill.

faq.a: Dustwind Cave is situated high along the clifftops of Razorwind Canyon, directly northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar.
faq.q: Where is Dustwind Cave located?

faq.a: The cave is occupied by cultists and initiates of the Burning Blade, a shadowy demonic cult dedicated to spreading fel corruption and destabilizing the Horde.
faq.q: Who occupies Dustwind Cave?

faq.a: The Burning Blade uses Dustwind Cave as a secluded training outpost where seasoned cultists instruct new recruits in demonic arts away from the immediate gaze of the Orgrimmar and Razor Hill guards.
al: why are cultists in dustwind cave
faq.q: Why is the Burning Blade operating here?

faq.a: Having demon-worshiping cultists lurking just steps away from Razor Hill poses an unacceptable security risk to traveling recruits and the overall defense of Durotar.
faq.q: Why does the Horde want this cave cleared?

text.s: Dustwind Cave is a secluded hollow perched atop the cliffs of Razorwind Canyon, just northeast of Razor Hill. It serves as an active training ground and covert sanctuary for initiates of the nefarious Burning Blade cult operating within Durotar.

sec.b: Overlooking Razorwind Canyon, Dustwind Cave is one of the closest and most perilous threats to Razor Hill. While many assume demonic cultists gather only in deep subterranean depths, here the Burning Blade trains fresh recruits right under the noses of the Horde authorities. Shadowy cultists tutor initiates in forbidden dark magics and demonology, preparing them to undermine the young orcish realm from within Durotar's own borders.

Those who trespass into the cave risk exposure to the cultists' dangerous corruptions. Practitioners inside channel volatile dark arts such as felblood afflictions, demonstrating how deeply the Burning Blade clings to the demonic legacy Thrall fought so hard to banish. Eliminating the cabal here is vital for maintaining the precarious peace of Durotar.

subzone:eastvale-logging-camp.n: Aserradero de la Vega del Este
subzone:eastvale-logging-camp.s: Aserradero de la Vega del Este. El Aserradero de la Vega del Este es un asentamiento maderero vital enclavado en los bosques orientales del Bosque de Elwynn, cerca de la frontera con las Montañas Crestagrana. El campamento suministra madera esencial a Ventormenta y a los asentamientos circundantes, pero sus operaciones se ven constantemente obstaculizadas por depredadores hambrientos que merodean por los bosques cercanos. Los pedidos de madera llegan constantemente al Aserradero de la Vega del Este de parte de compradores de todo el Reino de Ventormenta, pero cumplir estos plazos tan estrictos es una tarea angustiosa. La densa espesura que rodea el campamento rebosa de lobos feroces y osos al acecho que a menudo ahuyentan a los leñadores de sus puestos de trabajo, dejando valiosa madera cortada abandonada en el bosque. Bajo la dirección del Supervisor Raelen, el campamento recurre con frecuencia a aventureros errantes para diezmar a las bestias invasoras y recuperar la madera caída antes de que las entregas sufran retrasos irreparables.

ang.faction:Alliance: Eastvale Logging Camp is one of the premier locations in Elwynn Forest where Alliance members can purchase dependable Stormwind steeds.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, Eastvale provides the essential timber that continues to rebuild and maintain the kingdom's settlements.

faq.a: Eastvale serves as the primary timber source in eastern Elwynn Forest for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Lumberjacks here work long hours under strict deadlines to fulfill heavy demands for wood from builders and nobles across the realm.
faq.q: What is the main purpose of Eastvale Logging Camp?
