Más allá del enorme portal, los visitantes acceden a la propia ciudad, recibidos de inmediato por una gigantesca estatua de piedra en honor al rey supremo Modimus Yunquemar, el legendario monarca que unió a los clanes enanos antes de la Guerra de los Tres Martillos. Cruzar estas puertas conduce directamente al bullicioso distrito comercial de los Aledaños.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Gates of Ironforge stand as one of the Alliance's most fortified redoubts, virtually impervious to siege from the frigid valleys of Dun Morogh.
ang.race:Dwarf: Standing beneath the grand likeness of High King Modimus Anvilmar reminds every dwarf of the ancient era when all clans lived under one mountain as a single kin.

faq.a: They connect the exterior mountain terrain of Dun Morogh to the city of Ironforge. Passing through the threshold brings you directly into the southwestern part of the Commons, the city's lively trade and banking hub.
faq.q: Where do the Gates of Ironforge lead?

faq.a: The monumental sculpture just inside the entrance depicts High King Modimus Anvilmar. He was the wise and revered monarch who presided over all dwarven clans before political rifts fractured them into the Bronzebeard, Wildhammer, and Dark Iron factions.
al: who is the statue at the gate
faq.q: Who is the statue inside the gates depicting?

faq.a: From central Dun Morogh, head north and climb the broad, fortified stone ramp carved into the mountainside. The ramp leads straight to the exterior threshold of the mountain fortress.
faq.q: How do you reach the gates from Dun Morogh?

text.s: The Gates of Ironforge serve as the monumental main entrance leading travelers from the snowy mountain vales of Dun Morogh into the dwarven capital. Carved directly into the sheer stone face of the mountain, they are guarded inside by a colossal statue of High King Modimus Anvilmar.

sec.b: Approached by climbing the winding, fortified ramp ascending from central Dun Morogh, the Gates of Ironforge present an imposing facade visible across much of the snowy lowlands. Beyond the massive portal, visitors enter the city proper, greeted immediately by an enormous stone statue honoring High King Modimus Anvilmar—the legendary ruler who united the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. Passing through these gates leads directly into the bustling commercial district of the Commons.

subzone:gates-of-orgrimmar.s: Puertas de Orgrimmar. Las Puertas de Orgrimmar forman el imponente umbral sur de la capital de la Horda, excavado directamente en la roca roja del norte de Durotar. Flanqueada por pesadas almenas de madera y hierro, esta gran entrada conecta los áridos páramos del exterior con los concurridos espacios comunes del Valle de la Fuerza. Se erige como una declaración física de la resistencia y la fuerza marcial orcas. Enmarcada por imponentes empalizadas de madera, enormes púas de hierro y torres de vigilancia fortificadas, la puerta principal custodia el desfiladero primario que se adentra en las montañas que protegen Orgrimmar. Para los viajeros que se aproximan desde Cerrotajo y los matorrales de Durotar, la entrada sirve tanto de monumento de bienvenida como de severo elemento disuasorio para cualquiera que amenace a la nueva Horda. Orgrimmar Grunts y Lanza Negra Headhunters fuertemente armados patrullan la aproximación, manteniendo una vigilancia constante sobre todo el tráfico que entra a la ciudad.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance scouts and infiltrators, the gate is one of the most heavily guarded bottlenecks on Kalimdor, virtually impossible to breach by frontal assault.
ang.faction:Horde: The massive gates represent safety, belonging, and a hard-won homeland forged under the leadership of Warchief Thrall.

faq.a: The gates connect northern Durotar directly into the Valley of Strength, which serves as the primary entrance and central commons of Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Where do the Gates of Orgrimmar lead?

faq.a: The front gates are guarded by seasoned Orgrimmar Grunts and Darkspear Headhunters, maintaining a constant vigil against hostile infiltrators and wild beasts.
faq.q: Who guards the gates?

faq.a: The architecture reflects traditional orcish frontier fortification, utilizing sturdy timber from nearby lands and iron spikes to create an intimidating, easily defensible choke point within the canyon walls.
faq.q: Why is the entrance fortified with wood and spikes?

faq.a: Alliance members attempting to walk through the main gate will immediately face hostile veteran guards ready to strike down any enemy of the Horde on sight.
faq.q: Can Alliance players pass through this gate?

text.s: The Gates of Orgrimmar form the imposing southern threshold of the Horde capital, carved directly into the red rock of northern Durotar. Flanked by heavy timber and iron battlements, this grand entryway connects the arid wastes outside to the busy commons of the Valley of Strength. It stands as a physical declaration of orcish endurance and martial strength.

sec.b: Framed by towering wooden palisades, massive iron spikes, and fortified watchtowers, the main gate guards the primary chasm cutting into the mountains sheltering Orgrimmar. For travelers approaching from Razor Hill and the scrublands of Durotar, the entrance serves as both a welcoming monument and a stark deterrent to any who would threaten the new Horde. Heavily armed Orgrimmar Grunts and Darkspear Headhunters patrol the approach, keeping vigilant watch over all traffic entering the city.

Passing beneath the shadowed arch of the gates leads directly into the Valley of Strength, the civic and martial heart of Orgrimmar. The gate tunnel acts as an acoustic and tactical bottleneck, funneling envoys, merchants, and warriors past watchful sentries. It represents the realization of Warchief Thrall's dream: a secure sanctuary carved from the harsh desert where the disparate peoples of the Horde can walk united without fear.

subzone:gol-bolar-quarry.s: Cantera de Gol'Bolar. La Cantera de Gol'Bolar es una excavación enana excavada en las colinas nevadas del sureste de Dun Morogh. Rica en piedra y mineral, la bulliciosa explotación minera se ha paralizado tras verse desbordada por despiadados troggs surgidos de las profundidades. Situada al sureste de Kharanos, la Cantera de Gol'Bolar fue establecida por los enanos de Forjaz para extraer piedra vital y riqueza mineral de las montañas. Sin embargo, las excavaciones a gran profundidad descubrieron madrigueras subterráneas, liberando una horda de troggs hostiles que no tardaron en expulsar a los mineros. Hoy en día, el campamento superior sirve como una base de operaciones sitiada donde los capataces, los artesanos y el Prospector Gehn congregan a reclutas enanos y gnomos para hacer retroceder a las bestias y recuperar la fosa.

ang.profession:Mining: The exposed rock tiers and adjacent tunnels offer plentiful mineral veins, though prospectors must fight through entrenched troggs to reach them.
ang.race:Dwarf: Clearing Gol'Bolar Quarry is a matter of both economic necessity and clan pride, as Ironforge cannot afford to let brutish troggs seize its mountain resources.

faq.a: Gol'Bolar Quarry is an open-pit mining operation in southeastern Dun Morogh. Maintained by Ironforge dwarves, it serves as both an excavation site and a small outpost providing supplies and work for local adventurers.
faq.q: What is Gol'Bolar Quarry?

faq.a: Dwarven miners dug too deeply into the earth and breached subterranean tunnels inhabited by troggs. The creatures swarmed into the open pits and adjoining mine shafts, forcing the miners to fall back to the quarry's upper rim.
faq.q: Why are there so many troggs here?

faq.a: Prospector Gehn is a dwarven supervisor stationed at the quarry's camp. He oversees efforts to secure the dig site, issuing bounties and tasks to adventurers willing to cull the trogg population.
faq.q: Who is Prospector Gehn?

text.s: Gol'Bolar Quarry is a dwarven excavation site carved into the snowy hills of southeastern Dun Morogh. Rich in stone and ore, the bustling mining operation has ground to a halt after being overrun by vicious troggs surging from the depths.

sec.b: Situated southeast of Kharanos, Gol'Bolar Quarry was established by Ironforge dwarves to extract vital stone and mineral wealth from the mountains. However, deep excavation work uncovered underground warrens, unleashing a horde of hostile troggs that quickly drove out the miners. Today, the upper camp serves as an embattled staging ground where overseers, tradesfolk, and Prospector Gehn rally dwarven and gnomish recruits to drive the beasts back and reclaim the pit.

subzone:gol-bolar-quarry-mine.n: Mina de la Cantera de Gol'Bolar
subzone:gol-bolar-quarry-mine.s: Mina de la Cantera de Gol'Bolar. Mina de la Cantera de Gol'Bolar es un pozo de excavación invadido en el corazón de Cantera de Gol'Bolar, en el este de Dun Morogh. Originalmente explotada por mineros enanos, los túneles perforaron cavernas subterráneas de troggs, desatando una violenta plaga que se apoderó de todo el lugar. Hoy en día, los pozos más profundos sirven de fortaleza para la banda de guerra trogg liderada por el bruto Hammerspine. La mina fue establecida por los enanos de Forjaz en busca de piedra y ricos yacimientos de mineral bajo los escarpados picos de Dun Morogh. Las obras se detuvieron de forma abrupta y violenta cuando los picos fracturaron un muro que daba a un antiguo sistema de cavernas subterráneas habitado por troggs. Al salir en masa de la oscuridad, las bestias subterráneas abrumaron a las cuadrillas de trabajo y las forzaron a una precipitada retirada, desbordándose finalmente hacia el exterior para invadir también el foso de la cantera circundante.

ang.profession:Mining: A stark reminder of the hazards of subterranean excavation, this mine remains entirely blocked by hostile troggs until its deepest tunnels are purged.
ang.race:Dwarf: Every pick swing into the mountain carries the risk of awakening what lies beneath. Reclaiming Gol'Bolar Mine is a matter of both economic necessity and dwarven pride.

faq.a: Dwarven miners accidentally broke into a hidden underground cavern while digging. The slumbering troggs inside swarmed through the breach, slaughtered or drove out the excavators, and claimed the mine shafts as their home.
al: why are troggs in gol bolar
faq.q: Why is the mine full of troggs?

faq.a: The troggs inside the mine are led by Hammerspine, a hulking brute who commands the strongest members of the warband from deep within the shafts.
faq.q: Who leads the troggs inside Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine?

faq.a: Yes. The outer quarry pit contains the surface works and weaker troggs, while the mine consists of deep, claustrophobic subterranean tunnels containing the toughest troggs and their chieftain.
faq.q: Is the mine different from the rest of the quarry?

faq.a: No. All mining operations have completely ceased. The site is an active war zone where dwarven mountaineers and adventurers work to purge the trogg threat rather than harvest stone.
faq.q: Can miners still work here?

text.s: Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine is an overrun excavation pit deep within the heart of Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. Originally worked by dwarven miners, the tunnels breached subterranean trogg caverns, unleashing a violent infestation that claimed the entire site. Today, the deepest shafts serve as the stronghold for the trogg warband led by the brute Hammerspine.

sec.b: The mine was established by Ironforge dwarves seeking stone and rich ore deposits beneath the craggy peaks of Dun Morogh. Work came to an abrupt, violent halt when pickaxes fractured a wall into an ancient subterranean cavern system inhabited by troggs. Swarming out from the dark, the subterranean beasts overwhelmed the work crews and forced a hasty retreat, ultimately spilling outward to overrun the surrounding quarry pit as well.

While younger, weaker troggs roam the sunlit terraces of the quarry basin, the mine itself harbors the warband's fiercest fighters. Deep within these cramped, torchlit tunnels lurks their vicious chieftain, Hammerspine. Reclaiming the valuable quarry remains an urgent priority for the local mountaineers, but driving the infestation out requires venturing into the blackest depths of the mine to cut off the beasts at their source.

subzone:gold-coast-quarry.n: Mina de la Costa del Oro
subzone:gold-coast-quarry.s: Mina de la Costa del Oro. La Mina de la Costa del Oro es una mina a cielo abierto excavada en los riscos del suroeste de Páramos de Poniente. Antaño una preciada fuente de piedra, minerales y oro para el Reino de Ventormenta, ha sido tomada por la Hermandad Defias para alimentar su creciente insurrección. Antes de que el reino cayera en el abandono, la Mina de la Costa del Oro suministraba materiales de construcción en bruto y oro precioso para ayudar a reconstruir Ventormenta. Cuando las tropas reales se retiraron de Páramos de Poniente y dejaron el campo desprotegido, los salteadores de caminos de los Defias y los obreros renegados se hicieron con el control de las excavaciones. La Hermandad patrulla ahora las rampas de piedra aterrazadas, aprovechando la posición ventajosa del lugar sobre la costa y saqueando los minerales que aún quedan para financiar su rebelión.

ang.faction:Alliance: Reclaiming sites like the Gold Coast Quarry is vital to restoring order in Westfall, where the absence of royal garrisons has forced local volunteers to take up arms.
ang.profession:Mining: Miners wandering Westfall will find rich stone faces and mineral veins cut along the quarry cliffs, though working them means fighting through entrenched Defias patrols.

faq.a: The quarry was established by the Kingdom of Stormwind to extract stone, minerals, and gold from the coastal bluffs. Much of the stone quarried across Westfall helped support Stormwind's reconstruction following the Second War.
al: why is there a quarry here
faq.q: What was the quarry originally used for?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood controls the site. Their brigands, looters, and highwaymen patrol the terraced cliffs and mine entrances, keeping honest settlers away and extracting resources for their own illicit operations.
faq.q: Who controls the Gold Coast Quarry right now?

faq.a: With King Varian Wrynn missing and the Stormwind House of Nobles unwilling to fund a standing military garrison in Westfall, the region has been abandoned by the crown. The local People's Militia must fight for control of places like the quarry on their own.
faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent guards to clear the quarry?

faq.a: It is carved into the cliffs along the southwestern coastline of Westfall, situated south of the Saldean and Alexston farmsteads and overlooking the Great Sea.
al: how to find gold coast quarry
faq.q: Where is the Gold Coast Quarry located?

text.s: The Gold Coast Quarry is an open-pit mine carved into the bluffs of southwestern Westfall. Once a prized source of stone, minerals, and gold for the Kingdom of Stormwind, it has been seized by the Defias Brotherhood to fuel their growing insurrection.

sec.b: Before the kingdom fell into neglect, the Gold Coast Quarry supplied raw building materials and precious gold to help rebuild Stormwind. When royal troops withdrew from Westfall and left the countryside unprotected, Defias highwaymen and renegade laborers took control of the diggings. The Brotherhood now patrols the terraced stone ramps, using the site's vantage over the coast and plundering whatever minerals remain to fund their rebellion.

subzone:gold-road.s: Camino del Oro. El Camino del Oro es la principal arteria norte-sur que atraviesa la árida extensión de Los Baldíos. Extendiéndose desde La Muralla de Mor'shan, en la frontera de Vallefresno, pasando por El Cruce hacia los confines meridionales, sirve como una vital línea de tránsito para la joven Horda. El Camino del Oro es una larga calzada de tierra curtida por el sol que se abre paso a través del centro de Los Baldíos. Hacia el norte, comienza cerca de los fortificados La Muralla de Mor'shan y Campamento de Mor'shan, que custodian la zona frente a las incursiones de los elfos de la noche desde Vallefresno. Al viajar hacia el sur, conecta con el camino oriental que conduce a Durotar antes de cruzarse con el bullicioso asentamiento comercial de El Cruce. Continuando hacia el sur, más allá de las frondosas aguas de los oasis locales y las estribaciones cercanas a las Cuevas de los Lamentos, el tramo septentrional de la calzada llega a un lecho de río seco, donde los viajeros pasan a la parte meridional más peligrosa de la sabana.

ang.class:Hunter: The savanna bordering the road teems with plains beasts, making its long path an ideal trek for tracking and taming early hunting companions like lions and raptors.
ang.faction:Horde: The Gold Road is the backbone of Horde logistics in Kalimdor, tying the orcish capital in Durotar to the tauren lands in Mulgore and the northern forward camps near Ashenvale.

faq.a: The Gold Road begins in the far north of the Barrens at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border of Ashenvale. Its northern section runs south through the Crossroads down to a dried-up riverbed dividing the northern and southern Barrens, where the Southern Gold Road continues onward past Camp Taurajo toward the Great Lift.
al: where does the gold road go
faq.q: Where does the Gold Road begin and end?

faq.a: The road connects all major territories of the newly established Horde in central Kalimdor. It bridges the supply lines from Durotar and the port of Ratchet with the tauren homelands in Mulgore and the northern military front against the Night Elves in Ashenvale.
faq.q: Why is the Gold Road so important to the Horde?

faq.a: Travelers frequently encounter Razormane and Bristleback quilboar raiding parties, wandering Kolkar centaur, and aggressive wild beasts such as savanna prowlers and thunder lizards. The road is far from secure outside the perimeter of the Crossroads.
faq.q: What threats wander near the road?

faq.a: North of the Crossroads, an eastward fork branches off from the Gold Road and leads directly over the Southfury River via the wooden bridge into Durotar.
faq.q: How does the Gold Road connect to Durotar?

text.s: The Gold Road is the primary north-south artery cutting through the arid expanse of the Barrens. Stretching from the Mor'shan Rampart on the border of Ashenvale down past the Crossroads toward the southern reaches, it serves as the vital transit line for the young Horde.

sec.b: The Gold Road is a long, sun-baked dirt highway that carves its way through the center of the Barrens. To the north, it begins near the fortified Mor'shan Rampart and Mor'shan Base Camp, which guard against night elf incursions from Ashenvale. Traveling south, it connects with the eastern roadway leading to Durotar before intersecting the bustling trading settlement of the Crossroads. Continuing southward past the lush waters of the local oases and the foothills near the Wailing Caverns, the northern span of the highway reaches a dried-up riverbed, where travelers cross into the more hazardous southern portion of the savanna.

Despite being the lifeblood of Horde trade and military movement between Kalimdor's central territories, the Gold Road is perilous. Marauding quilboar tribes, centaur warbands, and prowling plainstriders and lions constantly threaten supply caravans and solitary messengers. The Horde expends considerable resources deploying scouts and warriors along its length, yet travelers are urged to remain armed and alert whenever leaving the safety of the major outposts.

subzone:golden-plains.s: Las Llanuras Doradas. Las Llanuras Doradas forman una vasta cuenca bañada por el sol que se extiende al sureste de Cima del Trueno, en el centro de Mulgore. Muy queridas por los tauren, estas amplias praderas sirven como territorio de caza primordial y hábitat de pasto vital para las manadas errantes de kodos. Extendiéndose bajo las imponentes mesetas de Cima del Trueno, Las Llanuras Doradas representan el corazón salvaje de Mulgore. El ondulante mar de hierba dorada y verde ofrece un santuario abundante para la fauna local, lo que las convierte en uno de los cotos de caza tradicionales más preciados de los nómadas tauren. Grandes manadas de kodos deambulan por la ondulada cuenca, mientras los cazadores comparten historias de presas legendarias, en especial del gran kodo Arra'chea, que vaga en silencio entre los altos tallos.

ang.class:Hunter: The vast open expanse and roaming kodo herds make these plains a prime testing ground for trackers seeking legendary beasts like Arra'chea.
ang.race:Tauren: For the tauren, the Golden Plains are an enduring symbol of their homeland's bounty, offering sacred hunting grounds beneath the shadow of Thunder Bluff.

faq.a: The Golden Plains are a broad grassland basin located southeast of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore. They are a beloved cultural hunting ground for the tauren, defined by wide vistas and sprawling wildlife.
faq.q: What are the Golden Plains?

faq.a: The basin is famous for its abundant herds of wild kodo, alongside other native creatures of Mulgore. The most famous beast said to wander these grasslands is the elusive and revered kodo named Arra'chea.
faq.q: What animals roam the Golden Plains?

faq.a: The plains serve as a vital source of game and hides, providing sustenance for the newly founded settlements across Mulgore and celebrating the tauren tradition of tracking and honoring their quarry.
faq.q: Why is this area important to the tauren?

text.s: The Golden Plains form a vast, sun-drenched basin stretching southeast of Thunder Bluff in central Mulgore. Cherished by the tauren, these sweeping grasslands serve as prime hunting territory and a vital grazing habitat for wandering herds of kodo.

sec.b: Spreading out beneath the towering mesas of Thunder Bluff, the Golden Plains represent the untamed heart of Mulgore. The shifting sea of golden and green grass offers an abundant sanctuary for local wildlife, making it one of the most treasured traditional hunting grounds of the nomadic tauren. Broad kodo herds roam across the rolling basin, while hunters share stories of legendary quarry, most notably the great kodo Arra'chea, who wanders quietly through the tall stalks.

subzone:goldshire.s: Villadorada. Villadorada es una encrucijada vital de los humanos situada en el centro del Bosque de Elwynn, que conecta Ciudad de Ventormenta con Páramos de Poniente, Montañas Crestagrana y la frontera sur. Reconstruida tras su destrucción en la Primera Guerra, sirve como una bulliciosa estación de paso articulada en torno a la célebre Posada Orgullo de León y defendida por un contingente de la Guardia de Ventormenta en apuros. Ubicada en la intersección de los caminos reales, Villadorada ha sido durante mucho tiempo el núcleo cívico y comercial de la zona rural de Elwynn. Sin embargo, el encanto bucólico del pueblo oculta un peligro creciente en el año 25 ADP. Con los recursos militares de Ventormenta mermados y el rey Varian Wrynn misteriosamente ausente, el Alguacil Dughan debe recurrir a aventureros de paso en lugar de a tropas regulares para contener las amenazas circundantes. Los agresivos gnolls Zarparrío avanzan hacia el interior desde la frontera occidental, mientras que despiadados múrlocs se adueñan de las orillas del Lago del Hito y el Lago de Cristal, cobrándose las vidas de guardias reales y aproximándose peligrosamente al centro del pueblo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Goldshire is an essential transit hub connecting the Alliance capital to the surrounding frontier lands of Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood.
ang.race:Human: For humans fresh out of Northshire Abbey, Goldshire represents the first real taste of the kingdom beyond monastery walls, offering a sobering look at Stormwind's strained borders.

faq.a: Marshal Dughan of the Stormwind Guard commands local defense. Operating out of the center of town, he coordinates the garrison, though a lack of reinforcements forces him to hire freelance adventurers to handle border threats and monster bounties.
faq.q: Who is in charge of defending Goldshire?

faq.a: Goldshire is pressured from multiple fronts: Riverpaw gnolls raiding eastward toward Westbrook Garrison, and bands of hostile murlocs infesting the waterways at Stone Cairn Lake and Crystal Lake. Local scouts warn that without intervention, skirmishes could reach the village streets.
faq.q: What threats are currently menacing the town?

faq.a: Goldshire was one of the last two human towns to fall before the sack of Stormwind. Warchief Blackhand destroyed it alongside Moonbrook to sever King Llane's supply lines, leaving the settlement in ruins until it was rebuilt following the Second War.
faq.q: What happened to Goldshire during the First War?

faq.a: The Lion's Pride Inn is renowned as one of the most respectable and frequented alehouses in Azeroth. Situated at the junction of several regional highways, it serves as the primary meeting hall, resting spot, and training ground for travelers passing through the kingdom.
faq.q: Why is the Lion's Pride Inn so notable?

text.s: Goldshire is a vital human crossroads town nestled in central Elwynn Forest, connecting Stormwind City with Westfall, Redridge, and the southern frontier. Rebuilt after its destruction in the First War, it serves as a bustling waystation anchored by the famous Lion's Pride Inn and defended by a hard-pressed contingent of the Stormwind Guard.

sec.b: Positioned where the king's highways meet, Goldshire has long been the civic and commercial heart of rural Elwynn. However, the town's bucolic charm masks escalating peril in Year 25 ADP. With Stormwind's military resources stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn mysteriously absent, Marshal Dughan must rely on passing adventurers rather than regular troops to contain surrounding threats. Aggressive Riverpaw gnolls push inward from the western border, while vicious murlocs claim the shores of Stone Cairn Lake and Crystal Lake, claiming the lives of royal guards and encroaching dangerously close to the town center.

Goldshire's quiet atmosphere belies a brutal military history. Circa 75 BDP, the settlement repelled savage assaults during the Gnoll War. Decades later in the First War, Goldshire and Moonbrook were the final strongholds overwhelmed by the Orcish Horde as Warchief Blackhand cut off King Llane Wrynn I from his realm before sacking Stormwind Keep. The town was reduced to ash and remained barren until after the Second War, when the Alliance of Lordaeron under Supreme Commander Turalyon funded and organized its reconstruction to repatriate human refugees returning south.

subzone:grand-vestibule.s: Gran Vestíbulo. El Gran Vestíbulo es el monumental vestíbulo de entrada del Monasterio Escarlata en Claros de Tirisfal. Bordeado de pilares carmesíes y efigies de piedra de cruzados caídos, sirve como umbral donde los aventureros se preparan para penetrar en las salas interiores del monasterio. Más allá de las pesadas puertas exteriores del Monasterio se encuentra el Gran Vestíbulo, una amplia sala de mármol dedicada al orgullo marcial de la Cruzada Escarlata. Estatuas de campeones acorazados montan guardia junto a pilares de piedra abovedados, y centinelas, discípulos y augures fanáticos patrullan las losas para abatir a cualquiera que ose entrar sin el tabardo carmesí de la orden. Para los intrusos, es la primera muestra de la implacable disciplina y el fanatismo de la Cruzada.

ang.faction:Alliance: The vestibule displays the tragic corruption of Lordaeron's former holy sanctuaries, showing how devotion to the Light curdled into blind, violent fanaticism.
ang.race:Undead: Positioned just northeast of the Undercity, this grand entryway represents the frontline of the living zealots actively threatening Forsaken sovereignty in Tirisfal.

faq.a: It is the grand entrance chamber of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, connecting the outer courtyard to the four interior wings.
faq.q: What is the Grand Vestibule?

faq.a: The chamber is defended by active Scarlet Crusade personnel, primarily Scarlet Sentries, Scarlet Disciples, and Scarlet Augurs stationed to bar intruders.
faq.q: What enemies guard this area?

faq.a: Both factions send champions into the Monastery—the Alliance seeking to reclaim Lordaeron's holy sites or purge heretics, and the Horde acting to secure Tirisfal Glades for the Forsaken. Their paths inevitably collide in this shared entrance hall.
faq.q: Why do the Alliance and Horde fight here?

faq.a: The statues depict honored warriors and heroes of the Scarlet Crusade, sculpted in heavy plate armor to serve as enduring symbols of their unyielding crusade against the undead.
faq.q: Whom do the statues in the vestibule depict?

text.s: The Grand Vestibule is the monumental entrance hall of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Lined with crimson pillars and stone effigies of fallen crusaders, it serves as the threshold where adventurers prepare to breach the monastery's inner halls.

sec.b: Past the heavy outer gates of the Monastery lies the Grand Vestibule, an expansive marble hall dedicated to the martial pride of the Scarlet Crusade. Statues of armored champions stand vigil beside vaulted stone pillars, and zealous sentries, disciples, and augurs patrol the flagstones to strike down anyone daring to enter without the order's crimson tabard. For trespassers, it is the first taste of the Crusade's unrelenting discipline and fanaticism.

Because the vestibule sits directly outside the secured inner wings of the monastery, it functions as a perilous gathering point. Both Alliance strike teams sent north and Horde forces pushing out from the nearby Undercity converge under these high arches, turning the ornate entry into a chaotic and bloody battleground long before anyone breaches the inner cloisters.

subzone:great-forge.s: Gran Fundición. La Gran Fundición es el ardiente corazón de la capital enana de Forjaz y da nombre a la ciudad. Situada en el mismísimo centro de la ciudad, sus gigantescos hornos y su célebre Gran Yunque nunca descansan, produciendo armamento legendario y sirviendo como el bullicioso centro de la vida cívica. La Gran Fundición fue la primerísima estructura construida por los primeros enanos bajo la montaña de Forjaz, y la gran capital creció en anillos concéntricos a su alrededor. La roca fundida y la escoria se vierten constantemente desde gigantescas fundiciones hacia canales incandescentes, iluminando la caverna con una neblina ámbar. En su centro se alza el imponente Gran Yunque, supervisado por el maestro de la forja Myolor Furiahendida. Renombrados maestros del trabajo del metal se reúnen alrededor de su borde, forjando armaduras, herramientas y armas día y noche.

ang.profession:Blacksmithing: The Great Anvil is considered the premier smithing site in the Alliance, home to high-ranking trainers and the legendary anvil where King Magni forged the Ashbringer.
ang.race:Dwarf: The forge represents the very foundation of dwarven civilization under the mountain, keeping centuries of smithing tradition alive without ever letting its fires go cold.

faq.a: When the dwarves first carved out the mountain, the Great Forge was the first part of the settlement they constructed. As the subterranean halls expanded outward from this central chamber, the entire mountain city was named Ironforge in honor of the colossal furnace at its center.
faq.q: Why is the city named after this forge?

faq.a: The Great Anvil has yielded historic masterpieces throughout dwarven history. King Magni Bronzebeard personally forged the legendary blade Ashbringer upon its surface. The dwarves also crafted two monumental alliance bells here, sending one as a gift to Lordaeron and the other to Stormwind City, alongside ancient relics like the Aerie Battle Mace.
al: what was made at the great anvil
faq.q: What notable items have been created here?

faq.a: The day-to-day operations and maintenance of the massive hearth are directed by Myolor Sunderfury, who bears the title Keeper of the Great Forge.
faq.q: Who oversees the forge?

faq.a: The forge sits at the geographic center of Ironforge, connecting directly to the outer ring and nearby districts. It hosts essential crafting trainers, merchant shops, and Ironforge's central gryphon roost, ensuring that citizens, couriers, and foreign adventurers pass through constantly.
al: why so many people at the forge
faq.q: Why is it always so crowded here?

text.s: The Great Forge is the fiery heart and namesake of the dwarven capital of Ironforge. Situated at the very center of the city, its massive furnaces and famed Great Anvil never rest, producing legendary armaments and serving as the bustling center of civic life.

sec.b: The Great Forge was the very first structure built by the early dwarves beneath Ironforge Mountain, and the grand capital grew in concentric rings around it. Molten stone and slag pour constantly from giant foundries into glowing channels, illuminating the cavern with an amber haze. At its center stands the massive Great Anvil, overseen by Master of the Forge Myolor Sunderfury. Renowned masters of metalwork gather around its rim, hammering out armor, tools, and weapons day and night.

Beyond its smithing operations, the Great Forge is the bustling crossroads of the entire mountain city. Ringed with guild offices, supply shops, and the city's primary gryphon roost maintained by Gryth Thurden, travelers from every corner of the Alliance mingle amid the clatter of hammers.

subzone:great-lift.s: El Gran Elevador. El Gran Elevador es un enorme sistema de elevadores de ingeniería tauren situado en el extremo sur de Los Baldíos. Es la ruta principal para transportar a viajeros y suministros en un descenso de cientos de metros hasta la cuenca del escarpado cañón de Las Mil Agujas. A pesar de su valor estratégico, los agresivos jabaespines que avanzan por los páramos del sur han hecho que acercarse al borde sea cada vez más peligroso. Cruzando el escarpado borde del acantilado entre el sur de Los Baldíos y el suelo del cañón de Las Mil Agujas, El Gran Elevador se erige como una maravilla de la práctica construcción tauren. Construido con madera maciza, cuerda trenzada y poleas con contrapesos, sus plataformas emparejadas transportan caravanas, mensajeros y guerreros de forma segura a través de un precipicio vertical que, de otro modo, destrozaría cualquier carreta. En las plataformas superior e inferior, tauren como el Valiente Lunasta y Grish Largocamino montan guardia, manteniendo a los viajeros informados sobre el camino que tienen por delante y asegurándose de que la carga pase sin problemas.

ang.faction:Horde: The lift is a vital Horde arterial link connecting central Kalimdor to the isolated reaches of Thousand Needles and Shimmering Flats.
ang.race:Tauren: Constructed with sturdy timber and counterweights, the lift showcases your people's ingenious ability to overcome rugged landscape obstacles without scarring the earth.

faq.a: The Great Lift was designed and constructed by the tauren to bridge the massive vertical gap between the arid plateaus of the Barrens and the deep canyon floor of Thousand Needles.
faq.q: Who built the Great Lift?

faq.a: The encroaching quilboar of the southern Barrens have aggressively expanded their territory toward the rim. Their raiding parties prowl the approaches, often harassing or outright ambushing supply caravans and couriers bound for the elevator platforms.
faq.q: Why is traveling to the lift dangerous?

faq.a: Brave Moonhorn and Grish Longrunner are stationed at the lift to watch the routes, assist Horde travelers, and keep an eye on the surrounding wilderness.
faq.q: Who watches over the Great Lift?

faq.a: Riding the platforms down brings travelers onto the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, while ascending leads straight into the southern Barrens.
faq.q: Where does the Great Lift lead?

text.s: The Great Lift is a massive, tauren-engineered elevator system perched on the southern edge of the Barrens. It serves as the primary route lowering travelers and supplies hundreds of feet into the sheer canyon basin of Thousand Needles. Despite its strategic value, aggressive quilboar encroaching through the southern wastes have made approaching the rim increasingly perilous.

sec.b: Spanning the sheer cliff edge between the southern Barrens and the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, the Great Lift stands as a marvel of practical tauren construction. Built using heavy timber, braided rope, and counterweighted pulleys, its paired platforms carry caravans, couriers, and warriors safely across a vertical precipice that would otherwise break any wagon. At the top and bottom platforms, tauren like Brave Moonhorn and Grish Longrunner maintain watch, keeping travelers informed of the road ahead and ensuring cargo passes smoothly.
sec.t: A Gateway Carved from Wood and Rope

sec.b: Operating the lift has become increasingly hazardous due to the hostile territory above it. Aggressive quilboar tribes in the southern Barrens have expanded aggressively southward, choking the road toward the lift and threatening to cut off Thousand Needles from the northern trails entirely. Those who make the long journey south must constantly fend off razorfen raiders before they can ever step foot onto the wooden platforms.

subzone:greenpaw-village.s: Poblado Zarpaverde. Poblado Zarpaverde es un asentamiento fúrbolg ubicado en el centro de Vallefresno, situado entre el Refugio de la Algaba y el Refugio Brisa de Plata. Sirve como hogar principal de la tribu Maderiza, liderada por el jefe Murgut y el chamán Oakpaw. Atrapado por la corrupción demoníaca y asediado por fuerzas externas, el poblado es un punto de conflicto activo tanto para los viajeros de la Alianza como de la Horda. Situado al sur del Refugio de la Algaba y al noreste del Refugio Brisa de Plata, Poblado Zarpaverde fue antaño un hogar tranquilo para los habitantes úrsidos del bosque. A raíz de la Tercera Guerra, sus fúrbolgs residentes —la tribu Maderiza— sucumbieron a la insidiosa corrupción que contaminaba el suelo y los espíritus de Vallefresno. Bajo el dominio del jefe Murgut y su guía espiritual corrupto, el chamán Oakpaw, los Maderiza se han vuelto hostiles e inestables, atacando a cualquier viajero que se adentre en su territorio forestal.

ang.class:Druid: Druids witness the pain of the ancient bear folk firsthand at Greenpaw Village, where the balance of nature has broken down into rampant feral madness.
ang.race:NightElf: For the night elves, seeing the Foulweald succumb to corruption so near Raynewood Retreat and their sacred moonwells is a tragic reminder of Ashenvale's lingering demonic scars.

faq.a: Greenpaw Village lies in central Ashenvale, directly south of Raynewood Retreat, northeast of Silverwind Refuge, and just northwest of the southern moonwell.
faq.q: Where is Greenpaw Village located?

faq.a: The settlement is populated by the Foulweald furbolg tribe, who are governed by Chief Murgut alongside their corrupted spiritual advisor, Shaman Oakpaw.
faq.q: Who lives in Greenpaw Village?

faq.a: Like many furbolg tribes across northern Kalimdor, the Foulweald tribe fell victim to the demonic corruption left behind after the Burning Legion invaded Ashenvale, driving their minds into maddened aggression.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in Greenpaw Village hostile?

faq.a: Both factions view the aggressive Foulweald as a threat to their roads and settlements. The night elves seek to cleanse or contain the madness near their moonwells, while Horde forces clash with the furbolgs as they push through Ashenvale.
faq.q: Why are the Alliance and Horde fighting here?

text.s: Greenpaw Village is a furbolg settlement nestled in central Ashenvale, situated between Raynewood Retreat and Silverwind Refuge. It serves as the primary home of the Foulweald tribe, led by Chief Murgut and the shaman Oakpaw. Gripped by demonic corruption and embattled by outside forces, the village is an active conflict point for both Alliance and Horde travelers.

sec.b: Situated south of Raynewood Retreat and northeast of Silverwind Refuge, Greenpaw Village was once a quiet home for the forest's ursine denizens. In the wake of the Third War, its resident furbolgs—the Foulweald tribe—succumbed to the insidious corruption tainting Ashenvale's soil and spirits. Under the dominion of Chief Murgut and their corrupted spiritual guide, Shaman Oakpaw, the Foulweald have become hostile and unstable, attacking any travelers who stray into their forest territory.

Because of their relentless aggression and proximity to major roadways, Greenpaw Village draws hostility from every side. Alliance sentinels and night elf druids seek to purge the mad furbolgs to protect their nearby outposts and sacred moonwells. Simultaneously, Horde forces advancing into Ashenvale have fought bloody skirmishes against the Foulweald as both factions push through the ancient woodland.

subzone:greymane-wall.s: La Muralla de Cringrís. La Muralla de Cringrís es un enorme baluarte de piedra que se extiende por la frontera sur del Bosque de Argénteos. Construida por el rey Genn Cringrís tras la Segunda Guerra, aísla al reino de Gilneas del mundo exterior tras unas puertas impenetrables y cerradas a cal y canto. Tras la Segunda Guerra, el rey Genn Cringrís comenzó a resentirse con la Alianza de Lordaeron, en particular por los impuestos necesarios para mantener los campos de internamiento de orcos y construir el Castillo de Nethergarde. Al decidir que Gilneas ya había aportado suficientes monedas y sangre por problemas ajenos, Cringrís se retiró de la Alianza y ordenó erigir una colosal barrera a lo largo de la entrada de la península. Al hacerlo, abandonó tierras pertenecientes a Lord Darius Crowley —incluidas Aldea Piroleña y Molino Ámbar—, dejándolas aisladas en el lado norte de los muros. Cuando la Tercera Guerra trajo la Plaga de la no-muerte y a innumerables refugiados desesperados a sus pies, las puertas permanecieron despiadadamente atrancadas.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Greymane Wall stands as a bitter reminder of Gilnean abandonment. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, Greymane turned a deaf ear to his former allies, leaving them to rot outside his gates.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Forsaken who now claim Silverpine Forest, the wall forms an impassable southern border, sealing away a human kingdom whose intentions and inner strength remain entirely unknown.

faq.a: Behind the wall lies the peninsula kingdom of Gilneas. Ruled by King Genn Greymane, it completely isolated itself from Lordaeron and the rest of the world before the Third War, barring all commerce and communication.
al: what kingdom is behind the wall
faq.q: What lies beyond the Greymane Wall?

faq.a: No. The massive portcullis and iron-banded doors are firmly barred from the southern side. Gilneas has severed all contact with the outside world, and nothing enters or leaves.
al: how to get past greymane wall
faq.q: Can you open the gates of the Greymane Wall?

faq.a: The wall utilized the surrounding mountainous terrain as a natural barrier. Building along this ridge forced the kingdom to abandon the northern holdings of Lord Darius Crowley—including Pyrewood Village and Ambermill—sowing bitter domestic dissent within Gilneas.
al: why did they build it here
faq.q: Why was the wall built here instead of farther south?

faq.a: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, masses of fleeing human refugees gathered outside the wall begging for entry. King Greymane refused to unseal the gates to protect his kingdom, and the desperate refugees were eventually slaughtered by the undead outside.
faq.q: What happened to the refugees who fled here during the Third War?

text.s: The Greymane Wall is a massive stone bulwark spanning the southern frontier of Silverpine Forest. Built by King Genn Greymane after the Second War, it seals the kingdom of Gilneas away from the outside world behind impenetrable, locked gates.

sec.b: Following the Second War, King Genn Greymane grew resentful of the Alliance of Lordaeron, particularly the taxes required to maintain the orc internment camps and build Nethergarde Keep. Deciding Gilneas had given enough of its coin and blood for foreign troubles, Greymane withdrew from the Alliance and ordered a colossal barrier raised across the head of the peninsula. In doing so, he abandoned lands belonging to Lord Darius Crowley—including Pyrewood Village and Ambermill—leaving them stranded on the northern side of the stones. When the Third War brought the Plague of Undeath and countless desperate refugees to its foot, the gates remained pitilessly barred.

While the rampart successfully kept the armies of the Scourge from overrunning the peninsula, safety brought a dark price. Gilnean forces briefly opened the gates during the war to fight the undead, only to be overwhelmed. In desperation, King Greymane ordered Archmage Arugal to summon the feral worgen. Though the beasts drove back the Scourge, they turned on their summoners. Greymane's soldiers retreated and sealed the gates shut once more, but infected fighters carried the beastly contagion back inside. Behind the cold, silent wall, internal rebellion and a creeping curse now tear the isolated kingdom apart.

subzone:grim-batol.s: Grim Batol. Grim Batol es una antigua fortaleza montañosa enana en ruinas que se alza sobre el extremo oriental de Los Humedales. Construida por el clan Martillo Salvaje, abandonada tras una oscura maldición durante la Guerra de los Tres Martillos y ocupada más tarde por los orcos Faucedraco como guarida de cría de dragones, sus puertas selladas siguen siendo una ominosa lacra sobre las tierras altas. Tras la antigua guerra civil de los tres clanes, el thalador Khardros Martillo Salvaje excavó Grim Batol en las escarpadas montañas al este de la ciénaga. Durante la posterior Guerra de los Tres Martillos, la hechicera Hierro Negro Modgud asedió la fortaleza. Aunque Khardros la abatió, Modgud proyectó una sombra vil sobre las piedras antes de morir. La mácula persistente volvió inhabitables las salas, lo que obligó a los enanos Martillo Salvaje supervivientes a abandonar su magnífico reino y emigrar al norte, hacia Tierras del Interior.

ang.faction:Horde: The mountain represents the grim heights of the Second War, where the Dragonmaw clan harnessed enslaved dragons to conquer the skies before their violent ruin.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Grim Batol stands as a bitter testament to the War of the Three Hammers—a once-proud sister city to Ironforge rendered permanently unlivable by Dark Iron sorcery.

faq.a: No. The colossal stone gates at the end of the mountain road remain firmly barred and inaccessible to travelers. Only its imposing gates and exterior battlements in the eastern mountains of the Wetlands can be visited.
al: can i go inside grim batol
faq.q: Can players enter Grim Batol?

faq.a: During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud infused the stronghold with a vile shadow curse before she was slain. The taint left behind rendered the fortress unlivable for the Wildhammers, driving them to abandon it and build Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
al: why did dwarves leave grim batol
faq.q: Why did the Wildhammer dwarves abandon it?

faq.a: When the mage Rhonin and his companions shattered the Demon Soul, the captive Dragonqueen Alexstrasza was freed from her chains. Enraged by her cruel captivity, she and her brood incinerated Nekros Skullcrusher and shattered the Dragonmaw presence in the fortress.
al: what happened to the orcs here
faq.q: What happened to the Dragonmaw orcs who lived here?

faq.a: Presently, Grim Batol is an abandoned ruin. While remnants of the Dragonmaw clan and wild beasts linger in the surrounding crags, the Red Dragonflight maintains a watchful eye over the cursed mountain to ensure its dark history never repeats.
al: who lives in grim batol now
faq.q: Who controls Grim Batol right now?

text.s: Grim Batol is an ancient, ruined dwarven mountain fortress looming over the eastern edge of the Wetlands. Built by the Wildhammer clan, abandoned after a dark curse during the War of the Three Hammers, and later occupied by the Dragonmaw orcs as a dragon breeding lair, its sealed gates remain an ominous blight upon the highlands.

sec.b: Following the ancient civil war of the three clans, Thane Khardros Wildhammer carved Grim Batol out of the jagged mountains east of the marsh. During the subsequent War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud laid siege to the fortress. Although Khardros struck her down, Modgud cast a foul shadow across the stones before her death. The lingering taint rendered the halls uninhabitable, forcing the surviving Wildhammer dwarves to abandon their magnificent kingdom and migrate north into the Hinterlands.

Centuries later during the Second War, the fortress found a darker purpose when Orgrim Doomhammer dispatched the Dragonmaw clan to claim it. Led by the warlock Nekros Skullcrusher, the orcs utilized the ancient artifact known as the Demon Soul to enslave the red Dragonqueen Alexstrasza deep within the mountain's roots. Forced to hatch broods for the Horde's war effort, Alexstrasza remained chained until a small band of heroes shattered the artifact. Once freed, the enraged Dragon Aspect incinerated the orcs within, leaving Grim Batol a smoldering, desolate ruin watched closely by surviving red dragons.

subzone:grizzled-den.s: El Cubil Pardo. El Cubil Pardo es una caverna enclavada en las colinas nevadas justo al suroeste de Kharanos. Sirve como una conocida guarida para los feroces wendigos que escupen escarcha, autóctonos de Dun Morogh. Excavado en las profundidades de los riscos al suroeste de Kharanos, El Cubil Pardo es tristemente célebre entre los montañeros locales por ser el nido de las manadas de wendigos de Dun Morogh. Estas agresivas bestias simiescas usan su aliento helado contra los intrusos y se agrupan para proteger sus madrigueras. A pesar del peligro, cazadores intrépidos desafían con frecuencia las profundidades de la caverna para recolectar las densas melenas de wendigo, que alcanzan un precio respetable entre los artesanos que buscan forrar asientos fríos y carruajes con pieles aislantes.

ang.profession:Mining: The outer and inner tunnels of the den hold exposed copper deposits, making it a viable early digging spot if you can keep the wendigos off your back.
ang.race:Dwarf: Clearing the Grizzled Den is practically a rite of passage for young dwarven mountaineers training around Kharanos.

faq.a: The Grizzled Den is found southwest of Kharanos in Dun Morogh, tucked away into the snow-covered mountain ridges.
al: how to get to grizzled den
faq.q: Where is the Grizzled Den located?

faq.a: The cavern is overrun with packs of ferocious wendigos. These aggressive, white-furred beasts can exhale freezing frost and will readily swarm any interloper.
faq.q: What creatures live in the Grizzled Den?

faq.a: Hunters and adventurers brave the den primarily to hunt wendigos for their thick manes, which are highly prized for crafting warm seat covers. Others brave the freezing tunnels to extract raw copper ore from the cavern walls.
faq.q: Why do people venture into the Grizzled Den?

text.s: The Grizzled Den is a cavern nestled in the snowy hills just southwest of Kharanos. It serves as a notorious lair for the ferocious, frost-breathing wendigos indigenous to Dun Morogh.

sec.b: Carved deep into the crags southwest of Kharanos, the Grizzled Den is notorious among local mountaineers as the nesting ground of Dun Morogh's wendigo packs. These aggressive, ape-like beasts wield frosty breath against intruders and band together to protect their hollows. Despite the peril, daring hunters regularly brave the cavern's depths to harvest thick wendigo manes, which fetch a respectable sum among craftsmen looking to line cold chairs and carriage seats with insulated fur.

Beyond its fearsome inhabitants, the twisting tunnels of the Grizzled Den draw opportunists searching for natural wealth. Prospectors frequently venture past the outer entrance to hammer at copper veins jutting from the frozen stone walls, while adventurous scouts often scour the darker corners for discarded footlockers. However, delve too far into the inner reaches, and you are bound to face the dens' largest and most vicious predators lurking in the shadows.

subzone:grizzlepaw-ridge.s: Fuerte Zarpagris. Fuerte Zarpagris es una ladera escarpada y rocosa que se alza al sur de Thelsamar, en Loch Modan. Es conocida entre los montañeros locales por su densa población de osos salvajes, liderados por la legendaria bestia Ol' Sooty. Con vistas al camino al sur de Thelsamar y lindando con Valle Rompecantos al oeste, Fuerte Zarpagris es un terreno agreste dominado por fauna depredadora. Las laderas están tomadas por osos territoriales que suponen un peligro para los viajeros que bordean las montañas. En las profundidades de la cresta habita Ol' Sooty, un oso descomunal y extraordinariamente feroz temido por los cazadores locales. Los viajeros que se desplazan entre los asentamientos enanos deben vigilar de cerca la linde del bosque y las terrazas rocosas de arriba.

ang.class:Hunter: The ridge provides a classic proving ground for tracking wild beasts and confronting apex predators like Ol' Sooty.
ang.race:Dwarf: Perched right beside Thelsamar, the ridge's bear population represents a constant nuisance to local mountaineers and supply routes.

faq.a: Grizzlepaw Ridge lies in the central hills of Loch Modan, directly south of the town of Thelsamar and east of the trogg-infested Stonesplinter Valley.
al: how to get to grizzlepaw ridge
faq.q: Where is Grizzlepaw Ridge located?

faq.a: The ridge is crawling with aggressive bears. Its most infamous resident is Ol' Sooty, an exceptionally large and ferocious beast that occasionally prowls down toward the mountain base.
faq.q: What dangerous creatures live on Grizzlepaw Ridge?

text.s: Grizzlepaw Ridge is a rugged, craggy hillside rising south of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. It is notorious among local mountaineers for its dense population of wild bears, led by the legendary beast Ol' Sooty.

sec.b: Overlooking the road south of Thelsamar and bordering Stonesplinter Valley to the west, Grizzlepaw Ridge is rough country dominated by predatory wildlife. The slopes are claimed by territorial bears that pose a hazard to travelers skirting the mountains. Deep within the ridge dwells Ol' Sooty, a massive and unusually fierce bear feared by local hunters. Travelers moving between the dwarven settlements must keep a wary eye on the tree line and rocky terraces above.

subzone:grol-dom-farm.s: Granja de Grol'dom. La Granja de Grol'dom es una modesta hacienda orca situada en el norte de Los Baldíos, junto al camino que une Durotar y El Cruce. Habitada por Kranal Fiss y su familia, la granja cría cerdos en las áridas llanuras a pesar del constante acoso de los agresivos jabaespines locales. Establecida tras la colonización de Durotar, la Granja de Grol'dom representa los primeros esfuerzos de la Horda por cultivar la seca extensión de Los Baldíos. Atendida por el orco Kranal Fiss y sus hijos, la pequeña hacienda cría principalmente cerdos mientras desafía a la dura fauna y a los agresivos asaltantes jabaespines Crines de Acero que rondan las crestas cercanas. Es un puesto remoto y austero que proporciona un sustento vital a la emergente nación orca.

ang.class:Shaman: For initiates walking the elemental path, Grol'dom Farm is a vital milestone where Kranal Fiss guides you through the dangerous rites required to commune with the spirits of fire.
ang.faction:Horde: Homesteads like Grol'dom Farm showcase the grit required by early Horde settlers trying to carve a sustainable life out of the harsh, untamed Barrens.

faq.a: Grol'dom Farm is an orcish swine farm located in the northern Barrens. Established after the founding of Orgrimmar, it serves as a remote homestead worked by the orc Kranal Fiss and his children.
faq.q: What is Grol'dom Farm?

faq.a: The farm is tended by an orc named Kranal Fiss along with his children. Together they maintain the pens, herd the pigs, and defend their meager livelihood against roving beasts and quillboar raiders.
faq.q: Who lives at Grol'dom Farm?

faq.a: Kranal Fiss possesses knowledge of elemental rites. Orc and tauren shaman are routinely sent to speak with him during their early training to undergo trials necessary to earn their Call of Fire and manifest the Fire Totem.
faq.q: Why do shamans come to Grol'dom Farm?

faq.a: The surrounding savannah is infested with the Razormane tribe of quillboars. These aggressive raiders constantly harass the farm, threatening the livestock and endangering Kranal's family.
faq.q: What threats face the farm?

text.s: Grol'dom Farm is a modest orcish homestead situated in the northern Barrens along the road between Durotar and the Crossroads. Inhabited by Kranal Fiss and his family, the farm raises swine in the arid plains despite constant harassment from aggressive local quillboars.

sec.b: Established following the settlement of Durotar, Grol'dom Farm represents the Horde's early efforts to farm the dry expanse of the Barrens. Tended by the orc Kranal Fiss and his children, the small homestead primarily raises pigs while braving the harsh wildlife and aggressive Razormane quillboar raiders that prowl the nearby ridges. It is a lonely, rugged outpost that supplies vital sustenance to the emerging orcish nation.
sec.t: A Swine Farm in the Savannah

sec.b: Beyond its mundane function as a pig farm, the homestead holds quiet importance for Horde initiates on the spiritual path. Kranal Fiss possesses deep knowledge of elemental rites and plays a key role in guiding young shaman through their trials. Seekers traveling west from Orgrimmar are regularly directed to this humble farm to learn the secrets necessary to commune with the primal spirits of fire.

subzone:grommash-hold.s: Fuerte Grommash. Fuerte Grommash es la sede fortificada del Jefe de Guerra Thrall, enclavada en lo alto de los riscos rojos del Valle de la Sabiduría en Orgrimmar. Nombrada en honor al sacrificio de Grommash Grito Infernal, la fortaleza sirve como Centro de Mando y corazón político de La nueva Horda. Ubicada en el apacible Valle de la Sabiduría, Fuerte Grommash sirve como corte real y santuario estratégico de la Horda. Construido en los imponentes muros del cañón, su grueso interior de piedra se mantiene notablemente sombrío y frío, una elección deliberada del Jefe de Guerra Thrall para mantener a emisarios, peticionarios y señores de la guerra alerta y serenos durante las audiencias. Aquí, Thrall delibera sobre la defensa de Kalimdor, guiado por veteranos consejeros como Eitrigg y visitado por líderes raciales como Vol'jin.

ang.faction:Horde: This is the very heart of the Horde's sovereignty, where treaties are forged and campaigns against threats across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms are directed.
ang.race:Orc: For orcs, the hold and Mannoroth's remains outside are the ultimate testament to their liberation from the demonic blood curse by the sacrifice of Grom Hellscream.

faq.a: Warchief Thrall holds court here, alongside key Horde leaders and advisors including the orcish elder Eitrigg, the Darkspear leader Vol'jin, and the warrior Nazgrel.
faq.q: Who is inside Grommash Hold?

faq.a: It is named after Grommash 'Grom' Hellscream, the legendary chieftain of the Warsong clan. Grom struck down the pit lord Mannoroth during the Third War, paying with his life to permanently free the orcish race from demonic servitude.
faq.q: Why is it named Grommash Hold?

faq.a: The skull and armor belong to Mannoroth, the demon lord whose blood initially enslaved the orcs on Draenor. The remains were hauled from Ashenvale and mounted on a tree trunk outside the hold as a monument to the Horde's freedom.
faq.q: What are the giant bones displayed outside?

faq.a: Many orcish guards and older directional signs still refer to the structure as Thrall's Fortress, after the warchief who holds court inside.
faq.q: Why do some city signs call it Thrall's Fortress?

text.s: Grommash Hold is the fortified seat of Warchief Thrall, nestled high in the red cliffs of the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. Named in honor of Grommash Hellscream's sacrifice, the fortress serves as the command center and political heart of the new Horde.

sec.b: Perched within the tranquil Valley of Wisdom, Grommash Hold serves as the royal court and strategic sanctum of the Horde. Built into the towering canyon walls, its thick stone interior remains notably dim and chilly—a deliberate choice by Warchief Thrall to keep emissaries, petitioners, and warlords sharp and sober during audiences. Here, Thrall deliberates on the defense of Kalimdor, guided by veteran counselors like Eitrigg and visited by racial chieftains such as Vol'jin.

Just outside the stronghold rests the shattered armor and horned skull of the pit lord Mannoroth, mounted upon the trunk of an ancient tree. Placed there to honor Grom Hellscream, who traded his life to slay the demon in Ashenvale, the memorial stands as both a proud symbol of the orcs' liberation from the demonic blood curse and a permanent, solemn warning against falling into reckless savagery again.

subzone:grove-of-the-ancients.s: Páramo de los Ancestros. El Páramo de los Ancestros es un santuario sagrado de los elfos de la noche situado entre las ruinas de un antiguo templo en el sureste de Costa Oscura. Enclavado junto al Río Culebra, este sereno refugio sirve como punto de encuentro para espíritus de la naturaleza y está custodiado por el venerable ancestro del conocimiento, Onus. Escondido cerca de las montañas del sureste de Costa Oscura, el Páramo de los Ancestros se erige como un remanso de paz rodeado por las antiguas piedras de un templo. A través de su corazón fluyen las agitadas aguas del Río Culebra, proporcionando un tranquilo refugio en medio de una costa cada vez más asolada por la corrupción y una fauna inquieta. La arboleda sirve como lugar de reunión para el Círculo de los Ancestros, donde los espíritus de la naturaleza y los kaldorei velan por el delicado equilibrio del bosque.

ang.class:Druid: The grove is a revered natural sanctuary, offering druids a direct connection to the wisdom of the Ancient of Lore Onu and the spirits of the forest.
ang.race:NightElf: Surrounded by ancient temple ruins and tended by nature spirits, the grove serves as a solemn reminder of long-standing kaldorei harmony with the land.

faq.a: The grove is located in the southeastern region of Darkshore, nestled against the mountain foothills near the banks of the Wildbend River.
al: where is grove of the ancients
faq.q: Where is the Grove of the Ancients?

faq.a: Onu is a wise Ancient of Lore residing in the grove. He acts as an elder guide, watching over the southeastern woods and advising druids and travelers attempting to mend the balance of Darkshore.
faq.q: Who is Onu?

faq.a: The Circle of Ancients is an assembly of great nature spirits and ancient treants who gather at the grove to commune, share knowledge, and discuss the welfare of the wild lands.
faq.q: What is the Circle of Ancients?

faq.a: While the grove itself is a safe sanctuary with friendly guardians and merchants, hostile wildlife and territorial furbolg encampments lie just across the river and to the southeast.
faq.q: Are there dangers near the grove?

text.s: The Grove of the Ancients is a sacred night elven sanctuary set amidst old temple ruins in southeastern Darkshore. Nestled beside the Wildbend River, this serene haven serves as a gathering ground for nature spirits and is watched over by the venerable Ancient of Lore, Onu.

sec.b: Tucked away near the southeastern mountains of Darkshore, the Grove of the Ancients stands as a peaceful haven surrounded by aged temple stones. Through its heart flows the surging Wildbend River, providing a quiet refuge amidst a coastline increasingly plagued by corruption and restless wildlife. The grove serves as a meeting place for the Circle of Ancients, where nature spirits and kaldorei tend to the delicate balance of the forest.

The focal presence within the grove is Onu, a towering Ancient of Lore who observes the land's shifting fortunes and offers ancient wisdom to passing travelers. Alongside Onu, wandering merchants and slumbering druids find rest beneath the boughs. Though quiet, the grove lies close to territorial furbolg camps to the southeast, making it an essential frontier outpost for Alliance sentinels and druids monitoring southern Darkshore.

subzone:gunther-s-retreat.s: Refugio de Gunther. El Refugio de Gunther es un santuario insular aislado situado en el Lago Aguasclaras, en el centro de los Claros de Tirisfal. Sirve de refugio a Gunther Arcanos, un nigromante renegado que se liberó de la Plaga mediante pura fuerza de voluntad. Desconfiado de todos los forasteros, el eremita rodea su campamento con leales esbirros no-muertos para mantener alejados a los intrusos. Situado entre las brumosas aguas del Lago Aguasclaras, el Refugio de Gunther es un modesto campamento insular que se confunde fácilmente con otro reducto de la Plaga. Su amo, Gunther Arcanos, logró lo que pocos hechiceros mortales pudieron: al ser alzado en la no-muerte, su maestría arcana le permitió arrancar su alma del férreo control del Rey Exánime sin ninguna ayuda externa. Desconfiando de todo el mundo, Gunther asumió que el resto de los no-muertos que vagaban por Lordaeron seguían siendo marionetas de la Plaga. Se retiró a esta solitaria isla para practicar su arte en paz, apostando centinelas zombi para despedazar a cualquiera que cruce las aguas.

ang.class:Mage: Arcanists will appreciate Gunther's rare feat; his magical will was formidable enough to sever the Lich King's mental grip entirely unassisted.
ang.race:Undead: Gunther Arcanus mirrors the Forsaken's own tragedy: free from the Lich King, yet suspicious and guarded against a world he assumes remains in thrall to the Scourge.

faq.a: The island is inhabited by Gunther Arcanus, a powerful necromancer who broke free of the Lich King's control under his own power. He resides there alongside a retinue of undead thralls who guard his camp.
faq.q: Who lives at Gunther's Retreat?

faq.a: Gunther Arcanus believes that every other undead being in Tirisfal is still enslaved by the Scourge. Because he values his independence above all else, his minions are commanded to attack anyone who approaches the island on sight.
faq.q: Why are the undead on the island hostile?

faq.a: Initially, no. While technically a free-willed undead like the Forsaken, Gunther isolates himself entirely. The authorities in the Undercity seek to prove to him that they too are free of the Lich King's grasp and recruit his talents to their cause.
faq.q: Is Gunther aligned with the Forsaken?

faq.a: Just off the southwestern edge of Gunther's Retreat lies a tiny, unnamed islet known as Lillith's Dinner Table, a curious and eerie landmark resting quietly in the waters of Brightwater Lake.
faq.q: What is the small islet southwest of the retreat?

text.s: Gunther's Retreat is an isolated island sanctuary set in Brightwater Lake in central Tirisfal Glades. It serves as the refuge of Gunther Arcanus, a renegade necromancer who broke free from the Scourge through raw willpower. Distrustful of all outsiders, the recluse surrounds his campsite with loyal undead minions to keep intruders away.

sec.b: Situated amid the misty waters of Brightwater Lake, Gunther's Retreat is an unassuming island encampment easily mistaken for another pocket of the Scourge. Its master, Gunther Arcanus, achieved what few mortal sorcerers could: when raised in undeath, his arcane mastery allowed him to tear away his soul from the Lich King's iron grip without any outside help. Mistrusting everyone, Gunther assumed the rest of the undead wandering Lordaeron were still puppets of the Scourge. He retired to this lonely isle to practice his craft in peace, posting zombie sentinels to tear apart anyone who crosses the water.

subzone:hall-of-arms.s: Sala de Armas. La Sala de Armas sirve como cuartel general del poder militar de Forjaz y como el principal arsenal del reino enano. Situado dentro de la Sala Militar, este recinto fortificado adiestra a combatientes enanos y orquesta el despliegue de blindados pesados y máquinas de guerra aéreas. Ubicada en la esquina suroriental de la Sala Militar, la Sala de Armas es el centro de mando de las fuerzas armadas de Forjaz. Además de albergar a veteranos instructores de guerreros y cazadores, esta amplia instalación sirve como un enorme depósito y base de operaciones para la guerra mecanizada. Los pesados tanques de vapor se ensamblan y mantienen in situ para reforzar los campos de batalla de la Alianza, mientras que los girocópteros y las máquinas voladoras se elevan mediante cintas transportadoras industriales y se lanzan directamente a través de pozos de acceso verticales en el techo de la caverna hacia el Aeródromo de Forjaz situado arriba.

ang.class:Warrior: The facility functions as the premier gathering ground for dwarven armsmen and veterans in the capital, offering instruction and battlemaster leadership.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, the Hall of Arms exemplifies Khaz Modan's union of martial discipline and mechanical ingenuity, housing the tanks and aerial squadrons that protect the mountain kingdom.

faq.a: It serves as the headquarters and command center for Ironforge's military forces. It functions as both a training ground for warriors and hunters and a vital depot where war machines like steam tanks and gyrocopters are maintained and deployed.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Arms?

faq.a: Dwarven flying machines are raised by conveyor systems and launched through vertical shafts in the ceiling directly out to the Ironforge Airfield on the mountain slopes above. This chimney is one of the only direct surface exits out of the mountain besides the main gates.
faq.q: Where do the flying machines launched from the ceiling go?

faq.a: The facility houses instructors for warriors and hunters, as well as Alliance battlemasters organizing troop movements and enlistments for wider battlefronts across the continent.
faq.q: Who can I find training inside the Hall?

faq.a: It is located in the southeastern quadrant of Ironforge, anchoring the back of the Military Ward.
al: how to get to hall of arms
faq.q: Where is the Hall of Arms located?

text.s: The Hall of Arms serves as the headquarters of Ironforge's military might and the chief arsenal of the dwarven kingdom. Located within the Military Ward, this fortified compound trains dwarven combatants and orchestrates the deployment of heavy armor and aerial war machines.

sec.b: Situated in the southeastern corner of the Military Ward, the Hall of Arms is the operational command center for the armed forces of Ironforge. Beyond housing veteran trainers for warriors and hunters, the expansive facility serves as a massive depot and staging ground for mechanized warfare. Heavy steam tanks are assembled and maintained on-site to reinforce Alliance battlefields, while gyrocopters and flying machines are brought up via industrial conveyor belts and launched directly through vertical access shafts in the cavern ceiling toward the Ironforge Airfield above.

subzone:hall-of-gears.s: Sala de los Engranajes. La Sala de los Engranajes es una cámara industrial de varios niveles situada en el interior de la caída ciudad de Gnomeregan, justo después de Corredor Mecánico. En su momento un bullicioso centro de movimiento mecánico, ha caído en la ruina, inundada de lodo tóxico, mocos errantes y troggs irradiados. Ubicada justo más allá de Corredor Mecánico, la Sala de los Engranajes ilustra el catastrófico colapso de la capital de los gnomos. Dividida en dos niveles principales, las pasarelas superiores de la cámara están ocupadas por agresivos troggs irradiados que se abren paso a través de conductos de acceso derrumbados. Abajo, el suelo yace anegado en charcos de lluvia radiactiva, donde cienos corrosivos y elementales de veneno vivos proliferan en los vertidos tóxicos.

ang.profession:Engineering: The sheer scale of the automated gearing and elevated platforms displays the pinnacle of pre-fall gnomish engineering, though now heavily corroded by radioactive fallout.
ang.race:Gnome: Seeing the massive cogs and catwalks submerged in irradiated sludge is a painful reminder of the desperate decision that poisoned the city and drove the gnome race into exile.

faq.a: The Hall of Gears lies deep inside the dungeon of Gnomeregan, directly following the Clockwerk Run. It connects further inward toward the Clean Zone, the Dormitory, and the Launch Bay.
al: how to get to hall of gears
faq.q: Where is the Hall of Gears located?

faq.a: When High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered the venting of radioactive gas to repel the trogg invasion, the contaminated runoff collected in the city's low-lying machinery halls, turning the lower floor of the Hall of Gears into a toxic wasteland.
faq.q: Why is the lower level full of radioactive sludge?

faq.a: The upper level is infested with mutated, irradiated troggs pouring through breach tunnels. The lower tier is filled with radioactive fallout slimes, oozes, and volatile poison elementals that formed from the industrial runoff.
al: what lives in hall of gears
faq.q: What creatures inhabit this chamber?

faq.a: The upper walkways lead southwest toward the Clean Zone and the Dormitory, as well as a dead-end maintenance corridor to the southeast. The lower irradiated floor features a winding passage to the west that leads directly into the Launch Bay.
al: where to go from hall of gears
faq.q: Where do the exits lead from here?

text.s: The Hall of Gears is a multi-tiered industrial chamber situated inside the fallen city of Gnomeregan, just past the Clockwerk Run. Once a bustling center of mechanical movement, it has fallen into ruin, flooded with toxic sludge, roaming oozes, and irradiated troggs.

sec.b: Positioned just beyond the Clockwerk Run, the Hall of Gears illustrates the catastrophic collapse of the gnome capital. Divided into two main levels, the chamber's upper catwalks are held by aggressive, irradiated troggs that claw through collapsed access shafts. Below, the floor sits drenched in pools of radioactive fallout, where corrosive slimes and living poison elementals thrive in the toxic runoff.

The chamber serves as a critical junction deep within Gnomeregan's operational quarters. From its upper walkways, paths branch toward contaminated dead ends and the relative safety of the Clean Zone and the Dormitory. Descending into the radioactive depths below eventually leads travelers through winding maintenance passages toward the Launch Bay, though navigating either floor requires cutting through the lingering horrors of Sicco Thermaplugg's devastating venting scheme.

subzone:hall-of-legends.s: Sala de las Leyendas. La Sala de las Leyendas es el santuario militar de élite y el cuartel de oficiales de la Horda, ubicado dentro del Valle de la Fuerza en Orgrimmar. Tras su umbral protegido, los campeones de la Horda se reúnen en torno a planes de batalla y se pertrechan con armas de primer nivel obtenidas en conflictos a lo largo de Azeroth y más allá. Situada junto a las concurridas avenidas del Valle de la Fuerza, la Sala de las Leyendas sirve como reducto privado para los oficiales veteranos de la Horda. Más allá de su entrada custodiada, estrategas y delegados de todas las facciones —como jefe Earthbind de Cima del Trueno, guardia de sangre Hini'wana de los Lanza Negra y consejero Willington de Entrañas— debaten sobre mapas de tierras en disputa y el estado militar de ambas facciones. Aquí, solo a los guerreros que han puesto a prueba su temple y alcanzado el rango de Guardia de piedra o superior se les permite el paso para reclamar el botín y el armamento dignos de su estatus.

ang.class:Warrior: For front-line fighters, gaining entry to the Hall of Legends represents the pinnacle of martial respect, granting access to weapons forged in conflicts across multiple worlds.
ang.faction:Horde: The Hall of Legends is the ultimate testament to Horde military achievement, offering recognition, strategic council, and prized wargear to those who shed blood for the Warchief.

faq.a: Only Horde champions who have achieved the rank of Stone Guard (Rank 6) or higher in the military honor system are granted passage through its threshold. Lower-ranking soldiers and ordinary citizens are turned away at the entrance.
al: can i enter hall of legends
rank required for hall of legends
faq.q: Who is allowed inside the Hall of Legends?

faq.a: The Hall of Legends is situated in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, near the city's primary barracks and administrative seat.
al: how to get to hall of legends
faq.q: Where is the Hall of Legends located?

faq.a: Inside lies a central strategy table flanked by military representatives of the Horde's various races, surrounded by maps of Azeroth and military records. Quartermasters also maintain armories here, distributing prestigious arms, armor, and mounts to accomplished officers.
al: what is in hall of legends
faq.q: What is inside the Hall of Legends?

faq.a: Yes. The Alliance counterpart is the Champions' Hall, situated in the Old Town district of Stormwind City, which similarly serves as an officer barracks and armory for honored Alliance combatants.
faq.q: Does the Alliance have an equivalent location?

text.s: The Hall of Legends is the elite military sanctuary and officer barracks of the Horde, nestled within Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Behind its warded threshold, champions of the Horde gather around battle plans and arm themselves with premier weapons taken from conflicts across Azeroth and beyond.

sec.b: Located off the bustling avenues of the Valley of Strength, the Hall of Legends serves as the private redoubt for proven officers of the Horde. Beyond its guarded entrance, strategists and delegates from across the factions—including Chieftain Earthbind of Thunder Bluff, Blood Guard Hini'wana of the Darkspear, and Advisor Willington of the Undercity—confer over maps of contested lands and the military standing of both factions. Here, only warriors who have tested their mettle and achieved the rank of Stone Guard or higher are permitted entry to claim the spoils and armaments befitting their status.

More than just an officer lounge, the hall houses armories containing battle-tested wargear from across Azeroth and the orcs' shattered homeworld of Draenor. Many of these weapons were claimed as spoils from the ongoing clashes against the Alliance and other adversaries. For those climbing the martial ranks, it represents the physical manifestation of Horde honor, martial prowess, and hard-won victory.

subzone:hall-of-mysteries.s: Sala de los Misterios. Enclavado en la Sala Mística de Forjaz, la Sala de los Misterios sirve como el corazón espiritual y erudito de la ciudad para lo arcano y lo divino. En su interior iluminado con tonos azules, practicantes enanos y gnomos estudian textos antiguos, se instruyen en los misterios de la Luz Sagrada y tejen encantamientos arcanos lejos del estruendo de la Gran Fundición. Iluminado por una característica luminiscencia azul y púrpura, la Sala de los Misterios destaca enormemente frente al resto de Forjaz.
