Mientras que la ciudad que lo rodea prospera sobre la piedra, el hierro y las armaduras pesadas, los cinco imponentes pilares del recinto cobijan a eruditos ataviados con suaves y vaporosas togas. Une tanto la hechicería arcana como la devoción sagrada, sirviendo de cuartel general para el sacerdocio enano y la Orden de la Mano de Plata en Khaz Modan. Aquí, jóvenes clérigos y caballeros estudian textos sagrados como el Libro de la Divinidad y reciben orientación antes de que sus viajes los lleven hacia la Catedral de la Luz de Ventormenta.

ang.class:Paladin: For dwarven champions of the Silver Hand, the hall is a foundation of their calling, where masters assign trials of virtue and grant access to the sacred Tome of Divinity.
ang.class:Priest: High Priest Rohan guides acolytes of the Light through spiritual lessons here before sending promising priests south to confer with the leadership in Stormwind.

faq.a: The Hall of Mysteries is Ironforge's foremost center for both divine devotion and arcane learning. It serves as a temple for the Holy Light and a study hall where dwarven and gnomish priests, paladins, and mages gather to practice their crafts, research old scripture, and train newcomers.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Mysteries?

faq.a: High Priest Rohan oversees the priesthood within the hall, serving as the spiritual guide for dwarven practitioners of the Light, alongside paladin mentors such as Valgar Highforge who direct the city's knights of the Silver Hand.
faq.q: Who leads the clergy here?

faq.a: While Stormwind's Cathedral of Light is dedicated purely to the holy faith and grand ceremonial worship, the Hall of Mysteries seamlessly blends holy study with arcane scholarship under one roof. Its atmosphere is scholarly and quiet rather than strictly liturgical.
al: cathedral of light vs hall of mysteries
faq.q: How does it compare to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind?

faq.a: Yes. Dwarven paladins are sent to the hall to study the Tome of Divinity under the mentorship of the Silver Hand, receiving instruction and sacred trials designed to test their compassion, devotion, and courage.
faq.q: Can paladins complete their training trials here?

text.s: Tucked into the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, the Hall of Mysteries serves as the city's spiritual and scholarly heart for the arcane and the divine. Within its blue-lit interior, dwarven and gnomish practitioners study ancient texts, train in the mysteries of the Holy Light, and weave arcane enchantments far from the clang of the Great Forge.

sec.b: Illuminated by a distinctive blue and purple luminescence, the Hall of Mysteries stands out starkly against the rest of Ironforge. While the city around it thrives on stone, iron, and heavy plate, the hall's five soaring pillars shelter scholars draped in soft, flowing robes. It bridges both arcane wizardry and holy devotion, serving as the headquarters for the dwarven priesthood and the Order of the Silver Hand within Khaz Modan. Here, young clerics and knights study holy texts like the Tome of Divinity and receive guidance before their journeys carry them onward to Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.
sec.t: A Temple of Magic and Faith

subzone:hall-of-the-brave.s: Sala de los Valientes. La Sala de los Valientes es el gran cuartel de guerreros situado en los altos orientales del Valle del Honor de Orgrimmar. Sirve como el principal complejo de entrenamiento y sede para los combatientes de primera línea, instructores y maestros de batalla de la Horda. Con vistas a las tranquilas aguas y los círculos de entrenamiento del Valle del Honor, la Sala de los Valientes sirve como un centro militar vital para la creciente Horda. En su interior, oficiales veteranos y curtidos guerreros instruyen a los iniciados en los brutales fundamentos del combate cuerpo a cuerpo, el dominio de las actitudes y la disciplina. El salón está repleto de muñecos de entrenamiento y armamento, y alberga a maestros de batalla que organizan a los combatientes para grandes enfrentamientos militares por todo Azeroth.

ang.class:Warrior: The Hall of the Brave is your martial home in the capital, housing trainers who unlock advanced stances and battle maneuvers as your prowess grows.
ang.faction:Horde: This barracks stands as a living demonstration of the Horde's frontline discipline, housing battlemasters who muster troops to fight across the continent.

faq.a: It serves as the main barracks and guild hall for warriors in Orgrimmar. Here, warriors learn their techniques from veteran trainers, hone their strikes on practice dummies, and consult battlemasters regarding military deployments across contested lands.
al: what is hall of the brave
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of the Brave?

faq.a: The Hall of the Brave is situated on the eastern side of the Valley of Honor, nestled along the red canyon walls overlooking the valley's central pond.
al: where is hall of the brave
faq.q: Where in Orgrimmar is the hall located?

faq.a: The hall houses various warrior class trainers, battlemasters coordinating large-scale conflicts, and Horde grunts resting between active patrols.
al: who is in hall of the brave
faq.q: Who can be found inside the hall?

text.s: The Hall of the Brave is the grand warrior barracks situated in the eastern heights of Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. It serves as the primary training compound and guild house for the Horde's front-line combatants, drillmasters, and battlemasters.

sec.b: Overlooking the tranquil waters and training rings of the Valley of Honor, the Hall of the Brave serves as a vital military hub for the burgeoning Horde. Inside, veteran officers and seasoned warriors instruct initiates in the brutal fundamentals of melee combat, stance mastery, and discipline. The hall is lined with training dummies and armaments, housing battlemasters who organize combatants for major military engagements across Azeroth.

subzone:helm-s-bed-lake.s: Lago de Helm. El Lago de Helm es una masa de agua congelada ubicada en las colinas del sureste de Dun Morogh. Un agujero abierto en el grueso hielo proporciona agua dulce vital a los montañeros y viajeros de la zona. Sin embargo, la orilla circundante se ha vuelto peligrosa debido a las bestias salvajes al acecho, el avance de los troggs y los hostiles infiltrados Hierro Negro. El Lago de Helm yace en calma bajo una gruesa capa de hielo invernal en el sureste de Dun Morogh. Los enanos de la zona mantienen un agujero excavado en la escarcha para extraer agua limpia y fresca. Aunque cruzar la extensión helada es bastante seguro, merodear cerca de las orillas se ha vuelto cada vez más arriesgado. Bestias salvajes deambulan por los límites, troggs desplazados hurgan por las crestas y una célula de enanos Hierro Negro hostiles se ha adueñado de un refugio abandonado justo al sur del agua, emboscando violentamente a cualquier viajero que pase por allí.

ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance scouts traveling east toward Loch Modan must stay alert here, as the southward trail skirts uncomfortably close to aggressive Dark Iron ambushes.
ang.race:Dwarf: For the Ironforge dwarves, Helm's Bed Lake represents both a vital freshwater spot and an irritating security failure, as Dark Iron saboteurs and troggs push deeper into Dun Morogh's heartland.

faq.a: The hole in the thick ice is deliberately maintained by local dwarves to allow consistent access to fresh, unfrozen water amid Dun Morogh's sub-zero climate.
faq.q: Why is there an open hole in the middle of the frozen lake?

faq.a: While the lake surface itself is solid, the perimeter is hunted by predatory beasts and stray troggs. To the south, an encampment of hostile Dark Iron dwarves occupies an old building and violently repels anyone who draws near.
faq.q: What dangers lurk around Helm's Bed Lake?

faq.a: Narm Faulk is an unfortunate dwarf whose body can be found along the shoreline of Helm's Bed Lake, a grim casualty of the sudden surge of hostile threats and Dark Iron infiltrators in the area.
al: dead body at helms bed lake
faq.q: Who is Narm Faulk?

faq.a: They have not seized the lake outright, but an armed squad has claimed an abandoned structure just to the south, using it as a forward position to stage skirmishes into central Dun Morogh.
faq.q: Are the Dark Iron dwarves officially occupying the lake?

text.s: Helm's Bed Lake is a frozen body of water nestled in the southeastern hills of Dun Morogh. A maintained hole in the thick ice provides crucial fresh water to local mountaineers and travelers. However, the surrounding shoreline has become perilous due to prowling wildlife, encroaching troggs, and hostile Dark Iron infiltrators.

sec.b: Helm's Bed Lake sits quietly beneath a thick sheet of winter ice in southeastern Dun Morogh. Local dwarves keep an opening chopped through the frost to draw clean, fresh water. While crossing the frozen expanse is stable enough, lingering near the banks has become increasingly risky. Wild beasts wander the edges, displaced troggs scavenge along the ridges, and a cell of hostile Dark Iron dwarves has commandeered an abandoned lodge just south of the water, aggressively ambushing any travelers who pass through.

subzone:heroes-vigil.s: Vigilia de los Héroes. La Vigilia de los Héroes es un claro tranquilo y sagrado situado en la isla central del Lago del Hito, en el este del Bosque de Elwynn. Centrado en torno a un monumento conocido como la Piedra del Recuerdo, fue dedicado a honrar a aquellos que cayeron durante la Primera Guerra. Hoy en día, sin embargo, el santuario se encuentra en gran parte desatendido por Ventormenta y está infestado de peligrosos magos renegados. Erigida tras la Primera Guerra, la Vigilia de los Héroes gira en torno a la Piedra del Recuerdo, un círculo de piedra grabado destinado a honrar a los soldados y ciudadanos masacrados durante el saqueo de Villadorada y los valles circundantes a manos de la Antigua Horda. Aunque en el pasado fue venerada como un bastión sagrado de fe y sacrificio, la vigilia ha ido escapando de la atención de los actuales gobernantes de Ventormenta, dejando sus tierras sagradas cubiertas de maleza y sin la vigilancia de los soldados del reino.

ang.class:Mage: The renegade wizards encamping on these sacred grounds practice dangerous, unregulated arts without the discipline or sanction of the Academy of Arcane Sciences.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, this sacred stone ring is a bitter reminder of the First War's blood price and the kingdom's modern failure to protect its own heritage.

faq.a: Heroes' Vigil is a monument located on the island in Stone Cairn Lake in eastern Elwynn Forest. It consists of a stone ring and memorial dedicated to honoring the fallen victims of the First War.
faq.q: What is Heroes' Vigil?

faq.a: The Stone of Remembrance was placed in memory of the fallen citizens and defenders who perished when the orcish Horde sacked Goldshire and ravaged eastern Elwynn Forest during the First War.
al: what is the stone of remembrance
faq.q: What does the Stone of Remembrance commemorate?

faq.a: The island and the vigil have been occupied by hostile rogue wizards. These rogue spellcasters operate outside the law of the Kingdom of Stormwind and the oversight of established magical institutions.
faq.q: Who controls Heroes' Vigil today?

faq.a: With King Varian Wrynn missing and the realm stretched thin handling internal dissent, brigands, and monster incursions, remote shrines like Heroes' Vigil have been left undefended and largely forgotten by the ruling regency.
faq.q: Why has Stormwind neglected the vigil?

faq.a: Henze Faulk is a fallen traveler whose lifeless body lies abandoned near the monument, an unfortunate testament to the ruthless hostility of the rogue wizards occupying the island.
al: who is the dead guy on the island
faq.q: Who is Henze Faulk?

text.s: Heroes' Vigil is a quiet, sacred clearing situated on the central island within Stone Cairn Lake in eastern Elwynn Forest. Centered around a monument known as the Stone of Remembrance, it was dedicated to honor those who fell during the First War. Today, however, the shrine sits largely neglected by Stormwind and is overrun by dangerous renegade wizards.

sec.b: Erected after the First War, Heroes' Vigil centers upon the Stone of Remembrance, an inscribed stone circle meant to honor the soldiers and citizens slaughtered during the Old Horde's sacking of Goldshire and the surrounding valleys. Though once revered as a sacred bastion of faith and sacrifice, the vigil has gradually slipped from the attention of Stormwind's current rulers, leaving its hallowed grounds overgrown and unattended by the realm's soldiers.

Because the kingdom has left the island garrisoned by none, outcasts have seized the memorial. A cabal of rogue wizards now controls Stone Cairn Lake and the monument grounds, practicing wild and undisciplined magic away from the oversight of the Kirin Tor and the Academy of Arcane Sciences. The desecration is made all the more bitter by tragic casualties left near the stones, including the body of Henze Faulk, leaving travelers to wonder if the shrine will ever be restored to peace.

subzone:hidden-path.s: Sendero Oculto. El Sendero Oculto es un apartado camino de montaña que serpentea entre los riscos sobre el Valle de los Retos, en Durotar. Sirve como rito de iniciación para los aspirantes a chamán que buscan la sagrada Roca de los Espíritus, al tiempo que ofrece un mirador poco frecuentado que domina las escarpadas fronteras de Los Baldíos. Esculpido en los picos rojizos que bordean el Valle de los Retos, el Sendero Oculto es deliberadamente difícil de detectar desde el fondo del cañón. Los mentores guían a los jóvenes chamanes hasta aquí para poner a prueba su percepción y disciplina antes de comulgar con los espíritus en la Roca de los Espíritus. En los tramos más altos del sendero, los viajeros disfrutan de amplias vistas panorámicas que se extienden hacia el oeste, en dirección a las onduladas sabanas de Los Baldíos.

ang.class:Shaman: The Hidden Path is your first true physical and spiritual climb, testing your perception before you commune with the earth spirits at Spirit Rock.
ang.faction:Horde: Though sacred to shaman, this unfortified passage represents a security blind spot above the Valley of Trials that warrants a watchful eye.

faq.a: The path ascends from the Valley of Trials up into the crags to Spirit Rock, a sacred site where shaman commune with the elements. It also winds along mountain passes that connect toward the Barrens and the coastline.
faq.q: Where does the Hidden Path lead?

faq.a: Initiate shaman in the Valley of Trials are tasked with locating this secluded trail as part of their early elemental trials. Climbing the path allows them to reach the Spirit Rock and drink the Sapta required to commune with the spirits.
faq.q: Why is the path significant to shaman?

faq.a: Yes. The low gaps along the path bypass the standard guarded entrances to the valley. A cunning Alliance strike force coming from Ratchet or the coast could theoretically use the trail to bypass Horde scouts and enter the training grounds undetected.
faq.q: Could enemies use the Hidden Path to attack the Valley of Trials?

faq.a: At its highest point, the trail offers a clear, elevated view looking west toward the vast plains of the Barrens, as well as sweeping views across the red canyons of Durotar.
faq.q: What can you see from the top of the path?

text.s: The Hidden Path is a secluded mountain trail winding through the crags above the Valley of Trials in Durotar. It serves as a rite of passage for aspiring shaman seeking the sacred Spirit Rock, while offering an overlooked vantage overlooking the rugged borders of the Barrens.

sec.b: Carved into the red peaks bordering the Valley of Trials, the Hidden Path is intentionally difficult to spot from the canyon floor. Young shaman are directed here by their mentors to prove their awareness and discipline before communing with the spirits at Spirit Rock. Along the trail's highest reaches, travelers are treated to expansive panoramic views stretching westward toward the rolling savannas of the Barrens.

Beyond its spiritual importance, the path cuts a precarious breach through the natural fortifications enclosing the valley. A low pass along the route provides a direct back door toward Ratchet and the road to Orgrimmar. Because it circumvents the standard canyon checkpoints, vigilant defenders fear that bold Alliance infiltrators could exploit this quiet trail to slip directly into the Horde's primary proving grounds.

subzone:high-rise.s: Alto Superior. Alto Superior es el nivel superior de la meseta central de Cima del Trueno, coronando la capital de los tauren. Alberga un bullicioso anfiteatro centrado alrededor de una hoguera comunal junto a avezados artesanos, comerciantes de armas y maestros culinarios. A diferencia de los niveles inferiores, esta cumbre depende por completo de puentes colgantes de cuerda y del nido de jinetes del viento para viajar. Alto Superior se alza en lo alto de la meseta central de Cima del Trueno, recibiendo los vientos abiertos muy por encima de las Llanuras Onduladas de Mulgore. Punto de encuentro neurálgico para las tribus unidas, se articula en torno a un anfiteatro al aire libre y una hoguera donde los ciudadanos escuchan importantes anuncios tribales y decisiones trascendentales. Las tiendas y puestos de madera circundantes albergan a renombrados mercaderes, armerías e instructores culinarios, entre ellos la Cocina de Aska y el establecimiento Cebos y Aparejos de la Cumbre. Mientras que los niveles inferiores conectan directamente con la pradera de Mulgore mediante enormes ascensores de madera, el Alto Superior se mantiene en las alturas, accesible principalmente a través del nido de jinetes del viento y de amplios puentes de cuerda que lo unen con los altos vecinos: el Alto de los Ancestros y el Alto de los Cazadores.

ang.profession:Cooking: The High Rise is home to Aska's Kitchen and renowned pit masters, making it the primary destination in Thunder Bluff to hone your culinary skills over open flame.
ang.race:Tauren: As the crest of your capital city, the High Rise represents unity among the tribes, gathering hunters, shamans, and elders around its high communal fire.

faq.a: You can reach the High Rise through the central wind rider roost from the lower tiers, or across the suspension bridges from Elder Rise and Hunter Rise. There is no lift running directly from the Mulgore plains to this tier.
al: how to get to high rise
faq.q: How do you reach the High Rise?

faq.a: The tier is known for its tradesfolk and outdoor gathering places. Notable establishments include Aska's Kitchen for cooking instruction, Mountaintop Bait & Tackle for fishing gear, and various weapon merchants like Ragetotem Arms and Thunderhoof's Firearms.
faq.q: What services are found on the High Rise?

faq.a: The open-air amphitheater surrounds a central bonfire, serving as a communal gathering area. Here, the tauren people assemble beneath the open sky to hear news, deliberate tribal affairs, and witness important proclamations delivered atop the mesa.
faq.q: What is the amphitheater on the High Rise used for?

text.s: The High Rise is the uppermost tier of Thunder Bluff's central mesa, crowning the tauren capital. It hosts a bustling amphitheater centered around a communal bonfire alongside seasoned artisans, weapon merchants, and culinary masters. Unlike the lower tiers, this summit relies entirely on suspension rope bridges and the wind rider roost for travel.

sec.b: The High Rise perches atop Thunder Bluff's core plateau, catching the open winds high above the rolling plains of Mulgore. A focal gathering point for the united tribes, it centers around an open-air amphitheater and fire pit where citizens listen to important tribal announcements and fateful decisions. The surrounding tents and wooden stalls house renowned merchants, armories, and culinary trainers, including Aska's Kitchen and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle. While the lower tiers connect directly to Mulgore's prairie floor via massive wooden elevators, the High Rise stays aloft, accessible primarily through the wind rider roost and sweeping rope bridges linking to the neighboring Elder Rise and Hunter Rise.

subzone:high-seat.s: Trono. El Trono es la gran sala del trono de Forjaz, situada entre Distrito Comercial y la Gran Fundición. Desde esta cámara elevada, el Rey Magni Barbabronce preside el reino enano junto a sus consejeros reales e historiadores. La sala también alberga el pasadizo sellado que desciende a las antiguas profundidades de Viejo Forjaz. Con vistas a los bulliciosos anillos de Forjaz, el Trono sirve como la sede real del poder para el reino de Khaz Modan. Dentro de esta cámara abovedada, el Rey Magni Barbabronce atiende a los peticionarios, celebra consejos con sus asesores y dirige la defensa de los baluartes del norte de la Alianza. Flanqueado por dignatarios reales como el Historiador Real Archesonus y el Senador Barin Rocaroja, el Trono sigue siendo un símbolo de la inquebrantable autoridad Barbabronce y de la resistencia enana en tiempos turbulentos en todo Azeroth.

ang.faction:Alliance: As the seat of dwarven power, this chamber is critical to Alliance logistics and high-level strategy, housing envoys, advisors, and royal decrees.
ang.race:Dwarf: The High Seat represents the unbroken lineage of Khaz Modan's sovereignty, where King Magni Bronzebeard continues to lead his people with an iron will.

faq.a: King Magni Bronzebeard rules Ironforge from the throne within the High Seat. He directs the affairs of the Bronzebeard clan, listens to subjects, and coordinates military and diplomatic matters with the Grand Alliance.
faq.q: Who rules from the High Seat?

faq.a: The chamber is centrally located in Ironforge, connected directly to the outer ring between the Commons and the Great Forge, allowing easy access for visiting citizens and envoys.
faq.q: Where is the High Seat located in Ironforge?

faq.a: The large archway at the rear of the High Seat leads into Old Ironforge, the cavernous ancestral ruins that lie directly beneath the modern mountain city. Access to these lower passages remains restricted.
faq.q: What is the sealed corridor at the back of the throne room?

faq.a: King Magni is attended by prominent dwarven figures, including Royal Historian Archesonus, who safeguards the records and relics of the Bronzebeard dynasty, and Senator Barin Redstone.
faq.q: Who else can be found advising the King here?

text.s: The High Seat is the grand throne room of Ironforge, situated between the Commons and the Great Forge. From this elevated chamber, King Magni Bronzebeard presides over the dwarven realm alongside his royal advisors and historians. The room also houses the sealed passageway leading down into the ancient depths of Old Ironforge.

sec.b: Overlooking the vibrant bustling rings of Ironforge, the High Seat serves as the royal seat of power for the kingdom of Khaz Modan. Within this vaulted chamber, King Magni Bronzebeard hears petitioners, holds council with his advisors, and directs the defense of the Alliance's northern bastions. Flanked by royal dignitaries such as Royal Historian Archesonus and Senator Barin Redstone, the High Seat remains a symbol of unyielding Bronzebeard authority and dwarven resilience amid troubling times across Azeroth.

Behind the majestic stone appointments of the throne room lies a heavy doorway leading into the shadowy expanse of Old Ironforge. These lower ruins represent the original, ancestral halls carved out by the dwarves before the city was reconfigured around the Great Forge. Guarded and sealed to general traffic, the portal reminds visitors of the vast antiquity and cavernous history resting beneath the modern capital's stones.

subzone:hillsbrad-fields.s: Campos de Trabalomas. Los Campos de Trabalomas comprenden las tierras de cultivo y el asentamiento rústico de Trabalomas, en el oeste de Laderas de Trabalomas. Al ser una de las pocas comunidades humanas supervivientes de la antigua Lordaeron que se negó a sucumbir ante la Plaga o a unirse a la fanática Cruzada Escarlata, sus granjeros y su milicia se enfrentan ahora a constantes asaltos por parte de los Renegados del cercano Molino Tarren. Abarcando huertos, campos de calabazas y pastos entre Colinas de Darrow y la Mina Azur, los Campos de Trabalomas suministran provisiones esenciales a Costasur y a la resistencia superviviente de la Alianza. Mientras que gran parte de Lordaeron cayó ante la plaga de la no-muerte, la gente de Trabalomas resistió, conservando con orgullo el tabardo real y la heráldica de su reino caído. Liderado por el magistrado Burnside y el Consejo de Trabalomas, el municipio opera como un cuerpo cívico independiente bajo asedio constante. El herrero local Verringtan y sus aprendices mantienen armado al pueblo, asegurándose de que cada granjero y trabajador esté preparado para defender su tierra.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Hillsbrad Fields are a vital breadbasket and a poignant symbol of Lordaeron's enduring spirit, warranting protection against Forsaken extermination.
ang.faction:Horde: High Executor Darthalia demands the systematic dismantling of Hillsbrad's farms and militia to secure the southern frontier for the Forsaken.

faq.a: Hillsbrad and neighbouring Southshore are among the very few settlements in Lordaeron that avoided complete destruction by the Scourge during the Third War. Unlike other survivors who fled south or joined the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, these residents remained to rebuild their lives and maintain their homeland.
faq.q: Why are there still living humans farming here?

faq.a: The town and farmlands are governed by Magistrate Burnside, aided by Clerk Horrace Whitesteed and the Council of Hillsbrad from the local town hall. Landowners such as Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz manage the surrounding estates, while local blacksmith Verringtan equips the town watch.
faq.q: Who rules over the town and fields?

faq.a: High Executor Darthalia at Tarren Mill considers Hillsbrad a dangerous Alliance foothold on the Forsaken border. Undercity orders direct soldiers to break the human supply lines by destroying food stores, slaughtering livestock, and eliminating town leaders to clear the way for Forsaken dominance in the foothills.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking the farms?

faq.a: During the Second War, Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer ordered a devastating assault on Hillsbrad to break human morale while building up Horde forces in the Southshore region. Hillsbrad was destroyed in a gruesome show of force, but the Alliance drove the orcs out and the town was subsequently rebuilt.
faq.q: What happened to Hillsbrad during the Second War?

text.s: The Hillsbrad Fields encompass the cultivated farmlands and rustic settlement of Hillsbrad in western Hillsbrad Foothills. As one of the few surviving human communities in former Lordaeron that refused to succumb to the Scourge or join the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, its farmers and militia now face constant assaults from the nearby Forsaken at Tarren Mill.

sec.b: Spanning orchards, pumpkin patches, and pastures between Darrow Hill and the Azurelode Mine, the Hillsbrad Fields supply essential provisions to Southshore and the surviving Alliance resistance. While much of Lordaeron fell to the plague of undeath, the people of Hillsbrad endured, proudly retaining the royal tabard and heraldry of their fallen kingdom. Led by Magistrate Burnside and the Council of Hillsbrad, the township operates as an independent civic body under constant siege. The local blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices keep the populace armed, ensuring every farmer and laborer is prepared to defend their land.

The fertile fields are a prime target for High Executor Darthalia and the Forsaken forces entrenched at Tarren Mill. Viewing the thriving human settlement as an existential threat on their southern flank, the Undercity has orchestrated continuous raids against the community's infrastructure, targeting crops, livestock, councilors, and civilian farmers alike. In response, Hillsbrad's defenders have formed a hardened militia. Far from helpless peasants, local landowners like Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz organize ambushes and fight fiercely against undead incursions to preserve their homes.
sec.t: Front Line of the Undead Advance

subzone:howling-vale.s: Vega del Aullido. Escondida en el centro-norte de Vallefresno, cerca de la frontera con Frondavil, la Vega del Aullido es una oscura hondonada invadida por unas salvajes y extrañas bestias lobunas conocidas como los huargen Luporror. Oculto en lo más profundo de sus cuevas se encuentra el antiguo Santuario de Mel'Thandris, una ruina bendecida por Elune íntimamente ligada a los trágicos orígenes de la maldición de los huargen en Kalimdor. Al norte del camino hacia Frondavil, la serena majestuosidad de Vallefresno da paso a unos aullidos inquietantes y depredadores. La vega cobija árboles ancestrales junto a corruptos señores de la manada Luporror y fauna agresiva. En su corazón yace una cueva que consagra el recuerdo de Mel'Thandris, una antigua sacerdotisa elfa de la noche. Aunque el santuario fue antaño un lugar de devoción tranquila, sus pacíficas salas han caído en la ruina y el abandono, profanadas por hombres lobo salvajes cuyo origen desconcierta a las centinelas apostadas en las cercanías.

ang.class:Druid: The feral packlords roaming the cave bear an ancient, cursed tie to forbidden shapeshifting traditions originating during the War of the Satyr.
ang.race:NightElf: The defilement of Mel'Thandris's shrine and the tragic missteps of Velinde Starsong serve as a bitter reminder of the perils of meddling with forbidden, primal magics.

faq.a: The vale earned its grim name from the chilling calls of the Terrowulf worgen who claimed it. Their constant, echoing howls reverberate through the canyon and cavern, drowning out the natural sounds of Ashenvale's canopy.
faq.q: Why is it called the Howling Vale?

faq.a: It is an ancient sanctuary dedicated to Elune and built in honor of Mel'Thandris, a night elf priestess who fought in the ancient War of the Satyr. Inscribed with Darnassian prayers, it served for millennia as the secret resting place of the Scythe of Elune.
faq.q: What is the Shrine of Mel'Thandris?

faq.a: Their origin puzzles the Sentinels. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study the Tome of Mel'Thandris at the shrine, whose history holds the key to where the wolf-men came from.
al: how did worgen get to ashenvale
faq.q: Where did the worgen here come from?

faq.a: It is a sacred historical text resting at the shrine in the depths of the cave. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study the tome to understand the origins of the mysterious wolf-men plaguing the forest.
faq.q: What is the Tome of Mel'Thandris?

text.s: Tucked away in north-central Ashenvale near the Felwood border, the Howling Vale is a darkened dell overrun by savage, alien wolf-beasts known as the Terrowulf worgen. Hidden deep within its caves lies the ancient Shrine of Mel'Thandris, an Elune-blessed ruin tied intimately to the tragic origins of the worgen curse on Kalimdor.

sec.b: North of the road toward Felwood, the calm majesty of Ashenvale gives way to eerie, predatory howling. The vale shelters ancient trees alongside corrupted Terrowulf packlords and aggressive wildlife. At its heart lies a cave enshrining the memory of Mel'Thandris, an ancient night elf priestess. While the shrine once stood as a place of quiet devotion, its tranquil halls have fallen into ruined disrepair, defiled by feral wolf-men whose origin puzzles the Sentinels stationed nearby.

During the ancient War of the Satyr, Mel'Thandris was entrusted with safeguarding the Scythe of Elune, a fateful artifact that bound away the feral Druids of the Scythe. After she fell in battle, her shrine sheltered the artifact for millennia. In recent times, the night elf Sentinel Velinde Starsong uncovered historical records in Darnassus, traveled here, and retrieved the Scythe. Her attempts to channel its power to fight demons inadvertently unleashed the worgen upon the surrounding woods, leaving the vale haunted by the very beasts she summoned.
sec.t: The Scythe and the Starsong Legacy

subzone:hunter-rise.s: Alto de los Cazadores. El Alto de los Cazadores es una de las mesetas elevadas que componen la ciudad de Cima del Trueno, situada justo al sur del risco central. Sirve como el principal punto de entrenamiento y reunión para los guerreros, cazadores, rastreadores y desolladores tauren. A lo largo de sus plataformas azotadas por el viento, los jóvenes bravos perfeccionan sus habilidades marciales y se preparan para el combate. Conectado a los riscos vecinos mediante puentes de cuerda colgantes, el Alto de los Cazadores está dedicado a las tradiciones marciales de los tauren. Su núcleo es la Sala de los Cazadores, donde tiradores, rastreadores y guerreros experimentados transmiten su disciplina a las generaciones más jóvenes. Alrededor del pabellón hay campos de prácticas equipados con maniquíes de entrenamiento, armeros y postes de desuello, lo que lo convierte en un bullicioso centro para aquellos que viven de la lanza, el arco y el pellejo.

ang.class:Hunter: For young tauren hunters, this rise is the natural heart of your calling in the capital, providing training, pet supplies, and guidance from master trackers.
ang.class:Warrior: The grounds of Hunter Rise provide training dummies, combat mentors, and battlemasters eager to test your strength in the ongoing defense of the Horde.

faq.a: Hunter Rise is located on the southern side of Thunder Bluff. It is reached by crossing the wooden rope bridges that connect it to the lower rise and high rise mesas of the city.
al: how to get to hunter rise
faq.q: Where is Hunter Rise located?

faq.a: The mesa is home to tauren hunters, warriors, trackers, trappers, and leatherworkers. In addition to class and profession trainers, Horde battlemasters make their stand here to recruit fighters for the faction's wars.
faq.q: Who lives and trains on Hunter Rise?

faq.a: The Hunter's Hall is the primary longhouse on the rise where seasoned hunters and warriors congregate. It serves as an armory, school, and hearth for those learning the ways of tracking, marksmanship, and close combat.
faq.q: What is the Hunter's Hall?

faq.a: No. Thunder Bluff is a major Horde capital city, and Hunter Rise is guarded by seasoned tauren braves. Any Alliance adventurer attempting to cross its bridges will be attacked immediately by city guards.
al: can alliance go to hunter rise
faq.q: Can members of the Alliance visit Hunter Rise?

text.s: Hunter Rise is one of the elevated mesas making up the city of Thunder Bluff, situated just south of the central bluff. It serves as the primary training and gathering ground for the tauren's warriors, hunters, trackers, and skinners. Across its windswept platforms, young braves hone their martial skills and prepare for combat.

sec.b: Connected to the neighboring bluffs by swaying rope bridges, Hunter Rise is dedicated to the martial traditions of the tauren. It is anchored by the Hunter's Hall, where experienced marksmen, trackers, and warriors pass down their discipline to younger generations. Surrounding the lodge are practice grounds outfitted with training dummies, weapon racks, and skinning posts, making it a bustling center for those who live by spear, bow, and hide.

Beyond hunting wild game across the plains of Mulgore, the inhabitants of Hunter Rise help ensure the defense of Thunder Bluff and the wider Horde. Battlemasters stationed along the rise recruit seasoned fighters to answer the call of skirmishes against Alliance incursions across contested battlegrounds. It remains an essential rallying point for anyone sworn to protect the herd.

subzone:hushed-bank.s: La Ribera Silente. La Ribera Silente es la sombría costa occidental de Bosque del Ocaso, que bordea el río que separa el bosque de Páramos de Poniente. Extendiéndose desde el cruce cerca de Tres Caminos hacia el sur en dirección a Vega de Tuercespina, es un bosque silencioso pero peligroso acechado por bestias merodeadoras y ensombrecido por oscuros misterios. Extendiéndose a lo largo del límite fluvial entre Bosque del Ocaso y Páramos de Poniente, La Ribera Silente marca la transición de las llanuras abiertas y las granjas soleadas al crepúsculo omnipresente y antinatural. El puente cubierto de madera cruza el río aquí, ofreciendo paso a los viajeros que se dirigen al oeste fuera del lúgubre bosque. La densa maleza y la niebla que se arrastra dominan las orillas del río, donde grandes arañas y hambrientos lobos del bosque acechan a los caminantes incautos que se desvían del camino transitado.

ang.class:Hunter: The wolves and spiders haunting the dense foliage along the riverbank offer classic wilderness beasts for trackers charting the darker reaches of the forest.
ang.faction:Alliance: The covered bridge along the bank serves as a critical strategic passage connecting the farmlands of Westfall to the besieged outpost of Duskwood.

faq.a: The Hushed Bank forms the western edge of Duskwood along the river that separates the forest from Westfall. It extends from the fork near Three Corners in the north down toward the southern borders leading toward Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: Where is the Hushed Bank located?

faq.a: A wooden covered bridge spans the river at the Hushed Bank, allowing foot and cart traffic to cross safely between the sunny plains of Westfall and the cursed gloom of Duskwood.
al: how to cross river to westfall
faq.q: What connects the Hushed Bank to Westfall?

faq.a: Sven Yorgen and his associate Lars have established an encampment in the northern corner of the bank. Both live as isolated recluses, having fled the horrors that claimed Sven's nearby farm.
faq.q: Who lives along the Hushed Bank?

faq.a: The Hushed Bank is home to vicious woodland beasts, including overgrown webwood spiders and predatory dusking wolves that prey upon anything moving through the brush.
faq.q: What threats are found along this shoreline?

text.s: The Hushed Bank is the shadowy western shoreline of Duskwood, bordering the river that divides the forest from Westfall. Stretching from the junction near the Three Corners south toward Stranglethorn Vale, it is a quiet yet hazardous woodland stalked by prowling beasts and shadowed by dark mysteries.

sec.b: Running along the river boundary between Duskwood and Westfall, the Hushed Bank marks the transition from open plains and sunlit farms to pervasive, unnatural twilight. The wooden covered bridge crosses the river here, offering passage to travelers heading west out of the grim wood. Thick underbrush and creeping fog dominate the riverbanks, where large spiders and hungry forest wolves stalk unwary wayfarers who stray from the beaten path.

Near the northern reaches of the bank, solitary souls have carved out meager existences away from the suspicious eyes of Darkshire. Sven Yorgen and his companion Lars keep camp in these dense woods, watching the treeline and harboring bitter grievances tied to the dark tragedies that plagued the region. Their isolated refuge remains one of the few signs of living humanoid presence on this lonely shore.

subzone:iris-lake.s: Lago Iris. El Lago Iris es una masa de agua marchita situada en la parte central norte de Vallefresno, al este de Astranaar. Antaño cristalinas, sus aguas se han vuelto de un color verde amarillento enfermizo debido a la corrupción demoníaca que se filtra desde Frondavil, y ahora hostiles bestias del pantano merodean por sus orillas. Enclavado entre Astranaar y la poza de la luna custodiada por Shael'dryn, el Lago Iris se erige como un sombrío recordatorio de las heridas infligidas durante la Tercera Guerra. Las energías viles que bajan hacia el sur desde las contaminadas alturas de Frondavil han envenenado la cuenca, convirtiendo sus otrora claras aguas en un cenagal fétido y de un verde amarillento enfermizo. La corrupción ha retorcido la vegetación autóctona y los espíritus del agua, haciendo surgir agresivas bestias del pantano que atacan a cualquier viajero que se acerque.

ang.class:Druid: The twisted bog beasts and stagnant, corrupted waters demonstrate the devastating toll that demonic energy takes on nature when left unchecked.
ang.race:NightElf: Iris Lake is a heartbreaking example of the creeping corruption threatening Ashenvale, but recovering Elune's Tears from its fouled shores offers hope for cleansing the forest.

faq.a: Iris Lake has been tainted by demonic corruption bleeding down from neighboring Felwood. The dark magic has poisoned the water table, turning the lake into a yellowish-green pool that twists nearby wildlife into aggressive monstrosities.
faq.q: Why is the water at Iris Lake green and murky?

faq.a: The lake and its shores are infested with corrupted bog beasts. These plant and mud elementals have been maddened by fel energy and will violently attack anyone approaching the water.
faq.q: What creatures roam around Iris Lake?

faq.a: Elune's Tears are sacred glowing blue stones found near the shores of Iris Lake. Priests and keepers of the night elves use their consecrated nature in purification rites, notably to cleanse corrupted moonwells.
faq.q: What are Elune's Tears?

faq.a: Iris Lake lies in north-central Ashenvale. It is positioned directly east of the night elf settlement of Astranaar and west of Shael'dryn's moonwell.
al: how to get to iris lake
faq.q: Where is Iris Lake located?

text.s: Iris Lake is a blighted body of water resting in north-central Ashenvale, east of Astranaar. Once pristine, its waters have turned a sickly yellowish-green from demonic corruption seeping down from Felwood, and hostile bog beasts now prowl its shores.

sec.b: Nestled between Astranaar and the moonwell tended by Shael'dryn, Iris Lake stands as a grim reminder of the wounds inflicted during the Third War. Fel energies drifting south from the tainted heights of Felwood have poisoned the basin, turning its once-clear waters into a foul, sickly yellow-green mire. The corruption has twisted the native plant life and water spirits, raising aggressive bog beasts that lash out at any traveler who wanders near.

Despite the severe pollution choking the lake, sacred remnants of the past still linger along its edges. Rare crystalline stones known as Elune's Tears can sometimes be found resting along the muddy banks. Keepers of elven traditions, such as Shael'dryn, seek these holy stones to aid in purifying tainted moonwells and resisting the spreading demonic blight across Ashenvale.

subzone:ironband-s-compound.s: Complejo Vetaferro. El Complejo Vetaferro es un puesto fortificado enclavado en las colinas nevadas al sur del Lago de Helm, en la zona oriental de Dun Morogh. Anteriormente hogar del prospector Sturgy Ironband, el campamento ha sido invadido por hostiles enanos Hierro Negro que atacan a cualquiera que se acerque demasiado. Establecido originalmente por Sturgy Ironband, este complejo al sur del Lago de Helm sirvió antaño como base de operaciones en los parajes nevados de Dun Morogh. Todo cambió cuando los infiltrados Hierro Negro se adentraron en territorio Barbabronce y se apoderaron del lugar. Ahora, repleto de enanos hostiles, el complejo funciona como una base avanzada enemiga que amenaza a viajeros y asentamientos cercanos, justo ante las narices de Forjaz.

ang.class:Warrior: Aspiring warriors are dispatched here by Ironforge's veteran trainers to prove their mettle by aiding fallen comrades and collecting proof of the Dark Iron presence.
ang.race:Dwarf: For the Bronzebeards, seeing the treacherous Dark Irons entrenching themselves within Dun Morogh's borders is a direct insult and a persistent danger to their homeland.

faq.a: The outpost was formerly inhabited and used by Sturgy Ironband before hostile forces drove him out and took control of the site.
faq.q: Who originally built Ironband's Compound?

faq.a: The camp has been seized by a band of hostile Dark Iron dwarves who readily assault any wanderers or Ironforge patrols that approach.
faq.q: Who controls Ironband's Compound now?

faq.a: You can find it nestled in the snowy hills of eastern Dun Morogh, just south of Helm's Bed Lake.
faq.q: Where is Ironband's Compound located?

faq.a: Having an enemy clan establish a fortified base so close to the dwarf capital is an alarming security breach. Ironforge authorities send fighters here to gather hard evidence of Dark Iron infiltration.
faq.q: Why is this camp important to the leaders of Ironforge?

text.s: Ironband's Compound is a fortified outpost tucked into the snowy hills south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. Formerly home to the prospector Sturgy Ironband, the camp has been overrun by hostile Dark Iron dwarves who attack anyone venturing too close.

sec.b: Originally established by Sturgy Ironband, this compound south of Helm's Bed Lake once served as a staging post in the snowy wilderness of Dun Morogh. That changed when Dark Iron infiltrators pushed deep into Bronzebeard territory and seized the site for themselves. Now bristling with hostile dwarves, the compound serves as an enemy forward base threatening travelers and nearby settlements, right under the nose of Ironforge.
sec.t: A Fall to the Dark Irons

sec.b: The presence of a fortified Dark Iron camp within Dun Morogh's own borders is a serious provocation. Ironforge keeps a wary eye on the compound, dispatching seasoned warriors to recover fallen scouts and secure vital intelligence proving the extent of the Dark Iron threat in the mountain kingdom.

subzone:ironband-s-excavation-site.s: Excavación de Vetaferro. La Excavación de Vetaferro es una amplia excavación enana situada en el sureste de Loch Modan, justo al sur del lago y al suroeste de la Cabaña del Errante. Dirigida por el Prospector Vetaferro, la operación arqueológica se detuvo bruscamente cuando unos troggs agresivos e inestables invadieron las trincheras. Impulsado por el afán de los enanos por descubrir sus antiguos orígenes titánicos, el Prospector Vetaferro estableció esta vasta excavación junto a los escarpados acantilados del sureste de Loch Modan. Lo que comenzó como una excavación prometedora se convirtió rápidamente en un desastre cuando las obras perturbaron a una raza subterránea de troggs inusualmente feroces y corpulentos. Las criaturas surgieron de la tierra, haciendo retroceder a los mineros y acampando entre herramientas dispersas, carretas rotas y reliquias a medio desenterrar.

ang.profession:Mining: The quarry and open pits showcase typical dwarven heavy-extraction techniques, though ongoing trogg hostility makes any prospecting hazardous.
ang.race:Dwarf: The overrun dig is a stinging setback for the Explorers' League, who view the recovery of ancient relics here as vital to understanding dwarven heritage.

faq.a: The excavation site is located in the southeastern region of Loch Modan, directly south of the Loch and southwest of Farstrider Lodge.
faq.q: Where is Ironband's Excavation Site located?

faq.a: Prospector Ironband is an archaeologist and explorer heading up the excavation on behalf of the dwarven Explorers' League, attempting to salvage artifacts and drive back the local troggs.
faq.q: Who is Prospector Ironband?

faq.a: As the dwarven miners excavated deeper into the soil of Loch Modan, their tunneling breached subterranean pockets inhabited by a large and aggressive breed of troggs, who quickly overwhelmed the workers and seized the site.
faq.q: Why is the excavation site overrun with troggs?

faq.a: Like many dwarven archaeological digs across Khaz Modan, the miners were searching for ancient Titan relics and stone ruins that might shed light on the ancestral origins of the dwarven race.
faq.q: What were the dwarves hoping to find here?

text.s: Ironband's Excavation Site is an expansive dwarven dig located in southeastern Loch Modan, just south of the lake and southwest of Farstrider Lodge. Led by Prospector Ironband, the archaeological operation was abruptly halted when aggressive, volatile troggs overran the trenches.

sec.b: Spurred by the dwarven drive to uncover their ancient Titan origins, Prospector Ironband established this sprawling digsite along the rugged cliffs of southeastern Loch Modan. What began as a promising excavation quickly turned into a disaster when the digging disturbed an unusually fierce and large breed of subterranean troggs. The creatures surged from the earth, driving back the miners and setting up camp amidst the scattered tools, broken carts, and half-excavated relics.

Much like archaeological efforts in the Badlands, Wetlands, and Uldaman, the site sits in dangerous limbo. Surviving prospectors cling to the edges of the perimeter, desperate to reclaim their stolen gear and protect exposed artifacts—including strange ancient statues left behind by long-forgotten builders—from being smashed or carried off by the ravenous trogg infestation.

subzone:ironbeard-s-tomb.s: Tumba de Barbaférrea. La Tumba de Barbaférrea es un lugar de enterramiento enano profanado situado al oeste del camino que conduce al norte hacia Dun Modr, en Los Humedales. Marcada por un cementerio al aire libre y una estatua de piedra que le da nombre, la cripta ha caído en desuso a medida que los mocos ácidos invadían el terreno. Los viajeros rara vez ponen un pie en la hondonada a menos que busquen pertenencias perdidas devoradas por el fango. Con vistas a las marismas a lo largo del camino hacia el norte a Dun Modr, la Tumba de Barbaférrea se erige como testimonio de la presencia enana en Los Humedales. Una monumental estatua de piedra, que presumiblemente representa al propio Barbaférrea, vigila el cementerio circundante. Sin embargo, la solemne paz ya no vela este lugar. La cripta subterránea ha sido invadida por completo por cepas de mocos negros y carmesíes, dejando la tumba contaminada. Los enanos ya no traen a sus muertos a este santuario en ruinas, y los pocos valientes que se atreven a perturbar las bóvedas lo hacen principalmente para rebuscar entre los restos digeridos por los limos acechantes.

ang.race:Dwarf: Seeing a clan hero's final resting place infested by mindless marsh oozes is a bitter disgrace for any dwarf traveling the road toward the Thandol Span.

faq.a: Very little is recorded about Ironbeard himself, though the massive statue and crypt grounds suggest he was an honored dwarven figure of note in the Wetlands. The monument erected in his likeness watches over the hillside above the cemetery.
faq.q: Who was Ironbeard?

faq.a: The crypt has been completely overrun by acidic black and crimson oozes. With the burial grounds defiled and infested with dangerous slimes, mourning families have ceased bringing their dead here.
faq.q: Why is the tomb abandoned?

faq.a: Beyond fighting back the foul infestation, travelers frequently search the tomb's slimes hoping to recover swallowed items, most notably Sida's lost bag.
faq.q: Why do adventurers explore Ironbeard's Tomb?

faq.a: The tomb sits in north-central Wetlands, nestled into the hill just west of the main road heading north toward the dwarven redoubt of Dun Modr.
al: how to get to ironbeard tomb
faq.q: Where is Ironbeard's Tomb located?

text.s: Ironbeard's Tomb is a defiled dwarven burial site situated west of the road leading north toward Dun Modr in the Wetlands. Marked by an outdoor graveyard and a stone statue of its namesake, the crypt has fallen into disuse as acidic oozes swarm the grounds. Travelers rarely set foot in the hollow unless searching for lost possessions swallowed by the slime.

sec.b: Overlooking the marshes along the road north to Dun Modr, Ironbeard's Tomb stands as a testament to the dwarven presence in the Wetlands. A monumental stone statue, presumed to depict Ironbeard himself, watches over the surrounding burial plot. Yet solemn peace no longer keeps vigil here. The subterranean crypt has been completely overrun by oozes of various black and crimson strains, leaving the tomb contaminated. Dwarves no longer bring their dead to this ruined sanctuary, and those brave enough to disturb the vaults do so primarily to hunt through the remains digested by the lurking slimes.

subzone:ironclad-cove.s: Cala del Acorazado. La Cala del Acorazado es una inmensa caverna subterránea oculta bajo Páramos de Poniente que alberga un astillero y un muelle subterráneos. Sirve como dársena secreta de construcción para el gran acorazado de la Hermandad Defias y conecta directamente con el mar. Enterrada en el punto más profundo de Las Minas de la Muerte, la Cala del Acorazado es una monumental caverna marina convertida en un astillero fortificado. Aquí, Edwin VanCleef y la Hermandad Defias han construido un enorme buque de guerra conocido como el acorazado. La caverna cuenta con extensos andamios de madera, islotes y pasarelas de carga tripuladas por piratas Defias, marineros y capataces. Su existencia revela la verdadera magnitud de la amenaza Defias: VanCleef no solo pretende asaltar las granjas de Páramos de Poniente, sino reunir una fuerza naval privada capaz de bombardear las mismísimas costas de Ventormenta.

ang.class:Rogue: The cove represents the zenith of Edwin VanCleef's craftsmanship, engineering prowess, and underground logistics, making it legendary among thieves and outlaws.
ang.faction:Alliance: Finding a full-sized war galleon buried under Westfall transforms the Defias from a regional bandit gang into an existential military threat against the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.a: The juggernaught is the centerpiece of Edwin VanCleef's military ambitions. The Defias Brotherhood assembled this massive warship deep beneath the earth so it could launch undetected through subterranean water channels and strike at Stormwind from the sea.
al: why is there a ship here
faq.q: What is the ship in Ironclad Cove being built for?

faq.a: The massive gates open directly into the ocean along the southern coast of Westfall, near the border of northern Stranglethorn Vale. When opened, the juggernaught can sail straight out into the Great Sea.
al: where do the sea gates open
faq.q: Where does the large metal door in the cove lead?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood holds the cove under the command of Edwin VanCleef. While independent pirates originally used the secluded cavern, VanCleef's forces wiped them out to commandeer the docks and keep the juggernaught's construction entirely secret.
faq.q: Who controls Ironclad Cove?

faq.a: That is Cookie, the Defias ship's cook. Armed with a rolling pin and cooking cauldrons, he is an unusual ally among the human and goblin renegades, having claimed the galley as his personal domain.
al: why is there a murloc pirate
faq.q: Who is the murloc aboard the ship?

text.s: Ironclad Cove is a massive subterranean cavern hidden beneath Westfall, housing an underground shipyard and dock. It serves as the secret construction dock for the Defias Brotherhood's war juggernaught and connects directly to the sea.

sec.b: Buried at the deepest point of the Deadmines, Ironclad Cove is a monumental sea cavern converted into a fortified dockyard. Here, Edwin VanCleef and the Defias Brotherhood have constructed an enormous warship known as the juggernaught. The cavern features extensive wooden scaffolding, islets, and loading catwalks manned by Defias pirates, deckhands, and overseers. Its existence reveals the true scale of the Defias threat: VanCleef intends not merely to raid Westfall's farmsteads, but to assemble a private naval force capable of bombarding the shores of Stormwind itself.

The cavern is dominated by colossal iron-reinforced sea doors set into the rock wall. Once opened, these gates provide a direct outlet into the Great Sea, emerging along the coastline just north of Stranglethorn Vale. Before the Defias Brotherhood seized the cove, it was held by an independent pirate crew whom the Brotherhood slaughtered to ensure total secrecy. Shielded from the eyes of the Stormwind naval fleet, the cove provides the Brotherhood an unmonitored lane for moving contraband, staging maritime raids, and preparing their naval assault.

subzone:ironforge-airfield.s: Aeródromo de Forjaz. Escondida en lo alto de los picos nevados al noreste de Forjaz, esta remota pista de aterrizaje enana sirve como campo de pruebas y zona de operaciones para las máquinas voladoras de los gnomos y los montañeros enanos. Sin caminos principales que la señalen, la meseta se alza sobre los riscos escarpados de Dun Morogh y el pronunciado descenso hacia Los Humedales. Encaramado muy por encima de los senderos trillados de Dun Morogh, este aeródromo de gran altitud es una discreta maravilla de la cooperación de la Alianza. Al abrigo de las cumbres montañosas circundantes, la cantería enana afianza las crestas azotadas por el viento, mientras que las máquinas voladoras gnomo permanecen estacionadas a lo largo de pistas de aterrizaje al aire libre. Los montañeros vigilan el perímetro junto a ingenieros ocupados en ajustar engranajes e inspeccionar motores que escupen vapor en medio del frío cortante.

ang.profession:Engineering: For tinkers, the airstrip showcases the apex of gnomish aviation, featuring fully assembled flying machines stationed in extreme, sub-zero conditions.
ang.race:Dwarf: A testament to dwarven territorial watchfulness, the airfield proves that Ironforge's Mountaineers stand sentry even in the most inaccessible heights of Khaz Modan.

faq.a: There are no roads, flights, or maintained tunnels connecting the valley to Ironforge or lower Dun Morogh. Reaching it requires scaling the steep mountainsides on foot, typically via tricky ridgeline climbing paths beginning out of Loch Modan or near the passes of Dun Morogh.
faq.q: How do you get up to the airfield?

faq.a: It serves as an elevated flight testing and military outpost where dwarven mountaineers and gnome engineers maintain flying machines and scout the high mountain borderlands separating Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and the Wetlands.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this place?

faq.a: Local Frostmane trolls inhabit caves in the southern cliffs of the valley. Dwarven mountaineers clash regularly with them over the frozen lake just beneath the runway.
al: who is fighting on the lake
faq.q: Who is attacking the dwarven guards here?

faq.a: No standard quests direct adventurers to visit the airstrip in everyday travels. It remains an obscure, remote plateau largely separated from the main logistics of the dwarven kingdom.
faq.q: Is the airfield tied to any official quests?

text.s: Tucked away high in the snowy peaks northeast of Ironforge, this remote dwarven airstrip serves as a proving ground and staging area for gnome flying machines and dwarven mountaineers. Unmarked by main roads, the plateau overlooks the jagged crags of Dun Morogh and the steep descent toward the Wetlands.

sec.b: Perched far above the beaten trails of Dun Morogh, the high-altitude airfield is a quiet marvel of Alliance cooperation. Sheltered by surrounding mountain peaks, dwarven masonry anchors the blustery ridgelines while gnomish flying machines sit parked along open landing strips. Mountaineers keep watch over the perimeter alongside engineers busy wrenching gears and inspecting steam-belching engines in the biting cold.
sec.t: A Hidden Redoubt in the Crags

sec.b: Despite its isolation, the airfield is far from serene. The surrounding valley features frozen waters and crags contested by Frostmane trolls, who dwell in nearby caves and constantly harass the dwarven sentries. In the shadow of the peaks, dwarven defenders and Stormpike patrols clash regularly with troll raiders across the ice, keeping the remote installation in a state of quiet, vigilant standoff.

subzone:ivar-patch.s: Los Dominios de Ivar. Los Dominios de Ivar son una granja de calabazas asolada ubicada en el norte del Bosque de Argénteos. En su día fue una próspera finca agrícola de Lordaeron, pero sus residentes fueron aniquilados durante la Tercera Guerra y transformados en necrófagos voraces y ciegamente hostiles. Antes de que la Tercera Guerra arrasara Lordaeron, este campo de calabazas era una próspera propiedad de un granjero llamado Ivar, quien empleaba a un animado grupo de peones y sirvientes. Cuando la Plaga desató la peste de la no-muerte por la campiña, la granja quedó completamente consumida. En lugar de alzarse con la mente intacta como los Renegados de libre albedrío, Ivar, su familia y sus trabajadores quedaron reducidos a necrófagos putrefactos y salvajes, condenados a merodear por la tierra en ruinas.

ang.faction:Horde: Culling the ravenous ghouls at the patch is vital to securing the northern roadway between Silverpine Forest and the safety of Undercity.
ang.race:Undead: The ruined farm stands as a bitter reminder of the Plague of Undeath that tore Lordaeron apart, showing the horrifying mindless fate the Forsaken narrowly escaped.

faq.a: The farm was struck down by the Plague of Undeath during the Third War. Farmer Ivar, his family, and his workers all succumbed, rising again as feral, rotting ghouls under the lingering sway of the Scourge.
faq.q: What happened to the farm and its owner?

faq.a: Deathstalkers Rane and Quinn Yorick were part of a scouting reconnaissance squad dispatched to gauge regional threats in Silverpine Forest. While passing through, they were ambushed by the ghouls, and Quinn was severely injured by Ivar the Foul, forcing them to take refuge inside the dilapidated farmhouse.
faq.q: Why are there Deathstalkers hiding inside the house?

faq.a: No. The ghouls roaming the pumpkin fields are mindless Scourge remnants created by the Plague of Undeath. They lack free will and will attack any living travelers or Forsaken on sight.
faq.q: Are the ghouls here part of the Forsaken?

faq.a: The Ivar Patch lies in northern Silverpine Forest, north of the Dead Field and just south of the road leading toward Malden's Orchard.
faq.q: Where is the Ivar Patch located?

text.s: The Ivar Patch is a blighted pumpkin farm located in northern Silverpine Forest. Once a thriving agricultural homestead of Lordaeron, its residents were wiped out during the Third War and transformed into ravenous, mindlessly hostile ghouls.

sec.b: Before the Third War swept through Lordaeron, this pumpkin patch was a prosperous homestead owned by a farmer named Ivar, who employed a lively crew of farmhands and servants. When the Scourge unleashed the Plague of Undeath across the countryside, the farm was consumed completely. Rather than rising with their minds intact like the free-willed Forsaken, Ivar, his family, and his laborers were reduced to rotting, feral ghouls bound to prowl the ruined soil.

When the Forsaken began securing northern Silverpine, three Deathstalkers—Rane Yorick, Quinn Yorick, and Erland McKree—scouted the region to evaluate local threats. Passing through the Dead Field, the patrol was ambushed by the feral pack at the patch. Quinn was badly mauled by Ivar himself, now known as Ivar the Foul. With Quinn gravely wounded, the Yoricks fortified themselves inside the farm's old ruined house while McKree pressed on alone toward Malden's Orchard.

subzone:jaggedswine-farm.s: La Pocilga. La Pocilga es una modesta granja de ganado situada en el norte de Durotar, justo al sur de la entrada principal de Orgrimmar. Compuesta por un cobertizo de almacenamiento de madera, un extenso corral y una charca enfangada, sirve como una fuente de alimento crucial que cría resistentes cerdos para la cercana capital de la Horda. Excavada en la implacable y calcinada tierra de Durotar, La Pocilga representa la dura realidad de mantener una fortaleza urbana como Orgrimmar. La tierra roja de la región ofrece una agricultura escasa, lo que hace que el ganado robusto sea esencial para alimentar a miles de guerreros y trabajadores orcos. La granja se articula en torno a un almacén de madera, un amplio corral de estacas y una charca natural donde se pastorea, cría y sacrifica a los cerdos para mantener abastecidos los graneros de la Horda.

ang.faction:Horde: Establishing stable meat supplies in the arid wastes of Durotar is a matter of survival, making outposts like Jaggedswine vital to sustaining Orgrimmar's military strength.
ang.profession:Cooking: For Horde cooks learning their trade in Durotar, the abundant swine around Jaggedswine Farm make it a primary local source for tender ribs, pork cuts, and cooking grease.

faq.a: The farm raises and maintains swine to provide meat and lard for the Horde, particularly to feed the population and garrison of nearby Orgrimmar.
al: why is there a pig farm in durotar
faq.q: What is the purpose of Jaggedswine Farm?

faq.a: It lies in northern Durotar, sitting just outside the southern approach and grand gates that lead into the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
al: how to get to jaggedswine farm
faq.q: Where exactly is Jaggedswine Farm located?

faq.a: Orcish livestock farming in Durotar is utilitarian and unglamorous. Between free-roaming boars and sparse timber structures, the steading lacks grand homesteads, but it remains actively used by Horde supply lines.
faq.q: Why does the farm look somewhat deserted?

faq.a: While the domesticated swine inside the pens are docile, wild and mature boars roaming the outskirts can be aggressive if startled by young travelers or careless foragers.
faq.q: Are the pigs here dangerous to travelers?

text.s: Jaggedswine Farm is a modest livestock steading situated in northern Durotar, just south of the main entrance to Orgrimmar. Comprising a timber storage shed, a sprawling pen, and a muddy watering hole, it serves as a critical food source raising hardy swine for the nearby Horde capital.

sec.b: Carved out of Durotar's unforgiving, sunbaked earth, Jaggedswine Farm represents the harsh reality of sustaining an urban stronghold like Orgrimmar. The red soil of the region yields sparse agriculture, making robust livestock essential to feeding thousands of orcish warriors and laborers. The farm centers on a timber storehouse, a wide wooden pen, and a natural watering pond where swine are herded, bred, and butchered to keep the Horde's granaries stocked.

Though quiet and often appearing half-tended under the dry heat, the farm is a regular stomping ground for local swineherds and patrolling Orgrimmar Grunts. Wild and mature swine roam both inside and outside the enclosures, occasionally testing the patience of nearby guards. Sitting right on the threshold of the capital's valley approach, the plot remains an unassuming yet indispensable outpost in the daily logistics of Durotar.

subzone:jangolode-mine.s: Mina de Jango. La Mina de Jango es una rica excavación minera ubicada en las onduladas colinas de Páramos de Poniente. Antaño una fuente vital de mineral y materias primas para Ciudad de Ventormenta, la mina ha sido tomada por los bandidos de la Hermandad Defias. Antes de que Páramos de Poniente cayera en decadencia, la Mina de Jango proporcionaba un flujo constante de metales cruciales para la reconstrucción y el abastecimiento de Ciudad de Ventormenta. A medida que el orden civil se deterioró y el reino retiró sus guarniciones, la Hermandad Defias se hizo con el control del enclave para abastecer sus propias operaciones. Los bandidos ahora explotan las ricas vetas para sí mismos, defendiendo con fiereza su botín subterráneo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Reclaiming Westfall's resources is vital for stabilizing the kingdom, and driving the bandits out of Jangolode is one step toward restoring the region's prosperity.
ang.profession:Mining: The Jangolode Mine remains rich in basic copper and tin deposits, making it a lucrative stop for prospectors willing to fight past the subterranean pests.

faq.a: It is an excavation site in Westfall that historically supplied Stormwind City with essential minerals and metal ore. With regional defense weakened, it fell into hostile hands.
faq.q: What is the Jangolode Mine?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood holds the underground shafts, having driven out the original miners to feed their own operations.
faq.q: Who controls the mine right now?

faq.a: Stormwind is mired in political unrest and struggling to protect even its core borders. The kingdom lacks the troops to garrison Westfall's outlying mines, leaving the People's Militia and local adventurers to manage the threat.
faq.q: Why does Stormwind not reclaim the mine?

text.s: Jangolode Mine is a rich mineral excavation located in the rolling hills of Westfall. Once a vital source of ore and raw materials for Stormwind City, the mine has been seized by the bandits of the Defias Brotherhood.

sec.b: Before Westfall fell into decline, the Jangolode Mine provided a steady flow of metals crucial to the reconstruction and supply of Stormwind City. As civil order deteriorated and the kingdom withdrew its garrisons, the Defias Brotherhood seized control of the site to feed their own operations. The bandits now work the rich veins for themselves, fiercely defending their subterranean prize.

subzone:jasperlode-mine.s: Cantera de Jaspe. La Cantera de Jaspe es una excavación de hierro y minerales situada en la zona centronorte del Bosque de Elwynn que antaño abastecía a Ciudad de Ventormenta con recursos vitales. En la actualidad, los pozos están invadidos por enjambres de kóbolds y letales arañas gigantes, lo que deja al mermado reino sin capacidad para recuperarla. Históricamente, la Cantera de Jaspe fue una de las operaciones mineras más productivas de Ventormenta, proporcionando una constante riqueza mineral junto a la cercana Mina Abisal. Como el ejército del reino apenas da abasto para hacer frente a las amenazas externas y a los disturbios, las guarniciones locales se han visto incapaces de proteger los pozos. Los kóbolds aprovecharon la oportunidad para excavar en su interior, expulsando a los mineros humanos y acumulando oro robado y velas de sebo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Securing raw metal from Jasperlode is vital to maintaining Stormwind's equipment supplies during a time when the kingdom's borders face constant peril.
ang.profession:Mining: Rich in mineral veins, Jasperlode remains an enticing target for prospectors willing to fight through kobold pickaxes and spider webs to stake a claim.

faq.a: Stormwind's standing army is spread thin across the realm, leaving rural outposts like Goldshire short on manpower. Opportunistic kobolds quickly swarmed the dig sites once the human miners lost their guard protection.
faq.q: Why is Jasperlode Mine overrun?

faq.a: Fargodeep Mine lies to the south near the Maclure and Stonefield farms, while Jasperlode sits to the north nestled in the foothills near the river. Both are major Elwynn mineral sites lost to the kobold infestation.
faq.q: What is the difference between Jasperlode and Fargodeep?

faq.a: The deepest shafts are infested with predatory mine spiders led by a massive arachnid known as Mother Fang. Even the occupying kobolds avoid their webbed caverns.
faq.q: What lurks in the back of the mine?

faq.a: Marshal Dughan lacks the troops to mount a prolonged subterranean clearing. Between Defias river patrols, gnoll incursions, and garrison duties, the local militia must rely on traveling adventurers to scout and cull the threats inside.
faq.q: Why hasn't Marshal Dughan cleared the mine?

text.s: Jasperlode Mine is an iron and mineral excavation in north-central Elwynn Forest that once supplied Stormwind City with vital resources. Today, the shafts are overrun by swarming kobolds and deadly giant spiders, leaving the resource-strapped kingdom unable to reclaim it.

sec.b: Jasperlode Mine was historically one of Stormwind's most productive mining operations, providing steady mineral wealth alongside nearby Fargodeep. With the kingdom's military stretched thin defending against external threats and unrest, local garrisons have been unable to protect the shafts. Kobolds seized the opportunity to burrow inside, driving human miners out and stockpiling stolen gold and tallow candles.

The infestation within Jasperlode extends beyond simple vermin. In the deepest, darkest corridors beneath the timber supports, an aggressive colony of mine spiders has taken root. Led by a massive matriarch known to locals as Mother Fang, the spiders treat trespassing kobolds—and any unwary prospectors—as effortless prey, making any attempt to salvage the mine exceptionally hazardous.

subzone:jerod-s-landing.s: Embarcadero de Jerod. El Embarcadero de Jerod es un modesto muelle fluvial situado en la orilla del río Nazferiti correspondiente al Bosque de Elwynn. Actualmente tomado por la Hermandad Defias, este puesto de avanzada sirve como punto de transferencia clandestino para cargamentos ilícitos que se introducen de contrabando a través de las vías fluviales del reino. Escondido a lo largo de las aguas orientales del río Nazferiti, el Embarcadero de Jerod proporciona acceso fluvial que conecta el Bosque de Elwynn con los territorios vecinos. Aunque en su origen era un simple muelle para botes, el lugar ha caído firmemente en manos de la Hermandad Defias. Bajo la atenta mirada de un maestro de dársena Defias, los forajidos utilizan el muelle como centro para recibir mercancías saqueadas en las Montañas Crestagrana, trasladando discretamente los cargamentos río abajo hacia posesiones como La torre de Klaven en los Páramos de Poniente.

ang.class:Rogue: Rogues working on behalf of SI:7 are dispatched to Jerod's Landing to test their stealth, pickpocket the Defias dockmaster, and recover sensitive trade ledgers.
ang.faction:Alliance: The occupation of Jerod's Landing highlights how thoroughly the Defias have compromised the interior waterways linking Elwynn to Redridge right beneath Stormwind's nose.

faq.a: Jerod's Landing is located in eastern Elwynn Forest, resting along the western bank of the Nazferiti River, which marks the boundary between Elwynn and the Redridge Mountains.
faq.q: Where is Jerod's Landing located?

faq.a: The landing has been occupied by members of the Defias Brotherhood, led by a Defias dockmaster who coordinates shipments with armed bandits guarding the waterside.
faq.q: Who controls Jerod's Landing?

faq.a: The Brotherhood utilizes the dock as a smuggling waystation to transport stolen goods and weaponry intercepted in the Redridge Mountains toward rogue strongholds like Klaven's Tower in Westfall.
al: why do defias use jerods landing
faq.q: What is the purpose of this dock for the Defias?

faq.a: Master Mathias Shaw and his intelligence agents track the flow of Defias contraband through this dock to expose the network linking Westfall, Elwynn, and Redridge.
faq.q: Why is SI:7 interested in Jerod's Landing?

text.s: Jerod's Landing is a modest river dock situated on the Elwynn Forest bank of the Nazferiti River. Currently seized by the Defias Brotherhood, the outpost serves as a clandestine transfer point for illicit shipments smuggled across the kingdom's waterways.

sec.b: Tucked away along the eastern waters of the Nazferiti River, Jerod's Landing provides river access connecting Elwynn Forest to neighboring territories. While originally an ordinary boat dock, the site has fallen firmly into the hands of the Defias Brotherhood. Under the watchful eye of a Defias dockmaster, outlaws utilize the dock as a hub to receive goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains, discreetly moving river cargo downstream toward holdings such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

Because of its strategic placement on the river, Jerod's Landing has drawn the attention of SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence network. Operatives monitoring Defias operations view the landing as a vital link in the syndicate's supply lines, sending resourceful rogues to infiltrate the docks, pilfer river shipment ledgers, and unravel the wider conspiracy strangling the kingdom.

subzone:kargathia-keep.s: Fuerte de Kargathia. El Fuerte de Kargathia es un bastión fortificado de la Horda que afianza el frente oriental del Aserradero Grito de Guerra en Vallefresno. Al servir como cuartel general de los capataces del puesto de avanzada, vigila la frontera fluvial y garantiza líneas de refuerzo rápido directas a Orgrimmar. Encaramado en el extremo oriental del Aserradero Grito de Guerra, justo al oeste del Río Furia del Sur, el Fuerte de Kargathia sirve como Centro de Mando para las operaciones madereras de la Horda en Vallefresno. Mejorado con pesadas barricadas de púas, este puesto fortificado alberga al Capataz Gorthak y a sus oficiales. Su posición estratégica junto a la frontera fluvial permite al clan Grito de Guerra vigilar las incursiones que se aproximan y recibir refuerzos rápidos directamente desde las tierras vecinas de Durotar y Orgrimmar siempre que atacan las escaramuzas de los elfos de la noche.

ang.faction:Horde: For Horde defenders, Kargathia Keep is an indispensable sanctuary on the frontline of Ashenvale, securing valuable timber shipments vital to Orgrimmar's construction.
ang.race:NightElf: To the night elves, this heavily spiked stronghold represents the aggressive, deeply entrenched nature of the Horde's intrusion into their sacred ancestral forest.

faq.a: Kargathia Keep is situated in eastern Ashenvale, on the eastern edge of the Warsong Lumber Camp just west of the Southfury River.
faq.q: Where is Kargathia Keep located?

faq.a: Overseer Gorthak commands the Warsong Lumber Camp from within Kargathia Keep, directing logging operations and coordinating defenses against Alliance attacks.
al: who is in charge of kargathia keep
faq.q: Who leads the keep?

faq.a: The stronghold was named in honor of Kargath Bladefist, the legendary chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan, sharing this naming heritage with Kargath in the Badlands and Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
al: who is kargathia keep named after
faq.q: Why was the keep named Kargathia?

faq.a: The keep commands the eastern border of the logging camp along the Southfury River, securing the vital supply route and enabling rapid troop reinforcements to cross over from Orgrimmar.
faq.q: What is the strategic purpose of this stronghold?

text.s: Kargathia Keep is a fortified Horde stronghold anchoring the eastern front of the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale. Serving as headquarters for the outpost's overseers, it guards the river border and ensures rapid reinforcement lines directly back to Orgrimmar.

sec.b: Perched on the eastern edge of the Warsong Lumber Camp just west of the Southfury River, Kargathia Keep serves as the command center for the Horde's logging operations in Ashenvale. Upgraded with heavy spiked barricades, this fortified outpost houses Overseer Gorthak and his officers. Its strategic position against the river border allows the Warsong clan to monitor incoming incursions and receive swift reinforcements directly from the neighboring lands of Durotar and Orgrimmar whenever night elf skirmishers strike.

Like the fortress of Kargath in the Badlands and Bladefist Bay along the coast of Durotar, the outpost takes its name from the famed chieftain Kargath Bladefist. For the Warsong orcs braving Ashenvale's hostile woodlands, the keep's imposing classic architecture stands as an enduring symbol of martial resilience and Horde defiance in territory claimed by the night elves.

subzone:kharanos.s: Kharanos. Kharanos es un bullicioso asentamiento montañoso situado en el corazón nevado de Dun Morogh, siguiendo el camino desde Forjaz.
