Ships steam continually across the ocean toward Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and Auberdine in darkshore, carrying trade, diplomats, and off-duty Kul Tiran marines blowing their wages at the Deepwater Tavern. Yet peace is fragile here: inland supply paths through Dun Algaz are regularly contested by the Dragonmaw clan, while hostile Dark Iron raiders pressure the northern marshes, leaving Captain Stoutfist and the harbor garrison on constant alert.

subzone:merchant-coast.s: La Costa Mercante. La Costa Mercante es el tramo del litoral oriental de Los Baldíos que bordea el Mare Magnum. Dominada por el bullicioso puerto goblin de Trinquete, la costa debe su nombre al lucrativo comercio marítimo, aunque los piratas se la disputan constantemente. A lo largo del borde oriental de Los Baldíos, La Costa Mercante sirve como una arteria marítima vital que conecta el centro de Kalimdor con los Reinos del Este y Theramore. Su nombre rinde homenaje a los laboriosos comerciantes goblins del Cártel Bonvapor, cuyo puerto neutral de Trinquete gestiona cargamentos para cualquiera que disponga de monedas. Sin embargo, las rutas marítimas abiertas atraen a algo más que navíos mercantes: los filibusteros del Mar del Sur merodean por las arenas y las aguas cercanas, acechando a los barcos mercantes y estableciendo operaciones ilícitas a lo largo de las playas.

ang.faction:Alliance: The Alliance maintains a nearby naval presence at Northwatch Hold, keeping a wary eye on both the goblin trade passing through Ratchet and the unruly Southsea pirates along the shore.
ang.faction:Horde: The Merchant Coast is the Horde's primary commercial lifeline to the sea in the Barrens, making the security of Ratchet and suppression of local pirates vital for regional supply lines.

faq.a: The shoreline earned its name from the lucrative trade conducted through the goblin port of Ratchet. Steamwheedle merchants move cargo across the Great Sea from this coast to ports all around Azeroth.
faq.q: Why is it called the Merchant Coast?

faq.a: The most prominent settlement is Ratchet, a neutral goblin port city run by Gazlowe. Farther south along the coast lies the Alliance stronghold of Northwatch Hold, while Fray Island sits just offshore.
faq.q: What major settlements are on the Merchant Coast?

faq.a: While Ratchet controls the immediate harbor, the Southsea Freebooters have established encampments along the surrounding beaches. These pirates actively disrupt trade, rob goblin convoys, and challenge Ratchet's authority.
faq.q: Who controls the beaches around here?

text.s: The Merchant Coast is the stretch of eastern shoreline in the Barrens bordering the Great Sea. Dominated by the bustling goblin port of Ratchet, the coast derives its name from lucrative sea trade, though it remains constantly contested by pirates.

sec.b: Running along the eastern edge of the Barrens, the Merchant Coast serves as a vital maritime artery connecting central Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms and Theramore. Its name honors the industrious goblin traders of the Steamwheedle Cartel, whose neutral port of Ratchet handles cargo for anyone with coin. However, the open sea lanes attract more than merchant vessels: Southsea Freebooters prowl the sands and nearby waters, preying on merchant ships and setting up illicit operations along the beaches.
sec.t: A Gateway for Commerce and Conflict

subzone:military-ward.s: Sala Militar. La Sala Militar sirve como el corazón marcial de Forjaz, albergando la infraestructura de mando de la ciudad, maestros de armas y barracones. Marcado por llamativos estandartes rojos, es el lugar donde los soldados, cazadores e ingenieros de asedio enanos entrenan junto a máquinas de asedio mecanizadas y máquinas voladoras. Situada en el perímetro norte de la fortaleza de la montaña, la Sala Militar concentra las fuerzas defensivas de Forjaz en una bulliciosa zona de concentración. El complejo central, la Sala de Armas, acoge a instructores de guerreros y cazadores, maestros de batalla y hangares que albergan máquinas voladoras y tanques de vapor enanos. Alrededor de las plazas de instrucción y los muñecos de entrenamiento se encuentran puntos de suministros como Armaduras de Placas y Malla de Craghelm, Suministros de Caza de Goldfury y Armería Timberline, lo que convierte al distrito en el principal punto de preparación para los montañeros y defensores de la ciudad.

ang.class:Hunter: Rangers and mountaineers will find beast masters and supplies in the Hall of Arms, alongside Goldfury's Hunting Supplies for munitions and gear.
ang.class:Warrior: The Military Ward is the chief martial hub in Ironforge, offering warrior trainers, training dummies for combat practice, and weapon masters to broaden your battlefield arsenal.

faq.a: It is the martial quarter of Ironforge, serving as the central base for the dwarven army, warrior and hunter trainers, weapons merchants, and siege machinery.
faq.q: What is the Military Ward?

faq.a: Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand is stationed at Timberline Arms within the Military Ward, offering training in various armaments to Alliance fighters.
faq.q: Where can I train in weapons in Ironforge?

faq.a: The Hall of Arms functions as the military headquarters, containing combat instructors, battlemasters, and large bays storing steam tanks and dwarven flying machines.
al: what is in hall of arms
faq.q: What is kept inside the Hall of Arms?

faq.a: Ironforge's districts use specific heraldic colors for navigation and tradition; the Military Ward is draped in bold red banners to represent the martial arm of the mountain city.
faq.q: Why are the banners red in this district?

text.s: The Military Ward serves as the martial heart of Ironforge, housing the city's command infrastructure, weapons masters, and barracks. Marked by bold red banners, it is where dwarven soldiers, hunters, and siege engineers train alongside mechanized siege engines and flying machines.

sec.b: Situated within the northern perimeter of the mountain fortress, the Military Ward concentrates Ironforge's defensive forces into a bustling staging ground. The central complex, the Hall of Arms, accommodates warrior and hunter trainers, battlemasters, and hangars housing dwarven flying machines and steam tanks. Surrounding the drill squares and training dummies are supply outlets such as Craghelm's Plate and Chain, Goldfury's Hunting Supplies, and Timberline Arms, making the ward the primary staging point for mountaineers and city defenders.

Distinguished from the pale blue of the Commons and the fiery orange of the Great Forge, the Military Ward is draped in martial red banners. Between drills and weapons inspections, soldiers and off-duty guards gather at Bruuk's Corner for an ale, while Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand instructs recruits in ancient dwarven martial traditions.
sec.t: A Garrison under Banners of War

subzone:mirror-lake.s: Lago Espejo. El Lago Espejo es una pintoresca masa de agua resguardada en el noroeste del Bosque de Elwynn, cerca de un huerto de frutales. Alimentado por una suave cascada bajo los acantilados de Ventormenta, su tranquila superficie oculta los peligros que acechan en sus orillas, desde bandidos Defias al acecho hasta extrañas perturbaciones en las líneas Ley locales. Situado bajo las imponentes murallas de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, el Lago Espejo debería ser un pacífico retiro para pescadores y viajeros cansados. En su lugar, los forajidos de la Hermandad Defias merodean por los huertos circundantes, convirtiendo cualquier estancia prolongada en un peligro para los lugareños que pasan por allí. Peor aún, las perturbaciones místicas por todo Azeroth han comenzado a distorsionar los canales naturales de energía arcana por todo el bosque. Los magos del Sagrario del Mago vigilan el lago con cautela y envían practicantes para tomar muestras de sus corrientes y asegurarse de que las comunidades río abajo no se envenenen con los vertidos arcanos caóticos.

ang.class:Mage: Initiates studying under the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind are dispatched here to gather water samples, learning firsthand how turbulent arcane channels can seep into the natural ecosystem.
ang.faction:Alliance: Though close to the capital's towering walls, the lake stands as a reminder of how thinly stretched the kingdom's guards are against Defias outlaws.

faq.a: Despite its scenic appearance, the area around the lake is heavily prowled by Defias bandits who target travelers and farmers. Additionally, the recent fluctuations in regional magic have prompted concerns about the lake's water safety.
faq.q: Why is Mirror Lake dangerous?

faq.a: Massive magical conflicts across Azeroth have destabilized ley currents throughout Elwynn Forest and Stormwind. The Wizard's Sanctum dispatches initiates to sample the lake's water to test for unstable arcane residue before it can affect those who drink from it.
faq.q: Why are mages studying Mirror Lake?

faq.a: The waterfall cascades down from the high cliffs and waterways flanking the perimeter of Stormwind City, feeding the lake before the water winds through the Elwynn river system.
faq.q: Where does the waterfall at Mirror Lake come from?

text.s: Mirror Lake is a picturesque body of water tucked into northwestern Elwynn Forest near an orchard. Fed by a gentle waterfall beneath the cliffs of Stormwind, its tranquil surface belies the dangers lurking on its shores, from prowling Defias bandits to strange disruptions in the local ley lines.

sec.b: Situated beneath the towering ramparts of Stormwind City, Mirror Lake ought to be a peaceful retreat for fishermen and weary travelers. Instead, brigands of the Defias Brotherhood stalk the surrounding orchards, making any prolonged stay perilous for passing locals. Worse still, mystical disturbances across Azeroth have begun warping the natural channels of arcane energy throughout the forest. The mages of the Wizard's Sanctum keep a cautious eye on the lake, sending practitioners to sample its currents and ensure that downstream communities are not poisoned by chaotic arcane runoff.

subzone:mirror-lake-orchard.s: Vergel del Lago Espejo. El Vergel del Lago Espejo es una tranquila arboleda y cabaña situada en la orilla sur del Lago Espejo, en el oeste del Bosque de Elwynn. En su día fue una apacible granja cerca de las Cataratas del Trueno, pero ha caído en manos de los bandidos Defias, que se aprovechan de la campiña mientras los guardias de Ventormenta miran hacia otro lado. Escondido cerca de las aguas torrenciales de las Cataratas del Trueno, el Vergel del Lago Espejo fue en su momento una productiva granja que se beneficiaba de las aguas limpias del Lago Espejo. Hoy en día, la apacible cabaña se encuentra invadida, tomada por ladrones y forajidos oportunistas que portan los colores de la Hermandad Defias. Con las fuerzas militares del reino mermadas y el rey Varian Wrynn desaparecido, las propiedades rurales como este vergel se han convertido en presas fáciles para los forajidos que buscan asegurarse escondites por toda la campiña de Elwynn.

ang.class:Rogue: The orchard demonstrates classic Defias strategy: seizing defensible, overlooked properties near water and cliffs to monitor roads while evading city patrols.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers, the occupied orchard is another bitter sign of the Defias Brotherhood's bold expansion across the heartland of the kingdom.

faq.a: Defias bandits currently occupy Mirror Lake Orchard and the cottage alongside it. They have driven away whatever honest folk once tended the trees and now use the secluded grounds as a base in western Elwynn.
al: who is at mirror lake orchard
faq.q: Who controls Mirror Lake Orchard right now?

faq.a: The orchard sits along the southern shore of Mirror Lake in western Elwynn Forest, just east of Thunder Falls and north of the main road heading toward Westfall.
faq.q: Where is Mirror Lake Orchard located?

faq.a: Stormwind's standing army is largely absent from rural Elwynn due to political deadlock and the mysterious disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. With local garrisons shorthanded, distant farmsteads and orchards are frequently left to fend for themselves against the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind reclaimed the orchard?

faq.a: Mirror Lake drains directly into Thunder Falls, placing the orchard just above the roaring cascade. Its secluded position near the cliffs makes it an ideal, defensible spot for bandits.
faq.q: What is the connection between the orchard and Thunder Falls?

text.s: Mirror Lake Orchard is a quiet grove and cottage nestled on the southern banks of Mirror Lake in western Elwynn Forest. Once a peaceful homestead near Thunder Falls, it has fallen into the hands of Defias bandits who exploit the countryside while Stormwind's guards look elsewhere.

sec.b: Tucked away near the cascading waters of Thunder Falls, Mirror Lake Orchard was once a productive farmstead benefiting from the clean waters of Mirror Lake. Today, the peaceful cottage sits overrun, claimed by opportunistic thieves and brigands flying the colors of the Defias Brotherhood. With the kingdom's military stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn missing, rural properties like this orchard have become easy pickings for outlaws looking to secure hideouts across the Elwynn countryside.

subzone:molsen-farm.s: La Granja de Molsen. La Granja de Molsen es una hacienda abandonada ubicada en la región agrícola de Páramos de Poniente. Antaño una fértil tierra de cultivo que alimentaba a Ventormenta, ha quedado en ruinas tras el alzamiento de la Hermandad Defias y los acechantes gólems de la cosecha mecánicos que dejaron a su paso. Al igual que muchas haciendas de Páramos de Poniente, La Granja de Molsen es una víctima del abandono del reino y del levantamiento criminal. Cuando la Hermandad Defias tomó el control del campo, los granjeros locales fueron expulsados o sufrieron un destino peor, dejando atrás sus cultivos y edificios. Ahora, en lugar de jornaleros recolectando grano, hostiles Vigías de la cosecha mecánicos y forajidos errantes recorren los campos descuidados, convirtiendo la granja en un peligro para cualquiera que viaje por la provincia.

ang.faction:Alliance: The overgrown fields of Molsen Farm are a grim reminder of Stormwind's failing grasp on its rural territories and the pressing threat of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.a: The farm was abandoned when the Defias Brotherhood swept across Westfall. Left without military protection from Stormwind, the homesteaders could not defend their land against bandits and rogue harvest golems, forcing them to flee their homes.
faq.q: Why is Molsen Farm abandoned?

faq.a: The fields are overrun by malfunctioning Harvest Watchers and outlaws aligned with the Defias Brotherhood. No lawful citizens currently occupy or work the property.
faq.q: Who controls the farm now?

faq.a: The farm takes its name from the local family that originally settled and tilled the land before the recent unrest drove Westfall's agrarian population into exile or poverty.
faq.q: Who was Molsen?

text.s: Molsen Farm is an abandoned homestead located in the breadbasket region of Westfall. Once a fertile piece of farmland feeding Stormwind, it has fallen into ruin following the rise of the Defias Brotherhood and the prowling mechanical harvest golems left in their wake.

sec.b: Like many homesteads across Westfall, Molsen Farm stands as a casualty of the kingdom's neglect and criminal uprising. When the Defias Brotherhood took control of the countryside, the resident farmers were driven out or worse, abandoning their crops and buildings. Now, instead of laborers gathering grain, hostile mechanical Harvest Watchers and wandering outlaws scour the untended fields, making the farm a hazard to anyone traveling through the province.

subzone:moonbrook.s: Arroyo de la Luna. En su momento un bullicioso núcleo agrícola y pueblo minero en el suroeste de Páramos de Poniente, Arroyo de la Luna se alza hoy como un pueblo fantasma sin ley. La Hermandad Defias ha invadido por completo la localidad y la utiliza como pantalla fortificada para ocultar su cuartel general subterráneo en Las Minas de la Muerte. Antes de la Primera Guerra, Arroyo de la Luna era una comunidad vital en el centro del granero de Páramos de Poniente, que sustentaba a las familias de agricultores locales y los lucrativos pozos de oro de Las Minas de la Muerte. Aunque fue arrasado por la Horda Antigua y reconstruido minuciosamente tras la Segunda Guerra, su paz no duró mucho. Desatendido por la Cámara de los Nobles de Ventormenta y desprovisto de protección militar, el asentamiento no pudo resistir a la vengativa Hermandad de los Albañiles cuando huyeron a las tierras salvajes. Los bandidos expulsaron a los colonos honrados y obligaron tanto a ciudadanos como a maestros a huir hacia Colina del Centinela y el Bosque de Elwynn.

ang.class:Rogue: The alleys and ransacked homes of Moonbrook offer an unvarnished look at an entire outlaw syndicate operating in broad daylight.
ang.faction:Alliance: Moonbrook stands as a bitter reminder of the kingdom's neglect, where law-abiding subjects were abandoned to the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.a: Moonbrook was abandoned by its peaceful residents when the Defias Brotherhood seized control of Westfall. Without the Stormwind Army to garrison the region, the townsfolk were forced out, and the bandits claimed the entire town as their own stronghold.
al: why are there bandits in moonbrook
faq.q: Why is Moonbrook abandoned?

faq.a: The mine entrance beneath the barn on the edge of Moonbrook leads into the Deadmines. Once an immense source of gold for Stormwind, the labyrinthine tunnels are now the secret redoubt and staging ground of the Defias Brotherhood.
faq.q: Where does the mine inside Moonbrook lead?

faq.a: Moonbrook was once populated by miners, farmers, and tradespeople who supported Westfall's agriculture. Notable former residents included Stalvan Mistmantle, who briefly served as the headmaster of the local Moonbrook Schoolhouse before the bandits overran the town.
faq.q: Who used to live here before the bandits?

faq.a: Stormwind's court has repeatedly refused to send royal troops to liberate Moonbrook or the surrounding farms, claiming resources are stretched thin. The local defense is left entirely to the volunteer People's Militia stationed at Sentinel Hill.
al: why doesn't the army help moonbrook
faq.q: Does Stormwind plan to reclaim the town?

text.s: Once a bustling agricultural hub and mining town in southwestern Westfall, Moonbrook now stands as a lawless ghost town. The town has been completely overrun by the Defias Brotherhood, who use it as a fortified screen to hide their subterranean headquarters in the Deadmines.

sec.b: Before the First War, Moonbrook was a vital community at the center of Westfall's breadbasket, supporting local farming families and the lucrative gold shafts of the Deadmines. Though it was razed by the Old Horde and painstakingly rebuilt after the Second War, its peace did not last. Neglected by the House of Nobles in Stormwind and stripped of military protection, the settlement could not resist the vengeful Stonemasons Guild when they fled into the wilderness. Bandits drove out the honest homesteaders, forcing citizens and teachers alike to flee toward Sentinel Hill and Elwynn Forest.

Today, Moonbrook is effectively the surface garrison for Edwin VanCleef's rebellion. Red-masked thugs and rogue wizards patrol the streets and ransacked homes, while harvest golems patrol the surrounding weed-choked fields. The quiet residential streets conceal the entrance to the Deadmines beneath an unassuming barn on the town edge, making Moonbrook the most dangerous hotbed of treason in the kingdom.

subzone:moonshrine-ruins.s: Ruinas del Santuario Lunar. Las Ruinas del Santuario Lunar son una extensión inundada de antigua arquitectura de los elfos de la noche en las profundidades de Cavernas de Brazanegra. En su día dedicadas al culto a Elune, estas salas en ruinas han sido profanadas y tomadas por el culto del Martillo Crepuscular. Más allá de la cavernosa Alberca de Ask'ar se encuentran las Ruinas del Santuario Lunar, un sombrío testimonio del antiguo pasado de los elfos de la noche en la costa de Vallefresno. Estas salas parcialmente sumergidas resonaron antaño con cánticos en honor a la Diosa de la Luna Elune, pero el Gran Cataclismo destrozó el templo e inundó sus niveles inferiores con agua de mar. Hoy en día, las aguas turbias bullen de bestias acuáticas salvajes, desde cangrejos agresivos hasta tresadones serpentinos, mientras que el culto del Martillo Crepuscular mantiene una presencia activa entre las piedras, entregado a oscuros rituales que se burlan del origen sagrado del santuario.

ang.class:Shaman: The binding of water spirits like Baron Aquanis via dark runestones reveals how deeply the Twilight's Hammer distorts and enslaves elemental forces.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing these sacred halls dedicated to Elune reduced to flooded, cult-infested ruins is a bitter grievance for any night elf journeying into the deeps.

faq.a: The ruins were originally part of a grand underground temple complex dedicated to the night elven goddess Elune, constructed before the Great Sundering tore the ancient continent apart.
faq.q: What were the Moonshrine Ruins originally built for?

faq.a: The ruins are infested with hostile aquatic beasts like threshadons and snapping crabs, alongside cultists belonging to the Twilight's Hammer, who have overrun the entire sunken complex.
faq.q: Who controls the Moonshrine Ruins now?

faq.a: The ruins lie past the tunnels beyond the Pool of Ask'ar. From the Moonshrine Ruins, pathways connect directly deeper toward the Moonshrine Sanctum and provide access to the Forgotten Pool.
faq.q: Where do the Moonshrine Ruins lead?

faq.a: Baron Aquanis is a powerful water elemental summoned by touching a submerged runestone hidden in the murky water beneath the ruins, serving the sinister aims of the Twilight's Hammer.
faq.q: Who is Baron Aquanis?

text.s: The Moonshrine Ruins are a flooded expanse of ancient night elven architecture deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Once dedicated to the worship of Elune, these crumbling halls have been desecrated and seized by the Twilight's Hammer cult.

sec.b: Past the cavernous Pool of Ask'ar lies the Moonshrine Ruins, a somber testament to the night elves' ancient past along the Ashenvale coast. These partially submerged halls once rang with chants honoring the Moon Goddess Elune, but the Great Sundering shattered the temple and drowned its lower levels in sea water. Today, the murky waters churn with feral aquatic beasts, from aggressive crabs to serpentine threshadons, while the Twilight's Hammer cult maintains an active presence throughout the stones, bent on dark rituals that mock the shrine's sacred origin.

Connecting directly toward the Forgotten Pool and the Moonshrine Sanctum, the ruins serve as a staging ground for the cult's summonings. Beneath the surface of the flooded chambers sits an ancient runestone bound to the elements. Through this aquatic focus, the Twilight's Hammer manipulates the waters of the deeps, calling forth Baron Aquanis, a monstrous water elemental bound to their dark designs.

subzone:mor-shan-rampart.s: La Muralla de Mor'shan. La Muralla de Mor'shan es una barricada de la Horda fuertemente fortificada situada en la frontera norte de Los Baldíos, que custodia la entrada a Vallefresno. Construida principalmente por el Clan Grito de Guerra, protege el territorio de la Horda frente a los contraataques de los elfos de la noche y sirve al mismo tiempo como base de operaciones para incursiones más profundas en el bosque. Erguida en el extremo norte del Camino del Oro, la Muralla de Mor'shan marca la transición entre las áridas llanuras de Los Baldíos y el dosel ancestral de Vallefresno. Levantado con maderos pesados, empalizadas defensivas y torres de vigilancia fortificadas, este baluarte se erigió para contener las represalias de las fuerzas de los elfos de la noche, indignadas por las operaciones de tala de la Horda. Funciona tanto de escudo que asegura la puerta norte hacia el interior de Kalimdor como de puesto de avanzada para partidas de asalto que avanzan hacia el norte, en dirección a Astranaar.

ang.faction:Alliance: Alliance fighters view the Mor'shan Rampart as an aggressive barricade erected by Horde lumber operations to protect stolen territory and stage raids into Ashenvale.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Horde, the Rampart is the primary overland gate protecting the heart of the Barrens from night elf incursions, while keeping the supply lines to Ashenvale's logging operations intact.

faq.a: It is a fortified Horde border post situated where the Barrens meets Ashenvale. It was constructed to block Alliance counterattacks from entering the Barrens and to guard the northern end of the Gold Road.
faq.q: What is the Mor'shan Rampart?

faq.a: The fortification is garrisoned by the Horde, specifically warriors and sentries tied to the Warsong clan. They maintain watchtowers and palisades along the forest boundary.
faq.q: Who controls this fortification?

faq.a: It anchors the northern terminus of the Gold Road, making it the primary land route connecting the central Barrens with Ashenvale. Controlling this chokepoint ensures that night elf strikes cannot easily sweep south into the heart of Horde-held lands.
faq.q: Why is the rampart here instead of deeper in Ashenvale?

faq.a: No. The rampart is an active Horde military position. Alliance travelers approaching from either Ashenvale or the Barrens will be attacked on sight by the stationed guards.
faq.q: Can Alliance travelers pass through the rampart safely?

text.s: The Mor'shan Rampart is a heavily fortified Horde barricade positioned at the northern border of the Barrens, guarding the entrance to Ashenvale. Constructed primarily by the Warsong clan, it shields Horde territory from night elf counterattacks while serving as a staging ground for incursions deeper into the forest.

sec.b: Standing at the northern terminus of the Gold Road, the Mor'shan Rampart marks the transition between the arid plains of the Barrens and the ancient canopies of Ashenvale. Built from heavy timber, defensive palisades, and fortified watchtowers, this bulwark was raised to stem the retaliatory strikes of night elven forces outraged by the Horde's logging operations. It acts both as a shield securing the northern gate to Kalimdor's interior and as a forward staging post for raiding parties pushing north toward Astranaar.

Manned primarily by battle-hardened fighters affiliated with the Warsong clan, the rampart remains under constant military readiness. From these parapets, sentries monitor the tree line for night elf scouts and archers, keeping open supply lines between the frontline outposts of Ashenvale and the greater Horde settlements to the south.

subzone:mystic-ward.s: Sala Mística. La Sala Mística es el distrito noroccidental de Forjaz, que sirve como el tranquilo santuario de la capital enana para la devoción espiritual y el estudio arcano. Distinguible por sus estandartes de color azul pálido y sus silenciosas salas, contrasta enormemente con el resonar de los yunques de la cercana Gran Fundición. Su estructura más imponente, la Sala de los Misterios, reúne a sacerdotes, paladines y magos bajo cavernosos arcos de piedra. Aunque los enanos son famosos en todo Azeroth por su destreza en la forja y en el campo de batalla, la Sala Mística representa las actividades intelectuales y espirituales más sosegadas del reino. Marcado por una heráldica de color azul pálido, este cavernoso barrio conecta el Distrito Comercial con la Caverna Abandonada y la Gran Fundición. En sus inmediaciones, los comerciantes abastecen a eruditos y tejedores de hechizos con vestimentas, pergaminos y componentes alquímicos en tiendas como El Mago Combatiente y Vestimentas Místicas de Maeva. Dominando el distrito se alza la majestuosa Sala de los Misterios, donde las disciplinas sagradas de la Luz Sagrada se cruzan con las artes practicadas de la magia arcana, ofreciendo guía a quienes blanden poderes invisibles en defensa de la Alianza.

ang.class:Mage: For Alliance spellweavers, the Mystic Ward serves as the premier center in Khaz Modan for arcane supplies, spell tomes, and advanced study outside the academies of Stormwind.
ang.class:Priest: The ward and its grand Hall of Mysteries provide a peaceful haven where dwarven and visiting practitioners of the Holy Light gather for prayer, guidance, and communion.

faq.a: The Mystic Ward is Ironforge's dedicated district for arcane magic, scholarly research, and spiritual worship. It provides spellcaster supplies, reagent shops, and training grounds for paladins, priests, and mages.
faq.q: What is the Mystic Ward used for?

faq.a: The district is anchored by the Hall of Mysteries, a grand vaulted chamber housing the capital's trainers for holy and arcane spellcasters, as well as a prominent ornamental pool.
faq.q: What is the main building in the Mystic Ward?

faq.a: Ironforge uses distinct heraldry to delineate its city districts. While the Military Ward flies martial red and the Great Forge features fiery orange, the Mystic Ward displays pale blue banners to symbolize contemplation, wisdom, and magical study.
faq.q: Why are the banners in this ward pale blue?

faq.a: The ward sits in the northwestern quadrant of the city. Passages connect it south toward the Commons, southeast to the Great Forge, and east directly into the Forlorn Cavern.
al: how to get to mystic ward
faq.q: Where does the Mystic Ward lead?

text.s: The Mystic Ward is the northwestern district of Ironforge, serving as the dwarven capital's quiet sanctuary for spiritual devotion and arcane study. Distinguishable by its cool, pale blue banners and quiet halls, it stands in stark contrast to the clanging anvils of the nearby Great Forge. Its grandest structure, the Hall of Mysteries, gathers priests, paladins, and mages beneath cavernous stone arches.

sec.b: While dwarves are famed across Azeroth for their prowess at the forge and on the battlefield, the Mystic Ward represents the kingdom's quieter intellectual and spiritual pursuits. Marked by pale blue heraldry, this cavernous quarter connects the bustling Commons to the Forlorn Cavern and the Great Forge. Within its reaches, merchants supply scholars and spellweavers with regalia, scrolls, and alchemical reagents from shops like The Fighting Wizard and Maeva's Mystical Apparel. Dominating the district is the majestic Hall of Mysteries, where the holy disciplines of the Holy Light intersect with the practiced arts of arcane magic, offering guidance to those who wield unseen powers in defense of the Alliance.
sec.t: A Sanctuary of Faith and Sorcery

subzone:mystral-lake.s: Lago Mystral. El Lago Mystral es la masa de agua más grande de Vallefresno, situada en la zona centro-sur del bosque, justo debajo de Refugio Brisa de Plata. Aunque antaño fue un santuario tranquilo custodiado por elementales de agua leales a los elfos de la noche, sus aguas se han vuelto muy peligrosas debido a la corrupción de los elementales locales. El Lago Mystral, que abarca una vasta extensión al sur de Refugio Brisa de Plata y al este de Vega del Espolón, fue muy apreciado durante mucho tiempo por los kaldorei gracias a sus aguas puras y a sus pacíficos elementales guardianes. Sin embargo, una oscura interferencia ha quebrado esa paz ancestral. El mago renegado Sarilus Foulborne utilizó sus artes con los espíritus de agua del lago, corrompiéndolos en entidades hostiles y violentas. En la actualidad, los viajeros tanto de la Horda como de la Alianza se ven a menudo conducidos a estas orillas perturbadas, teniendo que lidiar con la ira de unos espíritus que antaño protegían el bosque.

ang.class:Shaman: The turbulent depths of Mystral Lake serve as a vital stop during the Call of Water, where aspiring shaman must confront the local spirits to master their elemental craft.
ang.race:NightElf: Once home to peaceful guardians aligned with your people, the lake stands as a bitter reminder of the outside corruption encroaching upon Ashenvale's sacred groves.

faq.a: Mystral Lake lies in south-central Ashenvale. It sits directly south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, making it the largest open body of water in the forest.
faq.q: Where is Mystral Lake located?

faq.a: The water elementals were originally peaceful and loyal to the night elves of Ashenvale. However, a rogue caster named Sarilus Foulborne corrupted them, twisting their gentle nature into relentless hostility toward any who approach the lake.
faq.q: Why are the water elementals here hostile?

faq.a: Horde shaman are directed to Mystral Lake during their spiritual trials for the Call of Water. The lake possesses a deep elemental resonance, making it an important location for understanding and attuning to water spirits.
faq.q: Why do shaman visit Mystral Lake?

faq.a: Neither faction holds direct military control over the lake itself. The night elves monitor it from nearby outposts like Silverwind Refuge, but hostile corrupted elementals currently dominate the waters, threatening members of both the Alliance and the Horde.
al: is mystral lake horde or alliance
faq.q: Who controls Mystral Lake?

text.s: Mystral Lake is the largest body of water in Ashenvale, resting in the south-central forest just below Silverwind Refuge. Once a tranquil sanctuary guarded by water elementals loyal to the night elves, its waters have become fraught with danger due to corruption of the local elementals.

sec.b: Spanning a vast expanse south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, Mystral Lake was long cherished by the kaldorei for its pure waters and peaceful guardian elementals. However, dark interference has broken that ancient peace. The rogue mage Sarilus Foulborne turned his arts upon the lake's water spirits, corrupting them into hostile, violent entities. Today, travelers from both the Horde and Alliance frequently find their journeys pulling them to these troubled shores, contending with the wrath of spirits that once sheltered the woods.

Beyond the corruption troubling the local night elves, Mystral Lake draws attention across faction lines. Horde shaman traveling the path of elemental communion seek out its deep waters during their trials to understand the element of water. Despite the corruption infesting its guardian spirits, the raw primal resonance of the lake makes it an essential pilgrimage site for those learning to bind and respect the tidal spirits.

subzone:night-run.s: Senda de la Noche. Senda de la Noche es un puesto de sátiros pequeño y aislado, situado en lo alto de un risco rodeado de acantilados en la zona centro-este de Vallefresno. Habitado por los demoníacos sátiros Felmusk, sirve como un campamento corrompido que alberga oscura magia de almas entre antiguas ruinas élficas. Senda de la Noche es la más pequeña y aislada de las tres principales fortalezas de sátiros de Vallefresno, junto a Xavian y Satyrnaar. Cobijado entre mampostería élfica en ruinas y pilares derruidos, el asentamiento sobresale en una alta cresta flanqueada por acantilados empinados e intransitables. Llegar hasta él requiere una caminata tortuosa a lo largo del Río Falfarren, cerca de las Aguas de Xavian, o atravesar una peligrosa cornisa al norte, sobre el Refugio de la Algaba. A pesar de su modesto tamaño, el enclave representa un grave peligro: los sátiros Felmusk que habitan aquí cooperan con el sombrío Culto de la Facción Oscura, anclando gemas de alma retorcidas para acumular esencia demoníaca en el bosque.

ang.faction:Alliance: Nestled just north of Raynewood Retreat, Night Run represents an ever-present demonic menace overlooking crucial Sentinel supply lines.
ang.race:NightElf: The defilement of Night Run is an enduring scar: these ancient stones were soaked in night elf blood during the War of the Satyr and remain corrupted by the twisted Felmusk.

faq.a: Night Run is occupied by the Felmusk satyr, a faction of demonic night elf corrupters affiliated with the Cult of the Dark Strand.
faq.q: Who controls Night Run?

faq.a: Because it sits on an elevated bluff bordered by sheer cliffs, travelers must approach either via a narrow ledge north of Raynewood Retreat or by tracking along the Falfarren River toward Xavian before cutting west up the ridge.
al: how to get to night run
faq.q: How do you reach Night Run?

faq.a: The cult works alongside the satyrs, maintaining a dark soulgem within Night Run to harvest and channel demonic energies across Ashenvale.
al: cult of the dark strand night run
faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand doing here?

faq.a: Thousands of years ago, following the Great Sundering, early druids wielding the feral Pack Form attacked night elf Sentinels here, wounding Shandris Feathermoon and marking an explosive opening in the War of the Satyr.
al: war of the satyr night run
faq.q: What historical events happened at Night Run?

text.s: Night Run is a small, secluded satyr outpost perched atop a cliff-ringed bluff in east-central Ashenvale. Inhabited by the demonic Felmusk satyr, it serves as a corrupted encampment harboring dark soul magic within ancient elven ruins.

sec.b: Night Run is the smallest and most isolated of Ashenvale's three major satyr strongholds, alongside Xavian and Satyrnaar. Sheltered among crumbling elven stonework and broken pillars, the settlement juts outward on a high ridge bounded by steep, impassable cliffs. Reaching it requires a circuitous trek along the Falfarren River near the waters of Xavian or navigating a precarious northern ledge above Raynewood Retreat. Despite its modest size, the enclave poses a severe danger: the Felmusk satyr who dwell here work in concert with the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand, anchoring twisted soulgems to pool demonic essence within the forest.

subzone:north-coast.s: La Costa Norte. La Costa Norte es un tramo de litoral desolado y envuelto en niebla que marca el extremo septentrional de los Claros de Tirisfal a lo largo del Mare Magnum. Corrompidas por la caída de Lordaeron, las frías playas están repletas de fauna marina en descomposición y son defendidas con ferocidad por tribus de múrlocs hostiles. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, estas aguas norteñas y playas pedregosas formaban parte de la pacífica frontera norte de Lordaeron. Cuando la Plaga de la No-Muerte arrasó el continente, su añublo corruptor se filtró por los acantilados y envenenó la costa. Las aguas se volvieron gélidas y turbias, arrastrando a la orilla los cadáveres de criaturas marinas gigantescas que ahora se pudren sobre la arena entre la perenne niebla costera.

ang.race:Undead: While Forsaken patrol routes cling to the road through Brill, clearing the North Coast of encroaching murlocs ensures the northern flank of Tirisfal Glades remains relatively secure.

faq.a: The beach is primarily occupied by aggressive Vile Fin murlocs, their tadpoles, and scavengers picking at the rotting sea life that washes ashore from the Great Sea.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit the North Coast?

faq.a: Deeb is an individual murloc who can be found lingering along the North Coast among the huts and shallows of the shore.
faq.q: Who is Deeb?

faq.a: The Plague of Undeath that devastated Lordaeron seeped into the coastal ecology, poisoning the surrounding shallows and causing dead marine beasts to wash ashore to decay on the blighted sand.
faq.q: Why is the coast covered in rotting carcasses?

faq.a: Neither the Forsaken nor any remnants of the Alliance actively garrison the North Coast. It remains a wild, untamed fringe left largely to murlocs and sea vermin.
faq.q: Is the North Coast contested by any major factions?

text.s: The North Coast is a bleak, fog-shrouded stretch of shoreline marking the northern edge of Tirisfal Glades along the Great Sea. Tainted by the fall of Lordaeron, the cold beaches are littered with rotting marine life and aggressively defended by tribes of hostile murlocs.

sec.b: Before the Third War, these northern waters and stony beaches were part of the peaceful northern boundary of Lordaeron. When the Plague of Undeath swept across the continent, its corrupting blight seeped down the bluffs and poisoned the coast. The waters turned chill and murky, washing up the carcasses of giant sea creatures that now rot upon the sand amid the perennial coastal fog.

With the human kingdom shattered and the Forsaken focusing their attention around Brill and the Capital City, coastal murlocs claimed the desolate sands. The local Vile Fin tribe maintains huts along the surf, utilizing nearby shallows as spawning grounds. Swarms of ravenous murlocs, including notable figures like Deeb and numerous growing tadpoles, violently guard the tideline against any surface-dwellers.

subzone:north-gate-outpost.s: Avanzada de la Puerta Norte. La Avanzada de la Puerta Norte es un campamento enano fortificado situado en lo alto del Paso de la Puerta Norte de Dun Morogh. Al vigilar la escarpada ruta entre el nevado corazón de Forjaz y Loch Modan, sus montaces protegen a los viajeros de la fauna hostil que infesta los riscos. Situado en mitad del Paso de la Puerta Norte, este pequeño asentamiento sirve como el umbral nororiental de Dun Morogh. Los montaces enanos apostados aquí mantienen el camino principal despejado de bestias al acecho y vigilan el tráfico que se dirige a través de los túneles montañosos hacia Loch Modan. El clima riguroso y los empinados barrancos hacen que las patrullas sean traicioneras, y la guarnición a menudo recurre a los viajeros para explorar las crestas circundantes en busca de patrullas desaparecidas y peligrosos depredadores.

ang.race:Dwarf: The outpost showcases the stoic duty of Ironforge's Mountaineers, who hold the harsh highland passes open regardless of freezing weather or prowling predators.
ang.race:Gnome: Having resettled across Dun Morogh, gnomes often lend their wits and marksmanship to assist the dwarven garrison in tracking down lost patrols.

faq.a: It serves as a mountain military checkpoint that secures North Gate Pass, the northern roadway connecting Dun Morogh to Loch Modan. Mountaineers stationed here keep the pass open to trade and travel by curbing wild beast populations.
al: why is north gate outpost here
faq.q: What is North Gate Outpost used for?

faq.a: Traveling east through the mountain tunnels beyond the outpost leads into the temperate valley of Loch Modan, while heading west leads back down toward Kharanos and Ironforge.
al: where does north gate pass go
faq.q: Where does the road through the pass lead?

faq.a: The local wildlife along the snowy cliffs is fiercely territorial. Several mountaineers have gone missing into the crags while hunting dangerous beasts, forcing the garrison to enlist capable scouts to discover their fates.
faq.q: Why do the mountaineers need help from travelers?

text.s: North Gate Outpost is a fortified dwarven camp situated high in the North Gate Pass of Dun Morogh. Manning the rugged route between Ironforge's snowy heartland and Loch Modan, its mountaineers guard travelers against the hostile wildlife that infests the crags.

sec.b: Positioned in the middle of North Gate Pass, this small settlement serves as the northeastern threshold of Dun Morogh. Dwarven mountaineers stationed here keep the main roadway cleared of prowling beasts and monitor traffic heading through the mountain tunnels into Loch Modan. The harsh climate and steep ravines make patrol duty treacherous, and the garrison frequently calls upon travelers to scout the surrounding ridges for missing patrols and dangerous predators.

subzone:north-gate-pass.s: Paso de la Puerta Norte. El Paso de la Puerta Norte es una vía montañosa vital que conecta los riscos nevados de Dun Morogh con la ondulada cuenca de Loch Modan. Forma el corredor septentrional a través de los picos de Khaz Modan, vigilado por una avanzada enana fortificada. Los viajeros que se dirigen hacia las tierras bajas del norte de Los Humedales recorren con frecuencia este camino de gran altitud. Tallado en la roca escarpada de Khaz Modan, el Paso de la Puerta Norte sirve como el enlace arterial septentrional entre los altos y helados valles de Dun Morogh y las templadas aguas de Loch Modan. Al descender a través de empinados túneles de montaña, los viajeros que emergen del oeste son recibidos por la amplia extensión del valle del lago. Debido a que se encuentra a poca distancia de los caminos que descienden hacia Los Humedales, el paso soporta un intenso tráfico de mensajeros enanos, comerciantes y aventureros errantes. Su valor estratégico está afianzado por la Avanzada de la Puerta Norte, donde los montañeros mantienen una vigilancia constante frente a los troggs y los depredadores de las montañas.

ang.faction:Alliance: The pass represents a crucial military and supply corridor connecting the dwarven capital to northern Alliance expeditions bound for the Wetlands.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves journeying between the high gates of Ironforge and the frontier settlements around The Loch, the pass is a familiar, stone-hewn threshold guarded by fellow mountaineers.

faq.a: The pass connects eastern Dun Morogh to northwestern Loch Modan. Following the road further north around the loch leads toward the mountain tunnels descending into the Wetlands, making it a critical junction for northern travelers.
al: where does north gate pass go
faq.q: Where does North Gate Pass lead?

faq.a: The Ironforge Mountaineers maintain North Gate Outpost directly along the road, monitoring travelers and keeping the mountain passage clear of prowling beasts and roaming troggs.
faq.q: What guards the pass?

faq.a: Both passes link Dun Morogh to Loch Modan through carved tunnels, but North Gate Pass lies to the north, offering the most direct overland route for travelers moving onward toward the Wetlands and northern lands.
al: difference north and south gate pass
faq.q: How does this differ from South Gate Pass?

text.s: North Gate Pass is a vital mountain thoroughfare connecting the snowy crags of Dun Morogh with the rolling basin of Loch Modan. It forms the northern corridor through the Khaz Modan peaks, watched over by a fortified dwarven outpost. Travelers heading toward the northern lowlands of the Wetlands frequently traverse this high road.

sec.b: Carved into the sheer stone of Khaz Modan, North Gate Pass serves as the northern arterial link between the high, frozen valleys of Dun Morogh and the temperate waters of Loch Modan. Descending through steep mountain tunnels, travelers emerging from the west are greeted by the broad expanse of the loch valley. Because it sits within easy striking distance of the paths heading down into the Wetlands, the pass carries heavy traffic of dwarven messengers, merchants, and roaming adventurers. Its strategic value is anchored by the North Gate Outpost, where mountaineers keep vigilant watch against troggs and mountain predators.

subzone:north-tide-s-hollow.s: Hoya Mareanorte. Hoya Mareanorte es un agreste rincón salvaje en el Bosque de Argénteos situado justo al norte de El Sepulcro. Acechado por huargen Furia Lunar feroces y leales al archimago renegado Arugal, el claro sirve como base de operaciones para las bestias que merodean por los bosques costeros. Escondida entre la densa arboleda al norte del asentamiento Renegado de El Sepulcro, Hoya Mareanorte está dominada por la salvaje manada Furia Lunar. Estos huargen feroces, traídos a Lordaeron mediante la temeraria hechicería del archimago Arugal, han establecido toscos campamentos por toda la hoya. Construidos únicamente con lo estrictamente necesario para estas resistentes bestias, estos toscos refugios proporcionan una base avanzada peligrosamente cerca de las rutas de viaje de los Renegados.

ang.race:Undead: Positioned uncomfortably close to the Sepulcher, the Moonrage pack in North Tide's Hollow poses an immediate threat to Forsaken sovereignty and logistical lines in Silverpine.

faq.a: North Tide's Hollow is located in western Silverpine Forest, situated just to the north of the Forsaken outpost known as the Sepulcher, near the coastal bluffs.
faq.q: Where is North Tide's Hollow?

faq.a: The hollow is infested with Moonrage worgen, supernatural wolf-beasts bound to the madness of Archmage Arugal.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit North Tide's Hollow?

faq.a: While worgen are vicious and wild, the Moonrage pack retains enough cunning to organize basic encampments. Being naturally resilient and hardened, they require only the most primitive shelters and survival necessities to endure the Lordaeron wilderness.
faq.q: Why do the worgen live in crude camps here?

faq.a: The Moonrage worgen in North Tide's Hollow serve Archmage Arugal, who summoned worgen into Lordaeron and commands them from Shadowfang Keep.
faq.q: Who controls the worgen in this area?

text.s: North Tide's Hollow is a rugged wilderness pocket in Silverpine Forest located just north of the Sepulcher. Haunted by feral Moonrage worgen loyal to the rogue Archmage Arugal, the clearing serves as a base of operations for the beasts stalking the coastal woods.

sec.b: Tucked away in the dense timber north of the Forsaken settlement of the Sepulcher, North Tide's Hollow is dominated by the savage Moonrage pack. These feral worgen, brought into Lordaeron through the reckless sorcery of Archmage Arugal, have established crude encampments throughout the hollow. Built with only the barest necessities required by the hardy beasts, these rough shelters provide a forward staging ground dangerously close to Forsaken travel routes.

Unlike ordinary wilderness predators, the worgen of North Tide's Hollow answer to the sinister will emanating from Shadowfang Keep. Their proximity to both the western shoreline and the main road through Silverpine makes them a constant menace to Forsaken couriers and patrols attempting to secure the region.

subzone:north-tide-s-run.s: Cala Mareanorte. Cala Mareanorte es la costa noroccidental de Bosque de Argénteos, azotada por el viento y bordeando la orilla del Mare Magnum. Marcado por una solitaria fogata y un naufragio semisumergido, este tramo de arena es conocido como un aislado terreno de pruebas para los druidas viajeros que buscan la armonía con las aguas. Extendiéndose a lo largo del extremo noroccidental de Bosque de Argénteos, Cala Mareanorte se compone de arena fría, un oleaje constante y una franja del Mare Magnum. Su punto de referencia más inconfundible es un barco naufragado parcialmente sumergido, inclinado de forma precaria en los bajíos cercanos a la playa. Aparte de los restos del naufragio, la única señal de presencia humana es una humilde fogata atendida por Wallace el Ciego, quien mantiene una tranquila vigilia junto al romper de la marea.

ang.class:Druid: For tauren druids, this cold coast represents a vital rite of passage, housing the submerged trial components necessary to master the sea lion form.
ang.race:Tauren: Far from the warm plains of Mulgore, North Tide's Run is one of the few places in Lordaeron that young tauren travel to early in their spiritual journeys.

faq.a: It is the northwestern shoreline and coastal shelf of Silverpine Forest, bordered by the Great Sea. It is characterized by its sunken ship, tidal waters, and bleak, quiet strand.
faq.q: What is North Tide's Run?

faq.a: Wallace the Blind is a hermit who has pitched a small camp and fire right at the water's edge along the beach, sitting quietly near the sunken vessel.
al: who is the guy at the fire
faq.q: Who is Wallace the Blind?

faq.a: Tauren druids travel here on pilgrimage during their trials to commune with the spirits of the sea. By braving the depths near the shoreline to recover lost pendant fragments, they earn the power to assume aquatic form.
faq.q: Why do druids come to North Tide's Run?

faq.a: The wreck is a partially submerged vessel resting in the shallows just off the sand. Its presence serves as a navigational landmark for travelers combing the coast.
faq.q: What is the sunken ship in the water?

text.s: North Tide's Run is the windswept northwestern shoreline of Silverpine Forest, skirting the edge of the Great Sea. Marked by a lonely campfire and a half-sunken shipwreck, this stretch of sand is known as a secluded trial ground for traveling druids seeking harmony with the waters.

sec.b: Stretching along the northwest edge of Silverpine Forest, North Tide's Run consists of cold sand, pounding surf, and a strip of the Great Sea. Its most unmistakable landmark is a partially submerged shipwreck tilted precariously in the shallows near the beach. Aside from the wreckage, the only sign of habitation is a humble campfire tended by Wallace the Blind, who keeps a quiet vigil beside the lapping tide.

Despite its bleak atmosphere, North Tide's Run holds sacred importance for Horde initiates walking the path of Cenarius. Young tauren druids are directed here on pilgrimage to recover underwater relics lost to the waves, testing their lung capacity and endurance to earn the blessing of the aquatic form.

faq.a: La Hermandad de Villanorte es una orden religiosa de clérigos, sacerdotes y paladines con base en la Abadía de Villanorte. Fundada originalmente hace siglos por clérigos misioneros de Lordaeron, fue restablecida por el arzobispo Alonsus Faol tras la Primera Guerra para entrenar a devotos defensores y preservar las sagradas escrituras.

Durante la Primera Guerra, la abadía poseía una importancia estratégica y espiritual para Ventormenta. Las fuerzas orcas incitaron a bandidos humanos a atacarla y, tras mantener cautiva brevemente allí a la semiorca Garona, una embestida masiva de la Horda arrasó el recinto sagrado. Permaneció en ruinas durante toda la guerra hasta que la Alianza expulsó a los clanes orcos y la reconstruyó.

El ejército de Ventormenta está disperso protegiendo fronteras lejanas, dejando las regiones periféricas escasamente vigiladas. Los oportunistas kóbold han infestado las minas de oro locales, mientras que la Hermandad Defias aprovecha las brechas para asaltar a los viajeros, acosar los viñedos locales y saquear la biblioteca de la abadía en busca de tomos arcanos y reliquias sagradas.

Durante la Primera Guerra, un cabecilla ogro llamado Turok robó el sagrado Libro de la Divinidad de la Abadía de Villanorte y se refugió en Las Minas de la Muerte. Sir Anduin Lothar encabezó una expedición a las profundidades para recuperar las sagradas escrituras, quedando atrapado hasta que un grupo de rescate real lo salvó y devolvió el tomo a la custodia de la abadía.

subzone:northshire-abbey.s: Abadía de Villanorte. La Abadía de Villanorte es un monasterio histórico enclavado en el Valle de Villanorte, en las estribaciones septentrionales del Bosque de Elwynn. Reconstruida tras su destrucción en la Primera Guerra, sirve como el corazón espiritual de la Hermandad de Villanorte y como centro de adiestramiento principal para los nuevos defensores que responden a la llamada del reino de Ventormenta. Siglos atrás, clérigos procedentes de Lordaeron viajaron al sur, al reino de Ventormenta, para difundir el culto a la Luz Sagrada, fundando la Sagrada Orden de los Clérigos de Villanorte y su abadía. El monasterio no tardó en convertirse en un pilar de la vida del reino, atendiendo a los enfermos e incluso cuidando del joven Guardián Medivh durante sus años en coma. Durante la Primera Guerra, la abadía sufrió constantes asaltos a manos de bandidos y de la Horda orca, que culminaron en su absoluta destrucción. Cuando la Alianza de Lordaeron liberó la región en la Segunda Guerra, el arzobispo Alonsus Faol ayudó a reconstruir el santuario, refundando a sus protectores bajo el nombre de Hermandad de Villanorte.

ang.class:Paladin: Northshire represents the legacy of Archbishop Alonsus Faol and the early clerics whose sacrifices laid the foundation for the Knights of the Silver Hand.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, Northshire Abbey is the cradle of your journey, where the kingdom's history of resilience and devotion welcomes every recruit taking up arms.

faq.a: The Brotherhood of Northshire is a religious order of clerics, priests, and paladins based out of Northshire Abbey. Originally founded centuries ago by missioning clerics from Lordaeron, it was re-established by Archbishop Alonsus Faol after the First War to train faithful defenders and preserve sacred scripture.
faq.q: What is the Brotherhood of Northshire?

faq.a: During the First War, the abbey held strategic and spiritual importance for Stormwind. Orcish forces incited human brigands to attack it, and after the half-orc Garona was briefly held captive there, a massive Horde onslaught leveled the holy grounds. It remained ruined throughout the war until the Alliance drove out the orcish clans and rebuilt it.
faq.q: Why was Northshire Abbey destroyed in the First War?

faq.a: Stormwind's military is stretched thin protecting distant borders, leaving outlying regions poorly guarded. Opportunistic kobolds have infested the local gold mines, while the Defias Brotherhood exploits the gaps to rob travelers, harass the local vineyards, and raid the abbey's library for arcane tomes and holy relics.
faq.q: Why are there Defias bandits and kobolds outside the abbey?

faq.a: During the First War, an ogre chieftain named Turok stole the sacred Tome of Divinity from Northshire Abbey and retreated into the Deadmines. Sir Anduin Lothar led an expedition into the depths to recover the holy scripture, getting trapped until a royal rescue party saved him and returned the tome to the abbey's care.
faq.q: What is the connection between Northshire Abbey and the Deadmines?

text.s: Northshire Abbey is a historic monastery nestled in Northshire Valley within the northern foothills of Elwynn Forest. Rebuilt after its destruction in the First War, it serves as the spiritual heart of the Brotherhood of Northshire and a premier training center for new defenders answering the kingdom of Stormwind's call.

sec.b: Centuries ago, clerics from Lordaeron traveled south into the kingdom of Stormwind to spread the worship of the Holy Light, establishing the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics and their abbey. The monastery quickly became an anchor of kingdom life, caring for the sick and even tending to the young Guardian Medivh during his years in a coma. During the First War, the abbey suffered repeated assaults by brigands and the Orcish Horde, culminating in its utter destruction. When the Alliance of Lordaeron liberated the region in the Second War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol helped rebuild the sanctuary, refounding its protectors as the Brotherhood of Northshire.
sec.t: A Legacy of Faith and Ruin

sec.b: Today, Northshire Abbey functions as the starting ground for volunteers, militia recruits, and novices seeking to defend a beleaguered Stormwind. Split into the Main Hall, Hall of Arms, and Library Wing, it houses instructors in the martial, arcane, and holy arts, while scouts and rogues train in the outer yards. Despite the watchful presence of the Knights of the Silver Hand, peace here remains precarious. Kobolds overrun nearby mines, aggressive wolves roam the orchards, and agents of the Defias Brotherhood stalk the valley roads, pilfering ancient scrolls and sacred librams from the abbey's storied archives.

subzone:northshire-valley.s: Valle de Villanorte. Escondido en las montañas septentrionales del Bosque de Elwynn, el Valle de Villanorte sirve como cuna pacífica y campo de entrenamiento para los nuevos defensores del reino de Ventormenta. Rodeado de barreras naturales, alberga la histórica Abadía de Villanorte, fértiles viñedos y la rica Mina del Eco. A pesar de su apariencia tranquila, el valle se enfrenta a una creciente agitación provocada por bandidos rebeldes, plagas de kóbold y depredadores desplazados. El Valle de Villanorte está delimitado por crestas montañosas casi infranqueables, con su único camino en dirección sur a través de un cuerpo de guardia fortificado hacia Villadorada y el resto del Bosque de Elwynn. Un río de aguas cristalinas serpentea por sus pastos antes de desembocar al sur en el Lago de Cristal. En el corazón del valle se alza la Abadía de Villanorte, un antiguo santuario donde se enseña la Luz Sagrada y donde los reclutas son instruidos por los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata y veteranos experimentados. Más allá de los muros de la abadía se extienden los pródigos Viñedos de Villanorte y la Mina del Eco, conformando un reducto autosuficiente del territorio de Ventormenta que parece muy alejado de las guerras del resto del mundo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Northshire serves as a crucial recruitment and recovery station for the Grand Alliance, training the next generation of defenders to stabilize the heart of the kingdom.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, Northshire Valley is the place where their journey begins, stepping into the abbey's grounds to answer the call of a kingdom in need.

faq.a: The valley contains Northshire Abbey, a key spiritual hub and training ground for Stormwind's forces, as well as crucial local resources like Echo Ridge Mine and the vineyards. With Stormwind's military stretched thin, Marshal McBride maintains a guarded gate at the southern pass to prevent threats from leaking between the valley and greater Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Why is Northshire Valley so heavily guarded?

faq.a: Deputy Willem notes that packs of wolves have recently surged across the river, having fled into the valley from the darkened forests of Duskwood to the south. The darkness spreading in Duskwood has driven wild beasts into normally tranquil pastures.
faq.q: Where did all the wolves in the valley come from?

faq.a: Kobolds are opportunistic burrowers drawn to underground mineral veins. As kingdom patrols grew thin, a clan of kobolds took advantage of the lack of protection to claim Echo Ridge Mine for its gold and candles, forcing the human miners out of the tunnels.
faq.q: Why are kobolds attacking Echo Ridge Mine?

faq.a: The thieves operating near Milly Osworth's vineyard are agents of the Defias Brotherhood. They prey on the outskirts of the valley to disrupt supplies, harass local farmers, and test the abbey's defenses.
faq.q: Who are the bandits harassing the vineyards?

faq.a: During the Second War, Northshire Abbey fell into enemy hands and was briefly utilized as a headquarters by Cho'gall's Twilight's Hammer clan before the Alliance reclaimed and restored the valley.
faq.q: What happened to Northshire during the Second War?

faq.a: The only passable exit on foot is the southern road leading through the guarded gatehouse. Passing through this gate takes travelers directly into central Elwynn Forest, pointing down the main road toward Goldshire.
faq.q: How do you leave Northshire Valley?

text.s: Tucked away in the northern mountains of Elwynn Forest, Northshire Valley serves as the peaceful cradle and training ground for the kingdom of Stormwind's newest defenders. Surrounded by natural barriers, it hosts the historic Northshire Abbey, fertile vineyards, and the rich Echo Ridge Mine. Despite its tranquil appearance, the valley faces mounting unrest from rogue bandits, infesting kobolds, and displaced predators.

sec.b: Northshire Valley is framed by nearly impassable mountain ridges, with its only road heading south through a fortified gatehouse toward Goldshire and the rest of Elwynn Forest. A clear river winds through its pastures before feeding south into Crystal Lake. At the valley's heart stands Northshire Abbey, an ancient sanctuary where the Holy Light is taught and where recruits are trained by the Knights of the Silver Hand and seasoned veterans. Beyond the abbey walls lie the bountiful Northshire Vineyards and Echo Ridge Mine, forming a self-sustaining pocket of Stormwind territory that feels far removed from the wider world's wars.

Even this sheltered haven has felt the strain of Stormwind's overextended defenses. Marshal McBride and his detachment of the Stormwind Guard struggle to maintain order across the vale. Packs of wolves driven north from blighted Duskwood prowl the surrounding woods, while vermin-like kobolds have overrun the tunnels of Echo Ridge Mine. Worse still, masked thugs aligned with the Defias Brotherhood openly harass the vineyards and threaten the abbey's grounds, forcing local commanders to recruit every able-bodied civilian arriving at their gates.

subzone:northshire-vineyards.s: Viñedos de Villanorte. Los Viñedos de Villanorte son campos de uva cultivados situados justo al este de la Abadía de Villanorte, en la cuenca resguardada del valle. Aunque antaño fueron una pacífica fuente de vino para los clérigos, los campos han caído bajo el control de la Hermandad Defias y sus bandidos locales. Ubicados al este, cruzando el arroyo desde la Abadía de Villanorte, los Viñedos de Villanorte representan la tranquila vida agraria del valle. Los campos son atendidos por trabajadores locales como Milly Osworth, pero la creciente agitación civil los ha dejado desprotegidos. Bandidos alineados con la Hermandad Defias, liderados sobre el terreno por un degollador llamado Garrick Padfoot, se han apoderado de las tierras. Lejos de tratarse de simple vandalismo, los ladrones ocupan los campos para saquear la cosecha y despojar a los granjeros locales de su sustento, proporcionando a los nuevos reclutas de la Hermandad un punto de apoyo fácil justo bajo las narices de la abadía.

ang.faction:Alliance: The unrest in these peaceful grape fields demonstrates how deeply lawlessness has penetrated even the most protected corners of the kingdom of Stormwind.
ang.race:Human: For many young humans venturing out into the world, the occupied vineyards are their first direct encounter with the bitterness and reach of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.a: Thieves and cutthroats belonging to the Defias Brotherhood occupy the fields. Their local ringleader is Garrick Padfoot, a wanted rogue who directs the looting of the crops and terrorizes the local workers.
faq.q: Who controls the Northshire Vineyards right now?

faq.a: Stormwind's military resources are stretched extraordinarily thin with King Varian Wrynn missing. The abbey guards have pulled back to defend the abbey itself and watch the valley roads, forcing local farmers to rely on newly arrived adventurers to reclaim their stolen goods.
al: why isn't the abbey defending the vineyards
faq.q: Why is the abbey letting bandits run rampant in the fields?

faq.a: Milly Osworth is a local farmer working the vineyards. When the Defias bandits moved in and seized the grape harvest, she was driven off and now seeks brave travelers to venture into the fields and recover her plundered crates.
faq.q: Who is Milly Osworth?

text.s: The Northshire Vineyards are cultivated grape fields lying just east of Northshire Abbey in the valley's sheltered basin. Though once a peaceful source of wine for the clerics, the fields have fallen under the control of the Defias Brotherhood and their local brigands.

sec.b: Located east across the stream from Northshire Abbey, the Northshire Vineyards represent the valley's quiet agrarian life. The fields are tended by local workers like Milly Osworth, but rising civil unrest has left them unprotected. Bandits aligned with the Defias Brotherhood, led on the ground by a cutthroat named Garrick Padfoot, have seized the acreage. Rather than mere vandalism, the thieves occupy the fields to plunder the harvest and strip the local farmers of their livelihood, providing new recruits to the Brotherhood an easy foothold right under the abbey's nose.

subzone:old-ironforge.s: Viejo Forjaz. Viejo Forjaz, también llamado la Asamblea de Thanes, es una antigua cámara subterránea situada directamente bajo el Trono de Forjaz. Esculpida en las profundidades de las raíces de la montaña sobre vetas de magma incandescente, representa el corazón ancestral de la capital enana. En la actualidad, sus pesadas puertas de acceso en la sala del trono real permanecen selladas y celosamente custodiadas. Bajo el trono del Rey Magni Barbabronce en el Trono reposa la cavernosa sala conocida como Viejo Forjaz o la Asamblea de Thanes. En lo más profundo de estos ardientes cimientos subterráneos, sinuosos puentes de piedra cruzan estanques de lava subterránea. Mucho antes de que las bulliciosas salas de la Gran Fundición y Distrito Comercial resonaran con el comercio enano moderno, los antiguos thanes se reunían en estas cavernosas profundidades para deliberar y gobernar el reino de la montaña.

ang.class:Rogue: Stormwind's spymaster Mathias Shaw strictly warns against attempting to sneak into Old Ironforge, noting the intense security and the grim cost of getting caught by King Magni's guards.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Old Ironforge and the Assembly of Thanes are sacred connections to their ancestral roots, preserving the deepest stone foundations carved out during the dawn of their mountain realm.

faq.a: Old Ironforge, historically known as the Assembly of Thanes, is the ancient lower district carved directly beneath the modern city of Ironforge. It consists of cavernous halls and lava conduits.
faq.q: What is Old Ironforge?

faq.a: No. The main gates in the High Seat throne room are sealed shut, and the entryway is heavily guarded by the dwarven royal guard. The chambers below remain closed to regular citizens and adventurers.
al: how to get into old ironforge
faq.q: Can players enter Old Ironforge?

faq.a: The entrance is located directly inside the High Seat, the royal audience chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard sits in the city of Ironforge.
faq.q: Where is the entrance located?

faq.a: Known as the Assembly of Thanes, it served as an ancient meeting ground for dwarven leaders and mountain kings in early eras before the upper rings of the modern mountain capital were fully established.
al: why is it called assembly of thanes
faq.q: Why is Old Ironforge significant to dwarven history?

text.s: Old Ironforge, also called the Assembly of Thanes, is an ancient subterranean chamber lying directly beneath the High Seat of Ironforge. Carved deep into the mountain's roots above glowing magma veins, it represents the ancestral heart of the dwarven capital. In the present day, its heavy access gates in the royal throne room remain sealed and vigilantly guarded.

sec.b: Beneath King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat rests the cavernous hall known as Old Ironforge or the Assembly of Thanes. Deep inside these fiery subterranean foundations, winding stone bridges cross pools of subterranean lava. Long before the bustling halls of the Great Forge and the Commons echoed with modern dwarven commerce, early thanes gathered in these cavernous depths to deliberate and govern the mountain kingdom.

Currently, entrance to Old Ironforge from the throne room is securely barred. The Ironforge royal guard keeps strict watch over the thresholds leading down into the old vaults. Even Master Mathias Shaw of Stormwind's SI:7 notes the presence of heavy security around these lower levels, warning that any attempt to trespass or meddle in the secured undercity risks severe dwarven justice.

subzone:old-town.s: Casco Antiguo. Casco Antiguo es el barrio más antiguo y descuidado de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, habiendo sobrevivido en gran parte intacto a la destrucción de la Primera Guerra. En lugar de relucientes plazas de piedra, sus estrechos callejones presentan ladrillos desgastados, viviendas obreras y bulliciosas instalaciones militares. Sirve de hogar para el Centro de Mando militar del reino, así como para el cuartel general clandestino de la organización IV:7. Mientras que el resto de Ventormenta fue meticulosamente reconstruido desde los cimientos por los Albañiles tras la Primera Guerra, Casco Antiguo escapó de la ruina total. Al no haber necesitado una reconstrucción integral, nunca recibió las inmaculadas fachadas de mármol ni los grandes canales presentes en el Distrito de Mercaderes o en la Plaza de la Catedral. Por contra, sigue siendo un barrio rústico y concurrido donde residen trabajadores, peones y los habitantes más humildes de la ciudad. Sus calles adoquinadas son más estrechas, sucias y mucho más caóticas que las del resto de la capital, pero aún conservan la atmósfera auténtica de Ventormenta previa a la guerra.

ang.class:Rogue: Old Town is your natural sanctuary in the capital; behind its ordinary alleys lies the headquarters of SI:7, where master spies and covert handlers offer guidance.
ang.class:Warrior: The Command Center and Champions' Hall make Old Town the premier gathering place in Stormwind for battle-tested veterans seeking gear and combat training.

faq.a: Old Town largely survived the Horde's razing of Stormwind during the First War. Because it was not leveled, the Stonemasons did not rebuild it from scratch, meaning it missed out on the pristine new masonry and grand architecture granted to the rest of the city.
al: why is old town run down
faq.q: Why does Old Town look so much dirtier than the rest of Stormwind?

faq.a: SI:7 is the secretive intelligence agency of Stormwind and the Alliance, overseen by Master Mathias Shaw. Their covert headquarters is tucked away in the back of Old Town, past the training yards and military stables.
faq.q: What is SI:7 and where is it located?

faq.a: The Command Center serves as the primary garrison and headquarters for Stormwind's military. Inside and around its yard, officers coordinate city defenses, while warriors and hunters train alongside stable masters and riding instructors.
faq.q: What is the Command Center in Old Town used for?

faq.a: The local watering hole is the Pig and Whistle Tavern, located near the center of the district. It is famous for hosting hungry soldiers, adventurers, and travelers looking for hearty cooking recipes.
faq.q: Where is the tavern in Old Town?

text.s: Old Town is the oldest and grittiest quarter of Stormwind City, having largely survived the destruction of the First War intact. Rather than gleaming stone plazas, its narrow alleys feature weathered brick, working-class tenements, and bustling military facilities. It serves as home to the kingdom's military Command Center as well as the clandestine headquarters of SI:7.

sec.b: While the rest of Stormwind was painstakingly rebuilt from the ground up by the Stonemasons following the First War, Old Town escaped total ruin. Because it did not require wholesale reconstruction, it never received the pristine marble facades and grand canals seen in the Trade District or Cathedral Square. Instead, it remains a rustic, crowded quarter where working folk, laborers, and the city's poorest residents reside. Its cobbled streets are narrower, dirtier, and far more chaotic than the rest of the capital, yet they preserve the authentic atmosphere of pre-war Stormwind.
sec.t: A Relic of the Old Kingdom

sec.b: Behind its weathered tenements, Old Town functions as the martial backbone of the Alliance capital. The Command Center houses Stormwind's military officers, barracks, and combat trainers, alongside the Champions' Hall where the Alliance's finest warriors gather. Tucked away toward the district's edge sits the covert compound of SI:7, the kingdom's secretive intelligence agency led by Master Mathias Shaw. Off-duty footmen and shadowy operatives alike gather at the Pig and Whistle Tavern, rubbing shoulders in one of the city's liveliest watering holes.

subzone:olsen-s-farthing.s: Finca de Olsen. La Finca de Olsen fue antaño una próspera granja situada a lo largo del principal camino comercial que atraviesa el Bosque de Argénteos. Tras la Tercera Guerra, los campos quedaron en ruinas y fueron invadidos por siervos reanimados vinculados al nigromante renegado Thule Corvozarpa. Antes de que la plaga consumiera Lordaeron, la Finca de Olsen era una concurrida hacienda agrícola con acceso directo a la principal ruta comercial terrestre del Bosque de Argénteos. Hoy en día, sus campos arados están asfixiados por la maleza, sus estructuras yacen derruidas y cualquier recuerdo de la agricultura honrada ha sido borrado por la nigromancia de la Plaga. Siervos no-muertos, subyugados como esclavos y asaltantes bajo las órdenes de Thule Corvozarpa, deambulan por las tierras yermas para masacrar a cualquier viajero que se acerque demasiado.

ang.faction:Horde: Clearing the raiders from Olsen's Farthing is vital for securing the supply road linking the Sepulcher to the north and the road toward Tirisfal Glades.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, places like Olsen's Farthing are grim reminders of the lingering Scourge threat that seeks to enslave the dead rather than liberate them.

faq.a: It was a productive roadside farmstead supporting local commerce along Silverpine Forest's main trade thoroughfare, feeding the settlements of Lordaeron before the kingdom fell to the Scourge.
faq.q: What was Olsen's Farthing before the Third War?

faq.a: The farm was destroyed during the Third War and its remnants were seized by the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, who raised the dead as thralls and raiders to terrorize travelers along the road.
al: who controls the undead at olsens farthing
faq.q: Why is the farm infested with undead?

faq.a: Thule Ravenclaw is a dangerous necromancer aligned with the Scourge who orchestrates undead incursions across Silverpine Forest from his stronghold on Fenris Isle.
faq.q: Who is Thule Ravenclaw?

faq.a: No. The farm is completely overrun by hostile undead loyal to Thule Ravenclaw, making it hostile ground for Forsaken scouts and Horde travelers alike.
al: do forsaken live at olsens farthing
is there a quest hub here
faq.q: Does the Horde or Forsaken hold any presence here?

text.s: Olsen's Farthing was once a flourishing farmstead situated along the primary trade road running through Silverpine Forest. In the wake of the Third War, the fields fell into ruin and became overrun by reanimated thralls bound to the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw.

sec.b: Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, Olsen's Farthing was a busy agricultural homestead with direct access to Silverpine's main overland trading route. Today, its tilled fields are choked with weeds, its structures lie broken, and any memory of honest farming has been erased by Scourge necromancy. Undead thralls, bound as slaves and raiders under the command of Thule Ravenclaw, wander the barren grounds to slaughter any travelers who stray too close.

The shambling horrors haunting Olsen's Farthing are not mindless wanderers, but servants answering to Thule Ravenclaw, a powerful necromancer operating from Fenris Isle in the center of Lake Lordamere. Using dark sorcery to animate and enslave the dead of the surrounding countryside, Thule's reach extends through Olsen's Farthing and poses a direct threat to the Forsaken seeking to secure the northern reaches of Silverpine Forest.

subzone:oracle-glade.s: El Claro del Oráculo. Enclavado en el noroeste de Teldrassil, El Claro del Oráculo es un santuario boscoso sagrado que alberga el portentoso Árbol del Oráculo y la poza de la luna principal del Árbol del Mundo. A pesar de su sereno propósito como centro de comunión y vigilancia, el claro sufre el constante hostigamiento de las invasoras arpías Plumapena. El Claro del Oráculo reposa tranquilamente entre Darnassus y Lago Primigenio, actuando como un nexo vital para la comunión de los elfos de la noche con la naturaleza. En su centro se alza el Árbol del Oráculo, un antiguo espécimen cuyas enormes ramas evocan la silueta de un águila posada sobre un oso.
