Cerca de allí resplandece la primera y más potente de las pozas de la luna sagradas de Teldrassil, un oasis de magia lunar bañado en La Gracia de Elune. Junto con el Círculo de los Ancestros, el Árbol del Oráculo vela por las ramas de la isla, desprendiendo Corteza grabada que sirve como vitales comunicados para el archidruida Fandral Corzocelada sobre la salud del Árbol del Mundo.

ang.class:Druid: For druids of the wild, the Oracle Tree is a living partner in stewardship, offering written records of the land's health shed directly from its very bark.
ang.race:NightElf: The Oracle Glade represents the tender care required to nurse Teldrassil to fruition, housing the crown's most potent moonwell and a silent watcher that speaks directly to the Cenarion leadership.

faq.a: The Oracle Tree is an ancient, magically nurtured tree shaped like a great eagle resting upon a bear. It monitors the growth and health of Teldrassil, shedding inscribed bark containing detailed reports that the druids deliver directly to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
faq.q: What is the Oracle Tree?

faq.a: The Bloodfeather clan of harpies has nested in the high canopies of the glade, drawn by its untamed wilderness and magical vitality. They violently defend their roosts and harass the Oracle Tree, requiring local Sentinels to keep them contained.
faq.q: Why are harpies attacking the Oracle Glade?

faq.a: The pool in the Oracle Glade is the very first and most powerful moonwell established on Teldrassil. It channels the sacred energies of Elune to nourish the surrounding forest and sustain kaldorei druids and priestesses who come to draw upon its waters.
faq.q: What is the importance of the moonwell in this glade?

faq.a: It is located in northwestern Teldrassil, just west of Wellspring Lake. A southern road connects the glade directly back to the main path circling outside the gates of Darnassus.
al: how to get to oracle glade
faq.q: Where is the Oracle Glade located?

text.s: Nestled in northwestern Teldrassil, the Oracle Glade is a sacred woodland sanctuary home to the wondrous Oracle Tree and the World Tree's premier moonwell. Despite its serene purpose as a center of communion and vigilance, the glade faces constant harassment from encroaching Bloodfeather harpies.

sec.b: The Oracle Glade rests quietly between Darnassus and Wellspring Lake, serving as a vital nexus of night elven communion with nature. At its center stands the Oracle Tree, an ancient specimen whose massive boughs evoke the silhouette of an eagle perched atop a bear. Nearby shimmers the first and most potent of Teldrassil's sacred moonwells, an oasis of lunar magic bathed in Elune's grace. Alongside the Circle of the Ancients, the Oracle Tree watches over the island boughs, shedding inscribed bark that acts as vital communiques to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm regarding the World Tree's health.

The glade's tranquility is fragile. Aggressive Bloodfeather harpies have descended upon the grove, establishing roosts among the high branches and threatening the sacred tree. Sentinels dispatched from Darnassus struggle to root out the avian scavengers, who actively harass traveling druids and taint the natural serenity of the moonwell. Travelers passing through the northern boughs must tread lightly, as the harpies strike swiftly at any who venture near their roosts.

subzone:palemane-rock.s: Roca Crines Pálidas. Roca Crines Pálidas es una caverna y campamento enclavado en las montañas occidentales de Mulgore. Sirve como bastión principal para la agresiva tribu de gnolls Crines Pálidas, lo que supone una molestia constante y una amenaza para los tauren cercanos de Poblado Pezuña de Sangre. Situada a lo largo del linde occidental de las llanuras cubiertas de hierba de Mulgore, Roca Crines Pálidas consta de un extenso campamento al aire libre frente a una profunda y sombría caverna excavada en la ladera de la montaña. Los gnolls Crines Pálidas han reclamado como territorio propio tanto el interior de la cueva como las colinas circundantes. Hostiles y territoriales, estos gnolls defienden agresivamente su guarida, atacando a cazadores, viajeros y exploradores que se acercan demasiado a su refugio rocoso.

ang.faction:Horde: Securing Mulgore's borders against local pests like the Palemane gnolls is essential for keeping the tauren homeland safe and stable.
ang.race:Tauren: The Palemane gnolls entrenched in these western caves are a persistent thorn in the side of your people, threatening game and unwary wanderers across Mulgore's pastures.

faq.a: Palemane Rock is a natural cave formation and entrenched gnoll settlement set into the western cliffs of Mulgore.
faq.q: What is Palemane Rock?

faq.a: The cavern and surrounding camp are held by gnolls belonging to the Palemane tribe. They aggressively defend their territory against outsiders, including the native tauren.
faq.q: Who lives at Palemane Rock?

faq.a: The proximity of Palemane Rock to central Mulgore and Bloodhoof Village makes it an active nest of hostile raiders that tauren hunters and braves must continually suppress.
faq.q: Why does Palemane Rock matter to the tauren?

text.s: Palemane Rock is a cavern and campsite nestled into the western mountains of Mulgore. It serves as a primary stronghold for the aggressive Palemane gnoll tribe, posing a continual nuisance and threat to the nearby tauren of Bloodhoof Village.

sec.b: Situated along the western rim of the grassy plains of Mulgore, Palemane Rock consists of a sprawling open-air encampment fronting a deep, shadowed cavern carved into the mountainside. The Palemane gnolls have claimed both the cave interior and the immediate foothills outside as their territory. Hostile and territorial, these gnolls aggressively defend their den, attacking hunters, travelers, and scouts who wander too close to their rocky haven.

subzone:park.s: Parque. Enclavado en el extremo occidental de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, entre Plaza de la Catedral y el Barrio de los Magos, el Parque es un frondoso santuario de vegetación y tranquila reflexión. Dedicado a la naturaleza y al ocio en medio de la bulliciosa capital de piedra, sirve como refugio principal para los elfos de la noche que están de visita y alberga a los únicos instructores de druidas de los Reinos del Este. Mientras que el resto de Ventormenta está dominado por paseos empedrados, imponentes murallas de piedra caliza y concurridos puestos de mercado, el Parque ofrece un respiro tranquilo de naturaleza virgen. Establecido originalmente como un apacible lugar de recreo para los habitantes de la ciudad, se transformó de forma natural en un enclave para los emisarios y viajeros elfos de la noche que llegaban desde el otro lado del Mare Magnum. Al abrigo de frondosas copas y alrededor de un Pozo de la Luna central, el distrito trae una pizca de los claros sagrados de Kalimdor al corazón del reino humano.

ang.class:Druid: This tranquil enclave is your sole sanctuary for training and counsel across all of the Eastern Kingdoms.
ang.race:NightElf: For night elves traveling across the sea, the Park provides a welcome taste of home, centered around a glowing Moonwell and familiar teachers of Elune and the wild.

faq.a: The Park sits along the far western edge of Stormwind City. You can reach its verdant paths by heading southwest from Cathedral Square or northwest from the Mage Quarter.
al: how to get to the park
faq.q: Where is the Park located in Stormwind?

faq.a: The Park was embraced as a refuge by visiting night elves who sought relief from Stormwind's towering stone streets. Its lush groves and serene atmosphere reminded them of their home forests, leading them to settle here and even establish a Moonwell in the square.
faq.q: Why are there so many night elves in the Park?

faq.a: Yes. The Park is currently the only place anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms where Alliance druid trainers are stationed, offering guidance and training to Kaldorei practitioners away from Kalimdor.
al: where to train druid eastern kingdoms
faq.q: Can I train druid abilities here?

faq.a: The pool in the middle of the Park is a consecrated night elven Moonwell, created by Kaldorei visitors to serve as a sacred font of spiritual peace and lunar power amidst the human city.
faq.q: What is the glowing pool in the center of the Park?

text.s: Tucked along the western edge of Stormwind City between Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter, the Park is a lush sanctuary of greenery and quiet reflection. Devoted to nature and leisure amidst the bustling stone capital, it serves as the primary haven for visiting night elves and houses the only druid trainers in the Eastern Kingdoms.

sec.b: While the rest of Stormwind is dominated by cobbled walkways, towering limestone ramparts, and crowded market stalls, the Park offers a tranquil breath of wilderness. Originally established as a quiet place of recreation for the city's populace, it naturally transformed into an enclave for night elf emissaries and travelers arriving from across the Great Sea. Sheltered beneath shaded canopies and surrounding a central Moonwell, the district brings a sliver of Kalimdor's sacred glades into the heart of the human kingdom.
sec.t: A Grove in the Stone Capital

sec.b: For the night elves, the Park is a vital foothold in foreign lands. Here, Kaldorei priests such as Nara Meideros tend to visiting pilgrims, and druidic mentors offer their guidance to those devoted to the wild. The district also serves as a peaceful retreat where weary adventurers rest their eyes from the clatter of the Trade District and the solemn duties of the Cathedral.

subzone:petitioner-s-chamber.s: cámara de peticiones. La cámara de peticiones, también conocida como la Sala de los Peticionarios, es una antecámara situada justo al lado de la rampa de entrada principal del Castillo de Ventormenta. Sirve como sala de espera oficial para la nobleza, los dignatarios de la iglesia y los súbditos visitantes que solicitan una audiencia con la corona. Quienes esperan aquí a menudo pasan las horas relacionándose, bebiendo o aguardando la disposición del regente. Ubicada inmediatamente a la derecha al subir hacia el Castillo de Ventormenta, la cámara de peticiones es donde los asuntos de estado se topan con la burocracia cotidiana. Nobles como el Conde Remington Bonacresta y miembros del clero de alto rango como el Obispo DeLavey pasan el tiempo en estas salas mientras esperan una audiencia con el joven rey Anduin Wrynn y el Alto Señor Bolvar Fordragón. Tras la pulida fachada de la etiqueta cortesana, es un rincón ideal del castillo para los cotilleos, las discretas maniobras de influencia y para discernir quién ostenta verdaderamente el poder en el reino.

ang.class:Priest: With Bishop DeLavey often stationed in this antechamber, the room serves as an intersection between the Holy Light's administrative hierarchy and the royal court.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance loyalists, this chamber represents the administrative bottleneck of Stormwind, where domestic appeals, church affairs, and noble requests await the royal council's scarce attention.

faq.a: The chamber is located inside Stormwind Keep. As soon as you ascend the grand entrance ramp into the keep, it is the first room directly on your right.
faq.q: Where is the Petitioner's Chamber located?

faq.a: The room is frequented by petitioners, court attendees, and nobles seeking the ear of the throne, including figures like Count Remington Ridgewell, Caledra Dawnbreeze, and Bishop DeLavey of the Church of the Holy Light.
faq.q: Who gathers in this room?

faq.a: Its formal function is to host subjects who have submitted formal petitions to the crown. Visitors must wait here until the regent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, or the royal council grants them admittance to the throne room.
faq.q: Why is it also called the Hall of Petitioners?

faq.a: The chamber is primarily visited when delivering goods or speaking with nobles and clergy stationed within the keep, such as running errands to supply refined drinks like port for thirsty aristocrats waiting on court business.
faq.q: What happens here during city quests?

text.s: The Petitioner's Chamber, also known as the Hall of Petitioners, is an antechamber situated just off the main entrance ramp of Stormwind Keep. It serves as an official waiting room for nobility, church dignitaries, and visiting subjects seeking an audience with the crown. Those lingering here often pass the hours mingling, drinking, or waiting upon the regent's pleasure.

sec.b: Found immediately to the right upon ascending into Stormwind Keep, the Petitioner's Chamber is where matters of state meet everyday bureaucracy. Nobles such as Count Remington Ridgewell and high-ranking clergy like Bishop DeLavey pass their time in these halls while waiting for an audience with the boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Behind the polished veneer of courtly etiquette, it is an ideal corner of the castle for gossip, quiet lobbying, and discerning who truly holds influence within the realm.
sec.t: A Room of Waiting and Influence

subzone:pool-of-ask-ar.s: Alberca de Ask'ar. La Alberca de Ask'ar es un extenso lago cavernoso sumergido situado en las profundidades de Cavernas de Brazanegra. Rebosante de bestias acuáticas y viles invasores naga, sus aguas ocultan una antigua arquitectura de elfos de la noche junto a pasadizos ocultos que serpentean más profundamente en el santuario corrompido. Situada justo más allá del Sagrario Inundado, la Alberca de Ask'ar llena una enorme bóveda subterránea con agua turbia y fría. Las cavernas naturales y la antigua cantería se han convertido en un lugar de anidación para tortugas mordedoras descomunales y cangrejos de aguas profundas, vigilados por el enorme y ancestral quelonio conocido como Ghamoo-ra. Los naga que se han apoderado del templo utilizan este umbral sumergido como punto de despliegue defensivo, custodiando los accesos inundados que conducen más hacia el interior del complejo, en dirección a Lady Sarevess y las Ruinas del Santuario Lunar.

ang.faction:Alliance: The waterways must be breached to uncover the fate of Argent Guard Thaelrid, who ventured into these cavern depths on a holy mission against the Twilight's Hammer.
ang.race:NightElf: The pool floods what was once holy Elune temple grounds, drowning ancient architecture and scattering sacred relics like the Lorgalis Manuscript to be scavenged by naga.

faq.a: It is a vast subterranean pool within Blackfathom Deeps, located right past the Drowned Sacellum. It is dominated by snapping turtles, crabs, and naga guards.
faq.q: What is the Pool of Ask'ar?

faq.a: The cavern is inhabited by wild reef creatures such as snapping turtles and crabs, most notably the colossal turtle Ghamoo-ra. Hostile naga also patrol the submerged banks and nearby chambers.
faq.q: Who lives in this subterranean pool?

faq.a: Navigating the flooded southern passages leads out toward chambers occupied by Lady Sarevess and Argent Guard Thaelrid, and opens into the path winding past Gelihast toward the Moonshrine Ruins.
faq.q: Where do the underwater tunnels lead?

faq.a: The submerged ruins along the pool's periphery contain the Lorgalis Manuscript, an ancient text on the Old Gods coveted by Gerrig Bonegrip of Ironforge.
faq.q: What notable items can be found in the pool?

text.s: The Pool of Ask'ar is a sprawling, submerged cavern lake located deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Teeming with aquatic beasts and foul naga invaders, its waters conceal ancient night elven architecture alongside hidden passageways that wind deeper into the corrupted sanctuary.

sec.b: Situated just beyond the Drowned Sacellum, the Pool of Ask'ar fills a massive subterranean vault with murky, cold water. The natural caverns and ancient stonework have become a nesting ground for oversized snapping turtles and deep-sea crabs, overseen by the enormous ancient chelonian known as Ghamoo-ra. The naga who have taken over the temple utilize this submerged threshold as a defensive staging ground, guarding the waterlogged approaches that lead deeper into the complex toward Lady Sarevess and the Moonshrine Ruins.

Beyond its monstrous fauna and hostile patrols, the waters of the pool hide valuable relics from the shrine's pre-Sundering past. Submerged ledges and hidden alcoves along the cavern's edges conceal lost artifacts, including the valuable Lorgalis Manuscript sought by the dwarven scholar Gerrig Bonegrip of Ironforge. Swimming through the flooded southern passageways brings travelers out into dry tunnels guarded by vile murlocs and Old God cultists, marking the pool as the critical aquatic crossroads of Blackfathom Deeps.

subzone:pools-of-arlithrien.s: Estanques de Arlithrien. Los Estanques de Arlithrien son un grupo de manantiales apartados situados en el oeste de Teldrassil, justo al sur de las puertas de Darnassus. Antaño un retiro tranquilo centrado alrededor de una poza de la luna sagrada, la zona ha caído en el abandono y el peligro a medida que la fauna local y los cercanos y hostiles fúrbolgs Tuercepinos la han invadido. Escondidos entre las ramas sombrías al sur de Darnassus, los Estanques de Arlithrien estaban destinados originalmente a ser un lugar tranquilo de armonía natural. En su corazón se encuentra una poza de la luna de piedra, un receptáculo para las aguas imbuidas de la gracia de Elune. Sin embargo, a pesar de su proximidad a la capital de los elfos de la noche, el santuario se ha vuelto peligroso. Bestias agitadas merodean por los bajíos, y la persistente hostilidad de los fúrbolgs Tuercepinos desplazados obligó a los elfos de la noche a abandonar el mantenimiento rutinario del lugar, dejando una maravilla pacífica ensombrecida por el creciente malestar de la isla.

ang.class:Druid: Druids studying the imbalances of Teldrassil see the unruly wildlife and the neglected moonwell here as another sign that the Great Tree lacks nature's true blessing.
ang.race:NightElf: The abandonment of a holy moonwell so close to Darnassus is a troubling reminder to night elves of the corruption and disruption creeping across Teldrassil.

faq.a: The pools are nestled in the western reaches of Teldrassil, located just south of the main bridge and entryway into the capital city of Darnassus.
faq.q: Where are the Pools of Arlithrien located?

faq.a: The night elves withdrew from actively tending the moonwell due to mounting danger. Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs established a threatening presence nearby, and aggressive forest wildlife overran the surrounding waters.
faq.q: Why was the moonwell here abandoned?

faq.a: Travelers wandering near the pools must contend with aggressive woodland creatures that have taken over the waters, alongside the looming risk posed by nearby territorial Gnarlpine furbolgs.
faq.q: What threats can travelers find at the pools?

faq.a: Yes. Though untended and abandoned by the priesthood and druids due to local dangers, the moonwell itself still holds its sacred waters and remains a functional source of lunar essence.
faq.q: Can players still use the moonwell at the Pools of Arlithrien?

text.s: The Pools of Arlithrien are a cluster of secluded springs resting in western Teldrassil, just south of the gates to Darnassus. Once a tranquil retreat centered around a sacred moonwell, the area has fallen into neglect and danger as local wildlife and nearby hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs encroached upon it.

sec.b: Tucked along the shaded boughs south of Darnassus, the Pools of Arlithrien were originally meant to be a quiet place of natural harmony. At their heart lies a stone moonwell, a vessel for the waters imbued with the grace of Elune. Yet despite its proximity to the night elven capital, the sanctuary has become perilous. Agitated beasts roam the shallows, and the persistent hostility of the displaced Gnarlpine furbolgs forced the night elves to abandon routine upkeep of the site, leaving a peaceful wonder shadowed by the island's growing malaise.

subzone:pools-of-vision.s: Pozas de las Visiones. Las Pozas de las Visiones son una caverna subterránea situada bajo el Alto de los Espíritus, en Cima del Trueno. Marcado por aguas tranquilas y grutas oscuras, este aislado espacio subterráneo sirve como el principal enclave de los Renegados en la capital tauren. Mientras que las cumbres soleadas de Cima del Trueno pertenecen al viento, la tierra y el cielo, las Pozas de las Visiones se adentran directamente bajo el Alto de los Espíritus en un sombrío retiro. Accesible a través de un discreto sendero que parte del puente hacia el alto, esta gruta subterránea ofrece un respiro subterráneo muy diferente a las cabañas al aire libre de arriba. Aquí, las aguas brumosas se estancan en la oscuridad, creando una atmósfera aislada donde los taumaturgos de la Horda se reúnen lejos de las bulliciosas mesetas centrales.

ang.class:Mage: The cavern anchors the arcane ley connections to the city; any teleportation spell weaving into Thunder Bluff delivers its caster right beside these secluded pools.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken traversing the plains of Kalimdor, this cavern provides a familiar, shaded haven complete with arcane resources, priestly guidance, and fellowship.

faq.a: The entrance is a cave mouth located on Spirit Rise, situated immediately to the right just after crossing the wooden rope bridge leading from the lower mesa.
al: how to get to pools of vision
faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Pools of Vision?

faq.a: The cavern serves as the central hub for Forsaken stationed in Thunder Bluff. It provides shelter away from the harsh Kalimdor sunlight and accommodates practices that may make traditional tauren spiritualists uneasy.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken living down here?

faq.a: The cavern hosts trainers and practitioners for priests and mages, along with emissaries for the Defilers who muster soldiers for the war effort in the Arathi Highlands.
al: what is in pools of vision
faq.q: What services can you find inside the Pools of Vision?

faq.a: Mages casting a teleport or opening a portal to Thunder Bluff manifest directly inside the sheltered waters of the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise.
faq.q: Where do mages arrive when they teleport to Thunder Bluff?

text.s: The Pools of Vision are a subterranean cavern nestled beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Marked by still waters and dim caverns, this secluded subterranean space serves as the primary enclave for the Forsaken within the tauren capital.

sec.b: While the sunlit peaks of Thunder Bluff belong to the wind, earth, and sky, the Pools of Vision plunge directly beneath Spirit Rise into shadowy seclusion. Accessible from a discreet cave path off the bridge leading to the rise, this subterranean grotto offers subterranean respite quite unlike the open-air lodges above. Here, misty waters pool in the dark, creating an isolated atmosphere where Horde spellcasters gather far from the bustling central mesas.

Within Thunder Bluff, the Pools of Vision function as the de facto base of operations for the Forsaken. Travelers from the eastern continent find kindred souls here: undead priests practicing their shadowed arts, mages conjuring arcane portals, and emissaries of the Defilers seeking recruits for their campaigns in the Arathi Highlands. Whether tucked away by tauren skepticism or by the Forsaken's own natural preference for the dark, this quiet refuge bridges Lordaeron's undead with their Kalimdor allies.

subzone:pyrewood-village.s: Aldea Piroleña. Aldea Piroleña es un asentamiento humano aislado situado en el sur de Bosque de Argénteos, bajo el Castillo de Colmillo Oscuro. Originalmente parte de Gilneas antes de quedar aislada fuera de La Muralla de Cringrís, sus habitantes vivos albergan un horrible secreto provocado por el demente archimago Arugal. Aldea Piroleña fue en su día un próspero asentamiento gilneano propiedad de Lord Darius Crowley. Cuando el rey Genn Greymane decidió aislar su reino tras la descomunal Muralla de Cringrís después de la Segunda Guerra, Aldea Piroleña y su vecina Molino Ámbar quedaron abandonadas en el lado norte. Aislados de su patria, los lugareños quedaron completamente indefensos durante la Tercera Guerra mientras la Plaga marchaba por Lordaeron. Aunque lograron sobrevivir a la oleada inicial de no-muertos, su verdadera pesadilla comenzó cuando el mago Arugal se refugió en la fortaleza de arriba.

ang.faction:Alliance: The village represents a tragic remnant of living humanity in Lordaeron, willing to trade with travelers by day before succumbing to a horrific curse each night.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Forsaken, Pyrewood is a lingering pocket of hostile humans and monstrous worgen serving Archmage Arugal right on the border of their lands.

faq.a: The villagers are afflicted by a dark curse cast by Archmage Arugal of Shadowfang Keep. During the day, they retain their human forms and normal faculties, but each night they transform into ravenous Moonrage worgen who attack all outsiders on sight.
faq.q: Why does Pyrewood Village attack me at night?

faq.a: King Genn Greymane ordered the Greymane Wall constructed to seal Gilneas off from the outside world following the Second War. Lord Darius Crowley strongly opposed the wall because it cut off his northern holdings, including Pyrewood and Ambermill, leaving their residents to fend for themselves.
faq.q: Why is Pyrewood outside the Greymane Wall?

faq.a: Yes, but strictly during daylight hours. Alliance travelers can walk among the townsfolk and trade with the village merchants while the sun is up. Once darkness falls, however, the entire village transforms into hostile worgen regardless of your faction.
faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Pyrewood safely?

faq.a: The Forsaken view the village as an intolerable threat on their southern border. Under the direction of agents like Deathstalker Faerleia, the Horde seeks to assassinate the village's council and sever Pyrewood's ties to Arugal.
faq.q: How does the Horde view Pyrewood?

text.s: Pyrewood Village is an isolated human settlement nestled in southern Silverpine Forest beneath Shadowfang Keep. Originally part of Gilneas before being stranded outside the Greymane Wall, its living residents harbor a horrific secret brought upon them by the mad archmage Arugal.

sec.b: Pyrewood was once a prosperous Gilnean settlement owned by Lord Darius Crowley. When King Genn Greymane chose to isolate his kingdom behind the massive Greymane Wall following the Second War, Pyrewood and its neighbor Ambermill were abandoned on the northern side. Cut off from their homeland, the townsfolk were left entirely defenseless during the Third War as the Scourge marched across Lordaeron. Though they managed to survive the initial wave of the undead, their true nightmare began when the mage Arugal took refuge in the fortress above.

From the towers of Shadowfang Keep, Archmage Arugal unleashed otherworldly beasts upon the surrounding lands, ultimately cursing the living population of Pyrewood. By the light of day, the citizens appear as normal human villagers, quietly maintaining their town hall, blacksmith, and chapel, even offering trade to visiting Alliance travelers. Yet as soon as the sun dips beneath the horizon, a terrible transformation occurs: every resident shifts into a savage, bloodthirsty worgen of the Moonrage pack, turning on anyone unfortunate enough to linger within the walls.

subzone:ragefire-chasm-classic.s: Sima Ígnea (Classic). Sima Ígnea es una extensa red de túneles volcánicos excavados directamente bajo Orgrimmar, accesible a través de las profundidades sombrías de El Circo de las Sombras. A pesar de estar situada bajo la capital soberana de la Horda, estas cavernas ardientes están plagadas de hostiles troggs y un aquelarre subversivo de cultistas leales al Consejo de la Sombra. Bajo las calles de piedra y las torres fortificadas de Orgrimmar se encuentra Sima Ígnea, una traicionera red de cavernas subterráneas repletas de magma. Los túneles fueron invadidos recientemente por los salvajes troggs Furia Ígnea, que ascendieron desde profundas fisuras subterráneas. Magatha Tótem Siniestro, de los tauren, intentó una diplomacia pacífica con las criaturas, pero sus propuestas fueron rechazadas violentamente. Si no se les pone freno, los troggs amenazan con excavar aún más en los propios cimientos de la ciudad.

ang.faction:Horde: Clearing Ragefire Chasm is a matter of homeland defense, securing the bedrock of Durotar against internal sabotage while rooting out demonic collaborators.
ang.race:Tauren: Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent emissaries to sue for peace with the invading troggs; their bloody refusal proved diplomacy is impossible against these underground beasts.

faq.a: The entrance portal is located deep within Orgrimmar, specifically in the subterranean canyon known as the Cleft of Shadow. It sits near the tent of the orc warlock Neeru Fireblade.
faq.q: Where is the entrance to Ragefire Chasm?

faq.a: The troggs surfaced from ancient, deep cavern systems beneath Durotar, emerging directly into the volcanic underbelly of the city. Their sudden invasion poses a structural and physical hazard to the capital, refusing any attempts at peaceful containment.
faq.q: Why are there troggs beneath Orgrimmar?

faq.a: Warchief Thrall is fully aware of the cult's presence beneath the city. Rather than launching a blunt assault that might cause the wider network to scatter, he allows them to operate under close watch in hopes they will inadvertently reveal the identity and whereabouts of the Shadow Council's true leadership.
al: why is searing blade under orgrimmar
faq.q: Why does Thrall allow cultists to live under the capital?

faq.a: The Searing Blade inside Ragefire Chasm is commanded by three figures: Taragaman the Hungerer, a formidable felguard; Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock; and Bazzalan, a treacherous satyr.
faq.q: Who leads the cultists inside the chasm?

text.s: Ragefire Chasm is a sprawling network of volcanic tunnels carved directly beneath Orgrimmar, accessible through the shadowy depths of the Cleft of Shadow. Despite being situated under the Horde's sovereign capital, these fiery caverns crawl with hostile troggs and a subversive coven of cultists loyal to the Shadow Council.

sec.b: Beneath the stone streets and fortified towers of Orgrimmar lies Ragefire Chasm, a treacherous network of magma-filled subterranean caverns. The tunnels recently became overrun by the savage Ragefire troggs, who pushed upward from deep subterranean fissures. Magatha Grimtotem of the tauren attempted peaceful diplomacy with the creatures, but her overtures were violently rejected. Left unchecked, the troggs threaten to tunnel further into the foundations of the city itself.

Far more dangerous than mindless troggs is the presence of the Searing Blade, an insurgent cult subordinate to the demonic Shadow Council. Led by the hulking felguard Taragaman the Hungerer, the orc warlock Jergosh the Invoker, and the corrupt satyr Bazzalan, these conspirators scheme to unravel everything Thrall's Horde has established in Durotar. Rather than immediately cleansing the caves, Warchief Thrall has maintained surveillance on their activities, hoping their foolish overconfidence will expose their masters higher up in the Shadow Council's hierarchy.

subzone:raptor-grounds.s: Tierras de los Raptores. Enclavadas en las colinas polvorientas del sur de Los Baldíos, las Tierras de los Raptores son un valle apartado reclamado por los raptores Escamasol. A diferencia de las bestias salvajes corrientes, la manada de aquí muestra una inquietante astucia para usar herramientas y una necesidad compulsiva de robar baratijas brillantes de los asentamientos cercanos. Situadas al oeste de Fuerte del Norte, las Tierras de los Raptores sirven como el principal territorio de anidación de los raptores Escamasol. Los viajeros descubren pronto que estas criaturas distan mucho de ser depredadores descerebrados: muestran una inteligencia impropia, fabrican refugios toscos, montan herramientas primitivas y coordinan sus cacerías. Impulsada por una implacable fascinación por los objetos brillantes e inusuales, la manada asalta con regularidad las caravanas que pasan y los campamentos de la Horda, arrastrando monedas, baratijas y suministros al interior de sus guaridas en el cañón.

ang.class:Hunter: The Sunscale pack's unusual cunning, pack coordination, and ability to construct rudimentary shelters make them a fascinating subject of study for any skilled tracker.
ang.faction:Horde: The Sunscale raptors pose a recurring threat to Horde caravans and outposts across the southern Barrens, prompting bounties and recovery expeditions for stolen wealth.

faq.a: The Raptor Grounds is a small, sunken valley in the southern portion of the Barrens, nestled in the rocky hills west of Northwatch Hold.
faq.q: Where is the Raptor Grounds?

faq.a: The Sunscale raptors show an unnatural degree of intelligence. Rather than relying purely on feral instinct, they assemble primitive tools and construct crude huts to shelter their pack and hide stolen goods.
faq.q: Why are the raptors here different from normal beasts?

faq.a: The pack possesses an obsessive attraction to shiny, glittering, or unusual objects. This fascination drives them to ambush travelers and loot Horde settlements, hoarding stolen coin and metal deep in their valley.
faq.q: Why do the raptors attack caravans and steal items?

faq.a: Neither faction holds the valley. It remains the untamed hunting and nesting territory of the wild Sunscale raptors, who fiercely defend it against any who venture inside.
faq.q: Who controls this valley?

text.s: Tucked into the dusty hills of the southern Barrens, the Raptor Grounds is a secluded valley claimed by the Sunscale raptors. Unlike ordinary wild beasts, the pack here exhibits an eerie, tool-using cunning and a compulsive urge to steal bright trinkets from nearby settlements.

sec.b: Located west of Northwatch Hold, the Raptor Grounds serves as the primary nesting territory for the Sunscale raptors. Travelers quickly discover that these creatures are far from mindless predators: they display an unnatural intelligence, fashioning crude shelters, assembling primitive tools, and coordinating their hunts. Driven by a relentless fascination with shiny and unusual items, the pack regularly raids passing caravans and Horde encampments, dragging coins, trinkets, and supplies back into their canyon dens.
sec.t: Uncanny Beasts of the Southern Wastes

subzone:ratchet.s: Trinquete. Trinquete es una bulliciosa ciudad portuaria neutral dirigida por el Cártel Bonvapor en la costa oriental de Los Baldíos. Fundada por el ingeniero jefe Gazlowe tras ayudar a construir Orgrimmar, sirve como el principal núcleo de comercio marítimo que conecta el centro de Kalimdor con los Reinos del Este. Encaramada en la árida costa entre Durotar y Marjal Revolcafango, Trinquete ofrece un puerto seguro a cualquiera que lleve monedas. Fundada por el emprendedor ingeniero Gazlowe tras la Tercera Guerra, el puerto surgió gracias a contrabandistas, exiliados y audaces comerciantes deseosos de explotar la frontera de Kalimdor. Opera bajo el estandarte del Cártel Bonvapor, manteniendo una estricta neutralidad entre la Horda y la Alianza. Barcos como La Fantasía de la Doncella surcan con regularidad las aguas del Mare Magnum hasta Bahía del Botín, transportando mercancías, mercenarios y materias primas entre continentes. Los matones locales mantienen un ojo vigilante sobre los muelles, moliendo a palos sin piedad a cualquiera lo bastante insensato como para iniciar una refriega e interrumpir el comercio.

ang.class:Warlock: The tower perched on the bluffs above Ratchet serves as a major training ground where warlocks of all origins gather under Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender to master advanced demonic summoning.
ang.faction:Alliance: Ratchet offers Alliance adventurers a rare safe landing point in the hostile territory of the central Barrens, complete with boat transport and flight connections.

faq.a: Ratchet is overseen by Chief Engineer Gazlowe, operating on behalf of the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel. Gazlowe established the town shortly after being paid handsomely by Warchief Thrall for directing the construction of Orgrimmar's infrastructure.
al: who is in charge of ratchet
faq.q: Who rules Ratchet?

faq.a: Yes. Ratchet is a neutral goblin port. As long as you maintain non-hostile standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel and do not attack anyone within city limits, both Alliance and Horde travelers can use the inn, bank, vendors, flight paths, and ferry.
faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Ratchet safely?

faq.a: The vessel docked at the southern pier, The Maiden's Fancy, sails across the Great Sea to Booty Bay, situated at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale. It serves as one of the primary naval links between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
al: where does the ratchet ship go
faq.q: Where does the boat in Ratchet go?

faq.a: The tower overlooking Ratchet houses a warlock coven led by figures like Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender. The Steamwheedle Cartel's indifference to dark magic allows these sorcerers to operate, teach apprentices, and bind demons without interference from religious or civil authorities.
faq.q: Why are there warlocks in the hills above the town?

faq.a: Ratchet Bruisers will immediately intervene, attacking the instigator with heavy clubs and netting. Disrupting business is strictly forbidden in goblin settlements, and fighting here will quickly damage your reputation with the Steamwheedle Cartel.
faq.q: What happens if I start a fight in Ratchet?

text.s: Ratchet is a bustling neutral port town run by the Steamwheedle Cartel on the eastern coast of the Barrens. Founded by chief engineer Gazlowe after he helped construct Orgrimmar, it serves as the primary maritime trade hub linking central Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms.

sec.b: Perched on the arid coastline between Durotar and Dustwallow Marsh, Ratchet offers safe harbor to anyone carrying coin. Founded by the entrepreneurial engineer Gazlowe following the Third War, the port arose from smugglers, exiles, and daring traders looking to exploit Kalimdor's frontier. It operates beneath the banner of the Steamwheedle Cartel, maintaining strict neutrality between the Horde and the Alliance. Ships like The Maiden's Fancy regularly ply the waters across the Great Sea to Booty Bay, transporting goods, mercenaries, and raw materials between continents. Local bruisers keep a watchful eye on the docks, ruthlessly thrashing anyone foolish enough to start a brawl and disrupt commerce.
sec.t: The Crossroads of the Great Sea

sec.b: Despite its outward appearance as a boisterous merchant town of docks, taverns, and workshops, Ratchet harbors darker dealings. Overlooking the harbor from the hills above sits a secluded tower occupied by an open coven of warlocks, including figures like Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender. While townsfolk and sailors busy themselves with cargo manifests and goblin engineering, practitioners of the dark arts gather here unmolested to commune with demonic forces, untroubled by the moral restrictions enforced in traditional faction capitals.

subzone:ravaged-caravan.s: Caravana Devastada. La caravana devastada es un amasijo humeante situado en la orilla nororiental del Lago Toro de Piedra, en Mulgore. Antaño fue un convoy de suministros destinado a las operaciones mineras del Supervisor Saltatuercas, pero cayó en una emboscada y fue destruido por los tauren locales, decididos a poner fin a la explotación goblin de su tierra natal. Emplazada sobre un promontorio junto al Lago Toro de Piedra, la Caravana Devastada señala uno de los primeros enfrentamientos entre los tauren de Poblado Pezuña de Sangre y el avance de Ventura y Cía. Enviada para entregar suministros mineros, planos y equipo en la excavación del Supervisor Saltatuercas, la caravana fue interceptada y destruida por defensores tauren antes de que pudiera alcanzar su destino. A pesar de la devastación, los obstinados supervivientes de Ventura y Cía. siguen aferrados a los carros en ruinas y a las cajas humeantes, custodiando con recelo el escaso cargamento que aún queda.

ang.class:Druid: The black smoke choking the shore of Stonebull Lake serves as a stark reminder of the reckless damage goblin machinery inflicts on the natural balance.
ang.race:Tauren: The charred wagons represent your people's immediate and decisive refusal to let foreign industrial syndicates despoil the sacred pastures of Mulgore.

faq.a: The caravan was intercepted and wrecked by local tauren who spotted the Venture Company moving deep into Mulgore. Seeking to stop the goblins from stripping the land, the tauren destroyed the convoy before its cargo could reach the nearby mine.
faq.q: What happened to this caravan?

faq.a: The caravan belongs to the Venture Company, an unscrupulous goblin mining consortium attempting to establish unpermitted operations in the hills of Mulgore.
faq.q: Who owns the wrecked wagons?

faq.a: It was hauling tools, machinery, and supplies north toward Supervisor Fizsprocket, who leads the Venture Company's strip-mining operation at the Venture Co. Mine.
faq.q: Where was the caravan heading?

faq.a: The surviving Venture Co. hirelings and workers are fiercely protective of company property. Rather than abandoning the loss, they remain entrenched around the charred wagons, attempting to salvage what little remains of their equipment.
faq.q: Why are there still Venture Co. workers lingering at the wreck?

text.s: The Ravaged Caravan is a smoldering wreck located on the northeastern shore of Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. Once a supply convoy bound for Supervisor Fizsprocket's mining operations, it was ambushed and destroyed by local tauren determined to halt goblin exploitation of their homeland.

sec.b: Perched on a rise above Stonebull Lake, the Ravaged Caravan marks an early clash between the tauren of Bloodhoof Village and the encroaching Venture Company. Sent to deliver mining supplies, blueprints, and equipment to Supervisor Fizsprocket's dig site, the caravan was cut off and wrecked by tauren defenders before it could reach its destination. Despite the devastation, stubborn Venture Co. survivors still cling to the ruined wagons and smoldering crates, jealously guarding what little cargo remains.

subzone:raven-hill.s: Cerro del Cuervo. Cerro del Cuervo es una aldea desolada y en ruinas situada en el oeste de Bosque del Ocaso, bajo la alargada sombra del vasto Cementerio del Cerro del Cuervo. Antaño un animado asentamiento humano, ahora yace abandonado por todos salvo por un puñado de asustados ocupantes y espíritus invisibles. Situado a lo largo del camino occidental de Bosque del Ocaso, justo al norte de la Granja de Addle, Cerro del Cuervo es una trágica sombra de lo que fue. Cuando la magia oscura y los horrores no-muertos asolaron la región de Grand Hamlet, los vivos evacuaron hacia el este en dirección a Villa Oscura o huyeron por completo del territorio. En la actualidad, las casas de madera en ruinas se pudren bajo una penumbra perpetua, evitadas por los viajeros que temen tanto a los muertos inquietos que bajan errantes desde el cementerio vecino como a los invisibles Unseen que acechan entre los muros desmoronados.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers crossing the bridge from Westfall, Raven Hill serves as an ominous welcome to the nightmare overtaking western Duskwood.
ang.race:Human: The decaying cottages stand as a grim reminder of how much territory the kingdom of Stormwind has lost to creeping darkness and neglect.

faq.a: Raven Hill was abandoned when the shadow fell over Duskwood, bringing forth undead horrors, dark magic, and predatory beasts. The town's proximity to the massive Raven Hill Cemetery made it especially indefensible, forcing surviving residents to flee eastward toward the fortified settlement of Darkshire.
faq.q: Why is Raven Hill abandoned?

faq.a: Only a few daring or desperate souls dwell here. The terrified human Jitters hides among the ruined foundations, plagued by guilt and fear, while a goblin vendor named Bliztik operates out of an upper floor, trading with anyone brave enough to search the abandoned buildings.
faq.q: Who actually lives in the village now?

faq.a: The Unseen are invisible, hostile spirits that wander through Raven Hill and the nearby cemetery. While invisible to ordinary sight, their presence poses a sudden and deadly threat to any unwary traveler exploring the desolate township.
faq.q: What are the Unseen haunting Raven Hill?

faq.a: The road running past Raven Hill connects westward toward the river bridge into Westfall, southward toward Addle's Stead and the border of Stranglethorn Vale, and eastward through the heart of Duskwood to Darkshire.
faq.q: Where does the road through Raven Hill lead?

text.s: Raven Hill is a desolate, ruined village in western Duskwood sitting in the long shadow of the vast Raven Hill Cemetery. Once a lively human settlement, it lies abandoned by all but a handful of frightened squatters and invisible spirits.

sec.b: Situated along the western thoroughfare of Duskwood just north of Addle's Stead, Raven Hill is a tragic shell of its former self. When dark magic and undead horrors swept through the Grand Hamlet region, the living evacuated eastward toward Darkshire or fled the territory entirely. Today, ruined timber homes rot beneath perpetual gloom, avoided by travelers who fear both the restless dead wandering down from the neighboring cemetery and the invisible Unseen lurking between the crumbling walls.

Despite its bleak reputation, Raven Hill is not entirely uninhabited. A nervous wreck of an adventurer named Jitters hides among the abandoned structures, terrified of the horrors his own past curiosity helped unleash. Higher up in one of the dilapidated attics, an entrepreneurial goblin named Bliztik ekes out a solitary living selling supplies to wary passersby. They share the ruins with invisible spirits known as the Unseen, living on borrowed time at the edge of the sprawling burial grounds.

subzone:ravenholdt-manor.s: Mansión Ravenholdt. Escondida en lo alto de las montañas sobre las Laderas de Trabalomas, la Mansión Ravenholdt sirve como sede aislada para el gremio de ladrones y asesinos conocido como Ravenholdt. Supervisada por Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, la finca ofrece un discreto refugio donde los practicantes del sigilo perfeccionan su arte lejos de los ojos de las autoridades. Oculta tras un estrecho paso montañoso y una cueva serpenteante al noroeste del Castillo de Durnholde, la Mansión Ravenholdt se asienta aislada en las tierras fronterizas de las Montañas de Alterac. La propiedad pertenece a Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, un noble que mantiene un disciplinado enclave de pícaros, asesinos y agentes de inteligencia. El terreno cuenta con un tranquilo jardín y una arena de entrenamiento al aire libre supervisada por expertos marciales como el maestro Kang, lo que proporciona un espacio disciplinado para practicar forzar cerraduras, elaborar venenos y el combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Aunque la mansión acoge a quienes tienen talento para las trapacerías, los centinelas vigilantes de la mansión tratan a los forasteros torpes y a los visitantes no deseados con fría sospecha.

ang.class:Rogue: Ravenholdt Manor is the premier sanctuary for your profession, offering rigorous trials, specialized training, and a deep network of underground contacts.
ang.profession:Engineering: Discerning engineers venture through the mountain pass specifically to acquire the rare schematic for the Gnomish Cloaking Device from the manor's supply.

faq.a: To reach the manor, travel to the plateau northwest of Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills. Near where the plateau meets the northern mountains, an obscure dirt path twists upward and passes through a hidden cave, emerging directly onto the manor's grounds.
faq.q: How do you reach Ravenholdt Manor?

faq.a: The estate belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, who leads an elite brotherhood of thieves and assassins known simply as Ravenholdt. He commands deep respect among rogues throughout Azeroth.
faq.q: Who owns Ravenholdt Manor?

faq.a: Both factions claim roots in the shattered lands of Alterac. While the displaced nobles of the Syndicate resort to banditry and lawlessness across the hills, Ravenholdt operates with strict discipline and actively works to thwart the Syndicate's ambitions.
faq.q: Why does Ravenholdt hate the Syndicate?

faq.a: Any traveler can physically walk into the grounds, but the guards and assassins stationed there are openly hostile in tone to outsiders. Rogues and trusted operatives find a warm welcome and extensive training, while others receive chilling warnings to leave.
faq.q: Can anyone visit the manor?

text.s: Tucked away high in the mountains above Hillsbrad Foothills, Ravenholdt Manor serves as the secluded headquarters for the guild of thieves and assassins known as Ravenholdt. Overseen by Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, the estate provides a discreet haven where practitioners of stealth hone their craft far from the eyes of authorities.

sec.b: Hidden behind a narrow mountain pass and a winding cave northwest of Durnholde Keep, Ravenholdt Manor sits isolated on the borderlands of the Alterac Mountains. The property belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, a nobleman who maintains a disciplined enclave of rogues, assassins, and intelligence operatives. The grounds feature a tranquil garden and an outdoor training arena overseen by martial experts like Master Kang, providing a disciplined space to practice lockpicking, poison-crafting, and close-quarters combat. While the manor welcomes those with a talent for skullduggery, clumsy outsiders and unwanted visitors are treated with cold suspicion by the manor's watchful sentries.

Prior to the First War, the land surrounding the manor was part of the kingdom of Alterac, reflected in the weathered orange tiles of the manor's roof. In the turbulent wake of Alterac's ruin, the fallen nobles of the Syndicate sought to control the region, placing them in direct conflict with Ravenholdt. Ravenholdt maintains an uneasy association with Stormwind's SI:7 intelligence service, cooperating where interests align to purge Syndicate influences from the surrounding highlands. For Jorach's followers, every skirmish fought across Hillsbrad and Alterac is part of a silent war to maintain their sovereign haven.
sec.t: A Bitter Feud in the Foothills

subzone:raynewood-retreat.s: Refugio de la Algaba. El Refugio de la Algaba es un antiguo puesto de avanzada de los elfos de la noche situado alrededor de un enorme gran árbol en el centro-norte de Vallefresno. Custodiado por dríades y protectores Cenarion, sirve como un santuario vigilante que controla los pasos septentrionales hacia el corrupto Frondavil. También es el santuario del Guardián Ordanus, un hijo mayor de Cenarius que se ha convertido en el objetivo de siniestras fuerzas externas. Mucho antes de los conflictos modernos entre la Alianza y la Horda, el Refugio de la Algaba sirvió como base militar de operaciones para los defensores elfos de la noche durante la antigua Guerra de los Sátiros, hace milenios. Hoy en día, el campamento conserva su sagrado propósito marcial. Enclavado entre la poza de la luna de Shael'dryn y las ruinas infestadas de sátiros de la Senda de la Noche, el puesto de avanzada está ferozmente custodiado por Protectores Cenarion, dragones féricos y Hermanas sonrientes. Su vigilancia colectiva mantiene un ojo atento sobre la creciente corrupción que desciende desde Frondavil, justo al norte.

ang.class:Druid: Raynewood Retreat is holy ground under the stewardship of Cenarius's children, serving as a bulwark against demonic and fel corruption.
ang.faction:Horde: To the Horde, the retreat is an Alliance-friendly grove whose guardian, Keeper Ordanus, is targeted for elimination by covert questgivers.

faq.a: Raynewood Retreat is a night elf and Cenarion settlement situated around a Great Tree in north-central Ashenvale. It acts as an Alliance-aligned sanctuary and watchpost monitoring the approaches to Felwood.
faq.q: What is Raynewood Retreat?

faq.a: The outpost is defended by Cenarion Protectors, dryads known as Laughing Sisters, and faerie dragons. Its most prominent resident is Keeper Ordanus, who dwells high within the great tree.
faq.q: Who lives at Raynewood Retreat?

faq.a: Keeper Ordanus is a powerful keeper of the grove and one of the eldest sons of the demigod Cenarius. He oversees the sanctuary but finds himself hunted by hostile infiltrators.
faq.q: Who is Keeper Ordanus?

faq.a: Braelyn Firehand hires Horde adventurers to infiltrate the tree and seek Keeper Ordanus. Her motives and allegiances are uncovered through the quest.
faq.q: Why does the Horde attack Raynewood Retreat?

faq.a: Nearly ten thousand years ago, during the War of the Satyr, the night elf military utilized Raynewood Retreat as an operational base to combat the demonic satyr forces threatening Kalimdor.
faq.q: What is the history of this place?

text.s: Raynewood Retreat is an ancient night elf outpost perched around a massive great tree in north-central Ashenvale. Guarded by dryads and Cenarion protectors, it serves as a watchful sanctuary monitoring the northern passes toward corrupted Felwood. It is also the sanctuary of Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius targeted by sinister outside forces.

sec.b: Long before the modern conflicts between the Alliance and Horde, Raynewood Retreat served as a military staging ground for night elf defenders during the ancient War of the Satyr millennia ago. Today, the encampment retains its sacred martial purpose. Nestled between Shael'dryn's moonwell and the satyr-infested ruins of Night Run, the outpost is fiercely guarded by Cenarion Protectors, faerie dragons, and Laughing Sisters. Their collective vigilance keeps a wary eye on the encroaching taint descending from Felwood just to the north.

High atop the boughs of the great tree resides Keeper Ordanus, one of Cenarius's eldest sons. While the canopy offers him refuge, it has also become a focal point of dark intrigue. Agents aligned with the shadowy remnants of the Shadow Council, notably Braelyn Firehand, seek the keeper's demise. Horde mercenaries are dispatched to storm the heights and claim his head, turning what should be a peaceful forest sanctuary into a battleground.

subzone:razor-hill.s: Cerrotajo. Cerrotajo es el principal asentamiento de la Horda en el centro de Durotar, enclavado en la encrucijada estratégica entre el Valle de los Retos, Los Baldíos y Orgrimmar. Centrado en torno a unos prominentes barracones fortificados, sirve de base de operaciones y centro de instrucción para jóvenes guerreros orcos y troles que ponen a prueba su valía en estas tierras salvajes e implacables. Construido en un nudo geográfico vital, Cerrotajo conecta el norte de Durotar con los asentamientos costeros del sur y las extensas llanuras de Los Baldíos al otro lado del Río Furia del Sur. Dominado por sus barracones de piedra y madera y sus clásicas madrigueras orcas, el asentamiento se estableció en los primeros compases de la fundación de Durotar. Poco después de la Tercera Guerra, fuerzas humanas de Kul Tiras atrajeron a la Horda a una emboscada en este lugar con el pretexto de una cumbre de emisarios; un asalto frustrado cuando Rexxar acudió en lugar de Thrall. En la actualidad, el puesto de avanzada está completamente fortificado frente a nuevas incursiones costeras.

ang.faction:Horde: As the first true town encountered after leaving the training grounds, Razor Hill serves as the launchpad for young Horde soldiers proving their loyalty to Thrall's new nation.
ang.race:Orc: Razor Hill stands as a testament to the new life orcs have carved out in Durotar, trading demonic servitude for sturdy burrows and hard-won survival.

faq.a: Razor Hill serves as the main administrative and defensive outpost in central Durotar. It connects the southern shores and the Valley of Trials to Orgrimmar in the north and the Barrens to the west, while providing supplies and training for young adventurers.
faq.q: What is Razor Hill's purpose in Durotar?

faq.a: Following the Third War, forces loyal to Kul Tiras offered a peaceful summit with Warchief Thrall at Razor Hill. Suspecting treachery, the champion Rexxar went in Thrall's place, uncovered an ambush, and defeated the human assassins.
al: what happened at razor hill summit
faq.q: What happened here during the Kul Tiras invasion?

faq.a: The settlement's garrison is commanded by the orc veteran Gar'Thok from within the town's barracks, overseeing patrols against human remnants and local wild beasts.
faq.q: Who commands the settlement?

faq.a: The shadowy demonic cult has infiltrated hidden crags and canyons around central Durotar. Horde scouts, directed by Orgnil Soulscar, work out of Razor Hill to uncover their covens and eliminate their influence.
faq.q: What is the Burning Blade doing near Razor Hill?

text.s: Razor Hill is the principal Horde settlement in central Durotar, nestled at the strategic crossroads between the Valley of Trials, the Barrens, and Orgrimmar. Centered around a prominent fortified barracks, it serves as the staging ground and training center for young orc and troll warriors testing their mettle in the harsh wilderness.

sec.b: Built at a vital geographical junction, Razor Hill connects northern Durotar with the coastal settlements to the south and the sprawling plains of the Barrens across the Southfury River. Dominated by its stone-and-timber barracks and classic orcish burrows, the settlement was established early in the founding of Durotar. Shortly after the Third War, human forces from Kul Tiras lured the Horde into an ambush here under the guise of an emissary summit, an assault thwarted when Rexxar went in Thrall's stead. Today, the outpost stands fully fortified against further coastal incursions.

Under the command of veteran officers like Gar'Thok, Razor Hill coordinates local defense against several looming threats. Human marine remnants still hold Tiragarde Keep along the eastern shoreline, while aggressive quilboar and harpy tribes harass local supply lines. Far more insidious is the presence of the Burning Blade cult, whose shadowy rituals and corrupted agents in the nearby crags are closely tracked and stamped out by investigators like Orgnil Soulscar.

subzone:razorfen-downs.s: Zahúrda Rajacieno. Zahúrda Rajacieno es la capital ancestral y el laberinto funerario sagrado de los jabaespines, excavada en lo profundo de las colosales zarzas que bordean el sur de Los Baldíos y Las Mil Agujas. Antaño su santuario más sagrado, ha caído bajo el influjo de la Plaga no-muerta, transformándose en un bastión purulento de nigromancia. Venerada durante mucho tiempo como la capital ancestral y los campos funerarios de la raza de los jabaespines, Zahúrda Rajacieno descansa en el interior de las colosales zarzas petrificadas nacidas del semidiós caído Agamaggan. La leyenda cuenta que su entrada arqueada fue tallada directamente de las mismísimas fauces del Gran Jabalí. Durante siglos, los sumos sacerdotes de la tribu Caramuerte cuidaron de estas madrigueras profundas y serpenteantes, y honraron a sus venerados muertos. Sin embargo, a pesar de su estatus sagrado entre la gente jabalí, el laberinto de huesos y zarzas ha sufrido recientemente una catástrofe mucho más oscura que cualquier disputa por el agua de Los Baldíos.

ang.faction:Horde: The quilboar are a constant thorn in the side of the Crossroads, but an outpost of the Lich King right on the edge of the Barrens is an existential menace that the Horde cannot afford to ignore.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, discovering a Scourge lich operating covertly on Kalimdor is a chilling reminder of the master they rebelled against, demanding swift and decisive eradication.

faq.a: Razorfen Downs is the ancestral capital city and burial grounds of the quilboar race. Grown from the enormous thorn brambles formed by the fallen Ancient Agamaggan, it serves as the spiritual heart of quilboar culture and the headquarters of their high priesthood, the Death's Head tribe.
faq.q: What is Razorfen Downs?

faq.a: The lich Amnennar the Coldbringer arrived following the Third War to establish a Kalimdor stronghold for the Lich King. By corrupting the Death's Head priesthood and raising quilboar dead, Amnennar turned the labyrinthine thorn city into a hidden nest of necromantic power.
al: why are there undead in razorfen downs
faq.q: Why is the Scourge inside Razorfen Downs?

faq.a: Razorfen Kraul is the primary military redoubt and living warren of the quilboar, ruled directly by the crone Charlga Razorflank. In contrast, the Downs is their traditional capital and sacred burial ground, deeper south, which has fallen under the sway of necromancy and Scourge control.
faq.q: How does Razorfen Downs differ from Razorfen Kraul?

faq.a: The Downs is situated at the very southern border of the Barrens, overlooking the great drop into Thousand Needles. Its entrance is a natural arched fissure nestled into the towering, tangled brambles, reputed in myth to be carved from Agamaggan's gaping maw.
al: how to get into razorfen downs
faq.q: Where is the entrance located?

text.s: Razorfen Downs is the ancestral capital and sacred burial labyrinth of the quilboar, carved deep into the colossal brambles bordering the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles. Once their holiest sanctuary, it has fallen under the sway of the undead Scourge, transforming into a festering bastion of necromancy.

sec.b: Long revered as the ancestral capital city and burial grounds of the quilboar race, Razorfen Downs rests within the colossal petrified briars sprung from the fallen demigod Agamaggan. Legend holds that its arched entryway was carved directly from the Great Boar's very maw. For centuries, the high priests of the Death's Head tribe tended these deep, winding burrows and honored their revered dead. Yet despite its sacred standing among the boar-folk, the maze of bone and bramble has recently suffered a catastrophe far darker than any squabble over Barrens water.

Following the devastation of the Third War, the tendrils of the undead Scourge reached silently into southern Kalimdor. Led by the frost-wielding lich Amnennar the Coldbringer, agents of death infiltrated the thorn maze and subverted the Death's Head priesthood. Instead of honoring their ancestors, the quilboar now harbor rotting ghouls, skeletons, and necromancers within their sacred pens. The corruption here threatens to fester outward across the Barrens, turning the quilboar's holiest ground into a launchpad for the Scourge's ambitions in the west.

subzone:razorfen-downs-classic.s: Zahúrda Rajacieno (Classic). Zahúrda Rajacieno es el cementerio ancestral y la capital tradicional de los jabaespines, enclavada en las profundidades de unas gigantescas zarzas espinosas en el sur de Los Baldíos. Recientemente, agentes de la Plaga de los no-muertos liderados por el exánime Amnennar el Gélido tomaron el control del laberinto, reanimando a los jabaespines muertos y amenazando con expandir su dominio por el centro de Kalimdor. Nacida de las mismas enredaderas gigantescas y petrificadas que el cercano Horado Rajacieno, Zahúrda Rajacieno descansa donde el antiguo semidiós jabalí Agamaggan cayó durante la Guerra de los Ancestros. Durante generaciones, el laberinto de espinas sirvió como la necrópolis sagrada y la sede del poder de los jabaespín, custodiada de cerca por los místicos de la tribu Caramuerte. Para los jabaespín, las densas zarzas son tierra sagrada, empapada con la sangre de su divino progenitor.

ang.faction:Horde: The presence of a Scourge citadel right along the southern border of the Barrens poses an imminent threat to the Horde's heartland and supply routes.
ang.race:Undead: The Royal Apothecary Society and Forsaken leadership in the Undercity take intense interest in investigating and purging the rival necromantic magic blooming within the Downs.

faq.a: Razorfen Downs is the ancestral capital and necropolis of the quilboar race, carved into massive briars in the southern Barrens. It has recently fallen under the control of the Scourge.
faq.q: What is Razorfen Downs?

faq.a: A Scourge lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer invaded the Downs, subjugating the local Death's Head tribe and raising dead quilboar to build an undead beachhead on Kalimdor.
faq.q: Why are there undead inside a quilboar city?

faq.a: Both dungeons are carved from the brambles of Agamaggan, but Razorfen Kraul serves as the living quilboar stronghold led by Charlga Razorflank. Razorfen Downs is their ancestral burial ground, currently overrun by the Scourge.
faq.q: What is the difference between Razorfen Downs and Razorfen Kraul?

faq.a: Amnennar the Coldbringer, a lich of the Scourge, commands the stronghold from deep within the Spiral of Thorns.
faq.q: Who rules Razorfen Downs right now?

text.s: Razorfen Downs is the ancestral burial ground and traditional capital city of the quilboar, nestled deep within giant thorny brambles in the southern Barrens. Recently, agents of the undead Scourge led by the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer seized control of the labyrinth, reanimating the quilboar dead and threatening to expand their dominion across central Kalimdor.

sec.b: Grown from the same towering, petrified vines as nearby Razorfen Kraul, Razorfen Downs rests where the ancient boar demigod Agamaggan fell during the War of the Ancients. For generations, the labyrinth of thorns served as the sacred necropolis and seat of power for the quilboar, guarded closely by the mystics of the Death's Head tribe. To the quilboar, the dense briars are holy ground, soaked in the blood of their divine progenitor.

The sanctity of the Downs was shattered when agents of the Scourge infiltrated the brambles. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a powerful lich serving the Lich King, subjugated the resident Death's Head quilboar and turned the ancestral resting grounds into an undead redoubt. Reanimated skeletons, shambling corpses, and shrieking banshees now prowl the Spiral of Thorns. Both the Horde in the nearby Barrens and emissaries from the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind view this growing pocket of Scourge power as a grave threat to the continent.

subzone:razorfen-kraul-classic.s: Rajacieno Kraul (Classic). Horado Rajacieno es el corazón ancestral de los jabaespines, excavado en las colosales espinas que brotaron de la sangre del semidiós jabalí caído Agamaggan. Gobernado por la despiadada vieja Charlga Filonavaja, este laberinto fortificado sirve como base de operaciones para sangrientas incursiones por el sur de Los Baldíos. Hace diez mil años, durante la Guerra de los Ancestros, el colosal semidiós jabalí Agamaggan pereció luchando contra la Legión Ardiente para salvar Azeroth. Allá donde su sangre sagrada se filtró en la tierra del sur de Kalimdor, brotaron del suelo enormes e impenetrables zarzas de espinas. Los jabaespines, creyéndose los vástagos mortales del Gran Jabalí, se reunieron en estas densas zarzas para morar y venerar su sacrificio. La densa masa conocida como Horado Rajacieno se erige como su reducto más venerado, repleto de guerreros jabaespines, adiestradores de bestias y chamanes que moldean la tierra.

ang.faction:Horde: Charlga Razorflank's aggressive raids directly threaten southern settlements and trade routes, making pacifying the Kraul an urgent security priority for the Horde.
ang.race:Tauren: Tauren hunters and shamans hold deep historical enmity with the quilboar, and the rumors of unholy Scourge corruption taking root in the revered earth of Agamaggan demand their swift intervention.

faq.a: According to legend, the colossal thorn vines sprouted wherever the blood of the boar demigod Agamaggan struck the ground during the War of the Ancients ten thousand years ago.
faq.q: What created the giant thorns around Razorfen Kraul?

faq.a: Razorfen Kraul is commanded by Charlga Razorflank, a ruthless quilboar crone and geomancer who directs raids against neighboring tribes and settlements.
faq.q: Who rules Razorfen Kraul?

faq.a: Charlga Razorflank has reportedly entered secret negotiations with agents of the Scourge, seeking an unholy alliance that could bring the power of undeath into the quilboar folds.
faq.q: Why are there undead near the Kraul?

faq.a: Razorfen Kraul is situated in the southernmost reaches of the Barrens, nestled on the western side of the colossal thorn thickets just north of the Great Lift.
faq.q: Where is Razorfen Kraul located?

text.s: Razorfen Kraul is the ancestral heartland of the quilboar, carved deep into the colossal thorns that sprang from the blood of the fallen boar demigod Agamaggan. Ruled by the ruthless crone Charlga Razorflank, this fortified labyrinth serves as a staging ground for bloody raids across the southern Barrens.

sec.b: Ten thousand years ago during the War of the Ancients, the colossal boar demigod Agamaggan perished battling the Burning Legion to save Azeroth. Wherever his sacred blood seeped into the soil of southern Kalimdor, massive, impenetrable thorn vines erupted from the earth. The quilboar, believing themselves the mortal progeny of the Great Boar, gathered within these dense briars to dwell and venerate his sacrifice. The dense mass known as Razorfen Kraul stands as their most revered redoubt, thick with quilboar warriors, beast trainers, and earth-shaping shamans.

Control over the Kraul has fallen to the aging geomancer Charlga Razorflank. Under her iron rule, the Razorfen tribe has waged merciless war against rival quilboar bands and nearby Horde encampments alike. Far more chilling than mere territorial raiding, however, are reports from watchful scouts noting undead figures lurking around the thorny briars. Whispers suggest that Charlga has begun bargaining with agents of the Scourge, endangering not only the Barrens but threatening to open a grim foothold for undeath on Kalimdor.

subzone:razormane-grounds.s: Tierras Crines de Acero. Las Tierras Crines de Acero forman el campamento de avanzada de los jabaespines Crines de Acero que avanzan hacia el este desde Los Baldíos hacia el centro de Durotar. Atestado de afiladas zarzas y de los cadáveres desollados de animales salvajes, este erizado puesto de avanzada sirve como primera línea en el incesante conflicto de los jabaespines contra los orcos de Orgrimmar. Extendiéndose bajo los riscos rojos del centro de Durotar, las Tierras Crines de Acero marcan el punto más oriental de la expansión de los jabaespines fuera de Los Baldíos. Enredado en espesas zarzas y rodeado de huesos blanqueados, el campamento supone un peligro constante para los viajeros a lo largo del Río Furia del Sur. El campamento está liderado por figuras como el capitán Colmillo Plano de la Guardia de Batalla y el geoseñor Motas, quienes orquestan incursiones contra los asentamientos orcos vecinos y las líneas de suministro de paso. A pesar de las patrullas regulares enviadas desde Cerrotajo y los puestos de avanzada cercanos, los Crines de Acero reponen sus filas sin descanso, brotando de las zarzas más rápido de lo que la Horda puede erradicarlos.

ang.faction:Horde: Keeping the Razormane Grounds suppressed is vital to securing travel and supply lines between the Barrens and the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.
ang.race:Orc: For the orcs of Durotar, the Razormane Grounds are a persistent threat right in the heart of their new homeland, requiring young warriors to prove their mettle by culling the quilboar.

faq.a: It is a fortified quilboar encampment in central Durotar, acting as a forward base for the Razormane tribe as they expand eastward from the Barrens.
faq.q: What is the Razormane Grounds?

faq.a: The Razormane quilboar view all neighboring territories as rightfully theirs, seeking to expand their thorny thickets and hunting lands at the expense of the new Horde settlements.
faq.q: Why are the quilboar attacking Durotar?

faq.a: The encampment is commanded by Captain Flat Tusk, leader of the Razormane Battleguard, alongside the earth-shaping geomancer Geolord Mottle.
faq.q: Who leads the quilboar at the Razormane Grounds?

faq.a: The Razormane are aggressive scavengers and hunters who strip the local wildlife down to the bone to feed their raiders, leaving the carcasses behind to mark their territory.
faq.q: Why are there so many bones around the camp?

text.s: The Razormane Grounds form the forward encampment of the Razormane quilboar pushing eastward from the Barrens into central Durotar. Choked with sharp briars and the stripped carcasses of wild game, this bristling outpost serves as the frontline in the quilboars' unending clash with the orcs of Orgrimmar.

sec.b: Sprawling beneath the red cliffs of central Durotar, the Razormane Grounds mark the furthest eastern reach of quilboar expansion out of the Barrens. Entangled within thick brambles and surrounded by bleached bones, the encampment poses a constant danger to travelers along the Southfury River. The camp is led by figures such as Captain Flat Tusk of the Battleguard and Geolord Mottle, who orchestrate raids against neighboring orc settlements and passing supply lines. Despite regular patrols dispatched from Razor Hill and nearby outposts, the Razormane replenish their ranks tirelessly, sprouting from the briars faster than the Horde can clear them.

subzone:razorwind-canyon.s: Cañón del Ventajo. El Cañón del Ventajo es un barranco rocoso y serpenteante dividido a través del camino principal entre Cerrotajo y Orgrimmar. Infestado por las agresivas arpías Dustwind, el cañón representa un peligro constante para los viajeros que avanzan hacia el norte, rumbo a la capital de la Horda. El Cañón del Ventajo flanquea la arteria central que une Cerrotajo con Orgrimmar, abriendo caminos tanto hacia los riscos orientales como hacia los matorrales occidentales en dirección a la Granja Tor'kren. El cañón es el lugar de anidación de las arpías Dustwind, criaturas territoriales que atacan sin vacilar a los viajeros que se acercan demasiado a sus dormideros. Su presencia tan cerca de las rutas comerciales de la capital hace que limpiar estos barrancos sea una necesidad constante para los defensores de Durotar.

ang.faction:Horde: Clearing the Dustwind harpies from Razorwind Canyon is vital to keeping the main thoroughfare between Razor Hill and the capital of Orgrimmar safe for couriers and fresh recruits.
ang.race:Orc: The harpies nesting right along Durotar's central roadway are an insult to the security of the orcish homeland, requiring young warriors to cull their numbers.

faq.a: Razorwind Canyon is located in central Durotar, flanking both sides of the main road running between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. Entrances lead into it north of Razor Hill, near Tor'kren Farm, and through a cave connecting to Drygulch Ravine.
faq.q: Where is Razorwind Canyon located?

faq.a: The canyon is heavily inhabited by the Dustwind harpies. These aggressive, avian creatures nest in large clutches throughout the gullies and rocky outcroppings, preying on unwary travelers.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit Razorwind Canyon?

faq.a: Razorwind Canyon borders the primary trade and travel route between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. The nesting harpies frequently harass couriers, supply caravans, and travelers passing along the central road.
faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about this canyon?

faq.a: Yes. In addition to opening onto the main road, the canyon provides trails west toward Tor'kren Farm, as well as an eastern cavern leading into Drygulch Ravine.
faq.q: Does Razorwind Canyon connect to other areas?

text.s: Razorwind Canyon is a winding, rocky gulch split across the main road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. Infested by the aggressive Dustwind harpies, the canyon poses a persistent danger to travelers moving north toward the Horde's capital.

sec.b: Razorwind Canyon flanks the central artery linking Razor Hill to Orgrimmar, carving paths into both the eastern bluffs and the western scrublands toward Tor'kren Farm. The canyon is the nesting ground of the Dustwind harpies, territorial creatures that strike without hesitation at travelers who stray too close to their roosts. Their presence so near the capital's trade routes makes clearing out these gullies an ongoing necessity for the defenders of Durotar.
sec.t: A Threat on the High Road

sec.b: Beyond serving as harpy nests, the twists of Razorwind Canyon function as hidden routes through Durotar's red rock hills. The eastern branch tunnels deeply into the crags, providing a passage through a cavern into Drygulch Ravine. Because the harpies roost on the high perches and descend in flocks, unwary adventurers traversing these passes can easily find themselves surrounded and cut down.

subzone:red-rocks.s: Roca Roja. Roca Roja es un imponente risco de arenisca en el noreste de Mulgore que sirve como cementerio ancestral sagrado para los tauren. Aquí, los campeones caídos son encomendados a la Madre Tierra mediante llamas purificadoras, y los jóvenes bravos viajan a sus tranquilas alturas para buscar la sabiduría de sus antepasados. Elevándose sobre las llanuras del noreste de Mulgore, las formaciones carmesíes de Roca Roja marcan un umbral sagrado entre el mundo de los vivos y el más allá. La tradición tauren reserva este solemne terreno para sus héroes más valerosos: caudillos, defensores y campeones que dieron sus vidas fundando y protegiendo Cima del Trueno. Sus restos son entregados al cielo y a la tierra a través de piras ceremoniales, devolviendo sus espíritus a la Madre Tierra y al Padre Cielo. Es igualmente un lugar de inicio espiritual, donde los jóvenes tauren completan sus ritos de iniciación honrando las tumbas ancestrales y comunicándose con el viento.

ang.class:Shaman: The wind carries the sorrow of unsettled spirits disturbed by quilboar defilement, calling on shamanic rites to restore elemental balance and ancestral peace.
ang.race:Tauren: For your people, Red Rocks is sacred soil. The presence of foul quilboar rooting among your honored ancestors' pyres is an open outrage that demands cleansing.

faq.a: Red Rocks serves as the premier ancestral burial ground and ceremonial rite site for the tauren of Mulgore. Fallen heroes and honored braves are cremated here to return their spirits to the Earth Mother, and young tauren visit its heights to honor the dead during their trials of adulthood.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Red Rocks?

faq.a: The Bristleback quilboar pushed out from their bramble burrows and overrun the plateau, defiling the burial mounds. Their intrusion is seen by the tauren as an intolerable sacrilege against the resting spirits of their ancestors.
faq.q: Why are there quilboar at Red Rocks?

faq.a: Burial at Red Rocks is an honor reserved for the most valiant tauren, including great warriors who fought alongside Cairne Bloodhoof to secure Mulgore and build Thunder Bluff, as well as heroes who died serving their tribes.
faq.q: Who is buried at Red Rocks?

faq.a: Beyond funerary pyres commended to the Earth Mother and Sky Father, the bluff is a focal point for the Rite of Wisdom, where tauren braves leave offerings and listen for the guidance of ancestral spirits on the wind.
faq.q: What ceremonies are performed here?

text.s: Red Rocks is a towering sandstone bluff in northeastern Mulgore that serves as a sacred ancestral burial ground for the tauren.
