Here, fallen champions are commended to the Earth Mother through cleansing flame, and young braves travel to its quiet heights to seek the wisdom of their forebears.

sec.b: Rising high above the plains of northeastern Mulgore, the crimson formations of Red Rocks mark a sacred threshold between the living world and the next. Tauren tradition reserves this solemn ground for their most valiant heroes—chieftains, defenders, and champions who gave their lives founding and protecting Thunder Bluff. Their remains are surrendered to the sky and soil through ceremonial pyres, returning their spirits to the Earth Mother and Sky Father. It is equally a place of spiritual beginning, where young tauren complete their rites of passage by honoring the ancestral graves and communing with the wind.

The enduring peace of Red Rocks has been shattered by the Bristleback quilboar. Creeping out from their dens, these aggressive scavengers have infested the sandstone ledges and desecrated the ancestral burial pyres with filth. This violation deeply affronts the spiritual traditions of Thunder Bluff. Shaman and lorekeepers now summon aid to cleanse the crags, driving out the Bristlebacks and reclaiming the sanctity of their resting dead.

subzone:remtravel-s-excavation.s: Excavación de Tripirrem. La Excavación de Tripirrem es un yacimiento arqueológico situado en los confines meridionales de Costa Oscura. Establecida por el prospector enano Tripirrem, la expedición topó recientemente con antiguas ruinas subterráneas, desenterrando inadvertidamente a hostiles troggs y gólems de piedra que no tardaron en invadir la cantera. El Prospector Tripirrem llegó a Costa Oscura en busca de reliquias de un pasado remoto, estableciendo una ambiciosa excavación lejos de la seguridad de Auberdine. Mientras excavaba estratos antiguos, su equipo desenterró un enjambre de troggs Gravelflint subterráneos junto a descomunales gólems de piedra sepultados bajo tierra. El lugar pasó al instante de ser una cantera académica a una zona de peligro, dispersando a los mineros y dejando a Tripirrem luchando por recuperar sus hallazgos más prometedores.

ang.race:Dwarf: Dwarven explorers of the Explorers' League are well known for seeking the secrets of the past, though unearthing dangerous troggs in foreign lands often leads to familiar headaches.
ang.race:NightElf: The kaldorei generally observe the deep meddling of Alliance dwarven picks with skepticism, especially when careless delving awakens wild troggs on Darkshore's ancient soil.

faq.a: It is an archaeological dig site in southern Darkshore founded by Prospector Remtravel, an explorer searching for ancient fossils and subterranean relics.
faq.q: What is Remtravel's Excavation?

faq.a: Dwarven miners dug too deeply into the earth and breached subterranean caverns, awakening a local tribe known as the Gravelflint troggs alongside dormant stone golems.
faq.q: Why are there troggs here?

faq.a: He is a dwarven archaeologist leading the excavation. Known for his keen eye for artifacts as well as his absent-minded nature, he lost track of a key fossil when his dig was attacked.
faq.q: Who is Prospector Remtravel?

faq.a: Remtravel discovered an unusual fossil imbued with strange, mystic properties shortly before the troggs surged from the lower depths.
faq.q: What kind of relic was discovered here?

text.s: Remtravel's Excavation is an archaeological dig site located in the southern reaches of Darkshore. Established by the dwarven Prospector Remtravel, the expedition recently struck ancient subterranean ruins, inadvertently unearthing hostile troggs and stone golems that quickly overran the quarry.

sec.b: Prospector Remtravel came to Darkshore in search of relics of the distant past, establishing an ambitious dig far from the safety of Auberdine. While excavating ancient strata, his team unearthed a swarm of subterranean Gravelflint troggs alongside hulking stone golems buried beneath the earth. The site was instantly transformed from a scholarly quarry into a hazard zone, scattering the miners and leaving Remtravel scrambling to retrieve his most promising findings.

Before the excavation descended into chaos, Remtravel had uncovered a rare fossil radiating curious mystic properties. In the panic of the trogg onslaught—and hindered by his notorious absent-mindedness—the prospector misplaced the valuable relic amid the sprawling dirt pits. Venturing down into the dig to recover it means braving both the vicious troggs and the ancient automatons awakened by the pickaxes.

subzone:render-s-rock.s: Roca de Render. Roca de Render es una caverna fortificada oculta en los riscos noroccidentales de las Montañas Crestagrana, situada cerca del paso elevado que conduce hacia Las Estepas Ardientes. Controlada por los feroces orcos Roca Negra, sirve como reducto avanzado y punto de partida activo para sus incursiones en los valles de abajo. Escavada en las escarpadas alturas al norte de Villa del Lago, Roca de Render sirve como un sistema de cuevas fortificado para el invasor Clan Roca Negra. Desde este reducto defendible cerca del paso de montaña hacia Las Estepas Ardientes, veteranos orcos Roca Negra orquestan ataques contra los defensores locales de Crestagrana. Sus profundidades sombrías están estrictamente vigiladas, lo que convierte cualquier incursión en su interior en una empresa peligrosa para aquellos que buscan interrumpir las líneas de suministro orcas o rescatar a los cautivos perdidos en el conflicto en curso.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance fighters, Render's Rock represents one of the most entrenched Blackrock positions in Redridge, and clearing it is vital for freeing Corporal Keeshan and protecting Lakeshire.

faq.a: Render's Rock is situated in the far northwestern peaks of the Redridge Mountains, nestled near the path leading north into the Burning Steppes.
faq.q: Where is Render's Rock located?

faq.a: The cave is occupied by formidable Blackrock orcs who use the crag as a redoubt to coordinate attacks and oversee the mountain passes bordering the Burning Steppes.
faq.q: Who controls Render's Rock?

faq.a: Corporal Keeshan, a wounded veteran soldier of the Alliance garrison, is held captive inside Render's Rock and requires assistance to safely escape back to Lakeshire.
al: who is trapped in renders rock
faq.q: Who is imprisoned inside the cave?

faq.a: Because it harbors experienced Blackrock warriors right above the Redridge valley, Render's Rock poses an immediate threat to the town of Lakeshire and allows the orcs to maintain a foothold south of the Burning Steppes.
faq.q: Why is this cave important to Lakeshire's defense?

text.s: Render's Rock is a cavern stronghold tucked into the northwestern crags of the Redridge Mountains, sitting near the high pass leading toward the Burning Steppes. Controlled by the fierce Blackrock orcs, it serves as a forward redoubt and an active staging ground for their raids on the valleys below.

sec.b: Carved into the rugged heights north of Lakeshire, Render's Rock serves as a fortified cave system for the invading Blackrock clan. From this defensible redoubt near the mountain pass to the Burning Steppes, veteran Blackrock orcs orchestrate attacks against the local defenders of Redridge. Its shadowed depths are strictly guarded, making any foray inside a perilous undertaking for those seeking to disrupt the orcish supply lines or recover captives lost in the ongoing conflict.
sec.t: A Blackrock Bastion in the Heights

sec.b: Beyond its strategic value to the orcs, Render's Rock holds grim importance for the defenders of Lakeshire. The wounded Redridge soldier Corporal Keeshan is held captive within its recesses. Deep behind enemy lines and isolated from his companions, Keeshan's captivity represents both the audacity of the Blackrock incursions and the high price the local garrison has paid trying to keep the mountain road open.

subzone:render-s-valley.s: Valle de Render. El Valle de Render es un campamento escondido y controlado por orcos Rocanegra en el sureste de las Montañas Crestagrana. Mucho menos atrincherado que las enormes fortalezas de Petravista, supone no obstante una amenaza constante para los viajeros cercanos y alberga cautivos apresados en las tierras circundantes. Escondido entre las crestas rocosas al sureste del Lago Sempiterno, el Valle de Render sirve como campamento auxiliar para los orcos Rocanegra que operan en Crestagrana. A diferencia de las fortalezas fuertemente fortificadas y las torres de piedra de los riscos del norte, el valle consta de una modesta agrupación de tiendas de guerra, estandartes y puestos de vigilancia. A pesar de ser más pequeño y estar menos armado que las fuerzas principales del clan, los guerreros de aquí asaltan los caminos locales, hostigan a los viajeros y mantienen prisioneros capturados bajo vigilancia en toscas jaulas.

ang.faction:Alliance: The camp is a secondary Blackrock raiding outpost that threatens southern Redridge, making its clearing vital for securing trade and travel in Lakeshire.
ang.profession:Tailoring: The Captured Servant of Azora imprisoned in the orc camp offers unique tailoring patterns and materials to craftsmen willing to fight through the sentries to reach him.

faq.a: The valley is occupied by the Blackrock clan, an aggressive orcish faction that has pushed south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge to conquer territory and harass human settlements.
al: what clan is in renders valley
faq.q: Who controls Render's Valley?

faq.a: No. The Blackrock warriors stationed in Render's Valley are generally younger or less formidable skirmishers compared to the hardened elite forces garrisoning Stonewatch Keep to the north.
al: how strong are the orcs here
faq.q: Are the orcs here as dangerous as the ones at Stonewatch?

faq.a: A servant affiliated with the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest was captured by the Blackrock clan and held here in a cage. Those brave enough to reach him can acquire specialized tailoring supplies.
faq.q: Who is the prisoner kept in the camp?

faq.a: Yes. A steep, unofficial mountain trail winds through the southern bluffs just past Render's Valley, offering a hidden shortcut directly into the northern marches of the Swamp of Sorrows.
faq.q: Can you reach the Swamp of Sorrows from here?

text.s: Render's Valley is a tucked-away encampment held by Blackrock orcs in the southeastern Redridge Mountains. Far less entrenched than the massive fortresses of Stonewatch, it nonetheless poses a persistent threat to nearby travelers and hosts captives taken from surrounding lands.

sec.b: Tucked among the rocky ridges southeast of Lake Everstill, Render's Valley serves as an auxiliary camp for the Blackrock orcs operating in Redridge. Unlike the heavily fortified keeps and stone towers of the northern cliffs, the valley consists of a modest cluster of war tents, banners, and sentry outposts. Despite being smaller and less armed than the clan's core forces, the warriors here raid local roads, harass travelers, and keep captured prisoners in crude cages under guard.

Beyond the war parties roaming its dirt paths, the valley holds unexpected points of interest for intrepid scouts. Human prisoners have occasionally been sighted within the camp, including a captive servant connected to the Tower of Azora who managed to trade specialist goods right under his captors' noses. Additionally, rugged and unmarked pathways through the high southern bluffs behind the valley allow daring pathfinders to slip across the border into the murky bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows.

subzone:ridgepoint-tower.s: Torre de la Peña. La Torre de la Peña es un puesto de guardia fortificado que vigila la frontera oriental del Bosque de Elwynn. Guarnecida por la Guardia de Ventormenta, sirve como baluarte de alerta temprana contra las incursiones hostiles que amenazan el corazón del reino. Sus guardias vigilan constantemente los peligrosos pasos que conducen a las tierras salvajes vecinas. Erigida como centinela en el terreno elevado del este del Bosque de Elwynn, la Torre de la Peña marca el último bastión de la autoridad directa de Ventormenta antes de que se impongan las tierras salvajes indómitas. La guarnición apostada aquí mantiene una vigilancia constante sobre los valles y caminos circundantes. Con las crecientes tensiones en todo el continente, esta atalaya de piedra garantiza que las amenazas invasoras sean detectadas y contenidas antes de que puedan poner en peligro las granjas y asentamientos más cercanos a Northshire y Villadorada.

ang.class:Warrior: Soldiers and mercenaries alike can respect the stoic resolve of the guardsmen holding such an exposed border outpost against surrounding hostiles.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers, Ridgepoint Tower is a reassuring beacon of safety and order before crossing into the perilous passes of Redridge or the haunted roads of Duskwood.

faq.a: Ridgepoint Tower is a fortified scout tower operated by the Stormwind Guard in eastern Elwynn Forest. It serves as a frontline watchpost tasked with alerting and protecting the kingdom from hostile intrusions.
faq.q: What is Ridgepoint Tower?

faq.a: The tower is held and garrisoned by guardsmen and scouts loyal to the Kingdom of Stormwind, operating under the command of the Stormwind Guard.
faq.q: Who controls and mans the tower?

faq.a: The guards watch for gnolls and invading orcs spilling out of the Redridge Mountains, undead crossing from the blighted groves of Duskwood, and Defias bandits operating in clandestine woodland camps nearby.
faq.q: What threats does the garrison watch out for?

faq.a: It stands on the elevated ground in the far eastern reaches of Elwynn Forest, near the borders connecting Elwynn with both Redridge Mountains and Duskwood.
faq.q: Where is Ridgepoint Tower located?

text.s: Ridgepoint Tower is a fortified guard post watching the eastern frontier of Elwynn Forest. Manned by the Stormwind Guard, it serves as an early warning bulwark against hostile incursions threatening the heart of the kingdom. Its guards keep vigil over the perilous corridors leading to neighboring wilderness.

sec.b: Standing sentinel on the high ground of eastern Elwynn Forest, Ridgepoint Tower marks the final bastion of direct Stormwind authority before the untamed wilds take over. The garrison stationed here keeps a constant watch over the surrounding valleys and roads. With tensions mounting across the continent, this stone watchtower ensures that encroaching threats are spotted and checked before they can endanger the farms and settlements closer to Northshire and Goldshire.

Ridgepoint Tower faces pressure from multiple frontiers at once. To the east lie the Redridge Mountains, home to aggressive gnoll packs and blackrock orc raiders who test human defenses. Across the southern river looms the shadowy timberline of Duskwood, with its prowling undead horrors. Closer to home, rogue Defias Brotherhood bandits prowl the wilderness camps, eager to exploit any gap in the guard's defensive line.

subzone:rocktusk-farm.s: Granja Rocamuela. La Granja Rocamuela es un pequeño rancho de cerdos situado en el norte de Durotar, siguiendo el camino a las puertas de Orgrimmar. Resguardada cerca de los accesos fortificados de la capital, la granja suministra carne y provisiones vitales a los habitantes de la ciudad. Excavada en el árido suelo de Durotar, la Granja Rocamuela se dedica a la cría de cerdos resistentes y adaptados al duro clima desértico. Debido al terreno notoriamente seco y pedregoso de Durotar, cultivar resulta difícil, lo que convierte a las granjas de cerdos domésticos en un sustento esencial para alimentar a la creciente población de Orgrimmar. Situada cerca del perímetro fortificado de la capital, la hacienda goza de un grado de seguridad rara vez visto en las inhóspitas tierras salvajes de los cañones rojos.

ang.faction:Horde: Settled just outside the capital, the swine reared here are critical sustenance for the warriors and laborers stationed in Orgrimmar.
ang.profession:Cooking: The pigs raised on the farm are prized by Horde cooks searching for fresh pork, ribs, and savory cuts to roast.

faq.a: Rocktusk Farm is a domestic pig farm. It raises swine to supply fresh meat and provisions to the neighboring capital of Orgrimmar, where arable land is scarce.
faq.q: What is Rocktusk Farm used for?

faq.a: The farm sits in northern Durotar, located just southwest down the road from the main gates of Orgrimmar and nestled along the rocky bluffs.
faq.q: Where is Rocktusk Farm located?

faq.a: Its close proximity to Orgrimmar and nearby Horde military patrols keeps it safer than most outlying homesteads in Durotar, though wild beasts and roaming pests still prowl the outskirts.
faq.q: Is the farm safe from wild beasts?

text.s: Rocktusk Farm is a small swine ranch situated in northern Durotar just down the road outside the gates of Orgrimmar. Tucked near the fortified approaches of the capital, the stead supplies vital meat and provisions to the city's inhabitants.

sec.b: Carved out of the arid soil of Durotar, Rocktusk Farm is dedicated to raising hardy swine suited to the rough desert climate. Due to Durotar's notoriously dry and stony ground, raising crops is difficult, making domestic swine farms an essential lifeline for feeding Orgrimmar's burgeoning population. Nestled close to the capital's fortified perimeter, the homestead enjoys a degree of safety rarely found in the harsh wilds of the red canyonlands.

subzone:rogues-quarter.s: Barrio de los Pícaros. Barrio de los Pícaros es un distrito tenuemente iluminado en el ala sureste de Entrañas. Sirve como centro de operaciones para los exploradores, asesinos y operativos del submundo de los Renegados, junto con los artesanos que los respaldan. Escondido en el cuadrante sureste de la ciudad subterránea, Barrio de los Pícaros reúne a los supervivientes más astutos y letales de los Renegados. En vida, muchos fueron ladrones, carteristas o filos silenciosos al servicio del Reino de Lordaeron; en la muerte, su pericia en el sigilo, los venenos y el despiste se ha reorientado para proteger a la naciente nación de la Plaga y de La Cruzada Escarlata. El distrito bulle con una discreta actividad, ofreciendo un refugio clandestino donde los operativos afilan sus dagas, elaboran toxinas mortíferas y perfeccionan habilidades encubiertas.

ang.class:Rogue: For Forsaken and Horde assassins, this quarter is the premier hub for mastering stealth, learning combat techniques, and stocking up on lethal poison reagents.
ang.profession:Engineering: Tinkers visit the Rogues' Quarter to learn schematics and craft bombs, gadgets, and mechanical tools favored by undercover agents.

faq.a: The Rogues' Quarter is situated in the southeastern section of the Undercity's outer ring, past the Trade Quarter.
faq.q: Where is the Rogues' Quarter located?

faq.a: The quarter houses trainers for rogues, as well as instructors for leatherworking, skinning, engineering, and first aid. Poison vendors are also stationed nearby to supply reagents.
faq.q: What trainers can be found here?

faq.a: Surrounded by hostile forces like the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade, the Forsaken rely heavily on espionage, assassination, and hit-and-run tactics to defend their territory, making covert operatives vital to their survival.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken maintain a dedicated district for rogues?

text.s: The Rogues' Quarter is a dimly lit district in the southeastern wing of the Undercity. It serves as the staging ground for the Forsaken's scouts, assassins, and underworld operatives, along with the craftsmen who support them.

sec.b: Tucked away in the southeastern quadrant of the subterranean city, the Rogues' Quarter gathers the Forsaken's most cunning and lethal survivors. In life, many were thieves, cutpurses, or silent blades for the Kingdom of Lordaeron; in death, their expertise in stealth, poisons, and misdirection has been repurposed to protect the fledgling nation from the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. The district hums with quiet activity, offering a covert haven where operatives sharpen their daggers, brew deadly toxins, and hone clandestine skills.

Beyond stealth and assassination, the Rogues' Quarter is home to the specialized trades that enable undercover survival. Artisans gather here to instruct travelers in leatherworking and skinning, turning raw hides into light, silent armor. The clatter of engineering benches echoes through the stone halls as tinkers assemble gadgets, while field medics and apothecaries provide instruction in first aid and vend lethal poisons essential for covert work.

subzone:rolling-plains.s: Las Llanuras Onduladas. Las Llanuras Onduladas abarcan la extensión meridional de Mulgore, extendiéndose entre Poblado Pezuña de Sangre y la frontera con Los Baldíos. Estos pastizales azotados por el viento albergan prósperas manadas de fauna salvaje, pero también son un punto de constante vigilancia debido a los centauros asaltantes que merodean y a las agresivas arpías. Extendiéndose hacia el sur desde Poblado Pezuña de Sangre hacia las puertas naturales de tierra que conducen a Los Baldíos, Las Llanuras Onduladas personifican las vastas y abiertas praderas del hogar tauren. La zona rebosa de piezas de caza esenciales para las tribus, como lobos de las praderas, manadas de kodos, pumas de las llanuras y veloces zancudos. Para los jóvenes cazadores que demuestran su valía ante los ancianos, estas amplias sabanas sirven como un campo de pruebas indispensable donde el rastreo, la paciencia y la reverencia por la naturaleza se ponen a prueba.

ang.class:Hunter: With ample herds of kodo, tallstriders, wolves, and cougars, the Rolling Plains offer an ideal wilderness for honing tracking skills, gathering provisions, and taming first animal companions.
ang.race:Tauren: The Rolling Plains provide vital hunting grounds for the newly unified tribes, but the intrusion of ancient centaur enemies so close to Bloodhoof Village makes guarding this southern corridor a matter of tribal survival.

faq.a: The grasslands support a rich variety of native fauna, including roaming herds of wild kodo, nimble tallstriders, prowling prairie wolves, and stalking flatland cougars. These beasts provide vital meat, hides, and sinew for the tribes of Bloodhoof Village.
faq.q: What animals can be found on the Rolling Plains?

faq.a: The Rolling Plains border the eastern passes into the Barrens, making them the only region in Mulgore where centaur raiders have managed to breach the perimeter. Marauding outriders constantly scout the plains, probing tauren defenses and threatening isolated hunters.
faq.q: Why are centaur found wandering this part of Mulgore?

faq.a: Aside from roaming centaur scouts, a dangerous enclave of Windfury harpies nests along the eastern crags of the region, preying upon unwary travelers and harassing local wildlife.
faq.q: What other hostile creatures threaten the plains?

faq.a: The plains cover much of southern Mulgore, stretching from Bloodhoof Village to the mountain border adjoining the Barrens.
faq.q: Where do the Rolling Plains begin and end?

text.s: The Rolling Plains span the southern expanse of Mulgore, stretching between Bloodhoof Village and the border of the Barrens. These windswept grasslands are home to thriving herds of wildlife, but they are also a point of perpetual vigilance due to prowling centaur raiders and aggressive harpies.

sec.b: Spanning south from Bloodhoof Village toward the natural earthen gates leading into the Barrens, the Rolling Plains embody the vast open ranges of the tauren homeland. The area teems with wild game essential to the tribes, including prairie wolves, kodo herds, flatland cougars, and swift tallstriders. For young hunters proving their worth to the elders, these sweeping savannahs serve as an indispensable proving ground where tracking, patience, and reverence for nature are put to the test.

Despite Mulgore's naturally fortified ring of bluffs, the Rolling Plains remain uniquely exposed to outside threats. It is the only frontier where aggressive centaur outriders have managed to push past defensive perimeters to harass passing travelers and hunting parties. Adding to the peril, a nest of predatory Windfury harpies roosts in the eastern crags, swooping down upon stray game and vulnerable nomadic camps.

subzone:rotting-orchard.s: El Vergel Pútrido. El Vergel Pútrido es una plantación de frutales marchita y abandonada situada en el sur de Bosque del Ocaso. En su día fue una fuente de cosechas para el cercano asentamiento de Villa Oscura, pero ha caído en la ruina y ahora está infestada por rapaces depredadores lupinos conocidos como la manada de los Nocturnos. Ubicado al este de la ruinosa Hacienda Yorgen y al oeste del Cementerio del Jardín Sereno, el Vergel Pútrido se erige como un lúgubre testimonio del declive de Bosque del Ocaso. Los árboles se doblan por el peso de frutos marchitos y podridos, mientras que graneros y dependencias ruinosas han sido convertidos en toscos campamentos por los huargen Nocturnos. Los acechadores nocturnos merodean entre la maleza retorcida, mientras que lanzadores de conjuros oscuros conocidos como tejesombras tejen su siniestra magia entre la madera en descomposición. La manada responde ante su feroz líder, Marus, que acecha por los bosques circundantes vigilando su dominio robado.

ang.class:Hunter: The twisted trees and ruined outbuildings provide prime stalking ground, but the predatory senses and spellcraft of the Nightbane pack make it an ambush waiting to happen.
ang.faction:Alliance: The encroachment of the Nightbane worgen at the Rotting Orchard poses a direct predatory threat to the fragile security of Darkshire just up the road.

faq.a: The orchard is completely infested by the Nightbane pack, a faction of ravenous worgen. These include cunning prowlers called Nightbane Stalkers, dark spellcasters known as Nightbane Shadow Weavers, and their roaming leader, Marus.
faq.q: What creatures occupy the Rotting Orchard?

faq.a: The Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, southwest of the town of Darkshire. It is nestled right between the ruined Yorgen Farmstead to its west and the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery to its east.
faq.q: Where is the Rotting Orchard located in Duskwood?

faq.a: The packleader of the worgen here is named Marus. He prowls the territory between the decaying orchard grounds and his nearby den, aggressively defending the pack's domain.
faq.q: Who leads the worgen in this orchard?

faq.a: No. Like many surrounding homesteads in Duskwood, it was once a productive farm and fruit grove supporting the local human populace before dark curses and supernatural horrors overtook the region and drove the farmers away.
faq.q: Was this place always overrun by monsters?

text.s: The Rotting Orchard is a blighted, abandoned fruit grove situated in southern Duskwood. Once a source of harvest for the nearby settlement of Darkshire, it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by ravenous lupine predators known as the Nightbane pack.

sec.b: Located east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, the Rotting Orchard stands as a grim testament to Duskwood's decline. The trees hang heavy with withered, spoiled fruit, while dilapidated barns and outbuildings have been converted into rough encampments by the Nightbane worgen. Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush, while dark casters known as Shadow Weavers weave their sinister magic amid the decaying timber. The pack answers to their fierce leader, Marus, who prowls the surrounding woods keeping watch over their stolen domain.

subzone:royal-gallery.s: Galería Real. Escondida en el interior del Castillo de Ventormenta tras el jardín del patio, la Galería Real sirve como una tranquila sala del recuerdo. Exhibe magníficas estatuas y bellas obras de arte en honor a figuras destacadas de la historia del reino y de la Gran Alianza. La Galería Real se encuentra adyacente a la Biblioteca Real, justo más allá del verde jardín interior del Castillo de Ventormenta. La sala alberga estatuas de imponentes figuras que forjaron el reino: el Rey Llane Wrynn, el soberano caído de Ventormenta; el Gran Almirante Daelin Valiente de Kul Tiras; y Mara Fordragón, antepasada del actual regente. Sirve a la vez como museo privado de la nobleza y como un retiro tranquilo para visitantes cortesanos como Lady Dena Kennedy.

ang.faction:Alliance: The gallery stands as a quiet monument to the sacrifices of the Alliance, paying homage to legendary leaders like Daelin Proudmoore and King Llane.
ang.race:Human: For humans of Stormwind, this hall honors the legacy of House Wrynn and House Fordragon, preserving their royal heritage within the keep.

faq.a: The Royal Gallery is located inside Stormwind Keep. Head through the keep past the small interior courtyard park, situated right next to the Royal Library.
al: how to get to royal gallery
faq.q: Where is the Royal Gallery located?

faq.a: The gallery features grand statues honoring King Llane Wrynn, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and Mara Fordragon, celebrating the lineage and valor of the kingdom and its closest allies.
faq.q: Which historical figures are commemorated here?

faq.a: Lady Dena Kennedy can frequently be found admiring the fine art and reflective atmosphere of the gallery.
faq.q: Who can be found visiting the gallery?

faq.a: While situated immediately next to one another in the royal wing of Stormwind Keep, they are distinct chambers. The library houses royal archives and scholars, while the gallery focuses on fine art and memorial sculpture.
al: is it part of the library
faq.q: What is the difference between the Royal Gallery and the Royal Library?

text.s: Tucked away inside Stormwind Keep past the courtyard garden, the Royal Gallery serves as a quiet hall of remembrance. It displays magnificent statues and fine works of art honoring prominent figures from the kingdom's history and the Grand Alliance.

sec.b: The Royal Gallery sits adjacent to the Royal Library, just beyond the verdant interior garden of Stormwind Keep. The hall houses statues of towering figures who shaped the realm: King Llane Wrynn, the fallen ruler of Stormwind; Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras; and Mara Fordragon, ancestor of the current Regent. It serves as both a private museum of noble heritage and a quiet retreat for courtly visitors like Lady Dena Kennedy.

subzone:royal-library.s: Biblioteca Real. Escondida en lo profundo del ala de piedra del Castillo de Ventormenta, la Biblioteca Real preserva la memoria colectiva, los pergaminos de crónicas y los tratados del reino. Bajo la atenta mirada del bibliotecario jefe Milton Gavilla, sus estantes albergan registros cruciales de guerras antiguas, leyendas perdidas y los reinos de más allá del mar. Mientras Castillo de Ventormenta rebosa de guardias con armadura e intrigas cortesanas, su Biblioteca Real ofrece un remanso de tranquilidad erudita. Supervisada por Milton Gavilla, la sala sirve como el principal archivo de la historia de los humanos del sur, conservando textos supervivientes de antes de la Primera Guerra junto con crónicas militares recientes y tomos recuperados. Los eruditos, sacerdotes y viajeros de la Alianza son libres de consultar sus tratados abiertos, que abarcan desde la formación de la original Alianza de Lordaeron hasta el reciente surgimiento de la Horda de Thrall en Kalimdor.

ang.class:Mage: For scholars of the arcane, the library offers rare primary sources on Tirisfal's past, ancient dragon hunts, and the legacy of the Last Guardian.
ang.faction:Alliance: The shelves preserve the foundational treaties and war chronicles that bind the human, dwarven, and elven peoples across generations of conflict.

faq.a: It is located inside Stormwind Keep, the royal fortress resting in the eastern sector of Stormwind City. Once through the keep's grand foyer, take the corridors leading into the scholar and archive wings.
faq.q: Where is the Royal Library located?

faq.a: Milton Sheaf serves as the head librarian. He manages the archive's records and assists scholars and adventurers seeking missing volumes or specific kingdom treatises.
faq.q: Who runs the library?

faq.a: Visitors can read historical works covering the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Guardians of Tirisfal, the aftermath of the Second War, and reports regarding the New Horde, alongside regional histories of Stormwind and Alterac.
faq.q: What kinds of books can be read here?

faq.a: After the defeat of the Horde in the Second War, the dangerous spellbook was secured within the Royal Library for safekeeping. However, Alterac conspirators stole it, crossing paths with Teron Gorefiend's death knights who were staging an assault to claim it for Ner'zhul.
faq.q: Why was the Book of Medivh kept here?

text.s: Tucked deep within the stone wing of Stormwind Keep, the Royal Library preserves the collective memory, chronicle scrolls, and treatises of the kingdom. Under the watchful eye of Head Librarian Milton Sheaf, its shelves hold crucial records of ancient wars, lost legends, and the realms beyond the sea.

sec.b: While Stormwind Keep bristles with armored guards and courtly intrigue, its Royal Library offers an island of scholarly quiet. Overseen by Milton Sheaf, the hall serves as the premier archive of southern human history, preserving surviving texts from before the First War alongside recent military chronicles and recovered tomes. Alliance scholars, priests, and travelers are free to browse its open treatises, which cover everything from the formation of the original Alliance of Lordaeron to the recent emergence of Thrall's Horde in Kalimdor.

The library has not always remained unmolested by outside conflicts. Following the Second War, the dangerous Book of Medivh was stored within its vaults, drawing Alterac infiltrators and death knights sent by Ner'zhul in a brazen castle raid.

subzone:ruins-of-mathystra.s: Ruinas de Mathystra. Las Ruinas de Mathystra son los restos derruidos de una antigua ciudad de los elfos de la noche situada a lo largo de la costa norte de Costa Oscura. Destrozadas durante el Gran Cataclismo hace diez mil años, las ruinas costeras están ahora infestadas por hostiles naga Stormscale y merodeadas por escurridizos Ghost Sabers. Hace diez milenios, Mathystra era un bullicioso asentamiento de los elfos de la noche, hogar de nobles Altonato de alto rango. Cuando el Pozo de la Eternidad colapsó durante el Gran Cataclismo, olas cataclísmicas destrozaron la ciudad costera, derribando sus grandes arcos de mármol y arrastrando gran parte de su sillería al mar. Los elfos de la noche supervivientes abandonaron la ciudad en ruinas en favor de aldeas boscosas más pequeñas más al sur, dejando los patios hundidos y los cimientos agrietados de Mathystra a merced de los implacables elementos costeros.

ang.class:Hunter: The translucent Ghost Sabers prowling among the rubble of Mathystra are renowned beasts for beastmasters seeking a striking companion with ties to the spirit world.
ang.race:NightElf: Mathystra stands as a somber monument to the hubris of the ancient Highborne, whose reckless sorcery brought cataclysm down upon their own grand coastal settlements.

faq.a: Mathystra was a thriving night elven city built during the height of the ancient Highborne empire. It was shattered and largely drowned ten thousand years ago during the Great Sundering, when the Well of Eternity exploded and cleaved Kalimdor apart.
faq.q: What used to be here before the ruins?

faq.a: The ruins are currently occupied by the Stormscale naga, who have emerged from the sea to claim the sunken pavilions and coastlines. They aggressively attack any land-dwellers who intrude upon their territory.
faq.q: Who controls the Ruins of Mathystra right now?

faq.a: Ghost Sabers are ethereal, translucent felines that haunt the ruined stonework of Mathystra. Hunters often seek them out along the coast, though disturbing the ancient figurines in the area is known to draw these spirits out from the shadows.
faq.q: What are Ghost Sabers?

faq.a: Young night elves and scholars occasionally venture into the ruins to recover ancient Highborne relics left behind after the Sundering. However, the presence of fierce Stormscale naga makes recovering these historical treasures extremely perilous.
faq.q: Why do night elves visit these ruins today?

text.s: The Ruins of Mathystra are the crumbled remnants of an ancient night elven city sitting along the northern coast of Darkshore. Shattered during the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago, the coastal ruins are now overrun by hostile Stormscale naga and prowled by elusive Ghost Sabers.

sec.b: Ten millennia ago, Mathystra stood as a bustling night elven settlement, home to high-ranking Highborne nobility. When the Well of Eternity collapsed during the Great Sundering, cataclysmic waves shattered the coastal city, toppling its grand marble arches and washing much of its stonework into the sea. The surviving night elves abandoned the ruined city in favor of smaller woodland villages further south, leaving Mathystra's sunken courtyards and cracked foundations to the relentless coastal elements.
sec.t: A City Cast into the Sea

sec.b: In the modern era, Mathystra has become a dangerous domain ruled by the Stormscale naga. Creeping up from the dark depths, these serpentine abominations guard the broken halls fiercely, driving away any travelers who venture north past the Tower of Althalaxx. Among the shattered flagstones, ancient Highborne relics still lie half-buried in sand and seafoam. Daring young night elves sometimes brave the naga vipers hoping to recover remnants of their lost heritage, often contending not only with serpent blades but also with the spectral Ghost Sabers that stalk the broken streets.
sec.t: The Stormscale Vipers and Ghost Sabers

subzone:ruins-of-ordil-aran.s: Las Ruinas de Ordil'Aran. Las Ruinas de Ordil'Aran son los vestigios derruidos de un antiguo asentamiento de elfos de la noche en el noroeste de Vallefresno, situado entre la Atalaya de Maestra y las Ruinas de Bathran. Antaño reducto oculto de cultores de las sombras, las piedras caídas han sido invadidas recientemente por los corruptos fúrbolgs Piel de Cardo. Poco queda de la arquitectura kaldorei original en Ordil'Aran, salvo pilares erosionados, arcos agrietados y mampostería cubierta de musgo. Durante un tiempo, las ruinas aisladas sirvieron de guarida para el Culto de la Facción Oscura, que acechaba entre los escombros para tender emboscadas a los viajeros por los senderos del noroeste de Vallefresno. Recientemente, sin embargo, los violentos fúrbolgs de la tribu Piel de Cardo expulsaron a los cultores en una sangrienta toma de control. Los cadáveres de los practicantes caídos de la Facción Oscura todavía cubren el suelo mientras fúrbolgs agresivos patrullan el perímetro, custodiando con fiereza el lugar y el antiguo árbol Duramen que crece en su interior.

ang.faction:Alliance: Positioned just north of Maestra's Post, the aggressive occupants of Ordil'Aran threaten Alliance scouts and travelers heading toward Darkshore.
ang.race:NightElf: The ruins are another painful reminder of the Kalimdor empire's collapse, now defiled by corrupt furbolgs and dark cultists.

faq.a: Ordil'Aran was an ancient night elf settlement dating back before the Great Sundering. Like many Kaldorei outposts across Ashenvale, it fell into decay over millennia, leaving behind only overgrown stone arches and crumbling masonry.
faq.q: What was Ordil'Aran originally?

faq.a: The Cult of the Dark Strand previously used these ruins as a base of operations. The Thistlefur furbolgs violently attacked and ousted them, seizing the ruins for themselves and leaving slain cultists strewn across the site.
faq.q: Why are there dead cultists lying around the ruins?

faq.a: The Heartswood is a distinctive ancient tree growing within the Ruins of Ordil'Aran. Its branches and wood are sought after for their potent magical and natural properties.
faq.q: What is the Heartswood?

faq.a: The aggressive Thistlefur furbolgs currently occupy the ruins, having slain or driven out the Dark Strand cultists who previously inhabited the area.
faq.q: Who currently controls the ruins?

text.s: The Ruins of Ordil'Aran are the crumbling remnants of an ancient night elf settlement in northwestern Ashenvale, situated between Maestra's Post and Bathran's Haunt. Once a hidden redoubt for shadow cultists, the fallen stones have recently been overrun by the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs.

sec.b: Little remains of the original Kaldorei architecture at Ordil'Aran save for weathered pillars, cracked arches, and moss-draped stonework. For a time, the isolated ruins served as a lair for the Cult of the Dark Strand, who lurked among the debris to ambush travelers along the northwestern paths of Ashenvale. Recently, however, violent furbolgs of the Thistlefur tribe drove out the cultists in a bloody takeover. The bodies of fallen Dark Strand practitioners still litter the ground while aggressive furbolgs patrol the perimeter, fiercely guarding the site and the ancient Heartswood tree growing within.

subzone:ruins-of-stardust.s: Las Ruinas del Polvo Estelar. Las ruinas del Polvo Estelar son un antiguo santuario sagrado de los elfos de la noche en ruinas, enclavado en una isla lacustre en el suroeste de Vallefresno. Antaño un sereno lugar de devoción, las aguas de la isla y las bestias del pantano autóctonas han sufrido la corrupción procedente de la podredumbre demoníaca que desciende de Frondavil. A pesar de esta plaga omnipresente, los luminosos arbustos de polvo estelar todavía prosperan entre las piedras derruidas, conservando un potente poder restaurador. Ubicadas en una isla solitaria al sur de Astranaar, Las ruinas del Polvo Estelar fueron antaño un venerado lugar sagrado de los elfos de la noche. Hoy en día, un tono verdoso amarillento, inquietante y enfermizo, se cierne sobre el agua; una consecuencia de la inmunda podredumbre demoníaca que drena hacia el sur desde Frondavil, de forma muy parecida a lo que ocurre en el cercano Lago Iris. La flora local ha mutado en hostiles bestias del pantano que merodean por los restos de mampostería caídos, con sus temperamentos alterados por el lago contaminado.

ang.class:Shaman: The uncorrupted stardust found here serves as a vital cleansing reagent during spiritual trials, including the vital Call of Water trials to master the restorative elements.
ang.race:NightElf: Watching this former sanctuary succumb to Felwood's slow, putrid runoff is a painful reminder of the ongoing struggle to protect Ashenvale from enduring demonic corruption.

faq.a: In ancient times, the site was a sacred holy ground tended by the night elves. Its classical marble pillars and lakeside perch served as a tranquil place of reverence long before demonic corruption took root in the forest.
faq.q: What were the Ruins of Stardust originally used for?

faq.a: Demonic corruption seeping down from the blighted peaks of Felwood into Ashenvale's waterways has tainted the lake, tinting the waters a murky, yellowish-green shade and disturbing the natural balance.
faq.q: Why is the water around the island discolored?

faq.a: Despite growing in soil soaked in demonic runoff, stardust shrubs remain completely pure. They resist the ambient taint and possess exceptional restorative and healing properties, making them valuable reagents for cleansing rituals.
faq.q: What makes the stardust shrubs special?

faq.a: The island is overrun by large, corrupted bog beasts. The lake's tainted water has warped these nature elementals from peaceful forest guardians into aggressive, lumbering threats to anyone crossing the shallows.
faq.q: What creatures wander the ruins?

text.s: The Ruins of Stardust are an ancient, fallen night elven holy sanctuary nestled on a lake island in southwestern Ashenvale. Once a serene place of worship, the island's waters and native bog beasts have suffered corruption from demonic rot washing down from Felwood. Despite this pervasive blight, luminous stardust shrubs still thrive amidst the crumbling stones, retaining potent restorative power.

sec.b: Resting on a solitary island south of Astranaar, the Ruins of Stardust were once a venerated night elf holy site. Today, an eerie, sickly yellowish-green hue hangs over the water—a consequence of foul demonic rot draining south from Felwood, much like at nearby Iris Lake. The local plant life has twisted into hostile bog beasts that prowl the fallen masonry, their temperaments warped by the tainted lake.

Despite the corruption saturating the soil and shoreline, the island possesses an unyielding spark of resilience. Scattered among the ruins are stardust shrubs, blooming unmarred by the demonic taint. Their leaves and blossoms hold remarkable cleansing and healing virtues, attracting shamans, herbalists, and local night elf defenders seeking remedies against Ashenvale's encroaching decay.

subzone:rut-theran-village.s: Aldea Rut'theran. Aldea Rut'theran es un refugio costero enclavado en la base sur de Teldrassil. Al servir como el principal puerto marítimo de Darnassus, conecta el aislado Árbol del Mundo con el continente de Kalimdor mediante rutas de ferry e hipogrifos. Encaramada a la orilla del agua, bajo las imponentes alturas de Teldrassil, Aldea Rut'theran actúa como el umbral entre la capital de los elfos de la noche y el resto del mundo. Mientras que Darnassus reposa entre las ramas en lo alto, Rut'theran proporciona la base logística necesaria para sustentarla. Un portal místico se alza bajo los árboles, transportando en un instante a los viajeros entre la orilla y Darnassus. Para los viajes a través del mar, un servicio de ferry opera desde los muelles de la aldea directamente hasta Auberdine, en la costa continental de Costa Oscura, acompañado de maestros de vuelo que cuidan de posaderos exclusivos de hipogrifos adiestrados.

ang.class:Druid: Druids passing through Rut'theran Village can catch hippogryph flights directly across northern Kalimdor to the sacred sanctuary of Moonglade.
ang.race:NightElf: For young night elves leaving Teldrassil to aid the Alliance, Rut'theran Village is the final farewell to the crown of the World Tree before sailing into mainland Kalimdor.

faq.a: Walk up the gentle slope from the docks toward the giant pavilion tent. Stepping directly into the glowing purple portal on the platform will instantly transport you to the Temple Gardens inside Darnassus.
faq.q: How do I get to Darnassus from here?

faq.a: The ship docked at Rut'theran Village, the Moonspray, provides passage across the Veiled Sea to the town of Auberdine on the coast of Darkshore.
faq.q: Where does the boat from the dock go?

faq.a: Teldrassil's canopy is far too elevated for conventional sailing ships or sea trade. Rut'theran Village was established at its roots to provide a sea-level port and roosting ground, linked to the heights via a permanent teleportation gateway.
al: why is ruttheran at sea level
faq.q: Why is this village down at sea level instead of up in the tree?

faq.a: Yes. A hippogryph handler operates from the village roost, offering flight routes across the water to Auberdine in Darkshore, as well as specialized transport for Cenarion Circle druids to Moonglade.
faq.q: Can I fly anywhere from here?

text.s: Rut'theran Village is a coastal haven nestled at the southern base of Teldrassil. Serving as the primary maritime harbor for Darnassus, it connects the secluded World Tree to the mainland of Kalimdor via ferry and hippogryph routes.

sec.b: Perched at the water's edge below the towering heights of Teldrassil, Rut'theran Village acts as the threshold between the night elven capital and the wider world. While Darnassus rests within the boughs high above, Rut'theran provides the logistical foundation required to sustain it. A mystical portal arches beneath the trees, whisking travelers between the shore and Darnassus in an instant. For journeys across the sea, ferry service runs from the village docks directly to Auberdine on the mainland of Darkshore, accompanied by flight masters tending dedicated roosts of trained hippogryphs.

subzone:saldean-s-farm.s: Finca de Saldean. La Finca de Saldean es el único hogar de Páramos de Poniente que no ha sido invadido por completo y abandonado ante la Hermandad Defias. Mantenida por el testarudo Granjero Saldean y su esposa Salma, la granja sigue siendo un refugio seguro poco común en medio de la agitación de la región. Mientras las tierras vecinas sucumbían al bandidaje y al sabotaje mecánico, la familia Saldean se negó a abandonar sus tierras. El Granjero Saldean y su esposa Salma han permanecido en su propiedad, ofreciendo comida caliente y palabras amables a los viajeros que pasan. A pesar de su resistencia, los campos continúan asolados por gólems de la cosecha rebeldes desplegados por las llanuras, lo que obliga a la familia a permanecer cerca de los muros de la granja.

ang.faction:Alliance: Saldean's Farm represents the raw, failing edge of the kingdom's frontier, exposing how deeply ordinary citizens suffer when Stormwind's leadership is distracted.
ang.profession:Cooking: Salma Saldean is renowned among travelers for turning scavenged Westfall ingredients into hearty, lifesaving dishes like Goretusk Liver Pie.

faq.a: Farmer Saldean and his wife simply refused to pack up and flee when the Defias Brotherhood swept through Westfall. Though hostile harvest golems prowl their crops, the family stubbornly defends the immediate perimeter with the help of passing militia and adventurers.
faq.q: Why is this farm still standing when the others fell?

faq.a: The farm's residents are Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma; anyone else you find there is likely a passing traveler, as the couple welcome visitors and the adventurers willing to help them with the dangers plaguing their fields.
faq.q: Who are all the people gathered around the house?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood repurposed the region's mechanical harvest reapers and golems into deadly sentries. They roam the fields attacking anyone who attempts to cultivate or clear the land.
faq.q: Why are mechanical golems attacking the fields?

faq.a: Official military presence is practically nonexistent. A few scattered guards from Sentinel Hill and Stormwind provide minimal watch, but the crown has largely left Westfall's defense to local initiative.
faq.q: Is the Stormwind Army protecting the farm?

text.s: Saldean's Farm is the only homestead in Westfall that has not been completely overrun and abandoned to the Defias Brotherhood. Held by the stubborn Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma, the farmhouse remains a rare safe haven amid the region's turmoil.

sec.b: While neighboring lands fell to banditry and mechanical sabotage, the Saldean family refused to abandon their soil. Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma have stayed on their homestead, offering hot food and a kind word to passing travelers. Despite their resilience, the fields remain plagued by rogue harvest golems deployed across the plains, forcing the family to stay close to the farmhouse walls.

Because the Stormwind crown has largely neglected Westfall, law enforcement here is thin. A handful of Sentinel Hill and Stormwind guards patrol the periphery, but the farm survives primarily through sheer grit and the aid of passing travelers. For the Saldeans, Salma's famous Westfall stew and goretusk liver pie and the shelter of their farmhouse are small comforts against the ever-present threat of the Defias.

subzone:satyrnaar.s: Satyrnaar. Satyrnaar es un antiguo asentamiento en ruinas de los elfos de la noche situado en el noreste de Vallefresno que ha caído por completo en manos de los sátiros Bleakheart. Emplazado justo al lado del camino principal entre el Puesto del Hachazo y Azshara, es el más intacto y de más fácil acceso de los bastiones de sátiros del bosque. Ubicado al noreste del Puesto del Hachazo y al suroeste de Canción del Bosque, Satyrnaar se erige como uno de los tres asentamientos principales de sátiros de Vallefresno junto a Xavian y la Senda de la Noche. A diferencia de las ruinas más adentradas en la espesura, Satyrnaar está relativamente bien conservado, con tiendas montadas entre la derruida arquitectura élfica. Sirve como un concurrido campamento para los sátiros Bleakheart, haciendo que la ruta comercial cercana esté plagada de peligros para los viajeros que van hacia el este rumbo a Azshara. Además, aquí se fraguan oscuros vínculos: los sátiros han forjado una alianza con el sombrío Culto de la Facción Oscura, albergando una de sus insidiosas gemas de alma entre las piedras corruptas.

ang.class:Druid: The twisted fel corruption spread by the Bleakheart satyrs actively chokes the natural spirit of Ashenvale, demanding swift cleansing.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing ancestral stonework defiled by fel corruption and inhabited by the cursed remnants of the Highborne is a bitter offense to any night elf traveling through Ashenvale.

faq.a: Satyrnaar is a ruined night elf site in northeastern Ashenvale that has been claimed and occupied by the Bleakheart satyrs. It serves as one of their primary strongholds in the region.
faq.q: What is Satyrnaar?

faq.a: The settlement is held by the Bleakheart tribe of satyrs. They have erected tents among the ancient ruins and work in league with the Cult of the Dark Strand.
faq.q: Who lives in Satyrnaar?

faq.a: Of the three main satyr sites in Ashenvale—Satyrnaar, Night Run, and Xavian—Satyrnaar is the most intact and centrally located, lying right off the road toward Azshara.
faq.q: Why is Satyrnaar significant compared to other satyr ruins?

faq.a: Satyrnaar houses one of the corrupted soulgems belonging to the Cult of the Dark Strand, a mortal shadow cult allied with the Bleakheart satyrs.
faq.q: What is the dark artifact hidden in Satyrnaar?

text.s: Satyrnaar is an ancient, ruined night elf settlement in northeastern Ashenvale that has fallen entirely into the hands of the Bleakheart satyrs. Perched just off the main road between Splintertree Post and Azshara, it is the most intact and easily accessible of the satyr strongholds in the forest.

sec.b: Located northeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of Forest Song, Satyrnaar stands as one of Ashenvale's three primary satyr settlements alongside Xavian and Night Run. Unlike the deeper wilderness ruins, Satyrnaar is relatively well-preserved, featuring pitched tents nestled among crumbled elven architecture. It serves as a bustling camp for the Bleakheart satyrs, making the nearby trade route fraught with peril for travelers moving east toward Azshara. Furthermore, dark ties fester here: the satyrs have forged an alliance with the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand, harboring one of their insidious soulgems amidst the corrupted stones.
sec.t: A Den of Fel and Shadow

subzone:scarlet-raven-tavern.s: Mesón del Cuervo Escarlata. El Mesón del Cuervo Escarlata es el centro social y la posada principal de Villa Oscura, y ofrece un refugio junto al fuego en la penumbra de Bosque del Ocaso. Regentada por el tabernero Smitts, sirve como punto de encuentro para lugareños asediados, aventureros de paso y viajeros aterrorizados que intentan escapar de los horrores que acechan más allá de los límites de la villa. Situado cerca del corazón de Villa Oscura, el Mesón del Cuervo Escarlata mantiene su hogar encendido mientras un anochecer eterno asfixia el bosque circundante. Años atrás, era una parada bulliciosa donde el alguacil Haggard y la Guardia de Ventormenta compartían pintas tras las patrullas. Hoy en día, el negocio ha menguado a la par que la seguridad del pueblo. El tabernero Smitts atiende la barra para una clientela sombría y ansiosa que se acurruca contra el frío y el miedo. Aun así, la taberna sigue siendo una encrucijada indispensable para los rumores, sirviendo como punto de partida para los viajeros que buscan respuestas a los oscuros fenómenos que consumen la región.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers traversing the southern border, the Scarlet Raven provides one of the few safe hearths and rest stops between Elwynn Forest and Deadwind Pass.
ang.profession:Cooking: The inn's menu features regional delicacies like Dusky Crab Cakes, a local staple that desperate wanderers like Jitters crave even while hiding in the graveyard.

faq.a: Tavernkeep Smitts is the tavern keeper. The inn also has an innkeeper and other staff serving travelers in Darkshire.
faq.q: Who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern?

faq.a: The curse hanging over Duskwood has choked the trade routes and terrified the locals. With undead, feral worgen, and shadowy riders prowling the woods outside, the patron crowd consists of terrified townsfolk and desperate mercenaries rather than carefree travelers.
faq.q: Why is the tavern's atmosphere so gloomy?

faq.a: Jitters stayed at the tavern and frantically wrote in his journal before fleeing town. His reasons are uncovered through the investigation into Duskwood.
faq.q: Did Jitters stay at the Scarlet Raven?

faq.a: Old patrons and past town records preserved in and around the tavern hold clues regarding Stalvan Mistmantle, who once frequented the settlement before falling into tragedy and infamy.
faq.q: What connection does this tavern have to the Legend of Stalvan?

text.s: The Scarlet Raven Tavern is the social center and primary inn of Darkshire, offering hearthside shelter in the gloom of Duskwood. Presided over by Tavernkeep Smitts, it serves as a gathering spot for beleaguered locals, passing adventurers, and terrified travelers trying to escape the horrors lurking beyond the town's perimeter.

sec.b: Standing near the heart of Darkshire, the Scarlet Raven Tavern keeps its hearth ablaze while eternal dusk chokes the surrounding forest. Years ago, it was a bustling stop where Marshal Haggard and the Stormwind Guard would share pints after patrols. Today, business has withered alongside the town's security. Tavernkeep Smitts tends bar for a somber, anxious clientele huddled against the cold and fear. Even so, the tavern remains an indispensable crossroads for rumors, serving as the starting point for travelers seeking answers to the dark phenomena consuming the region.

Beyond serving as a shelter, the tavern holds pieces of several unfolding mysteries. The reclusive wanderer Jitters rented a room here for days, frantically scribbling in his journal by night before fleeing town ahead of the terrifying Dark Riders. Decades-old town gossip and preserved guest records kept beneath its roof also link back to long-forgotten figures like Stalvan Mistmantle, making Smitts' taproom the first place inquisitive investigators search when tracing the histories of Duskwood's restless dead.

subzone:scarlet-watch-post.s: Atalaya Escarlata. La Atalaya Escarlata es una torre de vigilancia aislada situada en las colinas rocosas del noreste de Claros de Tirisfal, justo al norte del Monasterio Escarlata. Mantenida por una vigilante guarnición de cruzados, su único propósito es proteger el vulnerable flanco norte del monasterio contra ataques por el flanco. Encaramada en las escarpadas alturas tras el Monasterio Escarlata, la Atalaya Escarlata sirve como un bastión crucial de alerta temprana para los fanáticos de abajo. Mientras que el camino del sur hacia la puerta del monasterio cuenta con gran tráfico y fortificaciones, los escarpados acantilados a lo largo de la costa norte de Tirisfal ofrecen una tentadora ruta trasera para los infiltrados. Para eliminar este punto ciego, La Cruzada Escarlata mantiene esta torre de piedra fortificada, uno de los varios puestos avanzados de cruzados dispersos por Claros de Tirisfal. Bajo el severo mando del capitán Melrache, una fuerza combinada de neófitos, vanguardistas y devotos frailes mantiene una vigilancia incesante sobre los acantilados, asegurando que ni la Plaga ni los Renegados puedan sorprender a la orden por la espalda.

ang.faction:Horde: The Crusaders view all outsiders—living or dead—as tainted carriers of undeath, making this watch post strictly hostile ground to any Horde travelers braving the hills.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, the Scarlet Crusade is an existential threat lingering right on the Undercity's doorstep; purging isolated towers like this disrupts the zealots' communication network and secures northern Tirisfal.

faq.a: The outpost protects the Scarlet Monastery from being flanked. While the monastery's main entrance faces south toward the Tirisfal roads, its rear slopes toward the northern wilderness, leaving it vulnerable to coordinated assaults. The watch post ensures sentries spot and intercept any intruders attempting a northern bypass.
al: why is scarlet watch post here
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scarlet Watch Post?

faq.a: Captain Melrache oversees the garrison stationed at the tower. He commands a defensive retinue including personal bodyguards, front-line Vanguards, aspiring Neophytes, and spellcasting Friars.
faq.q: Who commands the Scarlet Watch Post?

faq.a: Yes. It is one of four distinct Crusader outposts ringing the northern and western reaches of Tirisfal Glades. These stone towers create a defensive perimeter to monitor Scourge activity and contain the Forsaken expansion from the Undercity.
faq.q: Is the Scarlet Watch Post related to the other towers in Tirisfal?

text.s: The Scarlet Watch Post is an isolated watchtower stationed in the rocky hills of northeastern Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Scarlet Monastery. Maintained by a vigilant garrison of Crusaders, its sole purpose is to safeguard the monastery's vulnerable northern flank against flanking assaults.

sec.b: Perched in the rugged heights behind the Scarlet Monastery, the Scarlet Watch Post serves as a critical early-warning bastion for the zealots below. While the southern road up to the monastery gate receives heavy traffic and fortifications, the rugged cliffs along Tirisfal's northern coastline provide a tempting back route for infiltrators. To eliminate this blind spot, the Scarlet Crusade maintains this fortified stone tower—one of several Crusader outposts scattered across Tirisfal Glades. Under the stern command of Captain Melrache, a mixed force of Neophytes, Vanguards, and devout Friars keeps ceaseless vigil over the cliffs, ensuring neither the Scourge nor the Forsaken can surprise the order from behind.

subzone:screaming-gully.s: Barranco de los Gritos. El Barranco de los Gritos es la primera y vasta caverna subterránea que se encuentra justo tras la entrada de las Cuevas de los Lamentos. Bañada por un brillo fúngico antinatural y aguas poco profundas, sirve como reducto exterior para los corruptos Druidas del Colmillo y sus bestias mutadas. Cruzar el umbral de las Cuevas de los Lamentos conduce directamente al Barranco de los Gritos, un abismo resonante donde el viento gime a través de fisuras subterráneas. Lejos de los áridos Baldíos de la superficie, la quebrada está asfixiada por una vegetación húmeda, niebla sofocante y una fauna agresiva retorcida por la Pesadilla Esmeralda. La noble del Colmillo Lady Anacondra vigila la cámara, rodeada de acólitos de los Druidas del Colmillo y feroces raptores descarriados, mientras antiguas tortugas mordedoras como Kresh patrullan las aguas someras inferiores.

ang.class:Druid: For Cenarion druids, Screaming Gully is a heartbreaking display of their fallen brethren who abandoned the path of the claw and sky to embrace serpentine corruption.

faq.a: The Screaming Gully is the first major chamber you enter directly after stepping through the portal inside the Wailing Caverns, located beneath the northern Barrens.
faq.q: Where is the Screaming Gully located?

faq.a: The Wailing Caverns earn their name from the howling, moaning sounds caused by subterranean steam and winds venting through rock fissures, and this wide entrance chasm catches the brunt of those echoing cries.
faq.q: Why is it called the Screaming Gully?

faq.a: The chamber is overseen by Lady Anacondra, one of the primary Fanglords who fell under the corruption of the Emerald Nightmare alongside Naralex.
faq.q: Who rules over the Screaming Gully?

faq.a: The gully is populated by deviate raptors, corrupted Druids of the Fang, and wandering aquatic life, including the ancient turtle Kresh roaming the flooded floor.
faq.q: What creatures roam this chamber?

text.s: Screaming Gully is the first sprawling subterranean cavern encountered just beyond the entrance of the Wailing Caverns. Bathed in unnatural fungal glow and shallow waters, it serves as the outer redoubt for the corrupted Druids of the Fang and their mutated beasts.

sec.b: Stepping through the threshold of the Wailing Caverns leads directly into Screaming Gully, an echoing chasm where the wind groans through subterranean fissures. Far from the arid Barrens above, the gully is choked with damp overgrowth, humid mist, and aggressive wildlife twisted by the Emerald Nightmare. The Fanglord Lady Anacondra oversees the chamber, surrounded by acolytes of the Druids of the Fang and vicious deviate raptors, while ancient snapping turtles like Kresh patrol the shallow waterways below.

subzone:scuttle-coast.s: Costa de la Huída. La Costa de la Huída es la costa oriental de Durotar, azotada por las olas y situada entre Cerrotajo y el Fuerte de Tiragarde. La playa rocosa está sembrada de restos hundidos de la flota de Kul Tiras del almirante Daelin Valiente, lo que la convierte en una activa zona de rescate para la Horda y un constante recordatorio de la reciente guerra naval. Extendiéndose a lo largo del extremo oriental de Durotar hacia el Mare Magnum, la Costa de la Huída adquirió su sombrío carácter durante la invasión liderada por el Gran Almirante Daelin Valiente. Cuando la flota de Kul Tiras asaltó la incipiente nación de Durotar, las encarnizadas batallas con la Horda arrojaron muchos buques de guerra humanos contra los escarpados bajíos, destrozándolos y reduciéndolos a cascos astillados. Hoy en día, la costa está abarrotada de maderas cubiertas de percebes, jarcias rotas y barriles de carga recuperados. Para los campamentos cercanos de Cerrotajo, la costa representa tanto un persistente peligro para la seguridad como una valiosa fuente de provisiones recuperadas y mecanismos abandonados de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Horde: The broken hulls littering this beach stand as stark monuments to Durotar's defense against Daelin Proudmoore's invading navy.
ang.profession:Engineering: The sunken Alliance holds along the shore contain abandoned gnomish gadgets, scrap metal, and intricate machinery ripe for reverse-engineering.

faq.a: The shattered ships belonged to the naval fleet of Kul Tiras under Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. They were smashed against Durotar's rocky shallows during the admiral's failed military campaign against the newly founded Horde.
faq.q: Where did all these shipwrecks come from?

faq.a: The name carries a double meaning. It refers directly to the warships scuttled along the coastline during naval combat, as well as the numerous makrura and crabs that scuttle across the rocky sands.
al: why is it called scuttle coast
faq.q: Why is it called the Scuttle Coast?

faq.a: Horde scouts and scavengers search the broken holds for salvageable tools, supplies, and discarded gnomish technology left behind by the Alliance forces.
faq.q: What is the Horde looking for along the coast?

faq.a: No. Aside from treacherous waves and jagged rocks, hostile coastal beasts like makrura prowl the surf, and armed Kul Tiras survivors remain entrenched just to the south at Tiragarde Keep.
faq.q: Is the Scuttle Coast safe to travel?

text.s: The Scuttle Coast is the wave-battered eastern shoreline of Durotar, situated between Razor Hill and Tiragarde Keep. The rocky beach is strewn with sunken wreckage from Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's Kul Tiras fleet, making it an active scavenging ground for the Horde and a lingering reminder of recent naval warfare.

sec.b: Running along Durotar's eastern edge out to the Great Sea, the Scuttle Coast earned its grim character during the invasion led by Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. When the Kul Tiras fleet assaulted the fledgling nation of Durotar, fierce battles with the Horde drove many human warships against the jagged shoals, smashing them into splintered hulks. Today, the shoreline is choked with barnacle-encrusted timber, broken rigging, and salvaged cargo barrels. For the nearby encampments of Razor Hill, the coast represents both a lingering security hazard and a valuable source of recovered provisions and abandoned Alliance mechanisms.

The name Scuttle Coast refers not only to the sunken warships deliberately scuttled or grounded during the fighting, but also to the swarms of crabs and makrura that pick through the rotting detritus. While shoreline wildlife and dangerous tides keep casual travelers away, Horde scavengers periodically comb through the wreckage to retrieve valuable equipment, including gnomish technical components abandoned in the cargo holds of the sunken ships.

subzone:sen-jin-village.s: Poblado Sen'jin. El Poblado Sen'jin es un asentamiento costero en la costa sur de Durotar que sirve de santuario para los trols Lanza Negra. Fundada por el Jefe Vol'jin tras ser expulsado su pueblo de su hogar ancestral en las Islas del Eco, la aldea rinde homenaje a su difunto padre, el médico brujo Sen'jin. Hoy se erige como un frágil refugio centrado en la supervivencia, la herboristería y la recuperación de lo que les fue arrebatado. Cuando el oscuro médico brujo Zalazane traicionó a los Lanza Negra y se hizo con el control de las Islas del Eco, el Jefe Vol'jin se vio obligado a guiar a los supervivientes a través del estrecho hasta el continente de Durotar. Allí, al abrigo de los acantilados costeros y con la vista puesta en el mar, levantaron toscas chozas y fundaron el Poblado Sen'jin. El asentamiento lleva el nombre del padre de Vol'jin, el venerable anciano que se sacrificó durante la Tercera Guerra para salvar a su pueblo de los múrlocs costeros. A pesar de su estrecha alianza con la Horda de Thrall, los trols de aquí viven bajo la sombra del exilio, contemplando a diario desde los bajíos el hogar que perdieron.

ang.profession:Herbalism: The village is a vital starting center for natural medicine, surrounded by coastal Peacebloom, Silverleaf, and Earthroot used by local witch doctors to treat venom and curses.
ang.race:Troll: For Darkspear trolls emerging from the Valley of Trials, this refuge is the beating heart of their displaced people, holding memories of their lost chieftain and the enduring sting of Zalazane's betrayal.

faq.a: The Darkspear fled across the strait to the Durotar coastline after the witch doctor Zalazane went mad and took control of their home on the Echo Isles. Sen'jin Village was established by Vol'jin as a temporary refuge and staging ground just across the water from their stolen land.
al: why did trolls leave echo isles
faq.q: Why did the Darkspear build Sen'jin Village here?

faq.a: Sen'jin was a respected witch doctor and chieftain of the Darkspear tribe, as well as the father of Vol'jin. During the Third War, he foresaw Thrall's arrival and sacrificed his life while saving his tribe and the young Horde from fanatical sea murlocs in the South Seas.
faq.q: Who was Sen'jin?

faq.a: The local witch doctors and medicine men rely heavily on Durotar's coastal flora and scorpok venoms to concoct charms, antidotes, and rituals. These botanical brews sustain the wounded and offer wards against the dark hexes drifting over from the Echo Isles.
faq.q: Why are there so many herbalists and alchemists here?

faq.a: The Echo Isles sit directly across the eastern water from the village. Adventurers often swim or wade across the shallow channel to strike back at Zalazane's voodoo cultists, recover stolen artifacts, or gather resources for the village defenders.
al: how to get to echo isles
faq.q: Can you reach the Echo Isles from Sen'jin Village?

text.s: Sen'jin Village is a coastal settlement on the southern shores of Durotar, serving as a sanctuary for the Darkspear trolls. Established by Chieftain Vol'jin after his people were driven from their ancestral home on the Echo Isles, the hamlet honors his fallen father, the witch doctor Sen'jin. Today, it stands as a fragile haven focused on survival, herbalism, and reclaiming what was stolen.

sec.b: When the dark witch doctor Zalazane betrayed the Darkspear and seized control of the Echo Isles, Chieftain Vol'jin was forced to lead the survivors across the strait to the mainland of Durotar. There, nestled beneath coastal cliffs and looking out over the water, they raised crude huts and established Sen'jin Village. The settlement carries the name of Vol'jin's father, the venerable elder who sacrificed himself during the Third War to save their people from coastal murlocs. Despite their close alliance with Thrall's Horde, the trolls here live under the shadow of exile, staring daily across the shallows at the home they lost.

Daily life in Sen'jin Village revolves around preparation and defense. Between local Centaur raids, aggressive sea beasts, and Zalazane's hexes reaching across the sea, the villagers rely heavily on herbal remedies and brewing potent alchemical spirits. While Vol'jin coordinates broader tribal defense from the Horde capital, local shamans, hunters, and scouts gather here to recruit fresh wanderers stepping out of the Valley of Trials. Their aim is clear: to gather resources, protect Durotar's southern flank, and plot the eventual downfall of the traitor Zalazane.

subzone:sentinel-hill.s: Colina del Centinela. La Colina del Centinela es el bastión principal de la Alianza en Páramos de Poniente y sirve como centro de mando para Las Milicias del Pueblo. Rodeada de campos descuidados, gnolls carroñeros y forajidos hostiles, esta elevación fortificada es el único punto de apoyo seguro para los ciudadanos leales de la región. Encaramada en una posición elevada en el centro de Páramos de Poniente, la Colina del Centinela se erige como un santuario vital en un territorio sumido en la anarquía. Cuenta con una posada tipo barracón, un nido de grifos que conecta a los viajeros con Ventormenta y más allá, una forja y un aserradero, todo ello anclado por la imponente Torre del Centinela. Mientras las tierras circundantes han caído presa del bandidaje y de bestias voraces, el campamento mantiene un frágil perímetro donde viajeros, granjeros asediados y reclutas pueden reagruparse bajo la atenta mirada de veteranos defensores.

ang.faction:Alliance: Sentinel Hill is your only fortified outpost and supply hub in Westfall, anchoring the Alliance's presence against outlaws and raiders.
ang.race:Human: Seeing Westfall's farmers forced to raise their own militia here reflects the kingdom's deepening crisis while the throne remains vacant.

faq.a: With King Varian Wrynn missing and resources spread thin across the realm, Stormwind's regency has largely abandoned the western provinces to their own devices. Local citizens and veterans had to form the People's Militia themselves to hold Sentinel Hill and protect what remains of Westfall.
faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent soldiers to defend Sentinel Hill?

faq.a: Gryan Stoutmantle commands the People's Militia from the base of Sentinel Tower. He coordinates local defense, gathers intelligence on surrounding threats, and directs visiting adventurers against the gnolls and highwaymen encroaching on the settlement.
faq.q: Who is in charge of Sentinel Hill?

faq.a: The encampment faces constant pressure from aggressive Riverpaw gnolls roaming the western plains, as well as the insidious, coordinated sabotage of the Defias Brotherhood lurking throughout the abandoned farms.
faq.q: What threats actively endanger the hill?

faq.a: Sentinel Hill provides a full set of frontier accommodations: a gryphon master offering travel to Stormwind City and other Alliance outposts, an innkeeper, a mailbox, trade supply vendors, and repair facilities around the local forge.
faq.q: What services are available here for travelers?

text.s: Sentinel Hill is the primary bastion of the Alliance in Westfall, serving as the command center for the People's Militia. Surrounded by overgrown fields, scavenging gnolls, and hostile outlaws, this fortified rise is the only secure foothold for lawful citizens in the region.

sec.b: Perched on high ground in central Westfall, Sentinel Hill stands as a vital sanctuary in an otherwise lawless territory. It features a barracks-style inn, a gryphon roost connecting travelers to Stormwind and beyond, a forge, and a lumber mill, all anchored by the imposing Sentinel Tower. While the surrounding lands have fallen to banditry and ravenous beasts, the encampment maintains a fragile perimeter where travelers, beleaguered farmers, and recruits can regroup under the watchful eyes of veteran defenders.

With the royal army detained in Stormwind and unable to spare soldiers to protect outlying territories, Gryan Stoutmantle established the People's Militia directly upon this hill. From here, volunteer fighters organize scouts, coordinate strikes against the Riverpaw gnolls, and investigate the organized banditry tearing through Westfall's abandoned farmsteads. Sentinel Hill is neither an opulent fort nor a comfortable refuge, but a working frontline camp determined to reclaim the kingdom's former breadbasket.

subzone:sentinel-tower.s: Torre del Centinela. Torre del Centinela corona la cima de la Colina del Centinela, erigiéndose como el principal punto de observación y cuartel general de los defensores en Páramos de Poniente. Desde sus alturas, Gryan Mantorrecio y las Milicias del Pueblo organizan su desesperada defensa contra bandidos, gnolls y la creciente sombra de la Hermandad Defias. Erigida sobre la cresta de la Colina del Centinela, Torre del Centinela es el corazón militar de los inestables Páramos de Poniente. Con el ejército oficial de Ventormenta casi ausente y denegando su ayuda, los voluntarios locales y los veteranos se unieron para crear un reducto central. La torre de piedra otorga a los vigías una vista ininterrumpida de las llanuras polvorientas, desde los campos de calabazas abandonados hasta las brumosas costas, lo que permite dar una alerta temprana cuando los salteadores de caminos renegados o las partidas de saqueo de gnolls comienzan a merodear.

ang.faction:Alliance: Sentinel Tower represents the grit of ordinary Alliance subjects fighting for their homeland when the high lords in Stormwind have turned a blind eye.
ang.race:Human: For humans of the kingdom, the tower is a painful reminder that the agrarian breadbasket of Stormwind is barely holding together against homegrown rebellion.

faq.a: Gryan Stoutmantle directs operations from the tower. As head of the People's Militia, he coordinates the defense of Westfall's displaced farmers and manages the recruitment of willing adventurers.
faq.q: Who is in charge at Sentinel Tower?

faq.a: It is the only fortified garrison and lookout post left in the central plains. Because Stormwind has left Westfall largely undefended, the tower serves as the last organized bastion of order and safety for refugees in the region.
faq.q: Why is the tower so important to Westfall?

faq.a: You will find militia officers, sentinels keeping watch, quartermasters, and fleeing farmsteader families who have abandoned their ruined lands to seek shelter near its sturdy stone walls.
faq.q: Who stays in and around the tower?
