faq.a: Sentinels monitor the movements of the Riverpaw gnolls, stray murlocs crawling inland from the coast, and above all, roaming highwaymen and brigands belonging to the Defias Brotherhood.
al: what does the tower guard against
faq.q: What threats are watched from the tower?

text.s: Sentinel Tower crowns the apex of Sentinel Hill, standing as the primary vantage point and headquarters for defenders in Westfall. From its heights, Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia organize their desperate defense against bandits, gnolls, and the growing shadow of the Defias Brotherhood.

sec.b: Erected upon the crest of Sentinel Hill, Sentinel Tower is the military heart of unsettled Westfall. With Stormwind's official army largely absent and withholding aid, local volunteers and veterans banded together to create a central redoubt. The stone tower grants lookouts an unbroken view across the dusty plains, from the abandoned pumpkin patches to the misty shores, giving early warning when rogue highwaymen or gnoll raiding parties begin to prowl.

The tower serves as the command post for Gryan Stoutmantle and the core of the local leadership. Surrounded by makeshift defenses, wounded refugees, and weary soldiers, it operates as both an administrative hub and an emergency shelter for homesteaders driven from their lands. Here, intelligence on the Defias Brotherhood is pieced together, coordinating volunteers into cohesive strikes against the syndicate that has choked the province into ruin.

subzone:sepulcher.s: El Sepulcro. El Sepulcro es el principal asentamiento y bastión de los Renegados en Bosque de Argénteos. Antaño un cementerio y cripta funeraria ordinarios de Lordaeron con vistas a la costa occidental, hoy sirve como santuario fortificado para la Horda frente a las amenazas regionales que lo rodean. Encaramado en las colinas sobre la costa de Lordaeron, el Sepulcro fue originalmente un tranquilo cementerio y cripta junto al camino occidental. Tras la Tercera Guerra, los recién emancipados Renegados reutilizaron la antigua bóveda de piedra y sus terrenos como un puesto de avanzada esencial. Rodeado de fuerzas hostiles por todos lados —los huargen salvajes al sur, remanentes errantes de la Plaga al este y magos del Kirin Tor vigilando desde Molino Ámbar—, el Sepulcro proporciona un insólito remanso de seguridad, suministros y mando para los viajeros que recorren Bosque de Argénteos.

ang.faction:Horde: For any Horde traveler venturing south from Tirisfal Glades, the Sepulcher offers the only reliable refuge, repair, and flight hub for miles.
ang.race:Undead: The Sepulcher is the staging ground for the Forsaken's struggle to pacify Silverpine Forest, directing operations against lingering Scourge loyalists, Kirin Tor remnants, and feral worgen.

faq.a: Before the Third War and the fall of the Kingdom of Lordaeron, it was simply a roadside cemetery and stone crypt where local villagers buried their dead.
faq.q: What was the Sepulcher before the Forsaken moved in?

faq.a: It serves as the Forsaken's sole fortified hub in Silverpine Forest. From this central position, Forsaken scouts and commanders can monitor encroaching Dalaran mages, Scourge holdouts, and the spreading beastly worgen menace lurking near Shadowfang Keep.
faq.q: Why is the Sepulcher so vital to the Forsaken?

faq.a: Yes. While the base is managed and inhabited entirely by Forsaken deathguards, merchants, and apothecaries, it functions as an official Horde refuge offering respite and trade to orcs, trolls, and tauren passing through the region.
faq.q: Are travelers belonging to other Horde races welcome here?

faq.a: The settlement is hemmed in by hostile powers: Scourge forces roam to the east, the Kirin Tor holds Ambermill to the southeast, and ferocious worgen stalk the woods to the south.
faq.q: What threats surround the Sepulcher?

text.s: The Sepulcher is the primary Forsaken settlement and stronghold in Silverpine Forest. Once an ordinary Lordaeron graveyard and burial crypt overlooking the western coast, it now serves as a fortified sanctuary for the Horde against surrounding regional threats.

sec.b: Perched in the hills above the Lordaeron coastline, the Sepulcher was originally a quiet cemetery and crypt alongside the western road. In the wake of the Third War, the newly emancipated Forsaken repurposed the ancient stone vault and its grounds into an essential outpost. Surrounded by hostile forces on all sides—the feral worgen to the south, wandering Scourge remnants to the east, and Kirin Tor wizards watching from Ambermill—the Sepulcher provides a rare haven of safety, supplies, and command for travelers marching through Silverpine.

subzone:shadow-grave.s: Sepulcro Sombrío. Sepulcro Sombrío es una cripta de piedra encaramada en lo alto de los terrenos de enterramiento sobre Camposanto, en Claros de Tirisfal. Sirve como el punto de despertar físico donde los Renegados recién liberados se sacuden el estupor de la muerte y el debilitado control del Rey Exánime. Escondido en las estribaciones rocosas tras las tumbas de Camposanto, el Sepulcro Sombrío es un sencillo mausoleo de piedra con un propósito extraordinario. En sus húmedas bóvedas, los cadáveres levantados para la servidumbre descerebrada de la Plaga despiertan gradualmente al libre albedrío. Bajo la atenta mirada de cuidadores como el Enterrador Mordo, estos no-muertos recién liberados se levantan de sus losas de piedra y dan sus primeros y estremecidos pasos en un mundo que los desprecia, emprendiendo el sendero hacia Camposanto para consagrarse a la Reina Alma en Pena.

ang.race:Undead: Every Forsaken adventurer begins their journey on the cold stone slabs of this crypt, opening their eyes to the grim reality of unlife and free will.

faq.a: It is the crypt where newly awakened Forsaken rise into consciousness. Instead of remaining mindless Scourge thralls in the dirt, these resurrected individuals regain their free will inside the tomb and begin their second life serving Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: What is the Shadow Grave used for?

faq.a: Shadow Grave is situated at the top of the hill above the Deathknell Graves, backed against the southern mountains of Tirisfal Glades. A dirt trail winds downhill from its entrance toward the settlement of Deathknell.
faq.q: Where is the Shadow Grave located?

faq.a: Undertaker Mordo attends the newly awakened within the tomb, assessing whether those rising from the slabs have recovered their minds and are fit to serve the Forsaken cause.
faq.q: Who oversees the newly awakened here?

text.s: Shadow Grave is a stone crypt perched atop the sloping burial grounds above Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. It serves as the physical awakening point where newly liberated Forsaken shake off the stupor of death and the Lich King's faded control.

sec.b: Tucked into the rocky foothills behind Deathknell Graves, the Shadow Grave is a simple stone mausoleum with an extraordinary purpose. Inside its damp vaults, corpses raised into the mindless servitude of the Scourge gradually awaken to free will. Under the watchful eye of caretakers like Undertaker Mordo, these freshly liberated undead stand up from their stone slabs and take their first shuddering steps into a world that despises them, setting out down the footpath toward Deathknell to pledge themselves to the Banshee Queen.

faq.a: Cañada Umbría es el protegido bosque inicial de los elfos de la noche, ubicado en los confines nororientales de Teldrassil. Es un remanso pacífico y apartado centrado en el imponente árbol Aldrassil, donde los novicios se entrenan bajo la guía de mentores antes de recorrer el Árbol del Mundo.

El árbol es Aldrassil, un túmulo arbóreo que constituye el corazón de Cañada Umbría. Su interior hueco sirve como recinto administrativo y núcleo de adiestramiento donde los elfos de la noche novicios conocen a instructores de clase, mentores y cuidadores.

La principal amenaza procede del noroeste, en la Gruta Narácnida, una caverna infestada de arañas venenosas que se deslizan con frecuencia hacia el claro. Los jóvenes defensores tienen la tarea de diezmar a las arañas y calmar a la inquieta fauna local.

Cañada Umbría está enteramente rodeada de cordilleras salvo por un único sendero hacia el sur. Cruzar este estrecho desfiladero de montaña conduce en dirección sur hacia Aldea Brisa Estelar y el asentamiento de Dolanaar.

subzone:shadowglen.s: Cañada Umbría. Cañada Umbría es un valle apartado y en penumbra situado entre las ramas nororientales de Teldrassil. Dominado por el gran túmulo arbóreo de Aldrassil, sirve como refugio seguro donde los jóvenes elfos de la noche dan sus primeros pasos en el servicio antes de aventurarse en el ancho mundo. Resguardada en las copas nororientales de Teldrassil, Cañada Umbría está rodeada por altas crestas que la protegen del resto del mundo. Bañado en un crepúsculo eterno, el valle gira en torno a Aldrassil, un inmenso túmulo arbóreo cuyo tronco hueco alberga a ancianos, sacerdotisas y mentores para los jóvenes elfos de la noche que inician su adiestramiento. La única ruta de salida del valle conduce hacia el sur a través de un estrecho paso de montaña hacia Aldea Brisa Estelar y Dolanaar, lo que convierte a Cañada Umbría en uno de los santuarios más pacíficos y naturalmente fortificados del Árbol del Mundo.

ang.faction:Alliance: Situated high on the boughs of Teldrassil and deep behind guarded ports, Shadowglen stands as one of the Alliance's most insulated and well-defended sanctuary vales.
ang.race:NightElf: Every young night elf begins their active journey here among the sheltered roots of Aldrassil, receiving their first blessings and instructions before facing the perils of Kalimdor.

faq.a: Shadowglen is the sheltered starting grove for the night elves, located in the northeastern reaches of Teldrassil. It is a peaceful, secluded haven centered around the grand tree Aldrassil, where novices train under mentors before journeying across the World Tree.
faq.q: What is Shadowglen?

faq.a: The tree is Aldrassil, a barrow-tree that forms the heart of Shadowglen. Its hollowed interior serves as an administrative lodge and training hub where novice night elves meet class trainers, mentors, and caretakers.
faq.q: What is the massive tree at the center of the glen?

faq.a: The primary threat comes from the northwest in Shadowthread Cave, a cavern infested with venomous spiders that regularly creep out into the glade. Young defenders are tasked with culling the spiders and calming the restless local wildlife.
faq.q: What threats exist in Shadowglen?

faq.a: Shadowglen is entirely surrounded by ridges except for a single path to the south. Passing through this narrow mountain gap leads southward toward Starbreeze Village and the settlement of Dolanaar.
faq.q: How do you leave Shadowglen?

text.s: Shadowglen is a secluded, twilit vale nestled within the northeastern boughs of Teldrassil. Dominated by the great barrow-tree Aldrassil, it serves as the safe haven where young night elves take their first steps into service before journeying out into the wider world.

sec.b: Tucked away in the northeastern canopy of Teldrassil, Shadowglen is ringed by high ridges that shelter it from the rest of the world. Bathed in eternal dusk, the vale centers on Aldrassil, a massive barrow-tree whose hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors for young night elves beginning their training. The only route out of the valley leads south through a narrow mountain pass toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar, making Shadowglen one of the most naturally fortified and peaceful sanctuaries on the World Tree.

Despite its tranquil seclusion, Shadowglen is not entirely free from danger. In the extreme northwest lies Shadowthread Cave, a dark cavern infested with venomous spiders that constantly threaten the tranquil glade. Even on the pristine branches of Teldrassil, vigilance is required, and fledgling defenders are tasked with driving back the encroaching vermin and untamed wildlife before venturing into the broader expanse of the boughs beyond.

subzone:shadowthread-cave.s: Gruta Narácnida. La Gruta Narácnida es una caverna húmeda excavada en los riscos del noroeste de Cañada Umbría, en Teldrassil. Habitada tradicionalmente por arañas Tejerrabiza autóctonas, la cueva se ha vuelto recientemente y de forma peligrosa agresiva bajo el dominio de su matriarca, Githyiss la Vil. Escondida en el perímetro sombrío de Cañada Umbría, la Gruta Narácnida ha servido durante mucho tiempo como guarida natural para las arañas gigantes de Teldrassil. En años anteriores, estos arácnidos coexistían pacíficamente junto a las ramas nacientes del Árbol del Mundo. Sin embargo, recientemente su temperamento se ha vuelto ferozmente territorial. Gruesas capas de seda de Tejerrabiza obstruyen ahora los pasillos de piedra, y la naturaleza agresiva de la prole supone un peligro inmediato para los jóvenes kaldorei que dan sus primeros pasos más allá de Aldrassil.

ang.class:Druid: The unchecked aggression of the Webwood brood in Shadowthread Cave is a troubling indicator to druids that the natural harmony of Teldrassil is deeply disturbed.
ang.race:NightElf: For young night elves, clearing Shadowthread Cave and slaying Githyiss the Vile serves as one of their very first trials in defending their sacred home from creeping corruption.

faq.a: Shadowthread Cave lies in the northwest corner of Shadowglen, nestled against the rocky hillside bordering the night elf starting valley in Teldrassil.
faq.q: Where is Shadowthread Cave located?

faq.a: While spiders have always dwelled within the cave, a foul sickness and growing imbalance across Teldrassil has driven the local wildlife mad, turning the webwood spiders exceptionally violent.
faq.q: Why are the spiders in the cave so aggressive?

faq.a: Githyiss the Vile is a massive, venomous webwood spider matriarch nestled at the deepest point of Shadowthread Cave. She is the mother of the aggressive brood threatening young kaldorei in Shadowglen.
faq.q: Who is Githyiss the Vile?

faq.a: The cave is packed with layers of dense, naturally spun webwood silk, a valuable and resilient crafting material woven by the endless swarms of arachnids inhabiting its dark chambers.
faq.q: What makes the cave valuable despite the danger?

text.s: Shadowthread Cave is a damp cavern carved into the northwest cliffs of Shadowglen on Teldrassil. Traditionally inhabited by indigenous Webwood spiders, the cave has recently turned dangerously aggressive under the dominion of their broodmother, Githyiss the Vile.

sec.b: Tucked away in the shaded perimeter of Shadowglen, Shadowthread Cave has long served as a natural lair for Teldrassil's giant spiders. In earlier years, these arachnids coexisted quietly alongside the nascent boughs of the World Tree. Recently, however, their temperament has turned fiercely territorial. Thick layers of webwood silk now choke the stone corridors, and the aggressive nature of the brood poses an immediate hazard to young kaldorei taking their first steps beyond Aldrassil.

The primary menace lurking deep within the cave's darkest recesses is Githyiss the Vile, a monstrous broodmother whose ferocity far outstrips the common webwood crawlers. Novice night elf sentinels and druids are dispatched to the cave to curb the spider infestation and slay Githyiss, ensuring that the corruption touching Teldrassil's wildlife does not overrun the sanctuary of Shadowglen entirely.

subzone:shimmer-ridge.s: Monte Luz. Monte Luz es una escarpada meseta situada en el norte de Dun Morogh, justo al oeste de las Puertas de Forjaz. Ocupadas por los hostiles troles Frostmane, las alturas rocosas constan de dos campamentos unidos por un destartalado puente y son famosas por ser el único lugar donde se recolecta la potente hierba centelleante cardaluz. Encaramado a lo largo de las escarpadas laderas justo al oeste de la imponente entrada de Forjaz, Monte Luz sirve como un reducto activo para la tribu de troles Frostmane. Dividido en dos campamentos gemelos a ambos lados de un abismo y unidos por una pasarela de madera, el enclave está fuertemente custodiado por troles carroñeros y sus jabalíes de montaña amaestrados. Su proximidad al camino principal y a la capital de los enanos supone una molestia constante para los viajeros y las patrullas de las montañas, que deben permanecer continuamente en guardia contra las incursiones oportunistas desde las alturas.

ang.profession:Herbalism: While ordinary flora struggles in Dun Morogh's sub-zero climate, Shimmer Ridge uniquely supports valuable shimmerweed baskets tended among the Frostmane camps.
ang.race:Dwarf: Nestled in the shadow of Ironforge's gates, Shimmer Ridge is an irritating reminder of the persistent Frostmane threat and the dangerous source of choice shimmerweed for legendary dwarven stout.

faq.a: Shimmer Ridge is situated in northern Dun Morogh, directly to the west of the massive Gates of Ironforge that lead into the dwarven capital.
faq.q: Where is Shimmer Ridge located?

faq.a: The ridge is occupied by the indigenous Frostmane troll tribe, who have established dual camps connected by a bridge and defend the heights alongside their tamed boars.
faq.q: Who controls Shimmer Ridge?

faq.a: Shimmerweed is a distinct mountain herb that thrives on the cold slopes of the ridge. Local dwarven brewers value it immensely as an essential ingredient for specialized, flavorful recipes of highland ale.
faq.q: What is shimmerweed and why is it sought after?

faq.a: Ironforge's military is occupied with broader defense and external matters, leaving local threats like the Frostmane enclaves in Dun Morogh to be managed by regional mountaineers and wandering recruits.
faq.q: Why don't the dwarves clear out the trolls completely?

text.s: Shimmer Ridge is a rugged highland nestled in northern Dun Morogh, directly west of the Gates of Ironforge. Occupied by hostile Frostmane trolls, the rocky heights consist of two camps joined by a rickety bridge and are renowned as the sole harvesting ground for potent shimmerweed.

sec.b: Perched along the craggy slopes just west of Ironforge's mighty entryway, Shimmer Ridge serves as an active redoubt for the Frostmane troll tribe. Divided into twin camps straddling a chasm and linked by a wooden span, the enclave is heavily guarded by troll scavengers and their tamed mountain boars. Their proximity to the main roadway and the dwarven capital poses a continuous nuisance to travelers and mountain patrols, who must constantly remain on guard against opportunistic raids from the high ground.

Aside from strategic positioning, the ridge is famous for cultivating shimmerweed, a plant grown by the Frostmane trolls. Prized by local dwarven brewmasters for crafting potent, flavorful highland ales, the herb cannot easily be gathered elsewhere. Daring mountaineers and young recruits frequently risk Frostmane ambushes and savage tusked beasts simply to harvest fresh baskets of the precious botanical directly from the trolls' plots.

subzone:shimmering-flats.s: El Desierto de Sal. El Desierto de Sal es una extensa llanura salina situada en el extremo suroriental de Las Mil Agujas, en la frontera con el desierto de Tanaris. Antaño el lecho de un antiguo lago, esta extensión abrasada por el sol es ahora célebre por las rivalidades mecánicas a alta velocidad del Circuito del Espejismo y por una dura fauna de bestias del desierto. Extendiéndose bajo el cegador sol del sur, El Desierto de Sal es el vasto lecho de un lago seco desprovisto de vegetación, salpicado de huesos de tortuga blanqueados por el sol e incluso del pecio de madera de un antiguo navío de vela. Su superficie completamente llana y continua lo convierte en el principal campo de pruebas de Kalimdor para vehículos experimentales. En el centro de la llanura se encuentra el Circuito del Espejismo, donde manitas gnomos y goblins se enfrentan constantemente para ver qué bólidos cohete, girocópteros y motores alcanzan las mayores velocidades, lo que a menudo resulta en ardientes colisiones y humeantes cráteres por toda la corteza blanca.

ang.profession:Engineering: The salt flats are a pilgrimage site for engineers, littered with scrap, fuel experiments, and high-speed vehicular trial runs fueled by the endless rivalry between goblin and gnomish machinists.
ang.race:Gnome: Out on the Mirage Raceway, gnomish pilots and mechanostriders boldly defend gnomish engineering pride against the volatile, explosive designs of their goblin rivals.

faq.a: The Shimmering Flats was once a massive inland lake that dried up long ago. The wrecked vessel resting in the northern stretch of the flats is a remnant of that ancient body of water, left behind when the lake evaporated into the vast salt pan seen today.
faq.q: Why is there a ruined ship out in the middle of the desert?

faq.a: The unbroken, flat salt crust provides the perfect terrain for testing rocket cars and cutting-edge mechanical contraptions. Rather than fighting over territory, local gnomes and goblins established the Mirage Raceway to fuel their technological rivalry, endlessly trying to outdo each other in speed, engineering, and reckless bravado.
faq.q: Why are gnomes and goblins here together?

faq.a: The Rustmaul Dig Site was established by dwarven archaeologists, who were soon attacked by a Horde raiding party led by Moktar Krin. Then the diggers inadvertently broke into a subterranean silithid hive, releasing swarms of insectoid horrors that drove everyone out and overran the southern flats.
faq.q: What happened to the dwarven dig site in the south?

faq.a: Following the tracks southeast across the salt pan leads directly to the mountain pass that opens into the vast desert of Tanaris and the neutral port of Gadgetzan.
faq.q: Where does the road through the Shimmering Flats lead?

text.s: The Shimmering Flats is an expansive salt flat lying at the southeastern tip of Thousand Needles, bordering the desert of Tanaris. Once the bed of an ancient lake, this sun-baked expanse is now famous for the high-speed mechanical rivalries of the Mirage Raceway and a harsh population of desert beasts.

sec.b: Stretching out under the blinding southern sun, the Shimmering Flats is a vast dried lakebed devoid of vegetation, dotted with the sun-bleached bones of turtles and even the wooden wreck of an ancient sailing vessel. Its sheer, unbroken level surface makes it the premier testing ground on Kalimdor for experimental vehicles. At the center of the flats lies the Mirage Raceway, where gnome and goblin tinkerers constantly clash to see whose rocket cars, gyrocopters, and engines can achieve the highest speeds—often resulting in fiery crashes and smoking craters across the white crust.
sec.t: A Bed of Salt and Speed

sec.b: Beyond the roaring engines of the raceway, the basin is far from peaceful. Hardened basilisks, aggressive scorpids, and circling vultures prey upon anything that slows down on the open expanse. Further south, the ground grows treacherous around the Rustmaul Dig Site. Originally excavated by dwarven prospectors before being contested by the Horde, the quarry was entirely abandoned when picks cracked into subterranean tunnels, unleashing a swarm of vicious silithid into the southern edge of the flats.

subzone:shining-strand.s: La Playa Plateada. La Playa Plateada es la franja de costa que bordea el Lago Lordamere a lo largo del este del Bosque de Argénteos, extendiéndose hacia el sur desde las Ruinas de Lordaeron hacia las escarpadas estribaciones de Alterac. Antaño dominadas por los agresivos múrlocs Vile Fin, las costas son ahora un terreno disputado donde los campamentos de los Renegados vigilan el agua y se enfrentan a los huargen invasores. A lo largo del borde oriental del Bosque de Argénteos, La Playa Plateada bordea las brumosas aguas del Lago Lordamere. En tiempos anteriores, la tribu de múrlocs Vile Fin estableció varios asentamientos agresivos a lo largo de estos bajíos, lo que suponía un peligro mortal para cualquiera que intentara recorrer el camino del lago. Aunque los Vile Fin han desplazado en gran medida su presencia hacia el este, a las Islas del Alba, la costa dista mucho de ser pacífica. Los exploradores y boticarios de los Renegados han establecido posiciones a lo largo de la playa, enfrentándose a los huargen ferales que surgen de la espesura del bosque y manteniendo un ojo vigilante tanto en las aguas como en las colinas que limitan con Alterac.

ang.faction:Horde: The strand offers a clear, if perilous, transit corridor along Lordamere Lake connecting the northern approaches of Silverpine to the passages heading toward the Alterac Mountains.
ang.race:Undead: Holding the Shining Strand protects the Undercity's southern lake flank and provides valuable specimens for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into a new plague.

faq.a: The Shining Strand is the eastern shoreline of Silverpine Forest, bordering the waters of Lordamere Lake. It begins just south of the Ruins of Lordaeron and ends against the rough hills that separate Silverpine from the Alterac Mountains.
faq.q: Where is the Shining Strand located?

faq.a: Forsaken encampments along the strand contend regularly with prowling worgen that emerge from the Silverpine woods. While the Vile Fin murlocs previously held strongpoints on the shore, most have relocated to the nearby Dawning Isles, though aquatic threats still lurk in the shallows.
faq.q: What threats are found along the Shining Strand?

faq.a: The late Apothecary Berard documented that the native Vile Fin murlocs carried hardened tumors with unique physiological traits. The Society saw these growths as promising ingredients in their ongoing research to develop a lethal new plague.
faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society interested in this area?

faq.a: After pressure from Forsaken forces securing the shoreline, the Vile Fin tribe relocated their major encampments off the mainland coast to the Dawning Isles in Lordamere Lake.
faq.q: Where did the local murlocs go?

text.s: The Shining Strand is the strip of shoreline hugging Lordamere Lake along eastern Silverpine Forest, stretching south from the Ruins of Lordaeron toward the rugged foothills of Alterac. Once dominated by aggressive Vile Fin murlocs, the shores are now contested ground where Forsaken encampments watch the water and skirmish with encroaching worgen.

sec.b: Running along the eastern edge of Silverpine Forest, the Shining Strand borders the misty waters of Lordamere Lake. In earlier days, the Vile Fin tribe of murlocs established several aggressive settlements along these shallows, posing a deadly hazard to anyone attempting to travel the lake road. While the Vile Fins have largely shifted their presence eastward to the Dawning Isles, the shore remains far from peaceful. Forsaken scouts and apothecaries have established footholds along the strand, contending with feral worgen roaming out from the deep woods and keeping a watchful eye on both the waters and the hills bordering Alterac.

Beyond its strategic position between Lordaeron and the southern borders, the Shining Strand and its neighboring waters drew early attention from the Royal Apothecary Society. The late Apothecary Berard recorded notes on unusual hardened tumors harvested from the local Vile Fin murlocs, theorizing that their corrupted anatomy could serve as a valuable catalyst in concocting a new plague for Sylvanas Windrunner's fledgling nation.

subzone:shrine-of-the-dormant-flame.s: Santuario de la Llama Latente. Encaramado en la cima del pico más alto al noroeste del Valle de los Retos, el Santuario de la Llama Latente es un refugio apartado y venerado por los chamanes de la Horda. Guiados por su solitario guardián, Telf Joolam, los iniciados emprenden la peligrosa ascensión para entrar en comunión con el elemento del fuego y demostrar su maestría espiritual. Llegar al Santuario de la Llama Latente requiere enfrentarse a un sendero estrecho y serpenteante que comienza junto al Río Furia del Sur, en el extremo suroeste de Southfury Watershed. Muy por encima de los riscos rojos de Durotar, la cumbre de la montaña ofrece una vista imponente de las tierras circundantes, aunque un solo paso en falso por el precipicio supone una muerte segura. En este tranquilo refugio deambula Telf Joolam, un ermitaño solitario encargado de supervisar los ritos sagrados. Para los aspirantes a chamán orcos y trols que emprenden el ritual de La llamada del Fuego, el brasero del santuario sirve como crisol donde deben prender los carbones dormidos usando el rescoldo de un elemental derrotado, demostrando su poder para comunicarse con los destructivos espíritus de la llama y respetarlos.

ang.class:Shaman: Every young orc and troll shaman must make the arduous trek up this crag to kindle their spiritual connection with fire and earn their Fire Totem.
ang.faction:Horde: Tucked away in the mountains above Durotar, this isolated shrine preserves ancient elemental rites vital to the spiritual heart of the new Horde.

faq.a: The path begins along the Southfury River on the southwestern edge of the Southfury Watershed, just northwest of the Valley of Trials. A narrow mountain trail spirals around the peak, leading directly up to the summit.
al: how to get to shrine of the dormant flame
faq.q: How do you reach the Shrine of the Dormant Flame?

faq.a: The shrine is a sacred site where aspiring Horde shaman learn to understand and command the element of fire. As part of their Call of Fire journey, initiates must travel to this summit to prepare a ritual draft and kindle the dormant brazier.
faq.q: Why is this shrine important to shaman?

faq.a: Telf Joolam is a solitary troll hermit who serves as the keeper of the shrine. He guides young shaman through their trials, concocting a draught of fire to awaken their spiritual sight and testing their resolve.
faq.q: Who is Telf Joolam?

faq.a: Shaman who have gathered the required ritual components and defeated a hostile fire elemental place its burning ember into the brazier. This acts as an offering to prove they have the strength and discipline to tame the volatile spirit of flame.
faq.q: What happens when you kindle the brazier?

text.s: Perched atop the highest peak northwest of the Valley of Trials, the Shrine of the Dormant Flame is a secluded sanctuary revered by Horde shaman. Guided by its solitary keeper, Telf Joolam, initiates make the treacherous climb to commune with the element of fire and prove their spiritual mastery.

sec.b: Reaching the Shrine of the Dormant Flame requires braving a narrow, winding trail that begins along the Southfury River at the southwestern edge of the Southfury Watershed. High above the red cliffs of Durotar, the mountain summit offers a commanding view of the surrounding lands, though a single misstep along the precipice means certain death. In this quiet refuge wanders Telf Joolam, a solitary hermit tasked with overseeing sacred rites. For aspiring orc and troll shaman undertaking the ritual Call of Fire, the shrine's brazier serves as the crucible where they must ignite slumbering coals using the ember of a vanquished elemental, proving their power to commune with and respect the destructive spirits of flame.
sec.t: A Summit of Trial and Flame

subzone:shrine-of-the-fallen-warrior.s: Santuario del Guerrero Caído. Encaramado en una cresta apartada al oeste de El Cruce se encuentra el Santuario del Guerrero Caído, un tranquilo monumento conmemorativo que domina las extensas sabanas rojas de Los Baldíos. Marcado por un plinto de piedra con las iniciales «MK» grabadas y el cuerpo de un guerrero orco caído, está custodiado por la apacible presencia de un Ángel de la Resurrección llamado Koiter. Escondido en lo alto de las colinas al noroeste de El Cruce, el Santuario del Guerrero Caído se alza como un remanso inusualmente solemne en medio del polvo y el peligro de Los Baldíos. Para encontrarlo, los viajeros deben subir por un sendero sinuoso por la cresta al suroeste de la cima hasta alcanzar un suave montículo. En la cima descansa un monumento de piedra tallada, con las iniciales «MK» grabadas en su plinto. Ante él yace la figura en armadura de un guerrero orco en reposo, vigilado día y noche por un Ángel de la Resurrección con nombre propio: Koiter. Aquí no suenan cuernos de batalla, solo reina una tranquila contemplación en honor a un campeón que recorrió las tierras de Kalimdor.

ang.class:Warrior: Warriors of all races often make a quiet pilgrimage to this hill, paying respects to a fallen brother-in-arms who fought bravely before passing into legend.
ang.faction:Horde: Set right in the heartland of Horde territory, this solitary resting place captures the honor, duty, and sacrifice at the core of the shamanic and warrior traditions of Kalimdor.

faq.a: The shrine sits atop a hill west of the Crossroads in the northern Barrens. Travelers can reach it by locating the base of a ridge southwest of the elevation and following a winding path up to the grassy knoll.
al: how to get to shrine of fallen warrior
faq.q: Where is the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior located?

faq.a: In-game, he represents a revered fallen warrior. In reality, he is modeled directly after Twincruiser, the orc warrior character played by late Blizzard artist Michel Koiter during early development.
faq.q: Who is the orc lying upon the plinth?

faq.a: The runic initials 'MK' honor Michel Koiter, a senior artist who passed away in 2004 during the development of the world.
faq.q: What does the 'MK' carved into the stone mean?

faq.a: The Spirit Healer is named Koiter. Unlike ordinary Spirit Healers that only appear to spirits walking in death, Koiter stands in vigil and can be seen clearly by living wanderers who make the trek up the hill.
faq.q: Who is the Spirit Healer standing beside the shrine?

faq.a: No. The Shrine of the Fallen Warrior is not part of any questline or faction conflict. It exists purely as a solemn place of reflection, remembrance, and tribute.
faq.q: Are there any quests associated with this shrine?

text.s: Perched upon a secluded ridge west of the Crossroads lies the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior, a quiet memorial overlooking the sweeping red savannahs of the Barrens. Marked by a stone plinth bearing the initials 'MK' and the body of a fallen orc warrior, it is watched over by the gentle presence of a Spirit Healer named Koiter.

sec.b: Tucked away high upon the hills northwest of the Crossroads, the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior stands as an unusually solemn haven amidst the dust and peril of the Barrens. To find it, travelers must scale a winding ridge pathway southwest of the summit until they reach a gentle mound. Upon the summit rests a carved stone monument, its plinth carved with the initials 'MK'. Before it lies the armored form of an orc warrior at rest, watched over day and night by a named Spirit Healer known as Koiter. There are no battle horns here, only quiet contemplation honoring a champion who walked Kalimdor's lands.

Within the world, the shrine stands as an enduring tribute to a departed champion of the Horde whose soul lingers in the care of the spirits. Outside the realm, the monument serves as a heartfelt tribute created by the game's artists to honor Michel Koiter, a beloved illustrator who passed away during the development of the world. The resting warrior is modeled precisely after Koiter's own beta character, Twincruiser, immortalizing his presence forever beneath Kalimdor's open skies.

subzone:silver-stream-mine.s: Mina de Fuenteplata. La Mina de Fuenteplata es una mina enana agotada situada en el norte de Loch Modan, resguardada entre la Estación de Algaz y la Presa de las Tres Cabezas. Antaño una rica veta de plata para el reino de Forjaz, el hueco excavado se reconvirtió en un depósito de suministros de la Liga de Mineros antes de ser invadido por alimañas. Hoy en día, los kóbolds Rata de Túnel ocupan los túneles, acumulando equipo robado y raras curiosidades minerales. La Mina de Fuenteplata rebosaba antaño de valioso mineral y contribuyó en gran medida a las reservas de plata de Forjaz. Con el tiempo, los picos de los enanos excavaron lo suficiente como para agotar las vetas principales, convirtiendo las extensas cámaras en un complejo subterráneo vacío. En lugar de abandonar las laboriosas obras de tierra, la Liga de Mineros transformó los pozos en un depósito de almacenamiento seguro para herramientas, cajas de minería y equipo regional. También sirve como la única fuente conocida de las raras Charged Rift Gems, que atraen a arcanistas inquisitivos en busca de delicados componentes de sastrería.

ang.class:Mage: Apprentice mages journey into the dangerous kobold-infested tunnels specifically to extract Charged Rift Gems, an indispensable ingredient for crafting ritual garments.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, Silver Stream Mine is an infuriating loss of hard-earned infrastructure, where clumsy kobolds now sully a respectable Ironforge Miners' League depot.

faq.a: Originally, it was a productive silver mine excavated by the dwarves of Ironforge. After the veins ran dry, the Ironforge Miners' League repurposed the vacant subterranean halls into a storage depot for tools and excavation supplies.
faq.q: What was the Silver Stream Mine originally used for?

faq.a: The mine has been completely overrun by Tunnel Rat kobolds. They chased off the dwarf caretakers and now guard the tunnels, hoarding the League's abandoned supply crates and digging for residual scraps.
al: who lives in silver stream mine
what is inside silver stream mine
faq.q: Who currently occupies the mine?

faq.a: The mine is the only known source of Charged Rift Gems. These volatile, magically reactive stones are sought after by Alliance arcanists to weave potent enchanted robes.
faq.q: Why do mages travel to Silver Stream Mine?

faq.a: Behind the mine sit broken orcish wagons and ruined catapults, weathered remnants of earlier wartime conflicts that threatened the passages connecting Loch Modan and the northern mountain passes.
faq.q: What are the ruined catapults behind the mine?

text.s: Silver Stream Mine is a depleted dwarf mine located in northern Loch Modan, nestled between Algaz Station and the Stonewrought Dam. Once a rich silver vein for the kingdom of Ironforge, the excavated hollow was repurposed as a Miners' League supply depot before being overrun by vermin. Today, Tunnel Rat kobolds squat inside the tunnels, hoarding stolen equipment and rare mineral curiosities.

sec.b: Silver Stream Mine once flowed with precious ore, contributing heavily to the silver reserves of Ironforge. In time, the dwarf pickaxes dug deep enough to exhaust the primary veins, turning the sprawling chambers into an empty subterranean complex. Rather than abandon the hard-won earthworks, the Miners' League transformed the shafts into a secure storage depot for tools, mining crates, and regional equipment. It also serves as the only known source of rare Charged Rift Gems, which draw inquisitive arcanists searching for delicate tailoring reagents.
sec.t: From Rich Vein to Storage Depot

sec.b: The quiet depot did not remain secure for long. Aggressive Tunnel Rat kobolds, drawn by the smell of unattended tools, candle wax, and forgotten subterranean crevices, swarmed the shafts in large numbers. The Miners' League caretakers were promptly driven out into the Loch Modan cold. Now, the kobolds guard the stolen dwarf crates with manic fervor, while old, shattered orcish catapults and wagons rest forgotten outside the rear entrances, silent reminders of older frontier skirmishes.

subzone:silverwind-refuge.s: Refugio Brisa de Plata. El Refugio Brisa de Plata es un sereno asentamiento de los elfos de la noche situado en el centro-sur de Vallefresno, justo al norte del Lago Mystral. Protegido por centinelas y elementales de agua aliados, ofrece un acogedor refugio para los viajeros que recorren los senderos boscosos de la espesura. Ubicado entre las plácidas aguas del Lago Mystral y el Lago Iris al norte, el Refugio Brisa de Plata se erige como una de las principales paradas de postas de los elfos de la noche en el centro de Vallefresno, junto a Astranaar. Cuenta con una cómoda posada, artesanos y maestros de profesión que instruyen a los viajeros en herboristería, alquimia, desuello y caza. Custodiado por firmes centinelas junto a espíritus de agua locales, el retiro sirve como un pacífico lugar de descanso para los aliados que atraviesan los umbríos bosques ancestrales.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance wanderers traversing Ashenvale, Silverwind Refuge provides a reliable camp to rest, restock supplies, and refine wilderness trades without venturing all the way to Astranaar.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The refuge serves as a vital stop in Ashenvale for gatherers, offering on-site herbalism training surrounded by the rich flora of Mystral Lake.

faq.a: Silverwind Refuge is an Alliance settlement, built and maintained by the night elves. It is heavily guarded by the Sentinels, alongside water elementals who help protect the tranquil grounds.
faq.q: Who controls Silverwind Refuge?

faq.a: It is located in south-central Ashenvale, positioned directly north of Mystral Lake and south of Iris Lake.
faq.q: Where is Silverwind Refuge located?

faq.a: Travelers can find an inn, trade supply vendors, and professional trainers offering instruction in herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunter skills.
faq.q: What services are found at the refuge?

text.s: Silverwind Refuge is a serene night elven settlement nestled in south-central Ashenvale, situated just north of Mystral Lake. Protected by Sentinels and allied water elementals, it offers a welcoming haven for travelers along the forest's wooded trails.

sec.b: Resting between the placid waters of Mystral Lake and Iris Lake to the north, Silverwind Refuge stands as one of the major night elven waystations in central Ashenvale alongside Astranaar. It boasts a comfortable inn, craftsmen, and wilderness trainers who instruct travelers in herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunting. Guarded by stalwart Sentinels alongside local water spirits, the retreat serves as a peaceful rest stop for allies moving through the shaded ancient woods.

subzone:silverwing-grove.s: Claro Ala de Plata. Escondido en la zona centro-sur de Vallefresno, cerca del Lago Cielo Estrellado, Claro Ala de Plata sirve como punto de concentración para las Centinelas Ala de Plata. Desde esta hondonada fortificada, los guerreros elfos de la noche reúnen a las fuerzas de la Alianza para hacer retroceder a los leñadores del clan Grito de Guerra que arrasan el bosque. Oculto bajo el dosel esmeralda al suroeste de Avanzada Ala de Plata, Claro Ala de Plata es un puesto militar de concentración crucial para las Centinelas Ala de Plata. Lejos de ser un apacible retiro boscoso, funciona como el centro neurálgico de operaciones para la encarnizada disputa territorial de los elfos de la noche contra las talas de la Horda en Garganta Grito de Guerra. Oficiales de alto rango de la Alianza, suministros y exploradores se reúnen aquí, organizando escaramuzas y congregando campeones para defender el ancestral Vallefresno de la expansión de los orcos.

ang.faction:Alliance: The grove is the primary staging ground for Alliance champions seeking to muster and enter the bloody skirmishes of Warsong Gulch.
ang.race:NightElf: For the kaldorei, Silverwing Grove represents the steadfast resolve to halt the desecration of sacred trees at the axes of the Warsong Clan.

faq.a: Silverwing Grove serves as the staging base for the Silverwing Sentinels. It is where the night elf military and their Alliance allies organize efforts to contest the Warsong Clan's deforesting efforts and enter the ongoing conflict in Warsong Gulch.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Silverwing Grove?

faq.a: It is located in south-central Ashenvale, situated southwest of Silverwing Outpost and just west of Fallen Sky Lake.
faq.q: Where is Silverwing Grove located?

faq.a: The grove is manned by the Silverwing Sentinels alongside Alliance military commanders, including an Alliance Brigadier General, logistical vendors, and officers such as Sentinel Farsong who coordinate efforts against the Horde.
faq.q: Who operates out of Silverwing Grove?

faq.a: No. The grove is an active military post populated by hostile Alliance sentinels and guards who will immediately attack any encroaching Horde members on sight.
al: can horde go to silverwing grove
faq.q: Can Horde players enter Silverwing Grove?

text.s: Tucked away in south-central Ashenvale near Fallen Sky Lake, Silverwing Grove serves as the staging grounds for the Silverwing Sentinels. From this fortified hollow, night elf warriors muster Alliance forces to push back the Warsong Clan loggers tearing through the forest.

sec.b: Hidden beneath the emerald canopy southwest of Silverwing Outpost, Silverwing Grove is a crucial military staging post for the Silverwing Sentinels. Rather than a tranquil woodland retreat, it functions as the operational heartbeat for the night elves' bitter territorial contest against the Horde's lumber operations in Warsong Gulch. High-ranking Alliance officers, provisions, and scouts gather here, organizing skirmishes and marshaling champions to defend ancient Ashenvale against orcish expansion.
sec.t: Front Line of the Forest War

subzone:silverwing-outpost.s: Avanzada Ala de Plata. La Avanzada Ala de Plata es una guarnición fortificada de elfos de la noche situada en el centro-sur de Vallefresno, al este del Río Falfarren. Comandada por Duriel Moonfire, se erige como el bastión más oriental de la Alianza frente a la Horda en este bosque en disputa. Situada al suroeste del Puesto del Hachazo y justo al norte de la frontera con Los Baldíos, la Avanzada Ala de Plata ocupa una posición estratégica intrínsecamente peligrosa. Al asentarse en la orilla oriental del Río Falfarren —un territorio fuertemente disputado y patrullado por la Horda—, la avanzada sirve como escudo directo para las posesiones de los elfos de la noche en las profundidades del bosque. Duriel Moonfire y sus Centinelas Ala de Plata permanecen bajo el asedio constante de los orcos cercanos, decididos a purgar por completo las fuerzas de los elfos de la noche de la zona.

ang.faction:Alliance: Silverwing Outpost serves as your vital forward redoubt on the Horde side of the river, checking orc expansion out of Splintertree Post.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Horde, the outpost is an intolerable thorn in the side of Splintertree Post, directly obstructing your movements and supply lines through southern Ashenvale.

faq.a: It is located in south-central Ashenvale, southwest of Splintertree Post, north of the Barrens border, and on the eastern side of the Falfarren River.
faq.q: Where is Silverwing Outpost located?

faq.a: The outpost is commanded by Duriel Moonfire, a night elf officer leading the Silverwing Sentinels defending the eastern reaches of the forest.
faq.q: Who commands Silverwing Outpost?

faq.a: Silverwing Outpost sits directly on the eastern side of the Falfarren River near Splintertree Post. Its presence allows the Sentinels to cut off Horde supply lines and directly threaten orcish operations in Ashenvale.
faq.q: Why does the Horde target this outpost so aggressively?

faq.a: The Silverwing Sentinels are a militant order of night elf warriors and huntresses dedicated to protecting Ashenvale from incursions, particularly against the encroaching lumber camps and war parties of the Horde.
faq.q: Who are the Silverwing Sentinels?

text.s: Silverwing Outpost is a fortified night elf garrison positioned in south-central Ashenvale, east of the Falfarren River. Commanded by Duriel Moonfire, it stands as the easternmost bastion of the Alliance against the Horde in the contested woodland.

sec.b: Situated southwest of Splintertree Post and just north of the border with the Barrens, Silverwing Outpost holds an inherently perilous strategic position. By sitting on the eastern side of the Falfarren River—territory heavily contested and patrolled by the Horde—the outpost serves as a direct shield for night elf holdings deeper in the forest. Duriel Moonfire and her Silverwing Sentinels remain under constant siege from nearby orcs determined to purge night elf forces from the area entirely.

The skirmishes surrounding Silverwing Outpost are among the fiercest in Ashenvale. Orcish war parties based out of Splintertree Post, such as raiders led by Torek, launch relentless ambushes against the garrison's walls. For the Horde, neutralizing the outpost is essential to securing the road and expanding resource operations without the constant threat of Sentinel counterattacks.

subzone:sishir-canyon.s: Cañón Sishir. El Cañón Sishir es un escarpado desfiladero en Sierra Espolón, que se abre paso hacia el este a través de las abruptas cumbres. Plagado por densos enjambres de monstruosas arañas Musgoprofundo y cubierto de telarañas, sirve como peligroso acceso a las Ruinas de Eldre'thar. Los viajeros que se atreven a adentrarse en sus enmarañadas profundidades deben enfrentarse a arácnidos venenosos y a su amenazante matriarca. El Cañón Sishir, que nace como una bifurcación de los caminos de montaña de Sierra Espolón, es un traicionero corredor natural que se abre paso hacia las antiguas Ruinas de Eldre'thar. Lejos de ser un apacible sendero de montaña, el desfiladero ha sido completamente invadido por arañas Musgoprofundo. Sus pegajosos mantos de seda y sus cúmulos de sacos de huevos asfixian el suelo pedregoso y las paredes de roca, transformando el barranco en un nido viviente. Los viajeros y centinelas que buscan las ruinas de los elfos de la noche que aguardan más allá deben abrirse camino entre enjambres de agresivas tejedoras.

ang.class:Hunter: The dangerous webbing and venomous Deepmoss spiders make Sishir Canyon a demanding testing ground for hunters tracking and trapping wild beasts in tight ravine quarters.
ang.race:NightElf: The overrun canyon cuts off easy, safe passage to the ancestral Ruins of Eldre'thar, requiring Kaldorei sentinels and scholars to fight through dense spider nests to reach their heritage.

faq.a: Sishir Canyon is a spider-infested gorge in the Stonetalon Mountains that winds from the main mountain paths toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar.
faq.q: What is Sishir Canyon?

faq.a: The canyon is thoroughly claimed by predatory Deepmoss spiders. The arachnids have coated the ravine in dense webbing and egg sacs, preying on anything that enters their territory.
faq.q: What creatures live in the canyon?

faq.a: Besseleth is the formidable spider matriarch dwelling deep within Sishir Canyon. She leads the Deepmoss brood and poses the greatest threat to travelers passing through the area.
faq.q: Who is Besseleth?

faq.a: Following the canyon eastward leads directly out to the Ruins of Eldre'thar, an ancient night elven site tucked high in the mountains.
al: what is at the end of sishir canyon
faq.q: Where does Sishir Canyon lead?

text.s: Sishir Canyon is a rugged gorge in the Stonetalon Mountains, carving an eastward path through the craggy heights. Thickly swarmed by monstrous Deepmoss spiders and choked in webbing, it serves as the dangerous approach to the Ruins of Eldre'thar. Travelers who brave its tangled depths must contend with venomous arachnids and their brooding matriarch.

sec.b: Branching off the mountain roads of the Stonetalon range, Sishir Canyon is a treacherous natural corridor cutting toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar. Rather than a quiet mountain trail, the gorge has been thoroughly overrun by Deepmoss spiders. Their sticky silken sheets and clusters of egg sacs smother the stony ground and rock walls, transforming the ravine into a living nest. Travelers and sentinels seeking the night elven ruins beyond must cut their way through swarms of aggressive webspinners.

Lurking in the deepest recess of the canyon is Besseleth, the massive and deadly matriarch of the Deepmoss brood. Her venom and monstrous size make her a terror to anyone attempting to secure the pass. Local forces in Stonetalon keep a wary watch on the canyon, warning adventurers that venturing into the webbed recesses means facing not just scattered spiders, but an apex predator fiercely guarding her brood.

subzone:skittering-dark.s: Penumbra de las Celerácnidas. La Penumbra de las Celerácnidas es una mina abandonada y una hondonada boscosa y sombría en el oeste de Bosque de Argénteos. Infestadas por agresivas arañas gigantes, la caverna y los bosques circundantes están repletos de telarañas y peligros para las bestias y los viajeros incautos. Escondida entre las colinas justo al este de la costa occidental de Cala Mareanorte, la Penumbra de las Celerácnidas fue antaño una mina activa. Hoy en día, los pozos están completamente atestados de telarañas y sirven como un extenso nido de arañas gigantes. Con la sombría tejedora Krethis merodeando por el exterior, las arañas cazan a cualquiera que se acerque demasiado.

ang.faction:Horde: Horde travelers venturing into Silverpine should take note: the spiders of the Skittering Dark ambush unwary prey that strays from the surrounding woods into their webbed dens.

faq.a: It is an abandoned mine in western Silverpine Forest that has been entirely overrun by giant spiders. The cavern network and surrounding trees are thick with sticky webbing and predatory arachnids.
faq.q: What is the Skittering Dark?

faq.a: No single ruler of the brood is known. The most feared of the spiders is Krethis Shadowspinner, a rare and dangerous weaver that prowls in and around the mine.
faq.q: Who leads the spiders in the mine?

faq.a: It sits nestled against the hills in western Silverpine Forest, just east of the shoreline known as North Tide's Run.
faq.q: Where is the Skittering Dark located?

text.s: The Skittering Dark is an abandoned mine and shadowy woodland hollow in western Silverpine Forest. Infested by aggressive giant spiders, the cavern and its surrounding woods are thick with webbing and danger for unwary beasts and travelers.

sec.b: Tucked into the hills just east of the western coast of North Tide's Run, the Skittering Dark was once a working mine. Today, the shafts are completely choked with cobwebs, serving as the sprawling nest of giant spiders. With the shadowy weaver Krethis haunting the exterior, the spiders hunt anything that strays too close.

subzone:skull-rock.s: Roca del Cráneo. Roca del Cráneo es una caverna escondida en los acantilados de la costa oriental de Durotar, justo al este de Orgrimmar. Sirve como un aquelarre fortificado para el culto demoníaco del Filo Ardiente justo delante de las narices de la capital. Oculta bajo los riscos del noreste de Durotar, Roca del Cráneo es uno de los bastiones más peligrosos del culto del Filo Ardiente en la región. Oscuros cultistas, orcos devotos de lo vil y convocadores se reúnen en las profundidades de los serpenteantes túneles para practicar artes demoníacas y urdir conspiraciones contra la naciente Horda. La célula está liderada por el peligroso brujo Gazz'uz, cuyas operaciones representan una amenaza inminente para las cercanas Puertas de Orgrimmar y los viajeros que recorren la costa este.

ang.class:Warlock: The dark arts practiced within Skull Rock showcase the unchecked spread of demonic influence that Thrall's Horde seeks to root out and control.
ang.faction:Horde: Clearing the cultists from Skull Rock is vital to securing the coastal approaches to Durotar and protecting Orgrimmar from subversion from within.

faq.a: Skull Rock is a cave system situated in northeastern Durotar along the coast. It is occupied by cultists of the Burning Blade who use its natural cover to plot against Thrall's Horde.
faq.q: What is Skull Rock?

faq.a: The cavern is infested by the Burning Blade cult, led by the orc warlock Gazz'uz from the deepest chamber of the cave.
faq.q: Who controls Skull Rock?

faq.a: Its proximity to Orgrimmar makes it a severe security hazard. The Burning Blade actively seeks to undermine Thrall's new realm and plunge the orcs back into demonic servitude.
faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this cave?

text.s: Skull Rock is a cavern tucked into the eastern coastal cliffs of Durotar, just east of Orgrimmar. It serves as a fortified coven for the demonic Burning Blade cult right under the capital's nose.

sec.b: Hidden beneath the crags of northeastern Durotar, Skull Rock is one of the most perilous strongholds of the Burning Blade cult in the region. Dark cultists, fel-worshipping orcs, and summoners gather deep within the winding tunnels to practice demonic arts and weave conspiracies against the nascent Horde. The cell is led by the dangerous warlock Gazz'uz, whose operations pose an imminent threat to the nearby gates of Orgrimmar and travelers traversing the eastern shoreline.

subzone:sludge-fen.s: El Fangal. El Fangal es un campo petrolífero industrial y tóxico explotado por Ventura y Cía. en el noreste de Los Baldíos. Antaño un estanque prístino de aguas de color azul cristalino, el humedal quedó transformado en un lodazal aceitoso después de que los goblins levantaran plataformas de perforación y maquinaria. La explotación está supervisada por Supervisor Lugwizzle y atrae un constante espionaje industrial y sabotajes por parte de sus rivales en Trinquete. Antes de la llegada de Ventura y Cía., El Fangal era un estanque virgen de aguas cristalinas alimentado por manantiales naturales en los áridos Baldíos. Impulsada por la implacable búsqueda de beneficios, Ventura y Cía. construyó una extensa explotación de extracción petrolífera sobre la cuenca, arruinando el humedal y convirtiéndolo en un embalse repleto de fango cubierto de densos residuos industriales. Bajo la mirada de Supervisor Lugwizzle, perforadores, ingenieros y capataces goblin bombean crudo a todas horas, sin importarles la ruina medioambiental. Sus aguas están ahora densas por los vertidos y los subproductos tóxicos, dejando a la fauna acuática autóctona asfixiada bajo la grasa.

ang.class:Druid: Sludge Fen stands as a sickening testament to unnatural exploitation. Horde druids journey into its oily depths during the Trial of the Sea Lion to retrieve the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility.
ang.profession:Engineering: The Venture Company operates cutting-edge shredders and machinery here, making the site an irresistible target for blueprints, specialized components, and trade theft orchestrated from Ratchet.

faq.a: Sludge Fen was originally a basin of pure, crystal-blue water. The Venture Company ruined the natural oasis when they built an oil rig and refining operation directly on top of it, drowning the surrounding wetland in crude oil and chemical refuse.
faq.q: What was Sludge Fen like before the Venture Company arrived?

faq.a: The oil field is run by Supervisor Lugwizzle on behalf of the Venture Company. He oversees the labor force of overseers, drillers, and engineers alongside lieutenants like Overseer Glibby and Foreman Grills.
faq.q: Who runs the operation at Sludge Fen?

faq.a: The goblin Wizzlecrank was sent by Sputtervalve from Ratchet to steal the Venture Company's superior shredder design. However, he leaped into the cockpit without first securing the ignition key, leaving him stranded surrounded by hostile Venture Co. workers.
faq.q: Why is there a hijacked shredder parked in the middle of the fen?

faq.a: Horde druids undergoing the Trial of the Sea Lion are guided to the bottom of the contaminated pool to recover the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility from a submerged lockbox, testing their endurance against the foul environment.
faq.q: Why do druids dive into these polluted waters?

text.s: Sludge Fen is a toxic industrial oil field operated by the Venture Company in the northeastern Barrens. Once a pristine, crystal-blue pool, the wetland was transformed into an oily quagmire after the goblins erected drilling platforms and machinery. The operation is overseen by Supervisor Lugwizzle and attracts constant industrial espionage and sabotage from rivals in Ratchet.

sec.b: Before the arrival of the Venture Company, Sludge Fen was an untainted pool of crystal-clear water fed by natural springs in the arid Barrens. Driven by the relentless pursuit of profit, the Venture Company constructed an extensive oil-drilling operation over the basin, despoiling the wetland into a sludge-filled reservoir coated in heavy industrial waste. Overseen by Supervisor Lugwizzle, goblin drillers, engineers, and overseers pump crude oil around the clock, heedless of the environmental ruin. The waters are now thick with runoff and toxic byproducts, leaving the native aquatic life choked beneath the grease.

The fen's machinery and shredder innovations have made it a prime target for industrial theft. In nearby Ratchet, Tinkers' Union engineer Sputtervalve has faced fierce pressure to match the Venture Company's cutting-edge logging and excavation technology. Rather than inventing his own designs, Sputtervalve dispatched an operative named Wizzlecrank to commandeer a Venture Company shredder straight from the Sludge Fen. Because Wizzlecrank foolishly hijacked the machine without securing the ignition key, hired mercenaries are often drawn into the mire to pry the keys from Lugwizzle and escort the stolen war machine out through a gauntlet of furious Venture Co. employees.

subzone:solliden-farmstead.s: Hacienda Solliden. La Hacienda Solliden es una granja de calabazas humana activa situada en el oeste de los Claros de Tirisfal, justo al norte de Camposanto. Representa una rara anomalía en el norte de Lordaeron: granjeros nativos vivos que sobrevivieron a la Plaga de la no-muerte y se aferran ferozmente a su tierra bajo la sombra de la Cruzada Escarlata. Mientras la mayor parte de Lordaeron caía en la ruina y la podredumbre, los campos de la Hacienda Solliden aún producen cosechas sanas. El asentamiento se remonta siglos atrás, cuando familias nobles inmigrantes de Strom adquirieron parcelas de pioneros por todo Tirisfal. En la actualidad, estos granjeros humanos supervivientes viven bajo la atenta protección de la Cruzada Escarlata, que patrulla desde una torre cercana. Traumatizados y aislados, defienden su hacienda con una hostilidad inquebrantable, atacando a cualquier forastero que se acerque, ya sea de la Horda o de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Alliance: Seeing living humans tilling Lordaeron's soil brings a glimmer of hope, but the bitter reality is that these isolated survivors view Stormwind's citizens with the same xenophobic hatred they hold for the undead.
ang.race:Undead: For the newly risen Forsaken, Solliden Farmstead is an immediate lesson in realpolitik: living Lordaeronians who despise what you have become, serving as both raw material for Apothecary toxins and a potential southern beachhead.

faq.a: The Solliden farmers are native Lordaeron humans who miraculously escaped infection during the Third War. Shielded by the Scarlet Crusade patrolling from a nearby tower, they stubbornly continue cultivating the land rather than fleeing their ancestral home.
faq.q: Why are there living humans farming in Tirisfal Glades?

faq.a: Living through the fall of Lordaeron has left the farmers paranoid, bitter, and completely untrusting of anyone outside their immediate circle. Protected by the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, they view all trespassers as potential threats or infected scavengers, attacking Alliance and Horde travelers indiscriminately.
faq.q: Why are the Solliden farmers hostile to Alliance players?

faq.a: Apothecaries serving the Royal Apothecary Society require fresh, uncorrupted organic matter to test and refine their New Plague. The plump, untainted pumpkins growing in Solliden's soil serve as ideal living hosts for developing toxic strains.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want pumpkins from Solliden Farmstead?

faq.a: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken officer stationed near Deathknell. He sends fledgling Forsaken to raid the farm, steal ten of its pumpkins for Apothecary Johaan in Brill, and teach the humans and their Scarlet Crusade protectors a lesson.
faq.q: Who is Deathguard Simmer, and why does he target the farm?

text.s: Solliden Farmstead is an active human pumpkin farm nestled in western Tirisfal Glades, just north of Deathknell. It represents a rare anomaly in northern Lordaeron: living native farmers who survived the Plague of Undeath and cling fiercely to their soil under the shadow of the Scarlet Crusade.

sec.b: While most of Lordaeron fell to ruin and rot, the fields of Solliden Farmstead still produce healthy crops. The settlement traces its lineage back centuries to when immigrant noble families from Strom acquired pioneer plots across Tirisfal. Today, these surviving human farmers live under the watchful shield of the Scarlet Crusade patrolling from a nearby tower. Traumatized and insular, they defend their homestead with unyielding hostility, striking at any outsiders who draw near—Horde and Alliance alike.

To the Forsaken just emerging from Deathknell, Solliden is both a threat and a resource. The Royal Apothecary Society eyes the farm's pristine pumpkins as prime organic testing material for brewing their New Plague. Meanwhile, Forsaken officers like Deathguard Simmer send fledgling recruits to raid the fields, steal those pumpkins for Apothecary Johaan in Brill, and teach the living a lesson.

subzone:south-gate-outpost.s: Avanzada de la Puerta Sur. La Avanzada de la Puerta Sur es un puesto de montaña enano fortificado situado a lo largo del Paso de la Puerta Sur, entre Dun Morogh y Loch Modan. Custodiando el nevado camino del sur, sus montaraces protegen el constante flujo de viajeros que transitan entre las gélidas alturas de Forjaz y el valle templado de Loch Modan. Encaramada a medio camino en el desfiladero de alta montaña del Paso de la Puerta Sur, la Avanzada de la Puerta Sur marca la frontera entre las laderas nevadas de Dun Morogh y la verde cuenca de Loch Modan. Aquí están apostados montaraces de Forjaz encargados de patrullar las curvas rocosas y mantener a la fauna peligrosa lejos del camino principal. En comparación con sus apurados camaradas de la Avanzada de la Puerta Norte, los defensores de este puesto han asegurado en gran medida su tramo de camino, permitiendo que viajeros, peregrinos y carros de comercio con destino a Thelsamar viajen con relativa seguridad.

ang.faction:Alliance: The outpost serves as a dependable military shelter along one of Khaz Modan's primary domestic supply lines, keeping the passage between the capital and eastern settlements open.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves leaving Coldridge Valley and Dun Morogh for the first time, South Gate Outpost is the final chilly landmark before descending into the vibrant, sunlit lands of Loch Modan.

faq.a: It serves as a fortified border checkpoint and garrison along South Gate Pass. Mountaineers stationed here keep the snowy transit road clear of mountain beasts and hostile interlopers traveling between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.
al: why is south gate outpost here
faq.q: What is the purpose of South Gate Outpost?

faq.a: The garrison at South Gate Outpost has successfully culled the aggressive wildlife immediately bordering the road. North Gate Outpost, by contrast, contends with heavier incursions and wilder mountain terrain, leaving the southern pass comparatively calm.
al: difference between north gate and south gate
faq.q: Why is it so much calmer here than at North Gate Outpost?

faq.a: Heading westward up the pass brings you into the snowy highlands of Dun Morogh toward Ironforge. Traveling eastward downhill leads directly out into the temperate valley of Loch Modan, with the road winding straight toward the settlement of Thelsamar.
faq.q: Where does the road through South Gate Outpost lead?

text.s: South Gate Outpost is a fortified dwarven mountain post situated along the South Gate Pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Manning the snowy southern road, its mountaineers guard the steady flow of travelers walking between Ironforge's frigid heights and the temperate valley of the Loch.

sec.b: Perched midway through the high mountain cut of South Gate Pass, South Gate Outpost marks the frontier between the snowy slopes of Dun Morogh and the verdant basin of Loch Modan. Stationed here are Ironforge mountaineers tasked with patrolling the rocky switchbacks and keeping dangerous wildlife off the main highway. Compared to their hard-pressed kin up at North Gate Outpost, the defenders here have largely secured their stretch of road, allowing travelers, pilgrims, and trade wagons headed toward Thelsamar to journey in relative safety.

subzone:south-gate-pass.s: Paso de la Puerta Sur. El Paso de la Puerta Sur es la principal vía montañosa que une las nevadas alturas de Dun Morogh con la cuenca del valle de Loch Modan. Flanqueado por túneles y puestos de vigilancia enanos, sirve como la ruta más directa entre Forjaz y el asentamiento de Thelsamar. Esculpido a través de la cordillera de Khaz Modan, el Paso de la Puerta Sur conecta las altas montañas de Dun Morogh con el ondulado valle de Loch Modan hacia el este. Los viajeros que dejan atrás las frías laderas emergen a través de arcos de piedra hacia las tierras centrales enanas, más cálidas. Dado que el camino conduce directamente hacia Thelsamar, soporta un flujo constante de montañeros, mensajeros y aventureros recién instruidos que parten de la capital.

ang.faction:Alliance: The pass serves as a vital internal artery connecting Ironforge with the eastern Alliance territories, maintained and secured by the King's Mountaineers.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves leaving Dun Morogh, South Gate Pass is the threshold where the icy mountain air gives way to the open valleys and quarries of Loch Modan.

faq.a: Heading west through the tunnels brings you into the snowy highlands of Dun Morogh, on the road toward Ironforge. Traveling east leads down into the basin of Loch Modan, directly toward the settlement of Thelsamar.
al: where does south gate pass go
faq.q: Where does South Gate Pass lead?

faq.a: The road itself is relatively secure thanks to the dwarven guards stationed at South Gate Outpost, but bears, spiders, and encroaching troggs inhabit the surrounding crags and hillsides outside the tunnel mouth.
faq.q: Is South Gate Pass safe to travel?

faq.a: South Gate Pass provides the most direct and convenient overland connection between Dun Morogh and Thelsamar, making it the preferred route for local trade, supply caravans, and travelers heading into central Loch Modan.
faq.q: Why is this pass used more than North Gate Pass?

text.s: South Gate Pass is the primary mountain thoroughfare linking the snowy heights of Dun Morogh with the valley basin of Loch Modan. Flanked by dwarven tunnels and watch posts, it serves as the most direct route between Ironforge and the settlement of Thelsamar.

sec.b: Carved straight through the Khaz Modan range, South Gate Pass connects Dun Morogh's high mountains to the rolling valley of Loch Modan to the east. Travelers leaving the cold slopes behind emerge through stone archways into the warmer dwarven heartlands. Because the path leads straight toward Thelsamar, it carries a steady flow of mountaineers, couriers, and newly trained adventurers setting out from the capital.

The pass is fortified against wild beasts and prowling troggs by the South Gate Outpost, where dwarven mountaineers maintain a constant watch. Though generally safer than the untamed wilds deeper in the valley, travelers are advised to keep to the road, as hostile wildlife and roving threats frequently probe the approaches.

subzone:south-tide-s-run.s: Cala Mareasur. Cala Mareasur es la solitaria costa suroccidental de Bosque de Argénteos, extendiéndose a lo largo de las frías aguas del Mare Magnum. Flanqueando el interior boscoso, estas arenas húmedas y su oleaje actúan como el homólogo meridional de Cala Mareanorte. Extendiéndose por el extremo suroccidental de Bosque de Argénteos, Cala Mareasur conforma un límite desolado entre los bosques y el Mare Magnum. A diferencia de los protegidos caminos orientales que descienden hacia La Muralla de Cringrís, esta costa abierta sufre el embate directo de las mareas occidentales, sirviendo como un inhóspito páramo costero prácticamente inexplorado por los asentamientos del interior.

ang.race:Undead: The wild southwestern coast lies far from the protection of the Sepulcher, making it an empty frontier rarely trodden by the Forsaken.

faq.a: South Tide's Run occupies the southwestern coastline of Silverpine Forest, bordering the open expanse of the Great Sea.
faq.q: Where is South Tide's Run located?

faq.a: Both are long stretches of beach defining Silverpine Forest's western shoreline, but South Tide's Run covers the southern portion of the coast, whereas North Tide's Run extends along the northwest near the border with Tirisfal Glades.
al: north tides run vs south tides run
faq.q: How does South Tide's Run differ from North Tide's Run?

faq.a: There are no major towns or outposts along the beach itself. Most Forsaken activity remains inland near the main thoroughfares, leaving the shoreline isolated.
al: who lives in south tides run
faq.q: Are there any settlements along South Tide's Run?

text.s: South Tide's Run is the lonely southwestern coastline of Silverpine Forest, stretching along the cold waters of the Great Sea. Flanking the forested interior, these damp sands and surf serve as the southern complement to North Tide's Run.

sec.b: Stretching along the southwestern edge of Silverpine Forest, South Tide's Run forms a desolate boundary between the woods and the Great Sea. Unlike the protected eastern roads that lead down toward the Greymane Wall, this open shore takes the brunt of the western tides, serving as a bleak coastal wilderness largely untouched by the settlements inland.

subzone:southern-gold-road.s: Camino del Oro Sur. El Camino del Oro Sur es la vía desértica vital que se extiende a través de la mitad sur de Los Baldíos, uniendo las llanuras centrales con El Gran Elevador. Sirve como una arteria indispensable para el comercio regional, transportando caravanas, suministros y caminantes que viajan entre confines lejanos de Kalimdor. Comenzando oficialmente en el puente de piedra que divide las mitades norte y sur de Los Baldíos, el Camino del Oro Sur discurre directamente hacia el sur hasta encontrarse con El Gran Elevador, que desciende hacia Las Mil Agujas. Al igual que el tramo norte, llamado sencillamente Camino del Oro, esta polvorienta calzada debe su apelativo al interminable flujo de lucrativas caravanas mercantes que la recorren de punta a punta. A pesar del constante hostigamiento de las tribus locales de jabaespines y de los depredadores que merodean por la sabana, sigue siendo una de las rutas de larga distancia más transitadas del continente, transportando mercancías entre puestos avanzados remotos y puertos bulliciosos.

ang.faction:Horde: The road serves as the backbone of Horde supply lines running between the central crossway of the Barrens and the southern outposts nearing Thousand Needles.

faq.a: The road officially begins at the bridge that splits the northern and southern halves of the Barrens, continuing southward until it reaches the edge of the Thousand Needles at the Great Lift.
faq.q: Where does the Southern Gold Road start and end?

faq.a: The thoroughfare is named for the valuable trade caravans that regularly travel along it, ferrying precious goods, ore, and coin across the heart of Kalimdor.
faq.q: Why is it called the Gold Road?

faq.a: The dividing line is the bridge crossing the central divide of the Barrens. North of that point, the trail is known simply as the Gold Road, while the stretch leading south to the Great Lift is designated the Southern Gold Road.
al: gold road vs southern gold road
faq.q: What is the difference between the Gold Road and the Southern Gold Road?

faq.a: Aside from local Horde couriers and patrols, merchants and explorers make use of the route to travel between distant territories, connecting places like Gadgetzan to the far south with Darkshore and Moonglade in the far north.
faq.q: Who travels along this stretch of road?

text.s: The Southern Gold Road is the vital desert thoroughfare stretching through the southern half of the Barrens, linking the central plains to the Great Lift. It serves as an indispensable artery for regional trade, carrying caravans, supplies, and wayfarers traveling between distant reaches of Kalimdor.

sec.b: Officially beginning at the stone bridge dividing the northern and southern halves of the Barrens, the Southern Gold Road runs directly south until it meets the Great Lift leading down into the Thousand Needles. Like the northern portion simply named the Gold Road, this dusty highway derives its moniker from the endless stream of lucrative merchant caravans that trek along its length. Despite constant harassment from local quilboar tribes and predators prowling the savannah, it remains one of the busiest long-distance paths on the continent, ferrying goods between remote outposts and bustling ports.

The road sees travel far beyond local Horde traffic. Adventurers and hardy traders journeying to and from places as far-flung as Gadgetzan in the southern deserts of Tanaris, Auberdine along the misty shores of Darkshore, and the sacred groves of Nighthaven in Moonglade tread this sun-baked expanse. For travelers journeying on foot through Kalimdor's interior, surviving the journey down the Southern Gold Road is a grueling rite of passage.

subzone:southshore.s: Costasur. Costasur es un puerto costero humano en las Laderas de Trabalomas y uno de los pocos bastiones supervivientes de la Alianza en la caída Lordaeron. Antaño una apacible aldea de pescadores, ahora se erige como un asediado bastión que se enfrenta a la hostilidad constante de la guarnición de los Renegados en Molino Tarren, de bandidos rebeldes de la Hermandad y de monstruos de la costa. Costasur cobró importancia por primera vez durante la Primera Guerra, cuando los barcos de refugiados que transportaban a supervivientes del caído reino de Ventormenta desembarcaron en sus playas. Aunque fue disputada e invadida durante la Segunda Guerra, fue reconstruida y más tarde soportó los horrores de la Tercera Guerra. Hoy en día, mientras el resto de Lordaeron yace en ruinas o bajo el dominio de los Renegados, Costasur se mantiene firmemente leal a la Gran Alianza. Ofrece refugio a supervivientes humanos desplazados, paladines veteranos de la Mano de Plata y eruditos del Kirin Tor.

ang.faction:Alliance: Southshore serves as your primary haven, quest hub, and military redoubt in northern Lordaeron, offering essential support against both the Forsaken and the Syndicate.
ang.faction:Horde: For the Horde—especially the Forsaken at nearby Tarren Mill—Southshore represents an obstinate Alliance enclave trespassing on land reclaimed by the dead.

faq.a: Southshore was spared total destruction during the Scourge's invasion. Its surviving human populace reaffirmed their historic oaths to the Grand Alliance, receiving military and logistical backing from Stormwind to maintain a foothold in the north.
faq.q: Why is Southshore still aligned with the Alliance when Lordaeron fell?

faq.a: Tarren Mill is held by the Forsaken, while Southshore is the primary Alliance bastion in the region. Both factions claim rightful dominion over the Hillsbrad Foothills, resulting in near-constant border skirmishes, raids, and sabotage.
al: why do southshore and tarren mill fight
faq.q: Why is there such intense fighting between Southshore and Tarren Mill?
