faq.a: Civil governance is handled by Magistrate Henry Maleb, who took over after the previous magistrate was assassinated by the Syndicate. Military defense and town security are directed by Marshal Redpath.
faq.q: Who leads the town of Southshore?

faq.a: Beyond the Forsaken, Southshore must fend off coastal murlocs and naga, Crushridge ogres descending from the Alterac Mountains, and the criminal Syndicate based out of Durnholde Keep.
faq.q: What threats does Southshore face other than the Forsaken?

text.s: Southshore is a coastal human port in the Hillsbrad Foothills and one of the Alliance's few surviving strongholds in fallen Lordaeron. Once a sleepy fishing village, it now stands as an embattled bastion facing constant hostility from the Forsaken garrison at Tarren Mill, rogue Syndicate bandits, and shoreline monsters.

sec.b: Southshore first rose to prominence during the First War when refugee boats carrying survivors from the fallen kingdom of Stormwind landed upon its beaches. Though contested and overrun during the Second War, it was rebuilt and later endured the horrors of the Third War. Today, while the rest of Lordaeron lies in ruins or under the rule of the Forsaken, Southshore remains fiercely loyal to the Grand Alliance. It offers shelter to displaced human survivors, veteran paladins of the Silver Hand, and scholars of the Kirin Tor.

Despite its scenic docks and famous turtle bisque, life in Southshore is perilous. Led by Magistrate Henry Maleb and Marshal Redpath, the town struggles against relentless pressure. To the north, the Forsaken of Tarren Mill wage a bitter border conflict for dominance over Hillsbrad. Inland, the aristocratic outlaws of the Syndicate raid supply lines and assassinate local leaders, while ogres, murlocs, and naga constantly harass the town's borders.

subzone:spirit-rise.s: Alto de los Espíritus. El Alto de los Espíritus es la meseta noroccidental de Cima del Trueno y sirve como el principal santuario de la capital tauren para el estudio espiritual y chamánico. Supervisado por guías espirituales como la tribu Skychaser, cuenta con salas de entrenamiento sagradas en la superficie y desciende hacia las cavernosas Pozas de las Visiones en las profundidades. Encaramado en lo alto de los riscos que dominan las llanuras de Mulgore, el Alto de los Espíritus está dedicado a la comunión con los elementos y los espíritus de los ancestros. Conectado a la meseta central mediante puentes de cuerda, alberga la Sala de los Espíritus y el pabellón de Sanación Espiritual, donde chamanes novatos y veteranos se reúnen para profundizar su conexión con la tierra, el aire, el fuego y el agua. La tribu Skychaser mantiene una fuerte presencia por todo el alto, guiando a quienes buscan respuestas a través de tradiciones ancestrales.

ang.class:Shaman: For shaman of the Horde, Spirit Rise serves as an essential gathering place to consult trainers, perform elemental rites, and commune with ancestral spirits.
ang.race:Tauren: The rise embodies the deep spiritual roots of your people, offering solace away from secular duties alongside the mystical waters of the Pools of Vision.

faq.a: Spirit Rise is the spiritual heart of Thunder Bluff, primarily dedicated to shamanic practice, healing, and communing with nature spirits and ancestors. It also serves as the entryway to the Pools of Vision.
faq.q: What is Spirit Rise known for?

faq.a: The Skychaser tribe holds prominent influence here, fostering the spiritual traditions, divination rituals, and shamanic training that define the rise.
faq.q: Which tauren tribe leads activities on Spirit Rise?

faq.a: A descent through the rise leads into the Pools of Vision, a humid subterranean cavern filled with steaming waters where seers and spiritual practitioners meditate and seek visions.
faq.q: What can I find underneath Spirit Rise?

text.s: Spirit Rise is the northwest mesa of Thunder Bluff, serving as the tauren capital's premier sanctum for spiritual and shamanic study. Overseen by spiritual guides such as the Skychaser tribe, it features sacred training halls above and descends into the cavernous Pools of Vision below.

sec.b: Perched high upon the bluffs overlooking the plains of Mulgore, Spirit Rise is devoted to communion with the elements and ancestor spirits. Connected to the central mesa by rope bridges, it houses the Hall of Spirits and the Spiritual Healing pavilion, where young and veteran shaman gather to deepen their connection with the earth, air, fire, and water. The Skychaser tribe maintains a strong presence across the rise, guiding seekers through ancient traditions.

Beneath the breezy huts and open-air totem shrines lies an entrance burrowing into the mesa itself: the steamy Pools of Vision, a sacred subterranean cavern where seers peer into spirit-touched waters.

subzone:spirit-rock.s: Roca de los Espíritus. La Roca de los Espíritus es un risco sagrado situado en los escarpados riscos sobre el Valle de los Retos, en Durotar. Accesible a través de un sendero serpenteante conocido como el Sendero Oculto, sirve como un lugar sagrado y apartado donde los iniciados comunican directamente con las fuerzas elementales de la tierra. Con vistas al cañón rojo donde los jóvenes guerreros y exploradores de la Horda comienzan su adiestramiento, la Roca de los Espíritus se erige como un altar de comunión. Aislada del estrépito del Valle de los Retos, solo se puede acceder a ella a través del Sendero Oculto que serpentea por la cresta rocosa. Los aspirantes a chamán peregrinan a este desolado promontorio para beber el tradicional sapta, descubriendo el misterio del mundo físico para escuchar los retumbos y susurros de la propia tierra.

ang.class:Shaman: Spirit Rock is a vital rite of passage for young orc and troll shaman, who venture up the Hidden Path to drink the Earth Sapta and forge their first bond with the spirits of stone and soil.

faq.a: Spirit Rock is a sacred site used primarily by Horde shaman initiates. By consuming a specialized draught known as an Earth Sapta at the rock, novices gain the spiritual vision required to commune directly with the spirits of the earth.
faq.q: What is Spirit Rock used for?

faq.a: Spirit Rock sits high in the cliffs above the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar. It is accessible by ascending the Hidden Path, a narrow, unmarked trail that winds out of the canyon floor into the rugged hills.
al: how to get to spirit rock
faq.q: How do you reach Spirit Rock?

faq.a: A sapta is a ceremonial elemental brew prepared by shaman trainers. Drinking it alters the seeker's perception, allowing them to perceive elemental manifestations that remain invisible to ordinary senses.
faq.q: What is a sapta?

text.s: Spirit Rock is a sacred crag perched in the rugged bluffs above the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Reached by a winding trail known as the Hidden Path, it serves as a secluded holy site where initiates commune directly with the elemental forces of the land.

sec.b: Overlooking the red canyon where young Horde warriors and scouts begin their training, Spirit Rock stands as an altar of communion. Isolated from the clatter of the Valley of Trials, it is approached only via the Hidden Path winding up the rocky ridgeline. Aspiring shaman make pilgrimages to this desolate outcrop to drink the traditional sapta, piercing the veil of the physical world to hear the rumblings and whisperings of the earth itself.

subzone:splintertree-post.s: Puesto del Hachazo. El Puesto del Hachazo es la principal fortaleza de la Horda en el este de Vallefresno, situada al noroeste de Cerro Lumbrevil. Establecido por Grommash Grito Infernal y el Clan Grito de Guerra durante la Tercera Guerra, sirve como un baluarte fuertemente fortificado contra los elfos de la noche y como base de operaciones para la expansión territorial. Tallado directamente en los bosques ancestrales, el Puesto del Hachazo sirve como el principal centro militar y logístico de la Horda en el este de Vallefresno. Establecido originalmente por Grommash Grito Infernal y el Clan Grito de Guerra cuando los orcos se adentraron por primera vez en el bosque durante la Tercera Guerra, sigue siendo un enclave fuertemente armado defendido principalmente por exploradores y guerreros orcos y tauren. Dotado de un maestro de vuelo, una posada y líneas de suministro constantes con Orgrimmar, afianza la disputada presencia de la Horda bajo la arboleda.

ang.faction:Horde: Splintertree Post is the essential central base camp for adventurers pressing through Ashenvale, offering repairs, respite, and crucial flight routes across Kalimdor.
ang.race:NightElf: To the night elves, this fortress is a bitter scar upon Ashenvale, founded by the very warlord who struck down Cenarius and perpetuated by invaders who butcher their ancient trees.

faq.a: It was established by Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan when the orcs first pushed into Ashenvale during the Third War to gather timber and establish a foothold.
faq.q: Who founded Splintertree Post?

faq.a: The night elves view Splintertree as an illegal, desecrating intrusion on ancestral lands. Hostility lingers from Grommash's brutal campaigns in the Third War, fueled further by ongoing Horde logging and skirmishes against the nearby elven stronghold of Astranaar.
faq.q: Why do the night elves frequently attack this base?

faq.a: Splintertree Post provides an inn, stable master, mailbox, armor repair, and a wind rider flight master with routes connecting to Orgrimmar, the Crossroads, and other Horde outposts across Kalimdor.
faq.q: What amenities and travel options are available here?

faq.a: The settlement is populated primarily by orcs and tauren, functioning as seasoned scouts, sentries, and frontline officers tasked with holding the frontier.
faq.q: Who currently makes up the garrison at Splintertree?

text.s: Splintertree Post is the primary Horde fortress in eastern Ashenvale, situated northwest of Felfire Hill. Established by Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan during the Third War, it serves as a heavily fortified bulwark against the night elves and a staging ground for territorial expansion.

sec.b: Carved straight out of the ancient woodlands, Splintertree Post serves as the Horde's main military and logistical hub across eastern Ashenvale. Originally established by Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan when orcs first pressed into the forest during the Third War, it remains a heavily armed enclave defended primarily by orcish and tauren scouts and warriors. Armed with a flight master, an inn, and steady supply lines to Orgrimmar, it anchors the Horde's contested presence beneath the canopy.

Splintertree Post exists in a state of perpetual readiness. The night elves have neither forgotten nor forgiven Grommash's actions during the war, nor do they tolerate ongoing orcish logging and raids against Astranaar. As a result, the settlement faces constant retaliatory strikes and guerilla attacks from the Sentinels hiding in the surrounding timber, testing the garrison's watchmen at all hours.

subzone:splithoof-crag.s: Risco Pezuña Quebrada. Risco Pezuña Quebrada es un asentamiento fortificado de los centauros Galak, resguardado a lo largo de los acantilados septentrionales de Las Mil Agujas. Sirve como uno de los principales enclaves de la tribu junto a las altas mesetas, custodiando la entrada a Campamento Pezuña Quebrada. Los viajeros que cruzan el fondo del cañón deben enfrentarse a las agresivas patrullas Galak que merodean cerca de los riscos. Ubicado contra la escarpada pared rocosa septentrional de Las Mil Agujas, Risco Pezuña Quebrada se encuentra justo al este de la imponente Cumbre de la Nube Negra. Es un asentamiento consolidado de los centauros Galak, provisto de toscos campamentos de tiendas y senderos de tierra que atraviesan los riscos. En el corazón de la aldea, contra la ladera del acantilado, se halla Campamento Pezuña Quebrada, una caverna subterránea que alberga la Pezuña Partida, una antigua reliquia de los centauros protegida por un brasero sagrado.

ang.faction:Horde: Controlling the passage beneath the crags is vital for ensuring secure travel between the southern Barrens, Freewind Post, and the Shimmering Flats.
ang.race:Tauren: The long-standing hostility between tauren and centaur makes Splithoof Crag an immediate concern for Horde scouts monitoring hostile activity throughout Thousand Needles.

faq.a: The settlement belongs to the Galak centaur tribe, one of the prominent clans inhabiting Thousand Needles alongside the hostile Grimtotem tauren.
faq.q: Who lives in Splithoof Crag?

faq.a: It lies along the northern canyon wall of Thousand Needles, situated directly east of Darkcloud Pinnacle.
faq.q: Where is Splithoof Crag located?

faq.a: Splithoof Hold is the central cavern of the village. Deep within its chambers, the Galak guard the Cloven Hoof, an ancient tribal artifact shielded by a sacred flame burning in an ancient brazier.
faq.q: What is inside Splithoof Hold?

faq.a: No. The Galak centaur and the Grimtotem tauren on Darkcloud Pinnacle are bitter territorial rivals, fighting for dominance over this stretch of the canyon.
faq.q: Are the centaur here allied with the nearby Grimtotem?

text.s: Splithoof Crag is a fortified settlement of the Galak centaur, tucked along the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles. It serves as one of the tribe's major enclaves alongside the high mesas, guarding the entrance to Splithoof Hold. Travelers traversing the canyon floor must contend with aggressive Galak patrols roaming near the bluffs.

sec.b: Nestled against the sheer northern rock face of Thousand Needles, Splithoof Crag sits just east of the towering Darkcloud Pinnacle. It is an established enclave of the Galak centaur, complete with crude tent encampments and dirt pathways cutting through the crags. At the heart of the village against the cliffside lies Splithoof Hold, a subterranean cavern holding the Cloven Hoof, an ancient relic of the centaur safeguarded by a sacred brazier.

The Galak fiercely contest this corner of the canyon, clashing with any travelers, Horde expeditions, or tauren scouting parties wandering beneath their bluffs. While the Grimtotem occupy the soaring pinnacles nearby, the centaur hold firm control of this canyon ravine and the caverns burrowed deep beneath the stone.

subzone:splithoof-hold.s: Campamento Pezuña Quebrada. Campamento Pezuña Quebrada es una profunda fortaleza cavernosa excavada en la piedra de Risco Pezuña Quebrada, en Las Mil Agujas. Ocupada por la tribu de centauros Galak, la caverna sirve como guarida fortificada y alberga el Ancient Brazier, un lugar que contiene una llama sagrada que arde eternamente. Oculto en el interior de Risco Pezuña Quebrada, Campamento Pezuña Quebrada sirve como reducto fortificado para los centauros Galak. A diferencia del fondo del cañón azotado por el viento, esta cueva cerrada les ofrece refugio, puntos de estrangulamiento fáciles de defender y un santuario seguro frente a tribus rivales y viajeros que cruzan Las Mil Agujas.

ang.class:Shaman: The existence of an eternal flame burning deep within a dark stone cavern draws the attention of any spiritualist attuned to the primal mysteries of elemental fire.
ang.race:Tauren: The Galak centaur remain sworn blood enemies of the tauren, making any stronghold they maintain in Thousand Needles an immediate threat to the peace of Freewind Post.

faq.a: Splithoof Hold is situated within the crags and ramparts of Splithoof Crag, along the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles. It is entered through a cave opening nestled inside the main centaur settlement.
faq.q: Where is Splithoof Hold located?

faq.a: The cavern is held by the Galak centaur tribe, who aggressively defend the cave against outsiders, beast incursions, and the nearby tauren of Freewind Post.
faq.q: Who controls Splithoof Hold?

faq.a: Beyond hostile Galak centaur defenders, the cave houses the Ancient Brazier, an artifact that keeps the mystical Sacred Flame burning eternally within the depths of the rock.
faq.q: What is inside the hold?

text.s: Splithoof Hold is a deep cavern stronghold carved into the stone of Splithoof Crag in Thousand Needles. Held by the Galak centaur tribe, the cavern serves as a fortified den and houses the Ancient Brazier, a site holding an eternally burning sacred flame.

sec.b: Tucked away inside Splithoof Crag, Splithoof Hold serves as a fortified redoubt for the Galak centaur. Unlike the windswept canyon floor, this enclosed cave offers them shelter, defensible chokepoints, and a secure sanctuary from rival tribes and travelers passing through the Needles.

Deep within the shadowed recesses of the hold lies an ancient brazier cradling the Sacred Flame. This mystic fire burns incessantly, serving as a focal point of power and ritual reverence for the centaur and an object of deep curiosity for spiritual wanderers across the canyon.

subzone:stagnant-oasis.s: El Oasis Estancado. El Oasis Estancado es una de las valiosas masas de agua enclavadas en el árido corazón de Los Baldíos, situada entre el Camino del Oro y La Costa Mercante. Rodeadas de frondosas palmeras y disputadas por los centauros Kolkar, sus turbias aguas y las orillas que lo rodean sustentan una fauna local única, que incluye tortugas mordedoras y kodos errantes. Escondido al este del Camino del Oro y hacia el interior desde La Costa Mercante, El Oasis Estancado proporciona un reducto vital de verdor en medio del polvoriento matorral de Los Baldíos. Al igual que las aguas vecinas, la poza sustenta una densa vegetación y agresivas tortugas quijarrasante, mientras que kodos de Los Baldíos debilitados suelen extraviarse aquí, lejos de las manadas masivas de la Tierra de Gigantes. Sin embargo, los viajeros deben andar con cuidado: los centauros Kolkar mantienen campamentos a lo largo de sus orillas, defendiendo con fiereza los derechos sobre el agua contra cualquiera que se adentre en su territorio.

ang.faction:Horde: For Horde couriers and scouts traversing the territory between Crossroads and Taurajo, the centaur encampments at the oasis pose a constant threat to supply traffic on the Gold Road.
ang.profession:Cooking: The waters of the Stagnant Oasis yield rare Deviate Fish, the essential ingredient for baking Savory Deviate Delights.

faq.a: The Stagnant Oasis lies in the central-southern stretch of the Barrens, located east of the Gold Road and west of the cliffs lining the Merchant Coast.
faq.q: Where is the Stagnant Oasis located?

faq.a: Nomadic Kolkar centaur have established camps around the perimeter of the pool. In addition to the centaur, dangerous beasts such as Oasis Snapjaws and solitary, wandering kodos roam the surrounding greenery.
faq.q: Who controls the Stagnant Oasis?

faq.a: Unlike the massive, coordinated herds found further south in the Field of Giants, the kodos near the Stagnant Oasis are solitary and often weakened or lost, making them significantly easier prey for hunters and travelers.
faq.q: Why are the kodos here easier to hunt?

faq.a: Anglers can hook Deviate Fish from the murky pool, a peculiar catch that can be cooked into culinary delicacies prized across Kalimdor.
faq.q: What kind of fish can be caught in the pool?

faq.a: It is widely believed that the Stagnant Oasis was one of the three watering holes Thrall and the newly arrived Horde secured while marching alongside Cairne Bloodhoof across the Barrens.
faq.q: Did Thrall visit this oasis during the Long March?

text.s: The Stagnant Oasis is one of the precious bodies of water nestled in the arid heart of the Barrens, positioned between the Gold Road and the Merchant Coast. Ringed by lush palms and contested by Kolkar centaur, its murky waters and surrounding shores sustain unique local wildlife, including snapping turtles and wandering kodos.

sec.b: Tucked away east of the Gold Road and inland from the Merchant Coast, the Stagnant Oasis provides a vital pocket of greenery amid the dusty scrubland of the Barrens. Like its neighboring waters, the pool supports dense foliage and aggressive snapjaw turtles, while weakened Barrens kodos often stray here away from the massive herds of the Field of Giants. However, travelers must tread carefully: Kolkar centaur maintain encampments along its banks, fiercely guarding the water rights against any who wander into their territory.
sec.t: A Murky Haven in the Drought

sec.b: Despite its stagnant appearance, the pool teems with unusual aquatic life, including strange mutate variants like Deviate Fish. Scholars and shamans keep a watchful eye on the Barrens oases, studying the peculiar forces affecting the local springheads and the wildlife that drinks from them.

subzone:starbreeze-village.s: Aldea Brisa Estelar. La Aldea Brisa Estelar es un asentamiento abandonado de elfos de la noche situado al este de Dolanaar, en Teldrassil. Antaño una tranquila aldea boscosa, recientemente ha caído en manos de los enloquecidos fúrbolgs de la tribu Tuercepinos. El asentamiento en ruinas se alza ahora como un patente símbolo de la creciente corrupción que se filtra por las raíces del Árbol del Mundo. Situada al sureste de Cañada Umbría y justo al final del camino desde Dolanaar, la Aldea Brisa Estelar fue antaño el hogar de pacíficas familias de elfos de la noche que vivían bajo las ramas de Teldrassil. Hoy en día, la aldea se encuentra en ruinas y sus estructuras de madera están invadidas por agresivos fúrbolgs Tuercepinos. Enloquecidos por una siniestra corrupción que aflige las ramas del Árbol del Mundo, estos hombres-bestia expulsaron a los residentes elfos y ahora defienden ferozmente los terrenos en ruinas.

ang.class:Druid: The madness consuming the Gnarlpine furbolgs and the defilement of Starbreeze Village directly challenge the Cenarion Circle's charge to restore balance to Teldrassil's wildlife.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing an elven settlement so close to Dolanaar fall into ruin is a painful reminder of Teldrassil's precarious state and the corruption gnawing at the World Tree.

faq.a: The village was overrun when the Gnarlpine furbolgs fell prey to a spreading corruption within Teldrassil. Driven mad and violent, the furbolgs attacked the night elf inhabitants, forcing them to flee and abandon their homes.
faq.q: Why is Starbreeze Village abandoned?

faq.a: Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs now occupy the village. Prominent figures among them include the wandering patrol Uruson and the corrupt figure known as Ferocitas the Dream Eater.
faq.q: Who lives in Starbreeze Village now?

faq.a: Starbreeze Village is located in eastern Teldrassil, lying southeast of Shadowglen and east of Dolanaar.
faq.q: Where is Starbreeze Village located?

faq.a: Ferocitas is a dangerous, corrupted creature found on the outskirts of Starbreeze Village, associated with the dark forces driving the local Gnarlpine tribe into frenzy.
faq.q: Who is Ferocitas the Dream Eater?

text.s: Starbreeze Village is an abandoned night elf settlement situated east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Once a tranquil woodland hamlet, it has recently fallen to the maddened furbolgs of the Gnarlpine tribe. The ruined settlement now stands as a glaring symbol of the growing corruption seeping into the roots of the World Tree.

sec.b: Located southeast of Shadowglen and just down the road from Dolanaar, Starbreeze Village was once home to peaceful night elf families living beneath the boughs of Teldrassil. Today, the village lies in shambles, its wooden structures overrun by aggressive Gnarlpine furbolgs. Driven wild by a sinister corruption afflicting the boughs of the World Tree, the beast-men drove the elven residents out and now defend the ruined grounds ferociously.

The Gnarlpine presence in the village is not merely an ordinary territorial raid. Lurking on the outskirts of the settlement is Ferocitas the Dream Eater, an enigmatic, corrupted entity whose presence suggests dark, foul magic is actively driving the furbolgs mad. Together with hulking beasts like Uruson who prowl the paths, these invaders make Starbreeze an active danger to travelers journeying through eastern Teldrassil.

subzone:steelgrill-s-depot.s: Almacén de Brasacerada. El Almacén de Brasacerada es un bullicioso taller de ingeniería y estación de reparación situado justo al este de Kharanos, en Dun Morogh. Supervisado por Beldin Brasacerada y una cuadrilla de artesanos, sirve como núcleo de primera línea para el mantenimiento de vehículos, transportes de suministros de manitas y labores de rescate de chatarra. Ubicado junto al nevado camino al este de Kharanos, el Almacén de Brasacerada bulle con el estrépito del metal al chocar, el silbido de los respiraderos de vapor y el zumbido de motores experimentales. Mineros enanos y excéntricos ingenieros gnomos se congregan aquí entre maquinaria pesada, armazones andantes mecanizados y reservas de mineral en bruto extraído de las canteras cercanas. Ante los incesantes altercados de los troggs y la escasez de suministros mecánicos que asolan Dun Morogh, Beldin Brasacerada y su cuadrilla mantienen la maquinaria de la Alianza en funcionamiento, convirtiéndose en una parada indispensable para los viajeros que buscan piezas de repuesto o asesoramiento técnico en mitad del frío cortante.

ang.profession:Engineering: The depot is an open-air laboratory surrounded by steam machinery and tinkering supplies, making it a natural rest stop for aspiring engineers traveling through Dun Morogh.
ang.race:Gnome: Working closely with their dwarven hosts, exiled gnomish tinkers often use the depot's forge fires and spare components to keep their salvaged contraptions running.

faq.a: Steelgrill's Depot is an engineering workshop and outpost in Dun Morogh, located just down the road east of Kharanos. It caters to miners, tinkerers, and field technicians maintaining heavy machinery.
faq.q: What is Steelgrill's Depot?

faq.a: The depot is managed by the Steelgrill family, notably Beldin Steelgrill, alongside fellow dwarven and gnomish crafters who maintain the surrounding machinery and oversee mining operations.
faq.q: Who runs the depot?

faq.a: The depot houses trade suppliers, repair services, and trainers for craftsmen looking to hone their engineering and gathering skills out in the field.
faq.q: What services are available here?

text.s: Steelgrill's Depot is a bustling engineering workshop and repair station situated directly east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Overseen by Beldin Steelgrill and a crew of craftsmen, it serves as a frontline hub for vehicle maintenance, tinker supply runs, and salvage efforts.

sec.b: Nestled just off the snowy road east of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot buzzes with the clamor of clanking metal, hissing steam vents, and the hum of experimental engines. Dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather here amid heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and stockpiles of raw ores hauled out from nearby quarries. With Dun Morogh facing relentless trogg disruptions and mechanical supply shortages, Beldin Steelgrill and his crew keep Alliance machinery in working order, serving as an indispensable stop for travelers seeking spare parts or technical guidance in the bitter cold.
sec.t: A Bastion of Steam and Steel

subzone:stillwater-pond.s: Charca Aguaserena. La Charca Aguaserena es una masa de agua tranquila y estancada situada justo al oeste de Rémol, en los Claros de Tirisfal. En su día fue un querido lugar de pícnic y baño para los niños vivos de Lordaeron, pero se ha degradado hasta convertirse en una poza turbia habitada por peces esqueléticos y rondada por peligrosos carroñeros. Antes de la Tercera Guerra y los estragos de la Plaga de la no-muerte, la Charca Aguaserena servía como un tranquilo retiro para las gentes de los Claros de Tirisfal. Las familias de las aldeas cercanas se reunían en sus orillas cubiertas de hierba para hacer pícnics por la tarde, y los niños demasiado pequeños para aventurarse en las traicioneras profundidades del Lago Aguasclaras aprendían a nadar en sus aguas poco profundas. Hoy en día, sus idílicas aguas se han vuelto grises y sin vida. Los vivos desaparecieron hace mucho, dejando solo peces esqueléticos que cruzan bajo la superficie y no-muertos errantes que deambulan por los bosques circundantes.

ang.class:Hunter: The blighted wildlife around the pond, including feral darkhounds like Bayne, makes the area a hazardous hunting ground for scouts patrolling the outskirts of Brill.
ang.race:Undead: For Forsaken who retain memories of life in Lordaeron, Stillwater Pond stands as a grim reminder of lost childhood days spent picnicking and swimming along its once-clear banks.

faq.a: In the days of human Lordaeron, Stillwater Pond was a scenic and popular spot for local picnics. Because it was shallow and calmer than the expansive Brightwater Lake, families frequently brought young children here to swim safely.
al: what was stillwater pond used for
faq.q: What was Stillwater Pond like before the Plague?

faq.a: Normal aquatic life did not survive the blighting of Tirisfal. The only things swimming beneath the gray surface are the animated, skeletal remains of fish left behind by the Scourge's corruption.
faq.q: Is there anything living in the water now?

faq.a: Apart from mindless undead wandering the glades, the most notorious threat along the shore is Bayne, an unusually powerful and aggressive darkhound who feeds on unwary travelers.
faq.q: What dangerous creatures wander near the pond?

faq.a: Stillwater Pond sits in central Tirisfal Glades, directly west of the town of Brill and southwest of the larger Brightwater Lake.
faq.q: Where is Stillwater Pond located?

text.s: Stillwater Pond is a quiet, stagnant body of water resting just west of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Once a beloved picnic and swimming spot for the living children of Lordaeron, it has decayed into a murky pool inhabited by skeletal fish and prowled by dangerous scavengers.

sec.b: Before the Third War and the ravages of the Plague of Undeath, Stillwater Pond served as a tranquil retreat for the folk of Tirisfal Glades. Families from nearby hamlets gathered on its grassy banks for afternoon picnics, and children too young to brave the treacherous depths of Brightwater Lake learned to swim in its shallows. Today, the idyllic waters have turned lifeless and gray. The living have long vanished, leaving only skeletal fish darting beneath the surface and wandering undead drifting through the surrounding woods.

Though quiet compared to the besieged roads and contested farms of Tirisfal, Stillwater Pond holds its own perils. The murky waters provide water only to the blighted beasts of the glades, most notably a ferocious darkhound named Bayne who stalks the shoreline. Travelers cutting through the western meadows on their way toward Brill must tread carefully, as predatory beasts and aimless zombies frequently linger along the water's edge.

subzone:stone-cairn-lake.s: Lago del Hito. El Lago del Hito es una masa de agua en forma de anillo situada en el noreste de Bosque de Elwynn. En su centro yace una isla coronada por la Vigilia de los Héroes, un monumento conmemorativo a los caídos en la Primera Guerra. Antaño un lugar tranquilo para la reflexión, el lago se ve ahora perturbado por múrlocs hostiles a lo largo de sus orillas y magos renegados que ocupan la isla. El Lago del Hito debe su nombre al prominente hito de piedra erigido en la gran isla de su centro. Conocido como la Vigilia de los Héroes, este monumento se levantó para honrar las graves pérdidas de vidas humanas sufridas durante la Primera Guerra contra la Horda orca. Antaño, familias y peregrinos viajaban a la isla con total seguridad para presentar sus respetos a los caídos, contemplando a través de las aguas tranquilas la solemne mampostería. Hoy en día, sin embargo, peligrosos magos renegados han establecido un campamento junto al monumento, convirtiendo un lugar sagrado de recuerdo en un reducto hostil.

ang.profession:Mining: The bluffs and hills encircling Stone Cairn Lake boast one of the heaviest concentrations of copper deposits in all of Elwynn Forest, making it a lucrative stop for aspiring blacksmiths and engineers.
ang.race:Human: The central island represents a deeply personal memorial for the Kingdom of Stormwind, honoring those lost when the kingdom fell during the First War.

faq.a: The lake takes its name from Heroes' Vigil, a stone cairn monument raised on the central island to commemorate the Alliance soldiers and civilians who perished during the First War.
faq.q: Why is it called Stone Cairn Lake?

faq.a: The island is overrun by rogue wizards and renegades who have chased away ordinary pilgrims and set up a fortified camp around the memorial.
faq.q: Who is currently occupying the central island?

faq.a: A local tribe of murlocs has settled the southern shallows and riverbanks, building primitive huts and claiming the plentiful fishing waters as their territory.
faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the water?

faq.a: The monument is known as Heroes' Vigil, featuring a stone cairn often referred to as the Stone of Remembrance.
faq.q: What is the memorial on the island called?

text.s: Stone Cairn Lake is a ring-shaped body of water resting in northeastern Elwynn Forest. At its center lies an island crowned with Heroes' Vigil, a memorial to the fallen of the First War. Once a tranquil site for reflection, the lake is now troubled by hostile murlocs along its shores and renegade wizards occupying the isle.

sec.b: Stone Cairn Lake earns its name from the prominent stone memorial erected on the large island in its center. Known as Heroes' Vigil, this monument was raised to honor the heavy loss of human life suffered during the First War against the Orcish Horde. Families and pilgrims once traveled safely to the island to pay respects to the fallen, gazing across the calm waters at the solemn stonework. Today, however, dangerous renegade wizards have established a camp directly beside the memorial, turning a place of sacred remembrance into a hostile redoubt.

Surrounding the ring-shaped lake is a scenic shoreline that has grown increasingly dangerous for locals and travelers. A tribe of aggressive murlocs has claimed the southern banks, erecting crude huts along the waterline and harassing anyone who draws near. Beyond its dangers, the hills and outcrops encircling the lake are rich in mineral veins, making the perimeter a frequent destination for prospectors and miners willing to brave the local threats.

subzone:stonebull-lake.s: Lago Toro de Piedra. El Lago Toro de Piedra es una serena masa de agua en forma de herradura que rodea el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre, en el centro de Mulgore. Alimentado por las prístinas escorrentías naturales de las llanuras, proporciona agua dulce vital, abundante pesca y costas tranquilas para los jóvenes tauren que alcanzan la edad adulta bajo la guía de Cairne Pezuña de Sangre. Bordeando el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre por tres lados, el Lago Toro de Piedra define la geografía del centro de Mulgore. Un puente de madera cruza el tramo más estrecho del lago, albergando el camino principal de tierra entre el asentamiento y la gran meseta de Cima del Trueno hacia el norte. Sus tranquilas aguas están repletas de peces autóctonos, lo que convierte sus orillas en el lugar predilecto de cazadores que descansan, viajeros agotados y aprendices de pescador que aprenden su oficio bajo el inmenso cielo abierto.

ang.race:Tauren: For the tauren establishing their homes across Mulgore, Stonebull Lake provides gentle sustenance and a reminder of the Earth Mother's bounty near their capital.

faq.a: Stonebull Lake is located in central Mulgore. It forms a horseshoe around Bloodhoof Village, flanking the settlement on three sides.
faq.q: Where is Stonebull Lake located?

faq.a: The bridge crosses the narrowest part of Stonebull Lake to carry the main road connecting Bloodhoof Village directly to Thunder Bluff in the north.
faq.q: What is the bridge across the lake used for?

faq.a: The lake is an essential freshwater source and a vital fishing spot for the inhabitants of Bloodhoof Village. It also offers a quiet place of contemplation and gathering for young tauren braves training in central Mulgore.
faq.q: Why is Stonebull Lake important to the tauren?

text.s: Stonebull Lake is a serene, horseshoe-shaped body of water wrapping around Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore. Fed by the pristine natural runoff of the plains, it provides vital fresh water, abundant fish, and peaceful shores for the young tauren coming of age under Cairne Bloodhoof's guidance.

sec.b: Curving around Bloodhoof Village on three sides, Stonebull Lake defines the geography of central Mulgore. A wooden bridge crosses the lake's narrowest stretch, carrying the main dirt road between the settlement and the great mesa of Thunder Bluff to the north. Its calm waters are filled with native fish, making its banks a favored spot for resting hunters, weary travelers, and apprentice fishers learning their trade under the sweeping open sky.

subzone:stonefield-farm.s: La Granja Pedregosa. La Granja Pedregosa es una hacienda en activo situada en el sur del Bosque de Elwynn. Es el hogar de la familia Stonefield, que lleva mucho tiempo enzarzada en una amarga disputa con sus vecinos, los Maclure. Enclavada entre las verdes colinas al sur de Villadorada, La Granja Pedregosa produce cosechas para el reino mientras mantiene un rencor feroz y prolongado durante décadas contra Los Viñedos de Maclure cercanos. La mala sangre entre ambos hogares da lugar a disputas mezquinas, acusaciones mutuas de robo y una tensión constante. Sin embargo, bajo estas riñas hostiles, el joven Tommy Joe Pedregosa se ha enamorado en secreto de Maybell Maclure, forjando un discreto romance que podría tender puentes entre las familias o desatar aún más indignación.

ang.race:Human: For humans starting out from Northshire, the squabbles between the Stonefields and Maclures offer a lighthearted look at rural kingdom life beyond the threat of bandits and gnolls.

faq.a: The Stonefield and Maclure families hold a long-standing, stubborn rivalry in southern Elwynn Forest. They constantly accuse one another of trespassing, petty theft, and general wrongdoing, refusing to cooperate on even simple neighborhood matters.
faq.q: What is the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures?

faq.a: The farmstead is managed by the Stonefield clan, including Gramma Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield.
faq.q: Who lives at Stonefield Farm?

faq.a: Despite the bitter hostility between the two households, Tommy Joe Stonefield is secretly in love with Maybell Maclure. The two lovers rely on sympathetic travelers to pass messages and gifts back and forth without their families noticing.
faq.q: What is Tommy Joe Stonefield's secret?

text.s: Stonefield Farm is a working homestead situated in southern Elwynn Forest. It is home to the Stonefield family, who have long been locked in a bitter feud with their neighbors, the Maclures.

sec.b: Nestled in the rolling greenery south of Goldshire, Stonefield Farm produces crops for the realm while maintaining a fierce, decades-long grudge against the nearby Maclure Vineyards. The bad blood between the households leads to petty squabbles, mutual accusations of theft, and constant tension. Yet beneath the hostile bickering, young Tommy Joe Stonefield has fallen secretly in love with Maybell Maclure, creating a quiet romance that could either bridge the divide between the families or ignite further outrage.

subzone:stonefire-tavern.s: Taberna Fuego de Piedra. La Taberna Fuego de Piedra es la posada principal que atiende a los viajeros dentro de la ciudad montañosa de Forjaz. Situada en el bullicioso Distrito Comercial, justo al norte de las puertas de la ciudad, ofrece un cálido hogar, fuerte cerveza enana y un lugar de descanso para los aventureros que llegan desde todo Khaz Modan. Ubicada inmediatamente al norte de las puertas de la fortaleza en el Distrito Comercial, la Taberna Fuego de Piedra funciona como la taberna más destacada de Forjaz. Regentada por el Tabernero Brebefuego junto a su hija Gwenna, la posada ofrece a los fatigados caminantes comidas copiosas, cervezas locales y alojamiento bajo la montaña. Ya sea buscando respiro de las duras nieves montañosas de Dun Morogh o con la intención de intercambiar relatos y provisiones antes de adentrarse en las profundidades de la ciudad, los viajeros de todos los rincones de la Alianza se reúnen con frecuencia alrededor de su crepitante fuego.

ang.faction:Alliance: As the closest major inn to the Ironforge front gates, the Stonefire is often the central staging ground for Alliance travelers visiting the dwarven capital.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves returning from expeditions across Khaz Modan, the Stonefire Tavern is the first place in the capital to grab a cold pint of Firebrew ale and catch up on local gossip.

faq.a: The tavern sits in the Commons district of Ironforge, just a short walk north after passing through the main city gates.
faq.q: Where is the Stonefire Tavern located?

faq.a: The tavern is managed by Innkeeper Firebrew with the assistance of his daughter, Gwenna Firebrew.
faq.q: Who operates the Stonefire Tavern?

faq.a: Yes. Innkeeper Firebrew welcomes Alliance travelers seeking to make the Stonefire Tavern their home base within Ironforge.
faq.q: Can travelers bind their hearthstones here?

faq.a: Right outside the tavern entrance sits a city mailbox, and the surrounding Commons are filled with banks, merchants, and trade supplies.
faq.q: What amenities are nearby?

text.s: The Stonefire Tavern is the primary inn serving travelers inside the mountain city of Ironforge. Situated in the bustling Commons district just north of the city gates, it provides a warm hearth, strong dwarven ale, and a resting place for adventurers arriving from across Khaz Modan.

sec.b: Located immediately north of the fortress gates in the Commons, the Stonefire Tavern serves as the premier public house in Ironforge. Run by Innkeeper Firebrew alongside his daughter Gwenna, the inn offers weary wayfarers hearty meals, local brews, and lodging beneath the mountain. Whether seeking respite from the harsh mountain snows of Dun Morogh or looking to trade tales and supplies before venturing deep into the city, travelers from all corners of the Alliance routinely gather around its roaring hearth.

subzone:stonetalon-peak.s: Cima del Espolón. La Cima del Espolón es un antiguo santuario de los elfos de la noche resguardado en un frondoso valle alpino en el extremo noroccidental de Sierra Espolón. Sagrado para los kaldorei y cuidado por druidas locales, sirve como el principal bastión de la Alianza en estas escarpadas alturas. Encaramada muy por encima del polvo árido de las cordilleras inferiores, la Cima del Espolón se abre a un santuario exuberante y envuelto en brumas. Considerado sagrado durante mucho tiempo e impregnado de magia ancestral, el valle alberga ruinas que datan de milenios atrás, cuando la región albergaba templos en honor a la reina Azshara antes del Gran Cataclismo. En la era moderna, las centinelas y los druidas kaldorei han restablecido aquí una pacífica custodia, manteniendo un refugio tranquilo dotado de un túmulo y un nido de vuelo vital para la Alianza.

ang.class:Druid: The sanctuary is deeply intertwined with Cenarion history and the sacred Talon Den, making it an essential place of pilgrimage and defense for wardens of the wild.
ang.faction:Alliance: Stonetalon Peak is your sole fortified foothold in the western mountains, offering vital respite, flight paths, and questing aid amidst hostile territory.

faq.a: Stonetalon Peak rests within a sheltered high-altitude basin suffused with ancient magic. The dedicated care of the night elves and the druids of the nearby Talon Den has preserved a vibrant, forested sanctuary where vegetation flourishes in sharp contrast to the charred, jagged cliffs below.
faq.q: Why is Stonetalon Peak so green compared to the rest of the mountains?

faq.a: Led by the Prophet Medivh's prophetic warnings, both Jaina Proudmoore and Thrall traveled to Stonetalon Peak in search of the Oracle within the mountain's caverns. Their meeting deep inside the stone led them to forge a historic truce, uniting humans and orcs to confront the Burning Legion.
al: what happened at stonetalon peak warcraft 3
faq.q: What happened here during the Third War?

faq.a: The peak is an Alliance outpost, protected and maintained by night elf Sentinels and druids. It serves as the primary safe haven, quest hub, and flight master connection for Alliance adventurers operating in the Stonetalon Mountains.
al: is stonetalon peak alliance or horde
faq.q: Who controls Stonetalon Peak right now?

faq.a: The crumbling pillars and marble structures scattered through the vale are remnants of the ancient night elven empire, having once served as temple grounds dedicated to Queen Azshara before her descent into madness and the Great Sundering.
faq.q: What ancient ruins are located here?

text.s: Stonetalon Peak is an ancient night elven sanctuary tucked into a verdant alpine valley at the northwestern edge of the Stonetalon Mountains. Sacred to the kaldorei and cared for by local druids, it serves as the primary bastion of the Alliance in these craggy heights.

sec.b: Perched high above the arid dust of the lower ranges, Stonetalon Peak opens into a lush, mist-shrouded sanctuary. Long considered sacred and steeped in ancient magic, the valley holds ruins dating back millennia to when the region housed temples honoring Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering. In the modern era, kaldorei Sentinels and druids have restored a measure of peaceful stewardship here, maintaining a tranquil refuge complete with a barrow den and a vital Alliance flight roost.

Beyond its idyllic forests and ancient ruins, Stonetalon Peak holds historic weight from the Third War. Guided by the visions of Medivh, both Jaina Proudmoore's human expedition and Thrall's Horde scaled these perilous heights in search of the elusive Oracle dwelling within the mountain's deep caverns. That fateful encounter forced mortal enemies to set aside their blades, laying the foundation for the uneasy pact that stood against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Today, the peak remains firmly under Sentinel watch, though Horde incursions in the lowlands keep the defenders vigilant.

subzone:stonewatch.s: Petravista. Petravista es un bastión fortificado en el centro de las Montañas Crestagrana, construido para defender las tierras humanas circundantes de las invasiones del norte. Antaño defendida por soldados de Ventormenta, la fortaleza ha caído bajo el brutal control de los orcos Roca Negra, lo que representa una amenaza inmediata para la cercana Villa del Lago. Ubicada sobre los acantilados cerca de las Cascadas Petravista, Petravista consta de una torre y un torreón fuertemente construidos, diseñados para vigilar los accesos desde Las Estepas Ardientes. En su origen en manos de los defensores de Villa del Lago, la fortificación cayó cuando el brujo renegado Morganth forjó una alianza con el clan Roca Negra. Imbuidos de magia oscura, los orcos invasores arrollaron a la guarnición humana local (el 12.º Regimiento de Sables) y se apoderaron de la fortaleza. Aunque Morganth acabó traicionando a sus aliados y se retiró a la cercana Torre de Ilgalar con un ejército de gnolls Pellejo Sombrío, los orcos Roca Negra mantuvieron el control férreo sobre el torreón bajo el mando del general Gath'Ilzogg y el teniente Tharil'zun.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stonewatch represents one of the most perilous forward incursions of hostile orcs into core Alliance territory, making its recovery vital to the safety of Redridge.
ang.race:Human: The slaughter of the 12th Sabre Regiment and the fall of the keep stand as painful reminders of Lakeshire's vulnerability and Stormwind's political neglect.

faq.a: Stonewatch is occupied by the Blackrock clan of orcs, under the command of General Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. They drove out the kingdom's garrison and now use the stronghold as a staging ground for attacks across Redridge.
faq.q: Who controls Stonewatch right now?

faq.a: The keep fell during a concerted invasion by the Blackrock clan, empowered by the dark sorcery of the rogue human warlock Morganth. Together, they crushed the defenders of the 12th Sabre Regiment and captured the entire complex.
faq.q: How did the humans lose Stonewatch?

faq.a: Stormwind has refused to allocate sufficient troops to the border regions, leaving Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris to defend Redridge alone. Lakeshire relies on visiting adventurers and mercenaries to mount counterattacks against Stonewatch.
faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind sending an army to take it back?

faq.a: Morganth originally aided the Blackrock orcs in taking Stonewatch, but shortly after their victory, he betrayed his allies. He constructed the nearby Tower of Ilgalar to amass his own retinue of magical thralls and Shadowhide gnolls, attacking orc and human alike.
faq.q: What is the relationship between Stonewatch and the Tower of Ilgalar?

text.s: Stonewatch is a fortified stronghold in central Redridge Mountains, built to defend the surrounding human lands from northern invasions. Formerly manned by Stormwind soldiers, the fortress has fallen under the brutal control of the Blackrock orcs, posing an immediate threat to nearby Lakeshire.

sec.b: Positioned over the cliffs near Stonewatch Falls, Stonewatch comprises a heavily built tower and keep designed to guard the approaches from the Burning Steppes. Originally held by Lakeshire's defenders, the fortification fell when the rogue warlock Morganth forged an alliance with the Blackrock clan. Infused with dark magic, the invading orcs overwhelmed the local human garrison—the 12th Sabre Regiment—and claimed the fortress. Although Morganth eventually turned on his allies and withdrew to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar with an army of Shadowhide gnolls, the Blackrock orcs retained a stranglehold over the keep under the command of General Gath'Ilzogg and Lieutenant Tharil'zun.

With Stonewatch firmly garrisoned by hostile orcs, Lakeshire sits directly in the crosshairs of an impending conquest. Cut off from substantial military reinforcements by an indifferent or paralyzed Stormwind House of Nobles, Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have been forced to hire mercenary aid and volunteers. Decapitating the fortress's leadership—targeting both Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg—remains the town's desperate primary hope for relieving the siege on the region.

subzone:stonewatch-falls.s: Cascadas Petravista. Cascadas Petravista es una pintoresca cascada y una profunda poza de montaña situada en los confines orientales de las Montañas Crestagrana, alimentada por el desagüe del Lago Sempiterno. Cayendo en cascada por la ladera bajo las imponentes alturas de Petravista, sus aguas aisladas están ocupadas por una tribu hostil de múrlocs. Brotando del río oriental del Lago Sempiterno, Cascadas Petravista se precipita por el escarpado terreno situado bajo el bastión de los orcos Roca Negra de Petravista. El agua que se despeña horada una profunda poza resguardada contra la ladera de la montaña. A pesar de su belleza natural, los viajeros rara vez se demoran a admirar la vista; una despiadada banda de múrlocs infesta la poza, construyendo toscas chozas de juncos y atacando a cualquiera que sea lo bastante insensato como para adentrarse en la orilla del agua.

ang.faction:Alliance: The murloc settlement at Stonewatch Falls represents yet another dangerous pocket of monsters harassing travelers in the already beleaguered eastern Redridge countryside.

faq.a: The falls are fed by the river draining out of the eastern side of Lake Everstill, tumbling downhill into a secluded mountain basin beneath the cliffs of Stonewatch.
faq.q: Where does the water from Stonewatch Falls come from?

faq.a: A local tribe of murlocs occupies the shores of the falls. They subsist on fish drawn from the deep mountain pool and build rough lean-tos and shoreline shelters along the banks.
faq.q: What creatures live around Stonewatch Falls?

faq.a: The falls sit at the foot of the hillside directly below Stonewatch and its ruined keep. While Blackrock orcs command the fortified heights above, the murlocs dominate the water basin below.
al: is stonewatch keep near the falls
faq.q: Is Stonewatch Falls connected to Stonewatch Keep?

text.s: Stonewatch Falls is a scenic waterfall and deep mountain pool situated in the eastern reaches of the Redridge Mountains, fed by the outflow of Lake Everstill. Cascading down the hillside beneath the looming heights of Stonewatch, its isolated waters are claimed by a hostile tribe of murlocs.

sec.b: Pouring from the eastern river of Lake Everstill, Stonewatch Falls cascades down the rugged terrain beneath the Blackrock orc stronghold of Stonewatch. The plunging water carves out a deep pool tucked against the mountainside. Despite its natural beauty, travelers rarely linger to admire the view; a vicious band of murlocs infests the pool, building crude reed hovels and preying upon any foolish enough to trespass along the water's edge.

subzone:stonewatch-keep.s: Fuerte de Petravista. El Fuerte de Petravista es una fortaleza de piedra que se alza en el este de las Montañas Crestagrana, antaño construida y defendida por el Reino de Ventormenta. Ha caído en manos de una hueste invasora de orcos Rocanegra y sirve como base de operaciones avanzada desde la que sus señores de la guerra aterrorizan Villa del Lago. En sus orígenes, el Fuerte de Petravista defendía las crestas orientales y protegía a los colonos de Villa del Lago contra incursiones hostiles. Esa paz se truncó cuando el brujo renegado Morganth forjó una alianza con el clan Rocanegra. Fortalecidos por la magia oscura, los orcos asaltaron la fortaleza con una ferocidad despiadada, arrollando a los defensores humanos y adueñándose del fuerte. Aunque Morganth abandonó más tarde a sus aliados para erigir la cercana Torre de Ilgalar y subyugar a los gnolls locales, los invasores Rocanegra consolidaron con éxito su dominio sobre Petravista, transformando un antiguo bastión de la Alianza en un punto de partida fortificado para su asalto al valle.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stonewatch Keep is a painful reminder of Stormwind's strained borders; clearing its ramparts is essential to protecting Lakeshire's vulnerable townsfolk.
ang.race:Human: Human defenders shed blood defending these walls, and liberating the keep helps avenge the fallen soldiers and captives taken by the Blackrock clan.

faq.a: The keep is currently occupied by the Blackrock clan, led on-site by Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant Tharil'zun. It was formerly an Alliance stronghold defending the town of Lakeshire before it was captured.
faq.q: Who owns Stonewatch Keep right now?

faq.a: The Blackrock clan allied with the rogue human warlock Morganth. Empowered by Morganth's dark sorcery, the orcs launched a ferocious assault that overwhelmed the human defenders stationed at Stonewatch.
faq.q: How did the Blackrock orcs capture the keep?

faq.a: The Stormwind Army has left Redridge largely neglected due to internal politics and troop shortages across the kingdom. As a result, Lakeshire's town leaders must rely on independent adventurers to deal with the threat.
faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind Army retake Stonewatch Keep?

faq.a: Morganth helped the Blackrock clan conquer Stonewatch Keep, but betrayed them shortly after their victory. He relocated to construct his own lair, the Tower of Ilgalar, using ensorcelled Shadowhide gnolls rather than orcs to do his bidding.
faq.q: What is Morganth's connection to this fortress?

text.s: Stonewatch Keep is a fortified stone stronghold looming in eastern Redridge Mountains, once built and manned by the Kingdom of Stormwind. It has fallen to an invading host of Blackrock orcs, serving as the forward operational base from which their warlords terrorize Lakeshire.

sec.b: Stonewatch Keep originally defended the eastern ridges and guarded the settlers of Lakeshire against hostile incursions. That peace shattered when the renegade warlock Morganth struck an alliance with the Blackrock clan. Bolstered by dark magic, the orcs stormed the fortress with vicious ferocity, overwhelming the human defenders and taking the keep for themselves. Although Morganth later abandoned his allies to raise the nearby Tower of Ilgalar and subjugate local gnolls, the Blackrock invaders successfully consolidated their grip over Stonewatch, transforming a former bastion of the Alliance into a fortified staging ground for their assault on the valley.

Now occupied by a heavy garrison of Blackrock warriors, the keep is overseen by the formidable orcish warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his brutal lieutenant, Tharil'zun. From the stone ramparts, these commanders coordinate raids across Redridge, taking prisoners such as Stormwind's Corporal Keeshan. With the kingdom's military spread thin and unable to dispatch a full regiment to liberate the fortress, Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have been forced to hire mercenary champions to infiltrate the stronghold and execute the Blackrock leadership before Lakeshire is completely overrun.

subzone:stonewatch-tower.s: Torre de Petravista. La Torre de Petravista es una torre de vigilancia de piedra situada dentro de la fortaleza invadida de Petravista, en el noreste de Crestagrana. Antaño mantenida por los defensores de Villa del Lago, el puesto de avanzada fue capturado por el clan Roca Negra para vigilar los riscos circundantes y asegurar su bastión montañoso. Construida por el Reino de Ventormenta para vigilar los pasos de alta montaña sobre el Lago Sempiterno, la Torre de Petravista servía como el puesto de exploración avanzado hermano del Fuerte de Petravista. Desde su elevada posición estratégica, los centinelas podían vigilar fácilmente los riscos orientales y alertar a Villa del Lago de cualquier amenaza que avanzara desde Las Estepas Ardientes. Esa red de alerta temprana se derrumbó cuando los orcos Roca Negra del general Gath'Ilzogg descendieron desde las alturas, arrollando a los defensores humanos y reclamando la fortaleza para su propio esfuerzo bélico. Hoy en día, la torre está repleta de centinelas Roca Negra, lo que garantiza que ningún explorador de la Alianza se acerque a la fortaleza sin ser detectado.

ang.faction:Alliance: Stonewatch Tower is a grim reminder of how far the Blackrock clan has pushed into Stormwind territory while the kingdom's central army remains absent.
ang.race:Human: For the folk of Lakeshire, seeing orcish standards flying above Stonewatch's towers is an ongoing threat to their very survival.

faq.a: It is a fortified human watchtower located inside the greater Stonewatch complex in northeastern Redridge Mountains. Originally built to protect the region, it is currently held by invaders from the Blackrock clan.
faq.q: What is Stonewatch Tower?

faq.a: The tower is occupied by orcs of the Blackrock clan serving under General Gath'Ilzogg, who captured the stronghold from the local humans of Redridge.
faq.q: Who controls Stonewatch Tower right now?

faq.a: Its high elevation allows the Blackrock clan to spot approaching Alliance forces and safeguard the approach to their primary fortress, Stonewatch Keep.
al: why do orcs want stonewatch tower
faq.q: Why is the tower important to the Blackrock orcs?

faq.a: Lakeshire lacks the military manpower to retake Stonewatch on its own and relies on wandering adventurers to thin out the Blackrock garrison holding the tower and keep.
faq.q: Can Lakeshire reclaim the tower?

text.s: Stonewatch Tower is a stone guard tower standing within the overrun stronghold of Stonewatch in northeastern Redridge. Once maintained by the defenders of Lakeshire, the outpost was captured by the Blackrock clan to monitor the surrounding ridges and secure their mountain bastion.

sec.b: Built by the Kingdom of Stormwind to guard the high mountain passes above Lake Everstill, Stonewatch Tower served as the forward scouting sibling to Stonewatch Keep. From its elevated vantage point, sentries could easily watch the eastern ridges and alert Lakeshire to any threats advancing from the Burning Steppes. That early warning network collapsed when General Gath'Ilzogg's Blackrock orcs swept down from the heights, overrunning the human defenders and claiming the stronghold for their own war effort. Today, the tower bristles with Blackrock sentinels, ensuring no Alliance scouts approach the fortress undetected.

subzone:stonewrought-dam.s: Presa de las Tres Cabezas. La Presa de las Tres Cabezas es una colosal maravilla de la ingeniería enana erigida a lo largo del extremo norte de Loch Modan. Retiene las aguas de Loch Modan, creando el enorme lago de las tierras altas mientras drena los Humedales que se encuentran debajo para convertirlos en marismas habitables. Extendiéndose a lo largo del cañón al este de Dun Algaz, la Presa de las Tres Cabezas está considerada una de las mayores hazañas estructurales de la civilización enana. Diseñada por el maestro arquitecto Hierro Negro Franclorn Forgewright, la barrera fue construida utilizando su innovadora técnica de cantería forjada en piedra. Al atrapar las aguas de la cuenca montañosa, la presa duplicó la superficie de Loch Modan a la vez que reducía de forma constante los niveles de agua hacia el norte, permitiendo que la cuenca pantanosa de los Humedales emergiera de un valle que antaño estaba completamente anegado.

ang.profession:Engineering: For engineers of any stripe, the dam is a masterclass in hydraulic control and stonewrought load-bearing mechanics, rivaling even the great works beneath Ironforge.
ang.race:Dwarf: The dam stands as a monument to ancient dwarven masonry and architectural ingenuity, though its Dark Iron heritage remains a sore and contested point among Ironforge's historians.

faq.a: It was designed and overseen by the famous Dark Iron architect Franclorn Forgewright, who invented the stonewrought construction technique. Although built by a Dark Iron master, it serves the Bronzebeard kingdom today.
faq.q: Who built the Stonewrought Dam?

faq.a: A collapse would be catastrophic. The Loch would rapidly drain and leave Loch Modan an empty crater of mud, while the displaced water would sweep down into the Wetlands as an uncontrollable, devastating flood.
faq.q: What happens if the dam breaks?

faq.a: The Dark Iron clan seeks to strike at Ironforge's vital infrastructure and destabilize the region. Crippling the dam would cripple supply lines, drown the northern wetlands, and strike a bitter blow against Bronzebeard pride.
faq.q: Why are Dark Iron dwarves attacking it?

faq.a: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII manages the day-to-day operations and defensive fortifications of the dam, coordinating with Ironforge forces to weed out saboteurs.
faq.q: Who is currently in charge of the dam's defense?

text.s: The Stonewrought Dam is a colossal dwarven engineering marvel standing along the northern rim of Loch Modan. It holds back the waters of the Loch, creating the massive highland lake while draining the Wetlands below into habitable marshes.

sec.b: Stretching across the canyon east of Dun Algaz, the Stonewrought Dam is widely regarded as one of the great structural triumphs of dwarven civilization. Designed by the master Dark Iron architect Franclorn Forgewright, the barrier was built using his pioneering stonewrought technique. By trapping the waters of the mountain basin, the dam doubled the surface area of the Loch while steadily lowering water levels to the north, allowing the marshy basin of the Wetlands to emerge from a once completely flooded valley.

Though built under the guidance of a Dark Iron architect, the dam today serves Ironforge—and has become a prime target for Dark Iron saboteurs operating out of the southern mountains. Recent assaults and infiltration attempts have forced Ironforge to station a garrison here under Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII. Guards and engineers patrol the masonry day and night, knowing that any breach would catastrophically drain the Loch and unleash a devastating deluge across the Wetlands below.

subzone:stormwind-gate.s: Ventormenta Gate. La Ventormenta Gate es la monumental entrada fortificada que conecta el Bosque de Elwynn con Ciudad de Ventormenta. Custodiado constantemente por centinelas reales, este umbral se alza como el límite principal entre los tranquilos bosques y el majestuoso Valle de los Héroes. Erigiéndose sobre el camino meridional del Bosque de Elwynn, la Ventormenta Gate sirve tanto de baluarte defensivo como de umbral ceremonial para la capital. Los centinelas de la guardia de la Ciudad de Ventormenta mantienen una vigilancia constante a lo largo del portal de piedra, custodiando los accesos desde el bosque mientras patrullas regulares marchan entre el arco exterior y el Valle de los Héroes. A pesar de la persistente agitación en todo Elwynn, los enormes portones de hierro y piedra permanecen abiertos de par en par para dar la bienvenida a viajeros, mercaderes y defensores que regresan al corazón de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Alliance: The gate represents the safety and endurance of the Grand Alliance, serving as the first glimpse of majesty for traveling soldiers and young adventurers.
ang.race:Human: To the people of Stormwind, returning through these stone arches means returning home to safety after long journeys through Elwynn and beyond.

faq.a: Passing through the gate from Elwynn Forest brings you directly into the Valley of Heroes, the grand entryway to Stormwind City lined with towering monuments of the Second War.
faq.q: Where does the Stormwind Gate lead?

faq.a: Stormwind thrives on open trade and steady travel from Goldshire and across the Alliance. While banditry and Defias activity trouble the surrounding woods, the city keeps the passage manned with vigilant guards rather than shutting out its own citizenry and commerce.
faq.q: Why is the gate left open if Elwynn Forest is dangerous?

faq.a: The entryway is garrisoned by the Stormwind City Guard. Two sentries stand watch immediately outside in Elwynn Forest, two more guard the inner passage, and armed footmen patrol the bridge leading through the Valley of Heroes.
faq.q: Who guards the gates?

faq.a: Yes. The open ground around the Stormwind Gate frequently hosts major citywide holidays and seasonal gatherings for the Alliance, serving as an open assembly area outside the crowded districts.
faq.q: Are there special events held at the gate?

text.s: The Stormwind Gate is the monumental fortified entryway connecting Elwynn Forest to Stormwind City. Guarded constantly by royal sentries, this threshold stands as the primary boundary between the tranquil woodlands and the grand Valley of Heroes.

sec.b: Towering over the southern road of Elwynn Forest, the Stormwind Gate serves as both a defensive bulwark and a ceremonial threshold for the capital. Sentinels of the Stormwind City Guard maintain a constant watch across the stone portal, guarding the approaches from the forest while regular patrols march between the outer arch and the Valley of Heroes. Despite lingering unrest throughout Elwynn, the massive iron-and-stone gates remain wide open to welcome travelers, merchants, and returning defenders into the heart of the Alliance.

subzone:stormwind-keep.s: Castillo de Ventormenta. Castillo de Ventormenta se alza sobre la capital como la fortaleza de piedra y sede del poder del Reino de Ventormenta. Reconstruido tras quedar en ruinas en la Primera Guerra, actualmente alberga la corte real del joven rey niño Anduin Wrynn y de su regente, el Alto Señor Bolvar Fordragón. Encaramado sobre una meseta que domina toda la ciudad, Castillo de Ventormenta sirve tanto de palacio como de bastión militar. La fortaleza original fue reducida a cenizas por la Antigua Horda cuando el rey Llane fue asesinado cerca del final de la Primera Guerra. Erigido de nuevo sobre los antiguos cimientos tras recuperar la Alianza el reino, el torreón reconstruido alberga no solo la gran sala del trono y la Sala de Guerra, sino también tranquilos patios ajardinados y la amplia Biblioteca Real.

ang.faction:Alliance: The keep is the heart of the Alliance's eastern military command, where Bolvar Fordragon and the marshals direct defenses against rising threats across Elwynn, Westfall, and beyond.
ang.race:Human: Rebuilt from ashes after the devastation of the First War, the fortress stands as a testament to the resilience and pride of Stormwind's people.

faq.a: King Anduin Wrynn technically holds the throne, but because he is only ten years old, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs as regent alongside Lady Katrana Prestor as royal advisor.
faq.q: Who rules in Stormwind Keep right now?

faq.a: King Varian vanished under mysterious circumstances while traveling across the sea to a peace conference in Theramore. His sudden disappearance left the throne vacant, forcing Bolvar and the court to crown young Anduin to ensure political stability.
faq.q: What happened to King Varian Wrynn?

faq.a: Yes. Following the murder of King Llane Wrynn by Garona, the Old Horde overwhelmed the city and completely razed the keep. The current fortress was rebuilt upon the ancient foundations after the Alliance prevailed in the Second War.
al: did the orcs destroy the keep
faq.q: Was the keep destroyed in the First War?

faq.a: The complex contains the main throne room, the War Room directly behind it, the Petitioner's Chamber for visiting supplicants, an open garden courtyard, the Royal Gallery, and the Royal Library.
faq.q: What major wings can be visited inside the keep?

text.s: Stormwind Keep stands high above the capital as the stone fortress and seat of power for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Rebuilt after its ruin in the First War, it currently houses the royal court of the young boy-king Anduin Wrynn and his regent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

sec.b: Perched upon a plateau overlooking the entire city, Stormwind Keep serves as both a palace and a military bastion. The original stronghold was burned to the ground by the Old Horde when King Llane was assassinated near the end of the First War. Raised anew upon the old foundations after the Alliance reclaimed the kingdom, the reconstructed keep houses not only the grand throne room and the War Room, but peaceful garden courtyards and the expansive Royal Library.

Behind the keep's banners and polished stone lies an uneasy peace. With King Varian Wrynn mysteriously missing en route to a diplomatic summit at Theramore, governance rests on ten-year-old King Anduin Wrynn. Effective rule falls to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the noble Lady Katrana Prestor. While Bolvar handles defense and military affairs, court politics remain paralyzed by aristocratic infighting, leaving the outlying territories vulnerable and the crown deeply distracted.

subzone:stormwind-stockade.s: Mazmorras de Ventormenta. Escondidas bajo los canales a lo largo del borde norte del Barrio de los Magos, Las Mazmorras sirven como la penitenciaría de alta seguridad de Ventormenta. Destinada a encerrar a asesinos, disidentes políticos y enemigos extranjeros, la fortaleza subterránea se ha sumido recientemente en el caos absoluto tras una rebelión coordinada de los reclusos. Supervisadas habitualmente por el Alcaide Thelagua, Las Mazmorras son el lugar donde el reino confina a sus prisioneros más volátiles, que van desde degolladores y agentes Defias hasta orcos Roca Negra y enanos Hierro Negro capturados. Sin embargo, un violento levantamiento orquestado por el astuto conspirador Defias Bazil Thredd ha desbordado por completo a los guardias de la prisión. Los reclusos ahora deambulan libremente por las celdas inferiores, convirtiendo el recinto en una fortaleza amotinada. Thelagua, tras haber asegurado a duras penas los accesos principales, depende de aventureros independientes para adentrarse en los corredores subterráneos y reprimir la revuelta antes de que se extienda a los canales.

ang.class:Rogue: The riot lays bare the operations of the Defias Brotherhood and Bazil Thredd, offering a glimpse into how deeply organized the criminal underworld has become right under the crown's nose.
ang.faction:Alliance: The Stockade sits directly in the capital, making its suppression vital to civil defense; clearing its halls exposes just how heavily the Defias Brotherhood has penetrated Stormwind.

faq.a: The entrance sits along the canal district in Stormwind City, tucked on the northern bend right next to the bridge leading into the Mage Quarter. A guarded doorway leads down a stone stairwell directly into the subterranean cells.
faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Stockade located?

faq.a: The revolt was planned and ignited by Bazil Thredd, a high-ranking Defias Brotherhood ringleader imprisoned within the compound. Under his command, the prisoners overpowered the guards, seized armaments, and established total control of the underground cellblocks.
faq.q: Who started the riot inside the prison?

faq.a: Stormwind captures high-priority hostiles from across its contested territories. Notably, Targorr the Dread was seized from the Redridge Mountains, and Kam Deepfury represents the Dark Iron threat. Rather than being swiftly executed, many were brought here as military prisoners or kept alive by noble decree for political leverage.
al: why are there orcs in stockades
faq.q: Why are there orcs and Dark Iron dwarves in a Stormwind jail?

faq.a: Outlying settlements like Darkshire and Lakeshire sentenced criminals like Dextren Ward and Targorr the Dread to die, only to see the House of Nobles stay their executions. Frustrated by Stormwind's bureaucratic meddling, local leaders quietly enlist sellswords to bypass royal paperwork and finish the job.
faq.q: Why are Duskwood and Redridge asking people to kill prisoners here?

text.s: Tucked away beneath the canals along the northern edge of the Mage Quarter, the Stockade serves as Stormwind's high-security penitentiary. Intended to lock away murderers, political dissidents, and foreign enemies, the subterranean fortress has recently collapsed into total chaos following a coordinated inmate rebellion.

sec.b: Ordinarily overseen by Warden Thelwater, the Stockade is where the kingdom deposits its most volatile prisoners, ranging from cutthroats and Defias operatives to captured Blackrock orcs and Dark Iron dwarves. However, a violent uprising orchestrated by the cunning Defias conspirator Bazil Thredd has entirely displaced the prison guards. The inmates now roam freely in the lower cells, turning the fortress into a fortress of riots. Thelwater, having barely secured the entry thresholds, relies on independent adventurers to plunge into the subterranean corridors and suppress the revolt before it spills out into the canals.

The Stockade holds more than ordinary street convicts; it has long served as a bargaining chip for the kingdom's corrupt House of Nobles. Murderers and high-value prisoners who received death sentences elsewhere—such as the graverobber Dextren Ward from Duskwood or the Blackrock warlord Targorr the Dread from Redridge—have had their executions delayed by aristocratic interference to serve as political pawns. Even neighboring Ironforge has taken notice, covertly hiring mercenaries to execute dangerous inmates like Kam Deepfury when human bureaucracy stalls rightful justice.

subzone:stormwind-stockade-classic.s: Ventormenta Stockade (Classic). Las Mazmorras de Ventormenta son una prisión subterránea fortificada situada bajo el distrito de los canales de Ciudad de Ventormenta. Construida en su origen para retener a delincuentes menores, mercenarios violentos y subversivos políticos, se ha sumido recientemente en el caos tras una violenta revuelta de reclusos. Ocultas junto a los canales entre Casco Antiguo y el Barrio de los Magos, las Mazmorras funcionan como la principal instalación penal del Reino de Ventormenta. Presidido por el Alcaide Thelagua, el complejo subterráneo alberga a una variedad de los malhechores más peligrosos del reino: degolladores de la Hermandad Defias, un orco Roca Negra merodeador, un ogro e incluso un enano Hierro Negro infiltrado. Recientemente, un motín carcelario coordinado y orquestado por el astuto criminal Bazil Thredd desbordó a la guarnición, expulsó a los guardias supervivientes y dejó a los convictos en pleno control de los pasillos interiores.

ang.faction:Alliance: The riot directly beneath the capital's streets is an acute humiliation for Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's administration, showing how vulnerable Stormwind is from within while the king remains absent.
ang.race:Human: For humans of the outlying towns, the Stockade's dysfunction proves that the House of Nobles cares far more for legal red tape in the capital than protecting border settlements from murderers.

faq.a: The Stockade entrance is situated inside Stormwind City along the northern canal bank, bridging the passage between Old Town and the Cathedral and Mage districts.
faq.q: Where is the Stockade located?

faq.a: While Warden Thelwater is the official warden, he was driven out during the rebellion. The facility is currently under the de facto control of the prisoner who instigated the uprising, Bazil Thredd, alongside allied Defias rioters.
al: who is in charge of stockade
faq.q: Who is currently running the prison?

faq.a: Stormwind holds high-value prisoners of war and saboteurs here. Targorr the Dread is a captured Blackrock orc raider from the nearby mountains, while Kam Deepfury is a hostile Dark Iron dwarf imprisoned for subversion against the Alliance.
al: why are there orcs in stockade
faq.q: Why are there orcs and Dark Iron dwarves locked up in Stormwind?

faq.a: Bureaucracy and political interference from high-ranking Stormwind nobles repeatedly stalled executions for convicts like Dextren Ward and Targorr, sparking outrage from outer territories such as Redridge and Duskwood.
faq.q: Why were condemned murderers kept alive instead of executed?

text.s: The Stormwind Stockade is a fortified underground prison beneath the canal district of Stormwind City. Originally built to contain petty criminals, violent mercenaries, and political subversives, it has recently plunged into chaos following a violent inmate revolt.

sec.b: Tucked away off the canals between Old Town and the Mage Quarter, the Stockade serves as the primary penal facility of the Kingdom of Stormwind. Presided over by Warden Thelwater, the subterranean complex houses an assortment of the realm's most dangerous malefactors: cutthroats of the Defias Brotherhood, a marauding Blackrock orc, an ogre, and even an infiltrating Dark Iron dwarf. Recently, a coordinated prison riot orchestrated by the cunning felon Bazil Thredd overwhelmed the garrison, driving out surviving guards and leaving the convicts in full control of the interior halls.

The disaster within the Stockade exposes deep cracks in Stormwind's governance. Several notorious inmates, such as the Blackrock terror Targorr the Dread and the body-selling grave robber Dextren Ward, had long been sentenced to death, yet were kept alive due to endless stays of execution arranged by influential nobles. Frustrated by aristocratic stalling, neighboring settlements like Lakeshire and Darkshire, alongside the dwarven garrison at Dun Modr, have circumvented royal channels entirely, contracting outside adventurers to march in and execute key ringleaders amidst the bedlam.

subzone:strahnbrad.s: Strahnbrad.
