Strahnbrad es un asentamiento humano en ruinas situado en las alturas del noreste de las Montañas de Alterac, cerca de la frontera con las Tierras de la Peste del Oeste. Antaño famoso por ser el lugar de la temprana defensa del príncipe Arthas Menethil contra los asaltantes orcos Roca Negra, el pueblo ha caído desde entonces en la decadencia y sirve como bastión fortificado para la organización criminal de la Hermandad. Originalmente una posesión del reino de Alterac antes de ser absorbido por Lordaeron tras la Segunda Guerra, la desgracia de Strahnbrad comenzó en vísperas de la Tercera Guerra. Los orcos del Clan Roca Negra asaltaron el asentamiento para conseguir sacrificios humanos para la Legión Ardiente, lo que llevó al príncipe Arthas Menethil y a los Caballeros de la Mano de Plata a cabalgar en su defensa. Aunque Arthas expulsó a los asaltantes y abatió a su amo de esclavos, el pueblo sufrió un sangriento castigo. Cuando Lordaeron se desmoronó poco después a manos de la Plaga, Strahnbrad quedó abandonado a merced de los elementos.

ang.class:Paladin: Walking the cobblestones of Strahnbrad recalls the early, untainted days of Prince Arthas Menethil and Uther the Lightbringer, serving as a bitter reminder of how far Lordaeron's heroes have fallen.
ang.faction:Horde: The Syndicate's enslavement of the orc Gol'dir makes Strahnbrad an urgent target for Horde champions seeking to strike at human brigands and rescue their kin.

faq.a: Strahnbrad was the site of the opening clash of the Third War for Prince Arthas Menethil. Sent by Uther the Lightbringer to protect the settlement from rampaging Blackrock orcs, Arthas made his first celebrated stand here, rescuing townsfolk and cutting down the orc raiders.
faq.q: Why is Strahnbrad significant in history?

faq.a: The Syndicate holds Strahnbrad. These human brigands, loyal to the fallen noble bloodlines of Alterac, have fortified the ruined town hall and blacksmith to use as a primary staging ground for their ambitions in the mountains.
faq.q: Who controls Strahnbrad now?

faq.a: Strahnbrad was originally part of the Kingdom of Alterac before the First War. After Alterac betrayed the Alliance during the Second War, the town was integrated under the domain of the Kingdom of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Which kingdom did Strahnbrad belong to originally?

faq.a: The Syndicate captured an orc named Gol'dir and forced him into brutal slave labor within Strahnbrad's ruins. Horde operatives from Tarren Mill, directed by Krusk, send adventurers here to breach the Syndicate's defenses and break Gol'dir out.
faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this town?

text.s: Strahnbrad is a ruined human settlement nestled in the northeastern heights of the Alterac Mountains, near the border of the Western Plaguelands. Once famous as the site of Prince Arthas Menethil's early defense against Blackrock orc raiders, the town has since fallen into decay and serves as a fortified stronghold for the criminal Syndicate.

sec.b: Originally a holding of the Kingdom of Alterac before being absorbed into Lordaeron following the Second War, Strahnbrad's misfortune began on the eve of the Third War. Blackrock clan orcs raided the settlement to take human sacrifices for the Burning Legion, leading Prince Arthas Menethil and the Knights of the Silver Hand to ride to its defense. Though Arthas drove the raiders away and slew their slave master, the town was heavily bloodied. When Lordaeron crumbled beneath the Scourge shortly thereafter, Strahnbrad was abandoned to the elements.

Today, Strahnbrad has become a crucial operations hub for the Syndicate, the organization of displaced Alteraci nobility and outlaws plotting to reclaim their fallen realm. Patrolled by human rogues and brigands, its abandoned town hall and blacksmith now serve as hideouts and staging grounds. The Syndicate uses the ruined town to house supplies and captive labor, including unfortunate prisoners like the orc Gol'dir, whom Horde scouts from Tarren Mill actively seek to liberate.

subzone:sun-rock-retreat.s: Refugio Roca del Sol. El Refugio Roca del Sol es un santuario oculto de la Horda enclavado en lo alto de los picos centrales de Sierra Espolón, justo al sur del Lago Mirkfallon. Dominado por fuerzas de tauren y orcos, sirve como el principal punto de concentración y puesto de suministros de la Horda en la región. Más allá de su utilidad estratégica, el asentamiento se asienta sobre tierra sagrada venerada desde hace mucho tiempo por los tauren debido a su profunda resonancia espiritual. Escondido en una cuenca montañosa al sur del Lago Mirkfallon, el Refugio Roca del Sol ha tenido desde hace mucho tiempo una gran importancia espiritual para los tauren. Según la antigua tradición, An'she, el Sol, besó el mismísimo pico de la montaña donde se alza la aldea. Durante generaciones antes de la llegada de la Horda, chamanes y peregrinos tauren viajaban hasta aquí para realizar rituales que tendían puentes sobre el velo mortal, extrayendo fuerza del poderoso vínculo de esta tierra con el mundo de los espíritus.

ang.faction:Horde: As the Horde's main staging hub in the Stonetalon Mountains, Sun Rock Retreat offers a vital resupply post and flight hub amidst contested peaks.
ang.race:Tauren: Sun Rock Retreat is more than an outpost to the shu'halo; it is sacred ground blessed by An'she, where shamans have walked the spirit realm for centuries.

faq.a: Sun Rock Retreat is the primary Horde outpost in the Stonetalon Mountains. Inhabited mainly by tauren and orcs, it acts as a peaceful sanctuary, trading station, and command post for Horde champions working in the region.
faq.q: What is Sun Rock Retreat?

faq.a: Tauren legend holds that An'she, the Sun, touched the mountain where the retreat now stands. The land has an enduring connection to the spirit world, making it an ancient pilgrimage site for vision quests and communion with ancestors.
faq.q: Why is this place sacred to the tauren?

faq.a: The retreat contends with aggressive territorial harpies, hostile night elves guarding the sacred woods, and the destructive mining and logging efforts of the Venture Company, which ravages the natural landscape.
faq.q: What threats does the retreat face?

faq.a: Sun Rock Retreat provides wind rider service connecting travelers directly to major central Kalimdor locations, including the Crossroads in the Barrens and the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Where does the local flight master connect?

text.s: Sun Rock Retreat is a hidden Horde sanctuary nestled high within the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains, just south of Mirkfallon Lake. Dominated by tauren and orcish forces, it serves as the Horde's primary staging ground and supply post in the region. Beyond its strategic utility, the settlement rests upon sacred ground long revered by the tauren for its deep spiritual resonance.

sec.b: Tucked away in a mountain basin south of Mirkfallon Lake, Sun Rock Retreat has long held spiritual importance for the tauren. According to ancient tradition, An'she, the Sun, kissed the very mountain peak where the village stands. For generations before the Horde's arrival, tauren shamans and pilgrims journeyed here to perform rituals bridging the mortal veil, drawing strength from the land's strong bond to the spirit world.
sec.t: A Sacred Haven in the Peaks

sec.b: Today, Sun Rock Retreat serves as the Horde's principal base of operations across the Stonetalon Mountains. Orcs and tauren work side by side to establish a secure foothold against hostile harpy broods, local night elf sentinels, and the industrial pillaging of the Venture Company. As a central hub connecting trade and flight routes between Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and the borders of Ashenvale, the retreat provides shelter, provisions, and spiritual guidance to those braving the crags.

subzone:talondeep-path.s: El Paso del Espolón. El Paso del Espolón es un serpenteante túnel subterráneo que atraviesa la cordillera montañosa situada entre Vallefresno y Sierra Espolón. Desprovisto de criaturas hostiles o viajeros, sirve como un paso subterráneo natural y tranquilo que conecta el Lago Mystral con el Risco Cortaviento. Oculto bajo la escarpada cresta que separa Vallefresno y Sierra Espolón se encuentra El Paso del Espolón, una tranquila ruta subterránea. El paso une los bosques situados justo al oeste del Lago Mystral directamente con los confines noroccidentales del Risco Cortaviento. A diferencia de los peligrosos senderos de la superficie, acechados por depredadores y facciones enfrentadas, el interior del túnel permanece misteriosamente en calma, libre de bestias hostiles o campamentos, aunque plagado de recovecos serpenteantes, grietas y nichos naturales en la roca. En la superficie aún perduran los tenues vestigios de un antiguo camino exterior, lo que sugiere que antaño los viajeros escalaban los altos picos antes de que esta cueva protegida se convirtiera en la ruta predilecta a través de la piedra.

ang.profession:Mining: The cavern's winding rock alcoves cut straight through the deep stone foundation of the mountain range, making it a natural landmark when navigating between mineral-rich Ashenvale and Stonetalon.

faq.a: The tunnel connects southwestern Ashenvale to northeastern Stonetalon Mountains. Its northern entrance sits just west of Mystral Lake, while its southern mouth opens into the northwestern side of Windshear Crag.
faq.q: Where does the Talondeep Path lead?

faq.a: No. The interior of the cavern is uniquely peaceful and completely barren of hostile monsters, beasts, or friendly NPCs, making it a safe passageway for travelers traversing the mountain divide.
faq.q: Are there monsters or enemies inside the tunnel?

faq.a: Remnants of an overgrown surface road run along the mountain ridge directly above the cavern. It suggests an older, treacherous overland route across the crags predated the passage through the hollowed interior.
faq.q: What are the ruins above the cavern?

faq.a: Neither faction holds the tunnel. It is entirely unfortified and neutral wilderness, allowing safe foot passage for travelers of any allegiance moving between the contested forest and the mountains.
faq.q: Is Talondeep Path an Alliance or Horde tunnel?

text.s: Talondeep Path is a winding underground tunnel boring through the mountain ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. Devoid of hostile creatures or travelers, it serves as a tranquil, natural subterranean passage connecting Mystral Lake to Windshear Crag.

sec.b: Hidden beneath the rugged ridgeline separating Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains lies Talondeep Path, a quiet subterranean route. The passage links the forests just west of Mystral Lake directly to the northwestern reaches of Windshear Crag. Unlike the dangerous surface trails haunted by predators and warring factions, the tunnel interior remains eerily calm, free of hostile beasts or encampments, though riddled with twisting side pockets, crevices, and natural alcoves in the rock. Above ground, faint remnants of an ancient surface road still linger, hinting that travelers once scaled the high peaks before this sheltered cave became the preferred route through the stone.

subzone:talondeep-vale.s: Vega del Espolón. Vega del Espolón es una hondonada boscosa y tranquila enclavada en la zona centro-sur de Vallefresno. Bordeando el Refugio Brisa de Plata, las Ruinas del Polvo Estelar y la entrada a Sierra Espolón, actúa como un dosel pacífico a través del cual los viajeros se desplazan por el sur de Kalimdor. Escondida bajo el denso dosel de la zona centro-sur de Vallefresno, Vega del Espolón sirve como encrucijada entre varios lugares emblemáticos. Está flanqueada por el Refugio Brisa de Plata al este, las inquietantes Ruinas del Polvo Estelar en las cercanías y la escarpada cuesta que conduce a Sierra Espolón. En la sombra de árboles ancestrales, el valle sigue siendo una extensión de bosque salvaje por la que transitan celadoras de los elfos de la noche, centinelas y caminantes de paso mientras se desplazan entre el corazón del bosque y los altos riscos más allá.

ang.race:NightElf: Nestled near the sacred waters of Mystral Lake and the Ruins of Stardust, these valley paths are familiar ground to the sentinels and wardens patrolling southern Ashenvale.

faq.a: Talondeep Vale lies in south-central Ashenvale, nestled between Silverwind Refuge, the ancient Ruins of Stardust, and the southern mountain pass heading into the Stonetalon Mountains.
faq.q: Where is Talondeep Vale located?

faq.a: Following the trail through the vale leads travelers toward Talondeep Path, an ascent through the rugged heights connecting the woodlands of Ashenvale directly with the arid peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains.
faq.q: Where does the path leading south through the vale go?

faq.a: The vale sits adjacent to Silverwind Refuge to the east, as well as the waterlogged Ruins of Stardust, where ancient night elven remnants still stand beneath the tree boughs.
faq.q: What nearby landmarks should travelers watch for?

text.s: Talondeep Vale is a quiet, forested hollow nestled in south-central Ashenvale. Bordering Silverwind Refuge, the Ruins of Stardust, and the gateway to the Stonetalon Mountains, it acts as a peaceful canopy through which travelers navigate southern Kalimdor.

sec.b: Tucked away beneath the dense canopy of south-central Ashenvale, Talondeep Vale serves as a crossroads between several landmark sites. It is framed by Silverwind Refuge to the east, the haunting Ruins of Stardust nearby, and the rugged rise leading up into the Stonetalon Mountains. Shaded by ancient trees, the valley remains an untamed tract of woodland through which night elf wardens, sentinels, and passing wanderers traverse as they move between the heart of the forest and the high crags beyond.

subzone:tarren-mill.s: Molino Tarren. Molino Tarren es un asediado puesto de avanzada de los Renegados enclavado en los confines septentrionales de las Laderas de Trabalomas, al pie de las Montañas de Alterac. Antaño una pacífica aldea agrícola humana, ahora sirve como el bastión principal de la Horda en Trabalomas, enfrascado en un conflicto constante con la villa de Costasur de la Alianza al sur. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, Molino Tarren era un próspero municipio agrícola leal al Reino de Lordaeron. Durante la Segunda Guerra, cobró renombre cuando las fuerzas de la Alianza rescataron a arqueros altos elfos capturados de campamentos orcos cercanos, asegurando el pleno compromiso de Quel'Thalas con la Alianza de Lordaeron. Hoy en día, sin embargo, los habitantes vivos originales de la villa han desaparecido, reemplazados por los Renegados. La arquitectura del asentamiento se alza desgastada y deteriorada, sus campos están yermos y su viejo molino permanece en silencio mientras los nuevos ocupantes no-muertos fortifican el lugar contra las constantes amenazas de bestias montañosas, forajidos de la Hermandad y hostigadores de la Alianza.

ang.faction:Horde: Tarren Mill is your only major refuge in the Hillsbrad Foothills, offering a bat handler, supplies, and vital military support against encroaching Alliance forces from Southshore.
ang.race:Undead: Taking hold of Tarren Mill expands Queen Sylvanas's southern borders, turning a once-proud Lordaeron farming town into a strategic stronghold against the living.

faq.a: Tarren Mill is controlled entirely by the Forsaken and functions as the primary Horde questing hub and outpost in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
al: is tarren mill horde or alliance
faq.q: Who controls Tarren Mill right now?

faq.a: Tarren Mill represents the Forsaken and the Horde's southern reach in Lordaeron, while Southshore is the last major stronghold of the Alliance in the region. Their close proximity makes ongoing territorial warfare inevitable as both factions contest control of Hillsbrad's fertile land and strategic roads.
faq.q: Why are Tarren Mill and Southshore fighting?

faq.a: It was a peaceful human farming and milling settlement of the Kingdom of Lordaeron. During the Second War, Alliance soldiers famously freed captive high elven archers near the town, securing Quel'Thalas's military pact with the Alliance of Lordaeron.
faq.q: What was Tarren Mill like before the plague?

faq.a: Beyond Southshore's forces, Tarren Mill must contend with local bandits of the Syndicate, highland yetis and ogres descending from the Alterac peaks, and fierce mountain wildlife roaming the foothills.
faq.q: What threats exist around Tarren Mill besides the Alliance?

text.s: Tarren Mill is a beleaguered Forsaken outpost nestled in the northern reaches of the Hillsbrad Foothills beneath the Alterac Mountains. Once a peaceful human farming village, it now serves as the primary bastion of the Horde in Hillsbrad, locked in constant conflict with the Alliance town of Southshore to the south.

sec.b: Before the Third War, Tarren Mill was a thriving agricultural township loyal to the Kingdom of Lordaeron. During the Second War, it earned renown when Alliance forces rescued captured high elven archers from nearby orc encampments, securing Quel'Thalas's full commitment to the Alliance of Lordaeron. Today, however, the town's original living inhabitants are gone, replaced by the Forsaken. The town's architecture stands weathered and decayed, its fields barren, and its old mill silent as the new undead occupants fortify the settlement against constant threats from mountain beasts, Syndicate outlaws, and Alliance skirmishers.

Tarren Mill functions as the Horde's vital forward operations base in the region. Directly opposed to the Alliance port of Southshore, the road between the two settlements has devolved into an open warzone. Horde travelers use Tarren Mill to push back against the human farmers and soldiers occupying Hillsbrad, coordinate strikes against dwarven excavators at Dun Garok, and secure the treacherous roads leading up into the snowy crags of the Alterac Mountains.

subzone:temple-gardens.s: Los Jardines del Templo. Los Jardines del Templo forman el corazón tranquilo y acuático de Darnassus, rodeando pequeños islotes justo al norte del Templo de la Luna. Decorado con puentes y una flora impoluta, el distrito alberga el banco de la ciudad y el místico portal arbóreo que conduce a la base de Teldrassil. Extendiéndose sobre las aguas del centro de Darnassus, Los Jardines del Templo sirven como cruce de caminos de la capital de los elfos de la noche. Puentes de madera conectan sus islotes ajardinados con el Enclave Cenarion al norte, las bulliciosas terrazas al este y el gran santuario del Templo de la Luna al sur. Los elfos de la noche moldean cuidadosamente las aguas y el frondoso follaje del distrito, creando una atmósfera serena que ofrece descanso tanto a viajeros como a sacerdotisas.

ang.faction:Alliance: Any visitor sailing in through the docks must step through the Rut'theran portal into these tranquil waters to access the rest of the city.
ang.race:NightElf: The gardens represent the harmonious blend of wilderness and civic architecture that defines Darnassian culture, offering peace for reflection amidst administrative daily life.

faq.a: The glowing tree portal on the western edge of the gardens is the primary transport between the crown of Teldrassil and its base. Stepping through it instantly transports travelers to Rut'theran Village, where ships and hippogryphs connect the night elves to darkshore and the wider world.
faq.q: What is the glowing pink portal in the gardens?

faq.a: The city's main bank is situated right in the Temple Gardens, housed in an open elven pavilion on the district's largest central island.
faq.q: Where is the Darnassus bank located?

faq.a: The district takes its name from the magnificent Temple of the Moon, which sits directly adjacent to the gardens along their southern border.
faq.q: Why are they called the Temple Gardens?

faq.a: Bridges branch out across the water from the gardens to nearly every quarter: the Cenarion Enclave to the north, the Craftsmen's, Warrior's, and Tradesmen's Terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south.
faq.q: Which districts connect to the Temple Gardens?

text.s: The Temple Gardens form the tranquil, water-filled heart of Darnassus, surrounding small islets just north of the Temple of the Moon. Decorated with bridges and pristine flora, the district hosts the city bank and the mystical tree portal leading to the base of Teldrassil.

sec.b: Spanning the waters at the center of Darnassus, the Temple Gardens serve as the crossroads of the night elven capital. Wooden bridges connect its landscaped islets to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the bustling terraces to the east, and the grand sanctuary of the Temple of the Moon to the south. The night elves carefully shape the district's flowing waters and lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere that offers rest to travelers and priestesses alike.

Beyond housing the city's central vault and bank on its main island, the Temple Gardens hold critical importance for travelers entering or leaving the World Tree. On the western bank of the gardens stands a massive, glowing pink tree portal. This magical archway provides instantaneous passage down through the boughs to Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's base, connecting the isolated boughs to the coastal docks and flight paths.

subzone:temple-of-the-moon.s: Templo de la Luna. El templo de la Luna se alza en Darnassus como el corazón espiritual del pueblo de los elfos de la noche y la sede del gobierno en Teldrassil. Presidido por la suma sacerdotisa Tyrande Susurravientos, el santuario sirve como cuartel general de las Hermanas de Elune. Sus imponentes niveles de mármol albergan una poza de la luna sagrada cuyas aguas benditas otorgan sanación y comunión con la Diosa de la Luna. Erigido poco después de la Tercera Guerra, cuando los elfos de la noche se asentaron en Teldrassil, el Templo de la Luna se cuenta entre las mayores estructuras de piedra construidas por manos kaldorei modernas. Gran parte de su mármol se extrajo del continente de Kalimdor y se transportó a través del mar mediante artes mágicas. En el centro de su interior yace una amplia poza de la luna custodiada por la estatua de Haidene, donde aguas consagradas irradian un poder sereno. Más allá de servir como lugar de culto y reflexión apacible para los peregrinos, el templo funciona como la cúspide política de Darnassus, albergando a la suma sacerdotisa Tyrande Susurravientos mientras guía a su pueblo en los albores de una nueva y convulsa era.

ang.class:Priest: For Alliance priests—especially night elves—the temple represents the supreme font of Elune's divine mandate and the home of their highest trainers.
ang.race:NightElf: The temple stands as the cultural, spiritual, and civic core of modern kaldorei life, uniting the Sisterhood of Elune and the governance of Teldrassil under one roof.

faq.a: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind presides over the temple. As the leader of the Sisterhood of Elune and de facto head of the kaldorei government, she holds court on the upper tiers, guiding both the spiritual and military affairs of Darnassus.
faq.q: Who leads the Temple of the Moon?

faq.a: While Teldrassil was grown from boughs across the ocean, the temple itself is one of the few large stone edifices in Darnassus. Its marble and masonry were quarried from the mainland of Kalimdor and moved to the world tree's summit using magical transportation.
al: how was temple of the moon built
faq.q: How was the temple built on Teldrassil?

faq.a: The central pool is a sacred moonwell watched over by the statue of Haidene. Its waters are deeply consecrated and revered as the direct blessing of Elune, utilized by the Sisterhood for cleansing rites, meditation, and powerful restorative magic.
al: water in temple of the moon
faq.q: What is the pool in the center of the temple?

faq.a: The temple acts as the primary hub for Priest training in Darnassus. Adventurers also arrive here to report to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and receive guidance or assignments dispatched by the Sisterhood of Elune.
al: what is in temple of elune
faq.q: What services can players find here?

text.s: The Temple of the Moon stands in Darnassus as the spiritual heart of the night elven people and the seat of government on Teldrassil. Presided over by High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, the sanctuary serves as the headquarters for the Sisterhood of Elune. Its towering marble tiers house a sacred moonwell whose blessed waters bring healing and communion with the Moon Goddess.

sec.b: Erected shortly after the Third War when the night elves settled Teldrassil, the Temple of the Moon is among the largest stone structures constructed by modern kaldorei hands. Much of its marble was quarried from the Kalimdor mainland and transported across the sea through magical means. At the center of its interior lies an expansive moonwell overseen by the statue of Haidene, where consecrated waters radiate quiet power. Beyond serving as a place of worship and quiet reflection for pilgrims, the temple functions as the political apex of Darnassus, housing High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind as she guides her people through the dawn of a uncertain new age.

Within the temple's quiet terraces, the priestesses of the Sisterhood of Elune carry out the goddess's will both spiritually and tactically. From here, emissaries and dispatched sisters are sent outward across northern Kalimdor to investigate threats or offer aid to local sentinels, such as Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde's inquiries along the Darkshore coastline. Novices and veteran priestesses alike gather beneath the starry vaulted ceiling to train in divine spellwork, tend to the wounded, and guard the sanctum from outside corruption.

subzone:the-den.s: El Cubil. El Cubil es la cueva protegida situada en el corazón del Valle de los Retos, en el suroeste de Durotar. Al servir como base principal de operaciones para los jóvenes aventureros orcos y trols, les proporciona entrenamiento marcial y mágico antes de que se adentren en el resto del mundo. Ubicado en las paredes de los cañones rojos del Valle de los Retos, El Cubil sirve como un austero campo de pruebas. Dentro de su sombrío interior excavado, los luchadores novatos, lanzadores de conjuros y cazadores se presentan ante veteranos como Gornek y Vistalonga. Es aquí donde los recién llegados reciben su instrucción de combate básica, suministros y sus primeros ritos de iniciación, templándolos para las duras realidades de Durotar y los mayores desafíos que afronta la nueva Horda.

ang.race:Orc: Every young orc begins their journey at the Den, shedding the complacency of internment camps and blood haze to earn their place through discipline and labor.
ang.race:Troll: Following the devastation of the Darkspear Isles, young Darkspear trolls train in the Den alongside their orc allies, proving their mettle under the Horde's banner.

faq.a: The Den serves as the central command post and training sanctuary within the Valley of Trials. Here, novice orcs and Darkspear trolls gather to learn basic class techniques, purchase provisions, and receive assignments that prove their loyalty and combat readiness to the Horde.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Den?

faq.a: The encampment is supervised by veteran overseers such as Gornek and Foreman Thazz'ril, along with spiritual and magical mentors like Zureetha Fargaze and Canaga Earthcaller, all working together to instruct the newest generation of warriors and mystics.
faq.q: Who runs things inside the Den?

faq.a: No. The Den only hosts basic class trainers and general equipment merchants. New adventurers must travel north to Razor Hill or on to Orgrimmar to study primary trade skills such as Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, or Mining.
faq.q: Can you learn primary professions here?

text.s: The Den is the sheltered cave at the heart of the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar. Serving as the primary base of operations for young orc and troll adventurers, it provides martial and magical training before they set out into the wider world.

sec.b: Tucked into the red canyon walls of the Valley of Trials, the Den serves as an austere proving ground. Within its carved, shadowy interior, novice fighters, spellcasters, and hunters report to veterans like Gornek and Zureetha Fargaze. It is here that fledglings receive their foundational combat instruction, supplies, and initial rites of passage, hardening them for the harsh realities of Durotar and the greater struggles facing the new Horde.

Beyond housing class trainers and provisions, the Den functions as an active field redoubt. Between dispatching new recruits to cull the local beasts and aggressive quillboars, the overseers maintain a strict, vigilant watch over the valley.

subzone:the-loch.s: Loch Modan. Loch Modan es el vasto lago de agua dulce que domina el valle de Loch Modan. Contenido por la monumental Presa de las Tres Cabezas, es la mayor masa de agua de Khaz Modan y el sustento vital de los asentamientos enanos de los alrededores. Loch Modan, que se extiende por el centro de la región de Loch Modan, se encuentra entre los lagos interiores más grandes del mundo conocido, rivalizando únicamente con el Lago Lordamere y el Lago Darrowmere en el norte. Sus aguas sustentan a los pescadores locales y proporcionan un plácido telón de fondo para la localidad de Thelsamar y los pabellones de caza cercanos. Sin embargo, bajo su calma superficie merodean agresivos treseladones y bestias de agua dulce que hacen de cruzarlo a nado una peligrosa empresa.

ang.faction:Alliance: The tranquil waters of The Loch provide vital freshwater and trade routes between Ironforge's central valley and the surrounding outposts.
ang.race:Dwarf: The Loch is a centerpiece of Ironforge pride, demonstrating how dwarven masonry and the Stonewrought Dam can tame nature to sustain settlements like Thelsamar.

faq.a: The Loch is the massive mountain lake that fills the center of the Loch Modan valley in Khaz Modan. It is one of the largest bodies of freshwater in the world and defines the geography and livelihood of the local dwarves.
faq.q: What is The Loch?

faq.a: The lake is contained to the north by the Stonewrought Dam, a towering dwarven construction. The dam holds back countless gallons of water that would otherwise spill down through the mountain pass into the low-lying Wetlands.
faq.q: How does the lake stay full?

faq.a: Not entirely. While local fishermen dot the shores and piers, deeper waters are home to predatory threshadons and snapping beasts that frequently attack unwary travelers venturing far from land.
faq.q: Is it safe to swim in The Loch?

faq.a: It is the largest body of water on the continent of Khaz Modan and the third largest known lake in the Eastern Kingdoms, behind only Lordamere Lake and Darrowmere Lake in Lordaeron.
faq.q: How large is The Loch compared to other lakes?

text.s: The Loch is the vast freshwater lake that dominates the valley of Loch Modan. Held back by the monumental Stonewrought Dam, it is the largest body of water on Khaz Modan and the lifeblood of the surrounding dwarven settlements.

sec.b: Spanning the center of Loch Modan, The Loch is among the largest inland lakes in the known world, rivaled only by Lordamere Lake and Darrowmere Lake in the north. Its waters support local fishermen and provide a peaceful backdrop for the town of Thelsamar and nearby hunting lodges. Beneath its calm surface, however, prowl aggressive threshadons and freshwater beasts that make swimming across a perilous venture.

The Loch exists in its current tranquil state thanks to masterwork dwarven engineering. To the north stands the massive Stonewrought Dam, an architectural marvel built across the mountain cleft to prevent the lake from flooding out into the Wetlands below. Maintaining this colossal structure is essential to preserving the valley's ecosystem and keeping Khaz Modan secure.

subzone:thistlefur-hold.s: Bastión Piel de Cardo. Bastión Piel de Cardo es una guarida cavernosa excavada al norte del Poblado Piel de Cardo, en la zona centro-oeste de Vallefresno. Antaño osos pacíficos del bosque, los fúrbolgs Piel de Cardo que residen aquí han sucumbido a la corrupción y se vuelven violentos contra cualquier forastero que se acerque. Ubicado en los confines septentrionales del Poblado Piel de Cardo, Bastión Piel de Cardo sirve como el corazón del territorio de la tribu Piel de Cardo. Los fúrbolgs de este lugar enloquecieron tras entrar en posesión del Ídolo de Remulos, cayendo en un estado de hostilidad salvaje que los hace peligrosos tanto para los viajeros como para sus vecinos. En lo profundo de las serpenteantes cavernas, la tribu acumula reliquias saqueadas —incluidos unos talismanes trol de interés para los Lanza Negra— y retiene a cautivos atados en jaulas de madera, como el aprisionado valiente tauren Ruul Nevopezuña.

ang.class:Druid: Seeing the Thistlefur furbolgs fall to madness under the sway of the Idol of Remulos is a tragic reminder of how easily nature's guardians can be corrupted in Ashenvale.
ang.faction:Horde: The hold represents both a rescue mission and a salvage operation for the Horde, demanding warriors enter the den to liberate Ruul Snowhoof and retrieve stolen troll charms.

faq.a: Thistlefur Hold is the subterranean cavern complex at the northern end of Thistlefur Village in west-central Ashenvale. It houses the densest population of the hostile Thistlefur furbolg tribe.
faq.q: What is Thistlefur Hold?

faq.a: The Thistlefur furbolgs were corrupted by the Idol of Remulos, an artifact they kept within their possession. The malign influence twisted their minds and drove them to lash out against all outsiders.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in Thistlefur Hold hostile?

faq.a: Ruul Snowhoof, a tauren brave, was captured by the Thistlefur tribe and sits locked in a wooden cage deep inside the caverns awaiting rescue by Horde champions.
faq.q: Who is trapped inside the hold?

faq.a: The Horde seeks to free the captured tauren Ruul Snowhoof and recover valuable troll charms that the furbolgs have hoarded within the depths of the cave.
faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Thistlefur Hold?

text.s: Thistlefur Hold is a cavernous den carved into northern Thistlefur Village in west-central Ashenvale. Once peaceful bears of the forest, the Thistlefur furbolgs residing here have succumbed to corruption and turn violent toward any outsider who draws near.

sec.b: Tucked into the northern reaches of Thistlefur Village, Thistlefur Hold serves as the heart of the Thistlefur tribe's territory. The furbolgs here were driven mad after coming into possession of the Idol of Remulos, falling into a state of feral hostility that makes them dangerous to travelers and neighbors alike. Deep within the winding caverns, the tribe hordes scavenged relics—including troll charms of interest to the Darkspear—and keeps captives bound in wooden cages, such as the imprisoned tauren brave Ruul Snowhoof.

subzone:thistlefur-village.s: Poblado Piel de Cardo. El Poblado Piel de Cardo es un extenso asentamiento escondido en el bosque al norte de Astranaar, en la zona centro-oeste de Vallefresno. Sirve como hogar principal de la tribu de fúrbolgs Piel de Cardo, quienes han caído presa de una oscura corrupción y asaltan con violencia a cualquier forastero que se acerque a sus guaridas. Situado justo al norte del refugio de los elfos de la noche de Astranaar, el Poblado Piel de Cardo formó parte en su día de las pacíficas comunidades boscosas nativas de Vallefresno. Sin embargo, la maligna corrupción que se ha filtrado en los antiguos bosques se ha apoderado por completo de la tribu Piel de Cardo. Ahora, totalmente enloquecidos y sumamente hostiles, los fúrbolgs vigilan con ferocidad los caminos que serpentean por su asentamiento. El clan responde ante dos caudillos excepcionalmente feroces, Dal Bloodclaw y Rorgish Jowl, cuya implacable agresión representa una amenaza constante para los viajeros y los asentamientos cercanos.

ang.class:Druid: The fallen state of the Thistlefur tribe serves as a grim reminder of the lingering taint afflicting the spirits and wildlife of Ashenvale, demanding vigilant cleansing from the Cenarion Circle.
ang.race:NightElf: For centuries, the night elves lived in harmony alongside the native furbolg tribes. Seeing the Thistlefur succumb to violent corruption so close to Astranaar is both a heartbreak and a dire security crisis for the Sentinels.

faq.a: Thistlefur Village is situated in the west-central reaches of Ashenvale, nestled deep in the woodland hills directly north of the night elf town of Astranaar.
faq.q: Where is Thistlefur Village located?

faq.a: The Thistlefur furbolgs have been gripped by the dark corruption spreading across the forests of Ashenvale. Driven mad by these foul influences, they view all outsiders as immediate enemies and attack anyone who approaches their territory.
faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here attacking travelers?

faq.a: The tribe is led by two particularly fierce and brutal warrior chieftains named Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl, who maintain vicious dominance over the village and its nearby dens.
faq.q: Who leads the Thistlefur furbolgs?

faq.a: Yes. Because Thistlefur Village lies immediately north of Astranaar, the aggressive and unstable nature of the corrupted furbolgs makes them a persistent danger to night elf scouts, supply lines, and sentries stationed along the central roads.
faq.q: Does Thistlefur Village pose a danger to Astranaar?

text.s: Thistlefur Village is a sprawling settlement tucked into the forest north of Astranaar in west-central Ashenvale. It serves as the primary home of the Thistlefur furbolg tribe, who have fallen prey to dark corruption and violently assault any outsiders venturing near their dens.

sec.b: Situated just north of the night elf haven of Astranaar, Thistlefur Village was once part of the peaceful woodland communities native to Ashenvale. However, the malignant corruption that has seeped into the ancient forests has entirely claimed the Thistlefur tribe. Now thoroughly maddened and intensely hostile, the furbolgs fiercely guard the paths winding through their settlement. The clan answers to two exceptionally ferocious chieftains, Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl, whose unyielding aggression poses a constant threat to travelers and nearby settlements.

subzone:thistlefuzz-arcanery.s: Taller Arcano Cardopelusa. Taller Arcano Cardopelusa es un destacado taller y academia de las artes mágicas situado al este de la Gran Fundición en Forjaz. Regentado principalmente por practicantes gnomos, sirve como el principal refugio de la capital para encantadores y eruditos que buscan imbuir magia en el metal y el pergamino. Sus concurridas estancias vibran con energía arcana justo al lado de los rugientes fuegos de la industria enana. Ubicado justo al este de la atronadora Gran Fundición, Taller Arcano Cardopelusa ofrece un marcado contraste con el resonar de los yunques de los herreros enanos. En sus dos niveles, eruditos, practicantes y aprendices se reúnen para dominar las sutiles disciplinas del encantamiento y el estudio mágico. Mientras que los enanos de Forjaz prefieren moldear el acero a fuerza de músculo y fuego, los gnomos del taller arcano demuestran cómo la energía arcana pura puede ligarse directamente a armas, armaduras y curiosas herramientas. Se erige como un santuario esencial para los lanzadores de conjuros que transitan por la fortaleza de la montaña.

ang.class:Mage: Visiting mages find familiar reagents, quiet corners of theory, and kindred spellcasters among the otherwise martial, weapon-focused halls of the dwarf capital.
ang.race:Gnome: For gnomes residing in Ironforge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery is a comfortable reminder of their love for arcane theory, technical study, and delicate experimentation amidst a city dominated by heavy dwarven iron.

faq.a: Thistlefuzz Arcanery sits along the eastern ring of the Great Forge in central Ironforge, easily identified by the arcane apparatuses and enchanting supplies displayed around its doors.
faq.q: Where is Thistlefuzz Arcanery located?

faq.a: The shop caters to practitioners of magical crafts. Enchanting trainers, spellcraft suppliers, and scholars gather here to teach apprentices, trade rare reagents, and conduct experiments away from the physical soot of the smithies.
faq.q: What services are offered inside the Arcanery?

faq.a: Positioning an enchanting workshop right beside the Great Forge is practical. Newly forged blades, armor plates, and mechanical components produced by the dwarven smiths can immediately be carried east to be imbued with protective enchantments and elemental power.
al: why is it near the forge
faq.q: Why is an arcane workshop situated so close to the Great Forge?

text.s: Thistlefuzz Arcanery is a prominent workshop and academy of the magical arts located east of the Great Forge in Ironforge. Run primarily by gnome practitioners, it serves as the capital's premier haven for enchanters and scholars seeking to weave magic into metal and parchment. Its busy chambers hum with arcane energy right alongside the roaring fires of dwarven industry.

sec.b: Tucked directly east of the thundering Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery offers a stark contrast to the clanging anvils of dwarven smiths. Within its two levels, scholars, practitioners, and apprentices gather to master the subtle disciplines of enchanting and magical study. While the Ironforge dwarves prefer to reshape steel through muscle and fire, the gnomes of the Arcanery demonstrate how raw arcane energy can be bound directly into weaponry, armor, and curious tools. It stands as an essential sanctuary for spellcasters navigating the mountain stronghold.

subzone:thorn-hill.s: Colina Espinosa. Colina Espinosa es un enclave fortificado de jabaespines Crines de Acero situado en las altas crestas al este de El Cruce, en Los Baldíos. El asentamiento sirve como base avanzada para las partidas de guerra de jabaespines que asaltan las líneas de suministro de la Horda que viajan entre Durotar y la sabana interior. Encaramada en la cara norte de las escarpadas colinas entre Durotar y El Cruce, Colina Espinosa domina un punto de observación privilegiado sobre los principales corredores comerciales de Los Baldíos. El asentamiento alberga una peligrosa concentración de la tribu Crines de Acero, que incluye cazadores, lobos adiestrados y geománticos que moldean la tierra. Guiados por místicos como Elder Mystic Razorsnout, los jabaespines de aquí han intensificado sus ataques contra las caravanas de suministros de la Horda que pasan por la zona. Dado que este campamento de montaña se encuentra tan cerca de rutas de tránsito vitales, los guardias de El Cruce consideran Colina Espinosa como uno de los peligros militares más inmediatos de la sabana central.

ang.faction:Horde: Securing the road between the Crossroads and Durotar is vital for the fledgling Horde, making the aggressive raiders at Thorn Hill an urgent target for new warriors.

faq.a: Thorn Hill is a major encampment of Razormane quilboar nestled on the mountain slopes in the northern Barrens, directly between the Crossroads and the border of Durotar.
faq.q: What is Thorn Hill?

faq.a: The most prominent figure among the quilboar here is Elder Mystic Razorsnout, a Razormane mystic who guides the tribe's warbands.
faq.q: Who leads the quilboar at Thorn Hill?

faq.a: Razormane warbands based at Thorn Hill regularly ambush Horde supply caravans making the trek across the border from Durotar to the Crossroads, forcing local Horde authorities to dispatch warriors to clear the ridges.
faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the quilboar here?

faq.a: The encampment is defended by Razormane geomancers, hunters, trained wolves, and ferocious berserkers.
faq.q: What kinds of enemies live in Thorn Hill?

text.s: Thorn Hill is a fortified Razormane quilboar enclave nestled on the high ridges east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. The settlement serves as a forward base for quilboar warbands raiding Horde supply lines traveling between Durotar and the interior savanna.

sec.b: Perched on the north face of the rugged hills between Durotar and the Crossroads, Thorn Hill commands a watchful vantage over the primary trade corridors of the Barrens. The settlement is home to a dangerous gathering of the Razormane tribe, including hunters, trained wolves, and earth-shaping geomancers. Guided by mystics like Elder Mystic Razorsnout, the quilboar here have escalated their attacks against passing Horde supply caravans. Because this mountain camp sits so close to vital transit routes, the guards at the Crossroads consider Thorn Hill one of the most immediate military hazards in the central savanna.
sec.t: A Thorn in the Horde's Side

subzone:three-corners.s: Tres Caminos. Tres Caminos es una encrucijada vital situada justo en el interior de la frontera occidental de las Montañas Crestagrana. Al ramificarse hacia los tres pueblos vecinos de Villadorada, Villa del Lago y Villa Oscura, marca el límite entre el corazón del reino y las peligrosas tierras salvajes de Crestagrana. Una torre de vigilancia de la guardia de Ventormenta se alza sobre la intersección, manteniendo la línea contra las jaurías de gnolls que intentan avanzar. Situado en el extremo occidental de las Montañas Crestagrana, Tres Caminos conecta tres asentamientos clave de la Alianza: Villadorada en el Bosque de Elwynn al oeste, Villa del Lago al noreste y Villa Oscura en el Bosque del Ocaso al sur. Debido a esta unión estratégica, Ventormenta erigió Torre de Vigilancia en el centro de la encrucijada. Al custodiar el puesto, los guardias y exploradores locales intentan mantener las vías despejadas de los agresivos gnolls de Crestagrana, que amenazan constantemente a los viajeros y carromatos de suministros que transitan entre las regiones.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers leaving the relative safety of Elwynn Forest, Three Corners is the first fortified outpost and a stark reminder that Stormwind's grip on its borderlands is stretched thin.
ang.race:Human: The watchtower links the southern human heartlands, serving as a critical junction for couriers and trade moving between Elwynn, Duskwood, and Redridge.

faq.a: The crossroads splits into three distinct roads heading toward the 'Three Shires' of southern Stormwind: Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, Lakeshire in Redridge, and Darkshire in Duskwood.
faq.q: Why is this place called Three Corners?

faq.a: The outpost, known as Tower Watch, is manned by members of the Stormwind Guard. They serve as an early warning post and defensive bulwark against gnolls venturing down from the Redridge peaks toward the Elwynn border.
faq.q: Who guards the tower at Three Corners?

faq.a: Gnolls from the surrounding hills constantly prowl the roadway, ambushing travelers and couriers. The guards stationed here regularly call upon passing adventurers to cull the gnoll packs and keep the roads passable.
faq.q: What threats are active around Three Corners?

text.s: Three Corners is a vital crossroads nestled just inside the western border of the Redridge Mountains. Branching toward the three neighboring towns of Goldshire, Lakeshire, and Darkshire, it marks the boundary between the heart of the kingdom and Redridge's perilous wilderness. A Stormwind Guard watchtower stands over the intersection, holding the line against encroaching gnoll packs.

sec.b: Situated at the western edge of the Redridge Mountains, Three Corners connects three key Alliance settlements: Goldshire in Elwynn Forest to the west, Lakeshire to the northeast, and Darkshire in Duskwood to the south. Because of this strategic junction, Stormwind erected Tower Watch at the center of the crossroads. Manning the post, local guards and scouts attempt to keep the thoroughfares clear of Redridge's aggressive gnolls, who constantly threaten travelers and supply wagons passing between the regions.

subzone:thunder-falls.s: Cataratas del Trueno. Cataratas del Trueno es un barranco de montaña apartado, escondido en las alturas noroccidentales de Bosque de Elwynn. Protegido entre escarpados acantilados y alimentado por estruendosas cascadas, cuenta con una tranquila cabaña junto al río que ha caído en manos de bandidos locales. Escondidas en las escarpadas crestas sobre Lago Espejo, Cataratas del Trueno es una inusual hendidura geográfica. El barranco está excavado por un rápido arroyo de montaña que entra a través de una cascada inaccesible por el norte, para luego precipitarse a ambos lados en impresionantes saltos de agua. Uno de los lados cae directamente a Lago Espejo, mientras que el curso río abajo fluye hacia el oeste, en dirección a las agrestes fronteras de Páramos de Poniente. A pesar del rugido de las aguas, en la orilla se asientan una pequeña cabaña, un muelle y una forja al aire libre, aunque los forajidos ahora reclaman este apacible claro para sí mismos.

faq.a: You can reach Thunder Falls by heading to the northern side of Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest. A steep, narrow trail winds up into the hills along the right side of the Mirror Lake waterfall, leading directly into the secluded ravine.
al: how to get to thunder falls
faq.q: How do you reach Thunder Falls?

faq.a: The secluded cabin appears to have once belonged to a solitary fisherman or frontiersman, complete with a dock, rowing boat, and outdoor anvil. Today, however, it serves as a remote hideout for bandits operating in the wilderness of Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Who lives in the cottage at Thunder Falls?

faq.a: The stream flows through the narrow mountain gap from an upper mountain cascade. Downstream, it winds past the cottage and cascades down another steep fall that empties near the eastern boundary of Westfall.
faq.q: Where does the river at Thunder Falls flow?

text.s: Thunder Falls is a secluded mountain ravine tucked away in the northwestern heights of Elwynn Forest. Cradled between sheer cliffs and fed by roaring cascades, it features a quiet riverside cottage that has fallen into the hands of local bandits.

sec.b: Tucked away in the jagged ridges above Mirror Lake, Thunder Falls is an unusual geographical cleft. The ravine is carved by a swift mountain stream that enters via an inaccessible northern cascade, only to drop away on both sides in dramatic waterfalls. One side plunges down into Mirror Lake, while the downstream course flows west toward the rugged borders of Westfall. Despite the roaring waters, a small cottage, a dock, and an outdoor forge sit along the shore, though outlaws now claim the peaceful clearing for themselves.

subzone:thunderbrew-distillery.s: Destilería Cebatruenos. La Destilería Cebatruenos sirve como la bulliciosa taberna y el punto de encuentro central de Kharanos en Dun Morogh. Reconocida a lo largo y ancho por sus potentes cervezas, funciona tanto de cervecería activa como de parada de descanso esencial para los viajeros que cruzan los puertos de montaña nevados. En su interior, los parroquianos encuentran hogares cálidos, pintas frías y una amplia variedad de mentores de clase y comerciantes locales. Ubicada en el centro de Kharanos, la Destilería Cebatruenos es el corazón de la vida cívica en el sur de Dun Morogh. Fundada por el clan Cebatruenos —establecida por Arkilus Cebatruenos y mantenida por sus parientes—, la cervecería es famosa en todo Khaz Modan por elaborar cervezas robustas y reconfortantes, hechas para combatir el cortante frío de la montaña. Funciona como la posada local, administrada en la sala por el Tabernero Belm, y ofrece a los montañeros agotados un fuego crepitante, comida sustanciosa y camas para resguardarse de las ventiscas del exterior.

ang.profession:Cooking: The kitchen inside the distillery offers culinary training and supplies, making it a key stop for cooks looking to learn how to prepare hearty mountain provisions.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves leaving Coldridge Valley, the distillery is a beloved homecoming, providing familiar stout, a seat near a blazing hearth, and trusted mentors in iron and faith.

faq.a: The establishment belongs to the Thunderbrew family, founded by Arkilus Thunderbrew. His son Ragnar Thunderbrew actively looks after the family brewing traditions, while Innkeeper Belm handles hospitality and rooms for travelers resting in Kharanos.
faq.q: Who owns and operates the Thunderbrew Distillery?

faq.a: The distillery serves as the primary inn of Kharanos. Inside, travelers can bind their hearthstones with Innkeeper Belm, purchase drinks and supplies from vendors, and seek instruction from trainers for warriors, paladins, priests, mages, rogues, cooking, and first aid.
faq.q: What services are available inside the distillery?

faq.a: The distillery is celebrated throughout the Eastern Kingdoms for crafting exceptionally potent dwarven ales, particularly Thunderbrew Ale. Its brews are known to fortify travelers against the harsh freezing temperatures of the Dun Morogh peaks.
faq.q: Why is the distillery so famous?

faq.a: Yes, dwarven accounts recall the wandering pandaren brewmaster Chen Stormstout visiting the distillery in Kharanos years ago, crossing paths with the Thunderbrew family during his travels across the continent.
faq.q: Did Chen Stormstout really visit the distillery?

text.s: Thunderbrew Distillery serves as the bustling tavern and central gathering place of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Renowned far and wide for its potent ales, it functions as both an active brewhouse and an essential rest stop for travelers passing through the snowy mountain passes. Inside, patrons find warm hearths, cold pints, and a wide array of class mentors and local tradesfolk.

sec.b: Perched in the center of Kharanos, the Thunderbrew Distillery is the heart of civic life in southern Dun Morogh. Founded by the Thunderbrew clan—established by Arkilus Thunderbrew and maintained by his kin—the brewhouse is famous across Khaz Modan for producing robust, warming ales built to ward off the biting mountain chill. It operates as the local inn, managed on the floor by Innkeeper Belm, offering weary mountaineers a roaring fire, hearty fare, and beds to escape the blizzards outside.

Beyond pouring renowned stouts, the distillery doubles as a vital hub for developing adventurers. Because Kharanos is the first major settlement travelers reach after departing Coldridge Valley, the Thunderbrew tavern plays host to diverse trainers. Mentors in martial arts, holy rites, arcane studies, and roguecraft congregate under its sturdy timber rafters alongside instructors in cooking and emergency medical aid, turning a boisterous drinking hall into an indispensable preparation post.
sec.t: A Crossroads of Knowledge and Craft

subzone:thunderhorn-water-well.s: Pozo Tronacuerno. El Pozo Tronacuerno es una fuente de agua vital situada en las llanuras onduladas del centro de Mulgore, a lo largo del camino entre el Poblado Pezuña de Sangre y Cima del Trueno. Como todos los pozos del valle, proporciona un sustento esencial a las tribus y a las manadas que recorren los pastizales. Mantener esta agua limpia y protegida es crucial para preservar la vida en la tierra natal de los tauren. Situado en medio de los extensos pastizales del centro de Mulgore, el Pozo Tronacuerno se nutre directamente de los acuíferos puros que alimentan el valle. Para los tauren nómadas y sus aldeas recién asentadas, estos pozos comunales representan la vida, el sustento y la generosidad de la Madre Tierra. Dado que el agua es un bien preciado en las llanuras bañadas por el sol, controlar los pozos significa controlar la tierra misma. Intrusos como Ventura y Cía. han puesto sus ojos en estas fuentes en repetidas ocasiones, intentando aprovecharlas para la explotación industrial y alterando el frágil equilibrio que las tribus luchan por preservar.

ang.class:Shaman: Shaman deeply revere the pure water springs of Mulgore, viewing the protection of water spirits and subterranean currents as a sacred duty.
ang.race:Tauren: For the tauren, wells like Thunderhorn are vital lifelines gifted by the Earth Mother, requiring constant guardianship against foreign polluters and greedy trespassers.

faq.a: The well is located in central Mulgore, situated along the north-south road running between Bloodhoof Village and the bluffs of Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Where is the Thunderhorn Water Well located?

faq.a: The water wells of Mulgore tap into the pristine subterranean waters of the valley, sustaining the herds, pilgrims, and settlements. To the tauren, water is a sacred gift from the Earth Mother that must be safeguarded from outside corruption and greed.
faq.q: Why is this water well important to the tauren?

faq.a: Goblins of the Venture Company attempted to seize control of the well to monopolize the valley's water supply for their nearby mining and logging ventures, but local tauren fought back to reclaim and purify it.
faq.q: Who has threatened the well?

text.s: Thunderhorn Water Well is a vital water source situated in the rolling plains of central Mulgore along the path between Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff. Like all the wells across the valley, it provides essential nourishment to the tribes and the herds roaming the grasslands. Keeping this water clean and defended is crucial to maintaining life in the tauren homeland.

sec.b: Situated amid the sprawling grasslands of central Mulgore, the Thunderhorn Water Well taps directly into the pure aquifers feeding the valley. For the nomadic tauren and their newly settled villages, these communal wells represent life, sustenance, and the Earth Mother's bounty. Because water is precious across the sun-drenched plains, controlling the wells means controlling the land itself. Intruders such as the Venture Company have repeatedly eyed these sources, attempting to harness them for industrial exploitation and disrupt the fragile balance the tribes fight to preserve.

subzone:tidus-stair.s: El Escalón de la Marea. El Escalón de la Marea es una formación rocosa natural de amplias terrazas escalonadas de piedra situadas sobre La Costa Mercante, al sureste de Trinquete. Al abrigo del Mare Magnum, sirve como un apacible retiro para dos chamanes tauren que comulgan con las mareas y los espíritus del agua. Al descender hacia el oleaje al sureste de Trinquete, El Escalón de la Marea parece un conjunto monumental de escalones de piedra desgastada tallados directamente en los acantilados costeros. Aunque Los Baldíos circundantes son áridos, polvorientos y propensos a escaramuzas, este tramo tranquilo con vistas a La Costa Mercante está dominado por el sonido del romper de las olas. En lo alto de las terrazas se encuentra una modesta choza donde residen los tauren Islen Vident'aqua y Mahren Visioceleste. Lejos de los bulliciosos muelles comerciales de los goblins, ambos pasan sus días pescando, contemplando el horizonte y buscando el conocimiento de los espíritus del agua de la costa.

ang.class:Shaman: Every Horde shaman eventually journeys down these coastal steps to seek out Islen Waterseer during their trials to bind the water totem.
ang.race:Tauren: The quiet presence of Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer shows how tauren seers maintain a spiritual vigil even far outside Mulgore's borders.

faq.a: Tidus Stair lies along the eastern coast of the Barrens, directly southeast of the goblin port of Ratchet. It overlooks the waters of the Merchant Coast.
al: how to get to tidus stair
faq.q: Where is Tidus Stair located?

faq.a: Two tauren make their home here: Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer. They live in a simple seaside hut on the terraces, spending their time fishing and communing with nature.
faq.q: Who lives at Tidus Stair?

faq.a: Horde shamans seeking to master the element of water are guided across Kalimdor to find Islen Waterseer at Tidus Stair. Here, beside the open ocean, initiates learn to commune with the tides and seek out pure waters to bind their water totem.
faq.q: Why is Tidus Stair significant to shamans?

faq.a: The resident tauren are loyal to the Horde and guide Horde shamans, though the remote terraces sit outside any formal military borders.
faq.q: Is Tidus Stair aligned with the Horde or neutral?

text.s: Tidus Stair is a natural rock formation of broad, stepped stone terraces perched over the Merchant Coast southeast of Ratchet. Sheltered beside the Great Sea, it serves as a quiet retreat for two tauren shamans communing with the tides and water spirits.

sec.b: Descending toward the surf southeast of Ratchet, the Tidus Stair resembles a monumental set of weathered stone steps cut directly into the coastal bluffs. While the surrounding Barrens are arid, dusty, and prone to skirmishes, this quiet stretch overlooking the Merchant Coast is dominated by the sound of crashing waves. Perched on the terraces is a modest hut where the tauren Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer reside. Far from the bustling trade docks of the goblins, the two spend their days fishing, watching the horizon, and seeking insight from the coastal water spirits.

subzone:tinkers-court.s: Cámara de los Manitas. Cámara de los Manitas es la gran cámara del consejo situada en el corazón de Gnomeregan. Antaño la bulliciosa sede del Manitas Mayor y su consejo de gobierno, en la actualidad es el lúgubre bastión del traidor Mekigeniero Termochufe. Antes del desastre que asoló Gnomeregan, Cámara de los Manitas servía como el corazón cívico y político de la nación. Era aquí donde el Manitas Mayor Gelbin Mekkatorque se reunía con consejeros y maestros inventores, incluido el Maestro manitas Sobrechispa, para debatir sobre avances tecnológicos, gobernar asuntos cívicos y guiar a la sociedad gnómica. La corte representaba la cúspide del ingenio y el gobierno de los gnomos, situada justo más allá de las obras industriales de Laboratorios de Ingeniería y Hangar de Lanzamiento.

ang.profession:Engineering: The chamber is an alarming showcase of corrupted engineering, filled with deadly bomb delivery systems and the lethal siege suit operated by Thermaplugg.
ang.race:Gnome: Standing in the Tinkers' Court is a painful reminder of betrayal; this room was once where gnomish leaders gathered before Sicco Thermaplugg seized it amidst irradiated ruin.

faq.a: Historically, the Tinkers' Court served as the meeting place and civic chamber for the elected High Tinker and the ruling council of Gnomeregan. Gelbin Mekkatorque and high-ranking advisors, such as Tinkmaster Overspark, used this hall to discuss city governance and cutting-edge innovations.
faq.q: What was the Tinkers' Court used for originally?

faq.a: Mekgineer Sicco Thermaplugg currently occupies the court. Calling himself the King of Gnomeregan, he holds the chamber alongside his defensive machinery and irradiated minions.
faq.q: Who controls Tinkers' Court now?

faq.a: Tinkers' Court lies in the deepest reaches of Gnomeregan, beyond the dark tunnels and lower levels connected to both the Launch Bay and the Engineering Labs.
al: how to get to tinkers court
faq.q: Where is the court located within Gnomeregan?

faq.a: Reaching the court is the ultimate objective of reclaiming the city, as Mekgineer Thermaplugg directs his irradiated minions from within. Deposing him is the critical first step toward Gnomeregan's liberation.
faq.q: Why is reaching Tinkers' Court so important for the Alliance?

text.s: Tinkers' Court is the grand council chamber at the heart of Gnomeregan. Once the bustling seat of the High Tinker and his ruling council, it is now the grim stronghold of the traitor Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

sec.b: Before the disaster that ruined Gnomeregan, the Tinkers' Court served as the civic and political heart of the nation. It was here that High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque gathered with advisors and master inventors, including Tinkmaster Overspark, to debate technological advancements, govern civic matters, and guide gnomish society. The court represented the pinnacle of gnomish ingenuity and governance, situated just beyond the industrial works of the Engineering Labs and the Launch Bay.

Following the disastrous radiation venting that drove the gnomes into exile, Mekgineer Sicco Thermaplugg claimed the chamber as his own. Styling himself the King of Gnomeregan, the mad inventor now sits in the Tinkers' Court surrounded by twisted contraptions, loyal leper gnomes, and bomb dispensers. From this desecrated council hall, he directs his remaining forces, making the court the final and most dangerous threshold for any strike team seeking to end his rule.

subzone:tiragarde-keep.s: Fuerte de Tiragarde. El Fuerte de Tiragarde es un bastión humano fortificado situado en la Costa de la Huída de Durotar, al sur de Cerrotajo. Construida originalmente durante la invasión del Gran Almirante Daelin Valiente, la ciudadela en ruinas sigue contando con una guarnición de infantes de marina hostiles de Kul Tiras a las órdenes del Lieutenant Benedict. Representa una desafiante espina clavada en el costado de la Horda, justo en su propio territorio. Erigido durante la campaña del Gran Almirante Daelin Valiente para erradicar el recién fundado reino de Thrall, el Fuerte de Tiragarde proporcionó a la flota de Kul Tiras una cabeza de playa atrincherada en las costas rojas de Durotar. Aunque la Horda acabó rompiendo el asedio y mató a Valiente en la Isla Theramore, el fuerte nunca se abandonó del todo. Las fuerzas de reabastecimiento bajo el mando del Lieutenant Benedict recuperaron los muros de piedra derruidos, siguiendo las órdenes permanentes del difunto almirante de librar una guerra implacable contra los orcos y rechazando por completo la paz forjada por Lady Jaina Valiente.

ang.faction:Horde: Tiragarde Keep is a blatant Alliance invasion base right on Durotar's doorstep; raiding its ramparts and eliminating Lieutenant Benedict is a rite of passage for young soldiers serving Razor Hill.
ang.race:Human: The garrison represents the unbending, vengeful legacy of Kul Tiras and Admiral Proudmoore, fighting a stubborn guerrilla war in defiance of Jaina Proudmoore's diplomacy.

faq.a: These humans are Kul Tiras sailors and marines who arrived with Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore during his invasion following the Third War. They reject peace with the Horde and maintain this garrison to harass the orcs.
al: who are the humans in tiragarde
faq.q: Why are there humans in Durotar?

faq.a: No. While Jaina Proudmoore rules Theramore Isle and maintains an uneasy truce with Thrall, these soldiers follow the orders of her late father, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. They consider any peace with orcs unacceptable treason.
faq.q: Are these humans part of Jaina's forces in Theramore?

faq.a: The stronghold is commanded by Lieutenant Benedict, a Kul Tiran officer acting on posthumous invasion orders left by Admiral Proudmoore to secure the coast and attack the Horde.
faq.q: Who commands Tiragarde Keep?

faq.a: The keep is fortified and manned by disciplined, well-armed Kul Tiran troops. While the defenders from Razor Hill frequently skirmish with the garrison and use it as a proving ground for new recruits, launching a full-scale siege would draw heavy casualties and divert vital resources away from securing the rest of Durotar.
al: why is the keep still here
faq.q: Why hasn't the Horde simply wiped them out?

text.s: Tiragarde Keep is a fortified human stronghold situated along Durotar's Scuttle Coast, south of Razor Hill. Originally built during Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's invasion, the ruined citadel remains garrisoned by hostile Kul Tiran marines under Lieutenant Benedict. It serves as a defiant, permanent thorn in the Horde's side right on their home territory.

sec.b: Erected during Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's campaign to eradicate Thrall's newly founded realm, Tiragarde Keep provided the Kul Tiran fleet an entrenched beachhead on the red shores of Durotar. Although the Horde eventually broke the siege and killed Proudmoore at Theramore Isle, the keep was never fully abandoned. Resupply forces under Lieutenant Benedict reclaimed the shattered stone walls, following the late Admiral's standing orders to wage an unyielding war against the orcs, entirely refusing the peace forged by Lady Jaina Proudmoore.

Today, the keep's gleaming white battlements stand in harsh contrast against Durotar's crimson cliffs. Well-trained Kul Tiras sailors and marines patrol the ramparts and launch raids targeting supply lines near Razor Hill. For the Horde, Tiragarde Keep is an ongoing security crisis and a live proving ground. Orc and troll commanders constantly task young warriors with assaulting the fortress and cutting down Benedict's soldiers, seeking to contain the garrison before the humans can mount a deeper inland offensive.

subzone:tower-of-althalaxx.s: Torre de Althalaxx. La Torre de Althalaxx es una antigua aguja de los Altonato situada en el norte de Costa Oscura, cerca de la costa. En su día fue un retiro aislado para el hechicero Athrikus Narassin antes del Gran Cataclismo, pero ahora se ha visto infestada de cultistas demoníacos y brujos que practican artes oscuras. Hace diez mil años, la Reina Azshara asentó a sirvientes Altonato predilectos en las poblaciones costeras de Ameth'Aran y Bashal'Aran, otorgando autoridad sobre ellos al poderoso hechicero Athrikus Narassin. Distanciándose del gobierno civil, Athrikus prefirió aislarse en la cercana Torre de Althalaxx. Cuando el Gran Cataclismo destrozó el antiguo Kalimdor, la torre resistió junto a la desolada costa de Costa Oscura, alzándose como una silenciosa ruina de magias élficas olvidadas.

ang.class:Warlock: The dark rites conducted by the Cult of the Dark Strand demonstrate the far-reaching influence and lingering presence of the Shadow Council in Kalimdor.
ang.race:NightElf: The tower represents a grim reminder of Highborne corruption and demonic folly lingering on ancestral lands, demanding swift intervention from Darnassus.

faq.a: It is an ancient elven mage tower built in northern Darkshore during the reign of Queen Azshara, now occupied by dark sorcerers and cultists.
faq.q: What is the Tower of Althalaxx?

faq.a: Athrikus Narassin, a powerful Highborne sorcerer appointed by Queen Azshara to oversee the nearby settlements of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran, retreated here when he grew bored of his duties.
faq.q: Who originally built and lived in the tower?

faq.a: They belong to the Cult of the Dark Strand, a sect of warlocks, cultists, and satyrs practicing dark rites within the ruined tower.
faq.q: Who are the cultists occupying the tower now?

faq.a: The cultists conduct dark rituals and soul-binding magic, subjecting the long-dead elven spirits of ancient Darkshore to agonizing torment for their spells.
faq.q: Why are there ghosts and tortured spirits here?

text.s: The Tower of Althalaxx is an ancient Highborne spire standing in northern Darkshore near the coast. Once an isolated retreat for the sorcerer Athrikus Narassin before the Great Sundering, it has become infested by demonic cultists and warlocks practicing dark arts.

sec.b: Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne servants in the coastal towns of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran, placing the powerful sorcerer Athrikus Narassin in authority over them. Growing distant from civic governance, Athrikus chose to isolate himself within the nearby Tower of Althalaxx. When the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, the tower endured along the desolate coastline of Darkshore, standing as a quiet ruin of forgotten elven magics.

In the modern era, the tower has stirred with malignant sorcery. Warlocks, dark cultists calling themselves the Cult of the Dark Strand, and allied satyrs have congregated within the ruin under the leadership of Athrikus Narassin himself. Their rites channel demonic magic and torment the lingering spirits of the ancient dead, serving sinister designs tied directly to the demonic Shadow Council.

subzone:tower-of-azora.s: Torre de Azora. La Torre de Azora es una esbelta aguja de mago que se alza en la parte oriental del Bosque de Elwynn, al norte de la Plantación de Calabazas de Brackwell. Presidido por el archimago humano Theocritus, este enclave sirve como puesto académico inmerso en una silenciosa disputa mágica contra una torre hostil en las vecinas Montañas Crestagrana. Erigida junto al camino oriental hacia las Montañas Crestagrana, la Torre de Azora es un santuario arcano atendido casi en su totalidad por taumaturgos gnomos. Bajo la tutela del archimago Theocritus, estos eruditos estudian extrañas curiosidades y ofrecen instrucción mágica a los tejedores de hechizos errantes. El aura mágica salvaje que rodea la aguja altera en ocasiones a la fauna cercana, obligando a los sirvientes gnomos a lidiar con objetos domésticos encantados e insectos mutados que se cuelan por la entrada.

ang.class:Mage: For mages traveling beyond Stormwind, the tower offers a secluded haven of study, arcane trainers, and a front-row seat to the dangerous arts of remote divination.
ang.race:Gnome: Seeing an arcane spire in human lands staffed by gnomes under Archmage Theocritus is a proud showcase of your people's mastery over the mystic arts.

faq.a: The tower is presided over by Archmage Theocritus, an accomplished human wizard. He directs the servants within the spire and coordinates their magical defenses against rival sorcerers.
al: who leads the tower of azora
faq.q: Who rules the Tower of Azora?

faq.a: The servants of Azora are predominantly gnome researchers and acolytes who assist Archmage Theocritus with his studies, arcane experiments, and housekeeping against magical mishaps.
faq.q: Why are there so many gnomes here?

faq.a: The tower is locked in a magical rivalry with the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains, home to the evil sorcerer Morganth. Both spires spy on each other with scrying artifacts and contest each other's influence.
faq.q: Who is the tower fighting against?

faq.a: The Eye of Azora is an enchanted scrying focus placed on a table in the upper sanctum. Touching it allows an observer to gaze through magical distance to monitor the outskirts of the Tower of Ilgalar.
faq.q: What is the Eye of Azora on the top floor?

text.s: The Tower of Azora is a slender wizard's spire rising out of eastern Elwynn Forest, north of the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Presided over by the human Archmage Theocritus, the enclave serves as a scholarly outpost locked in a silent magical feud with a hostile tower in neighboring Redridge Mountains.

sec.b: Standing along the eastern road toward the Redridge Mountains, the Tower of Azora is an arcane sanctuary staffed almost entirely by gnome spellcasters. Under the stewardship of Archmage Theocritus, these scholars study strange curiosities and provide magical instruction to wandering spellweavers. The wild magical aura surrounding the spire occasionally warps the nearby wildlife, leaving the gnome servants to contend with enchanted household items and mutated insects creeping past the doorway.

Beneath its quiet scholarly exterior, the tower is engaged in an enduring war of scrying and sabotage. To the east, atop the crags of Redridge, sits the sinister Tower of Ilgalar, ruled by the renegade sorcerer Morganth. Theocritus and Morganth constantly spy on one another through arcane means, employing daring adventurers to plant scrying relics like the Eye of Azora to pierce the wards of Ilgalar and monitor Morganth's dark machinations.

subzone:tower-of-ilgalar.s: Torre de Ilgalar. La Torre de Ilgalar es una aguja aislada encaramada en lo alto de los riscos de las Montañas Crestagrana orientales. Antaño el retiro de un mago, ha caído en la sombra como escondite de Morganth, un hechicero desterrado de Ventormenta que ahora comanda a los salvajes gnolls de la región y practica magia oscura. Erigiéndose sobre el este de Crestagrana, la Torre de Ilgalar sirve como santuario personal de Morganth. Expulsado del Barrio de los Magos de Ventormenta por incursionar en la magia prohibida, el hechicero renegado se retiró a estas escarpadas alturas para profundizar en las artes oscuras sin interferencia imperial. En lugar de vivir en soledad, Morganth impuso su dominio sobre el clan local de gnolls Pellejo Negro, empleándolos como centinelas salvajes alrededor de la base de la aguja. En su interior, la torre está repleta de canes demoníacos conjurados y crepita con poder sombrío, representando una amenaza constante e inquietante para el asediado pueblo de Villa del Lago, situado más abajo.

ang.class:Mage: The tower serves as a stark warning of what happens when arcane studies delve into forbidden dark magic, drawing the watchful eye of Kirin Tor veterans like Theocritus.
ang.class:Warlock: Morganth's reliance on summoned darkhounds and shadowy hexes mirrors demonic arts, making his mountain retreat an intriguing example of rogue spellcraft outside of city covens.

faq.a: The tower is held by Morganth, a renegade human sorcerer who was exiled from Stormwind City for practicing forbidden dark magic. He now rules the tower alongside summoned demonic darkhounds and commands the local Shadowhide gnolls.
al: who is in tower of ilgalar
faq.q: Who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar?

faq.a: Morganth was cast out of the Mage Quarter in Stormwind after pursuing the dark arts. He retreated to the remote crags of Redridge to conduct his forbidden experiments far away from the scrutiny of the realm's authorities and the Kirin Tor.
faq.q: Why did Morganth flee to Redridge?

faq.a: Both towers are prominent magical spires in southern Stormwind, seemingly mirrored in purpose. From the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest, the mage Theocritus actively scries upon the upper sanctum of Ilgalar using the Eye of Azora to keep watch over Morganth's dark rituals.
faq.q: What is the connection between this tower and the Tower of Azora?

faq.a: Morganth used his magical influence to subjugate the local Shadowhide clan of gnolls. They act as outer sentries and muscle, keeping intruders, scouts, and the Lakeshire militia from scaling the cliffs to his sanctum.
faq.q: Why are there gnolls guarding the tower?

text.s: The Tower of Ilgalar is an isolated spire perched high in the crags of the eastern Redridge Mountains. Once a wizard's retreat, it has fallen into shadow as the hideout of Morganth, a banished sorcerer from Stormwind who now commands the region's feral gnolls and practices dark magic.

sec.b: Looming over eastern Redridge, the Tower of Ilgalar serves as the personal sanctum of Morganth. Cast out from the Mage Quarter of Stormwind for dabbling in forbidden magic, the rogue sorcerer retreated into these rugged heights to delve deeper into the dark arts without imperial interference. Rather than living in solitude, Morganth asserted dominion over the local Shadowhide gnoll clan, employing them as savage sentries around the base of the spire. Inside, the tower crawls with conjured demonic hounds and crackles with shadowy power, posing a constant, brooding menace to the beleaguered town of Lakeshire below.

Scholars often draw parallels between the Tower of Ilgalar and the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. While the true identity of Ilgalar remains shrouded in mystery, the two towers stand in quiet, magical opposition. In Elwynn, the Kirin Tor mage Theocritus maintains careful watch over Ilgalar through enchanted scrying devices like the Eye of Azora, monitoring Morganth's sinister experiments and plotting to neutralize the renegade before his corruption spreads further through the kingdom.

subzone:trade-district.s: Distrito de Mercaderes.
