El Distrito de Mercaderes es el bullicioso corazón comercial de la Ciudad de Ventormenta, situado justo después de las puertas principales y del Valle de los Héroes. Sirve como centro neurálgico tanto para aventureros como para ciudadanos, y alberga el banco central de la ciudad, la casa de subastas, el registro de hermandades y diversas tiendas de mercaderes. Al cruzar bajo los arcos de piedra desde el Valle de los Héroes, los viajeros acceden directamente al Distrito de Mercaderes. Esta vibrante plaza abierta actúa como el principal mercado y centro logístico de Ventormenta. En su centro se erige la Casa de Subastas, flanqueada cerca por el Banco de Ventormenta —el banco principal de la ciudad— y la popular taberna conocida como La Rosa Áurea. El distrito conecta directamente el enclave militar del Casco Antiguo, la serena Plaza de la Catedral y las arcanas avenidas del Barrio de los Magos, asegurando que las monedas, las materias primas y los suministros para la aventura circulen con rapidez por el reino.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions, the Trade District is the quintessential hub for banking, trading at the Auction House, organizing guilds, and taking flight across the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.a: The Trade District sits just past the city's main entrance gates and the Valley of Heroes. It connects directly to Cathedral Square to the northwest, Old Town to the east, and the Mage Quarter across the canals to the southwest.
al: how to get to trade district
faq.q: Where is the Trade District located?

faq.a: The Stormwind Counting House (the primary city bank) and The Gilded Rose inn are situated along the southwest perimeter of the Trade District, directly convenient to the main thoroughfare.
faq.q: Where can I find the bank and the inn?

faq.a: The Stormwind Visitor's Center, located on your left immediately upon entering the Trade District from the city gates, houses the Guild Master and tabard design services.
faq.q: Where do I register a guild or design a tabard in Stormwind?

faq.a: A stone ramp on the eastern side of the Trade District leads directly up to the Gryphon Roost, where the flight master dispatches gryphons across the kingdom and beyond.
faq.q: Where can I take a gryphon flight from the Trade District?

text.s: The Trade District is the bustling commercial heart of Stormwind City, located immediately past the main gates and the Valley of Heroes. It serves as the primary hub for adventurers and citizens alike, housing the city's central bank, auction house, guild registry, and diverse merchant shops.

sec.b: Crossing beneath the stone arches from the Valley of Heroes brings travelers directly into the Trade District. This vibrant open plaza acts as Stormwind's primary marketplace and logistical hub. At its center stands the Auction House, flanked nearby by the Stormwind Counting House, the city's main bank, and the popular tavern known as The Gilded Rose. The district directly bridges the gap between the military enclave of Old Town, the serene Cathedral Square, and the arcane avenues of the Mage Quarter, ensuring that coin, raw goods, and adventuring supplies circulate swiftly through the realm.

Every essential commodity can be acquired along the paved avenues and flanking canals. Weapon smiths at Weller's Arsenal and Lionheart Armory supply blades and mail, fletchers peddle bows at The Empty Quiver, and artisanal stalls offer everything from fresh flowers to fine aged vintages from the Gallina Winery. Just inside the gates, the Stormwind Visitor's Center coordinates newly registered charters and tabard designs for organized adventuring guilds, while an elevated ramp on the eastern side climbs toward the Gryphon Roost, linking the capital's mercantile life to the rest of the Alliance territories.

subzone:trade-quarter.s: Barrio del Comercio. El Barrio del Comercio forma el núcleo central de Entrañas, situado directamente bajo los elevadores de las Ruinas de Lordaeron. Funciona como el palpitante corazón económico de los Renegados, albergando sus principales cámaras bancarias, la casa de subastas y servicios cívicos esenciales. Desde este centro concéntrico, pasillos abovedados se ramifican hacia los distritos circundantes. Al descender desde la devastada superficie de Lordaeron, los viajeros bajan de los elevadores para adentrarse en la resonante extensión de piedra del Barrio del Comercio. Diseñado con una disposición circular escalonada, su plataforma central alberga las arcas de la ciudad y el banco central, enmarcado por puentes que cruzan canales de efluvios nocivos. Las terrazas circundantes bullen de vendedores, registros de hermandades y subastadores que regatean en medio de una penumbra inquietante. Incluso los alojamientos más básicos reflejan el pragmatismo de los Renegados: la posada local ofrece ataúdes de madera sin forrar en lugar de camas blandas. Desde este nexo central, arcadas de piedra conducen hacia los barrios especializados de la ciudad, convirtiéndolo en el cruce de caminos inevitable para cualquier negocio que se lleve a cabo en la capital.

ang.faction:Horde: For Orc, Tauren, or Troll emissaries arriving in Tirisfal Glades, the Trade Quarter serves as the foreign, shadowy market center of their northern allies.
ang.race:Undead: The Trade Quarter represents the swift reclamation of civilized order by the Forsaken, turning subterranean dungeons into a thriving market dedicated to funding their survival.

faq.a: The Trade Quarter occupies the dead center of the Undercity. When entering the capital via the surface elevators beneath the Ruins of Lordaeron, you step out immediately onto the upper ring of the district.
faq.q: Where is the Trade Quarter located?

faq.a: The district hosts the central Undercity bank, an auction house along the outer ring, the primary inn, a bat handler for air travel, guild registrars, and various trade trainers including the city's cooking mentor.
faq.q: What services are found in the Trade Quarter?

faq.a: Forsaken physiology requires no true sleep, and many retain habits suited to their undead condition. The inn provides plain, unlined wooden caskets rather than traditional bedding—a matter of routine comfort for the dead, though deeply unsettling for living visitors.
faq.q: Why are there coffins in the inn?

faq.a: Jeremiah Payson makes his living under one of the central bridges crossing into the bank. While standard merchants peddle weaponry and trade goods up above, Payson sells live pet cockroaches to curious passersby.
faq.q: Who is the vendor lurking beneath the bridges?

text.s: The Trade Quarter forms the central core of the Undercity, resting directly beneath the lifts from the Ruins of Lordaeron. It functions as the beating economic heart of the Forsaken, housing their primary bank vaults, auction market, and essential civic services. From this concentric hub, vaulted corridors branch outward into the surrounding districts.

sec.b: Descending from the shattered surface of Lordaeron, travelers step off the lifts into the echoing stone expanse of the Trade Quarter. Designed around a tiered, circular layout, its central platform holds the city coffers and central bank, framed by bridges spanning noxious runoff canals. Surrounding terraces buzz with vendors, guild registries, and auctioneers bargaining amidst the eerie gloom. Even basic accommodations reflect Forsaken pragmatism: the local inn offers unlined wooden caskets rather than soft beds. From this central nexus, stone archways lead outward into the city's specialized quarters, making it the unavoidable crossroads for any business conducted within the capital.

subzone:tradesmen-s-terrace.s: Bancal de los Mercaderes. El Bancal de los Mercaderes es el bullicioso corazón comercial de Darnassus, situado a lo largo del flanco sur de la ciudad. Reúne a artesanos, comerciantes y la casa de subastas local bajo la amplia arquitectura de madera de la capital de los elfos de la noche. El bancal sirve como el principal nexo comercial que conecta a los artesanos con los aventureros que viajan por Teldrassil y más allá. Ocupando la franja sur de Darnassus, el Bancal de los Mercaderes alberga la vida mercantil de la capital. Mientras que gran parte de la ciudad está dedicada a la contemplación silenciosa, los santuarios de naturaleza salvaje y los deberes espirituales, este bancal congrega a tenderos, artesanos y comerciantes que atienden tanto a los kaldorei locales como a viajeros de toda la Alianza. Contiene la casa de subastas central de Darnassus, provisiones generales y tiendas de suministros para profesiones, lo que lo convierte en el punto de partida esencial para los viajes por la naturaleza. Amplios senderos lo conectan hacia el norte directamente con el Bancal del Guerrero y hacia el oeste con las serenas aguas de Los Jardines del Templo y el grandioso Templo de la Luna.

ang.faction:Alliance: The terrace offers Alliance travelers coming through Rut'theran Village access to banking, auctioneers, and essential trade supplies before heading deeper into Kalimdor.
ang.race:NightElf: For the night elves, Tradesmen's Terrace is a rare center of dense urban commerce, adapted to preserve the peaceful canopy of Darnassus without the disruptive industry of other races.

faq.a: Tradesmen's Terrace is the southern marketplace district of Darnassus. It serves as the commercial center for the night elven capital, containing most of the city's merchants, artisans, and its central auction house.
faq.q: What is Tradesmen's Terrace?

faq.a: The Darnassus auction house is located right here in Tradesmen's Terrace. It provides travelers, traders, and locals access to citywide and Alliance commerce.
faq.q: Where is the auction house in Darnassus?

faq.a: Paths from Tradesmen's Terrace lead north into the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the towering Temple of the Moon.
faq.q: How do I reach the other districts from here?

faq.a: The terrace hosts a broad variety of general merchants, trade supply vendors, and craftspeople catering to everyday needs, repairs, and goods produced across Teldrassil.
faq.q: What kinds of vendors are found in this district?

text.s: Tradesmen's Terrace is the bustling commercial heart of Darnassus, situated along the city's southern flank. It brings together craftspeople, merchants, and the local auction house beneath the sweeping wooden architecture of the night elf capital. The terrace serves as the primary trade link connecting artisans with adventurers journeying across Teldrassil and beyond.

sec.b: Occupying the southern stretch of Darnassus, Tradesmen's Terrace houses the capital's mercantile life. While much of the city is devoted to quiet contemplation, wilderness sanctuaries, and spiritual duties, this terrace brings together shopkeepers, tradespeople, and merchants serving both local kaldorei and travelers from the wider Alliance. It contains Darnassus's central auction house, general provisions, and crafting supply stores, making it the essential staging ground for journeys into the wilds. Broad footpaths connect it northward directly to the Warrior's Terrace and westward toward the serene waters of the Temple Gardens and the grand Temple of the Moon.

Kaldorei crafts prioritize harmony with nature, and the shops here reflect that delicate balance. Even amidst everyday commerce, the terrace operates without the roaring furnaces or smog seen in dwarven or human workshops, favoring quiet stone, curated timber, and woven goods. For visiting adventurers seeking trade contracts, repairs, or materials gathered from Teldrassil's dense boughs, the terrace stands as the principal center of business in northern Kalimdor.

subzone:train-depot.s: Estación de Trenes. La Estación de Trenes es un nudo de transporte subterráneo situado justo debajo de las entradas de superficie de Gnomeregan en Dun Morogh. Antaño un bullicioso centro de locomoción gnómica, ahora está plagado de hostiles gnomos parias y troggs invasores. Situada en el fondo del gran ascensor que baja desde Dun Morogh, la Estación de Trenes sirvió en su día como el nexo principal para el transporte ferroviario por toda la maravilla subterránea de Gnomeregan. En la actualidad, los andenes y las vías yacen en ruinas. La radiación que contaminó la ciudad transformó a los trabajadores restantes en enloquecidos gnomos parias, mientras que los troggs subterráneos han invadido las vías. Los exploradores que descienden a la ciudad en ruinas deben sortear esta zona preliminar para llegar a sectores más profundos como Corredor Mecánico, la Sala de Carga y las instalaciones interiores de ingeniería.

ang.profession:Engineering: Engineers seeking rare schematics often scout the depot's lower platforms, where surviving gnome peddlers like Namdo Bizzfizzle still ply their trade amidst the wreckage.
ang.race:Gnome: For exiled gnomes, the abandoned depot is a tragic sight, showing the ruin of the advanced locomotion systems that once united their subterranean metropolis.

faq.a: The Train Depot lies directly beneath the surface entrance elevator in Dun Morogh, acting as one of the outer threshold areas before venturing into the core of Gnomeregan.
al: how to get to train depot
faq.q: Where is the Train Depot located?

faq.a: The depot is overrun by feral troggs who burrowed up from the deep earth and wretched leper gnomes who lost their sanity during the radioactive disaster.
faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Train Depot now?

faq.a: Passages lead west into Clockwerk Run and toward the Loading Room, while a northern workshop area houses a back door down into the upper Engineering Labs.
faq.q: Where do the paths from the Train Depot lead?

faq.a: Namdo Bizzfizzle, an engineering supplier, manages to survive tucked away beneath the north side of the main platform on the depot's lower level.
faq.q: Who is hiding in the Train Depot?

text.s: The Train Depot is a subterranean transit hub located just below the surface entrances of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. Once a bustling center of gnomish locomotion, it now swarms with hostile leper gnomes and invading troggs.

sec.b: Situated at the bottom of the grand elevator leading down from Dun Morogh, the Train Depot once served as the primary nexus for rail transport across the subterranean marvel of Gnomeregan. Today, the platforms and railbeds lie in shambles. The fallout that irradiated the city transformed its remaining workers into crazed leper gnomes, while subterranean troggs have overrun the tracks. Explorers descending into the ruined city must navigate this staging ground to reach deeper sectors such as Clockwerk Run, the Loading Room, and the inner engineering facilities.

subzone:tundrid-hills.s: Las Colinas Tundra. Las Colinas Tundra son un tramo escarpado y cubierto de nieve de tierras altas en el centro-sur de Dun Morogh, situado justo al oeste de la Cantera de Gol'Bolar. Habitados por una peligrosa fauna de montaña, los pasos rocosos rara vez son transitados por viajeros ocasionales. Extendiéndose entre el Valle de Crestanevada y las tierras bajas del este de Dun Morogh, las Colinas Tundra ofrecen una ruta escarpada a través del campo para aquellos que buscan evitar los caminos principales que pasan por Kharanos. Sin embargo, la comodidad tiene un precio muy alto. Las escarpadas laderas nevadas están acechadas por feroces depredadores, lo que convierte el territorio en un lugar peligroso para los viajeros desprevenidos que se aventuran fuera del camino trillado sin un arma en la mano.

ang.class:Hunter: The wind-battered crags provide rugged tracking grounds filled with hardy beasts adapted to Dun Morogh's punishing mountain chill.
ang.race:Dwarf: For mountaineers of Ironforge, these heights serve as an ever-present reminder that wilderness and hostile Frostmane trolls press close against Dun Morogh's heartland.

faq.a: The Tundrid Hills span the south-central portion of Dun Morogh, positioned west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry and forming a natural, elevated boundary south of the main road connecting Kharanos to eastern lands.
faq.q: Where are the Tundrid Hills located?

faq.a: Adventurers sometimes navigate these harsh ridges as an overland shortcut between Coldridge Valley and eastern Dun Morogh, bypassing the established settlement routes, though it is far more hazardous than sticking to the patrolled roads.
faq.q: Why would anyone travel through the Tundrid Hills?

faq.a: The hills are home to fierce native wildlife accustomed to the freezing heights, and few travel here without a weapon at hand.
faq.q: What threats can be found in the Tundrid Hills?

text.s: The Tundrid Hills are a rugged, snowbound stretch of highland in south-central Dun Morogh, lying just west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry. Inhabited by dangerous mountain wildlife, the rocky passes are rarely traversed by casual travelers.

sec.b: Stretching between Coldridge Valley and the lowlands of eastern Dun Morogh, the Tundrid Hills offer a rugged cross-country route for those looking to bypass the main roads through Kharanos. However, convenience comes at a steep price. The jagged snowy slopes are prowled by ferocious predators, making the territory perilous for unwary travelers who venture off the beaten path without a drawn weapon.

subzone:twilight-grove.s: Arboleda del Crepúsculo. Escondida en el centro de Bosque del Ocaso, la Arboleda del Crepúsculo es un impresionante enclave de exuberante flora de Kalimdor que contrasta con el bosque sombrío y asolado que la rodea. Bajo su imponente gran árbol y su antigua arquitectura de elfos de la noche se encuentran un pozo de la luna y un enorme portal esmeralda conectado directamente con el Sueño Esmeralda. Oculta tras las escarpadas crestas de un cráter en el corazón de Bosque del Ocaso, la Arboleda del Crepúsculo parece completamente ajena a los Reinos del Este. Antiguos cenadores de elfos de la noche, vibrantes prados verdes y un sereno pozo de la luna enmarcan un gran árbol anónimo que se alza sobre el lúgubre dosel arbóreo. Hace milenios, el archidruida Fandral Corzocelada y su círculo plantaron aquí una rama encantada de Nordrassil para purgar la corrupción tóxica que brotaba de las profundidades de la tierra. El árbol echó raíces como un conducto de la naturaleza, filtrando el vigor puro del Sueño Esmeralda hacia el mundo de la vigilia y permitiendo que este cráter prospere incluso bajo la penumbra eterna de Bosque del Ocaso.

ang.class:Druid: For druids exploring the Eastern Kingdoms, the grove is a rare oasis of home, housing an active moonwell and a direct link to the ancestral dreamways.
ang.race:NightElf: Finding a secluded moonwell and traditional gazebos so far from Kalimdor is a poignant reminder of your people's ancient duty to heal the wounds of Azeroth.

faq.a: Thousands of years ago, druids led by Fandral Staghelm traveled from Kalimdor across the world to contain subterranean blights. They planted an enchanted branch from the World Tree Nordrassil in this crater and tended to it with traditional kaldorei structures and a sacred moonwell.
faq.q: Why is there night elf architecture in Duskwood?

faq.a: It is a Great Tree portal leading directly into the Emerald Dream, the primordial blueprint of Azeroth overseen by the green dragonflight. Three similar portals exist in Ashenvale, Feralas, and the Hinterlands.
faq.q: What is the giant glowing green portal?

faq.a: Historically, lieutenants of Ysera's green dragonflight guarded this sanctuary. While often empty to travelers passing through, growing disturbances within the Emerald Dream threaten to bring corrupted guardians through the portal into the mortal world.
faq.q: Who watches over the grove today?

faq.a: The great tree acts as a conduit to the Emerald Dream, radiating pure, untamed life energy. This constant influx of natural vitality protects the inner basin from the supernatural curse and blight choking the surrounding woods.
faq.q: Why doesn't the Twilight Grove look dead like the rest of Duskwood?

text.s: Tucked away in the center of Duskwood, the Twilight Grove is a stunning enclave of lush Kalimdor flora contrasting the grim, blighted forest around it. Beneath its towering great tree and ancient night elf architecture sits a moonwell and a massive emerald gateway connected directly to the Emerald Dream.

sec.b: Hidden behind steep crater ridges in the heart of Duskwood, the Twilight Grove looks utterly alien to the Eastern Kingdoms. Ancient night elf gazebos, vibrant green meadows, and a serene moonwell frame an unnamed great tree that towers over the gloomy canopy. Millennia ago, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and his circle planted an enchanted bough of Nordrassil here to purge toxic corruption rising from the deep earth. The tree took root as a conduit of nature, filtering the raw vigor of the Emerald Dream into the waking world and allowing this crater to thrive even beneath the eternal gloom of Duskwood.

At the base of the great tree looms a massive stone portal, one of four known gateways across Azeroth linking the physical realm directly to the Emerald Dream. While traditionally watched over by Ysera's green dragonflight, dark whispers claim that malevolent forces have begun twisting the tranquil realm beyond. The gateway stands largely silent for now, but its emerald swirl serves as a grim reminder that cosmic corruption can spill forth into Duskwood from paths far deeper than the Scourge or the local worgen.

subzone:twilight-shore-darkshore.s: Orilla Crepuscular (Costa Oscura). La Orilla Crepuscular es un escarpado tramo de costa en el sur de Costa Oscura que se extiende hacia el sur desde la Playa del Oleaje hasta la frontera con Vallefresno. Sus playas sombrías y cubiertas de niebla están interrumpidas por acantilados marinos salientes, islotes y un oleaje traicionero. La zona está infestada de tribus de múrlocs agresivos y voraces depredadores acuáticos como los trilladones. Extendiéndose al sur de la Playa del Oleaje más allá de las ruinas de Ameth'Aran hacia Vallefresno, la Orilla Crepuscular es una de las partes más escarpadas e inhóspitas de la costa de Costa Oscura. La arena gris da paso a acantilados afilados y azotados por las olas, así como a islas rocosas dispersas. Las aguas de la zona son notablemente hostiles; nadar cerca de la costa invita al ataque de trilladones territoriales y reptadores marinos, mientras que las propias playas están dominadas por prósperos campamentos de múrlocs agresivos.

ang.race:NightElf: The Twilight Shore marks the lonely, mist-shrouded threshold between the haunted ruins of Darkshore and the sacred ancestral forests of Ashenvale.

faq.a: It encompasses the southernmost coastal strip of Darkshore, beginning south of the Long Wash (roughly west of the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran) and continuing southward until reaching the rocky borders of Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where is the Twilight Shore located?

faq.a: The shoreline is heavily settled by aggressive murloc tribes, while the surrounding cold surf is home to territorial threshadons, lurkers, and giant crabs that prey upon unwary travelers.
faq.q: What threats can be found along the Twilight Shore?

faq.a: Unlike the flatter, expansive beaches farther north, the Twilight Shore is fragmented by sharp sea cliffs, rocky shoals, and small offshore islands shaped by the relentless pounding of the Veiled Sea.
faq.q: Why is the terrain so rugged here?

text.s: The Twilight Shore is a rugged stretch of coast in southern Darkshore, running south from the Long Wash down to the border of Ashenvale. Its gloomy, mist-laden beaches are interrupted by jutting sea cliffs, offshore islets, and treacherous surf. The area is infested with aggressive murloc tribes and ravenous aquatic predators like threshadons.

sec.b: Stretching south of the Long Wash past the ruins of Ameth'Aran toward Ashenvale, the Twilight Shore is among the most rugged and inhospitable parts of Darkshore's coastline. Gray sand gives way to sharp, wave-battered cliffs and scattered rocky islands. The waters here are notoriously hostile; swimming off the coast invites attacks from territorial threshadons and sea crawlers, while the beaches themselves are dominated by thriving camps of aggressive murlocs.

subzone:twilight-vale.s: Vega Crepuscular. La Vega Crepuscular abarca los densos y sombríos bosques meridionales de Costa Oscura, que se extienden hacia la frontera con Vallefresno. Bajo su penumbra, fúrbolgs corruptos, osos rabiosos y feroces sables de la noche merodean por la maleza, haciendo que viajar campo a través sea sumamente peligroso. Sirve como un lúgubre umbral entre la costa mancillada de Costa Oscura y las copas sagradas del sur. Extendiéndose desde el sur de las antiguas ruinas de Ameth'Aran hasta la frontera con Vallefresno, la Vega Crepuscular cubre los confines meridionales de Costa Oscura en un anochecer perpetuo. La corrupción invasora que asola el norte de Kalimdor ha hecho mella profunda en la fauna local. Osos rabiosos vagan junto a sables de la noche feroces, y tribus hostiles de fúrbolgs acechan en el oscuro bosque. Tanto las centinelas como los viajeros aconsejan ceñirse estrictamente al camino principal, ya que desviarse tan solo unos pasos entre los árboles invita a sufrir emboscadas rápidas y letales.

ang.class:Druid: Druids passing between Darkshore and Ashenvale witness firsthand the sickness afflicting the vale's creatures, underscoring the urgent need to cleanse the land.
ang.race:NightElf: The degradation of the southern woods weighs heavily on the night elves, who mourn the corruption of the native beasts and the fall of their furbolg neighbors so close to Ashenvale's threshold.

faq.a: Twilight Vale forms the southern portion of Darkshore. It begins just south of the highborne ruins of Ameth'Aran and extends all the way to the border pass that enters Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where is the Twilight Vale located?

faq.a: The vale is infested with afflicted wildlife and hostile tribes. Travelers will encounter rabid bears, aggressive nightsabers, and corrupted furbolgs who attack anyone intruding upon their territory.
faq.q: What threats wander this forest?

faq.a: No wilderness in Darkshore is entirely safe, but sticking firmly to the established dirt road is far safer than cutting through the underbrush. Straying off the beaten track puts you directly in the path of feral beasts.
faq.q: Is it safe to travel through the vale?

faq.a: Darkshore has suffered heavily since the Third War and the sundering magic lingering across northern Kalimdor. Tainted water and dark magical residue have maddened the local wildlife and turned peaceful furbolgs violent.
al: why are bears rabid in darkshore
faq.q: Why is the wildlife in the vale corrupted?

text.s: Twilight Vale encompasses the dense, shadowed southern woodlands of Darkshore stretching toward the Ashenvale border. Beneath its gloom, corrupted furbolgs, rabid bears, and vicious nightsabers prowl the undergrowth, making off-road passage perilous. It serves as a grim threshold between the tainted coast of Darkshore and the sacred canopies to the south.

sec.b: Running from the south of the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran all the way to the border of Ashenvale, the Twilight Vale blankets the southern reaches of Darkshore in perpetual dusk. The encroaching corruption plaguing northern Kalimdor has bitten deep into the wildlife here. Rabid bears roam alongside feral nightsabers, and hostile furbolg tribes stalk the dark wood. Sentinels and travelers alike advise sticking strictly to the main road, as straying even a few paces into the trees invites swift and deadly ambushes.

subzone:valgan-s-field.s: Campo de Valgan. El Campo de Valgan es una granja de trigo abandonada situada en el norte de Bosque de Argénteos, con vistas al Lago Lordamere. Antaño una pintoresca hacienda, ahora yace desolada e invadida por los feroces huargen Furia Lunar desatados por el archimago Arugal. Situado justo al oeste de La Playa Plateada y al norte del río cercano, el Campo de Valgan fue en su momento una próspera granja de trigo con vistas panorámicas al Lago Lordamere. Esa pacífica vida se desvaneció cuando la Plaga arrasó Lordaeron, obligando a su dueño, Valgan, a huir o encontrar su fin. Sin nadie a su cuidado, las estructuras en ruinas cayeron en las garras de los feroces huargen Furia Lunar que bajaban merodeando desde el Castillo de Colmillo Oscuro. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, el mago Arugal pasó un tiempo aquí, dejando tras de sí restos de sus investigaciones arcanas que ahora llaman la atención de los Renegados.

ang.class:Mage: Arugal's abandoned research at the farm offers a sobering warning of the catastrophic perils of unchecked summoning and extraplanar magic.
ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken, clearing Valgan's Field is essential to securing the road through Silverpine and recovering Arugal's notes before his monstrous pets spread further north.

faq.a: Valgan was the human farmer who owned and worked this homestead before the Third War. When the Scourge swept across northern Lordaeron, Valgan either died or fled into exile, leaving the farm to fall into ruin.
faq.q: Who was Valgan?

faq.a: The feral Moonrage pack infesting the farm was summoned into Silverpine Forest by Archmage Arugal. Arugal unleashed the beasts against the Scourge, but quickly lost control as they spread across the forest, and guilt drove him mad.
faq.q: Why are worgen roaming Valgan's Field?

faq.a: Archmage Arugal resided at the farm before the war and left behind valuable spellbooks. The Forsaken seek out these lost writings in their campaign to understand and counter Arugal's terrifying magic.
al: why forsaken care about valgans field
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken interested in this farm?

faq.a: Aside from the packs of Moonrage worgen haunting the fields, a dangerous beast known as Nightlash is occasionally spotted prowling the surrounding perimeter.
faq.q: What rare threats appear near the farm?

text.s: Valgan's Field is an abandoned wheat farm nestled in northern Silverpine Forest, overlooking Lordamere Lake. Once a picturesque homestead, it now lies desolate and overrun by the feral Moonrage worgen unleashed by Archmage Arugal.

sec.b: Situated just west of the Shining Strand and north of the nearby river, Valgan's Field was once a prosperous wheat farm offering scenic views of Lordamere Lake. That peaceful life vanished when the Scourge tore through Lordaeron, forcing its owner, Valgan, to flee or meet his end. Left untended, the ruined structures fell into the claws of feral Moonrage worgen prowling down from Shadowfang Keep. Before the Third War, the mage Arugal spent time here, leaving behind remnants of his arcane research that now draw the attention of the Forsaken.

subzone:valley-of-heroes.s: Valle de los Héroes. El Valle de los Héroes conforma la monumental entrada sur a Ciudad de Ventormenta, llevando a los viajeros por un puente de piedra que cruza el foso. Flanqueado por imponentes estatuas en honor a los líderes de la Alianza en su expedición a Draenor, sirve tanto de sobrecogedora bienvenida como de puesto de control fuertemente fortificado. Erigidas durante la gran reconstrucción de Ventormenta tras la Segunda Guerra, las estatuas que bordean la calzada conmemoran a los comandantes de la expedición de la Alianza. Estos campeones cruzaron El Portal Oscuro hacia el mundo natal de los orcos, Draenor, para sellar la brecha para siempre, dando sus vidas para que Azeroth pudiera sobrevivir. Los visitantes que avanzan hacia el norte en dirección al Distrito de Mercaderes pasan bajo los rostros del archimago Khadgar, Kurdran Martillo Salvaje, la capitana forestal Alleria Brisaveloz, el comandante en jefe Danath Aterratrols y el alto general Turalyon.

ang.class:Paladin: The statue of General Turalyon stands as a profound inspiration to paladins, immortalizing one of the original champions of the Knights of the Silver Hand.
ang.faction:Alliance: Every citizen of the Grand Alliance reveres the valley as a solemn testament to racial cooperation, honoring human, high elven, and dwarven martyrs side by side.

faq.a: The five colossal monuments depict the legendary commanders of the Sons of Lothar who led the Alliance Expedition to Draenor: High General Turalyon, Ranger-Captain Alleria Windrunner, Archmage Khadgar, Kurdran Wildhammer, and Force Commander Danath Trollbane.
faq.q: Who are the statues lining the path?

faq.a: Constructed during the city's restoration after the Second War, the statues serve as an enduring tribute to the heroes assumed lost during the destruction of Draenor. They remind all who enter of the steep price paid to keep the kingdom safe.
faq.q: Why were these monuments placed at the city gate?

faq.a: General Marcus Jonathan, the supreme commander of the Stormwind City Guard, oversees the security of the valley directly from the front lines, supported by officers such as Major Mattingly and Field Marshal Stonebridge.
al: who is the guy on the horse
faq.q: Who commands the guards stationed at the entrance?

faq.a: Heading north over the bridge brings travelers directly into Stormwind City's bustling Trade District, while heading south exits the gates into the pastoral forests of Elwynn.
faq.q: Where does the Valley of Heroes lead?

text.s: The Valley of Heroes forms the monumental southern entrance to Stormwind City, carrying travellers across a stone bridge spanning the moat. Flanked by towering statues honoring the leaders of the Alliance Expedition to Draenor, it serves as both an awe-inspiring welcome and a heavily fortified checkpoint.

sec.b: Erected during the grand rebuilding of Stormwind following the Second War, the statues lining the causeway commemorate the commanders of the Alliance Expedition. These champions marched through the Dark Portal into the orcish homeworld of Draenor to seal the rift forever, giving their lives so Azeroth might survive. Visitors proceeding north toward the Trade District pass beneath the visages of Archmage Khadgar, Kurdran Wildhammer, Ranger-Captain Alleria Windrunner, Force Commander Danath Trollbane, and High General Turalyon.

Beyond its ceremonial role, the valley is the primary defensive choke point guarding Stormwind from overland invasion. The approaches are overseen by General Marcus Jonathan, commander of the city guard, who monitors all traffic entering and departing through the great gates astride his steed. Flanking commanders, including Major Mattingly and Field Marshal Stonebridge, maintain vigilance alongside rows of seasoned guards, ensuring the capital remains secure against external threats.

subzone:valley-of-honor.s: Valle del Honor. El Valle del Honor sirve como el núcleo marcial y distrito de guerreros de Orgrimmar, enclavado en los cañones del noreste de la capital. Alberga los cuarteles de la ciudad, las hermandades de guerreros y cazadores, y los maestros de batalla que dirigen a las fuerzas de la Horda por todo Azeroth. Con forjas activas, fosos de instrucción y aguas tranquilas, es el lugar donde la Horda perfecciona su fuerza y recuerda su legado marcial. Situado tras las altas crestas del cañón, el Valle del Honor actúa como el principal barrio militar de Orgrimmar. Aquí, el entrechocar de las armas de práctica y el tintineo de los yunques de herrería marcan el día a día. La Sala de los Valientes domina el valle, sirviendo como punto de encuentro para guerreros veteranos y maestros de batalla que coordinan campañas en frentes como el Valle de Alterac y la Garganta Grito de Guerra. Flanqueado por instalaciones de instrucción para maestros de bestias y cazadores, el distrito está dedicado por completo a equipar, adiestrar y movilizar a los defensores de primera línea de la Horda.

ang.class:Hunter: The Hunter's Hall and beast-taming grounds make this valley an essential stop for replenishing ammunition, honing marksmanship, and stabling companions.
ang.class:Warrior: The Valley of Honor is your spiritual home in Orgrimmar, housing the Hall of the Brave, veteran combat instructors, and the armorers who forge the Horde's front lines.

faq.a: It is the military and martial hub of Orgrimmar. It contains the city's barracks, warrior and hunter trainers, weaponsmiths, and the battlemasters responsible for dispatching soldiers to major battlefronts.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Valley of Honor?

faq.a: The Horde battlemasters are stationed inside the Hall of the Brave, located in the Valley of Honor. From there, soldiers are enlisted and dispatched to ongoing engagements across Azeroth.
faq.q: Where can I find battlemasters in Orgrimmar?

faq.a: The valley is home to trainers and supply vendors for blacksmithing, mining, and fishing, along with goblin engineering specialists operating out of Nogg's Machine Shop.
faq.q: What professions are trained in the Valley of Honor?

faq.a: The Wyvern's Tail is the local tavern and inn situated along the edge of the valley, providing food, drink, and rest for weary warriors, hunters, and travelers.
faq.q: What is The Wyvern's Tail?

text.s: The Valley of Honor serves as the martial core and warrior district of Orgrimmar, nestled in the northeastern canyons of the capital. It houses the city's barracks, warrior and hunter guilds, and the battlemasters directing Horde forces across Azeroth. With active forges, training rings, and quiet waters, it is where the Horde hones its strength and remembers its martial heritage.

sec.b: Situated behind high canyon ridges, the Valley of Honor acts as Orgrimmar's primary military quarter. Here, the clatter of practice weaponry and the ringing of blacksmith anvils define daily life. The Hall of the Brave dominates the valley, serving as a gathering point for seasoned warriors and battlemasters coordinating campaigns across battlefronts like Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch. Flanked by training facilities for beastmasters and hunters, the district is dedicated entirely to equipping, drilling, and mobilizing the Horde's frontline defenders.

Beyond arms and drill grounds, the valley supports the logistics of war. The Burning Anvil and Red Canyon Mining supply armor and raw iron, while engineers tinker nearby in Nogg's Machine Shop. Between duties, grunts and visiting adventurers cast a line into the valley's surprisingly serene secluded pool, offering brief moments of calm away from the dusty bustle of the Valley of Strength.

subzone:valley-of-kings.s: Valle de los Reyes. El Valle de los Reyes es un frondoso cañón situado en el rincón sudoccidental de Loch Modan, justo al sur del paso hacia Dun Morogh. Sirve como puerta de entrada fuertemente vigilada a la ardiente Garganta de Fuego, flanqueada por figuras monumentales de piedra esculpidas en memoria de la Guerra de los Tres Martillos. Los viajeros que se aventuran aquí caminan bajo la historia enana ancestral mientras afrontan la amenaza inmediata de los invasores Rocanegra y los troggs. El elemento más imponente del valle es la pareja de estatuas colosales que representan al rey Madoran Barbabronce y al Alto señor feudal Khardros Martillo Salvaje. Esculpidos por encargo conjunto de sus hijos tras sus muertes, estos titanes de piedra dominan el paso hacia las calcinadas tierras del sur. Se erigen como un monumento duradero a la victoria aliada en la Guerra de los Tres Martillos y una advertencia eterna contra el clan Hierro Negro, recordando a todos los que miran hacia el sur la ruina traída sobre las Montañas Crestagrana por la invocación de Ragnaros.

ang.faction:Alliance: The valley acts as the northern bulwark against the gathering threats of the Redridge badlands, keeping the smoldering perils of the Searing Gorge from spilling into peaceful Khaz Modan.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves of Ironforge, the Valley of Kings is hallowed ground showcasing the unbreakable bond forged between Bronzebeard and Wildhammer against the treachery of the Dark Irons.

faq.a: The two immense statues depict King Madoran Bronzebeard of Ironforge and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer. Their sons commissioned the monuments together following their fathers' deaths to celebrate the alliance that triumphed in the War of the Three Hammers.
faq.q: Who do the two giant statues represent?

faq.a: They were erected to gaze directly toward the southern territories shattered by the Dark Iron clan's summoning of Ragnaros. The twin kings stand as a protective shield and an enduring warning to the Dark Irons and any other hostile force attempting to invade the northern dwarven lands.
faq.q: Why were the statues built facing south?

faq.a: The gate leading into the Searing Gorge is kept locked for traveler safety. You must speak with Mountaineer Pebblebitty, who stands guard at the gate, and prove your capabilities by undertaking a task for her before she will provide the key to pass through.
al: how to open searing gorge gate
faq.q: How do I get through the locked gate at the southern end?

faq.a: The valley connects the South Gate Pass leading to Dun Morogh, the trogg-infested Stonesplinter Valley to the east, and the blazing badlands of the Searing Gorge through the heavily fortified southern gate.
faq.q: Where does this valley lead?

text.s: The Valley of Kings is a lush canyon nestled in the southwestern corner of Loch Modan, directly south of the passage to Dun Morogh. It serves as a heavily watched gateway into the fiery Searing Gorge, flanked by monumental stone figures carved in memory of the War of the Three Hammers. Travelers venturing here walk beneath ancient dwarven history while facing the immediate threat of Blackrock encroachers and troggs.

sec.b: The valley's most commanding feature is the pair of colossal statues depicting King Madoran Bronzebeard and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer. Carved by joint commission from their sons following their deaths, these stone titans overlook the pass into the scorched southlands. They stand as a lasting monument to the allied victory in the War of the Three Hammers and an eternal warning against the Dark Iron clan, reminding all who look south of the ruin brought upon the Redridge Mountains by the summoning of Ragnaros.

Beyond serving as a path between South Gate Pass and Stonesplinter Valley, the Valley of Kings holds the heavy iron gate leading down into the Searing Gorge. Because of the hostile Blackrock orcs, Dark Iron dwarves, and volcanic hazards lurking on the other side, the gate is kept strictly locked and guarded by Ironforge mountaineers. Mountaineer Pebblebitty keeps watch over the threshold, turning away all but the hardiest adventurers who can prove they possess the strength to survive the inferno beyond.
sec.t: The Gate to the Searing Gorge

subzone:valley-of-spirits.s: Valle de los Espíritus. Enclavado contra los acantilados occidentales de Orgrimmar, Valle de los Espíritus actúa como la sede tradicional de la tribu Lanza Negra dentro de la capital de la Horda. Repleto de cabañas de paja, postes tiki y estanques serenos, ofrece un marcado contraste con la arquitectura orca circundante de piedra roja y hierro forjado. Extendiéndose hacia el oeste desde el bullicioso Valle de la Fuerza, Valle de los Espíritus es un enclave exuberante y tranquilo dedicado a los trols Lanza Negra. Cuando la tribu se asentó en Durotar junto a los orcos de Thrall, este rincón sosegado entre los riscos se convirtió en su punto de reunión urbano. Artesanos, espiritualistas y practicantes trols se congregan alrededor de sus puentes de madera y aguas serpenteantes, practicando sus artes lejos del calor seco de las avenidas principales.

ang.profession:Herbalism: The quiet waterways and specialized lodges in the valley make it a prime hub in the city for gathering wisdom from local herbalist masters.
ang.race:Troll: For the Darkspear tribe, this peaceful enclave provides a crucial piece of home and cultural identity within the towering red canyons of the orcish capital.

faq.a: The valley is primarily home to the Darkspear trolls who settled in Durotar alongside the orcs. You will find their craftsmen, spiritual leaders, herbalists, and hunters here, living among distinct troll-style huts and carved tiki totems.
faq.q: Who lives in the Valley of Spirits?

faq.a: The Talon Gate sits at the rear of the Valley of Spirits, functioning as the western exit of Orgrimmar. Passing through it leads directly into the Southfury River basin and the plains of the Barrens.
faq.q: Where does the Talon Gate lead?

faq.a: The Valley of Spirits features trainers and merchants for herbalism, cooking, and various wilderness and magical disciplines, housed across notable structures such as the Spirit Lodge and Darkbriar Lodge.
al: what is in valley of spirits
faq.q: What services and trainers are found here?

text.s: Tucked against the western cliffs of Orgrimmar, the Valley of Spirits serves as the long-standing seat of the Darkspear tribe within the Horde's capital. Filled with thatched lodges, tiki poles, and serene pools, it offers a stark contrast to the surrounding red stone and iron-clad orcish architecture.

sec.b: Branching westward off the bustling Valley of Strength, the Valley of Spirits is a lush and quiet enclave dedicated to the Darkspear trolls. When the tribe settled in Durotar alongside Thrall's orcs, this tranquil pocket among the crags became their urban gathering place. Trollish craftspeople, spiritualists, and practitioners gather around its wooden bridges and winding waters, practicing their arts away from the dry heat of the main thoroughfares.

Beyond its dwellings and tranquil pools, the valley hosts practitioners of magic and wild crafts. Witch doctors, herbalists, and spellcasters congregate in lodges like the Spirit Lodge and Darkbriar Lodge. Tucked toward the back is the Talon Gate, which opens directly toward the open plains of the Barrens, offering quick passage for wanderers, hunters, and travelers roaming beyond the canyon walls.

subzone:valley-of-strength.s: Valle de la Fuerza. El Valle de la Fuerza es la bulliciosa plaza central de Orgrimmar, que recibe a todos los que cruzan las imponentes puertas principales de la ciudad. Al albergar el banco de la ciudad, la casa de subastas central y la posada Colmillo Roto, sirve como el palpitante corazón comercial y administrativo de la capital de la Horda. Cruza las puertas fortificadas de madera de Orgrimmar y entrarás en el Valle de la Fuerza. Esculpido en lo profundo de la roca roja del cañón de Durotar, este valle sirve como la plaza principal de la Horda. Aventureros, comerciantes y guerreros de todas las naciones aliadas se mezclan en sus polvorientas plazas, compartiendo historias de guerra junto a jarras de la posada Colmillo Roto o atendiendo a intercambios vitales en el banco central y la casa de subastas. Es un bullicioso testimonio de la fuerza y la unidad que los orcos lucharon por establecer en su nuevo hogar.

ang.faction:Horde: As the primary plaza inside Orgrimmar's gates, the Valley of Strength is the first place Horde travelers meet to trade, recruit for expeditions.

faq.a: It is the primary entryway and central valley of Orgrimmar, located just inside the city's main gates. It contains essential urban services such as the bank, auction house, general goods merchants, and the Broken Tusk inn.
faq.q: What is the Valley of Strength?

faq.a: Grommash Hold is not in the Valley of Strength; it stands to the north in the Valley of Wisdom, serving as the seat of Warchief Thrall and the Horde's high command.
faq.q: Where is Grommash Hold located relative to this valley?

faq.a: The valley houses the city's primary bank, the auction house, trade supplies, armor merchants at Soran's Leather and Steel Armory, lodging at the Broken Tusk, and general trade goods.
faq.q: What services can I find here?

faq.a: The valley is heavily patrolled by Orgrimmar Grunts, seasoned orc warriors who maintain peace, protect incoming caravans, and direct travelers through the labyrinthine canyon city.
faq.q: Who guards the Valley of Strength?

text.s: The Valley of Strength is the bustling central commons of Orgrimmar, greeting all who pass through the city's towering front gates. Housing the city bank, the central auction house, and the Broken Tusk inn, it serves as the beating commercial and administrative heart of the Horde capital.

sec.b: Step past the fortified timber gates of Orgrimmar and you enter the Valley of Strength. Carved deep into the red canyon rock of Durotar, this valley serves as the Horde's front square. Adventurers, merchants, and warriors from all allied nations mingle across its dusty plazas, swapping war stories over flagons from the Broken Tusk inn or attending to vital trade at the central bank and auction house. It is a bustling testament to the strength and unity the orcs fought to establish in their new homeland.

Beyond its defensive significance, the valley functions as the capital's foremost marketplace. Shops such as Soran's Leather and Steel Armory sell armor, while various vendors supply provisions for long treks across the Barrens. Grunts stand vigilant watch at every corner, directing newcomers and ensuring order among the diverse peoples who have taken refuge beneath Thrall's banner.

faq.a: Es el campo de pruebas tradicional para los reclutas de la Horda, principalmente jóvenes orcos y trols Lanza Negra. En sus resguardados cañones, los nuevos aventureros completan rigurosas tareas para demostrar su habilidad marcial, instinto de supervivencia y lealtad antes de que se les permita partir hacia el resto de Durotar.

El Cubil es una cueva excavada en los acantilados aproximadamente en el centro del valle. Alberga a instructores de clase, vendedores y supervisores como Gornek, que orientan a los nuevos reclutas, los equipan y vigilan su progreso durante sus pruebas iniciales.

Los fanáticos pertenecientes al Filo Ardiente han establecido un aquelarre secreto en las cuevas del norte. Aunque los instructores utilizan a sus débiles familiares para poner a prueba a los reclutas, la presencia del culto sugiere que fuerzas sombrías como el Consejo de la Sombra buscan afianzarse justo a las puertas de Durotar.

Sarkoth es un escórpido venenoso e inusualmente grande que habita en las alturas rocosas del valle. Debido a su agresividad y letalidad, los instructores encargan a los reclutas prometedores que le den caza para poner a prueba su valor y traer su garra destrozada como prueba.

subzone:valley-of-trials.s: Valle de los Retos. Escondido tras los escarpados acantilados rojos del sur de Durotar, el Valle de los Retos sirve como campo de pruebas para los nuevos reclutas de la Horda. Los jóvenes orcos y sus aliados, los trols Lanza Negra, acuden aquí para demostrar su fuerza y ganarse su lugar entre los guerreros de Kalimdor. Aquellos que sobreviven a la implacable fauna del valle y a sus amenazas ocultas parten listos para defender su recién nacida nación. El Valle de los Retos está diseñado para purgar a los débiles antes de que lleguen a poner un pie en las extensiones más amplias de Durotar. Supervisados por cabecillas e instructores apostados en el refugio excavado en la pared del acantilado conocido como El Cubil, los jóvenes combatientes son arrojados al barranco abrasado por el sol para cazar escórpidos, abatir jabalíes agresivos e imponer disciplina entre los peones vagos que talan la escasa madera. La prueba es implacable: quienes demuestran su valía se ganan el derecho a marchar como auténticos soldados de la Horda, mientras que los que fracasan quedan a blanquear bajo el sol del desierto.

ang.race:Orc: The valley represents a rite of passage for every young orc seeking honor, echoing the warrior traditions of Draenor in a newly forged homeland.
ang.race:Troll: Having lost their home on the Echo Isles to Zalazane, the Darkspear trolls train alongside their orc allies in this canyon to earn their place in the Horde.

faq.a: It is the traditional proving ground for recruits of the Horde, primarily young orcs and Darkspear trolls. Within its sheltered canyons, new adventurers complete rigorous tasks to demonstrate their martial skill, survival instinct, and loyalty before being permitted to leave for the rest of Durotar.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Valley of Trials?

faq.a: The Den is a cave carved into the cliffs roughly in the center of the valley. It houses class trainers, vendors, and overseers like Gornek who direct new recruits, equip them, and monitor their progress during their initial trials.
faq.q: What is The Den?

faq.a: Cultists belonging to the Burning Blade have established a secret coven in the northern caves. Although trainers use their weak familiars to test recruits, the cult's presence suggests shadowy forces like the Shadow Council are seeking a foothold right on Durotar's doorsteps.
al: why demons in valley of trials
faq.q: Why are there demons in a beginner's training ground?

faq.a: Sarkoth is an unusually large, venomous scorpid residing in the rocky heights of the valley. Due to his aggression and lethality, instructors task promising recruits with hunting him down to test their courage and bring back his mangled claw as proof.
faq.q: Who is Sarkoth?

text.s: Tucked away behind the rugged red cliffs of southern Durotar, the Valley of Trials serves as the testing ground for new recruits of the Horde. Young orcs and their Darkspear troll allies come here to prove their strength and earn their place among the warriors of Kalimdor. Those who survive the valley's harsh wildlife and hidden threats depart ready to defend their fledgling nation.

sec.b: The Valley of Trials is designed to weed out the weak before they ever set foot in the broader reaches of Durotar. Overseen by chieftains and trainers stationed in the carved cliffside shelter known as The Den, young fighters are thrust into the sun-scorched gulch to hunt scorpids, culled aggressive boars, and enforce discipline among lazy peons harvesting scarce timber. The trial is uncompromising: those who prove their mettle earn the right to venture forth as true soldiers of the Horde, while those who fail are left to bleach beneath the desert sun.
sec.t: A Crucible of Sand and Stone

sec.b: What was once an isolated training ground has recently taken on a far more sinister edge. In the natural caves along the northern cliffs, cultists of the Burning Blade have taken root, summoning minor demonic familiars into the valley. While trainers treat these interlopers as live-combat practice for fresh recruits, the presence of fel magic so close to Orgrimmar's threshold fuels dark rumors that the Shadow Council is actively attempting to sink its claws back into the orcish people.

subzone:venomweb-vale.s: Vega Venerácnidas. Vega Venerácnidas es un valle sombrío en el este de los Claros de Tirisfal, situado justo al sur del Monasterio Escarlata. Antaño un frondoso bosque repleto de caza, la vega ha degenerado en un nido asolado e infestado por arácnidos agresivos y venenosos. Aunque la mayoría de los que pasan por allí lo ignoran, también alberga un antiguo legado como el sagrado lugar de reunión del Consejo de Tirisfal. Antes de que la plaga consumiera Lordaeron, este valle era un remanso de paz con hierba exuberante y árboles verdes, predilecto para los cazadores locales que rastreaban ciervos y conejos. Hoy en día, la podredumbre y una penumbra invasiva dominan el paisaje. Arañas gigantescas y venenosas pululan entre los árboles y las hondonadas, lideradas por el monstruoso arácnido Sri'skulk. El extremo norte de la vega limita con el territorio de la Cruzada Escarlata, donde los canes oscuros merodean cerca del Campamento Escarlata fortificado bajo el mando del teniente Sanders.

ang.class:Mage: For practitioners of the arcane, the vale is hallowed ground: it was the historic meeting site of the Council of Tirisfal, where Guardians of old—including Aegwynn—were chosen and empowered.
ang.race:Undead: Forsaken travelers traveling toward the Scarlet Monastery must navigate both the lethal toxins of Sri'skulk's brood and the watchful patrols of Lieutenant Sanders's Crusaders to the north.

faq.a: The spiders are not simply wild beasts or products of the Scourge plague. Centuries ago, a member of the secret Council of Tirisfal magically created and unleashed them in a mad attempt to defend their secluded meeting grounds from trespassers. They multiplied and overtook the valley.
faq.q: Why are there so many spiders in Venomweb Vale?

faq.a: Venomweb Vale served as the traditional secret assembly site for the Council of Tirisfal. Within this quiet valley, elven and human magi gathered to bestow their collective might upon the realm's defenders, including empowering the very first Guardian of Tirisfal.
faq.q: What is the Council of Tirisfal's connection to this valley?

faq.a: The spider brood is led by a massive, deadly arachnid known as Sri'skulk, who stalks the shadowed hollows beneath the valley's blighted canopy.
faq.q: Who rules the arachnids in the vale?

faq.a: Centuries ago, an apprentice named Falric accidentally transformed a boulder into fool's gold during his studies. The strange landmark became the exact meeting point where the famed Guardian Aegwynn would gather with the Council of Tirisfal.
faq.q: What is the story behind the fool's gold rock in the vale?

text.s: Venomweb Vale is a shadowed valley in eastern Tirisfal Glades, sitting just south of the Scarlet Monastery. Once a lush woodland teeming with game, the vale has devolved into a blighted nest overrun by aggressive, venomous arachnids. Unknown to most who pass through, it also holds an ancient legacy as the sacred meeting place of the Council of Tirisfal.

sec.b: Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, this valley was a peaceful retreat of lush grass and verdant trees, favored by local hunters tracking deer and rabbits. Today, rot and creeping gloom dominate the landscape. Giant, venomous spiders swarm among the trees and hollows, led by the monstrous arachnid Sri'skulk. The vale's northern edge borders the territory of the Scarlet Crusade, where darkhounds prowl near the fortified Scarlet Encampment under Lieutenant Sanders.

Long before spiders infested the hollows, the vale served as the clandestine gathering ground for the ancient Council of Tirisfal. It was here that the very first Guardian of Tirisfal was empowered to battle demonic incursions. In a desperate and misguided attempt to secure their sanctuary against intruders, one council member bred and unleashed the deadly spiders that plague the basin today. An odd boulder of fool's gold—the result of a centuries-old transmutation mishap by the apprentice Falric—still marks the secluded spot where Guardian Aegwynn once convened with the Council.

subzone:venture-co-mine.s: Mina de Ventura y Cía. Enclavada en los acantilados orientales de Mulgore, la Mina de Ventura y Cía. es una excavación industrial no autorizada dirigida por codiciosos oportunistas goblins. A pesar de que los tauren les negaron los derechos, Ventura y Cía. excavó en las colinas de todos modos, amenazando el equilibrio natural de las llanuras. Cuando Ventura y Cía. solicitó los derechos para expoliar los minerales de Mulgore, los tauren se negaron en redondo. El cártel corporativo los ignoró, perforando profundamente en la pared montañosa oriental bajo la dirección del Supervisor Saltatuercas. Su extenso complejo cuenta con tres entradas: un túnel a ras de suelo custodiado por matones a sueldo, un mirador en un escarpado acantilado y un pasaje superior que conduce a un pequeño campamento maderero. Las máquinas invasoras, el humo y los montones de escoria representan una profanación flagrante de una tierra sagrada.

ang.profession:Engineering: Past the mine tunnels and through the higher lumber clearing lurks Twizwick Sprocketgrind, a tinkerer willing to share mechanical trade secrets away from prying corporate eyes.
ang.race:Tauren: The mine is a profound insult to the Earth Mother, bringing soot, noise, and reckless scarring to the ancestral valleys the tribes have sworn to safeguard.

faq.a: The Venture Company sought permission to extract minerals from Mulgore, but the tauren denied their request. Unwilling to respect native territorial claims or environmental balance, the cartel sneaked workers and machinery into the eastern cliffs to plunder the hills without authorization.
faq.q: Why are goblins mining in Mulgore?

faq.a: Supervisor Fizsprocket oversees all Venture Company operations in Mulgore from his post inside the main entrance. He takes orders directly from the company's executive board and Mogul Razdunk.
faq.q: Who is in charge of this mining site?

faq.a: Tauren Outrunners ambushed and set fire to a Venture Company supply caravan near the northern shore of Stonebull Lake to stop machinery from reaching the mine. The goblins swiftly dispatched salvage teams to sift through the charred wreckage and recover their goods.
faq.q: What happened to the supply caravan by the lake?

faq.a: Beyond hollowing out the cliffs for ore, internal communiques reveal plans to construct a lumber mill and deploy shredders to clear-cut Mulgore's trees for additional corporate profit.
faq.q: What else do the goblins plan to build here?

text.s: Tucked into the eastern cliffs of Mulgore, the Venture Co. Mine is an unauthorized industrial excavation run by greedy goblin opportunists. Despite being denied rights by the tauren, the Venture Company dug into the hills regardless, threatening the natural balance of the plains.

sec.b: When the Venture Company sought rights to strip Mulgore of its minerals, the tauren flatly refused. The corporate cartel ignored them, tunneling deep into the eastern mountain wall anyway under the direction of Supervisor Fizsprocket. Their sprawling complex features three entrances—a ground tunnel guarded by hired muscle, a sheer cliffside overlook, and an upper passage leading out to a small lumber camp. The encroaching machines, smoke, and slag heaps represent a blatant defilement of sacred land.

Mining was only the opening bid for the cartel. Internal documents show that Mogul Razdunk and the Venture Company board encouraged Fizsprocket to expand further into full-scale timber harvesting, promising advanced goblin shredders to clear the rolling hills. Although tauren Outrunners attacked and burned a corporate supply caravan near Stonebull Lake to stall their expansion, salvagers were immediately dispatched to recover the cargo. To halt the destruction, the tribes have turned toward direct retaliation against the mine's supervisors.

subzone:vul-gol-ogre-mound.s: Túmulo de Vul'Gol. El Túmulo de Vul'Gol es una cuenca hundida en el sur de Bosque del Ocaso, invadida por los ogros Puñoastillado bajo el mando del bruto Zzarc'Vul. Antaño un grupo de granjas humanas, sus caseríos en ruinas y su caverna subterránea están ahora repletos de cadáveres y del botín saqueado por el clan. Escondido entre las sombras al suroeste de la bifurcación que se dirige hacia la Vega de Tuercespina, el Túmulo de Vul'Gol sirve como sede del clan Puñoastillado en Bosque del Ocaso. La cuenca fue en su día una apacible tierra de cultivo, pero sus habitantes humanos hace tiempo que huyeron o perecieron, dejando tras de sí cabañas destartaladas que ahora reclaman torpes ogros y utilizan como toscos refugios. En el interior de la caverna situada bajo la colina, montones de osos negros degollados dan fe del voraz apetito del clan. Su cacique, Zzarc'Vul, gobierna el campamento, acumulando extrañas baratijas junto a mondanas mercancías desperdiciadas.

ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance travelers traversing the southern path toward Stranglethorn Vale, keeping the Splinter Fist contained at Vul'Gol is vital to maintaining an open supply route through an already treacherous forest.
ang.race:Human: The smashed remnants of farmsteads in the basin are a bitter reminder of how much territory the kingdom of Stormwind has lost in Duskwood over the past generation.

faq.a: The mound is occupied by the Splinter Fist clan of ogres, led by the hulking chieftain Zzarc'Vul. They dwell among ruined human cottages and deep within an earthen cavern.
faq.q: Who lives in the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound?

faq.a: The Night Watch lacks the manpower to march in force on the southern basin. With Darkshire threatened on all sides by undead, worgen, and the horrors of Addle's Stead, the militia hires travelling adventurers to cull the Splinter Fist instead of risking town guards.
faq.q: Why hasn't the Night Watch cleared out the ogres?

faq.a: Human homesteaders once farmed the fertile pocket in southern Duskwood, back when the region was still known as Brightwood. When the curse fell upon the land, the farms fell to ruin, and the invading ogres claimed the abandoned structures.
faq.q: Who lived here before the ogres?

faq.a: The Splinter Fist ogres ambushed the hermit Abercrombie and made off with a crate containing his herbs and embalming tools. Unable to fight them himself, Abercrombie directs travelers into the mound to recover his stolen goods.
faq.q: Why did the hermit Abercrombie send me here?

faq.a: Vul'Gol lies in the far south of Duskwood, just southwest of the road junction that splits off and leads south toward the border of Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: Where is the mound located?

text.s: Vul'Gol Ogre Mound is a sunken basin in southern Duskwood overrun by the Splinter Fist ogres under the brute Zzarc'Vul. Once a cluster of human homesteads, its ruined farmhouses and subterranean cavern are now littered with the carcasses and scavenged plunder of the clan.

sec.b: Tucked away in the shadows southwest of the fork heading toward Stranglethorn Vale, the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound serves as the seat of the Splinter Fist clan in Duskwood. The basin was once peaceful farmland, but its human inhabitants have long since fled or perished, leaving behind hollowed-out cabins now claimed by lumbering ogres and used as crude shelters. Inside the cavern beneath the rise, piles of slaughtered black bears attest to the clan's voracious appetite. Their chieftain, Zzarc'Vul, rules over the encampment, hoarding odd trinkets alongside mundane scavenged goods.

Because the beleaguered Night Watch must stretch its thin ranks to guard Darkshire against rabid worgen and the restless dead, Commander Althea Ebonlocke and her militia rely on outside mercenaries to cull the Splinter Fist numbers before they push north. However, the ogres have made enemies beyond the town guard. They raided the recluse Abercrombie, stealing a crate of his alchemical tools, and attracted the attention of inquisitive mages seeking the arcane lenses that chieftain Zzarc'Vul is rumored to possess.
sec.t: A Menace on the Southern Border

subzone:war-quarter.s: Barrio de la Guerra. El Barrio de la Guerra es el distrito noroccidental de Entrañas, y sirve como puesto de mando y campo de instrucción marcial para los Renegados. En el interior de sus resonantes salas de piedra, los soldados, sacerdotes y artesanos de Lordaeron perfeccionan sus armas y su Magia de las Sombras en defensa de su incipiente reino. Alberga salas de instrucción para guerreros y sacerdotes junto a maestros de armas e industria pesada. Ocupando el sector noroeste de la metrópolis subterránea, el Barrio de la Guerra se erige como el bastión del poder militar de los Renegados. Bajo sus lúgubres arcos de piedra, guardias de a pie y campeones de élite se reúnen para entrenar en el combate armado. A diferencia de los cuarteles tradicionales de los reinos de los vivos, este centro militar combina la despiadada guerra de hierro con los escalofriantes ritos de las sombras, albergando un siniestro Altar de la Oscuridad donde la disciplina espiritual se funde con la ambición militar.

ang.class:Warrior: The War Quarter is your primary haven in the Undercity, offering weapon masters, advanced combat instructors, and heavy armories to prepare you for the brutal frontline battles of Lordaeron.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: Housing both training masters and high-heat anvils, the War Quarter is the central hub for smiths hammering out munitions and plate for the Forsaken war effort.

faq.a: The War Quarter serves as the military headquarters of the Undercity. It hosts martial training grounds for warriors and priests, along with vital crafting centers for blacksmithing and mining to keep the Forsaken army armed and armored.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the War Quarter?

faq.a: Forsaken priests largely focus on the discipline of the Shadow, using it as a potent weapon alongside their warriors rather than maintaining pastoral sanctuaries. Their presence near the martial forces and the Altar of Darkness reflects how deeply intertwined faith and warfare are in the defense of the Forsaken.
al: why are priests in war quarter
faq.q: Why are priests located in the War Quarter?

faq.a: The Altar of Darkness is a focal point of dark spiritual power located within the War Quarter. It is tied to the Forsaken's dark rites and training, anchoring the shadowy magic wielded by their priests and champions.
faq.q: What is the Altar of Darkness?

faq.a: The War Quarter occupies the northwest quadrant of the Undercity's circular layout, northwest of the central Trade Quarter, between the Magic Quarter to the east and the Apothecarium to the south.
faq.q: Where is the War Quarter located in the Undercity?

text.s: The War Quarter is the northwestern district of the Undercity, serving as the command post and martial training ground for the Forsaken. Within its echoing stone chambers, the soldiers, priests, and crafters of Lordaeron hone their weapons and shadow magic in defense of their fledgling kingdom. It houses training halls for warriors and priests alongside weapon masters and heavy industry.

sec.b: Occupying the northwest sector of the subterranean metropolis, the War Quarter stands as the bastion of martial strength for the Forsaken. Beneath its gloomy stone arches, rank-and-file guards and elite champions assemble to drill in armed combat. Unlike traditional barracks of living kingdoms, this military center combines ruthless iron warfare with the chilling rites of shadow, housing an ominous Altar of Darkness where spiritual discipline merges with military ambition.

Beyond housing warrior and priest guilds, the quarter functions as the heart of Undercity's wartime production. The clatter of blades and armor echoes continually against the stone, supported by the district's blacksmiths, smelters, and weapon masters. Here, iron forged deep in the earth is shaped to outfit the forces defending the ruins of Lordaeron from the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade.

subzone:warrior-s-terrace.s: Bancal del Guerrero. El Bancal del Guerrero es el distrito oriental de Darnassus y actúa tanto como núcleo de instrucción marcial como puerta de entrada fortificada de la capital. Con vistas al camino que se adentra en el resto de Teldrassil, alberga a los maestros de batalla de la ciudad, instructores de guerreros y patrullas de Centinelas. Ubicado en el umbral oriental de Darnassus, el Bancal del Guerrero —a veces denominado Sala de la Justicia— se alza como el principal baluarte defensivo frente a las incursiones procedentes de la naturaleza de Teldrassil. Centinelas fuertemente armadas y montadas en sables de la noche custodian sus altas puertas arqueadas, manteniendo una atenta vigilancia sobre los viajeros que llegan. En sus plazas al aire libre, los aspirantes a combatientes se entrenan junto a veteranos curtidos en extensos campos de duelo y galerías de tiro. El distrito también atiende necesidades militares prácticas, albergando a forjadores de armas, armeros y a los maestros de batalla que coordinan a las fuerzas de los elfos de la noche por todo el mundo.

ang.class:Warrior: For warriors training in the night elf capital, this district is your base of operations, providing access to martial instructors, dueling areas, and battlemasters.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: The terrace hosts the city's blacksmithing trainers and forge facilities, catering to armor and weapon craft alongside the garrison.

faq.a: The Warrior's Terrace functions as the military heart of Darnassus and its main defensive gateway. It houses the city's martial trainers, battlemasters, dueling grounds, and target ranges, while stationed Sentinels guard the eastern gate leading into the broader boughs of Teldrassil.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Warrior's Terrace?

faq.a: The grand gates on the eastern edge of the terrace lead directly out of Darnassus and onto the forest paths of greater Teldrassil, connecting the isolated capital to settlement hubs like Dolanaar and Rut'theran Village below.
faq.q: Where does the road through the eastern gate lead?

faq.a: The district and its perimeter gates are guarded primarily by the Sentinels, the elite night elven standing army. Many patrol the terraces and gateways while mounted atop armored nightsabers.
faq.q: Who guards the district?

faq.a: Bridges and walkways link the Warrior's Terrace directly to the Craftsmen's Terrace to the north, the Tradesmen's Terrace to the south, and the lush Temple Gardens toward the center of the city to the west.
al: how to get to warriors terrace
faq.q: Which other districts connect to the Warrior's Terrace?

text.s: The Warrior's Terrace is the eastern district of Darnassus, acting as both a martial training hub and the capital's fortified gateway. Overlooking the road into greater Teldrassil, it houses the city's battlemasters, warrior trainers, and Sentinel patrols.

sec.b: Positioned at the eastern threshold of Darnassus, the Warrior's Terrace—sometimes referred to as the Hall of Justice—stands as the primary defensive bulwark against incursions from the Teldrassil wilds. Heavily armed Sentinels mounted on nightsabers guard its high arched gates, maintaining a vigilant watch over incoming travelers. Within its open-air plazas, aspiring combatants drill alongside seasoned veterans on extensive dueling grounds and target ranges. The district also serves practical military needs, hosting weapon smiths, armorers, and the battlemasters coordinating night elf forces across the wider world.

subzone:warsong-labor-camp.n: Campo de trabajos forzados Grito de Guerra
subzone:warsong-labor-camp.s: Campo de trabajos forzados Grito de Guerra. El Campo de trabajos forzados Grito de Guerra es un puesto de tala aislado de la Horda escondido en el sureste de Vallefresno. Operado por leñadores Grito de Guerra y defendido por centinelas orcos, el campamento de trabajo tala madera para impulsar el crecimiento de Durotar mientras desafía la hostilidad del bosque circundante. Situado al este del Lago Cielo Estrellado y al suroeste de El Túmulo de Dor'danil, el Campo de trabajos forzados Grito de Guerra existe con un único propósito vital: talar la densa madera de Vallefresno. Las secas llanuras de Durotar ofrecen poca madera utilizable para construir ciudades como Orgrimmar, lo que obliga al clan Grito de Guerra a adentrarse en los disputados bosques. Con una dotación de recios leñadores y guardias orcos, el lugar opera en un relativo aislamiento, talando árboles milenarios a pesar de la constante amenaza de los exploradores elfos de la noche y las partidas de guerra de la Alianza que cruzan la zona.

ang.faction:Horde: The lumber harvested by these loggers is crucial to building and maintaining Orgrimmar, making their remote work station a vital economic lifeline in contested territory.
ang.race:NightElf: The camp represents a continuous wound in the living woods of Ashenvale, deforesting ancestral groves to fuel the warmachine of Durotar.

faq.a: The labor camp lies in southeastern Ashenvale, east of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den.
faq.q: Where is the Warsong Labor Camp located?

faq.a: The outpost serves as a timber harvesting operation. Orc loggers cut and process the ancient woods of Ashenvale to provide building materials for Orgrimmar and other settlements in Durotar.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this camp?

faq.a: The camp sits in isolation, far from major Horde fortifications. Night elves fiercely despise the harvesting of their sacred forests, and Alliance champions often raid the outpost because its remote position prevents nearby guards from offering swift backup.
faq.q: Why is the camp frequently attacked?

faq.a: Warchief Thrall originally sent Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan into Ashenvale during the Third War specifically to harvest lumber. The Labor Camp stands as an active continuation of those original logging efforts.
faq.q: Did Grommash Hellscream found this camp?

text.s: The Warsong Labor Camp is an isolated Horde timber-harvesting outpost tucked away in southeastern Ashenvale. Operated by Warsong loggers and defended by orcish sentries, the work site cuts lumber to fuel the growth of Durotar while braving the hostility of the surrounding forest.

sec.b: Situated east of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, the Warsong Labor Camp exists for one vital purpose: harvesting the dense timber of Ashenvale. The dry plains of Durotar offer little usable lumber to build cities like Orgrimmar, forcing the Warsong clan to push deep into the contested woods. Staffed by hardy loggers and orcish guards, the site operates in relative isolation, grinding through ancient trees despite the ever-present threat of night elf scouts and passing Alliance warbands.

Because of its remote location far from the main road and fortified bases like Splintertree Post, the camp is exceptionally vulnerable. Alliance raiders often strike the working peons and watchmen, knowing reinforcements will not arrive swiftly. To the night elves, every felled tree is an act of sacrilege, turning this mundane logging camp into a perennial flashpoint in the regional war.

subzone:warsong-lumber-camp.s: Aserradero Grito de Guerra. El Aserradero Grito de Guerra es una explotación maderera orca fortificada en las profundidades de Vallefresno, dirigida por el clan Grito de Guerra para talar madera destinada a la Horda. Respaldado por el fortificado Fuerte de Kargathia, sirve tanto de salvavidas económico para los asentamientos cercanos de la Horda como de constante provocación para los elfos de la noche. El sonido incesante de las trituradoras de manufactura goblin desgarrando ramas milenarias convierte este claro en un punto crítico de la guerra forestal. Tallado directamente bajo la densa cubierta forestal del este de Vallefresno, el Aserradero Grito de Guerra es el motor industrial que impulsa la expansión de la Horda por Kalimdor. Los peones orcos y los ingenieros goblin contratados despojan el bosque con el zumbido de sus trituradoras, transformando troncos imponentes en madera con la que reforzar las murallas de puestos de avanzada como el cercano Puesto del Hachazo y consolidar la incipiente nación de Durotar. El campamento está fuertemente fortificado contra los constantes contraataques de los elfos de la noche, articulándose en torno a las empalizadas del Fuerte de Kargathia y una activa perrera para los feroces lobos de guerra del clan. Para los Grito de Guerra, cada árbol talado significa supervivencia y fuerza; para las Centinelas nativas, cada hoja de sierra es un acto de sacrilegio.

ang.faction:Horde: The lumber harvested here supplies the building materials for Splintertree Post and the fortifications safeguarding the Horde's future across Kalimdor.
ang.race:NightElf: The camp's whining shredders and falling trees represent a direct, brutal assault on the sacred balance of Ashenvale that the Sentinels have vowed to extinguish.

faq.a: The lands settled by the Horde—particularly Durotar and the Barrens—are arid and sparse, lacking the dense timber required to construct buildings, palisades, and war machinery.
