Ashenvale offers a massive, virtually endless supply of prime wood essential for the survival and expansion of orc outposts like Splintertree Post and the capital of Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Why is the Horde logging in Ashenvale?

faq.a: Kargathia Keep is the fortified stronghold anchoring the Warsong Lumber Camp. It provides barracks, strategic command, and a reinforced bastion where peons and overseers can retreat and hold off night elf ambushes when Sentinels or local wildlife strike the logging perimeter.
faq.q: What is Kargathia Keep?

faq.a: To the night elves, Ashenvale is a sacred ancestral homeland protected by nature spirits and ancients. Felling ancient trees with noisy, smoke-belching goblin machinery is considered wanton destruction and outright desecration, prompting constant guerrilla attacks to expel the Warsong orcs from the forest.
faq.q: Why are the night elves so hostile to this camp?

faq.a: Goblin mercenaries and technicians provide the specialized technology driving the lumber operation, most notably steam-powered shredders. These machines allow the Warsong clan to harvest and strip massive ancient trees at speeds conventional hand axes could never achieve.
faq.q: What role do goblins play in the camp?

text.s: The Warsong Lumber Camp is a fortified orc logging operation deep in Ashenvale, run by the Warsong clan to harvest timber for the Horde. Anchored by the fortified Kargathia Keep, it stands as both an economic lifeline for nearby Horde settlements and an unrelenting provocation to the night elves. The constant sound of goblin-built shredders chewing through ancient boughs makes this clearing a primary flashpoint of the forest war.

sec.b: Carved straight out of the dense canopy of eastern Ashenvale, the Warsong Lumber Camp is the industrial engine fueling the Horde's expansion across Kalimdor. Orc peons and hired goblin engineers strip the forest with whirring shredders, processing towering trunks into lumber to reinforce outpost walls like nearby Splintertree Post and build up the fledgling nation of Durotar. The camp is heavily fortified against constant night elf counterattacks, centering on the stockades of Kargathia Keep and an active kennel for the clan's fierce war wolves. For the Warsong, every felled tree is survival and strength; for the native Sentinels, every saw blade is an act of sacrilege.

The Warsong clan's presence in these woods dates back to the Third War, when Grom Hellscream first led his warriors into the sacred groves to claim wood for the Horde. That initial deforestation ignited the fury of the demigod Cenarius and brought down the ancient wrath of the night elves. Though the modern camp operates under the banners of Thrall's Horde, the old animosities burn just as fiercely. Surrounded by untamed timber, hostile elves, and the lingering demonic corruption around neighboring Felfire Hill, the camp's defenders remain armed around the clock, harvesting trees with axes in hand and ready to drop their timber to repel the next ambush.

subzone:weathered-nook.s: El Hueco Perdido. Escondido a lo largo del acantilado norte de Las Mil Agujas, El Hueco Perdido es una hendidura y refugio apartado situado muy por encima del fondo del cañón. Con vistas al vasto mar de agujas de piedra, sirve de modesto hogar y retiro para tauren solitarios que buscan la contemplación tranquila lejos de los bulliciosos asentamientos. Esculpido en la escarpada pared de arenisca al norte de Poblado Viento Libre, los viajeros que recorren la cuenca del cañón pueden pasar por alto El Hueco Perdido con facilidad. Una rampa natural serpentea por la pared del acantilado y conduce a una cornisa resguardada y a una cueva al abrigo de los vientos dominantes. En lugar de albergar un puesto militar o un gran asentamiento, el rincón sirve como un humilde hogar para caminantes solitarios como Dorn Acechaprados y Prate Nubeprofeta, ofreciendo seguridad, aislamiento y una vista panorámica de las mesetas azotadas por el viento.

ang.faction:Horde: Horde wanderers exploring the heights of the canyon walls will find friendly kindred sheltering here along the northern cliffs.
ang.race:Tauren: For tauren travelers, the Weathered Nook represents the quiet spirit of self-reliance, offering a peaceful vantage point across the canyon to commune with the elements away from the busy bridges of Freewind Post.

faq.a: The nook is nestled along the northern cliff wall of Thousand Needles. From Freewind Post, travel north until you reach the towering rock face, then follow the cliffs east until you find a winding ramp leading up the mesa wall.
faq.q: Where is the Weathered Nook located?

faq.a: The shelter is home to Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer, solitary tauren who have chosen this remote ledge above the canyon rather than dwelling atop the crowded towers of Freewind Post.
faq.q: Who lives in the Weathered Nook?

faq.a: While the residents are tauren and align naturally with their kindred, the nook is not a formal Horde garrison. It is a humble personal camp and dwelling tucked quietly into the wilderness.
faq.q: Is the Weathered Nook affiliated with the Horde?

text.s: Tucked away along the northern cliffside of Thousand Needles, the Weathered Nook is a secluded cleft and shelter perched high above the canyon floor. Overlooking the vast sea of stone spires, it serves as a modest home and retreat for solitary tauren dwellers seeking quiet contemplation away from bustling settlements.

sec.b: Carved into the sheer sandstone wall north of Freewind Post, the Weathered Nook is easily missed by travelers passing along the canyon basin below. A natural ramp winds up the cliff face, leading to a sheltered ledge and cave out of the prevailing winds. Rather than housing a military outpost or large settlement, the nook serves as a humble homestead for solitary wanderers like Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer, offering safety, seclusion, and a sweeping view across the windswept needle plateaus.

subzone:webwinder-path.s: Senda de las Tejedoras. La Senda de las Tejedoras es un sinuoso camino montañoso en Sierra Espolón que conecta el puesto de avanzada trol de Malaka'jin con el Lago Mirkfallon. Atraviesa riscos escarpados y densos bosques de tierras altas habitados por arácnidos agresivos y bestias autóctonas. Discurriendo desde el asentamiento de la Horda de Malaka'jin hacia el Lago Mirkfallon, la Senda de las Tejedoras sirve como una de las principales vías que surcan la parte baja de Sierra Espolón. Fiel a su nombre, la ruta es tristemente célebre por las gruesas telarañas tendidas en lo alto del dosel arbóreo y a lo largo de los escarpados acantilados. Los viajeros que recorren este sinuoso tramo deben vigilar constantemente por dónde pisan, compartiendo el camino trillado con arañas de montaña al acecho, agresivos lagartos trueno y carneros territoriales.

ang.class:Hunter: The path is home to robust thunder lizards, sturdy mountain rams, and venomous web-spinners, making it an excellent trail for scouting and taming Stonetalon beasts.
ang.faction:Horde: The path is a crucial overland artery right on the doorstep of Malaka'jin, connecting your scouts to the deeper valleys of Stonetalon.

faq.a: Webwinder Path stretches between the Darkspear troll outpost of Malaka'jin in the south and Mirkfallon Lake further up the mountain to the north.
faq.q: Where does Webwinder Path lead?

faq.a: The road earns its name from the sheer abundance of arachnids inhabiting the region. Spiders spin vast labyrinths of glittering silk high in the trees and along rocky ledges flanking the roadway.
faq.q: Why is it called Webwinder Path?

faq.a: Aside from the venomous spiders that weave webs above the road, travelers frequently encounter roaming thunder lizards, highland rams, and ordinary mountain critters.
faq.q: What creatures wander the path?

faq.a: It is far from safe. The local predators are fierce and territorial, and the road passes directly past the Horde camp at Malaka'jin, making it perilous for Alliance wayfarers venturing up from the Barrens.
faq.q: Is Webwinder Path safe to travel?

text.s: Webwinder Path is a winding mountainous road in the Stonetalon Mountains connecting the troll outpost of Malaka'jin to Mirkfallon Lake. It cuts through rugged crags and dense highland woods inhabited by aggressive arachnids and native beasts.

sec.b: Running from the Horde settlement of Malaka'jin toward Mirkfallon Lake, Webwinder Path serves as one of the primary roadways carving through the lower Stonetalon Mountains. True to its name, the route is notorious for the thick cobwebs strung high among the canopy and jagged cliff sides. Travelers along this winding stretch must constantly watch their step, sharing the beaten path with prowling mountain spiders, aggressive thunder lizards, and territorial rams.

subzone:wellspring-lake.s: Lago Primigenio. El Lago Primigenio es una serena masa de agua dulce que descansa en lo alto de las ramas de Teldrassil, situada al noreste de Darnassus. Alimentadas por manantiales naturales procedentes de lo más profundo del Árbol del Mundo, sus aguas nutren el serpenteante Río Primigenio. Lo que antaño fuera un retiro pacífico para los pescadores elfos de la noche, ahora ve sus orillas víctimas de la creciente corrupción que perturba a la fauna de Teldrassil. Ubicado bajo el dosel arbóreo entre Darnassus y El Claro del Oráculo, el Lago Primigenio fue durante mucho tiempo muy apreciado por los kaldorei como un tranquilo remanso para la pesca y la contemplación. Sus aguas transparentes provienen de manantiales subterráneos que recorren las colosales ramas del Árbol del Mundo, los cuales desaguan luego hacia el norte a través del Río Primigenio. En tiempos recientes, sin embargo, una insidiosa plaga ha comenzado a apoderarse de la naturaleza circundante. Arañas agresivas, sables de la noche al acecho y agitados timberlings merodean ahora por las orillas, convirtiendo lo que antaño fue un estanque idílico en un lugar traicionero para los viajeros incautos.

ang.class:Druid: Druids study the agitated timberlings and beasts near Wellspring Lake to understand the source of the unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil's waters and soil.
ang.race:NightElf: For the Kaldorei, the degradation of peaceful groves like Wellspring Lake into dangerous monster dens is a painful reminder that something has gone deeply wrong with their young World Tree.

faq.a: Wellspring Lake lies in northern Teldrassil, northeast of the capital city of Darnassus and just southeast of the Oracle Glade.
al: how to get to wellspring lake
faq.q: Where is Wellspring Lake located?

faq.a: The lake is fed by natural springs rising deep from within the roots and wood of Teldrassil itself. The excess water drains into the Wellspring River, which flows north to the edge of the tree.
faq.q: Where does the lake's water come from and go?

faq.a: While it was previously a tranquil spot favored by Kaldorei anglers, the spreading corruption across the World Tree has driven local beasts mad. Prowling nightsabers, giant webwood spiders, and corrupted timberling bark-spirits now stalk the shoreline.
faq.q: Why is the area around Wellspring Lake dangerous?

faq.a: Local night elven fishermen often visited the lake for quiet reflection and angling before the recent blight agitated the wildlife and made the shores hazardous.
faq.q: Who used to gather at Wellspring Lake?

text.s: Wellspring Lake is a serene body of fresh water resting high within the boughs of Teldrassil, situated northeast of Darnassus. Fed by natural springs originating from deep within the World Tree, its waters feed the winding Wellspring River. Once a peaceful retreat for night elf fishermen, the lake's shores have fallen prey to the growing corruption unsettling Teldrassil's wildlife.

sec.b: Nestled beneath the canopy between Darnassus and the Oracle Glade, Wellspring Lake was long cherished by the Kaldorei as a quiet haven for fishing and contemplation. Its clear waters originate from subterranean springs running through the colossal boughs of the World Tree, which then drain northward through the Wellspring River. In recent times, however, an insidious blight has begun to seize the surrounding wilds. Aggressive spiders, prowling nightsabers, and agitated timberlings now roam the banks, making what was once an idyllic pond a treacherous place for unwary travelers.

subzone:wellspring-river.s: Río Primigenio. El Río Primigenio mana de un manantial natural dentro de Teldrassil, fluyendo hacia el norte desde el Lago Primigenio hasta precipitarse desde las ramas en una imponente cascada hacia el océano que se encuentra muy por debajo. En su día una fuente pacífica de agua dulce para el ecosistema del Árbol del Mundo, sus orillas se han vuelto peligrosas debido a la agitada fauna local. Alimentado por los profundos manantiales naturales cobijados en las ramas de Teldrassil, el Río Primigenio transporta agua hacia el norte desde el Lago Primigenio a través del verde suelo del bosque antes de precipitarse de forma espectacular sobre el borde del gran árbol hacia el mar. A pesar del entorno sereno, las riberas del río son cada vez más inseguras. Los briznados que habitan a lo largo del agua han enloquecido y se han vuelto hostiles, atacando violentamente a los viajeros y druidas que intentan acercarse a la orilla del río.

ang.class:Druid: The corrupted and maddened state of the river's native timberlings is an unsettling sign of the growing sickness creeping through Teldrassil's ecosystem.
ang.race:NightElf: The freshwater waterways flowing from the heart of Teldrassil represent the vitality of the Kaldorei's new home, making the unrest along their banks deeply concerning.

faq.a: The Wellspring River flows northward out of Wellspring Lake. Eventually, it reaches the rim of Teldrassil's canopy and plunges over the edge in an enormous waterfall that drops all the way down into the surrounding ocean.
faq.q: Where does the Wellspring River lead?

faq.a: The timberlings along the Wellspring River have become erratic and crazed, turning on anyone who wanders nearby. This aggression is part of a broader disturbance spreading through Teldrassil's natural wildlife, alarming the local night elven druids.
faq.q: Why are the timberlings along the river attacking people?

faq.a: The river is fed directly by Wellspring Lake, which itself is sustained by a natural freshwater spring rising deep from within the living trunk and boughs of the World Tree.
al: where does wellspring water come from
faq.q: Where does the water in the river come from?

text.s: The Wellspring River flows from a natural spring within Teldrassil, coursing north out of Wellspring Lake until it plummets off the boughs in a towering waterfall to the ocean far below. Once a peaceful source of fresh water for the World Tree's ecosystem, its banks have grown perilous due to agitated local wildlife.

sec.b: Nourished by the deep natural springs nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil, the Wellspring River carries water north from Wellspring Lake across the verdant forest floor before cascading dramatically over the edge of the great tree down into the sea below. Despite the serene surroundings, the riverbanks are increasingly unsafe. The timberlings that dwell along the water have grown crazed and hostile, violently attacking travelers and druids who attempt to draw near the river's edge.

subzone:westbrook-garrison.s: Cuartel Arroyoeste. El Cuartel Arroyoeste es un puesto avanzado de la guardia de Ventormenta situado en el extremo occidental del Bosque de Elwynn, cerca de la frontera con los Páramos de Poniente. Atendido por una dotación mínima, sobrecargada de trabajo y desabastecida bajo el mando del Ayudante del alguacil Rainer, sirve como primera línea de defensa del reino contra el avance de los gnolls Zarparrío y los bandidos errantes. Ubicado donde el Bosque de Elwynn comienza a clarear hacia los Páramos de Poniente, el Cuartel Arroyoeste se erige como un punto de vigilancia vital pero en apuros. Con gran parte del ejército de Ventormenta comprometido en el extranjero o atado por la inercia política en la capital, el puesto se ha quedado en una situación crítica por falta de personal. El Ayudante del alguacil Rainer y su puñado de guardias deben patrullar los caminos occidentales mientras repelen a ladrones envalentonados y a los despiadados gnolls Zarparrío, que han invadido los bosques del sur. Incapaz de conseguir refuerzos oficiales del Alguacil Dughan en Villadorada, el cuartel depende casi por completo de los aventureros de paso para asegurar el camino principal.

ang.class:Warrior: The beleaguered guards at Westbrook represent an overstretched kingdom holding back wilderness predators with sheer grit, offering plenty of straightforward, brutal work clearing gnoll war bands.
ang.faction:Alliance: For Alliance champions setting out from Elwynn toward Westfall, securing Westbrook's perimeter and claiming the bounty on Hogger is essential to keeping the heartland's western borders secure.

faq.a: The bulk of the Stormwind Army is deployed abroad, and political indecision within the capital's House of Nobles has starved regional garrisons of fresh troops and supplies. Westbrook's commanders must rely heavily on wandering adventurers to pick up the slack.
faq.q: Why is Westbrook Garrison so understaffed?

faq.a: Deputy Rainer oversees operations at Westbrook Garrison. He answers directly to Marshal Dughan stationed at Goldshire, though his requests for additional soldiers have largely gone unanswered.
faq.q: Who is in command at the garrison?

faq.a: The garrison deals with wandering bandits spilling out of Westfall and the ferocious Riverpaw gnolls who camp in the surrounding woods, led by their dangerous chieftain Hogger.
faq.q: What threats does the garrison face?

faq.a: Westbrook Garrison is the final outpost in Elwynn Forest along the western road before crossing the bridge into Westfall, guarding the border against the lawlessness rising from the west.
faq.q: What is the relation between Westbrook and Westfall?

text.s: Westbrook Garrison is a Stormwind Guard outpost situated on the western edge of Elwynn Forest near the Westfall border. Manned by an overworked, under-supplied skeleton crew under Deputy Rainer, it serves as the realm's first line of defense against the encroaching Riverpaw gnolls and rogue bandits.

sec.b: Positioned where Elwynn Forest begins to thin toward Westfall, Westbrook Garrison stands as a vital but struggling watchpoint. With much of the Stormwind Army committed abroad or tied down by political inertia in the capital, the outpost has been left critically shorthanded. Deputy Rainer and his handful of guards must patrol the western roads while fending off emboldened thieves and the vicious Riverpaw gnolls who have overrun the southern woods. Unable to secure formal reinforcements from Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, the garrison relies almost entirely on traveling adventurers to secure the highway.

The primary threat facing Westbrook is the swelling gnoll presence centered around the south of Forest's Edge. The packs have grown bold enough to stage raids directly on supply lines and homesteads, organized under the fearsome gnoll chieftain known as Hogger. Outnumbered and overwhelmed by the brute strength of Hogger's forces, the garrison has posted a high bounty across its grounds, desperately seeking capable fighters willing to venture into the hills and bring down the beast before he pushes farther east.

subzone:westfall-lighthouse.s: Faro de Poniente. Encaramado en un islote rocoso frente a la costa suroccidental de Páramos de Poniente, el Faro de Poniente antaño advertía a los barcos de los peligrosos bajíos de Mare Magnum. Hoy en día, sus guardianes vivos han desaparecido, aniquilados en un brutal asalto liderado por el infame múrloc Viejo Ojosombrío, dejando solo al espíritu del Capitán Grisillo para vigilar la llama. Construido a lo largo de los traicioneros acantilados del suroeste de Páramos de Poniente, el faro proporcionó durante mucho tiempo un paso seguro a los barcos que navegaban por la costa cercana a Ventormenta. Sin embargo, a medida que la ley y el orden se desmoronaban en la región y las patrullas reales mermaban, los peligros costeros aumentaron sin control. En su origen, una familia de guardianes cuidaba de la baliza, pero las agresivas tribus de múrlocs los obligaron a retirarse tierra adentro. Aunque regresaron valientemente para volver a encender la torre, el infame asaltante múrloc Viejo Ojosombrío reunió a los suyos para una segunda e implacable embestida, masacrando a la familia y extinguiendo la baliza.

ang.faction:Alliance: The lighthouse stands as a stark symbol of Stormwind's failing reach, where isolated kingdom servants were abandoned to savage coastal beasts without military support.

faq.a: The human family that tended the lighthouse was driven out by local murlocs. When they returned to relight the beacon, Old Murk-Eye led a second raid that massacred the entire family before Captain Grayson's eyes.
faq.q: Why is the Westfall Lighthouse abandoned?

faq.a: Captain Grayson is a ghost haunting the island outside the lighthouse. Bound by guilt and duty after witnessing the keepers' deaths, he tasks brave travelers with gathering oil to keep the beacon lit and hunting the coastal murlocs responsible.
faq.q: Who is Captain Grayson?

faq.a: Old Murk-Eye is an unusually cunning and vicious murloc chieftain who stalks the Westfall shoreline. He rallied the coastal tribes to overrun the lighthouse and slaughter the keepers.
faq.q: Who is Old Murk-Eye?

faq.a: The mechanical lantern still functions, projecting a sweeping beam of light across the ocean at night, while Captain Grayson asks travelers for the oil needed to keep the fire burning.
faq.q: Does the lighthouse still function?

text.s: Perched on a rocky isle off the southwestern shore of Westfall, the Westfall Lighthouse once warned vessels away from the perilous shallows of the Great Sea. Today, its living keepers are gone, wiped out in a brutal assault led by the notorious murloc Old Murk-Eye, leaving only the spirit of Captain Grayson to watch over the flame.

sec.b: Built along the treacherous southwestern bluffs of Westfall, the lighthouse long provided safe passage for ships navigating the coastline near Stormwind. However, as law and order collapsed across the region and royal patrols dwindled, coastal dangers surged unchecked. A family of keepers originally tended the beacon, but aggressive murloc tribes drove them inland. Though they bravely returned to relight the tower, the infamous murloc raider Old Murk-Eye rallied his kin for a second, merciless onslaught, butchering the family and extinguishing the beacon.

Following the tragedy, the beacon did not remain entirely abandoned. The specter of Captain Grayson now lingers on the rocky outcrop, bound to the site where he helplessly witnessed the family's demise. Unable to rest while the beacon is dark and the shore crawls with monsters, Grayson enlists passing adventurers to gather oil from the harvest golems to keep the flame burning and to hunt down Old Murk-Eye to avenge the fallen keepers.

subzone:whispering-forest.s: Bosque Susurrante. El Bosque Susurrante es un bosque montañoso y apartado, enclavado tras los escarpados acantilados al oeste de Camposanto. Prácticamente aislado del resto de los Claros de Tirisfal, alberga una fauna insólita, un misterioso círculo de hadas y una profunda corrupción que duerme bajo el suelo. Escondido tras Roca de la Cara Norte y el Castillo de Bandarion, el Bosque Susurrante parece completamente ajeno al reino azotado por la plaga que lo rodea. Aunque en él habitan ciervos afligidos y depredadores errantes, también cuenta con un lago apacible y un extraño círculo de setas gigantes que brillan con una energía insólita bajo una nube flotante de niebla. El fantasmal Knight of Mourning vaga por el círculo de hadas, atado a él por juramento, en medio de una magia natural que parece desafiar la tierra asolada por la Plaga.

ang.class:Druid: The glowing faerie ring stands out as one of the few pulses of natural magic remaining within blighted Lordaeron.
ang.race:Undead: Nestled just past Deathknell and overseen by Tyr's Watch at Bandarion Keep, the secluded woodland hides forgotten dangers that pose a silent threat right on the Undercity's doorstep.

faq.a: The forest lies in the mountains of western Tirisfal Glades, positioned just west of Deathknell and south of Tyr's Fall. It is walled off by Northface Rock, the steep ridge upon which Bandarion Keep rests.
al: how to get to whispering forest
faq.q: Where is the Whispering Forest located?

faq.a: The ring of giant mushrooms glows with a strange energy beneath a hovering cloud of mist. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders the circle, bound there by an oath, but what the ring's magic truly is remains unknown.
faq.q: What happens at the giant mushroom circle?

faq.a: The overlooking heights of Bandarion Keep are held by Tyr's Watch, an order of Forsaken paladins. Near the fairy circle itself, the spectral Knight of Mourning is bound by oath to wander the woods.
faq.q: Who watches over the forest?

faq.a: When the high elves originally landed on Lordaeron's shores, they attempted to build a settlement in Tirisfal. Within a few years, an unsettling presence buried deep underground began eroding their sanity, compelling them to abandon the glades and travel north.
faq.q: Why did the high elves abandon this region long ago?

faq.a: Shadowvale is a ruined village situated southwest of the forest's lake. It is occupied by the Tarnished alongside mindless undead afflicted by a necromantic crystal fragment dating back to clashes involving the Undercity.
faq.q: What is Shadowvale?

text.s: The Whispering Forest is a secluded, mountainous woodland nestled behind the steep cliffs west of Deathknell. Largely cut off from the rest of Tirisfal Glades, it harbors uncanny wildlife, a mysterious fairy circle, and deep-seated corruption sleeping far beneath the soil.

sec.b: Tucked away behind Northface Rock and Bandarion Keep, the Whispering Forest feels entirely alienated from the surrounding plague-touched kingdom. While it contains afflicted deer and roaming predators, it also features a tranquil lake and a strange ring of giant mushrooms, glowing with an uncanny energy beneath a hovering cloud of mist. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders the fairy circle, bound there by oath, amid a natural magic that seems to defy the Scourge-ruined land.

Despite its outward wonder, the forest is tainted by an ancient dread. Centuries ago, the high elves briefly attempted to settle in Tirisfal Glades before being driven away when the latent evil sleeping deep underground began driving them mad. Around the local lake, Vile Fin murlocs and the undead threshadon Blightsculler prowl the waters, while the ruined settlement of Shadowvale lies blighted by necromantic remnants. Even mad wanderers across Lordaeron mutter fearful warnings of the consuming darkness resting beneath Tirisfal's roots.

subzone:whispering-shore.s: Costa Murmurante. La Costa Murmurante es un sombrío tramo de costa en el oeste de Claros de Tirisfal, situado justo al norte de la Hacienda Solliden. En su día un refugio tranquilo y generoso para los pescadores de Lordaeron, sus frías aguas han sido invadidas desde entonces por una violenta tribu de múrlocs. Antes de que la Tercera Guerra arrasara el norte de Lordaeron, la Costa Murmurante era famosa entre los lugareños por ser un apreciado refugio de pesca, célebre por sus aguas tranquilas y sus abundantes capturas. Hoy en día, el gélido rocío del Mare Magnum rompe contra una costa vacía y despojada de su pacífico pasado. Las aguas se han vuelto frías y oscuras, carentes de su antigua generosidad, y cualquier viajero desafortunado que baje de las colinas se arriesga a sufrir una emboscada a manos de territoriales habitantes costeros.

ang.race:Undead: For the Forsaken securing western Tirisfal Glades, the murloc infestation at Whispering Shore poses an unruly threat right along the perimeter of their holdings.

faq.a: The Whispering Shore lies along the western coast of Tirisfal Glades, directly north of the Solliden Farmstead.
faq.q: Where is the Whispering Shore located?

faq.a: In the days of the Kingdom of Lordaeron, the shore was a beloved and tranquil spot for local fishermen drawn to its rich coastal waters.
al: what was whispering shore used for
faq.q: What used to be at the Whispering Shore before the Scourge?

faq.a: A tribe of aggressive murlocs has taken over the coastline. They are led by a particularly vicious murloc chieftain named Muad, attacking anyone who strays near the water.
faq.q: Who controls the Whispering Shore now?

faq.a: The coastline is no longer the peaceful haven it once was. Its waters are cold and dark, having lost much of their former bounty, and hostile murlocs aggressively guard the shoreline.
faq.q: Can you still fish peacefully at the Whispering Shore?

text.s: The Whispering Shore is a somber stretch of coastline in western Tirisfal Glades, resting just north of the Solliden Farmstead. Once a tranquil and bountiful retreat for Lordaeron's fishermen, its cold waters have since been overrun by a violent tribe of murlocs.

sec.b: Before the Third War swept across northern Lordaeron, the Whispering Shore was renowned among locals as a favored fishing haven, celebrated for its calm waters and plentiful catches. Today, the chilling spray of the Great Sea crashes against an empty coast stripped of its peaceful past. The waters have grown cold and dark, devoid of their former bounty, and any unfortunate traveler wandering down from the hills risks being ambushed by territorial coastal dwellers.

The beach is now firmly claimed by a band of hostile murlocs who ruthlessly attack anyone approaching the surf. Led by a fierce chieftain named Muad, these aquatic scavengers guard the shallows and tidal flats aggressively, posing a constant danger to nearby roads and the nearby Solliden Farmstead.

subzone:whitereach-post.s: Campamento del Tramo Blanco. El Campamento del Tramo Blanco es un pequeño campamento de la Horda situado junto al polvoriento camino del cañón en Las Mil Agujas. Al funcionar como una parada menor cerca del Campamento E'thok, ofrece descanso y vigilancia sobre la dura ruta del desierto. Para los viajeros que se desplazan entre Feralas y los salares, se erige como un puesto de avanzada seguro de la Horda bajo los imponentes pilares de arenisca. Ubicado a lo largo del sendero trillado que serpentea por las profundidades de Las Mil Agujas, el Campamento del Tramo Blanco es uno de los diversos y modestos enclaves de la Horda labrados en el escarpado paisaje. Emplazado muy cerca del Campamento E'thok, el puesto ayuda a mantener una presencia constante en el fondo del cañón, vigilando el tránsito entre las mesetas azotadas por el viento. Aunque no está tan fortificado como El Gran Elevador o los principales asentamientos tribales, sirve como una parada indispensable para mensajeros, exploradores y aventureros que cruzan estos páramos en disputa.

ang.faction:Horde: Whitereach Post represents a vital resting point and scouting presence for Horde travelers journeying through the perilous canyons of Thousand Needles.
ang.race:Tauren: Tauren scouts help secure this roadside camp, ensuring that tribesfolk moving between Mulgore, Feralas, and the Shimmering Flats have a safe place to rest.

faq.a: Whitereach Post is a minor Horde outpost located along the primary canyon path in Thousand Needles, situated not far from Camp E'thok.
faq.q: What is Whitereach Post?

faq.a: It is controlled by the Horde, primarily maintained by tauren scouts keeping watch over the gorge trails.
faq.q: Which faction controls Whitereach Post?

faq.a: The post is manned by local Horde scouts and wanderers, including the tauren Kanati Greycloud, who watches over the canyon passage.
faq.q: Who can be found stationed here?

text.s: Whitereach Post is a small Horde encampment nestled along the dusty canyon path in Thousand Needles. Serving as a minor waystation near Camp E'thok, it offers respite and watchful eyes over the harsh desert highway. For travelers moving between Feralas and the salt flats, it stands as an outpost of Horde safety beneath the looming sandstone pillars.

sec.b: Perched along the beaten path winding through the depths of Thousand Needles, Whitereach Post is one of several modest Horde footholds carved out of the rugged landscape. Stationed in close proximity to Camp E'thok, the post helps maintain a reliable presence along the canyon floor, monitoring travel between the windswept mesas. While not as fortified as the great lift or major tribal settlements, it serves as an indispensable stop for couriers, scouts, and adventurers traversing the contested wastes.

subzone:wildbend-river.s: Río Culebra. El Río Culebra es un cauce contaminado que serpentea por los bosques meridionales de Costa Oscura, cerca del Páramo de los Ancestros. Fluyendo directamente desde las corrompidas alturas de Frondavil, sus aguas arrastran veneno demoníaco hacia el mar, poniendo en peligro la naturaleza circundante. El Río Culebra atraviesa los confines meridionales de Costa Oscura, fluyendo hacia el oeste más allá del sagrado Páramo de los Ancestros antes de desembocar en el mar. En lugar de ofrecer un sustento limpio al bosque, hace descender la corrupción desde las montañas. El río es la continuación directa del Río del Veneno de Frondavil, cayendo entre las crestas rocosas y arrastrando fétidas escorrentías corruptas hacia el ecosistema de Costa Oscura. Los elfos de la noche vigilan sus orillas muy de cerca, atentos a la fauna deformada y a la insidiosa propagación de la plaga demoníaca.

ang.class:Druid: Druids studying the ecological aftermath of the Third War keep a wary eye on the river, monitoring how deeply Felwood's corruption penetrates downstream flora and fauna.
ang.race:NightElf: The polluted waters cascading from Felwood threaten the ancient roots of Darkshore, making the riverbanks a frequent concern for night elf wardens.

faq.a: The river originates high in the mountains of Felwood, where it is known as the Bloodvenom River. Felwood was thoroughly saturated with demonic magic during the Third War, and that foul runoff spills down the cliffs into Darkshore as the Wildbend River.
faq.q: Why is the Wildbend River corrupted?

faq.a: Cascading down from the eastern ridges that separate Felwood from Darkshore, the river winds through southern Darkshore near the Grove of the Ancients before flowing into the Veiled Sea.
faq.q: Where does the river flow?

faq.a: The river passes close to the Grove of the Ancients, posing a constant environmental threat to the ancient protectors rooted there. The night elves work tirelessly to contain the blight and prevent the poisoned water from rotting the sacred groves.
faq.q: Does the river affect the Grove of the Ancients?

text.s: Wildbend River is a tainted waterway winding through the southern forests of Darkshore near the Grove of the Ancients. Flowing down directly from the corrupted heights of Felwood, its waters carry demonic poison toward the sea, endangering the surrounding wilderness.

sec.b: Wildbend River cuts through the southern reaches of Darkshore, flowing westward past the sacred Grove of the Ancients before emptying into the sea. Rather than offering clean nourishment to the woodland, it brings corruption down from the mountains. The river is the direct continuation of Felwood's Bloodvenom River, tumbling through the rocky ridges and dragging foul, corrupted runoff into Darkshore's ecosystem. The night elves monitor its banks closely, watching for twisted wildlife and the creeping spread of demonic blight.

subzone:wildmane-water-well.s: Pozo Ferocrín. El Pozo Ferocrín es el más septentrional de los pozos de agua sagrados dispersos por Mulgore, situado justo al norte de los riscos de Cima del Trueno. Vital para las llanuras y sus manadas, se ha convertido en un punto conflictivo codiciado por oportunistas goblins que buscan asfixiar la savia vital de los tauren. Durante generaciones, los tauren nómadas han dependido de los sagrados pozos de agua excavados a lo largo de Las Llanuras Doradas de Mulgore para sustentar a su pueblo y a sus manadas errantes de kodos. El Pozo Ferocrín protege la extensión norte, justo más allá de la sombra de Cima del Trueno. Su importancia vital lo convierte en un objetivo irresistible para los enemigos de las tribus. Los goblins de Ventura y Cía. lo han contaminado con sus venenos en un intento de controlar el suministro de agua regional, y solo un ritual de purificación con un tótem creado por los tauren puede volver a purificar sus aguas.

ang.class:Druid: The goblins' attempts to corrupt Mulgore's fresh water threaten the delicate balance of the plains, demanding druidic vigilance to cleanse and heal the land.
ang.race:Tauren: The sacred wells of Mulgore are a gift from the Earth Mother. Defending the Wildmane Well from defilement and poison is a sacred duty for every young brave.

faq.a: The Wildmane Water Well is situated on the plains of Mulgore, directly north of the towering mesas of Thunder Bluff. It is the northernmost of the sacred wells that sustain the region.
faq.q: Where is the Wildmane Water Well located?

faq.a: Fresh water is life on the plains. The tauren hold the land's wells sacred as vital lifelines for their settlements, traveling hunters, and the great kodo herds roaming the plains of Mulgore.
al: why do tauren care about the well
faq.q: Why is the well important to the tauren?

faq.a: The goblins of the Venture Company have poisoned the well in an effort to control Mulgore's water supply, and the tauren must cleanse it with a sacred totem.
faq.q: Who has tried to sabotage or control the well?

text.s: The Wildmane Water Well is the northernmost of the sacred water wells scattered across Mulgore, resting just north of the mesas of Thunder Bluff. Vital to the plains and their herds, it has become a contested flashpoint targeted by goblin opportunists seeking to choke the tauren's lifeblood.

sec.b: For generations, the nomadic tauren have relied on sacred water wells dug across the golden plains of Mulgore to sustain their people and their wandering kodo herds. The Wildmane Well guards the northern expanse just beyond the shadow of Thunder Bluff. Its vital importance makes it an irresistible target for enemies of the tribes. The goblins of the Venture Company have fouled it with their poisons in a bid to control the regional water supply, and only a cleansing ritual with a totem crafted by the tauren can make its waters pure again.

subzone:windfury-ridge.s: Cresta Viento Furioso. Cresta Viento Furioso es una escarpada zona de tierras altas que flanquea los pastos de Mulgore. Conocida por albergar a feroces arpías junto a lobos y pumas depredadores, supone un peligro constante para los viajeros, al tiempo que ofrece preciadas plumas a los artesanos tauren. Cresta Viento Furioso se alza abruptamente sobre las serenas llanuras de Mulgore, sirviendo como coto de caza para las arpías Viento Furioso. Estas feroces criaturas aladas anidan en lo alto de los riscos y se lanzan en picado sobre cualquier caminante incauto que bordee las colinas. El terreno rocoso está poblado además por lobos de las praderas al acecho y pumas de montaña salvajes, lo que convierte la cresta en una de las fronteras más traicioneras del corazón de las tierras tauren. A pesar del peligro, los valientes guerreros tauren cazan con frecuencia a las arpías; su plumaje vibrante e iridiscente es muy cotizado en toda Cima del Trueno para adornar ropajes ceremoniales en banquetes fastuosos y celebraciones de bodas.

ang.class:Hunter: The steep inclines and cunning predators provide an excellent early testing ground for tracking, beast taming, and range management.
ang.race:Tauren: The ridge is both a recurring nuisance to young hunters and a source of vital ceremonial ornaments used to honor marriages and seasonal gatherings.

faq.a: The ridge is teeming with predatory cougars and prairie wolves, but its most persistent menace is the flock of aggressive harpies nesting along the heights. They actively dive from the crags to capture or butcher intruders who wander too close to their nesting sites.
faq.q: What makes Windfury Ridge dangerous?

faq.a: Beyond securing the borders from their predations, tauren hunt the Windfury harpies for their brilliant feathers. These colorful plumes are traditionally harvested and woven into ceremonial headdresses and decorations used during feasts and weddings.
faq.q: Why do the tauren hunt the harpies on Windfury Ridge?

faq.a: Windfury Ridge lies along the elevated bluffs in the pastoral region of Mulgore, in the far north of Mulgore, beyond Thunder Bluff.
faq.q: Where is Windfury Ridge located?

text.s: Windfury Ridge is a rugged highland area flanking the pastures of Mulgore. Notorious for harboring vicious harpies alongside predatory wolves and cougars, it poses a constant hazard to travelers while offering prized feathers to tauren artisans.

sec.b: Windfury Ridge rises sharply above Mulgore's serene plains, serving as the hunting grounds of the Windfury harpies. These vicious winged creatures nest high along the crags, readily swooping down upon any unwary wanderers who skirt the hills. The rocky terrain is further populated by prowling prairie wolves and wild mountain cougars, making the ridge one of the more treacherous borders of the tauren heartland. Despite the danger, the harpies are frequently hunted by brave tauren warriors; their vibrant, iridescent plumage is highly sought after across Thunder Bluff to adorn ceremonial garments for lavish feasts and wedding celebrations.

subzone:windshear-crag.s: Risco Cortaviento. Risco Cortaviento es un valle profundamente expoliado en el centro de Sierra Espolón, despojado de su madera ancestral por Ventura y Cía. Antaño un frondoso bosque, la región es ahora un páramo industrial dominado por el zumbido de trituradoras, escorrentías turbias y agresivas cuadrillas de leñadores. A la sombra de la maquinaria, los kóbolds locales escarban en busca de mineral mientras los pasos de montaña conectan este paisaje marcado por las cicatrices con Vallefresno. No hace mucho tiempo, Risco Cortaviento era un espeso bosque primario que flanqueaba las laderas de Sierra Espolón. Esa naturaleza tranquila desapareció cuando Ventura y Cía. llegó en busca de beneficios. Hoy en día, la cuenca está repleta de tocones cortados, humo acre y maquinaria ruidosa. Toda la empresa maderera está supervisada por Gerenzo Silbillave, un gnomo paria cuyo ingenio para la ingeniería produjo la Súper Leñadora 6000: un terror mecánico capaz de reducir troncos enormes a astillas en cuestión de instantes. Desde una plataforma elevada sobre el contaminado Lago del Peñasco, Gerenzo dirige una operación desenfrenada que deja la montaña al desnudo, granjeándose la hostilidad tanto de ingenieros rivales como de los habitantes locales.

ang.faction:Horde: Horde travelers heading toward Ashenvale encounter Braug Dimspirit near the Talondeep Path, where he tests their knowledge of Kalimdor's history.
ang.profession:Engineering: The industrial equipment throughout the crag showcases cutthroat goblin trade secrets and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's lethal Super Reaper designs.

faq.a: The logging venture is commanded on-site by Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a brilliant but contaminated leper gnome engineer. Operating under contract with the Venture Company, he watches over the crag from a timber platform raised directly over Cragpool Lake.
al: who is the boss of windshear
faq.q: Who is running the logging operation here?

faq.a: The Super Reaper 6000 is an advanced mechanical logging prototype engineered by Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Designed to clear timber at unprecedented speeds, it can grind ancient mountain trees into sawdust within moments, accelerating the company's clear-cutting.
faq.q: What is the Super Reaper 6000?

faq.a: Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union in Undermine wants Gerenzo dead, and the goblin Ziz Fizziks, who already helped steal the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints, puts out the order. The trade princes of Undermine disapprove of the Venture Company consorting with the gnome.
faq.q: Why is the Undermine Tinkers' Union targeting Gerenzo?

faq.a: The cave in the northeast corner is the Talondeep Path. It cuts through the subterranean roots of the mountains, providing a foot route between Windshear Crag and the dense forests of Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where does the cave in the northeast lead?

faq.a: The Windshear kobolds have overrun the local mine in the southeastern corner of the crag. They vigorously defend their subterranean claim, excavating deposits of Smoky Iron Ingots used by regional smiths.
faq.q: Who are the kobolds digging in the southeast?

text.s: Windshear Crag is a heavily despoiled valley in the central Stonetalon Mountains, stripped of its ancient timber by the Venture Company. Once a lush forest, the region is now an industrial wasteland dominated by whirring shredders, murky runoff, and aggressive logging crews. In the shadows of the machinery, local kobolds burrow for ore while mountain passes connect the scarred landscape to Ashenvale.

sec.b: Not long ago, Windshear Crag was a thick, old-growth woodland flanking the slopes of Stonetalon. That tranquil wilderness vanished when the Venture Company arrived in search of profit. Today, the basin is filled with severed stumps, acrid smog, and clanking machinery. The entire logging enterprise is overseen by Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a leper gnome whose engineering genius produced the Super Reaper 6000—a mechanical terror capable of reducing massive trunks to kindling in moments. From an elevated platform above the polluted Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo directs an unchecked operation that strips the mountain bare, earning the hostility of rival engineers and local inhabitants alike.

Beyond the active timberyards, Windshear Crag holds other hazards and crossroads. To the southeast lies Windshear Mine, where territorial kobolds dig through the rock for Smoky Iron Ingots, fiercely attacking anyone who nears their haul. In the crag's northeast reaches, travelers can find the Talondeep Path, an underground cavern tunnel threading straight beneath the ridges into Ashenvale. Stationed near this shadowed portal stands the tauren elder Braug Dimspirit, who tests the historical wisdom and resolve of Horde wayfarers venturing through the contested peaks.

subzone:winterhoof-water-well.s: Pozo Pezuña Invernal. El Pozo Pezuña Invernal es una fuente vital de agua dulce situada al borde de Las Llanuras Onduladas, en el sur de Mulgore. Crucial para la fauna local y las tribus tauren nómadas, el pozo se ha visto amenazado recientemente por la explotadora Ventura y Cía., que busca envenenar y controlar el suministro de agua de la región. En las áridas extensiones del centro de Kalimdor, el agua es vida, y los pozos subterráneos de Mulgore sustentan tanto a las manadas de las llanuras como a los campamentos de los tauren. El Pozo Pezuña Invernal, bautizado en honor a una de las respetadas tribus de las llanuras, se abastece de los profundos acuíferos que yacen bajo Las Llanuras Onduladas. Desgraciadamente, su importancia estratégica ha atraído la codicia de Ventura y Cía. En lugar de compartir la tierra o negociar, el despiadado cártel de goblins ha intentado envenenar el suministro de agua para ejercer presión sobre el territorio circundante.

ang.class:Shaman: Cleansing the well requires elemental harmony, serving as a practical demonstration of using totems to heal wounded water spirits.
ang.race:Tauren: Defending and purifying the ancestral water wells is one of the first trials young braves face to safeguard the land from outside exploitation.

faq.a: The well is located in southern Mulgore, right on the fringes of the Rolling Plains south of Bloodhoof Village.
faq.q: Where is the Winterhoof Water Well located?

faq.a: The Venture Company poisoned the well. The unscrupulous goblin trading organization attempted to foul the water supply in a bid to control the local resources and weaken the native tauren.
faq.q: Who poisoned the Winterhoof Water Well?

faq.a: The well is cleansed through a ritual utilizing an enchanted totem crafted by Mull Thunderhorn, which uses primal magic to purge the Venture Company's foul toxins from the water.
faq.q: How can the poisoned well be cleansed?

faq.a: Beyond providing necessary hydration for tribes and roaming herds, water sources in Mulgore are viewed as gifts from the Earth Mother. Corrupting them is considered both a direct physical threat and a severe spiritual affront.
al: why do tauren care about wells
faq.q: Why are water wells so sacred to the tauren?

text.s: The Winterhoof Water Well is a vital fresh water source situated on the edge of the Rolling Plains in southern Mulgore. Crucial to the local wildlife and nomadic tauren tribes, the well has recently fallen under threat from the exploitative Venture Company, who seek to poison and control the region's water supply.

sec.b: In the arid stretches of central Kalimdor, water is life, and Mulgore's subterranean wells sustain both the herds of the plains and the encampments of the tauren. The Winterhoof Water Well, named for one of the respected tribes of the plains, taps into the deep aquifers beneath the Rolling Plains. Unfortunately, its strategic importance has drawn the avarice of the Venture Company. Rather than sharing the land or negotiating, the ruthless goblin cartel has attempted to poison the water supply to exert leverage over the surrounding territory.

To counter the industrial sabotage of the Venture Company, tauren elders and shamans have mobilized young braves across Mulgore. Mull Thunderhorn has crafted sacred totems designed to counter the industrial toxins and restore the spiritual and physical balance of the well. Cleansing the well is not merely an act of survival for the tauren, but a spiritual duty to ensure that the earth and its waters remain uncorrupted by foreign greed.

subzone:xavian.s: Xavian. Xavian es un antiguo complejo de templos de elfos de la noche en ruinas en el noreste de Vallefresno, ahora invadido y reclamado por los sátiros. Al servir como la sede principal de la influencia de los sátiros en el bosque, la ruina está corrompida por la corrupción demoníaca y oscuros ritos dirigidos contra la arboleda. Escondido en las colinas del noreste de Vallefresno, al oeste de Canción del Bosque y al norte de Satyrnaar, Xavian se erige como el principal bastión del poder de los sátiros en la región. Antaño un templo élfico sagrado, sus arcos de piedra y terrazas han sido profanados por seguidores de la Legión Ardiente. Líderes entre los sátiros, incluidos Prince Raze y Geltharis, supervisan a los suyos desde estas ruinas. Llevan a cabo rituales profanadores por todo el lugar, utilizando incluso aceite Grito de Guerra robado para marchitar aún más el bosque sagrado. La zona recibe su nombre de Xavius, el consejero bien nacido que se convirtió en el primer sátiro durante la Guerra de los Ancestros tras fallarle a Sargeras.

ang.class:Druid: The satyrs here have stolen the Branch of Cenarius and use fel rites to corrupt the land; druids are called upon to reclaim the artifact and heal the grove's spiritual wounds.
ang.race:NightElf: Seeing the desecrated halls of an ancient temple defiled by the twisted descendants of the Highborne is a bitter offense to any night elf, demanding swift retribution.

faq.a: The stronghold is named in honor of Lord Xavius, the highborne courtier of Queen Azshara who helped usher the Burning Legion into Azeroth during the War of the Ancients. After displeasing Sargeras, Xavius was remade into the very first satyr, a demonic curse that spread to others of his kind.
faq.q: Why is this place named Xavian?

faq.a: The satyrs use Xavian as their primary command center in Ashenvale. They conduct dark rituals to spread demonic corruption throughout the ancient forest, utilizing defiled sacred relics like the stolen Branch of Cenarius as well as machinery oil pilfered from the Warsong orcs.
al: what are they doing in xavian
faq.q: What are the satyrs doing here?

faq.a: Her name is Anilia. She was part of a dryad effort to recover the stolen Branch of Cenarius from the satyrs. She was mortally wounded during the skirmish and lies among the ruins, pleading for someone to reclaim the sacred branch before it is completely corrupted.
faq.q: Who is the dying dryad lying on the ground?

faq.a: While Satyrnaar and Night Run are notable satyr camps within Ashenvale, Xavian acts as the political and ritual heart of their forces in the forest. High-ranking satyr leaders such as Geltharis and Prince Raze make their base here among the ruins.
faq.q: How does Xavian differ from Satyrnaar or Night Run?

text.s: Xavian is an ancient ruined night elf temple complex in northeastern Ashenvale, now overrun and claimed by the satyrs. Serving as the primary seat of satyr influence in the forest, the ruin is foul with demonic corruption and dark rites directed against the woodland.

sec.b: Tucked away in the northeastern hills of Ashenvale, west of Forest Song and north of Satyrnaar, Xavian stands as the foremost bastion of satyr power in the region. Once a sacred elven temple, its stone arches and terraces have been desecrated by followers of the Burning Legion. Leaders among the satyrs, including Prince Raze and Geltharis, oversee their kin from these ruins. They perform defiling rituals across the grounds, even utilizing stolen Warsong oil to further blight the sacred woodland. The area takes its name from Xavius, the highborne councilor who became the first satyr during the War of the Ancients after failing Sargeras.

The corruption radiating from Xavian has not gone unchallenged, but confronting the satyrs comes at a grim price. Sentinels and woodland guardians keep a watchful eye on the stronghold, knowing its strategic malice eclipses nearby enclaves like Night Run. Recently, dryad defenders attempted to infiltrate the ruins to recover the sacred Branch of Cenarius, only to suffer grievous losses. Adventurers who breach the outer terraces can find the dying dryad Anilia, struck down while attempting to halt the defilers from using holy relics in their dark incantations.

subzone:yorgen-farmstead.s: La Hacienda Yorgen. La Hacienda Yorgen es una granja abandonada ubicada en el sur de Bosque del Ocaso, caída en la ruina junto con el resto de la turbulenta región. Antaño propiedad del granjero Sven Yorgen, la finca ha sido tomada y ocupada por bandoleros de la Hermandad Defias. Situada en medio de los lúgubres bosques del sur de Bosque del Ocaso, La Hacienda Yorgen fue en su día un próspero hogar perteneciente a Sven Yorgen. Como muchos asentamientos aislados de la región, la granja no pudo resistir los crecientes peligros del territorio. Sven se vio obligado a abandonar sus tierras y se retiró al norte a un campamento improvisado a lo largo de La Ribera Lóbrega. En su ausencia, los terrenos desiertos fueron reclamados por forajidos que buscaban un punto de apoyo lejos de la mirada de las autoridades de Ventormenta.

ang.class:Rogue: The hidden Defias assassins stalking the farmstead make the area treacherous, demonstrating how readily rogue operatives turn neglected wilderness holdings into camouflaged hideouts.
ang.faction:Alliance: The loss of Sven's farmstead to the Defias Brotherhood highlights how deeply the outlaw syndicates have penetrated Duskwood while the Night Watch struggles to maintain order in Darkshire.

faq.a: The farmstead was originally established and farmed by Sven Yorgen. After tragedy struck his home and driven away by rising dangers, Sven fled to a solitary camp located further north on the Darkened Bank.
faq.q: Who owns the Yorgen Farmstead?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood has seized the deserted property. Cutpurses, bandits, and stealthed assassins prowl the overgrown yards and barnyards, making the farmstead extremely dangerous to visit.
faq.q: Who occupies the farmstead now?

faq.a: Sven abandoned the farm and can now be found residing in a modest camp along the Darkened Bank, situated to the north along the river separating Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where did Sven Yorgen go?

faq.a: The Defias Brotherhood has expanded its operations far beyond Westfall. Disorganized rural settlements and weakened regional defenses allow their agents to set up secret camps and strongholds out of reach of Stormwind's marshals.
faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood in Duskwood?

text.s: The Yorgen Farmstead is a derelict farm nestled in southern Duskwood, fallen into ruin alongside the rest of the troubled region. Formerly owned by the farmer Sven Yorgen, the property has been seized and occupied by brigands of the Defias Brotherhood.

sec.b: Situated amidst the gloomy woodlands of southern Duskwood, the Yorgen Farmstead was once a functioning homestead belonging to Sven Yorgen. Like many isolated holdings in the region, the farm could not withstand the encroaching perils of the territory. Sven was forced to abandon his lands, retreating north to a makeshift camp along the Darkened Bank. In his absence, the abandoned grounds were claimed by outlaws looking for a foothold far from the gaze of Stormwind's authorities.

Rather than lying vacant, the farmstead has been repurposed as a staging ground by the Defias Brotherhood. Masked highwaymen and stealthy cutthroats lurk among the decaying fences and weathered outbuildings, using the dense tree cover to conceal their presence. Travelers approaching the farmstead must tread carefully, as Defias assassins patrol the perimeter and ambush anyone trespassing on their newly seized sanctuary.

subzone:zoram-gar-outpost.s: Avanzada de Zoram'gar. La Avanzada de Zoram'gar es una cabeza de playa fortificada de la Horda situada en el extremo occidental de Vallefresno, a lo largo de La Ensenada de Zoram. Al servir como un campamento costero crucial, proporciona a la Horda acceso al Mar Velado y vigila las amenazas regionales, como los naga invasores y las siniestras profundidades cercanas. Situada en el extremo noroccidental de Vallefresno, donde el bosque primigenio se desploma hacia el mar, la Avanzada de Zoram'gar sirve como la aislada posición costera de la Horda en La Ensenada de Zoram. Cercado por el territorio de los elfos de la noche tierra adentro y por los peligros marítimos mar adentro, el campamento actúa como punto de partida para exploradores, cazadores y chamanes encargados de rastrear los peligros locales. La vida en la avanzada es una vigilia constante: los naga merodean con frecuencia por las aguas poco profundas, mientras que cultores al acecho y horrores primigenios palpitan desde el sistema de cavernas subterráneas conocido como Cavernas de Brazanegra, a poca distancia por la orilla.

ang.faction:Alliance: An entrenched Horde presence on the coast of Ashenvale, Zoram'gar represents a dangerous supply foothold close to night elf ancestral lands.
ang.faction:Horde: The outpost serves as your primary haven in northwest Ashenvale, offering shelter, rest, and wind rider transport amidst dangerous wilderness.

faq.a: The Horde established the camp to secure a foothold on the western shoreline of Ashenvale. It provides maritime monitoring along the Zoram Strand and offers a defensible station to counter the aggressive naga infesting the coast.
al: why did horde build zoram gar
faq.q: Why did the Horde establish Zoram'gar Outpost?

faq.a: The immediate threat comes from the Wrathtail naga slithering across the Zoram Strand. Additionally, the twilight cultists and beastly horrors residing within the nearby temple ruins of Blackfathom Deeps pose a constant lurking danger.
faq.q: What threats does the outpost face?

faq.a: Zoram'gar Outpost connects aerial wind riders across central Kalimdor, linking travelers to Splintertree Post, Sun Rock Retreat, the Crossroads, and the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff.
al: where can i fly from zoram gar
faq.q: Where does the outpost connect via flight master?

faq.a: Blackfathom Deeps lies just north of the outpost along the shoreline ruins. Horde forces stationed at Zoram'gar monitor the corruption seeping out of the flooded temple and dispatch adventurers inside to counter the cultists and their beast, Aku'mai.
faq.q: What is the relation between the outpost and Blackfathom Deeps?

text.s: Zoram'gar Outpost is a fortified Horde beachhead nestled on the western edge of Ashenvale along the Zoram Strand. Serving as a crucial coastal encampment, it provides the Horde with access to the Veiled Sea and keeps watch over regional threats like the encroaching naga and the sinister depths nearby.

sec.b: Situated at the northwestern lip of Ashenvale where the primeval forest collapses into the sea, Zoram'gar Outpost serves as the Horde's isolated coastal footing on the Zoram Strand. Hemmed in by night elf territory inland and maritime hazards offshore, the encampment acts as a staging ground for scouts, hunters, and shaman tasked with tracking local dangers. Life at the outpost is an endless vigil: naga regularly prowl the shallows, while lurking cultists and primal horrors pulse from the subterranean cavern system known as Blackfathom Deeps just down the shore.

Because of its peripheral location, Zoram'gar maintains flight connections with other critical Horde holdings like Splintertree Post, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff. While small in footprint, the outpost anchors Horde supply lines on the western coast.

subzone:zoram-strand.s: La Ensanada de Zoram. La Ensenada de Zoram es una costa azotada por el viento que bordea el extremo noroccidental de Vallefresno a lo largo del Mar Velado. En su día fue el emplazamiento de una antigua ciudad de los elfos de la noche engullida por el Gran Cataclismo; ahora, la costa está plagada de nagas Colafuria, naufragios y leviatanes varados. También alberga la entrada al complejo del templo sumergido de las Cavernas de Brazanegra. Hace diez mil años, la grandiosa ciudad de los elfos de la noche de Zoram adornaba estas costas antes de que el Gran Cataclismo desgarrara Kalimdor y arrojara el asentamiento a las profundidades del océano. Hoy en día, la marea arrastra continuamente reliquias antiguas, restos de embarcaciones destrozadas y los cadáveres de enormes bestias marinas. Los nagas Colafuria han invadido las playas y las pozas de marea, custodiando con ferocidad las ruinas inundadas y los artefactos antiguos frente a cualquiera que ose acercarse.

ang.faction:Horde: Defending the approaches to Zoram'gar Outpost is vital to maintaining a northern naval and coastal presence in Ashenvale against the relentless Wrathtail brood.
ang.race:NightElf: The strand is a sobering reminder of the ancient world lost to the Sundering, where sacred relics and submerged temples to Elune now suffer beneath the tread of the naga.

faq.a: Prior to the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago, Zoram was a majestic night elven city. The cataclysm shattered the coast, plunging the city beneath the Veiled Sea and leaving only jagged ruins and washed-up statuettes along the shore.
faq.q: What was Zoram before it was destroyed?

faq.a: The shoreline itself is largely overrun by the Wrathtail naga, who fiercely defend the shallows and ancient ruins. The Horde maintains a fortified foothold at Zoram'gar Outpost along the southern cliffs, while dangerous wildlife such as hydras and crabs prowl the sand.
faq.q: Who controls the Zoram Strand today?

faq.a: The entrance to Blackfathom Deeps is located in the submerged caverns along the Zoram Strand. Travelers venture into the coastal caves along the water's edge to reach the descent into the sunken temple.
faq.q: Where is the entrance to Blackfathom Deeps?

faq.a: The tumultuous tides and dark currents of the Veiled Sea frequently wash massive marine creatures ashore. Researchers and naturalists from both factions often seek out these remains to investigate what drives ocean behemoths to perish along the rocks.
faq.q: Why are there so many beached sea creatures here?

text.s: The Zoram Strand is a windswept coastline lining the northwestern edge of Ashenvale along the Veiled Sea. Once the site of an ancient night elven city swallowed by the Great Sundering, the shore is now plagued by Wrathtail naga, shipwrecks, and beached leviathans. It also holds the entrance to the submerged temple complex of Blackfathom Deeps.

sec.b: Ten thousand years ago, the grand night elven city of Zoram graced these shores before the Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart and cast the settlement into the ocean depths. Today, the tide continually washes up ancient relics, remnants of shattered vessels, and the carcasses of massive sea beasts. The Wrathtail naga have overrun the beaches and tidal pools, fiercely guarding the flooded ruins and ancient artifacts against anyone daring to approach.

Despite the naga menace, both mainland travelers and coastal wanderers find themselves drawn to the strand. To the south lies the fortified Horde encampment of Zoram'gar Outpost, whose warriors fight a continuous battle to secure the coast. Deep within the nearby caverns sits Blackfathom Deeps, an ancient temple of Elune that has fallen into dark hands, making the strand a gathering ground for scouts, scholars, and treasure seekers braving the surf.

faq.a: Los cielonatos, o shen'dorei («el pueblo oculto»), son altos elfos descendientes de antiguos elfos de la noche que se rebelaron contra el príncipe Tortheldrin en Eldre'Thalas. Para escapar de su flota vengativa, sellaron un pacto con espíritus del viento, quienes trasladaron su isla, la Isla de Zephras, al interior del Plano Elemental del Aire.

Milenios en el Plano Elemental del Aire han remodelado sutilmente su biología. Un fenómeno reciente conocido como la Bendición Tocada por el Cielo hace que una proporción creciente de niños (actualmente unos tres de cada diez) nazca con la piel azul. Los eruditos predicen que sus rasgos ancestrales de elfo de la noche pronto quedarán suplantados por completo.

El Shal'nan, o «el Velado», fue el líder enmascarado que encabezó la resistencia contra la invocación demoníaca del príncipe Tortheldrin en Eldre'Thalas. Tras guiar a los supervivientes a un lugar seguro en Muro Celeste, abdicó para establecer un consejo democrático y sirvió a su pueblo hasta que desapareció misteriosamente hace siglos junto a sus benefactores elementales.

La Isla de Zephras se sostiene en el aire dentro de Muro Celeste gracias a pilones mágicos sintonizados con el poder elemental. Cuando los espíritus del viento que los mantenían desaparecieron repentinamente hace siglos, los pilones de anclaje comenzaron a fallar. Ciertas partes de la masa de tierra se han quebrado hacia el vacío, dejando aislados a supervivientes y arrojando a elfos desplazados al bandidaje.

Son las dos facciones culturales principales de los cielonatos. La Orden Eminente desciende de los magos altonato y busca reconstruir su decadente sociedad mediante un disciplinado dominio arcano. Los Formavientos tienen sus orígenes en los ciudadanos comunes entre los elfos de la noche y veneran las costumbres elementales y espirituales cultivadas durante su tiempo en Muro Celeste.

Los Al'Aketh son una secta desesperada de cielonatos que adora a Al'Akir, el Señor del Viento. Aunque los benefactores elementales de sus antepasados temían y evitaban hablar de Al'Akir, el colapso de la Isla de Zephras llevó a refugiados desposeídos y sin hogar a acudir al señor elemental en busca de salvación y poder.

topic:skyborne.s: Cielonatos. Los cielonatos, o shen'dorei, son una escisión de altos elfos descendientes de rebeldes que huyeron de Eldre'Thalas tras oponerse a los pactos demoníacos del príncipe Tortheldrin. Al forjar un trato desesperado con espíritus del viento, sus ancestros escaparon de Azeroth para morar sobre la flotante Isla de Zephras, en el interior de Muro Celeste. Hoy en día, con la repentina desaparición de sus benefactores elementales, su santuario flotante afronta fracturas internas y un colapso físico. Tras el Cataclismo, los Shen'dralar de Eldre'Thalas languidecieron sin el Pozo de la Eternidad. El príncipe Tortheldrin ideó una oscura salvación: invocar al demonio Immol'thar y drenar su poder. Nobles y ciudadanos horrorizados se resistieron, temiendo otra invasión de la Legión. En respuesta, Tortheldrin ejecutó una sangrienta purga de decenas de casas. De las sombras de los supervivientes surgió una resistencia encabezada por una figura enmascarada conocida solo como el Shal'nan («el Velado»). Cuando una incursión rebelde desesperada en el sagrario ritual de Tortheldrin degeneró en una catastrófica magia caótica, el Shal'nan reunió a los supervivientes y huyó hacia el oeste hasta el puerto de Eldre'narr, echándose a la mar perseguidos por la flota del Príncipe.

ang.class:Mage: The High Order among the Skyborne preserves ancient Highborne spellcraft brought out of Eldre'Thalas, seeking to salvage their crumbling island through rigorous arcane mastery.
ang.class:Shaman: The Windshapers represent an elven lineage deeply intertwined with the wind spirits of Skywall, relying on elemental communion rather than the arcane traditions of their Highborne forebears.
ang.race:NightElf: The Skyborne share direct bloodlines with the ancient Shen'dralar and northern night elves, though millennia in Skywall have physically altered them into high elves with an increasing prevalence of elemental blue skin.

faq.a: The Skyborne, or shen'dorei ('the hidden people'), are high elves descended from ancient night elves who rebelled against Prince Tortheldrin in Eldre'Thalas. To escape his vengeful fleet, they struck a pact with wind spirits, who relocated their island, Zephras Isle, into the Elemental Plane of Air.
faq.q: Who are the Skyborne?

faq.a: Millennia in the Elemental Plane of Air have subtly reshaped their biology. A recent phenomenon known as the Sky-Touched Blessing causes an increasing proportion of children—now roughly three out of ten—to be born with blue skin. Scholars predict their ancestral night elf traits will soon be entirely supplanted.
faq.q: Why do some Skyborne have blue skin?

faq.a: The Shal'nan, or 'the Veiled One', was the masked leader who spearheaded the resistance against Prince Tortheldrin's demon summoning in Eldre'Thalas. After leading the survivors to safety in Skywall, he abdicated to establish a democratic council, serving his people until mysteriously vanishing centuries ago alongside their elemental benefactors.
faq.q: Who was the Shal'nan?

faq.a: Zephras Isle is held aloft within Skywall by magical pylons attuned to elemental power. When the wind spirits who maintained them abruptly disappeared centuries ago, the anchoring pylons began to fail. Portions of the landmass have broken off into the void, stranding survivors and driving displaced elves to banditry.
faq.q: What is happening to Zephras Isle?

faq.a: They are the two primary cultural factions of the Skyborne. The High Order descends from Highborne magisters and seeks to rebuild their crumbling society through disciplined arcane mastery. The Windshapers trace their roots to ordinary night elf citizens and revere the elemental and spiritual customs cultivated during their time in Skywall.
faq.q: What are the High Order and the Windshapers?

faq.a: The Al'Aketh are a desperate cult of Skyborne who worship Al'Akir the Windlord. While their ancestors' elemental benefactors feared and avoided speaking of Al'Akir, the collapse of Zephras Isle led homeless and disenfranchised refugees to turn to the elemental lord for salvation and power.
faq.q: Who are the Al'Aketh?

text.s: The Skyborne, or shen'dorei, are an offshoot of high elves descended from rebels who fled Eldre'Thalas after opposing Prince Tortheldrin's demonic pacts. Striking a desperate bargain with wind spirits, their ancestors escaped Azeroth to dwell atop the floating Zephras Isle within Skywall. Today, with their elemental benefactors abruptly gone, their floating sanctuary faces internal fractures and physical collapse.

sec.b: Following the Sundering, the Shen'dralar of Eldre'Thalas languished without the Well of Eternity. Prince Tortheldrin devised a dark salvation: summon the demon Immol'thar and siphon its power. Horrified nobles and citizens resisted, fearing another Legion invasion. In response, Tortheldrin executed a bloody purge of dozens of houses. From the surviving shadows rose a resistance spearheaded by a masked figure known only as the Shal'nan ('the Veiled One'). When a desperate rebel raid on Tortheldrin's ritual sanctum descended into catastrophic chaotic magic, the Shal'nan rallied the survivors and fled west to the port of Eldre'narr, taking to the seas pursued by the Prince's fleet.

Cornered on the open ocean, the exiles forged a pact with primordial wind spirits. These beings lifted Zephras Isle straight into the skies, anchoring it safely within Skywall—the Elemental Plane of Air. Relieved of absolute rule, the Shal'nan stepped down during the consecration of the Shrine of the Four Winds, placing governance in the hands of an elected council. Over millennia in this alien realm, the night elf exiles evolved into fair, slender high elves. In recent generations, an elemental influence known as the Sky-Touched Blessing has emerged, causing a growing number of children to be born with pale blue skin.

For centuries, life in Skywall flourished in isolation. The wind spirits strictly forbade mention of the Windlord, Al'Akir, brushing off questions with eerie unease. A few centuries ago, catastrophe struck: the elemental benefactors vanished without explanation, and the Shal'nan disappeared along with them. Deprived of their caretakers, the arcane pylons anchoring Zephras Isle began failing. Outlying landmasses broke away, refugees flooded what remained, and desperation fueled the rise of bandits and the Al'Aketh—a fanatical cult dedicated to Al'Akir. Today, society fractures between the High Order, who seek salvation in reclaiming ancestral arcane magic, and the Windshapers, who cling to elemental rites.

zone:arathi.s: Tierras Altas de Arathi. Las Tierras Altas de Arathi son una meseta escarpada en el sureste de Lordaeron, célebre por ser la antigua cuna del Imperio de Arathor. Hoy en día, el reino de Stromgarde yace en ruinas, lo que deja a este territorio rocoso sumido en una guerra abierta en múltiples frentes entre los restos de Stromgarde, la Horda, los nobles criminales de la Hermandad y los ogros invasores. Hace milenios, el rey Thoradin unió a las fracturadas tribus humanas bajo el estandarte de los Arathi y construyó la majestuosa capital de Strom a lo largo de estas llanuras áridas y fáciles de defender. Fue aquí donde la humanidad forjó su legendario pacto con los altos elfos durante las Guerras Trol, dominando las artes arcanas para hacer retroceder a los Amani. Con el tiempo, los linajes nobles emigraron al norte hacia Lordaeron y al sur hacia Ventormenta, pero la guardia imperial se quedó atrás para fundar el reino marcial de Stromgarde. Durante eras, Stromgarde se alzó como un bastión de firmes guerreros consagrados a mantener a raya a los trols del bosque.

ang.class:Warrior: Stromgarde produced the most celebrated frontline martial tradition on Azeroth, making its rugged battlegrounds a revered trial by arms.
ang.faction:Horde: Hammerfall stands as sacred ground to the modern Horde—a monument to Orgrim Doomhammer's sacrifice that freed an enslaved people from internment.
ang.profession:Mining: The craggy ridges of Arathi are rich in iron and mithril, and Drywhisker Gorge is the only known source of lesser bloodstone ore.
ang.race:Human: Every human kingdom traces its roots to the Empire of Arathor; seeing the seat of human civilization broken and overrun by ogres and thieves is a profound cultural tragedy.

faq.a: Following King Thoras Trollbane's death, Stromgarde succumbed to internal strife and overwhelming assaults. Boulderfist ogres seized the city's exterior districts while the opportunistic Syndicate seized the sanctum, leaving Prince Galen Trollbane and his dwindling garrison clinging to a single fortified corner while fighting desperate battles inside their own capital.
faq.q: What happened to Stromgarde Keep?

faq.a: Hammerfall is a fortified Horde outpost built within the remnants of a human internment camp where orcs were held after the Second War. It was named to honor former Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer, who fell leading the campaign to liberate the captives held across Lordaeron's camps.
faq.q: What is Hammerfall?

faq.a: Alliance soldiers and Stromgarde defenders stage their operations out of Refuge Pointe, a naturally fortified canyon in the center of the highlands. From here, they launch sorties to reclaim Stromgarde Keep and fight back encroaching ogres and trolls.
faq.q: Where does the Alliance operate in Arathi?

faq.a: The Circles of Binding—Inner, Outer, East, and West—are ancient magical seals maintained and guarded by rogue elementals. They serve to imprison an unknown, primordial entity buried deep beneath the highlands.
faq.q: What are the stone circles across the plains?

faq.a: Travelers from the north and west pass through the breach in Thoradin's Wall from the Hillsbrad Foothills. Travelers arriving from Khaz Modan in the south cross the massive dwarven bridge of the Thandol Span, which spans the chasm separating the highlands from the Wetlands.
al: how to get to arathi highlands
faq.q: How do you reach the Arathi Highlands?

faq.a: The Syndicate consists of exiled Alteraci nobility seeking to carve out new domains by pillaging fallen realms. In Arathi, they have overrun large sections of Stromgarde Keep and outlying farms like Northfold Manor, secretly guided by the dark cultists of the Argus Wake.
faq.q: What is the Syndicate doing in Arathi?

text.s: The Arathi Highlands are a rugged plateau in southeastern Lordaeron, renowned as the ancient birthplace of the Empire of Arathor. Today, the kingdom of Stromgarde lies in ruins, leaving the craggy realm engulfed in multi-front warfare between the remnants of Stromgarde, the Horde, criminal Syndicate nobles, and invading ogres.

sec.b: Millennia ago, King Thoradin united the fractured human tribes under the banner of the Arathi, constructing the majestic capital of Strom across these dry, defensible plains. It was here that humanity forged its legendary compact with the high elves during the Troll Wars, mastering the arcane arts to push back the Amani. Over time, noble bloodlines migrated north into Lordaeron and south toward Stormwind, but the imperial guard stayed behind to form the martial realm of Stromgarde. For ages, Stromgarde stood as a bastion of stalwart warriors dedicated to keeping the forest trolls at bay.

Stromgarde proved vital in defending the Alliance during the Second War under King Thoras Trollbane, but the Third War and its aftermath shattered the nation. Although the kingdom spared itself the worst ravages of the Scourge plague, the mysterious death of King Thoras threw the realm into turmoil. Boulderfist ogres swept in from the hills, while the traitorous Alteraci nobles of the Syndicate seized sprawling districts of Stromgarde Keep. Today, Prince Galen Trollbane and his loyalist survivors cling to a tiny sliver of the city and their redoubt at Refuge Pointe, waging a bitter guerrilla war against hopeless odds.
