Antes del Gran Cataclismo, Marjal Revolcafango era una meseta herbosa repleta de manadas de animales. El cataclismo destrozó el valle, haciendo que el nivel freático subiera y ahogara la tierra en interminables charcas estancadas, bajíos cubiertos de musgo y lodo asfixiante. Los manantiales subterráneos garantizan que la ciénaga permanezca perpetuamente húmeda y sumergida, cubierta por una densa niebla e infestada de crocoliscos, raptores y arañas. Los bajíos escarpados y las ciénagas movedizas hacen que viajar sea peligroso para cualquier aventurero que se aleje de las calzadas en ruinas.

ang.class:Mage: Mages are drawn across the fens to Tabetha's Farm in the Quagmire, seeking out the recluse's unique expertise regarding arcane conduits and ancient power sources.
ang.faction:Alliance: Dustwallow Marsh hosts Theramore Isle, the heart of the Alliance's presence on Kalimdor. Adventurers arriving via Menethil Harbor guard its causeways while untangling a web of deserters and missing envoys.
ang.faction:Horde: Horde emissaries come to support the beleaguered Stonemaul ogres at Brackenwall Village, repelling dragon incursions from the Wyrmbog and keeping a wary eye on human movements from the coast.

faq.a: The Alliance's presence is centered at Theramore Isle, a fortified city-state situated on a rocky island off the eastern coast. Founded by Lady Jaina Proudmoore following the Third War, it connects to Kalimdor by a narrow roadway and maintains vital ship routes to Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: What is the main Alliance settlement here?

faq.a: Horde travelers make camp at Brackenwall Village in the northwestern reaches of the marsh. The settlement was founded by the Stonemaul clan of ogres, who joined the Horde under Rexxar and opened their gates to orcish and tauren allies.
faq.q: Where can Horde adventurers find refuge in the swamp?

faq.a: The southern region, known as the Wyrmbog and Dragonmurk, is the brood grounds and domain of Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing. Her black dragonspawn violently drove out the Stonemaul ogres and turned the rocky outcroppings and deep caves into nests for whelps and drakes.
faq.q: Why are there so many black dragons in the southern marsh?

faq.a: The Stonemaul ogres originally dwelt peacefully in Stonemaul Village in the southern marsh. However, the black dragonflight launched a devastating assault, slaughtering many and forcing the survivors to flee northwest to Brackenwall Village.
faq.q: What happened to the Stonemaul ogres' original home?

faq.a: The cottage belongs to Tabetha, an eccentric and powerful hermit mage living quietly in the depths of the marsh. Arcane practitioners often seek her out for instruction or assistance with cleansing volatile magical relics.
al: who is the witch in the swamp
faq.q: Who lives in the lonely cottage out in the Quagmire?

faq.a: Alcaz Island is a heavily guarded isle off the northeast coast of the marsh, held by the Strashaz naga and patrolled by dangerous elite defenders, with hydras lurking in the surrounding waters.
faq.q: What is Alcaz Island and who controls it?

text.s: Dustwallow Marsh is a vast, sweltering swampland in central Kalimdor, trapped between the arid plains of the Barrens and the Great Sea. Fed by perpetual subterranean springs, its treacherous fens harbor dangerous predators, covert faction skirmishes, and the lurking presence of the black dragonflight. It serves as home to the Alliance fortress-island of Theramore in the east and the Horde-allied Stonemaul ogres of Brackenwall Village to the northwest.

sec.b: Before the Great Sundering, Dustwallow was a high, grassy plain teeming with herd animals. The cataclysm shattered the valley, causing the water table to rise and drown the earth in endless stagnant pools, mossy shallows, and choking mud. Underground springs ensure the marsh remains perpetually humid and submerged, blanketed in thick fog and infested with crocolisks, raptors, and spiders. Jagged shallows and wandering bogs make travel perilous for any adventurer stepping off the crumbling causeways.

Dustwallow was largely wild until the aftermath of the Third War, when Lady Jaina Proudmoore led human refugees across the sea to establish the citadel of Theramore Isle on its eastern coast. Soon after, Kul Tiran forces under Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore waged war against Thrall's fledgling Horde, culminating in bloody battles across the wetlands and the Admiral's defeat. Today, an official armistice exists between Theramore and Orgrimmar, yet tension smolders beneath the surface. Theramore struggles with desertions and sabotage, while spies wage quiet, deadly conflicts across the fens.

The south of the marsh rises into a jagged, rocky quagmire known as the Dragonmurk and the Wyrmbog. Originally settled by the Stonemaul ogres under the Mok'Nathal champion Rexxar, the area became a graveyard when the black dragonflight violently drove the clan from Stonemaul Village. The displaced ogres fled north to Brackenwall Village under Overlord Mok'Morokk, swearing vengeance. Within these jagged crags lurks Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, directing her brood and weaving sinister machinations far beyond the swamp.

zone:easternplaguelands.n: Tierras de la Peste del Este
zone:easternplaguelands.s: Tierras de la Peste del Este. Las Tierras de la Peste del Este representan el corazón devastado del caído Reino de Lordaeron, asfixiado bajo la corrupción de la Plaga, nieblas tóxicas y crecimientos fúngicos corrompidos. Stratholme se alza en el norte como la base del poder no-muerto en la región, mientras que la fanática Cruzada Escarlata se atrinchera en el este. En medio de la pesadilla, la Capilla de la Esperanza de la Luz se erige como un santuario neutral y resuelto para cualquiera con el valor de luchar. Antaño conocida como la fértil Eastweald, esta región era la columna vertebral agrícola del norte de Lordaeron, articulada en torno a la gran metrópolis de Stratholme y prósperas poblaciones como Villa Darrow y el Cruce de Corin. Durante la Tercera Guerra, el príncipe Arthas purgó Stratholme tras descubrir que su suministro de grano había sido contaminado con la Plaga de la No-Muerte. Tras el colapso del reino, la magia oscura de la Plaga campó a sus anchas. La tierra se volvió parda y pútrida, la flora ordinaria mutó en hongos colosales y una inquietante niebla naranja se asentó por los valles.

ang.class:Paladin: The fallen realm of Lordaeron holds profound tragedy for the Silver Hand, from the site of Arthas's dark turning in Stratholme to the valiant last stand at Light's Hope Chapel.
ang.faction:Alliance: For the Alliance, venturing into the Plaguelands is a solemn pilgrimage to reclaim and honor the devastated remnants of their former northern allies.
ang.profession:Herbalism: This blighted region is one of the exceptionally rare places to gather volatile, high-tier herbs like Arthas' Tears, Plaguebloom, and Black Lotus.
ang.profession:Mining: Veins of Truesilver, Mithril, and Rich Thorium are embedded across the corrupted hillsides and dangerous Scourge-infested valleys.
ang.race:Undead: The Eastern Plaguelands represent both the birthplace of the Scourge menace and a vital frontline where the Forsaken strike back against their former masters and the Scarlet zealots.

faq.a: The landscape suffers from the concentrated effects of the Cult of the Damned's Plague of Undeath. Left unchecked after the Third War, the foul necromantic magic blighted the earth, mutated local wildlife, choked the atmosphere in an unnatural orange smog, and transformed natural forests into grotesque fungal groves like the Plaguewood.
faq.q: What caused the sky and trees to look so sick?

faq.a: Light's Hope Chapel, located along the eastern edge of the zone, is the main sanctuary. Maintained by the Argent Dawn, it provides flight paths connecting to Undercity, Ironforge, Chillwind Camp, and the Hinterlands, welcoming both Alliance and Horde travelers.
faq.q: Where can I find a safe haven or flight path here?

faq.a: Stratholme is divided by ongoing warfare. The majority of the burning ruins are ruled by the Scourge under Baron Rivendare, serving Kel'Thuzad. However, the Scarlet Crusade maintains an aggressive garrison within the western district, waging a relentless and bloody siege against the undead forces.
faq.q: Who controls the city of Stratholme?

faq.a: Following the fall of Lordaeron and the fracturing of the Silver Hand, the Scarlet Crusade succumbed to rampant zealotry and paranoia. Convinced that all outsiders harbor the taint of the plague or consort with the undead, they attack any non-members who approach their strongholds, such as Tyr's Hand.
al: why does scarlet crusade attack me
faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile to outside adventurers?

faq.a: During the Third War, Scourge forces led by the death knight Marduk the Black and the ghoul Horgus the Ravager assaulted the town. Although paladin Davil Crokford and Captain Joseph Redpath fought valiantly, Redpath's soul was corrupted by necromancy, turning him into an instrument of slaughter against his own people. The town now lies in haunted ruins.
faq.q: What happened to the town of Darrowshire?

faq.a: Scattered across the zone are four ruined Lordaeron watchtowers: Crown Guard, Eastwall, Northpass, and Plaguewood. Both factions contend for their control to claim strategic defensive outposts and area-wide tactical boons that aid their forces against the surrounding undead.
faq.q: Why are Alliance and Horde fighting over the ruined towers?

text.s: The Eastern Plaguelands represent the devastated heart of the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, suffocated under Scourge blight, toxic mists, and corrupted fungal growths. Stratholme looms in the north as the undead power base in the region, while the zealous Scarlet Crusade entrenches in the east. Amid the nightmare, Light's Hope Chapel stands as a resolute, neutral sanctuary for anyone brave enough to fight back.

sec.b: Once known as the fertile Eastweald, this region was the agricultural spine of northern Lordaeron, anchored by the great metropolis of Stratholme and prosperous towns like Darrowshire and Corin's Crossing. During the Third War, Prince Arthas purged Stratholme after discovering its grain supply had been laced with the Plague of Undeath. Following the kingdom's collapse, the Scourge's dark magic ran unchecked. The soil turned brown and rotten, ordinary flora warped into colossal mushrooms, and an eerie orange mist settled across the valleys.

Stratholme serves as the southern seat of Scourge authority in Lordaeron, commanded by Baron Rivendare under the direction of the lich Kel'Thuzad. Defying the undead from the southeast is the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, which has fortified the town of Tyr's Hand and assaults Stratholme's scarlet bastions. Their dogmatic hatred extends beyond the dead to any living traveler who crosses their borders. To the north, the Mossflayer forest trolls of Zul'Mashar wage their own isolated, desperate campaigns, caught in the crossfire of the greater conflict.

Survival in the Eastern Plaguelands requires careful footing. The neutral Argent Dawn operates out of Light's Hope Chapel in the far east, offering a safe haven, essential supplies, and flight routes to both Alliance and Horde champions. Beyond the chapel, the two factions actively clash over four strategic ruined towers—Crown Guard, Eastwall, Northpass, and Plaguewood—wrestling for area-wide tactical dominance to bolster their fighters against the undead horrors.

faq.a: Las fuerzas armadas de Ventormenta apenas dan abasto. El reino amplió cuantiosos despliegues militares hacia el sur, en la Vega de Tuercespina, contrayendo profundas deudas y mermando la mano de obra local. Como resultado, puestos avanzados como el Cuartel Arroyoeste y Villadorada dependen de guarniciones muy reducidas y reclutas voluntarios para repeler a bandidos, gnolls y múrlocs.

Ante la escasez de guardias, kóbolds oportunistas irrumpieron en la Mina Abisal, la Cantera de Jaspe y la Mina del Eco en busca de oro y minerales preciosos. Expulsaron a los prospectores y mineros humanos, defendiendo con agresividad sus concesiones subterráneas con velas, picos rudimentarios y herramientas improvisadas.

Son miembros de la Hermandad Defias, liderados por Edwin VanCleef. En su origen, muchos eran artesanos de la Hermandad de los Albañiles que reconstruyeron Ciudad de Ventormenta tras la Primera Guerra. Cuando la nobleza se negó a pagarles los salarios prometidos, estallaron revueltas que llevaron a su destierro y a su caída en el bandidaje organizado.

Al cruzar el puente sobre el río Nazferiti se entra en el Bosque del Ocaso, conocido históricamente como Brightwood. Ese territorio, antaño pacífico, ha caído en una oscuridad antinatural y ahora está infestado de no-muertos, arañas monstruosas y bestias voraces.

Los Pedregosa y los Maclure son familias campesinas vecinas del sur de Elwynn que mantienen un rencor encarnizado y de larga data entre sí. A pesar de sus incesantes riñas y acusaciones, dos de sus parientes más jóvenes, Maybell Maclure y Tommy Joe Pedregosa, se han enamorado en secreto, complicando la rivalidad aún más.

La Torre de Azora es una aguja arcana situada junto al camino entre Villadorada y el Aserradero de la Vega del Este. Alberga a magos solitarios, entre ellos Theocritus, que observan las líneas ley de la región y llevan a cabo investigaciones mágicas al margen de la supervisión directa del Sagrario del Mago de Ventormenta.

zone:elwynn.s: Bosque de Elwynn. El Bosque de Elwynn es el corazón verde del Reino de Ventormenta, y abastece a la capital de madera, oro, pescado y cosechas esenciales. Al abrigo de majestuosos árboles de madera dura, sirve como campo de pruebas para los nuevos reclutas humanos que parten de la Abadía de Villanorte. Sin embargo, bajo su idílica cubierta de ramas, los bosques se encuentran seriamente asediados por alimañas invasoras, fauna desplazada y un bandidaje generalizado. Extendiéndose hacia el sur desde las puertas de Ventormenta hasta el río Nazferiti, Elwynn es una región fértil bendecida con abundantes lluvias y densos bosques de madera dura. Comunidades como Villadorada y el Aserradero de la Vega del Este proporcionan grano, ganado, madera y cobre en bruto cruciales para sostener la gran capital. La región también es famosa por la cría de robustos caballos de Evendale, predilectos de viajeros y caballeros de todo el reino.

ang.class:Rogue: The pervasive shadow of the Defias Brotherhood makes Elwynn an intriguing crossroads of thievery, smuggled goods, and underground rebel signals.
ang.faction:Alliance: Protecting Elwynn is vital to the survival of the Alliance's primary human kingdom; if the lumber, ore, and grain routes collapse, Stormwind City cannot sustain itself.
ang.profession:Mining: Echo Ridge, Fargodeep, and Jasperlode are laden with copper veins, making the forest an essential early proving ground for miners despite the kobold infestations.
ang.race:Human: This is the ancestral heart of the kingdom. Human adventurers begin here, training at Northshire Abbey before venturing out to defend their homeland from bandits, beasts, and political ruin.

faq.a: Stormwind's armed forces are severely overstretched. The kingdom expanded heavy military deployments southward into Stranglethorn Vale, running up deep debts and draining local manpower. As a result, outposts like Westbrook Garrison and Goldshire rely on small skeleton crews and volunteer recruits to fight off bandits, gnolls, and murlocs.
faq.q: Why is the Stormwind Guard barely policing the forest?

faq.a: With guards in short supply, opportunistic kobolds swarmed into Fargodeep Mine, Jasperlode Mine, and Echo Ridge Mine in search of precious gold and minerals. They drove out the human prospectors and miners, aggressively defending their subterranean claims with candles, crude picks, and scavenged tools.
al: why are kobolds in the mines
faq.q: Why are there kobolds inside all the mines?

faq.a: They are members of the Defias Brotherhood, led by Edwin VanCleef. Many were originally artisans of the Stonemasons Guild who rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War. When the nobility refused to pay them their promised wages, riots broke out, leading to their banishment and descent into organized brigandage.
al: who are the defias in elwynn
faq.q: Who are the bandits wearing red masks?

faq.a: Crossing the bridge over the Nazferiti River takes you into Duskwood, historically known as Brightwood. That once-peaceful territory has fallen into unnatural darkness and is now infested with undead, monstrous spiders, and ravenous beasts.
faq.q: Where does the road south lead?

faq.a: The Stonefields and the Maclures are neighboring farming families in southern Elwynn who have maintained a bitter, longstanding grudge against each other. Despite their endless bickering and accusations, two of their younger kin—Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield—have secretly fallen in love, complicating the rivalry even further.
faq.q: What is the feud between the Maclures and Stonefields?

faq.a: The Tower of Azora is an arcane spire located along the road between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp. It houses secluded mages, including Theocritus, who observe the region's leylines and conduct magical research outside the direct oversight of Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum.
al: tower on the road to eastvale
who lives in the tower of azora
faq.q: What is the Tower of Azora?

text.s: Elwynn Forest is the verdant heartland of the Kingdom of Stormwind, providing the capital with essential timber, gold, fish, and crops. Sheltered beneath stately hardwoods, it serves as the proving ground for new human recruits stepping forth from Northshire Abbey. Yet beneath its idyllic pastoral canopy, the woods are sorely beleaguered by encroaching vermin, displaced wildlife, and widespread brigandage.

sec.b: Stretching south from the gates of Stormwind down to the Nazferiti River, Elwynn is a fertile region blessed with abundant rainfall and dense hardwood forests. Communities like Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp provide crucial grain, livestock, lumber, and raw copper to sustain the grand capital. The region is also celebrated for breeding sturdy Evendale horses, favored by travelers and knights across the kingdom.

Despite its outward serenity, the woods are on the brink of disorder. The Stormwind Army is stretched thin by distant obligations, leaving local marshals and deputies reliant on untested recruits. Kobolds have overrun the vital Fargodeep and Jasperlode mines, Riverpaw gnolls prowl the southwestern borders, and savage murlocs have claimed the shores of Stone Cairn Lake and Crystal Lake. In the wake of rising corruption across the river in Duskwood, wolves have fled north across the border.

Far more organized than mere scavengers, the Defias Brotherhood has deeply infiltrated the forest. Originating from Edwin VanCleef's disenfranchised Stonemasons Guild following bitter pay disputes with the House of Nobles, these masked outlaws have seized holdings across Elwynn, including the Northshire Vineyards, the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Jerod's Landing, and Mirror Lake Orchard. Rumors persist that their coordinated agents are subtly orchestrating the neighboring gnolls and kobolds to further destabilize the realm. Guards Rolf and Malakai, sent to investigate murlocs near Stone Cairn Lake, were killed and left along its banks.

zone:felwood.s: Frondavil. Frondavil es un bosque asolado situado entre Vallefresno y el Monte Hyjal, profundamente envenenado por magia demoníaca durante la Tercera Guerra. Antaño un exuberante paraíso de praderas y arboledas cuidadas por los elfos de la noche, ahora está infestado de sátiros demoníacos, bestias babeantes y ancestros retorcidos. Los druidas del Círculo Cenarion, junto con avanzadas de la Alianza y la Horda, trabajan desesperadamente para purificar la tierra y purgar al Consejo de la Sombra de sus profundidades. Antes de la Tercera Guerra, este valle era un remanso de paz con aves cantarinas, arroyos transparentes y arboledas tranquilas custodiadas por antiguos protectores. Todo terminó cuando el señor del terror Tichondrius y la Legión Ardiente desplegaron la Calavera de Gul'dan para envenenar el norte de Kalimdor antes de su asalto al Monte Hyjal. Las viles hechicerías de la calavera convirtieron el suelo del bosque en una ciénaga ennegrecida. Aunque Illidan Tempestira acabó matando a Tichondrius y consumió la esencia del artefacto, la tierra permaneció sumida en la corrupción vil. Poderosos antárboles y ancestros se pudrieron desde dentro, los ríos se convirtieron en bilis hirviente y las bestias del bosque cayeron en una locura caníbal.

ang.class:Druid: Felwood is a profound tragedy for the Cenarion Circle, where druids dedicate their lives to cleansing blighted plants and calming maddened nature spirits.
ang.class:Warlock: The dark tunnels of Jaedenar and the lingering demonic forces make Felwood a focal point for hunting rival cultists of the Shadow Council.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The fel-soaked earth yields rare and volatile flora, serving as one of the few places in Azeroth to gather Gromsblood and Arthas' Tears.
ang.race:NightElf: The desecration of these ancient woods is a source of immense grief and shame for the kaldorei, who failed to protect them from the Legion's touch.

faq.a: During the Third War, the dreadlord Tichondrius used the demonic artifact known as the Skull of Gul'dan to corrupt the forest. This was intended to weaken the night elves' defenses during the Burning Legion's march toward Mount Hyjal, blighting the wildlife, water, and ancients.
faq.q: Why is Felwood corrupted?

faq.a: Yes. Druids of the Cenarion Circle provide adventurers with salves brewed from collected fel taints and mineral residues. Applying these salves to plants like songflowers, whiplash tubers, and night dragons purges their corruption and yields potent restorative fruit and blessings.
faq.q: Can the corrupted plants in the forest be cleansed?

faq.a: Jaedenar is held by the Shadow Council, a clandestine sect of mortal warlocks and demon worshippers. From deep within the subterranean caverns of Shadow Hold, the dreadlord Lord Banehollow oversees their dark rituals and commands the satyrs inhabiting the region.
faq.q: Who controls Jaedenar?

faq.a: Most are hostile. Tribes such as the Deadwood have completely succumbed to demonic corruption and fel madness. However, the Timbermaw tribe holding the northern tunnel network remains uncorrupted, though they are deeply distrustful of outsiders until proven friendly.
faq.q: Are the furbolgs in Felwood hostile?

faq.a: The road leads north directly into Timbermaw Hold, a fortified cavern complex. The uncorrupted Timbermaw furbolgs control the tunnels connecting Felwood to Moonglade and Winterspring. Travelers must either earn their trust or fight their way through.
faq.q: How do you get to Moonglade or Winterspring through Felwood?

faq.a: The once-noble ancients and treants were warped and poisoned by demonic magic. Bound in eternal agony, their shattered minds harbor deep resentment toward the night elves, whom they perceive as having abandoned them to the Burning Legion.
faq.q: Why do the corrupted ancients attack night elves?

text.s: Felwood is a blighted forest nestled between Ashenvale and Mount Hyjal, deeply poisoned by demonic magic during the Third War. Once a lush paradise of meadows and groves tended by the night elves, it now crawls with demonic satyrs, slavering beasts, and twisted ancients. Cenarion Circle druids, alongside outposts of the Alliance and Horde, desperately work to cleanse the land and purge the Shadow Council from its depths.

sec.b: Before the Third War, this valley was a peaceful haven of singing birds, clear streams, and tranquil groves guarded by ancient protectors. That ended when the dreadlord Tichondrius and the Burning Legion deployed the Skull of Gul'dan to poison northern Kalimdor ahead of their assault on Mount Hyjal. The skull's vile sorceries twisted the forest floor into a blackened mire. Though Illidan Stormrage eventually slew Tichondrius and consumed the artifact's essence, the land remained steeped in fel corruption. Mighty treants and ancients rotted from within, rivers turned to boiling bile, and the forest's beasts were driven into cannibalistic madness.

Healing Felwood has proven agonizingly slow. At the Emerald Sanctuary along the southern border, the Cenarion Circle wages an uphill battle against the blighted corruption. Druids equip wanderers with Cenarion beacons and cleansing salves, laboring to heal poisoned plants like songflowers and night dragon bulbs. Both factions maintain footholds in the tainted wilds—the night elves at Talonbranch Glade in the north and the Horde at Bloodvenom Post. These outposts serve as fragile bulwarks amid a deadly wilderness where nature has turned against all mortal flesh.

The lingering fel taint is actively nurtured by dark cultists. Within the subterranean labyrinth of Jaedenar and Shadow Hold, remnants of the Shadow Council conduct foul rituals under the direction of Lord Banehollow. Allied with deceitful satyrs who desecrate ancient moonwells, these warlocks harvest the forest's agony and summon forth demonic reinforcements. Any lasting hope of redeeming Felwood requires tearing this insidious council out by its roots.

zone:feralas.s: Feralas. Feralas es una vasta selva tropical envuelta en niebla situada entre Desolace, Las Mil Agujas y el Mar Adusto. Protegida por imponentes murallas montañosas, preserva un ecosistema ancestral salpicado de ruinas kaldorei cubiertas de vegetación y bestias primigenias. En la actualidad, esta naturaleza virgen es territorio en disputa, atrapada entre antiguos vestigios de los Altonato, los invasores ogros Gordunni y los puestos de avanzada rivales establecidos por la Alianza y la Horda. Mientras que las vecinas Desolace y Las Mil Agujas se han secado hasta convertirse en yermos áridos y cañones desecados, Feralas permanece intensamente verde. Las cordilleras montañosas aíslan el dosel arbóreo, manteniendo un microclima cálido de densas nieblas, árboles milenarios y cascadas imponentes. Antes del Gran Cataclismo, gran parte de Kalimdor lucía así. Con el paso de los milenios, la densa jungla devoró los monumentos de la civilización kaldorei que una vez dominó aquí, ocultando templos y pabellones olvidados bajo el musgo asfixiante y espesos helechos.

ang.class:Druid: The Dream Bough and its connection to the Emerald Dream make Feralas sacred ground, demanding vigilance against encroaching corruption and defilers.
ang.faction:Alliance: Operations are anchored out of Feathermoon Stronghold under Shandris Feathermoon, tasking operatives with policing coastal naga and defending elven legacy.
ang.faction:Horde: Camp Mojache serves as a vital frontier bastion, requiring reliable warriors to push back aggressive Gordunni incursions, rogue Grimtotem, and Woodpaw gnolls.
ang.profession:Herbalism: The damp, shaded floor of the canopy yields prized temperate and tropical flora, including Sungrass, Purple Lotus, and Khadgar's Whisker.
ang.race:NightElf: Feralas holds profound cultural weight as a cradle of ancient Kaldorei civilization, yet the sight of sacred ruins like Eldre'Thalas defiled by ogres stirs deep sorrow and anger.

faq.a: Dire Maul is the present-day name for Eldre'Thalas, a glorious elven city that survived the Sundering. Over the millennia, it fell into decline and was overrun by the brutal Gordunni clan. The complex is now partitioned into contested wings harboring ogres, treacherous spirits, and ancient Highborne secrets.
faq.q: What is Dire Maul?

faq.a: Alliance explorers coming from Desolace can pass south through the Twin Colossals, though the beasts there are perilous. Alternatively, travelers can slip into the ocean along the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace and swim south along the Forgotten Coast directly to Sardor Isle, entirely bypassing the dangerous overland road and Camp Mojache.
al: how to get to feralas alliance
faq.q: How do Alliance travelers safely reach Feathermoon Stronghold?

faq.a: The Gordunni ogres are violently expanding out of Dire Maul, raiding supply caravans and attacking travelers across the jungle. Their destructive war parties actively threaten Camp Mojache, prompting Horde leaders like Belgrom Rockmaul to call for swift, aggressive strikes against the clan's outposts.
faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Gordunni ogres so aggressively?

faq.a: The Dream Bough is one of the four Great Trees of Azeroth, housing a mystical natural portal that connects physical reality to the Emerald Dream. Like its counterparts in Ashenvale, Duskwood, and the Hinterlands, it is watched by the green dragonflight and ancient guardians.
faq.q: What is the Dream Bough?

faq.a: A renegade sect of Grimtotem tauren maintains a compound in the wilderness, operating outside the authority of Thunder Bluff. Their presence is hostile toward both the Alliance and the Horde; they have trapped local faerie dragons and are actively targeted by Horde scouts.
faq.q: Why are Grimtotem tauren present in Feralas?

faq.a: Yes. South of the main road lies The Writhing Deep, a swarming subterranean hive of silithid insectoids. Their emergence in the lush rainforest is an unsettling sign that the hive mind is expanding far beyond the desert borders of southern Kalimdor.
faq.q: Are there Silithid in Feralas?

text.s: Feralas is a vast, mist-shrouded rainforest nestled between Desolace, Thousand Needles, and the Veiled Sea. Sheltered by soaring mountain walls, it preserves an ancient ecosystem dotted with overgrown Kaldorei ruins and primordial beasts. Today, the wilderness is contested territory, caught between ancient Highborne remnants, invasive Gordunni ogres, and rival outposts established by the Alliance and the Horde.

sec.b: While neighboring Desolace and Thousand Needles have dried into barren badlands and desiccated canyons, Feralas remains intensely verdant. Mountain ranges seal off the canopy, sustaining a warm microclimate of deep mists, ancient trees, and towering waterfalls. Before the Great Sundering, much of Kalimdor looked like this. Over millennia, the deep jungle swallowed the monuments of the Kaldorei civilization that once ruled here, hiding forgotten temples and pavilions beneath strangling moss and thick fern brush.
sec.t: A Forest Untouched by the Wastes

sec.b: Dominating central Feralas is the ruined metropolis of Eldre'Thalas, now called Dire Maul. Built at the peak of the Kaldorei empire, its vast stone courtyards have fallen into ruin, desecrated by the savage Gordunni ogre clan. These ogres spread across the valley, pillaging sacred sites, defiling pristine groves, and driving indigenous wildlife into territorial frenzy. Deep within Dire Maul's sealed chambers, whispers persist of Highborne remnants and trapped powers dating back ten thousand years.

Both the Alliance and the Horde have mounted major expeditions into the jungle, though traversing it remains dangerous. From Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle, General Shandris Feathermoon directs Sentinels against both ogre expansion and encroaching naga. To the east lies Camp Mojache, a central Horde garrison struggling against aggressive Woodpaw gnolls, hostile Grimtotem tauren, and the relentless ogre clans. Neither faction commands true control over the untamable interior.

zone:gnomeregan.s: Gnomeregan. Esculpida en las estribaciones nevadas de Dun Morogh, Gnomeregan fue antaño la capital subterránea y la mayor maravilla tecnológica de la raza gnoma. Hoy yace en ruinas y en cuarentena, envenenada por la lluvia radiactiva tras una desesperada defensa contra una invasión subterránea de troggs. Sus supervivientes viven ahora como refugiados en la cercana Forjaz, mientras las salas irradiadas siguen infestadas de troggs mutados, gnomos parias desquiciados y centinelas mecánicos rebeldes. Mucho antes de su trágica caída, Gnomeregan se erigía como un testimonio de las cumbres del ingenio, la ambición y la industria gnomos. Construido con la ayuda de los cercanos enanos de Forjaz, el extenso complejo mecánico funcionaba gracias a gigantescos motores trituradores, engranajes giratorios y una intrincada red de ventilación que requería a quince técnicos trabajando día y noche solo para mantener el aire fresco. Era un próspero centro de invención, artesanía competitiva y política centrado en la Cámara de los Manitas, y servía como la orgullosa capital desde la que los gnomos aportaron valiosas máquinas de asedio, artefactos voladores y armamento a la Alianza de Lordaeron durante la Segunda Guerra.

ang.faction:Alliance: The gnomes stood shoulder-to-shoulder with the Alliance in the Second War, and liberating their lost capital from Thermaplugg is vital to restoring their strength within the faction.
ang.profession:Engineering: The ruined city remains an unmatched graveyard of advanced masterworks, schematics, and experimental contraptions, offering invaluable blueprints amidst the lethal mechanical chaos.
ang.race:Dwarf: Your kinship with the gnomes traces back to when your ancestors helped lay Gnomeregan's foundations, and your excavations at Uldaman inadvertently unleashed the trogg hordes that caused its ruin.
ang.race:Gnome: Gnomeregan is the heart of your people's deepest tragedy and enduring shame; venturing within is a harrowing pilgrimage to avenge eighty percent of your fallen race and dethrone the traitor Thermaplugg.

faq.a: When troggs invaded from beneath the earth, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque attempted to exterminate them by opening the pressure valves on the city's radioactive waste tanks on the advice of Sicco Thermaplugg. The plan was meant to flood only the lower sectors, but the deadly toxic radiation seeped throughout the entire city, slaughtering eighty percent of the gnomish population and mutating the survivors.
faq.q: Why is Gnomeregan irradiated?

faq.a: The troggs were ancient creatures stirred from deep subterranean slumber by dwarven archaeological excavations at the titan complex of Uldaman. Drawn to the vibrations and heat of Gnomeregan's heavy machinery, they dug extensive tunnel networks directly into the lower levels and engineering quarters of the city.
al: why are there troggs in gnomeregan
faq.q: Where did all the troggs come from?

faq.a: The trogg invasion occurred at the height of the Third War, while the Kingdom of Lordaeron was falling to the Scourge. Believing the survival of the wider Alliance took precedence, High Tinker Mekkatorque chose not to divert human, dwarven, or elven forces away from the northern battlefronts, attempting to handle the invasion internally with gnomish technology and soldiers alone.
faq.q: Why didn't the gnomes ask the Alliance for help against the troggs?

faq.a: Leper gnomes are gnomes who survived the radioactive venting of Gnomeregan but suffered severe physical and mental corruption from prolonged exposure. Their skin has turned a sickly pale green, their bodies are blistered and diseased, and their minds have decayed into raving, homicidal mania under the thrall of Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
al: why are the gnomes green and crazy
faq.q: What are leper gnomes?

faq.a: Sicco Thermaplugg was High Tinker Mekkatorque's closest confidant and chief advisor. Driven mad by jealousy and a lust for power, he intentionally engineered the radioactive purge to ruin Mekkatorque and seize the throne. Irradiated along with the city, he now rules as a deranged leper despot from within Tinkers' Court.
faq.q: Who is Sicco Thermaplugg?

faq.a: Defeating Thermaplugg cuts off the leadership directing the leper gnomes and rogue defenses, securing critical technical data and striking a major blow for gnomish morale. However, it does not immediately cleanse the city. Lethal radiation and thick trogg infestations continue to choke the lower corridors, requiring Mekkatorque to prepare deeper excavations before a full reclamation can occur.
faq.q: What changes after Mekgineer Thermaplugg is defeated?

faq.a: The hostile Dark Iron clan dispatched emissaries into Gnomeregan, represented by the Dark Iron Ambassador. Ever eager to sabotage both Ironforge and the Alliance, the Dark Irons seek an opportunistic alliance with Thermaplugg, hoping to exploit gnomish technology and weaponized machinery for their own war efforts.
al: why are dark irons in gnomeregan
faq.q: Why are the Dark Iron dwarves inside Gnomeregan?

faq.a: Following the radioactive catastrophe, the surviving untainted gnomes fled through the mountains to Ironforge. Their dwarven cousins granted them sanctuary inside Tinkertown, an engineering enclave within the mountain fortress where Gelbin Mekkatorque governs his exiled people while planning their eventual homecoming.
faq.q: Where are the surviving gnomes living now?

text.s: Carved into the snowy foothills of Dun Morogh, Gnomeregan was once the subterranean capital and greatest technological wonder of the gnomish race. Today it lies ruined and quarantined, poisoned by radioactive fallout following a desperate defense against an underground trogg invasion. Its surviving people now dwell as refugees in nearby Ironforge, while the irradiated halls remain overrun by mutated troggs, deranged leper gnomes, and rogue mechanical sentries.

sec.b: Long before its tragic fall, Gnomeregan stood as a testament to the heights of gnomish brilliance, ambition, and industry. Constructed with the assistance of the nearby dwarves of Ironforge, the sprawling mechanical complex was powered by giant grinding engines, whirring gears, and an intricate ventilation network that required fifteen technicians working around the clock just to maintain fresh air. It was a thriving center of invention, competitive craft, and politics centered on Tinkers' Court, serving as the proud capital from which gnomes contributed invaluable siege engines, flying machines, and armaments to the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War.
sec.t: A Marvel of Iron and Steam

sec.b: Around the time the Scourge tore through Lordaeron during the Third War, a subterranean nightmare stirred beneath Dun Morogh. Unwitting dwarven excavations at the ancient titan vault of Uldaman awakened hordes of primitive troggs, which burrowed into the lower foundations of Gnomeregan. Reluctant to abandon the Alliance in its hour of need by asking for help, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his forces fought an agonizing five-year war of attrition against the invaders. When defenses collapsed, Mekkatorque yielded to the counsel of his chief advisor, Mekgineer Sicco Thermaplugg, and authorized venting the city's radioactive waste tanks into the lower levels to eradicate the troggs. Instead, the toxic gas spread uncontrollable catastrophe, wiping out nearly eighty percent of the gnomish population in days.
sec.t: The Trogg Invasion and the Poisoning

sec.b: The disaster was no mechanical accident. Sicco Thermaplugg, consumed by jealousy over Mekkatorque's election as High Tinker, intentionally allowed the invasion to escalate and planned the toxic catastrophe, plotting to sweep in, slay the troggs, and seize leadership of the survivors. Instead, the disaster spun beyond his control. The radiation failed to kill the troggs, driving them into a violent frenzy, while Thermaplugg himself was trapped within the contaminated lower tiers. Twisted by radioactive sickness into an insane leper gnome, Thermaplugg crowned himself the techno-overlord of Gnomeregan, commanding mindless leper survivors and erratic machineries from his throne in Tinkers' Court.

High Tinker Mekkatorque currently coordinates the reclamation of Gnomeregan from Tinkertown in Ironforge, dispatching Alliance adventurers into the toxic depths to break Thermaplugg's rule. Slaying the Mekgineer at the heart of Tinkers' Court dismantles his command over the rogue defenses and leper cohorts, delivering long-sought vengeance for his monumental betrayal. Yet a permanent reconquest remains elusive: the deeper tunnels remain choked with irradiated sludge, mutated beasts, and troggs, leaving Mekkatorque to assemble gyrodrillmatic excavationators and formulate broader military plans to one day reclaim his people's ancestral home.

zone:hallofthanes.s: El Salón de los Feudales. En las profundidades de la bulliciosa ciudad de Forjaz se encuentra el Salón de los Feudales, un antiguo complejo subterráneo impregnado de historia enana. Destinada a los aventureros noveles de la Alianza, esta apartada mazmorra alberga reliquias del pasado del reino de la montaña que se encuentran amenazadas. Lograr acceder requiere desenterrar rutas olvidadas a través de la propia montaña. Mientras Forjaz vibra con el repiqueteo de los martillos en la Gran Fundición, salas olvidadas se adentran mucho más abajo en la piedra. El Salón de los Feudales representa uno de estos venerables confines subterráneos. Ligado durante mucho tiempo a linajes enanos ancestrales y reliquias de cantería, ahora requiere que intrépidos campeones de la Alianza se aventuren en sus sombrías bóvedas para asegurar las profundidades.

ang.faction:Alliance: The stability of Ironforge directly bolsters the Alliance, making the cleansing of these deep caverns vital to securing the High Seat.
ang.race:Dwarf: For dwarves, entering the Hall of Thanes is a journey into the ancestral bedrock of Dun Morogh, purging defilers from sacred halls that bear legendary clan names.
ang.race:Gnome: As close allies living within Ironforge, gnomes share an urgent interest in neutralizing mechanical constructs like Plunder that threaten their shared refuge.

faq.a: The Hall of Thanes is located beneath the dwarven capital of Ironforge. It is tucked away in the mountain's deeper, restricted subterranean sectors rather than the main city thoroughfares.
faq.q: Where is the Hall of Thanes located?

faq.a: Entry requires unlocking the dungeon through an attunement questline. Adventurers must begin by pursuing the quest 'Underground Map' to chart a path into the mountain's lower vaults.
al: how to get into hall of thanes
faq.q: How do I gain access to the Hall of Thanes?

faq.a: The expedition challenges four major threats: Faldrim Anvilmar, the volcanic behemoth Magmatus, an enchanted golem named Plunder, and the final adversary, Durgen Dirgehammer.
faq.q: What bosses are inside the Hall of Thanes?

faq.a: The dungeon is tailored for Alliance adventurers between levels 13 and 18, serving as an early subterranean challenge alongside Ironforge's deep network.
al: what level is hall of thanes
faq.q: What level range is recommended for this dungeon?

faq.a: No. The Hall of Thanes is an Alliance-exclusive dungeon situated directly beneath the Alliance capital of Ironforge.
al: can horde do hall of thanes
is hall of thanes alliance only
faq.q: Can Horde players enter the Hall of Thanes?

faq.a: Overcoming Durgen Dirgehammer breaks the grip of rogue dwarven forces and their summoned constructs deep within Ironforge's foundations. Striking him down restores safety to the ancient ancestral vaults beneath the Great Forge.
faq.q: What does defeating Durgen Dirgehammer achieve?

text.s: Deep beneath the bustling city of Ironforge lies the Hall of Thanes, an ancient subterranean complex steeped in dwarven history. Intended for early Alliance adventurers, this secluded dungeon holds relics of the mountain kingdom's past that have fallen into peril. Gaining entry requires unearthing forgotten routes through the mountain itself.

sec.b: While Ironforge hums with the ringing of hammers in the Great Forge, forgotten halls delve far deeper beneath the stone. The Hall of Thanes represents one of these venerable subterranean reaches. Long tied to ancestral dwarven bloodlines and relics of stonecraft, it now requires intrepid Alliance champions to venture into its shadowed vaults to secure the depths.

Accessing the Hall of Thanes is no casual feat. The corridors leading to these ancient vaults have been sealed away or hidden from everyday travelers in Ironforge. Adventurers must decipher forgotten charting, beginning with recovering an Underground Map, before they can navigate the deeper tunnels and breach the threshold of the dungeon.

Within the heart of the complex lies a formidable assembly of threats, from enchanted guardians like Plunder and the fiery brute Magmatus to rogue figures of ancient dwarven lineage such as Faldrim Anvilmar. Presiding over the inner sanctuary is Durgen Dirgehammer, whose defeat finally quells the growing unrest simmering beneath the city floor and secures the sacred dwarven halls from subversion.

zone:hillsbrad.s: Laderas de Trabalomas. Laderas de Trabalomas es una región verde y fértil que representa el último bastión pastoral del reino caído de Lordaeron. A pesar de haber escapado en gran medida a la peste de la Plaga, la tierra está desgarrada por una brutal guerra abierta entre los humanos de Costasur y los Renegados atrincherados en Molino Tarren. Sirve como una violenta encrucijada donde los ejércitos de la Alianza y la Horda chocan sin piedad. Mientras el norte de Lordaeron se pudre bajo la peste de la Plaga, Trabalomas permanece sorprendentemente verde. Sus onduladas praderas, pinares y granjas en activo ofrecen a los viajeros un insólito atisbo de cómo lucía el reino antes de la Tercera Guerra. Sin embargo, esa apariencia tranquila es engañosa. Los pacíficos campos y caminos rurales son recorridos constantemente por patrullas armadas, mercenarios renegados y bestias carroñeras. Lo que debería ser el granero de Lordaeron se ha convertido en su frontera más disputada.

ang.class:Rogue: Hidden high in the mountains above the foothills lies Ravenholdt Manor, the secretive gathering place and training ground for Azeroth's most elite guild of thieves and assassins.
ang.race:Dwarf: The soldiers of Dun Garok represent Ironforge's resolute military commitment to defending their human allies and containing the undead threat north of the Wetlands.
ang.race:Human: Southshore is one of your people's final refuges in Lordaeron; walking these pastures is a painful reminder of the great kingdom that was lost to betrayal and undeath.
ang.race:Orc: This soil holds monumental weight for your people: the ruined ramparts of Durnholde Keep are where Warchief Thrall broke his chains and reawakened the spirit of the Horde.
ang.race:Undead: Tarren Mill anchors the southern frontier of the Forsaken realm, where Apothecary Lydon works tirelessly to develop the New Plague to secure your people's future.

faq.a: The Scourge marched primarily along the central corridors toward the capital and the northern kingdoms, leaving Hillsbrad largely bypassed by the plague cauldrons that ruined the north. As a result, the soil remains fertile and the vegetation healthy, making it the most pristine remnant of old Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why isn't Hillsbrad blighted like the rest of Lordaeron?

faq.a: Neither faction holds full control. The Alliance maintains Southshore and nearby farms like the Hillsbrad Fields, while the Forsaken hold Tarren Mill to the north. Dwarven forces hold the fortress of Dun Garok in the east, and the criminal Syndicate occupies the ruins of Durnholde Keep.
faq.q: Who controls Hillsbrad right now?

faq.a: Durnholde was once the headquarters of the Alliance internment camp system after the Second War, governed by Aedelas Blackmoore, who raised Thrall there as a gladiator slave. Thrall escaped, rallied the orcs, and laid waste to the keep. In the aftermath of Lordaeron's fall, the ruins were occupied by the Syndicate.
faq.q: What is Durnholde Keep?

faq.a: Tarren Mill represents the southern frontier of Sylvanas Windrunner's domain, while Southshore is the Alliance's primary staging ground and port into Lordaeron. The Forsaken view Southshore as an existential threat to their southern flank, while the humans view the undead as horrific usurpers who must be driven from their homeland.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken and humans fight so fiercely here?

faq.a: Purgation Isle is an isolated, rugged island off the southern coast of Hillsbrad. Unlike the mainland hills, the island is infested with powerful undead ghouls, skeletons, and vengeful spirits, making it an extremely dangerous offshore haven for dark magic and restless dead.
faq.q: What is Purgation Isle?

faq.a: They belong to the Syndicate, an organized network of former nobility and foot soldiers from the fallen human kingdom of Alterac. Cast out for their kingdom's betrayal during the Second War, they now operate as ruthless bandits seeking to reclaim their lands through blackmail, theft, and slaughter.
faq.q: Who are the bandits occupying the camps and towers?

text.s: Hillsbrad Foothills is a green, fertile region that represents the last pastoral bastion of the fallen kingdom of Lordaeron. Despite having largely escaped the Scourge's plague, the land is torn apart by brutal open war between the humans of Southshore and the Forsaken entrenched at Tarren Mill. It serves as a violent crossroads where the armies of the Alliance and the Horde clash without mercy.

sec.b: While northern Lordaeron rots under the blight of the Scourge, Hillsbrad remains strikingly green. Its rolling pastures, pine groves, and working farmsteads offer travelers a rare glimpse of what the kingdom looked like before the Third War. Yet that tranquil appearance is deceptive. The peaceful fields and rural roads are constantly swept by armed patrols, rogue mercenaries, and scavenger beasts. What should be Lordaeron's breadbasket has instead become its most contested borderland.

The political heart of Hillsbrad is defined by two entrenched strongholds. In the south along the coast lies Southshore, an Alliance haven populated by human refugees and soldiers fiercely loyal to the Alliance. To the north sits Tarren Mill, once a quiet human farming hamlet that was wiped out by the Scourge and later fortified as the Forsaken's southernmost garrison. The open ground between the two settlements is known throughout Azeroth as a relentless kill zone, where Alliance and Horde champions wage perpetual skirmishes for control of the region.
sec.t: The War of Southshore and Tarren Mill

sec.b: Hillsbrad's history of violence runs deep. During the Second War, its coast and hills witnessed the first massive clashes between the Grand Alliance and the Old Horde. Later, the fortress of Durnholde Keep served as the internment camp where Thrall was raised before leading the orcish rebellion. Today, Durnholde lies in ruins, seized by the Syndicate—displaced human nobles turned bandit cutthroats. Coastal murlocs, hostile gnolls, and the shadowed dead on Purgation Isle ensure that no corner of the hills is truly secure.

faq.a: El Rey Magni Barbabronce gobierna Forjaz y el reino de Khaz Modan desde el Trono. Un hábil guerrero y maestro herrero, ha guiado a su pueblo a través de la Segunda y la Tercera Guerra, manteniéndose como un pilar profundamente leal de la Alianza.

Cuando la cercana capital gnómica de Gnomeregan cayó ante una repentina invasión trogg y un desastroso accidente radiactivo, los gnomos supervivientes huyeron hacia Dun Morogh. El Rey Magni les dio la bienvenida en Forjaz, otorgándoles un barrio entero de la ciudad que ahora se conoce como Ciudad Manitas.

La Gran Fundición es el ardiente corazón industrial de la ciudad, alimentado por cascadas subterráneas de magma derretido. Rodea al Gran Yunque, donde los maestros armeros enanos forjan armas y armaduras legendarias. El propio Rey Magni forjó la célebre hoja sagrada Crematoria sobre este yunque.

Forjaz está conectada directamente con la Ciudad de Ventormenta mediante el Tren subterráneo, una extraordinaria vía férrea subterránea construida por la ingeniería gnómica que atraviesa el lecho de roca montañosa de los Reinos del Este.

Forjaz nunca ha caído ante un invasor externo. El clan Foso Sangrante de Kilrogg Mortojo la asedió durante meses durante la Segunda Guerra, y los Hierro Negro combatieron hasta el interior de la ciudad durante la Guerra de los Tres Martillos, pero las puertas y los defensores resistieron.

Tras la Guerra de los Tres Martillos, el derrotado clan Martillo Salvaje se trasladó al norte, hacia Los Humedales y las Tierras del Interior, mientras que el hostil clan Hierro Negro se asentó en las regiones de Crestagrana y Roca Negra bajo el yugo del Señor del Fuego.

zone:ironforge.s: Forjaz. Tallada en el corazón de la montaña de Forjaz, en la nevada Dun Morogh, Forjaz es la capital ancestral de los enanos Barbabronce y un inexpugnable bastión de la Alianza. Con el calor ardiente de la Gran Fundición en su centro, esta extensa ciudad subterránea sirve como un bullicioso núcleo de comercio, industria y antiguos saberes enanos. Bajo el firme mandato del Rey Magni Barbabronce, ahora también cobija a los gnomos desplazados de la cercana Gnomeregan. Forjaz fue fundada hace dos mil quinientos años, cuando la primera generación de enanos despertó en Uldaman y viajó hacia el oeste, hacia los escarpados picos de Dun Morogh. Al excavar en la montaña más alta, erigieron un inmenso santuario dedicado a su progenitor titán Khaz'goroth junto a la colosal Gran Fundición. Desde entonces, la ciudad se ha expandido en anillos concéntricos alrededor de ese ardiente hogar. A diferencia de las capitales de la superficie, Forjaz está enteramente protegida bajo techos de piedra, caldeada por rugientes hornos y ríos subterráneos de magma ardiente. Sus puertas fortificadas y sus cavernosas profundidades han demostrado ser casi inexpugnables a lo largo de siglos de guerra.

ang.faction:Alliance: Connected seamlessly to Stormwind via the Deeprun Tram, Ironforge stands as the Alliance's northern anchor and one of its most reliable military fortresses.
ang.profession:Blacksmithing: The Great Forge is revered across Azeroth as the premier center of metalworking, housing the Great Anvil where master smiths and King Magni himself shape metal into legend.
ang.race:Dwarf: Ironforge is the ancestral home of your kin, standing as a proud testament to your resilience, your mastery of stone, and the sacred lineage tracing back to the titans.
ang.race:Gnome: Since the disaster that consumed Gnomeregan, Tinker Town has served as your temporary home and command center as High Tinker Mekkatorque plots the liberation of your city.

faq.a: King Magni Bronzebeard rules Ironforge and the kingdom of Khaz Modan from the High Seat. A skilled warrior and master blacksmith, he has governed his people through the Second and Third Wars and remains a deeply loyal pillar of the Alliance.
faq.q: Who rules Ironforge?

faq.a: When the nearby gnomish capital of Gnomeregan fell to a sudden trogg invasion and a disastrous radiation accident, the surviving gnomes fled into Dun Morogh. King Magni welcomed them into Ironforge, granting them an entire quarter of the city now known as Tinker Town.
faq.q: Why are there so many gnomes in Ironforge?

faq.a: The Great Forge is the fiery industrial heart of the city, fed by underground waterfalls of molten magma. It surrounds the Great Anvil, where dwarven weaponsmiths craft legendary arms and armor. King Magni himself forged the famed holy blade Ashbringer upon this anvil.
faq.q: What is the Great Forge?

faq.a: Ironforge is connected directly to Stormwind City by the Deeprun Tram, an extraordinary subterranean railway built by gnomish engineering that cuts straight through the mountain bedrock of the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: How do you travel between Ironforge and Stormwind?

faq.a: Ironforge has never fallen to an outside invader. Kilrogg Deadeye's Bleeding Hollow clan laid siege to it for months during the Second War, and the Dark Irons fought into the city during the War of the Three Hammers, but the gates and defenders held.
faq.q: Has Ironforge ever fallen to an enemy army?

faq.a: After the War of the Three Hammers, the defeated Wildhammer clan relocated north into the Wetlands and the Hinterlands, while the hostile Dark Iron clan settled within the Redridge and Blackrock regions under the thrall of the Firelord.
faq.q: Where did the other dwarf clans go?

text.s: Carved into the heart of Ironforge Mountain in snowy Dun Morogh, Ironforge is the ancestral capital of the Bronzebeard dwarves and an unassailable bastion of the Alliance. Centered on the molten heat of the Great Forge, this sprawling underground city serves as a bustling hub of commerce, industry, and ancient dwarven lore. Under the steadfast rule of King Magni Bronzebeard, it now also shelters the displaced gnomes of nearby Gnomeregan.

sec.b: Ironforge was founded twenty-five hundred years ago when the first generation of dwarves awakened in Uldaman and journeyed west into Dun Morogh's jagged peaks. Delving into the tallest mountain, they built a massive shrine to their titan progenitor Khaz'goroth alongside the colossal Great Forge. Ever since, the city has expanded in concentric rings around that fiery hearth. Unlike surface capitals, Ironforge is entirely enclosed beneath stone ceilings, warmed by roaring hearths and subterranean rivers of molten magma. Its fortified gates and cavernous depths have proven near-impregnable throughout centuries of war.
sec.t: A City of Stone and Fire

sec.b: For generations, three dwarven clans coexisted within Ironforge: the Bronzebeards, the Wildhammers, and the Dark Irons. When High King Modimus Anvilmar died in 230 BDP, a bitter civil war erupted for dominion over the mountain. The Bronzebeard clan prevailed and expelled their rivals. Later, Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan led a vengeful Dark Iron siege that penetrated to the heart of Ironforge before being repulsed by Bronzebeard forces. Thaurissan accidentally summoned Ragnaros the Firelord to the south, shattering the Redridge Mountains and dooming his own host. The Bronzebeards have held undisputed control of Ironforge ever since.
sec.t: The War of the Three Hammers

sec.b: During the Second War, the Bleeding Hollow orc clan overran much of Khaz Modan, but Ironforge held firm behind its sealed gates until the Alliance of Lordaeron lifted the siege. Bound by this debt of honor, King Magni Bronzebeard pledged Ironforge's eternal loyalty to the Alliance, standing firm even when kingdoms like Gilneas and Quel'Thalas abandoned it. In the Third War, Magni channeled his grief over the loss of his brother Muradin in Northrend to forge the famed blade Ashbringer at the Great Anvil. Today, Ironforge remains one of the Alliance's fiercest bulwarks.

Following the tragic fall of Gnomeregan to trogg invaders and irradiation, King Magni opened Ironforge's gates to thousands of gnome refugees. Under High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, the exiles established Tinker Town, carving out a buzzing technological haven within the stone city. Coupled with the subterranean Deeprun Tram connecting Ironforge directly to Stormwind City, the dwarven stronghold has transformed into a lively crossroads of dwarven steelcraft and gnomish ingenuity.

zone:lochmodan.s: Loch Modan. Loch Modan es un valle montañoso templado al este de Dun Morogh, famoso por su enorme lago alpino contenido por la monumental Presa de las Tres Cabezas. Centrada alrededor del pueblo enano de Thelsamar, la región lidia con crecientes infestaciones de troggs, kóboldes en las minas y agresivos ogros en las tierras altas del noreste. Situado en el este de Khaz Modan, Loch Modan presenta un marcado y agradable contraste con los campos nevados y helados de Dun Morogh. Cumbres montañosas escarpadas encierran un valle templado de pinos y abedules en cuyo centro se extiende el lago. Esta enorme masa de agua dulce está contenida por la Presa de las Tres Cabezas, un triunfo arquitectónico que se alza imponente a lo largo del borde norte. El apacible asentamiento de Thelsamar actúa como núcleo cívico del territorio, albergando a montaraces itinerantes, cazadores y mineros que aprovechan las productivas vetas de cobre y estaño dispersas por las colinas.

ang.class:Hunter: The Farstrider Lodge along the southeastern ridges offers a renowned gathering place for trackers hunting the valley's bears, crocolisks, and mountain buzzards.
ang.faction:Alliance: Guarding the line between Dun Morogh and the northern routes toward the Wetlands, Loch Modan is a vital bulwark for Ironforge's territorial defense.
ang.profession:Mining: The hills, quarries, and trogg-infested caves of Loch Modan are rich in accessible veins of copper, tin, and silver.
ang.race:Dwarf: Loch Modan represents both the unmatched engineering genius of dwarven masonry and the dangerous ancient history your people repeatedly uncover beneath the stone.

faq.a: The Stonewrought Dam, a massive wonder of dwarven stonework and engineering, holds back the entire Loch. Dwarven engineers maintain it meticulously, as its failure would wash out the lower marshlands of the Wetlands to the north.
al: why does loch modan have a dam
faq.q: What holds the lake back from flooding the Wetlands?

faq.a: Dwarven exploratory expeditions and miners accidentally breached underground chambers deep in the mountains, unleashing hordes of savage troggs that quickly swarmed to the surface and carved out camps in the valleys.
faq.q: Where did all the troggs come from?

faq.a: Thelsamar, nestled on the western bluffs, serves as the main Alliance town and travel hub, featuring the Stoutlager Inn, tradesfolk, and gryphon masters connecting to Ironforge and beyond.
faq.q: What is the primary Alliance settlement in the zone?

faq.a: The stronghold in the northeast mountains is held by brute ogres who descended into the valley, establishing a fortified micro-dungeon outpost that terrorizes nearby hunters and travelers.
faq.q: Who rules Mo'grosh Stronghold?

faq.a: Prospector Ironband's archaeological dig was overrun by troggs spilling out from the subterranean chambers, forcing the excavation team to abandon their progress and fight to secure their remaining supplies.
faq.q: What happened to Ironband's Excavation Site?

faq.a: Yes. Footpaths lead south through the mountains into the arid wasteland of the Badlands, while the Stonewrought Pass through the Valley of Kings leads southwest into the volcanic crags of Searing Gorge.
faq.q: Can you travel from Loch Modan to the Badlands or Searing Gorge?

text.s: Loch Modan is a temperate mountain valley east of Dun Morogh, renowned for its massive alpine lake held in place by the monumental Stonewrought Dam. Centered around the dwarven town of Thelsamar, the region struggles under encroaching trogg infestations, kobolds in the mines, and aggressive ogres in the northeast highlands.

sec.b: Situated in eastern Khaz Modan, Loch Modan presents a stark, pleasant contrast to the frozen snowfields of Dun Morogh. Rugged mountain peaks enclose a temperate valley of pine and birch, cradling the Loch itself. This massive body of fresh water is held in place by the Stonewrought Dam, an architectural triumph that towers along the northern rim. The peaceful settlement of Thelsamar serves as the civic heart of the territory, housing traveling mountaineers, hunters, and miners who ply the productive veins of copper and tin scattered throughout the hills.

Loch Modan's tranquil scenery conceals recurrent violence. Broken catapults and ballistae resting on the lake bed remain from the Second War, when the orcish Horde occupied the valley before the dwarves drove them out. More recently, dwarven archaeological excavations accidentally unearthed subterranean swarms of savage troggs. Led by savage chieftains, trogg tribes have overrun the southern canyons of Stonesplinter Valley and the Valley of Kings, threatening trade routes and forcing the Ironforge Mountaineers to wage a desperate defense.

Troggs and the hulking ogres of Mo'grosh Stronghold are not the only dangers encroaching on the valley. Deeper investigations into local sabotages reveal that the treacherous Dark Iron dwarves are operating in Loch Modan. Having made incursions from the burning passes to the south, Dark Iron infiltrators target dwarven blastpowder reserves and harbor sinister designs against the Stonewrought Dam itself.

zone:moonglade.s: Claro de la Luna. Claro de la Luna es un valle boscoso, antiguo y apartado, situado en las alturas del norte de Kalimdor, venerado como el corazón sagrado del druidismo y hogar del Círculo Cenarion. Al abrigo de un crepúsculo perpetuo e inmune a la corrupción mortal, es un refugio neutral donde practicantes elfos de la noche y tauren estudian la naturaleza codo con codo. Para quienes no son druidas, llegar a este santuario de las tierras altas requiere adentrarse en el peligroso túnel montañoso del Bastión de los Fauces de Madera. Rodeado de escarpadas montañas al norte de Frondavil y Cuna del Invierno, Claro de la Luna se encuentra en una noche serena y eterna bajo el suave resplandor de la luna de Elune. En su centro yace el Lago Elune'ara, una profunda y tranquila masa de agua considerada sagrada desde los albores de la civilización kaldorei. El claro se mantuvo a salvo de la Legión Ardiente tanto durante las antiguas invasiones como en la reciente Tercera Guerra, protegido por el vigilante semidiós Cenarius y su progenie. En la actualidad, bajo la tutela del Guardián Remulos, el valle sirve de reducto pacífico donde se preserva el equilibrio de la naturaleza al margen de los conflictos de facción.

ang.class:Druid: Moonglade is your sacred home and sanctuary. Through your innate spiritual link, you can teleport here from anywhere across Azeroth to consult masters like Dendrite Starblaze, commune with great spirits, and master forms such as the aquatic form.
ang.race:NightElf: For ten millennia, Moonglade was your people's spiritual heartland and the resting place of your sleeping archdruids, sheltered beneath the enduring blessing of Elune.
ang.race:Tauren: Your inclusion in the Cenarion Circle represents a historic revival of an ancient bond with Cenarius, championed by Hamuul Runetotem and respected across Moonglade despite ancient night elf seclusion.

faq.a: Unless brought by ritual magic during seasonal events, travelers on foot must pass through Timbermaw Hold, a tunnel complex bridging upper Felwood, Winterspring, and Moonglade. The Timbermaw furbolgs fiercely guard this passage, requiring outsiders to prove their goodwill before granting safe conduct.
faq.q: How do non-druid travelers reach Moonglade?

faq.a: Moonglade is governed by the Cenarion Circle, an order dedicated entirely to nature rather than politics. The Moonglade Wardens stationed throughout Nighthaven enforce strict neutrality, immediately attacking anyone who initiates violence against those in good standing with the Circle.
al: can horde and alliance fight here
faq.q: Why can Horde and Alliance walk together peacefully here?

faq.a: Nighthaven is the primary settlement in Moonglade, serving as the dwelling place and operational hub for the Cenarion Circle. It houses trainers, caretakers, and sanctuaries where both kaldorei and tauren druids confer on matters concerning the health of Azeroth's wild lands.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Nighthaven?

faq.a: Keeper Remulos, a powerful son of the demigod Cenarius, watches over Moonglade from the Shrine of Remulos. Working alongside senior circle members like Dendrite Starblaze, he tends to the sacred grounds and directs efforts to heal the world.
faq.q: Who rules Moonglade in Malfurion Stormrage's absence?

faq.a: The Barrow Dens are deep underground chambers where druids traditionally entered extended communion with the Emerald Dream. Deep wings of these chambers retain powerful conduits to the Dream, though recent disturbances suggest unsettling nightmares are beginning to stir inside.
faq.q: What rests beneath the Stormrage Barrow Dens?

faq.a: The hippogryph master Silva Fil'naveth and wind rider keeper Bunthen Plainswind offer dedicated transit directly to Rut'theran Village and Thunder Bluff solely for druids, ensuring the order can readily travel between their sacred grove and their racial homelands.
faq.q: Why do druids have special flight paths out of Nighthaven?

text.s: Moonglade is an ancient, secluded forest valley nestled high in northern Kalimdor, revered as the sacred heartland of druidism and the home of the Cenarion Circle. Sheltered beneath perpetual twilight and untouched by mortal corruption, it is a neutral haven where night elf and tauren practitioners study nature side by side. For non-druids, reaching this highland sanctuary requires braving the hazardous mountain tunnel of Timbermaw Hold.

sec.b: Ringed by sheer mountains north of Felwood and Winterspring, Moonglade exists in a state of eternal, serene night under the soft glow of Elune's moon. At its center lies Lake Elune'ara, a deep, tranquil body of water held sacred since the dawn of kaldorei civilization. The glade remained unmarred by the Burning Legion during both ancient invasions and the recent Third War, shielded by the vigilant demigod Cenarius and his offspring. Today, under the stewardship of Keeper Remulos, the valley serves as a peaceful redoubt where nature's balance is preserved free from factional conflict.

Moonglade is the headquarters of the Cenarion Circle, founded millennia ago by Malfurion Stormrage during the War of the Satyr. In the lakeside village of Nighthaven, ancient traditions guide druidic instruction. Following the Third War, the Circle took the historic step of welcoming tauren into their ranks, led by the teachings of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. In Moonglade, political loyalties to the Alliance or Horde are put aside; armed sentries enforce strict neutrality, ensuring that any violence between members meets swift justice.

South of Lake Elune'ara stand the ancient Stormrage Barrow Dens. For thousands of years, elven druids lay slumbering within these subterranean hollows, traversing the spirit realm of the Emerald Dream while their mortal bodies rested under constant vigil. It was here that Tyrande Whisperwind sounded the Horn of Cenarius to awaken Malfurion during the Third War. Even now, the dens remain intimately tied to the Dream, though strange, unsettling ripples have begun emerging from the deep tunnels as dark whispers trouble the Emerald realm.
sec.t: The Barrow Dens and the Dream

faq.a: El Jefe de Guerra Thrall gobierna la ciudad desde su trono en el Fuerte Grommash. Dirige la nueva Horda centrándose en el honor, la supervivencia y el legado chamánico, con el estrecho apoyo del cacique Lanza Negra Vol'jin y el veterano comandante Varok Colmillosauro.

Thrall bautizó la ciudad en honor a Orgrim Martillo Maldito, el legendario antiguo Jefe de Guerra que rompió el dominio del Consejo de la Sombra sobre la Antigua Horda y cedió su armadura de guerra y el Martillo Maldito a Thrall antes de caer en batalla.

Aunque fue fundada por orcos, la ciudad es un refugio para la tribu de Trols de Lanza Negra (que ocupan el Valle de los Espíritus) y acoge a embajadores tauren de visita en el Valle de la Sabiduría. Un contingente de emisarios de los Renegados también ha establecido su presencia tras su reciente ingreso en la Horda.

El Circo de las Sombras es una fisura cavernosa y sombría escondida bajo los riscos del cañón junto a la Calle Mayor. Alberga los gremios de pícaros y brujos de la ciudad, manteniendo sus negocios ilícitos y sus peligrosas invocaciones demoníacas apartados de los distritos civiles.

Directamente bajo el Circo de las Sombras se encuentra Sima Ígnea, una traicionera red de fisuras volcánicas subterráneas infestada de troggs, elementales abrasadores y brujos traicioneros que conspiran para socavar el gobierno de Thrall desde las profundidades.

Los zepelines de ingeniería goblin atracan en lo alto de las torres situadas fuera de la puerta principal, ofreciendo vuelos regulares a través del Mare Magnum hacia los Claros de Tirisfal, cerca de Entrañas, y al sur hacia el Campamento Grom'Gol, en la Vega de Tuercespina.

zone:orgrimmar.s: Orgrimmar. Orgrimmar es la fortaleza capital de los orcos y el corazón palpitante de la nueva Horda de Thrall. Esculpida directamente en los imponentes cañones de roca roja del norte de Durotar, la ciudad fortificada se alza como un monumento a la perseverancia orca y un santuario inquebrantable para trols, tauren y aliados Renegados por igual. Tras la Tercera Guerra, el Jefe de Guerra Thrall guio a los orcos a las áridas costas de Kalimdor para forjar un hogar libre de la corrupción demoníaca y de la servidumbre humana. Tras bautizar la inhóspita región como Durotar en honor a su padre, Thrall fundó Orgrimmar en memoria de su difunto mentor, Orgrim Martillo Maldito. Levantar la ciudad exigió sangre y sudor; con la ayuda de los tauren, los Trols de Lanza Negra, los ingenieros goblins y el Campeón Rexxar, la Horda repelió el asedio de centauros, arpías y feroces lagartos del trueno para asegurar la fortaleza del cañón.

ang.class:Shaman: Thrall has restored shamanism to the core of Horde leadership; practitioners gather within the tranquil Valley of Wisdom to study the elements and commune with ancestral spirits.
ang.class:Warlock: Warlocks find an uneasy refuge here: banished to the secluded Cleft of Shadow, they operate under Thrall's watchful eye while honing their dark arts away from open judgment.
ang.faction:Horde: As the supreme military and cultural seat of the New Horde, Orgrimmar provides all Horde champions with essential weaponmasters, class mentors, trade hubs, and direct audience with Warchief Thrall.
ang.race:Orc: For the orcs, Orgrimmar represents hard-won freedom from demonic lethargy and internment, serving as their proud ancestral fortress on the soil of Durotar.
ang.race:Troll: Having lost the Darkspear Isles, the Darkspear trolls found enduring sanctuary alongside the orcs, claiming the Valley of Spirits as a secure spiritual home.

faq.a: Warchief Thrall rules the city from his seat in Grommash Hold. He leads the New Horde with a focus on honor, survival, and shamanistic heritage, supported closely by Darkspear chieftain Vol'jin and veteran commander Varok Saurfang.
al: who is in charge of orgrimmar
faq.q: Who rules Orgrimmar?

faq.a: Thrall named the city in honor of Orgrim Doomhammer, the legendary former Warchief who broke the shadow council's hold on the Old Horde and passed his warplate and the Doomhammer to Thrall before dying in battle.
faq.q: Why is the city named Orgrimmar?

faq.a: While founded by orcs, the city is a haven for the Darkspear troll tribe—who occupy the Valley of Spirits—and hosts visiting tauren ambassadors in the Valley of Wisdom. An emissary contingent of Forsaken has also established a presence following their recent entry into the Horde.
faq.q: Who lives in Orgrimmar besides orcs?

faq.a: The Cleft of Shadow is a dim, cavernous fissure tucked beneath the canyon bluffs off The Drag. It houses the city's rogue and warlock guilds, keeping their illicit trade and dangerous demonic invocations secluded from the civilian districts.
faq.q: What is the Cleft of Shadow?

faq.a: Directly below the Cleft of Shadow lies Ragefire Chasm, a treacherous network of subterranean volcanic fissures infested with troggs, searing elementals, and treacherous warlocks seeking to undermine Thrall's rule from the depths.
faq.q: What threats exist inside the city?

faq.a: Goblin-engineered zeppelins dock atop towers outside the main gate, providing regular flights across the Great Sea to Tirisfal Glades near Undercity and south to Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: How do you travel to other continents from Orgrimmar?

text.s: Orgrimmar is the fortress capital of the orcs and the beating heart of Thrall's New Horde. Carved directly into the towering red-rock canyons of northern Durotar, the fortified city stands as a monument to orcish perseverance and an unyielding sanctuary for trolls, tauren, and Forsaken allies alike.

sec.b: Following the Third War, Warchief Thrall led the orcs to the arid coasts of Kalimdor to build a homeland free from demonic corruption and human bondage. Naming the harsh region Durotar after his father, Thrall established Orgrimmar in memory of his fallen mentor, Orgrim Doomhammer. Raising the city required blood and sweat; aided by the tauren, the Darkspear trolls, goblin engineers, and the Champion Rexxar, the Horde drove back encroaching centaur, harpies, and ferocious thunder lizards to secure the canyon stronghold.

Orgrimmar is naturally fortified by rugged mountains that shield it from both foreign invaders and the violent razor-winds sweeping through Durotar. The settlement is partitioned into distinct natural hollows. The Valley of Strength serves as the bustling civic gatehouse, leading deeper into the trade bazaar of The Drag. Tauren druids and shaman congregate in the serene pools of the Valley of Wisdom, while Darkspear shadow hunters and witch doctors dwell among the stilted pavilions of the Valley of Spirits.

Beneath the martial pride of the Valley of Honor and the heights of Grommash Hold lies a dimmer reality. In the subterranean cavern known as the Cleft of Shadow, warlocks and rogues practice arts Thrall strictly watches yet grudgingly tolerates. Deeper still plunges Ragefire Chasm, a fiery labyrinth of volcanic tunnels beneath the canyon floor where dark cultists and subterranean beasts fester, threatening the fortress from directly within its own foundations.

zone:ragefire.s: Sima Ígnea. Sima Ígnea es una red de serpenteantes túneles volcánicos situada directamente bajo la capital orca de Orgrimmar. Con entrada a través de las oscuras cavidades del Circo de las Sombras, la sima está infestada de salvajes troggs y una secta demoníaca de fanáticos conocida como la Hoja Abrasadora. De no ser controlados, los oscuros poderes y los enjambres subterráneos que proliferan en las profundidades amenazan los cimientos mismos de la joven nación de la Horda. Bajo el polvo y las rocas rojas de Orgrimmar se oculta un abrasador laberinto de corredores volcánicos y fosas de lava. Mientras los constructores orcos forjaban su nuevo hogar en la superficie, agresivos troggs Furia Ígnea comenzaron a brotar desde las profundidades del subsuelo. Magatha Tótem Siniestro intentó abrir vías diplomáticas con los brutos en nombre de Cima del Trueno, pero su enviado Maur Tótem Siniestro fue masacrado, lo que demostró que los troggs solo cederán ante la fuerza.

ang.class:Warlock: The dark rites and demonic tomes used by Jergosh the Invoker and Bazzalan offer warlock initiates a firsthand look at the dark magic of the Searing Blade.
ang.faction:Horde: Cleansing the chasm under Orgrimmar is an essential trial for young champions to prove their strength and protect the Horde's vulnerable capital.
ang.race:Tauren: Maur Grimtotem's tragic death at the hands of the Ragefire troggs makes hunting the subterranean beasts a matter of honor and retribution for Thunder Bluff.

faq.a: The entrance portal is located inside Orgrimmar within the subterranean district known as the Cleft of Shadow. It sits near the tent of the warlock trainer Neeru Fireblade.
faq.q: Where is the entrance to Ragefire Chasm?

faq.a: The Ragefire troggs tunneled upward from subterranean recesses beneath Durotar. Their sudden presence beneath the capital is regarded as a severe danger that diplomacy failed to quell.
faq.q: Why are troggs under Orgrimmar?

faq.a: The Searing Blade within the chasm is directed by the warlock Jergosh the Invoker and the satyr Bazzalan, both supported by the summoned felguard Taragaman the Hungerer.
faq.q: Who leads the cultists inside the chasm?
